1.msb: This is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham:
1.kjv: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
1.blb: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, son of David, son of Abraham:
1.bbe: The book of the generations of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
1.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus

1.msb: Abraham was the father of Isaac, Isaac the father of Jacob, and Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers.
1.kjv: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;
1.blb: Abraham begat Isaac, and Isaac begat Jacob, and Jacob begat Judah and his brothers.
1.bbe: The son of Abraham was Isaac; and the son of Isaac was Jacob; and the sons of Jacob were Judah and his brothers;

1.msb: Judah was the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar, Perez the father of Hezron, and Hezron the father of Ram.
1.kjv: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
1.blb: And Judah begat Perez and Zerah out of Tamar, and Perez begat Hezron, and Hezron begat Aram.
1.bbe: And the sons of Judah were Perez and Zerah by Tamar; and the son of Perez was Hezron; and the son of Hezron was Ram;

1.msb: Ram was the father of Amminadab, Amminadab the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon the father of Salmon.
1.kjv: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;
1.blb: And Aram begat Amminadab, and Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon.
1.bbe: And the son of Ram was Amminadab; and the son of Amminadab was Nahshon; and the son of Nahshon was Salmon;

1.msb: Salmon was the father of Boaz by Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth, Obed the father of Jesse,
1.kjv: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
1.blb: And Salmon begat Boaz out of Rahab, and Boaz begat Obed out of Ruth, and Obed begat Jesse,
1.bbe: And the son of Salmon by Rahab was Boaz; and the son of Boaz by Ruth was Obed; and the son of Obed was Jesse;

1.msb: and Jesse the father of David the king. Next: David the king was the father of Solomon by Uriah’s wife,
1.kjv: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;
1.blb: and Jesse begat David the king. And: David begat Solomon out of her who was of Uriah,
1.bbe: And the son of Jesse was David the king; and the son of David was Solomon by her who had been the wife of Uriah;

1.msb: Solomon the father of Rehoboam, Rehoboam the father of Abijah, and Abijah the father of Asa.
1.kjv: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;
1.blb: and Solomon begat Rehoboam, and Rehoboam begat Abijah, and Abijah begat Asaph.
1.bbe: And the son of Solomon was Rehoboam; and the son of Rehoboam was Abijah; and the son of Abijah was Asa;

1.msb: Asa was the father of Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat the father of Joram, and Joram the father of Uzziah.
1.kjv: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;
1.blb: And Asaph begat Jehoshaphat, and Jehoshaphat begat Joram, and Joram begat Uzziah.
1.bbe: And the son of Asa was Jehoshaphat; and the son of Jehoshaphat was Joram; and the son of Joram was Uzziah;

1.msb: Uzziah was the father of Jotham, Jotham the father of Ahaz, and Ahaz the father of Hezekiah.
1.kjv: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;
1.blb: And Uzziah begat Jotham, and Jotham begat Ahaz, and Ahaz begat Hezekiah.
1.bbe: And the son of Uzziah was Jotham; and the son of Jotham was Ahaz; and the son of Ahaz was Hezekiah;

1.msb: Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh, Manasseh the father of Amon, Amon the father of Josiah,
1.kjv: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;
1.blb: And Hezekiah begat Manasseh, and Manasseh begat Amos, and Amos begat Josiah,
1.bbe: And the son of Hezekiah was Manasseh; and the son of Manasseh was Amon; and the son of Amon was Josiah;

1.msb: and Josiah the father of Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.
1.kjv: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
1.blb: and Josiah begat Jeconiah and his brothers at the deportation to Babylon.
1.bbe: And the sons of Josiah were Jechoniah and his brothers, at the time of the taking away to Babylon.

1.msb: After the exile to Babylon: Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel, Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel,
1.kjv: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;
1.blb: And after the deportation to Babylon: Jeconiah begat Shealtiel, and Shealtiel begat Zerubbabel,
1.bbe: And after the taking away to Babylon, Jechoniah had a son Shealtiel; and Shealtiel had Zerubbabel;

1.msb: Zerubbabel the father of Abiud, Abiud the father of Eliakim, and Eliakim the father of Azor.
1.kjv: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
1.blb: and Zerubbabel begat Abiud, and Abiud begat Eliakim, and Eliakim begat Azor.
1.bbe: And Zerubbabel had Abiud; and Abiud had Eliakim; and Eliakim had Azor;

1.msb: Azor was the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Achim, and Achim the father of Eliud.
1.kjv: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
1.blb: And Azor begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Achim, and Achim begat Eliud.
1.bbe: And Azor had Zadok; and Zadok had Achim; and Achim had Eliud;

1.msb: Eliud was the father of Eleazar, Eleazar the father of Matthan, Matthan the father of Jacob,
1.kjv: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
1.blb: And Eliud begat Eleazar, and Eleazar begat Matthan, and Matthan begat Jacob,
1.bbe: And Eliud had Eleazar; and Eleazar had Matthan; and Matthan had Jacob;

1.msb: and Jacob the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
1.kjv: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
1.blb: and Jacob begat Joseph, the husband of Mary, out of whom was begotten Jesus, the One being called Christ.
1.bbe: And the son of Jacob was Joseph the husband of Mary, who gave birth to Jesus, whose name is Christ.

1.msb: In all, then, there were fourteen generations from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile to Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to the Christ.
1.kjv: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.
1.blb: Therefore all the generations from Abraham until David were fourteen generations, and from David until the deportation to Babylon fourteen generations, and from the deportation to Babylon until the Christ fourteen generations.
1.bbe: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David to the taking away to Babylon, fourteen generations; and from the taking away to Babylon to the coming of Christ, fourteen generations.

1.msb: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about: His mother Mary was pledged in marriage to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be with child through the Holy Spirit.
1.kjv: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
1.blb: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was thus: His mother Mary, having been betrothed to Joseph, before their coming together was found having in womb from the Holy Spirit.
1.bbe: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was in this way: when his mother Mary was going to be married to Joseph, before they came together the discovery was made that she was with child by the Holy Spirit.
1.heading: The Birth of Jesus

1.msb: Because Joseph her husband was a righteous man and was unwilling to disgrace her publicly, he resolved to divorce her quietly.
1.kjv: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
1.blb: And Joseph her husband, being righteous and not willing to make an example of her, resolved to send her away secretly.
1.bbe: And Joseph, her husband, being an upright man, and not desiring to make her a public example, had a mind to put her away privately.

1.msb: But after he had pondered these things, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to embrace Mary as your wife, for the One conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.
1.kjv: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
1.blb: But on his having pondered these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph son of David, you should not be afraid to receive Mary as your wife, for that having been begotten in her is from the Holy Spirit.
1.bbe: But when he was giving thought to these things, an angel of the Lord came to him in a dream, saying, Joseph, son of David, have no fear of taking Mary as your wife; because that which is in her body is of the Holy Spirit.

1.msb: She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.”
1.kjv: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
1.blb: And she will bear a Son, and you will call His name Jesus, for He will save His people from their sins.”
1.bbe: And she will give birth to a son; and you will give him the name Jesus; for he will give his people salvation from their sins.

1.msb: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet:
1.kjv: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,
1.blb: And all this has come to pass so that it might be fulfilled, that having been spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,
1.bbe: Now all this took place so that the word of the Lord by the prophet might come true,

1.msb: “Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and they will call Him Immanuel” (which means, “God with us”).
1.kjv: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
1.blb: “Behold, the virgin will have in womb, and she will bear a son, and they will call His name Immanuel,” which is, being translated, “God with us.”
1.bbe: See, the virgin will be with child, and will give birth to a son, and they will give him the name Immanuel, that is, God with us.

1.msb: When Joseph woke up, he did as the angel of the Lord had commanded him and embraced Mary as his wife.
1.kjv: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
1.blb: And Joseph, having been awoken from sleep, did as the angel of the Lord commanded him and received his wife.
1.bbe: And Joseph did as the angel of the Lord had said to him, and took her as his wife;

1.msb: But he had no union with her until she gave birth to her firstborn Son. And he gave Him the name Jesus.
1.kjv: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.
1.blb: And he did not know her until she bore a Son, and he called His name Jesus.
1.bbe: And he had no connection with her till she had given birth to a son; and he gave him the name Jesus.

2.msb: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod, Magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem,
2.kjv: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
2.blb: Now on Jesus having been born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king, behold, Magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem,
2.bbe: Now when the birth of Jesus took place in Beth-lehem of Judaea, in the days of Herod the king, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
2.heading: The Pilgrimage of the Magi

2.msb: asking, “Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews? We saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him.”
2.kjv: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
2.blb: saying, “Where is the One having been born King of the Jews? For we saw His star in the east and came to worship Him.”
2.bbe: Saying, Where is the King of the Jews whose birth has now taken place? We have seen his star in the east and have come to give him worship.

2.msb: When Herod the king heard this, he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.
2.kjv: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
2.blb: And King Herod, having heard, was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
2.bbe: And when it came to the ears of Herod the king, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

2.msb: And when he had assembled all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ was to be born.
2.kjv: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.
2.blb: And having gathered together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he was inquiring of them where the Christ is born.
2.bbe: And he got together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, questioning them as to where the birth-place of the Christ would be.

2.msb: “In Bethlehem in Judea,” they replied, “for this is what the prophet has written:
2.kjv: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
2.blb: And they said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for thus it has been written through the prophet:
2.bbe: And they said to him, In Beth-lehem of Judaea; for so it is said in the writings of the prophet,

2.msb: ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah, for out of you will come a ruler who will be the shepherd of My people Israel.’”
2.kjv: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.
2.blb: ‘And you, Bethlehem, land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah, for out of you will come forth One leading, who will shepherd My people Israel.’”
2.bbe: You Beth-lehem, in the land of Judah, are not the least among the chiefs of Judah: out of you will come a ruler, who will be the keeper of my people Israel.

2.msb: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and learned from them the exact time the star had appeared.
2.kjv: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
2.blb: Then Herod, having called the Magi secretly, learned exactly of them the time of the appearing star.
2.bbe: Then Herod sent for the wise men privately, and put questions to them about what time the star had been seen.

2.msb: And sending them to Bethlehem, he said: “Go and search carefully for the Child, and when you find Him, report to me, so that I too may go and worship Him.”
2.kjv: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
2.blb: And having sent them to Bethlehem, he said, “Having gone, search carefully for the Child; and when you shall have found Him, report to me, so that I also, having come, may worship Him.”
2.bbe: And he sent them to Beth-lehem and said, Go and make certain where the young child is; and when you have seen him, let me have news of it, so that I may come and give him worship.

2.msb: After they had heard the king, they went on their way, and the star they had seen in the east went ahead of them until it stood over the place where the Child was.
2.kjv: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
2.blb: And having heard the king, they went, and behold, the star that they saw in the east went before them until, having come, it stood over where the Child was.
2.bbe: And after hearing the king, they went on their way; and the star which they saw in the east went before them, till it came to rest over the place where the young child was.

2.msb: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with great delight.
2.kjv: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
2.blb: And having seen the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.
2.bbe: And when they saw the star they were full of joy.

2.msb: On coming to the house, they saw the Child with His mother Mary, and they fell down and worshiped Him. Then they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.
2.kjv: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
2.blb: And having come into the house, they saw the Child with His mother Mary, and having fallen down, they worshiped Him. And having opened their treasures, they offered to Him gifts: gold and frankincense and myrrh.
2.bbe: And they came into the house, and saw the young child with Mary, his mother; and falling down on their faces they gave him worship; and from their store they gave him offerings of gold, perfume, and spices.

2.msb: And having been warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they withdrew to their country by another route.
2.kjv: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
2.blb: And having been divinely warned in a dream not to return to Herod, through another way they withdrew to their country.
2.bbe: And it was made clear to them by God in a dream that they were not to go back to Herod; so they went into their country by another way.

2.msb: When the Magi had gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and flee to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod is going to search for the Child to kill Him.”
2.kjv: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
2.blb: And on their having withdrawn, behold, an angel of the Lord appears to Joseph in a dream saying, “Having arisen, take the Child and His mother and flee into Egypt. And be there until I should tell you, for Herod is about to seek the Child to destroy Him.”
2.bbe: And when they had gone, an angel of the Lord came to Joseph in a dream, saying, Get up and take the young child and his mother, and go into Egypt, and do not go from there till I give you word; for Herod will be searching for the young child to put him to death.
2.heading: The Flight to Egypt

2.msb: So he got up, took the Child and His mother by night, and withdrew to Egypt,
2.kjv: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
2.blb: And having arisen, he took the Child and His mother by night and withdrew into Egypt,
2.bbe: So he took the young child and his mother by night, and went into Egypt;

2.msb: where he stayed until the death of Herod. This fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: “Out of Egypt I called My Son.”
2.kjv: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.
2.blb: and there he was until the death of Herod, so that it might be fulfilled, that having been spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called My Son.”
2.bbe: And was there till the death of Herod; so that the word of the Lord through the prophet might come true, Out of Egypt have I sent for my son.

2.msb: When Herod saw that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was filled with rage. Sending orders, he put to death all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under, according to the time he had learned from the Magi.
2.kjv: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men.
2.blb: Then Herod, having seen that he was mocked by the Magi, was exceedingly enraged. And having sent forth, he put to death all the boys in Bethlehem and in all its borders from two years old and under, according to the time that he learned exactly from the Magi.
2.bbe: Then Herod, when he saw that he had been tricked by the wise men, was very angry; and he sent out, and put to death all the male children in Beth-lehem and in all the parts round about it, from two years old and under, acting on the knowledge which he had got with care from the wise men.
2.heading: Weeping and Great Mourning

2.msb: Then what was spoken through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled:
2.kjv: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,
2.blb: Then was fulfilled that having been spoken through the prophet Jeremiah, saying:
2.bbe: Then the word of Jeremiah the prophet came true,

2.msb: “A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation and weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.”
2.kjv: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
2.blb: “A voice was heard in Ramah, weeping and much mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; and she would not be comforted, because they are not.”
2.bbe: In Ramah there was a sound of weeping and great sorrow, Rachel weeping for her children, and she would not be comforted for their loss.

2.msb: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt.
2.kjv: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
2.blb: But on Herod having died, behold, an angel of the Lord appears in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
2.bbe: But when Herod was dead, an angel of the Lord came in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
2.heading: The Return to Nazareth

2.msb: “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and go to the land of Israel, for those seeking the Child’s life are now dead.”
2.kjv: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child’s life.
2.blb: saying, “Having arisen, take the Child and His mother and go into the land of Israel, for those seeking the life of the Child have died.”
2.bbe: Saying, Get up and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: because they who were attempting to take the young child's life are dead.

2.msb: So Joseph got up, took the Child and His mother, and went to the land of Israel.
2.kjv: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
2.blb: And having arisen, he took the Child and His mother and came into the land of Israel.
2.bbe: And he got up, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

2.msb: But when he learned that Archelaus was reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. And having been warned in a dream, he withdrew to the district of Galilee,
2.kjv: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
2.blb: But having heard that Archelaus reigns over Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to depart to there. And having been divinely warned in a dream, he withdrew to the parts of Galilee.
2.bbe: But when it came to his ears that Archelaus was ruling over Judaea in the place of his father Herod, he was in fear of going there; and God having given him news of the danger in a dream, he went out of the way into the country parts of Galilee.

2.msb: and he went and lived in a town called Nazareth. So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophets: “He will be called a Nazarene.”
2.kjv: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
2.blb: And having come, he dwelt in a city being called Nazareth, so that it might be fulfilled, that having been spoken through the prophets, that “He will be called a Nazarene.”
2.bbe: And he came and was living in a town named Nazareth: so that the word of the prophets might come true, He will be named a Nazarene.

3.msb: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea
3.kjv: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
3.blb: Now in those days John the Baptist comes, preaching in the wilderness of Judea
3.bbe: And in those days John the Baptist came preaching in the waste land of Judaea,
3.heading: The Mission of John the Baptist

3.msb: and saying, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”
3.kjv: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
3.blb: and saying, “Repent, for the kingdom of the heavens has drawn near.”
3.bbe: Saying, Let your hearts be turned from sin; for the kingdom of heaven is near.

3.msb: This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’”
3.kjv: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
3.blb: For this is the one having been spoken of through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “A voice of one crying in the wilderness: ‘Prepare the way of the Lord; make straight His paths.’”
3.bbe: For this is he of whom Isaiah the prophet said, The voice of one crying in the waste land, Make ready the way of the Lord, make his roads straight.

3.msb: John wore a garment of camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
3.kjv: And the same John had his raiment of camel’s hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
3.blb: And John himself had his clothing of camel’s hair and a belt of leather around his waist, and his food was locusts and wild honey.
3.bbe: Now John was clothed in camel's hair, with a leather band about him; and his food was locusts and honey.

3.msb: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region around the Jordan.
3.kjv: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,
3.blb: At that time they were going out to him—Jerusalem and all Judea and all the region around the Jordan.
3.bbe: Then Jerusalem and all Judaea went out to him, and all the people from near Jordan;

3.msb: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan.
3.kjv: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
3.blb: And they were being baptized in the Jordan River by him, confessing their sins.
3.bbe: And they were given baptism by him in the river Jordan, saying openly that they had done wrong.

3.msb: But when John saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his place of baptism, he said to them, “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
3.kjv: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
3.blb: But having seen many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said to them, “Offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
3.bbe: But when he saw a number of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said to them, Offspring of snakes, at whose word are you going in flight from the wrath to come?

3.msb: Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance.
3.kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
3.blb: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance.
3.bbe: Let your change of heart be seen in your works:

3.msb: And do not presume to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
3.kjv: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
3.blb: And do not think to say in yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as father.’ For I say to you that out of these stones God is able to raise up children to Abraham.
3.bbe: And say not to yourselves, We have Abraham for our father; because I say to you that God is able from these stones to make children for Abraham.

3.msb: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
3.kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
3.blb: And already the ax is laid to the root of the trees; therefore every tree not producing good fruit is cut down and is thrown into fire.
3.bbe: And even now the axe is put to the root of the trees; every tree then which does not give good fruit is cut down, and put into the fire.

3.msb: I baptize you with water for repentance, but after me will come One more powerful than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.
3.kjv: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
3.blb: I indeed baptize you in water unto repentance, but the One coming after me is mightier than I, of whom I am not sufficient to carry the sandals. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire,
3.bbe: Truly, I give baptism with water to those of you whose hearts are changed; but he who comes after me is greater than I, whose shoes I am not good enough to take up: he will give you baptism with the Holy Spirit and with fire:

3.msb: His winnowing fork is in His hand, and He will clear His threshing floor and gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
3.kjv: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
3.blb: whose winnowing fork is in His hand, and He will thoroughly cleanse His threshing floor and will gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
3.bbe: In whose hand is the instrument with which he will make clean his grain; he will put the good grain in his store, but the waste will be burned up in the fire which will never be put out.

3.msb: At that time Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.
3.kjv: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
3.blb: Then Jesus comes from Galilee to the Jordan to John to be baptized by him.
3.bbe: Then Jesus came from Galilee to John at the Jordan, to be given baptism by him.
3.heading: The Baptism of Jesus

3.msb: But John tried to prevent Him, saying, “I need to be baptized by You, and do You come to me?”
3.kjv: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
3.blb: But John was preventing Him, saying, “I have need to be baptized by You, and You come to me?”
3.bbe: But John would have kept him back, saying, It is I who have need of baptism from you, and do you come to me?

3.msb: “Let it be so now,” Jesus replied. “It is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness in this way.” Then John permitted Him.
3.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
3.blb: But answering, Jesus said to him, “Permit it presently; for thus it is fitting to us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he permits Him.
3.bbe: But Jesus made answer, saying to him, Let it be so now: because so it is right for us to make righteousness complete. Then he gave him baptism.

3.msb: As soon as Jesus was baptized, He went up out of the water. Suddenly the heavens were opened to Him, and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and resting on Him.
3.kjv: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
3.blb: And having been baptized, Jesus immediately went up from the water; and behold, the heavens were opened, and He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove and coming upon Him.
3.bbe: And Jesus, having been given baptism, straight away went up from the water; and, the heavens opening, he saw the Spirit of God coming down on him as a dove;

3.msb: And a voice from heaven said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!”
3.kjv: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
3.blb: And behold, a voice out of the heavens, saying, “This is My Son, the Beloved, in whom I was well pleased.”
3.bbe: And a voice came out of heaven, saying, This is my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased.

4.msb: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
4.kjv: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
4.blb: Then Jesus was led up into the wilderness by the Spirit to be tempted by the devil.
4.bbe: Then Jesus was sent by the Spirit into the waste land to be tested by the Evil One.
4.heading: The Temptation of Jesus

4.msb: After fasting forty days and forty nights, He was hungry.
4.kjv: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
4.blb: And having fasted forty days and forty nights, afterward He was hungry.
4.bbe: And after going without food for forty days and forty nights, he was in need of it.

4.msb: The tempter came to Him and said, “If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”
4.kjv: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
4.blb: And the one tempting, having come to Him, said, “If You are the Son of God, speak, that these stones might become loaves.”
4.bbe: And the Evil One came and said to him, If you are the Son of God, give the word for these stones to become bread.

4.msb: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’”
4.kjv: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
4.blb: But answering, He said, “It has been written: ‘Not on bread alone shall the man live, but on every word coming out through the mouth of God.’”
4.bbe: But he made answer and said, It is in the Writings, Bread is not man's only need, but every word which comes out of the mouth of God.

4.msb: Then the devil took Him to the holy city and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple.
4.kjv: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
4.blb: Then the devil takes Him to the holy city, and he set Him on the pinnacle of the temple,
4.bbe: Then the Evil One took him to the holy town; and he put him on the highest point of the Temple and said to him,

4.msb: “If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down. For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’”
4.kjv: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
4.blb: and he says to Him, “If You are the Son of God, throw Yourself down. For it has been written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You, and on hands they will lift You up, lest ever You might strike Your foot against a stone.’”
4.bbe: If you are the Son of God, let yourself go down; for it is in the Writings, He will give his angels care over you; and, In their hands they will keep you up, so that your foot may not be crushed against a stone.

4.msb: Jesus replied, “It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”
4.kjv: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
4.blb: Jesus said to him, “Again it has been written: ‘You shall not test the Lord your God.’”
4.bbe: Jesus said to him, Again it is in the Writings, You may not put the Lord your God to the test.

4.msb: Again, the devil took Him to a very high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
4.kjv: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
4.blb: Again the devil takes Him to a mountain exceedingly high and shows to Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
4.bbe: Again, the Evil One took him up to a very high mountain, and let him see all the kingdoms of the world and the glory of them;

4.msb: “All this I will give You,” he said, “if You will fall down and worship me.”
4.kjv: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
4.blb: And he said to Him, “All these things I will give to You if, falling down, You worship me.”
4.bbe: And he said to him, All these things will I give you, if you will go down on your face and give me worship.

4.msb: “Get behind Me, Satan!” Jesus told him. “For it is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’”
4.kjv: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
4.blb: Then Jesus says to him, “Go away, Satan! For it has been written: ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and Him only shall you serve.’”
4.bbe: Then said Jesus to him, Away, Satan: for it is in the Writings, Give worship to the Lord your God and be his servant only.

4.msb: Then the devil left Him, and angels came and ministered to Him.
4.kjv: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
4.blb: Then the devil leaves Him, and behold, angels came and were ministering to Him.
4.bbe: Then the Evil One went away from him, and angels came and took care of him.

4.msb: When Jesus heard that John had been imprisoned, He withdrew to Galilee.
4.kjv: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
4.blb: And having heard that John was delivered up, He withdrew into Galilee.
4.bbe: Now when it came to his ears that John had been put in prison, he went away to Galilee;
4.heading: Jesus Begins His Ministry

4.msb: Leaving Nazareth, He went and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,
4.kjv: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
4.blb: And having left Nazareth, having come, He dwelt at Capernaum, which is by the sea in the borders of Zebulun and Naphtali,
4.bbe: And going away from Nazareth, he came and made his living-place in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the country of Zebulun and Naphtali:

4.msb: to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
4.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
4.blb: that it might be fulfilled, that having been spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying:
4.bbe: So that the word of the prophet Isaiah might come true,

4.msb: “Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles—
4.kjv: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;
4.blb: “Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles—
4.bbe: The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, by the way of the sea, the other side of Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,

4.msb: the people living in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned.”
4.kjv: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
4.blb: the people sitting in darkness saw a great light, and to those sitting in the region and shadow of death, a light dawned on them.”
4.bbe: The people who were in the dark saw a great light, and to those in the land of the shade of death did the dawn come up.

4.msb: From that time on Jesus began to preach, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”
4.kjv: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
4.blb: From that time Jesus began to proclaim and to say, “Repent, for the kingdom of the heavens has drawn near.”
4.bbe: From that time Jesus went about preaching and saying, Let your hearts be turned from sin, for the kingdom of heaven is near.

4.msb: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw two brothers, Simon called Peter and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
4.kjv: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
4.blb: And walking by the Sea of Galilee, He saw two brothers, Simon called Peter and his brother Andrew, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
4.bbe: And when he was walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon, whose other name was Peter, and Andrew, his brother, who were putting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
4.heading: The First Disciples

4.msb: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”
4.kjv: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
4.blb: And He says to them, “Come after Me, and I will make you fishers of men.”
4.bbe: And he said to them, Come after me, and I will make you fishers of men.

4.msb: And at once they left their nets and followed Him.
4.kjv: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
4.blb: And immediately, having left the nets, they followed Him.
4.bbe: And straight away they let go the nets and went after him.

4.msb: Going on from there, He saw two other brothers, James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat with their father Zebedee, mending their nets. Jesus called them,
4.kjv: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
4.blb: And having gone on from there, He saw two others, brothers, James son of Zebedee and his brother John, in the boat with their father Zebedee, mending their nets; and He called them.
4.bbe: And going on from there he saw two other brothers, James, the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, in the boat with their father, stitching up their nets; and he said, Come.

4.msb: and immediately they left the boat and their father and followed Him.
4.kjv: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
4.blb: And immediately, having left the boat and their father, they followed Him.
4.bbe: And they went straight from the boat and their father and came after him.

4.msb: Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.
4.kjv: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
4.blb: And He was going about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and proclaiming the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
4.bbe: And Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their Synagogues and preaching the good news of the kingdom, and making well those who were ill with any disease among the people.
4.heading: Jesus Heals the Multitudes

4.msb: News about Him spread all over Syria, and people brought to Him all who were ill with various diseases, those suffering acute pain, the demon-possessed, those having seizures, and the paralyzed, and He healed them.
4.kjv: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
4.blb: And the news of Him went out into all Syria. And they brought to Him all the ill having various diseases and oppressing torments, and being possessed by demons, and being epileptics, and paralytics, and He healed them.
4.bbe: And news of him went out through all Syria; and they took to him all who were ill with different diseases and pains, those having evil spirits and those who were off their heads, and those who had no power of moving. And he made them well.

4.msb: Large crowds followed Him, having come from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and beyond the Jordan.
4.kjv: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.
4.blb: And there followed Him many crowds from Galilee, and the Decapolis, and Jerusalem, and Judea, and beyond the Jordan.
4.bbe: And there went after him great numbers from Galilee and Decapolis and Jerusalem and Judaea and from the other side of Jordan.

5.msb: When Jesus saw the crowds, He went up on the mountain and sat down. His disciples came to Him,
5.kjv: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
5.blb: And having seen the crowds, He went up onto the mountain. And on His having sat down, His disciples came to Him.
5.bbe: And seeing great masses of people he went up into the mountain; and when he was seated his disciples came to him.
5.heading: The Sermon on the Mount

5.msb: and He began to teach them, saying:
5.kjv: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
5.blb: And having opened His mouth, He was teaching them, saying:
5.bbe: And with these words he gave them teaching, saying,

5.msb: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
5.kjv: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
5.blb: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, because theirs is the kingdom of the heavens.
5.bbe: Happy are the poor in spirit: for the kingdom of heaven is theirs.
5.heading: The Beatitudes

5.msb: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
5.kjv: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
5.blb: Blessed are those mourning, because they will be comforted.
5.bbe: Happy are those who are sad: for they will be comforted.

5.msb: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.
5.kjv: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
5.blb: Blessed are the meek, because they will inherit the earth.
5.bbe: Happy are the gentle: for the earth will be their heritage.

5.msb: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.
5.kjv: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
5.blb: Blessed are those hungering and thirsting for righteousness, because they will be filled.
5.bbe: Happy are those whose heart's desire is for righteousness: for they will have their desire.

5.msb: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.
5.kjv: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
5.blb: Blessed are the merciful, because they will receive mercy.
5.bbe: Happy are those who have mercy: for they will be given mercy.

5.msb: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
5.kjv: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
5.blb: Blessed are the pure in heart, because they will see God.
5.bbe: Happy are the clean in heart: for they will see God.

5.msb: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.
5.kjv: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
5.blb: Blessed are the peacemakers, because they will be called sons of God.
5.bbe: Happy are the peacemakers: for they will be named sons of God.

5.msb: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
5.kjv: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness’ sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
5.blb: Blessed are those having been persecuted on account of righteousness, because theirs is the kingdom of the heavens.
5.bbe: Happy are those who are attacked on account of righteousness: for the kingdom of heaven will be theirs.

5.msb: Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say every evil thing against you because of Me.
5.kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
5.blb: Blessed are you when they may reproach you and may persecute you and may say all evil against you, lying, on account of Me.
5.bbe: Happy are you when men give you a bad name, and are cruel to you, and say all evil things against you falsely, because of me.

5.msb: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you.
5.kjv: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
5.blb: Rejoice and exult, because your reward is great in the heavens; for thus they persecuted the prophets before you.
5.bbe: Be glad and full of joy; for great is your reward in heaven: for so were the prophets attacked who were before you.

5.msb: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its savor, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled by men.
5.kjv: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
5.blb: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt should become tasteless, with what will it be salted? For nothing is it potent any longer except, having been cast out, to be trampled upon by men.
5.bbe: You are the salt of the earth; but if its taste goes from the salt, how will you make it salt again? it is then good for nothing but to be put out and crushed under foot by men.
5.heading: Salt and Light

5.msb: You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.
5.kjv: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
5.blb: You are the light of the world. A city lying on a hill is not able to be hidden.
5.bbe: You are the light of the world. A town put on a hill may be seen by all.

5.msb: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a basket. Instead, they set it on a stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.
5.kjv: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
5.blb: Nor do they light a lamp and put it under the basket, but upon the lampstand, and it shines to all those in the house.
5.bbe: And a burning light is not put under a vessel, but on its table; so that its rays may be shining on all who are in the house.

5.msb: In the same way, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.
5.kjv: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
5.blb: Thus let your light shine before men, so that they may see your good works and may glorify your Father who is in the heavens.
5.bbe: Even so let your light be shining before men, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father in heaven.

5.msb: Do not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets. I have not come to abolish them, but to fulfill them.
5.kjv: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
5.blb: Do not suppose that I came to abolish the Law or the Prophets. I did not come to abolish, but to fulfill.
5.bbe: Let there be no thought that I have come to put an end to the law or the prophets. I have not come for destruction, but to make complete.
5.heading: The Fulfillment of the Law

5.msb: For I tell you truly, until heaven and earth pass away, not a single jot, not a stroke of a pen, will disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.
5.kjv: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
5.blb: For truly I say to you, until the heaven and the earth should pass away, not even one iota, or one stroke of a letter, shall pass away from the Law, until everything should come to pass.
5.bbe: Truly I say to you, Till heaven and earth come to an end, not the smallest letter or part of a letter will in any way be taken from the law, till all things are done.

5.msb: So then, whoever breaks one of the least of these commandments and teaches others to do likewise will be called least in the kingdom of heaven; but whoever practices and teaches them will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
5.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
5.blb: Whoever then may break one of the least of these commandments and may teach men thus, he will be called least in the kingdom of the heavens; but whoever may do and may teach them, this one will be called great in the kingdom of the heavens.
5.bbe: Whoever then goes against the smallest of these laws, teaching men to do the same, will be named least in the kingdom of heaven; but he who keeps the laws, teaching others to keep them, will be named great in the kingdom of heaven.

5.msb: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
5.kjv: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
5.blb: For I say to you that unless your righteousness should abound more than that of the scribes and Pharisees, you shall certainly not enter into the kingdom of the heavens.
5.bbe: For I say to you, If your righteousness is not greater than the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never go into the kingdom of heaven.

5.msb: You have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not murder’ and ‘Anyone who murders will be subject to judgment.’
5.kjv: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
5.blb: You heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘You shall not murder,’ and, ‘Whoever may murder will be liable to the judgment.’
5.bbe: You have knowledge that it was said in old times, You may not put to death; and, Whoever puts to death will be in danger of being judged:
5.heading: Anger and Reconciliation

5.msb: But I tell you that anyone who is angry with his brother without cause will be subject to judgment. Again, anyone who says to his brother, ‘Raca,’ will be subject to the Sanhedrin. But anyone who says, ‘You fool!’ will be subject to the fire of hell.
5.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
5.blb: But I say to you that everyone being angry with his brother will be liable to the judgment, and whoever may say to his brother, ‘Raca,’ will be liable to the Sanhedrin. But whoever may say, ‘Fool!’ will be liable to the Gehenna of fire.
5.bbe: But I say to you that everyone who is angry with his brother will be in danger of being judged; and he who says to his brother, Raca, will be in danger from the Sanhedrin; and whoever says, You foolish one, will be in danger of the hell of fire.

5.msb: So if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother has something against you,
5.kjv: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
5.blb: Therefore, if you may offer your gift at the altar, and there may remember that your brother has something against you,
5.bbe: If then you are making an offering at the altar and there it comes to your mind that your brother has something against you,

5.msb: leave your gift there before the altar. First go and be reconciled to your brother; then come and offer your gift.
5.kjv: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
5.blb: leave your gift there before the altar and first go, be reconciled to your brother, and then, having come, offer your gift.
5.bbe: While your offering is still before the altar, first go and make peace with your brother, then come and make your offering.

5.msb: Reconcile quickly with your adversary, while you are still on the way to court. Otherwise, he may hand you over to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and you may be thrown into prison.
5.kjv: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
5.blb: Be agreeing quickly with your adversary while you are with him in the way, lest ever the adversary may deliver you to the judge, and the judge to the officer, and you will be cast into prison.
5.bbe: Come to an agreement quickly with him who has a cause against you at law, while you are with him on the way, for fear that he may give you up to the judge and the judge may give you to the police and you may be put into prison.

5.msb: Truly I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.
5.kjv: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
5.blb: Truly I say to you, you shall never come out from there until you should pay back the last kodrantes.
5.bbe: Truly I say to you, You will not come out from there till you have made payment of the very last farthing.

5.msb: You have heard that it was said, ‘Do not commit adultery.’
5.kjv: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
5.blb: You heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery.’
5.bbe: You have knowledge that it was said, You may not have connection with another man's wife:
5.heading: Adultery

5.msb: But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
5.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
5.blb: But I say to you that everyone looking at a woman in order to desire her already committed adultery with her in his heart.
5.bbe: But I say to you that everyone whose eyes are turned on a woman with desire has had connection with her in his heart.

5.msb: If your right eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.
5.kjv: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
5.blb: Now if your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. For it is better for you that one of your members should perish and not that your whole body should be cast into Gehenna.
5.bbe: And if your right eye is a cause of trouble to you, take it out and put it away from you; because it is better to undergo the loss of one part, than for all your body to go into hell.

5.msb: And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be cast into hell.
5.kjv: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
5.blb: And if your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. For it is better for you that one of your members should perish and not that your whole body should go away into Gehenna.
5.bbe: And if your right hand is a cause of trouble to you, let it be cut off and put it away from you; because it is better to undergo the loss of one part, than for all your body to go into hell.

5.msb: It has also been said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce.’
5.kjv: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
5.blb: And it was said, ‘Whoever may send away his wife, let him give to her a certificate of divorce.’
5.bbe: Again, it was said, Whoever puts away his wife has to give her a statement in writing for this purpose:
5.heading: Divorce

5.msb: But I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, brings adultery upon her. And he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
5.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.
5.blb: But I say to you that everyone sending away his wife, except for the reason of sexual immorality, causes her to commit adultery. And whoever shall marry her who has been sent away, he commits adultery.
5.bbe: But I say to you that everyone who puts away his wife for any other cause but the loss of her virtue, makes her false to her husband; and whoever takes her as his wife after she is put away, is no true husband to her.

5.msb: Again, you have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not break your oath, but fulfill your vows to the Lord.’
5.kjv: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
5.blb: Again, you heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘You shall not swear falsely, but you shall repay your oaths to the Lord.’
5.bbe: Again, you have knowledge that it was said in old times, Do not take false oaths, but give effect to your oaths to the Lord:
5.heading: Oaths and Vows

5.msb: But I tell you not to swear at all: either by heaven, for it is God’s throne;
5.kjv: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God’s throne:
5.blb: But I say to you not to swear at all: neither by heaven, because it is the throne of God;
5.bbe: But I say to you, Take no oaths at all: not by the heaven, because it is the seat of God;

5.msb: or by the earth, for it is His footstool; or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
5.kjv: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
5.blb: nor by the earth, because it is the footstool for His feet; nor by Jerusalem, because it is the city of the great King.
5.bbe: Or by the earth, because it is the resting-place for his foot; or by Jerusalem, because it is the town of the great King.

5.msb: Nor should you swear by your head, for you cannot make a single hair white or black.
5.kjv: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
5.blb: Nor may you swear by your head, because you are not able to make one hair white or black.
5.bbe: You may not take an oath by your head, because you are not able to make one hair white or black.

5.msb: Simply let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes,’ and your ‘No,’ ‘No.’ Anything more comes from the evil one.
5.kjv: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
5.blb: But let your word ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes,’ and ‘No,’ ‘No.’ And that which is more than these comes from the evil one.
5.bbe: But let your words be simply, Yes or No: and whatever is more than these is of the Evil One.

5.msb: You have heard that it was said, ‘Eye for eye and tooth for tooth.’
5.kjv: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
5.blb: You heard that it was said, ‘Eye for eye and tooth for tooth.’
5.bbe: You have knowledge that it was said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
5.heading: Love Your Enemies

5.msb: But I tell you not to resist an evil person. If someone slaps you on the right cheek, turn to him the other also;
5.kjv: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
5.blb: But I say to you not to resist the evil person. But whoever may strike you on your right cheek, turn to him also the other.
5.bbe: But I say to you, Do not make use of force against an evil man; but to him who gives you a blow on the right side of your face let the left be turned.

5.msb: if someone wants to sue you and take your tunic, let him have your cloak as well;
5.kjv: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloke also.
5.blb: And the one wanting to sue you and to take your tunic, yield to him also the cloak.
5.bbe: And if any man goes to law with you and takes away your coat, do not keep back your robe from him.

5.msb: and if someone forces you to go one mile, go with him two miles.
5.kjv: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
5.blb: And whoever will compel you to go one milion, go with him two.
5.bbe: And whoever makes you go one mile, go with him two.

5.msb: Give to the one who asks you, and do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.
5.kjv: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
5.blb: To the one asking you, you should give, and from the one wanting to borrow from you, you should not turn away.
5.bbe: Give to him who comes with a request, and keep not your property from him who would for a time make use of it.

5.msb: You have heard that it was said, ‘Love your neighbor’ and ‘Hate your enemy.’
5.kjv: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
5.blb: You heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and shall hate your enemy.’
5.bbe: You have knowledge that it was said, Have love for your neighbour, and hate for him who is against you:

5.msb: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
5.kjv: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
5.blb: But I say to you, love your enemies and pray for those persecuting you,
5.bbe: But I say to you, Have love for those who are against you, and make prayer for those who are cruel to you;

5.msb: that you may be sons of your Father in heaven. He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.
5.kjv: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
5.blb: so that you may be sons of your Father who is in the heavens. For He makes His sun rise on evil and good, and He sends rain on righteous and unrighteous.
5.bbe: So that you may be the sons of your Father in heaven; for his sun gives light to the evil and to the good, and he sends rain on the upright man and on the sinner.

5.msb: If you love those who love you, what reward will you get? Do not even tax collectors do the same?
5.kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
5.blb: For if you love those loving you, what reward do you have? Do not also the tax collectors do the same?
5.bbe: For if you have love for those who have love for you, what credit is it to you? do not the tax-farmers the same?

5.msb: And if you greet only your friends, what are you doing more than others? Do not even the tax collectors do the same?
5.kjv: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
5.blb: And if you greet only your brothers, what extraordinary thing do you do? Do not also the Gentiles do the same?
5.bbe: And if you say, Good day, to your brothers only, what do you do more than others? do not even the Gentiles the same?

5.msb: Be perfect, therefore, as your Father in heaven is perfect.
5.kjv: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
5.blb: You shall be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
5.bbe: Be then complete in righteousness, even as your Father in heaven is complete.

6.msb: “Be careful not to perform your acts of charity before men to be seen by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.
6.kjv: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
6.blb: “ And beware not to do your righteousness before men in order to be seen by them. Otherwise, you have no reward from your Father who is in the heavens.
6.bbe: Take care not to do your good works before men, to be seen by them; or you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.
6.heading: Giving to the Needy

6.msb: So when you give to the needy, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
6.kjv: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
6.blb: Therefore, when you may do charity, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets so that they may be glorified by men. Truly I say to you, they have their reward in full.
6.bbe: When then you give money to the poor, do not make a noise about it, as the false-hearted men do in the Synagogues and in the streets, so that they may have glory from men. Truly, I say to you, They have their reward.

6.msb: But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
6.kjv: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
6.blb: But in your doing charity, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
6.bbe: But when you give money, let not your left hand see what your right hand does:

6.msb: so that your giving may be in secret. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will Himself reward you openly.
6.kjv: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
6.blb: so that your charity may be in secret. And your Father, the One seeing in secret, will reward to you.
6.bbe: So that your giving may be in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will give you your reward.

6.msb: And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
6.kjv: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
6.blb: And when you may pray, you shall not be like the hypocrites, because they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the corners of the streets so that they might be seen by men. Truly I say to you, they have their reward in full.
6.bbe: And when you make your prayers, be not like the false-hearted men, who take pleasure in getting up and saying their prayers in the Synagogues and at the street turnings so that they may be seen by men. Truly I say to you, They have their reward.
6.heading: The Lord’s Prayer

6.msb: But when you pray, go into your inner room, shut your door, and pray to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you openly.
6.kjv: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
6.blb: But you, when you may pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father, the One in secret. And your Father, the One seeing in secret, will reward to you.
6.bbe: But when you make your prayer, go into your private room, and, shutting the door, say a prayer to your Father in secret, and your Father, who sees in secret, will give you your reward.

6.msb: And when you pray, do not babble on like pagans, for they think that by their many words they will be heard.
6.kjv: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
6.blb: And praying, do not use vain repetitions like the Gentiles, for they think that in their many words they will be heard.
6.bbe: And in your prayer do not make use of the same words again and again, as the Gentiles do: for they have the idea that God will give attention to them because of the number of their words.

6.msb: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask Him.
6.kjv: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
6.blb: Therefore do not be like them, for your Father knows of what things you have need before your asking Him.
6.bbe: So be not like them; because your Father has knowledge of your needs even before you make your requests to him.

6.msb: So then, this is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name.
6.kjv: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
6.blb: Therefore pray you this way: ‘Our Father who is in the heavens, hallowed be Your name.
6.bbe: Let this then be your prayer: Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

6.msb: Your kingdom come, Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
6.kjv: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
6.blb: Your kingdom come. Your will be done, as in heaven, also upon earth.
6.bbe: Let your kingdom come. Let your pleasure be done, as in heaven, so on earth.

6.msb: Give us this day our daily bread.
6.kjv: Give us this day our daily bread.
6.blb: Give us today our necessary bread.
6.bbe: Give us this day bread for our needs.

6.msb: And forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.
6.kjv: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
6.blb: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
6.bbe: And make us free of our debts, as we have made those free who are in debt to us.

6.msb: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For Yours is the kingdom and the power and the glory forever. Amen.’
6.kjv: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
6.blb: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’
6.bbe: And let us not be put to the test, but keep us safe from the Evil One.

6.msb: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
6.kjv: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
6.blb: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
6.bbe: For if you let men have forgiveness for their sins, you will have forgiveness from your Father in heaven.

6.msb: But if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive yours.
6.kjv: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
6.blb: But if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
6.bbe: But if you do not let men have forgiveness for their sins, you will not have forgiveness from your Father for your sins.

6.msb: When you fast, do not be somber like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces to show men they are fasting. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
6.kjv: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
6.blb: And when you may fast, do not be as the hypocrites, gloomy-faced; for they disfigure their faces so that they might appear to men as fasting. Truly I say to you, they have their reward in full.
6.bbe: And when you go without food, be not sad-faced as the false-hearted are. For they go about with changed looks, so that men may see that they are going without food. Truly I say to you, They have their reward.
6.heading: Proper Fasting

6.msb: But when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
6.kjv: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;
6.blb: But you, fasting, anoint your head and wash your face,
6.bbe: But when you go without food, put oil on your head and make your face clean;

6.msb: so that your fasting will not be obvious to men, but only to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
6.kjv: That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.
6.blb: so that you might not appear to men as fasting, but to your Father, the One in secret. And your Father, the One seeing in secret, will reward you.
6.bbe: So that no one may see that you are going without food, but your Father in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will give you your reward.

6.msb: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.
6.kjv: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
6.blb: Do not treasure up for yourselves treasures on the earth, where moth and rust disfigure, and where thieves break in and steal.
