6.bbe: Make no store of wealth for yourselves on earth, where it may be turned to dust by worms and weather, and where thieves may come in by force and take it away.
6.heading: Treasures in Heaven

6.msb: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moth and rust do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal.
6.kjv: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
6.blb: But treasure up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust disfigure, and where thieves do not break in, nor do they steal.
6.bbe: But make a store for yourselves in heaven, where it will not be turned to dust and where thieves do not come in to take it away:

6.msb: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
6.kjv: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
6.blb: For where your treasure is, there will be also your heart.
6.bbe: For where your wealth is, there will your heart be.

6.msb: The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are good, your whole body will be full of light.
6.kjv: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
6.blb: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore if your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.
6.bbe: The light of the body is the eye; if then your eye is true, all your body will be full of light.
6.heading: The Lamp of the Body

6.msb: But if your eyes are bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!
6.kjv: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!
6.blb: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
6.bbe: But if your eye is evil, all your body will be dark. If then the light which is in you is dark, how dark it will be!

6.msb: No one can serve two masters: Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.
6.kjv: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
6.blb: No one is able to serve two masters. For either he will hate the one and he will love the other, or he will hold to one and he will despise the other. You are not able to serve God and mammon.
6.bbe: No man is able to be a servant to two masters: for he will have hate for the one and love for the other, or he will keep to one and have no respect for the other. You may not be servants of God and of wealth.

6.msb: Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat and drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?
6.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
6.blb: Because of this I say to you, do not be anxious for your life, what you might eat or what you might drink, nor for your body, what you might put on. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothing?
6.bbe: So I say to you, Take no thought for your life, about food or drink, or about clothing for your body. Is not life more than food, and the body more than its clothing?
6.heading: Do Not Worry

6.msb: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?
6.kjv: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
6.blb: Look at the birds of the sky, that they do not sow, nor do they reap, nor do they gather into barns, and your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?
6.bbe: See the birds of heaven; they do not put seeds in the earth, they do not get in grain, or put it in store-houses; and your Father in heaven gives them food. Are you not of much more value than they?

6.msb: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?
6.kjv: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
6.blb: And who of you, being anxious, is able to add to his lifespan one cubit?
6.bbe: And which of you by taking thought is able to make himself a cubit taller?

6.msb: And why do you worry about clothes? Consider how the lilies of the field grow: They do not labor or spin.
6.kjv: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
6.blb: And why are you anxious about clothing? Consider carefully the lilies of the field, how they grow: They do not labor, nor do they spin.
6.bbe: And why are you troubled about clothing? See the flowers of the field, how they come up; they do no work, they make no thread:

6.msb: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.
6.kjv: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
6.blb: Yet I say to you that not even Solomon in all his glory was clothed like one of these.
6.bbe: But I say to you that even Solomon in all his glory was not clothed like one of these.

6.msb: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
6.kjv: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
6.blb: But if God thus clothes the grass of the field, being today and tomorrow being thrown into the furnace, will He not much more you, O little of faith?
6.bbe: But if God gives such clothing to the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is put into the oven, will he not much more give you clothing, O you of little faith?

6.msb: Therefore do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’
6.kjv: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
6.blb: Therefore do not be anxious, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘With what shall we be clothed?’
6.bbe: Then do not be full of care, saying, What are we to have for food or drink? or, With what may we be clothed?

6.msb: For the Gentiles strive after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.
6.kjv: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
6.blb: For the nations seek after all these things. For your heavenly Father knows that you have need of all of these.
6.bbe: Because the Gentiles go in search of all these things: for your Father in heaven has knowledge that you have need of all these things:

6.msb: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
6.kjv: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
6.blb: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.
6.bbe: But let your first care be for his kingdom and his righteousness; and all these other things will be given to you in addition.

6.msb: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about the things of itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.
6.kjv: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
6.blb: Therefore do not be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Sufficient to the day is its evil.
6.bbe: Then have no care for tomorrow: tomorrow will take care of itself. Take the trouble of the day as it comes.

7.msb: “Do not judge, or you will be judged.
7.kjv: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
7.blb: “ Do not judge, that you may not be judged.
7.bbe: Be not judges of others, and you will not be judged.
7.heading: Judging Others

7.msb: For with the same judgment you pronounce, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
7.kjv: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
7.blb: For in what judgment you judge, you will be judged; and in what measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
7.bbe: For as you have been judging, so you will be judged, and with your measure will it be measured to you.

7.msb: Why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye but fail to notice the beam in your own eye?
7.kjv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
7.blb: And why do you look at the splinter that is in the eye of your brother, but not notice the beam in your own eye?
7.bbe: And why do you take note of the grain of dust in your brother's eye, but take no note of the bit of wood which is in your eye?

7.msb: How can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye,’ while there is still a beam in your own eye?
7.kjv: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?
7.blb: Or how will you say to your brother, ‘Permit that I might cast out the splinter from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your eye?
7.bbe: Or how will you say to your brother, Let me take out the grain of dust from your eye, when you yourself have a bit of wood in your eye?

7.msb: You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
7.kjv: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother’s eye.
7.blb: Hypocrite! First cast out the beam from your eye, and then you will see clearly to cast out the splinter from the eye of your brother.
7.bbe: You false one, first take out the bit of wood from your eye, then will you see clearly to take out the grain of dust from your brother's eye.

7.msb: Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine. If you do, they may trample them under their feet, and then turn and tear you to pieces.
7.kjv: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
7.blb: Do not give what is holy to the dogs, nor cast your pearls before the pigs, lest they will trample them among their feet and, having turned, tear you to pieces.
7.bbe: Do not give that which is holy to the dogs, or put your jewels before pigs, for fear that they will be crushed under foot by the pigs whose attack will then be made against you.

7.msb: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
7.kjv: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
7.blb: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.
7.bbe: Make a request, and it will be answered; what you are searching for you will get; give the sign, and the door will be open to you:
7.heading: Ask, Seek, Knock

7.msb: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
7.kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
7.blb: For everyone asking receives; and the one seeking finds; and to the one knocking, it will be opened.
7.bbe: Because to everyone who makes a request, it will be given; and he who is searching will get his desire, and to him who gives the sign, the door will be open.

7.msb: Which of you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone?
7.kjv: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
7.blb: Or which man is of you who, if his son will ask for bread, will give to him a stone,
7.bbe: Or which of you, if his son makes a request for bread, will give him a stone?

7.msb: And if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?
7.kjv: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
7.blb: or also, if he will ask for a fish, will give to him a serpent?
7.bbe: Or if he makes a request for a fish, will give him a snake?

7.msb: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!
7.kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
7.blb: Therefore if you, being evil, know to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in the heavens give good things to those asking Him!
7.bbe: If you, then, being evil, are able to give good things to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who make requests to him?

7.msb: In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you. For this is the essence of the Law and the Prophets.
7.kjv: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
7.blb: All things, therefore, as many as you may want that men may do to you, so also you do to them, for this is the Law and the Prophets.
7.bbe: All those things, then, which you would have men do to you, even so do you to them: because this is the law and the prophets.

7.msb: Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.
7.kjv: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
7.blb: Enter through the narrow gate, because wide is the gate and broad the way that is leading to destruction, and many are those entering through it.
7.bbe: Go in by the narrow door; for wide is the door and open is the way which goes to destruction, and great numbers go in by it.
7.heading: The Narrow Gate

7.msb: But small is the gate and narrow the way that leads to life, and only a few find it.
7.kjv: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
7.blb: For narrow is the gate and compressed the way that is leading to life, and few are those finding it.
7.bbe: For narrow is the door and hard the road to life, and only a small number make discovery of it.

7.msb: Beware of false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.
7.kjv: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
7.blb: Beware of the false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravenous wolves.
7.bbe: Be on the watch for false prophets, who come to you in sheep's clothing, but inside they are cruel wolves.
7.heading: A Tree and Its Fruit

7.msb: By their fruit you will recognize them. Are grapes gathered from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?
7.kjv: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
7.blb: From their fruits you will recognize them. Do they gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?
7.bbe: By their fruits you will get knowledge of them. Do men get grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?

7.msb: Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.
7.kjv: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
7.blb: Thus every good tree produces good fruits, but the rotten tree produces evil fruits.
7.bbe: Even so, every good tree gives good fruit; but the bad tree gives evil fruit.

7.msb: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.
7.kjv: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
7.blb: A good tree is not able to produce evil fruits, nor a rotten tree to produce good fruits.
7.bbe: It is not possible for a good tree to give bad fruit, and a bad tree will not give good fruit.

7.msb: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
7.kjv: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
7.blb: Every tree not producing good fruit is cut down and is thrown into fire.
7.bbe: Every tree which does not give good fruit is cut down and put in the fire.

7.msb: So then, by their fruit you will recognize them.
7.kjv: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
7.blb: Therefore from their fruits you will recognize them.
7.bbe: So by their fruits you will get knowledge of them.

7.msb: Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only he who does the will of My Father in heaven.
7.kjv: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
7.blb: Not everyone who is saying to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the kingdom of the heavens, but the one doing the will of My Father who is in the heavens.
7.bbe: Not everyone who says to me, Lord, Lord, will go into the kingdom of heaven; but he who does the pleasure of my Father in heaven.

7.msb: Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and in Your name drive out demons and perform many miracles?’
7.kjv: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
7.blb: Many will say to Me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and in Your name cast out demons, and in Your name do many miracles?’
7.bbe: A great number will say to me on that day, Lord, Lord, were we not prophets in your name, and did we not by your name send out evil spirits, and by your name do works of power?

7.msb: Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’
7.kjv: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
7.blb: And then I will profess to them, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you working lawlessness!’
7.bbe: And then will I say to them, I never had knowledge of you: go from me, you workers of evil.

7.msb: Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them I will liken to a wise man who built his house on the rock.
7.kjv: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
7.blb: Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and does them will be likened to a wise man who built his house on the rock.
7.bbe: Everyone, then, to whom my words come and who does them, will be like a wise man who made his house on a rock;
7.heading: The House on the Rock

7.msb: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house; yet it did not fall, because its foundation was on the rock.
7.kjv: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
7.blb: And the rain came down, and the rivers came, and the winds blew and fell upon that house; and it did not fall, for it had been founded on the rock.
7.bbe: And the rain came down and there was a rush of waters and the winds were driving against that house, but it was not moved; because it was based on the rock.

7.msb: But everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not act on them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.
7.kjv: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
7.blb: And everyone who is hearing these words of Mine and not doing them will be likened to a foolish man who built his house on the sand.
7.bbe: And everyone to whom my words come and who does them not, will be like a foolish man who made his house on sand;

7.msb: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell—and great was its collapse!”
7.kjv: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
7.blb: And the rain came down, and the rivers came, and the winds blew and beat upon that house; and it fell—and its fall was great!”
7.bbe: And the rain came down and there was a rush of waters and the winds were driving against that house; and it came down and great was its fall.

7.msb: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were astonished at His teaching,
7.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
7.blb: And it came to pass when Jesus finished these words that the crowds were astonished at His teaching.
7.bbe: And it came about, when Jesus had come to the end of these words, that the people were surprised at his teaching,
7.heading: The Authority of Jesus

7.msb: because He taught as one who had authority, and not as the scribes.
7.kjv: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
7.blb: For He was teaching them as One having authority, and not as their scribes.
7.bbe: for he was teaching as one having authority, and not as their scribes.

8.msb: When Jesus came down from the mountain, large crowds followed Him.
8.kjv: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
8.blb: And on His having come down from the mountain, many crowds followed Him.
8.bbe: And when he had come down from the mountain, great numbers of people came after him.
8.heading: The Leper’s Prayer

8.msb: Suddenly a leper came and knelt before Him, saying, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”
8.kjv: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
8.blb: And behold, a leper, having come, was kneeling down to Him, saying, “Lord, if You are willing, You are able to cleanse me.”
8.bbe: And a leper came and gave him worship, saying, Lord, if it is your pleasure, you have power to make me clean.

8.msb: Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!” And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
8.kjv: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
8.blb: And having stretched out the hand, He touched him, saying, “I am willing; be cleansed!” And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
8.bbe: And he put his hand on him, saying, It is my pleasure; be clean. And straight away he was made clean.

8.msb: Then Jesus instructed him, “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift prescribed by Moses, as a testimony to them.”
8.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
8.blb: And Jesus says to him, “See that you tell no one. But go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
8.bbe: And Jesus said to him, See that you say nothing about this to anyone; but go and let the priest see you and make the offering which was ordered by Moses, for a witness to them.

8.msb: When Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came and pleaded with Him,
8.kjv: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
8.blb: And on His having entered into Capernaum, a centurion came to Him, imploring Him
8.bbe: And when Jesus was come into Capernaum, a certain captain came to him with a request,
8.heading: The Faith of the Centurion

8.msb: “Lord, my servant lies at home, paralyzed and in terrible agony.”
8.kjv: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
8.blb: and saying, “Lord, my servant is laid in the house a paralytic, terribly tormented.”
8.bbe: Saying, Lord, my servant is ill in bed at the house, with no power in his body, and in great pain.

8.msb: “I will go and heal him,” Jesus replied.
8.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
8.blb: And He says to him, “I, having gone, will heal him.”
8.bbe: And he said to him, I will come and make him well.

8.msb: The centurion answered, “Lord, I am not worthy to have You come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
8.kjv: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
8.blb: But answering, the centurion said, “Lord, I am not fit that You should enter under my roof; but only say a word, and my servant will be healed.
8.bbe: And the captain in answer said, Lord, I am not good enough for you to come under my roof; but only say the word, and my servant will be made well.

8.msb: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes, and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.”
8.kjv: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
8.blb: For I also am a man under authority, having soldiers under me. And I say to this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does.”
8.bbe: Because I myself am a man under authority, having under me fighting men; and I say to this one, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does it.

8.msb: When Jesus heard this, He marveled and said to those following Him, “Truly I tell you, I have not found even in Israel such great faith.
8.kjv: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
8.blb: And having heard, Jesus marveled and said to those following, “Truly I say to you, with no one in Israel did I find such great faith.
8.bbe: And when these words came to the ears of Jesus he was surprised, and said to those who came after him, Truly I say to you, I have not seen such great faith, no, not in Israel.

8.msb: I say to you that many will come from the east and the west to share the banquet with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
8.kjv: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
8.blb: And I say to you that many will come from east and west and will recline with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of the heavens.
8.bbe: And I say to you that numbers will come from the east and the west, and will take their seats with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven:

8.msb: But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
8.kjv: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
8.blb: But the sons of the kingdom will be cast out into the outer darkness—there will be weeping and gnashing of the teeth.”
8.bbe: But the sons of the kingdom will be put out into the dark, and there will be weeping and cries of pain.

8.msb: Then Jesus said to the centurion, “Go! As you have believed, so will it be done for you.” And his servant was healed at that very hour.
8.kjv: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.
8.blb: And Jesus said to the centurion, “Go! As you believed, let it be to you.” And his servant was healed in that very hour.
8.bbe: And Jesus said to the captain, Go in peace; as your faith is, so let it be done to you. And the servant was made well in that hour.

8.msb: When Jesus arrived at Peter’s house, He saw Peter’s mother-in-law sick in bed with a fever.
8.kjv: And when Jesus was come into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother laid, and sick of a fever.
8.blb: And Jesus, having come to the house of Peter, saw his mother-in-law laid and having a fever.
8.bbe: And when Jesus had come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother in bed, very ill.
8.heading: Jesus Heals at Peter’s House

8.msb: So He touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she got up and began to serve Him.
8.kjv: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.
8.blb: And He touched her hand, and the fever left her; and she arose and was serving Him.
8.bbe: And he put his hand on hers and the disease went from her, and she got up and took care of his needs.

8.msb: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to Jesus, and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.
8.kjv: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
8.blb: And evening having come, they brought to Him many being possessed by demons, and He cast out the spirits with a word and healed all those being ill,
8.bbe: And in the evening, they took to him a number of people who had evil spirits; and he sent the spirits out of them with a word, and made well all who were ill;

8.msb: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “He took up our infirmities and carried our diseases.”
8.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
8.blb: so that it might be fulfilled, that having been spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying: “He Himself took our infirmities, and carried the diseases.”
8.bbe: So that the word of Isaiah the prophet might come true: He himself took our pains and our diseases.

8.msb: When Jesus saw large crowds around Him, He gave orders to cross to the other side of the sea.
8.kjv: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
8.blb: And Jesus, having seen a great crowd around Him, commanded to go away to the other side.
8.bbe: Now when Jesus saw a great mass of people about him, he gave an order to go to the other side.
8.heading: The Cost of Discipleship

8.msb: And one of the scribes came to Him and said, “Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.”
8.kjv: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
8.blb: And having come, one scribe said to Him, “Teacher, I will follow You wherever You may go.”
8.bbe: And there came a scribe and said to him, Master, I will come after you wherever you go.

8.msb: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”
8.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
8.blb: And Jesus says to him, “The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere He might lay the head.”
8.bbe: And Jesus said to him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of heaven have a resting-place; but the Son of man has nowhere to put his head.

8.msb: Another of His disciples requested, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”
8.kjv: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
8.blb: And another of His disciples said to Him, “Lord, allow me first to go away and to bury my father.”
8.bbe: And another of the disciples said to him, Lord, let me first go and give the last honours to my father.

8.msb: But Jesus told him, “Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.”
8.kjv: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.
8.blb: But Jesus says to him, “Follow Me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”
8.bbe: But Jesus said to him, Come after me; and let the dead take care of their dead.

8.msb: When He got into the boat, His disciples followed Him.
8.kjv: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
8.blb: And on His having entered into the boat, His disciples followed Him.
8.bbe: And when he had got into a boat, his disciples went after him.
8.heading: Jesus Calms the Storm

8.msb: Suddenly a violent storm came up on the sea, so that the boat was engulfed by the waves. But Jesus was sleeping.
8.kjv: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
8.blb: And behold, a great storm arose in the sea, so that the boat was being covered by the waves; but He Himself was sleeping.
8.bbe: And there came up a great storm in the sea, so that the boat was covered with the waves: but he was sleeping.

8.msb: Then the disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Lord, save us! We are perishing!”
8.kjv: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
8.blb: And having come, they awoke Him, saying, “Lord, save us! We are perishing!”
8.bbe: And they came to him, and, awaking him, said, Help, Lord; destruction is near.

8.msb: “You of little faith,” Jesus replied, “why are you so afraid?” Then He got up and rebuked the winds and the sea, and it was perfectly calm.
8.kjv: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
8.blb: And He says to them, “Why are you cowardly, O little of faith?” Then, having arisen, He rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm.
8.bbe: And he said to them, Why are you full of fear, O you of little faith? Then he got up and gave orders to the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.

8.msb: The men were amazed and asked, “What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the sea obey Him!”
8.kjv: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!
8.blb: And the men marveled, saying, “What kind is this, that even the winds and the sea obey Him?”
8.bbe: And the men were full of wonder, saying, What sort of man is this, that even the winds and the sea do his orders?

8.msb: When Jesus arrived on the other side in the region of the Gergesenes, He was met by two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.
8.kjv: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
8.blb: And on His having come to the other side, to the region of the Gadarenes, two men being possessed by demons met Him, coming out of the tombs, extremely violent, so as for no one to have strength to pass by that way.
8.bbe: And when he had come to the other side, to the country of the Gadarenes, there came out to him from the place of the dead, two who had evil spirits, so violent that no man was able to go that way.
8.heading: The Demons and the Pigs

8.msb: “What do You want with us, Jesus, Son of God?” they shouted. “Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time?”
8.kjv: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
8.blb: And behold, they cried out, saying, “What to us and to You, Son of God? Did You come here to torment us before the time?”
8.bbe: And they gave a loud cry, saying, What have we to do with you, you Son of God? Have you come here to give us punishment before the time?

8.msb: In the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding.
8.kjv: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
8.blb: Now there was far off from them a herd of many pigs feeding.
8.bbe: Now there was, some distance away, a great herd of pigs taking their food.

8.msb: So the demons begged Jesus, “If You drive us out, permit us to go off into the herd of pigs.”
8.kjv: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
8.blb: And the demons were imploring Him, saying, “If You cast us out, send us away into the herd of pigs.”
8.bbe: And the evil spirits made strong prayers to him, saying, If you send us out, let us go into the herd of pigs.

8.msb: “Go!” He told them. So they came out and went into the herd of pigs, and the whole herd of pigs rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters.
8.kjv: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
8.blb: And He said to them, “Go!” And having gone out, they went away into the pigs, and behold, all the herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters.
8.bbe: And he said to them, Go. And they came out, and went into the pigs; and the herd went rushing down a sharp slope into the sea and came to their end in the water.

8.msb: Those tending the pigs ran off into the town and reported all this, including the account of the demon-possessed men.
8.kjv: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
8.blb: And those feeding them fled, and having gone away into the city, they related everything, and the matter of those being possessed by demons.
8.bbe: And their keepers went in flight to the town and gave an account of everything, and of the men who had the evil spirits.

8.msb: Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. And when they saw Him, they begged Him to leave their region.
8.kjv: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
8.blb: And behold, all the city went out to meet Jesus. And having seen Him, they implored Him that He might depart from their borders.
8.bbe: And all the town came out to Jesus; and seeing him they made request that he would go away from their part of the country.

9.msb: Jesus got into a boat, crossed over, and came to His own town.
9.kjv: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
9.blb: And having entered into a boat, He crossed over, and He came into His own city.
9.bbe: And he got into a boat and went across and came to his town.
9.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

9.msb: Just then some men brought to Him a paralytic lying on a mat. When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Take courage, son; your sins are forgiven you.”
9.kjv: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
9.blb: And behold, they were bringing to Him a paralytic lying on a bed. And Jesus, having seen their faith, said to the paralytic, “Take courage, child; your sins are forgiven.”
9.bbe: And they took to him a man stretched on a bed who had no power of moving; and Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the man who was ill, Son, take heart; you have forgiveness for your sins.

9.msb: On seeing this, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man is blaspheming!”
9.kjv: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
9.blb: And behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This One blasphemes!”
9.bbe: And some of the scribes said among themselves, This man has no respect for God.

9.msb: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said, “Why do you harbor evil in your hearts?
9.kjv: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
9.blb: And Jesus, having known their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?
9.bbe: And Jesus, having knowledge of what was in their minds, said, Why are your thoughts evil?

9.msb: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?
9.kjv: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
9.blb: For which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?
9.bbe: For which is the simpler, to say, You have forgiveness for your sins; or to say, Get up and go?

9.msb: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...” Then He said to the paralytic, “Get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”
9.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
9.blb: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on the earth to forgive sins...” Then He says to the paralytic, “Having arisen, take up your mat and go to your house.”
9.bbe: But so that you may see that on earth the Son of man has authority for the forgiveness of sins, (then said he to the man who was ill,) Get up, and take up your bed, and go to your house.

9.msb: And the man got up and went home.
9.kjv: And he arose, and departed to his house.
9.blb: And having arisen, he went away to his house.
9.bbe: And he got up and went away to his house.

9.msb: When the crowds saw this, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
9.kjv: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
9.blb: And the crowds, having seen, feared and glorified God, the One having given such authority to men.
9.bbe: But when the people saw it they were full of fear, and gave glory to God who had given such authority to men.

9.msb: As Jesus went on from there, He saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax booth. “Follow Me,” He told him, and Matthew got up and followed Him.
9.kjv: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
9.blb: And Jesus, passing on from there, saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax booth, and He says to him, “Follow Me.” And having risen up, he followed Him.
9.bbe: And when Jesus was going from there, he saw a man whose name was Matthew, seated at the place where taxes were taken; and he said to him, Come after me. And he got up and went after him.
9.heading: Jesus Calls Matthew

9.msb: Later, as Jesus was dining at Matthew’s house, many tax collectors and sinners came and ate with Him and His disciples.
9.kjv: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
9.blb: And it came to pass in His reclining in the house, that behold, many tax collectors and sinners, having come, were reclining with Jesus and His disciples.
9.bbe: And it came about, when he was in the house taking food, that a number of tax-farmers and sinners came and took their places with Jesus and his disciples.

9.msb: When the Pharisees saw this, they asked His disciples, “Why does your Teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
9.kjv: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
9.blb: And having seen, the Pharisees were saying to His disciples, “Why does your Teacher eat with the tax collectors and sinners?”
9.bbe: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, Why does your Master take food with tax-farmers and sinners?

9.msb: On hearing this, Jesus said to them, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.
9.kjv: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
9.blb: But having heard, He said, “Those being strong have no need of a physician, but those being ill.
9.bbe: But on hearing this he said, Those who are well have no need of a medical man, but those who are ill.

9.msb: But go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice.’ For I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”
9.kjv: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
9.blb: But having gone, learn what is ‘I desire mercy and not sacrifice.’ For I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”
9.bbe: But go and take to heart the sense of these words, My desire is for mercy, not offerings: for I have come not to get the upright, but sinners.

9.msb: Then John’s disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Why is it that we and the Pharisees fast so often, but Your disciples do not fast?”
9.kjv: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
9.blb: Then the disciples of John come to Him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast much, but Your disciples do not fast?”
9.bbe: Then the disciples of John came to him, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees frequently go without food, but your disciples do not?
9.heading: Questions about Fasting

9.msb: Jesus replied, “How can the guests of the bridegroom mourn while He is with them? But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.
9.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
9.blb: And Jesus said to them, “Are the sons of the bridechamber able to mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But days will come when the bridegroom shall have been taken away from them, and then they will fast.
9.bbe: And Jesus said to them, Will the friends of the newly-married man be sad as long as he is with them? But the days will come when he will be taken away from them, and then will they go without food.

9.msb: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. For the patch will pull away from the garment, and a worse tear will result.
9.kjv: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
9.blb: But no one puts a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, for the filling up of it pulls away from the garment, and a worse tear happens.
9.bbe: And no man puts a bit of new cloth on an old coat, for by pulling away from the old, it makes a worse hole.
9.heading: The Patches and the Wineskins

9.msb: Neither do men pour new wine into old wineskins. If they do, the skins will burst, the wine will spill, and the wineskins will be ruined. Instead, they pour new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved.”
9.kjv: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
9.blb: Nor do they put new wine into old wineskins; and if otherwise, the wineskins are burst, and the wine is poured out, and the wineskins are destroyed. But they put new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved.”
9.bbe: And men do not put new wine into old wine-skins; or the skins will be burst and the wine will come out, and the skins are of no more use: but they put new wine into new wine-skins, and so the two will be safe.

9.msb: While Jesus was saying these things, a synagogue leader came and knelt before Him. “My daughter has just died,” he said. “But come and place Your hand on her, and she will live.”
9.kjv: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
9.blb: In His speaking these things to them, behold, one ruler, having come, was kneeling down to Him, saying, “My daughter just now died, but having come, lay Your hand upon her, and she will live.”
9.bbe: While he was saying these things to them, there came a ruler and gave him worship, saying, My daughter is even now dead; but come and put your hand on her, and she will come back to life.
9.heading: The Healing Touch of Jesus

9.msb: So Jesus got up and went with him, along with His disciples.
9.kjv: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
9.blb: And having arisen, Jesus was following him, as well as His disciples.
9.bbe: And Jesus got up and went after him, and so did his disciples.

9.msb: Suddenly a woman who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years came up behind Him and touched the fringe of His cloak.
9.kjv: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:
9.blb: And behold, a woman having a flow of blood twelve years, having come behind Him, touched the fringe of His garment.
9.bbe: And a woman, who for twelve years had had a flow of blood, came after him, and put her hand on the edge of his robe:

9.msb: She said to herself, “If only I touch His cloak, I will be healed.”
9.kjv: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
9.blb: For she was saying within herself, “If only I shall touch His garment, I will be saved.”
9.bbe: Because, she said to herself, if I may but put my hand on his robe, I will be made well.

9.msb: Jesus turned around and saw her. “Take courage, daughter,” He said, “your faith has healed you.” And the woman was healed from that very hour.
9.kjv: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
9.blb: And Jesus, having turned and having seen her, said, “Take courage, daughter; your faith has saved you.” And the woman was saved from that hour.
9.bbe: But Jesus, turning and seeing her, said, Daughter, take heart; your faith has made you well. And the woman was made well from that hour.

9.msb: When Jesus entered the house of the synagogue leader, He saw the flute players and the noisy crowd.
9.kjv: And when Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
9.blb: And Jesus, having come into the house of the ruler and having seen the flute players and the crowd making a commotion,
9.bbe: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house and saw the players with their instruments and the people making a noise,

9.msb: “Go away,” He told them. “The girl is not dead, but asleep.” And they laughed at Him.
9.kjv: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
9.blb: was saying, “Withdraw, for the girl did not die, but sleeps.” And they were laughing at Him.
9.bbe: He said, Make room; for the girl is not dead, but sleeping. And they were laughing at him.

9.msb: After the crowd had been put outside, Jesus went in and took the girl by the hand, and she got up.
9.kjv: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
9.blb: And when the crowd was put outside, having entered, He took hold of her hand, and the girl arose.
9.bbe: But when the people were sent out, he went in and took her by the hand; and the girl got up.

9.msb: And the news about this spread throughout that region.
9.kjv: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
9.blb: And this report went out into all that land.
9.bbe: And the news of it went out into all that land.

9.msb: As Jesus went on from there, two blind men followed Him, crying out, “Have mercy on us, Son of David!”
9.kjv: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of David, have mercy on us.
9.blb: And Jesus passing on from there, two blind men followed Him, crying out and saying, “Have mercy on us, Son of David!”
9.bbe: And when Jesus went on from there, two blind men came after him, crying out, Have mercy on us, you Son of David.
9.heading: Jesus Heals the Blind and Mute

9.msb: After Jesus had entered the house, the blind men came to Him. “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” He asked. “Yes, Lord,” they answered.
9.kjv: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
9.blb: And having come into the house, the blind men came to Him, and Jesus says to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They say to Him, “Yes, Lord.”
9.bbe: And when he had come into the house, the blind men came to him; and Jesus said to them, Have you faith that I am able to do this? They said to him, Yes, Lord.

9.msb: Then He touched their eyes and said, “According to your faith will it be done to you.”
9.kjv: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
9.blb: Then He touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith let it be to you.”
9.bbe: Then he put his hand on their eyes, saying, As your faith is, let it be done to you.

9.msb: And their eyes were opened. Jesus warned them sternly, “See that no one finds out about this!”
9.kjv: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
9.blb: And their eyes were opened. And Jesus strictly instructed them, saying, “See, let no one know!”
9.bbe: And their eyes were made open. And Jesus said to them sharply, Let no man have knowledge of it.

9.msb: But they went out and spread the news about Him throughout the land.
9.kjv: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
9.blb: But having gone out, they reported about Him in all that land.
9.bbe: But they went out and gave news of him in all that land.

9.msb: As they were leaving, a demon-possessed man who was mute was brought to Jesus.
9.kjv: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
9.blb: And in their going out, behold, they brought to Him a mute man possessed by a demon.
9.bbe: And while they were going away, there came to him a man without the power of talking, and with an evil spirit.

9.msb: And when the demon had been driven out, the man began to speak. The crowds were amazed and said, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
9.kjv: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
9.blb: And the demon having been cast out, the mute man spoke. And the crowds marveled, saying, “Never thus was it seen in Israel!”
9.bbe: And when the evil spirit had been sent out, the man had the power of talking: and they were all surprised, saying, Such a thing has never been seen in Israel.

9.msb: But the Pharisees said, “It is by the prince of demons that He drives out demons.”
9.kjv: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
9.blb: But the Pharisees were saying, “By the prince of the demons He casts out the demons.”
9.bbe: But the Pharisees said, By the ruler of evil spirits, he sends evil spirits out of men.

9.msb: Jesus went through all the towns and villages, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.
9.kjv: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
9.blb: And Jesus was going throughout all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and proclaiming the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness.
9.bbe: And Jesus went about all the towns and small places, teaching in their Synagogues and preaching the good news of the kingdom and making well all sorts of disease and pain.
9.heading: The Lord of the Harvest

9.msb: When He saw the crowds, He was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.
9.kjv: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
9.blb: And having seen the crowds, He was moved with compassion for them, because they were wearied and cast away, as sheep not having a shepherd.
9.bbe: But when he saw all the people he was moved with pity for them, because they were troubled and wandering like sheep without a keeper.

9.msb: Then He said to His disciples, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few.
9.kjv: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
9.blb: Then He says to His disciples, “The harvest indeed is much, but the workers are few.
9.bbe: Then he said to his disciples, There is much grain but not enough men to get it in.

9.msb: Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into His harvest.”
9.kjv: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
9.blb: Therefore implore the Lord of the harvest, that He might put forth workers into His harvest.”
9.bbe: Make prayer, then, to the Lord of the grain-fields, that he may send out workers to get in his grain.

10.msb: And calling His twelve disciples to Him, Jesus gave them authority over unclean spirits, so that they could drive them out and heal every disease and sickness.
10.kjv: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
10.blb: And having summoned His twelve disciples, He gave them authority over unclean spirits, so as to cast them out and to heal every disease and every sickness.
10.bbe: And he got together his twelve disciples and gave them the power of driving out unclean spirits, and of making well all sorts of disease and pain.
10.heading: The Twelve Apostles

10.msb: These are the names of the twelve apostles: first Simon, called Peter, and his brother Andrew; James son of Zebedee, and his brother John;
10.kjv: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
10.blb: And these are the names of the twelve apostles: first Simon who is called Peter, and his brother Andrew; and James the son of Zebedee, and his brother John;
10.bbe: Now the names of the twelve are these: The first, Simon, who is named Peter, and Andrew, his brother; James, the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother;

10.msb: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus called Thaddaeus;
10.kjv: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
10.blb: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;
10.bbe: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew, the tax-farmer; James, the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;

10.msb: Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus.
10.kjv: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
10.blb: Simon the Cananean, and Judas Iscariot, the one also having betrayed Him.
10.bbe: Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, who was false to him.

10.msb: These twelve Jesus sent out with the following instructions: “Do not go onto the road of the Gentiles or enter any town of the Samaritans.
10.kjv: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
10.blb: These twelve Jesus sent forth, having instructed them, saying: “Do not go into the way of the Gentiles, and into a city of the Samaritans do not enter.
10.bbe: These twelve Jesus sent out and gave them orders, saying, Do not go among the Gentiles, or into any town of Samaria,
10.heading: The Ministry of the Twelve

10.msb: Go rather to the lost sheep of Israel.
10.kjv: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
10.blb: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
10.bbe: But go to the wandering sheep of the house of Israel,

10.msb: As you go, preach this message: ‘The kingdom of heaven is near.’
10.kjv: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
10.blb: And going, proclaim, saying, ‘The kingdom of the heavens has drawn near.’
10.bbe: And, on your way, say, The kingdom of heaven is near.

10.msb: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, drive out demons. Freely you have received; freely give.
10.kjv: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
10.blb: Heal the ailing, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, cast out demons. Freely you received; freely give.
10.bbe: Make well those who are ill, give life to the dead, make lepers clean, send evil spirits out of men; freely it has been given to you, freely give.

10.msb: Do not take along any gold or silver or copper in your belts.
10.kjv: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
10.blb: Acquire neither gold nor silver nor copper in your belts,
10.bbe: Take no gold or silver or copper in your pockets;

10.msb: Take no bag for the road, or second tunic, or sandals, or staffs; for the worker is worthy of his provisions.
10.kjv: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
10.blb: nor a bag for the way, nor two tunics, nor sandals, nor a staff; for the worker is worthy of his food.
10.bbe: Take no bag for your journey and do not take two coats or shoes or a stick: for the workman has a right to his food.

10.msb: Whatever town or village you enter, find out who is worthy there and stay at his house until you move on.
10.kjv: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
10.blb: And into whatever city or village you may enter, inquire who is worthy in it, and remain there until you may go out.
10.bbe: And into whatever town or small place you go, make search there for someone who is respected, and make his house your resting-place till you go away.

10.msb: As you enter the home, greet its occupants.
10.kjv: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
10.blb: And entering into the house, greet it.
10.bbe: And when you go in, say, May peace be on this house.

10.msb: If the home is worthy, let your peace rest on it, but if it is not, let your peace return to you.
10.kjv: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
10.blb: And if indeed the house is worthy, let your peace come upon it; but if it is not worthy, let your peace return to you.
10.bbe: And if the house is good enough, let your peace come on it: but if not, let your peace come back to you.

10.msb: And if anyone will not welcome you or heed your words, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that home or town.
10.kjv: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
10.blb: And whoever may not receive you nor hear your words, going forth out of the house or that city, shake off the dust of your feet.
10.bbe: And whoever will not take you in, or give ear to your words, when you go out from that house or that town, put off its dust from your feet.

10.msb: Truly I tell you, it will be more bearable for Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that town.
10.kjv: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
10.blb: Truly I say to you, it will be more bearable for the land of Sodom and of Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.
10.bbe: Truly I say to you, It will be better for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of God's judging than for that town.

10.msb: Behold, I am sending you out like sheep among wolves; therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves.
10.kjv: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
10.blb: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves; therefore be shrewd as the serpents and innocent as the doves.
10.bbe: See, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Be then as wise as snakes, and as gentle as doves.
10.heading: Sheep among Wolves

10.msb: But beware of men, for they will hand you over to their councils and flog you in their synagogues.
10.kjv: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
10.blb: But beware of men; for they will deliver you up into the councils, and in their synagogues they will flog you.
10.bbe: But be on the watch against men: for they will give you up to the Sanhedrins, and in their Synagogues they will give you blows;

10.msb: On My account you will be brought before governors and kings as witnesses to them and to the Gentiles.
10.kjv: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
10.blb: And you will be led before governors and also kings on account of Me, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
10.bbe: And you will come before rulers and kings because of me, for a witness to them and to the Gentiles.

10.msb: But when they hand you over, do not worry about how to respond or what to say. In that hour you will be given what to say.
10.kjv: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
10.blb: And when they may deliver you up, do not be anxious how or what you shall speak; for it will be given to you in that hour what you shall speak.
10.bbe: But when you are given up into their hands, do not be troubled about what to say or how to say it: for in that hour what you are to say will be given to you;

10.msb: For it will not be you speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.
10.kjv: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
10.blb: For you are not the ones speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking in you.
10.bbe: Because it is not you who say the words, but the Spirit of your Father in you.

10.msb: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
10.kjv: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
10.blb: And brother will deliver up brother to death, and father, child; and children will rise up against parents and will put them to death.
10.bbe: And brother will give up brother to death, and the father his child: and children will go against their fathers and mothers, and put them to death.

10.msb: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
10.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
10.blb: And you will be hated by all because of My name; but the one having endured to the end, this one will be saved.
10.bbe: And you will be hated by all men because of my name: but he who is strong to the end will have salvation.

10.msb: When they persecute you in one town, flee to another. Truly I tell you, you will not reach all the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes.
10.kjv: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
10.blb: And when they may persecute you in one city, flee to the other. For truly I say to you, you shall not have completed the cities of Israel until the Son of Man shall come.
10.bbe: But when they are cruel to you in one town, go in flight to another: for truly, I say to you, You will not have gone through the towns of Israel before the Son of man comes.

10.msb: A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master.
10.kjv: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
10.blb: A disciple is not above the teacher, nor a servant above his master.
10.bbe: A disciple is not greater than his master, or a servant than his lord.

10.msb: It is enough for a disciple to be like his teacher, and a servant like his master. If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, how much more the members of his household!
10.kjv: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
10.blb: Aufficient to the disciple is that he may become like his teacher, and the servant like his master. If the master of the house they have called Beelzebul, how much more the members of his household!
10.bbe: It is enough for the disciple that he may be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have given the name Beelzebub to the master of the house, how much more to those of his house!

10.msb: So do not be afraid of them. For there is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.
10.kjv: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
10.blb: Therefore do not fear them. For nothing is concealed that will not be revealed, and hidden that will not be known.
10.bbe: Have, then, no fear of them: because nothing is covered which will not come to light, or secret which will not be made clear.
10.heading: Fear God Alone

10.msb: What I tell you in the dark, speak in the daylight; what is whispered in your ear, proclaim from the housetops.
10.kjv: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.
10.blb: What I say to you in the darkness, say in the light; and what you hear in the ear, proclaim upon the housetops.
10.bbe: What I say to you in the dark, say in the light: and what comes to your ear secretly, say publicly from the house-tops.

10.msb: Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Instead, fear the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell.
10.kjv: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
10.blb: And do not be afraid of those killing the body but not being able to kill the soul. But fear, rather, the One being able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.
10.bbe: And have no fear of those who put to death the body, but are not able to put to death the soul. But have fear of him who has power to give soul and body to destruction in hell.

10.msb: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.
10.kjv: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
10.blb: Are not two sparrows sold for an assarion? And not one of them will fall to the ground apart from your Father.
10.bbe: Are not sparrows two a farthing? and not one of them comes to an end without your Father:

10.msb: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
10.kjv: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
10.blb: And even the hairs of your head are all numbered.
10.bbe: But the hairs of your head are all numbered.

10.msb: So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
10.kjv: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
10.blb: Therefore do not be afraid; you are more valuable than many sparrows.
10.bbe: Then have no fear; you are of more value than a flock of sparrows.

10.msb: Therefore everyone who confesses Me before men, I will also confess him before My Father in heaven.
10.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
10.blb: Therefore everyone who will confess in Me before men, I will also confess in him before My Father who is in the heavens.
10.bbe: To everyone, then, who gives witness to me before men, I will give witness before my Father in heaven.
10.heading: Confessing Christ

10.msb: But whoever denies Me before men, I will also deny him before My Father in heaven.
10.kjv: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
10.blb: But whoever shall deny Me before men, I also will deny him before My Father who is in the heavens.
10.bbe: But if anyone says before men that he has no knowledge of me, I will say that I have no knowledge of him before my Father in heaven.

10.msb: Do not assume that I have come to bring peace to the earth; I have not come to bring peace, but a sword.
10.kjv: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
10.blb: Do not think that I came to cast peace upon the earth; I did not come to cast peace, but a sword.
10.bbe: Do not have the thought that I have come to send peace on the earth; I came not to send peace but a sword.
10.heading: Not Peace but a Sword

10.msb: For I have come to turn ‘a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
10.kjv: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
10.blb: For I came to set at variance: ‘A man against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
10.bbe: For I have come to put a man against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law:

10.msb: A man’s enemies will be the members of his own household.’
10.kjv: And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household.
10.blb: And the enemies of the man are the members of his household.’
10.bbe: And a man will be hated by those of his house.

10.msb: Anyone who loves his father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me; anyone who loves his son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me;
10.kjv: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
10.blb: The one loving father or mother above Me is not worthy of Me, and the one loving son or daughter above Me is not worthy of Me.
10.bbe: He who has more love for his father or mother than for me is not good enough for me; he who has more love for son or daughter than for me is not good enough for me.

10.msb: and anyone who does not take up his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me.
10.kjv: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
10.blb: And whoever does not take his cross and follow after Me is not worthy of Me.
10.bbe: And he who does not take his cross and come after me is not good enough for me.

10.msb: Whoever finds his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
10.kjv: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
10.blb: The one having found his life will lose it, and the one having lost his life on account of Me will find it.
10.bbe: He who has the desire to keep his life will have it taken from him, and he who gives up his life because of me will have it given back to him.

10.msb: He who receives you receives Me, and he who receives Me receives the One who sent Me.
10.kjv: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
10.blb: The one receiving you receives Me, and the one receiving Me receives the One having sent Me.
10.bbe: He who gives honour to you gives honour to me; and he who gives honour to me gives honour to him who sent me.
10.heading: The Reward of Service

10.msb: Whoever receives a prophet because he is a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward, and whoever receives a righteous man because he is a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.
10.kjv: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet’s reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man’s reward.
10.blb: The one receiving a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive the reward of a prophet, and the one receiving a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive the reward of a righteous man.
10.bbe: He who gives honour to a prophet, in the name of a prophet, will be given a prophet's reward; and he who gives honour to an upright man, in the name of an upright man, will be given an upright man's reward.

10.msb: And if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is My disciple, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.”
10.kjv: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
10.blb: And whoever shall give to drink to one of these little ones merely a cup of cold water in the name of a disciple, truly I say to you, he shall certainly not lose his reward.”
10.bbe: And whoever gives to one of these little ones a cup of cold water only, in the name of a disciple, truly I say to you, he will not go without his reward.

11.msb: After Jesus had finished instructing His twelve disciples, He went on from there to teach and preach in their cities.
11.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
11.blb: And it came to pass, when Jesus finished commanding His twelve disciples, that He departed from there to teach and to preach in their cities.
11.bbe: And it came about that when Jesus had come to the end of giving these orders to his twelve disciples, he went away from there, teaching and preaching in their towns.
11.heading: John’s Inquiry

11.msb: Meanwhile John heard in prison about the works of Christ, and he sent two of his disciples
11.kjv: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
11.blb: And John, having heard in the prison the works of the Christ, having sent through his disciples,
11.bbe: Now when John had news in prison of the works of the Christ, he sent his disciples

11.msb: to ask Him, “Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?”
11.kjv: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?
11.blb: said to Him, “Are You the coming One, or do we look for another?”
11.bbe: To say to him, Are you he who is to come, or are we waiting for another?

11.msb: Jesus replied, “Go back and report to John what you hear and see:
11.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:
11.blb: And answering, Jesus said to them, “Having gone, report to John what you hear and see:
11.bbe: And Jesus, answering, said to them, Go and give news to John of the things which you are seeing and hearing:
