11.msb: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.
11.kjv: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
11.blb: The blind receive sight and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed and the deaf hear and the dead are raised and the poor have good news proclaimed.
11.bbe: The blind see; those who were not able to, are walking; lepers are made clean; those who were without hearing, now have their ears open; the dead come to life again, and the poor have the good news given to them.

11.msb: Blessed is the one who does not fall away on account of Me.”
11.kjv: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
11.blb: And blessed is the one who shall not be caused to stumble in Me.”
11.bbe: And a blessing will be on him who has no doubts about me.

11.msb: As John’s disciples were leaving, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?
11.kjv: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
11.blb: And as these are going, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
11.bbe: And when they were going away, Jesus, talking of John, said to all the people, What went you out into the waste land to see? a tall stem moving in the wind?
11.heading: Jesus Testifies about John

11.msb: Otherwise, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Look, those who wear fine clothing are found in kings’ palaces.
11.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.
11.blb: But what did you go out to see? A man having been dressed in soft garments? Behold, those wearing soft garments are in the houses of kings.
11.bbe: But what went you out to see? a man delicately clothed? Those who have fair robes are in kings' houses.

11.msb: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
11.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
11.blb: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I say to you, and one more than a prophet.
11.bbe: But why did you go out? to see a prophet? Yes, I say to you, and more than a prophet.

11.msb: For this is the one about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way before You.’
11.kjv: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
11.blb: This is he about whom it has been written: ‘Behold, I send My messenger before Your face, who will prepare Your way before You.’
11.bbe: This is he of whom it has been said, See, I send my servant before your face, who will make ready your way before you.

11.msb: Truly I tell you, among those born of women there has risen no one greater than John the Baptist. Yet even the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
11.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
11.blb: Truly I say to you, among those born of women there has not risen one greater than John the Baptist. Yet the least in the kingdom of the heavens is greater than he.
11.bbe: Truly I say to you, Among the sons of women there has not been a greater than John the Baptist: but he who is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

11.msb: From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven has been subject to violence, and the violent lay claim to it.
11.kjv: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
11.blb: And from the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of the heavens is subject to violence, and the violent seize it.
11.bbe: And from the days of John the Baptist till now, the kingdom of heaven is forcing its way in, and men of force take it.

11.msb: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.
11.kjv: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
11.blb: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.
11.bbe: For all the prophets and the law were in force till John.

11.msb: And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.
11.kjv: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.
11.blb: And if you are willing to receive it, he is Elijah, the one being about to come.
11.bbe: And if you are able to see it, this is Elijah who was to come.

11.msb: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
11.kjv: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
11.blb: The one having ears, let him hear!
11.bbe: He who has ears, let him give ear.

11.msb: To what can I compare this generation? They are like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to one another:
11.kjv: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,
11.blb: But to what will I liken this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others,
11.bbe: But what comparison may I make of this generation? It is like children seated in the market-places, crying out to one another,

11.msb: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge for you, and you did not mourn.’
11.kjv: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.
11.blb: saying: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn.’
11.bbe: We made music for you and you did not take part in the dance; we gave cries of sorrow and you made no signs of grief.

11.msb: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon!’
11.kjv: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
11.blb: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon!’
11.bbe: For John came, taking no food or drink, and they say, He has an evil spirit.

11.msb: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Look at this glutton and drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is vindicated by her children.”
11.kjv: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.
11.blb: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a man, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and of sinners!’ But wisdom was justified from her works.”
11.bbe: The Son of man has come feasting, and they say, See, a lover of food and wine, a friend of tax-farmers and sinners! And wisdom is judged to be right by her works.

11.msb: Then Jesus began to denounce the cities in which most of His miracles had been performed, because they did not repent.
11.kjv: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
11.blb: Then He began to reproach the cities in which most of His miracles happened, because they did not repent.
11.bbe: Then he went on to say hard things to the towns where most of his works of power were done, because they had not been turned from their sins.
11.heading: Woe to the Unrepentant

11.msb: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
11.kjv: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
11.blb: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles having happened in you had happened in Tyre and Sidon, long ago in sackcloth and ashes they would have repented.
11.bbe: Unhappy are you, Chorazin! Unhappy are you, Beth-saida! For if the works of power which were done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have been turned from their sins in days gone by, clothing themselves in haircloth and putting dust on their heads.

11.msb: But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
11.kjv: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
11.blb: But I say to you, for Tyre and Sidon it will be more bearable in the day of judgment than for you.
11.bbe: But I say to you, It will be better for Tyre and Sidon in the day of judging, than for you.

11.msb: And you, Capernaum, which is lifted up to heaven, will be brought down to Hades! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.
11.kjv: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
11.blb: And you, Capernaum, to heaven will you be lifted up? To Hades you will be brought down! For if the miracles having happened in you had happened in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
11.bbe: And you, Capernaum, were you not to be lifted up to heaven? you will go down into hell: for if the works of power which were done in you had been done in Sodom, it would have been here to this day.

11.msb: But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you.”
11.kjv: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
11.blb: But I say to you that it will be more bearable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment than for you.”
11.bbe: But I say to you that it will be better for the land of Sodom in the day of judging, than for you.

11.msb: At that time Jesus declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.
11.kjv: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.
11.blb: In that time, answering, Jesus said, “I acknowledge You, Father, Lord of the heaven and of the earth, because You hid these things from the wise and intelligent, and You revealed them to little children.
11.bbe: At that time Jesus made answer and said, I give praise to you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have kept these things secret from the wise and the men of learning, and have made them clear to little children.
11.heading: Rest for the Weary

11.msb: Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.
11.kjv: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
11.blb: Yes, Father, because of this it was good pleasure before You.
11.bbe: Yes, Father, for so it was pleasing in your eyes.

11.msb: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.
11.kjv: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
11.blb: All things were delivered to Me by My Father. And no one knows the Son except the Father, nor does anyone know the Father except the Son and the one to whom the Son may resolve to reveal Him.
11.bbe: All things have been given to me by my Father; and no one has knowledge of the Son, but the Father; and no one has knowledge of the Father, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will make it clear.

11.msb: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
11.kjv: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
11.blb: Come to Me, all those toiling and burdened, and I will give you rest.
11.bbe: Come to me, all you who are troubled and weighted down with care, and I will give you rest.

11.msb: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
11.kjv: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
11.blb: Take up My yoke upon you and learn from Me, because I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
11.bbe: Take my yoke on you and become like me, for I am gentle and without pride, and you will have rest for your souls;

11.msb: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”
11.kjv: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
11.blb: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”
11.bbe: For my yoke is good, and the weight I take up is not hard.

12.msb: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry and began to pick the heads of grain and eat them.
12.kjv: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
12.blb: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbaths, and His disciples were hungry, and they began to pluck the heads of grain and to eat.
12.bbe: At that time Jesus went through the fields on the Sabbath day; and his disciples, being in need of food, were taking the heads of grain.
12.heading: The Lord of the Sabbath

12.msb: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to Him, “Look, Your disciples are doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath.”
12.kjv: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
12.blb: And the Pharisees, having seen, said to Him, “Behold, Your disciples do what it is not lawful to do on a Sabbath.”
12.bbe: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, See, your disciples do that which it is not right to do on the Sabbath.

12.msb: Jesus replied, “Have you not read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
12.kjv: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
12.blb: And He said to them, “Did you not read what David did when he was hungry, and those with him—
12.bbe: But he said to them, Have you no knowledge of what David did when he had need of food, and those who were with him?

12.msb: He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread, which was not lawful for them to eat, but only for the priests.
12.kjv: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
12.blb: how he entered into the house of God, and they ate the loaves of the presentation, which it was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those with him, except for the priests only?
12.bbe: How he went into the house of God and took for food the holy bread which it was not right for him or for those who were with him to take, but only for the priests?

12.msb: Or haven’t you read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple break the Sabbath and yet are innocent?
12.kjv: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
12.blb: Or did you not read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?
12.bbe: Or is it not said in the law, how the Sabbath is broken by the priests in the Temple and they do no wrong?

12.msb: But I tell you that One greater than the temple is here.
12.kjv: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
12.blb: But I say to you that a greater One than the temple is here.
12.bbe: But I say to you that a greater thing than the Temple is here.

12.msb: If only you had known the meaning of ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.
12.kjv: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
12.blb: But if you had known what is ‘I desire mercy and not sacrifice,’ then you would not have condemned the guiltless.
12.bbe: But if these words had been in your minds, My desire is for mercy and not for offerings, you would not have been judging those who have done no wrong.

12.msb: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
12.kjv: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
12.blb: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
12.bbe: For the Son of man is lord of the Sabbath.

12.msb: Moving on from there, Jesus entered their synagogue,
12.kjv: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
12.blb: And having departed from there, He went into their synagogue.
12.bbe: And he went from there into their Synagogue:
12.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

12.msb: and a man with a withered hand was there. In order to accuse Jesus, they asked Him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
12.kjv: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
12.blb: And behold, a man having a withered hand, and they asked Him, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbaths?” so that they might accuse Him.
12.bbe: And there was a man with a dead hand. And they put a question to him, saying, Is it right to make a man well on the Sabbath day? so that they might have something against him.

12.msb: He replied, “If one of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will he not take hold of it and lift it out?
12.kjv: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
12.blb: And He said to them, “What man will there be of you who will have one sheep, and if this one should fall into a pit on the Sabbaths, will not take hold of it and will raise it up?
12.bbe: And he said to them, Which of you, having a sheep, if it gets into a hole on the Sabbath day, will not put out a helping hand and get it back?

12.msb: How much more valuable is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath.”
12.kjv: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
12.blb: How much more valuable, therefore, is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful on the Sabbaths to do good.”
12.bbe: Of how much more value is a man than a sheep! For this reason it is right to do good on the Sabbath day.

12.msb: Then Jesus said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” So he stretched it out, and it was restored to full use, just like the other.
12.kjv: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
12.blb: Then He says to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” And he stretched it out, and it was restored, sound as the other.
12.bbe: Then said he to the man, Put out your hand. And he put it out, and it was made as well as the other.

12.msb: But the Pharisees went out and plotted how they might kill Jesus.
12.kjv: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
12.blb: And the Pharisees, having gone out, took counsel against Him, how they might destroy Him.
12.bbe: But the Pharisees went out and made designs against him, how they might put him to death.

12.msb: Aware of this, Jesus withdrew from that place. Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them all,
12.kjv: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
12.blb: And Jesus, having known, withdrew from there. And many crowds followed Him, and He healed them all,
12.bbe: And Jesus, having knowledge of this, went away from there, and a great number went after him; and he made them all well,
12.heading: God’s Chosen Servant

12.msb: warning them not to make Him known.
12.kjv: And charged them that they should not make him known:
12.blb: and He warned them that they should not make Him known,
12.bbe: Ordering them not to give people word of him:

12.msb: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
12.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
12.blb: so that it might be fulfilled, that having been spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying:
12.bbe: So that what was said by Isaiah the prophet might come true,

12.msb: “Here is My Servant, whom I have chosen, My beloved, in whom My soul delights. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will proclaim justice to the nations.
12.kjv: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
12.blb: “Behold My servant, whom I chose, My Beloved, in whom My soul was well pleased. I will put My Spirit upon Him, and He will proclaim judgment to the nations.
12.bbe: See my servant, the man of my selection, my loved one in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my Spirit on him, and he will make my decision clear to the Gentiles.

12.msb: He will not quarrel or cry out; no one will hear His voice in the streets.
12.kjv: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
12.blb: He will not quarrel, nor will He cry out; nor will anyone hear His voice in the streets.
12.bbe: His coming will not be with fighting or loud cries; and his voice will not be lifted up in the streets.

12.msb: A bruised reed He will not break, and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish, till He leads justice to victory.
12.kjv: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
12.blb: A bruised reed He will not break, and a smoldering wick He will not quench, until He should put forth judgment to victory.
12.bbe: The crushed stem will not be broken by him; and the feebly burning light will he not put out, till he has made righteousness overcome all.

12.msb: In His name the nations will put their hope.”
12.kjv: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
12.blb: And in His name the nations will hope.”
12.bbe: And in his name will the Gentiles put their hope.

12.msb: Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute was brought to Jesus, and He healed the man so that the blind and mute man could both speak and see.
12.kjv: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
12.blb: Then was brought to Him one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, and He healed him, in order for the mute man to speak and to see.
12.bbe: Then they took to him one with an evil spirit, who was blind and had no power of talking: and he made him well so that he had the power of talking and seeing.
12.heading: A House Divided

12.msb: The crowds were astounded and asked, “Could this be the Son of David?”
12.kjv: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
12.blb: And all the crowds were amazed and were saying, “Is this the Son of David?”
12.bbe: And all the people were surprised and said, Is not this the Son of David?

12.msb: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, “Only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, does this man drive out demons.”
12.kjv: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
12.blb: And the Pharisees, having heard, said, “This man does not cast out the demons except by Beelzebul, ruler of the demons.”
12.bbe: But the Pharisees, hearing of it, said, This man only sends evil spirits out of men by Beelzebub, the ruler of evil spirits.

12.msb: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.
12.kjv: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
12.blb: And knowing their thoughts, He said to them, “Every kingdom having been divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house having been divided against itself will not stand.
12.bbe: And having knowledge of their thoughts he said to them, Every kingdom having division in itself is made waste, and every town or house having division in itself will come to destruction.

12.msb: If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then can his kingdom stand?
12.kjv: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
12.blb: And if Satan casts out Satan, he was divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?
12.bbe: And if Satan sends out Satan, he makes war against himself; how then will he keep his kingdom?

12.msb: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
12.kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
12.blb: And if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons cast them out? Because of this, they will be your judges.
12.bbe: And if I by Beelzebub send evil spirits out of men, by whom do your sons send them out? So let them be your judges.

12.msb: But if I drive out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
12.kjv: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
12.blb: But if I cast out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
12.bbe: But if I by the Spirit of God send out evil spirits, then is the kingdom of God come on you.

12.msb: Or again, how can anyone enter a strong man’s house and steal his possessions, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can plunder his house.
12.kjv: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
12.blb: Or how is anyone able to enter into the house of the strong man and to plunder his goods, unless first he should bind the strong man? And then he will plunder his house.
12.bbe: Or how may one go into a strong man's house and take his goods, if he does not first put cords round the strong man? and then he may take his goods.

12.msb: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.
12.kjv: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
12.blb: The one not being with Me is against Me, and the one not gathering with Me scatters.
12.bbe: Whoever is not with me is against me; and he who does not take part with me in getting people together, is driving them away.

12.msb: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.
12.kjv: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
12.blb: Because of this I say to you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men; but the blasphemy of the Spirit will not be forgiven.
12.bbe: So I say to you, Every sin and every evil word against God will have forgiveness; but for evil words against the Spirit there will be no forgiveness.
12.heading: The Unpardonable Sin

12.msb: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in the present age or in the one to come.
12.kjv: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
12.blb: And whoever may speak a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever may speak against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him—neither in this age nor in the coming one.
12.bbe: And whoever says a word against the Son of man, will have forgiveness; but whoever says a word against the Holy Spirit, will not have forgiveness in this life or in that which is to come.

12.msb: Make a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad, for a tree is known by its fruit.
12.kjv: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
12.blb: Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree rotten and its fruit rotten. For by the fruit, the tree is known.
12.bbe: Make the tree good, and its fruit good; or make the tree bad, and its fruit bad; for by its fruit you will get knowledge of the tree.
12.heading: Good and Bad Fruit

12.msb: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For out of the overflow of the heart the mouth speaks.
12.kjv: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
12.blb: Offspring of vipers, how are you able to speak good things, being evil? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.
12.bbe: You offspring of snakes, how are you, being evil, able to say good things? because out of the heart's store come the words of the mouth.

12.msb: The good man brings good things out of his good store of treasure, and the evil man brings evil things out of his evil store of treasure.
12.kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
12.blb: The good man out of his good treasure puts forth good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure puts forth evil things.
12.bbe: The good man out of his good store gives good things; and the evil man out of his evil store gives evil things.

12.msb: But I tell you that men will give an account on the day of judgment for every careless word they have spoken.
12.kjv: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
12.blb: And I say to you that every careless word that men will speak, they will give an account concerning it in the day of judgment.
12.bbe: And I say to you that in the day when they are judged, men will have to give an account of every foolish word they have said.

12.msb: For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.”
12.kjv: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
12.blb: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”
12.bbe: For by your words will your righteousness be seen, and by your words you will be judged.

12.msb: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees said, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from You.”
12.kjv: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
12.blb: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees answered Him, saying, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from You.”
12.bbe: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees, hearing this, said to him, Master, we are looking for a sign from you.
12.heading: The Sign of Jonah

12.msb: Jesus replied, “A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
12.kjv: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
12.blb: And answering, He said to them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah the prophet.
12.bbe: But he, answering, said to them, An evil and false generation is looking for a sign; and no sign will be given to it but the sign of the prophet Jonah:

12.msb: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
12.kjv: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
12.blb: For just as Jonah was in the belly of the great fish three days and three nights, so the Son of Man will be in the heart of the earth three days and three nights.
12.bbe: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the stomach of the great fish, so will the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

12.msb: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now One greater than Jonah is here.
12.kjv: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
12.blb: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and behold, One greater than Jonah is here.
12.bbe: The men of Nineveh will come up in the day of judging and give their decision against this generation: because they were turned from their sins at the preaching of Jonah; and now a greater than Jonah is here.

12.msb: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here.
12.kjv: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
12.blb: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and behold, One greater than Solomon is here.
12.bbe: The queen of the South will come up in the day of judging and give her decision against this generation: for she came from the ends of the earth to give ear to the wisdom of Solomon; and now a greater than Solomon is here.

12.msb: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.
12.kjv: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
12.blb: Now when the unclean spirit may go out from the man, it passes through waterless places seeking rest and does not find it.
12.bbe: But the unclean spirit, when he is gone out of a man, goes through dry places looking for rest, and getting it not.
12.heading: An Unclean Spirit Returns

12.msb: Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ On its return, it finds the house vacant, swept clean, and put in order.
12.kjv: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
12.blb: Then it says, ‘I will return to my house from which I came out.’ And having come, it finds it being unoccupied, and swept, and put in order.
12.bbe: Then he says, I will go back into my house from which I came out; and when he comes, he sees that there is no one in it, but that it has been made fair and clean.

12.msb: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and dwell there. And the final plight of that man is worse than the first. So will it be with this wicked generation.”
12.kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
12.blb: Then it goes and takes along with itself seven other spirits more evil than itself, and having entered, they dwell there; and the last of that man becomes worse than the first. So also will it be to this evil generation.”
12.bbe: Then he goes and takes with him seven other spirits worse than himself, and they go in and make it their living-place: and the last condition of that man is worse than the first. Even so will it be with this evil generation.

12.msb: While Jesus was still speaking to the crowds, His mother and brothers stood outside, wanting to speak to Him.
12.kjv: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
12.blb: Now in His still speaking to the crowds, behold, His mother and brothers had stood outside, seeking to speak to Him.
12.bbe: While he was still talking to the people, his mother and his brothers came, desiring to have talk with him.
12.heading: Jesus’ Mother and Brothers

12.msb: Someone told Him, “Look, Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to You.”
12.kjv: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
12.blb: And someone said to Him, “Behold, Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside, seeking to speak to You.”
12.bbe: And one said to him, See, your mother and your brothers are outside, desiring to have talk with you.

12.msb: But Jesus replied, “Who is My mother, and who are My brothers?”
12.kjv: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
12.blb: And answering, He said to the one speaking to Him, “Who is My mother, and who are My brothers?”
12.bbe: But he in answer said to him who gave the news, Who is my mother and who are my brothers?

12.msb: Pointing to His disciples, He said, “Here are My mother and My brothers.
12.kjv: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
12.blb: And having stretched out His hand to His disciples, He said, “Behold, My mother and My brothers.
12.bbe: And he put out his hand to his disciples and said, See, my mother and my brothers!

12.msb: For whoever does the will of My Father in heaven is My brother and sister and mother.”
12.kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
12.blb: For whoever shall do the will of My Father who is in the heavens, he is My brother and sister and mother.”
12.bbe: For whoever does the pleasure of my Father in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.

13.msb: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the sea.
13.kjv: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
13.blb: In that day, Jesus, having gone out of the house, was sitting by the sea.
13.bbe: On that day Jesus went out of the house and was seated by the seaside.
13.heading: The Parable of the Sower

13.msb: Such large crowds gathered around Him that He got into the boat and sat down, while all the people stood on the shore.
13.kjv: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
13.blb: And many crowds were gathered together to Him so that He, having entered into a boat, sat down, and all the crowd stood on the shore.
13.bbe: And great numbers of people came together to him, so that he got into a boat; and the people took up their position by the sea.

13.msb: And He told them many things in parables, saying, “A farmer went out to sow his seed.
13.kjv: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
13.blb: And He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, the one sowing went out to sow.
13.bbe: And he gave them teaching in the form of a story, saying, A man went out to put seed in the earth;

13.msb: And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.
13.kjv: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
13.blb: And in his sowing, some indeed fell along the path, and the birds, having come, devoured them.
13.bbe: And while he did so, some seeds were dropped by the wayside, and the birds came and took them for food:

13.msb: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.
13.kjv: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
13.blb: And others fell upon the rocky places, where it did not have much soil, and immediately it sprang up because of it not having depth of soil.
13.bbe: And some of the seed went among the stones, where it had not much earth, and straight away it came up because the earth was not deep:

13.msb: But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
13.kjv: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
13.blb: And the sun having risen, they were scorched, and because of not having root, they withered.
13.bbe: And when the sun was high, it was burned; and because it had no root it became dry and dead.

13.msb: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings.
13.kjv: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
13.blb: And others fell upon the thorns, and the thorns came up and choked them.
13.bbe: And some seeds went among thorns, and the thorns came up and they had no room for growth:

13.msb: Still other seed fell on good soil and produced a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.
13.kjv: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
13.blb: And others fell upon the good soil and were giving fruit—some indeed a hundredfold, and some sixty, and some thirty.
13.bbe: And some, falling on good earth, gave fruit, some a hundred, some sixty, some thirty times as much.

13.msb: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
13.kjv: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
13.blb: The one having ears, let him hear.”
13.bbe: He who has ears, let him give ear.

13.msb: Then the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Why do You speak to the people in parables?”
13.kjv: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
13.blb: And having come, the disciples said to Him, “Why do You speak to them in parables?”
13.bbe: And the disciples came and said to him, Why do you say things to them in the form of stories?
13.heading: The Purpose of Jesus’ Parables

13.msb: He replied, “The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.
13.kjv: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
13.blb: And answering, He said to them, “Because to you it has been given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of the heavens, but to these it has not been given.
13.bbe: And he said to them in answer, To you is given the knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

13.msb: Whoever has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
13.kjv: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
13.blb: For whoever has, it will be given to him, and he will be in abundance. And whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
13.bbe: Because whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have more; but from him who has not, even what he has will be taken away.

13.msb: This is why I speak to them in parables: ‘Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.’
13.kjv: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
13.blb: Because of this I speak to them in parables: ‘Because seeing, they do not see, and hearing, they do not hear, nor do they understand.’
13.bbe: For this reason I put things into the form of stories; because they see without seeing, and give ear without hearing, and the sense is not clear to them.

13.msb: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled: ‘You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.
13.kjv: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
13.blb: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah, saying: ‘In hearing you will hear and never understand; and seeing, you will see and never perceive.
13.bbe: And for them the words of Isaiah have come true, Though you give ear, you will not get knowledge; and seeing, you will see, but the sense will not be clear to you:

13.msb: For this people’s heart has grown callous; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.’
13.kjv: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
13.blb: For the heart of this people grew dull, and they barely hear with the ears, and they closed their eyes, lest ever they might see with the eyes, and might hear with the ears, and might understand with the heart, and might return, and I will heal them.’
13.bbe: For the heart of this people has become fat and their ears are slow in hearing and their eyes are shut; for fear that they might see with their eyes and give hearing with their ears and become wise in their hearts and be turned again to me, so that I might make them well.

13.msb: But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.
13.kjv: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
13.blb: But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.
13.bbe: But a blessing be on your eyes, because they see; and on your ears, because they are open.

13.msb: For truly I tell you, many prophets and righteous men longed to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.
13.kjv: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
13.blb: For truly I say to you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see what you see and did not see, and to hear what you hear and did not hear.
13.bbe: For truly, I say to you that prophets and upright men had a desire to see the things which you see, and saw them not; and to have knowledge of the words which have come to your ears, and they had it not.

13.msb: Consider, then, the parable of the sower:
13.kjv: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
13.blb: You, therefore, hear the parable of the one having sown:
13.bbe: Give ear, then, to the story of the man who put the seed in the earth.
13.heading: The Parable of the Sower Explained

13.msb: When anyone hears the message of the kingdom but does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is the seed sown along the path.
13.kjv: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
13.blb: Everyone hearing the word of the kingdom and not understanding, the evil one comes and snatches away that having been sown in his heart. This is the one having been sown along the path.
13.bbe: When the word of the kingdom comes to anyone, and the sense of it is not clear to him, then the Evil One comes, and quickly takes away that which was put in his heart. He is the seed dropped by the wayside.

13.msb: The seed sown on rocky ground is the one who hears the word and at once receives it with joy.
13.kjv: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
13.blb: And that having been sown upon the rocky places, this is the one hearing the word and immediately receiving it with joy.
13.bbe: And that which went on the stones, this is he who, hearing the word, straight away takes it with joy;

13.msb: But since he has no root, he remains for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.
13.kjv: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
13.blb: And he has no root in himself, but is temporary. But on tribulation or persecution having come because of the word, immediately he is caused to stumble.
13.bbe: But having no root in himself, he goes on for a time; and when trouble comes or pain, because of the word, he quickly becomes full of doubts.

13.msb: The seed sown among the thorns is the one who hears the word, but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
13.kjv: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
13.blb: And that having been sown among the thorns, this is the one hearing the word, and the anxiety of this age and the deceit of riches choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
13.bbe: And that which was dropped among the thorns, this is he who has the word; and the cares of this life, and the deceits of wealth, put a stop to the growth of the word and it gives no fruit.

13.msb: But the seed sown on good soil is the one who hears the word and understands it. He indeed bears fruit and produces a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.”
13.kjv: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
13.blb: But that having been sown on the good soil, this is the one hearing the word and understanding, who indeed bears fruit and produces—some indeed a hundredfold, and some sixty, and some thirty.”
13.bbe: And the seed which was put in good earth, this is he who gives ear to the word, and gets the sense of it; who gives fruit, some a hundred, some sixty, some thirty times as much.

13.msb: Jesus put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.
13.kjv: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
13.blb: He put before them another parable, saying, “The kingdom of the heavens was likened to a man having sown good seed in his field.
13.bbe: And he gave them another story, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like a man who put good seed in his field:
13.heading: The Parable of the Weeds

13.msb: But while everyone was asleep, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and slipped away.
13.kjv: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
13.blb: And while the men are sleeping, his enemy came and sowed weeds in the midst of the wheat, and went away.
13.bbe: But while men were sleeping, one who had hate for him came and put evil seeds among the grain, and went away.

13.msb: When the wheat sprouted and bore grain, then the weeds also appeared.
13.kjv: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
13.blb: And when the plants sprouted and produced fruit, then the weeds also appeared.
13.bbe: But when the green stem came up and gave fruit, the evil plants were seen at the same time.

13.msb: The owner’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?’
13.kjv: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
13.blb: And having come, the servants of the master of the house said to him, ‘Sir, did you not sow good seed in your field? From where, then, does it have weeds?’
13.bbe: And the servants of the master of the house came and said to him, Sir, did you not put good seed in your field? how then has it evil plants?

13.msb: ‘An enemy did this,’ he replied. So the servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’
13.kjv: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
13.blb: And he said to them, ‘An enemy did this.’ And the servants said to him, ‘Then do you desire that, having gone away, we should collect them?’
13.bbe: And he said, Someone has done this in hate. And the servants say to him, Is it your pleasure that we go and take them up?

13.msb: ‘No,’ he said, ‘if you pull the weeds now, you might uproot the wheat with them.
13.kjv: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
13.blb: And he said, ‘No, lest collecting the weeds, you might uproot the wheat with them.
13.bbe: But he says, No, for fear that by chance while you take up the evil plants, you may be rooting up the grain with them.

13.msb: Let both grow together until the harvest. At that time I will tell the harvesters: First collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to be burned; then gather the wheat into my barn.’”
13.kjv: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
13.blb: Allow both to grow together until the harvest, and in the time of the harvest I will say to the harvesters: First collect the weeds and bind them into bundles in order to burn them up; but gather together the wheat into my barn.’”
13.bbe: Let them come up together till the getting in of the grain; and then I will say to the workers, Take up first the evil plants, and put them together for burning: but put the grain into my store-house.

13.msb: He put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed that a man took and planted in his field.
13.kjv: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
13.blb: He put before them another parable, saying: “The kingdom of the heavens is like a grain of mustard, which a man, having taken, sowed in his field,
13.bbe: He put another story before them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his field:
13.heading: The Parable of the Mustard Seed

13.msb: Although it is the smallest of all seeds, yet it grows into the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches.”
13.kjv: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
13.blb: which indeed is smallest of all the seeds, but when it may be grown, it is greater than the garden plants and becomes a tree, so as for the birds of the sky to come and to lodge in its branches.”
13.bbe: Which is smaller than all seeds; but when it has come up it is greater than the plants, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of heaven come and make their resting-places in its branches.

13.msb: He told them still another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.”
13.kjv: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
13.blb: He spoke to them another parable: “The kingdom of the heavens is like leaven that a woman, having taken, hid in three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.”
13.bbe: Another story he gave to them: The kingdom of heaven is like leaven, which a woman took, and put in three measures of meal, till it was all leavened.
13.heading: The Parable of the Leaven

13.msb: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowds in parables. He did not tell them anything without using a parable.
13.kjv: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
13.blb: All these things Jesus spoke in parables to the crowds, and without a parable He was not speaking to them,
13.bbe: All these things Jesus said to the people in the form of stories; and without a story he said nothing to them:
13.heading: I Will Open My Mouth in Parables

13.msb: So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet: “I will open My mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden since the foundation of the world.”
13.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
13.blb: so that it might be fulfilled, that having been spoken through the prophet, saying: “I will open My mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”
13.bbe: That it might come true which was said by the prophet, Opening my mouth, I will give out stories; I will give knowledge of things kept secret from before all time.

13.msb: Then Jesus dismissed the crowds and went into the house. His disciples came to Him and said, “Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field.”
13.kjv: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
13.blb: Then, having dismissed the crowds, He went into the house. And His disciples came to Him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the weeds of the field.”
13.bbe: Then he went away from the people, and went into the house; and his disciples came to him, saying, Make clear to us the story of the evil plants in the field.
13.heading: The Parable of the Weeds Explained

13.msb: He replied, “The One who sows the good seed is the Son of Man.
13.kjv: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
13.blb: And answering, He said, “The One sowing the good seed is the Son of Man;
13.bbe: And he made answer and said, He who puts the good seed in the earth is the Son of man;

13.msb: The field is the world, and the good seed represents the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one,
13.kjv: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
13.blb: and the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the sons of the kingdom; and the weeds are the sons of the evil one;
13.bbe: And the field is the world; and the good seed is the sons of the kingdom; and the evil seeds are the sons of the Evil One;

13.msb: and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.
13.kjv: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
13.blb: and the enemy having sown them is the devil; and the harvest is the consummation of the age; and the harvesters are angels.
13.bbe: And he who put them in the earth is Satan; and the getting in of the grain is the end of the world; and those who get it in are the angels.

13.msb: As the weeds are collected and burned in the fire, so will it be at the end of this age.
13.kjv: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
13.blb: Therefore, as the weeds are gathered together and are burned up in fire, so will it be in the consummation of the age.
13.bbe: As then the evil plants are got together and burned with fire, so will it be in the end of the world.

13.msb: The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will weed out of His kingdom every cause of sin and all who practice lawlessness.
13.kjv: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
13.blb: The Son of Man will send forth His angels, and they will gather out of His kingdom all the stumbling blocks and those doing lawlessness,
13.bbe: The Son of man will send out his angels, and they will take out of his kingdom everything which is a cause of error, and all those who do wrong,

13.msb: And they will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
13.kjv: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
13.blb: and they will cast them into the furnace of the fire—there will be weeping and gnashing of the teeth.
13.bbe: And will put them into the fire; there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.

13.msb: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
13.kjv: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
13.blb: Then the righteous will shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. The one having ears, let him hear.
13.bbe: Then will the upright be shining as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him give ear.

13.msb: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and in his joy he went and sold all he had and bought that field.
13.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
13.blb: The kingdom of the heavens is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man, having found, hid. And from his joy, he goes and he sells all that he has, and he buys that field.
13.bbe: The kingdom of heaven is like a secret store of wealth in a field, which a man came across and put back again; and in his joy he goes and gives all he has, to get that field.
13.heading: The Parables of the Treasure and the Pearl

13.msb: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls.
13.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
13.blb: Again, the kingdom of the heavens is like a man, a merchant, seeking fine pearls.
13.bbe: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a trader searching for beautiful jewels.

13.msb: When he found one very precious pearl, he went away and sold all he had and bought it.
13.kjv: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
13.blb: And having found one very precious pearl, having gone away, he has sold all things, as many as he had, and bought it.
13.bbe: And having come across one jewel of great price, he went and gave all he had in exchange for it.

13.msb: Once again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was cast into the sea and caught all kinds of fish.
13.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
13.blb: Again, the kingdom of the heavens is like a dragnet having been cast into the sea and having gathered together of every kind,
13.bbe: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net, which was put into the sea and took in every sort of fish:
13.heading: The Parable of the Net

13.msb: When it was full, the men pulled it ashore. Then they sat down and sorted the good fish into containers, but threw the bad away.
13.kjv: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
13.blb: which, when it was filled, having drawn it up on the shore and having sat down, they collected the good into vessels, and they cast out the bad.
13.bbe: When it was full, they took it up on the sands; and seated there they put the good into vessels, but the bad they put away.

13.msb: So will it be at the end of the age: The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous
13.kjv: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
13.blb: So will it be in the consummation of the age: The angels will go out and will separate the evil from the midst of the righteous
13.bbe: So will it be in the end of the world: the angels will come and take out the bad from the good,

13.msb: and throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
13.kjv: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
13.blb: and will cast them into the furnace of the fire—there will be weeping and gnashing of the teeth.
13.bbe: And will put them into the fire: there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.

13.msb: Have you understood all these things?” Jesus asked them. “Yes, Lord,” they answered.
13.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
13.blb: Did you understand all these things?” They say to Him, “Yes.”
13.bbe: Are all these things now clear to you? They say to him, Yes.

13.msb: Then He told them, “For this reason, every scribe who has been discipled in the kingdom of heaven is like a homeowner who brings out of his storeroom new treasures as well as old.”
13.kjv: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
13.blb: And He said to them, “Because of this, every scribe having been discipled in the kingdom of the heavens is like a man, a master of a house, who puts forth out of his treasure new and old.”
13.bbe: And he said to them, For this reason every scribe who has become a disciple of the kingdom of heaven is like the owner of a house, who gives out from his store things new and old.

13.msb: When Jesus had finished these parables, He withdrew from that place.
13.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
13.blb: And it came to pass, when Jesus finished these parables, that He withdrew from there.
13.bbe: And when Jesus had come to the end of these stories he went away from there.
13.heading: The Rejection at Nazareth

13.msb: Coming to His hometown, He taught the people in their synagogue, and they were astonished. “Where did this man get such wisdom and miraculous powers?” they asked.
13.kjv: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
13.blb: And having come into His hometown, He was teaching them in their synagogue, so that they are astonished and are saying, “From where unto this One is this wisdom and the miracles?”
13.bbe: And coming into his country, he gave them teaching in their Synagogue, so that they were greatly surprised and said, Where did this man get this wisdom and these works of power?

13.msb: “Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t His mother’s name Mary, and aren’t His brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?
13.kjv: Is not this the carpenter’s son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
13.blb: Is this not the son of the carpenter? Is not His mother called Mary, and His brothers James and Joseph and Simon and Judas?
13.bbe: Is not this the woodworker's son? is not his mother named Mary? and his brothers James and Joseph and Simon and Judas?

13.msb: Aren’t all His sisters with us as well? Where then did this man get all these things?”
13.kjv: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
13.blb: And are not all His sisters with us? Then from where are unto this One all these things?”
13.bbe: And his sisters, are they not all with us? from where, then, has he all these things?

13.msb: And they took offense at Him. But Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”
13.kjv: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
13.blb: And they were taking offense at Him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his hometown and in his house.”
13.bbe: And they were bitter against him. But Jesus said to them, A prophet is nowhere without honour but in his country and among his family.

13.msb: And He did not do many miracles there, because of their unbelief.
13.kjv: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
13.blb: And He did not do many miracles there, because of their unbelief.
13.bbe: And the works of power which he did there were small in number because they had no faith.

14.msb: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus
14.kjv: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
14.blb: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the news of Jesus,
14.bbe: At that time news of Jesus came to Herod the king;
14.heading: The Beheading of John

14.msb: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”
14.kjv: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
14.blb: and he said to his servants, “This is John the Baptist; he was raised from the dead! And because of this, the miraculous powers are working in him.”
14.bbe: And he said to his servants, This is John the Baptist; he has come back from the dead, and so these powers are working in him.

14.msb: Now Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison on account of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife,
14.kjv: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife.
14.blb: For Herod, having seized John, bound him and put him in prison because of Herodias, the wife of Philip his brother.
14.bbe: For Herod had taken John and put him in prison because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.

14.msb: because John had been telling him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
14.kjv: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
14.blb: For John was saying to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
14.bbe: Because John had said to him, It is not right for you to have her.

14.msb: Although Herod wanted to kill John, he was afraid of the people, because they regarded John as a prophet.
14.kjv: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
14.blb: And wanting to kill him, he feared the crowd, because they were holding him as a prophet.
14.bbe: And he would have put him to death, but for his fear of the people, because in their eyes John was a prophet.

14.msb: When Herod’s birthday was being celebrated, however, the daughter of Herodias danced before them and pleased Herod
14.kjv: But when Herod’s birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
14.blb: But the birthday of Herod having come, the daughter of Herodias danced in the midst and pleased Herod,
14.bbe: But when Herod's birthday came, the daughter of Herodias was dancing before them, and Herod was pleased with her.

14.msb: so much that he promised with an oath to give to her whatever she asked.
14.kjv: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
14.blb: whereupon he promised with an oath to give to her whatever she might ask.
14.bbe: So he gave her his word with an oath to let her have whatever she might make request for.

14.msb: Prompted by her mother, she said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.”
14.kjv: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist’s head in a charger.
14.blb: And having been urged on by her mother, she says, “Give to me here upon a platter the head of John the Baptist.”
14.bbe: And she, at her mother's suggestion, said, Give me here on a plate the head of John the Baptist.

14.msb: The king was grieved, but because of his oaths and his guests, he ordered that her wish be granted
14.kjv: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath’s sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
14.blb: And the king, having been made sorrowful because of the oaths and those reclining with him, commanded it to be given.
14.bbe: And the king was sad; but because of his oaths and because of his guests, he gave the order for it to be given to her;

14.msb: and sent to have John beheaded in the prison.
14.kjv: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
14.blb: And having sent, he beheaded John in the prison.
14.bbe: And he sent and had John's head cut off in the prison.

14.msb: John’s head was brought in on a platter and presented to the girl, who carried it to her mother.
14.kjv: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
14.blb: And his head was brought on a platter and was given to the girl, and she brought it to her mother.
14.bbe: And his head was put on a plate and given to the girl; and she took it to her mother.

14.msb: Then John’s disciples came and took his body and buried it. And they went and informed Jesus.
14.kjv: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
14.blb: And having come, his disciples took up the body and buried it. And having come, they reported it to Jesus.
14.bbe: And his disciples came, and took up his body and put it in the earth; and they went and gave Jesus news of what had taken place.

14.msb: When Jesus heard about John, He withdrew by boat privately to a solitary place. But the crowds found out about it and followed Him on foot from the towns.
14.kjv: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
14.blb: And having heard, Jesus withdrew from there in a boat to a wilderness place by Himself. And having heard, the crowds followed Him on foot from the cities.
14.bbe: Now when it came to the ears of Jesus, he went away from there in a boat, to a waste place by himself: and the people hearing of it, went after him on foot from the towns.
14.heading: The Feeding of the Five Thousand

14.msb: When Jesus stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, He had compassion on them and healed their sick.
14.kjv: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
14.blb: And having gone out, He saw a great crowd and was moved with compassion toward them, and He healed their sick.
14.bbe: And he came out and saw a great number of people and he had pity on them, and made well those of them who were ill.

14.msb: When evening came, His disciples came to Him and said, “This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late. Dismiss the crowds so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food.”
14.kjv: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
14.blb: And evening having come, the disciples came to Him, saying, “This place is desolate, and the time already is gone by. Therefore dismiss the crowds so that, having gone to the villages, they might buy food for themselves.”
14.bbe: And when evening had come, the disciples came to him, saying, This place is waste land, and the time is now past; send the people away so that they may go into the towns and get themselves food.

14.msb: “They do not need to go away,” Jesus replied. “You give them something to eat.”
14.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
14.blb: But Jesus said to them, “They have no need to go away. You give them something to eat.”
14.bbe: But Jesus said to them, There is no need for them to go away; give them food yourselves.

14.msb: “We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered.
14.kjv: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
14.blb: And they say to Him, “We have nothing here except five loaves and two fish.”
14.bbe: And they say to him, We have here but five cakes of bread and two fishes.

14.msb: “Bring them here to Me,” Jesus said.
14.kjv: He said, Bring them hither to me.
14.blb: And He said, “Bring them here to Me.”
14.bbe: And he said, Give them to me.

14.msb: And He directed the crowds to sit down on the grass. Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, He spoke a blessing. Then He broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.
14.kjv: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
14.blb: And having commanded the crowds to sit down on the grass, having taken the five loaves and the two fish, having looked up to the heaven, He blessed. And having broken, He gave the loaves to the disciples, and the disciples to the crowds.
14.bbe: And he gave orders for the people to be seated on the grass; and he took the five cakes of bread and the two fishes and, looking up to heaven, he said words of blessing, and made division of the food, and gave it to the disciples, and the disciples gave it to the people.

14.msb: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
14.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
14.blb: And all ate and were satisfied, and they took up the superabounding of the fragments, twelve hand-baskets full.
14.bbe: And they all took of the food and had enough: and they took up twelve baskets full of broken bits which were not used.

14.msb: About five thousand men were fed, besides women and children.
14.kjv: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
14.blb: And those eating were about five thousand men, apart from women and children.
14.bbe: And those who had food were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

14.msb: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of Him to the other side, while He dismissed the crowds.
14.kjv: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
