14.blb: And immediately He compelled the disciples to enter into the boat and to go before Him to the other side, until He might dismiss the crowds.
14.bbe: And straight away he made the disciples get into the boat and go before him to the other side, till he had sent the people away.
14.heading: Jesus Walks on Water

14.msb: After He had dismissed them, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray. When evening came, He was there alone,
14.kjv: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
14.blb: And having dismissed the crowds, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray. And evening having come, He was there alone,
14.bbe: And after he had sent the people away, he went up into the mountain by himself for prayer: and when evening was come, he was there by himself.

14.msb: but the boat was already in the middle of the sea, buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it.
14.kjv: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
14.blb: and the boat, being now many stadia from the land, is distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.
14.bbe: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, and was troubled by the waves: for the wind was against them.

14.msb: During the fourth watch of the night, Jesus went out to them, walking on the sea.
14.kjv: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
14.blb: And in the fourth watch of the night He went to them, walking on the sea.
14.bbe: And in the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea.

14.msb: When the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were terrified. “It’s a ghost!” they said, and cried out in fear.
14.kjv: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
14.blb: And the disciples, having seen Him walking on the sea, were troubled, saying, “It is a ghost!” And they cried out in fear.
14.bbe: And when they saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they gave cries of fear.

14.msb: But Jesus spoke up at once: “Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.”
14.kjv: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
14.blb: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Take courage! I am He! Do not” be afraid.
14.bbe: But straight away Jesus said to them, Take heart; it is I, have no fear.

14.msb: “Lord, if it is You,” Peter replied, “command me to come to You on the water.”
14.kjv: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
14.blb: And answering Him, Peter said, “Lord, if You are He, command me to come to You on the waters.”
14.bbe: And Peter, answering, said to him, Lord, if it is you, give me the order to come to you on the water.

14.msb: “Come,” said Jesus. Then Peter got down out of the boat and walked on the water to go toward Jesus.
14.kjv: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
14.blb: And He said, “Come.” And having gone down from the boat, Peter walked on the waters and came to Jesus.
14.bbe: And he said, Come. And Peter got out of the boat, and walking on the water, went to Jesus.

14.msb: But when he saw the strength of the wind, he was afraid and, beginning to sink, cried out, “Lord, save me!”
14.kjv: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
14.blb: And seeing the strong wind, he was afraid, and having begun to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”
14.bbe: But when he saw the wind he was in fear and, starting to go down, he gave a cry, saying, Help, Lord.

14.msb: Immediately Jesus reached out His hand and took hold of Peter. “You of little faith,” He said, “why did you doubt?”
14.kjv: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
14.blb: And immediately Jesus, having stretched out the hand, took hold of him and says to him, “O little of faith, why did you waver?”
14.bbe: And straight away Jesus put out his hand and took a grip of him, and said to him, O man of little faith, why were you in doubt?

14.msb: And when they had climbed back into the boat, the wind died down.
14.kjv: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
14.blb: And they having gone up into the boat, the wind abated.
14.bbe: And when they had got into the boat, the wind went down.

14.msb: Then those who were in the boat came and worshiped Him, saying, “Truly You are the Son of God!”
14.kjv: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
14.blb: And those in the boat worshiped Him, saying, “Truly You are God's Son!”
14.bbe: And those who were in the boat gave him worship, saying, Truly you are the Son of God.

14.msb: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.
14.kjv: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
14.blb: And having crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.
14.bbe: And when they had gone across, they came to land at Gennesaret.
14.heading: Jesus Heals at Gennesaret

14.msb: And when the men of that place recognized Jesus, they sent word to all the surrounding region. People brought all the sick to Him
14.kjv: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
14.blb: And having recognized Him, the men of that place sent to all that surrounding region, and they brought to Him all those being ill,
14.bbe: And when the men of that place had news of him, they sent into all the country round about, and took to him all who were ill,

14.msb: and begged Him just to let them touch the fringe of His cloak. And all who touched Him were healed.
14.kjv: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
14.blb: and they were imploring Him that they might only touch the fringe of His garment. And as many as touched were saved.
14.bbe: With the request that they might only put their hands on the edge of his robe: and all those who did so were made well.

15.msb: Then some scribes and Pharisees came to Jesus from Jerusalem and asked,
15.kjv: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
15.blb: Then Pharisees and scribes come to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,
15.bbe: Then there came to Jesus from Jerusalem Pharisees and scribes, saying,
15.heading: The Tradition of the Elders

15.msb: “Why do Your disciples break the tradition of the elders? They do not wash their hands before they eat.”
15.kjv: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
15.blb: “Why do Your disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? For they do not wash their hands when they shall eat bread.”
15.bbe: Why do your disciples go against the teaching of the fathers? for they take food with unwashed hands.

15.msb: Jesus replied, “And why do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?
15.kjv: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?
15.blb: And answering, He said to them, “Why also do you transgress the commandment of God because of your tradition?
15.bbe: And in answer he said to them, Why do you, yourselves, go against the word of God on account of the teaching which has been handed down to you?

15.msb: For God commanded, saying, ‘Honor your father and mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.’
15.kjv: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
15.blb: For God said, ‘Honor your father and mother’ and ‘The one speaking evil of father or mother, in death let him end.’
15.bbe: For God said, Give honour to your father and mother: and, He who says evil of father or mother will be put to death.

15.msb: But you say that if anyone says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is a gift devoted to God,’
15.kjv: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;
15.blb: But you say, ‘Whoever might say to father or mother: Whatever you might be profited by me is a gift,’
15.bbe: But you say, If a man says to his father or his mother, That by which you might have had profit from me is given to God;

15.msb: then he need not honor his father or mother with it. Thus you nullify the commandment of God for the sake of your tradition.
15.kjv: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.
15.blb: he shall not honor his father or his mother. And you made void the word of God because of your tradition.
15.bbe: There is no need for him to give honour to his father. And you have made the word of God without effect because of your teaching.

15.msb: You hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied correctly about you:
15.kjv: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,
15.blb: Hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied correctly about you, saying:
15.bbe: You false ones, well did Isaiah say of you,

15.msb: ‘These people draw near to Me with their mouths, and they honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.
15.kjv: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
15.blb: ‘This people honors Me with the lips, but their heart is kept far away from Me;
15.bbe: These people give me honour with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

15.msb: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’”
15.kjv: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
15.blb: and in vain they worship Me, teaching as teachings the precepts of men.’”
15.bbe: But their worship is to no purpose, while they give as their teaching the rules of men.

15.msb: Jesus called the crowd to Him and said, “Listen and understand.
15.kjv: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
15.blb: And having summoned the crowd, He said to them, “Hear and understand.
15.bbe: And he got the people together and said to them, Give ear, and let my words be clear to you:
15.heading: What Defiles a Man

15.msb: A man is not defiled by what enters his mouth, but by what comes out of it.”
15.kjv: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
15.blb: Not what is entering into the mouth defiles the man; but what is proceeding out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”
15.bbe: Not that which goes into the mouth makes a man unclean, but that which comes out of the mouth.

15.msb: Then His disciples came to Him and said, “Are You aware that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this?”
15.kjv: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
15.blb: Then the disciples, having come, said to Him, “Do You know that the Pharisees, having heard the saying, were offended?”
15.bbe: Then the disciples came and said to him, Did you see that the Pharisees were troubled when these words came to their ears?

15.msb: But Jesus replied, “Every plant that My heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by its roots.
15.kjv: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.
15.blb: And answering, He said, “Every plant that My heavenly Father did not plant will be uprooted.
15.bbe: But he said in answer, Every plant which my Father in heaven has not put in the earth, will be taken up by the roots.

15.msb: Disregard them! They are blind guides. If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit.”
15.kjv: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
15.blb: Leave them! They are blind guides of the blind. And if the blind may guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”
15.bbe: Let them be: they are blind guides. And if a blind man is guiding a blind man, the two will go falling into a hole together.

15.msb: Peter said to Him, “Explain this parable to us.”
15.kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
15.blb: And answering, Peter said to Him, “Explain to us this parable.”
15.bbe: Then Peter said to him, Make the story clear to us.

15.msb: “Do you still not understand?” Jesus asked.
15.kjv: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?
15.blb: And He said, “Are you also still without understanding?
15.bbe: And he said, Are you, like them, still without wisdom?

15.msb: “Do you not yet realize that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and then is eliminated?
15.kjv: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
15.blb: Do you not perceive that everything entering into the mouth goes into the belly and is cast out into the sewer?
15.bbe: Do you not see that whatever goes into the mouth goes on into the stomach, and is sent out as waste?

15.msb: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and these things defile a man.
15.kjv: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
15.blb: But the things proceeding out of the mouth come forth out of the heart, and these defile the man.
15.bbe: But the things which come out of the mouth come from the heart; and they make a man unclean.

15.msb: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, and slander.
15.kjv: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
15.blb: For out of the heart come forth evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual immorality, thefts, false testimonies, slanders.
15.bbe: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, the taking of life, broken faith between the married, unclean desires of the flesh, taking of property, false witness, bitter words:

15.msb: These are what defile a man, but eating with unwashed hands does not defile him.”
15.kjv: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
15.blb: These are the things defiling the man, but to eat with unwashed hands does not defile the man.”
15.bbe: These are the things which make a man unclean; but to take food with unwashed hands does not make a man unclean.

15.msb: Leaving that place, Jesus withdrew to the district of Tyre and Sidon.
15.kjv: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
15.blb: And having gone out from there, Jesus withdrew to the parts of Tyre and Sidon.
15.bbe: And Jesus went away from there into the country of Tyre and Sidon.
15.heading: The Faith of the Canaanite Woman

15.msb: And a Canaanite woman from that region came to Him, crying out, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me! My daughter is miserably possessed by a demon.”
15.kjv: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
15.blb: And behold, a Canaanite woman from those borders, having come out, was crying out, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, Son of David! My daughter is miserably possessed by a demon.”
15.bbe: And a woman of Canaan came out from those parts, crying and saying, Have pity on me, O Lord, Son of David; my daughter is greatly troubled with an unclean spirit.

15.msb: But Jesus did not answer a word. So His disciples came and urged Him, “Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us.”
15.kjv: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
15.blb: But He did not answer her a word. And having come, His disciples were imploring Him, saying, “Dismiss her, because she cries out after us.”
15.bbe: But he gave her no answer. And his disciples came and said to him, Send her away, for she is crying after us.

15.msb: He answered, “I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
15.kjv: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
15.blb: And answering, He said, “I was not sent, except to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
15.bbe: But he made answer and said, I was sent only to the wandering sheep of the house of Israel.

15.msb: The woman came and knelt before Him. “Lord, help me!” she said.
15.kjv: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
15.blb: And having come, she was worshiping Him, saying, “Lord, help me!”
15.bbe: But she came and gave him worship, saying, Help, Lord.

15.msb: But Jesus replied, “It is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”
15.kjv: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.
15.blb: And answering, He said, “It is not good to take the bread of the children and to cast it to the dogs.”
15.bbe: And he made answer and said, It is not right to take the children's bread and give it to the dogs.

15.msb: “Yes, Lord,” she said, “even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their master’s table.”
15.kjv: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.
15.blb: And she said, “Yes, Lord, for even the dogs eat from the crumbs falling from the table of their masters.”
15.bbe: But she said, Yes, Lord: but even the dogs take the bits from under their masters' table.

15.msb: “O woman,” Jesus answered, “your faith is great! Let it be done for you as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that very hour.
15.kjv: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
15.blb: “Then answering, Jesus said to her, “O woman, great is your faith! Let it be to you as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.
15.bbe: Then Jesus, answering, said to her, O woman, great is your faith: let your desire be done. And her daughter was made well from that hour.

15.msb: Moving on from there, Jesus went along the Sea of Galilee. Then He went up on a mountain and sat down.
15.kjv: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
15.blb: And having departed from there, Jesus went along the Sea of Galilee. And having gone up on the mountain, He was sitting there.
15.bbe: And Jesus went from there and came to the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and took his seat there.
15.heading: The Feeding of the Four Thousand

15.msb: Large crowds came to Him, bringing the lame, the blind, the mute, the crippled, and many others, and laid them at Jesus' feet, and He healed them.
15.kjv: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus’ feet; and he healed them:
15.blb: And many crowds came to Him, having with them the lame, the crippled, the blind, the mute, and many others. And they cast them at His feet, and He healed them,
15.bbe: And there came to him great numbers of people having with them those who were broken in body, or blind, or without voice, or wounded, or ill in any way, and a number of others; they put them down at his feet and he made them well:

15.msb: The crowds were amazed when they saw the mute speaking, the crippled restored, the lame walking, and the blind seeing. And they glorified the God of Israel.
15.kjv: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.
15.blb: so that the crowd marveled, seeing the mute speaking, the crippled restored, and the lame walking, and the blind seeing. And they glorified the God of Israel.
15.bbe: So that the people were full of wonder when they saw that those who had no voice were talking, the feeble were made strong, those whose bodies were broken had the power of walking, and the blind were able to see: and they gave glory to the God of Israel.

15.msb: Then Jesus called His disciples to Him and said, “I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat. I do not want to send them away hungry, or they may faint along the way.”
15.kjv: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
15.blb: And Jesus, having summoned His disciples, said, “I have compassion toward the crowd, because already three days they continue with Me, and they have nothing that they might eat. And I do not want to dismiss them hungry, lest they faint on the way.”
15.bbe: And Jesus got his disciples together and said, I have pity for the people, because they have now been with me three days and have no food: and I will not send them away without food, or they will have no strength for the journey.

15.msb: His disciples replied, “Where in this desolate place could we find enough bread to feed such a large crowd?”
15.kjv: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?
15.blb: And the disciples say to Him, “From where unto us in a secluded place are so many loaves so as to satisfy so great a crowd?”
15.bbe: And the disciples say to him, How may we get enough bread in a waste place, to give food to such a number of people?

15.msb: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied, “and a few small fish.”
15.kjv: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.
15.blb: And Jesus says to them, “How many loaves do you have?” And they said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”
15.bbe: And Jesus says to them, How much bread have you? And they said, Seven cakes, and some small fishes.

15.msb: And He commanded the crowd to sit down on the ground.
15.kjv: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
15.blb: And having commanded the crowd to sit down on the ground,
15.bbe: Then he gave an order to the people to be seated on the earth,

15.msb: Taking the seven loaves and the fish, He gave thanks and broke them. Then He gave them to His disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.
15.kjv: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
15.blb: He took the seven loaves and the fish, and having given thanks, He broke them and was giving them to the disciples, and the disciples to the crowds.
15.bbe: And he took the seven cakes of bread and the fishes; and having given praise, he gave the broken bread to the disciples, and the disciples gave it to the people.

15.msb: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
15.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
15.blb: And they all ate and were satisfied, and they took up the superabounding of the fragments, seven baskets full.
15.bbe: And they all took food, and had enough; and they took up of the broken bits, seven baskets full.

15.msb: A total of four thousand men were fed, besides women and children.
15.kjv: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
15.blb: And those eating were four thousand men, apart from women and children.
15.bbe: And there were four thousand men who took food, together with women and children.

15.msb: After Jesus had dismissed the crowds, He got into the boat and went to the region of Magdala.
15.kjv: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
15.blb: And having dismissed the crowds, He entered into the boat and went to the borders of Magadan.
15.bbe: And when he had sent the people away, he got into the boat, and came into the country of Magadan.

16.msb: Then the Pharisees and Sadducees came and tested Jesus by asking Him to show them a sign from heaven.
16.kjv: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
16.blb: And having come, the Pharisees and Sadducees, testing Him, asked Him to show them a sign out of heaven.
16.bbe: And the Pharisees and Sadducees came and, testing him, made a request to him to give them a sign from heaven.
16.heading: The Demand for a Sign

16.msb: But He replied, “When evening comes, you say, ‘The weather will be fair, for the sky is red,’
16.kjv: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
16.blb: And answering, He said to them, “Evening having come, you say, ‘Fair weather, for the sky is red,’
16.bbe: But in answer he said to them, At nightfall you say, The weather will be good, for the sky is red.

16.msb: and in the morning, ‘Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.’ You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but not the signs of the times.
16.kjv: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?
16.blb: and in the morning, ‘Today a storm, for the sky is red, being overcast.’ Indeed, you know to discern the face of the sky, but the signs of the times you are not able.
16.bbe: And in the morning, The weather will be bad today, for the sky is red and angry. You are able to see the face of heaven, but not the signs of the times.

16.msb: A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” Then He left them and went away.
16.kjv: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
16.blb: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and a sign will not be given to it except the sign of Jonah.” And having left them, He went away.
16.bbe: An evil and false generation is searching after a sign; and no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah. And he went away from them.

16.msb: When they crossed to the other side, His disciples forgot to take bread.
16.kjv: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
16.blb: And the disciples, having come to the other side, forgot to take loaves.
16.bbe: And when the disciples came to the other side they had not taken thought to get bread.
16.heading: The Leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees

16.msb: “Watch out!” Jesus told them. “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
16.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
16.blb: And Jesus said to them, “Watch out and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
16.bbe: And Jesus said to them, Take care to have nothing to do with the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

16.msb: They discussed this among themselves and concluded, “It is because we did not bring any bread.”
16.kjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
16.blb: And they were reasoning among themselves, saying, “Because we took no loaves.”
16.bbe: And they were reasoning among themselves, saying, We took no bread.

16.msb: Aware of their conversation, Jesus said to them, “You of little faith, why are you debating among yourselves about having brought no bread?
16.kjv: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
16.blb: But having known this, Jesus said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, O little of faith, that you have no loaves?
16.bbe: And Jesus, seeing it, said, O you of little faith, why are you reasoning among yourselves, because you have no bread?

16.msb: Do you still not understand? Do you not remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
16.kjv: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
16.blb: Do you not yet perceive? Nor do you remember the five loaves for the five thousand and how many hand-baskets you took up,
16.bbe: Do you still not see, or keep in mind the five cakes of bread of the five thousand, and the number of baskets you took up?

16.msb: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
16.kjv: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
16.blb: nor the seven loaves for the four thousand and how many baskets you took up?
16.bbe: Or the seven cakes of bread of the four thousand, and the number of baskets you took up?

16.msb: How do you not understand that I was not telling you about bread, but to beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees?”
16.kjv: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
16.blb: How do you not perceive that I did not speak to you about loaves? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
16.bbe: How is it that you do not see that I was not talking to you about bread, but about keeping away from the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees?

16.msb: Then they understood that He was not telling them to beware of the leaven used in bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
16.kjv: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
16.blb: Then they understood that He did not say to beware of the leaven of the loaves, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
16.bbe: Then they saw that it was not the leaven of bread which he had in mind, but the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

16.msb: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, He questioned His disciples: “Who do people pronounce Me, the Son of Man, to be?”
16.kjv: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
16.blb: And Jesus, having come into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, was questioning His disciples, saying, “Who do men say the Son of Man is?”
16.bbe: Now when Jesus had come into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he said, questioning his disciples, Who do men say that the Son of man is?
16.heading: Peter’s Confession of Christ

16.msb: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”
16.kjv: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
16.blb: And they said, “Some indeed, John the Baptist; and others, Elijah; and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”
16.bbe: And they said, Some say, John the Baptist; some, Elijah; and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.

16.msb: “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?”
16.kjv: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
16.blb: He says to them, “But you, who do you say I am?”
16.bbe: He says to them, But who do you say that I am?

16.msb: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
16.kjv: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
16.blb: And answering, Simon Peter said, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
16.bbe: And Simon Peter made answer and said, You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.

16.msb: Jesus replied, “Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah! For this was not revealed to you by flesh and blood, but by My Father in heaven.
16.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-jona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
16.blb: And answering, Jesus said to him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar-Jonah! For flesh and blood did not reveal it to you, but My Father who is in the heavens.
16.bbe: And Jesus made answer and said to him, A blessing on you, Simon Bar-jonah: because this knowledge has not come to you from flesh and blood, but from my Father in heaven.

16.msb: And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
16.kjv: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
16.blb: And I also say to you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
16.bbe: And I say to you that you are Peter, and on this rock will my church be based, and the doors of hell will not overcome it.

16.msb: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven. Whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.”
16.kjv: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
16.blb: I will give to you the keys of the kingdom of the heavens. And whatever you might bind on the earth will be bound in the heavens, and whatever you might loose on the earth will be loosed in the heavens.”
16.bbe: I will give to you the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatever is fixed by you on earth will be fixed in heaven: and whatever you make free on earth will be made free in heaven.

16.msb: Then He commanded His disciples not to tell anyone that He was Jesus the Christ.
16.kjv: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.
16.blb: Then He instructed the disciples that they should tell no one that He is the Christ.
16.bbe: Then he gave orders to the disciples to give no man word that he was the Christ.

16.msb: From that time on Jesus began to show His disciples that He must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things at the hands of the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and that He must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.
16.kjv: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
16.blb: From that time Jesus began to show to His disciples that it is necessary for Him to go away to Jerusalem, and to suffer many things from the elders and chief priests and scribes, and to be killed, and on the third day to be raised.
16.bbe: From that time Jesus went on to make clear to his disciples how he would have to go up to Jerusalem, and undergo much at the hands of those in authority and the chief priests and scribes, and be put to death, and the third day come again from the dead.
16.heading: Christ’s Passion Foretold

16.msb: Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him. “Far be it from You, Lord!” he said. “This shall never happen to You!”
16.kjv: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.
16.blb: And having taken Him aside, Peter began to rebuke Him, saying, “Far be it from You, Lord! This never will be unto You!”
16.bbe: And Peter, protesting, said to him, Be it far from you, Lord; it is impossible that this will come about.

16.msb: But Jesus turned and said to Peter, “Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me. For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.”
16.kjv: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
16.blb: But having turned, He said to Peter, “Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me. For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.”
16.bbe: But he, turning to Peter, said, Get out of my way, Satan: you are a danger to me because your mind is not on the things of God, but on the things of men.

16.msb: Then Jesus told His disciples, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
16.kjv: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
16.blb: Then Jesus said to His disciples, “If anyone wants to come after Me, let him deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
16.bbe: Then Jesus said to his disciples, If any man would come after me, let him give up all, and take up his cross, and come after me.
16.heading: Take Up Your Cross

16.msb: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
16.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
16.blb: For whoever may want to save his life will lose it, but whoever may lose his life on account of Me will find it.
16.bbe: Because whoever has a desire to keep his life safe will have it taken from him; but whoever gives up his life because of me, will have it given back to him.

16.msb: What does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his soul? Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
16.kjv: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
16.blb: For what will it profit a man if he should gain the whole world, but lose his soul? Or what will a man give as an exchange for his soul?
16.bbe: For what profit has a man, if he gets all the world with the loss of his life? or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

16.msb: For the Son of Man will come in His Father’s glory with His angels, and then He will repay each one according to what he has done.
16.kjv: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
16.blb: For the Son of Man is about to come in the glory of His Father with His angels, and then He will repay each one according to his deeds.
16.bbe: For the Son of man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he will give to every man the reward of his works.

16.msb: Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom.”
16.kjv: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
16.blb: Truly I say to you that there are some of those standing here who shall not taste of death until they shall see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom.”
16.bbe: Truly I say to you, There are some of those here who will not have a taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.

17.msb: After six days Jesus took with Him Peter, James, and John the brother of James, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.
17.kjv: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
17.blb: And after six days, Jesus takes along Peter and James and John his brother, and He brings them up onto a high mountain by themselves.
17.bbe: And after six days Jesus takes with him Peter, and James, and John, his brother, and makes them go up with him into a high mountain by themselves.
17.heading: The Transfiguration

17.msb: There He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and His clothes became as white as the light.
17.kjv: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
17.blb: And He was transfigured before them, and His face shone like the sun, and His garments became white as the light.
17.bbe: And he was changed in form before them; and his face was shining like the sun, and his clothing became white as light.

17.msb: Suddenly Moses and Elijah appeared before them, talking with Jesus.
17.kjv: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
17.blb: And behold, there appeared to them Moses and Elijah, talking with Him.
17.bbe: And Moses and Elijah came before their eyes, talking with him.

17.msb: Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If You wish, we will put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
17.kjv: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
17.blb: And answering, Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If You wish, I will make here three tabernacles—one for You, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
17.bbe: And Peter made answer and said to Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if you will let me, I will make here three tents, one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

17.msb: While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!”
17.kjv: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
17.blb: In his still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them, and behold, a voice out of the cloud, saying, “This is My Son, the Beloved, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!”
17.bbe: While he was still talking, a bright cloud came over them: and a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased; give ear to him.

17.msb: When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown in terror.
17.kjv: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
17.blb: And having heard it, the disciples fell upon their face, and they were exceedingly terrified.
17.bbe: And at these words the disciples went down on their faces in great fear.

17.msb: Then Jesus came over and touched them. “Get up,” He said. “Do not be afraid.”
17.kjv: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
17.blb: And Jesus, having come near and having touched them, said, “Rise up, and do not be afraid.”
17.bbe: And Jesus came and put his hand on them and said, Get up and have no fear.

17.msb: And when they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.
17.kjv: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.
17.blb: And having lifted up their eyes, they saw no one except Jesus Himself alone.
17.bbe: And lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, but Jesus only.

17.msb: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus commanded them, “Do not tell anyone about this vision until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”
17.kjv: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
17.blb: And in their coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Tell no one the vision until the Son of Man should be raised out from the dead.”
17.bbe: And when they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus gave them orders, saying, Let no man have word of what you have seen, till the Son of man has come again from the dead.

17.msb: His disciples asked Him, “Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
17.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
17.blb: And the disciples questioned Him, saying, “Why then do the scribes say that it is necessary for Elijah to come first?”
17.bbe: And his disciples, questioning him, said, Why then do the scribes say that Elijah has to come first?

17.msb: Jesus replied, “Elijah does indeed come first, and he will restore all things.
17.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
17.blb: And answering, He said, “Elijah indeed comes and will restore all things.
17.bbe: And in answer he said, Elijah truly has to come and put all things right:

17.msb: But I tell you that Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but have done to him whatever they wished. In the same way, the Son of Man will suffer at their hands.”
17.kjv: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.
17.blb: But I say to you that Elijah did already come, and they did not know him, but they did to him whatever they wanted. Thus also the Son of Man is about to suffer under them.”
17.bbe: But I say to you that Elijah has come, and they had no knowledge of him, but did to him whatever they were pleased to do; the same will the Son of man undergo at their hands.

17.msb: Then the disciples understood that He was speaking to them about John the Baptist.
17.kjv: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
17.blb: Then the disciples understood that He spoke to them about John the Baptist.
17.bbe: Then the disciples saw that he was talking to them of John the Baptist.

17.msb: When they came to the crowd, a man came up to Jesus and knelt before Him.
17.kjv: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
17.blb: And on their having come to the crowd, a man came to Him, kneeling down to Him
17.bbe: And when they came to the people, a man went down on his knees to him, saying,
17.heading: The Boy with a Demon

17.msb: “Lord, have mercy on my son,” he said. “He has seizures and is suffering terribly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.
17.kjv: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.
17.blb: and saying, “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers miserably; for often he falls into the fire, and often into the water.
17.bbe: Lord have mercy on my son: for he is off his head, and is in great pain; and frequently he goes falling into the fire, and frequently into the water.

17.msb: I brought him to Your disciples, but they could not heal him.”
17.kjv: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
17.blb: And I brought him to Your disciples, and they were not able to heal him.”
17.bbe: And I took him to your disciples, and they were not able to make him well.

17.msb: “O unbelieving and perverse generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy here to Me.”
17.kjv: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
17.blb: And answering, Jesus said, “O unbelieving and perverse generation, until when will I be with you? Until when will I bear with you? Bring him here to Me.”
17.bbe: And Jesus, answering, said, O false and foolish generation, how long will I be with you? how long will I put up with you? let him come here to me.

17.msb: Then Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed from that moment.
17.kjv: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
17.blb: And Jesus rebuked him, and the demon came out from him, and the boy was healed from that hour.
17.bbe: And Jesus gave orders to the unclean spirit, and it went out of him: and the boy was made well from that hour.

17.msb: Afterward the disciples came to Jesus privately and asked, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”
17.kjv: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
17.blb: Then the disciples, having come to Jesus in private, said, “Why were we not able to cast it out?”
17.bbe: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, Why were we not able to send it out?
17.heading: The Power of Faith

17.msb: “Because of your unbelief,” Jesus answered. “For truly I tell you, if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.
17.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
17.blb: And He said to them, “Because of your little faith. For truly I say to you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard, you will say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. And nothing will be impossible for you.”
17.bbe: And he says to them, Because of your little faith: for truly I say to you, If you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, Be moved from this place to that; and it will be moved; and nothing will be impossible to you.

17.msb: But this kind does not go out except by prayer and fasting.”
17.kjv: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.

17.msb: While they were staying together in Galilee, Jesus told them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men.
17.kjv: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
17.blb: And in their gathering together in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be betrayed into the hands of men,
17.bbe: And while they were going about in Galilee, Jesus said to them, The Son of man will be given up into the hands of men;
17.heading: The Second Prediction of the Passion

17.msb: They will kill Him, and on the third day He will be raised to life.” And the disciples were deeply grieved.
17.kjv: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
17.blb: and they will kill Him, and on the third day He will be raised up.” And they were deeply grieved.
17.bbe: And they will put him to death, and the third day he will come again from the dead. And they were very sad.

17.msb: After they had arrived in Capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma tax came to Peter and asked, “Does your Teacher pay the two drachmas?”
17.kjv: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
17.blb: And on their having come to Capernaum, those receiving the didrachmas came to Peter and said, “Does your Teacher pay the didrachmas?”
17.bbe: And when they had come to Capernaum, those who took the Temple tax came to Peter and said, Does not your master make payment of the Temple tax?
17.heading: The Temple Tax

17.msb: “Yes,” he answered. When Peter entered the house, Jesus preempted him. “What do you think, Simon?” He asked. “From whom do the kings of the earth collect customs and taxes: from their own sons, or from others?”
17.kjv: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
17.blb: He says, “Yes.” And on his having come into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive custom or tribute: From their sons, or from the strangers?”
17.bbe: He says, Yes. And when he came into the house, Jesus said to him, What is your opinion, Simon? from whom do the kings of the earth get payment or tax? from their sons or from other people?

17.msb: “From others,” Peter answered. “Then the sons are exempt,” Jesus said to him.
17.kjv: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.
17.blb: And on his having said, “From the strangers,” Jesus said to him, “Then the sons are free.
17.bbe: And when he said, From other people, Jesus said to him, Then are the sons free.

17.msb: “But so that we may not offend them, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take the first fish you catch. When you open its mouth, you will find a four-drachma coin. Take it and give it to them for My tax and yours.”
17.kjv: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
17.blb: But so that we might not offend them, having gone to the sea, cast a hook, and take the first fish having come up. And having opened its mouth, you will find a stater. Having taken that, give it to them for Me and you.”
17.bbe: But, so that we may not be a cause of trouble to them, go to the sea, and let down a hook, and take the first fish which comes up; and in his mouth you will see a bit of money: take that, and give it to them for me and you.

18.msb: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Who then is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?”
18.kjv: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
18.blb: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greater in the kingdom of the heavens?”
18.bbe: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Who is greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
18.heading: The Greatest in the Kingdom

18.msb: Jesus invited a little child to stand among them.
18.kjv: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
18.blb: And having summoned a little child, He set him in their midst
18.bbe: And he took a little child, and put him in the middle of them,

18.msb: “Truly I tell you,” He said, “unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
18.kjv: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
18.blb: and said, “Truly I say to you, if you shall not be turned and become as the little children, you shall never enter into the kingdom of the heavens.
18.bbe: And said, Truly, I say to you, If you do not have a change of heart and become like little children, you will not go into the kingdom of heaven.

18.msb: Therefore, whoever humbles himself like this little child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
18.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
18.blb: Therefore whoever will humble himself like this little child, he is the greatest in the kingdom of the heavens.
18.bbe: Whoever, then, will make himself as low as this little child, the same is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

18.msb: And whoever welcomes a little child like this in My name welcomes Me.
18.kjv: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.
18.blb: And whoever shall receive one such little child in My name, he receives Me.
18.bbe: And whoever gives honour to one such little child in my name, gives honour to me:

18.msb: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
18.kjv: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
18.blb: And whoever might cause to stumble one of these little ones believing in Me, it is better for him that a heavy millstone should be hung around his neck and he should be sunk in the depth of the sea.
18.bbe: But whoever is a cause of trouble to one of these little ones who have faith in me, it would be better for him to have a great stone fixed to his neck, and to come to his end in the deep sea.
18.heading: Temptations and Trespasses

18.msb: Woe to the world for the causes of sin. These stumbling blocks must come, but woe to that man through whom they come!
18.kjv: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!
18.blb: Woe to the world because of the stumbling blocks. For it is a necessity that the stumbling blocks come, but woe to the man through whom the stumbling block comes!
18.bbe: A curse is on the earth because of trouble! for it is necessary for trouble to come; but unhappy is that man through whom the trouble comes.

18.msb: If your hand or your foot causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life lame or crippled than to have two hands and two feet and be thrown into the eternal fire.
18.kjv: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
18.blb: Now if your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you; it is better for you to enter into life crippled or lame than, having two hands or two feet, to be cast into the eternal fire.
18.bbe: And if your hand or your foot is a cause of trouble, let it be cut off and put it away from you: it is better for you to go into life with the loss of a hand or a foot than, having two hands or two feet, to go into the eternal fire.

18.msb: And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.
18.kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
18.blb: And if your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life one-eyed than, having two eyes, to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.
18.bbe: And if your eye is a cause of trouble to you, take it out, and put it away from you: it is better for you to go into life with one eye than, having two eyes, to go into the hell of fire.

18.msb: See that you do not look down on any of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven.
18.kjv: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
18.blb: See that you do not despise one of these little ones. For I say to you that their angels in the heavens always see the face of My Father who is in the heavens.
18.bbe: Let it not seem to you that one of these little ones is of no value; for I say to you that in heaven their angels see at all times the face of my Father in heaven.
18.heading: The Parable of the Lost Sheep

18.msb: For the Son of Man came to save the lost.
18.kjv: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.

18.msb: What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them goes astray, does he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go out to search for the one that is lost?
18.kjv: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?
18.blb: What do you think? If unto any man there should be a hundred sheep, and one of them should go astray, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the mountains and, having gone, seek the one going astray?
18.bbe: What would you say now? if a man has a hundred sheep, and one of them has gone wandering away, will he not let the ninety-nine be, and go to the mountains in search of the wandering one?

18.msb: And if he finds it, truly I tell you, he rejoices more over that one sheep than over the ninety-nine that did not go astray.
18.kjv: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
18.blb: And if it should come to pass that he finds it, truly I say to you that he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine not having gone astray.
18.bbe: And if he comes across it, truly I say to you, he has more joy over it than over the ninety-nine which have not gone out of the way.

18.msb: In the same way, your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should perish.
18.kjv: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
18.blb: Thus it is not the will of your Father who is in the heavens that one of these little ones should be lost.
18.bbe: Even so it is not the pleasure of your Father in heaven for one of these little ones to come to destruction.

18.msb: If your brother sins against you, go and confront him privately. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.
18.kjv: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
18.blb: And if your brother may sin against you, go reprove him between you and him alone. If he may hear you, you have gained your brother.
18.bbe: And if your brother does wrong to you, go, make clear to him his error between you and him in private: if he gives ear to you, you have got your brother back again.
18.heading: A Brother Who Sins

18.msb: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’
18.kjv: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
18.blb: But if he may not hear, take with you one or two more, so that ‘every word may be stood upon the testimony of two or three witnesses.’
18.bbe: But if he will not give ear to you, take with you one or two more, that by the lips of two or three witnesses every word may be made certain.

18.msb: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church. And if he refuses to listen even to the church, regard him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.
18.kjv: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.
18.blb: And if he may fail to hear them, say it to the church. And if he may fail to hear even the church, let him be unto you as the Gentile and the tax collector.
18.bbe: And if he will not give ear to them, let it come to the hearing of the church: and if he will not give ear to the church, let him be to you as a Gentile and a tax-farmer.

18.msb: Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.
18.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
18.blb: Truly I say to you, whatever you shall bind on the earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you shall loose on the earth will be loosed in heaven.
18.bbe: Truly I say to you, Whatever things are fixed by you on earth will be fixed in heaven: and whatever you make free on earth will be made free in heaven.

18.msb: Again, I tell you truly that if two of you on the earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by My Father in heaven.
18.kjv: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
18.blb: Again, truly I say to you that if two of you on the earth shall agree about any matter that they shall ask, it will be done for them by My Father who is in the heavens.
18.bbe: Again, I say to you, that if two of you are in agreement on earth about anything for which they will make a request, it will be done for them by my Father in heaven.
18.heading: Ask in My Name

18.msb: For where two or three gather together in My name, there am I with them.”
18.kjv: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
18.blb: For where two or three are gathered together unto My name, there am I in their midst.”
18.bbe: For where two or three are come together in my name, there am I among them.

18.msb: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, “Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother who sins against me? Up to seven times?”
18.kjv: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
18.blb: Then, having come, Peter said to Him, “Lord, how often will my brother sin against me, and I will forgive him? Up to seven times?”
18.bbe: Then Peter came and said to him, Lord, what number of times may my brother do wrong against me, and I give him forgiveness? till seven times?
18.heading: The Unforgiving Servant

18.msb: Jesus answered, “I tell you, not just seven times, but seventy-seven times!
18.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
18.blb: Jesus says to him, “I do not say to you, up to seven times, but up to seventy-seven times!
18.bbe: Jesus says to him, I say not to you, Till seven times; but, Till seventy times seven.

18.msb: Because of this, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
18.kjv: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
18.blb: Because of this, the kingdom of the heavens was likened to to a man, a king, who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
18.bbe: For this reason the kingdom of heaven is like a king, who went over his accounts with his servants.

18.msb: As he began the settlements, a debtor owing ten thousand talents was brought to him.
18.kjv: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.
18.blb: And on his having begun to settle, one was brought to him, a debtor of ten thousand talents.
18.bbe: And at the start, one came to him who was in his debt for ten thousand talents.

18.msb: Since the man was unable to pay, the master ordered that he be sold to pay his debt, along with his wife and children and everything he owned.
18.kjv: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
18.blb: And on his having nothing to repay, the master commanded him to be sold—and the wife and the children and all of whatever he had—and repayment to be made.
18.bbe: And because he was not able to make payment, his lord gave orders for him, and his wife, and his sons and daughters, and all he had, to be given for money, and payment to be made.

18.msb: Then the servant fell on his knees before him. ‘Master, have patience with me,’ he begged, ‘and I will pay back everything.’
18.kjv: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
18.blb: Therefore the servant, having fallen down, was bowing on his knees to him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay all to you.’
18.bbe: So the servant went down on his face and gave him worship, saying, Lord, give me time to make payment and I will give you all.

18.msb: His master had compassion on him, forgave his debt, and released him.
18.kjv: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
18.blb: And having been moved with compassion, the master of that servant released him and forgave him the debt.
18.bbe: And the lord of that servant, being moved with pity, let him go, and made him free of the debt.

18.msb: But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii. He grabbed him and began to choke him, saying, ‘Pay back what you owe me!’
18.kjv: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
18.blb: But having gone out, that servant found one of his fellow servants who was owing him a hundred denarii. And having seized him, he was choking him, saying, ‘Repay what you owe!’
18.bbe: But that servant went out, and meeting one of the other servants, who was in debt to him for one hundred pence, he took him by the throat, saying, Make payment of your debt.

18.msb: So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, ‘Have patience with me, and I will pay you back.’
18.kjv: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
18.blb: Therefore, having fallen down, his fellow servant was calling on him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you.’
18.bbe: So that servant went down on his face, requesting him and saying, Give me time and I will make payment to you.

18.msb: But he refused. Instead, he went and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay his debt.
18.kjv: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
18.blb: But he was not willing. Rather, having gone, he cast him into prison until he should repay what was owed.
18.bbe: And he would not: but went and put him into prison till he had made payment of the debt.

18.msb: When his fellow servants saw what had happened, they were greatly distressed, and they went and recounted all of this to their master.
18.kjv: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
18.blb: Therefore his fellow servants, having seen the things having happened, were deeply grieved, and having gone, they made clear to their master all the things having happened.
18.bbe: So when the other servants saw what was done they were very sad, and came and gave word to their lord of what had been done.

18.msb: Then the master summoned him and said, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave all your debt because you begged me.
18.kjv: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
18.blb: Then, having summoned him, his master says to him, ‘Evil servant! I forgave you all that debt because you called on me.
18.bbe: Then his lord sent for him and said, You evil servant; I made you free of all that debt, because of your request to me:

18.msb: Shouldn’t you have had mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had on you?’
18.kjv: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?
18.blb: Was it not necessary for you also to have had mercy on your fellow servant, as I also had mercy on you?’
18.bbe: Was it not right for you to have mercy on the other servant, even as I had mercy on you?

18.msb: In anger his master turned him over to the jailers to be tortured, until he should repay all that was owed him.
18.kjv: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
18.blb: And having become angry, his master delivered him to the tormenters until he should repay everything being owed to him.
18.bbe: And his lord was very angry, and put him in the hands of those who would give him punishment till he made payment of all the debt.

18.msb: That is how My heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother his trespasses from your heart.”
18.kjv: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
18.blb: Thus also My heavenly Father will do to you unless each of you should forgive his brother from your hearts.”
18.bbe: So will my Father in heaven do to you, if you do not everyone, from your hearts, give forgiveness to his brother.

19.msb: When Jesus had finished saying these things, He left Galilee and went into the region of Judea beyond the Jordan.
19.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
19.blb: And it came to pass when Jesus finished these words that He withdrew from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.
19.bbe: And it came about that after saying these words, Jesus went away from Galilee, and came into the parts of Judaea on the other side of Jordan.
19.heading: Teachings about Divorce

19.msb: Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them there.
19.kjv: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
19.blb: And many crowds followed Him, and He healed them there.
19.bbe: And a great number went after him; and he made them well there.

19.msb: Then the Pharisees came and tested Him by asking, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
19.kjv: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
19.blb: And Pharisees came to Him, testing Him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to send away his wife for any cause?”
19.bbe: And certain Pharisees came to him, testing him, and saying, Is it right for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

19.msb: Jesus answered, “Have you not read that from the beginning the Creator ‘made them male and female,’
19.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
19.blb: And answering, He said, “Did you not read that the One having created from the beginning ‘made them male and female,’
19.bbe: And he said in answer, Have you not seen in the Writings, that he who made them at the first made them male and female, and said,

19.msb: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’?
19.kjv: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
19.blb: and He said, ‘On account of this a man will leave the father and the mother and be joined with his wife, and the two will be for one flesh’?
19.bbe: For this cause will a man go away from his father and mother, and be joined to his wife; and the two will become one flesh?

19.msb: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”
19.kjv: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
19.blb: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God yoked together, let man not separate.”
19.bbe: So that they are no longer two, but one flesh. Then let not that which has been joined by God be parted by man.

19.msb: “Why then,” they asked, “did Moses order a man to give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?”
19.kjv: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
19.blb: They say to Him, “Why then did Moses command to give her a roll of divorce and to send her away?”
19.bbe: They say to him, Why then did Moses give orders that a husband might give her a statement in writing and be free from her?

19.msb: Jesus replied, “Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because of your hardness of heart. But it was not this way from the beginning.
19.kjv: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
19.blb: He says to them, “Moses, for your hardness of heart, allowed you to divorce your wives; but it has not been this way from the beginning.
19.bbe: He says to them, Moses, because of your hard hearts, let you put away your wives: but it has not been so from the first.

19.msb: Now I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman commits adultery. And he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.”
19.kjv: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
19.blb: And I say to you that whoever shall send away his wife, except for sexual immorality, and shall marry another, he commits adultery.”
19.bbe: And I say to you, Whoever puts away his wife for any other cause than the loss of her virtue, and takes another, is a false husband: and he who takes her as his wife when she is put away, is no true husband to her.

19.msb: His disciples said to Him, “If this is the case between a man and his wife, it is better not to marry.”
19.kjv: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
19.blb: His disciples say to Him, “If this is the case of the man with the wife, it is better not to marry.”
19.bbe: The disciples say to him, If this is the position of a man in relation to his wife, it is better not to be married.

19.msb: “Not everyone can accept this word,” He replied, “but only those to whom it has been given.
19.kjv: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
19.blb: And He said to them, “Not all receive this word, but those to whom it has been given.
19.bbe: But he said to them, Not all men are able to take in this saying, but only those to whom it is given.

19.msb: For there are eunuchs who were born that way; others were made that way by men; and still others live like eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. The one who can accept this should accept it.”
19.kjv: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother’s womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
19.blb: For there are eunuchs who were born thus from the womb of their mother, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men, and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of the heavens. The one being able to receive it, let him receive it.”
19.bbe: For there are men who, from birth, were without sex: and there are some who were made so by men: and there are others who have made themselves so for the kingdom of heaven. He who is able to take it, let him take it.

19.msb: Then little children were brought to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them and pray for them. And the disciples rebuked those who brought them.
19.kjv: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
19.blb: Then little children were brought to Him so that He might lay the hands on them and He might pray, but the disciples rebuked them.
19.bbe: Then some people took little children to him, so that he might put his hands on them in blessing: and the disciples said sharp words to them.
19.heading: Jesus Blesses the Children

19.msb: But Jesus said, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.”
