19.kjv: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
19.blb: But Jesus said, “Permit the little children, and do not forbid them to come to Me! For unto such is the kingdom of the heavens.”
19.bbe: But Jesus said, Let the little ones come to me, and do not keep them away: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

19.msb: And after He had placed His hands on them, He went on from there.
19.kjv: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
19.blb: And having laid the hands on them, He went from there.
19.bbe: And he put his hands on them, and went away.

19.msb: Just then a man came up to Jesus and inquired, “Good Teacher, what good thing must I do to obtain eternal life?”
19.kjv: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
19.blb: And behold, one having come to Him said, “Teacher, what good shall I do so that I shall have eternal life?”
19.bbe: And one came to him and said, Master, what good thing have I to do, so that I may have eternal life?
19.heading: The Rich Young Man

19.msb: “Why do you call Me good?” Jesus replied. “There is no one who is good but God. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments.”
19.kjv: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
19.blb: And He said to him, “Why do you ask Me about the good? One is good. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”
19.bbe: And he said to him, Why are you questioning me about what is good? One there is who is good: but if you have a desire to go into life, keep the rules of the law.

19.msb: “Which ones?” the man asked. Jesus answered, “‘Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness,
19.kjv: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
19.blb: He says to Him, “Which?” And Jesus said, “‘You will not murder, you will not commit adultery, you will not steal, you will not bear false witness,
19.bbe: He says to him, Which? And Jesus said, Do not put anyone to death, Do not be untrue in married life, Do not take what is not yours, Do not give false witness,

19.msb: honor your father and mother, and love your neighbor as yourself.’”
19.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
19.blb: honor the father and the mother, and you will love your neighbor as yourself.’”
19.bbe: Give honour to your father and your mother: and, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself.

19.msb: “All these I have kept from my youth,” said the young man. “What do I still lack?”
19.kjv: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
19.blb: The young man says to Him, “All these I kept. What do I still lack?”
19.bbe: The young man says to him, All these things have I done: what more is there?

19.msb: Jesus told him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”
19.kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
19.blb: Jesus was saying to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you are possessing and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in the heavens. And come, follow Me.”
19.bbe: Jesus said to him, If you have a desire to be complete, go, get money for your property, and give it to the poor, and you will have wealth in heaven: and come after me.

19.msb: When the young man heard this, he went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.
19.kjv: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
19.blb: And having heard this word, the young man went away grieving, for he was one having many possessions.
19.bbe: But hearing these words the young man went away sorrowing: for he had much property.

19.msb: Then Jesus said to His disciples, “Truly I tell you, it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.
19.kjv: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
19.blb: And Jesus said to His disciples, “Truly I say to you that with difficulty a rich man will enter into the kingdom of the heavens.
19.bbe: And Jesus said to his disciples, Truly I say to you, It is hard for a man with much money to go into the kingdom of heaven.

19.msb: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
19.kjv: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
19.blb: And again I say to you, it is easier for a camel to enter through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.”
19.bbe: And again I say to you, It is simpler for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a man with much money to go into the kingdom of God.

19.msb: When His disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, “Who then can be saved?”
19.kjv: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
19.blb: And having heard, the disciples were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then is able to be saved?”
19.bbe: And the disciples, hearing this, were greatly surprised, saying, Who then may have salvation?

19.msb: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
19.kjv: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
19.blb: And having looked on them, Jesus said to them, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
19.bbe: And Jesus, looking at them, said, With men this is not possible; but with God all things are possible.

19.msb: “Look,” Peter replied, “we have left everything to follow You. What then will there be for us?”
19.kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
19.blb: Then answering, Peter said to Him, “Behold, we have left all and followed You. What then will be unto us?”
19.bbe: Then Peter said to him, See, we have given up everything and have come after you; what then will we have?

19.msb: Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, in the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on His glorious throne, you who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
19.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
19.blb: And Jesus said to them, “Truly I say to you that you, the ones having followed Me, in the regeneration, when the Son of Man shall sit down upon His throne of glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
19.bbe: And Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you that in the time when all things are made new, and the Son of man is seated in his glory, you who have come after me will be seated on twelve seats, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

19.msb: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of My name will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life.
19.kjv: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
19.blb: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of My name will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life.
19.bbe: And everyone who has given up houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or child, or land, for my name, will be given a hundred times as much, and have eternal life.

19.msb: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.
19.kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
19.blb: But many who are first will be last, and last, first.
19.bbe: But a great number who are first will be last, and some who are last will be first.

20.msb: “For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire workers for his vineyard.
20.kjv: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
20.blb: “For the kingdom of the heavens is like a man, a master of a house, who went out in the morning to hire workmen for his vineyard.
20.bbe: For the kingdom of heaven is like the master of a house, who went out early in the morning to get workers into his vine-garden.
20.heading: The Parable of the Workers

20.msb: He agreed to pay them a denarius for the day and sent them into his vineyard.
20.kjv: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
20.blb: And having agreed with the workmen for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
20.bbe: And when he had made an agreement with the workmen for a penny a day, he sent them into his vine-garden.

20.msb: About the third hour he went out and saw others standing in the marketplace doing nothing.
20.kjv: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
20.blb: And having gone out about the third hour, he saw others standing in the marketplace idle.
20.bbe: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others in the market-place doing nothing;

20.msb: ‘You also go into my vineyard,’ he said, ‘and I will pay you whatever is right.’
20.kjv: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
20.blb: And to those ones he said, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and I will give you whatever may be right.’
20.bbe: And he said to them, Go into the vine-garden with the others, and whatever is right I will give you. And they went to work.

20.msb: So they went. He went out again about the sixth hour and the ninth hour and did the same thing.
20.kjv: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.
20.blb: And they went away. And having gone out again about the sixth and ninth hour, he did likewise.
20.bbe: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did the same.

20.msb: About the eleventh hour he went out and found still others standing idle. ‘Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?’ he asked.
20.kjv: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
20.blb: And about the eleventh, having gone out, he found others standing, and he says to them, ‘Why do you stand here all the day idle?’
20.bbe: And about the eleventh hour he went out and saw others doing nothing; and he says to them, Why are you here all the day doing nothing?

20.msb: ‘Because no one has hired us,’ they answered. So he told them, ‘You also go into my vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’
20.kjv: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.
20.blb: They say to him, ‘Because no one hired us.’ He says to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard.’
20.bbe: They say to him, Because no man has given us work. He says to them, Go in with the rest, into the vine-garden.

20.msb: When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his foreman, ‘Call the workers and pay them their wages, starting with the last ones hired and moving on to the first.’
20.kjv: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
20.blb: And evening having come, the master of the vineyard says to his foreman, ‘Call the workmen and pay them the wages, having begun from the last, up to the first.’
20.bbe: And when evening came, the lord of the vine-garden said to his manager, Let the workers come, and give them their payment, from the last to the first.

20.msb: The workers who were hired about the eleventh hour came and each received a denarius.
20.kjv: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
20.blb: And having come, the ones of about the eleventh hour each received a denarius.
20.bbe: And when those men came who had gone to work at the eleventh hour, they were given every man a penny.

20.msb: So when the original workers came, they assumed they would receive more. But each of them also received a denarius.
20.kjv: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.
20.blb: And having come, the first thought that they will receive more. But they themselves also received each a denarius.
20.bbe: Then those who came first had the idea that they would get more; and they, like the rest, were given a penny.

20.msb: On receiving their pay, they began to grumble against the landowner.
20.kjv: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,
20.blb: And having received it, they were grumbling against the master of the house,
20.bbe: And when they got it, they made a protest against the master of the house,

20.msb: ‘These men who were hired last worked only one hour,’ they said, ‘and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden and the scorching heat of the day.’
20.kjv: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.
20.blb: saying, ‘These, the last, worked one hour, and you made them equal to us, the ones having borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat.’
20.bbe: Saying, These last have done only one hour's work, and you have made them equal to us, who have undergone the hard work of the day and the burning heat.

20.msb: But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am not being unfair to you. Did you not agree with me on one denarius?
20.kjv: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?
20.blb: And answering one of them, he said, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Did you not agree with me on a denarius?
20.bbe: But he in answer said to one of them, Friend, I do you no wrong: did you not make an agreement with me for a penny?

20.msb: Take your pay and go. I want to give this last man the same as I gave you.
20.kjv: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
20.blb: Take what is yours and go. But I want to give to this last one as to you also.
20.bbe: Take what is yours, and go away; it is my pleasure to give to this last, even as to you.

20.msb: Do I not have the right to do as I please with what is mine? Or are you envious because I am generous?’
20.kjv: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?
20.blb: Or is it not lawful for me to do what I want with what is mine? Or is your eye evil because I am good?’
20.bbe: Have I not the right to do as seems good to me in my house? or is your eye evil, because I am good?

20.msb: So the last will be first, and the first will be last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”
20.kjv: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
20.blb: Thus the last will be first, and the first, last.”
20.bbe: So the last will be first, and the first last.

20.msb: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, He took the twelve disciples aside and said,
20.kjv: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,
20.blb: And Jesus, going up to Jerusalem, took aside the twelve disciples by themselves, and on the way He said to them,
20.bbe: And when Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples on one side, and said to them,
20.heading: The Third Prediction of the Passion

20.msb: “Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes. They will condemn Him to death
20.kjv: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,
20.blb: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be betrayed to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn Him to death.
20.bbe: See, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man will be given into the hands of the chief priests and scribes; and they will give orders for him to be put to death,

20.msb: and will deliver Him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified. And on the third day He will rise again.”
20.kjv: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.
20.blb: And they will betray Him to the Gentiles to mock and to flog and to crucify, and on the third day He will be raised up.”
20.bbe: And will give him up to the Gentiles to be made sport of and to be whipped and to be put to death on the cross: and the third day he will come back again from the dead.

20.msb: Then the mother of Zebedee’s sons came to Jesus with her sons and knelt down to make a request of Him.
20.kjv: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee’s children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.
20.blb: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to Him with her sons, kneeling down and asking something from Him.
20.bbe: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, giving him worship and making a request of him.
20.heading: A Mother’s Request

20.msb: “What do you want?” He inquired. She answered, “Declare that in Your kingdom one of these two sons of mine may sit at Your right hand, and the other at Your left.”
20.kjv: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.
20.blb: And He said to her, “What do you want?” She says to Him, “Say that these two sons of mine shall sit, one at Your right hand and one at Your left hand, in Your kingdom.”
20.bbe: And he said to her, What is your desire? She says to him, Let my two sons be seated, the one at your right hand, and the other at your left, in your kingdom.

20.msb: “You do not know what you are asking,” Jesus replied. “Can you drink the cup I am going to drink or be baptized with the baptism with which I am baptized?” “We can,” the brothers answered.
20.kjv: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.
20.blb: And answering, Jesus said, “You do not know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink?” They say to Him, “We are able.”
20.bbe: But Jesus made answer and said, You have no idea what you are requesting. Are you able to take of the cup which I am about to take?

20.msb: “You will indeed drink My cup and be baptized with the baptism with which I am baptized,” Jesus said. “But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom My Father has prepared them.”
20.kjv: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.
20.blb: He says to them, “Indeed you will drink My cup, but to sit at My right hand and at My left, this is not Mine to give, but to those for whom it has been prepared by My Father.”
20.bbe: They say to him, We are able. He says to them, Truly, you will take of my cup: but to be seated at my right hand and at my left is not for me to give, but it is for those for whom my Father has made it ready.

20.msb: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.
20.kjv: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
20.blb: And having heard, the ten were indignant about the two brothers.
20.bbe: And when it came to the ears of the ten, they were angry with the two brothers.

20.msb: But Jesus called them aside and said, “You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their superiors exercise authority over them.
20.kjv: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
20.blb: But Jesus, having summoned them, said, “You know that the rulers of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them, and the great ones exercise authority over them.
20.bbe: But Jesus said to them, You see that the rulers of the Gentiles are lords over them, and their great ones have authority over them.

20.msb: But it shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
20.kjv: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
20.blb: It will not be this way among you. But whoever may want to become great among you, he will be your servant;
20.bbe: Let it not be so among you: but if anyone has a desire to become great among you, let him be your servant;

20.msb: and whoever wants to be first among you must be your slave—
20.kjv: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
20.blb: and whoever may want to be first among you, he will be your slave—
20.bbe: And whoever has a desire to be first among you, let him take the lowest place:

20.msb: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”
20.kjv: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
20.blb: even as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”
20.bbe: Even as the Son of man did not come to have servants, but to be a servant, and to give his life for the salvation of men.

20.msb: As they were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed Him.
20.kjv: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
20.blb: And in their going out from Jericho, a great crowd followed Him.
20.bbe: And when they were going out from Jericho, a great number went after him.
20.heading: The Blind Men by the Road

20.msb: And there were two blind men sitting beside the road. When they heard that Jesus was passing by, they cried out, “Have mercy on us, Lord, Son of David!”
20.kjv: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.
20.blb: And behold, two blind men sitting beside the road, having heard that Jesus is passing by, cried out, saying, “Lord, have mercy on us, Son of David!”
20.bbe: And two blind men seated by the wayside, when they had the news that Jesus was going by, gave a loud cry, saying, Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us.

20.msb: The crowd admonished them to be silent, but they cried out all the louder, “Have mercy on us, Lord, Son of David!”
20.kjv: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.
20.blb: And the crowd rebuked them, that they should be silent. But they cried out all the more, saying, “Lord, have mercy on us, Son of David!”
20.bbe: And the people gave them orders to be quiet; but they went on crying even louder, Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us.

20.msb: Jesus stopped and called them. “What do you want Me to do for you?” He asked.
20.kjv: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?
20.blb: And having stood, Jesus called them and said, “What do you want that I may do for you?”
20.bbe: And Jesus, stopping, sent for them, and said, What would you have me do to you?

20.msb: “Lord,” they answered, “let our eyes be opened.”
20.kjv: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
20.blb: They say to Him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”
20.bbe: They say to him, Lord, that our eyes may be open.

20.msb: Moved with compassion, Jesus touched their eyes, and at once they received their sight and followed Him.
20.kjv: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
20.blb: And having been moved with compassion, Jesus touched their eyes, and immediately they received their sight, and they followed Him.
20.bbe: And Jesus, being moved with pity, put his fingers on their eyes: and straight away they were able to see, and went after him.

21.msb: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethsphage on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent out two disciples,
21.kjv: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
21.blb: And when they drew near to Jerusalem and came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,
21.bbe: And when they were near Jerusalem, and had come to Beth-phage, to the Mountain of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples,
21.heading: The Triumphal Entry

21.msb: saying to them, “Go into the village opposite you, and at once you will find a donkey tied there, with her colt beside her. Untie them and bring them to Me.
21.kjv: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.
21.blb: saying to them, “Go into the village ahead of you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Having loosed them, bring them to Me.
21.bbe: Saying to them, Go into the little town in front of you, and straight away you will see an ass with a cord round her neck, and a young one with her; let them loose and come with them to me.

21.msb: If anyone questions you, tell him that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away.”
21.kjv: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
21.blb: And if anyone should say anything to you, you will say that the Lord has need of them, and immediately he will send them.”
21.bbe: And if anyone says anything to you, you will say, The Lord has need of them; and straight away he will send them.

21.msb: All this took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:
21.kjv: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,
21.blb: And this came to pass so that it might be fulfilled, that having been spoken through the prophet, saying,
21.bbe: Now this took place so that these words of the prophet might come true,

21.msb: “Say to the Daughter of Zion, ‘See, your King comes to you, gentle and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.’”
21.kjv: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.
21.blb: “Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your King comes to you, gentle and mounted on a donkey, and on a colt, the foal of a beast of burden.’”
21.bbe: Say to the daughter of Zion, See, your King comes to you, gentle and seated on an ass, and on a young ass.

21.msb: So the disciples went and did as Jesus had directed them.
21.kjv: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,
21.blb: And the disciples, having gone and having done as Jesus directed them,
21.bbe: And the disciples went and did as Jesus had given them orders,

21.msb: They brought the donkey and the colt and laid their cloaks on them, and Jesus sat on them.
21.kjv: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.
21.blb: led the donkey and the colt and put their garments on them, and He sat on them.
21.bbe: And got the ass and the young one, and put their clothing on them, and he took his seat on it.

21.msb: A massive crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
21.kjv: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
21.blb: And the very large crowd spread their garments in the road, and others were cutting branches from the trees and were spreading them in the road.
21.bbe: And all the people put their clothing down in the way; and others got branches from the trees, and put them down in the way.

21.msb: The crowds that went ahead of Him and those that followed were shouting: “Hosanna to the Son of David!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Hosanna in the highest!”
21.kjv: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
21.blb: And the crowds going before Him and those following were crying out, saying: “Hosanna to the Son of David!” “Blessed is the One coming in the name of the Lord!” “Hosanna in the highest!”
21.bbe: And those who went before him, and those who came after, gave loud cries, saying, Glory to the Son of David: A blessing on him who comes in the name of the Lord: Glory in the highest.

21.msb: When Jesus had entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, “Who is this?”
21.kjv: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
21.blb: And on His having entered into Jerusalem, all the city was shaken, saying, “Who is this?”
21.bbe: And when he came into Jerusalem, all the town was moved, saying, Who is this?

21.msb: The crowds replied, “This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.”
21.kjv: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
21.blb: And the crowds were saying, “This is the prophet, Jesus, the One from Nazareth of Galilee.”
21.bbe: And the people said, This is the prophet Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.

21.msb: Then Jesus entered the temple of God and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves.
21.kjv: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
21.blb: And Jesus entered into the temple and cast out all those selling and buying in the temple. And He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling the doves.
21.bbe: And Jesus went into the Temple and sent out all who were trading there, overturning the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those trading in doves.
21.heading: Jesus Cleanses the Temple

21.msb: And He declared to them, “It is written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer.’ But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”
21.kjv: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.
21.blb: And He says to them, “It has been written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer.’ But you are making it ‘a den of robbers.’”
21.bbe: And he said to them, It is in the Writings, My house is to be named a house of prayer, but you are making it a hole of thieves.

21.msb: The lame and the blind came to Him at the temple, and He healed them.
21.kjv: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
21.blb: And the blind and the lame came to Him in the temple, and He healed them.
21.bbe: And the blind and the broken in body came to him in the Temple, and he made them well.

21.msb: But the chief priests and scribes were indignant when they saw the wonders He performed and the children shouting in the temple courts, “Hosanna to the Son of David!”
21.kjv: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; they were sore displeased,
21.blb: But the chief priests and the scribes, having seen the wonders that He did and the children crying out in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the Son of David,” were indignant.
21.bbe: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the works of power which he did, and the children crying out in the Temple, Glory to the son of David, they were angry and said to him,

21.msb: “Do You hear what these children are saying?” they asked. “Yes,” Jesus answered. “Have you never read: ‘From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise’?”
21.kjv: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
21.blb: And they said to Him, “Do You hear what these say?” And Jesus says to them, “Yes. Did you never read: ‘Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings You prepared praise’?”
21.bbe: Have you any idea what these are saying? And Jesus said to them, Yes: have you not seen in the Writings, From the lips of children and babies at the breast you have made your praise complete?

21.msb: Then He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where He spent the night.
21.kjv: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
21.blb: And having left them, He went out of the city to Bethany, and He lodged there.
21.bbe: And he went away from them, and went out of the town to Bethany, and was there for the night.

21.msb: In the morning, as Jesus was returning to the city, He was hungry.
21.kjv: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
21.blb: And in the morning, having come back into the city, He was hungry.
21.bbe: Now in the morning when he was coming back to the town, he had a desire for food.
21.heading: The Barren Fig Tree

21.msb: Seeing a fig tree by the road, He went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. “May you never bear fruit again!” He said. And immediately the tree withered.
21.kjv: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
21.blb: And having seen one fig tree on the way, He went to it and found nothing on it except leaves. And He says to it, “Never let there be anymore fruit out of you, to the age!” And the fig tree withered immediately.
21.bbe: And seeing a fig-tree by the wayside, he came to it, and saw nothing on it but leaves only; and he said to it, Let there be no fruit from you from this time forward for ever. And straight away the fig-tree became dry and dead.

21.msb: When the disciples saw this, they marveled and asked, “How did the fig tree wither so quickly?”
21.kjv: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
21.blb: And having seen it, the disciples marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree wither immediately?”
21.bbe: And when the disciples saw it they were surprised, saying, How did the fig-tree become dry in so short a time?

21.msb: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “if you have faith and do not doubt, not only will you do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ it will happen.
21.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.
21.blb: And answering, Jesus said to them, “Truly I say to you, if you shall have faith and not doubt, you will do not only this of the fig tree, but even if you should say to this mountain, ‘Be taken away and be cast into the sea,’ it will come to pass.
21.bbe: And Jesus in answer said to them, Truly I say to you, If you have faith, without doubting, not only may you do what has been done to the fig-tree, but even if you say to this mountain, Be taken up and put into the sea, it will be done.

21.msb: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.”
21.kjv: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
21.blb: And all things, as many as you might ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”
21.bbe: And all things, whatever you make request for in prayer, having faith, you will get.

21.msb: When Jesus returned to the temple courts and began to teach, the chief priests and elders of the people came up to Him. “By what authority are You doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave You this authority?”
21.kjv: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
21.blb: And on His having come into the temple teaching, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to Him, saying, “By what authority do You do these things?” And who gave You this authority?
21.bbe: And when he had come into the Temple, the chief priests and those in authority over the people came to him while he was teaching, and said, By what authority do you do these things? and who gave you this authority?
21.heading: Jesus’ Authority Challenged

21.msb: “I will also ask you one question,” Jesus replied, “and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
21.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
21.blb: And answering, Jesus said to them, “I will also ask you one word, which if you tell Me, I will also tell you by what authority I do these things.
21.bbe: And Jesus said to them in answer, I will put one question to you, and if you give me the answer, I will say by what authority I do these things.

21.msb: What was the source of John’s baptism? Was it from heaven or from men?” They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
21.kjv: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
21.blb: From where was the baptism of John? From heaven or from men?” And they were reasoning among themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven,’ He will say to us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
21.bbe: The baptism of John, where did it come from? from heaven or from men? And they were reasoning among themselves, saying, If we say, From heaven; he will say to us, Why then did you not have faith in him?

21.msb: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we are afraid of the people, for they all regard John as a prophet.”
21.kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
21.blb: But if we should say, ‘From men,’ we fear the crowd, for all hold John as a prophet.”
21.bbe: But if we say, From men; we are in fear of the people, because all take John to be a prophet.

21.msb: So they answered, “We do not know.” And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
21.kjv: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
21.blb: And answering Jesus, they said, “We do not know.” And He said to them, “Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
21.bbe: And they made answer and said, We have no idea. Then he said to them, And I will not say to you by what authority I do these things.

21.msb: But what do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first one and said, ‘Son, go and work today in my vineyard.’
21.kjv: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
21.blb: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and having come to the first he said, ‘Son, go today, work in the vineyard.’
21.bbe: But how does it seem to you? A man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go and do work today in the vine-garden.
21.heading: The Parable of the Two Sons

21.msb: ‘I will not,’ he replied. But later he changed his mind and went.
21.kjv: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
21.blb: And answering, he said, ‘I will not.’ But afterward, having repented, he went.
21.bbe: And he said in answer, I will not: but later, changing his decision, he went.

21.msb: Then the man went to the second son and told him the same thing. ‘I will, sir,’ he said. But he did not go.
21.kjv: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
21.blb: And having come to the second, he said likewise. And answering, he said, ‘I will sir,’ and he did not go.
21.bbe: And he came to the second and said the same. And he made answer and said, I go, sir: and went not.

21.msb: Which of the two did the will of his father?” “The first,” they answered. Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God before you.
21.kjv: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
21.blb: Which of the two did the will of the father?” They say, “The first.” Jesus says to them, “Truly I say to you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes go before you into the kingdom of God.
21.bbe: Which of the two did his father's pleasure? They say, The first. Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you, that tax-farmers and loose women are going into the kingdom of God before you.

21.msb: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and prostitutes did. And even after you saw this, you did not repent and believe him.
21.kjv: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
21.blb: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. And you, having seen, did not even repent afterward to believe him.
21.bbe: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you had no faith in him, but the tax-farmers and the loose women had faith in him: and you, when you saw it, did not even have regret for your sins, so as to have faith in him.

21.msb: Listen to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it, and built a tower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.
21.kjv: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
21.blb: Hear another parable: There was a man, a master of a house, who planted a vineyard, and placed around it a fence, and dug a winepress in it, and built a tower. And he rented it out to farmers and traveled abroad.
21.bbe: Give ear to another story. A master of a house made a vine garden, and put a wall round it, and made a place for crushing out the wine, and made a tower, and let it out to field-workers, and went into another country.
21.heading: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants

21.msb: When the harvest time drew near, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit.
21.kjv: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
21.blb: And when the season of the fruits drew near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruits.
21.bbe: And when the time for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the workmen, to get the fruit.

21.msb: But the tenants seized his servants. They beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.
21.kjv: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
21.blb: And the farmers, having taken his servants, one they beat, and one they killed, and one they stoned.
21.bbe: And the workmen made an attack on his servants, giving blows to one, putting another to death, and stoning another.

21.msb: Again, he sent other servants, more than the first group. But the tenants did the same to them.
21.kjv: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
21.blb: Again he sent other servants, more than the first, and they did likewise to them.
21.bbe: Again, he sent other servants more in number than the first: and they did the same to them.

21.msb: Finally, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
21.kjv: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
21.blb: And afterward he sent his son to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
21.bbe: But after that he sent his son to them, saying, They will have respect for my son.

21.msb: But when the tenants saw the son, they said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and take his inheritance.’
21.kjv: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.
21.blb: But the farmers, having seen the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and gain possession of his inheritance.’
21.bbe: But when the workmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is he who will one day be the owner of the property; come, let us put him to death and take his heritage.

21.msb: So they seized him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
21.kjv: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.
21.blb: And having taken him, they cast him out of the vineyard and killed him.
21.bbe: And they took him and, driving him out of the vine-garden, put him to death.

21.msb: Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard returns, what will he do to those tenants?”
21.kjv: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
21.blb: Therefore, when the lord of the vineyard shall come, what will he do to those farmers?”
21.bbe: When, then, the lord of the vine-garden comes, what will he do to those workmen?

21.msb: “He will bring those wretches to a wretched end,” they replied, “and will rent out the vineyard to other tenants who will give him his share of the fruit at harvest time.”
21.kjv: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
21.blb: They say to Him, “He will destroy those evil ones grievously, and he will give out the vineyard to other farmers who will give back to him the fruits in their seasons.”
21.bbe: They say to him, He will put those cruel men to a cruel death, and will let out the vine-garden to other workmen, who will give him the fruit when it is ready.

21.msb: Jesus said to them, “Have you never read in the Scriptures: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?
21.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
21.blb: Jesus says to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures: ‘The stone that those building rejected, this became the head of the corner. This was from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?
21.bbe: Jesus says to them, Did you never see in the Writings, The stone which the builders put on one side, the same has been made the chief stone of the building: this was the Lord's doing, and it is a wonder in our eyes?

21.msb: Therefore I tell you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit.
21.kjv: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
21.blb: Because of this I say to you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you, and it will be given to a people producing its fruits.
21.bbe: For this reason I say to you, The kingdom of God will be taken away from you, and will be given to a nation producing the fruits of it.

21.msb: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed.”
21.kjv: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
21.blb: And the one having fallen on this stone will be broken; but on whomever it might fall, it will grind him to powder.”
21.bbe: Any man falling on this stone will be broken, but he on whom it comes down will be crushed to dust.

21.msb: When the chief priests and Pharisees heard His parables, they knew that Jesus was speaking about them.
21.kjv: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
21.blb: And the chief priests and the Pharisees, having heard His parables, knew that He speaks about them.
21.bbe: And when his stories came to the ears of the chief priests and the Pharisees, they saw that he was talking of them.

21.msb: Although they wanted to arrest Him, they were afraid of the crowds, because the people regarded Him as a prophet.
21.kjv: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.
21.blb: And seeking to lay hold of Him, they feared the crowds, because they were holding Him as a prophet.
21.bbe: And though they had a desire to take him, they were in fear of the people, because in their eyes he was a prophet.

22.msb: Once again, Jesus spoke to them in parables:
22.kjv: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,
22.blb: And answering, Jesus again spoke to them in parables, saying:
22.bbe: And Jesus, talking to them again in stories, said:
22.heading: The Parable of the Banquet

22.msb: “The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.
22.kjv: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,
22.blb: “The kingdom of the heavens was likened to a man, a king, who made a wedding feast for his son.
22.bbe: The kingdom of heaven is like a certain king, who made a feast when his son was married,

22.msb: He sent his servants to call those he had invited to the banquet, but they refused to come.
22.kjv: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
22.blb: And he sent his servants to call those having been called to the wedding feast, and they were not willing to come.
22.bbe: And sent out his servants to get in the guests to the feast: and they would not come.

22.msb: Again, he sent other servants and said, ‘Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner. My oxen and fattened cattle have been killed, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.’
22.kjv: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.
22.blb: Again he sent other servants, saying, ‘Say to those having been called: Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My oxen and fatlings have been killed, and all things are ready; come to the wedding feast.’
22.bbe: Again he sent out other servants, with orders to say to the guests, See, I have made ready my feast: my oxen and my fat beasts have been put to death, and all things are ready: come to the feast.

22.msb: But they paid no attention and went away, one to his field, another to his business.
22.kjv: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
22.blb: And having disregarded it, they went away, one to his own field, and one to his business.
22.bbe: But they gave no attention, and went about their business, one to his farm, another to his trade:

22.msb: The rest seized his servants, mistreated them, and killed them.
22.kjv: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.
22.blb: And the rest, having laid hold of his servants, mistreated and killed them.
22.bbe: And the rest put violent hands on his servants, and did evil to them, and put them to death.

22.msb: When he heard this, the king was enraged, and he sent his troops to destroy those murderers and burn their city.
22.kjv: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
22.blb: And the king was enraged, and having sent his armies, he destroyed those murderers and set on fire their city.
22.bbe: But the king was angry; and he sent his armies, and those who had put his servants to death he gave to destruction, burning down their town with fire.

22.msb: Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited were not worthy.
22.kjv: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.
22.blb: Then he says to his servants, ‘Indeed, the wedding feast is ready, but those having been called were not worthy.
22.bbe: Then he said to his servants, The feast is ready but the guests were not good enough.

22.msb: Go therefore to the crossroads and invite to the banquet as many as you can find.’
22.kjv: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.
22.blb: Therefore go on the thoroughfares of the roads and call to the wedding feast as many as you may find.’
22.bbe: Go then to the cross-roads, and get all those whom you see to come to the bride-feast.

22.msb: So the servants went out into the streets and gathered everyone they could find, both evil and good, and the wedding hall was filled with guests.
22.kjv: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.
22.blb: And those servants, having gone out into the roads, gathered together all whom they found, both evil and good, and the wedding feast was filled with those reclining.
22.bbe: And those servants went out into the streets, and got together all those whom they came across, bad and good: and the feast was full of guests.

22.msb: But when the king came in to see the guests, he spotted a man who was not dressed in wedding clothes.
22.kjv: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:
22.blb: And the king, having entered to view those reclining, saw a man there not dressed in clothing of a wedding feast.
22.bbe: But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who had not on a guest's robe;

22.msb: ‘Friend,’ he asked, ‘how did you get in here without wedding clothes?’ But the man was speechless.
22.kjv: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.
22.blb: And he says to him, ‘Friend, how did you enter here not having clothing of a wedding feast?’ And he was speechless.
22.bbe: And he says to him, Friend, how came you in here not having a guest's robe? And he had nothing to say.

22.msb: Then the king told the servants, ‘Tie him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
22.kjv: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
22.blb: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Having bound his feet and hands, cast him out into the outer darkness—there will be weeping and gnashing of the teeth.’
22.bbe: Then the king said to the servants, Put cords round his hands and feet and put him out into the dark; there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.

22.msb: For many are called, but few are chosen.”
22.kjv: For many are called, but few are chosen.
22.blb: For many are called, but few chosen.”
22.bbe: For out of all to whom the good news has come, only a small number will get salvation.

22.msb: Then the Pharisees went out and conspired to trap Jesus in His words.
22.kjv: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
22.blb: Then having gone, the Pharisees took counsel as to how they might trap Him in a word.
22.bbe: Then the Pharisees went and had a meeting to see how they might make use of his words to take him.
22.heading: Paying Taxes to Caesar

22.msb: They sent their disciples to Him along with the Herodians. “Teacher,” they said, “we know that You are honest and that You teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You seek favor from no one, because You pay no attention to external appearance.
22.kjv: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.
22.blb: And they send to Him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that You are true, and You teach the way of God in truth. And to You there is care about no one, for You do not look to the appearance of men.
22.bbe: And they sent to him their disciples, with the Herodians, saying, Master, we see that you are true, and that you are teaching the true way of God, and have no fear of anyone, because you have no respect for a man's position.

22.msb: So tell us what You think: Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”
22.kjv: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?
22.blb: Therefore tell us, what do You think? Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar or not?”
22.bbe: Give us, then, your opinion of this: Is it right to give tax to Caesar, or not?

22.msb: But Jesus knew their evil intent and said, “You hypocrites, why are you testing Me?
22.kjv: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?
22.blb: But having known their malice, Jesus said, “Why do you test Me, hypocrites?
22.bbe: But Jesus saw their trick and said, Oh false ones, why are you attempting to put me in the wrong?

22.msb: Show Me the coin used for the tax.” And they brought Him a denarius.
22.kjv: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.
22.blb: Show Me the coin of the tribute.” And they presented to Him a denarius.
22.bbe: Let me see the tax money. And they gave him a penny.

22.msb: “Whose image is this,” He asked, “and whose inscription?”
22.kjv: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
22.blb: And He says to them, “Whose is this image, and the inscription?”
22.bbe: And he said to them, Whose is this image and name on it?

22.msb: “Caesar’s,” they answered. So Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”
22.kjv: They say unto him, Cæsar’s. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which are Cæsar’s; and unto God the things that are God’s.
22.blb: They say to Him, “Caesar’s.” Then He says to them, “Therefore give back the things of Caesar to Caesar, and the things of God to God.”
22.bbe: They say to him, Caesar's. Then he said to them, Give to Caesar the things which are Caesar's, and to God the things which are God's.

22.msb: And when they heard this, they were amazed. So they left Him and went away.
22.kjv: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
22.blb: And having heard, they marveled. And having left Him, they went away.
22.bbe: And hearing it, they were full of wonder, and went away from him.

22.msb: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him.
22.kjv: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
22.blb: On that day Sadducees, saying there is not a resurrection, came to Him, and they questioned Him,
22.bbe: On the same day there came to him the Sadducees, who say that there is no coming back from the dead: and they put a question to him, saying,
22.heading: The Sadducees and the Resurrection

22.msb: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses declared that if a man dies without having children, his brother is to marry the widow and raise up offspring for him.
22.kjv: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
22.blb: saying, “Teacher, Moses said that if anyone should die not having children, his brother will marry his wife and will raise up seed for his brother.
22.bbe: Master, Moses said, If a man, at the time of his death, has no children, let his brother take his wife, and get a family for his brother;

22.msb: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died without having children. So he left his wife to his brother.
22.kjv: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:
22.blb: Now there were seven brothers with us. And the first, having married, died; and not having seed, he left his wife to his brother.
22.bbe: Now there were among us seven brothers; and the first was married and at his death, having no seed, gave his wife to his brother;

22.msb: The same thing happened to the second and third brothers, down to the seventh.
22.kjv: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
22.blb: Likewise also the second, and the third, to the seventh.
22.bbe: In the same way the second and the third, up to the seventh.

22.msb: And last of all, the woman also died.
22.kjv: And last of all the woman died also.
22.blb: And last of all, the woman died.
22.bbe: And last of all the woman came to her end.

22.msb: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be of the seven? For all of them were married to her.”
22.kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
22.blb: In the resurrection, therefore, of which of the seven will she be wife? For all had her.”
22.bbe: When they come back from the dead, then, whose wife will she be of the seven? because they all had her.

22.msb: Jesus answered, “You are mistaken because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.
22.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
22.blb: And answering, Jesus said to them, “You go astray, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.
22.bbe: But Jesus said to them in answer, You are in error, not having knowledge of the Writings, or of the power of God.

22.msb: In the resurrection, people will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels of God in heaven.
22.kjv: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
22.blb: For in the resurrection, they neither marry nor are they given in marriage, but they are like angels in heaven.
22.bbe: For when they come back from the dead there are no husbands and wives, but they are as the angels in heaven.

22.msb: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what God said to you:
22.kjv: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
22.blb: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, did you not read what has been spoken to you by God, saying,
22.bbe: But about the dead coming back to life, have you no knowledge of what was said to you by God in the Writings:

22.msb: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? He is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”
22.kjv: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
22.blb: ‘I am the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob’? He is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”
22.bbe: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead but of the living.

22.msb: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at His teaching.
22.kjv: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.
22.blb: And having heard, the crowds were astonished at His teaching.
22.bbe: And the people hearing it were surprised at his teaching.

22.msb: And when the Pharisees heard that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, they themselves gathered together.
22.kjv: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
22.blb: And the Pharisees, having heard that He silenced the Sadducees, were gathered at the same place.
22.bbe: But the Pharisees, hearing how the mouths of the Sadducees had been stopped, came together;
22.heading: The Greatest Commandment

22.msb: One of them, an expert in the law, tested Him with a question:
22.kjv: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
22.blb: And one of them, a lawyer, questioned, testing Him,
22.bbe: And one of them, a teacher of the law, put a question to him, testing him, and saying,

22.msb: “Teacher, which commandment is the greatest in the Law?”
22.kjv: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
22.blb: “Teacher, which is the great commandment in the Law?”
22.bbe: Master, which is the chief rule in the law?

22.msb: Jesus declared, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’
22.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
22.blb: And He said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’
22.bbe: And he said to him, Have love for the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind.

22.msb: This is the first and greatest commandment.
22.kjv: This is the first and great commandment.
22.blb: This is the great and first commandment.
22.bbe: This is the first and greatest rule.

22.msb: And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’
22.kjv: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
22.blb: And the second is like it: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
22.bbe: And a second like it is this, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself.

22.msb: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments.”
22.kjv: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
22.blb: On these two commandments hang all the Law and the Prophets.”
22.bbe: On these two rules all the law and the prophets are based.

22.msb: While the Pharisees were assembled, Jesus questioned them:
22.kjv: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
22.blb: And the Pharisees having been assembled together, Jesus questioned them,
22.bbe: Now while the Pharisees were together, Jesus put a question to them, saying,
22.heading: Whose Son Is the Christ?

22.msb: “What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is He?” “David’s,” they answered.
22.kjv: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.
22.blb: saying, “What do you think about the Christ? Of whom is He son?” They say to Him, “Of David.”
22.bbe: What is your opinion of the Christ? whose son is he? They say to him, The Son of David.

22.msb: Jesus said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call Him ‘Lord’? For he says:
22.kjv: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,
22.blb: He says to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call Him ‘Lord,’ saying:
22.bbe: He says to them, How then does David in the Spirit give him the name of Lord, saying,

22.msb: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’
22.kjv: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?
22.blb: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I place Your enemies as a footstool for Your feet”’?
22.bbe: The Lord said to my Lord, Be seated at my right hand, till I put under your feet all those who are against you?

22.msb: So if David calls Him ‘Lord,’ how can He be David’s son?”
22.kjv: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
22.blb: If, therefore, David calls Him ‘Lord,’ how is He his son?”
22.bbe: If David then gives him the name of Lord, how is he his son?

22.msb: No one was able to answer a word, and from that day on no one dared to question Him any further.
22.kjv: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
22.blb: And no one was able to answer Him a word, nor did anyone dare from that day to question Him any longer.
22.bbe: And no one was able to give him an answer, and so great was their fear of him, that from that day no one put any more questions to him.

23.msb: Then Jesus spoke to the crowds and to His disciples:
23.kjv: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
23.blb: Then Jesus spoke to the crowds and to His disciples,
23.bbe: Then Jesus said to the people and to his disciples:
23.heading: Woes to Scribes and Pharisees

23.msb: “The scribes and Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat.
23.kjv: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat:
23.blb: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sat down on Moses’ seat.
23.bbe: The scribes and the Pharisees have the authority of Moses;

23.msb: So observe and practice everything they tell you to observe. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.
23.kjv: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
23.blb: Therefore do and observe all things, whatsoever they might tell you. But do not do according to their works, for they speak and do not do.
23.bbe: All things, then, which they give you orders to do, these do and keep: but do not take their works as your example, for they say and do not.

23.msb: They tie up heavy, burdensome loads and lay them on men’s shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.
23.kjv: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
23.blb: And they tie up burdens heavy and hard to bear, and they lay them on the shoulders of men; but they themselves are not willing to move them with their finger.
23.bbe: They make hard laws and put great weights on men's backs; but they themselves will not put a finger to them.

23.msb: All their deeds are done for men to see. They broaden their phylacteries and lengthen the tassels of their garments.
23.kjv: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
23.blb: And they do all their works in order to be seen by men. For they broaden their phylacteries and lengthen their tassels.
23.bbe: But all their works they do so as to be seen by men: for they make wide their phylacteries, and the edges of their robes,

23.msb: They love the places of honor at banquets, the chief seats in the synagogues,
23.kjv: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
23.blb: And they love the chief place at the suppers, and the first seats in the synagogues,
23.bbe: And the things desired by them are the first places at feasts, and the chief seats in the Synagogues,

23.msb: the greetings in the marketplaces, and the title of ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by which they are addressed.
23.kjv: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
23.blb: and the greetings in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi’ by men.
23.bbe: And words of respect in the market-places, and to be named by men, Teacher.

23.msb: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, the Christ, and you are all brothers.
23.kjv: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.
23.blb: But you shall not be called ‘Rabbi,’ for your Teacher is One, and you are all brothers.
23.bbe: But you may not be named Teacher: for one is your teacher, and you are all brothers.

23.msb: And do not call anyone on earth your father, for you have one Father, who is in heaven.
23.kjv: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
23.blb: And you shall call no one your father on the earth, for One is your Father who is in heaven.
23.bbe: And give no man the name of father on earth: because one is your Father, who is in heaven.

23.msb: Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Christ.
23.kjv: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.
23.blb: Neither shall you be called instructors, because One is your Instructor, the Christ.
23.bbe: And you may not be named guides: because one is your Guide, even Christ.

23.msb: The greatest among you shall be your servant.
23.kjv: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
23.blb: But the greatest among you will be your servant.
23.bbe: But let the greatest among you be your servant.

23.msb: For whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
23.kjv: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
23.blb: And whoever will exalt himself will be humbled, and whoever will humble himself will be exalted.
23.bbe: And whoever makes himself high will be made low, and whoever makes himself low will be made high.

23.msb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You defraud widows of their houses, and for a show make lengthy prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.
23.kjv: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.
23.blb: But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you shut up the kingdom of the heavens before men. For you do not enter, nor even do you allow those who are entering to enter.
23.bbe: But a curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! because you are shutting the kingdom of heaven against men: for you do not go in yourselves, and those who are going in, you keep back.

23.msb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You shut the kingdom of heaven in men’s faces. You yourselves do not enter, nor will you let in those who wish to enter.
23.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.

23.msb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You traverse land and sea to win a single convert, and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of hell as you are.
23.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
23.blb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you traverse the sea and the dry land to make one convert, and when he might become one, you make him twofold more a son of Gehenna than yourselves.
23.bbe: A curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! for you go about land and sea to get one disciple and, having him, you make him twice as much a son of hell as yourselves.

23.msb: Woe to you, blind guides! You say, ‘If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gold of the temple, he is bound by his oath.’
23.kjv: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
23.blb: Woe to you, blind guides, those saying, ‘Whoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever shall swear by the gold of the temple is bound by his oath.’
23.bbe: A curse is on you, blind guides, who say, Whoever takes an oath by the Temple, it is nothing; but whoever takes an oath by the gold of the Temple, he is responsible.

23.msb: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes it sacred?
23.kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
23.blb: Foolish and blind ones! For which is greater: the gold, or the temple having sanctified the gold?
23.bbe: You foolish ones and blind: which is greater, the gold, or the Temple which makes the gold holy?

23.msb: And you say, ‘If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gift on it, he is bound by his oath.’
23.kjv: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
23.blb: And you say, ‘Whoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever shall swear by the gift that is upon it is bound by his oath.’
23.bbe: And, Whoever takes an oath by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever takes an oath by the offering which is on it, he is responsible.

23.msb: You are foolish and blind! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes it sacred?
23.kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
23.blb: Blind ones! For which is greater: the gift, or the altar sanctifying the gift?
23.bbe: You blind ones: which is greater, the offering, or the altar which makes the offering holy?

23.msb: So then, he who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.
23.kjv: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
23.blb: Therefore the one having sworn by the altar swears by it and by all things that are upon it.
23.bbe: He, then, who takes an oath by the altar, takes it by the altar and by all things on it.

23.msb: And he who swears by the temple swears by it and by the One who dwells in it.
23.kjv: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
23.blb: And the one having sworn by the temple swears by it and by the One dwelling in it.
23.bbe: And he who takes an oath by the Temple, takes it by the Temple and by him whose house it is.

23.msb: And he who swears by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the One who sits on it.
23.kjv: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
23.blb: And the one having sworn by heaven swears by the throne of God and by the One sitting upon it.
23.bbe: And he who takes an oath by heaven, takes it by the seat of God, and by him who is seated on it.
