23.msb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You pay tithes of mint, dill, and cumin. But you have disregarded the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.
23.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
23.blb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you pay tithes of mint and dill and cumin, and you left aside the weightier things of the law: justice and mercy and faithfulness. And it was necessary to do these, and those not to leave aside.
23.bbe: A curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! for you make men give a tenth of all sorts of sweet-smelling plants, but you give no thought to the more important things of the law, righteousness, and mercy, and faith; but it is right for you to do these, and not to let the others be undone.

23.msb: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.
23.kjv: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
23.blb: Blind guides—those straining out the gnat and swallowing up the camel!
23.bbe: You blind guides, who take out a fly from your drink, but make no trouble over a camel.

23.msb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and unrighteousness.
23.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
23.blb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you cleanse the outside of the cup and of the dish, but inside they are full of plundering and self-indulgence.
23.bbe: A curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! for you make clean the outside of the cup and of the plate, but inside they are full of violent behaviour and uncontrolled desire.

23.msb: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, so that the outside may become clean as well.
23.kjv: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
23.blb: Blind Pharisee! First cleanse the inside of the cup and of the dish, so that its outside might become clean also.
23.bbe: You blind Pharisee, first make clean the inside of the cup and of the plate, so that the outside may become equally clean.

23.msb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of dead men’s bones and every kind of impurity.
23.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men’s bones, and of all uncleanness.
23.blb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you are like whitewashed tombs, which indeed on the outside appear beautiful, but on the inside they are full of bones of the dead and of all uncleanness.
23.bbe: A curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! for you are like the resting-places of the dead, which are made white, and seem beautiful on the outside, but inside are full of dead men's bones and of all unclean things.

23.msb: In the same way, on the outside you appear to be righteous, but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.
23.kjv: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
23.blb: Thus also on the outside you indeed appear righteous to men, but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and lawlessness.
23.bbe: Even so you seem to men to be full of righteousness, but inside you are all false and full of wrongdoing.

23.msb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the monuments of the righteous.
23.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
23.blb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and adorn the monuments of the righteous.
23.bbe: A curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! because you put up buildings for housing the dead bodies of the prophets, and make fair the last resting-places of good men, and say,

23.msb: And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partners with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’
23.kjv: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
23.blb: And you say, ‘If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’
23.bbe: If we had been living in the days of our fathers, we would not have taken part with them in the blood of the prophets.

23.msb: So you testify against yourselves that you are the sons of those who murdered the prophets.
23.kjv: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
23.blb: Thus you bear witness to yourselves that you are sons of those having murdered the prophets.
23.bbe: So that you are witnesses against yourselves that you are the sons of those who put the prophets to death.

23.msb: Fill up, then, the measure of the sin of your fathers.
23.kjv: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
23.blb: And you, fill up the measure of your fathers.
23.bbe: Make full, then, the measure of your fathers.

23.msb: You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape the sentence of hell?
23.kjv: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
23.blb: Serpents! Offspring of vipers! How shall you escape from the judgment of Gehenna?
23.bbe: You snakes, offspring of snakes, how will you be kept from the punishment of hell?

23.msb: Because of this, I am sending you prophets and wise men and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify, and others you will flog in your synagogues and persecute from town to town.
23.kjv: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
23.blb: Because of this, behold, I send to you prophets and wise men and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify, and some of them you will flog in your synagogues and will persecute from city to city,
23.bbe: For this reason, I send you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: some of them you will put to death and put on the cross, and to some of them you will give blows in your Synagogues, driving them from town to town;

23.msb: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.
23.kjv: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
23.blb: so that upon you shall come all the righteous blood being poured out upon the earth, from the blood of the righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.
23.bbe: So that on you may come all the blood of the upright on the earth, from the blood of upright Abel to the blood of Zachariah, son of Barachiah, whom you put to death between the Temple and the altar.

23.msb: Truly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
23.kjv: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
23.blb: Truly I say to you, all these things will come upon this generation.
23.bbe: Truly I say to you, All these things will come on this generation.

23.msb: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were unwilling!
23.kjv: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
23.blb: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, killing the prophets and stoning those sent to her! How often I willed to gather together your children, the way that a hen gathers together her chicks under the wings, and you were not willing!
23.bbe: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, putting to death the prophets, and stoning those who are sent to her! Again and again would I have taken your children to myself as a bird takes her young ones under her wings, and you would not!
23.heading: Lament over Jerusalem

23.msb: Look, your house is left to you desolate.
23.kjv: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
23.blb: Behold, your house is left to you desolate!
23.bbe: See, your house is made waste.

23.msb: For I tell you that you will not see Me again until you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.’”
23.kjv: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
23.blb: For I say to you, you shall not see Me from now until you say, ‘Blessed is the One coming in the name of the Lord.’”
23.bbe: For I say to you, You will not see me from this time till you say, A blessing on him who comes in the name of the Lord.

24.msb: As Jesus left the temple and was walking away, His disciples came up to Him to point out its buildings.
24.kjv: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
24.blb: And having gone out from the temple, Jesus was going, and His disciples came near to point out to Him the buildings of the temple.
24.bbe: And Jesus went out of the Temple, and on the way his disciples came to him, pointing out the buildings of the Temple.
24.heading: Temple Destruction and Other Signs

24.msb: “Do you see all these things?” Jesus replied. “Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
24.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
24.blb: And answering, He said to them, “Do you not see all these things? Truly I say to you, not one stone here shall be left upon a stone, which will not be thrown down.”
24.bbe: But he, answering, said to them, See you not all these things? truly I say to you that here there will not be one stone resting on another, which will not be pulled down.

24.msb: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately. “Tell us,” they said, “when will these things happen, and what will be the sign of Your coming and of the end of the age?”
24.kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
24.blb: And He sitting upon the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him by Himself, saying, “Tell us when these things will be. And what is the sign of Your coming and the consummation of the age?”
24.bbe: And while he was seated on the Mountain of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, Make clear to us, when will these things be? and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the world?

24.msb: Jesus answered, “See to it that no one deceives you.
24.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
24.blb: And answering, Jesus said to them, “Take heed, lest anyone may lead you astray.
24.bbe: And Jesus said to them in answer, Take care that you are not tricked.

24.msb: For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will deceive many.
24.kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
24.blb: For many will come in My name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and they will lead many astray.
24.bbe: For people will come in my name, saying, I am the Christ; and a number will be turned from the true way through them.

24.msb: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. All these things must happen, but the end is still to come.
24.kjv: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
24.blb: And you will begin to hear of wars and rumors of wars. Behold, do not be alarmed; for it is necessary to happen, but the end is not yet.
24.bbe: And news will come to you of wars and talk of wars: do not be troubled, for these things have to be; but it is still not the end.

24.msb: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines, pestilences, and earthquakes in various places.
24.kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
24.blb: For nation will rise up against nation, and kingdom against kingdom, and there will be famines and earthquakes in various places.
24.bbe: For nation will be moved against nation, and kingdom against kingdom, and men will be without food, and the earth will be shaking in different places;

24.msb: All these are the beginning of birth pains.
24.kjv: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
24.blb: And all these are the beginning of birth pains.
24.bbe: But all these things are the first of the troubles.

24.msb: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.
24.kjv: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.
24.blb: Then they will deliver you up to tribulation, and they will kill you, and you will be hated by all the nations because of My name.
24.bbe: Then they will be cruel to you, and will put you to death: and you will be hated by all nations because of my name.
24.heading: Witnessing to All Nations

24.msb: At that time many will fall away and will betray and hate one another,
24.kjv: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
24.blb: And then many will be caused to stumble, and they will deliver up one another and will hate one another;
24.bbe: And numbers of people will be turned from the right way, and will give one another up and have hate for one another.

24.msb: and many false prophets will arise and deceive many.
24.kjv: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
24.blb: and many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.
24.bbe: And a number of false prophets will come, causing error.

24.msb: Because of the multiplication of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold.
24.kjv: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
24.blb: And because lawlessness is to be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.
24.bbe: And because wrongdoing will be increased, the love of most people will become cold.

24.msb: But the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
24.kjv: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
24.blb: But the one having endured to the end, he will be saved.
24.bbe: But he who goes through to the end will get salvation.

24.msb: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in all the world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.
24.kjv: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
24.blb: And this gospel of the kingdom will be proclaimed in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.
24.bbe: And this good news of the kingdom will be given through all the world for a witness to all nations; and then the end will come.

24.msb: So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination of desolation,’ spoken of by the prophet Daniel (let the reader understand),
24.kjv: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)
24.blb: Therefore, when you shall see the ‘abomination of the desolation,’ having been spoken of by the prophet Daniel, standing in the holy place (the one reading, let him understand),
24.bbe: When, then, you see in the holy place the unclean thing which makes destruction, of which word was given by Daniel the prophet (let this be clear to the reader),
24.heading: The Abomination of Desolation

24.msb: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
24.kjv: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:
24.blb: then those in Judea, let them flee to the mountains;
24.bbe: Then let those who are in Judaea go in flight to the mountains:

24.msb: Let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve anything from his house.
24.kjv: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
24.blb: the one on the housetop, let him not come down to take away the things out of his house;
24.bbe: Let not him who is on the house-top go down to take anything out of his house:

24.msb: And let no one in the field return for his garments.
24.kjv: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
24.blb: and the one in the field, let him not return back to take away his garment.
24.bbe: And let not him who is in the field go back to get his coat.

24.msb: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
24.kjv: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
24.blb: And woe to those having in womb and to those nursing in those days!
24.bbe: But it will be hard for women who are with child and for those with babies at the breast in those days.

24.msb: Pray that your flight will not occur in the winter or on the Sabbath.
24.kjv: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
24.blb: But pray that your flight may not be in winter, nor on a Sabbath.
24.bbe: And say a prayer that your flight may not be in the winter, or on a Sabbath.

24.msb: For at that time there will be great tribulation, unmatched from the beginning of the world until now, and never to be seen again.
24.kjv: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
24.blb: For then there will be great tribulation, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, nor ever shall be.
24.bbe: Because in those days there will be great sorrow, such as there has not been from the start of the world till now, or ever will be.

24.msb: If those days had not been cut short, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, those days will be cut short.
24.kjv: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.
24.blb: And if those days were not shortened, not any flesh would have been saved; but because of the chosen, those days will be shortened.
24.bbe: And if those days had not been made short there would have been no salvation for any, but because of the saints those days will be made short.

24.msb: At that time, if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
24.kjv: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
24.blb: At that time if anyone should say to you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ,’ or ‘Here,’ do not believe it.
24.bbe: Then if any man says to you, See, here is the Christ, or, Here; do not put faith in him;

24.msb: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
24.kjv: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
24.blb: For false Christs and false prophets will arise and will give great signs and wonders so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen.
24.bbe: For there will come up false Christs, and false prophets, who will do great signs and wonders; so that if possible even the saints might be tricked.

24.msb: See, I have told you in advance.
24.kjv: Behold, I have told you before.
24.blb: Behold, I have told you beforehand.
24.bbe: See, I have made it clear to you before it comes about.

24.msb: So if they tell you, ‘There He is in the wilderness,’ do not go out, or, ‘Here He is in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.
24.kjv: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
24.blb: Therefore if they may say to you, ‘Behold, He is in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or ‘Behold, in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.
24.bbe: If, then, they say to you, See, he is in the waste land; go not out: See, he is in the inner rooms; put no faith in it.
24.heading: The Return of the Son of Man

24.msb: For just as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
24.kjv: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
24.blb: For just as the lightning goes out from the east and shines as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
24.bbe: Because as in a thunderstorm the bright light coming from the east is seen even in the west; so will be the coming of the Son of man.

24.msb: For wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
24.kjv: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
24.blb: Wherever the carcass may be, there the vultures will be gathered.
24.bbe: Wherever the dead body is, there will the eagles come together.

24.msb: Immediately after the tribulation of those days: ‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’
24.kjv: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
24.blb: And immediately after the tribulation of those days: ‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give her light; and the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.”’
24.bbe: But straight away, after the trouble of those days, the sun will be made dark and the moon will not give her light and the stars will come down from heaven and the powers of heaven will be moved:

24.msb: At that time the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn. They will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
24.kjv: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
24.blb: And then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and then all the tribes of the earth will mourn. And they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.
24.bbe: And then the sign of the Son of man will be seen in heaven: and then all the nations of the earth will have sorrow, and they will see the Son of man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

24.msb: And He will send out His angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather His elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.
24.kjv: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
24.blb: And He will send His angels with a great trumpet call, and they will gather together His chosen from the four winds, from the ends of the heavens to the ends of them.
24.bbe: And he will send out his angels with a great sound of a horn, and they will get his saints together from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

24.msb: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
24.kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
24.blb: Now learn the parable from the fig tree: When its branch already shall have become tender and it may put forth leaves, you know that the summer is near.
24.bbe: Now take an example from the fig-tree: when her branch has become soft and puts out its leaves, you are certain that the summer is near;
24.heading: The Lesson of the Fig Tree

24.msb: So also, when you see all these things, you will know that He is near, right at the door.
24.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
24.blb: So also you, when you see all these things, know that He is near, at the doors.
24.bbe: Even so, when you see all these things, you may be certain that he is near, even at the doors.

24.msb: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
24.kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
24.blb: Truly I say to you that this generation shall not have passed away until all these things shall have come to pass.
24.bbe: Truly I say to you, This generation will not come to an end till all these things are complete.

24.msb: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
24.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
24.blb: The heaven and the earth will pass away, but My words shall never pass away.
24.bbe: Heaven and earth will come to an end, but my words will not come to an end.

24.msb: No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, but only My Father.
24.kjv: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
24.blb: But concerning that day and hour no one knows, not even the angels of the heavens, nor the Son, except the Father only.
24.bbe: But of that day and hour no one has knowledge, not even the angels in heaven, or the Son, but the Father only.
24.heading: Readiness at Any Hour

24.msb: As it was in the days of Noah, so will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
24.kjv: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
24.blb: For as were the days of Noah, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
24.bbe: And as were the days of Noah, so will be the coming of the Son of man.

24.msb: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark.
24.kjv: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
24.blb: For as in those days before the flood, they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until that day Noah entered into the ark.
24.bbe: Because as in those days before the overflowing of the waters, they were feasting and taking wives and getting married, till the day when Noah went into the ark,

24.msb: And they were oblivious until the flood came and swept them all away. So will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
24.kjv: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
24.blb: And they did not know until the flood came and took away all. So also will be the coming of the Son of Man.
24.bbe: And they had no care till the waters came and took them all away; so will be the coming of the Son of man.

24.msb: Two men will be in the field: one will be taken and the other left.
24.kjv: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
24.blb: Then two will be in the field: one is taken, and one is left.
24.bbe: Then two men will be in the field; one is taken, and one let go;

24.msb: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and the other left.
24.kjv: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
24.blb: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one is taken, and one is left.
24.bbe: Two women will be crushing grain; one is taken, and one let go.

24.msb: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the hour in which your Lord will come.
24.kjv: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
24.blb: Therefore watch, because you do not know on what day your Lord comes.
24.bbe: Be watching, then! for you have no knowledge on what day your Lord will come.

24.msb: But understand this: If the homeowner had known in which watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.
24.kjv: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
24.blb: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in which watch the thief comes, he would have watched and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.
24.bbe: But be certain of this, that if the master of the house had had knowledge of the time when the thief was coming, he would have been watching, and would not have let his house be broken into.

24.msb: For this reason, you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.
24.kjv: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
24.blb: Because of this also, you be ready, because in the hour that you do not think, the Son of Man comes.
24.bbe: Be ready then; for at a time which you have no thought of the Son of man will come.

24.msb: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his master has put in charge of his household, to give the others their food at the proper time?
24.kjv: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
24.blb: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master set over his household, to give them the food in season?
24.bbe: Who is the true and wise servant, whom his lord has put over those in his house, to give them their food at the right time?

24.msb: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
24.kjv: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
24.blb: Blessed is that servant whom his master, having come, will find so doing.
24.bbe: A blessing on that servant, who will be doing so when his lord comes.

24.msb: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
24.kjv: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
24.blb: Truly I say to you that he will set him over all of his possessions.
24.bbe: Truly, I say to you, he will put him over all he has.

24.msb: But suppose that servant is wicked and says in his heart, ‘My master will be a long time in coming.’
24.kjv: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;
24.blb: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My master delays,’
24.bbe: But if that evil servant says in his heart, My lord is a long time in coming;

24.msb: And he begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.
24.kjv: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
24.blb: and he should begin to beat his fellow servants, and he should eat and drink with those being drunk,
24.bbe: And is cruel to the other servants, taking his pleasure with those who are overcome with wine;

24.msb: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate.
24.kjv: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
24.blb: the master of that servant will come in a day that he does not expect and in an hour that he does not know,
24.bbe: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he is not looking for him, and in an hour of which he has no knowledge,

24.msb: Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
24.kjv: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
24.blb: and he will cut him in two and will appoint his portion with the hypocrites—there will be weeping and gnashing of the teeth.
24.bbe: And will have him cut in two, and will give him a part in the fate of the false ones: there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.

25.msb: “At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
25.kjv: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
25.blb: “ Then the kingdom of the heavens will be likened to ten virgins, who, having taken their lamps, went out to meet the bridegroom,
25.bbe: Then the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins, the friends of the bride, who took their lights, and went out with the purpose of meeting the husband.
25.heading: The Parable of the Ten Virgins

25.msb: Five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
25.kjv: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
25.blb: and five of them were foolish, and five wise.
25.bbe: And five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

25.msb: Those who were foolish took their lamps but did not take along any extra oil.
25.kjv: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
25.blb: For the foolish, having taken their lamps, did not take oil with them;
25.bbe: For the foolish, when they took their lights, took no oil with them.

25.msb: But the wise ones took oil in flasks along with their lamps.
25.kjv: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
25.blb: but the wise took oil in the vessels with their lamps.
25.bbe: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lights.

25.msb: When the bridegroom was delayed, they all became drowsy and fell asleep.
25.kjv: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
25.blb: And in the tarrying of the bridegroom, they all became drowsy and were sleeping.
25.bbe: Now the husband was a long time in coming, and they all went to sleep.

25.msb: At midnight the cry rang out: ‘Behold, the bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’
25.kjv: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
25.blb: And in the middle of the night there was a cry: ‘Behold, the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’
25.bbe: But in the middle of the night there is a cry, The husband comes! Go out to him.

25.msb: Then all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.
25.kjv: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
25.blb: Then all those virgins arose and trimmed their lamps.
25.bbe: Then all those virgins got up, and made ready their lights.

25.msb: The foolish ones said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.’
25.kjv: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
25.blb: And the foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, because our lamps are going out.’
25.bbe: And the foolish said to the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lights are going out.

25.msb: ‘No,’ said the wise ones, ‘or there may not be enough for both us and you. Instead, go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.’
25.kjv: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
25.blb: And the wise answered, saying, ‘No, lest it might not be sufficient for us and you. Go rather to those selling, and buy for yourselves.’
25.bbe: But the wise made answer, saying, There may not be enough for us and you; it would be better for you to go to the traders and get oil for yourselves.

25.msb: But while they were on their way to buy it, the bridegroom arrived. Those who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet, and the door was shut.
25.kjv: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
25.blb: And in their going away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.
25.bbe: And while they went to get oil, the master came; and those who were ready went in with him to the feast: and the door was shut.

25.msb: Later the other virgins arrived and said, ‘Lord, lord, open the door for us!’
25.kjv: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
25.blb: And afterward, the other virgins come also, saying, ‘Lord, lord, open to us!’
25.bbe: After that the other virgins came, saying, Lord, Lord, let us in.

25.msb: But he replied, ‘Truly I tell you, I do not know you.’
25.kjv: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
25.blb: And answering, he said, ‘Truly I say to you, I have not known you.’
25.bbe: But he made answer and said, Truly I say to you, I have no knowledge of you.

25.msb: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour when the Son of Man comes.
25.kjv: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
25.blb: Therefore watch, for you do not know the day nor the hour.
25.bbe: Keep watch, then, because you are not certain of the day or of the hour.

25.msb: For it is just like a man going on a journey, who called his servants and entrusted them with his possessions.
25.kjv: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
25.blb: For it is like a man going on a journey who called his own servants and delivered his possessions to them.
25.bbe: For it is as when a man, about to take a journey, got his servants together, and gave them his property.
25.heading: The Parable of the Talents

25.msb: To one he gave five talents, to another two talents, and to another one talent—each according to his own ability. And he went on his journey.
25.kjv: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
25.blb: And indeed, to one he gave five talents; and to one, two; and to one, one—to each according to his own ability. And he left the region.
25.bbe: And to one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one; to everyone as he was able; and he went on his journey.

25.msb: The servant who had received the five talents went at once and put them to work and made five more talents.
25.kjv: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
25.blb: Immediately the one having received the five talents, having gone, traded with them and gained five others.
25.bbe: Straight away he who had been given the five talents went and did trade with them, and made five more.

25.msb: Likewise, the one with the two talents also gained two more.
25.kjv: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
25.blb: Likewise, the one with the two gained two others.
25.bbe: In the same way he who had been given the two got two more.

25.msb: But the servant who had received the one talent went off, dug a hole in the ground, and hid his master’s money.
25.kjv: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.
25.blb: But the one having received the one, having gone away, dug in the earth and hid his master's money.
25.bbe: But he who was given the one went away and put it in a hole in the earth, and kept his lord's money in a secret place.

25.msb: After a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.
25.kjv: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
25.blb: And after much time, the master of those servants comes and settles the account with them.
25.bbe: Now after a long time the lord of those servants comes, and makes up his account with them.

25.msb: The servant who had received the five talents came and presented five more. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with five talents. See, I have gained five more besides them.’
25.kjv: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
25.blb: And the one having received the five talents, having come, brought to him five other talents, saying, ‘Master, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I gained five other talents.’
25.bbe: And he who had the five talents came with his other five talents, saying, Lord, you gave into my care five talents: see, I have got five more.

25.msb: His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Enter into the joy of your master!’
25.kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
25.blb: His master said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You were faithful over a few things; I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your master!’
25.bbe: His lord said to him, Well done, good and true servant: you have been true in a small thing, I will give you control over great things: take your part in the joy of your lord.

25.msb: The servant who had received the two talents also came and said, ‘Master, you entrusted me with two talents. See, I have gained two more besides them.’
25.kjv: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
25.blb: And the one with the two talents, also having come, said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I gained two other talents.’
25.bbe: And he who had the two talents came and said, Lord, you gave into my care two talents: see, I have got two more.

25.msb: His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Enter into the joy of your master!’
25.kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
25.blb: His master said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You were faithful over a few things; I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your master!’
25.bbe: His lord said to him, Well done, good and true servant: you have been true in a small thing, I will give you control over great things: take your part in the joy of your lord.

25.msb: Finally, the servant who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Master, I knew that you are a hard man, reaping where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.
25.kjv: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
25.blb: And the one having received the one talent, having come, also said, ‘Lord, I knew you, that you are a hard man, reaping where you did not sow, and gathering from where you did not scatter.
25.bbe: And he who had had the one talent came and said, Lord, I had knowledge that you are a hard man, getting in grain where you have not put seed, and making profits for which you have done no work:

25.msb: So I was afraid and went out and hid your talent in the ground. See, you have what belongs to you.’
25.kjv: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
25.blb: And having been afraid, having gone away, I hid your talent in the ground. Behold, you have what is yours.’
25.bbe: And I was in fear, and went away, and put your talent in the earth: here is what is yours.

25.msb: ‘You wicked, lazy servant!’ replied his master. ‘You knew that I reap where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed.
25.kjv: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
25.blb: And answering, his master said to him, ‘Wicked and slothful servant! You knew that I reap where I did not sow and gather from where I did not scatter.
25.bbe: But his lord in answer said to him, You are a bad and unready servant; if you had knowledge that I get in grain where I did not put seed, and make profits for which I have done no work,

25.msb: Then you should have deposited my money with the bankers, and on my return I would have received it back with interest.
25.kjv: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
25.blb: Therefore it was necessary for you to cast my money to the bankers, and having come, I would have received my own with interest.
25.bbe: Why, then, did you not put my money in the bank, and at my coming I would have got back what is mine with interest?

25.msb: Therefore take the talent from him and give it to the one who has ten talents.
25.kjv: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
25.blb: Therefore take away the talent from him and give it to the one having the ten talents.
25.bbe: Take away, then, his talent and give it to him who has the ten talents.

25.msb: For everyone who has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. But the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
25.kjv: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
25.blb: For everyone having will be given, and he will have in abundance. But the one not having, even that which he has will be taken away from him.
25.bbe: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have more: but from him who has not, even what he has will be taken away.

25.msb: And throw that worthless servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
25.kjv: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
25.blb: And cast out the worthless servant into the outer darkness—there will be weeping and gnashing of the teeth.’
25.bbe: And put out the servant who is of no profit into the outer dark: there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.

25.msb: When the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the holy angels with Him, He will sit on His glorious throne.
25.kjv: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
25.blb: And when the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the angels with Him, then He will sit upon the throne of His glory.
25.bbe: But when the Son of man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, then will he be seated in his glory:
25.heading: The Sheep and the Goats

25.msb: All the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate the people one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
25.kjv: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
25.blb: And all the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate them from one another, as the shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
25.bbe: And before him all the nations will come together; and they will be parted one from another, as the sheep are parted from the goats by the keeper.

25.msb: He will place the sheep on His right and the goats on His left.
25.kjv: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
25.blb: And indeed, He will set the sheep on His right hand and the goats on His left.
25.bbe: And he will put the sheep on his right, but the goats on the left.

25.msb: Then the King will say to those on His right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
25.kjv: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
25.blb: Then the King will say to those on His right hand, ‘Come, the blessed of My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
25.bbe: Then will the King say to those on his right, Come, you who have the blessing of my Father, into the kingdom made ready for you before the world was:

25.msb: For I was hungry and you gave Me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me something to drink, I was a stranger and you took Me in,
25.kjv: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
25.blb: For I hungered, and you gave Me something to eat; I thirsted, and you gave Me something to drink; I was a stranger, and you took Me in;
25.bbe: For I was in need of food, and you gave it to me: I was in need of drink, and you gave it to me: I was wandering, and you took me in;

25.msb: I was naked and you clothed Me, I was sick and you looked after Me, I was in prison and you visited Me.’
25.kjv: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
25.blb: I was naked, and you clothed Me; I was ailing, and you visited Me; I was in prison, and you came to Me.’
25.bbe: I had no clothing, and you gave it to me: when I was ill, or in prison, you came to me.

25.msb: Then the righteous will answer Him, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungry and feed You, or thirsty and give You something to drink?
25.kjv: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
25.blb: Then the righteous will answer Him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungering, and fed You? Or thirsting, and gave You to drink?
25.bbe: Then will the upright make answer to him, saying, Lord, when did we see you in need of food, and give it to you? or in need of drink, and give it to you?

25.msb: When did we see You a stranger and take You in, or naked and clothe You?
25.kjv: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
25.blb: And when did we see You a stranger, and took You in? Or naked, and clothed You?
25.bbe: And when did we see you wandering, and take you in? or without clothing, and give it to you?

25.msb: When did we see You sick or in prison and visit You?’
25.kjv: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
25.blb: And when did we see You ailing or in prison, and came to You?’
25.bbe: And when did we see you ill, or in prison, and come to you?

25.msb: And the King will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of Mine, you did for Me.’
25.kjv: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
25.blb: And answering, the King will say to them, ‘Truly I say to you, inasmuch as you did it to one of the least of these brothers of Mine, you did it to Me.’
25.bbe: And the King will make answer and say to them, Truly I say to you, Because you did it to the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.

25.msb: Then He will say to those on His left, ‘Depart from Me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.
25.kjv: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
25.blb: Then also He will say to those on His left, ‘Depart from Me, the cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.
25.bbe: Then will he say to those on the left, Go from me, you cursed ones, into the eternal fire which is ready for the Evil One and his angels:

25.msb: For I was hungry and you gave Me nothing to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me nothing to drink,
25.kjv: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
25.blb: For I hungered, and you did not give to Me to eat; and I thirsted, and you did not give Me to drink;
25.bbe: For I was in need of food, and you gave it not to me; I was in need of drink, and you gave it not to me:

25.msb: I was a stranger and you did not take Me in, I was naked and you did not clothe Me, I was sick and in prison and you did not look after Me.’
25.kjv: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
25.blb: I was a stranger, and you did not take Me in; naked, and you did not clothe Me; ailing and in prison, and you did not visit Me.’
25.bbe: I was wandering, and you took me not in; without clothing, and you gave me no clothing; ill, and in prison, and you came not to me.

25.msb: And they too will reply, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and did not minister to You?’
25.kjv: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
25.blb: Then they also will answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungering, or thirsting, or a stranger, or naked, or ailing, or in prison, and we did not minister to You?’
25.bbe: Then will they make answer, saying, Lord, when did we see you in need of food or drink, or wandering, or without clothing, or ill, or in prison, and did not take care of you?

25.msb: Then the King will answer, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for Me.’
25.kjv: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
25.blb: Then He will answer them, saying, ‘Truly I say to you, inasmuch as you did not do it to one of the least of these, you did not do it to Me.’
25.bbe: Then will he make answer to them, saying, Truly I say to you, Because you did it not to the least of these, you did it not to me.

25.msb: And they will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
25.kjv: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
25.blb: And these will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
25.bbe: And these will go away into eternal punishment; but the upright into eternal life.

26.msb: When Jesus had finished saying all these things, He told His disciples,
26.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
26.blb: And it came to pass, when Jesus finished all these words, that He said to His disciples,
26.bbe: And when Jesus had come to the end of all these words, he said to his disciples,
26.heading: The Plot to Kill Jesus

26.msb: “You know that the Passover is two days away, and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified.”
26.kjv: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
26.blb: “You know that after two days the Passover takes place, and the Son of Man is delivered over to be crucified.”
26.bbe: After two days is the Passover, and the Son of man will be given up to the death of the cross.

26.msb: At that time the chief priests, scribes, and elders of the people assembled in the courtyard of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas,
26.kjv: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
26.blb: Then the chief priests were gathered together—and the elders of the people—in the courtyard of the high priest, who is called Caiaphas,
26.bbe: Then the chief priests and the rulers of the people came together in the house of the high priest, who was named Caiaphas.

26.msb: and they conspired to arrest Jesus covertly and kill Him.
26.kjv: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.
26.blb: and they plotted together in order that they might seize Jesus by guile and kill Him.
26.bbe: And they made designs together to take Jesus by some trick, and put him to death.

26.msb: “But not during the feast,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.”
26.kjv: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
26.blb: But they were saying, “Not during the feast, lest a riot might take place among the people.”
26.bbe: But they said, Not while the feast is going on, for fear of trouble among the people.

26.msb: While Jesus was in Bethany in the home of Simon the Leper,
26.kjv: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
26.blb: And Jesus having been in Bethany in the house of Simon the Leper,
26.bbe: Now when Jesus was in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper,
26.heading: Jesus Anointed at Bethany

26.msb: a woman came to Him with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, which she poured on His head as He reclined at the table.
26.kjv: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
26.blb: a woman came to Him, having an alabaster flask of very costly fragrant oil, and she poured it on His head as He is reclining.
26.bbe: There came to him a woman having a bottle of perfume of great price, and she put the perfume on his head when he was seated at table.

26.msb: When His disciples saw this, they were indignant and asked, “Why this waste?
26.kjv: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
26.blb: And the disciples, having seen, became indignant, saying, “For what is this waste?
26.bbe: But when the disciples saw it they were angry, saying, To what purpose is this waste?

26.msb: This perfume could have been sold at a high price, and the money given to the poor.”
26.kjv: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
26.blb: For this could have been sold for much and given to the poor.”
26.bbe: For we might have got much money for this and given it to the poor.

26.msb: Aware of this, Jesus asked, “Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful deed to Me.
26.kjv: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
26.blb: And Jesus, having known, said to them, “Why do you cause trouble to the woman? For she did a beautiful work to Me.
26.bbe: But Jesus, seeing it, said to them, Why are you troubling the woman? she has done a kind act to me.

26.msb: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have Me.
26.kjv: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
26.blb: For the poor you always have with you, but not always do you have Me.
26.bbe: For the poor you have ever with you, but me you have not for ever.

26.msb: By pouring this perfume on Me, she has prepared My body for burial.
26.kjv: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
26.blb: For she, in pouring this fragrant oil on My body, did it for My burial.
26.bbe: For in putting this perfume on my body, she did it to make me ready for my last resting-place.

26.msb: Truly I tell you, wherever this gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.”
26.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
26.blb: Truly I say to you, wherever this gospel shall be proclaimed in the whole world, that which she did will also be spoken of, for a memorial of her.”
26.bbe: Truly I say to you, Wherever this good news goes out in all the world, what this woman has done will be talked of in memory of her.

26.msb: Then one of the Twelve, the one called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests
26.kjv: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
26.blb: Then one of the Twelve, the one being called Judas Iscariot, having gone to the chief priests,
26.bbe: Then one of the twelve, who was named Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests and said,
26.heading: Judas Agrees to Betray Jesus

26.msb: and asked, “What are you willing to give me if I hand Him over to you?” And they set out for him thirty pieces of silver.
26.kjv: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
26.blb: said, “What are you willing to give me, and I will betray Him to you?” And they appointed to him thirty pieces of silver.
26.bbe: What will you give me, if I give him up to you? And the price was fixed at thirty bits of silver.

26.msb: So from then on Judas looked for an opportunity to betray Jesus.
26.kjv: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
26.blb: And from that time, he was seeking an opportunity, that he might betray Him.
26.bbe: And from that time he was watching for a chance to give him into their hands.

26.msb: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Where do You want us to prepare for You to eat the Passover?”
26.kjv: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
26.blb: And on the first of the Unleavened, the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Where do You desire that we should prepare for You to eat the Passover?”
26.bbe: Now on the first day of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Where are we to make ready for you to take the Passover meal?
26.heading: Preparing the Passover

26.msb: He answered, “Go into the city to a certain man and tell him that the Teacher says, ‘My time is near. I will keep the Passover with My disciples at your house.’”
26.kjv: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
26.blb: And He said, “Go into the city to a certain man and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is near; at your house I will keep the Passover with My disciples.”’”
26.bbe: And he said to them, Go into the town to such a man, and say to him, The Master says, My time is near: I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.

26.msb: So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them and prepared the Passover.
26.kjv: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
26.blb: And the disciples did as Jesus directed them and prepared the Passover.
26.bbe: And the disciples did as Jesus had said to them; and they made ready the Passover.

26.msb: When evening came, Jesus was reclining with the Twelve.
26.kjv: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
26.blb: And evening having come, He was reclining with the twelve disciples.
26.bbe: Now when evening was come, he was seated at table with the twelve disciples;
26.heading: The Last Supper

26.msb: And while they were eating, He said to them, “Truly I tell you, one of you will betray Me.”
26.kjv: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
26.blb: And while they are eating, He said to them, “Truly I say to you that one of you will betray Me.”
26.bbe: And while they were taking food, he said, Truly I say to you that one of you will be false to me.

26.msb: They were deeply grieved and began to ask Him one after another, “Surely not I, Lord?”
26.kjv: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
26.blb: And being grieved exceedingly, they began, each one, to say to Him, “Is it I, Lord?”
26.bbe: And they were very said, and said to him, one by one, Is it I, Lord?

26.msb: Jesus answered, “The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with Me will betray Me.
26.kjv: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
26.blb: And answering, He said, “The one having dipped the hand in the bowl with Me, he will betray Me.
26.bbe: And he made answer and said, He who puts his hand into the plate with me, the same will be false to me.

26.msb: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed. It would be better for him if he had not been born.”
26.kjv: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
26.blb: Indeed the Son of Man goes as it has been written about Him; but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed. It would be better for him if he had not been born—that man.”
26.bbe: The Son of man goes, even as the Writings say of him: but a curse is on that man through whom the Son of man is given up; it would have been well for that man if he had never come into the world.

26.msb: Then Judas, who would betray Him, said, “Surely not I, Rabbi?” Jesus answered, “You have said it yourself.”
26.kjv: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
26.blb: And Judas, who was betraying Him, answering, said, “Is it I, Rabbi?” He says to him, “You have said.”
26.bbe: And Judas, who was false to him, made answer and said, Is it I, Master? He says to him, Yes.

26.msb: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to the disciples, saying, “Take and eat; this is My body.”
26.kjv: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
26.blb: Now while they are eating, Jesus, having taken bread and having blessed it, broke it, and having given it to the disciples, He said, “Take, eat; this is My body.”
26.bbe: And when they were taking food, Jesus took bread and, after blessing it, he gave the broken bread to the disciples and said, Take it; this is my body.

26.msb: Then He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, “Drink from it, all of you.
26.kjv: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
26.blb: And having taken a cup and having given thanks, He gave it to them, saying, “Drink of it, all of you.
26.bbe: And he took a cup and, having given praise, he gave it to them, saying,

26.msb: This is My blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
26.kjv: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
26.blb: For this is My blood of the covenant, being poured out for many for forgiveness of sins.
26.bbe: Take of it, all of you, for this is my blood of the testament, which is given for men for the forgiveness of sins.

26.msb: I tell you, I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it anew with you in My Father’s kingdom.”
26.kjv: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.
26.blb: And I say to you that I shall not drink of this fruit of the vine from now until that day when I drink it anew with you in the kingdom of My Father.”
26.bbe: But I say to you that from now I will not take of this fruit of the vine, till that day when I take it new with you in my Father's kingdom.

26.msb: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
26.kjv: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
26.blb: And having sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
26.bbe: And after a song of praise to God, they went out to the Mountain of Olives.

26.msb: Then Jesus said to them, “This very night you will all fall away on account of Me. For it is written: ‘I will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
26.kjv: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
26.blb: Then Jesus says to them, “All of you will fall away because of Me during this night. For it has been written: ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
26.bbe: Then said Jesus to them, All of you will be turned away from me this night: for it is said in the Writings, I will put to death the keeper of the sheep, and the sheep of the flock will be put to flight.
26.heading: Jesus Predicts Peter’s Denial

26.msb: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”
26.kjv: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
26.blb: But I, after being raised, will go before you into Galilee.”
26.bbe: But after I am come back from the dead, I will go before you into Galilee.

26.msb: Peter said to Him, “Even if all fall away on account of You, I never will.”
26.kjv: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
26.blb: And answering, Peter said to Him, “Even if all will fall away because of You, I never will fall away.”
26.bbe: But Peter made answer and said to him, Though all may be turned away from you, I will never be turned away.

26.msb: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus declared, “this very night, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.”
26.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
26.blb: Jesus said to him, “Truly I say to you that during this night, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.”
26.bbe: Jesus said to him, Truly I say to you that this night, before the hour of the cock's cry, you will say three times that you have no knowledge of me.

26.msb: Peter replied, “Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You.” And all the other disciples said the same thing.
26.kjv: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
26.blb: Peter says to Him, “Even if it were necessary for me to die with You, I will never deny You.” And all the disciples said likewise.
26.bbe: Peter says to him, Even if I am put to death with you, I will not be false to you. So said all the disciples.

26.msb: Then Jesus went with His disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and He told them, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.”
26.kjv: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
26.blb: Then Jesus comes with them to a place called Gethsemane, and He says to the disciples, “Sit here until, having gone away over there, I shall pray.”
26.bbe: Then comes Jesus with them to a place named Gethsemane, and says to his disciples, Be seated here, while I go over there for prayer.
26.heading: Jesus Prays at Gethsemane

26.msb: He took with Him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee and began to be sorrowful and deeply distressed.
26.kjv: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
26.blb: And having taken with Him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, He began to be sorrowful and deeply distressed.
26.bbe: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and became sad and very troubled.

26.msb: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with Me.”
26.kjv: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
26.blb: Then He says to them, “My soul is very sorrowful, even to death. Remain here and watch with Me.”
26.bbe: Then says he to them, My soul is very sad, even to death: keep watch with me here.

26.msb: Going a little farther, He fell facedown and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me. Yet not as I will, but as You will.”
26.kjv: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
26.blb: And having gone forward a little, He fell upon His face, praying and saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me. Nevertheless, not as I will, but as You.”
26.bbe: And he went forward a little, and falling down on his face in prayer, he said, O my Father, if it is possible, let this cup go from me; but let not my pleasure, but yours be done.

26.msb: Then Jesus returned to the disciples and found them sleeping. “Were you not able to keep watch with Me for one hour?” He asked Peter.
26.kjv: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
26.blb: And He comes to the disciples and finds them sleeping. And He says to Peter, “So, were you not able to watch with Me one hour?
26.bbe: And he comes to the disciples, and sees that they are sleeping, and says to Peter, What, were you not able to keep watch with me one hour?

26.msb: “Watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation. For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak.”
26.kjv: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
26.blb: Watch and pray so that you might not enter into temptation. the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh weak.”
26.bbe: Keep watch with prayer, so that you may not be put to the test: the spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is feeble.

26.msb: A second time He went away and prayed, “My Father, if this cup cannot pass from Me unless I drink it, may Your will be done.”
26.kjv: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
26.blb: Again, for a second time, having gone away, He prayed, saying, “My Father, if this is not possible to pass unless I drink it, Your will be done.”
26.bbe: Again, a second time he went away, and said in prayer, O my Father, if this may not go from me without my taking it, let your pleasure be done.

26.msb: And Jesus returned and found them sleeping again, for their eyes were heavy.
26.kjv: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
26.blb: And having come again, He found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
26.bbe: And he came again and saw them sleeping, for their eyes were tired.

26.msb: So He left them and went away once more and prayed a third time, saying the same thing.
26.kjv: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
26.blb: And having left them again, having gone away, He prayed for the third time, having said the same thing again.
26.bbe: And he went away from them again, and a third time said the same prayer.

26.msb: Then He returned to His disciples and said, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Look, the hour is near, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
26.kjv: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
26.blb: Then He comes to the disciples and says to them, “Sleep and take your rest later on. Behold, the hour has drawn near, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
26.bbe: Then he comes to the disciples; and says to them, Go on sleeping now, and take your rest: for the hour is come, and the Son of man is given into the hands of evil men.

26.msb: Rise, let us go! See, My betrayer is approaching!”
26.kjv: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
26.blb: Rise up, let us go! Behold, he who is betraying Me has drawn near!”
26.bbe: Up, let us be going: see, he who gives me up is near.

26.msb: While Jesus was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived, accompanied by a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and elders of the people.
26.kjv: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
26.blb: And in His still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the Twelve, came, and with him a great crowd with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
26.bbe: And while he was still talking, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a band armed with swords and sticks, from the chief priests and those in authority over the people.
26.heading: The Betrayal of Jesus

26.msb: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The One I kiss is the man; arrest Him.”
26.kjv: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
26.blb: And the one betraying Him gave them a sign, saying, “Whomever I shall kiss, it is He; seize Him.”
26.bbe: Now the false one had given them a sign saying, The one to whom I give a kiss, that is he: take him.

26.msb: Going directly to Jesus, he said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed Him.
26.kjv: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
26.blb: And having come up to Jesus immediately, he said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed Him.
26.bbe: And straight away he came to Jesus and said, Master! and gave him a kiss.

26.msb: “Friend,” Jesus replied, “why have you come?” Then the men stepped forward, seized Jesus, and arrested Him.
26.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
26.blb: And Jesus said to him, “Friend, for what are you come?” Then, having come, they laid hands on Jesus and seized Him.
26.bbe: And Jesus said to him, Friend, do that for which you have come. Then they came and put hands on Jesus, and took him.

26.msb: At this, one of Jesus’ companions drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
26.kjv: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest’s, and smote off his ear.
26.blb: And behold, one of those with Jesus, having stretched out the hand, drew his sword, and having struck the servant of the high priest, he cut off his ear.
26.bbe: And one of those who were with Jesus put out his hand, and took out his sword and gave the servant of the high priest a blow, cutting off his ear.

26.msb: “Put your sword back in its place,” Jesus said to him. “For all who draw the sword will perish by the sword.
26.kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
