26.blb: Then Jesus says to him, “Return your sword into its place; for all those having taken the sword will perish by the sword.
26.bbe: Then says Jesus to him, Put up your sword again into its place: for all those who take the sword will come to death by the sword.

26.msb: Are you not aware that I can call on My Father right now, and He will at once put at My disposal more than twelve legions of angels?
26.kjv: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
26.blb: Or do you think that I am not able to call upon My Father, and He will furnish to Me presently more than twelve legions of angels?
26.bbe: Does it not seem possible to you that if I make request to my Father he will even now send me an army of angels?

26.msb: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen this way?”
26.kjv: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
26.blb: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”
26.bbe: But how then would the Writings come true, which say that so it has to be?

26.msb: At that time Jesus said to the crowd, “Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would an outlaw? Every day I sat with you teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest Me.
26.kjv: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
26.blb: In that hour, Jesus said to the crowds, “Did you come out with swords and clubs, as against a robber, to capture Me? Every day in the temple I was sitting teaching, and you did not seize Me.
26.bbe: In that hour Jesus said to the people, Have you come out as against a thief with swords and sticks to take me? I was teaching every day in the Temple and you took me not.

26.msb: But this has all happened so that the writings of the prophets would be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples deserted Him and fled.
26.kjv: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
26.blb: And all this has come to pass so that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then the disciples, all having forsaken Him, fled.
26.bbe: But all this has taken place so that the writings of the prophets might come true. Then all his disciples went from him in flight.

26.msb: Those who had arrested Jesus led Him away to the house of Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and elders had gathered.
26.kjv: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
26.blb: And those having seized Jesus led Him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
26.bbe: And those who had made Jesus prisoner took him away to the house of Caiaphas, the high priest, where the scribes and those in authority over the people had come together.
26.heading: Jesus before the Sanhedrin

26.msb: But Peter followed Him at a distance, right up to the courtyard of the high priest. And he went in and sat down with the guards to see the outcome.
26.kjv: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest’s palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
26.blb: And Peter was following Him from afar, even to the court of the high priest. And having entered within, he was sitting with the guards to see the outcome.
26.bbe: But Peter went after him at a distance, to the house of the high priest, and went in and took his seat with the servants, to see the end.

26.msb: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking false testimony against Jesus in order to put Him to death.
26.kjv: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;
26.blb: And the chief priests and the whole Council were seeking false testimony against Jesus, so that they might put Him to death.
26.bbe: Now the chief priests and all the Sanhedrin were looking for false witness against Jesus, so that they might put him to death;

26.msb: But they did not find any. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. Finally two false witnesses came forward
26.kjv: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
26.blb: But they did not find any, of many false witnesses having come forward. And at last, two having come forward,
26.bbe: And they were not able to get it, though a number of false witnesses came.

26.msb: and declared, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.’”
26.kjv: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
26.blb: they said, “This man has been saying, ‘I am able to demolish the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.’”
26.bbe: But later there came two who said, This man said, I am able to give the Temple of God to destruction, and to put it up again in three days.

26.msb: So the high priest stood up and asked Him, “Have You no answer? What are these men testifying against You?”
26.kjv: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
26.blb: And the high priest, having risen up, said to Him, “Do You answer nothing? What do these witness against You?”
26.bbe: And the high priest got up and said to him, Have you no answer? what is it which these say against you?

26.msb: But Jesus remained silent. Then the high priest said to Him, “I charge You under oath by the living God: Tell us if You are the Christ, the Son of God.”
26.kjv: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.
26.blb: But Jesus was silent. And the high priest said to Him, “I adjure you by the living God that You tell us if You are the Christ, the Son of God.”
26.bbe: But Jesus said not a word. And the high priest said to him, I put you on oath, by the living God, that you will say to us if you are the Christ, the Son of God.

26.msb: “You have said it yourself,” Jesus answered. “But I say to all of you, from now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven.”
26.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
26.blb: Jesus says to him, “You said it. But I say to you, from now you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming upon the clouds of heaven.”
26.bbe: Jesus says to him, You say so: but I say to you, From now you will see the Son of man seated at the right hand of power, and coming on the clouds of heaven.

26.msb: At this, the high priest tore his clothes and declared, “He has blasphemed! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look, now you have heard His blasphemy.
26.kjv: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.
26.blb: Then the high priest tears his garments, saying, “He blasphemed! Why do we have any more need of witnesses? Behold, now you heard the blasphemy.
26.bbe: Then the high priest, violently parting his robes, said, He has said evil against God: what more need have we of witnesses? for now his words against God have come to your ears:

26.msb: What do you think?” “He deserves to die,” they answered.
26.kjv: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
26.blb: What do you think?” And answering, they said, “He is deserving of death.”
26.bbe: What is your opinion? They made answer and said, It is right for him to be put to death.

26.msb: Then they spit in His face and struck Him. Others slapped Him
26.kjv: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
26.blb: Then they spat in His face and struck Him. And others slapped Him,
26.bbe: Then they put shame on him, and were cruel to him: and some gave him blows, saying,

26.msb: and said, “Prophesy to us, Christ! Who hit You?”
26.kjv: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?
26.blb: saying, “Prophesy to us, Christ. Who is the one having struck You?”
26.bbe: Be a prophet, O Christ, and say who gave you a blow!

26.msb: Meanwhile, Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, and a servant girl came up to him. “You also were with Jesus the Galilean,” she said.
26.kjv: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.
26.blb: And Peter was sitting outside in the court, and one servant girl came to him, saying, “You also were with Jesus the Galilean.”
26.bbe: Now Peter was seated in the open square outside the house: and a servant-girl came to him, saying, You were with Jesus the Galilaean.
26.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

26.msb: But he denied it before them all: “I do not know what you are talking about.”
26.kjv: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
26.blb: And he denied it before all, saying, “I do not know what you say.”
26.bbe: But he said before them all that it was false, saying, I have no knowledge of what you say.

26.msb: When Peter had gone out to the gateway, another servant girl saw him and said to the people there, “This man was also with Jesus of Nazareth.”
26.kjv: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
26.blb: And having gone out to the gateway, another saw him and says to those there, “This man was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
26.bbe: And when he had gone out into the doorway, another saw him and says to those who were there, This man was with Jesus the Nazarene.

26.msb: And again he denied it with an oath: “I do not know the man!”
26.kjv: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
26.blb: And again he denied it with an oath: “I do not know the man.”
26.bbe: And again he said with an oath, I have no knowledge of the man.

26.msb: After a little while, those standing nearby came up to Peter. “Surely you are one of them,” they said, “for your accent gives you away.”
26.kjv: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
26.blb: And after a little while, those standing by, having come, said to Peter, “Truly you are of them also, for even your speech makes you evident.”
26.bbe: And after a little time those who were near came and said to Peter, Truly you are one of them; because your talk is witness against you.

26.msb: At that he began to curse and swear to them, “I do not know the man!” And immediately a rooster crowed.
26.kjv: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
26.blb: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I do not know the man!” And immediately a rooster crowed.
26.bbe: Then with curses and oaths he said, I have no knowledge of the man. And straight away there came the cry of a cock.

26.msb: Then Peter remembered the word that Jesus had spoken to him: “Before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.” And he went outside and wept bitterly.
26.kjv: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
26.blb: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, He having said, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.” And having gone out, he wept bitterly.
26.bbe: And the word of Jesus came back to Peter, when he said, Before the hour of the cock's cry, you will say three times that you have no knowledge of me. And he went out, weeping bitterly.

27.msb: When morning came, all the chief priests and elders of the people conspired against Jesus to put Him to death.
27.kjv: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
27.blb: And morning having come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus, so that they might put Him to death.
27.bbe: Now when it was morning, all the chief priests and those in authority took thought together with the purpose of putting Jesus to death.
27.heading: Jesus Delivered to Pilate

27.msb: They bound Him, led Him away, and handed Him over to Pontius Pilate the governor.
27.kjv: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
27.blb: And having bound Him, they led Him away and delivered Him to Pilate the governor.
27.bbe: And they put cords on him and took him away, and gave him up to Pilate, the ruler.

27.msb: When Judas, who had betrayed Him, saw that Jesus was condemned, he was filled with remorse and returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders.
27.kjv: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
27.blb: Then Judas, the one having delivered Him up, having seen that He was condemned, having regretted it, returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
27.bbe: Then Judas, who was false to him, seeing that he was to be put to death, in his regret took back the thirty bits of silver to the chief priests and those in authority,
27.heading: Judas Hangs Himself

27.msb: “I have sinned by betraying innocent blood,” he said. “What is that to us?” they replied. “You bear the responsibility.”
27.kjv: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.
27.blb: saying, “I sinned, having betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is it to us? You will see.”
27.bbe: Saying, I have done wrong in giving into your hands an upright man. But they said, What is that to us? it is your business.

27.msb: So Judas threw the silver into the temple and left. Then he went away and hanged himself.
27.kjv: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
27.blb: And having cast down the pieces of silver into the temple, he withdrew. And having gone away, he hanged himself.
27.bbe: And he put down the silver in the Temple and went out, and put himself to death by hanging.

27.msb: The chief priests picked up the pieces of silver and said, “It is unlawful to put this into the treasury, since it is blood money.”
27.kjv: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
27.blb: And the chief priests, having taken the pieces of silver, said, “It is not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”
27.bbe: And the chief priests took the silver and said, It is not right to put it in the Temple store for it is the price of blood.

27.msb: After conferring together, they used the money to buy the potter’s field as a burial place for foreigners.
27.kjv: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter’s field, to bury strangers in.
27.blb: And having taken counsel, they bought with them the potter’s field for a burial place for foreigners.
27.bbe: And they made a decision to get with the silver the potter's field, as a place for the dead of other countries.

27.msb: That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.
27.kjv: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
27.blb: Therefore that field was called Field of Blood until this day.
27.bbe: For this cause that field was named, The field of blood, to this day.

27.msb: Then what was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled: “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price set on Him by the people of Israel,
27.kjv: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;
27.blb: Then was fulfilled that having been spoken by the prophet Jeremiah, saying, “And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of the One having been priced, on whom a price was set by the sons of Israel,
27.bbe: Then came true that which was said by Jeremiah the prophet, And they took the thirty bits of silver, the price of him who was valued by the children of Israel;

27.msb: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord had commanded me.”
27.kjv: And gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord appointed me.
27.blb: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord directed me.”
27.bbe: And they gave them for the potter's field, as I had word from the Lord.

27.msb: Meanwhile Jesus stood before the governor, who questioned Him: “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
27.kjv: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
27.blb: Now Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor questioned Him, saying, “Are You the King of the Jews?” And Jesus said, “You say it.”
27.bbe: And Jesus was before the ruler, who put a question to him, Are you the King of the Jews? And Jesus said to him, You say so.
27.heading: Jesus before Pilate

27.msb: And when He was accused by the chief priests and elders, He gave no answer.
27.kjv: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
27.blb: And in His being accused by the chief priests and elders, He answered nothing.
27.bbe: But when the chief priests and those in authority made statements against him, he gave no answer.

27.msb: Then Pilate asked Him, “Do You not hear how many charges they are bringing against You?”
27.kjv: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
27.blb: Then Pilate says to Him, “Do You not hear how many things they witness against You?”
27.bbe: Then says Pilate to him, Do you give no attention to what their witnesses say against you?

27.msb: But Jesus gave no answer, not even to a single charge, much to the governor’s amazement.
27.kjv: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
27.blb: And He did not answer him, not even to one word, so as to amaze the governor exceedingly.
27.bbe: And he gave him no answer, not even a word: so that the ruler was greatly surprised.

27.msb: Now it was the governor’s custom at the feast to release to the crowd a prisoner of their choosing.
27.kjv: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
27.blb: And at the feast, the governor had been accustomed to release one prisoner to the multitude, whom they willed.
27.bbe: Now at the feast it was the way for the ruler to let free to the people one prisoner, at their selection.
27.heading: The Crowd Chooses Barabbas

27.msb: At that time they were holding a notorious prisoner named Barabbas.
27.kjv: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
27.blb: And at that time they were holding a notable prisoner called Barabbas.
27.bbe: And they had then an important prisoner, whose name was Barabbas.

27.msb: So when the crowd had assembled, Pilate asked them, “Which one do you want me to release to you: Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”
27.kjv: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
27.blb: Therefore, in their being gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you desire that I shall release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”
27.bbe: So when they came together, Pilate said to them, Whom will you have? Barabbas, or Jesus, who is named Christ?

27.msb: For he knew it was out of envy that they had handed Jesus over to him.
27.kjv: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
27.blb: For he had known that they delivered Him up because of envy.
27.bbe: For he saw that for envy they had given him up.

27.msb: While Pilate was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent him this message: “Have nothing to do with that innocent man, for I have suffered terribly in a dream today because of Him.”
27.kjv: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
27.blb: And in his sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Nothing with you and that righteous man, for I suffered many things in a dream today because of Him.”
27.bbe: And while he was on the judge's seat, his wife sent to him, saying, Have nothing to do with that upright man, for I have had much trouble this day in a dream because of him.

27.msb: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the crowds to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus put to death.
27.kjv: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
27.blb: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowds that they should ask for Barabbas, and should destroy Jesus.
27.bbe: Now the chief priests and those in authority got the people to make request for Barabbas, and for Jesus to be put to death.

27.msb: “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” asked the governor. “Barabbas,” they replied.
27.kjv: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
27.blb: And answering, the governor said to them, “Which of the two do you desire that I shall release to you?” And they said, “Barabbas.”
27.bbe: But the ruler made answer and said to them, Which of the two is it your pleasure that I let go free? And they said, Barabbas.

27.msb: “What then should I do with Jesus who is called Christ?” Pilate asked. They all answered, “Crucify Him!”
27.kjv: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
27.blb: Pilate says to them, “What then should I do with Jesus who is called Christ?” They all say, “Let Him be crucified!”
27.bbe: Pilate says to them, What, then, am I to do with Jesus, who is named Christ? They all say, Let him be put to death on the cross.

27.msb: “Why?” asked the governor. “What evil has He done?” But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify Him!”
27.kjv: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
27.blb: And he said, “For what evil did He commit?” And they kept crying out all the more, saying, “Let Him be crucified!”
27.bbe: And he said, Why, what evil has he done? But they gave loud cries, saying, To the cross with him!

27.msb: When Pilate saw that he was accomplishing nothing, but that instead a riot was breaking out, he took water and washed his hands before the crowd. “I am innocent of this righteous man’s blood,” he said. “You bear the responsibility.”
27.kjv: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
27.blb: And Pilate, having seen that it availed nothing, but rather a riot is arising, having taken water, he washed the hands before the crowd, saying, “I am guiltless of the blood of this man. For yourselves you will see.”
27.bbe: So when Pilate saw that he was able to do nothing, but that trouble was working up, he took water and, washing his hands before the people, said, The blood of this upright man is not on my hands: you are responsible.
27.heading: Pilate Washes His Hands

27.msb: All the people answered, “His blood be on us and on our children!”
27.kjv: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
27.blb: And answering, all the people, said, “His blood be on us and on our children!”
27.bbe: And all the people made answer and said, Let his blood be on us, and on our children.

27.msb: So Pilate released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed Him over to be crucified.
27.kjv: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
27.blb: Then he released Barabbas to them. And having flogged Jesus, He delivered Him up so that He might be crucified.
27.bbe: Then he let Barabbas go free: but after having Jesus whipped, he gave him up to be put to death on the cross.

27.msb: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company around Him.
27.kjv: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
27.blb: Then the soldiers of the governor, having taken with them Jesus into the Praetorium, gathered the whole cohort before Him.
27.bbe: Then the ruler's armed men took Jesus into the open square, and got all their band together.
27.heading: The Soldiers Mock Jesus

27.msb: They stripped Him and put a scarlet robe on Him.
27.kjv: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
27.blb: And having stripped Him, they put a scarlet robe around Him.
27.bbe: And they took off his clothing, and put on him a red robe.

27.msb: And they twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on His head. They put a staff in His right hand, knelt down before Him, and mocked Him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
27.kjv: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
27.blb: And having twisted together a crown of thorns, they put it on His head, and a reed in His right hand; and having bowed the knees before Him, they mocked Him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
27.bbe: And they made a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and put a rod in his right hand, and they went down on their knees before him, and made sport of him, saying, Long life to the King of the Jews.

27.msb: Then they spit on Him and took the staff and struck Him on the head repeatedly.
27.kjv: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
27.blb: And having spit upon Him, they took the reed and kept striking Him on His head.
27.bbe: And they put shame on him, and gave him blows on the head with the rod.

27.msb: After they had mocked Him, they removed the robe and put His own clothes back on Him. Then they led Him away to crucify Him.
27.kjv: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
27.blb: And when they had mocked Him, they took the robe off Him, and they put His garments on Him and led Him away to crucify Him.
27.bbe: And when they had made sport of him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothing on him, and took him away to put him on the cross.

27.msb: Along the way they found a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross of Jesus.
27.kjv: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
27.blb: And going out, they found a man of Cyrene named Simon. They compelled him that he might carry His cross.
27.bbe: And while they were coming out, they saw a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they made him go with them, so that he might take up his cross.
27.heading: The Crucifixion

27.msb: And when they came to a place called Golgotha, which means The Place of the Skull,
27.kjv: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
27.blb: And having come to a place called Golgotha, which is called Place of a Skull,
27.bbe: And when they came to the place named Golgotha, that is to say, Dead Man's Head,

27.msb: they offered Him sour wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, He refused to drink it.
27.kjv: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
27.blb: they gave Him wine to drink, mixed with gall; and having tasted it, He was not willing to drink it.
27.bbe: They gave him wine mixed with bitter drink: and after tasting it, he took no more.

27.msb: When they had crucified Him, they divided up His garments by casting lots.
27.kjv: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
27.blb: And having crucified Him, they divided His garments, casting a lot.
27.bbe: And when they had put him on the cross, they made division of his clothing among them by the decision of chance.

27.msb: And sitting down, they kept watch over Him there.
27.kjv: And sitting down they watched him there;
27.blb: And sitting down, they were guarding Him there.
27.bbe: And they were seated there watching him.

27.msb: Above His head they posted the written charge against Him: THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
27.kjv: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
27.blb: And they put up over His head the written accusation against Him: THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
27.bbe: And they put up over his head the statement of his crime in writing, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

27.msb: Two robbers were crucified with Him, one on His right and the other on His left.
27.kjv: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
27.blb: At that time two robbers are crucified with Him, one at the right hand and one at the left.
27.bbe: Then two thieves were put on crosses with him, one on the right and one on the left.

27.msb: And those who passed by heaped abuse on Him, shaking their heads
27.kjv: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
27.blb: And those passing by kept railing at Him, wagging their heads
27.bbe: And those who went by said bitter words to him, shaking their heads and saying,

27.msb: and saying, “You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days, save Yourself! If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”
27.kjv: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
27.blb: and saying, “The One demolishing the temple and building it in three days, save Yourself! If You are the Son of God, also come down from the cross!”
27.bbe: You who would give the Temple to destruction and put it up again in three days, get yourself free: if you are the Son of God, come down from the cross.

27.msb: In the same way, the chief priests, scribes, elders, and Pharisees mocked Him, saying,
27.kjv: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,
27.blb: Likewise also the chief priests, mocking, with the scribes and elders, were saying,
27.bbe: In the same way, the chief priests, making sport of him, with the scribes and those in authority, said,

27.msb: “He saved others, but He cannot save Himself. If He is the King of Israel, let Him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in Him.
27.kjv: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
27.blb: “He saved others. He is not able to save Himself. He is King of Israel! Let Him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in Him.
27.bbe: A saviour of others, he has no salvation for himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will have faith in him.

27.msb: He trusts in God. Let God deliver Him now if He wants Him. For He said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”
27.kjv: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
27.blb: He has trusted on God. Let Him deliver Him now if He wants Him, for He said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”
27.bbe: He put his faith in God; let God be his saviour now, if he will have him; for he said, I am the Son of God.

27.msb: In the same way, even the robbers who were crucified with Him berated Him.
27.kjv: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
27.blb: And likewise even the robbers, those having been crucified with Him, were upbraiding Him.
27.bbe: And the thieves who were on the crosses said evil words to him.

27.msb: From the sixth hour until the ninth hour darkness came over all the land.
27.kjv: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
27.blb: And from the sixth hour darkness was over all the land until the ninth hour.
27.bbe: Now from the sixth hour it was dark over all the land till the ninth hour.
27.heading: The Death of Jesus

27.msb: About the ninth hour Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” which means, “My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?”
27.kjv: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
27.blb: And about the ninth hour, Jesus cried out in a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” That is, “My God, My God, why did You forsake Me?”
27.bbe: And about the ninth hour Jesus gave a loud cry, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is, My God, my God, why are you turned away from me?

27.msb: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, “He is calling Elijah.”
27.kjv: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
27.blb: And some of those standing there, having heard, were saying, “This man calls Elijah.”
27.bbe: And some of those who were near by, hearing it, said, This man is crying to Elijah.

27.msb: One of them quickly ran and brought a sponge. He filled it with sour wine, put it on a reed, and held it up for Jesus to drink.
27.kjv: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
27.blb: And immediately one of them, having run and having taken a sponge, and having filled it with vinegar and having put it on a reed, gave Him to drink.
27.bbe: And straight away one of them went quickly, and took a sponge, and made it full of bitter wine, and put it on a rod and gave him drink.

27.msb: But the others said, “Leave Him alone. Let us see if Elijah comes to save Him.”
27.kjv: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
27.blb: And the rest were saying, “Let it be. Let us see whether Elijah comes to save Him.”
27.bbe: And the rest said, Let him be; let us see if Elijah will come to his help.

27.msb: When Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, He yielded up His spirit.
27.kjv: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
27.blb: And Jesus, having cried again in a loud voice, yielded up His spirit.
27.bbe: And Jesus gave another loud cry, and gave up his spirit.

27.msb: At that moment the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth quaked, and the rocks were split.
27.kjv: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
27.blb: And behold, the veil of the temple was torn into two from top to bottom. And the earth was shaken, and the rocks were split.
27.bbe: And the curtain of the Temple was parted in two from end to end; and there was an earth-shock; and the rocks were broken;

27.msb: The tombs broke open, and the bodies of many saints who had fallen asleep were raised.
27.kjv: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
27.blb: And the tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints having fallen asleep were raised.
27.bbe: And the resting-places of the dead came open; and the bodies of a number of sleeping saints came to life;

27.msb: After Jesus’ resurrection, when they had come out of the tombs, they entered the holy city and appeared to many people.
27.kjv: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
27.blb: And having gone forth out of the tombs after His resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.
27.bbe: And coming out of their resting-places, after he had come again from the dead, they went into the holy town and were seen by a number of people.

27.msb: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened, they were terrified and said, “Truly this was the Son of God.”
27.kjv: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
27.blb: And the centurion and those with him guarding Jesus, having seen the earthquake and the things taking place, feared greatly, saying, “Truly this was God’s Son.”
27.bbe: Now the captain and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earth-shock and the things which were done, were in great fear and said, Truly this was a son of God.

27.msb: And many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to minister to Him.
27.kjv: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
27.blb: And many women were there, looking on from afar off, who followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering to Him—
27.bbe: And a number of women were there, watching from a distance, who had come with Jesus from Galilee, waiting on his needs.

27.msb: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.
27.kjv: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee’s children.
27.blb: among whom was Mary Magdalene—also Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
27.bbe: Among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary, the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

27.msb: When it was evening, there came a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph, who himself was a disciple of Jesus.
27.kjv: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathæa, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus’ disciple:
27.blb: And evening having come, a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph came, who himself also was discipled to Jesus.
27.bbe: And in the evening, there came a man of wealth from Arimathaea, Joseph by name, who was a disciple of Jesus:
27.heading: The Burial of Jesus

27.msb: He went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus, and Pilate ordered that the body be given to him.
27.kjv: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
27.blb: Having gone to Pilate, he asked for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded it to be given up.
27.bbe: This man went in to Pilate, and made a request for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate gave orders for it to be given to him.

27.msb: So Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
27.kjv: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
27.blb: And Joseph, having taken the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth
27.bbe: And Joseph took the body, folding it in clean linen,

27.msb: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut into the rock. Then he rolled a great stone across the entrance to the tomb and went away.
27.kjv: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
27.blb: and placed it in his new tomb, which he had cut in the rock. And having rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, he went away.
27.bbe: And put it in the resting-place which had been cut out of the rock for himself; and after rolling a great stone to the door of it he went away.

27.msb: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.
27.kjv: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
27.blb: And Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.
27.bbe: And Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, seated by the place of the dead.

27.msb: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and Pharisees assembled before Pilate.
27.kjv: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
27.blb: And the next day, which is after the Preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together before Pilate,
27.bbe: Now on the day after the getting ready of the Passover, the chief priests and Pharisees came together to Pilate,
27.heading: The Guards at the Tomb

27.msb: “Sir,” they said, “we remember that while He was alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’
27.kjv: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
27.blb: saying, “Sir, we have remembered how that deceiver, while living, said, ‘After three days I arise.’
27.bbe: Saying, Sir, we have in mind how that false man said, while he was still living, After three days I will come again from the dead.

27.msb: So give the order that the tomb be secured until the third day. Otherwise, His disciples may come by night and steal Him away and tell the people He has risen from the dead. And this last deception would be worse than the first.”
27.kjv: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
27.blb: Therefore command the tomb to be secured until the third day, lest ever His disciples, having come, steal Him away and say to the people, ‘He is risen from the dead.’ And the last deception will be worse than the first.”
27.bbe: Give orders, then, that the place where his body is may be made safe till the third day, for fear that his disciples come and take him away secretly and say to the people, He has come back from the dead: and the last error will be worse than the first.

27.msb: “You have a guard,” Pilate said. “Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how.”
27.kjv: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
27.blb: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you have known.”
27.bbe: Pilate said to them, You have watchmen; go and make it as safe as you are able.

27.msb: So they went and secured the tomb by sealing the stone and posting the guard.
27.kjv: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
27.blb: And having gone with the guard, they made the tomb secure, having sealed the stone.
27.bbe: So they went, and made safe the place where his body was, putting a stamp on the stone, and the watchmen were with them.

28.msb: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.
28.kjv: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
28.blb: Now after the Sabbaths, it being dawn toward the first of the Sabbaths, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.
28.bbe: Now late on the Sabbath, when the dawn of the first day of the week was near, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the place where his body was.
28.heading: The Resurrection

28.msb: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, rolled away the stone from the entrance, and sat on it.
28.kjv: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
28.blb: And behold, there was a great earthquake; for an angel of the Lord, having descended out of heaven and having come, rolled away the stone and was sitting upon it.
28.bbe: And there was a great earth-shock; for an angel of the Lord came down from heaven and, rolling back the stone, took his seat on it.

28.msb: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
28.kjv: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
28.blb: And his appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.
28.bbe: His form was shining like the light, and his clothing was white as snow:

28.msb: The guards trembled in fear of him and became like dead men.
28.kjv: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
28.blb: And those keeping guard trembled from fear of him, and they became like dead men.
28.bbe: And for fear of him the watchmen were shaking, and became as dead men.

28.msb: But the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
28.kjv: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.
28.blb: And answering, the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, the One having been crucified.
28.bbe: And the angel said to the women, Have no fear: for I see that you are searching for Jesus, who was put to death on the cross.

28.msb: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
28.kjv: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
28.blb: He is not here, for He is risen, as He said! Come, see the place where He was lying.
28.bbe: He is not here, for he has come to life again, even as he said. Come, see the Lord's resting-place.

28.msb: Then go quickly and tell His disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him.’ See, I have told you.”
28.kjv: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
28.blb: And having gone quickly, say to His disciples, ‘He is risen from the dead, and behold, He goes before you into Galilee; there you will see Him.’ Behold, I have told you.”
28.bbe: And go quickly and give his disciples the news that he has come back from the dead, and is going before you into Galilee; there you will see him, as I have said to you.

28.msb: So they hurried out from the tomb in fear and great joy, and ran to tell His disciples.
28.kjv: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.
28.blb: And having gone out quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, they ran to tell His disciples.
28.bbe: And they went away quickly, with fear and great joy, to give his disciples the news.

28.msb: And as they were going to tell His disciples, suddenly Jesus met them and said, “Greetings!” They came to Him, grasped His feet, and worshiped Him.
28.kjv: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
28.blb: And behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Greetings!” And having come, they took hold of His feet and worshiped Him.
28.bbe: And on the way, Jesus came to them, saying, Be glad. And they came and put their hands on his feet, and gave him worship.

28.msb: “Do not be afraid,” said Jesus. “Go and tell My brothers to go to Galilee. There they will see Me.”
28.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
28.blb: Then Jesus says to them, “Do not be afraid. Go, tell My brothers, so that they should go into Galilee. And there they will see Me.”
28.bbe: Then said Jesus to them, Have no fear: go and give word to my brothers to go into Galilee, and there they will see me.

28.msb: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests all that had happened.
28.kjv: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.
28.blb: And in their going, behold, some of the guard, having gone into the city, reported to the chief priests all the things having come to pass.
28.bbe: Now, while they were going, some of the watchmen came into the town and gave news to the chief priests of all the things which had taken place.
28.heading: The Report of the Guards

28.msb: And after the chief priests had met with the elders and formed a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money
28.kjv: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
28.blb: And having been gathered together with the elders and having taken counsel, they gave many pieces of silver to the soldiers,
28.bbe: And when they had come together with those in authority, and had made their decision, they gave much money to the watchmen, saying,

28.msb: and instructed them: “You are to say, ‘His disciples came by night and stole Him away while we were asleep.’
28.kjv: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
28.blb: saying, “Say, ‘His disciples, having come by night, stole Him—we being asleep.’
28.bbe: Say, His disciples came by night and took him away secretly while we were sleeping.

28.msb: If this report reaches the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”
28.kjv: And if this come to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
28.blb: And if this is heard by the governor, we will persuade him, and we will keep you out of trouble.”
28.bbe: And if this comes to the ruler's ears, we will see that he does not make you responsible.

28.msb: So the guards took the money and did as they were instructed. And this account has been circulated among the Jews to this very day.
28.kjv: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
28.blb: And having taken the pieces of silver, they did as they were instructed. And this report was spread abroad among the Jews until the present day.
28.bbe: So they took the money, and did as they had been ordered: and this account has been current among the Jews till the present time.

28.msb: Meanwhile, the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain Jesus had designated.
28.kjv: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
28.blb: And the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus assigned them.
28.bbe: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had given them orders to go.
28.heading: The Great Commission

28.msb: When they saw Him, they worshiped Him, but some doubted.
28.kjv: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
28.blb: And having seen Him, they worshiped; but some doubted.
28.bbe: And when they saw him they gave him worship: but some were in doubt.

28.msb: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
28.kjv: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
28.blb: And having come near, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “All authority in heaven and on the earth was given to Me.
28.bbe: And Jesus came to them and said, All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

28.msb: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
28.kjv: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
28.blb: Therefore, having gone, disciple all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit,
28.bbe: Go then, and make disciples of all the nations, giving them baptism in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit:

28.msb: and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age. Amen.”
28.kjv: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
28.blb: teaching them to observe all things, as much as I commanded you. And behold, I am with you all the days, until the consummation of the age.”
28.bbe: Teaching them to keep all the rules which I have given you: and see, I am ever with you, even to the end of the world.

1.msb: This is the beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
1.kjv: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
1.blb: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, Son of God.
1.bbe: The first words of the good news of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
1.heading: The Mission of John the Baptist

1.msb: As it is written in the prophets: “Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way before You.”
1.kjv: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
1.blb: Just as it has been written in Isaiah the prophet: “Behold, I send My messenger before Your face, who will prepare Your way.”
1.bbe: Even as it is said in the book of Isaiah the prophet, See, I send my servant before your face, who will make ready your way;

1.msb: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’”
1.kjv: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
1.blb: “A voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way of the Lord, make straight His paths.’”
1.bbe: The voice of one crying in the waste land, Make ready the way of the Lord, make his roads straight;

1.msb: John came baptizing in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
1.kjv: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
1.blb: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching a baptism of repentance unto forgiveness of sins.
1.bbe: John came, and gave baptism in the waste land, preaching baptism as a sign of forgiveness of sin for those whose hearts were changed.

1.msb: People went out to him from all of Jerusalem and the countryside of Judea. Confessing their sins, they were all baptized by him in the Jordan River.
1.kjv: And there went out unto him all the land of Judæa, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
1.blb: And all the region of Judea and all those of Jerusalem were going out to him, and they were being baptized by him in the Jordan River, confessing their sins.
1.bbe: And there went out to him all the people of Judaea, and all those of Jerusalem, and they were given baptism by him in the river Jordan, saying that they were sinners.

1.msb: John was clothed in camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
1.kjv: And John was clothed with camel’s hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
1.blb: And John was clothed in camel’s hair, and a belt of leather was around his waist, and he is eating locusts and wild honey.
1.bbe: And John was clothed in camel's hair, with a leather band about him; and his food was locusts and honey.

1.msb: And he proclaimed: “After me will come One more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.
1.kjv: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
1.blb: And he was proclaiming, saying, “The One mighter than I comes after me, of whom I am not sufficient, having stooped down, to loose the strap of His sandals.
1.bbe: And he said to them all, There is one coming after me who is greater than I, whose shoes I am not good enough to undo.

1.msb: I indeed baptize you with water, but He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”
1.kjv: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
1.blb: I baptized you in water, but He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”
1.bbe: I have given you baptism with water, but he will give you baptism with the Holy Spirit.

1.msb: In those days Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
1.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
1.blb: And it came to pass in those days that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee and was baptized in the Jordan by John.
1.bbe: And it came about in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was given baptism by John in the Jordan.

1.msb: As soon as Jesus came up out of the water, He saw the heavens breaking open and the Spirit descending on Him like a dove.
1.kjv: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
1.blb: And immediately, going up out of the water, He saw the heavens being torn open and the Spirit descending like a dove to Him.
1.bbe: And straight away, coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens broken open and the Spirit coming down on him as a dove:

1.msb: And a voice came from heaven: “You are My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
1.kjv: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
1.blb: And a voice came out of the heavens: “You are My Son, the Beloved; in You I was well pleased.”
1.bbe: And a voice came out of heaven, You are my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased.

1.msb: At once the Spirit drove Jesus into the wilderness,
1.kjv: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
1.blb: And immediately the Spirit drives Him out into the wilderness.
1.bbe: And straight away the Spirit sent him out into the waste land.
1.heading: The Temptation and Preaching of Jesus

1.msb: and He was there in the wilderness for forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and the angels ministered to Him.
1.kjv: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
1.blb: And He was in the wilderness forty days being tempted by Satan, and He was with the wild animals, and the angels were ministering to Him.
1.bbe: And he was in the waste land for forty days, being tested by Satan; and he was with the beasts; and the angels took care of him.

1.msb: After the arrest of John, Jesus went into Galilee and proclaimed the gospel of the kingdom of God.
1.kjv: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
1.blb: And after the delivering up of John, Jesus came into Galilee, proclaiming the gospel of God
1.bbe: Now after John had been put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the good news of God,

1.msb: “The time is fulfilled,” He said, “and the kingdom of God is near. Repent and believe in the gospel!”
1.kjv: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
1.blb: and saying, “The time has been fulfilled, and the kingdom of God has drawn near. Repent and believe in the gospel!”
1.bbe: And saying, The time has come, and the kingdom of God is near: let your hearts be turned from sin and have faith in the good news.

1.msb: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
1.kjv: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
1.blb: And passing by the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
1.bbe: And going by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon, and Andrew, the brother of Simon, putting a net into the sea: for they were fishermen.
1.heading: The First Disciples

1.msb: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”
1.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
1.blb: And Jesus said to them, “Come after Me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.”
1.bbe: And Jesus said to them, Come after me, and I will make you fishers of men.

1.msb: And at once they left their nets and followed Him.
1.kjv: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
1.blb: And immediately, having left the nets, they followed Him.
1.bbe: And they went straight from their nets, and came after him.

1.msb: Going on a little farther from there, He saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat, mending their nets.
1.kjv: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
1.blb: And having gone on a little, He saw James of Zebedee and his brother John. And they were in the boat, mending the nets.
1.bbe: And going on a little farther, he saw James, the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were in their boat stitching up their nets.

1.msb: Immediately Jesus called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed Him.
1.kjv: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
1.blb: And immediately He called them, and having left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men, they went away after Him.
1.bbe: And he said, Come after me: and they went away from their father Zebedee, who was in the boat with the servants, and came after him.

1.msb: Then Jesus and His companions went to Capernaum, and right away Jesus entered the synagogue on the Sabbath and began to teach.
1.kjv: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
1.blb: And they go into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbaths, having entered into the synagogue, He was teaching.
1.bbe: And they came to Capernaum; and on the Sabbath he went into the Synagogue and gave teaching.
1.heading: Jesus Expels an Unclean Spirit

1.msb: The people were astonished at His teaching, because He taught as one who had authority, and not as the scribes.
1.kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.
1.blb: And they were astonished at His teaching, for He was teaching them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
1.bbe: And they were full of wonder at his teaching, because he gave it as one having authority, and not like the scribes.

1.msb: Now a man with an unclean spirit cried out in the synagogue:
1.kjv: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
1.blb: And immediately there was a man in their synagogue with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,
1.bbe: And there was in their Synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he gave a cry,

1.msb: “Let us alone! What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!”
1.kjv: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
1.blb: saying, “What to us and to You, Jesus the Nazarene? Did You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!”
1.bbe: Saying, What have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? have you come to put an end to us? I see well who you are, the Holy One of God.

1.msb: But Jesus rebuked the spirit. “Be silent!” He said. “Come out of him!”
1.kjv: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
1.blb: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silenced, and come out of him!”
1.bbe: And Jesus said to him sharply, Be quiet, and come out of him.

1.msb: At this, the unclean spirit threw the man into convulsions and came out with a loud shriek.
1.kjv: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
1.blb: And having thrown him into convulsions, and having cried in a loud voice, the unclean spirit came out of him.
1.bbe: And the unclean spirit, shaking him violently, and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

1.msb: All the people were amazed and began to ask one another, “What is this? What new teaching is this that with authority He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him?”
1.kjv: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
1.blb: And all were amazed, so as to question among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching with authority! He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him!”
1.bbe: And they were all greatly surprised, so that they put questions to one another, saying, What is this? a new teaching! with authority he gives orders even to the unclean spirits, and they do what he says.

1.msb: And the news about Jesus spread quickly through the whole region of Galilee.
1.kjv: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
1.blb: And the news of Him immediately went out everywhere into all the surrounding region of Galilee.
1.bbe: And news of him went out quickly everywhere into all parts of Galilee round about.

1.msb: As soon as Jesus and His companions had left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.
1.kjv: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
1.blb: And immediately, having gone out of the synagogue, they went into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
1.bbe: And when they came out of the Synagogue, they went into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
1.heading: Jesus Heals at Peter’s House

1.msb: Simon’s mother-in-law was sick in bed with a fever, and they promptly told Jesus about her.
1.kjv: But Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
1.blb: And the mother-in-law of Simon was lying sick, having a fever, and immediately they speak to Him about her.
1.bbe: Now Simon's wife's mother was ill, with a burning heat; and they gave him word of her:

1.msb: So He went to her, took her by the hand, and helped her up. Immediately the fever left her, and she began to serve them.
1.kjv: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
1.blb: And having come near, He raised her up, having taken hold of the hand. And the fever left her, and she was serving them.
1.bbe: And he came and took her by the hand, lifting her up; and she became well, and took care of their needs.

1.msb: That evening, after sunset, people brought to Jesus all the sick and demon-possessed,
1.kjv: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
1.blb: Now evening having come, when the sun set, they were bringing to Him all those being ill and those being demon-possessed.
1.bbe: And in the evening, at sundown, they took to him all who were diseased, and those who had evil spirits.

1.msb: and the whole town gathered at the door.
1.kjv: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
1.blb: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
1.bbe: And all the town had come together at the door.

1.msb: And He healed many who were ill with various diseases and drove out many demons. But He would not allow the demons to speak, because they knew who He was.
1.kjv: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
1.blb: And He healed many ill having various diseases, and He cast out many demons. And He was not allowing the demons to speak, because they knew Him.
1.bbe: And a number, who were ill with different diseases, he made well, and sent out evil spirits; but he did not let the evil spirits say anything, because they had knowledge of him.

1.msb: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up and went out to a solitary place to pray.
1.kjv: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
1.blb: And having risen up early, very much in the night, He went out and went away into a wilderness place, and there He was praying.
1.bbe: And in the morning, a long time before daylight, he got up and went out to a quiet place, and there he gave himself up to prayer.
1.heading: Jesus Prays and Preaches

1.msb: Simon and his companions went to look for Him,
1.kjv: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
1.blb: And Simon and those with him went after Him.
1.bbe: And Simon and those who were with him came after him.

1.msb: and when they found Him, they said, “Everyone is looking for You!”
1.kjv: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.
1.blb: And having found Him, also they say to Him, “Everyone seeks You!”
1.bbe: And when they came up with him, they said to him, Everyone is looking for you.

1.msb: But Jesus answered, “Let us go on to the neighboring towns so I can preach there as well, for that is why I have come.”
1.kjv: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
1.blb: And He says to them, “Let us go another way into the neighboring towns, so that I might preach there also; for I came out for this.”
1.bbe: And he said to them, Let us go to other parts into the nearest towns, so that I may give teaching there, because for this purpose I came.

1.msb: So He went throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.
1.kjv: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
1.blb: And He went preaching in their synagogues in all Galilee, and casting out demons.
1.bbe: And he went into their Synagogues in every part of Galilee, preaching and driving out evil spirits.

1.msb: Then a leper came to Jesus, begging and kneeling before Him and saying to Him: “If You are willing, You can make me clean.”
1.kjv: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
1.blb: And a leper comes to Him, imploring Him and falling on his knees, and saying to Him, “If You are willing, You are able to cleanse me.”
1.bbe: And a leper came to him and, going down on his knees before him, made a request, saying, If it is your pleasure, you have the power to make me clean.
1.heading: The Leper’s Prayer

1.msb: Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!”
1.kjv: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
1.blb: And having been moved with compassion, having stretched out His hand, He touched him and, He says to him, “I am willing; be cleansed!”
1.bbe: And being moved with pity, he put out his hand, and touching him said to him, It is my pleasure; be made clean.

1.msb: And when He had said this, immediately the leprosy left him, and the man was cleansed.
1.kjv: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
1.blb: And immediately the leprosy went away from him, and he was cleansed.
1.bbe: And straight away the disease went from him, and he was made clean.

1.msb: Jesus promptly sent him away with a stern warning:
1.kjv: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
1.blb: And having sternly warned him, immediately He sent him out.
1.bbe: And he sent him away, saying to him very sharply,

1.msb: “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
1.kjv: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
1.blb: And He says to him, “See that you say nothing to anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest, and offer concerning your cleansing what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
1.bbe: See that you say nothing to any man: but go and let the priest see you, and make yourself clean by an offering of the things ordered by Moses, for a witness to them.

1.msb: But the man went out and openly began to proclaim and spread the news. Consequently, Jesus could no longer enter a town in plain view, but He stayed out in solitary places. Yet people came to Him from every quarter.
1.kjv: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
1.blb: But he, having gone out, began to proclaim much and to spread abroad the word, so that He was no longer able to enter openly into a city, but He was out in wilderness places. And they were coming to Him from everywhere.
1.bbe: But he went out, and made it public, giving an account of it everywhere, so that Jesus was no longer able to go openly into a town, but was outside in the waste land; and they came to him from every part.

2.msb: A few days later Jesus went back to Capernaum. And when the people heard that He was home,
2.kjv: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
2.blb: And He having entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that He is in the house.
2.bbe: And when he came into Capernaum again after some days, the news went about that he was in the house.
2.heading: Jesus Heals a Paralytic

2.msb: immediately they gathered in such large numbers that there was no more room, not even outside the door, as Jesus spoke the word to them.
2.kjv: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.
2.blb: And many were gathered together, so as to have no more space, not even at the door. And He was speaking the word to them.
2.bbe: And a great number had come together, so that there was no longer room for them, no, not even about the door: and he gave them teaching.

2.msb: Then a paralytic was brought to Him, carried by four men.
2.kjv: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
2.blb: And they come, bringing to Him a paralytic, being carried by four.
2.bbe: And four men came to him with one on a bed who had no power of moving.

2.msb: Since they were unable to get to Jesus through the crowd, they uncovered the roof above Him, made an opening, and lowered the paralytic on his mat.
2.kjv: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
2.blb: And not being able to bring him to Him through the crowd, they unroofed the roof where He was, and having dug it out, they let down the mat on which the paralytic was lying.
2.bbe: And when they were unable to get near him because of all the people, they got the roof uncovered where he was: and when it was broken up, they let down the bed on which the man was.

2.msb: When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”
2.kjv: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.
2.blb: And Jesus, having seen their faith, says to the paralytic, “Child, your sins are forgiven.”
2.bbe: And Jesus, seeing their faith, said to him, Son, you have forgiveness for your sins.

2.msb: But some of the scribes were sitting there and thinking in their hearts,
2.kjv: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
2.blb: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,
2.bbe: But there were certain of the scribes seated there, and reasoning in their hearts,

2.msb: “Why does this man speak such blasphemies? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
2.kjv: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
2.blb: “Why does this man speak thus? He blasphemes! Who is able to forgive sins except One—God?”
2.bbe: Why does this man say such things? he has no respect for God: from whom does forgiveness come but from God only?

2.msb: At once Jesus knew in His spirit that they were thinking this way within themselves. “Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?” He asked.
2.kjv: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?
2.blb: And immediately Jesus, having known in His spirit that they are reasoning thus in themselves, says to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?
2.bbe: And Jesus, having knowledge in his spirit of their thoughts, said to them, Why are you reasoning about these things in your hearts?

2.msb: “Which is easier: to say to a paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, pick up your mat, and walk’?
2.kjv: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
2.blb: Which is easier: to say to the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your mat, and walk’?
2.bbe: Which is the simpler, to say to a man who is ill, You have forgiveness for your sins, or, Get up, take up your bed, and go?

2.msb: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...” He said to the paralytic,
2.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)
2.blb: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority to forgive sins on the earth...” He says to the paralytic,
2.bbe: But so that you may see that the Son of man has authority for the forgiveness of sins on earth, (he said to the man,)

2.msb: “I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”
2.kjv: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.
2.blb: “I say to you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”
2.bbe: I say to you, Get up, take up your bed, and go to your house.

2.msb: And immediately the man got up, picked up his mat, and walked out in front of them all. As a result, they were all astounded and glorified God, saying, “We have never seen anything like this!”
2.kjv: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
2.blb: And he arose, and immediately, having taken up the mat, he went out before all, so as for all to be amazed and to glorify God, saying, “Never thus did we see!”
