2.bbe: And he got up, and straight away took up the bed and went out before them all, so that they were all full of wonder, and gave glory to God, saying, We have never seen anything like this.

2.msb: Once again Jesus went out beside the sea. All the people came to Him, and He taught them there.
2.kjv: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
2.blb: And He went out again beside the sea. And all the crowd was coming to Him, and He taught them.
2.bbe: And he went out again by the seaside; and all the people came to him, and he gave them teaching.
2.heading: Jesus Calls Levi

2.msb: As He was walking along, He saw Levi son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax booth. “Follow Me,” He told him, and Levi got up and followed Him.
2.kjv: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphæus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
2.blb: And passing by, He saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax booth, and He says to him, “Follow Me.” And having risen up, he followed Him.
2.bbe: And when he went by, he saw Levi, the son of Alphaeus, seated at the place where taxes were taken, and he said to him, Come with me. And he got up, and went with him.

2.msb: While Jesus was dining at Levi’s house, many tax collectors and sinners were eating with Him and His disciples—for there were many who followed Him.
2.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
2.blb: And it came to pass, in His reclining in his house, that many tax collectors and sinners were reclining with Jesus and His disciples; for there were many, and they were following Him.
2.bbe: And it came about that he was seated at meat in his house, and a number of tax-farmers and sinners were at table with Jesus and his disciples: for there were a great number of them, and they came after him.

2.msb: When the scribes and Pharisees saw Jesus eating with these people, they asked His disciples, “Why does He eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?”
2.kjv: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
2.blb: And the scribes of the Pharisees, having seen that He eats with the sinners and tax collectors, were saying to His disciples, “Why does He eat with the tax collectors and sinners?”
2.bbe: And the scribes of the Pharisees, when they saw that he was taking food with the tax-farmers and sinners, said to his disciples, Why does he take food and drink with such men?

2.msb: On hearing this, Jesus told them, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”
2.kjv: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
2.blb: And Jesus, having heard, says to them, “Those being strong have no need of a physician, rather those being ill. I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”
2.bbe: And Jesus, hearing it, said to them, Those who are well have no need of a medical man, but those who are ill: I have come not to get the upright but sinners.

2.msb: Now the disciples of John and of the Pharisees were often fasting. So people came to Jesus and asked, “Why don’t Your disciples fast like John’s disciples and those of the Pharisees?”
2.kjv: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
2.blb: And the disciples of John and the Pharisees were fasting. And they come and say to Him, “Why do the disciples of John and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but Your disciples do not fast?”
2.bbe: And John's disciples and the Pharisees were taking no food: and they came and said to him, Why do John's disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees go without food, but your disciples do not?
2.heading: Questions about Fasting

2.msb: Jesus replied, “How can the guests of the bridegroom fast while He is with them? As long as He is with them, they cannot fast.
2.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
2.blb: And Jesus said to them, “Are the sons of the bridechamber able to fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long a time as they have the bridegroom with them, they are not able to fast.
2.bbe: And Jesus said to them, Will the friends of a newly-married man go without food while he is with them? as long as they have him with them they will not go without food.

2.msb: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.
2.kjv: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
2.blb: But days will come when the bridegroom shall have been taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.
2.bbe: But the days will come when the husband will be taken away from them, and then they will go without food.

2.msb: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. If he does, the new piece will pull away from the old, and a worse tear will result.
2.kjv: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
2.blb: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. and if otherwise, the filling up pulls away from it, the new from the old, and a worse tear happens.
2.bbe: No man puts a bit of new cloth on an old coat: or the new, by pulling away from the old, makes a worse hole.
2.heading: The Patches and the Wineskins

2.msb: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the new wine will burst the skins, the wine will spill out, and the wineskins will be ruined. Instead, new wine is poured into new wineskins.”
2.kjv: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.
2.blb: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins. and if otherwise, the wine will burst the wineskins, and the wine is destroyed—and the wineskins. But new wine is put into new wineskins.”
2.bbe: And no man puts new wine into old wine-skins: or the skins will be burst by the wine, and the wine and the skins will be wasted: but new wine has to be put into new wine-skins.

2.msb: One Sabbath Jesus was passing through the grainfields, and His disciples began to pick the heads of grain as they walked along.
2.kjv: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.
2.blb: And it came to pass that He is passing along through the grainfields on the Sabbaths, and His disciples began to make their way, plucking the heads of grain.
2.bbe: And it came about that on the Sabbath day he was going through the grain-fields; and while they were walking, his disciples took the heads of grain.
2.heading: The Lord of the Sabbath

2.msb: So the Pharisees said to Him, “Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”
2.kjv: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
2.blb: And the Pharisees were saying to Him, “Behold, why do they do on the Sabbaths what is not lawful?”
2.bbe: And the Pharisees said to him, Why are they doing what it is not right to do on the Sabbath?

2.msb: Jesus replied, “Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?
2.kjv: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?
2.blb: And He says to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry, he and those with him:
2.bbe: And he said to them, Have you no knowledge of what David did, when he had need and was without food, he, and those who were with him?

2.msb: During the high priesthood of Abiathar, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which was lawful only for the priests. And he gave some to his companions as well.”
2.kjv: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?
2.blb: how he entered into the house of God in the time of Abiathar the high priest, and he ate the loaves of the presentation, which is not lawful to eat, except for the priests—and he gave also to those being with him?”
2.bbe: How he went into the house of God when Abiathar was high priest, and took for food the holy bread, which only the priests may take, and gave it to those who were with him?

2.msb: Then Jesus declared, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
2.kjv: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
2.blb: And He said to them, “The Sabbath was made on account of the man, and not the man on account of the Sabbath.
2.bbe: And he said to them, The Sabbath was made for man, and not man for the Sabbath;

2.msb: Therefore, the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.”
2.kjv: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
2.blb: So then, the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.”
2.bbe: So that the Son of man is lord even of the Sabbath.

3.msb: Once again Jesus entered the synagogue, and a man with a withered hand was there.
3.kjv: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.
3.blb: And He entered into the synagogue again, and a man having a withered hand was there.
3.bbe: And he went again into the Synagogue; and there was a man there whose hand was dead.
3.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

3.msb: In order to accuse Jesus, they were watching to see if He would heal on the Sabbath.
3.kjv: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
3.blb: And they were watching Him, whether He will heal him on the Sabbaths, so that they might accuse Him.
3.bbe: And they were watching him to see if he would make him well on the Sabbath day, so that they might have something against him.

3.msb: Then Jesus said to the man with the withered hand, “Stand up among us.”
3.kjv: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.
3.blb: And He says to the man having the withered hand, “Arise into the midst.”
3.bbe: And he said to the man, Get up and come forward.

3.msb: And He asked them, “Which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?” But they were silent.
3.kjv: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
3.blb: And He says to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbaths to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill?” But they were silent.
3.bbe: And he said to them, Is it right to do good on the Sabbath or to do evil? to give life or to put to death? But they said nothing.

3.msb: Jesus looked around at them with anger and sorrow at their hardness of heart. Then He said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” So he stretched it out, and it was restored, as sound as the other.
3.kjv: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
3.blb: And having looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardness of their heart, He says to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” And he stretched it out, and his hand was restored.
3.bbe: And looking round on them he was angry, being sad because of their hard hearts; and he said to the man, Put out your hand. And he put it out, and his hand was made well.

3.msb: At this, the Pharisees went out and began plotting with the Herodians how they might kill Jesus.
3.kjv: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
3.blb: And the Pharisees, having gone out, immediately were taking counsel with the Herodians against Him, how they might destroy Him.
3.bbe: And the Pharisees went out, and straight away made designs with the Herodians about how they might put him to death.

3.msb: So Jesus withdrew with His disciples to the sea, accompanied by a large crowd from Galilee, Judea,
3.kjv: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judæa,
3.blb: And Jesus withdrew with His disciples to the sea, and a great multitude from Galilee followed, and from Judea,
3.bbe: And Jesus went away with his disciples to the sea, and a great number from Galilee came after him: and from Judaea,
3.heading: Jesus Heals the Multitudes

3.msb: Jerusalem, Idumea, the region beyond the Jordan, and the vicinity of Tyre and Sidon. The large crowd came to Him when they heard what great things He was doing.
3.kjv: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.
3.blb: and from Jerusalem, and from Idumea, and beyond the Jordan, and around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, having heard how much He was doing, came to Him.
3.bbe: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and the other side of Jordan, and the country about Tyre and Sidon, a great number, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

3.msb: Jesus asked His disciples to have a boat ready for Him so that the crowd would not crush Him.
3.kjv: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
3.blb: And He spoke to His disciples so that a boat may wait on Him because of the crowd, so that they might not press upon Him.
3.bbe: And he made a request to his disciples to have a little boat ready for him, so that he might not be crushed by the people;

3.msb: For He had healed so many that all who had diseases were pressing forward to touch Him.
3.kjv: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.
3.blb: For He healed many, so as for as many as had afflictions to fall upon Him so that they might touch Him.
3.bbe: For he had made such a great number well that all those who were diseased were falling down before him for the purpose of touching him.

3.msb: And when the unclean spirits saw Him, they fell down before Him and cried out, “You are the Son of God!”
3.kjv: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
3.blb: And the unclean spirits, when they were seeing Him, were falling down before Him and crying out, saying, “You are the Son of God!”
3.bbe: And the unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, went down before him, crying out, and saying, You are the Son of God.

3.msb: But He warned them sternly not to make Him known.
3.kjv: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.
3.blb: And He was warning them much that they should not make Him known.
3.bbe: And he gave them special orders not to say who he was.

3.msb: Then Jesus went up on the mountain and called for those He wanted, and they came to Him.
3.kjv: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.
3.blb: And He goes up onto the mountain, and He summons those whom He Himself was wanting, and they went away to Him.
3.bbe: And he went up into the mountain, and sent for those whom it was his pleasure to have with him: and they went to him.
3.heading: The Twelve Apostles

3.msb: He appointed twelve of them to accompany Him, to be sent out to preach,
3.kjv: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
3.blb: And He appointed twelve, whom also He named apostles, that they might be with Him and that He might send them to preach
3.bbe: And he took twelve to be with him, so that he might send them out as preachers,

3.msb: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to drive out demons:
3.kjv: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
3.blb: and to have authority to cast out demons.
3.bbe: And give them the power of driving out evil spirits:

3.msb: Simon (whom He named Peter),
3.kjv: And Simon he surnamed Peter;
3.blb: And He appointed the Twelve: And to Simon He added the name Peter,
3.bbe: To Simon he gave the second name of Peter;

3.msb: James son of Zebedee and his brother John (whom He named Boanerges, meaning “Sons of Thunder”),
3.kjv: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:
3.blb: and James the son of Zebedee and John the brother of James, and He added to them the name Boanerges, which is Sons of Thunder,
3.bbe: And to James, the son of Zebedee, and John, the brother of James, he gave the second name of Boanerges, which is, Sons of thunder:

3.msb: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot,
3.kjv: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,
3.blb: and Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Cananean,
3.bbe: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James, the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Zealot;

3.msb: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus.
3.kjv: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.
3.blb: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed Him.
3.bbe: And Judas Iscariot, who was false to him.

3.msb: Then they went into a house, and once again a crowd gathered, so that they could not even eat.
3.kjv: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
3.blb: And He comes to a house and a crowd comes together again, so that not even are they able to eat bread.
3.bbe: And he went into a house. And the people came together again, so that they were not even able to take bread.
3.heading: A House Divided

3.msb: When His family heard about this, they went out to take custody of Him, saying, “He is out of His mind.”
3.kjv: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
3.blb: And having heard, those belonging to Him went out to seize Him; for they were saying that He was out of His mind.
3.bbe: And when his friends had news of it, they went out to get him, saying, He is off his head.

3.msb: And the scribes who had come down from Jerusalem were saying, “He is possessed by Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons He drives out demons.”
3.kjv: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.
3.blb: And the scribes, those from Jerusalem, having come down, were saying, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the ruler of the demons He casts out the demons.”
3.bbe: And the scribes who came down from Jerusalem, said, He has Beelzebub, and, By the ruler of evil spirits he sends evil spirits out of men.

3.msb: So Jesus called them together and began to speak to them in parables: “How can Satan drive out Satan?
3.kjv: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
3.blb: And having summoned them, He was saying to them in parables, “How is Satan able to cast out Satan?
3.bbe: And turning to them, he said to them in the form of a story, How is it possible for Satan to put out Satan?

3.msb: If a kingdom is divided against itself, it cannot stand.
3.kjv: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
3.blb: And if a kingdom may be divided against itself, that kingdom is not able to stand.
3.bbe: If there is division in a kingdom, that kingdom will come to destruction;

3.msb: If a house is divided against itself, it cannot stand.
3.kjv: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
3.blb: And if a house may be divided against itself, that house will not be able to stand.
3.bbe: And if there is division in a house, that house will come to destruction;

3.msb: And if Satan is divided and rises against himself, he cannot stand; his end has come.
3.kjv: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
3.blb: And if Satan rose up against himself and was divided, he is not able to stand, but he has an end.
3.bbe: And if Satan is at war with himself, and there is division in him, he will not keep his place but will come to an end.

3.msb: No one can enter a strong man’s house to steal his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man. Then he can plunder his house.
3.kjv: No man can enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
3.blb: But no one is able, having entered into the house of the strong man, to plunder his goods, unless first he should bind the strong man. And then he will plunder his house.
3.bbe: But no one is able to go into the house of the strong man and take his goods, without first putting cords round the strong man, and then he will take his goods.

3.msb: Truly I tell you, the sons of men will be forgiven all sins and blasphemies, as many as they utter.
3.kjv: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:
3.blb: Truly I say to you that all sins and blasphemies will be forgiven the sons of men, as many as they may blaspheme.
3.bbe: Truly, I say to you, The sons of men will have forgiveness for all their sins and for all the evil words they say:
3.heading: The Unpardonable Sin

3.msb: But whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; he is subject to eternal judgment.”
3.kjv: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:
3.blb: But whoever may blaspheme in regard to the Holy Spirit does not have forgiveness to the age, but is guilty of eternal sin.”
3.bbe: But whoever says evil things against the Holy Spirit will never have forgiveness, but the evil he has done will be with him for ever:

3.msb: Jesus made this statement because they were saying, “He has an unclean spirit.”
3.kjv: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
3.blb: For they were saying, “He has an unclean spirit.”
3.bbe: Because they said, He has an unclean spirit.

3.msb: Then Jesus’ brothers and mother came and stood outside. They sent someone in to summon Him,
3.kjv: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.
3.blb: And His mother and His brothers come, and standing outside, they sent to Him, calling Him.
3.bbe: And his mother and brothers came and were outside, and sent for him, requesting to see him.
3.heading: Jesus’ Mother and Brothers

3.msb: and a crowd was sitting around Him. “Look,” He was told, “Your mother and brothers and sisters are outside, asking for You.”
3.kjv: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
3.blb: And a crowd was sitting around Him, and they say to Him, “Behold, Your mother and Your brothers outside seek You.”
3.bbe: And a great number were seated round him; and they said to him, See, your mother and your brothers are outside looking for you.

3.msb: But Jesus replied, “Who is My mother, or who are My brothers?”
3.kjv: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?
3.blb: And answering them, He says, “Who are My mother and My brothers?”
3.bbe: And he said in answer, Who are my mother and my brothers?

3.msb: Looking at those seated in a circle around Him, He said, “Here are My mother and My brothers!
3.kjv: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
3.blb: And having looked around at those sitting around Him in a circle, He says, “Behold, My mother and My brothers!
3.bbe: And looking round at those who were seated about him, he said, See, my mother and my brothers!

3.msb: For whoever does the will of God is My brother and sister and mother.”
3.kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
3.blb: For whoever shall do the will of God, this is My brother and sister and mother.”
3.bbe: Whoever does God's pleasure, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.

4.msb: Once again Jesus began to teach beside the sea, and such a large crowd gathered around Him that He got into the boat and sat in it, while all the people crowded along the shore.
4.kjv: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
4.blb: And again He began to teach beside the sea, and a very great crowd gathered together to Him, so that He, having entered into a boat, sat down in the sea, and all the crowd was close to the sea, on the land.
4.bbe: And again he was teaching by the seaside. And a very great number of people had come to him, so that he got into a boat on the sea and took his seat; and all the people were on the land by the seaside.
4.heading: The Parable of the Sower

4.msb: And He taught them many things in parables, and in His teaching He said,
4.kjv: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,
4.blb: And He was teaching them many things in parables, and He was saying to them in His teaching,
4.bbe: And he gave them teaching about a number of things in the form of stories, and said to them in his teaching, Give ear:

4.msb: “Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.
4.kjv: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:
4.blb: “Listen! Behold, the one sowing went out to sow.
4.bbe: A man went out to put seed in the earth:

4.msb: And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.
4.kjv: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.
4.blb: And it came to pass in the sowing that some indeed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.
4.bbe: And while he was doing it, some was dropped by the wayside, and the birds came and took it for food.

4.msb: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.
4.kjv: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:
4.blb: And other fell upon the rocky place, where it did not have much soil, and immediately it sprang up because of it not having depth of soil.
4.bbe: And some went on the stones, where it had not much earth; and it came up straight away, because the earth was not deep:

4.msb: But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
4.kjv: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
4.blb: And when the sun rose, it was scorched, and because of having no root, it withered.
4.bbe: And when the sun was high, it was burned; and because it had no root, it became dry and dead.

4.msb: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings, and they yielded no crop.
4.kjv: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
4.blb: And other fell among the thorns, and the thorns came up and choked it, and it gave no fruit.
4.bbe: And some went among the thorns, and the thorns came up, and it had no room for growth and gave no fruit.

4.msb: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it sprouted, grew up, and produced a crop—one bearing thirtyfold, another sixtyfold, and another a hundredfold.”
4.kjv: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.
4.blb: And others fell into the good soil, and it was giving fruit, coming up and increasing, and one bearing thirtyfold, and one sixty, and one a hundred.”
4.bbe: And some, falling on good earth, gave fruit, coming up and increasing, and giving thirty, sixty, and a hundred times as much.

4.msb: Then Jesus said, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
4.kjv: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
4.blb: And He was saying, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
4.bbe: And he said to them, Whoever has ears, let him give ear.

4.msb: As soon as Jesus was alone with the Twelve and those around Him, they asked Him about the parable.
4.kjv: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
4.blb: And when He was alone, those around Him with the Twelve were asking Him about the parables.
4.bbe: And when he was by himself, those who were round him with the twelve put questions to him about the purpose of the stories.
4.heading: The Purpose of Jesus’ Parables

4.msb: He replied, “To know the mystery of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to those on the outside everything is expressed in parables,
4.kjv: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:
4.blb: And He was saying to them, “To you has been given the mystery of the kingdom of God, but to those who are outside, everything is done in parables,
4.bbe: And he said to them, To you is given the secret of the kingdom of God, but to those who are outside, all things are given in the form of stories;

4.msb: so that, ‘they may be ever seeing but never perceiving, and ever hearing but never understanding; otherwise they might turn and be forgiven their sins.’”
4.kjv: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.
4.blb: so that: ‘Seeing they might see and not perceive, and hearing they might hear and not understand, lest ever they might return, and they might be forgiven.’””
4.bbe: So that seeing they may see, and it will not be clear to them; and hearing it, they will not get the sense; for fear that they may be turned again to me and have forgiveness.

4.msb: Then Jesus said to them, “Do you not understand this parable? Then how will you understand any of the parables?
4.kjv: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?
4.blb: And He says to them, “Do you not know this parable? And how will you know all the parables?
4.bbe: And he said to them, If you are not clear about this story, how will you be clear about the others?
4.heading: The Parable of the Sower Explained

4.msb: The farmer sows the word.
4.kjv: The sower soweth the word.
4.blb: The one sowing sows the word.
4.bbe: The seed is the word.

4.msb: Some are like the seeds along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in their hearts.
4.kjv: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.
4.blb: Now these are the ones along the path where the word is sown; and when they hear, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word sown in them.
4.bbe: And these are they by the wayside, where the word is planted; and when they have given ear, the Evil One comes straight away and takes away the word which has been planted in them.

4.msb: Some are like the seeds sown on rocky ground. They hear the word and at once receive it with joy.
4.kjv: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
4.blb: And these are likewise those sown upon the rocky places, who, when they hear the word, immediately receive it with joy.
4.bbe: And in the same way, these are they who are planted on the stones, who, when the word has come to their ears, straight away take it with joy;

4.msb: But they themselves have no root, and they remain for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.
4.kjv: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word’s sake, immediately they are offended.
4.blb: And they have no root in themselves, but are temporary. Then, on tribulation or persecution having come because of the word, immediately they are caused to stumble.
4.bbe: And they have no root in themselves, but go on for a time; then, when trouble comes or pain, because of the word, they quickly become full of doubts.

4.msb: Others are like the seeds sown among the thorns. They hear the word,
4.kjv: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
4.blb: And others are the ones sown among the thorns. These are the ones having heard the word,
4.bbe: And others are those planted among the thorns; these are they who have given ear to the word,

4.msb: but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth, and the desire for other things come in and choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
4.kjv: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
4.blb: and the anxieties of the age, and the deceit of riches, and the desires concerning the other things, entering, choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
4.bbe: And the cares of this life, and the deceits of wealth, and the desire for other things coming in, put a stop to the growth of the word, and it gives no fruit.

4.msb: Still others are like the seeds sown on good soil. They hear the word, receive it, and produce a crop—thirtyfold, sixtyfold, or a hundredfold.”
4.kjv: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
4.blb: And those are the ones having been sown upon the good soil, such as hear the word and receive it and bear fruit: one thirtyfold, and one sixty, and one a hundred.”
4.bbe: And these are they who were planted on the good earth; such as give ear to the word, and take it into their hearts, and give fruit, thirty and sixty and a hundred times as much.

4.msb: Jesus also said to them, “Does anyone bring in a lamp to put it under a basket or under a bed? Doesn’t he set it on a stand?
4.kjv: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
4.blb: And He was saying to them, “Does the lamp come so that it might be put under the basket or under the bed? Is it not so that it might be put upon the lampstand?
4.bbe: And he said to them, When the light comes in, do people put it under a vessel, or under the bed, and not on its table?
4.heading: The Lesson of the Lamp

4.msb: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be brought to light.
4.kjv: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
4.blb: For there is nothing that is hidden except so that it should be made manifest; nor was anything hidden away but so that it should come to be manifest.
4.bbe: There is nothing covered which will not be seen openly, and nothing has been made secret which will not come to light.

4.msb: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.”
4.kjv: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
4.blb: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.”
4.bbe: If any man has ears, let him give ear.

4.msb: He went on to say, “Pay attention to what you hear. With the measure you use, it will be measured to you, and even more will be added to you who hear.
4.kjv: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.
4.blb: And He was saying to them, “Look at what you hear. In what measure you measure, it will be measured to you, and it will be added to you.
4.bbe: And he said to them, Take care what you give ear to: in the same measure as you give you will get, and more will be given to you.

4.msb: For whoever has will be given more. But whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.”
4.kjv: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
4.blb: For whoever has, it will be given to him; and whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.”
4.bbe: He who has, to him will be given: and he who has not, from him will be taken even that which he has.

4.msb: Jesus also said, “The kingdom of God is like a man who scatters seed on the ground.
4.kjv: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
4.blb: And He was saying, “Thus is The kingdom of God: as a man may cast the seed upon the earth,
4.bbe: And he said, Such is the kingdom of God, as if a man put seed in the earth,
4.heading: The Seed Growing Secretly

4.msb: Night and day he sleeps and wakes, and the seed sprouts and grows, though he knows not how.
4.kjv: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.
4.blb: and may sleep and rise night and day, and the seed may sprout and grow—he does not know how.
4.bbe: And went to sleep and got up, night and day, and the seed came to growth, though he had no idea how.

4.msb: For all by itself the earth produces a crop—first the stalk, then the head, then grain that ripens within.
4.kjv: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
4.blb: Of itself, the earth bears fruit—first a plant, then an ear, then full grain in the ear.
4.bbe: The earth gives fruit by herself; first the leaf, then the head, then the full grain.

4.msb: And as soon as the grain is ripe, he swings the sickle, because the harvest has come.”
4.kjv: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
4.blb: And when the fruit may offer itself, immediately he sends the sickle, because the harvest has come.”
4.bbe: But when the grain is ready, he quickly sends men to get it cut, because the time for cutting has come.

4.msb: Then He asked, “To what can we compare the kingdom of God? With what parable shall we illustrate it?
4.kjv: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
4.blb: And He was saying, “To what shall we liken the kingdom of God? Or in what parable shall we put it?
4.bbe: And he said, What picture may we give of the kingdom of God, or with what story may we make it clear?
4.heading: The Parable of the Mustard Seed

4.msb: It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds sown upon the earth.
4.kjv: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
4.blb: It is like a grain of mustard, which, when it may be sown upon the earth, is smallest of all the seeds that are upon the earth.
4.bbe: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is put in the earth, is smaller than all the seeds on the earth,

4.msb: But after it is planted, it grows to be the largest of all garden plants and puts forth great branches, so that the birds of the air nest in its shade.”
4.kjv: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
4.blb: And when it may be sown, it comes up and becomes greater than all the garden plants and makes great branches, so that under its shadow the birds of the sky are able to lodge.”
4.bbe: But when it is planted, it comes up, and becomes taller than all the plants, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of heaven are able to take rest in its shade.

4.msb: With many such parables Jesus spoke the word to them, to the extent that they could understand.
4.kjv: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.
4.blb: And with many such parables He was speaking the word to them, as they were able to hear.
4.bbe: And with a number of such stories he gave them his teaching, as they were able to take it:

4.msb: He did not tell them anything without using a parable. But privately He explained everything to His own disciples.
4.kjv: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
4.blb: And without a parable He was not speaking to them; but in private to His own disciples He was explaining all things.
4.bbe: And without a story he said nothing to them: but privately to his disciples he made all things clear.

4.msb: When that evening came, He said to His disciples, “Let us cross to the other side.”
4.kjv: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.
4.blb: And on that day, evening having come, He says to them, “Let us pass over to the other side.”
4.bbe: And on that day, when the evening had come, he said to them, Let us go over to the other side.
4.heading: Jesus Calms the Storm

4.msb: After they had dismissed the crowd, they took Jesus with them, since He was already in the boat. And there were other little boats with Him.
4.kjv: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.
4.blb: And having dismissed the crowd, they take Him along just as He was, in the boat; and other boats were with Him.
4.bbe: And going away from the people, they took him with them, as he was, in the boat. And other boats were with him.

4.msb: Soon a violent windstorm came up, and the waves were breaking over the boat, so that it was being swamped.
4.kjv: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
4.blb: And there comes a great storm of wind, and the waves were breaking into the boat, so as already to be filling the boat.
4.bbe: And a great storm of wind came up, and the waves came into the boat, so that the boat was now becoming full.

4.msb: But Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on the cushion. So they woke Him and said, “Teacher, don’t You care that we are perishing?”
4.kjv: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
4.blb: And He was in the stern on the cushion, sleeping. And they awaken Him and say to Him, “Teacher, is it no concern to You that we are perishing?”
4.bbe: And he himself was in the back of the boat, sleeping on the cushion: and they, awaking him, said, Master, is it nothing to you that we are in danger of destruction?

4.msb: Then Jesus got up and rebuked the wind and the sea. “Silence!” He commanded. “Be still!” And the wind died down, and it was perfectly calm.
4.kjv: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
4.blb: And having been awoken, He rebuked the wind and said to the sea, “Silence! Be still!” And the wind abated, and there was a great calm.
4.bbe: And he came out of his sleep, and gave strong orders to the wind, and said to the sea, Peace, be at rest. And the wind went down, and there was a great calm.

4.msb: “Why are you so afraid?” He asked. “How do you still have no faith?”
4.kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?
4.blb: And He said to them, “Why are you cowardly? Have you still no faith?”
4.bbe: And he said to them, Why are you full of fear? have you still no faith?

4.msb: Overwhelmed with fear, they asked one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?”
4.kjv: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
4.blb: And they feared with great fear, and they were saying to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?”
4.bbe: And their fear was great, and they said one to another, Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea do his orders?

5.msb: On the other side of the sea, they arrived in the region of the Gadarenes.
5.kjv: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
5.blb: And they came to the other side of the sea, to the region of the Gerasenes.
5.bbe: And they came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gerasenes.
5.heading: The Demons and the Pigs

5.msb: As soon as Jesus got out of the boat, He was met by a man with an unclean spirit, who was coming from the tombs.
5.kjv: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
5.blb: And on His having gone out of the boat, immediately out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit met Him,
5.bbe: And when he had got out of the boat, straight away there came to him from the place of the dead a man with an unclean spirit.

5.msb: This man had been living in the tombs and could not be restrained, even with chains.
5.kjv: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
5.blb: who had his dwelling in the tombs. And no longer was anyone able to bind him, not even with a chain,
5.bbe: He was living in the place of the dead: and no man was able to keep him down, no, not with a chain;

5.msb: Though he was often bound with chains and shackles, he had broken the chains and shattered the shackles. Now there was no one with the strength to subdue him.
5.kjv: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.
5.blb: because he often had been bound with shackles and chains, and the chains had been torn in two by him, and the shackles had been shattered. And no one had strength to subdue him.
5.bbe: Because he had frequently been prisoned in chains and iron bands, and the chains had been parted and the bands broken by him: and no man was strong enough to make him quiet.

5.msb: Night and day in the mountains and in the tombs he kept crying out and cutting himself with stones.
5.kjv: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
5.blb: And constantly all night and day in the tombs and in the mountains he was crying out and cutting himself with stones.
5.bbe: And all the time, by day and by night, in the place of the dead, and in the mountains, he was crying out and cutting himself with stones.

5.msb: When the man saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees before Him.
5.kjv: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
5.blb: And having seen Jesus from afar, he ran and fell on his knees before Him.
5.bbe: And when he saw Jesus from far off, he went quickly to him and gave him worship;

5.msb: And he shouted in a loud voice, “What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You before God not to torture me!”
5.kjv: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.
5.blb: And having cried out in a loud voice, he says, “What is it to me and to You, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I adjure You by God, do not torment me!”
5.bbe: And crying out with a loud voice he said, What have I to do with you, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? In God's name, do not be cruel to me.

5.msb: For Jesus had already declared, “Come out of this man, you unclean spirit!”
5.kjv: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.
5.blb: For He was saying to him, “Come out of the man, unclean spirit!”
5.bbe: For Jesus had said to him, Come out of the man, you unclean spirit.

5.msb: “What is your name?” Jesus asked. “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”
5.kjv: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
5.blb: And He was asking him, “What is your name?” And he says to Him, “Legion is my name, because we are many.”
5.bbe: And Jesus said, What is your name? And he made answer, My name is Legion, because there are a great number of us.

5.msb: And he begged Jesus repeatedly not to send them out of that region.
5.kjv: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
5.blb: And he implored Him much that He might not send them out of the region.
5.bbe: And he made strong prayers to him not to send them away out of the country.

5.msb: There on the nearby hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding.
5.kjv: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
5.blb: Now there was near the mountain a great herd of pigs feeding.
5.bbe: Now on the mountain side there was a great herd of pigs getting their food.

5.msb: So all the demons begged Jesus, “Send us to the pigs, so that we may enter them.”
5.kjv: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
5.blb: And they implored Him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, so that we may enter into them.”
5.bbe: And they said to him, Send us into the pigs, so that we may go into them.

5.msb: So Jesus immediately gave them permission, and the unclean spirits came out and went into the pigs, and the herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned in the water.
5.kjv: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
5.blb: And He allowed them. And the unclean spirits, having gone out, entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea—about two thousand—and they were drowned in the sea.
5.bbe: And he let them do it. And the unclean spirits came out and went into the pigs; and the herd went rushing down a sharp slope into the sea, about two thousand of them; and they came to their death in the sea.

5.msb: Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.
5.kjv: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
5.blb: And those feeding them fled and reported it to the city and to the fields. And they went to see what it is that has happened.
5.bbe: And their keepers went running and gave an account of it in the town and in the country. And people came to see what had taken place.

5.msb: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons sitting there, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
5.kjv: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
5.blb: And they come to Jesus, and they see the man possessed by demons sitting, clothed and sound-minded—the one having had the legion—and they were afraid.
5.bbe: And they came to Jesus, and saw the man in whom had been the evil spirits seated, clothed and with full use of his senses, and they were full of fear.

5.msb: Those who had seen it described what had happened to the demon-possessed man and also to the pigs.
5.kjv: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
5.blb: And those having seen it related to them how it happened to the one possessed by demons, and about the pigs.
5.bbe: And those who had seen it gave them an account of what had been done to him who had the evil spirits, and of the fate of the pigs.

5.msb: And the people began to beg Jesus to leave their region.
5.kjv: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
5.blb: And they began to implore Him to go away from their borders.
5.bbe: And they made a request to him to go out of their country.

5.msb: As He was getting into the boat, the man who had been possessed by the demons begged to go with Him.
5.kjv: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
5.blb: And on His having entered into the boat, the one having been possessed by demons was imploring Him that he might be with Him.
5.bbe: And when he was getting into the boat, the man in whom had been the evil spirits had a great desire to come with him.

5.msb: But Jesus would not allow him. “Go home to your own people,” He said, “and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and what mercy He has shown you.”
5.kjv: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
5.blb: And He did not permit him, but He says to him, “Go to your house, to your own, and report to them how much the Lord has done for you, and how He had mercy on you.”
5.bbe: And he would not let him, but said to him, Go to your house, to your friends, and give them news of the great things the Lord has done for you, and how he had mercy on you.

5.msb: So the man went away and began to proclaim throughout the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And everyone was amazed.
5.kjv: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.
5.blb: And he went away and began to proclaim in the Decapolis how much Jesus did for him. And all were marveling.
5.bbe: And he went on his way, and made public in the country of Decapolis what great things Jesus had done for him: and all men were full of wonder.

5.msb: When Jesus had again crossed by boat to the other side, a large crowd gathered around Him beside the sea.
5.kjv: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
5.blb: And on Jesus having crossed over in the boat again to the other side, a great crowd was gathered to Him, and He was beside the sea.
5.bbe: And when Jesus had gone over again in the boat to the other side, a great number of people came to him: and he was by the sea.
5.heading: The Healing Touch of Jesus

5.msb: And behold, a synagogue leader named Jairus arrived, and seeing Jesus, he fell at His feet
5.kjv: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
5.blb: And one of the synagogue rulers comes, named Jairus, and having seen Him, he falls at His feet,
5.bbe: And one of the rulers of the Synagogue, Jairus by name, came, and seeing him, went down at his feet,

5.msb: and pleaded with Him urgently, “My little daughter is near death. Please come and place Your hands on her so that she will be healed, and she will live.”
5.kjv: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
5.blb: and he implores Him much, saying, “My little daughter is holding at the end, so that, having come, You might lay the hands on her, so that she might be saved, and she might live.”
5.bbe: And made strong prayers to him, saying, My little daughter is near to death: it is my prayer that you will come and put your hands on her, so that she may be made well, and have life.

5.msb: So Jesus went with him, and a large crowd followed and pressed around Him.
5.kjv: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
5.blb: And He went away with him. And a great crowd was following Him, and they were pressing in on Him.
5.bbe: And he went with him; and a great number of people went after him, and came round him.

5.msb: And a woman was there who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years.
5.kjv: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
5.blb: And a woman, being with a flow of blood twelve years,
5.bbe: And a woman, who had had a flow of blood for twelve years,

5.msb: She had borne much agony under the care of many physicians and had spent all she had, but to no avail. Instead, her condition had only grown worse.
5.kjv: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
5.blb: and having suffered much under many physicians, and having spent all of hers and having benefited in no way, but rather to the worse having come,
5.bbe: And had undergone much at the hands of a number of medical men, and had given all she had, and was no better, but even worse,

5.msb: When the woman heard about Jesus, she came up through the crowd behind Him and touched His cloak.
5.kjv: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
5.blb: having heard about Jesus, having come in the crowd behind, she touched His garment.
5.bbe: When she had news of the things which Jesus did, went among the people coming after him, and put her hand on his robe.

5.msb: For she kept saying, “If only I touch His garments, I will be healed.”
5.kjv: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
5.blb: For she was saying, “If I shall touch even His garments, I will be saved.”
5.bbe: For she said, If I may only put my hand on his robe, I will be made well.

5.msb: Immediately her bleeding stopped, and she sensed in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
5.kjv: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
5.blb: And immediately her flow of blood was dried up, and she knew in the body that she was healed from the affliction.
5.bbe: And straight away the fountain of her blood was stopped, and she had a feeling in her body that her disease had gone and she was well.

5.msb: At once Jesus was aware that power had gone out from Him. Turning to the crowd, He asked, “Who touched My garments?”
5.kjv: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
5.blb: And immediately Jesus, having known in Himself the power having gone out of Him, having turned in the crowd, said, “Who touched My garments?”
5.bbe: And straight away Jesus was conscious that power had gone out of him; and, turning to the people, he said, Who was touching my robe?

5.msb: His disciples answered, “You can see the crowd pressing in on You, and yet You ask, ‘Who touched Me?’”
5.kjv: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
5.blb: And His disciples were saying to Him, “You see the crowd pressing in on You, and You say, ‘Who touched Me?’”
5.bbe: And his disciples said to him, You see the people round you on every side, and you say, Who was touching me?

5.msb: But He kept looking around to see who had done this.
5.kjv: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
5.blb: And He was looking around to see the one having done this.
5.bbe: And on his looking round to see her who had done this thing,

5.msb: Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before Him trembling in fear, and she told Him the whole truth.
5.kjv: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
5.blb: And the woman, having been afraid and trembling, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before Him, and told Him all the truth.
5.bbe: The woman, shaking with fear, conscious of what had been done to her, came and, falling on her face before him, gave him a true account of everything.

5.msb: “Daughter,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be free of your affliction.”
5.kjv: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
5.blb: And He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has saved you; go in peace and be sound from your affliction.”
5.bbe: And he said to her, Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace, and be free from your disease.

5.msb: While He was still speaking, messengers from the house of Jairus arrived and said, “Your daughter is dead; why bother the Teacher anymore?”
5.kjv: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue’s house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
5.blb: In His still speaking, they come from the synagogue ruler, saying, “Your daughter died; why do you still trouble the Teacher?”
5.bbe: And while he was still talking, they came from the ruler of the Synagogue's house, saying, Your daughter is dead: why are you still troubling the Master?

5.msb: But Jesus overheard their conversation and immediately said to Jairus, “Do not be afraid; just believe.”
5.kjv: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
5.blb: But Jesus, having heard the word spoken, says to the synagogue ruler, “Do not fear; only believe.”
5.bbe: But Jesus, giving no attention to their words, said to the ruler of the Synagogue, Have no fear, only have faith.

5.msb: And He did not allow anyone to accompany Him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
5.kjv: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
5.blb: And He did not allow anyone to follow with Him except Peter and James and John the brother of James.
5.bbe: And he did not let anyone come with him, but Peter and James and John, the brother of James.

5.msb: When He arrived at the house of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw the commotion and the people weeping and wailing loudly.
5.kjv: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
5.blb: And they come to the house of the synagogue ruler, and He sees a commotion, and much weeping and wailing.
5.bbe: And they came to the house of the ruler of the Synagogue; and he saw people running this way and that, and weeping and crying loudly.

5.msb: He went inside and asked, “Why all this commotion and weeping? The child is not dead, but asleep.”
5.kjv: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
5.blb: And having entered, He says to them, “Why do you make a commotion and weep? The child did not die, but sleeps.”
5.bbe: And when he had gone in, he said to them, Why are you making such a noise and weeping? The child is not dead, but sleeping.

5.msb: And they laughed at Him. After He had put them all outside, He took the child’s father and mother and His own companions, and went in where the child was lying.
5.kjv: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.
5.blb: And they were laughing at Him. And He, having put all outside, takes along the father and the mother of the child, and those with Him, and He enters in where the child was.
5.bbe: And they were laughing at him. But he, having sent them all out, took the father of the child and her mother and those who were with him, and went in where the child was.

5.msb: Taking her by the hand, Jesus said, “Talitha koumi!” which means, “Little girl, I say to you, get up!”
5.kjv: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.
5.blb: And having taken the hand of the child, He says to her, “Talitha, koum!” which is translated, “Little girl, I say to you, arise!”
5.bbe: And taking her by the hand, he said to her, Talitha cumi, which is, My child, I say to you, Get up.

5.msb: Immediately the girl got up and began to walk around (she was twelve years old). And they were utterly astounded.
5.kjv: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
5.blb: And immediately the girl arose and began walking, for she was of twelve years. And immediately they were amazed with great amazement.
5.bbe: And the young girl got up straight away, and was walking about; she being twelve years old. And they were overcome with wonder.

5.msb: Then Jesus gave strict orders that no one should know about this, and He told them to give her something to eat.
5.kjv: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
5.blb: And He instructed them much that no one should know this; and He said to be given to her to eat.
5.bbe: And he gave them special orders that they were not to say anything of this; and he said that some food was to be given to her.

6.msb: Jesus went on from there and came to His hometown, accompanied by His disciples.
6.kjv: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
6.blb: And He went out from there and came to His hometown, and His disciples follow Him.
6.bbe: And he went away from there, and came into his country; and his disciples went with him.
6.heading: The Rejection at Nazareth

6.msb: When the Sabbath came, He began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard Him were astonished. “Where did this man get these ideas?” they asked. “What is this wisdom He has been given? And how can He perform such miracles?
6.kjv: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
6.blb: And on the Sabbath having come, He began to teach in the synagogue; and many hearing were astonished, saying, “From where to this man are these things, and what is the wisdom having been given to Him, and the miracles such as are done by His hands?
6.bbe: And when the Sabbath day had come, he was teaching in the Synagogue; and a number of people hearing him were surprised, saying, From where did this man get these things? and, What is the wisdom given to this man, and what are these works of power done by his hands?

6.msb: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and the brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? Aren’t His sisters here with us as well?” And they took offense at Him.
6.kjv: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
6.blb: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James and Joses and Judas and Simon? And are not His sisters here with us?” And they were taking offense at Him.
6.bbe: Is not this the woodworker, the son of Mary, and brother of James and Joses and Judas and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were bitter against him.

6.msb: Then Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown, among his relatives, and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”
6.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
6.blb: And Jesus was saying to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his hometown and among his relatives and in his house.”
6.bbe: And Jesus said to them, A prophet is nowhere without honour, but in his country, and among his relations, and in his family.

6.msb: So He could not perform any miracles there, except to lay His hands on a few of the sick and heal them.
6.kjv: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
6.blb: And He was not able to do there any miracle except, having laid the hands on a few of the sick, He healed them.
6.bbe: And he was unable to do any work of power there, but only to put his hands on one or two persons who were ill, and make them well.

6.msb: And He was amazed at their unbelief. And He went around from village to village, teaching the people.
6.kjv: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
6.blb: And He marveled because of their unbelief. And He was going around the villages, teaching.
6.bbe: And he was greatly surprised because they had no faith. And he went about the country places teaching.

6.msb: Then Jesus called the Twelve to Him and began to send them out two by two, giving them authority over unclean spirits.
6.kjv: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
6.blb: And He summons the Twelve, and He began to send them forth two by two, and He was giving to them authority over the unclean spirits.
6.bbe: And he gave orders to the twelve, and sent them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits;
6.heading: The Ministry of the Twelve

6.msb: He instructed them to take nothing but a staff for the journey—no bag, no bread, no money in their belts—
6.kjv: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
6.blb: And He instructed them that they may take nothing for the way, except only a staff—no bread, no bag, no copper in the belt—
6.bbe: And he said that they were to take nothing for their journey, but a stick only; no bread, no bag, no money in their pockets;

6.msb: and to wear sandals, but not a second tunic.
6.kjv: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
6.blb: but to wear sandals, and you may not put on two tunics.
6.bbe: They were to go with common shoes on their feet, and not to take two coats.

6.msb: And He told them, “When you enter a house, stay there until you leave that area.
6.kjv: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
6.blb: And He was saying to them, “Wherever you may enter into a house, remain there until you may go out from there.
6.bbe: And he said to them, Wherever you go into a house, make that your resting-place till you go away.

6.msb: If anyone will not welcome you or listen to you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that place, as a testimony against them. Truly I tell you, it will be more bearable for Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that town.”
6.kjv: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
6.blb: And whatever place may not receive you nor hear you, going out from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet, as a testimony against them.”
6.bbe: And whatever place will not take you in and will not give ear to you, when you go away, put off the dust from your feet as a witness against them.

6.msb: So they set out and preached that the people should repent.
6.kjv: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
6.blb: And having gone out, they preached that they should repent.
6.bbe: And they went out, preaching the need for a change of heart in men.

6.msb: They also drove out many demons and healed many of the sick, anointing them with oil.
6.kjv: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
6.blb: And they were casting out many demons, and they were anointing many sick with oil and healing them.
6.bbe: And they sent out a number of evil spirits, and put oil on a great number who were ill, and made them well.

6.msb: Now King Herod heard about this (for Jesus’ name had become well known) and he said, “John the Baptist has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”
6.kjv: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
6.blb: And King Herod heard; for His name became well known, And they were saying, “John, the one baptizing, has been raised out from the dead. And because of this, the miraculous powers are working in him.”
6.bbe: And king Herod had news of him, because his name was on the lips of all; and he said, John the Baptist has come back from the dead, and for this reason these powers are working in him.
6.heading: The Beheading of John

6.msb: Others were saying, “He is Elijah,” and still others, “He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of old.”
6.kjv: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
6.blb: But others were saying, “He is Elijah,” and others were saying, “A prophet, like one of the prophets.”
6.bbe: But others said, It is Elijah. And others said, It is a prophet, even like one of the prophets.

6.msb: But when Herod heard this, he said, “This is John, whom I beheaded; he has risen from the dead!”
6.kjv: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
6.blb: And having heard, Herod was saying, “John, whom I beheaded—this one was raised!”
6.bbe: But Herod, when he had news of it, said, John, whom I put to death, has come back from the dead.

6.msb: For Herod himself had ordered that John be arrested and bound and imprisoned, on account of his brother Philip’s wife Herodias, whom Herod had married.
6.kjv: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife: for he had married her.
6.blb: For Herod himself, having sent, seized John and bound him in prison because of Herodias, the wife of Philip his brother, because he married her.
6.bbe: For Herod himself had sent men out to take John and put him in prison, because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, whom he had taken for himself.

6.msb: For John had been telling Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife!”
6.kjv: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother’s wife.
6.blb: For John was saying to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have the wife of your brother.”
6.bbe: For John said to Herod, It is wrong for you to have your brother's wife.

6.msb: So Herodias held a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she had been unable,
6.kjv: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
6.blb: And Herodias was holding it against him and was wanting to kill him, and she was not able.
6.bbe: And Herodias was bitter against him, desiring to put him to death; but she was not able;

6.msb: because Herod feared John and protected him, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man. When he heard John’s words, he did much of what he said; and he listened to him gladly.
6.kjv: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
6.blb: For Herod was afraid of John, knowing him as a man righteous and holy, and he was keeping him safe. And having heard him, he was much perplexed and heard him gladly.
6.bbe: For Herod was in fear of John, being conscious that he was an upright and holy man, and kept him safe. And hearing him, he was much troubled; and he gave ear to him gladly.

6.msb: On Herod’s birthday, her opportunity arose. Herod held a banquet for his nobles and military commanders and the leading men of Galilee.
6.kjv: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
6.blb: And an opportune day having come, when Herod on his birthday made a banquet to his great men, and to the commanders, and to the first men of Galilee,
6.bbe: And the chance came when Herod on his birthday gave a feast to his lords, and the high captains, and the chief men of Galilee;

6.msb: When the daughter of Herodias came and danced, she pleased Herod and his guests, and the king said to the girl, “Ask me for whatever you wish, and I will give it to you.”
6.kjv: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
6.blb: and the daughter of Herodias herself, having entered and having danced, pleased Herod and those reclining with him. And the king said to the girl, “Ask me whatever you wish, and I will give it to you.”
6.bbe: And when the daughter of Herodias herself came in and did a dance, Herod and those who were at table with him were pleased with her; and the king said to the girl, Make a request for anything and I will give it you.

6.msb: And he swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half my kingdom!”
6.kjv: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
6.blb: And he swore to her much, “Whatever, you might ask me, I will give to you, up to half of my kingdom!”
6.bbe: And he took an oath, saying to her, Whatever is your desire I will give it to you, even half of my kingdom.

6.msb: Then she went out and asked her mother, “What should I request?” And her mother answered, “The head of John the Baptist.”
6.kjv: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
6.blb: And having gone out, she said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” And she said, “The head of John, the one baptizing.”
6.bbe: And she went out and said to her mother, What is my request to be? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.

6.msb: At once the girl hurried back to the king with her request: “I want you to give me the head of John the Baptist on a platter immediately.”
6.kjv: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
6.blb: And having entered immediately with haste to the king, she asked, saying, “I want that at once you might give to me upon a platter the head of John the Baptist.”
6.bbe: And she came in quickly to the king, and said, My desire is that you give me straight away on a plate the head of John the Baptist.

6.msb: The king was consumed with sorrow, but because of his oaths and his guests, he did not want to refuse her.
6.kjv: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath’s sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
6.blb: And the king, having been made very sorrowful because of the oaths and those reclining, did not want to set her aside.
6.bbe: And the king was very sad; but because of his oaths, and those who were with him at table, he would not say 'No' to her.
