10.msb: However, from the beginning of creation, ‘God made them male and female.’
10.kjv: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.
10.blb: but from the beginning of creation, ‘He made them male and female.’
10.bbe: But from the first, male and female made he them.

10.msb: ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife,
10.kjv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
10.blb: ‘On account of this a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife,
10.bbe: For this cause will a man go away from his father and mother, and be joined to his wife;

10.msb: and the two will become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two, but one flesh.
10.kjv: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
10.blb: and the two will be for one flesh,’ so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.
10.bbe: And the two will become one flesh; so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

10.msb: Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”
10.kjv: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
10.blb: Therefore what God has yoked together, let man not separate.”
10.bbe: Let not that which has been joined together by God be parted by man.

10.msb: When they were back inside the house, His disciples asked Jesus about this matter.
10.kjv: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.
10.blb: And in the house again, the disciples were questioning Him about this.
10.bbe: And in the house the disciples put questions to him again about this thing.

10.msb: So He told them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.
10.kjv: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.
10.blb: And He says to them, “Whoever shall send away his wife and shall marry another, he commits adultery against her.
10.bbe: And he said to them, Whoever puts away his wife and takes another, is false to his wife;

10.msb: And if a woman divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.”
10.kjv: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
10.blb: And if a woman, having divorced her husband, shall marry another, she commits adultery.”
10.bbe: And if she herself puts away her husband and takes another, she is false to her husband.

10.msb: Now people were bringing the little children to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them, and the disciples rebuked those who brought them.
10.kjv: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.
10.blb: And they were bringing little children to Him so that He might touch them, but the disciples rebuked them.
10.bbe: And they took to him little children, so that he might put his hands on them: and the disciples said sharp words to them.
10.heading: Jesus Blesses the Children

10.msb: But when Jesus saw this, He was indignant and told them, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
10.kjv: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
10.blb: And having seen, Jesus was indignant and said to them, “Permit the little children to come to Me; do not forbid them! For of such is the kingdom of God.
10.bbe: And when Jesus saw it, he was angry, and said to them, Let the little children come to me, and do not keep them away; for of such is the kingdom of God.

10.msb: Truly I tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”
10.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
10.blb: Truly I say to you, whoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall never enter into it.”
10.bbe: Truly I say to you, Whoever does not put himself under the kingdom of God like a little child, will not come into it at all.

10.msb: And He took the children in His arms, placed His hands on them, and blessed them.
10.kjv: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
10.blb: And having taken them in His arms, He was blessing them, having laid the hands on them.
10.bbe: And he took them in his arms, and gave them a blessing, putting his hands on them.

10.msb: As Jesus started on His way, a man ran up and knelt before Him. “Good Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
10.kjv: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
10.blb: And of Him going forth into the way, one having run up and having knelt down to Him was questioning Him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do so that I may inherit eternal life?”
10.bbe: And while he was going out into the way, a man came running to him, and went down on his knees, saying, Good Master, what have I to do so that I may have eternal life?
10.heading: The Rich Young Man

10.msb: “Why do you call Me good?” Jesus replied. “No one is good except God alone.
10.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.
10.blb: And Jesus said to him, “Why do you call Me good? No one is good except one—God.
10.bbe: And Jesus said to him, Why do you say I am good? no one is good but one, and that is God.

10.msb: You know the commandments: ‘Do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not bear false witness, do not cheat others, honor your father and mother.’”
10.kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.
10.blb: You know the commandments: ‘You shall not murder, you shall not commit adultery, you shall not steal, you shall not bear false witness, you shall not defraud, honor your father and mother.”
10.bbe: You have knowledge of what is said in the law, Do not put any one to death, Do not be untrue in married life, Do not take what is not yours, Do not give false witness, Do not get money by deceit, Give honour to your father and mother.

10.msb: “Teacher,” he replied, “all these I have kept from my youth.”
10.kjv: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.
10.blb: And he was saying to Him, “Teacher, all these I kept from my youth.”
10.bbe: And he said to him, Master, all these laws I have kept from the time when I was young.

10.msb: Jesus looked at him, loved him, and said to him, “There is one thing you lack: Go, sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, take up the cross, and follow Me.”
10.kjv: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
10.blb: And Jesus, having looked on him, loved him and said to him, “One thing to you is lacking: Go, sell as much as you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow Me.”
10.bbe: And Jesus, looking on him and loving him, said, There is one thing needed: go, get money for your goods, and give it to the poor, and you will have wealth in heaven: and come with me.

10.msb: But the man was saddened by these words and went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.
10.kjv: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.
10.blb: And having been sad at the word, he went away grieving; for he was one having many possessions.
10.bbe: But his face became sad at the saying, and he went away sorrowing: for he was one who had much property.

10.msb: Then Jesus looked around and said to His disciples, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!”
10.kjv: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
10.blb: And having looked around, Jesus says to His disciples, “How difficultly those having riches will enter into the kingdom of God!”
10.bbe: And Jesus, looking round about, said to his disciples, How hard it is for those who have wealth to come into the kingdom of God!

10.msb: And the disciples were amazed at His words. But Jesus said to them again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter the kingdom of God!
10.kjv: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
10.blb: And the disciples were astonished at His words. But Jesus, answering, says to them again, “Children, how difficult it is to enter into the kingdom of God!
10.bbe: And the disciples were full of wonder at his words. But Jesus said to them again, Children, how hard it is for those who put faith in wealth to come into the kingdom of God!

10.msb: It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
10.kjv: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
10.blb: It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of the needle than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.”
10.bbe: It is simpler for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a man of wealth to come into the kingdom of God.

10.msb: They were even more astonished and said to one another, “Who then can be saved?”
10.kjv: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?
10.blb: And they were exceedingly astonished, saying among themselves, “And who is able to be saved?”
10.bbe: And they were greatly surprised, saying to him, Who then may have salvation?

10.msb: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but not with God. For all things are possible with God.”
10.kjv: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
10.blb: Having looked on them, Jesus says, “With men it is impossible, but not with God; for all things are possible with God.”
10.bbe: Jesus, looking on them, said, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for all things are possible with God.

10.msb: Peter began to say to Him, “Look, we have left everything and followed You.”
10.kjv: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.
10.blb: Peter began to say to Him, “Behold, we left all and followed You.”
10.bbe: Peter said to him, See, we have given up everything, and come after you.

10.msb: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or wife or children or fields for My sake and for the gospel
10.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel’s,
10.blb: Jesus was saying, “Truly I say to you, there is no one who left house or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for My sake and for the sake of the gospel
10.bbe: Jesus said, Truly I say to you, There is no man who has given up house, or brothers, or sisters, or mother, or father, or children, or land, because of me and the good news,

10.msb: will fail to receive a hundredfold in the present age—houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and fields, along with persecutions—and in the age to come, eternal life.
10.kjv: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.
10.blb: who shall not receive a hundredfold now in this time—houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and fields, with persecutions—and in the age that is coming, eternal life.
10.bbe: Who will not get a hundred times as much now in this time, houses, and brothers, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and land — though with great troubles; and, in the world to come, eternal life.

10.msb: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.”
10.kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
10.blb: But many first will be last, and the last, first.”
10.bbe: But a great number who are first will be last: and those who are last will be first.

10.msb: As they were going up the road to Jerusalem, Jesus was walking ahead of them. The disciples were amazed, but as they followed, they were afraid. Again Jesus took the Twelve aside and began to tell them what was going to happen to Him:
10.kjv: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,
10.blb: And they were on the way, going up to Jerusalem, and Jesus was going on before them. And they were astonished, and those following were afraid. And having taken aside the Twelve again, He began to tell them the things being about to happen to Him:
10.bbe: And they were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going before them: and they were full of wonder; but those who came after him were in fear. And again he took the twelve, and gave them word of the things which were to come on him,
10.heading: The Third Prediction of the Passion

10.msb: “Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes. They will condemn Him to death and will deliver Him over to the Gentiles,
10.kjv: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:
10.blb: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be betrayed to the chief priests and to the scribes, and they will condemn Him to death and will betray Him to the Gentiles.
10.bbe: Saying, See, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man will be given up to the chief priests and the scribes; and they will give an order for his death, and will give him up to the Gentiles:

10.msb: who will mock Him and flog Him and spit on Him and kill Him. And on the third day He will rise again.”
10.kjv: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
10.blb: And they will mock Him and will spit upon Him and will flog Him and will kill Him, and after three days He will rise again.”
10.bbe: And they will make sport of him, and put shame on him, and give him cruel blows, and will put him to death; and after three days he will come back from the dead.

10.msb: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to Jesus and declared, “Teacher, we want You to do for us whatever we ask.”
10.kjv: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.
10.blb: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come to Him, saying to Him, “Teacher, we wish that You would do for us whatever we might ask You.”
10.bbe: And there came to him James and John, the sons of Zebedee, saying to him, Master, will you give us whatever may be our request?
10.heading: The Request of James and John

10.msb: “What do you want Me to do for you?” He inquired.
10.kjv: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
10.blb: And He said to them, “What do you want Me to do for you?”
10.bbe: And he said to them, What would you have me do for you?

10.msb: They answered, “Grant that one of us may sit at Your right hand and the other at Your left in Your glory.”
10.kjv: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.
10.blb: And they said to Him, “Give to us that one at Your right hand and one at Your left hand we might sit in Your glory.”
10.bbe: And they said to him, Let us be seated, one at your right hand and one at your left, in your glory.

10.msb: “You do not know what you are asking,” Jesus replied. “Can you drink the cup I will drink, and be baptized with the baptism I will undergo?”
10.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?
10.blb: And Jesus said to them, “You do not know what you ask. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, or to be baptized with the baptism with which I am baptized?”
10.bbe: But Jesus said to them, You have no knowledge of what you are saying. Are you able to take of my cup? or to undergo the baptism which I am to undergo?

10.msb: “We can,” the brothers answered. “You will indeed drink the cup that I drink,” Jesus said, “and you will be baptized with the baptism that I undergo.
10.kjv: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:
10.blb: And they said to Him, “We are able.” And Jesus said to them, “You will drink the cup that I drink, and you will be baptized with the baptism with which I am baptized.
10.bbe: And they said to him, We are able. And Jesus said to them, You will take of the cup from which I take; and the baptism which I am about to undergo you will undergo:

10.msb: But to sit at My right and left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom they have been prepared.”
10.kjv: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.
10.blb: But to sit at My right hand or at My left hand is not Mine to give, but it is to those for whom it has been prepared.”
10.bbe: But to be seated at my right hand or at my left is not for me to give: but it is for those for whom it has been made ready.

10.msb: When the ten heard about this, they became indignant with James and John.
10.kjv: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.
10.blb: And having heard, the ten began to be indignant about James and John.
10.bbe: And hearing this, the ten became very angry with James and John.

10.msb: So Jesus called them together and said, “You know that those regarded as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their superiors exercise authority over them.
10.kjv: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.
10.blb: And Jesus, having summoned them, says to them, “You know that those considered to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
10.bbe: And Jesus made them come to him, and said to them, You see that those who are made rulers over the Gentiles are lords over them, and their great ones have authority over them.

10.msb: But it shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
10.kjv: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:
10.blb: But it is not thus among you. But whoever may want to become great among you, he will be your servant;
10.bbe: But it is not so among you: but whoever has a desire to become great among you, let him be your servant:

10.msb: and whoever wants to be first must be the slave of all.
10.kjv: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
10.blb: and whoever may want to be first among you, he will be slave of all.
10.bbe: And whoever has a desire to be first among you, let him be servant of all.

10.msb: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”
10.kjv: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
10.blb: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”
10.bbe: For truly the Son of man did not come to have servants, but to be a servant, and to give his life for the salvation of men.

10.msb: Next, they came to Jericho. And as Jesus and His disciples were leaving Jericho with a large crowd, a blind man named Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, was sitting beside the road begging.
10.kjv: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimæus, the son of Timæus, sat by the highway side begging.
10.blb: And they come to Jericho. And in His going out from Jericho—and His disciples and a large crowd—the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting beside the road.
10.bbe: And they came to Jericho: and when he was going out of Jericho, with his disciples and a great number of people, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind man, was seated by the wayside, with his hand out for money.
10.heading: Jesus Heals Bartimaeus

10.msb: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”
10.kjv: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
10.blb: And having heard that it is Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out and to say, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”
10.bbe: And when it came to his ears that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he gave a cry, and said, Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me.

10.msb: Many people admonished him to be silent, but he cried out all the louder, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”
10.kjv: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
10.blb: And many were rebuking him that he should be silent. But much more he was crying out, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”
10.bbe: And some of them, turning in protest, gave him an order to be quiet: but he went on crying out all the more, Son of David, have mercy on me.

10.msb: Jesus stopped and asked for him to be called over. So they called the blind man. “Take courage!” they said. “Get up! He is calling for you.”
10.kjv: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
10.blb: And having stood, Jesus said, “Call him.” And they call the blind man, saying to him, “Take courage! Rise up! He calls you.”
10.bbe: And Jesus came to a stop and said, Let him come. And crying out to the blind man, they said to him, Be comforted: come, he has sent for you.

10.msb: Throwing off his cloak, Bartimaeus rose up and came to Jesus.
10.kjv: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
10.blb: And having cast away his cloak, having leaped up, he came to Jesus.
10.bbe: And he, putting off his coat, got up quickly, and came to Jesus.

10.msb: “What do you want Me to do for you?” Jesus asked. “Rabboni,” said the blind man, “let me see again.”
10.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.
10.blb: And answering him, Jesus says, “What do you desire that I may do for you?” And the blind man said to Him, “Rabboni, that I may receive sight.”
10.bbe: And Jesus said to him, What would you have me do to you? And the blind man said, Master, make me able to see.

10.msb: “Go,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you.” And immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road.
10.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
10.blb: “And” Jesus said to him, “Go, your faith has saved you.” And immediately he received his sight, and he was following Him on the road.
10.bbe: And Jesus said to him, Go on your way; your faith has made you well. And straight away he was able to see, and went after him in the way.

11.msb: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethsphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent out two of His disciples
11.kjv: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,
11.blb: And when they draw near to Jerusalem, to Bethphage and Bethany, toward the Mount of Olives, He sends two of His disciples,
11.bbe: And when they came near to Jerusalem, to Beth-phage and Bethany, at the Mountain of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
11.heading: The Triumphal Entry

11.msb: and said to them, “Go into the village ahead of you, and as soon as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has sat. Untie it and bring it here.
11.kjv: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.
11.blb: and He says to them, “Go into the village ahead of you, and immediately entering into it you will find a colt tied, on which no one of men yet sat. Having loosed it, also bring it.
11.bbe: And said to them, Go into the little town opposite: and when you come to it, you will see a young ass with a cord round his neck, on which no man has ever been seated; let him loose, and come back with him.

11.msb: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you doing this?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it,’ and he will send it here immediately.”
11.kjv: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.
11.blb: And if anyone should say to you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘Because the Lord has need of it, and immediately He sends it again here.’”
11.bbe: And if anyone says to you, Why are you doing this? say, The Lord has need of him and will send him back straight away.

11.msb: So they went and found a colt outside in the street, tied at a doorway. They untied it,
11.kjv: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.
11.blb: And they went away and found a colt tied at the door outside on the street, and they loose it.
11.bbe: And they went away and saw a young ass by the door outside in the open street; and they were getting him loose.

11.msb: and some who were standing there asked, “Why are you untying the colt?”
11.kjv: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
11.blb: And some of those standing there were saying to them, “What are you doing, loosing the colt?”
11.bbe: And some of those who were there said to them, What are you doing, taking the ass?

11.msb: The disciples answered as Jesus had commanded them, and the people gave them permission.
11.kjv: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.
11.blb: And they said to them just as Jesus said, and they allowed them.
11.bbe: And they said to them the words which Jesus had said; and they let them go.

11.msb: Then they led the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks over it, and He sat on it.
11.kjv: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
11.blb: And they bring the colt to Jesus, and they cast on it their garments, and He sat on it.
11.bbe: And they took the young ass to Jesus, and put their clothing on him, and he got on his back.

11.msb: Many in the crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
11.kjv: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
11.blb: And many spread their garments in the road, and others, branches having been cut from the fields.
11.bbe: And a great number put down their clothing in the way; and others put down branches which they had taken from the fields.

11.msb: The ones who went ahead and those who followed were shouting: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!”
11.kjv: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
11.blb: And those going before and those following were crying out: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is the One coming in the name of the Lord!”
11.bbe: And those who went in front, and those who came after, were crying, Glory: A blessing on him who comes in the name of the Lord:

11.msb: “Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord!” “Hosanna in the highest!”
11.kjv: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
11.blb: “Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!” “Hosanna in the highest!”
11.bbe: A blessing on the coming kingdom of our father David: Glory in the highest.

11.msb: Then Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple courts. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, He went out to Bethany with the Twelve.
11.kjv: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
11.blb: And He entered into Jerusalem, into the temple. And having looked around at all things, the hour being already late, He went out to Bethany with the Twelve.
11.bbe: And he went into Jerusalem into the Temple; and after looking round about on all things, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

11.msb: The next day, when they had left Bethany, Jesus was hungry.
11.kjv: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
11.blb: And on the next day, on their having gone out from Bethany, He was hungry.
11.bbe: And on the day after, when they had come out from Bethany, he was in need of food.
11.heading: Jesus Curses the Fig Tree

11.msb: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, He went to see if there was any fruit on it. But when He reached it, He found nothing on it except leaves, since it was not the season for figs.
11.kjv: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.
11.blb: And having seen a fig tree from afar having leaves, He went to see if perhaps He will find anything on it. And having gone to it, He found nothing except leaves, for it was not the season of figs.
11.bbe: And seeing a fig-tree in the distance with leaves, he went to see if by chance it had anything on it: and when he came to it, he saw nothing but leaves, for it was not the time for the fruit.

11.msb: Then Jesus said to the tree, “May no one ever eat of your fruit again.” And His disciples heard this statement.
11.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.
11.blb: And answering, He said to it, “No more to the age may anyone eat of your fruit.” And His disciples were hearing.
11.bbe: And he said to it, Let no man take fruit from you for ever. And his disciples took note of his words.

11.msb: When they arrived in Jerusalem, Jesus entered the temple courts and began to drive out those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves.
11.kjv: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
11.blb: And they come to Jerusalem. And having entered into the temple, He began to cast out those selling and those buying in the temple. And He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling the doves,
11.bbe: And they came to Jerusalem; and he went into the Temple, and sent out those who were trading there, overturning the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those who were offering doves for money;
11.heading: Jesus Cleanses the Temple

11.msb: And He would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple courts.
11.kjv: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
11.blb: and He was not permitting that anyone might carry a vessel through the temple.
11.bbe: And he would not let any man take a vessel through the Temple.

11.msb: Then Jesus began to teach them, and He declared, “Is it not written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”
11.kjv: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
11.blb: And He was teaching and was saying to them, “Has it not been written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”
11.bbe: And he gave them teaching, and said to them, Is it not in the Writings, My house is to be named a house of prayer for all the nations? but you have made it a hole of thieves.

11.msb: When the scribes and chief priests heard this, they looked for a way to kill Him. For they were afraid of Him, because the whole crowd was astonished at His teaching.
11.kjv: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
11.blb: And the chief priests and the scribes heard, and they were seeking how they might destroy Him. For they were afraid of Him, for all the crowd was astonished at His teaching.
11.bbe: And it came to the ears of the chief priests and scribes, and they took thought how they might put him to death; being in fear of him, because all the people were full of wonder at his teaching.

11.msb: And when evening came, Jesus went out of the city.
11.kjv: And when even was come, he went out of the city.
11.blb: And when evening came, they were going forth out of the city.
11.bbe: And every evening he went out of the town.

11.msb: As they were walking back in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered from its roots.
11.kjv: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
11.blb: And passing by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered from the roots.
11.bbe: And when they were going by in the morning, they saw the fig-tree dead from the roots.
11.heading: The Withered Fig Tree

11.msb: Peter remembered it and said, “Look, Rabbi! The fig tree You cursed has withered.”
11.kjv: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
11.blb: And having remembered, Peter says to Him, “Rabbi, look, the fig tree that You cursed has withered.”
11.bbe: And Peter, having a memory of it, said to him, Master, see, the tree which was cursed by you is dead.

11.msb: “Have faith in God,” Jesus said to them.
11.kjv: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.
11.blb: And answering, Jesus says to them, “Have faith from God.
11.bbe: And Jesus, answering, said to them, Have God's faith.

11.msb: “For truly I tell you that if anyone says to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ and has no doubt in his heart but believes that it will happen, whatever he says will be done for him.
11.kjv: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
11.blb: Truly I say to you that whoever shall say to this mountain, ‘Be taken away and be cast into the sea,’ and shall not doubt in his heart but shall believe that what he says happens, it will be done for him.
11.bbe: Truly I say to you, Whoever says to this mountain, Be taken up and be put into the sea; and has no doubt in his heart, but has faith that what he says will come about, he will have his desire.

11.msb: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
11.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
11.blb: Because of this, I say to you, all things—as many as you pray and ask—believe that you receive, and it will be unto you.
11.bbe: For this reason I say to you, Whatever you make a request for in prayer, have faith that it has been given to you, and you will have it.

11.msb: And when you stand to pray, if you hold anything against another, forgive it, so that your Father in heaven will forgive your trespasses as well.
11.kjv: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
11.blb: And when you stand praying, if you have anything against anyone, forgive, so that your Father who is in the heavens may also forgive you your trespasses.”
11.bbe: And whenever you make a prayer, let there be forgiveness in your hearts, if you have anything against anyone; so that you may have forgiveness for your sins from your Father who is in heaven.

11.msb: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your trespasses.”
11.kjv: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.

11.msb: After their return to Jerusalem, Jesus was walking in the temple courts, and the chief priests, scribes, and elders came up to Him.
11.kjv: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
11.blb: And they come again to Jerusalem, and in His walking in the temple, the chief priests and the scribes and the elders come to Him.
11.bbe: And they came again to Jerusalem: and while he was walking in the Temple, there came to him the chief priests and the scribes and those in authority:
11.heading: Jesus’ Authority Challenged

11.msb: “By what authority are You doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave You the authority to do them?”
11.kjv: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?
11.blb: And they were saying to Him, “By what authority do You do these things? Or who gave You this authority, that You should do these things?”
11.bbe: And they said to him, By what authority do you do these things? or who gave you authority to do these things?

11.msb: “I will also ask you one question,” Jesus replied, “and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
11.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
11.blb: And Jesus said to them, “I will question you one word, and you shall answer Me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
11.bbe: And Jesus said to them, I will put to you one question; give me an answer, and I will say by what authority I do these things.

11.msb: John’s baptism—was it from heaven or from men? Answer Me!”
11.kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.
11.blb: The baptism of John—was it from heaven or from men? Answer Me!”
11.bbe: The baptism of John, was it from heaven or from men? give me an answer.

11.msb: They deliberated among themselves: “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
11.kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?
11.blb: And they were reasoning with themselves, saying, “What should we say? If we should say, ‘From heaven,’ He will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
11.bbe: And they gave thought to it among themselves, saying, If we say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did you not have faith in him?

11.msb: But if we say, ‘From men’...” they were afraid of the people, for they all held that John truly was a prophet.
11.kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
11.blb: But should we say, ‘From men’...” they were afraid of the crowd, for all were holding that John truly was a prophet.
11.bbe: But if we say, From men — they were in fear of the people, because all took John to be truly a prophet.

11.msb: So they answered, “We do not know.” And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”
11.kjv: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
11.blb: And answering Jesus, they say, “We do not know.” And Jesus says to them, “Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
11.bbe: And they said in answer to Jesus, We have no idea. And Jesus said to them, And I will not say to you by what authority I do these things.

12.msb: Then Jesus began to speak to them in parables: “A man planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a wine vat, and built a watchtower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.
12.kjv: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
12.blb: And He began to speak to them in parables: “A man planted a vineyard, and he placed around it a fence and dug a wine vat and built a tower, and he rented it out to farmers and traveled abroad.
12.bbe: And he gave them teaching in the form of stories. A man had a vine-garden planted, and put a wall about it, and made a place for crushing out the wine, and put up a tower, and let it out to field-workers, and went into another country.
12.heading: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants

12.msb: At harvest time, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
12.kjv: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
12.blb: And he sent a servant to the farmers in the season, so that he might receive from the farmers from the fruit of the vineyard.
12.bbe: And when the time came, he sent a servant to get from the workmen some of the fruit of the garden.

12.msb: But they seized the servant, beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.
12.kjv: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
12.blb: And having taken him, they beat him and sent him away empty.
12.bbe: And they took him, and gave him blows, and sent him away with nothing.

12.msb: Then he sent them another servant, and casting stones they struck him over the head and sent him away, treating him shamefully.
12.kjv: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
12.blb: And again he sent to them another servant, and that one they struck on the head and dishonored him.
12.bbe: And again he sent to them another servant; and they gave him wounds on the head, and were very cruel to him.

12.msb: He sent still another, and this one they killed. He sent many others; some they beat and others they killed.
12.kjv: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
12.blb: And he sent another, and that one they killed—and many others—indeed beating some and killing some.
12.bbe: And he sent another; and they put him to death: and a number of others, whipping some, and putting some to death.

12.msb: Finally, having his one beloved son, he sent him to them last. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
12.kjv: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
12.blb: Yet having one beloved son, he sent him to them last, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
12.bbe: He still had one, a dearly loved son: he sent him last to them, saying, They will have respect for my son.

12.msb: But the tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
12.kjv: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
12.blb: But those farmers said to themselves, ‘This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
12.bbe: But those workmen said among themselves, This is he who will one day be the owner of the property; come, let us put him to death, and the heritage will be ours.

12.msb: So they seized the son, killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.
12.kjv: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
12.blb: And having taken him, they killed him and cast him out of the vineyard.
12.bbe: And they took him and put him to death, pushing his body out of the garden.

12.msb: What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants, and will give the vineyard to others.
12.kjv: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
12.blb: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and will destroy the farmers, and he will give the vineyard to others.
12.bbe: What then will the master of the garden do? He will come and put the workmen to death, and will give the garden into the hands of others.

12.msb: Have you never read this Scripture: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
12.kjv: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
12.blb: Did you not even read this Scripture: ‘The stone that those building rejected, this became the head of the corner;
12.bbe: Have you not seen this which is in the Writings: The stone which the builders put on one side, the same was made the chief stone of the building:

12.msb: This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?”
12.kjv: This was the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
12.blb: this was from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?”
12.bbe: This was the Lord's doing, and it is a wonder in our eyes?

12.msb: At this, the leaders sought to arrest Jesus, for they knew that He had spoken this parable against them. But fearing the crowd, they left Him and went away.
12.kjv: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
12.blb: And they were seeking to lay hold of Him, and they feared the crowd; for they knew that He spoke the parable against them. And having left Him, they went away.
12.bbe: And they made attempts to take him; but they were in fear of the people, because they saw that the story was against them; and they went away from him.

12.msb: Later, they sent some of the Pharisees and Herodians to catch Jesus in His words.
12.kjv: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
12.blb: And they send to Him some of the Pharisees and Herodians, so that they might catch Him in a word.
12.bbe: Then they sent to him certain of the Pharisees and the Herodians, so that they might make use of his words to take him by a trick.
12.heading: Paying Taxes to Caesar

12.msb: “Teacher,” they said, “we know that You are honest and seek favor from no one. Indeed, You are impartial and teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not? Should we pay them or not?”
12.kjv: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Cæsar, or not?
12.blb: And having come, they say to Him, “Teacher, we know that You are true, and to You there is no care about anyone; for You do not look to the appearance of men, but You teach the way of God on the basis of truth. Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar or not? Should we pay or not pay?”
12.bbe: And when they had come, they said to him, Master, we are certain that you are true, and have no fear of anyone: you have no respect for a man's position, but you are teaching the true way of God: Is it right to give taxes to Caesar or not?

12.msb: But Jesus saw through their hypocrisy and said, “Why are you testing Me? Bring Me a denarius to inspect.”
12.kjv: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.
12.blb: But knowing their hypocrisy, He said to them, “Why do you test Me? Bring Me a denarius, so that I might see it.”
12.bbe: Are we to give or not to give? But he, conscious of their false hearts, said to them, Why do you put me to the test? give me a penny, so that I may see it.

12.msb: So they brought it, and He asked them, “Whose image is this? And whose inscription?” “Caesar’s,” they answered.
12.kjv: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Cæsar’s.
12.blb: And they brought it. And He says to them, “Whose image is this—and the inscription?” And they said to Him, “Caesar’s.”
12.bbe: And they gave him one. And he said to them, Whose is this image and name on it? And they said to him, Caesar's.

12.msb: In response Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.” And they marveled at Him.
12.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Cæsar the things that are Cæsar’s, and to God the things that are God’s. And they marvelled at him.
12.blb: And Jesus said to them, “Give back the things of Caesar to Caesar, and the things of God to God.” And they were marveling at Him.
12.bbe: And Jesus said to them, Give to Caesar the things which are Caesar's, and to God the things which are God's. And they were full of wonder at him.

12.msb: Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him:
12.kjv: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
12.blb: And some Sadducees, who say there is not a resurrection, come to Him. And they were questioning Him, saying,
12.bbe: And there came to him Sadducees, who say there is no coming back from the dead; and they put a question to him, saying,
12.heading: The Sadducees and the Resurrection

12.msb: “Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother’s widow and raise up offspring for him.
12.kjv: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man’s brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
12.blb: “Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if anyone’s brother should die and leave behind a wife and not leave a child, that his brother should take the wife and should raise up seed for his brother.
12.bbe: Master, in the law Moses says, If a man's brother comes to his end, and has a wife still living and no child, it is right for his brother to take his wife, and get a family for his brother.

12.msb: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married and died, leaving no children.
12.kjv: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
12.blb: There were seven brothers; and the first took a wife, and dying, left no seed.
12.bbe: There were seven brothers: and the first took a wife, and at his death there were no offspring;

12.msb: Then the second one married the widow, but he also died and left no children. And the third did likewise.
12.kjv: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
12.blb: And the second took her and died, not having left behind seed; and the third likewise.
12.bbe: And the second took her, and at his death there were no offspring; and the third the same:

12.msb: In this way, none of the seven who had her left any children. And last of all, the woman died.
12.kjv: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
12.blb: And the seven left no seed. Last of all, the woman also died.
12.bbe: And all the seven had no seed. Last of all the woman herself came to her death.

12.msb: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”
12.kjv: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
12.blb: In the resurrection, when they rise, of which of them will she be wife? For the seven had her as wife.”
12.bbe: In the future life, when they come back from the dead, whose wife will she be? for the seven had her for a wife.

12.msb: Jesus answered them, “Aren’t you mistaken, because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?
12.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
12.blb: Jesus was saying to them, “Do you not go astray because of this, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God?
12.bbe: Jesus said to them, Is not this the reason for your error, that you have no knowledge of the holy Writings or of the power of God?

12.msb: When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
12.kjv: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
12.blb: For when they rise out from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage; but they are like angels in the heavens.
12.bbe: When they come back from the dead, they do not get married, but are like the angels in heaven.

12.msb: But concerning the dead rising, have you not read about the burning bush in the Book of Moses, how God told him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
12.kjv: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
12.blb: But concerning the dead, that they rise, did you not read in the book of Moses, at the bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob’?
12.bbe: But as to the dead coming back to life; have you not seen in the book of Moses, about the burning thorn-tree, how God said to him, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

12.msb: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living. Therefore you are badly mistaken!”
12.kjv: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
12.blb: He is not God of the dead, but of the living. You go astray greatly!”
12.bbe: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living: you are greatly in error.

12.msb: Now one of the scribes had come up and heard their debate. Noticing how well Jesus had answered them, he asked Him, “Which commandment is the most important of all?”
12.kjv: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
12.blb: And one of the scribes having come, having heard them reasoning together, having seen that He answered them well, questioned Him, “Which commandment is first of all?”
12.bbe: And one of the scribes came, and hearing their argument together, and seeing that he had given them a good answer, put the question to him, Which law is the first of all?
12.heading: The Greatest Commandment

12.msb: Jesus replied, “This is the most important of all the commandments: ‘Hear, O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is One.
12.kjv: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
12.blb: Jesus answered, “The first is, ‘Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is One.
12.bbe: Jesus said in answer, The first is, Give ear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord;

12.msb: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.
12.kjv: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
12.blb: And you shall love the Lord your God out of all your heart and out of all your soul and out of all your mind and out of all your strength.’
12.bbe: And you are to have love for the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.

12.msb: The second, like it, is this: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ No other commandment is greater than these.”
12.kjv: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
12.blb: The second is this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is not another commandment greater than these.”
12.bbe: The second is this, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself. There is no other law greater than these.

12.msb: “Right, Teacher,” the scribe replied. “You have stated correctly that God is One and there is no other but Him,
12.kjv: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
12.blb: And the scribe said to Him, “Right, Teacher; You have spoken according to truth that He is One and that there is not another besides Him,
12.bbe: And the scribe said to him, Truly, Master, you have well said that he is one, and there is no other but he:

12.msb: and to love Him with all your heart and with all your understanding and with all your soul and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself. This is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
12.kjv: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
12.blb: and to love Him out of all the heart and out of all the understanding and out of all the strength, and to love the neighbor as oneself is more than all the burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
12.bbe: And to have love for him with all the heart, and with all the mind, and with all the strength, and to have the same love for his neighbour as for himself, is much more than all forms of offerings.

12.msb: When Jesus saw that the man had answered wisely, He said, “You are not far from the kingdom of God.” And no one dared to question Him any further.
12.kjv: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
12.blb: And Jesus, having seen him that he answered wisely, said to him, “You are not far from the kingdom of God.” And no one dared to question Him any longer.
12.bbe: And when Jesus saw that he gave a wise answer, he said to him, You are not far from the kingdom of God. And every man after that was in fear of questioning him any more.

12.msb: While Jesus was teaching in the temple courts, He asked, “How can the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?
12.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?
12.blb: And answering, Jesus was saying, teaching in the temple, “How do the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?
12.bbe: And Jesus, when he was teaching in the Temple, said, How do the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?
12.heading: Whose Son Is the Christ?

12.msb: Speaking by the Holy Spirit, David himself declared: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’
12.kjv: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
12.blb: David himself said in the Holy Spirit: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I place Your enemies as a footstool for Your feet.”’
12.bbe: David himself said in the Holy Spirit, The Lord said to my Lord, Be seated at my right hand, till I put those who are against you under your feet.

12.msb: Therefore David himself calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?” And the large crowd listened to Him with delight.
12.kjv: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
12.blb: David himself calls Him ‘Lord.’ And from where is He his son?” And the great crowd was listening to Him gladly.
12.bbe: David himself gives him the name of Lord; and how then is he his son? And the common people gave ear to him gladly.

12.msb: In His teaching Jesus also said to them, “Watch out for the scribes. They like to walk around in long robes, to receive greetings in the marketplaces,
12.kjv: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
12.blb: And in His teaching He was saying, “Beware of the scribes, who are wanting to walk about in long robes and greetings in the marketplaces,
12.bbe: And in his teaching he said, Be on your watch against the scribes, whose pleasure it is to go about in long robes and be respected in the market-places,
12.heading: Beware of the Scribes

12.msb: and to have the chief seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.
12.kjv: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
12.blb: and first seats in the synagogues, and first places at the suppers—
12.bbe: And to have the chief seats in the Synagogues and the first places at feasts;

12.msb: They defraud widows of their houses, and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will receive greater condemnation.”
12.kjv: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
12.blb: those devouring the houses of widows and praying long as a pretext. These will receive more abundant judgment.”
12.bbe: Who take away the property of widows, and before the eyes of men make long prayers; these will be judged more hardly.

12.msb: As Jesus was sitting opposite the treasury, He watched the crowd putting money into it. And many rich people put in large amounts.
12.kjv: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
12.blb: And having sat down opposite the treasury, He was watching how the crowd casts money into the treasury; and many rich ones were casting in much.
12.bbe: And he took a seat by the place where the money was kept, and saw how the people put money into the boxes: and a number who had wealth put in much.
12.heading: The Widow’s Offering

12.msb: Then one poor widow came and put in two small copper coins, which amounted to a small fraction of a denarius.
12.kjv: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
12.blb: And having come, one poor widow cast in two lepta, which is a kodrantes.
12.bbe: And there came a poor widow, and she put in two little bits of money, which make a farthing.

12.msb: Jesus called His disciples to Him and said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put more than all the others into the treasury.
12.kjv: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
12.blb: And having summoned His disciples, He said to them, “Truly I say to you that this poor widow cast in more than all of those casting into the treasury.
12.bbe: And he made his disciples come to him, and said to them, Truly I say to you, This poor widow has put in more than all those who are putting money into the box:

12.msb: For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.”
12.kjv: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
12.blb: For all cast in out of that which is abounding to them, but she out of her poverty cast in all, as much as she had—her whole livelihood.”
12.bbe: Because they all put in something out of what they had no need for; but she out of her need put in all she had, even all her living.

13.msb: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of His disciples said to Him, “Teacher, look at the magnificent stones and buildings!”
13.kjv: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!
13.blb: And on His going forth out of the temple, one of His disciples says to Him, “Teacher, behold what stones and what buildings!”
13.bbe: And when he was going out of the Temple, one of his disciples said to him, Master, see, what stones and what buildings!
13.heading: Temple Destruction and Other Signs

13.msb: “Do you see all these great buildings?” Jesus replied. “Not one stone will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
13.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
13.blb: And Jesus said to him,” “Do you see these great buildings? Not one stone here shall be left upon a stone that shall not be thrown down.”
13.bbe: And Jesus said to him, Do you see these great buildings? there is not one stone here resting on another which will not be overturned.

13.msb: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked Him privately,
13.kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
13.blb: And in His sitting at the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew were questioning Him by Himself,
13.bbe: And while he was seated on the Mountain of Olives opposite the Temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew said to him privately,

13.msb: “Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to be fulfilled?”
13.kjv: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
13.blb: “Tell us when these things will be, and what is the sign when all these things are about to be accomplished?”
13.bbe: Say when these things will be, and what will be the sign when these things are all about to be done.

13.msb: In response, Jesus began by telling them, “See to it that no one deceives you.
13.kjv: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
13.blb: And Jesus began to say to them, “Take heed, lest anyone may lead you astray.
13.bbe: And Jesus said to them, Take care that you are not tricked by anyone.

13.msb: For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and will deceive many.
13.kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
13.blb: Many will come in My name, saying, ‘I am He,’ and they will lead many astray.
13.bbe: People will come in my name, saying, I am he; and a number will be turned from the true way.

13.msb: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. For these things must happen, but the end is still to come.
13.kjv: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
13.blb: And when you shall hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. It is necessary to happen, but the end is not yet.
13.bbe: And when you have news of wars and talk of wars, do not be troubled; these things have to be, but it is still not the end.

13.msb: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, as well as famines and riots. These are the beginning of birth pains.
13.kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.
13.blb: For nation will rise up against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places; there will be famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.
13.bbe: Nation will go to war with nation, and kingdom with kingdom: there will be earth-shocks in different places; there will be times when there is no food; these things are the first of the troubles.

13.msb: So be on your guard. For you will be delivered over to the councils and beaten in the synagogues. On My account you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.
13.kjv: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
13.blb: But you, take heed to yourselves. They will deliver you up to courts, and you will be beaten in synagogues, and you will stand before governors and kings on account of Me, for a testimony to them.
13.bbe: But take care: for they will give you up to the Sanhedrins; and in Synagogues you will be whipped; and you will be taken before rulers and kings because of me, for a sign to them.
13.heading: Witnessing to All Nations

13.msb: And the gospel must first be proclaimed to all the nations.
13.kjv: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
13.blb: And to all the nations first it is necessary for the gospel to be proclaimed.
13.bbe: And the good news has first to be given to all the nations.

13.msb: But when they arrest you and hand you over, do not worry beforehand or premeditate what to say. Instead, speak whatever you are given at that time, for it will not be you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
13.kjv: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
13.blb: But when they might lead you away, delivering you up, do not be anxious beforehand what you shall speak; but whatever might be given to you in that hour, speak that. For you are not the ones speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
13.bbe: And when you are taken and given up to be judged, do not be troubled about what to say: but whatever is given to you in that hour, say: because it is not you who say it, but the Holy Spirit.

13.msb: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
13.kjv: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
13.blb: And brother will deliver up brother to death, and father, child; and children will rise up against parents and will put them to death.
13.bbe: And brother will give up brother to death, and the father his child; and children will go against their fathers and mothers, and put them to death.

13.msb: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
13.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
13.blb: And you will be hated by all because of My name; but the one having endured to the end, he will be saved.
13.bbe: And you will be hated by all men, because of my name; but he who goes through to the end will have salvation.

13.msb: So when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it should not be (let the reader understand), then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
13.kjv: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judæa flee to the mountains:
13.blb: But when you shall see the ‘abomination of the desolation’ standing where it should not (the one reading, let him understand), then those in Judea, let them flee to the mountains;
13.bbe: But when you see the unclean thing which makes destruction, in the place where it has no right to be (let this be clear to the reader), then let those who are in Judaea go quickly to the mountains:
13.heading: The Abomination of Desolation

13.msb: Let no one on the housetop go back inside the house to retrieve anything from his house.
13.kjv: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:
13.blb: and the one upon the housetop, let him not come down nor go in to take up anything out of his house;
13.bbe: And let him who is on the house-top not go down, or go in, to take anything out of his house:

13.msb: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.
13.kjv: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
13.blb: and the one in the field, let him not return to the things behind to take away his garment.
13.bbe: And let not him who is in the field go back to take his coat.

13.msb: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
13.kjv: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
13.blb: And woe to those having in womb and to those nursing in those days!
13.bbe: And it will be hard for women who are with child and for her who has a baby at the breast in those days.

13.msb: Pray that your flight will not occur in the winter.
13.kjv: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
13.blb: And pray that it might not be in winter,
13.bbe: And say a prayer that it may not be in the winter.

13.msb: For those will be days of tribulation unmatched from the beginning of God’s creation until now, and never to be seen again.
13.kjv: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.
13.blb: for those days will be tribulation such as has not been from the beginning of creation that God created until now, and never shall be.
13.bbe: For in those days there will be sorrow, such as there has not been from the time when God made the world till now, and will not ever be again.

13.msb: If the Lord had not cut short those days, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, whom He has chosen, He has cut them short.
13.kjv: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect’s sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
13.blb: And if the Lord did not shorten the days, not any flesh would have been saved; but because of the chosen whom He chose, He shortened the days.
13.bbe: And if the Lord had not made the time short, no flesh would have been kept from destruction; but because of the saints he has made the time short.

13.msb: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
13.kjv: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
13.blb: And then if anyone shall say to you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or ‘Behold, there!’ do not believe it.
13.bbe: And then if any man says to you, See, here is Christ; or, See, there; have no faith in it:

13.msb: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders that would deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
13.kjv: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
13.blb: For false Christs and false prophets will arise and will give signs and wonders in order to lead astray, if possible, the chosen.
13.bbe: Because there will be false Christs and false prophets, and they will give signs and wonders in the hope of turning even the saints from the true way.

13.msb: So be on your guard; see, I have told you everything in advance.
13.kjv: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
13.blb: But you take heed; I have forewarned you of all things.
13.bbe: But take care; see, I have made all things clear to you before the time.

13.msb: But in those days, after that tribulation: ‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;
13.kjv: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
13.blb: But in those days, after that tribulation: ‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give her light;
13.bbe: But in those days, after that time of trouble, the sun will be made dark and the moon will not give her light,
13.heading: The Return of the Son of Man

13.msb: the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’
13.kjv: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
13.blb: and the stars will be falling out of the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.’
13.bbe: And the stars will be falling from heaven, and the powers which are in the heavens will be moved.

13.msb: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
13.kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
13.blb: And then they will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
13.bbe: And then they will see the Son of man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

13.msb: And He will send out His angels to gather His elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven.
13.kjv: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
13.blb: And then He will send the angels, and He will gather together His chosen from the four winds, from the end of earth to the end of heaven.
13.bbe: And then he will send out the angels, and will get together his saints from the four winds, from the farthest part of the earth to the farthest part of heaven.

13.msb: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
13.kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
13.blb: And from the fig tree, learn the parable: When its branch already shall have become tender, and it puts forth leaves, you know that summer is near.
13.bbe: Take an example from the fig-tree: when its branches become soft and put out their leaves, you see that the summer is near;
13.heading: The Lesson of the Fig Tree

13.msb: So also, when you see these things happening, know that He is near, right at the door.
13.kjv: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
13.blb: So also you, when you see these things coming to pass, know that He is near, at the doors.
