1.bbe: And he will go before his face in the spirit and power of Elijah, turning the hearts of fathers to their children, and wrongdoers to the way of righteousness; to make ready a people whose hearts have been turned to the Lord.

1.msb: “How can I be sure of this?” Zechariah asked the angel. “I am an old man, and my wife is well along in years.”
1.kjv: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
1.blb: And Zechariah said to the angel, “By what will I know this? For I am an old man, and my wife is advanced in her days.”
1.bbe: And Zacharias said to the angel, How may I be certain of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is far on in years.

1.msb: “I am Gabriel,” replied the angel. “I stand in the presence of God, and I have been sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
1.kjv: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
1.blb: And answering, the angel said to him, “I am Gabriel, the one standing before God, and I was sent to speak to you and to bring these good tidings to you.
1.bbe: And the angel, answering, said, I am Gabriel, whose place is before God; I have been sent to say these words to you and to give you this good news.

1.msb: And now you will be silent and unable to speak until the day this comes to pass, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled at their proper time.”
1.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
1.blb: And behold, you will be silent and not able to speak until that day these things shall take place, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their season.”
1.bbe: Now, see, you will be without voice or language till the day when these things come about, because you had not faith in my words, which will have effect at the right time.

1.msb: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he took so long in the temple.
1.kjv: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
1.blb: And the people were expecting Zechariah, and they were marveling at his delaying in the temple.
1.bbe: And the people were waiting for Zacharias and were surprised because he was in the Temple for such a long time.

1.msb: When he came out and was unable to speak to them, they realized he had seen a vision in the temple. He kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak.
1.kjv: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
1.blb: But having come out, he was not able to speak to them, and they recognized that he had seen a vision in the temple. And he was making signs to them and remained mute.
1.bbe: And when he came out he was not able to say anything, and they saw that he had seen a vision in the Temple; and he was making signs to them without words.

1.msb: And when the days of his service were complete, he returned home.
1.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
1.blb: And it came to pass, when the days of his service were fulfilled, that he went away to his house.
1.bbe: And when the days of his work in the Temple were ended, he went back to his house.

1.msb: After these days, his wife Elizabeth became pregnant and for five months remained in seclusion. She declared,
1.kjv: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
1.blb: And after these days, his wife Elizabeth conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,
1.bbe: After that time, Elisabeth, being certain that she was to become a mother, kept herself from men's eyes for five months, saying,

1.msb: “The Lord has done this for me. In these days He has shown me favor and taken away my disgrace among the people.”
1.kjv: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
1.blb: “Thus the Lord has done to me, in the days in which He looked upon me, to take away my reproach among men.”
1.bbe: The Lord has done this to me, for his eyes were on me, to take away my shame in the eyes of men.

1.msb: In the sixth month, God sent the angel Gabriel to a town in Galilee called Nazareth,
1.kjv: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
1.blb: Now in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent by God to a city of Galilee whose name was Nazareth,
1.bbe: Now in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a town in Galilee, named Nazareth,
1.heading: Gabriel Foretells Jesus’ Birth

1.msb: to a virgin pledged in marriage to a man named Joseph, who was of the house of David. And the virgin’s name was Mary.
1.kjv: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin’s name was Mary.
1.blb: to a virgin betrothed to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David. And the name of the virgin was Mary.
1.bbe: To a virgin who was to be married to a man named Joseph, of the family of David; and the name of the virgin was Mary.

1.msb: The angel appeared to her and said, “Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”
1.kjv: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
1.blb: And having come in to her, he said, “Greetings, O favored one! The Lord is with you.”
1.bbe: And the angel came in to her and said, Peace be with you, to whom special grace has been given; the Lord is with you.

1.msb: When she saw this, Mary was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be.
1.kjv: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
1.blb: And she was troubled at the word and was reasoning what kind this greeting might be.
1.bbe: But she was greatly troubled at his words, and said to herself, What may be the purpose of these words?

1.msb: So the angel told her, “Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
1.kjv: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
1.blb: And the angel said to her, “Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
1.bbe: And the angel said to her, Have no fear, Mary, for you have God's approval.

1.msb: Behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus.
1.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
1.blb: And behold, you will conceive in womb and will give birth to a son, and you will call His name Jesus.
1.bbe: And see, you will give birth to a son, and his name will be Jesus.

1.msb: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David,
1.kjv: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
1.blb: He will be great, and He will be called Son of the Most High. And the Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David,
1.bbe: He will be great, and will be named the Son of the Most High: and the Lord God will give him the kingdom of David, his father:

1.msb: and He will reign over the house of Jacob forever. His kingdom will never end!”
1.kjv: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
1.blb: and He will reign over the house of Jacob to the ages. And of His kingdom there will be no end!”
1.bbe: He will have rule over the house of Jacob for ever, and of his kingdom there will be no end.

1.msb: “How can this be,” Mary asked the angel, “since I am a virgin?”
1.kjv: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
1.blb: And Mary said to the angel, “How will this be, since I do not know a man?”
1.bbe: And Mary said to the angel, How may this be, because I have had no knowledge of a man?

1.msb: The angel replied, “The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. So the Holy One to be born will be called the Son of God.
1.kjv: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
1.blb: And answering, the angel said to her, “The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you; therefore also the Holy One being born will be called Son of God.
1.bbe: And the angel in answer said to her, The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will come to rest on you, and so that which will come to birth will be named holy, Son of God.

1.msb: Look, even Elizabeth your relative has conceived a son in her old age, and she who was called barren is in her sixth month.
1.kjv: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
1.blb: And behold, Elizabeth your relative, she also has conceived a son in her old age, and this is the sixth month to her who was called barren.
1.bbe: Even now Elisabeth, who is of your family, is to be a mother, though she is old: and this is the sixth month with her who was without children.

1.msb: For no word from God will ever fail.”
1.kjv: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
1.blb: For not any word will be impossible with God.”
1.bbe: For there is nothing which God is not able to do.

1.msb: “I am the Lord’s servant,” Mary answered. “May it happen to me according to your word.” Then the angel left her.
1.kjv: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
1.blb: And Mary said, “Behold, the Lord’s maidservant. May it happen to me according to your word.” And the angel went away from her.
1.bbe: And Mary said: I am the servant of the Lord; may it be to me as you say. And the angel went away.

1.msb: In those days Mary got ready and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judah,
1.kjv: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;
1.blb: Now Mary, having risen up in these days, went into the hill country with haste, to a city of Judah,
1.bbe: Then Mary got up and went quickly into the high lands, to a town of Judah;
1.heading: Mary Visits Elizabeth

1.msb: where she entered the home of Zechariah and greeted Elizabeth.
1.kjv: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
1.blb: and she entered into the house of Zechariah and greeted Elizabeth.
1.bbe: And went into the house of Zacharias and took Elisabeth in her arms.

1.msb: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
1.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:
1.blb: And it came to pass, as Elizabeth heard the greeting of Mary, that the baby in her womb leaped, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
1.bbe: And when the voice of Mary came to the ears of Elisabeth, the baby made a sudden move inside her; then Elisabeth was full of the Holy Spirit,

1.msb: In a loud voice she exclaimed, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
1.kjv: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
1.blb: And she cried out in a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
1.bbe: And she said with a loud voice: May blessing be on you among women, and a blessing on the child of your body.

1.msb: And why am I so honored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
1.kjv: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
1.blb: And from where is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
1.bbe: How is it that the mother of my Lord comes to me?

1.msb: For as soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy.
1.kjv: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
1.blb: For behold, as the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby in my womb leaped in exultation.
1.bbe: For, truly, when the sound of your voice came to my ears, the baby in my body made a sudden move for joy.

1.msb: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord’s word to her will be fulfilled.”
1.kjv: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
1.blb: And blessed is the one having believed that there will be a completion to the things spoken to her from the Lord.”
1.bbe: Happy will she be who had faith that the things which the Lord has said to her will be done.

1.msb: Then Mary said: “My soul magnifies the Lord,
1.kjv: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
1.blb: And Mary said: “My soul magnifies the Lord,
1.bbe: And Mary said: My soul gives glory to God;
1.heading: Mary’s Song

1.msb: and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior!
1.kjv: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
1.blb: and my spirit exulted in God my Savior!
1.bbe: My spirit is glad in God my Saviour.

1.msb: For He has looked with favor on the humble state of His servant. From now on all generations will call me blessed.
1.kjv: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
1.blb: For He looked upon the humiliation of His maidservant. For behold, from now on all the generations will call me blessed.
1.bbe: For he has had pity on his servant, though she is poor and lowly placed: and from this hour will all generations give witness to the blessing which has come to me.

1.msb: For the Mighty One has done great things for me. Holy is His name.
1.kjv: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.
1.blb: For the Mighty One did great things to me, and holy is His name.
1.bbe: For he who is strong has done great things for me; and holy is his name.

1.msb: His mercy extends to those who fear Him, from generation to generation.
1.kjv: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.
1.blb: And His mercy is to generations and generations, to those fearing Him.
1.bbe: His mercy is for all generations in whom is the fear of him.

1.msb: He has performed mighty deeds with His arm; He has scattered those who are proud in the thoughts of their hearts.
1.kjv: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
1.blb: He showed strength with His arm; He scattered the proud in the thought of their heart.
1.bbe: With his arm he has done acts of power; he has put to flight those who have pride in their hearts.

1.msb: He has brought down rulers from their thrones, but has exalted the humble.
1.kjv: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.
1.blb: He brought down rulers from thrones and exalted the humble.
1.bbe: He has put down kings from their seats, lifting up on high the men of low degree.

1.msb: He has filled the hungry with good things, but has sent the rich away empty.
1.kjv: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
1.blb: Those hungering He filled with good things, and those being rich He sent away empty.
1.bbe: Those who had no food he made full of good things; the men of wealth he sent away with nothing in their hands;

1.msb: He has helped His servant Israel, remembering to be merciful,
1.kjv: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;
1.blb: He took hold of Israel His servant, remembering mercy,
1.bbe: His help he has given to Israel, his servant, so that he might keep in mind his mercy to Abraham and his seed for ever,

1.msb: as He promised to our fathers, to Abraham and his descendants forever.”
1.kjv: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.
1.blb: as He spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and to his seed to the age.”
1.bbe: As he gave his word to our fathers.

1.msb: Mary stayed with Elizabeth for about three months and then returned home.
1.kjv: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.
1.blb: And Mary remained with her about three months, and she returned to her house.
1.bbe: And Mary was with her for about three months and then went back to her house.

1.msb: When the time came for Elizabeth to have her child, she gave birth to a son.
1.kjv: Now Elisabeth’s full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
1.blb: Now to Elizabeth the time was fulfilled for her to give birth, and she bore a son.
1.bbe: Now it was time for Elisabeth to give birth, and she had a son.
1.heading: The Birth of John the Baptist

1.msb: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown her great mercy, and they rejoiced with her.
1.kjv: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.
1.blb: And her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord magnified His mercy with her, and they were rejoicing with her.
1.bbe: And it came to the ears of her neighbours and relations that the Lord had been very good to her, and they took part in her joy.

1.msb: On the eighth day, when they came to circumcise the child, they were going to name him after his father Zechariah.
1.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
1.blb: And it came to pass on the eighth day that they came to circumcise the child, and they were calling him after the name of his father Zechariah.
1.bbe: And on the eighth day they came to see to the circumcision of the child, and they would have given him the name of Zacharias, his father's name;

1.msb: But his mother replied, “No! He shall be called John.”
1.kjv: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.
1.blb: And answering, his mother said, “No, but he will be called John.”
1.bbe: But his mother made answer and said, No, his name is John.

1.msb: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who bears this name.”
1.kjv: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
1.blb: And they said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”
1.bbe: And they said, Not one of your relations has that name.

1.msb: So they made signs to his father to find out what he wanted to name the child.
1.kjv: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.
1.blb: And they were making signs to his father—what he might want him to be called.
1.bbe: And they made signs to his father, to say what name was to be given to him.

1.msb: Zechariah asked for a tablet and wrote, “His name is John.” And they were all amazed.
1.kjv: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
1.blb: And having asked for a writing tablet, he wrote, saying, “John is his name.” And they all marveled.
1.bbe: And he sent for writing materials and put down: His name is John; and they were all surprised.

1.msb: Immediately Zechariah’s mouth was opened and his tongue was released, and he began to speak, praising God.
1.kjv: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.
1.blb: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue; and he was speaking, blessing God.
1.bbe: And straight away his mouth was open and his tongue was free and he gave praise to God.

1.msb: All their neighbors were filled with awe, and people throughout the hill country of Judea were talking about these events.
1.kjv: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judæa.
1.blb: And fear came upon all those dwelling around them. And in all the hill country of Judea, all these words were being talked about.
1.bbe: And fear came on all those who were living round about them: and there was much talk about all these things in all the hill-country of Judaea.

1.msb: And all who heard this wondered in their hearts and asked, “What then will this child become?” And the Lord’s hand was with him.
1.kjv: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
1.blb: And all those having heard laid them in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” For also the hand of the Lord was with him.
1.bbe: And all who had word of them kept them in their minds and said, What will this child be? For the hand of the Lord was with him.

1.msb: Then his father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied:
1.kjv: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,
1.blb: And Zechariah his father was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied, saying:
1.bbe: And his father, Zacharias, was full of the Holy Spirit, and with the voice of a prophet said these words:
1.heading: Zechariah’s Song

1.msb: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, because He has visited and redeemed His people.
1.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,
1.blb: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, because He visited and performed redemption for His people,
1.bbe: Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has come to his people and made them free,

1.msb: He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of His servant David,
1.kjv: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;
1.blb: and He raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of His servant David,
1.bbe: Lifting up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David,

1.msb: as He spoke through His holy prophets, those of ages past,
1.kjv: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:
1.blb: as He spoke by the mouth of His holy prophets from the age,
1.bbe: (As he said, by the mouth of his holy prophets, from the earliest times,)

1.msb: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us,
1.kjv: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
1.blb: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all those hating us,
1.bbe: Salvation from those who are against us, and from the hands of those who have hate for us;

1.msb: to show mercy to our fathers and to remember His holy covenant,
1.kjv: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;
1.blb: to show mercy toward our fathers and to remember His holy covenant,
1.bbe: To do acts of mercy to our fathers and to keep in mind his holy word,

1.msb: the oath He swore to our father Abraham, to grant us
1.kjv: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
1.blb: the oath that He swore to Abraham our father, to give us,
1.bbe: The oath which he made to Abraham, our father,

1.msb: deliverance from the hands of our enemies, that we may serve Him without fear,
1.kjv: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,
1.blb: having been saved from the hand of our enemies, to serve Him without fear
1.bbe: That we, being made free from the fear of those who are against us, might give him worship,

1.msb: in holiness and righteousness before Him all the days of our lives.
1.kjv: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.
1.blb: in holiness and righteousness before Him all our days.
1.bbe: In righteousness and holy living before him all our days.

1.msb: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the presence of the Lord to prepare the way for Him,
1.kjv: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;
1.blb: And you, child, will be called prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the Lord to prepare His ways,
1.bbe: And you, child, will be named the prophet of the Most High: you will go before the face of the Lord, to make ready his ways;

1.msb: to give to His people the knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins,
1.kjv: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,
1.blb: to give knowledge of salvation to His people in forgiveness of their sins,
1.bbe: To give knowledge of salvation to his people, through the forgiveness of sins,

1.msb: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the Dawn has visited us from on high,
1.kjv: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
1.blb: through the affections of mercy of our God, in which the Sunrise will visit us from on high,
1.bbe: Because of the loving mercies of our God, by which the dawn from heaven has come to us,

1.msb: to shine on those who live in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the path of peace.”
1.kjv: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
1.blb: to shine upon those sitting in darkness and in the shadow of death, to direct our feet into the way of peace.”
1.bbe: To give light to those in dark places, and in the shade of death, so that our feet may be guided into the way of peace.

1.msb: And the child grew and became strong in spirit; and he lived in the wilderness until the time of his public appearance to Israel.
1.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.
1.blb: And the child continued to grow and to become strong in spirit; and he was in the wilderness until the day of his appearance to Israel.
1.bbe: And the child became tall, and strong in spirit; and he was living in the waste land till the day when he came before the eyes of Israel.

2.msb: Now in those days a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that a census should be taken of the whole empire.
2.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Cæsar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
2.blb: And it came to pass in those days that a decree went out from Caesar Augustus to register all the world.
2.bbe: Now it came about in those days that an order went out from Caesar Augustus that there was to be a numbering of all the world.
2.heading: The Birth of Jesus

2.msb: This was the first census to take place while Quirinius was governor of Syria.
2.kjv: ( And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
2.blb: This registration first came to pass in the governing of Syria of Quirinius.
2.bbe: This was the first numbering, which was made when Quirinius was ruler of Syria.

2.msb: And everyone went to his own town to register.
2.kjv: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.
2.blb: And all were going to be registered, each to his own city.
2.bbe: And all men went to be numbered, everyone to his town.

2.msb: So Joseph also went up from Nazareth in Galilee to Judea, to the city of David called Bethlehem, since he was from the house and line of David.
2.kjv: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judæa, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
2.blb: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, to Judea, to the City of David, which is called Bethlehem, because of his being of the house and family of David,
2.bbe: And Joseph went up from Galilee, out of the town of Nazareth, into Judaea, to Beth-lehem, the town of David, because he was of the house and family of David,

2.msb: He went there to register with Mary, who was pledged to him in marriage and was expecting a child.
2.kjv: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
2.blb: to register with Mary, the one betrothed to him, she being pregnant.
2.bbe: To be put on the list with Mary, his future wife, who was about to become a mother.

2.msb: While they were there, the time came for her Child to be born.
2.kjv: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
2.blb: And it came to pass, in their being there, that the days of her giving birth were fulfilled.
2.bbe: And while they were there, the time came for her to give birth.

2.msb: And she gave birth to her firstborn, a Son. She wrapped Him in swaddling cloths and laid Him in the manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.
2.kjv: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
2.blb: And she gave birth to her Son, the firstborn, and she wrapped Him in swaddling cloths and laid Him in a manger, because there was no place for them in the inn.
2.bbe: And she had her first son; and folding him in linen, she put him to rest in the place where the cattle had their food, because there was no room for them in the house.

2.msb: And there were shepherds residing in the fields nearby, keeping watch over their flocks by night.
2.kjv: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
2.blb: And there were shepherds in the same region, lodging in the fields and keeping watch by night over their flock.
2.bbe: And in the same country there were keepers of sheep in the fields, watching over their flock by night.
2.heading: The Shepherds and the Angels

2.msb: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood before them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
2.kjv: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
2.blb: And an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they feared with great fear.
2.bbe: And an angel of the Lord came to them, and the glory of the Lord was shining round about them: and fear came on them.

2.msb: But the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid! For behold, I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the people:
2.kjv: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
2.blb: And the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid, for behold, I bring good news to you of great joy that will be to all the people.
2.bbe: And the angel said, Have no fear; for truly, I give you good news of great joy which will be for all the people:

2.msb: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!
2.kjv: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
2.blb: For today in the City of David a Savior was born to you, who is Christ the Lord.
2.bbe: For on this day, in the town of David, a Saviour has come to birth, who is Christ the Lord.

2.msb: And this will be the sign to you: You will find a baby wrapped in swaddling cloths and lying in a manger.”
2.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
2.blb: And this is the sign to you: You will find a baby wrapped in swaddling cloths and lying in a manger.”
2.bbe: And this is the sign to you: you will see a young child folded in linen, in the place where the cattle have their food.

2.msb: And suddenly there appeared with the angel a great multitude of the heavenly host, praising God and saying:
2.kjv: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
2.blb: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host, praising God and saying:
2.bbe: And suddenly there was with the angel a great band of spirits from heaven, giving praise to God, and saying,

2.msb: “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men!”
2.kjv: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
2.blb: “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace among men with whom He is well pleased!”
2.bbe: Glory to God in the highest, and on the earth peace among men with whom he is well pleased.

2.msb: When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, “Let us go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”
2.kjv: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.
2.blb: And it came to pass, as the angels went away from them into heaven, that the shepherds were saying to one another, “Let us go through indeed as far as Bethlehem, and let us see this saying that has come to pass, which the Lord made known to us.”
2.bbe: And when the angels had gone away from them into heaven, the keepers of the sheep said to one another, Let us go now to Beth-lehem, and see this thing which has come about, which the Lord has made clear to us.

2.msb: So they hurried off and found Mary and Joseph and the Baby, who was lying in the manger.
2.kjv: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
2.blb: And having hurried, they came and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby lying in the manger.
2.bbe: And they came quickly, and saw Mary and Joseph, and the child in the place where the cattle had their food.

2.msb: After they had seen the Child, they spread widely the message they had received about Him.
2.kjv: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
2.blb: And having seen, they made known concerning the saying having been spoken to them concerning this Child.
2.bbe: And when they saw it, they gave them an account of the things which had been said to them about the child.

2.msb: And all who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds said to them.
2.kjv: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
2.blb: And all those having heard marveled concerning the things having been spoken to them by the shepherds.
2.bbe: And all those to whose ears it came were full of wonder at the things said by the keepers of the sheep.

2.msb: But Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart.
2.kjv: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
2.blb: But Mary was preserving all these matters, pondering in her heart.
2.bbe: But Mary kept all these words in her heart, and gave much thought to them.

2.msb: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all they had heard and seen, which was just as the angel had told them.
2.kjv: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
2.blb: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all things that they heard and saw, just as it was said to them.
2.bbe: Then the keepers of the sheep went back, giving glory and praise to God for all the things which had come to their ears and which they had seen, as it had been said to them.

2.msb: When the eight days before His circumcision had passed, He was named Jesus, the name the angel had given Him before He was conceived.
2.kjv: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
2.blb: And when eight days to circumcise Him were fulfilled, then His name was called Jesus, which He had been called by the angel before His being conceived in the womb.
2.bbe: And when, after eight days, the time came for his circumcision, he was named Jesus, the name which the angel had given to him before his birth.
2.heading: Jesus Presented at the Temple

2.msb: And when the time of their purification according to the Law of Moses was complete, His parents brought Him to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord
2.kjv: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;
2.blb: And when the days of their purification were fulfilled according to the Law of Moses, they brought Him up to Jerusalem to present to the Lord
2.bbe: And when the necessary days for making them clean by the law of Moses had come to an end, they took him to Jerusalem to give him to the Lord

2.msb: (as it is written in the Law of the Lord: “Every firstborn male shall be consecrated to the Lord”),
2.kjv: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)
2.blb: (just as it has been written in the Law of the Lord: “Every male opening a womb will be called holy to the Lord”),
2.bbe: (As it says in the law of the Lord, Every mother's first male child is to be holy to the Lord),

2.msb: and to offer the sacrifice specified in the Law of the Lord: “A pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons.”
2.kjv: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
2.blb: and to give a sacrifice according to that said in the Law of the Lord: “A pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons.”
2.bbe: And to make an offering, as it is ordered in the law of the Lord, of two doves or other young birds.

2.msb: Now there was a man in Jerusalem named Simeon, who was righteous and devout. He was waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him.
2.kjv: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
2.blb: And behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. And this man was righteous and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him.
2.bbe: And there was then in Jerusalem a man whose name was Simeon; and he was an upright man, fearing God and waiting for the comfort of Israel: and the Holy Spirit was on him.
2.heading: The Prophecy of Simeon

2.msb: The Holy Spirit had revealed to him that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
2.kjv: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
2.blb: And it was divinely revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he would not see death before he should see the Christ of the Lord.
2.bbe: And he had knowledge, through the Holy Spirit, that he would not see death till he had seen the Lord's Christ.

2.msb: Led by the Spirit, he went into the temple courts. And when the parents brought in the child Jesus to do for Him what was customary under the Law,
2.kjv: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
2.blb: And he went in the Spirit into the temple. And in the parents bringing in the child Jesus for them to do according to that having become customary by the Law concerning Him,
2.bbe: And full of the Spirit he came into the Temple; and when the father and mother came in with the child Jesus, to do with him what was ordered by the law,

2.msb: Simeon took Him in his arms and blessed God, saying:
2.kjv: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
2.blb: then he took Him into the arms and blessed God, and he said:
2.bbe: Then he took him in his arms and gave praise to God and said,

2.msb: “Sovereign Lord, as You have promised, You now dismiss Your servant in peace.
2.kjv: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
2.blb: “Now, Lord, You dismiss Your servant in peace, according to Your word.
2.bbe: Now you are letting your servant go in peace, O Lord, as you have said;

2.msb: For my eyes have seen Your salvation,
2.kjv: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
2.blb: For my eyes saw Your salvation,
2.bbe: For my eyes have seen your salvation,

2.msb: which You have prepared in the sight of all people,
2.kjv: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
2.blb: which You prepared before the face of all the peoples,
2.bbe: Which you have made ready before the face of all nations;

2.msb: a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and for glory to Your people Israel.”
2.kjv: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.
2.blb: a light to the uncovering of the Gentiles, and the glory of Your people Israel.”
2.bbe: A light of revelation to the Gentiles, and the glory of your people Israel.

2.msb: And Joseph and the Child’s mother were amazed at what was spoken about Him.
2.kjv: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
2.blb: And His father and mother were marveling at the things having been spoken concerning Him.
2.bbe: And his father and mother were full of wonder at the things which were said about him.

2.msb: Then Simeon blessed them and said to His mother Mary: “Behold, this Child is appointed to cause the rise and fall of many in Israel, and to be a sign that will be spoken against,
2.kjv: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
2.blb: And Simeon blessed them and said to His mother Mary: “Behold, this Child is appointed for the falling and rising up of many in Israel, and for a sign spoken against—
2.bbe: And Simeon gave them his blessing and said to Mary, his mother, See, this child will be the cause of the downfall and the lifting up of great numbers of people in Israel, and he will be a sign against which hard words will be said;

2.msb: so that the thoughts of many hearts will be revealed—and a sword will pierce your soul as well.”
2.kjv: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
2.blb: and a sword will also pass through your own soul—so that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”
2.bbe: (And a sword will go through your heart;) so that the secret thoughts of men may come to light.

2.msb: There was also a prophetess named Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher, who was well along in years. She had been married for seven years,
2.kjv: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
2.blb: And there was Anna, a prophetess, daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher; she was advanced in many days, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,
2.bbe: And there was one, Anna, a woman prophet, the daughter of Phanuel, of the family of Asher (she was very old, and after seven years of married life
2.heading: The Prophecy of Anna

2.msb: and then was a widow to the age of eighty-four. She never left the temple, but worshiped night and day, fasting and praying.
2.kjv: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
2.blb: and she was a widow until eighty-four years, who did not depart the temple, serving with fastings and petitions night and day.
2.bbe: She had been a widow for eighty-four years); she was in the Temple at all times, worshipping with prayers and going without food, night and day.

2.msb: Coming forward at that moment, she gave thanks to the Lord and spoke about the Child to all who were waiting for redemption in Jerusalem.
2.kjv: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
2.blb: And having come up at that hour, she was giving praise to God and was speaking concerning Him to all those waiting for the redemption of Jerusalem.
2.bbe: And coming up at that time, she gave praise to God, talking of him to all those who were waiting for the freeing of Jerusalem.

2.msb: When Jesus’ parents had done everything required by the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own town of Nazareth.
2.kjv: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
2.blb: And when they accomplished everything according to the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their city, Nazareth.
2.bbe: And when they had done all the things which were ordered by the law of the Lord, they went back to Galilee, to Nazareth, the town where they were living.
2.heading: The Return to Nazareth

2.msb: And the Child grew and became strong in spirit. He was filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon Him.
2.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
2.blb: And the Child continued to grow and become strong, being filled with wisdom. And the grace of God was upon Him.
2.bbe: And the child became tall and strong and full of wisdom, and the grace of God was on him.

2.msb: Every year His parents went to Jerusalem for the Feast of the Passover.
2.kjv: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
2.blb: And His parents were going every year to Jerusalem for the Feast of the Passover.
2.bbe: And every year his father and mother went to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.
2.heading: The Boy Jesus at the Temple

2.msb: And when He was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the Feast.
2.kjv: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
2.blb: And when He was twelve years old, on their having gone up according to the custom of the Feast
2.bbe: And when he was twelve years old, they went up, as their way was, to the feast;

2.msb: When those days were over and they were returning home, the boy Jesus remained behind in Jerusalem, but Joseph and His mother were unaware He had stayed.
2.kjv: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.
2.blb: and having completed the days, in their returning, the boy Jesus remained behind in Jerusalem, and His parents did not know.
2.bbe: And when the days of the feast came to an end and they were going back, the boy Jesus was still in Jerusalem, but they had no knowledge of it:

2.msb: Assuming He was in their company, they traveled on for a day before they began to look for Him among their relatives and friends.
2.kjv: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day’s journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
2.blb: And having supposed Him to be in their company, they went a day’s journey and began seeking Him among the relatives and the acquaintances.
2.bbe: And in the belief that he was with some of their number, they went a day's journey; and after looking for him among their relations and friends,

2.msb: When they could not find Him, they returned to Jerusalem to search for Him.
2.kjv: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
2.blb: And not having found Him, they returned to Jerusalem, seeking Him.
2.bbe: And seeing that he was not there, they went back to Jerusalem, to make search for him.

2.msb: Finally, after three days they found Him in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.
2.kjv: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
2.blb: And it came to pass after three days that they found Him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both hearing them and questioning them.
2.bbe: And after three days they came across him in the Temple, seated among the wise men, giving ear to their words and putting questions to them.

2.msb: And all who heard Him were astounded at His understanding and His answers.
2.kjv: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
2.blb: And all those hearing Him were amazed at His understanding and answers.
2.bbe: And all to whose ears it came were full of wonder at his knowledge and the answers which he gave.

2.msb: When His parents saw Him, they were astonished. “Child, why have You done this to us?” His mother asked. “Your father and I have been anxiously searching for You.”
2.kjv: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
2.blb: And having seen Him, they were astonished, and His mother said to Him, “Child, why did You do thus to us? Behold, Your father and I, being distressed, were seeking You.”
2.bbe: And when they saw him they were surprised, and his mother said to him, Son, why have you done this to us? see, your father and I have been looking for you with sorrow.

2.msb: “Why were you looking for Me?” He asked. “Did you not know that I had to be in My Father’s house?”
2.kjv: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father’s business?
2.blb: And He said to them, “Why is it that you were seeking Me? Did you not know that it is necessary for Me to be in the house of My Father?”
2.bbe: And he said to them, Why were you looking for me? was it not clear to you that my right place was in my Father's house?

2.msb: But they did not understand the statement He was making to them.
2.kjv: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
2.blb: And they did not understand the word that He spoke to them.
2.bbe: And his words seemed strange to them.

2.msb: Then He went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. But His mother treasured up all these things in her heart.
2.kjv: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
2.blb: And He went down with them and came to Nazareth, and He was subject to them. And His mother was keeping all these matters in her heart.
2.bbe: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth; and did as he was ordered: and his mother kept all these words in her heart.

2.msb: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.
2.kjv: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.
2.blb: And Jesus continued to advance in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
2.bbe: And Jesus was increasing in wisdom and in years, and in grace before God and men.

3.msb: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, while Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
3.kjv: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Cæsar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judæa, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
3.blb: And in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip being tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and of Trachonitis, and Lysanias being tetrarch of Abilene,
3.bbe: Now in the fifteenth year of the rule of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being ruler of Judaea, and Herod being king of Galilee, his brother Philip king of the country of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias king of Abilene,
3.heading: The Mission of John the Baptist

3.msb: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the wilderness.
3.kjv: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
3.blb: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came upon John son of Zechariah in the wilderness.
3.bbe: When Annas and Caiaphas were high priests, the word of the Lord came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the waste land.

3.msb: He went into all the region around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins,
3.kjv: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;
3.blb: And he went into all the region around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance unto forgiveness of sins,
3.bbe: And he came into all the country round about Jordan, preaching baptism as a sign of forgiveness of sin for those whose hearts were changed.

3.msb: as it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.
3.kjv: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
3.blb: as it has been written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: “A voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way of the Lord; make straight His paths.
3.bbe: As it says in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, The voice of one crying in the waste land, Make ready the way of the Lord, make his roads straight.

3.msb: Every valley shall be filled in, and every mountain and hill made low. The crooked ways shall be made straight, and the rough ways smooth.
3.kjv: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
3.blb: Every valley will be filled, and every mountain and hill will be made low; and the crooked will become straight, and the rough ways into smooth.
3.bbe: Every valley will be lifted up, and all the mountains and hills made low, and the twisted will be made straight, and the rough ways smooth;

3.msb: And all humanity will see God’s salvation.’”
3.kjv: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
3.blb: And all flesh will see the salvation of God.”
3.bbe: And all flesh will see the salvation of God.

3.msb: Then John said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
3.kjv: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
3.blb: Then he was saying to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, “Offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
3.bbe: So he said to the people who went out to him for baptism: You offspring of snakes, at whose word are you going in flight from the wrath to come?

3.msb: Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance. And do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
3.kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
3.blb: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance. And do not begin to say in yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as father.’ For I say to you that out of these stones God is able to raise up children to Abraham.
3.bbe: Make clear by your acts that your hearts have been changed; and do not say to yourselves, We have Abraham for our father: for I say to you that God is able from these stones to make children of Abraham.

3.msb: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.”
3.kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
3.blb: And already also the ax is laid to the root of the trees; therefore every tree not producing good fruit is cut down and is thrown into fire.”
3.bbe: And even now the axe is put to the root of the trees; and every tree which does not have good fruit will be cut down and put into the fire.

3.msb: The crowds asked him, “What then should we do?”
3.kjv: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
3.blb: And the crowds were questioning him, saying, “What then shall we do?”
3.bbe: And the people put questions to him, saying, What have we to do?

3.msb: John replied, “Whoever has two tunics should share with him who has none, and whoever has food should do the same.”
3.kjv: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
3.blb: And answering, he was saying to them, “The one having two tunics, let him impart to the one having none; and the one having food, let him do likewise.”
3.bbe: And he made answer and said to them, He who has two coats, let him give to him who has not even one; and he who has food, let him do the same.

3.msb: Even tax collectors came to be baptized. “Teacher,” they asked, “what should we do?”
3.kjv: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
3.blb: And tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what shall we do?”
3.bbe: Then tax-farmers came to him for baptism and said to him, Master, what have we to do?

3.msb: “Collect no more than you are authorized,” he answered.
3.kjv: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
3.blb: And he said to them, “Exact nothing more than that having been appointed to you.”
3.bbe: And he said to them, Do not make an attempt to get more money than the right amount.

3.msb: Then some soldiers asked him, “And what should we do?” “Do not take money by force or false accusation,” he said. “Be content with your wages.”
3.kjv: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
3.blb: And those being soldiers were also questioning him, saying, “And what shall we do?” And he said to them, “Extort no one, nor accuse falsely, and be content with your wages.”
3.bbe: And men of the army put questions to him, saying, And what have we to do? And he said to them, Do no violent acts to any man, and do not take anything without right, and let your payment be enough for you.

3.msb: The people were waiting expectantly and were all wondering in their hearts if John could be the Christ.
3.kjv: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;
3.blb: And the people are expecting, and all are reasoning in their hearts concerning John, whether he might be the Christ.
3.bbe: And while the people were waiting, and all men were questioning in their hearts about John, if he was the Christ or not,

3.msb: John answered all of them: “I baptize you with water, but One more powerful than I will come, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
3.kjv: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
3.blb: John answered, saying to all, “I indeed baptize you in water, but the One mightier than I comes, of whom I am not sufficient to loose the strap of His sandals. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire,
3.bbe: John made answer, saying to them all, Truly, I give you baptism with water, but one is coming who is greater than I, whose shoes I am not good enough to undo: he will give you baptism with the Holy Spirit, and with fire:

3.msb: His winnowing fork is in His hand, and He will clear His threshing floor and gather the wheat into His barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
3.kjv: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
3.blb: whose winnowing fork is in His hand to thoroughly cleanse His threshing floor and to gather the wheat into His barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
3.bbe: In whose hand is the instrument with which he will make clean his grain; he will put the good grain in his store, but the waste will be burned in the fire which will never be put out.

3.msb: With these and many other exhortations, John proclaimed the good news to the people.
3.kjv: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
3.blb: Therefore indeed, exhorting many other things, he was proclaiming good news to the people.
3.bbe: And so comforting them with these and other words, he gave the good news to the people;

3.msb: But when he rebuked Herod the tetrarch regarding his brother’s wife Herodias and all the evils he had done,
3.kjv: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip’s wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
3.blb: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him concerning Herodias the wife of his brother and concerning all the evils that Herod did,
3.bbe: But Herod the king, because John had made a protest on account of Herodias, his brother's wife, and other evil things which Herod had done,

3.msb: Herod added this to them all: He locked John up in prison.
3.kjv: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.
3.blb: also added this to all: He also locked up John in prison.
3.bbe: Did this most evil thing of all, and had John shut up in prison.

3.msb: When all the people were being baptized, Jesus was baptized too. And as He was praying, heaven was opened,
3.kjv: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
3.blb: Now it came to pass, in all the people having been baptized and Jesus having been baptized and praying, that heaven was opened,
3.bbe: Now it came about that when all the people had been given baptism, Jesus, having had baptism with them, was in prayer, when, the heaven being open,
3.heading: The Baptism of Jesus

3.msb: and the Holy Spirit descended on Him in a bodily form like a dove. And a voice came from heaven, saying, “You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.”
3.kjv: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
3.blb: and the Holy Spirit descended upon Him in a bodily form as a dove. And a voice came out of heaven: “You are My Son, the Beloved; in You I was well pleased.”
3.bbe: The Holy Spirit came down in the form of a dove, and a voice came from heaven, saying, You are my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased.

3.msb: Jesus Himself was about thirty years old when He began His ministry. He was regarded as the son of Joseph, the son of Heli,
3.kjv: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,
3.blb: And Jesus Himself, beginning, was about thirty years old, being son, as was supposed, of Joseph, of Heli,
3.bbe: And Jesus at this time was about thirty years old, being the son (as it seemed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
3.heading: The Genealogy of Jesus

3.msb: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Janna, the son of Joseph,
3.kjv: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,
3.blb: of Matthat, of Levi, of Melchi, of Jannai, of Joseph,
3.bbe: The son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

3.msb: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,
3.kjv: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,
3.blb: of Mattathias, of Amos, of Nahum, of Esli, of Naggai,
3.bbe: The son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

3.msb: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semei, the son of Josech, the son of Judah,
3.kjv: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,
3.blb: of Maath, of Mattathias, of Semein, of Josech, of Joda,
3.bbe: The son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josech, the son of Joda,

3.msb: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,
3.kjv: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,
3.blb: of Joannen, of Rhesa, of Zerubbabel, of Shealtiel, of Neri,
3.bbe: The son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

3.msb: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,
3.kjv: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,
3.blb: of Melchi, of Addi, of Cosam, of Elmadam, of Er,
3.bbe: The son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmadam, the son of Er,

3.msb: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
3.kjv: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,
3.blb: of Joshua, of Eliezer, of Jorim, of Matthat, of Levi,
3.bbe: The son of Jesus, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

3.msb: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,
3.kjv: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,
3.blb: of Simeon, of Judah, of Joseph, of Jonam, of Eliakim,
3.bbe: The son of Symeon, the son of Judas, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonam, the son of Eliakim,

3.msb: the son of Melea, the son of Mainan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,
3.kjv: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,
3.blb: of Melea, of Menna, of Mattatha, of Nathan, of David,
3.bbe: The son of Melea, the son of Menna, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

3.msb: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,
3.kjv: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,
3.blb: of Jesse, of Obed, of Boaz, of Sala, of Nahshon,
3.bbe: The son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

3.msb: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,
3.kjv: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,
3.blb: of Amminadab, of Admin, of Arni, of Hezron, of Perez, of Judah,
3.bbe: The son of Amminadab, the son of Arni, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

3.msb: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,
3.kjv: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,
3.blb: of Jacob, of Isaac, of Abraham, of Terah, of Nahor,
3.bbe: The son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

3.msb: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,
3.kjv: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,
3.blb: of Serug, of Reu, of Peleg, of Eber, of Shelah,
3.bbe: The son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

3.msb: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
3.kjv: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,
3.blb: of Cainan, of Arphaxad, of Shem, of Noah, of Lamech,
3.bbe: The son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

3.msb: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel, the son of Cainan,
3.kjv: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,
3.blb: of Methuselah, of Enoch, of Jared, of Mahalalel, of Cainan,
3.bbe: The son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

3.msb: the son of Enosh, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
3.kjv: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.
3.blb: of Enosh, of Seth, of Adam, of God.
3.bbe: The son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

4.msb: Then Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
4.kjv: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
4.blb: And Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led in the Spirit in the wilderness,
4.bbe: And Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, came back from the Jordan, and was guided by the Spirit in the waste land
4.heading: The Temptation of Jesus

4.msb: where for forty days He was tempted by the devil. He ate nothing during those days, and afterward, when they had ended, He was hungry.
4.kjv: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.
4.blb: being tempted forty days by the devil. And He ate nothing in those days, and on their having ended, He was hungry.
4.bbe: For forty days, being tested by the Evil One. And he had no food in those days; and when they came to an end, he was in need of food.

4.msb: The devil said to Him, “If You are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread.”
4.kjv: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.
4.blb: And the devil said to Him, “If You are the Son of God, speak to this stone, that it might become bread.”
4.bbe: And the Evil One said to him, If you are the Son of God, give orders to this stone to become bread.

4.msb: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word of God.’”
4.kjv: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.
4.blb: And Jesus answered to him, “It has been written: ‘Not on bread alone shall the man live.’”
4.bbe: And Jesus made answer to him, It has been said in the Writings, Bread is not man's only need.

4.msb: Then the devil led Him up to a high mountain and showed Him in an instant all the kingdoms of the world.
4.kjv: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
4.blb: And having led Him up, he showed Him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
4.bbe: And he took him up and let him see all the kingdoms of the earth in a minute of time.

4.msb: “I will give You authority over all these kingdoms and all their glory,” he said. “For it has been relinquished to me, and I can give it to anyone I wish.
4.kjv: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
4.blb: And the devil said to Him, “I will give to You all this authority and their glory; for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whom I wish.
4.bbe: And the Evil One said, I will give you authority over all these, and the glory of them, for it has been given to me, and I give it to anyone at my pleasure.

4.msb: So if You worship me, it will all be Yours.”
4.kjv: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
4.blb: You, therefore, if You worship before me, all will be Yours.”
4.bbe: If then you will give worship to me, it will all be yours.

4.msb: But Jesus answered, “Get behind Me, Satan! It is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’”
4.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
4.blb: And answering, Jesus said to him, “It has been written: ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and Him only shall you serve.’”
4.bbe: And Jesus in answer said to him, It has been said in the Writings, Give worship to the Lord your God, and be his servant only.

4.msb: Then the devil led Him to Jerusalem and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple. “If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down from here.
4.kjv: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
4.blb: And he led Him to Jerusalem and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple, and he said to Him, “If You are the Son of God, throw Yourself down from here.
4.bbe: And he took him to Jerusalem and put him on the highest point of the Temple and said to him, If you are the Son of God, let yourself go down from here; for it is said in the Writings,

4.msb: For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You to guard You carefully,
4.kjv: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:
4.blb: For it has been written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You to guard You carefully,
4.bbe: He will give his angels orders to take care of you:

4.msb: and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’”
4.kjv: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
4.blb: and on hands they will lift You up, lest ever You may strike Your foot against a stone.’”
4.bbe: And, In their hands they will keep you up, so that your foot may not be crushed against a stone.

4.msb: But Jesus answered, “It also says, ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”
4.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
4.blb: And answering, Jesus said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not test the Lord your God.’”
4.bbe: And Jesus made answer and said to him, It is said in the Writings, You may not put the Lord your God to the test.

4.msb: When the devil had finished every temptation, he left Him until an opportune time.
4.kjv: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
4.blb: And the devil, having ended every temptation, departed from Him until an opportune time.
4.bbe: And when all these tests were ended the Evil One went away from him for a time.

4.msb: Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and the news about Him spread throughout the surrounding region.
4.kjv: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
4.blb: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit to Galilee, and a report went out through all the surrounding region concerning Him.
4.bbe: And Jesus came back to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and the news of him went through all the country round about.
4.heading: Jesus Begins His Ministry

4.msb: He taught in their synagogues and was glorified by everyone.
4.kjv: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
4.blb: And He was teaching in their synagogues, being glorified by all.
4.bbe: And he was teaching in their Synagogues and all men gave him praise.

4.msb: Then Jesus came to Nazareth, where He had been brought up. As was His custom, He entered the synagogue on the Sabbath. And when He stood up to read,
4.kjv: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
4.blb: And He came to Nazareth, where He had been brought up; and according to His custom, He entered into the synagogue on the day of the Sabbaths, and He rose up to read.
4.bbe: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been as a child, and he went, as his way was, into the Synagogue on the Sabbath, and got up to give a reading.
4.heading: The Rejection at Nazareth

4.msb: the scroll of Isaiah the prophet was handed to Him. Unrolling it, He found the place where it was written:
4.kjv: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
4.blb: And the scroll of the prophet Isaiah was given to Him, and having unrolled the scroll, He found the place where it was written:
4.bbe: And the book of the prophet Isaiah was given to him and, opening the book, he came on the place where it is said,

4.msb: “The Spirit of the Lord is on Me, because He has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to heal the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to release the oppressed,
4.kjv: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
4.blb: “The Spirit of the Lord is upon Me, because of which He anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to proclaim deliverance to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to send forth the oppressed in deliverance,
4.bbe: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because I am marked out by him to give good news to the poor; he has sent me to make well those who are broken-hearted; to say that the prisoners will be let go, and the blind will see, and to make the wounded free from their chains,

4.msb: to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.”
4.kjv: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.
4.blb: to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”
4.bbe: To give knowledge that the year of the Lord's good pleasure is come.

4.msb: Then He rolled up the scroll, returned it to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fixed on Him,
4.kjv: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
