7.bbe: And there was a woman in the town who was a sinner; and when she had news that he was a guest in the Pharisee's house, she took a bottle of perfume,

7.msb: As she stood behind Him at His feet weeping, she began to wet His feet with her tears and wipe them with her hair. Then she kissed His feet and anointed them with the perfume.
7.kjv: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
7.blb: and having stood behind Him at His feet weeping, she began to wet His feet with her tears, and she was wiping them with the hairs of her head, and she was kissing His feet and was anointing them with the fragrant oil.
7.bbe: And went in and took her place at the back of him, near his feet, weeping, so that his feet were washed with the drops from her eyes, and with her hair she made them dry, and kissing his feet she put the perfume on them.

7.msb: When the Pharisee who had invited Jesus saw this, he said to himself, “If this man were a prophet, He would know who this is and what kind of woman is touching Him—for she is a sinner!”
7.kjv: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.
7.blb: And the Pharisee, the one having called Him, having seen, spoke within himself, saying, “If this man were a prophet, He would have known who and what kind the woman is who touches Him—because she is a sinner.”
7.bbe: Now when the Pharisee in whose house he was saw it, he said to himself, This man, if he was a prophet, would be conscious what sort of woman this is who has put her hands on him, that she is a sinner.

7.msb: But Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” “Tell me, Teacher,” he said.
7.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
7.blb: And answering, Jesus said to him, “Simon, I have something to say to you.” And he says, “Teacher, say it.”
7.bbe: And Jesus, answering, said, Simon, I have something to say to you. And he said, Master, say on.

7.msb: “Two men were debtors to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
7.kjv: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
7.blb: “There were two debtors to a certain lender. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
7.bbe: And he said, Two men were in debt to a certain man of business: one had a debt of five hundred pence, and the other of fifty.

7.msb: When they were unable to repay him, he forgave both of them. Tell Me, which one, then, will love him more?”
7.kjv: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
7.blb: Of them having nothing to repay, he forgave both. Therefore which of them will love him more?”
7.bbe: When they were unable to make payment, he made the two of them free of their debts. Which of them, now, will have the greater love for him?

7.msb: “I suppose the one who was forgiven more,” Simon replied. “You have judged correctly,” Jesus said.
7.kjv: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
7.blb: Answering, Simon said, “I suppose he to whom he forgave the more.” And He said to him, “You judged correctly.”
7.bbe: Simon, in answer, said, It seems he whose debt was greater. And he said, Your decision is right.

7.msb: And turning toward the woman, He said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? When I entered your house, you did not give Me water for My feet, but she wet My feet with her tears and wiped them with the hair of her head.
7.kjv: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
7.blb: And having turned to the woman, He was saying to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house; you did not give water for My feet, but she herself wet My feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.
7.bbe: And turning to the woman he said to Simon, You see this woman? I came into your house; you did not give me water for my feet: but she has been washing my feet with the drops from her eyes, and drying them with her hair.

7.msb: You did not greet Me with a kiss, but she has not stopped kissing My feet since I arrived.
7.kjv: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
7.blb: You did not give to Me a kiss, but from which time I entered, she herself did not cease kissing My feet.
7.bbe: You did not give me a kiss: but she, from the time when I came in, has gone on kissing my feet.

7.msb: You did not anoint My head with oil, but she has anointed My feet with perfume.
7.kjv: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
7.blb: You did not anoint My head with oil, but she herself anointed My feet with fragrant oil.
7.bbe: You put no oil on my head: but she has put perfume on my feet.

7.msb: Therefore I tell you, her many sins have been forgiven, for she has loved much. But he who has been forgiven little loves little.”
7.kjv: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
7.blb: Therefore I say to you this: Her many sins have been forgiven, because she loved much; but to whom little is forgiven, he loves little.”
7.bbe: And so I say to you, She will have forgiveness for her sins which are great in number, because of her great love: but he who has small need of forgiveness gives little love.

7.msb: Then Jesus said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
7.kjv: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
7.blb: And He said to her, “Your sins have been forgiven.”
7.bbe: And he said to her, You have forgiveness for your sins.

7.msb: But those at the table began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
7.kjv: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
7.blb: And those reclining with Him began to say within themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
7.bbe: And those who were seated at table with him said to themselves, Who is this who even gives forgiveness of sins?

7.msb: And Jesus told the woman, “Your faith has saved you; go in peace.”
7.kjv: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
7.blb: And He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you; go in peace.”
7.bbe: And he said to the woman, By your faith you have salvation; go in peace.

8.msb: Soon afterward, Jesus traveled from one town and village to another, preaching and proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God. The Twelve were with Him,
8.kjv: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,
8.blb: And it came to pass in the thereafter that He was traveling through each city and village preaching and proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God, and the Twelve were with Him,
8.bbe: And it came about, after a short time, that he went through town and country giving the good news of the kingdom of God, and with him were the twelve,
8.heading: Women Minister to Jesus

8.msb: as well as some women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out,
8.kjv: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
8.blb: and certain women who had been healed from evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who is called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out,
8.bbe: And certain women who had been made free from evil spirits and diseases, Mary named Magdalene, from whom seven evil spirits had gone out,

8.msb: Joanna the wife of Herod’s household manager Chuza, Susanna, and many others. These women were ministering to them out of their own means.
8.kjv: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
8.blb: and Joanna wife of Chuza, steward of Herod, and Susanna, and many others, who were ministering to them out of their means.
8.bbe: And Joanna, the wife of Chuza, Herod's chief house-servant, and Susanna and a number of others, who gave him of their wealth for his needs.

8.msb: While a large crowd was gathering and people were coming to Jesus from town after town, He told them this parable:
8.kjv: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
8.blb: And a great crowd assembling and those from each town coming to Him, He spoke by a parable:
8.bbe: And when a great number of people came together, and men from every town went out to him, he gave them teaching in the form of a story:
8.heading: The Parable of the Sower

8.msb: “A farmer went out to sow his seed. And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, where it was trampled, and the birds of the air devoured it.
8.kjv: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
8.blb: “The one sowing went out to sow his seed. And in his sowing, some indeed fell along the path, and it was trampled upon, and the birds of the sky devoured it.
8.bbe: A man went out to put in seed, and while he was doing it, some was dropped by the wayside and it was crushed under foot, and was taken by the birds of heaven.

8.msb: Some fell on rocky ground, and when it came up, the seedlings withered because they had no moisture.
8.kjv: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
8.blb: And other fell upon the rock, and having sprung up, it withered because of it not having moisture.
8.bbe: And some went on the rock, and when it came up it became dry and dead because it had no water.

8.msb: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up with it and choked the seedlings.
8.kjv: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
8.blb: And other fell in the midst of the thorns, and having sprung up with it, the thorns choked it.
8.bbe: And some went among thorns, and the thorns came up with it and it had no room for growth.

8.msb: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it sprang up and produced a crop—a hundredfold.” As Jesus said this, He called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
8.kjv: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
8.blb: And other fell upon the good soil, and having sprung up, it produced fruit—a hundredfold.” Saying these things, He was calling out, “The one having ears to hear, let him hear.”
8.bbe: And some falling on good earth, came up and gave fruit a hundred times as much. And with these words he said in a loud voice, He who has ears, let him give ear.

8.msb: Then His disciples asked Him what this parable meant.
8.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
8.blb: And His disciples were asking Him, “What may this parable be?”
8.bbe: And his disciples put questions to him about the point of the story.

8.msb: He replied, “The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to others I speak in parables, so that, ‘though seeing, they may not see; though hearing, they may not understand.’
8.kjv: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
8.blb: And He said, “To you it has been given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God, but to the rest, it is in parables, so that, ‘Seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’
8.bbe: And he said, To you is given knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of God; but to the others, they are given in stories, so that seeing, they may not see, and though they give hearing, the sense will not be clear to them.

8.msb: Now this is the meaning of the parable: The seed is the word of God.
8.kjv: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
8.blb: And this is the parable: The seed is the word of God.
8.bbe: Now this is the point of the story: The seed is the word of God.

8.msb: The seeds along the path are those who hear, but the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.
8.kjv: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
8.blb: And the ones along the path are those having heard; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, lest having believed, they should be saved.
8.bbe: Those by the side of the road are those who have given hearing; then the Evil One comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not have faith and get salvation.

8.msb: The seeds on rocky ground are those who hear the word and receive it with joy, but they have no root. They believe for a season, but in the time of testing, they fall away.
8.kjv: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
8.blb: And the ones upon the rock are those who, when they may hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, who believe for a time, and in time of testing they fall away.
8.bbe: And those on the rock are those who with joy give hearing to the word; but having no root, they have faith for a time, and when the test comes they give up.

8.msb: The seeds that fell among the thorns are those who hear, but as they go on their way, they are choked by the worries, riches, and pleasures of this life, and their fruit does not mature.
8.kjv: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
8.blb: And the seed having fallen into the thorns, these are those having heard, and, going along, are choked under the anxieties and riches and pleasures of life, and they do not mature.
8.bbe: And those which went among thorns are those who have given hearing, and go on their way, but they are overcome by cares and wealth and the pleasures of life, and they give no fruit.

8.msb: But the seeds on good soil are those with a noble and good heart, who hear the word, cling to it, and by persevering produce a crop.
8.kjv: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
8.blb: And the seed in the good soil, these are those who, in a beautiful and good heart, having heard the word, hold it fast and bear fruit in perseverance.
8.bbe: And those in the good earth are those who, having given ear to the word, keep it with a good and true heart, and in quiet strength give fruit.

8.msb: No one lights a lamp and covers it with a jar or puts it under a bed. Instead, he sets it on a stand, so those who enter can see the light.
8.kjv: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
8.blb: And no one, having lit a lamp, covers it with a vessel or puts it under a bed. But he puts it on a lampstand, so that those entering may see the light.
8.bbe: No man, when the light is lighted, puts a cover over it, or puts it under a bed, but he puts it on its table, so that those who come in may see the light.
8.heading: The Lesson of the Lamp

8.msb: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be made known and brought to light.
8.kjv: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
8.blb: For nothing is hidden that will not become manifest, nor hidden away that shall not be known and come to visibility.
8.bbe: For nothing is put out of view which will not be made clear, and nothing is secret of which the knowledge will not come to light.

8.msb: Pay attention, therefore, to how you listen. Whoever has will be given more, but whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has will be taken away from him.”
8.kjv: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.
8.blb: Therefore look how you hear; for whoever may have, to him it will be given; and whoever may not have, even what he thinks to have will be taken away from him.”
8.bbe: So take care how you give hearing, for to him who has will be given, and from him who has not will be taken even what he seems to have.

8.msb: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers came to see Him, but they were unable to reach Him because of the crowd.
8.kjv: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
8.blb: Now His mother and brothers came to Him, and they were not able to get to Him because of the crowd.
8.bbe: And his mother and his brothers came to him, and they were not able to get near him because of the great number of people.
8.heading: Jesus’ Mother and Brothers

8.msb: He was told, “Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to see You.”
8.kjv: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
8.blb: And it was reported to Him, “Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside, wanting to see You.”
8.bbe: And someone said to him, Your mother and your brothers are outside desiring to see you.

8.msb: But He replied, “My mother and brothers are those who hear the word of God and carry it out.”
8.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.
8.blb: But answering, He said to them, “My mother and My brothers are those who are hearing and doing the word of God.”
8.bbe: But he said to them in answer, My mother and my brothers are those who have knowledge of the word of God and do it.

8.msb: One day Jesus said to His disciples, “Let us cross to the other side of the lake.” So He got into a boat with them and set out.
8.kjv: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
8.blb: And it came to pass on one of the days also that He and His disciples entered into a boat, and He said to them, “Let us pass over to the other side of the lake.” And they set out.
8.bbe: Now it came about on one of those days that he got into a boat with his disciples; and he said to them, Let us go over to the other side of the water: and they put out the boat.
8.heading: Jesus Calms the Storm

8.msb: As they sailed, He fell asleep, and a windstorm came down on the lake, so that the boat was being swamped, and they were in great danger.
8.kjv: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.
8.blb: And of their sailing, He fell asleep. And a storm of wind came down to the lake, and they were being swamped and were in danger.
8.bbe: But while they were sailing he went to sleep: and a storm of wind came down on the sea, and the boat became full of water and they were in danger.

8.msb: The disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Master, Master, we are perishing!” Then Jesus arose and rebuked the wind and the raging waters, and they subsided, and all was calm.
8.kjv: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
8.blb: And having come, they awoke Him, saying, “Master, Master, we are perishing!” And having arisen, He rebuked the wind and the raging of the water, and they ceased, and it became calm.
8.bbe: Then they came to him and, awaking him out of his sleep, said, Master, Master, destruction is near. And he, when he was awake, gave orders to the wind and the rolling waves, and the storm came to an end, and all was calm.

8.msb: “Where is your faith?” He asked. Frightened and amazed, they asked one another, “Who is this? He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey Him!”
8.kjv: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.
8.blb: And He said to them, “Where is your faith?” And having feared, they marveled, saying to one another, “Who then is this, that He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey Him?”
8.bbe: And he said to them, Where is your faith? And fear and wonder overcame them, and they said to one another, Who then is this, who gives orders even to the winds and the water and they do what he says?

8.msb: Then they sailed to the region of the Gadarenes, across the lake from Galilee.
8.kjv: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
8.blb: And they sailed down to the region of the Gerasenes, which is opposite Galilee.
8.bbe: And they came to the country of the Gerasenes, which is opposite Galilee.
8.heading: The Demons and the Pigs

8.msb: When Jesus stepped ashore, He was met by a man from the town who had been demon-possessed for a long time. This man had not worn clothing or lived in a house, but he stayed in the tombs.
8.kjv: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.
8.blb: And on His having gone out upon the land, a certain man out of the city met Him, having demons. And for a long time he was not wearing clothing and was not abiding in a house, but in the tombs.
8.bbe: And when he had come to the land, there came to him a certain man from the town who had evil spirits; and for a long time he had had no clothing on, and was not living in a house but in the place of the dead.

8.msb: When the man saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before Him, shouting in a loud voice, “What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You not to torture me!”
8.kjv: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.
8.blb: And having seen Jesus, having cried out, he fell down before Him and said in a loud voice, “What is it to me and to You, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You, do not torment me!”
8.bbe: And when he saw Jesus, he gave a loud cry and went down on the earth before him and in a loud voice said, What have I to do with you, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? Do not be cruel to me.

8.msb: For Jesus had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. Many times it had seized him, and though he was bound with chains and shackles, he had broken the chains and been driven by the demon into solitary places.
8.kjv: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
8.blb: For He commanded the unclean spirit to come out from the man. For many times it had seized him, and he was bound, being kept with chains and shackles. And breaking the bonds, he was driven by the demon into the wilderness.
8.bbe: For he gave an order to the evil spirit to come out of the man. For frequently it would take a grip of him: and he was kept under control, and prisoned with chains; but parting the chains in two, he would be sent by the driving of the evil spirit into waste places.

8.msb: “What is your name?” Jesus asked. “Legion,” he replied, because many demons had gone into him.
8.kjv: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
8.blb: And Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” And he said, “Legion,” because many demons were entered into him.
8.bbe: And Jesus said to him, What is your name? And he said, Legion; for a number of spirits had gone into him.

8.msb: And he kept begging Jesus not to order them to go into the Abyss.
8.kjv: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
8.blb: And they were imploring Him that He would not command them to go away into the Abyss.
8.bbe: And they made a request to him that he would not give them an order to go away into the deep.

8.msb: There on the hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding. So the demons begged Jesus to let them enter the pigs, and He gave them permission.
8.kjv: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.
8.blb: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they implored Him that He would allow them to enter into them, and He allowed them.
8.bbe: Now there was a great herd of pigs in that place, getting food on the mountain: and the evil spirits made a request to him that he would let them go into the pigs, and he let them.

8.msb: Then the demons came out of the man and went into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.
8.kjv: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
8.blb: And the demons, having gone out from the man, entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.
8.bbe: And the evil spirits came out of the man and went into the pigs: and the herd went rushing down a sharp slope into the water and came to destruction.

8.msb: When those tending the pigs saw what had happened, they ran off and reported this in the town and countryside.
8.kjv: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.
8.blb: And those feeding, having seen what had happened, fled and reported it to the city and to the fields.
8.bbe: And when the men who took care of them saw what had come about, they went quickly and gave news of it in the town and the country.

8.msb: So the people went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man whom the demons had left, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
8.kjv: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
8.blb: And they went out to see what had happened, and they came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons went out sitting, clothed and sound-minded, at the feet of Jesus. And they were afraid.
8.bbe: And they went out to see what had taken place, and they came to Jesus and saw the man out of whom the evil spirits had gone, seated, clothed and with full use of his senses, at the feet of Jesus; and fear came on them.

8.msb: Meanwhile, those who had seen it reported how the demon-possessed man had been healed.
8.kjv: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
8.blb: And those having seen related to them how the one having been possessed by demons was saved.
8.bbe: And those who had seen it gave them an account of how the man who had the evil spirits was made well.

8.msb: Then all the people of the region of the Gadarenes asked Jesus to depart from them, because great fear had taken hold of them. So He got into the boat and started back.
8.kjv: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.
8.blb: And all the multitude of the surrounding region of the Gerasenes asked Him to go away from them, because they were seized with great fear. And He, having entered into the boat, turned back.
8.bbe: And all the people of the country of the Gerasenes made a request to him to go away from them; for they were in great fear: and he got into a boat and went back.

8.msb: The man whom the demons had left begged to go with Jesus. But Jesus sent him away, saying,
8.kjv: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,
8.blb: But the man from whom the demons had gone out was begging Him to be with Him. But He sent him away, saying,
8.bbe: But the man from whom the evil spirits had gone out had a great desire to be with him, but he sent him away, saying,

8.msb: “Return home and describe how much God has done for you.” So the man went away and proclaimed all over the town how much Jesus had done for him.
8.kjv: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.
8.blb: “Return to your house and relate how much God did for you.” And he went away, proclaiming through the whole city how much Jesus did for him.
8.bbe: Go back to your house and let them have news of all the great things which God has done for you. And he went away, giving word through all the town of the great things which Jesus had done for him.

8.msb: When Jesus returned, the crowd welcomed Him, for they had all been waiting for Him.
8.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.
8.blb: And on the return of Jesus, the crowd welcomed Him, for they were all looking for Him.
8.bbe: And when Jesus went back, the people were glad to see him, for they were all waiting for him.
8.heading: The Healing Touch of Jesus

8.msb: Just then a synagogue leader named Jairus came and fell at Jesus’ feet. He begged Him to come to his house,
8.kjv: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus’ feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:
8.blb: And behold, there was a man whose name was Jairus, and this man was a ruler of the synagogue. And having fallen at the feet of Jesus, he was imploring Him to enter into his house
8.bbe: Then there came a man named Jairus, who was a ruler in the Synagogue: and he went down at the feet of Jesus, desiring him to come to his house;

8.msb: because his only daughter, who was about twelve, was dying. As Jesus went with him, the crowds pressed around Him,
8.kjv: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.
8.blb: because he had an only daughter, about twelve years old, and she was dying. And in His going, the crowds were pressing around Him.
8.bbe: For he had an only daughter, about twelve years old, and she was near to death. But while he was on his way, the people were pushing to be near him.

8.msb: including a woman who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years. She had spent all her money on physicians, but no one was able to heal her.
8.kjv: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,
8.blb: And a woman being with a flow of blood for twelve years, who, having spent all her living on physicians, was not able to be healed by any,
8.bbe: And a woman, who had had a flow of blood for twelve years, and had given all her money to medical men, and not one of them was able to make her well,

8.msb: She came up behind Jesus and touched the fringe of His cloak, and immediately her bleeding stopped.
8.kjv: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
8.blb: having come behind, touched the fringe of His garment, and immediately her flow of blood stopped.
8.bbe: Came after him and put her hand on the edge of his robe, and straight away the flowing of her blood was stopped.

8.msb: “Who touched Me?” Jesus asked. But they all denied it. “Master,” said Peter and those with him, “the people are crowding and pressing against You, and You say, ‘Who touched Me?’”
8.kjv: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
8.blb: And Jesus said, “Who is the one having touched Me?” But all denying, Peter said, “Master, the crowds surround You and press in.”
8.bbe: And Jesus said, Who was touching me? And when they all said, It is not I, Peter and those who were with him said, Master, the people are pushing round you on every side.

8.msb: But Jesus declared, “Someone touched Me, for I know that power has gone out from Me.”
8.kjv: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
8.blb: But Jesus said, “Someone touched Me, for I knew power has gone out from Me.”
8.bbe: But Jesus said, Someone was touching me, for I had the feeling that power had gone out from me.

8.msb: Then the woman, seeing that she could not escape notice, came trembling and fell down before Him. In the presence of all the people, she explained why she had touched Him and how she had immediately been healed.
8.kjv: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
8.blb: And the woman, having seen that she was not hidden, came trembling. And having fallen down before Him, she declared for what cause she touched Him before all the people, and how she was healed immediately.
8.bbe: And when the woman saw that she was not able to keep it secret, she came, shaking with fear, and falling down before him she made clear before all the people the reason for her touching him, and how she was made well straight away.

8.msb: “Take courage, daughter,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you. Go in peace.”
8.kjv: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
8.blb: And He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has saved you; go in peace.”
8.bbe: And he said to her, Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace.

8.msb: While He was still speaking, someone arrived from the house of the synagogue leader. “Your daughter is dead,” he told Jairus. “Do not bother the Teacher.”
8.kjv: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.
8.blb: of Him still speaking, someone comes from the synagogue ruler, saying, “Your daughter has died; trouble the Teacher no longer.”
8.bbe: While he was still talking, someone came from the house of the ruler of the Synagogue, saying, Your daughter is dead; do not go on troubling the Master.

8.msb: But Jesus overheard them and said to Jairus, “Do not be afraid; just believe, and she will be healed.”
8.kjv: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.
8.blb: But Jesus, having heard, answered him, “Do not be afraid; only believe, and she will be saved.”
8.bbe: But Jesus at these words said to him, Have no fear, only have faith, and she will be made well.

8.msb: When He entered the house, He did not allow anyone to go in except Peter, John, James, and the child’s father and mother.
8.kjv: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.
8.blb: And having come into the house, He did not allow anyone to enter with Him except Peter and John and James, and the father and the mother of the child.
8.bbe: And when he came to the house he did not let any man go in with him, but only Peter and John and James, and the father of the girl and her mother.

8.msb: Meanwhile, everyone was weeping and mourning for her. But Jesus said, “Stop weeping; she is not dead but asleep.”
8.kjv: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.
8.blb: And all were weeping and mourning for her. But He said, “Do not weep; for she did not die, but sleeps.”
8.bbe: And all the people were weeping and crying for her; but he said, Do not be sad, for she is not dead, but sleeping.

8.msb: And they laughed at Him, knowing that she was dead.
8.kjv: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
8.blb: And they were laughing at Him, knowing that she died.
8.bbe: And they were laughing at him, being certain that she was dead.

8.msb: But Jesus sent them all outside, took her by the hand, and called out, “Child, get up!”
8.kjv: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.
8.blb: And He, having taken hold of her hand, called out, saying, “Child, arise!”
8.bbe: But he, taking her hand, said to her, My child, get up.

8.msb: Her spirit returned, and at once she got up. And He directed that she be given something to eat.
8.kjv: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.
8.blb: And her spirit returned, and she arose immediately; and He directed there be given to her to eat.
8.bbe: And her spirit came back to her and she got up straight away: and he gave orders that food was to be given to her.

8.msb: Her parents were astounded, but Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened.
8.kjv: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.
8.blb: And her parents were amazed, but He instructed them to tell no one what had happened.
8.bbe: And her father and mother were full of wonder, but he gave orders to them to say nothing about it to anyone.

9.msb: Then Jesus called the Twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and power to cure diseases.
9.kjv: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.
9.blb: And having called together the Twelve, He gave to them power and authority over all the demons, and to heal diseases,
9.bbe: And getting the twelve together, he gave them power and authority over all evil spirits and over diseases, to make them well.
9.heading: The Ministry of the Twelve

9.msb: And He sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
9.kjv: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
9.blb: and He sent them forth to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
9.bbe: And he sent them out to be preachers of the kingdom of God, and to make well those who were ill.

9.msb: “Take nothing for the journey,” He told them, “no staffs, no bag, no bread, no money, no second tunic.
9.kjv: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.
9.blb: And He said to them, “Take nothing for the way, neither staff, nor bag, nor bread, nor silver, nor two tunics apiece to have.
9.bbe: And he said to them, Take nothing for your journey, no stick or bag or bread or money, and do not take two coats.

9.msb: Whatever house you enter, stay there until you leave that area.
9.kjv: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.
9.blb: And into whatever house you may enter, remain there and go out from there.
9.bbe: And if you go into a house, let that house be your resting-place till you go away.

9.msb: If anyone does not welcome you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that town, as a testimony against them.”
9.kjv: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
9.blb: And as many as may not receive you, going out from that city, shake off the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”
9.bbe: And if any people will not take you in, when you go away from that town, put off its dust from your feet for a witness against them.

9.msb: So they set out and went from village to village, preaching the gospel and healing people everywhere.
9.kjv: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.
9.blb: And going out, they were passing through the villages, proclaiming the gospel and healing everywhere.
9.bbe: And they went away, journeying through all the towns, preaching the good news and making people free from diseases in all places.

9.msb: When Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was being done by Him, he was perplexed. For some were saying that John had risen from the dead,
9.kjv: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;
9.blb: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all the things happening, and he was perplexed because it was said by some that John was risen out from the dead,
9.bbe: Now Herod the king had news of all these things: and he was in doubt, because it was said by some people that John had come back from the dead;
9.heading: Herod Tries to See Jesus

9.msb: others that Elijah had appeared, and still others that a prophet of old had arisen.
9.kjv: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
9.blb: and by some that Elijah appeared, and by others that a prophet of the ancients was risen.
9.bbe: And by some, that Elijah had come; and by others, that one of the old prophets had come back to life.

9.msb: “I beheaded John,” Herod said, “but who is this man I hear such things about?” And he kept trying to see Jesus.
9.kjv: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.
9.blb: And Herod said, “John I beheaded, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” And he was seeking to see Him.
9.bbe: And Herod said, I put John to death: but who is this, of whom such stories are given to me? And he had a desire to see him.

9.msb: Then the apostles returned and reported to Jesus all that they had done. Taking them away privately, He withdrew to a deserted place of the city called Bethsaida.
9.kjv: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
9.blb: And having returned, the apostles related to Him how much they had done. And having taken them, He withdrew by Himself to a city called Bethsaida.
9.bbe: And the twelve, when they came back, gave him an account of what they had done. And he took them with him and went away from the people to a town named Beth-saida.
9.heading: The Feeding of the Five Thousand

9.msb: But the crowds found out and followed Him. He welcomed them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and He healed those who needed healing.
9.kjv: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.
9.blb: But the crowds, having known it, followed Him; and having received them, He was speaking to them concerning the kingdom of God, and He was healing those having need of healing.
9.bbe: But the people, getting news of it, went after him: and he was pleased to see them, and gave them teaching about the kingdom of God, and made those well who were in need of it.

9.msb: As the day neared its end, the Twelve came to Jesus and said, “Dismiss the crowd so they can go to the surrounding villages and countryside for lodging and provisions. For we are in a desolate place here.”
9.kjv: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.
9.blb: And the day began to decline, and having come, the Twelve said to Him, “Dismiss the crowd so that, having gone to the surrounding villages and fields, they might lodge and might find provisions; for we are in a wilderness place here.”
9.bbe: And the day went on; and the twelve came to him and said, Send these people away so that they may go into the towns and the country round about and get resting-places and food for themselves, for we are in a waste place.

9.msb: But Jesus told them, “You give them something to eat.” “We have only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered, “unless we go and buy food for all these people.”
9.kjv: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.
9.blb: But He said to them, “You give to them to eat.” But they said, “There are unto us no more than five loaves and two fish, unless, having gone, we should buy food for all this people.”
9.bbe: But he said, Give them food yourselves. And they said, We have only five cakes of bread and two fishes, if we do not go and get food for all these people.

9.msb: (There were about five thousand men.) He told His disciples, “Have them sit down in groups of fifty each.”
9.kjv: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.
9.blb: For they were about five thousand men. And He said to His disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty.”
9.bbe: For there were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them be seated in groups, about fifty to a group.

9.msb: They did so, and everyone was seated.
9.kjv: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
9.blb: And they did so and made all sit down.
9.bbe: And they did so, and made them all be seated.

9.msb: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, Jesus spoke a blessing and broke them. Then He gave them to the disciples to set before the people.
9.kjv: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
9.blb: And having taken the five loaves and the two fish, having looked up to the heaven, He blessed and broke them, and He was giving them to the disciples to set before the crowd.
9.bbe: And he took the five cakes of bread and the two fishes and, looking up to heaven, he said words of blessing over them, and when they had been broken, he gave them to the disciples to give to the people.

9.msb: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
9.kjv: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.
9.blb: And they all ate and were satisfied; and that having superabounded to them was taken up, twelve hand-baskets of fragments.
9.bbe: And they all took the food and had enough; and they took up of the broken bits which were over, twelve baskets full.

9.msb: One day as Jesus was praying in private and the disciples were with Him, He questioned them: “Who do the crowds say I am?”
9.kjv: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?
9.blb: And it came to pass as He is praying alone that the disciples were with Him, and He questioned them, saying, “Who do the crowds say I am?”
9.bbe: And it came about that when he was in prayer, by himself, and the disciples were with him, he put a question to them, saying, Who do the people say I am?
9.heading: Peter’s Confession of Christ

9.msb: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, that a prophet of old has arisen.”
9.kjv: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
9.blb: And answering, they said, “John the Baptist; and others, Elijah; and others, that a prophet, one of the ancients, was risen.”
9.bbe: And they, answering, said, John the Baptist; but others say Elijah; and others, that one of the old prophets has come back.

9.msb: “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”
9.kjv: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
9.blb: And He said to them, “But you, who do you say I am?” And answering, Peter said, “The Christ of God.”
9.bbe: And he said, But who do you say that I am? And Peter, answering, said, The Christ of God.

9.msb: Jesus strictly warned them not to tell this to anyone.
9.kjv: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;
9.blb: And having warned them, He instructed them to say this to no one,
9.bbe: But he gave them special orders, not to say this to any man;
9.heading: Christ’s Passion Foretold

9.msb: “The Son of Man must suffer many things,” He said. “He must be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and He must be killed and on the third day rise again.”
9.kjv: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.
9.blb: having said, “It is necessary for the Son of Man to suffer many things, and to be rejected by the elders and chief priests and scribes, and to be killed, and on the third day to be raised.”
9.bbe: Saying, The Son of man will undergo much and be put on one side by the rulers and the chief priests and the teachers of the law, and be put to death, and on the third day he will come back to life.

9.msb: Then Jesus said to all of them, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
9.kjv: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
9.blb: And He was saying to all, “If anyone wants to come after Me, let him deny himself and take up his cross every day and follow Me.
9.bbe: And he said to them all, If any man has a desire to come after me, let him give up all, and take up his cross every day, and come after me.
9.heading: Take Up Your Cross

9.msb: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will save it.
9.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
9.blb: For whoever may want to save his life will lose it, but whoever may lose his life on account of Me, he will save it.
9.bbe: For whoever has a desire to keep his life will have it taken from him, but whoever gives up his life because of me, will keep it.

9.msb: What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet lose or forfeit his very self?
9.kjv: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?
9.blb: For what is a man profited, having gained the whole world, and having destroyed or having suffered the loss of himself?
9.bbe: For what profit will a man have if he gets all the world, but undergoes loss or destruction himself?

9.msb: If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when He comes in His glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.
9.kjv: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father’s, and of the holy angels.
9.blb: For whoever may be ashamed of Me and My words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when He shall come in His glory and that of the Father and of the holy angels.
9.bbe: For if any man has a feeling of shame because of me or of my words, the Son of man will have shame because of him when he comes in his glory and the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.

9.msb: But I tell you truly, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God.”
9.kjv: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
9.blb: And I say to you, truly, there are some of those standing here who shall not taste of death until they shall see the kingdom of God.”
9.bbe: But truly I say to you, Some of those who are here now will have no taste of death till they see the kingdom of God.

9.msb: About eight days after Jesus had said these things, He took with Him Peter, John, and James, and went up on a mountain to pray.
9.kjv: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.
9.blb: And it came to pass about eight days after these words, and having taken with Him Peter and John and James, that He went up onto the mountain to pray.
9.bbe: And about eight days after he had said these things, he took Peter and John and James with him and went up into the mountain for prayer.
9.heading: The Transfiguration

9.msb: And as He was praying, the appearance of His face changed, and His clothes became radiantly white.
9.kjv: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.
9.blb: And it came to pass in His praying that the appearance of His face was different and His clothing white, flashing forth.
9.bbe: And while he was in prayer, his face was changed and his clothing became white and shining.

9.msb: Suddenly two men, Moses and Elijah, began talking with Jesus.
9.kjv: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:
9.blb: And behold, two men were talking with Him, who were Moses and Elijah,
9.bbe: And two men, Moses and Elijah, were talking with him;

9.msb: They appeared in glory and spoke about His departure, which He was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
9.kjv: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.
9.blb: who, having appeared in glory, were speaking of His departure, which He was about to fulfill in Jerusalem.
9.bbe: Who were seen in glory and were talking of his death which was about to take place in Jerusalem.

9.msb: Meanwhile Peter and his companions were overcome by sleep, but when they awoke, they saw Jesus’ glory and the two men standing with Him.
9.kjv: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
9.blb: And Peter and those with him were heavy with sleep; and having awoken fully, they saw His glory and the two men standing with Him.
9.bbe: Now Peter and those who were with him were overcome with sleep: but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory and the two men who were with him.

9.msb: As Moses and Elijah were leaving, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.” (He did not know what he was saying.)
9.kjv: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.
9.blb: And it came to pass in their departing from Him that Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here; and let us make three tabernacles—one for You, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he is saying.
9.bbe: And when they were about to go away from him, Peter said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here; let us make three tents, one for you and one for Moses and one for Elijah: having no knowledge of what he was saying.

9.msb: While Peter was speaking, a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.
9.kjv: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
9.blb: And in his saying these things, there was a cloud, and it was overshadowing them; and they feared in their entering into the cloud.
9.bbe: And while he said these things, the shade of a cloud came over them, and they were full of fear when they went into the cloud.

9.msb: And a voice came from the cloud, saying, “This is My beloved Son. Listen to Him!”
9.kjv: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
9.blb: And a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is My Son, whom I have chosen; listen to Him!”
9.bbe: And there was a voice from the cloud saying, This is my Son, the man of my selection; give ear to him.

9.msb: After the voice had spoken, only Jesus was present with them. The disciples kept this to themselves, and in those days they did not tell anyone what they had seen.
9.kjv: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.
9.blb: And on the voice having come, Jesus was found alone. And they were silent, and they reported to no one in those days anything of what they have seen.
9.bbe: And after the voice was gone they saw that Jesus was by himself. And they kept quiet, and said nothing at that time to anyone of the things which they had seen.

9.msb: The next day, when they came down from the mountain, Jesus was met by a large crowd.
9.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.
9.blb: And it came to pass the next day, on their having come down from the mountain, that a great crowd met Him.
9.bbe: And on the day after, when they came down from the mountain, a great band of people came to him.
9.heading: The Boy with an Evil Spirit

9.msb: Suddenly a man in the crowd cried out, “Teacher, I beg You to look at my son, for he is my only child.
9.kjv: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.
9.blb: And behold, a man from the crowd cried out, saying, “Teacher, I implore You to look upon my son, because he is the only begotten unto me.
9.bbe: And a man from among them, crying out, said, Master, I make a request to you, give a thought to my son, for he is my only child:

9.msb: A spirit keeps seizing him, and he screams abruptly. It throws him into convulsions so that he foams at the mouth. It keeps mauling him and rarely departs from him.
9.kjv: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.
9.blb: And behold, a spirit takes him, and suddenly he cries out, and it throws him into convulsions with foaming, and with difficulty it departs from him, crushing him.
9.bbe: And see, a spirit takes him, and suddenly he gives a cry, twisted in pain and streaming at the lips, and when it goes away from him at last, he is marked as from blows.

9.msb: I begged Your disciples to drive it out, but they were unable.”
9.kjv: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.
9.blb: And I begged Your disciples that they might cast it out, and they were not able.”
9.bbe: And I made a request to your disciples to send it out of him, but they were not able to do it.

9.msb: “O unbelieving and perverse generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you and put up with you? Bring your son here.”
9.kjv: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.
9.blb: And answering, Jesus said, “O unbelieving and perverse generation, until when will I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”
9.bbe: And Jesus said, O generation without faith and false in heart, how long will I have to be with you and put up with you? let your son come here.

9.msb: Even while the boy was approaching, the demon slammed him to the ground in a convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.
9.kjv: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
9.blb: And in his still coming near, the demon threw him down and threw him into convulsions. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and He healed the boy and gave him back to his father.
9.bbe: And while he was coming, he was pushed violently down and twisted by the evil spirit. But Jesus gave sharp orders to the unclean spirit, and made the boy well, and gave him back to his father.

9.msb: And they were all astonished at the greatness of God. While everyone was marveling at all that Jesus had done, He said to His disciples,
9.kjv: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,
9.blb: And all were astonished at the majesty of God. But of all wondering at all that He was doing, He said to His disciples,
9.bbe: And they were full of wonder at the great power of God. But while they were all wondering at all the things which he did, he said to his disciples,
9.heading: The Second Prediction of the Passion

9.msb: “Let these words sink into your ears: The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men.”
9.kjv: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
9.blb: “You let these words sink into your ears; for the Son of Man is about to be betrayed into the hands of men.”
9.bbe: Let these words go deep into your ears, for the Son of man will be given up into the hands of men.

9.msb: But they did not understand this statement. It was veiled from them so that they could not comprehend it, and they were afraid to ask Him about it.
9.kjv: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.
9.blb: But they were not knowing this saying, and it was veiled from them, so that they should not understand it. And they were afraid to ask Him about this saying.
9.bbe: But this saying was not clear to them and its sense was kept secret from them so that they were not able to see it: and they had fear of questioning him about it.

9.msb: Then an argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.
9.kjv: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.
9.blb: And a reasoning entered among them, who might be the greater of them.
9.bbe: Now there was a discussion among them about which of them would be the greatest.
9.heading: The Greatest in the Kingdom

9.msb: But Jesus, seeing the thoughts of their hearts, had a little child stand beside Him.
9.kjv: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,
9.blb: But Jesus, having known the reasoning of their heart, having taken hold of a little child, set him beside Himself,
9.bbe: But when Jesus saw the reasoning of their hearts, he took a small child and put him by his side,

9.msb: And He said to them, “Whoever welcomes this little child in My name welcomes Me, and whoever welcomes Me welcomes the One who sent Me. For whoever is the least among all of you, he will be the greatest.”
9.kjv: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.
9.blb: and He said to them, “Whoever shall receive this little child in My name receives Me; and whoever shall receive Me receives the One having sent Me. For the one being least among you all, he is great.”
9.bbe: And said to them, Whoever gives honour to this child in my name, gives honour to me: and whoever gives honour to me, gives honour to him who sent me: for whoever is least among you all, that man is great.

9.msb: “Master,” said John, “we saw someone driving out demons in Your name, and we tried to stop him, because he does not accompany us.”
9.kjv: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.
9.blb: And answering, John said, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in Your name, and we were forbidding him because he does not follow with us.”
9.bbe: And John, answering, said, Master, we saw a man driving out evil spirits in your name, and we did not let him do it, because he was not one of us.

9.msb: “Do not stop him,” Jesus replied, “for whoever is not against us is for us.”
9.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.
9.blb: And Jesus said to him, “Do not forbid it; for whoever is not against you is for you.”
9.bbe: But Jesus said to him, Let him do it, for he who is not against you is for you.

9.msb: As the day of His ascension approached, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem.
9.kjv: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
9.blb: And it came to pass in the completing of the days of His being taken up that He steadfastly set the face to go to Jerusalem.
9.bbe: And it came about that when the days were near for him to be taken up, his face was turned to go to Jerusalem,
9.heading: The Samaritans Reject Jesus

9.msb: He sent messengers on ahead, who went into a village of the Samaritans to make arrangements for Him.
9.kjv: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
9.blb: And He sent messengers before His face, and having gone, they entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for Him.
9.bbe: And he sent men before: and they came to a small town of Samaria to make ready for him.

9.msb: But the people there refused to welcome Him, because He was heading for Jerusalem.
9.kjv: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
9.blb: And they did not receive Him, because His face was going to Jerusalem.
9.bbe: But they would not have him there, because he was clearly going to Jerusalem.

9.msb: When His disciples James and John saw this, they asked, “Lord, do You want us to call down fire from heaven to consume them, just as Elijah did?”
9.kjv: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
9.blb: And having seen it, the disciples James and John said, “Lord, do You want that we should call fire to come down from heaven and to consume them?”
9.bbe: And when his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, Lord, may we send fire from heaven and put an end to them?

9.msb: But Jesus turned and rebuked them and said, “You do not know what kind of spirit you are.
9.kjv: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.
9.blb: But having turned, He rebuked them,
9.bbe: But turning round he said sharp words to them.

9.msb: For the Son of Man did not come to destroy the lives of men, but to save them.” And He and His disciples went on to another village.
9.kjv: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.
9.blb: and they went to another village.
9.bbe: And they went to another small town.

9.msb: As they were walking along the road, someone said to Jesus, “Lord, I will follow You wherever You go.”
9.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
9.blb: And in their going along the road, someone said to Him, “I will follow You wherever You may go.”
9.bbe: And when they were on the way, a certain man said to him, I will come after you wherever you go.
9.heading: The Cost of Discipleship

9.msb: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”
9.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
9.blb: And Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere He might lay the head.”
9.bbe: And Jesus said to him, Foxes have holes and the birds of the air have resting-places, but the Son of man has nowhere to put his head.

9.msb: Then He said to another man, “Follow Me.” The man replied, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”
9.kjv: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
9.blb: And He said to another, “Follow Me.” But he said, “Lord, allow me first, having gone away, to bury my father.”
9.bbe: And he said to another, Come after me. But he said, Lord, let me first go and give the last honours to my father.

9.msb: But Jesus told him, “Let the dead bury their own dead. You, however, go and proclaim the kingdom of God.”
9.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.
9.blb: But He said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead; but you, having gone away, declare the kingdom of God.”
9.bbe: But he said to him, Let the dead take care of their dead; it is for you to go and give news of the kingdom of God.

9.msb: Still another said, “I will follow You, Lord; but first let me bid farewell to my family.”
9.kjv: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.
9.blb: And yet another said, “I will follow You, Lord; but first allow me to bid farewell to those at my home.”
9.bbe: And another man said, I will come with you, Lord, but first let me say a last good-day to those who are at my house.

9.msb: Then Jesus declared, “No one who puts his hand to the plow and then looks back is fit for the kingdom of God.”
9.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
9.blb: But Jesus said to him, “No one having laid the hand upon the plow and looking to the things behind is fit for the kingdom of God.”
9.bbe: But Jesus said, No man, having put his hand to the plough and looking back, is good enough for the kingdom of God.

10.msb: After this, the Lord appointed seventy others and sent them two by two ahead of Him to every town and place He was about to visit.
10.kjv: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
10.blb: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy-two others and sent them in two by two before His face into every city and place where He Himself was about to go.
10.bbe: Now after these things, the Lord made selection of seventy others and sent them before him, two together, into every town and place where he himself was about to come.
10.heading: Jesus Sends the Seventy-Two

10.msb: Therefore He told them, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into His harvest.
10.kjv: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
10.blb: And He was saying to them, “The harvest indeed is much, but the workers few. Therefore implore the Lord of the harvest that He might put forth workers into His harvest.
10.bbe: And he said to them, There is much grain ready to be cut, but not enough workers: so make prayer to the Lord of the grain-fields that he will send workers to get in the grain.

10.msb: Go! I am sending you out like lambs among wolves.
10.kjv: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
10.blb: Go! Behold, I send you forth as lambs in the midst of wolves.
10.bbe: Go on your way: see, I send you out like lambs among wolves.

10.msb: Carry no purse or bag or sandals. Do not greet anyone along the road.
10.kjv: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
10.blb: Carry no purse, no bag, no sandals; and greet no one on the road.
10.bbe: Take no bag for money or for food, and no shoes; say no word to any man on the way.

10.msb: Whatever house you enter, begin by saying, ‘Peace to this house.’
10.kjv: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
10.blb: And into whatever house you might enter, first say, ‘Peace to this house.’
10.bbe: And whenever you go into a house, first say, Peace be to this house.

10.msb: If a man of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; if not, it will return to you.
10.kjv: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
10.blb: And if a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
10.bbe: And if a son of peace is there, your peace will be with him: but if not, it will come back to you again.

10.msb: Stay at the same house, eating and drinking whatever you are offered. For the worker is worthy of his wages. Do not move around from house to house.
10.kjv: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
10.blb: And remain in the same house, eating and drinking the things unto them; for the worker is worthy of his wages. Do not move from house to house.
10.bbe: And keep in that same house, taking what food and drink they give you: for the worker has a right to his reward. Do not go from house to house.

10.msb: If you enter a town and they welcome you, eat whatever is set before you.
10.kjv: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
10.blb: And into whatever city you may enter and they may receive you, eat the things set before you.
10.bbe: And into whatever town you go, if they take you in, take whatever food is given to you:

10.msb: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘The kingdom of God is near you.’
10.kjv: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
10.blb: And heal the ailing in it, and say to them, ‘The kingdom of God has drawn near to you.’
10.bbe: And make well those in it who are ill and say to them, The kingdom of God is near to you.

10.msb: But if you enter a town and they do not welcome you, go into the streets and declare,
10.kjv: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,
10.blb: But into whatever city you might enter and they may not receive you, having gone out into its streets, say,
10.bbe: But if you go into a town where they will not have you, go out into the streets of it and say,

10.msb: ‘Even the dust of your town that clings to us, we wipe off as a testimony against you. Yet be sure of this: The kingdom of God is near to you.’
10.kjv: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
10.blb: ‘Even the dust of your city having clung to our feet we wipe off against you; yet know this, that the kingdom of God has drawn near.’
10.bbe: Even the dust of your town, which is on our feet, we put off as a witness against you; but be certain of this, that the kingdom of God is near.

10.msb: I tell you, it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that town.
10.kjv: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
10.blb: I say to you that for Sodom in that day it will be more bearable than for that city.
10.bbe: I say to you, It will be better in that day for Sodom than for that town.

10.msb: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
10.kjv: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
10.blb: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles having happened in you had happened in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
10.bbe: A curse is on you, Chorazin! A curse is on you, Beth-saida! For if such works of power had been done in Tyre and Sidon as have been done in you, they would have been turned from their sins, in days gone by, seated in the dust.
10.heading: Woe to the Unrepentant

10.msb: But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.
10.kjv: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
10.blb: But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.
10.bbe: But it will be better for Tyre and Sidon, in the day of judging, than for you.

10.msb: And you, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades!
10.kjv: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.
10.blb: And you, Capernaum, to heaven will you be lifted up? To Hades you will be brought down!
10.bbe: And you, Capernaum, were you not lifted up to heaven? you will go down to hell.

10.msb: Whoever listens to you listens to Me; whoever rejects you rejects Me; and whoever rejects Me rejects the One who sent Me.”
10.kjv: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.
10.blb: The one hearing you hears Me, and the one setting you aside sets Me aside, and the one setting Me aside sets aside the One having sent Me.”
10.bbe: Whoever gives ear to you, gives ear to me; and whoever is against you, is against me; and whoever is against me, is against him who sent me.

10.msb: The seventy returned with joy and said, “Lord, even the demons submit to us in Your name.”
10.kjv: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
10.blb: And the seventy-two returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in Your name.”
10.bbe: And the seventy came back with joy, saying, Lord, even the evil spirits are under our power in your name.
10.heading: The Joyful Return

10.msb: So He told them, “I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.
10.kjv: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.
10.blb: And He said to them, “I was beholding Satan having fallen like lightning out of heaven.
10.bbe: And he said, I was watching for Satan, falling from heaven like a star.

10.msb: Behold, I am giving you authority to tread on snakes and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will harm you.
10.kjv: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
10.blb: Behold, I have given you the authority to tread upon serpents and scorpions, and on all the power of the enemy, and nothing will injure you.
