10.bbe: See, I have given you power to put your feet on snakes and evil beasts, and over all the strength of him who is against you: and nothing will do you damage.

10.msb: Nevertheless, do not rejoice that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”
10.kjv: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
10.blb: But do not rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you; but rejoice that your names have been written in the heavens.”
10.bbe: Do not be glad, however, because you have power over spirits, but because your names are recorded in heaven.

10.msb: At that time Jesus rejoiced in the Spirit and declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.”
10.kjv: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.
10.blb: In the same hour, He exulted in the Holy Spirit and said, “I acknowledge You, Father, Lord of heaven and of the earth, because You hid away these things from the wise and intelligent, and You revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, because of thus it was good pleasure before You.
10.bbe: In that same hour he was full of joy in the Holy Spirit and said, I give praise to you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have kept these things secret from the wise and the men of learning, and have made them clear to little children: for so, O Father, it was pleasing in your eyes.
10.heading: Jesus’ Prayer of Thanksgiving

10.msb: And turning to the disciples, He said, “All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.”
10.kjv: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.
10.blb: All things were delivered to Me by My Father. And no one knows who the Son is except the Father, and who the Father is except the Son and the one to whom the Son may resolve to reveal Him.”
10.bbe: All things have been given to me by my Father: and no one has knowledge of the Son, but only the Father: and of the Father, but only the Son, and he to whom the Son will make it clear.

10.msb: Then Jesus turned to the disciples and said privately, “Blessed are the eyes that see what you see.
10.kjv: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:
10.blb: And having turned to the disciples, He said in private, “Blessed are the eyes seeing what you see.
10.bbe: And, turning to the disciples, he said privately, Happy are the eyes which see the things you see:

10.msb: For I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.”
10.kjv: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
10.blb: For I say to you that many prophets and kings desired to see what you see and did not see, and to hear what you hear and did not hear.”
10.bbe: For I say to you that numbers of prophets and kings have had a desire to see the things which you see, and have not seen them, and to have knowledge of the things which have come to your ears, and they had it not.

10.msb: One day an expert in the law stood up to test Him. “Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
10.kjv: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
10.blb: And behold, a certain lawyer rose up, testing Him, saying, “Teacher, having done what, will I inherit eternal life?”
10.bbe: And a certain teacher of the law got up and put him to the test, saying, Master, what have I to do so that I may have eternal life?
10.heading: The Parable of the Good Samaritan

10.msb: “What is written in the Law?” Jesus replied. “How do you read it?”
10.kjv: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
10.blb: And He said to him, “What has been written in the Law? How do you read it?”
10.bbe: And he said to him, What does the law say, in your reading of it?

10.msb: He answered, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind’ and ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’”
10.kjv: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
10.blb: And answering, he said, “‘You will love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind,’ and ‘your neighbor as yourself.’”
10.bbe: And he, answering, said, Have love for the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind; and for your neighbour as for yourself.

10.msb: “You have answered correctly,” Jesus said. “Do this and you will live.”
10.kjv: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
10.blb: And He said to him, “You answered correctly. Do this and you will live.”
10.bbe: And he said, You have given the right answer: do this and you will have life.

10.msb: But wanting to justify himself, he asked Jesus, “And who is my neighbor?”
10.kjv: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?
10.blb: But wanting to justify himself, he said to Jesus, “And who is my neighbor?”
10.bbe: But he, desiring to put himself in the right, said to Jesus, And who is my neighbour?

10.msb: Jesus took up this question and said, “A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho when he fell into the hands of robbers. They stripped him, beat him, and went away, leaving him half dead.
10.kjv: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
10.blb: And Jesus, having taken it up, said, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho and fell among robbers who, having both stripped him and having inflicted wounds, went away, having left him half dead.
10.bbe: And Jesus, answering him, said, A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he got into the hands of thieves, who took his clothing and gave him cruel blows, and when they went away, he was half dead.

10.msb: Now by chance a priest was going down the same road, but when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
10.kjv: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
10.blb: Now by chance a certain priest was going down on that road, and having seen him, he passed by on the opposite side.
10.bbe: And by chance a certain priest was going down that way: and when he saw him, he went by on the other side.

10.msb: So too, when a Levite came to that spot and saw him, he passed by on the other side.
10.kjv: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.
10.blb: And likewise also a Levite, having come to the place and having seen, passed by on the opposite side.
10.bbe: And in the same way, a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, went by on the other side.

10.msb: But a Samaritan on a journey came upon him, and when he saw him, he had compassion.
10.kjv: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
10.blb: But a certain Samaritan, journeying, came to him, and having seen, he was moved with compassion;
10.bbe: But a certain man of Samaria, journeying that way, came where he was, and when he saw him, he was moved with pity for him,

10.msb: He went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he put him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
10.kjv: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
10.blb: and having come, he bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine; and having put him on his own beast, he brought him to an inn and took care of him.
10.bbe: And came to him and put clean linen round his wounds, with oil and wine; and he put him on his beast and took him to a house and took care of him.

10.msb: The next day when he departed he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper. ‘Take care of him,’ he said, ‘and on my return I will repay you for any additional expense.’
10.kjv: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
10.blb: And on the next day, having taken out two denarii, he gave them to the innkeeper and said, ‘Take care of him, and whatever more you might expend, I, in my returning, will repay you.’
10.bbe: And the day after he took two pennies and gave them to the owner of the house and said, Take care of him; and if this money is not enough, when I come again I will give you whatever more is needed.

10.msb: So which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?”
10.kjv: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?
10.blb: Which of these three seems to you to have been a neighbor of the one having fallen among the robbers?”
10.bbe: Which of these three men, in your opinion, was neighbour to the man who came into the hands of thieves?

10.msb: “The one who showed him mercy,” replied the expert in the law. Then Jesus told him, “Go and do likewise.”
10.kjv: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
10.blb: And he said, “The one having done the mercy toward him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go, and you do likewise.”
10.bbe: And he said, The one who had mercy on him. And Jesus said, Go and do the same.

10.msb: As they traveled along, Jesus entered a village where a woman named Martha welcomed Him into her home.
10.kjv: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
10.blb: Now in their going, He entered into a certain village; and a certain woman named Martha received Him into her house.
10.bbe: Now, while they were on their way, he came to a certain town; and a woman named Martha took him into her house.
10.heading: Martha and Mary

10.msb: She had a sister named Mary, who sat at Jesus’ feet listening to His message.
10.kjv: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.
10.blb: And she had a sister called Mary, who also, having sat down at the feet of the Lord, was hearing His word.
10.bbe: And she had a sister, by name Mary, who took her seat at the Lord's feet and gave attention to his words.

10.msb: But Martha was distracted by all the preparations to be made. She came to Jesus and said, “Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? Tell her to help me!”
10.kjv: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
10.blb: But Martha was distracted about much service; and having stood, she said, “Lord, is it not concerning to You that my sister left me alone to serve? Therefore speak to her so that she might help me!”
10.bbe: But Martha had her hands full of the work of the house, and she came to him and said, Lord, is it nothing to you that my sister has let me do all the work? Say to her that she is to give me some help.

10.msb: “Martha, Martha,” Jesus replied, “you are worried and troubled about many things.
10.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
10.blb: And answering, the Lord said to her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things;
10.bbe: But the Lord, answering, said to her, Martha, Martha, you are full of care and troubled about such a number of things:

10.msb: But only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the good portion, and it will not be taken away from her.”
10.kjv: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
10.blb: but little is necessary, or one thing; for Mary chose the good portion, which will not be taken away from her.”
10.bbe: Little is needed, or even one thing only: for Mary has taken that good part, which will not be taken away from her.

11.msb: One day in a place where Jesus had just finished praying, one of His disciples requested, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples.”
11.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
11.blb: And it came to pass in His being in a certain place praying, that when He ceased, one of His disciples said to Him, “Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.”
11.bbe: And it came about that he was in prayer in a certain place, and when he came to an end, one of his disciples said to him, Lord, will you give us teaching about prayer, as John did to his disciples?
11.heading: The Lord’s Prayer

11.msb: So Jesus told them, “When you pray, say: ‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come, Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
11.kjv: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
11.blb: And He said to them, “When you pray, say: ‘Father, hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come.
11.bbe: And he said to them, When you say your prayers, say, Father, may your name be kept holy and your kingdom come.

11.msb: Give us each day our daily bread.
11.kjv: Give us day by day our daily bread.
11.blb: Give us each day our necessary bread.
11.bbe: Give us every day bread for our needs.

11.msb: And forgive us our sins, for we also forgive everyone who sins against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”
11.kjv: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.
11.blb: And forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation.’”
11.bbe: May we have forgiveness for our sins, as we make free all those who are in debt to us. And let us not be put to the test.

11.msb: Then Jesus said to them, “Suppose one of you goes to his friend at midnight and says, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
11.kjv: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
11.blb: And He said to them, “Who of you will have a friend and will go to him at midnight and would say to him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves,
11.bbe: And he said to them, Which of you, having a friend, would go to him in the middle of the night and say to him, Friend, let me have three cakes of bread;
11.heading: Ask, Seek, Knock

11.msb: because a friend has come to me on a journey, and I have nothing to set before him.’
11.kjv: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?
11.blb: since a friend of mine came to me from a journey, and I have nothing that I will set before him.’?
11.bbe: Because a friend of mine has come to me on a journey, and I have nothing to put before him;

11.msb: And suppose the one inside answers, ‘Do not bother me. My door is already shut, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you anything.’
11.kjv: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.
11.blb: And he, answering from within, may say, ‘Do not cause me trouble; already the door has been shut, and my children are with me in the bed. I am not able, having risen up, to give to you.’
11.bbe: And he, from inside the house, would say in answer, Do not be a trouble to me; the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; it is not possible for me to get up and give to you?

11.msb: I tell you, even though he will not get up to provide for him because of his friendship, yet because of the man’s persistence, he will get up and give him as much as he needs.
11.kjv: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
11.blb: I say to you, even if he will not give to him, having risen up because of being his friend, yet because of his persistence, having risen, he will give him as much as he needs.
11.bbe: I say to you, Though he will not get up and give to him, because he is his friend, still, if he keeps on making his request, he will get up and give him as much as he has need of.

11.msb: So I tell you: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
11.kjv: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
11.blb: And I say to you: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.
11.bbe: And I say to you, Make requests, and they will be answered; what you are searching for, you will get; when you give the sign, the door will be open to you.

11.msb: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
11.kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
11.blb: For everyone asking receives; and the one seeking finds; and to the one knocking, it will be opened.
11.bbe: For to everyone who makes a request, it will be given; and he who is searching will get his desire; and to him who gives the sign, the door will be open.

11.msb: What father among you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?
11.kjv: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
11.blb: And which father of you, if the son will ask for a fish, instead of even a fish, will give to him a serpent?
11.bbe: And which of you, being a father, will give a stone to his son, who makes request for bread? or for a fish, will give him a snake?

11.msb: Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?
11.kjv: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
11.blb: Or also, if he will ask for an egg, will give to him a scorpion?
11.bbe: Or for an egg, will give him a scorpion?

11.msb: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!”
11.kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
11.blb: Therefore if you, being evil, know to give good gifts to your children, how much more will the Father who is from heaven give the Holy Spirit to those asking Him!”
11.bbe: If, then, you who are evil are able to give good things to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who make request to him?

11.msb: One day Jesus was driving out a demon that was mute. And when the demon was gone, the man who had been mute spoke. The crowds were amazed,
11.kjv: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.
11.blb: And He was casting out a demon, and it was mute; and it came to pass, on the demon having gone out, that the mute man spoke. And the crowds marveled.
11.bbe: And he was sending an evil spirit out of a man who was without the power of talking. And it came about that when the spirit had gone the man had the power of talking; and the people were full of wonder.
11.heading: A House Divided

11.msb: but some of them said, “It is by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons, that He drives out demons.”
11.kjv: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
11.blb: And some of them said, “By Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons, He casts out the demons.”
11.bbe: But some of them said, He sends out evil spirits by Beelzebul, the ruler of evil spirits.

11.msb: And others tested Him by demanding a sign from heaven.
11.kjv: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.
11.blb: And others, testing, were seeking from Him a sign out of heaven.
11.bbe: And others, testing him, were looking for a sign from heaven from him.

11.msb: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and a house divided against a house will fall.
11.kjv: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.
11.blb: But He, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom having been divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house against a house falls.
11.bbe: But he, having knowledge of their thoughts, said to them, Every kingdom in which there is division is made waste; and a house in which there is division comes to destruction.

11.msb: If Satan is divided against himself, how can his kingdom stand? After all, you say that I drive out demons by Beelzebul.
11.kjv: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
11.blb: And if Satan also was divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say I cast out the demons by Beelzebul.
11.bbe: If, then, Satan is at war with himself, how will he keep his kingdom? because you say that I send evil spirits out of men by the help of Beelzebul.

11.msb: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
11.kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
11.blb: And if I cast out the demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons cast them out? Because of this, they will be your judges.
11.bbe: And if I, by Beelzebul, send out evil spirits, by whose help do your sons send them out? so let them be your judges.

11.msb: But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
11.kjv: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.
11.blb: But if I cast out the demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
11.bbe: But if I, by the finger of God, send out evil spirits, then the kingdom of God has overtaken you.

11.msb: When a strong man, fully armed, guards his house, his possessions are secure.
11.kjv: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
11.blb: When the strong man, being armed, might guard his house, his possessions are in peace.
11.bbe: When the strong man armed keeps watch over his house, then his goods are safe:

11.msb: But when someone stronger attacks and overpowers him, he takes away the armor in which the man trusted, and then he divides up his plunder.
11.kjv: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
11.blb: But when one stronger than he, having come upon him, might overcome him, he takes away his full armor in which he had trusted, and he divides his plunder.
11.bbe: But when one who is stronger makes an attack on him and overcomes him, he takes away his instruments of war, in which he had put his faith, and makes division of his goods.

11.msb: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.
11.kjv: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
11.blb: The one not being with Me is against Me, and the one not gathering with Me scatters.
11.bbe: He who is not with me is against me, and he who will not give me help in getting people together is driving them away.

11.msb: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it. Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’
11.kjv: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.
11.blb: When the unclean spirit may go out from the man, it passes through waterless places, seeking rest. And not finding it, then it says, ‘I will return to my house from which I came out.’
11.bbe: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of a man, goes through dry places, looking for rest; and when he does not get it, he says, I will go back to my house from which I came.
11.heading: An Unclean Spirit Returns

11.msb: On its return, it finds the house swept clean and put in order.
11.kjv: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
11.blb: And having come, it finds it swept and put in order.
11.bbe: And when he comes, he sees that it has been made fair and clean.

11.msb: Then it goes and brings seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go and dwell there. And the final plight of that man is worse than the first.”
11.kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.
11.blb: Then it goes and takes along seven other spirits more evil than itself, and having entered, they dwell there; and the last of that man becomes worse than the first.”
11.bbe: Then he goes and gets seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they go in, and take their places there: and the last condition of that man is worse than the first.

11.msb: As Jesus was saying these things, a woman in the crowd raised her voice and said, “Blessed is the womb that bore You, and blessed are the breasts that nursed You!”
11.kjv: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.
11.blb: And it came to pass, in His saying these things, that a certain woman out of the crowd, having lifted up her voice, said to Him, “Blessed is the womb having borne You and the breasts at which You nursed!”
11.bbe: And it came about that when he said these things, a certain woman among the people said in a loud voice, Happy is the body which gave you birth, and the breasts from which you took milk.
11.heading: True Blessedness

11.msb: But He replied, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.”
11.kjv: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
11.blb: But He said, “Rather, blessed are those hearing the word of God and keeping it.”
11.bbe: But he said, More happy are they who give hearing to the word of God and keep it.

11.msb: As the crowds were increasing, Jesus said, “This is a wicked generation. It seeks a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah the prophet.
11.kjv: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.
11.blb: Now the crowds being pressed around together, He began to say, “This generation is an evil generation; it seeks a sign, and no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah.
11.bbe: And when a great number of people came together to him, he said, This generation is an evil generation: it is looking for a sign and no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah.
11.heading: The Sign of Jonah

11.msb: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will be a sign to this generation.
11.kjv: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
11.blb: For just as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so also the Son of Man will be to this generation.
11.bbe: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so will the Son of man be to this generation.

11.msb: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with the men of this generation and condemn them; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here.
11.kjv: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
11.blb: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and behold, One greater than Solomon is here.
11.bbe: The queen of the South will come up on the day of judging and give her decision against the men of this generation: for she came from the ends of the earth to give ear to the wisdom of Solomon; and now something greater than Solomon is here.

11.msb: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now One greater than Jonah is here.
11.kjv: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
11.blb: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and behold, One greater than Jonah is here.
11.bbe: The men of Nineveh will come up in the day of judging and give their decision against this generation: for they were turned away from their sins at the preaching of Jonah; but now something greater than Jonah is here.

11.msb: No one lights a lamp and puts it in a cellar or under a basket. Instead, he sets it on a stand, so those who enter can see the light.
11.kjv: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.
11.blb: No one having lit a lamp puts it in secret, nor under the basket, but on the lampstand, so that those entering may see the light.
11.bbe: No man, when the light has been lighted, puts it in a secret place, or under a vessel, but on its table, so that those who come in may see the light.
11.heading: The Lamp of the Body

11.msb: The eye is the lamp of the body. So when your eyes are good, your whole body also is full of light. But when they are bad, your body is full of darkness.
11.kjv: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.
11.blb: The lamp of the body is your eye. When your eye may be sound, also your whole body is full of light; but when it may be evil, your body is also full of darkness.
11.bbe: The light of the body is the eye: when your eye is true, all your body is full of light; but when it is evil, your body is dark.

11.msb: Be careful, then, that the light within you is not darkness.
11.kjv: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.
11.blb: Take heed, therefore, that the light that is in you is not darkness.
11.bbe: So take care that the light which is in you is not dark.

11.msb: So if your whole body is full of light, with no part of it in darkness, you will be radiant, as though a lamp were shining on you.”
11.kjv: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.
11.blb: If, therefore, your whole body is full of light, not having any part full of darkness, the whole will be full of light, as when the lamp shining may shine on you.”
11.bbe: If, then, all your body is light, with no part of it dark, it will be completely full of light, as when a flame with its bright shining gives you light.

11.msb: As Jesus was speaking, a Pharisee invited Him to dine with him; so He went in and reclined at the table.
11.kjv: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
11.blb: And in His speaking, a Pharisee asked Him that He might dine with him. And having entered, He reclined.
11.bbe: Now, while he was talking, a Pharisee made a request that he would come to a meal with him; and he went in and took his seat at the meal.
11.heading: Woes to Pharisees and Experts in the Law

11.msb: But the Pharisee was surprised to see that Jesus did not first wash before the meal.
11.kjv: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
11.blb: But the Pharisee, having seen, marveled that He did not wash first before the dinner.
11.bbe: And when the Pharisee saw it, he was surprised because he came to the meal without first washing himself.

11.msb: Then the Lord said, “Now you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside you are full of greed and wickedness.
11.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
11.blb: But the Lord said to him, “Now you, the Pharisees, you cleanse the outside of the cup and of the dish, but your inside is full of plundering and of wickedness.
11.bbe: And the Lord said to him, You Pharisees make the outside of the cup and the plate clean; but inside you are thieves and full of evil.

11.msb: You fools! Did not the One who made the outside make the inside as well?
11.kjv: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?
11.blb: Fools! Did not the One having made the outside also make the inside?
11.bbe: O you foolish ones! did not he who made the outside in the same way make the inside?

11.msb: But give as alms the things that are within you, and behold, everything will be clean for you.
11.kjv: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.
11.blb: But give as alms the things being within, and behold, all things are clean for you.
11.bbe: But if you give to the poor such things as you are able, then all things are clean to you.

11.msb: Woe to you Pharisees! For you pay tithes of mint, rue, and every herb, but you disregard justice and the love of God. You should have practiced the latter without neglecting the former.
11.kjv: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
11.blb: But woe to you, the Pharisees, because you pay tithes of mint and rue and every herb, and you pass by the judgment and the love of God. But it was necessary to do these things, and those not to neglect.
11.bbe: But a curse is on you, Pharisees! for you make men give a tenth of every sort of plant, and give no thought to right and the love of God; but it is right for you to do these things, and not let the others be undone.

11.msb: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the chief seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.
11.kjv: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
11.blb: Woe to you, the Pharisees, because you love the first seat in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.
11.bbe: A curse is on you, Pharisees! for your desires are for the most important seats in the Synagogues and for words of respect said to you in the market-place.

11.msb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! For you are like unmarked graves, which men walk over without even noticing.”
11.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.
11.blb: Woe to you, because you are like unmarked tombs, and the men walking above do not know.”
11.bbe: A curse is on you! for you are like the resting-places of dead men, which are not seen, and men go walking over them without knowledge of it.

11.msb: One of the experts in the law told Him, “Teacher, when You say these things, You insult us as well.”
11.kjv: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.
11.blb: But answering, one of the lawyers says to Him, “Teacher, saying these things, You insult us also.”
11.bbe: And one of the teachers of the law, answering, said to him, Master, in saying this, you give a bad name to us as to them.

11.msb: “Woe to you as well, experts in the law!” He replied. “For you weigh men down with heavy burdens, but you yourselves will not lift a finger to lighten their load.
11.kjv: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
11.blb: But He said, “Woe also to you, the lawyers, because you burden men with burdens hard to bear, and you yourselves do not touch the burdens with one of your fingers.
11.bbe: And he said, A curse is on you, teachers of the law! for while other men are crushed under the weight of the rules you make for them, you yourselves do not put so much as one finger to them.

11.msb: Woe to you! For you build tombs for the prophets, but it was your fathers who killed them.
11.kjv: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
11.blb: Woe to you, because you build the tombs of the prophets, but your fathers killed them.
11.bbe: A curse is on you! for you make resting-places for the bodies of the prophets, but your fathers put them to death.

11.msb: So you bear witness and consent to the deeds of your fathers: They killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.
11.kjv: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.
11.blb: So you are witnesses and consent to the works of your fathers, because they indeed killed them, and you build the tombs.
11.bbe: So you are witnesses and give approval to the work of your fathers; for they put them to death and you make their last resting-places.

11.msb: Because of this, the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles; some of them they will kill and others they will persecute.’
11.kjv: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:
11.blb: Because of this also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles, and some of them they will kill and persecute,’
11.bbe: For this reason the wisdom of God has said, I will send them prophets and teachers, and to some of them they will give death and cruel pains;

11.msb: As a result, this generation will be charged with the blood of all the prophets that has been shed since the foundation of the world,
11.kjv: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
11.blb: so that the blood of all the prophets poured out from the foundation of the world might be required from this generation,
11.bbe: So that punishment may come on this generation for the blood of all the prophets which was given from the earliest days;

11.msb: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, I tell you, all of it will be charged to this generation.
11.kjv: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.
11.blb: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, the one having perished between the altar and the house. Yes, I say to you, it will be required from this generation.
11.bbe: From the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who was put to death between the altar and the Temple. Yes, I say to you, It will come on this generation.

11.msb: Woe to you experts in the law! For you have taken away the key to knowledge. You yourselves have not entered, and you have hindered those who were entering.”
11.kjv: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.
11.blb: Woe to you, the lawyers, because you took away the key of knowledge. You yourselves did not enter, and you hindered those entering.”
11.bbe: A curse is on you, teachers of the law! for you have taken away the key of knowledge: you did not go in yourselves, and you got in the way of those who were going in.

11.msb: As Jesus said these things to them, the scribes and Pharisees began to oppose Him bitterly and to ply Him with questions about many things,
11.kjv: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
11.blb: On His having gone out from there, the scribes and the Pharisees began terribly to press upon Him and to make Him speak about many things,
11.bbe: And when he had come out of that place, the scribes and the Pharisees came round him angrily, questioning him about more things;

11.msb: lying in wait for Him and seeking to catch Him in something He might say, so that they might accuse Him.
11.kjv: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
11.blb: lying in wait to catch Him in something out of His mouth.
11.bbe: And watching him, for a chance to get something from his words which might be used against him.

12.msb: In the meantime, a crowd of many thousands had gathered, so that they were trampling one another. Jesus began to speak first to His disciples: “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
12.kjv: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
12.blb: In these times, the myriads of the crowd having been gathered together so as to trample upon one another, He began to say to His disciples first, “Take heed to yourselves of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
12.bbe: At that time, when thousands of the people had come together, in such numbers that they were crushing one another, he said first to his disciples, Have nothing to do with the leaven of the Pharisees, which is deceit.
12.heading: The Leaven of the Pharisees

12.msb: There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.
12.kjv: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.
12.blb: And nothing is concealed that will not be revealed, and hidden that will not be known.
12.bbe: But nothing is covered up, which will not come to light, or secret, which will not be made clear.

12.msb: What you have spoken in the dark will be heard in the daylight, and what you have whispered in the inner rooms will be proclaimed from the housetops.
12.kjv: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
12.blb: Instead, whatever you said in the darkness will be heard in the light, and what you spoke to the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed upon the housetops.
12.bbe: So, whatever you have said in the dark, will come to men's hearing in the light, and what you have said secretly inside the house, will be made public from the house-tops.

12.msb: I tell you, My friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that can do no more.
12.kjv: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
12.blb: And I say to you, My friends, you should not be afraid of those killing the body and after these things not having anything more to do.
12.bbe: And I say to you, my friends, Have no fear of those who may put the body to death, and are able to do no more than that.
12.heading: Fear God Alone

12.msb: But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear the One who, after you have been killed, has authority to throw you into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear Him!
12.kjv: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
12.blb: But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear the One having authority, after the killing, to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I say to you, fear Him!
12.bbe: But I will make clear to you of whom you are to be in fear: of him who after death has power to send you to hell; yes, truly I say, Have fear of him.

12.msb: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God.
12.kjv: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
12.blb: Are not five sparrows sold for two assaria? And not one of them is forgotten before God.
12.bbe: Are not five sparrows given in exchange for two farthings? and God has every one of them in mind.

12.msb: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
12.kjv: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
12.blb: But even the hairs of your head have all been numbered. Do not be afraid; you are more valuable than many sparrows.
12.bbe: But even the hairs of your head are numbered. Have no fear: you are of more value than a flock of sparrows.

12.msb: I tell you, everyone who confesses Me before men, the Son of Man will also confess him before the angels of God.
12.kjv: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
12.blb: And I say to you, everyone who will confess in Me before men, the Son of Man also will confess in him before the angels of God.
12.bbe: And I say to you that to everyone who gives witness to me before men, the Son of man will give witness before the angels of God.
12.heading: Confessing Christ

12.msb: But whoever denies Me before men will be denied before the angels of God.
12.kjv: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.
12.blb: But the one having denied Me before men will be denied before the angels of God.
12.bbe: But if anyone says before men that he has no knowledge of me, I will say that I have no knowledge of him before the angels of God.

12.msb: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
12.kjv: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.
12.blb: And everyone who will speak a word to the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but the one having blasphemed to the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
12.bbe: And if anyone says a word against the Son of man, he will have forgiveness: but for him who says evil words against the Holy Spirit, there will be no forgiveness.

12.msb: When you are brought before synagogues, rulers, and authorities, do not worry about how to defend yourselves or what to say.
12.kjv: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
12.blb: And when they bring you in before the synagogues and the rulers and the authorities, do not be anxious about how or what you may reply in defense, or what you may say.
12.bbe: And when they take you before the Synagogues and the authorities and the rulers, take no thought about what answers you will give, or what you will say:

12.msb: For at that time the Holy Spirit will teach you what you should say.”
12.kjv: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.
12.blb: For the Holy Spirit will teach you in the same hour what it is necessary to say.”
12.bbe: For the Holy Spirit will make clear to you in that very hour what to say.

12.msb: Someone in the crowd said to Him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”
12.kjv: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.
12.blb: And one from the crowd said to Him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide with me the inheritance.”
12.bbe: And one of the people said to him, Master, give an order to my brother to make division of the heritage with me.
12.heading: The Parable of the Rich Fool

12.msb: But Jesus replied, “Man, who appointed Me judge or executor between you?”
12.kjv: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
12.blb: And He said to him, “Man, who appointed Me a judge or divider over you?”
12.bbe: But he said, Man, who made me a judge or a maker of decisions for you?

12.msb: And He said to them, “Watch out! Guard yourselves against greed, for one’s life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions.”
12.kjv: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man’s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
12.blb: And He said to them, “Beware, and keep yourselves from all covetousness, because not to anyone is his life in the abundance of that which he possesses.”
12.bbe: And he said to them, Take care to keep yourselves free from the desire for property; for a man's life is not made up of the number of things which he has.

12.msb: Then He told them a parable: “The ground of a certain rich man produced an abundance.
12.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
12.blb: And He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man brought forth abundantly.
12.bbe: And he said to them, in a story, The land of a certain man of great wealth was very fertile:

12.msb: So he thought to himself, ‘What shall I do, since I have nowhere to store my crops?’
12.kjv: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?
12.blb: And he was reasoning within himself, saying, ‘What shall I do, because I have nowhere I will store up my fruits?’
12.bbe: And he said to himself, What is to be done? for I have no place in which to put all my fruit.

12.msb: Then he said, ‘This is what I will do: I will tear down my barns and will build bigger ones, and there I will store up all my crops and my goods.
12.kjv: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.
12.blb: And he said, ‘This I will do: I will tear down my barns and will build larger ones, and I will gather there all my grain and goods.
12.bbe: And he said, This I will do: I will take down my store-houses and make greater ones, and there I will put all my grain and my goods.

12.msb: Then I will say to myself, “You have plenty of good things laid up for many years. Take it easy. Eat, drink, and be merry!”’
12.kjv: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.
12.blb: And I will say to my soul, “Soul, you have many good things laid up for many years; take your rest, eat, drink, be merry.”’
12.bbe: And I will say to my soul, Soul, you have a great amount of goods in store, enough for a number of years; be at rest, take food and wine and be happy.

12.msb: But God said to him, ‘You fool! This very night your life will be required of you. Then who will own what you have accumulated?’
12.kjv: But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?
12.blb: And God said to him, ‘Fool! This night, your soul is required of you; but what you prepared—to whom will it be?’
12.bbe: But God said to him, You foolish one, tonight I will take your soul from you, and who then will be the owner of all the things which you have got together?

12.msb: This is how it will be for anyone who stores up treasure for himself but is not rich toward God.”
12.kjv: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.
12.blb: So is the one treasuring up for himself and not being rich toward God.”
12.bbe: So that is what comes to the man who gets wealth for himself, and has not wealth in the eyes of God.

12.msb: Then Jesus said to His disciples, “Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat, or about your body, what you will wear.
12.kjv: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.
12.blb: And He said to His disciples, “Because of this I say to you, do not be anxious for life, what you may eat, nor for your body, what you might put on.
12.bbe: And he said to his disciples, For this reason I say to you, Take no thought for your life, about what food you will take, or for your body, how it may be clothed.
12.heading: Do Not Worry

12.msb: Life is more than food, and the body more than clothes.
12.kjv: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.
12.blb: For life is more than food, and the body than clothing.
12.bbe: Is not life more than food, and the body than its clothing?

12.msb: Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storehouse or barn; yet God feeds them. How much more valuable you are than the birds!
12.kjv: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
12.blb: Consider the ravens, that they do not sow nor reap; unto them there is not a storehouse nor a barn—and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than the birds!
12.bbe: Give thought to the ravens; they do not put seeds into the earth, or get together grain; they have no store-houses or buildings; and God gives them their food: of how much greater value are you than the birds!

12.msb: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?
12.kjv: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?
12.blb: And who of you, being anxious, is able to add to his lifespan a cubit?
12.bbe: And which of you by taking thought is able to make himself any taller?

12.msb: So if you cannot do such a small thing, why do you worry about the rest?
12.kjv: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?
12.blb: If, then, you are not even able to do the least, why are you anxious about the rest?
12.bbe: If, then, you are not able to do even that which is least, why are you troubled about the rest?

12.msb: Consider how the lilies grow: They do not labor or spin. Yet I tell you, not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.
12.kjv: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
12.blb: Consider the lilies, how they grow: They do not labor, nor do they spin. Yet I say to you, not even Solomon in all his glory was clothed like one of these.
12.bbe: Give thought to the flowers: they do no work, they make no thread; and still I say to you, Even Solomon, in all his glory, was not clothed like one of these.

12.msb: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, how much more will He clothe you, O you of little faith!
12.kjv: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?
12.blb: But if God thus clothes the grass in the field, being here today and tomorrow being thrown into the furnace, how much more you, O little of faith!
12.bbe: But if God gives such clothing to the grass in the field, which today is living, and tomorrow will be burned in the oven, how much more will he give clothing to you, O men of little faith?

12.msb: And do not be concerned about what you will eat or drink. Do not worry about it.
12.kjv: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.
12.blb: And you, do not seek what you might eat and what you might drink, and do not be in suspense;
12.bbe: And do not give overmuch thought to your food and drink, and let not your mind be full of doubts.

12.msb: For the Gentiles of the world strive after all these things, and your Father knows that you need them.
12.kjv: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.
12.blb: for all the nations of the world seek after these things, and your Father knows that you have need of these.
12.bbe: For the nations of the world go in search of all these things: but your Father has knowledge that you have need of them.

12.msb: But seek the kingdom of God, and all these things will be added unto you.
12.kjv: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.
12.blb: But seek His kingdom, and these things will be added to you.
12.bbe: But let your chief care be for his kingdom, and these other things will be given to you in addition.

12.msb: Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father is pleased to give you the kingdom.
12.kjv: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
12.blb: Do not fear, little flock, because your Father was well pleased to give you the kingdom.
12.bbe: Have no fear, little flock, for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
12.heading: Treasures in Heaven

12.msb: Sell your possessions and give to the poor. Provide yourselves with purses that will not wear out, an inexhaustible treasure in heaven, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.
12.kjv: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.
12.blb: Sell your possessions and give alms; make for yourselves purses not growing old, an unfailing treasure in the heavens, where thief does not draw near, nor does moth destroy.
12.bbe: Give what property you have in exchange for money, and give the money to the poor; make for yourselves money-bags which will not get old, wealth stored up in heaven which will be yours for ever, where thieves will not come nor worms put it to destruction.

12.msb: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
12.kjv: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
12.blb: For where your treasure is, there also your heart will be.
12.bbe: For where your wealth is, there will your heart be.

12.msb: Be dressed for service and keep your lamps burning.
12.kjv: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;
12.blb: Let your loins be girded around and the lamps burning,
12.bbe: Be ready, dressed as for a journey, with your lights burning.
12.heading: Readiness at Any Hour

12.msb: Then you will be like servants waiting for their master to return from the wedding banquet, so that when he comes and knocks, they can open the door for him at once.
12.kjv: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.
12.blb: and you be like men waiting for their master when he shall return from the wedding feasts, that, having come and having knocked, immediately they might open to him.
12.bbe: And be like men who are looking for their lord, when he comes back from the bride-feast; so that when he comes to the door, it will be open to him quickly.

12.msb: Blessed are those servants whom the master finds on watch when he returns. Truly I tell you, he will dress himself to serve and will have them recline at the table, and he himself will come and wait on them.
12.kjv: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.
12.blb: Blessed are those servants whom, having come, the master will find watching. Truly I say to you that he will gird himself and will make them recline, and having come up, will serve them.
12.bbe: Happy are those servants who are watching when the lord comes; truly I say to you, he will make himself their servant and, placing them at the table, he will come out and give them food.

12.msb: Even if he comes in the second or third watch of the night and finds them alert, those servants will be blessed.
12.kjv: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.
12.blb: And if he should come in the second, and if in the third watch, and he finds thus, blessed are those.
12.bbe: And if he comes in the second division of the night or in the third, and they are watching for him, happy are those servants.

12.msb: But understand this: If the homeowner had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.
12.kjv: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.
12.blb: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief comes, he would not have permitted his house to be broken into.
12.bbe: But be certain of this, that if the master of the house had had knowledge of the time when the thief was coming, he would have been watching, and would not have let his house be broken into.

12.msb: Therefore you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.”
12.kjv: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.
12.blb: And you, be ready, because the Son of Man comes in that hour you do not think.”
12.bbe: So be ready: for the Son of man is coming at a time when you are not looking for him.

12.msb: “Lord,” said Peter, “are You addressing this parable to us, or to everyone else as well?”
12.kjv: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?
12.blb: And Peter said, “Lord, do You say this parable to us, or also to all?”
12.bbe: And Peter said to him, Lord, are these words said to us only, or to all men?

12.msb: And the Lord answered, “Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their portion at the proper time?
12.kjv: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?
12.blb: And the Lord said, “Who then is the faithful, wise manager, whom the master will set over the care of his, to give in season the grain measure?
12.bbe: And the Lord said, Who then is the wise and responsible servant whom his lord will put in control of his family, to give them their food at the right time?

12.msb: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
12.kjv: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
12.blb: Blessed is that servant whom his master, having come, will find doing so.
12.bbe: Happy is that servant who, when his lord comes, is doing so.

12.msb: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
12.kjv: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.
12.blb: Truly I say to you that he will set him over all his possessions.
12.bbe: Truly I say to you, he will put him in control of all his goods.

12.msb: But suppose that servant says in his heart, ‘My master will be a long time in coming,’ and he begins to beat the menservants and maidservants, and to eat and drink and get drunk.
12.kjv: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
12.blb: But if that servant should say in his heart, ‘My master delays to come,’ and should begin to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and to drink and to get drunk,
12.bbe: But if that servant says to himself, My lord is a long time coming; and goes about giving blows to the men-servants and the women-servants, feasting and taking overmuch wine;

12.msb: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate. Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.
12.kjv: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
12.blb: the master of that servant will come in a day that he does not expect and in an hour that he does not know, and he will cut him in two and will appoint his portion with the unbelievers.
12.bbe: The lord of that servant will come at a time when he is not looking for him, and at an hour when he is not ready for him, and he will have him cut in two and will give him his part in the fate of those who have no faith;

12.msb: That servant who knows his master’s will but does not get ready or follow his instructions will be beaten with many blows.
12.kjv: And that servant, which knew his lord’s will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.
12.blb: Now that servant, the one having known the will of his master and not having prepared nor having done according to his will, he will be beaten with many.
12.bbe: And the servant who had knowledge of his lord's desires and was not ready for him and did not do as he was ordered, will be given a great number of blows;

12.msb: But the one who unknowingly does things worthy of punishment will be beaten with few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be required; and from him who has been entrusted with much, even more will be demanded.
12.kjv: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
12.blb: But the one not having known but having done things worthy of stripes will be beaten with few. And of everyone to whom much was given, much will be required; and from him to whom much was committed, more will they ask of him.
12.bbe: But he who, without knowledge, did things for which punishment is given, will get only a small number of blows. The man to whom much is given, will have to give much; if much is given into his care, of him more will be requested.

12.msb: I have come to bring fire to the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!
12.kjv: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?
12.blb: I came to cast fire upon the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!
12.bbe: I came to send a fire on the earth, and it may even now have been lighted.
12.heading: Not Peace but Division

12.msb: But I have a baptism to undergo, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!
12.kjv: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!
12.blb: But I have a baptism with which to be baptized, and how distressed I am until it should be accomplished!
12.bbe: But there is a baptism which I have to undergo; and how am I kept back till it is complete!

12.msb: Do you think that I have come to bring peace to the earth? No, I tell you, but division.
12.kjv: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
12.blb: Do you think that I came to grant peace on the earth? No, I say to you, but rather division.
12.bbe: Is it your opinion that I have come to give peace on earth? I say to you, No, but division:

12.msb: From now on, five in one household will be divided, three against two and two against three.
12.kjv: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
12.blb: For from now there will be five in one house divided, three against two and two against three.
12.bbe: For from this time, a family of five in one house will be on opposite sides, three against two and two against three.

12.msb: They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.”
12.kjv: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
12.blb: They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against the daughter and daughter against the mother, mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against the mother-in-law.”
12.bbe: They will be at war, the father against his son, and the son against his father; mother against daughter, and daughter against mother; mother-in-law against daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.

12.msb: Then Jesus said to the crowds, “As soon as you see a cloud rising from the west, you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and that is what happens.
12.kjv: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.
12.blb: And He was also saying to the crowds, “When you see the cloud rising up in the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.
12.bbe: Then he said to the people, When you see a cloud coming up in the west, straight away you say, There will be rain; and so it is.
12.heading: Interpreting the Present Time

12.msb: And when the south wind blows, you say, ‘It will be hot,’ and it is.
12.kjv: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.
12.blb: And when a south wind is blowing, you say, ‘There will be heat,’ and it happens.
12.bbe: And when you see a south wind blowing, you say, There will be heat; and so it is.

12.msb: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and sky. Why can’t you interpret the present time?
12.kjv: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?
12.blb: Hypocrites! The face of the earth and of the sky you know to discern, but how do you not know to discern this time?
12.bbe: O false ones! the face of the earth and the heaven is clear to you; how is it that the signs of these times are not as clear to you?

12.msb: And why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
12.kjv: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
12.blb: And why do you not even judge for yourselves what is right?
12.bbe: And why are you, in your hearts, unable to be judges of what is right?
12.heading: Reconciling with an Adversary

12.msb: Make every effort to reconcile with your adversary while you are on your way to the magistrate. Otherwise, he may drag you off to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and the officer may throw you into prison.
12.kjv: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.
12.blb: For as you are going with your adversary before a ruler, give effort to be set free from him in the way, lest ever he should drag you away to the judge, and the judge will deliver you to the officer, and the officer will cast you into prison.
12.bbe: For if anyone has a cause at law against you, and you are going with him before the ruler, make an attempt, on the way, to come to an agreement with him, for if you do not, he may take you before the judge and the judge will give you up to the police, and they will put you in prison.

12.msb: I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the very last penny.”
12.kjv: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.
12.blb: I say to you, you shall never come out from there until you should pay back even the last lepton.”
12.bbe: I say to you, You will not come out of it till you have made payment to the very last farthing.

13.msb: At that time some of those present told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
13.kjv: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilæans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
13.blb: Now at the same time, some were present, reporting to Him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate mixed with their sacrifices.
13.bbe: Now some people who were there at that time, gave him an account of how the blood of some Galilaeans had been mixed by Pilate with their offerings.
13.heading: A Call to Repentance

13.msb: To this Jesus replied, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered this way?
13.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilæans were sinners above all the Galilæans, because they suffered such things?
13.blb: And answering, He said to them, “Do you think that these Galileans were sinners beyond all the Galileans, because they have suffered these things?
13.bbe: And he, in answer, said to them, Are you of the opinion that these Galilaeans were worse than all other Galilaeans, because these things were done to them?

13.msb: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.
13.kjv: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
13.blb: No, I say to you; but unless you repent, you will all likewise perish.
13.bbe: I say to you, It is not so: but if your hearts are not changed, you will all come to the same end.

13.msb: Or those eighteen who were killed when the tower of Siloam collapsed on them: Do you think that they were more sinful than all the others living in Jerusalem?
13.kjv: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?
13.blb: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell, and it killed them: Do you think that these were debtors beyond all the men dwelling in Jerusalem?
13.bbe: Or those eighteen men who were crushed by the fall of the tower of Siloam, were they worse than all the other men living in Jerusalem?

13.msb: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.”
13.kjv: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
13.blb: No, I say to you; but unless you repent, you will all likewise perish.”
13.bbe: I say to you, It is not so: but if your hearts are not changed, you will all come to an end in the same way.

13.msb: Then Jesus told this parable: “A man had a fig tree that was planted in his vineyard. He went to look for fruit on it but did not find any.
13.kjv: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.
13.blb: And He was speaking this parable: “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it, and he did not find any.
13.bbe: And he made up this story for them: A certain man had a fig-tree in his garden, and he came to get fruit from it, and there was no fruit.
13.heading: The Parable of the Barren Fig Tree

13.msb: So he said to the keeper of the vineyard, ‘Look, for the past three years I have come to search for fruit on this fig tree and haven’t found any. Cut it down! Why should it use up the soil?’
13.kjv: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?
13.blb: And he said to the vinedresser, ‘Behold, for these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree and do not find it. Therefore cut it down! Why does it also render the soil useless?’
13.bbe: And he said to the gardener, See, for three years I have been looking for fruit from this tree, and I have not had any: let it be cut down; why is it taking up space?

13.msb: ‘Sir,’ the man replied, ‘leave it alone again this year, until I dig around it and fertilize it.
13.kjv: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:
13.blb: And answering, he says to him, ‘Sir, leave it this year also, until I may dig around it and put in manure,
13.bbe: And he said, Lord, let it be for this year, and I will have the earth turned up round it, and put animal waste on it, to make it fertile:

13.msb: If it bears fruit, fine. But if not, you can cut it down next year.’”
13.kjv: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.
13.blb: and if indeed it should make fruit in the time, so be it. But if not, you will cut it down.’”
13.bbe: And if, after that, it has fruit, it is well; if not, let it be cut down.

13.msb: One Sabbath Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues,
13.kjv: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
13.blb: And He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbaths.
13.bbe: And he was teaching in one of the Synagogues on the Sabbath.
13.heading: Jesus Heals a Disabled Woman

13.msb: and a woman there had been disabled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was hunched over and could not stand up straight.
13.kjv: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.
13.blb: And behold, a woman having a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and she was bent over and not able to lift herself up to the full.
13.bbe: And there was a woman who had had a disease for eighteen years; she was bent, and was not able to make herself straight.

13.msb: When Jesus saw her, He called her over and said, “Woman, you are set free from your disability.”
13.kjv: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
