21.blb: men fainting from fear and expectation of the things coming on the world. For the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
21.bbe: Men's strength will go from them in fear and in waiting for the things which are coming on the earth; for the powers of the heavens will be moved.

21.msb: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
21.kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
21.blb: And then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
21.bbe: And then they will see the Son of man coming in a cloud, with power and great glory.

21.msb: When these things begin to happen, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.”
21.kjv: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
21.blb: And these things beginning to come to pass, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption draws near.”
21.bbe: But when these things come about, let your heads be lifted up, because your salvation is near.

21.msb: Then Jesus told them a parable: “Look at the fig tree and all the trees.
21.kjv: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
21.blb: And He spoke to them a parable: “Behold the fig tree and all the trees.
21.bbe: And he made a story for them: See the fig-tree, and all the trees;
21.heading: The Lesson of the Fig Tree

21.msb: When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.
21.kjv: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
21.blb: When they already may cast forth, looking for yourselves you know that already the summer is near.
21.bbe: When they put out their young leaves, you take note of it, and it is clear to you that summer is coming.

21.msb: So also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.
21.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.
21.blb: So also you, when you see these things coming to pass, know that the kingdom of God is near.
21.bbe: In the same way, when you see these things taking place you may be certain that the kingdom of God is near.

21.msb: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
21.kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.
21.blb: Truly I say to you that this generation shall not pass away until all shall come to pass.
21.bbe: Truly I say to you, This generation will not come to an end till all things are complete.

21.msb: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
21.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
21.blb: The heaven and the earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
21.bbe: Heaven and earth will come to an end, but my words will not come to an end.

21.msb: But watch yourselves, or your hearts will be weighed down by dissipation, drunkenness, and the worries of life—and that day will spring upon you suddenly like a snare.
21.kjv: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
21.blb: And take heed to yourselves, lest your hearts ever be burdened with dissipation and drunkenness and the cares of life—and that day would come upon you suddenly as a snare.
21.bbe: But give attention to yourselves, for fear that your hearts become over-full of the pleasures of food and wine, and the cares of this life, and that day may come on you suddenly, and take you as in a net:
21.heading: Be Watchful for the Day

21.msb: For it will come upon all who dwell on the face of all the earth.
21.kjv: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
21.blb: For it will come upon all those sitting upon the face of all the earth.
21.bbe: For so it will come on all those who are living on the face of all the earth.

21.msb: So keep watch at all times, and pray that you may be deemed worthy to escape all that is about to happen and to stand before the Son of Man.”
21.kjv: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
21.blb: But stay awake in every season, praying that you may have strength to escape all these things that are about to come to pass, and to stand before the Son of Man.”
21.bbe: But keep watch at all times with prayer, that you may be strong enough to come through all these things and take your place before the Son of man.

21.msb: Every day Jesus taught at the temple, but every evening He went out to spend the night on the Mount of Olives.
21.kjv: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.
21.blb: And during the day He was teaching in the temple, and in the evening, going out, He was lodging on the mount called Olivet.
21.bbe: And every day he was teaching in the Temple and every night he went out to the mountain which is named the Mountain of Olives to take his rest.

21.msb: And early in the morning all the people would come to hear Him at the temple.
21.kjv: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
21.blb: And all the people were coming early to Him in the temple to hear Him.
21.bbe: And all the people came early in the morning to give ear to his words in the Temple.

22.msb: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching,
22.kjv: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
22.blb: And the Feast of the Unleavened, called the Passover, was drawing near.
22.bbe: Now the feast of unleavened bread was near, which is called the Passover.
22.heading: The Plot to Kill Jesus

22.msb: and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a way to put Jesus to death, for they feared the people.
22.kjv: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.
22.blb: And the chief priests and the scribes were seeking how they might put Him to death, for they were afraid of the people.
22.bbe: And the chief priests and the scribes were looking for a chance to put him to death, but they went in fear of the people.

22.msb: Then Satan entered Judas Iscariot, who was one of the Twelve.
22.kjv: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
22.blb: And Satan entered into Judas, the one being called Iscariot, being of the number of the Twelve.
22.bbe: And Satan came into Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve.
22.heading: Judas Agrees to Betray Jesus

22.msb: And Judas went to discuss with the chief priests and temple officers how he might betray Jesus to them.
22.kjv: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.
22.blb: And having gone away, he discussed with the chief priests and captains how he might betray Him to them.
22.bbe: And he went away and had a discussion with the chief priests and the rulers, about how he might give him up to them.

22.msb: They were delighted and agreed to give him money.
22.kjv: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
22.blb: And they rejoiced and agreed to give him money.
22.bbe: And they were glad, and undertook to give him money.

22.msb: Judas consented, and began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus to them in the absence of a crowd.
22.kjv: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
22.blb: And he promised, and began seeking opportunity to betray Him to them apart from a crowd.
22.bbe: And he made an agreement with them to give him up to them, if he got a chance, when the people were not present.

22.msb: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed.
22.kjv: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
22.blb: And the day of the Unleavened came, on which it was necessary for the Passover to be sacrificed.
22.bbe: And the day of unleavened bread came, when the Passover lamb is put to death.
22.heading: Preparing the Passover

22.msb: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover.”
22.kjv: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
22.blb: And He sent Peter and John, having said, “Having gone, prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”
22.bbe: And Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, Go and make the Passover ready for us, so that we may take it.

22.msb: “Where do You want us to prepare it?” they asked.
22.kjv: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?
22.blb: And they said to Him, “Where do You want that we should prepare?”
22.bbe: And they said to him, Where are we to get it ready?

22.msb: He answered, “When you enter the city, a man carrying a jug of water will meet you. Follow him to the house he enters,
22.kjv: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
22.blb: And He said to them, “Behold, of you having entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house into which he enters,
22.bbe: And he said to them, When you go into the town you will see a man coming to you with a vessel of water; go after him into the house into which he goes.

22.msb: and say to the owner of that house, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?’
22.kjv: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
22.blb: and you will say to the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?”’
22.bbe: And say to the master of the house, The Master says, Where is the guest-room, where I may take the Passover with my disciples?

22.msb: And he will show you a large upper room, already furnished. Make preparations there.”
22.kjv: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
22.blb: And he will show you a large furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”
22.bbe: And he will take you up to a great room with a table and seats: there make ready.

22.msb: So they went and found it just as Jesus had told them. And they prepared the Passover.
22.kjv: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
22.blb: And having gone, they found it as He had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.
22.bbe: And they went, and it was as he had said: and they made the Passover ready.

22.msb: When the hour had come, Jesus reclined at the table with His twelve apostles.
22.kjv: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.
22.blb: And when the hour was come, He reclined, and the apostles with Him.
22.bbe: And when the time had come, he took his seat, and the Apostles with him.
22.heading: The Last Supper

22.msb: And He said to them, “I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before My suffering.
22.kjv: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:
22.blb: And He said to them, “With desire I desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.
22.bbe: And he said, I have had a great desire to keep this Passover with you before I come to my death;

22.msb: For I tell you that I will not eat it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God.”
22.kjv: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
22.blb: For I say to you that no longer will I eat thereof until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God.”
22.bbe: For I say to you, I will not take it till it is made complete in the kingdom of God.

22.msb: After taking the cup, He gave thanks and said, “Take this and divide it among yourselves.
22.kjv: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:
22.blb: And having received a cup, having given thanks, He said, “Take this and divide it among yourselves.
22.bbe: And he took a cup and, having given praise, he said, Make division of this among yourselves;

22.msb: For I tell you that I will not drink of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes.”
22.kjv: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.
22.blb: For I say to you that I will not drink of the fruit of the vine from now until the kingdom of God shall come.”
22.bbe: For I say to you, I will not take of the fruit of the vine till the kingdom of God has come.

22.msb: And He took the bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, “This is My body, given for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”
22.kjv: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
22.blb: And having taken the bread, having given thanks, He broke it and gave to them, saying, “This is My body, which is given for you; do this in remembrance of Me,”
22.bbe: And he took bread and, having given praise, he gave it to them when it had been broken, saying, This is my body, which is given for you: do this in memory of me.

22.msb: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood, which is poured out for you.
22.kjv: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.
22.blb: and the cup likewise, after the supping, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood, which is being poured out for you.
22.bbe: And in the same way, after the meal, he took the cup, saying, This cup is the new testament, made with my blood which is given for you.

22.msb: Look! The hand of My betrayer is with Mine on the table.
22.kjv: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
22.blb: But, behold, the hand of him betraying Me is with Me on the table.
22.bbe: But the hand of him who is false to me is with me at the table.

22.msb: Indeed, the Son of Man will go as it has been determined, but woe to that man who betrays Him.”
22.kjv: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!
22.blb: For indeed, the Son of Man goes according to that having been determined. But woe to that man by whom He is betrayed.”
22.bbe: For it will be done to the Son of man after the purpose of God, but unhappy is that man by whom he is given up.

22.msb: Then they began to question among themselves which of them was going to do this.
22.kjv: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
22.blb: And they began to question among themselves who then it might be of them who is about to do this.
22.bbe: And they were wondering among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.

22.msb: A dispute also arose among the disciples as to which of them should be considered the greatest.
22.kjv: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.
22.blb: And there was also a dispute among them as to which of them is thought to be the greatest.
22.bbe: And there was an argument among them about which of them was the greatest.
22.heading: Who Is the Greatest?

22.msb: So Jesus declared, “The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those in authority over them call themselves benefactors.
22.kjv: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
22.blb: And He said to them, “The kings of the Gentiles rule over them, and those exercising authority over them are called benefactors.
22.bbe: And he said, The kings of the Gentiles are lords over them, and those who have authority are given names of honour.

22.msb: But you shall not be like them. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who leads like the one who serves.
22.kjv: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
22.blb: But you shall not be thus. Rather, the greatest among you, let him be as the younger, and the one leading as the one serving.
22.bbe: But let it not be so with you; but he who is greater, let him become like the younger; and he who is chief, like a servant.

22.msb: For who is greater, the one who reclines at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who reclines? But I am among you as one who serves.
22.kjv: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.
22.blb: For who is greater, the one reclining or the one serving? Is it not the one reclining? But I am in your midst as the One serving.
22.bbe: For which is greater, the guest who is seated at a meal or the servant who is waiting on him? is it not the guest? but I am among you as a servant.

22.msb: You are the ones who have stood by Me in My trials.
22.kjv: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
22.blb: Now you are those having remained with Me in My trials.
22.bbe: But you are those who have kept with me through my troubles;

22.msb: And I bestow on you a kingdom, just as My Father has bestowed one on Me,
22.kjv: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
22.blb: And I appoint to you a kingdom, as My Father appointed to Me,
22.bbe: And I will give you a kingdom as my Father has given one to me,

22.msb: so that you may eat and drink at My table and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”
22.kjv: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
22.blb: so that you may eat and may drink at My table in My kingdom, and may sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
22.bbe: So that you may take food and drink at my table in my kingdom, and be seated like kings, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

22.msb: And the Lord said, “Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift all of you like wheat.
22.kjv: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
22.blb: Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked for all of you to sift like wheat.
22.bbe: Simon, Simon, Satan has made a request to have you, so that he may put you to the test as grain is tested:
22.heading: Jesus Predicts Peter’s Denial

22.msb: But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith will not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.”
22.kjv: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
22.blb: But I begged for you, that your faith may not fail. And you, when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.”
22.bbe: But I have made prayer for you, that your faith may not go from you: and when you are turned again, make your brothers strong.

22.msb: “Lord,” said Peter, “I am ready to go with You even to prison and to death.”
22.kjv: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.
22.blb: And he said to Him, “Lord, I am ready to go with You both to prison and to death.”
22.bbe: And he said to him, Lord, I am ready to go with you to prison and to death.

22.msb: But Jesus replied, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will certainly not crow today before you have denied three times that you know Me.”
22.kjv: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
22.blb: But He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow today until you shall deny three times knowing Me.”
22.bbe: And he said, I say to you, Peter, before the cock's second cry today, you will say three times that you have no knowledge of me.

22.msb: Then Jesus asked them, “When I sent you out without purse or bag or sandals, did you lack anything?” “Nothing,” they answered.
22.kjv: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.
22.blb: And He said to them, “When I sent you without purse and bag and sandals, did you lack anything?” And they said, “Nothing.”
22.bbe: And he said to them, When I sent you out without money or bag or shoes, were you in need of anything? And they said, Nothing.

22.msb: “Now, however,” He told them, “the one with a purse should take it, and likewise a bag; and the one without a sword should sell his cloak and buy one.
22.kjv: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.
22.blb: And He said to them, “But now, the one having a purse, let him take it, and likewise a bag; and the one having no sword, let him sell his cloak and buy one.
22.bbe: And he said to them, But now, he who has a money-bag, or a bag for food, let him take it: and he who has not, let him give his coat for money and get a sword.

22.msb: For I tell you that this Scripture must yet be fulfilled in Me: ‘And He was numbered with the transgressors.’ For what is written about Me is reaching its fulfillment.”
22.kjv: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.
22.blb: For I say to you that this which has been written, it is necessary to be accomplished in Me: ‘And He was reckoned with the lawless.’ For also the things concerning Me have an end.”
22.bbe: For I say to you that these words will be put into effect in me, And he was numbered among the evil-doers: for what has been said in the Writings about me has an end.

22.msb: So they said, “Look, Lord, here are two swords.” “That is enough,” He answered.
22.kjv: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
22.blb: And they said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” And He said to them, “It is enough.”
22.bbe: And they said, Lord, here are two swords. And he said, It is enough.

22.msb: Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and His disciples followed Him.
22.kjv: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.
22.blb: And having gone out, He went according to the custom to the Mount of Olives, and the disciples also followed Him.
22.bbe: And he came out, and went, as his way was, to the Mountain of Olives, and the disciples went with him.
22.heading: Jesus Prays on the Mount of Olives

22.msb: When He came to the place, He told them, “Pray that you will not enter into temptation.”
22.kjv: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
22.blb: And having come to the place, He said to them, “Pray not to enter into temptation.”
22.bbe: And when he came to the place, he said to them, Make a prayer that you may not be put to the test.

22.msb: And He withdrew about a stone’s throw beyond them, where He knelt down and prayed,
22.kjv: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone’s cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
22.blb: And He withdrew from them about a stone’s throw, and having fallen on the knees, He was praying,
22.bbe: And he went a little distance away from them and, falling on his knees in prayer, he said,

22.msb: “Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.”
22.kjv: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
22.blb: saying, “Father, if You are willing, take away this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours, be done.”
22.bbe: Father, if it is your pleasure, take this cup from me: but still, let your pleasure, not mine, be done.

22.msb: Then an angel from heaven appeared to Him and strengthened Him.
22.kjv: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.
22.blb: And an angel from heaven appeared to Him, strengthening Him.
22.bbe: And an angel from heaven came to him, to give him strength.

22.msb: And in His anguish, He prayed more earnestly, and His sweat became like drops of blood falling to the ground.
22.kjv: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
22.blb: And having been in agony, He was praying more earnestly. And His sweat became like large drops of blood falling down upon the ground.
22.bbe: And being in great trouble of soul, the force of his prayer became stronger, and great drops, like blood, came from him, falling to the earth.

22.msb: When Jesus rose from prayer and returned to the disciples, He found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.
22.kjv: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,
22.blb: And having risen up from the prayer, having come to the disciples, He found them sleeping from the grief.
22.bbe: And, getting up from prayer, he came to the disciples, and saw that they were sleeping for sorrow.

22.msb: “Why are you sleeping?” He asked. “Get up and pray so that you will not enter into temptation.”
22.kjv: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
22.blb: And He said to them, “Why are you sleeping? Having risen up, pray that you might not enter into temptation.”
22.bbe: And he said, Why are you sleeping? Get up, and give yourselves to prayer, so that you may not be put to the test.

22.msb: While He was still speaking, a crowd arrived, led by the man called Judas, one of the Twelve. He approached Jesus to kiss Him.
22.kjv: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.
22.blb: In His still speaking, behold, a crowd, and he who is called Judas, one of the Twelve, was going before them, and he drew near to Jesus to kiss Him.
22.bbe: And while he was saying these words, there came a band of people, and Judas, one of the twelve, was in front of them, and he came near to Jesus to give him a kiss.
22.heading: The Betrayal of Jesus

22.msb: But Jesus asked him, “Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”
22.kjv: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?
22.blb: And Jesus said to him, “Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”
22.bbe: But Jesus said to him, Judas, will you be false to the Son of man with a kiss?

22.msb: Those around Jesus saw what was about to happen and said to Him, “Lord, should we strike with our swords?”
22.kjv: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?
22.blb: And those around Him, having seen what would be, said, “Lord, will we strike with the sword?”
22.bbe: And when those who were with him saw what was coming, they said, Lord, may we not make use of our swords?

22.msb: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
22.kjv: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
22.blb: And a certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his right ear.
22.bbe: And one of them gave a blow to the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.

22.msb: But Jesus answered, “No more of this!” And He touched the man’s ear and healed him.
22.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
22.blb: But Jesus, answering, said, “Permit only as far as” this! And having touched the ear, He healed him.
22.bbe: But Jesus, answering, said, Put up with this, at least. And touching his ear, he made it well.

22.msb: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, temple officers, and elders who had come for Him, “Have you come out with swords and clubs as you would against an outlaw?
22.kjv: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?
22.blb: And Jesus said to those having come out against Him, the chief priests and captains of the temple and elders, “Have you come out with swords and clubs as against a robber?
22.bbe: And Jesus said to the chief priests and the captains of the Temple and the rulers, who had come against him, Have you come out as against a thief, with swords and sticks?

22.msb: Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on Me. But this hour belongs to you and to the power of darkness.”
22.kjv: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
22.blb: Every day of My being with you in the temple, you did not stretch out the hands against Me; but this is your hour, and that of the power of the darkness.”
22.bbe: When I was in the Temple with you every day, your hands were not stretched out against me: but this is your hour, and the authority of the dark power.

22.msb: Then they seized Jesus, led Him away, and took Him into the house of the high priest. And Peter followed at a distance.
22.kjv: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest’s house. And Peter followed afar off.
22.blb: And having seized Him, they led Him away and led Him into the house of the high priest. And Peter was following afar off.
22.bbe: And they made him a prisoner and took him away to the house of the high priest. But Peter went after them at a distance.
22.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

22.msb: When those present had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat down among them.
22.kjv: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.
22.blb: And on their having kindled a fire in the midst of the courtyard and having sat down together, Peter was sitting among them.
22.bbe: And a fire was lighted in the middle of the open square, and they were seated together, and Peter was among them.

22.msb: A servant girl saw him seated in the firelight and looked intently at him. “This man also was with Him,” she said.
22.kjv: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.
22.blb: And a certain servant girl, having seen him sitting by the light and having looked intently on him, said, “This one also was with Him.”
22.bbe: And a certain woman-servant, seeing him in the light of the fire, and looking at him with attention, said, This man was with him.

22.msb: But Peter denied Him. “Woman, I do not know Him,” he said.
22.kjv: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.
22.blb: But he denied it, saying, “Woman, I do not know Him.”
22.bbe: But he said, Woman, it is not true; I have no knowledge of him.

22.msb: A short time later, someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them.” But Peter said, “Man, I am not.”
22.kjv: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.
22.blb: And after a little, having seen him, another was saying, “You also are of them.” But Peter was saying, “Man, I am not.”
22.bbe: And after a little time, another saw him and said, You are one of them; and he said, Man, I am not.

22.msb: About an hour later, another man insisted, “Certainly this man was with Him, for he too is a Galilean.”
22.kjv: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilæan.
22.blb: And about one hour having elapsed, a certain other strongly affirmed it, saying, “Of a truth, this one also was with Him; for he is also a Galilean.”
22.bbe: And after about an hour, another man said, with decision, Certainly this man was with him, for he is a Galilaean.

22.msb: “Man, I do not know what you are talking about,” Peter replied. And immediately, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.
22.kjv: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
22.blb: But Peter said, “Man, I do not know what you say.” And immediately in his still speaking, a rooster crowed.
22.bbe: And Peter said, Man, I have no knowledge of these things of which you are talking. And straight away, while he was saying these words, there came the cry of a cock.

22.msb: And the Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word that the Lord had spoken to him: “Before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.”
22.kjv: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
22.blb: And having turned, the Lord looked at Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how He said to him, “Before the rooster crows today, you will deny Me three times.”
22.bbe: And the Lord, turning, gave Peter a look. And the words of the Lord came to Peter's mind, how he had said, This night, before the hour of the cock's cry, you will be false to me three times.

22.msb: And Peter went outside and wept bitterly.
22.kjv: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
22.blb: And having gone forth outside, he wept bitterly.
22.bbe: And he went out, weeping bitterly.

22.msb: The men who were holding Jesus began to mock Him and beat Him.
22.kjv: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.
22.blb: And the men who are holding Him began mocking Him, beating Him.
22.bbe: And the men in whose hands Jesus was, made sport of him and gave him blows.
22.heading: The Soldiers Mock Jesus

22.msb: They blindfolded Him and kept striking Him in the face and demanding, “Prophesy! Who hit You?”
22.kjv: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?
22.blb: And having blindfolded Him, they were questioning Him, saying, “Prophesy, who is the one having struck You?”
22.bbe: And, covering his eyes, they said to him, Are you prophet enough to say who gave you that blow?

22.msb: And they said many other blasphemous things against Him.
22.kjv: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.
22.blb: And they were saying many other things to Him, blaspheming.
22.bbe: And they said a number of other evil things against him.

22.msb: At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and scribes, met together. They led Jesus into their Sanhedrin and said,
22.kjv: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,
22.blb: And when it was day, the elderhood of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led Him into their Council, saying,
22.bbe: And when it was day, the rulers of the people came together, with the chief priests and the scribes, and they took him before their Sanhedrin, saying,
22.heading: Jesus before the Sanhedrin

22.msb: “If You are the Christ, tell us.” Jesus answered, “If I tell you, you will not believe.
22.kjv: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:
22.blb: “If You are the Christ, tell us.” But He said to them, “If I should tell you, you would not believe,
22.bbe: If you are the Christ, say so. But he said, If I say so you will not have belief;

22.msb: And if I ask you a question, you will not answer Me nor release Me.
22.kjv: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.
22.blb: and if I should ask you, you would not answer.
22.bbe: And if I put a question to you, you will not give an answer.

22.msb: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”
22.kjv: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.
22.blb: But from now on the Son of Man will be sitting at the right hand of the power of God.”
22.bbe: But in the future the Son of man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.

22.msb: So they all asked, “Are You then the Son of God?” He replied, “You say that I am.”
22.kjv: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
22.blb: And they all said, “Are You then the Son of God?” And He was saying to them, “You say that I am.”
22.bbe: And they all said, Are you then the Son of God? and he said, You say that I am.

22.msb: “Why do we need any more testimony?” they declared. “We have heard it for ourselves from His own lips.”
22.kjv: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.
22.blb: And they said, “What need do we have of any more testimony? For we ourselves heard it from His mouth.”
22.bbe: And they said, What more need have we of witness? we have the very words of his mouth.

23.msb: Then the whole council rose and led Jesus away to Pilate.
23.kjv: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
23.blb: And having risen up, all the multitude of them led Him to Pilate.
23.bbe: And they all went and took him before Pilate.
23.heading: Jesus before Pilate

23.msb: And they began to accuse Him, saying, “We found this man subverting the nation, forbidding payment of taxes to Caesar, and proclaiming Himself to be Christ, a King.”
23.kjv: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cæsar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
23.blb: And they began to accuse Him, saying, “We found this man misleading our nation and forbidding taxes to be given to Caesar, and declaring Himself to be Christ, a King.”
23.bbe: And they made statements against him, saying, This man has to our knowledge been teaching our nation to do wrong, and not to make payment of taxes to Caesar, even saying that he himself is Christ, a king.

23.msb: So Pilate asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
23.kjv: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.
23.blb: And Pilate questioned Him, saying, “Are You the King of the Jews?” And answering him, He was saying, “You say.”
23.bbe: And Pilate said to him, Are you the King of the Jews? And he said in answer, You say so.

23.msb: Then Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”
23.kjv: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
23.blb: And Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, “I find no guilt in this man.”
23.bbe: And Pilate said to the chief priests and the people, In my opinion this man has done no wrong.

23.msb: But they kept insisting, “He stirs up the people all over Judea with His teaching. He began in Galilee and has come all the way here.”
23.kjv: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
23.blb: But they kept insisting, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all of Judea, and He has begun from Galilee even to here.”
23.bbe: But they became more violent than before, saying, He has made trouble among the people, teaching through all Judaea from Galilee to this place.

23.msb: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked if the man was a Galilean.
23.kjv: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilæan.
23.blb: And Pilate, having heard, asked whether the man is a Galilean.
23.bbe: But at these words Pilate said, Is the man a Galilaean?
23.heading: Jesus before Herod

23.msb: And learning that Jesus was under Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, who himself was in Jerusalem at that time.
23.kjv: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
23.blb: And having learned that He is from the jurisdiction of Herod, he sent Him up to Herod, he himself being also in Jerusalem in those days.
23.bbe: And when he saw that he was under the authority of Herod, he sent him to Herod, who was in Jerusalem himself at that time.

23.msb: When Herod saw Jesus, he was greatly pleased. He had wanted to see Him for a long time, because he had heard many things about Him and was hoping to see Him perform a miracle.
23.kjv: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
23.blb: And Herod, having seen Jesus, was exceedingly glad; for of a long time he is wanting to see Him, because of hearing concerning Him; and he was hoping to see some sign done by Him.
23.bbe: Now when Herod saw Jesus he was very glad, having for a long time had a desire to see him, for he had had accounts of him, and was hoping to see some wonders done by him.

23.msb: Herod questioned Jesus at great length, but He gave no answer.
23.kjv: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
23.blb: And he kept questioning Him in many words, but He answered him nothing.
23.bbe: And he put a great number of questions to him, but he said nothing.

23.msb: Meanwhile, the chief priests and scribes stood there, vehemently accusing Him.
23.kjv: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
23.blb: And the chief priests and the scribes had been standing by, vehemently accusing Him.
23.bbe: And the chief priests and the scribes were there, making statements against him violently.

23.msb: And even Herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked Him. Dressing Him in a fine robe, they sent Him back to Pilate.
23.kjv: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
23.blb: And Herod, with his troops, having treated Him with contempt and also having mocked Him, having put on Him splendid apparel, sent Him back to Pilate.
23.bbe: And Herod, with the men of his army, put shame on him and made sport of him, and dressing him in shining robes, he sent him back to Pilate.

23.msb: That day Pilate and Herod became friends; before this time they had been enemies.
23.kjv: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
23.blb: And both Herod and Pilate became friends with one another on that day; for previously they were at enmity between themselves.
23.bbe: And that day Herod and Pilate became friends with one another, for before they had been against one another.

23.msb: Then Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
23.kjv: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
23.blb: And Pilate, having called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
23.bbe: And Pilate sent for the chief priests and the rulers and the people, and said to them,
23.heading: The Crowd Chooses Barabbas

23.msb: and said to them, “You brought me this man as one who was inciting the people to rebellion. I have examined Him here in your presence and found Him not guilty of your charges against Him.
23.kjv: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
23.blb: said to them, “You brought to me this man as one misleading the people; and behold, having examined Him before you, I found nothing in this man guilty of that accusation you are bringing against Him—
23.bbe: You say that this man has been teaching the people evil things: now I, after going into the question before you, see nothing wrong in this man in connection with the things which you have said against him:

23.msb: Neither has Herod, for I sent you back to him. As you can see, He has done nothing deserving of death.
23.kjv: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
23.blb: no, nor even Herod, for he sent Him back to us. And behold, nothing worthy of death is done by Him.
23.bbe: And Herod is of the same opinion, for he has sent him back to us; for, you see, he has done nothing for which I might put him to death.

23.msb: Therefore I will punish Him and release Him.”
23.kjv: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.
23.blb: Therefore, having chastised Him, I will release Him.”
23.bbe: And so I will give him punishment and let him go.

23.msb: Now Pilate was obliged to release to the people one prisoner at the feast.
23.kjv: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)

23.msb: But they all cried out in unison: “Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!”
23.kjv: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:
23.blb: But they cried out all together, saying, “Away with this man, and release to us Barabbas,”
23.bbe: But with loud voices they said all together, Put this man to death, and make Barabbas free.

23.msb: (Barabbas had been imprisoned for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)
23.kjv: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
23.blb: who was one having been cast into the prison on account of a certain insurrection having been made in the city, and murder.
23.bbe: Now this man was in prison because of an attack against the government in the town, in which there had been loss of life.

23.msb: Wanting to release Jesus, Pilate addressed them again,
23.kjv: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.
23.blb: Therefore Pilate, wanting to release Jesus, called to them again.
23.bbe: And Pilate again said to them that it was his desire to let Jesus go free.

23.msb: but they kept shouting, “Crucify Him! Crucify Him!”
23.kjv: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.
23.blb: But they were crying out, saying, “Crucify! Crucify Him!”
23.bbe: But crying out they said, To the cross with him!

23.msb: A third time he said to them, “What evil has this man done? I have found in Him no offense worthy of death. So after I punish Him, I will release Him.”
23.kjv: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
23.blb: And he said to them a third time, “What evil indeed did this man commit? I found no cause of death in Him. Therefore having chastised Him, I will release Him.”
23.bbe: And he said to them a third time, Why, what evil has he done? I see no reason for putting him to death: I will give him punishment and let him go.

23.msb: But they were insistent, demanding with loud voices for Jesus to be crucified. And their clamor and that of the chief priests prevailed.
23.kjv: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
23.blb: But they were urgent, asking with loud voices for Him to be crucified. And their voices were prevailing.
23.bbe: But they went on crying out loudly, Let him be put to death on the cross. And they had their way.

23.msb: So Pilate sentenced that their demand be met.
23.kjv: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
23.blb: And Pilate sentenced their demand to be done.
23.bbe: And Pilate gave his decision for their desire to be put into effect.

23.msb: As they had requested, he released the one imprisoned for insurrection and murder, and he handed Jesus over to their will.
23.kjv: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
23.blb: And he released the one having been cast into prison on account of insurrection and murder, whom they had asked for; and Jesus he delivered up to their will.
23.bbe: And in answer to their request, he let that man go free who had been in prison for acting against the government and causing death, and Jesus he gave up to their pleasure.

23.msb: As the soldiers led Him away, they seized Simon of Cyrene on his way in from the country, and they put the cross on him to carry behind Jesus.
23.kjv: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.
23.blb: And as they led Him away, having laid hold on Simon, a certain man of Cyrene coming from the country, they put upon him the cross, to carry it behind Jesus.
23.bbe: And while they were taking him away, they put their hands on Simon of Cyrene, who was coming from the country, and made him take the cross after Jesus.
23.heading: The Crucifixion

23.msb: A great number of people followed Him, including women who kept mourning and wailing for Him.
23.kjv: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
23.blb: And a great multitude of the people were following Him, and of women who were mourning and lamenting for Him.
23.bbe: And a great band of people went after him, and of women making signs of grief and weeping for him.

23.msb: But Jesus turned to them and said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
23.kjv: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
23.blb: But having turned to them, Jesus said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
23.bbe: But Jesus, turning to them, said, Daughters of Jerusalem, let not your weeping be for me, but for yourselves and for your children.

23.msb: Look, the days are coming when people will say, ‘Blessed are the barren women, the wombs that never bore, and breasts that never nursed!’
23.kjv: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
23.blb: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never did bear, and the breasts that never nursed!’
23.bbe: For the days are coming in which they will say, Happy are those who have had no children, whose bodies have never given birth, whose breasts have never given milk.

23.msb: At that time ‘they will say to the mountains, “Fall on us!” and to the hills, “Cover us!”’
23.kjv: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
23.blb: Then ‘they will begin to say to the mountains, “Fall upon us,” and to the hills, “Cover us.”’
23.bbe: And they will say to the mountains, Come down on us, and to the hills, Be a cover over us.

23.msb: For if men do these things while the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?”
23.kjv: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
23.blb: For if they do these things in the green tree, what might happen in the dry?”
23.bbe: For if they do these things when the tree is green, what will they do when it is dry?

23.msb: Two others, who were criminals, were also led away to be executed with Jesus.
23.kjv: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
23.blb: And two other criminals also were being led away to be put to death with Him.
23.bbe: And two others, evil-doers, were taken with him to be put to death.

23.msb: When they came to the place called The Skull, they crucified Him there, along with the criminals, one on His right and the other on His left.
23.kjv: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
23.blb: And when they came to the place called The Skull, there they crucified Him, and the criminals, one on the right hand and one on the left hand.
23.bbe: And when they came to the place which is named Golgotha, they put him on the cross, and the evil-doers, one on the right side, and the other on the left.

23.msb: Then Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.” And they divided up His garments by casting lots.
23.kjv: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
23.blb: And Jesus was saying, “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they do.” And they cast lots, dividing His garments.
23.bbe: And Jesus said, Father, let them have forgiveness, for they have no knowledge of what they are doing. And they made division of his clothing among them by the decision of chance.

23.msb: The people stood watching, and the rulers with them sneered at Him, saying, “He saved others; let Him save Himself if He is the Christ, the Chosen One of God.”
23.kjv: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.
23.blb: And the people stood, looking on. And the rulers also were deriding Him, saying, “He saved others; let Him save Himself if this is the Christ of God, the Chosen One.”
23.bbe: And the people were looking on. And the rulers made sport of him, saying, He was a saviour of others; let him do something for himself, if he is the Christ, the man of God's selection.

23.msb: The soldiers also mocked Him and came up to offer Him sour wine.
23.kjv: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
23.blb: And the soldiers also mocked Him, coming near, offering Him sour wine
23.bbe: And the men of the army made sport of him, coming to him and giving him bitter wine,

23.msb: “If You are the King of the Jews,” they said, “save Yourself!”
23.kjv: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.
23.blb: and saying, “If You are the King of the Jews, save Yourself!”
23.bbe: And saying, If you are the King of the Jews, get yourself free.

23.msb: Above Him was posted an inscription written in Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
23.kjv: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
23.blb: And there was also an inscription over Him: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
23.bbe: And these words were put in writing over him, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

23.msb: One of the criminals who hung there heaped abuse on Him. “If You are the Christ,” he said, “save Yourself and us!”
23.kjv: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.
23.blb: And one of the criminals having been hanged was railing at Him, saying, “Are You not the Christ? Save Yourself and us!”
23.bbe: And one of the evil-doers on the cross, with bitter feeling, said to him, Are you not the Christ? Get yourself and us out of this.

23.msb: But the other one rebuked him, saying, “Do you not even fear God, since you are under the same judgment?
23.kjv: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
23.blb: But the other, answering, was rebuking him, saying, “Do you not even fear God, since you are under the same judgment,
23.bbe: But the other, protesting, said, Have you no fear of God? for you have a part in the same punishment,

23.msb: We are punished justly, for we are receiving what our actions deserve. But this man has done nothing wrong.”
23.kjv: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
23.blb: and we indeed justly? For we are receiving back things worthy of what we did, but this man did nothing wrong.”
23.bbe: And with reason; for we have the right reward of our acts, but this man has done nothing wrong.

23.msb: Then he said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when You come into Your kingdom!”
23.kjv: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
23.blb: And he was saying, “Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom!”
23.bbe: And he said, Jesus, keep me in mind when you come in your kingdom.

23.msb: And Jesus said to him, “Truly I tell you, today you will be with Me in Paradise.”
23.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
23.blb: And He said to him, “Truly I say to you, today you will be with Me in Paradise.”
23.bbe: And he said to him, Truly I say to you, Today you will be with me in Paradise.

23.msb: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over all the land until the ninth hour.
23.kjv: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.
23.blb: And now it was about the sixth hour, and darkness came over all the land until the ninth hour,
23.bbe: And it was now about the sixth hour; and all the land was dark till the ninth hour;
23.heading: The Death of Jesus

23.msb: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn down the middle.
23.kjv: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
23.blb: the sun having darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in the middle.
23.bbe: The light of the sun went out, and the curtain in the Temple was parted in two.

23.msb: Then Jesus called out in a loud voice, “Father, into Your hands I commit My Spirit.” And when He had said this, He breathed His last.
23.kjv: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
23.blb: And having called out in a loud voice, Jesus said, “Father, into Your hands I commit My Spirit.” And having said this, He breathed His last.
23.bbe: And Jesus gave a loud cry and said, Father, into your hands I give my spirit: and when he had said this, he gave up his spirit.

23.msb: When the centurion saw what had happened, he gave glory to God, saying, “Surely this was a righteous man.”
23.kjv: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
23.blb: And having seen that having taken place, the centurion was glorifying God, saying, “Certainly this man was righteous.”
23.bbe: And when the captain saw what was done, he gave praise to God, saying, Without doubt this was an upright man.

23.msb: And when all the people who had gathered for this spectacle saw what had happened, they returned home beating their breasts.
23.kjv: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
23.blb: And all the crowds having come together to this spectacle, having seen the things having taken place, were turning back, beating their breasts.
23.bbe: And all the people who had come together to see it, when they saw the things which were done, went back again making signs of grief.

23.msb: But all those who knew Jesus, including the women who had followed Him from Galilee, stood at a distance watching these things.
23.kjv: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.
23.blb: But all from those who knew Him, and the women, those having followed Him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.
23.bbe: And all his friends and the women who came with him from Galilee, were waiting at a distance, watching these things.

23.msb: Now there was a Council member named Joseph, a good and righteous man,
23.kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:
23.blb: And behold, a man named Joseph, being also a Council member, a good and righteous man—
23.bbe: Now there was a man named Joseph, a man of authority and a good and upright man
23.heading: The Burial of Jesus

23.msb: who had not consented to their decision or action. He was from the Judean town of Arimathea and himself was waiting for the kingdom of God.
23.kjv: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathæa, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
23.blb: he was not having consented to their counsel and deed—from Arimathea, a city of the Jews, who was waiting for the kingdom of God,
23.bbe: (He had not given his approval to their decision or their acts), of Arimathaea, a town of the Jews, who was waiting for the kingdom of God:

23.msb: He went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus.
23.kjv: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.
23.blb: he, having gone to Pilate, asked for the body of Jesus.
23.bbe: This man went to Pilate and made a request for the body of Jesus.

23.msb: Then he took it down, wrapped it in a linen cloth, and placed it in a tomb cut into the rock, where no one had yet been laid.
23.kjv: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
23.blb: And having taken it down, he wrapped it in a linen cloth and placed it in a tomb cut in a rock, in which no one yet was laid.
23.bbe: And he took it down, and folding it in a linen cloth, he put it in a place cut in the rock for a dead body; and no one had ever been put in it.

23.msb: It was Preparation Day, and the Sabbath was beginning.
23.kjv: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
23.blb: And it was the Day of Preparation, and Sabbath was beginning.
23.bbe: Now it was the day of making ready and the Sabbath was coming on.

23.msb: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed, and they saw the tomb and how His body was placed.
23.kjv: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.
23.blb: And the women who had come with Him out of Galilee, having followed, saw the tomb and how His body was laid.
23.bbe: And the women who had come with him from Galilee went after him and saw the place and how his body had been put to rest;

23.msb: Then they returned to prepare spices and perfumes. And they rested on the Sabbath, according to the commandment.
23.kjv: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.
23.blb: And having returned, they prepared spices and anointing oils. And they rested indeed on the Sabbath according to the commandment.
23.bbe: And they went back and got ready spices and perfumes; and on the Sabbath they took their rest, in agreement with the law.

24.msb: On the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they and certain other women with them came to the tomb, bringing the spices they had prepared.
24.kjv: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.
24.blb: But on the first of the Sabbaths at early dawn they came to the tomb bringing the spices that they prepared.
24.bbe: But on the first day of the week, at dawn, they came to the place where his body had been put, taking the spices which they had got ready.
24.heading: The Resurrection

24.msb: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb,
24.kjv: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.
24.blb: And they found the stone having been rolled away from the tomb,
24.bbe: And they saw that the stone had been rolled away.

24.msb: but when they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.
24.kjv: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.
24.blb: but having entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.
24.bbe: And they went in, but the body of the Lord Jesus was not there.

24.msb: While they were puzzling over this, suddenly two men in radiant apparel stood beside them.
24.kjv: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:
24.blb: And it came to pass that while they are perplexed about this, behold, two men in dazzling apparel stood by them.
24.bbe: And while they were in doubt about it, they saw two men in shining clothing by them:

24.msb: As the women bowed their faces to the ground in terror, the two men asked them, “Why do you look for the living among the dead?
24.kjv: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?
24.blb: And on their having become terrified and bowing the faces to the ground, they said to them, “Why do you seek the living with the dead?
24.bbe: And while their faces were bent down to the earth in fear, these said to them, Why are you looking for the living among the dead?

24.msb: He is not here; He has risen! Remember how He told you while He was still in Galilee:
24.kjv: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
24.blb: He is not here, but He is risen! Remember how He spoke to you, being yet in Galilee,
24.bbe: He is not here, he has come back to life: have in mind what he said to you when he was still in Galilee, saying,

24.msb: ‘The Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and on the third day rise again.’”
24.kjv: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
24.blb: saying, ‘It is necessary for the Son of Man to be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and to be crucified, and the third day to rise again.’”
24.bbe: The Son of man will be given up into the hands of evil-doers, and be put to death on the cross, and on the third day he will come back to life.

24.msb: Then they remembered His words.
24.kjv: And they remembered his words,
24.blb: And they remembered His words.
24.bbe: And his words came back into their minds,

24.msb: And when they returned from the tomb, they reported all these things to the Eleven and to all the others.
24.kjv: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.
24.blb: And having returned from the tomb, they related all these things to the Eleven and to all the rest.
24.bbe: And they went away from that place and gave an account of all these things to the eleven disciples and all the others.

24.msb: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them who told this to the apostles.
24.kjv: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.
24.blb: Now it was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them, who were saying these things to the apostles.
24.bbe: Now they were Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary, the mother of James: and the other women with them said these things to the Apostles.

24.msb: But their words seemed like nonsense to them, and they did not believe the women.
24.kjv: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
24.blb: And these words appeared before them like folly, and they did not believe them.
24.bbe: But these words seemed foolish to them, and they had no belief in them.

24.msb: Peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb. And after bending down and seeing only the linen cloths lying there, he went away, wondering to himself what had happened.
24.kjv: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.
24.blb: But Peter, having risen up, ran to the tomb, and having stooped down, he sees only the linen strips. And he went away, wondering in himself at that having come to pass.
24.bbe: But Peter got up and went to the place where the body had been put, and looking in he saw nothing but the linen cloths, and he went to his house full of wonder at what had taken place.

24.msb: That same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.
24.kjv: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.
24.blb: And behold, on the same day, two of them were going to a village whose name is Emmaus, sixty stadia distant from Jerusalem.
24.bbe: And then, two of them, on that very day, were going to a little town named Emmaus, which was about seven miles from Jerusalem.
24.heading: The Road to Emmaus

24.msb: They were talking with each other about everything that had happened.
24.kjv: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
24.blb: And they were talking with one another about all these things having taken place.
24.bbe: And they were talking together about all those things which had taken place.

24.msb: And as they talked and deliberated, Jesus Himself came up and walked along with them.
24.kjv: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
24.blb: And it came to pass, in their talking and reasoning, that Jesus Himself, having drawn near, was walking along with them.
24.bbe: And while they were talking and questioning together, Jesus himself came near and went with them.

24.msb: But their eyes were kept from recognizing Him.
24.kjv: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
24.blb: But their eyes were held not to know Him.
24.bbe: But their eyes were not open that they might have knowledge of him.

24.msb: He asked them, “What are you discussing so intently as you walk along with sadness on your faces?”
24.kjv: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
24.blb: And He said to them, “What are these words that you exchange with one another, walking?” And they stood still, looking sad.
24.bbe: And he said to them, What are you talking about together while you go?

24.msb: The one named Cleopas asked Him, “Are You the only visitor to Jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in recent days?”
24.kjv: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?
24.blb: And the one named Cleopas, answering, said to Him, “Are You alone visiting Jerusalem and have not known the things having come to pass in it in these days?”
24.bbe: Then stopping, and looking sadly at him, one of them, named Cleopas, said to him, Are you the only man living in Jerusalem who has not had news of the things which have taken place there at this time?

24.msb: “What things?” He asked. “The events involving Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered. “This man was a prophet, powerful in speech and action before God and all the people.
24.kjv: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:
24.blb: And He said to them, “What things?” And they said to Him, “The things concerning Jesus of Nazareth, a man who was a prophet, mighty in deed and word before God and all the people,
24.bbe: And he said to them, What things? And they said, The things to do with Jesus of Nazareth, who was a prophet, great in his acts and his words, before God and all the people:

24.msb: Our chief priests and rulers delivered Him up to the sentence of death, and they crucified Him.
24.kjv: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.
24.blb: and how our chief priests and rulers delivered Him up to the judgment of death, and they crucified Him.
24.bbe: And how the chief priests and our rulers gave him up to be put to death on the cross.

24.msb: But we were hoping He was the One who would redeem Israel. And besides all this, today is the third day since these things took place.
24.kjv: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.
24.blb: But we were hoping it is He who is about to redeem Israel. But indeed also with all these things, this brings the third day away from which these things came to pass.
24.bbe: But we were hoping that he would be the Saviour of Israel. In addition to all this he has now let three days go by from the time when these things took place;

24.msb: Furthermore, some of our women astounded us. They were at the tomb early,
24.kjv: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;
24.blb: But also, certain women out from us astonished us. Having been to the tomb early this morning
24.bbe: And certain women among us gave us cause for wonder, for they went early to the place where his body had been put,

24.msb: but they did not find His body. They came and told us they had seen a vision of angels, who said that Jesus was alive.
24.kjv: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.
24.blb: and not having found His body, they came declaring to have also seen a vision of angels, who say He is alive.
24.bbe: And it was not there; then they came saying that they had seen a vision of angels who said that he was living.

24.msb: Then some of our companions went to the tomb and found it just as the women had described. But Him they did not see.”
24.kjv: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
24.blb: And some of those with us went to the tomb and found it thus, even as the women said. But Him they did not see.”
24.bbe: And some of those who were with us went to the place, and saw that it was as the women had said, but him they did not see.

24.msb: Then Jesus said to them, “O foolish ones, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken!
24.kjv: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:
24.blb: And He said to them, “O foolish and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets spoke!
24.bbe: And he said, O foolish men! how slow you are to give belief to what the prophets have said.

24.msb: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and then to enter His glory?”
24.kjv: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?
24.blb: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and to enter into His glory?”
24.bbe: Was it not necessary for the Christ to go through these things, and to come into his glory?

24.msb: And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, He explained to them what was written in all the Scriptures about Himself.
24.kjv: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
24.blb: And having begun from Moses and from all the Prophets, He interpreted to them the things concerning Himself in all the Scriptures.
24.bbe: And he made clear to them all the things in the Writings, from Moses and from all the prophets, which had to do with himself.

24.msb: As they approached the village where they were headed, He seemed to be going farther.
24.kjv: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.
24.blb: And they drew near to the village where they were going, and He appeared to be going farther.
24.bbe: And they came near the town to which they were going, and he seemed as if he was going on;

24.msb: But they pleaded with Him, “Stay with us, for it is nearly evening and the day is almost over.” So He went in to stay with them.
24.kjv: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.
24.blb: And they constrained Him, saying, “Abide with us, for it is toward evening, and now the day has declined.” And He entered in to abide with them.
24.bbe: But they kept him back, saying, Do not go, for evening is near, the day is almost gone. And he went in with them.

24.msb: While He was reclining at the table with them, He took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to them.
24.kjv: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.
24.blb: And it came to pass, in His reclining with them, having taken the bread, that He blessed it; and having broken it, He began giving it to them.
24.bbe: And when he was seated with them at table, he took the bread, and said words of blessing and, making division of it, he gave it to them.

24.msb: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized Jesus—and He disappeared from their sight.
24.kjv: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
24.blb: And their eyes were opened, and they knew Him. And He, being seen, vanished from them.
24.bbe: And then their eyes were open, and they had knowledge of him, but he went from their view.

24.msb: They asked each other, “Were not our hearts burning within us as He spoke with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?”
24.kjv: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
24.blb: And they said to one another, “Was not our heart burning within us as He was speaking with us on the road, as He was opening the Scriptures to us?”
24.bbe: And they said to one another, Were not our hearts burning in us while he was talking to us on the way, making clear to us the holy Writings?

24.msb: And they got up that very hour and returned to Jerusalem. There they found the Eleven and those with them, gathered together
24.kjv: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
24.blb: And having risen up that same hour, they returned to Jerusalem. And they found the Eleven and those with them gathered together,
24.bbe: And that very hour they got up and went back to Jerusalem, where the eleven and the others had come together.

24.msb: and saying, “The Lord has indeed risen and has appeared to Simon!”
24.kjv: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
24.blb: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and He has appeared to Simon!”
24.bbe: And they said to them, The Lord has truly come back to life again, and Simon has seen him.

24.msb: Then the two told what had happened on the road, and how they had recognized Jesus in the breaking of the bread.
24.kjv: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
24.blb: And they began relating the things on the road, and how He was known to them in the breaking of the bread.
24.bbe: And they gave an account of the things which had taken place on the way, and how, when he gave them bread, they had knowledge of him.

24.msb: While they were describing these events, Jesus Himself stood among them and said, “Peace be with you.”
24.kjv: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
24.blb: And in their telling these things, He Himself stood in their midst and says to them, “Peace to you.”
