24.bbe: And while they were saying these things, he himself was among them, and said to them, Peace be with you!
24.heading: Jesus Appears to the Disciples

24.msb: But they were startled and frightened, thinking they had seen a spirit.
24.kjv: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
24.blb: But having been terrified, and having been filled with fear, they were thinking themselves to see a spirit.
24.bbe: But they were full of fear, being of the opinion that they were seeing a spirit.

24.msb: “Why are you troubled,” Jesus asked, “and why do doubts arise in your hearts?
24.kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?
24.blb: And He said to them, “Why are you troubled, and why do doubts come up in your hearts?
24.bbe: And he said to them, Why are you troubled, and why are your hearts full of doubt?

24.msb: Look at My hands and My feet. It is I Myself. Touch Me and see—for a spirit does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have.”
24.kjv: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.
24.blb: See My hands and My feet, that I am He. Touch Me and see, for a spirit does not have flesh and bones, as you see Me having.”
24.bbe: See; my hands and my feet: it is I myself; put your hands on me and make certain; for a spirit has not flesh and bones as you see that I have.

24.msb: And when He had said this, He showed them His hands and feet.
24.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.
24.blb: And having said this, He showed to them the hands and the feet.
24.bbe: And when he had said this, he let them see his hands and his feet.

24.msb: While they were still in disbelief because of their joy and amazement, He asked them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”
24.kjv: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?
24.blb: And in their still disbelieving from joy and wondering, He said to them, “Have you anything here to eat?”
24.bbe: And because, for joy and wonder, they were still in doubt, he said to them, Have you any food here?

24.msb: So they gave Him a piece of broiled fish and some honeycomb,
24.kjv: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
24.blb: And they gave to Him part of a broiled fish.
24.bbe: And they gave him a bit of cooked fish.

24.msb: and He took them and ate them in front of them.
24.kjv: And he took it, and did eat before them.
24.blb: And having taken, He ate before them.
24.bbe: And before their eyes he took a meal.

24.msb: Jesus said to them, “These are the words I spoke to you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about Me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms.”
24.kjv: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.
24.blb: And He said to them, “These are My words, which I spoke to you being still with you, that it is necessary to be fulfilled all things having been written concerning Me in the Law of Moses and the Prophets and the Psalms.”
24.bbe: And he said to them, These are the words which I said to you when I was still with you, how it was necessary for all the things which are in the writings of Moses and the prophets and in the Psalms about me, to be put into effect.

24.msb: Then He opened their minds to understand the Scriptures.
24.kjv: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,
24.blb: Then He opened their mind to understand the Scriptures.
24.bbe: Then he made the holy Writings clear to their minds.

24.msb: And He told them, “This is what is written: And thus it is necessary that the Christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,
24.kjv: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:
24.blb: And He said to them, “Thus it has been written: The Christ was to suffer and to rise out from the dead on the third day,
24.bbe: And he said to them, So it is in the Writings that the Christ would undergo death, and come back to life again on the third day;

24.msb: and in His name repentance and forgiveness of sins will be proclaimed to all nations, beginning in Jerusalem.
24.kjv: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
24.blb: and repentance and forgiveness of sins are to be proclaimed in His name to all nations, having begun from Jerusalem.
24.bbe: And that teaching about a change of heart and forgiveness of sins is to be given to Jerusalem first and to all nations in his name.

24.msb: You are witnesses of these things.
24.kjv: And ye are witnesses of these things.
24.blb: You are witnesses of these things.
24.bbe: You are witnesses of these things.

24.msb: And behold, I am sending the promise of My Father upon you. But remain in the city of Jerusalem until you have been clothed with power from on high.”
24.kjv: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.
24.blb: And behold, I am sending the promise of My Father upon you. But you, remain in the city until you should be clothed with power from on high.”
24.bbe: And now I will send to you what my father has undertaken to give you, but do not go from the town, till the power from heaven comes to you.

24.msb: When Jesus had led them out as far as Bethany, He lifted up His hands and blessed them.
24.kjv: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
24.blb: And He led them out as far as to Bethany, and having lifted up His hands, He blessed them.
24.bbe: And he took them out till they were near Bethany, and lifting up his hands, he gave them a blessing.
24.heading: The Ascension

24.msb: While He was blessing them, He left them and was carried up into heaven.
24.kjv: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.
24.blb: And it came to pass, in His blessing them, that He was separated from them and was carried up into heaven.
24.bbe: And while he was doing so, he went from them and was taken up into heaven.

24.msb: And they worshiped Him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
24.kjv: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
24.blb: And they, having worshiped Him, returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
24.bbe: And they gave him worship and went back to Jerusalem with great joy.

24.msb: praising and blessing God continually in the temple.
24.kjv: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
24.blb: and they were through all time in the temple, blessing God.
24.bbe: And they were in the Temple at all times, giving praise to God.

1.msb: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
1.kjv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
1.blb: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
1.bbe: From the first he was the Word, and the Word was in relation with God and was God.
1.heading: The Beginning

1.msb: He was with God in the beginning.
1.kjv: The same was in the beginning with God.
1.blb: This One was in the beginning with God.
1.bbe: This Word was from the first in relation with God.

1.msb: Through Him all things were made, and without Him nothing was made that has been made.
1.kjv: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
1.blb: All things came into being through Him, and without Him not even one thing came into being that has come into being.
1.bbe: All things came into existence through him, and without him nothing was.

1.msb: In Him was life, and that life was the light of men.
1.kjv: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
1.blb: In Him was life, and the life was the light of men.
1.bbe: What came into existence in him was life, and the life was the light of men.

1.msb: The Light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
1.kjv: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
1.blb: And the Light shines in the darkness, and the darkness did not overcome it.
1.bbe: And the light goes on shining in the dark; it is not overcome by the dark.

1.msb: There came a man who was sent from God. His name was John.
1.kjv: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
1.blb: There was a man sent from God; His name was John.
1.bbe: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
1.heading: The Witness of John

1.msb: He came as a witness to testify about the Light, so that through him everyone might believe.
1.kjv: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
1.blb: This one came for testimony, so that he might testify concerning the Light, so that all might believe through him.
1.bbe: He came for witness, to give witness about the light, so that all men might have faith through him.

1.msb: He himself was not the Light, but he came to testify about the Light.
1.kjv: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
1.blb: That one was not the Light, but it is so that he might testify concerning the Light.
1.bbe: He himself was not the light: he was sent to give witness about the light.

1.msb: The true Light, who gives light to everyone, was coming into the world.
1.kjv: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
1.blb: The true Light who enlightens every man was coming into the world.
1.bbe: The true light, which gives light to every man, was then coming into the world.

1.msb: He was in the world, and though the world was made through Him, the world did not recognize Him.
1.kjv: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
1.blb: He was in the world, and the world came into being through Him, and the world did not know Him.
1.bbe: He was in the world, the world which came into being through him, but the world had no knowledge of him.

1.msb: He came to His own, and His own did not receive Him.
1.kjv: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
1.blb: He came to His own, and His own did not receive Him.
1.bbe: He came to the things which were his and his people did not take him to their hearts.

1.msb: But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God—
1.kjv: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
1.blb: But as many as received Him, He gave to them authority to become children of God—to those believing in His name,
1.bbe: To all those who did so take him, however, he gave the right of becoming children of God — that is, to those who had faith in his name:

1.msb: children born not of blood, nor of the desire or will of man, but born of God.
1.kjv: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
1.blb: who were born not of blood, nor of will of flesh, nor of will of man, but of God.
1.bbe: Whose birth was from God and not from blood, or from an impulse of the flesh and man's desire.

1.msb: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us. We have seen His glory, the glory of the one and only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
1.kjv: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
1.blb: And the Word became flesh and tabernacled among us. And we saw His glory, glory as of the only begotten from the Father, full of grace and truth.
1.bbe: And so the Word became flesh and took a place among us for a time; and we saw his glory — such glory as is given to an only son by his father — saw it to be true and full of grace.
1.heading: The Word Became Flesh

1.msb: John testified concerning Him. He cried out, saying, “This is He of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’”
1.kjv: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
1.blb: John testifies concerning Him, and he has cried out, saying, “This was He of whom I said, ‘The One coming after me has precedence over me, because He was before me.’”
1.bbe: John gave witness about him, crying, This is he of whom I said, He who is coming after me is put over me because he was in existence before me.

1.msb: From His fullness we have all received grace upon grace.
1.kjv: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
1.blb: For from His fullness we all received also grace upon grace.
1.bbe: From his full measure we have all been given grace on grace.

1.msb: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
1.blb: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
1.bbe: For the law was given through Moses; grace and the true way of life are ours through Jesus Christ.

1.msb: No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is at the Father’s side, has made Him known.
1.kjv: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
1.blb: No one has ever yet seen God. The only begotten God, the One being in the bosom of the Father, He has made Him known.
1.bbe: No man has seen God at any time; the only Son, who is on the breast of the Father, he has made clear what God is.

1.msb: And this was John’s testimony when the Jews of Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him, “Who are you?”
1.kjv: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?
1.blb: And this is the testimony of John when the Jews of Jerusalem sent to him priests and Levites so that they might ask him, “Who are you?”
1.bbe: And this is the witness of John when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to him with the question, Who are you?
1.heading: The Mission of John the Baptist

1.msb: He did not refuse to confess, but openly declared, “I am not the Christ.”
1.kjv: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
1.blb: And he confessed and did not deny, but confessed, “I am not the Christ.”
1.bbe: He said quite openly and straightforwardly, I am not the Christ.

1.msb: “Then who are you?” they inquired. “Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the Prophet?” He answered, “No.”
1.kjv: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
1.blb: And they asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” And he says, “I am not.” “Are you the Prophet?” And he answered, “No.”
1.bbe: And they said to him, What then? Are you Elijah? And he said, I am not. Are you the prophet? And his answer was, I am not.

1.msb: So they said to him, “Who are you? We need an answer for those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
1.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
1.blb: Therefore they said to him, “Who are you, so that we might give an answer to those having sent us? What do you say about yourself?”
1.bbe: So they said to him, Who are you then? We have to give some answer to those who sent us. What have you to say about yourself?

1.msb: John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet: “I am a voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way for the Lord.’”
1.kjv: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
1.blb: He was saying, “I am a voice crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ just as Isaiah the prophet said.”
1.bbe: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the waste land, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said Isaiah the prophet.

1.msb: Then those whom the Pharisees had sent
1.kjv: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
1.blb: And ones having been sent were from the Pharisees,
1.bbe: Those who had been sent came from the Pharisees.

1.msb: asked him, “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?”
1.kjv: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
1.blb: and they asked him and said to him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?”
1.bbe: And they put this question to him, saying, Why then are you giving baptism if you are not the Christ, or Elijah, or the prophet?

1.msb: “I baptize with water,” John replied, “but among you stands One you do not know.
1.kjv: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
1.blb: John answered them, saying, “I baptize in water, but in the midst of you stands One whom you do not know,
1.bbe: John's answer was: I give baptism with water; but there is one among you of whom you have no knowledge;

1.msb: He is the One who comes after me, who is preferred before me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.”
1.kjv: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
1.blb: the One coming after me, of whom I am not worthy that I should loose the strap of His sandal.”
1.bbe: It is he who is coming after me; I am not good enough to undo his shoes.

1.msb: All this happened at Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
1.kjv: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
1.blb: These things came to pass in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
1.bbe: These things took place at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan, where John was giving baptism.

1.msb: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, “Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
1.kjv: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
1.blb: On the next day he sees Jesus coming to him and says, “Behold, the Lamb of God, the One taking away the sin of the world!
1.bbe: The day after, John sees Jesus coming to him and says, See, here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
1.heading: Jesus the Lamb of God

1.msb: This is He of whom I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’
1.kjv: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
1.blb: This is the One concerning whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who has precedence over me, because He was before me.’
1.bbe: This is he of whom I said, One is coming after me who is put over me because he was in existence before me.

1.msb: I myself did not know Him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that He might be revealed to Israel.”
1.kjv: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
1.blb: And I did not know Him, but so that He might be revealed to Israel, because of this, I came baptizing in water.”
1.bbe: I myself had no knowledge of him, but I came giving baptism with water so that he might be seen openly by Israel.

1.msb: Then John testified, “I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove and resting on Him.
1.kjv: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
1.blb: And John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending as a dove out of heaven, and it remained upon Him.
1.bbe: And John gave this witness, saying, I saw the Spirit coming down from heaven like a dove and resting on him.

1.msb: I myself did not know Him, but the One who sent me to baptize with water told me, ‘The man on whom you see the Spirit descend and rest is He who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’
1.kjv: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
1.blb: And I did not know Him, but the One having sent me to baptize in water, He said to me, ‘Upon whom you shall see the Spirit descending and remaining upon Him, this is the One baptizing in the Holy Spirit.’
1.bbe: I had no knowledge who he was, but he who sent me to give baptism with water said to me, The one on whom you see the Spirit coming down and resting, it is he who gives baptism with the Holy Spirit.

1.msb: I have seen and testified that this is the Son of God.”
1.kjv: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
1.blb: And I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
1.bbe: This I saw myself and my witness is that he is the Son of God.

1.msb: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.
1.kjv: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
1.blb: On the next day John again was standing, and two of his disciples.
1.bbe: The day after, John was there again with two of his disciples;
1.heading: The First Disciples

1.msb: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Look, the Lamb of God!”
1.kjv: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
1.blb: And having looked at Jesus walking, he says, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”
1.bbe: And looking at Jesus while he was walking he said, See, there is the Lamb of God!

1.msb: And when the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.
1.kjv: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
1.blb: And the two disciples heard him speaking and followed Jesus.
1.bbe: Hearing what he said, the two disciples went after Jesus.

1.msb: Jesus turned and saw them following. “What do you want?” He asked. They said to Him, “Rabbi” (which means Teacher), “where are You staying?”
1.kjv: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
1.blb: Then Jesus, having turned and having seen them following, says to them, “What do you seek?” And they said to Him, “Rabbi” (which, being translated, is to say Teacher), “where are You staying?”
1.bbe: And Jesus, turning round, saw them coming after him and said to them, What are you looking for? They said to him, Rabbi (which is to say, Master), where are you living?

1.msb: “Come and see,” He replied. So they went and saw where He was staying, and spent that day with Him. It was about the tenth hour.
1.kjv: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
1.blb: He says to them, “Come, and you will see.” Therefore they went and saw where He is staying, and they stayed with Him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
1.bbe: He said to them, Come and see. They went with him then and saw where he was living; and they were with him all that day: it was then about the tenth hour of the day.

1.msb: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard John’s testimony and followed Jesus.
1.kjv: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
1.blb: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the two having heard from John and having followed Him.
1.bbe: Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, was one of the two men who, hearing what John said, went after Jesus.

1.msb: He first found his brother Simon and told him, “We have found the Messiah” (which is translated as Christ).
1.kjv: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
1.blb: He first finds his own brother Simon, and he says to him, “We have found the Messiah” (which is, being translated, Christ).
1.bbe: Early in the morning he came across his brother and said to him, We have made discovery! It is the Messiah! (which is to say, the Christ).

1.msb: Andrew brought him to Jesus, who looked at him and said, “You are Simon son of Jonah. You will be called Cephas” (which is translated as Peter).
1.kjv: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
1.blb: He led him to Jesus. Having looked at him, Jesus said, “You are Simon the son of John. You will be called Cephas” (which is interpreted, Peter).
1.bbe: And he took him to Jesus. Looking at him fixedly Jesus said, You are Simon, the son of John; your name will be Cephas (which is to say, Peter).

1.msb: The next day Jesus decided to set out for Galilee. Finding Philip, He told him, “Follow Me.”
1.kjv: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
1.blb: On the next day He willed to go out into Galilee. And He finds Philip, and Jesus says to him, “Follow Me.”
1.bbe: The day after this, Jesus had a desire to go into Galilee. He came across Philip and said to him, Come and be my disciple.
1.heading: Jesus Calls Philip and Nathanael

1.msb: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the same town as Andrew and Peter.
1.kjv: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
1.blb: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, out of the city of Andrew and Peter.
1.bbe: Now Philip's town was Beth-saida, where Andrew and Peter came from.

1.msb: Philip found Nathanael and told him, “We have found the One Moses wrote about in the Law, the One the prophets foretold—Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
1.kjv: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
1.blb: Philip finds Nathanael and says to him, “We have found Him of whom Moses wrote in the Law—also the prophets—Jesus the son of Joseph, from Nazareth.”
1.bbe: Philip came across Nathanael and said to him, We have made a discovery! It is he of whom Moses, in the law, and the prophets were writing, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

1.msb: “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Nathanael asked. “Come and see,” said Philip.
1.kjv: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
1.blb: And Nathanael said to him, “Is any good thing able to be out of Nazareth?” Philip says to him, “Come and see.”
1.bbe: Nazareth! said Nathanael, Is it possible for any good to come out of Nazareth? Philip said to him, Come and see.

1.msb: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, He said of him, “Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit.”
1.kjv: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
1.blb: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to Him, and He says about him, “Behold, truly an Israelite, in whom there is no deceit.”
1.bbe: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him and said of him, See, here is a true son of Israel in whom there is nothing false.

1.msb: “How do You know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus replied, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
1.kjv: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
1.blb: Nathanael says to Him, “From where do You know me?” Jesus answered and said to him, “Before Philip calling you, being under the fig tree, I saw you.”
1.bbe: Nathanael said to him, Where did you get knowledge of me? In answer Jesus said, Before Philip was talking with you, while you were still under the fig-tree, I saw you.

1.msb: “Rabbi,” Nathanael answered, “You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!”
1.kjv: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
1.blb: Nathanael answered Him, “Rabbi, You are the Son of God; You are King of Israel!”
1.bbe: Nathanael said to him, Rabbi, you are the Son of God, you are King of Israel!

1.msb: Jesus said to him, “Do you believe just because I said to you, ‘I saw you under the fig tree’? You will see greater things than these.”
1.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
1.blb: Jesus answered and said to him, “Because I said to you that I saw you under the fig tree, do you believe? You will see greater things than these.”
1.bbe: In answer Jesus said to him, You have faith because I said to you, I saw you under the fig-tree. You will see greater things than these.

1.msb: Then He declared, “Truly, truly, I tell you, from now on you will all see heaven open and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
1.kjv: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
1.blb: And He says to him, “Truly, truly, I say to you, you will see the heaven opened and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
1.bbe: And he said to him, Truly I say to you all, You will see heaven opening and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of man.

2.msb: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there,
2.kjv: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
2.blb: And on the third day a wedding came to pass in Cana of Galilee, and the mother of Jesus was there,
2.bbe: On the third day two people were going to be married at Cana in Galilee. The mother of Jesus was there:
2.heading: The Wedding at Cana

2.msb: and Jesus and His disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
2.kjv: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
2.blb: and Jesus also was invited, and His disciples, to the wedding.
2.bbe: And Jesus with his disciples came as guests.

2.msb: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to Him, “They have no more wine.”
2.kjv: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
2.blb: And the wine having fallen short, the mother of Jesus says to Him, “They have no wine.”
2.bbe: When they had not enough wine, the mother of Jesus said to him, They have no wine.

2.msb: “Woman, what is that to you and to Me?” Jesus replied. “My hour has not yet come.”
2.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
2.blb: And Jesus says to her, “What is it to Me and to you, woman? My hour is not yet come.”
2.bbe: Jesus said to her, Woman, this is not your business; my time is still to come.

2.msb: His mother said to the servants, “Do whatever He tells you.”
2.kjv: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
2.blb: His mother says to the servants, “Whatever He may say to you, do it.”
2.bbe: His mother said to the servants, Whatever he says to you, do it.

2.msb: Now six stone water jars had been set there for the Jewish rites of purification. Each could hold from twenty to thirty gallons.
2.kjv: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.
2.blb: Now there were six stone water jars lying there, according to the purification of the Jews, having space for two or three metretae.
2.bbe: Now six pots of stone, every one taking two or three firkins of water, were placed there for the purpose of washing, as is the way of the Jews.

2.msb: Jesus told the servants, “Fill the jars with water.” So they filled them to the brim.
2.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
2.blb: Jesus says to them, “Fill the water jars with water.” And they filled them up to the top.
2.bbe: Jesus said to the servants, Make the pots full of water. And they made them full to the top.

2.msb: “Now draw some out,” He said, “and take it to the master of the banquet.” They did so,
2.kjv: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.
2.blb: And He says to them, “Draw some out now and carry it to the master of the feast.” And they carried it.
2.bbe: Then he said to them, Now take some, and give it to the master of the feast. So they took it to him.

2.msb: and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine. He did not know where it was from, but the servants who had drawn the water knew. Then he called the bridegroom aside
2.kjv: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,
2.blb: And as the master of the feast tasted the water that has become wine, and he did not know from where it is—but the servants having drawn the water knew—the master of the feast calls the bridegroom
2.bbe: After tasting the water which had now become wine, the master of the feast (having no idea where it came from, though it was clear to the servants who took the water out) sent for the newly-married man,

2.msb: and said, “Everyone serves the fine wine first, and then the cheap wine after the guests are drunk. But you have saved the fine wine until now!”
2.kjv: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.
2.blb: and says to him, “Every man first sets out the good wine, and when they might have become drunk, the inferior; you have kept the good wine until now.”
2.bbe: And said to him, Every man first puts out his best wine and when all have had enough he puts out what is not so good; but you have kept the good wine till now.

2.msb: Jesus performed this, the first of His signs, at Cana in Galilee. He thus revealed His glory, and His disciples believed in Him.
2.kjv: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
2.blb: This was the beginning of the signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and He revealed His glory, and His disciples believed in Him.
2.bbe: This, the first of his signs, Jesus did at Cana in Galilee and let his glory be seen openly; and his disciples put their faith in him.

2.msb: After this, He went down to Capernaum with His mother and brothers and His disciples, and they stayed there a few days.
2.kjv: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
2.blb: After this, He went down to Capernaum, He and His mother and His brothers and His disciples, and there they stayed not many days.
2.bbe: After this he went down to Capernaum, with his mother, his brothers, and his disciples, and they were there not more than two or three days.
2.heading: Jesus Cleanses the Temple

2.msb: When the Jewish Passover was near, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
2.kjv: And the Jews’ passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
2.blb: And the Passover of the Jews was near, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
2.bbe: The time of the Passover of the Jews was near and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

2.msb: In the temple courts He found men selling cattle, sheep, and doves, and money changers seated at their tables.
2.kjv: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
2.blb: And He found in the temple those selling oxen and sheep and doves, and the money changers sitting.
2.bbe: And there in the Temple he saw men trading in oxen and sheep and doves, and he saw the changers of money in their seats:

2.msb: So He made a whip out of cords and drove all from the temple courts, both sheep and cattle. He poured out the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.
2.kjv: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew the tables;
2.blb: And having made a whip out of cords, He cast out all from the temple, both sheep and oxen; and He poured out the coins of the money changers and overturned the tables.
2.bbe: And he made a whip of small cords and put them all out of the Temple, with the sheep and the oxen, sending in all directions the small money of the changers and overturning their tables;

2.msb: To those selling doves He said, “Get these out of here! How dare you turn My Father’s house into a marketplace!”
2.kjv: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father’s house an house of merchandise.
2.blb: And to those selling the doves He said, “Take these from here! Do not make the house of My Father a house of trade!”
2.bbe: And to those who were trading in doves he said, Take these things away; do not make my Father's house a market.

2.msb: His disciples remembered that it is written: “Zeal for Your house will consume Me.”
2.kjv: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
2.blb: His disciples remembered that it is written: “The zeal of Your house will consume Me.”
2.bbe: And it came to the minds of the disciples that the Writings say, I am on fire with passion for your house.

2.msb: On account of this, the Jews demanded, “What sign can You show us to prove Your authority to do these things?”
2.kjv: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
2.blb: Therefore the Jews answered and said to Him, “What sign do You show to us that You do these things?”
2.bbe: Then the Jews put this question to him: What sign of authority have you to give us, seeing that you do these things?

2.msb: Jesus answered, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up again.”
2.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
2.blb: Jesus answered and said to them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”
2.bbe: And Jesus said to them, Send destruction on this Temple and I will put it up again in three days.

2.msb: “This temple took forty-six years to build,” the Jews replied, “and You are going to raise it up in three days?”
2.kjv: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
2.blb: Therefore the Jews said, “This temple was built in forty and six years, and You will raise it up in three days?”
2.bbe: The Jews said, The building of this Temple took forty-six years; and you will put it up in three days!

2.msb: But Jesus was speaking about the temple of His body.
2.kjv: But he spake of the temple of his body.
2.blb: But He was speaking about the temple of His body.
2.bbe: But his words were about that holy building which was his body.

2.msb: After He was raised from the dead, His disciples remembered that He had said this. Then they believed the Scripture and the word that Jesus had spoken.
2.kjv: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
2.blb: Therefore, when He was raised up from the dead, His disciples remembered that He had said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word that Jesus said.
2.bbe: So when he had come back again from the dead, the memory of these words came back to the disciples, and they had faith in the holy Writings and in the word which Jesus had said.

2.msb: While He was in Jerusalem at the Passover Feast, many people saw the signs He was doing and believed in His name.
2.kjv: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
2.blb: And as He was in Jerusalem in the Passover, in the Feast, many believed in His name, beholding His signs that He was doing.
2.bbe: Now while he was in Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover, a great number of people came to have faith in his name, after seeing the signs which he did.

2.msb: But Jesus did not entrust Himself to them, for He knew them all.
2.kjv: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,
2.blb: But Jesus Himself was not entrusting Himself to them, because of His knowing all,
2.bbe: But Jesus did not have faith in them, because he had knowledge of them all.

2.msb: He did not need any testimony about man, for He knew what was in a man.
2.kjv: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
2.blb: and because He had no need that anyone should testify about man, for He Himself knew what was in man.
2.bbe: He had no need for any witness about man; for he himself had knowledge of what was in man.

3.msb: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a leader of the Jews.
3.kjv: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
3.blb: Now there was a man of the Pharisees, his name Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
3.bbe: Now there was among the Pharisees a man named Nicodemus, who was one of the rulers of the Jews.
3.heading: Jesus and Nicodemus

3.msb: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs You are doing if God were not with him.”
3.kjv: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
3.blb: This one came to Him by night and said to Him, “Rabbi, we know that You have come from God as a teacher, for no one is able to do these signs that You do unless God would be with him.”
3.bbe: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, Rabbi, we are certain that you have come from God as a teacher, because no man would be able to do these signs which you do if God was not with him.

3.msb: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again.”
3.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
3.blb: Jesus answered and said to him, “Truly, truly, I say to you, unless one would be born from above, he is not able to see the kingdom of God.”
3.bbe: Jesus said to him, Truly, I say to you, Without a new birth no man is able to see the kingdom of God.

3.msb: “How can a man be born when he is old?” Nicodemus asked. “Can he enter his mother’s womb a second time to be born?”
3.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?
3.blb: Nicodemus says to Him, “How is a man able to be born, being old? Is he able to enter into the womb of his mother a second time and to be born?”
3.bbe: Nicodemus said to him, How is it possible for a man to be given birth when he is old? Is he able to go into his mother's body a second time and come to birth again?

3.msb: Jesus answered, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit.
3.kjv: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
3.blb: Jesus answered, “Truly, truly, I say to you, unless one would be born of water and of the Spirit, he is not able to enter into the kingdom of God.
3.bbe: Jesus said in answer, Truly, I say to you, If a man's birth is not from water and from the Spirit, it is not possible for him to go into the kingdom of God.

3.msb: Flesh is born of flesh, but spirit is born of the Spirit.
3.kjv: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
3.blb: That having been born of the flesh is flesh, and that having been born of the Spirit is spirit.
3.bbe: That which has birth from the flesh is flesh, and that which has birth from the Spirit is spirit.

3.msb: Do not be amazed that I said, ‘You must be born again.’
3.kjv: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
3.blb: Do not marvel that I said to you, ‘It is necessary for you to be born from above.’
3.bbe: Do not be surprised that I say to you, It is necessary for you to have a second birth.

3.msb: The wind blows where it wishes. You hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”
3.kjv: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
3.blb: The wind blows where it wills, and you hear the sound of it, but you do not know from where it comes and where it goes. Thus is everyone having been born of the Spirit.”
3.bbe: The wind goes where its pleasure takes it, and the sound of it comes to your ears, but you are unable to say where it comes from and where it goes: so it is with everyone whose birth is from the Spirit.

3.msb: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
3.kjv: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
3.blb: Nicodemus answered and said to Him, “How are these things able to be?”
3.bbe: And Nicodemus said to him, How is it possible for these things to be?

3.msb: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and you do not understand these things?
3.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
3.blb: Jesus answered and said to him, “You are the teacher of Israel, and you do not know these things?
3.bbe: And Jesus, answering, said, Are you the teacher of Israel and have no knowledge of these things?

3.msb: Truly, truly, I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, and yet you people do not accept our testimony.
3.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
3.blb: Truly, truly, I say to you that we speak what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, and you do not receive our testimony.
3.bbe: Truly, I say to you, We say that of which we have knowledge; we give witness of what we have seen; and you do not take our witness to be true.

3.msb: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?
3.kjv: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
3.blb: If I spoke to you earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I should speak to you heavenly things?
3.bbe: If you have no belief when my words are about the things of earth, how will you have belief if my words are about the things of heaven?

3.msb: No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven—the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
3.kjv: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
3.blb: And no one has gone up into heaven except the One having come down out of heaven, the Son of Man.
3.bbe: And no one has ever gone up to heaven but he who came down from heaven, the Son of man.

3.msb: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
3.kjv: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
3.blb: And just as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, thus it is necessary for the Son of Man to be lifted up,
3.bbe: As the snake was lifted up by Moses in the waste land, even so it is necessary for the Son of man to be lifted up:

3.msb: that everyone who believes in Him may not perish, but may have eternal life.
3.kjv: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
3.blb: so that everyone believing in Him may have eternal life.
3.bbe: So that whoever has faith may have in him eternal life.

3.msb: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
3.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
3.blb: For God so loved the world that He gave the Son, the only begotten, so that everyone believing in Him shall not perish but shall have eternal life.
3.bbe: For God had such love for the world that he gave his only Son, so that whoever has faith in him may not come to destruction but have eternal life.

3.msb: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.
3.kjv: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
3.blb: For God did not send the Son into the world that He might judge the world, but that the world might be saved through Him.
3.bbe: God did not send his Son into the world to be judge of the world; he sent him so that the world might have salvation through him.

3.msb: Whoever believes in Him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe has already been condemned, because he has not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.
3.kjv: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
3.blb: The one believing in Him is not judged, but the one not believing already has been judged, because he has not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
3.bbe: The man who has faith in him does not come up to be judged; but he who has no faith in him has been judged even now, because he has no faith in the name of the only Son of God.

3.msb: And this is the verdict: The Light has come into the world, but men loved the darkness rather than the Light because their deeds were evil.
3.kjv: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
3.blb: And this is the judgment, that the Light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the Light, for their works were evil.
3.bbe: And this is the test by which men are judged: the light has come into the world and men have more love for the dark than for the light, because their acts are evil.

3.msb: Everyone who does evil hates the Light, and does not come into the Light for fear that his deeds will be exposed.
3.kjv: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
3.blb: For everyone practicing evil hates the Light and does not come to the Light, so that his works may not be exposed;
3.bbe: The light is hated by everyone whose acts are evil and he does not come to the light for fear that his acts will be seen.

3.msb: But whoever practices the truth comes into the Light, so that it may be seen clearly that what he has done has been accomplished in God.”
3.kjv: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
3.blb: but the one doing the truth comes to the Light, so that his works may be manifest, that in God they are having been worked.”
3.bbe: But he whose life is true comes to the light, so that it may be clearly seen that his acts have been done by the help of God.

3.msb: After this, Jesus and His disciples went into the Judean countryside, where He spent some time with them and baptized.
3.kjv: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judæa; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
3.blb: After these things, Jesus and His disciples went into the land of Judea, and there He was staying with them and was baptizing.
3.bbe: After these things Jesus and his disciples went into the land of Judaea, and there he was with them for some time, giving baptism.
3.heading: John’s Testimony about Jesus

3.msb: Now John was also baptizing at Aenon near Salem, because the water was plentiful there, and people kept coming to be baptized.
3.kjv: And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
3.blb: Now John was also baptizing in Aenon near Salim, because the waters were many there, and they were coming and were being baptized.
3.bbe: Now John was then giving baptism at Aenon near Salim, because there was much water there; and people came and were given baptism.

3.msb: (For John had not yet been thrown into prison.)
3.kjv: For John was not yet cast into prison.
3.blb: For John was not yet thrown into the prison.
3.bbe: For at this time John had not been put into prison.

3.msb: Then a dispute arose between John’s disciples and a certain Jew over the issue of ceremonial washing.
3.kjv: Then there arose a question between some of John’s disciples and the Jews about purifying.
3.blb: Then a debate arose from the disciples of John with a Jew about purification.
3.bbe: Then a question came up between John's disciples and a Jew about washing.

3.msb: So John’s disciples came to him and said, “Look, Rabbi, the One who was with you beyond the Jordan, the One you testified about—He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him.”
3.kjv: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
3.blb: And they came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, the One who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, this One is baptizing, and all are coming to Him.”
3.bbe: And they went to John and said to him, Rabbi, the man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan, the man to whom you gave witness, is now giving baptism, and everyone is going to him.

3.msb: John replied, “A man can receive only what is given him from heaven.
3.kjv: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
3.blb: John answered and said, “A man is not able to receive one thing unless it shall be given to him from heaven.
3.bbe: And this was John's answer: A man is unable to have anything if it is not given to him from heaven.

3.msb: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ, but am sent ahead of Him.’
3.kjv: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
3.blb: You yourselves testify to me that I said, ‘I am not the Christ, but I am sent before Him.’
3.bbe: You yourselves give witness that I said, I am not the Christ. What I said was, I am sent before the Christ.

3.msb: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend of the bridegroom stands and listens for him, and is overjoyed to hear the bridegroom’s voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.
3.kjv: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
3.blb: The one having the bride is the bridegroom, and the friend of the bridegroom, the one standing and hearing him, rejoices with joy because of the voice of the bridegroom. Therefore this joy of mine is fulfilled.
3.bbe: He who has the bride is the husband: but the husband's friend, whose place is by his side and whose ears are open to him, is full of joy because of the husband's voice: such is my joy, and it is complete.

3.msb: He must increase; I must decrease.
3.kjv: He must increase, but I must decrease.
3.blb: It is necessary for Him to increase, but for me to decrease.
3.bbe: He has to become greater while I become less.

3.msb: The One who comes from above is above all. The one who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks as one from the earth. The One who comes from heaven is above all.
3.kjv: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
3.blb: The One coming from above is above all. The one being from the earth is from the earth and speaks from the earth. The One coming from heaven is above all.
3.bbe: He who comes from heaven is greater than all others: he who comes from earth is of the earth, and of the earth are his words: he who comes from heaven is over all.

3.msb: He testifies to what He has seen and heard, yet no one accepts His testimony.
3.kjv: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
3.blb: What He has seen and heard, to this He testifies, and no one receives His testimony.
3.bbe: He gives witness of what he has seen and of what has come to his ears; and no man takes his witness as true.

3.msb: Whoever accepts His testimony has certified that God is truthful.
3.kjv: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
3.blb: The one having received His testimony has sealed that God is true.
3.bbe: He who so takes his witness has made clear his faith that God is true.

3.msb: For the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.
3.kjv: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
3.blb: For the One whom God sent speaks the words of God, for He gives the Spirit without measure.
3.bbe: For he whom God has sent says God's words; and God does not give him the Spirit by measure.

3.msb: The Father loves the Son and has placed all things in His hands.
3.kjv: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
3.blb: The Father loves the Son and has given all things into His hand.
3.bbe: The Father has love for the Son and has put all things into his hands.

3.msb: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life. Whoever rejects the Son will not see life. Instead, the wrath of God remains on him.”
3.kjv: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
3.blb: The one believing in the Son has eternal life; but the one not obeying the Son will not see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
3.bbe: He who has faith in the Son has eternal life; but he who has not faith in the Son will not see life; God's wrath is resting on him.

4.msb: When the Lord realized that the Pharisees were aware that Jesus was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John
4.kjv: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
4.blb: Therefore when Jesus knew that the Pharisees heard that Jesus makes and baptizes more disciples than John—
4.bbe: Now when it was clear to the Lord that word had come to the ears of the Pharisees that Jesus was making more disciples than John and was giving them baptism
4.heading: Jesus and the Samaritan Woman

4.msb: (although it was not Jesus who baptized, but His disciples),
4.kjv: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
4.blb: although indeed Jesus Himself was not baptizing, but His disciples—
4.bbe: (Though, in fact, it was his disciples who gave baptism, not Jesus himself),

4.msb: He left Judea and went away to Galilee.
4.kjv: He left Judæa, and departed again into Galilee.
4.blb: He left Judea and went away again into Galilee.
4.bbe: He went out of Judaea into Galilee again.

4.msb: Now He had to pass through Samaria.
4.kjv: And he must needs go through Samaria.
4.blb: And it was necessary for Him to pass through Samaria.
4.bbe: And it was necessary for him to go through Samaria.

4.msb: So He came to a town of Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground that Jacob had given to his son Joseph.
4.kjv: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
4.blb: Therefore He comes to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
4.bbe: So he came to a town of Samaria which was named Sychar, near to the bit of land which Jacob gave to his son Joseph:

4.msb: Since Jacob’s well was there, Jesus, weary from His journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
4.kjv: Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
4.blb: And Jacob’s well was there. Therefore Jesus, wearied from the journey, was thus sitting at the well. The hour was about the sixth.
4.bbe: Now Jacob's fountain was there. Jesus, being tired after his journey, was resting by the fountain. It was about the sixth hour.

4.msb: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, “Give Me a drink.”
4.kjv: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
4.blb: A woman out of Samaria comes to draw water. Jesus says to her, “Give to Me to drink.”
4.bbe: A woman of Samaria came to get water, and Jesus said to her, Give me some water.

4.msb: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)
4.kjv: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
4.blb: For His disciples had gone away into the city, that they might buy food.
4.bbe: For his disciples had gone to the town to get food.

4.msb: “You are a Jew,” said the woman. “How can You ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)
4.kjv: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
4.blb: Therefore the Samaritan woman says to Him, “How do You, being a Jew, ask to drink from me, being a Samaritan woman?” For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.
4.bbe: The woman of Samaria said to him, Why do you, a Jew, make a request for water to me, a woman of Samaria? She said this because Jews have nothing to do with the people of Samaria.

4.msb: Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”
4.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
4.blb: Jesus answered and said to her, “If you had known the gift of God and who it is saying to you, ‘Give to Me to drink,’ you would have asked Him, and He would have given to you living water.”
4.bbe: In answer Jesus said, If you had knowledge of what God gives freely and who it is who says to you, Give me water, you would make your prayer to him, and he would give you living water.

4.msb: “Sir,” the woman replied, “You have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where then will You get this living water?
4.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
4.blb: The woman says to Him, “Sir, You have nothing to draw with and the well is deep; from where, then, do You have the living water?
4.bbe: The woman said to him, Sir, you have no vessel and the fountain is deep; from where will you get the living water?

4.msb: Are You greater than our father Jacob, who gave us this well and drank from it himself, as did his sons and his livestock?”
4.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
4.blb: Are You greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank out of it himself, and his sons and his livestock?”
4.bbe: Are you greater than our father Jacob who gave us the fountain and took the water of it himself, with his children and his cattle?

4.msb: Jesus said to her, “Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again.
4.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
4.blb: Jesus answered and said to her, “Everyone drinking of this water will thirst again;
4.bbe: Jesus said to her, Everyone who takes this water will be in need of it again:

4.msb: But whoever drinks the water I give him will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give him will become in him a fount of water springing up to eternal life.”
4.kjv: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
4.blb: but whoever may drink of the water that I will give him, he will never thirst, to the age. Rather, the water that I will give to him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
4.bbe: But whoever takes the water I give him will never be in need of drink again; for the water I give him will become in him a fountain of eternal life.

4.msb: The woman said to Him, “Sir, give me this water so that I will not get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water.”
4.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
4.blb: The woman says to Him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I might not thirst nor come here to draw.”
4.bbe: The woman said to him, Sir, give me this water, so that I may not be in need again of drink and will not have to come all this way for it.

4.msb: Jesus told her, “Go, call your husband and come back.”
4.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
4.blb: He says to her, “Go, call your husband and come here.”
4.bbe: Jesus said to her, Go, get your husband and come back here with him.

4.msb: “I have no husband,” the woman replied. Jesus said to her, “You are correct to say that you have no husband.
4.kjv: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
4.blb: The woman answered and said to Him, “I do not have a husband.” Jesus says to her, “You have spoken correctly, ‘I do not have a husband.’
4.bbe: In answer, the woman said, I have no husband. Jesus said to her, You have said rightly, I have no husband:

4.msb: In fact, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. You have spoken truthfully.”
4.kjv: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
4.blb: For you have had five husbands, and the one whom you have now is not your husband; this you have said truly.”
4.bbe: You have had five husbands, and the man you have now is not your husband: that was truly said.

4.msb: “Sir,” the woman said, “I see that You are a prophet.
4.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
4.blb: The woman says to Him, “Sir, I see that You are a prophet.
4.bbe: The woman said to him, Sir, I see that you are a prophet.

4.msb: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say that the place where one must worship is in Jerusalem.”
4.kjv: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
4.blb: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, and you say that in Jerusalem is the place where it is necessary to worship.”
4.bbe: Our fathers gave worship on this mountain, but you Jews say that the right place for worship is in Jerusalem.

4.msb: “Believe Me, woman,” Jesus replied, “a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
4.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
4.blb: Jesus says to her, “Believe Me, woman, that an hour is coming when neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.
4.bbe: Jesus said to her, Woman, take my word for this; the time is coming when you will not give worship to the Father on this mountain or in Jerusalem.

4.msb: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.
4.kjv: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
4.blb: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we know, because salvation is of the Jews.
4.bbe: You give worship, but without knowledge of what you are worshipping: we give worship to what we have knowledge of: for salvation comes from the Jews.

4.msb: But a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth, for the Father is seeking such as these to worship Him.
4.kjv: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
4.blb: But an hour is coming, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth; for the Father also seeks such who worship Him.
4.bbe: But the time is coming, and is even now here, when the true worshippers will give worship to the Father in the true way of the spirit, for these are the worshippers desired by the Father.

4.msb: God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.”
4.kjv: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
4.blb: God is Spirit, and it is necessary for those worshiping Him to worship in spirit and truth.”
4.bbe: God is Spirit: then let his worshippers give him worship in the true way of the spirit.

4.msb: The woman said, “I know that Messiah” (called Christ) “is coming. When He comes, He will explain everything to us.”
4.kjv: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
4.blb: The woman says to Him, “I know that Messiah is coming, who is called Christ; when He comes, He will declare to us all things.”
4.bbe: The woman said to him, I am certain that the Messiah, who is named Christ, is coming; when he comes he will make all things clear to us.

4.msb: Jesus answered, “I who speak to you am He.”
4.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
4.blb: Jesus says to her, “I am He—the One speaking to you.”
4.bbe: Jesus said to her, I, who am talking to you, am he.

4.msb: Just then His disciples returned and were surprised that He was speaking with a woman. But no one asked Him, “What do You want from her?” or “Why are You talking with her?”
4.kjv: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
4.blb: And upon this His disciples came and marveled that He was speaking with a woman. No one, however, said, “What do You seek?” or, “Why do You speak with her?”
4.bbe: At that point the disciples came back, and they were surprised to see him talking to a woman; but not one of them said to him, What is your purpose? or, Why are you talking to her?
4.heading: The Disciples Return and Marvel

4.msb: Then the woman left her water jar, went back into the town, and said to the people,
4.kjv: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
4.blb: Then the woman left her water jar and went away into the city, and she says to the men,
4.bbe: Then the woman put down her water-pot and went into the town, and said to the people,

4.msb: “Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Christ?”
4.kjv: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
4.blb: “Come, see a man who told me all things, as many as I did. Could this be the Christ?”
4.bbe: Come and see a man who has been talking to me of everything I ever did! Is it possible that this is the Christ?

4.msb: So they left the town and made their way toward Jesus.
4.kjv: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
4.blb: They went out of the city and were coming to Him.
4.bbe: So they went out of the town and came to him.

4.msb: Meanwhile the disciples urged Him, “Rabbi, eat something.”
4.kjv: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
4.blb: In the meantime the disciples were urging Him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
4.bbe: While this was taking place, the disciples were saying to Jesus, Master, take some food.

4.msb: But He told them, “I have food to eat that you know nothing about.”
4.kjv: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
4.blb: But He said to them, “I have food to eat that you do not know.”
4.bbe: But he said to them, I have food of which you have no knowledge.

4.msb: So the disciples asked one another, “Could someone have brought Him food?”
4.kjv: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
4.blb: Therefore the disciples were saying to one another, “Did anyone bring Him something to eat?”
4.bbe: So the disciples said one to another, Did anyone give him food?

4.msb: Jesus explained, “My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to finish His work.
4.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
4.blb: Jesus says to them, “My food is that I should do the will of the One having sent Me and should finish His work.
4.bbe: Jesus said, My food is to do the pleasure of him who sent me and to make his work complete.

4.msb: Do you not say, ‘There are still four months until the harvest’? I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, for they are ripe for harvest.
4.kjv: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
4.blb: Do you not say, ‘It is yet four months and the harvest comes’? Behold, I say to you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, because they are white to harvest already.
4.bbe: You would say, Four months from now is the time of the grain-cutting. Take a look, I say to you, at the fields; they are even now white for cutting.

4.msb: Already the reaper draws his wages and gathers a crop for eternal life, so that both the sower and the reaper may rejoice together.
4.kjv: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
4.blb: The one reaping receives a wage and gathers fruit unto eternal life, so that the one sowing and the one reaping may rejoice together.
4.bbe: He who does the cutting now has his reward; he is getting together fruit for eternal life, so that he who did the planting and he who gets in the grain may have joy together.

4.msb: For in this case the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.
4.kjv: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
4.blb: For in this the word is true, that is, ‘One is sowing and another is reaping.’
4.bbe: In this the saying is a true one, One does the planting, and another gets in the grain.

4.msb: I sent you to reap what you have not worked for; others have done the hard work, and now you have taken up their labor.”
4.kjv: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
4.blb: I sent you to reap what you have not labored for; others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”
4.bbe: I sent you to get in grain which you had no hand in planting: other men did that work, and you take the reward.

4.msb: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in Jesus because of the woman’s testimony, “He told me everything I ever did.”
4.kjv: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
4.blb: And out of that city many of the Samaritans believed in Him because of the word of the woman testifying, “He told me all things that I did.”
4.bbe: Now a number of the people of that town had faith in him because of the woman's witness: He has been talking to me of everything I ever did.
4.heading: Many Samaritans Believe

4.msb: So when the Samaritans came to Him, they asked Him to stay with them, and He stayed two days.
4.kjv: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
4.blb: Therefore when the Samaritans came to Him, they were asking Him to stay with them, and He stayed there two days.
4.bbe: So when the people came to him they made request to him to be among them for a time, and he was there two days.

4.msb: And many more believed because of His message.
4.kjv: And many more believed because of his own word;
4.blb: And many more believed because of His word.
4.bbe: And a great number more of them came to have faith in him because of what he himself said.

4.msb: They said to the woman, “We now believe not only because of your words; we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man truly is the Christ, the Savior of the world.”
4.kjv: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
4.blb: And they were saying to the woman, “No longer because of your speech do we believe; for we ourselves have heard, and we know that this is truly the Savior of the world.”
4.bbe: And they said to the woman, Now we have faith, but not because of your story: we ourselves have given ear to his words, and we are certain that he is truly the Saviour of the world.

4.msb: After two days, Jesus left and went to Galilee.
4.kjv: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
4.blb: And after the two days He went out from there into Galilee.
4.bbe: And after the two days he went on from there into Galilee.
4.heading: Jesus Heals the Official’s Son

4.msb: Now He Himself had testified that a prophet has no honor in his own hometown.
4.kjv: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
4.blb: For Jesus Himself testified that a prophet in his own hometown does not have honor.
4.bbe: For Jesus himself said that a prophet has no honour in the country of his birth.

4.msb: Yet when He arrived, the Galileans welcomed Him. They had seen all the great things He had done in Jerusalem at the feast, for they had gone there as well.
4.kjv: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilæans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
4.blb: Therefore when He came into Galilee, the Galileans welcomed Him, having seen all things that He did in Jerusalem during the feast, for they themselves also went to the feast.
4.bbe: So when he came into Galilee, the Galilaeans took him to their hearts because of the things which they had seen him do in Jerusalem at the feast — they themselves having been there at the feast.

4.msb: So once again Jesus came to Cana in Galilee, where He had turned the water into wine. And there was a royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.
4.kjv: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
4.blb: He came, therefore, again to Cana of Galilee, where He made the water wine. And there was a certain royal official whose son was sick in Capernaum.
4.bbe: So he came to Cana in Galilee, where he had made the water wine. And there was a certain man of high position whose son was ill at Capernaum.

4.msb: When he heard that Jesus had come from Judea to Galilee, he went and begged Him to come down and heal his son, who was about to die.
