4.kjv: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judæa into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
4.blb: This one, having heard that Jesus is come out of Judea into Galilee, went to Him and was asking that He might come down and heal his son, for he was about to die.
4.bbe: When it came to his ears that Jesus had come from Judaea into Galilee, he went to him and made a request that he would come down to his son, who was near to death, and make him well.

4.msb: Jesus said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will never believe.”
4.kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
4.blb: Therefore Jesus said to him, “Unless you see signs and wonders, you will never believe.”
4.bbe: Then Jesus said to him, You will not have faith if you do not see signs and wonders.

4.msb: “Sir,” the official said, “come down before my child dies.”
4.kjv: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
4.blb: The royal official says to Him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
4.bbe: The man said, Sir, come down before my boy is dead.

4.msb: “Go,” said Jesus. “Your son will live.” The man took Jesus at His word and departed.
4.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
4.blb: Jesus says to him. “Go, your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus said to him, and he was going.
4.bbe: And Jesus said, Go in peace; your son is living. The man had faith in the word which Jesus said to him and went away.

4.msb: And while he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news: “Your boy is alive.”
4.kjv: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
4.blb: And already, in his going down, his servants met him, saying that his boy lives.
4.bbe: And while he was going down, his servants came to him and said, Your boy is living.

4.msb: So he inquired as to the hour when his son had recovered, and they told him, “The fever left him yesterday at the seventh hour.”
4.kjv: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
4.blb: Therefore he inquired from them the hour in which he got better. Therefore they said to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.”
4.bbe: So he put a question to them as to the hour when he became better; and they said to him, The disease went from him yesterday at the seventh hour.

4.msb: Then the father realized that this was the very hour in which Jesus had told him, “Your son will live.” And he and all his household believed.
4.kjv: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
4.blb: Therefore the father knew that it was in that hour at which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” And he himself believed, and his whole household.
4.bbe: It was clear then to the father that this was the very time at which Jesus said to him, Your son is living. And he had faith in Jesus, he and all his family.

4.msb: This was now the second sign that Jesus performed after coming from Judea into Galilee.
4.kjv: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judæa into Galilee.
4.blb: Now this again was the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.
4.bbe: Now this is the second sign which Jesus did after he had come out of Judaea into Galilee.

5.msb: Some time later came the feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
5.kjv: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
5.blb: After these things there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
5.bbe: After these things there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
5.heading: The Pool of Bethesda

5.msb: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool with five covered colonnades, which in Hebrew is called Bethesda.
5.kjv: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
5.blb: Now there is in Jerusalem by the Sheep Gate a pool, in Hebrew called Bethesda, having five porches.
5.bbe: Now in Jerusalem near the sheep-market there is a public bath which in Hebrew is named Beth-zatha. It has five doorways.

5.msb: On these walkways lay a great number of the sick, the blind, the lame, and the paralyzed, awaiting the moving of the water.
5.kjv: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
5.blb: In these were lying a multitude of those ailing, blind, lame, and withered.
5.bbe: In these doorways there were a great number of people with different diseases: some unable to see, some without the power of walking, some with wasted bodies.

5.msb: For from time to time an angel descended into the pool and stirred the water. As soon as the water was stirred, the first to enter the pool would be healed of his disease.
5.kjv: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.

5.msb: One man there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
5.kjv: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
5.blb: And a certain man was there, being thirty and eight years in his ailment.
5.bbe: One man was there who had been ill for thirty-eight years.

5.msb: When Jesus saw him lying there and realized that he had spent a long time in this condition, He asked him, “Do you want to get well?”
5.kjv: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
5.blb: Jesus, having seen this one lying and having known that he has been a long time already, says to him, “Do you want to become well?”
5.bbe: When Jesus saw him there on the floor it was clear to him that he had been now a long time in that condition, and so he said to the man, Is it your desire to get well?

5.msb: “Sir,” the invalid replied, “I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am on my way, someone else goes in before me.”
5.kjv: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
5.blb: The one ailing answered Him, “Sir, I do not have a man, that when the water might be stirred, he might put me into the pool; and while I am going, another goes down before me.”
5.bbe: The ill man said in answer, Sir, I have nobody to put me into the bath when the water is moving; and while I am on the way down some other person gets in before me.

5.msb: Then Jesus told him, “Get up, pick up your mat, and walk.”
5.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
5.blb: Jesus says to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”
5.bbe: Jesus said to him, Get up, take your bed and go.

5.msb: Immediately the man was made well, and he picked up his mat and began to walk. Now this happened on the Sabbath day,
5.kjv: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
5.blb: And immediately the man became well, and he took up his mat and was walking. And it was the Sabbath on that day.
5.bbe: And the man became well straight away, and took up his bed and went. Now that day was the Sabbath.

5.msb: so the Jews said to the man who had been healed, “This is the Sabbath! It is unlawful for you to carry your mat.”
5.kjv: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
5.blb: Therefore the Jews were saying to the one having been healed, “It is the Sabbath, and it is not lawful for you to take up your mat.”
5.bbe: So the Jews said to the man who had been made well, It is the Sabbath; and it is against the law for you to take up your bed.

5.msb: But he answered, “The man who made me well told me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’”
5.kjv: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
5.blb: But he answered them, “The One having made me well, that One said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’”
5.bbe: He said to them, But he who made me well, said to me, Take up your bed and go.

5.msb: “Who is this man who told you to pick up your mat and walk?” they asked.
5.kjv: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
5.blb: Therefore they asked him, “Who is the man having said to you, ‘Take it up and walk’?”
5.bbe: Then they put to him the question: Who is the man who said to you, Take it up and go?

5.msb: But the man who was healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had slipped away while the crowd was there.
5.kjv: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
5.blb: But the one having been healed did not know who it is, for Jesus moved away, a crowd being in the place.
5.bbe: Now he who had been made well had no knowledge who it was, Jesus having gone away because of the number of people who were in that place.

5.msb: Afterward, Jesus found the man at the temple and said to him, “See, you have been made well. Stop sinning, or something worse may happen to you.”
5.kjv: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
5.blb: After these things Jesus finds him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you have become well. Sin no more, so that something worse might not happen to you.”
5.bbe: After a time Jesus came across him in the Temple and said to him, See, you are well and strong; do no more sin for fear a worse thing comes to you.

5.msb: And the man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
5.kjv: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
5.blb: The man went away and declared to the Jews that Jesus is the One having made him well.
5.bbe: The man went away and said to the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

5.msb: Now because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jews began to persecute Him and were seeking to kill Him.
5.kjv: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
5.blb: And because of this, the Jews were persecuting Jesus, because He was doing these things on the Sabbath.
5.bbe: And for this reason the Jews were turned against Jesus, because he was doing these things on the Sabbath.
5.heading: The Father and the Son

5.msb: But Jesus answered them, “To this very day My Father is at His work, and I too am working.”
5.kjv: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
5.blb: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is working until now, and I am working.”
5.bbe: But his answer was: My Father is still working even now, and so I am working.

5.msb: Because of this, the Jews tried all the harder to kill Him. Not only was He breaking the Sabbath, but He was even calling God His own Father, making Himself equal with God.
5.kjv: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
5.blb: Therefore because of this, the Jews were seeking more to kill Him, because not only was He breaking the Sabbath, but He was also calling God His own Father, making Himself equal to God.
5.bbe: For this cause the Jews had an even greater desire to put Jesus to death, because not only did he not keep the Sabbath but he said God was his Father, so making himself equal with God.

5.msb: So Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing by Himself, unless He sees the Father doing it. For whatever the Father does, the Son also does.
5.kjv: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
5.blb: Therefore Jesus answered and was saying to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, the Son is able to do nothing from Himself, if not anything He may see the Father doing; for whatever He may do, these things the Son also does likewise.
5.bbe: So Jesus made answer and said, Truly I say to you, The Son is not able to do anything himself; he is able to do only what he sees the Father doing; whatever the Father does the Son does it in the same way.

5.msb: The Father loves the Son and shows Him all He does. And to your amazement, He will show Him even greater works than these.
5.kjv: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
5.blb: For the Father loves the Son and shows Him all things that He Himself does. And He will show Him greater works than these, so that you may marvel.
5.bbe: For the Father has love for the Son and lets him see everything which he does: and he will let him see greater works than these so that you may be full of wonder.

5.msb: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whom He wishes.
5.kjv: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
5.blb: For just as the Father raises the dead and makes alive, thus also the Son makes alive whom He wills.
5.bbe: In the same way, as the Father gives life to the dead, even so the Son gives life to those to whom he is pleased to give it.

5.msb: Furthermore, the Father judges no one, but has assigned all judgment to the Son,
5.kjv: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
5.blb: For the Father judges no one, but He has given all judgment to the Son,
5.bbe: The Father is not the judge of men, but he has given all decisions into the hands of the Son;

5.msb: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
5.kjv: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
5.blb: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. The one not honoring the Son does not honor the Father, the One having sent Him.
5.bbe: So that all men may give honour to the Son even as they give honour to the Father. He who gives no honour to the Son gives no honour to the Father who sent him.

5.msb: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever hears My word and believes Him who sent Me has eternal life and will not come under judgment. Indeed, he has crossed over from death to life.
5.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
5.blb: Truly, truly, I say to you that the one hearing My word and believing the One having sent Me has eternal life and does not come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
5.bbe: Truly I say to you, The man whose ears are open to my word and who has faith in him who sent me, has eternal life; he will not be judged, but has come from death into life.

5.msb: Truly, truly, I tell you, the hour is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
5.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
5.blb: Truly, truly, I say to you that an hour is coming, and now is, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those having heard will live.
5.bbe: Truly I say to you, The time is coming, it has even now come, when the voice of the Son of God will come to the ears of the dead, and those hearing it will have life.

5.msb: For as the Father has life in Himself, so also He has granted the Son to have life in Himself.
5.kjv: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
5.blb: For just as the Father has life in Himself, so also He gave to the Son to have life in Himself.
5.bbe: For even as the Father has life in himself, so he has given to the Son to have life in himself.

5.msb: And He has given Him authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man.
5.kjv: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
5.blb: And He gave Him authority to do judgment, because He is the Son of Man.
5.bbe: And he has given him authority to be judge because he is the Son of man.

5.msb: Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in their graves will hear His voice
5.kjv: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
5.blb: Do not marvel at this, for an hour is coming in which all those in the tombs will hear His voice,
5.bbe: Do not be surprised at this: for the time is coming when his voice will come to all who are in the place of the dead,

5.msb: and come out—those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment.
5.kjv: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
5.blb: and they will come out—those having done good to the resurrection of life, and those having practiced evil to the resurrection of judgment.
5.bbe: And they will come out; those who have done good, into the new life; and those who have done evil, to be judged.

5.msb: I can do nothing by Myself; I judge only as I hear. And My judgment is just, because I do not seek My own will, but the will of the Father who sent Me.
5.kjv: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
5.blb: I am able to do nothing from Myself. Just as I hear, I judge; and My judgment is just, because I do not seek My will, but the will of the One having sent Me.
5.bbe: Of myself I am unable to do anything: as the voice comes to me so I give a decision: and my decision is right because I have no desire to do what is pleasing to myself, but only what is pleasing to him who sent me.

5.msb: If I testify about Myself, My testimony is not valid.
5.kjv: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
5.blb: If I testify concerning Myself, My testimony is not true.
5.bbe: If I gave witness about myself, my witness would not be true.
5.heading: Testimonies about Jesus

5.msb: There is another who testifies about Me, and I know that His testimony about Me is valid.
5.kjv: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
5.blb: It is another testifying concerning Me, and I know that the testimony that He testifies concerning Me is true.
5.bbe: There is another who gives witness about me and I am certain that the witness he gives about me is true.

5.msb: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
5.kjv: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
5.blb: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
5.bbe: You sent to John and he gave true witness.

5.msb: Even though I do not accept human testimony, I say these things so that you may be saved.
5.kjv: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
5.blb: Now I do not receive testimony from man, but I say these things so that you may be saved.
5.bbe: But I have no need of a man's witness: I only say these things so that you may have salvation.

5.msb: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you were willing for a season to bask in his light.
5.kjv: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
5.blb: He was the lamp burning and shining, and you were willing to exult for an hour in his light.
5.bbe: He was a burning and shining light, and for a time you were ready to be happy in his light.

5.msb: But I have testimony more substantial than that of John. For the works that the Father has given Me to accomplish—the very works I am doing—testify about Me that the Father has sent Me.
5.kjv: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
5.blb: But I have testimony greater than that of John. For the works that the Father has given to Me so that I should complete them, the same works that I do, testify concerning Me that the Father has sent Me.
5.bbe: But the witness which I have is greater than that of John: the work which the Father has given me to do, the very work which I am now doing, is a witness that the Father has sent me.

5.msb: And the Father who sent Me has Himself testified about Me. You have never heard His voice nor seen His form,
5.kjv: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
5.blb: And the One having sent Me, the Father Himself, has testified concerning Me. You have neither heard His voice at any time, nor have you seen His form.
5.bbe: And the Father himself who sent me has given witness about me. Not one of you has ever given ear to his voice; his form you have not seen.

5.msb: nor does His word abide in you, because you do not believe the One He sent.
5.kjv: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
5.blb: And you do not have His word remaining in you, for you do not believe Him whom He sent.
5.bbe: And you have not kept his word in your hearts, because you have not faith in him whom he has sent.

5.msb: You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life. These are the very words that testify about Me,
5.kjv: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
5.blb: You search the Scriptures because you think to have eternal life in them, and these are they testifying concerning Me;
5.bbe: You make search in the holy Writings, in the belief that through them you get eternal life; and it is those Writings which give witness about me.
5.heading: The Witness of Scripture

5.msb: yet you refuse to come to Me to have life.
5.kjv: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
5.blb: and you are not willing to come to Me so that you may have life.
5.bbe: And still you have no desire to come to me so that you may have life.

5.msb: I do not accept glory from men,
5.kjv: I receive not honour from men.
5.blb: I do not receive glory from men,
5.bbe: I do not take honour from men;

5.msb: but I know you, that you do not have the love of God within you.
5.kjv: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
5.blb: but I have known you, that you do not have the love of God in yourselves.
5.bbe: But I have knowledge of you that you have no love for God in your hearts.

5.msb: I have come in My Father’s name, and you have not received Me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will receive him.
5.kjv: I am come in my Father’s name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
5.blb: I have come in the name of My Father, and you do not receive Me; if another should come in his own name, you will receive him.
5.bbe: I have come in my Father's name, and your hearts are not open to me. If another comes with no other authority but himself, you will give him your approval.

5.msb: How can you believe if you accept glory from one another, yet do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?
5.kjv: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
5.blb: How are you able to believe, receiving glory from one another, and you do not seek the glory that is from the only God?
5.bbe: How is it possible for you to have faith while you take honour one from another and have no desire for the honour which comes from the only God?

5.msb: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, in whom you have put your hope.
5.kjv: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
5.blb: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is the one accusing you: Moses, in whom you have hoped.
5.bbe: Put out of your minds the thought that I will say things against you to the Father: the one who says things against you is Moses, on whom you put your hopes.

5.msb: If you had believed Moses, you would believe Me, because he wrote about Me.
5.kjv: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.
5.blb: For if you were believing Moses, you would have been believing Me; for he wrote concerning Me.
5.bbe: If you had belief in Moses you would have belief in me; for his writings are about me.

5.msb: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how will you believe what I say?”
5.kjv: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
5.blb: But if you do not believe his writings, how will you believe My words?”
5.bbe: If you have no belief in his writings, how will you have belief in my words?

6.msb: After this, Jesus crossed to the other side of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias).
6.kjv: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
6.blb: After these things Jesus went away to the other side of the Sea of Galilee (of Tiberias),
6.bbe: After these things Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee — that is, the sea of Tiberias.
6.heading: The Feeding of the Five Thousand

6.msb: A large crowd followed Him because they saw His signs He was performing on the sick.
6.kjv: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
6.blb: and a great crowd was following Him because they were seeing the signs that He was doing upon the ailing.
6.bbe: And a great number of people went after him because they saw the signs which he did on those who were ill.

6.msb: Then Jesus went up on the mountain and sat down with His disciples.
6.kjv: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
6.blb: And Jesus went up on the mountain and was sitting there with His disciples.
6.bbe: Then Jesus went up the mountain and was seated there with his disciples.

6.msb: Now the Jewish Feast of the Passover was near.
6.kjv: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
6.blb: Now the Passover was near, the feast of the Jews.
6.bbe: Now the Passover, a feast of the Jews, was near.

6.msb: When Jesus looked up and saw a large crowd coming toward Him, He said to Philip, “Where can we buy bread for these people to eat?”
6.kjv: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
6.blb: Then Jesus, having lifted up the eyes and having seen that a great crowd is coming to Him, says to Philip, “From where shall we buy bread so that these might eat?”
6.bbe: Lifting up his eyes, Jesus saw a great number of people coming to where he was, and he said to Philip, Where may we get bread for all these people?

6.msb: But He was asking this to test him, for He knew what He was about to do.
6.kjv: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
6.blb: Now He was saying this testing him, for He knew what He was about to do.
6.bbe: This he said, testing him: for he had no doubt what he himself would do.

6.msb: Philip answered, “Two hundred denarii would not buy enough bread for each of them to have a small piece.”
6.kjv: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
6.blb: Philip answered Him, “Two hundred denarii of loaves are not sufficient for them, that each might receive some little piece.”
6.bbe: Philip made answer, Bread to the value of two hundred pence would not be enough even to give everyone a little.

6.msb: One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to Him,
6.kjv: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, saith unto him,
6.blb: One of His disciples, Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, says to Him,
6.bbe: One of his disciples, Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, said to Jesus,

6.msb: “Here is a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish. But what difference will these make among so many?”
6.kjv: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
6.blb: “Here is a little boy who has five barley loaves and two small fish, but what are these for so many?”
6.bbe: There is a boy here with five barley cakes and two fishes: but what is that among such a number?

6.msb: “Have the people sit down,” Jesus said. Now there was plenty of grass in that place, so the men sat down, about five thousand of them.
6.kjv: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
6.blb: Jesus said, “Make the men recline.” Now there was much grass in the place; therefore the men reclined, about five thousand in number.
6.bbe: Jesus said, Let the people be seated. Now there was much grass in that place. And those seated on the grass were about five thousand.

6.msb: Then Jesus took the loaves, gave thanks, and distributed them to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were seated—and the fish—as much as they wanted.
6.kjv: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
6.blb: And Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, He distributed to those reclining; likewise also of the small fish, as much as they were wanting.
6.bbe: Then Jesus took the cakes and having given praise to God, he gave them to the people who were seated, and the fishes in the same way, as much as they had need of.

6.msb: And when everyone was full, He said to His disciples, “Gather the pieces that are left over, so that nothing will be wasted.”
6.kjv: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
6.blb: Now when they were filled, He says to His disciples, “Gather together the fragments having superabounded, so that nothing may be lost.”
6.bbe: And when they had had enough, Jesus said to his disciples, Take up the broken bits which are over, so that nothing may be wasted.

6.msb: So they collected them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.
6.kjv: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
6.blb: So they gathered together and filled twelve hand-baskets of fragments from the five barley loaves that superabounded to those having eaten.
6.bbe: So they took them up: twelve baskets full of broken bits of the five cakes which were over after the people had had enough.

6.msb: When the people saw the sign that Jesus had performed, they began to say, “Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.”
6.kjv: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
6.blb: Therefore the men, having seen what sign He did, were saying, “This is truly the Prophet who is coming into the world.”
6.bbe: And when the people saw the sign which he had done, they said, Truly, this is the prophet who is to come into the world.

6.msb: Then Jesus, realizing that they were about to come and make Him king by force, withdrew to a mountain by Himself.
6.kjv: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
6.blb: Therefore Jesus, having known that they are about to come and to seize Him so that they might make Him king, withdrew again to the mountain by Himself alone.
6.bbe: Now when Jesus saw that the people were about to come and take him by force to make him a king, he went away again up the mountain by himself.

6.msb: When evening came, His disciples went down to the sea,
6.kjv: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
6.blb: Now as it became evening, His disciples went down to the sea,
6.bbe: When evening came the disciples went down to the sea;
6.heading: Jesus Walks on Water

6.msb: got into a boat, and started across the sea to Capernaum. It was already dark, and Jesus had not gone out to them.
6.kjv: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
6.blb: and having entered into a boat, they were going to the other side of the sea, to Capernaum. And darkness already had come, and Jesus had not yet come to them.
6.bbe: And they took a boat and went across the sea in the direction of Capernaum. By then it was dark and still Jesus had not come to them.

6.msb: A strong wind was blowing, and the sea grew agitated.
6.kjv: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
6.blb: And the sea was agitated by a great wind blowing.
6.bbe: The sea was getting rough because of a strong wind which was blowing.

6.msb: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the sea—and they were terrified.
6.kjv: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
6.blb: Therefore, having rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they see Jesus walking on the sea and coming near the boat, and they were afraid.
6.bbe: After they had gone three or four miles they saw Jesus walking on the sea and coming near to the boat; and they had great fear.

6.msb: But Jesus spoke up: “It is I; do not be afraid.”
6.kjv: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
6.blb: But He says to them, “I am He! Do not be afraid.”
6.bbe: But he said to them, It is I, have no fear.

6.msb: Then they were willing to take Him into the boat, and at once the boat reached the shore where they were heading.
6.kjv: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
6.blb: Then they were willing to take Him into the boat, and immediately the boat was at the land to which they were going.
6.bbe: Then they readily took him into the boat: and straight away the boat was at the land to which they were going.

6.msb: The next day, the crowd that had remained on the other side of the sea realized that no other boat had been there except the one that His disciples had entered, and that Jesus had not boarded it with His disciples, but they had gone away alone.
6.kjv: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
6.blb: On the next day, the crowd was standing on the other side of the sea, having seen that no other boat was there except one, and that Jesus did not go with His disciples into the boat, but His disciples went away alone.
6.bbe: The day after, the people who were on the other side of the sea saw that only one small boat had been there, that Jesus had not gone in that boat with the disciples, but that the disciples had gone away by themselves.
6.heading: Jesus the Bread of Life

6.msb: Then other boats, which were from Tiberias, landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
6.kjv: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
6.blb: (But boats from Tiberias came near the place where they ate the bread, the Lord having given thanks).
6.bbe: Some other boats, however, came from Tiberias near to the place where they had taken the bread after the Lord had given praise.

6.msb: So when the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor His disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Him.
6.kjv: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
6.blb: Therefore when the crowd saw that Jesus is not there, nor His disciples, they themselves entered into the boats and went to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
6.bbe: So when the people saw that Jesus was not there, or his disciples, they got into those boats and went over to Capernaum looking for Jesus.

6.msb: When they found Him on the other side of the sea, they asked Him, “Rabbi, when did You get here?”
6.kjv: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
6.blb: And having found Him on the other side of the sea, they said to Him, “Rabbi, when have You come here?”
6.bbe: And when they came across him on the other side of the sea they said, Rabbi, when did you come here?

6.msb: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it is not because you saw these signs that you are looking for Me, but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.
6.kjv: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
6.blb: Jesus answered them and said, “Truly, truly, I say to you, you seek Me not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were satisfied.
6.bbe: Jesus, answering them, said, Truly I say to you, You come after me, not because you saw signs, but because you were given the bread and had enough.

6.msb: Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval.”
6.kjv: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
6.blb: Do not work for the food that is perishing, but for the food remaining unto eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you; for God the Father sealed Him.”
6.bbe: Let your work not be for the food which comes to an end, but for the food which goes on for eternal life, which the Son of man will give to you, for on him has God the Father put his mark.

6.msb: Then they inquired, “What must we do to perform the works of God?”
6.kjv: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
6.blb: Therefore they said to Him, “What may we do so that we may work the works of God?”
6.bbe: Then they said to him, How may we do the works of God?

6.msb: Jesus replied, “The work of God is this: to believe in the One He has sent.”
6.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
6.blb: Jesus answered and said to them, “This is the work of God, that you should believe in Him whom He sent.”
6.bbe: Jesus, answering, said to them, This is to do the work of God: to have faith in him whom God has sent.

6.msb: So they asked Him, “What sign then will You perform, so that we may see it and believe You? What will You do?
6.kjv: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
6.blb: Therefore they said to Him, “Then what sign do You do, so that we may see and may believe You? What do You work?
6.bbe: So they said, What sign do you give us, so that we may see and have faith in you? What do you do?

6.msb: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’”
6.kjv: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
6.blb: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, as it is written: ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”
6.bbe: Our fathers had the manna in the waste land, as the Writings say, He gave them bread from heaven.

6.msb: Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven, but it is My Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.
6.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
6.blb: Therefore Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, Moses has not given you the bread out of heaven, but My Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.
6.bbe: Jesus then said to them, Truly I say to you, What Moses gave you was not the bread from heaven; it is my Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.

6.msb: For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”
6.kjv: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
6.blb: For the bread of God is the One coming down out of heaven and giving life to the world.”
6.bbe: The bread of God is the bread which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.

6.msb: “Sir,” they said, “give us this bread at all times.”
6.kjv: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
6.blb: Therefore they said to Him, “Sir, always give us this bread.”
6.bbe: Ah, Lord, they said, give us that bread for ever!

6.msb: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.
6.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
6.blb: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life; the one coming to Me never shall hunger, and the one believing in Me never will thirst at any time.
6.bbe: And this was the answer of Jesus: I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will never be in need of food, and he who has faith in me will never be in need of drink.

6.msb: But as I stated, you have seen Me and still you do not believe.
6.kjv: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
6.blb: But I said to you that you have also seen Me and you do not believe.
6.bbe: But it is as I said to you: you have seen me, and still you have no faith.

6.msb: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.
6.kjv: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
6.blb: All that the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one coming to Me I shall never cast out.
6.bbe: Whatever the Father gives to me will come to me; and I will not send away anyone who comes to me.

6.msb: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but to do the will of Him who sent Me.
6.kjv: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
6.blb: For I have come down from heaven, not so that I may do My will, but the will of the One having sent Me.
6.bbe: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my pleasure, but the pleasure of him who sent me.

6.msb: And this is the will of the Father who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.
6.kjv: And this is the Father’s will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
6.blb: Now this is the will of the One having sent Me, that all that He has given Me, I should lose none of it, but I will raise it up in the last day.
6.bbe: And this is the pleasure of him who sent me, that I am not to let out of my hands anything which he has given me, but I am to give it new life on the last day.

6.msb: And it is the will of Him who sent Me that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.”
6.kjv: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
6.blb: For this is the will of My Father, that everyone beholding the Son and believing in Him may have eternal life, and I will raise him up in the last day.”
6.bbe: This, I say, is my Father's pleasure, that everyone who sees the Son and has faith in him may have eternal life: and I will take him up on the last day.

6.msb: At this, the Jews began to grumble about Jesus because He had said, “I am the bread that came down from heaven.”
6.kjv: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
6.blb: Therefore the Jews were grumbling about Him because He said, “I am the bread having come down out of heaven.”
6.bbe: Now the Jews said bitter things about Jesus because of his words, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

6.msb: They were asking, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then can He say, ‘I have come down from heaven’?”
6.kjv: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
6.blb: And they were saying, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does He say, ‘I have come down out of heaven?’”
6.bbe: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we have seen? How is it then that he now says, I have come down from heaven?

6.msb: “Stop grumbling among yourselves,” Jesus therefore replied.
6.kjv: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
6.blb: Jesus answered and said to them, “Do not grumble with one another.
6.bbe: Jesus made answer and said, Do not say things against me, one to another.

6.msb: “No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him, and I will raise him up at the last day.
6.kjv: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
6.blb: No one is able to come to Me unless the Father, the One having sent Me, should draw him, and I will raise him up in the last day.
6.bbe: No man is able to come to me if the Father who sent me does not give him the desire to come: and I will take him up from the dead on the last day.

6.msb: It is written in the Prophets: ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who has heard the Father and learned from Him comes to Me—
6.kjv: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
6.blb: It is written in the Prophets: ‘And they will all be taught of God.’ Everyone having heard from the Father and having learned comes to Me.
6.bbe: The writings of the prophets say, And they will all have teaching from God. Everyone whose ears have been open to the teaching of the Father comes to me.

6.msb: not that anyone has seen the Father except the One who is from God; only He has seen the Father.
6.kjv: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.
6.blb: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except the One being from God; He has seen the Father.
6.bbe: Not that anyone has ever seen the Father; only he who is from God, he has seen the Father.

6.msb: Truly, truly, I tell you, he who believes in Me has eternal life.
6.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
6.blb: Truly, truly, I say to you, the one believing has eternal life.
6.bbe: Truly I say to you, He who has faith in me has eternal life.

6.msb: I am the bread of life.
6.kjv: I am that bread of life.
6.blb: I am the bread of life.
6.bbe: I am the bread of life.

6.msb: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.
6.kjv: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
6.blb: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.
6.bbe: Your fathers took the manna in the waste land — and they are dead.

6.msb: This is the bread that comes down from heaven, so that anyone may eat of it and not die.
6.kjv: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
6.blb: This is the bread coming down out of heaven, so that anyone may eat of it and not die.
6.bbe: The bread which comes from heaven is such bread that a man may take it for food and never see death.

6.msb: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. And this bread, which I will give for the life of the world, is My flesh.”
6.kjv: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
6.blb: I am the living bread having come down out of heaven. If anyone shall eat of this bread, he will live to the age. And the bread also that I will give for the life of the world is My flesh.”
6.bbe: I am the living bread which has come from heaven: if any man takes this bread for food he will have life for ever: and more than this, the bread which I will give is my flesh which I will give for the life of the world.

6.msb: At this, the Jews began to argue among themselves, “How can this man give us His flesh to eat?”
6.kjv: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
6.blb: Therefore the Jews were arguing with one another, saying, “How is this One able to give us His flesh to eat?”
6.bbe: Then the Jews had an angry discussion among themselves, saying, How is it possible for this man to give us his flesh for food?

6.msb: So Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man, you have no life in you.
6.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
6.blb: Therefore Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, unless you shall eat the flesh of the Son of Man and shall drink His blood, you do not have life in yourselves.
6.bbe: Then Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you, If you do not take the flesh of the Son of man for food, and if you do not take his blood for drink, you have no life in you.

6.msb: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
6.kjv: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
6.blb: The one eating My flesh and drinking My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up in the last day.
6.bbe: He who takes my flesh for food and my blood for drink has eternal life: and I will take him up from the dead at the last day.

6.msb: For My flesh is truly food, and My blood is truly drink.
6.kjv: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
6.blb: For My flesh is true food, and My blood is true drink.
6.bbe: My flesh is true food and my blood is true drink.

6.msb: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood remains in Me, and I in him.
6.kjv: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
6.blb: The one eating My flesh and drinking My blood remains in Me, and I in him.
6.bbe: He who takes my flesh for food and my blood for drink is in me and I in him.

6.msb: Just as the living Father sent Me and I live because of the Father, so also the one who feeds on Me will live because of Me.
6.kjv: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
6.blb: Just as the living Father sent Me and I live because of the Father, the one also feeding on Me, he also will live because of Me.
6.bbe: As the living Father has sent me, and I have life because of the Father, even so he who takes me for his food will have life because of me.

6.msb: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Unlike your fathers, who ate the manna and died, the one who eats this bread will live forever.”
6.kjv: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
6.blb: This is the bread having come down out of heaven, not as the fathers ate and died. The one eating this bread will live to the age.”
6.bbe: This is the bread which has come down from heaven. It is not like the food which your fathers had: they took of the manna, and are dead; but he who takes this bread for food will have life for ever.

6.msb: Jesus said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.
6.kjv: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
6.blb: He said these things teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.
6.bbe: Jesus said these things in the Synagogue while he was teaching at Capernaum.
6.heading: Many Disciples Turn Back

6.msb: On hearing it, many of His disciples said, “This is a difficult teaching. Who can accept it?”
6.kjv: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
6.blb: Therefore many of His disciples, having heard, said, “This word is difficult; who is able to hear it?”
6.bbe: Then, hearing this, a number of his disciples said, This is a hard saying; who is able to take in such teaching?

6.msb: Aware that His disciples were grumbling about this teaching, Jesus asked them, “Does this offend you?
6.kjv: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
6.blb: But Jesus, knowing in Himself that His disciples are grumbling about this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?
6.bbe: When Jesus became conscious that his disciples were protesting about what he said, he said to them, Does this give you trouble?

6.msb: Then what will happen if you see the Son of Man ascend to where He was before?
6.kjv: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
6.blb: Then what if you may behold the Son of Man ascending to where He was before?
6.bbe: What then will you say if you see the Son of man going up to where he was before?

6.msb: The Spirit gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words I speak to you are spirit and they are life.
6.kjv: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
6.blb: It is the Spirit making alive; the flesh profits nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are spirit and they are life.
6.bbe: The spirit is the life giver; the flesh is of no value: the words which I have said to you are spirit and they are life.

6.msb: However, there are some of you who do not believe.” (For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray Him.)
6.kjv: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
6.blb: But there are some of you who do not believe.” For Jesus had known from the beginning who are those not believing and who it is who will betray Him.
6.bbe: But still some of you have no faith. For it was clear to Jesus from the first who they were who had no faith, and who it was who would be false to him.

6.msb: Then Jesus said, “This is why I told you that no one can come to Me unless My Father has granted it to him.”
6.kjv: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
6.blb: And He was saying, “Because of this, I have said to you that no one is able to come to Me unless it shall have been given to him from the Father.”
6.bbe: And he said, This is why I said to you, No man is able to come to me if he is not given the power to do so by the Father.

6.msb: From that time on many of His disciples turned back and no longer walked with Him.
6.kjv: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
6.blb: From this time many of His disciples went away to the back and no longer were walking with Him.
6.bbe: Because of what he said, a number of the disciples went back and would no longer go with him.

6.msb: So Jesus asked the Twelve, “Do you want to leave too?”
6.kjv: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
6.blb: Therefore Jesus said to the Twelve, “Do you also want to go away?”
6.bbe: So Jesus said to the twelve, Have you a desire to go away?
6.heading: Peter’s Confession of Faith

6.msb: Simon Peter replied, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
6.kjv: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
6.blb: Simon Peter answered Him, “Lord, to whom will we go? You have the words of eternal life.
6.bbe: Then Simon Peter gave this answer: Lord, to whom are we to go? you have the words of eternal life;

6.msb: We believe and know that You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
6.kjv: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
6.blb: And we have believed and have known that You are the Holy One of God.”
6.bbe: And we have faith and are certain that you are the Holy One of God.

6.msb: Jesus answered them, “Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!”
6.kjv: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
6.blb: Jesus answered them, “Did I not choose you, the Twelve? And one of you is a devil!”
6.bbe: Then Jesus said, Did I not make a selection of you, the twelve, and one of you is a son of the Evil One?

6.msb: He was speaking about Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon. For although Judas was one of the Twelve, he was later to betray Jesus.
6.kjv: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
6.blb: Now He was speaking of Judas son of Simon Iscariot; for he, one of the Twelve, was about to betray Him.
6.bbe: He was talking of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. It was he who was to be false to Jesus — one of the twelve.

7.msb: After this, Jesus traveled throughout Galilee. He did not want to travel in Judea, because the Jews there were trying to kill Him.
7.kjv: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
7.blb: And after these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for He was not wanting to walk in Judea because the Jews were seeking to kill Him.
7.bbe: After this, Jesus went from place to place in Galilee. He did not go about in Judaea, because the Jews were looking for a chance to put him to death.
7.heading: Jesus Teaches at the Feast

7.msb: However, the Jewish Feast of Tabernacles was near.
7.kjv: Now the Jews’ feast of tabernacles was at hand.
7.blb: Now the feast of the Jews—that of Booths—was near.
7.bbe: But the feast of the Jews, the feast of tents, was near.

7.msb: So Jesus’ brothers said to Him, “Leave here and go to Judea, so that Your disciples there may see the works You are doing.
7.kjv: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judæa, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
7.blb: Therefore His brothers said to Him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, so that Your disciples will also see Your works that You do.
7.bbe: So his brothers said to him, Go away from here into Judaea so that your disciples may see the works which you do.

7.msb: For no one who wants to be known publicly acts in secret. Since You are doing these things, show Yourself to the world.”
7.kjv: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.
7.blb: For no one does anything in secret and himself seeks to be in public. If You do these things, manifest Yourself to the world.”
7.bbe: Because no man does things secretly if he has a desire that men may have knowledge of him. If you do these things, let yourself be seen by all men.

7.msb: For even His own brothers did not believe in Him.
7.kjv: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
7.blb: For not even His brothers were believing in Him.
7.bbe: For even his brothers had no belief in him.

7.msb: Therefore Jesus told them, “Although your time is always at hand, My time has not yet come.
7.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
7.blb: Therefore Jesus says to them, “My time is not yet present, but your time is always ready.
7.bbe: Jesus said to them, My time is still to come, but any time is good for you.

7.msb: The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me, because I testify that its works are evil.
7.kjv: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.
7.blb: The world is not able to hate you; but it hates Me, because I testify about it that its works are evil.
7.bbe: It is not possible for you to be hated by the world; but I am hated by it, because I give witness that what it does is evil.

7.msb: Go up to the feast on your own. I am not yet going up to this feast, because My time has not yet come.”
7.kjv: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.
7.blb: You go up to the feast. I am not going up to this feast, because My time has not yet been fulfilled.”
7.bbe: Go you up to the feast: I am not going up now to the feast because my time has not fully come.

7.msb: Having said this to them, Jesus remained in Galilee.
7.kjv: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
7.blb: And having said these things Himself, He remained in Galilee.
7.bbe: Having said these things to them, he still kept in Galilee.

7.msb: But after His brothers had gone up to the feast, He also went—not publicly, but in secret.
7.kjv: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
7.blb: But when His brothers went up to the feast, then He also went up—not openly, but as in secret.
7.bbe: But after his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he went up, not publicly, but in secret.

7.msb: So the Jews were looking for Him at the feast and asking, “Where is He?”
7.kjv: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
7.blb: Therefore the Jews were seeking Him in the feast and were saying, “Where is that One?”
7.bbe: At the feast the Jews were looking for him and saying, Where is he?

7.msb: Many in the crowds were whispering about Him. Some said, “He is a good man.” But others replied, “No, He deceives the people.”
7.kjv: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
7.blb: And there was much murmuring about Him among the crowds. Indeed, some were saying, “He is good.” But others were saying, “No, but He deceives the crowd.”
7.bbe: And there was much discussion about him among the mass of the people. Some said, He is a good man; but others said, No, he is giving people false ideas.

7.msb: Yet no one would speak publicly about Him for fear of the Jews.
7.kjv: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
7.blb: No one, however, was speaking publicly about Him, because of the fear of the Jews.
7.bbe: But no man said anything about him openly for fear of the Jews.

7.msb: About halfway through the feast, Jesus went up to the temple courts and began to teach.
7.kjv: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
7.blb: And it being now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and was teaching.
7.bbe: Now in the middle of the feast Jesus went up to the Temple and was teaching.

7.msb: The Jews were amazed and asked, “How did this man attain such learning without having studied?”
7.kjv: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
7.blb: Therefore the Jews were marveling, saying, “How has this One known writings, not having learned?”
7.bbe: Then the Jews were surprised and said, How has this man got knowledge of books? He has never been to school.

7.msb: “My teaching is not My own,” Jesus replied. “It comes from Him who sent Me.
7.kjv: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
7.blb: Therefore Jesus answered them and said, “My teaching is not of Me, but of the One having sent Me.
7.bbe: Jesus gave them this answer: It is not my teaching, but his who sent me.

7.msb: If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.
7.kjv: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.
7.blb: If anyone should desire to do His will, he will know concerning the teaching, whether it is from God, or I speak from Myself.
7.bbe: If any man is ready to do God's pleasure he will have knowledge of the teaching and of where it comes from — from God or from myself.

7.msb: He who speaks on his own authority seeks his own glory, but He who seeks the glory of the One who sent Him is a man of truth; in Him there is no falsehood.
7.kjv: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
7.blb: The one speaking from himself seeks his own glory, but the One seeking the glory of the One having sent Him, He is true, and no unrighteousness is in Him.
7.bbe: The man whose words come from himself is looking for glory for himself, but he who is looking for the glory of him who sent him — that man is true and there is no evil in him.

7.msb: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps it. Why are you trying to kill Me?”
7.kjv: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
7.blb: Has not Moses given to you the law? And none of you does the law. Why do you seek to kill Me?”
7.bbe: Did not Moses give you the law? Even so, not one of you keeps the law. Why have you a desire to put me to death?

7.msb: “You have a demon,” the crowd replied. “Who is trying to kill You?”
7.kjv: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?
7.blb: The crowd answered, “You have a demon. Who seeks to kill You?”
7.bbe: The people said in answer, You have an evil spirit: who has any desire to put you to death?

7.msb: Jesus answered them, “I did one miracle, and you are all amazed.
7.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.
7.blb: Jesus answered and said to them, “I did one work, and you all marvel.
7.bbe: This was the answer of Jesus: I have done one work and you are all surprised at it.

7.msb: But because Moses gave you circumcision, you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath (not that it is from Moses, but from the patriarchs.)
7.kjv: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
7.blb: Because of this Moses has given to you the circumcision—not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers—and on the Sabbath you circumcise a man.
7.bbe: Moses gave you circumcision — not that it comes from Moses, but from the fathers — and even on the Sabbath you give a child circumcision.

7.msb: If a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses will not be broken, why are you angry with Me for making the whole man well on the Sabbath?
7.kjv: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?
7.blb: If a man receives circumcision on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses might not be broken, are you angry with Me because I made the whole man sound on the Sabbath?
7.bbe: If a child is given circumcision on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses may not be broken, why are you angry with me because I made a man completely well on the Sabbath?

7.msb: Stop judging by outward appearances, and start judging justly.”
7.kjv: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
7.blb: Do not judge according to appearance, but judge the righteous judgment.”
7.bbe: Let not your decisions be based on what you see, but on righteousness.

7.msb: Then some of the people of Jerusalem began to say, “Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill?
7.kjv: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
7.blb: Therefore some of those of Jerusalem were saying, “Is this not whom they seek to kill?
7.bbe: Then some of the people of Jerusalem said, Is not this the man whose death is desired?
7.heading: Is Jesus the Christ?

7.msb: Yet here He is, speaking publicly, and they are not saying anything to Him. Have the rulers truly recognized that this is the Christ?
7.kjv: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?
7.blb: And behold, He speaks publicly, and they say nothing ever to Him. Did the rulers truly know that this is the Christ?
7.bbe: And here he is talking openly and they say nothing to him! Is it possible that the rulers have knowledge that this is truly the Christ?

7.msb: But we know where this man is from. When the Christ comes, no one will know where He is from.”
7.kjv: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
7.blb: But we know this man, where He is from. But the Christ, when He may come, no one knows where He is from.”
7.bbe: However, it is clear to us where this man comes from: but when the Christ comes no one will have knowledge where he comes from.

7.msb: Then Jesus, still teaching in the temple courts, cried out, “You know Me, and you know where I am from. I have not come of My own accord, but He who sent Me is true. You do not know Him,
7.kjv: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
7.blb: Therefore Jesus cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You know Me and you know where I am from. And I have not come of Myself, but the One having sent Me is true, whom you do not know.
7.bbe: Then, when he was teaching in the Temple, Jesus said with a loud voice, You have knowledge of me and you have knowledge of where I come from; and I have not come of myself; but there is One who has sent me; he is true, but you have no knowledge of him.

7.msb: but I know Him, because I am from Him and He sent Me.”
7.kjv: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
7.blb: I know Him, because I am from Him, and He sent Me.”
7.bbe: I have knowledge of him because I came from him and he sent me.

7.msb: So they tried to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him, because His hour had not yet come.
7.kjv: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
7.blb: Therefore they were seeking to seize Him, but no one laid the hand upon Him, because His hour had not yet come.
7.bbe: Then they had a desire to take him: but no man put hands on him because his hour was still to come.

7.msb: Many in the crowd, however, believed in Him and said, “When the Christ comes, will He perform more signs than this man?”
7.kjv: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?
7.blb: But many out of the crowd believed in Him and were saying, “When the Christ shall come, will He do more signs than this man did?”
7.bbe: And numbers of the people had belief in him, and they said, When the Christ comes will he do more signs than this man has done?

7.msb: When the Pharisees heard the crowd whispering these things about Jesus, they and the chief priests sent officers to arrest Him.
7.kjv: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
7.blb: The Pharisees heard the crowd murmuring these things about Him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers so that they might seize Him.
7.bbe: This discussion of the people came to the ears of the Pharisees; and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent servants to take him.

7.msb: So Jesus said, “I am with you only a little while longer, and then I am going to the One who sent Me.
7.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
7.blb: Therefore Jesus said, “Yet a little time I am with you, and I go to the One having sent Me.
7.bbe: Then Jesus said, I will be with you a little longer and then I go to him who sent me.

7.msb: You will look for Me, but you will not find Me; and where I am, you cannot come.”
7.kjv: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.
7.blb: You will seek Me and will not find Me; and where I am, you are not able to come.”
7.bbe: You will be looking for me, and you will not see me: and where I am you may not come.

7.msb: At this, the Jews said to one another, “Where does He intend to go that we will not find Him? Will He go where the Jews are dispersed among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?
7.kjv: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
7.blb: Therefore the Jews said among themselves, “Where is He about to go that we will not find Him? Is He about to go to the Diaspora among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?
7.bbe: So the Jews said among themselves, To what place is he going where we will not see him? will he go to the Jews living among the Greeks and become the teacher of the Greeks?

7.msb: What does He mean by saying, ‘You will look for Me, but you will not find Me,’ and, ‘Where I am, you cannot come’?”
7.kjv: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?
7.blb: What is this word that He said, ‘You will seek Me, and will not find Me,’ and, ‘Where I am, you are not able to come’?”
7.bbe: What is this saying of his, You will be looking for me and will not see me, and where I am you may not come?

7.msb: On the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood up and called out in a loud voice, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink.
7.kjv: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
7.blb: Now in the last day of the feast, the great day, Jesus stood and cried out, saying, “If anyone may thirst, let him come to Me and drink.
7.bbe: On the last day, the great day of the feast, Jesus got up and said in a loud voice, If any man is in need of drink let him come to me and I will give it to him.
7.heading: Living Water

7.msb: Whoever believes in Me, as the Scripture has said: ‘Streams of living water will flow from within him.’”
7.kjv: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
7.blb: The one believing in Me, as the Scripture said: ‘Out of his belly will flow rivers of living water.’”
7.bbe: He who has faith in me, out of his body, as the Writings have said, will come rivers of living water.

7.msb: He was speaking about the Spirit, whom those who believed in Him were later to receive. For the Holy Spirit had not yet been given, because Jesus had not yet been glorified.
7.kjv: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
7.blb: Now He said this about the Spirit, whom those having believed in Him were about to receive; for the Spirit was not yet, because Jesus was not yet glorified.
7.bbe: This he said of the Spirit which would be given to those who had faith in him: the Spirit had not been given then, because the glory of Jesus was still to come.

7.msb: On hearing these words, many of the people therefore said, “This is truly the Prophet.”
7.kjv: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
7.blb: Therefore, having heard these words, some of the crowd were saying, “This is truly the Prophet.”
7.bbe: When these words came to their ears, some of the people said, This is certainly the prophet.
7.heading: Division over Jesus

7.msb: Others declared, “This is the Christ.” But still others asked, “How can the Christ come from Galilee?
7.kjv: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
7.blb: Others were saying, “This is the Christ.” But others were saying, “How indeed does the Christ come out of Galilee?
7.bbe: Others said, This is the Christ. But others said, Not so; will the Christ come from Galilee?

7.msb: Doesn’t the Scripture say that the Christ will come from the line of David and from Bethlehem, the village where David lived?”
7.kjv: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
7.blb: Did not the Scripture say that out of the seed of David and from Bethlehem, the village where David was, comes the Christ?”
7.bbe: Do not the Writings say that the Christ comes of the seed of David and from Beth-lehem, the little town where David was?

7.msb: So there was division in the crowd because of Jesus.
7.kjv: So there was a division among the people because of him.
7.blb: Therefore a division happened in the crowd because of Him.
7.bbe: So there was a division among the people because of him.

7.msb: Some of them wanted to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him.
7.kjv: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
7.blb: Now some of them were wanting to seize Him, but no one laid the hands on Him.
7.bbe: And some of them had a desire to take him; but no man put hands on him.

7.msb: Then the officers returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, who asked them, “Why didn’t you bring Him in?”
7.kjv: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?
7.blb: Therefore the officers came to the chief priests and Pharisees, and they said to them, “Why did you not bring Him?”
7.bbe: Then the servants went back to the chief priests and Pharisees, who said to them, Why have you not got him with you?
7.heading: The Unbelief of the Jewish Leaders

7.msb: “Never has anyone spoken like this man!” the officers answered.
7.kjv: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
7.blb: The officers answered, “Never did a man speak thus, as this man speaks!”
7.bbe: The servants made answer, No man ever said things like this man.

7.msb: “Have you also been deceived?” replied the Pharisees.
7.kjv: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
7.blb: Therefore the Pharisees answered them, “Have you also been deceived?
7.bbe: Then the Pharisees said to them, Have you, like the others, been given false ideas?

7.msb: “Have any of the rulers or Pharisees believed in Him?
