7.kjv: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?
7.blb: Did anyone out of the rulers or out of the Pharisees believe in Him?
7.bbe: Have any of the rulers belief in him, or any one of the Pharisees?

7.msb: But this crowd that does not know the law—they are under a curse.”
7.kjv: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
7.blb: But this crowd, not knowing the law, they are accursed.”
7.bbe: But these people who have no knowledge of the law are cursed.

7.msb: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus by night and who himself was one of them, asked,
7.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)
7.blb: Nicodemus, the one having come to Him before, being one of them, says to them,
7.bbe: Nicodemus — he who had come to Jesus before, being himself one of them — said to them,

7.msb: “Does our law convict a man without first hearing from him to determine what he has done?”
7.kjv: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
7.blb: “Does our law judge the man unless it should first hear from him and know what he does?”
7.bbe: Is a man judged by our law before it has given him a hearing and has knowledge of what he has done?

7.msb: “Aren’t you also from Galilee?” they replied. “Look into it, and you will see that no prophet comes out of Galilee.”
7.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
7.blb: They answered and said to him, “Are you also out of Galilee? Search and see that out of Galilee a prophet is not raised.”
7.bbe: This was their answer: And do you come from Galilee? Make search and you will see that no prophet comes out of Galilee.

7.msb: Then each went to his own home.
7.kjv: And every man went unto his own house.
7.blb: And each went to his home.
7.bbe: [And every man went to his house;

8.msb: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
8.kjv: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
8.blb: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
8.bbe: But Jesus went to the Mountain of Olives.
8.heading: The Woman Caught in Adultery

8.msb: Early in the morning He went back into the temple courts. All the people came to Him, and He sat down to teach them.
8.kjv: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
8.blb: And early in the morning, again He came into the temple, and all the people were coming to Him. And having sat down, He was teaching them.
8.bbe: And early in the morning he came again into the Temple and all the people came to him and he was seated teaching them.

8.msb: The scribes and Pharisees, however, brought to Him a woman caught in adultery. They made her stand before them
8.kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
8.blb: Now the scribes and the Pharisees bring to Him a woman having been caught in adultery, and having set her in the midst,
8.bbe: Now the scribes and Pharisees came, with a woman who had been taken in the act of sinning against the married relation;

8.msb: and to test Him they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.
8.kjv: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
8.blb: they say to Him, “Teacher, this woman was caught in the very act, committing adultery.
8.bbe: And putting her forward, they said to him, Master, this woman has been taken in the very act of sinning against the married relation.

8.msb: In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such a woman. So what do You say?”
8.kjv: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
8.blb: Now in the Law Moses commanded us to stone such. You, therefore, what do You say?”
8.bbe: Now in the law Moses gave directions that such women were to be stoned; what do you say about it?

8.msb: They said this to test Him, in order to have a basis for accusing Him. But Jesus bent down and began to write on the ground with His finger, not taking notice.
8.kjv: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
8.blb: Now they were saying this, testing Him, so that they might have grounds to accuse Him. But Jesus, having stooped down, was writing with His finger into the ground.
8.bbe: They said this, testing him, so that they might have something against him. But Jesus, with his head bent down, made letters on the floor with his finger.

8.msb: When they continued to question Him, He straightened up and said to them, “Let him who is without sin among you be the first to cast a stone at her.”
8.kjv: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
8.blb: But as they continued asking Him, He lifted Himself up and said to them, “The one sinless among you, let him cast the first stone at her.”
8.bbe: But when they went on with their questions, he got up and said to them, Let him among you who is without sin be the first to send a stone at her.

8.msb: And again He bent down and wrote on the ground.
8.kjv: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
8.blb: And again having stooped down, He was writing into the ground.
8.bbe: And again, with bent head, he made letters on the floor.

8.msb: When they heard this and were convicted by their consciences, they began to go away one by one, beginning with the older ones, until only Jesus was left, with the woman standing there.
8.kjv: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
8.blb: And having heard, they were going out one by one, having begun from the elder ones until the last, and Jesus was left alone, and the woman being in the midst.
8.bbe: And when his words came to their ears, they went out one by one, starting with the oldest even to the last, because they were conscious of what was in their hearts: and Jesus was there by himself with the woman before him.

8.msb: Then Jesus straightened up and saw no one but the woman. And He asked her, “Where are your accusers? Has no one condemned you?”
8.kjv: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
8.blb: And having lifted Himself up, Jesus said to her, “Woman, where are those—your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”
8.bbe: Then Jesus got up, and seeing nobody but the woman, he said to her, Where are the men who said things against you? did no one give a decision against you?

8.msb: “No one, Lord,” she answered. “Then neither do I condemn you,” Jesus declared. “Go and sin no more.”
8.kjv: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
8.blb: And she said, “No one, Lord.” And Jesus said to her, “Neither do I condemn you. Go, and from now on sin no more.”
8.bbe: And she said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said, And I do not give a decision against you: go, and never do wrong again.]

8.msb: Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
8.kjv: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
8.blb: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. The one following Me shall not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
8.bbe: Then again Jesus said to them, I am the light of the world; he who comes with me will not be walking in the dark but will have the light of life.
8.heading: Jesus the Light of the World

8.msb: So the Pharisees said to Him, “You are testifying about Yourself; Your testimony is not valid.”
8.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
8.blb: Therefore the Pharisees said to Him, “You testify about Yourself; Your testimony is not true.”
8.bbe: So the Pharisees said to him, The witness you give is about yourself: your witness is not true.

8.msb: Jesus replied, “Even if I testify about Myself, My testimony is valid, because I know where I came from and where I am going. But you do not know where I came from or where I am going.
8.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
8.blb: Jesus answered and said to them, “Even if I testify about Myself, My testimony is true, because I know from where I came and where I am going. But you do not know from where I come or where I am going.
8.bbe: Jesus said in answer, Even if I give witness about myself, my witness is true, because I have knowledge of where I came from and where I am going; but you have no knowledge of where I come from or of where I am going.

8.msb: You judge according to the flesh; I judge no one.
8.kjv: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
8.blb: You judge according to the flesh; I judge no one.
8.bbe: You are judging from what you see; I am judging no man.

8.msb: But even if I do judge, My judgment is true, because I am not alone; I am with the Father who sent Me.
8.kjv: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
8.blb: But even if I judge, My judgment is true, because I am not alone—but I and the Father having sent Me.
8.bbe: Even if I am judging, my decision is right, because I am not by myself — with me is the Father who sent me.

8.msb: Even in your own Law it is written that the testimony of two men is valid.
8.kjv: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
8.blb: And even in your Law it has been written that the testimony of two men is true.
8.bbe: Even in your law it is said that the witness of two men is true.

8.msb: I am One who testifies about Myself, and the Father, who sent Me, also testifies about Me.”
8.kjv: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
8.blb: I am the One testifying about Myself, and the Father having sent Me testifies about Me.”
8.bbe: I give witness about myself and the Father who sent me gives witness about me.

8.msb: “Where is Your Father?” they asked Him. “You do not know Me or My Father,” Jesus answered. “If you knew Me, you would know My Father as well.”
8.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
8.blb: Therefore they were saying to Him, “Where is Your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither Me nor My Father. If you had known Me, you would have known My Father also.”
8.bbe: Then they said to him, Where is your Father? Jesus said in answer, You have no knowledge of me or of my Father: if you had knowledge of me you would have knowledge of my Father.

8.msb: Jesus spoke these words while teaching in the temple courts, near the treasury. Yet no one seized Him, because His hour had not yet come.
8.kjv: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
8.blb: He spoke these words in the treasury, teaching in the temple; and no one seized Him, because His hour had not yet come.
8.bbe: Jesus said these words in the place where the offerings were stored, while he was teaching in the Temple: but no man took him because his time was still to come.

8.msb: Again Jesus said to them, “I am going away, and you will look for Me, but you will die in your sin. Where I am going, you cannot come.”
8.kjv: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
8.blb: Therefore He said to them again, “I am going away, and you will seek Me, and you will die in your sin. Where I am going, you are not able to come.”
8.bbe: Then he said to them again, I am going away and you will be looking for me, but death will overtake you in your sins. It is not possible for you to come where I am going.

8.msb: So the Jews began to ask, “Will He kill Himself, since He says, ‘Where I am going, you cannot come’?”
8.kjv: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
8.blb: Therefore the Jews were saying, “Will He kill Himself, that He says, ‘Where I am going, you are not able to come’?”
8.bbe: So the Jews said, Will he take his life? Is that why he says, Where I go it is not possible for you to come?

8.msb: Then He told them, “You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.
8.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
8.blb: And He was saying to them, “You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.
8.bbe: And he said to them, You are of the earth; I am from heaven: you are of this world; I am not of this world.

8.msb: That is why I told you that you would die in your sins. For unless you believe that I am He, you will die in your sins.”
8.kjv: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
8.blb: Therefore I said to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am He, you will die in your sins.”
8.bbe: For this reason I said to you that death will overtake you in your sins: for if you have not faith that I am he, death will come to you while you are in your sins.

8.msb: “Who are You?” they asked. “Just what I have been telling you from the beginning,” Jesus replied.
8.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
8.blb: Therefore they were saying to Him, “Who are You?” Jesus said to them, “Even what I said to you from the beginning.
8.bbe: Then they said to him, Who are you? Jesus said, What I said to you from the first.

8.msb: “I have much to say about you and much to judge. But the One who sent Me is truthful, and what I have heard from Him, I tell the world.”
8.kjv: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
8.blb: I have many things to say and to judge concerning you. But the One having sent Me is true; and I, what I heard from Him, these things I say to the world.”
8.bbe: I have much to say about you and against you: but he who sent me is true and what he has said to me I say to the world.

8.msb: They did not understand that He was telling them about the Father.
8.kjv: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
8.blb: They did not know that He was speaking to them about the Father.
8.bbe: They did not see that his words were about the Father.

8.msb: So Jesus said, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am He, and that I do nothing on My own, but speak exactly what My Father has taught Me.
8.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
8.blb: Therefore Jesus said to them, “When you shall have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am He, and I do nothing from Myself; but just as the Father taught Me, these things I speak.
8.bbe: So Jesus said, When the Son of man has been lifted up by you, then it will be clear to you who I am, and that I do nothing of myself, but say as the Father gave me teaching.

8.msb: He who sent Me is with Me. The Father has not left Me alone, because I always do what pleases Him.”
8.kjv: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
8.blb: And the One having sent Me is with Me. He did not leave Me alone, because I always do the things pleasing to Him.”
8.bbe: He who sent me is with me; he has not gone from me, because at all times I do the things which are pleasing to him.

8.msb: As Jesus spoke these things, many believed in Him.
8.kjv: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
8.blb: of His speaking these things, many believed in Him.
8.bbe: When he said this a number came to have faith in him.
8.heading: The Truth Will Set You Free

8.msb: So He said to the Jews who had believed Him, “If you continue in My word, you are truly My disciples.
8.kjv: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;
8.blb: Therefore Jesus was saying to the Jews having believed in Him, “If you shall remain in My word, truly you are My disciples.
8.bbe: Then Jesus said to the Jews who had faith in him, If you keep my word, then you are truly my disciples;

8.msb: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
8.kjv: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
8.blb: And you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
8.bbe: And you will have knowledge of what is true, and that will make you free.

8.msb: “We are Abraham’s descendants,” they answered. “We have never been slaves to anyone. How can You say we will be set free?”
8.kjv: They answered him, We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
8.blb: They responded to Him, “We are seed of Abraham, and to no one ever have we been slaves. How do You say, ‘You will become free’?”
8.bbe: They said to him in answer, We are Abraham's seed and have never been any man's servant: why do you say, You will become free?

8.msb: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.
8.kjv: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
8.blb: Jesus answered them, “Truly, truly, I say to you that everyone who is doing sin is a slave of sin.
8.bbe: And this was the answer Jesus gave them: Truly I say to you, Everyone who does evil is the servant of sin.

8.msb: A slave does not remain in the house forever, but a son remains forever.
8.kjv: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
8.blb: Now the slave does not remain in the house to the age; the son remains to the age.
8.bbe: Now the servant does not go on living in the house for ever, but the son does.

8.msb: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
8.kjv: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
8.blb: Therefore if the Son shall set you free, you will be really free.
8.bbe: If then the son makes you free, you will be truly free.

8.msb: I know you are Abraham’s descendants, but you are trying to kill Me because My word has no place within you.
8.kjv: I know that ye are Abraham’s seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
8.blb: I know that you are seed of Abraham, but you seek to kill Me because My word has no place in you.
8.bbe: I am conscious that you are Abraham's seed; but you have a desire to put me to death because my word has no place in you.

8.msb: I speak of what I have seen in the presence of My Father, and you do what you have seen from your father.”
8.kjv: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.
8.blb: I speak the things I have seen with the Father; and you, therefore, the things you have heard with your father, you do.”
8.bbe: I say the things which I have seen in my Father's house: and you do the things which come to you from your father's house.

8.msb: “Abraham is our father,” they replied. “If you were children of Abraham,” said Jesus, “you would do the works of Abraham.
8.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
8.blb: They answered and said to Him, “Abraham is our father.” Jesus says to them, “If you were children of Abraham, you would do the works of Abraham.
8.bbe: In answer they said to him, Our father is Abraham. Jesus said to them, If you were Abraham's children you would do what Abraham did.

8.msb: But now you are trying to kill Me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham never did such a thing.
8.kjv: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.
8.blb: But now you seek to kill Me, a man who has spoken to you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham did not do this.
8.bbe: But now you have a desire to put me to death, a man who has said to you what is true, as I had it from God: Abraham did not do that.

8.msb: You are doing the works of your father.” “We are not illegitimate children,” they declared. “Our only Father is God Himself.”
8.kjv: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
8.blb: You are doing the works of your father.” Therefore they said to Him, “We have not been born of sexual immorality. We have one Father—God.”
8.bbe: You are doing the works of your father. They said to him, We are true sons of Abraham; we have one Father, who is God.

8.msb: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I have come here from God. I have not come on My own, but He sent Me.
8.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
8.blb: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I came forth from God and am here; for neither have I come of Myself, but He sent Me.
8.bbe: Jesus said to them, If God was your Father you would have love for me, because it was from God I came and am here. I did not come of myself, but he sent me.

8.msb: Why do you not understand what I am saying? It is because you are unable to accept My message.
8.kjv: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
8.blb: Why do you not know My speech? Because you are not able to hear My word.
8.bbe: Why are my words not clear to you? It is because your ears are shut to my teaching.

8.msb: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out his desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, refusing to stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, because he is a liar and the father of lies.
8.kjv: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
8.blb: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and he has not stood in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he may speak falsehood, he speaks from his own, because he is a liar and the father of it.
8.bbe: You are the children of your father the Evil One and it is your pleasure to do his desires. From the first he was a taker of life; and he did not go in the true way because there is no true thing in him. When he says what is false, it is natural to him, for he is false and the father of what is false.

8.msb: But because I speak the truth, you do not believe Me!
8.kjv: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
8.blb: But because I speak the truth, you do not believe Me!
8.bbe: But because I say what is true, you have no belief in me.

8.msb: Which of you can prove Me guilty of sin? If I speak the truth, why do you not believe Me?
8.kjv: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
8.blb: Which of you convicts Me concerning sin? If I speak the truth, why do you not believe Me?
8.bbe: Which of you is able truly to say that I am a sinner? If I say what is true, why have you no belief in me?

8.msb: Whoever belongs to God hears the words of God. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.”
8.kjv: He that is of God heareth God’s words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
8.blb: The one being of God hears the words of God; because of this you do not hear, because you are not of God.”
8.bbe: He who is a child of God gives ear to the words of God: your ears are not open to them because you are not from God.

8.msb: The Jews answered Him, “Are we not right to say that You are a Samaritan and You have a demon?”
8.kjv: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
8.blb: The Jews answered and said to Him, “Do we not rightly say that You are a Samaritan and You have a demon?”
8.bbe: The Jews said to him in answer, Are we not right in saying that you are of Samaria and have an evil spirit?
8.heading: Before Abraham Was Born, I Am

8.msb: “I do not have a demon,” Jesus replied, “but I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.
8.kjv: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
8.blb: Jesus answered, “I do not have a demon, but I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.
8.bbe: And this was the answer of Jesus: I have not an evil spirit; but I give honour to my Father and you do not give honour to me.

8.msb: I do not seek My own glory. There is One who seeks it, and He is the Judge.
8.kjv: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
8.blb: And I do not seek My glory; there is One seeking it and judging.
8.bbe: I, however, am not in search of glory for myself: there is One who is searching for it and he is judge.

8.msb: Truly, truly, I tell you, if anyone keeps My word, he will never see death.”
8.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
8.blb: Truly, truly, I say to you, if anyone shall keep My word, he shall never see death, to the age.”
8.bbe: Truly I say to you, If a man keeps my word he will never see death.

8.msb: “Now we know that You have a demon!” declared the Jews. “Abraham died, and so did the prophets, yet You say that anyone who keeps Your word will never taste death.
8.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
8.blb: Therefore the Jews said to Him, “Now we have known that You have a demon! Abraham died, and the prophets, and You say, ‘If anyone shall keep My word, he shall never taste of death, to the age.’
8.bbe: The Jews said to him, Now we are certain that you have an evil spirit. Abraham is dead, and the prophets are dead; and you say, If a man keeps my word he will never see death.

8.msb: Are You greater than our father Abraham? He died, as did the prophets. Who do You claim to be?”
8.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
8.blb: Are You greater than our father Abraham, who died? And the prophets died! Whom do You make Yourself?”
8.bbe: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who is dead? and the prophets are dead: who do you say that you are?

8.msb: Jesus answered, “If I glorify Myself, My glory means nothing. The One who glorifies Me is My Father, of whom you say ‘He is our God.’
8.kjv: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:
8.blb: Jesus answered, “If I glorify Myself, My glory is nothing; My Father is the One glorifying Me, of whom you say, ‘He is our God.’
8.bbe: Jesus said in answer, If I take glory for myself, my glory is nothing: it is my Father who gives me glory, of whom you say that he is your God.

8.msb: You do not know Him, but I know Him. If I said I did not know Him, I would be a liar like you. But I do know Him, and I keep His word.
8.kjv: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
8.blb: And you have not known Him, but I know Him. And if I say that I do not know Him, I will be a liar like you. But I know Him, and I keep His word.
8.bbe: You have no knowledge of him, but I have knowledge of him; and if I said I have no knowledge of him I would be talking falsely like you: but I have full knowledge of him, and I keep his word.

8.msb: Your father Abraham rejoiced that he would see My day. He saw it and was glad.”
8.kjv: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
8.blb: Abraham your father exulted that he should see My day, and he saw and rejoiced.”
8.bbe: Your father Abraham was full of joy at the hope of seeing my day: he saw it and was glad.

8.msb: Then the Jews said to Him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and You have seen Abraham?”
8.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
8.blb: Therefore the Jews said to Him, “Not yet do You have fifty years, and You have seen Abraham?”
8.bbe: Then the Jews said to him, You are not fifty years old; have you seen Abraham?

8.msb: “Truly, truly, I tell you,” Jesus declared, “before Abraham was born, I am!”
8.kjv: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
8.blb: Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, before Abraham came into being, I am!”
8.bbe: Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you, Before Abraham came into being, I am.

8.msb: At this, they picked up stones to throw at Him. But Jesus was hidden and went out of the temple area, going through the midst of them. And so He passed by.
8.kjv: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
8.blb: Therefore they took up stones so that they might cast them at Him; but Jesus hid Himself and went forth out of the temple.
8.bbe: So they took up stones to send at him: but Jesus got secretly out of their way and went out of the Temple.

9.msb: Now as Jesus was passing by, He saw a man blind from birth,
9.kjv: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
9.blb: And passing by, He saw a man blind from birth.
9.bbe: And when he went on his way, he saw a man blind from birth.
9.heading: Jesus Heals the Man Born Blind

9.msb: and His disciples asked Him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
9.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
9.blb: And His disciples asked Him, saying, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he should be born blind?”
9.bbe: And his disciples put a question to him, saying, Master, was it because of this man's sin, or the sin of his father and mother, that he has been blind from birth?

9.msb: Jesus answered, “Neither this man nor his parents sinned, but this happened so that the works of God would be displayed in him.
9.kjv: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
9.blb: Jesus answered, “Neither this man sinned, nor his parents; but it was so that the works of God should be displayed in him.
9.bbe: Jesus said in answer, It was not because of his sin, or because of his father's or mother's; it was so that the works of God might be seen openly in him.

9.msb: While it is daytime, I must do the works of Him who sent Me. Night is coming, when no one can work.
9.kjv: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
9.blb: It is necessary for us to work the works of the One having sent Me while it is day; night is coming, when no one is able to work.
9.bbe: While it is day we have to do the works of him who sent me: the night comes when no work may be done.

9.msb: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
9.kjv: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
9.blb: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
9.bbe: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

9.msb: When Jesus had said this, He spit on the ground, made some mud, and applied it to the eyes of the blind man.
9.kjv: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
9.blb: Having said these things, He spit on the ground and made clay of the spittle, and He applied the clay to his eyes.
9.bbe: Having said these words, he put earth, mixed with water from his mouth, on the man's eyes,

9.msb: Then He told him, “Go, wash in the Pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So the man went and washed, and came back seeing.
9.kjv: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
9.blb: And He said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). Therefore he went away and washed and came back seeing.
9.bbe: And said to him, Go and make yourself clean in the bath of Siloam (the sense of the name is, Sent). So he went away and, after washing, came back able to see.

9.msb: At this, his neighbors and those who had formerly seen him blind began to ask, “Isn’t this the man who used to sit and beg?”
9.kjv: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
9.blb: Therefore the neighbors and those seeing him before, that he was a beggar, were saying, “Is this not the one sitting and begging?”
9.bbe: Then the neighbours and others who had seen him before in the street, with his hand out for money, said, Is not this the man who got money from people?

9.msb: Some claimed that he was, but others said, “He just looks like him.” But the man kept saying, “I am the one.”
9.kjv: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
9.blb: Others were saying, “This is he.” Others were saying, “No, but he is like him.” He was saying, “I am he.”
9.bbe: Some said, It is he: others said, No, but he is like him. He said, I am he.

9.msb: “How were your eyes opened?” they asked.
9.kjv: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
9.blb: Therefore they were saying to him, “How then were your eyes opened?”
9.bbe: So they said to him, How then were your eyes made open?

9.msb: He answered, “The man they call Jesus made some mud and anointed my eyes, and He told me to go to the Pool of Siloam and wash. So I went and washed and received my sight.”
9.kjv: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
9.blb: He answered, “The man called Jesus made clay and anointed my eyes, and He said to me, ‘Go to Siloam and wash.’ Therefore, having gone away and having washed, I received sight.”
9.bbe: His answer was: The man who is named Jesus put earth mixed with water on my eyes, and said to me, Go and make yourself clean in Siloam: so I went away and, after washing, am now able to see.

9.msb: “Where is He?” they asked. “I do not know,” he answered.
9.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
9.blb: And they said to him, “Where is He?” He says, “I do not know.”
9.bbe: And they said to him, Where is he? His answer was: I have no knowledge.

9.msb: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.
9.kjv: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
9.blb: They bring him who once was blind to the Pharisees.
9.bbe: They took him before the Pharisees — this man who had been blind.
9.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

9.msb: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened his eyes was a Sabbath.
9.kjv: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
9.blb: Now it was a Sabbath—the day on which Jesus made the clay and opened his eyes.
9.bbe: Now the day on which the earth was mixed by Jesus and the man's eyes were made open was the Sabbath.

9.msb: So the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. The man answered, “He put mud on my eyes, and I washed, and now I can see.”
9.kjv: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
9.blb: Again, therefore, the Pharisees also were asking him how he received sight. And he said to them, “He put clay on my eyes, and I washed, and I see.”
9.bbe: So the Pharisees put more questions to him about how his eyes had been made open. And he said to them, He put earth on my eyes, and I had a wash and am able to see.

9.msb: Because of this, some of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, for He does not keep the Sabbath.” But others said, “How can a sinful man perform such signs?” And there was division among them.
9.kjv: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
9.blb: Therefore some of the Pharisees were saying, “This man is not from God, because He does not keep the Sabbath.” But others were saying, “How is a man, a sinner, able to do such signs?” And there was division among them.
9.bbe: Then some of the Pharisees said, That man has not come from God, for he does not keep the Sabbath. Others said, How is it possible for a sinner to do such signs? So there was a division among them.

9.msb: So once again they asked the man who had been blind, “What do you say about Him, since it was your eyes He opened?” “He is a prophet,” the man replied.
9.kjv: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
9.blb: Therefore they say to the blind man again, “What do you say about Him, since He opened your eyes?” And he said, “He is a prophet.”
9.bbe: Again they said to the blind man, What have you to say about him for opening your eyes? And he said, He is a prophet.

9.msb: The Jews still did not believe that the man had been blind and had received his sight until they summoned his parents
9.kjv: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
9.blb: Therefore the Jews did not believe concerning him that he was blind and received sight, until they called the parents of him having received sight
9.bbe: Now the Jews had no belief in the statement that he had been blind and was now able to see, till they sent for the father and mother of the man whose eyes had been made open,

9.msb: and asked, “Is this your son, the one you say was born blind? So how is it that he can now see?”
9.kjv: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
9.blb: and asked them, saying, “Is this your son, of whom you say that he was born blind? Then how does he now see?”
9.bbe: And put the question to them, saying, Is this your son, of whom you say that he was blind at birth? how is it then that he is now able to see?

9.msb: His parents answered, “We know he is our son, and we know he was born blind.
9.kjv: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
9.blb: Therefore his parents answered and said, “We know that this is our son and that he was born blind.
9.bbe: In answer his father and mother said, We are certain that this is our son and that he was blind at birth:

9.msb: But how he can now see or who opened his eyes, we do not know. He is of age. Ask him. He can speak for himself.”
9.kjv: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
9.blb: But how he sees now, we do not know; or who opened his eyes, we do not know. Ask him. He has age. He will speak concerning himself.”
9.bbe: But how it is he is now able to see, or who made his eyes open, we are not able to say: put the question to him; he is old enough to give an answer for himself.

9.msb: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews. For the Jews had already determined that anyone who confessed Jesus as the Christ would be put out of the synagogue.
9.kjv: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
9.blb: His parents said these things because they were afraid of the Jews. For the Jews already had agreed together that if anyone should confess Him as Christ, he would be expelled from the synagogue.
9.bbe: They said this because of their fear of the Jews: for the Jews had come to an agreement that if any man said that Jesus was the Christ he would be put out of the Synagogue.

9.msb: That was why his parents said, “He is old enough. Ask him.”
9.kjv: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
9.blb: Because of this, his parents said, “He has age. Ask him.”
9.bbe: That was the reason why they said, He is old enough; put the question to him.

9.msb: So a second time they called for the man who had been blind and said, “Give glory to God! We know that this man is a sinner.”
9.kjv: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
9.blb: Therefore they called out a second time the man who was blind, and they said to him, “Give glory to God! We know that this man is a sinner.”
9.bbe: So they sent a second time for the man who had been blind and they said to him, Give glory to God: it is clear to us that this man is a sinner.

9.msb: He answered, “Whether He is a sinner I do not know. There is one thing I do know: I was blind, but now I see!”
9.kjv: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
9.blb: Therefore he answered, “Whether He is a sinner I do not know. One thing I know, that being blind, now I see!”
9.bbe: He said in answer, I have no knowledge if he is a sinner or not, but one thing I am certain about; I was blind, and now I see.

9.msb: “What did He do to you?” they asked again. “How did He open your eyes?”
9.kjv: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
9.blb: Therefore they said to him, “What did He do to you? How did He open your eyes?”
9.bbe: Then they said to him, What did he do to you? how did he give you the use of your eyes?

9.msb: He replied, “I already told you, and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you also want to become His disciples?”
9.kjv: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?
9.blb: He answered them, “I told you already, and you did not hear. Why do you want to hear again? Do you also want to become His disciples?”
9.bbe: His answer was: I have said it before, but your ears were shut: why would you have me say it again? is it your desire to become his disciples?

9.msb: Then they heaped insults on him and said, “You are His disciple; we are disciples of Moses.
9.kjv: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses’ disciples.
9.blb: And they reviled him and said, “You are a disciple of that One, but we are disciples of Moses.
9.bbe: And they were angry with him and said, You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

9.msb: We know that God spoke to Moses, but we do not know where this man is from.”
9.kjv: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.
9.blb: We know that God has spoken to Moses, but we do not know from where this man is.”
9.bbe: We are certain that God gave his word to Moses: but as for this man, we have no knowledge where he comes from.

9.msb: “That is remarkable indeed!” the man said. “You do not know where He is from, and yet He opened my eyes.
9.kjv: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.
9.blb: The man answered and said to them, “In this, indeed, is an amazing thing, that you do not know from where He is, and yet He opened my eyes.
9.bbe: The man said in answer, Why, here is a strange thing! You have no knowledge where he comes from though he gave me the use of my eyes.

9.msb: We know that God does not listen to sinners, but He does listen to the one who worships Him and does His will.
9.kjv: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.
9.blb: We know that God does not hear sinners, but if anyone may be God-fearing and may do His will, He hears him.
9.bbe: We have knowledge that God does not give ear to sinners, but if any man is a worshipper of God and does his pleasure, to him God's ears are open.

9.msb: Never before has anyone heard of opening the eyes of a man born blind.
9.kjv: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.
9.blb: From the age it was not heard that anyone opened the eyes of one having been born blind.
9.bbe: In all the years nobody has ever before seen the eyes of a man blind from birth made open.

9.msb: If this man were not from God, He could do no such thing.”
9.kjv: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.
9.blb: If this man were not from God, He would be able to do nothing.”
9.bbe: If this man did not come from God he would be unable to do anything.

9.msb: They replied, “You were born in utter sin, and you are instructing us?” And they threw him out.
9.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.
9.blb: They answered and said to him, “You were born entirely in sins, and do you teach us?” And they cast him out.
9.bbe: Their answer was: You came to birth through sin; do you make yourself our teacher? And they put him out of the Synagogue.

9.msb: When Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, He found the man and said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”
9.kjv: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
9.blb: Jesus heard that they cast him out, and having found him, He said, “Do you believe in the Son of Man?”
9.bbe: It came to the ears of Jesus that they had put him out, and meeting him he said, Have you faith in the Son of man?
9.heading: Spiritual Blindness

9.msb: “Who is He, Sir?” he replied. “Tell me so that I may believe in Him.”
9.kjv: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
9.blb: He answered and said, “And who is He, Lord, that I may believe in Him?”
9.bbe: He said in answer, And who is he, Lord? Say, so that I may have faith in him.

9.msb: “You have already seen Him,” Jesus answered. “He is the One speaking with you.”
9.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.
9.blb: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen Him, and He is the One speaking with you.”
9.bbe: Jesus said to him, You have seen him; it is he who is talking to you.

9.msb: “Lord, I believe,” he said. And he worshiped Jesus.
9.kjv: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
9.blb: And he was saying, “I believe, Lord.” And he worshiped Him.
9.bbe: And he said, Lord, I have faith. And he gave him worship.

9.msb: Then Jesus declared, “For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind may see and those who see may become blind.”
9.kjv: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
9.blb: And Jesus said, “For judgment I came into this world, so that those not seeing may see and those seeing may become blind.”
9.bbe: And Jesus said, I came into this world to be a judge, so that those who do not see may see, and those who see may become blind.

9.msb: Some of the Pharisees who were with Him heard this, and they asked Him, “Are we blind too?”
9.kjv: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?
9.blb: Some of the Pharisees who were with Him heard these things, and they said to Him, “Are we also blind?”
9.bbe: These words came to the ears of the Pharisees who were with him and they said to him, Are we, then, blind?

9.msb: “If you were blind,” Jesus replied, “you would not be guilty of sin. But since you say, ‘We see,’ your guilt remains.”
9.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
9.blb: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would not have sin. But now that you say, ‘We see,’ your sin remains.”
9.bbe: Jesus said to them, If you were blind you would have no sin: but now that you say, We see; your sin is there still.

10.msb: “Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever does not enter the sheepfold by the gate, but climbs in some other way, is a thief and a robber.
10.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
10.blb: “Truly, truly, I say to you, the one not entering through the door to the fold of the sheep, but going up another way, he is a thief and a robber.
10.bbe: Truly I say to you, He who does not go through the door into the place where the sheep are kept, but gets in by some other way, is a thief and an outlaw.
10.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

10.msb: But the one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.
10.kjv: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
10.blb: But the one entering through the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
10.bbe: He who goes in by the door is the keeper of the sheep.

10.msb: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen for his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
10.kjv: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
10.blb: To this one the doorkeeper opens, and the sheep hear his voice. And he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
10.bbe: The porter lets him in; and the sheep give ear to his voice; he says over the names of the sheep, and takes them out.

10.msb: When he has brought out his own sheep, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.
10.kjv: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
10.blb: When he may bring out all his own, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him because they know his voice.
10.bbe: When he has got them all out, he goes before them, and the sheep go after him, for they have knowledge of his voice.

10.msb: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will flee from him because they do not recognize his voice.”
10.kjv: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
10.blb: But they will never follow a stranger, but will flee from him, because they do not know the voice of strangers.”
10.bbe: They will not go after another who is not their keeper, but will go from him in flight, because his voice is strange to them.

10.msb: Jesus spoke to them using this illustration, but they did not understand what He was telling them.
10.kjv: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
10.blb: Jesus spoke to them this allegory, but they did not know what it was that He was saying to them.
10.bbe: In this Jesus was teaching them in the form of a story: but what he said was not clear to them.

10.msb: So He said to them again, “Truly, truly, I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.
10.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
10.blb: Therefore Jesus again said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.
10.bbe: So Jesus said again, Truly I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.

10.msb: All who came were thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.
10.kjv: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
10.blb: All, as many as came before Me, are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not hear them.
10.bbe: All who came before me are thieves and outlaws: but the sheep did not give ear to them.

10.msb: I am the gate. If anyone enters through Me, he will be saved. He will come in and go out and find pasture.
10.kjv: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
10.blb: I am the door. If anyone may enter through Me, he will be saved, and he will come in and will go out and will find pasture.
10.bbe: I am the door: if any man goes in through me he will have salvation, and will go in and go out, and will get food.

10.msb: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I have come that they may have life, and have it in all its fullness.
10.kjv: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
10.blb: The thief does not come except so that he might steal and might kill and might destroy. I came so that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
10.bbe: The thief comes only to take the sheep and to put them to death: he comes for their destruction: I have come so that they may have life and have it in greater measure.

10.msb: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.
10.kjv: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
10.blb: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.
10.bbe: I am the good keeper of sheep: the good keeper gives his life for the sheep.

10.msb: The hired hand is not the shepherd, and the sheep are not his own. When he sees the wolf coming, he abandons the sheep and runs away. Then the wolf pounces on them and scatters the flock.
10.kjv: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.
10.blb: But the hired servant, not being the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, sees the wolf coming and leaves the sheep and flees—and the wolf snatches them and scatters them—
10.bbe: He who is a servant, and not the keeper or the owner of the sheep, sees the wolf coming and goes in flight, away from the sheep; and the wolf comes down on them and sends them in all directions:

10.msb: The man runs away because he is a hired servant and is unconcerned for the sheep.
10.kjv: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
10.blb: because he is a hired servant and is not himself caring about the sheep.
10.bbe: Because he is a servant he has no interest in the sheep.

10.msb: I am the good shepherd. I know My sheep and My sheep know Me,
10.kjv: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.
10.blb: I am the good shepherd, and I know My own, and My own know Me—
10.bbe: I am the good keeper; I have knowledge of my sheep, and they have knowledge of me,

10.msb: just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father. And I lay down My life for the sheep.
10.kjv: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.
10.blb: just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father—and I lay down My life for the sheep.
10.bbe: Even as the Father has knowledge of me and I of the Father; and I am giving my life for the sheep.

10.msb: I have other sheep that are not of this fold. I must bring them in as well, and they will listen to My voice. Then there will be one flock and one shepherd.
10.kjv: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.
10.blb: And I have other sheep that are not of this fold. It is necessary for Me to bring those also, and they will hear My voice, and there will be one flock and one shepherd.
10.bbe: And I have other sheep which are not of this field: I will be their guide in the same way, and they will give ear to my voice, so there will be one flock and one keeper.

10.msb: The reason My Father loves Me is that I lay down My life in order to take it up again.
10.kjv: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.
10.blb: Because of this, the Father loves Me, because I lay down My life so that I might take it again.
10.bbe: For this reason am I loved by the Father, because I give up my life so that I may take it again.

10.msb: No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down of My own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This charge I have received from My Father.”
10.kjv: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
10.blb: No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down of Myself. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it again. This commandment I received from My Father.”
10.bbe: No one takes it away from me; I give it up of myself. I have power to give it up, and I have power to take it again. These orders I have from my Father.

10.msb: Therefore there was again division among the Jews because of Jesus’ message.
10.kjv: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.
10.blb: Again there was division among the Jews because of these words.
10.bbe: There was a division again among the Jews because of these words.

10.msb: Many of them said, “He is demon-possessed and insane. Why would you listen to Him?”
10.kjv: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?
10.blb: And many of them were saying, “He has a demon and is insane. Why do you listen to Him?”
10.bbe: And a number of them said, He has an evil spirit and is out of his mind; why do you give ear to him?

10.msb: But others replied, “These are not the words of a man possessed by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?”
10.kjv: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
10.blb: Others were saying, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. Is a demon able to open the eyes of the blind?”
10.bbe: Others said, These are not the words of one who has an evil spirit. Is it possible for an evil spirit to make blind people see?

10.msb: At that time the Feast of Dedication took place in Jerusalem. It was winter,
10.kjv: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
10.blb: Then the Feast of Dedication took place at Jerusalem. It was winter,
10.bbe: Then came the feast of the opening of the Temple in Jerusalem: it was winter;
10.heading: Jesus at the Feast of Dedication

10.msb: and Jesus was walking in the temple courts in Solomon’s Colonnade.
10.kjv: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon’s porch.
10.blb: and Jesus was walking in the temple, in the porch of Solomon.
10.bbe: And Jesus was walking in the Temple, in Solomon's covered way.

10.msb: So the Jews gathered around Him and demanded, “How long will You keep us in suspense? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
10.kjv: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.
10.blb: Therefore the Jews encircled Him and were saying to Him, “Until when do You hold our soul in suspense? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
10.bbe: Then the Jews came round him, saying, how long are you going to keep us in doubt? If you are the Christ, say so clearly.

10.msb: “I already told you,” Jesus replied, “but you did not believe. The works I do in My Father’s name testify on My behalf.
10.kjv: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father’s name, they bear witness of me.
10.blb: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you do not believe. The works that I do in the name of My Father, these testify about Me.
10.bbe: Jesus said in answer, I have said it and you have no belief: the works which I do in my Father's name, these give witness about me.

10.msb: But because you are not My sheep, you refuse to believe, just as I said to you.
10.kjv: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
10.blb: But you do not believe, because you are not of My sheep.
10.bbe: But you have no belief because you are not of my sheep.

10.msb: My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.
10.kjv: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
10.blb: My sheep hear My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me.
10.bbe: My sheep give ear to my voice, and I have knowledge of them, and they come after me:

10.msb: I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.
10.kjv: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
10.blb: And I give them eternal life, and never shall they perish to the age, and no one will snatch them out of My hand.
10.bbe: And I give them eternal life; they will never come to destruction, and no one will ever take them out of my hand.

10.msb: My Father who has given them to Me is greater than all. No one can snatch them out of My Father’s hand.
10.kjv: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.
10.blb: My Father, who has given them to Me, is greater than all, and no one is able to snatch them out of the hand of the Father.
10.bbe: That which my Father has given to me has more value than all; and no one is able to take anything out of the Father's hand.

10.msb: I and the Father are one.”
10.kjv: I and my Father are one.
10.blb: I and the Father are one.”
10.bbe: I and my Father are one.

10.msb: At this, the Jews again picked up stones to stone Him.
10.kjv: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
10.blb: Therefore the Jews took up stones again so that they might stone Him.
10.bbe: Then the Jews took up stones again to send at him.

10.msb: But Jesus responded, “I have shown you many good works from My Father. For which of these do you stone Me?”
10.kjv: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
10.blb: Jesus answered them, “I showed you many good works from the Father; because of which work of them do you stone Me?”
10.bbe: Jesus said to them in answer, I have let you see a number of good works from the Father; for which of those works are you stoning me?

10.msb: “We are not stoning You for any good work,” said the Jews, “but for blasphemy, because You, who are a man, declare Yourself to be God.”
10.kjv: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
10.blb: The Jews answered Him, “We do not stone You concerning a good work, but concerning blasphemy, and because You, being a man, make Yourself God.”
10.bbe: This was their answer: We are not stoning you for a good work but for evil words; because being a man you make yourself God.

10.msb: Jesus replied, “Is it not written in your Law: ‘I have said you are gods’?
10.kjv: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?
10.blb: Jesus answered them, “Is it not written in your Law: ‘I said you are gods’?
10.bbe: In answer, Jesus said, Is there not a saying in your law, I said, You are gods?

10.msb: If he called them gods to whom the word of God came—and the Scripture cannot be broken—
10.kjv: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;
10.blb: If he called them gods to whom the word of God came—and the Scripture is not able to be broken—
10.bbe: If he said they were gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Writings may not be broken),

10.msb: then what about the One whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world? How then can you accuse Me of blasphemy for stating that I am the Son of God?
10.kjv: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?
10.blb: do you say of Him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?
10.bbe: Do you say of him whom the Father made holy and sent into the world, Your words are evil; because I said, I am God's Son?

10.msb: If I am not doing the works of My Father, then do not believe Me.
10.kjv: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
10.blb: If I do not do the works of My Father, do not believe Me.
10.bbe: If I am not doing the works of my Father, do not have belief in me;

10.msb: But if I am doing them, even though you do not believe Me, believe the works themselves, so that you may know and believe that the Father is in Me, and I am in Him.”
10.kjv: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.
10.blb: But if I do, even if you do not believe Me, believe the works, so that you may know and may understand that the Father is in Me and I in the Father.”
10.bbe: But if I am doing them, then have belief in the works even if you have no belief in me; so that you may see clearly and be certain that the Father is in me and I am in the Father.

10.msb: At this, they tried again to seize Him, but He escaped their grasp.
10.kjv: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
10.blb: Therefore they were seeking again to seize Him, but He went forth out of their hand.
10.bbe: Then again they made an attempt to take him; but he got away from them.

10.msb: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had first been baptizing, and He stayed there.
10.kjv: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
10.blb: And He went away again beyond the Jordan to the place where John was baptizing at first, and He remained there.
10.bbe: And he went again to the other side of the Jordan, to the place where John first gave baptism; and he was there for a time.
10.heading: John’s Testimony Confirmed

10.msb: Many came to Him and said, “Although John never performed a sign, everything he said about this man was true.”
10.kjv: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
10.blb: And many came to Him and were saying, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man was true.”
10.bbe: And a great number of people came to him, saying, John did no sign: but everything John said of this man was true.

10.msb: And many in that place believed in Jesus.
10.kjv: And many believed on him there.
10.blb: And many believed in Him there.
10.bbe: And a number came to have faith in him there.

11.msb: At this time a man named Lazarus was sick. He lived in Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
11.kjv: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
11.blb: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
11.bbe: Now a certain man named Lazarus was ill; he was of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
11.heading: The Death of Lazarus

11.msb: (Mary, whose brother Lazarus was sick, was to anoint the Lord with perfume and wipe His feet with her hair.)
11.kjv: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
11.blb: And Mary was the one having anointed the Lord with fragrant oil and having wiped His feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.
11.bbe: (The Mary whose brother Lazarus was ill, was the Mary who put perfumed oil on the Lord and made his feet dry with her hair.)

11.msb: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, “Lord, the one You love is sick.”
11.kjv: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
11.blb: Therefore the sisters sent to Him, saying, “Lord, behold, the one whom You love is sick.”
11.bbe: So the sisters sent to him, saying, Lord, your dear friend is ill.

11.msb: When Jesus heard this, He said, “This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.”
11.kjv: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
11.blb: And having heard, Jesus said, “This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.”
11.bbe: When this came to his ears, Jesus said, The end of this disease is not death, but the glory of God, so that the Son of God may have glory because of it.

11.msb: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
11.kjv: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
11.blb: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
11.bbe: Now Jesus had love in his heart for Martha and her sister and Lazarus.

11.msb: So on hearing that Lazarus was sick, He stayed where He was for two days,
11.kjv: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
11.blb: Therefore when He heard that he is sick, then indeed He remained in the place in which He was two days.
11.bbe: So when the news came to him that Lazarus was ill, he did not go from the place where he was for two days.

11.msb: and then He said to the disciples, “Let us go back to Judea.”
11.kjv: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judæa again.
11.blb: Then after this, He says to the disciples, “Let us go into Judea again.”
11.bbe: Then after that time he said to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.

11.msb: “Rabbi,” they replied, “the Jews just tried to stone You, and You are going back there?”
11.kjv: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
11.blb: The disciples say to Him, “Rabbi, just now the Jews were seeking to stone You, and again You are going there?”
11.bbe: The disciples said to him, Master, the Jews were attempting only the other day to have you stoned, and are you going back there again?

11.msb: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours of daylight? If anyone walks in the daytime, he will not stumble, because he sees by the light of this world.
11.kjv: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
11.blb: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours of the day? If anyone may walk in the day, he does not stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
11.bbe: Then Jesus said in answer, Are there not twelve hours in the day? A man may go about in the day without falling, because he sees the light of this world.

11.msb: But if anyone walks at night, he will stumble, because he has no light.”
11.kjv: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
11.blb: But if anyone may walk in the night, he stumbles, because the light is not in him.”
11.bbe: But if a man goes about in the night, he may have a fall because the light is not in him.

11.msb: After He had said this, He told them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going there to wake him up.”
11.kjv: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
11.blb: He said these things, and after this He says to them, “Lazarus our friend has fallen asleep, but I go so that I may awaken him.”
11.bbe: These things said he: and after that he said to them, Lazarus our friend is at rest; but I go so that I may make him come out of his sleep.

11.msb: His disciples replied, “Lord, if he is sleeping, he will get better.”
11.kjv: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
11.blb: Therefore the disciples said to Him, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will be saved.”
11.bbe: Then his disciples said to him, Lord, if he is resting he will get well.

11.msb: They thought that Jesus was talking about actual sleep, but He was speaking about the death of Lazarus.
11.kjv: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
11.blb: Now Jesus had spoken about his death; but they thought that He speaks about the rest of sleep.
11.bbe: Jesus, however, was talking of his death: but they had the idea that he was talking about taking rest in sleep.

11.msb: So Jesus told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead,
11.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
11.blb: So then Jesus said to them plainly, “Lazarus has died,
11.bbe: Then Jesus said to them clearly, Lazarus is dead.

11.msb: and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him.”
11.kjv: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
11.blb: and I rejoice for your sake (so that you might believe) that I was not there. But let us go to him.”
11.bbe: And because of you I am glad I was not there, so that you may have faith; but let us go to him.

11.msb: Then Thomas called Didymus said to his fellow disciples, “Let us also go, so that we may die with Him.”
11.kjv: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
11.blb: Therefore Thomas called Didymus said to his fellow disciples, “Let us also go, so that we may die with Him.”
11.bbe: Then Thomas, who was named Didymus, said to the other disciples, Let us go so that we may be with him in death.

11.msb: When Jesus arrived, He found that Lazarus had already spent four days in the tomb.
11.kjv: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.
11.blb: Therefore, having come, Jesus found him already having been four days in the tomb.
11.bbe: Now when Jesus came, he made the discovery that Lazarus had been put into the earth four days before.
11.heading: Jesus Comforts Martha and Mary

11.msb: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, a little less than two miles away,
11.kjv: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
11.blb: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.
11.bbe: Now Bethany was near to Jerusalem, about two miles away;

11.msb: and many of the Jews had come to the women around Martha and Mary to console them in the loss of their brother.
11.kjv: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
11.blb: And many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary, so that they might console them concerning their brother.
11.bbe: And a number of Jews had come to Martha and Mary to give them comfort about their brother.

11.msb: So when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet Him, but Mary stayed at home.
11.kjv: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
11.blb: Therefore Martha, when she heard that Jesus is coming, met Him; but Mary was sitting in the house.
11.bbe: When Martha had the news that Jesus was on the way, she went out to him, but Mary did not go from the house.

11.msb: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.
11.kjv: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
11.blb: Then Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.
11.bbe: Then Martha said to Jesus, Lord, if you had been here my brother would not be dead.

11.msb: But even now I know that God will give You whatever You ask of Him.”
11.kjv: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.
11.blb: But even now I know that whatever You might ask God, God will give You.”
11.bbe: But I am certain that, even now, whatever request you make to God, God will give it to you.

11.msb: “Your brother will rise again,” Jesus told her.
11.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
11.blb: Jesus says to her, “Your brother will rise again.”
11.bbe: Jesus said to her, Your brother will come to life again.

11.msb: Martha replied, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
11.kjv: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
11.blb: Martha says to Him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection in the last day.”
11.bbe: Martha said to him, I am certain that he will come to life again when all come back from the dead at the last day.

11.msb: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.
11.kjv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
11.blb: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life; the one believing in Me, even if he may die, he will live.
11.bbe: Jesus said to her, I am myself that day and that life; he who has faith in me will have life even if he is dead;

11.msb: And everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die. Do you believe this?”
11.kjv: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
11.blb: And everyone living and believing in Me shall never die, to the age. Do you believe this?”
11.bbe: And no one who is living and has faith in me will ever see death. Is this your faith?

11.msb: “Yes, Lord,” she answered, “I believe that You are the Christ, the Son of God, who was to come into the world.”
11.kjv: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.
11.blb: She says to Him, “Yes, Lord; I have believed that You are the Christ, the Son of God, the One coming into the world.”
11.bbe: She said to him, Yes, Lord: my faith is that you are the Christ, the Son of God, who was to come into the world.

11.msb: After Martha had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary aside to tell her, “The Teacher is here and is asking for you.”
11.kjv: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
11.blb: And having said these things, she went away and called her sister Mary secretly, having said, “The Teacher is come, and He calls you.”
11.bbe: And having said this, she went away and said secretly to her sister Mary, The Master is here and has sent for you.

11.msb: And when Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to Him.
11.kjv: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
11.blb: And she, as she heard, rose up quickly and was coming to Him.
11.bbe: And Mary, hearing this, got up quickly and went to him.

11.msb: Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was at the place where Martha had met Him.
