11.kjv: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
11.blb: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was still in the place where Martha met Him.
11.bbe: Now Jesus had not at this time come into the town, but was still in the place where Martha had seen him.

11.msb: When the Jews who were in the house consoling Mary saw how quickly she got up and went out, they followed her, saying that she was going to the tomb to mourn there.
11.kjv: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
11.blb: Then the Jews being with her in the house and consoling her, having seen that Mary rose up quickly and went out, followed her, having thought that she is going to the tomb so that she might weep there.
11.bbe: Then the Jews who were with her in the house, comforting her, when they saw Mary get up quickly and go out, went after her in the belief that she was going to the place of the dead and would be weeping there.

11.msb: When Mary came to Jesus and saw Him, she fell at His feet and said, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”
11.kjv: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
11.blb: Therefore Mary, as she came to where Jesus was, having seen Him, fell at His feet, saying to Him, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”
11.bbe: When Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she went down at his feet, saying, Lord, if you had been here my brother would not be dead.

11.msb: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come with her also weeping, He was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.
11.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
11.blb: Therefore Jesus, as He saw her weeping and the Jews having come with her weeping, was deeply moved in spirit and Himself troubled.
11.bbe: And when Jesus saw her weeping, and saw the Jews weeping who came with her, his spirit was moved and he was troubled,

11.msb: “Where have you put him?” He asked. “Come and see, Lord,” they answered.
11.kjv: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
11.blb: And He said, “Where have you laid him?” They say to Him, “Lord, come and see.”
11.bbe: And said, Where have you put him? They said, Come and see, Lord.

11.msb: Jesus wept.
11.kjv: Jesus wept.
11.blb: Jesus wept.
11.bbe: And Jesus himself was weeping.

11.msb: Then the Jews said, “See how He loved him!”
11.kjv: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
11.blb: Therefore the Jews were saying, “Behold how He was loving him!”
11.bbe: So the Jews said, See how dear he was to him!

11.msb: But some of them asked, “Could not this man who opened the eyes of the blind also have kept Lazarus from dying?”
11.kjv: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
11.blb: But some of them said, “Was not this man, the One having opened the eyes of the blind able to have caused also that this one should not have died?”
11.bbe: But some of them said, This man, who made open the eyes of the blind man, was he not able to keep his friend from death?

11.msb: Jesus, once again deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.
11.kjv: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
11.blb: So Jesus, being deeply moved in Himself again, comes to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone was lying upon it.
11.bbe: So Jesus, deeply troubled in heart, came to the place of the dead. It was a hole in the rock, and a stone was over the opening.
11.heading: Jesus Raises Lazarus

11.msb: “Take away the stone,” Jesus said. “Lord, by now he stinks,” said Martha, the sister of the dead man. “It has already been four days.”
11.kjv: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
11.blb: Jesus says, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of the one having died, says to Him, “Lord, already he stinks, for it is four days.”
11.bbe: Jesus said, Take away the stone. Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said, Lord, by this time the body will be smelling, for he has been dead four days.

11.msb: Jesus replied, “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?”
11.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
11.blb: Jesus says to her, “Did I not say to you that if you should believe, you will see the glory of God?”
11.bbe: Jesus said to her, Did I not say to you that if you had faith you would see the glory of God?

11.msb: So they took away the stone from where the dead man was lying. Then Jesus lifted His eyes upward and said, “Father, I thank You that You have heard Me.
11.kjv: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
11.blb: So they took away the stone. Now Jesus lifted His eyes upward and said, “Father, I thank You that You heard Me.
11.bbe: So they took away the stone. And Jesus, looking up to heaven, said, Father, I give praise to you for hearing me.

11.msb: I knew that You always hear Me, but I say this for the benefit of the people standing here, so they may believe that You sent Me.”
11.kjv: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
11.blb: And I knew that You always hear Me; but I said it because of the crowd standing around, so that they may believe that You sent Me.”
11.bbe: I was certain that your ears are at all times open to me, but I said it because of these who are here, so that they may see that you sent me.

11.msb: After Jesus had said this, He called out in a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
11.kjv: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
11.blb: And having said these things, He cried out in a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
11.bbe: Then he said in a loud voice, Lazarus, come out!

11.msb: The man who had been dead came out with his hands and feet bound in strips of linen, and his face wrapped in a cloth. “Unwrap him and let him go,” Jesus told them.
11.kjv: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
11.blb: The one having been dead came out, the feet and the hands bound with linen strips, and his face bound around in a soudario. Jesus says to them, “Unbind him and allow him to go.”
11.bbe: And he who was dead came out, with linen bands folded tightly about his hands and feet, and a cloth about his face. Jesus said to them, Make him free and let him go.

11.msb: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, believed in Him.
11.kjv: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
11.blb: Therefore many of the Jews, having come to Mary and having seen what He did, believed in Him.
11.bbe: Then a number of the Jews who had come to Mary and had seen the things which Jesus did had belief in him.
11.heading: The Plot to Kill Jesus

11.msb: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.
11.kjv: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
11.blb: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus did.
11.bbe: But some of them went to the Pharisees with the news of what Jesus had done.

11.msb: Then the chief priests and Pharisees convened the Sanhedrin and said, “What are we to do? This man is performing many signs.
11.kjv: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.
11.blb: Therefore the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered together a council, and they were saying, “What do we do? For this man does many signs.
11.bbe: Then the high priests and the Pharisees had a meeting and said, What are we doing? This man is doing a number of signs.

11.msb: If we let Him go on like this, everyone will believe in Him, and then the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”
11.kjv: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
11.blb: If we shall let Him alone like this, all will believe in Him, and the Romans will come and will take away both our place and nation.”
11.bbe: If we let him go on in this way, everybody will have belief in him and the Romans will come and take away our place and our nation.

11.msb: But one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all!
11.kjv: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
11.blb: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,
11.bbe: But one of them, Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, You have no knowledge of anything;

11.msb: You do not realize that it is better for us that one man die for the people than that the whole nation perish.”
11.kjv: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
11.blb: nor do you reckon that it is profitable for you that one man should die for the people and the whole nation should not perish.”
11.bbe: You do not see that it is in your interest for one man to be put to death for the people, so that all the nation may not come to destruction.

11.msb: Caiaphas did not say this on his own. Instead, as high priest that year, he was prophesying that Jesus would die for the nation,
11.kjv: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
11.blb: Now he did not say this from himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus was about to die for the nation,
11.bbe: He did not say this of himself, but being the high priest that year he said, as a prophet, that Jesus would be put to death for the nation;

11.msb: and not only for the nation, but also for the scattered children of God, to gather them together into one.
11.kjv: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.
11.blb: and not for the nation only, but also so that the children of God, those having been scattered, He might gather together into one.
11.bbe: And not for that nation only, but for the purpose of uniting in one body the children of God all over the world.

11.msb: So from that day on they plotted together to kill Him.
11.kjv: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.
11.blb: So from that day they took counsel together that they might kill Him.
11.bbe: And from that day they took thought together how to put him to death.

11.msb: As a result, Jesus no longer went about publicly among the Jews, but He withdrew to a town called Ephraim in an area near the wilderness. And He spent time there with His disciples.
11.kjv: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
11.blb: Therefore Jesus no longer was walking publicly among the Jews, but He went away from there into the region near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. And there He stayed with the disciples.
11.bbe: So Jesus no longer went about publicly among the Jews, but went from there into the country near to the waste land, to a town named Ephraim, where he was for some time with the disciples.

11.msb: Now the Jewish Passover was near, and many people went up from the country to Jerusalem to purify themselves before the Passover.
11.kjv: And the Jews’ passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
11.blb: Now the Passover of the Jews was near, and many went up to Jerusalem from the country before the Passover, so that they might purify themselves.
11.bbe: Now the Passover of the Jews was near, and numbers of people went up from the country to Jerusalem to make themselves clean before the Passover.

11.msb: They kept looking for Jesus and asking one another as they stood in the temple courts, “What do you think? Will He come to the feast at all?”
11.kjv: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
11.blb: Therefore they were seeking Jesus and were speaking with one another standing in the temple: “What does it seem to you? That He may not come to the feast?”
11.bbe: They were looking for Jesus and saying to one another while they were in the Temple, What is your opinion? Will he not come to the feast?

11.msb: But the chief priests and Pharisees had given an order that anyone who knew where He was must report it, so that they could arrest Him.
11.kjv: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.
11.blb: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a command that if anyone should know where He is, he should show it, so that they might seize Him.
11.bbe: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that if anyone had knowledge where he was, he was to give them word, so that they might take him.

12.msb: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, the hometown of Lazarus who had died, whom He had raised from the dead.
12.kjv: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
12.blb: Therefore Jesus, six days before the Passover, came to Bethany where Lazarus was, whom Jesus raised out from the dead.
12.bbe: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany where Lazarus was, whom Jesus had made to come back from the dead.
12.heading: Mary Anoints Jesus

12.msb: So they hosted a dinner for Jesus there. Martha served, and Lazarus was among those reclining at the table with Him.
12.kjv: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
12.blb: Therefore they made Him a supper there, and Martha was serving, and Lazarus was one of those reclining with Him.
12.bbe: So they made him a meal there, and he was waited on by Martha, and Lazarus was among those who were seated with him at table.

12.msb: Then Mary took about a pint of expensive perfume, made of pure nard, and she anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped them with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.
12.kjv: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
12.blb: Therefore Mary, having taken a litra of fragrant oil of pure nard, of great price, anointed the feet of Jesus and wiped His feet with her hair; and the house was filled with the fragrance of the oil.
12.bbe: Then Mary, taking a pound of perfumed oil of great value, put it on the feet of Jesus and made them dry with her hair: and the house became full of the smell of the perfume.

12.msb: But one of His disciples, Judas Iscariot, son of Simon, who was going to betray Him, asked,
12.kjv: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, which should betray him,
12.blb: But Judas Iscariot, one of His disciples, being about to betray Him, says,
12.bbe: But one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot (who was to give him up), said,

12.msb: “Why wasn’t this perfume sold for three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor?”
12.kjv: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
12.blb: “Why was this fragrant oil not sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”
12.bbe: Why was not this perfume traded for three hundred pence, and the money given to the poor?

12.msb: Judas did not say this because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief. As keeper of the money bag, he used to take from what was put into it.
12.kjv: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
12.blb: But he said this not because he was caring for the poor, but because he was a thief; and having the money bag, he used to take up that being put into it.
12.bbe: (He said this, not because he had any love for the poor; but because he was a thief, and, having the money-bag, took for himself what was put into it.)

12.msb: “Leave her alone,” Jesus replied. “She has kept this perfume in preparation for the day of My burial.
12.kjv: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
12.blb: Therefore Jesus said, “Leave her alone, so that for the day of My burial she may keep it.
12.bbe: Then Jesus said, Let her be. Let her keep what she has for the day of my death.

12.msb: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have Me.”
12.kjv: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.
12.blb: For you always have the poor with you, but not always do you have Me.”
12.bbe: The poor you have ever with you, but me you have not for ever.

12.msb: Meanwhile a large crowd of Jews learned that Jesus was there. And they came not only because of Him, but also to see Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.
12.kjv: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
12.blb: Therefore the great crowd of the Jews knew that He is there; and they came, not because of Jesus only, but so that they might see Lazarus also, whom He raised out from the dead.
12.bbe: Then a great number of the Jews had news that he was there: and they came, not only because of Jesus, but so that they might see Lazarus who had been dead and to whom he had given life.
12.heading: The Plot to Kill Lazarus

12.msb: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus as well,
12.kjv: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
12.blb: And the chief priests took counsel that they might kill Lazarus also,
12.bbe: Now there was talk among the chief priests of putting Lazarus to death;

12.msb: for on account of him many of the Jews were deserting them and believing in Jesus.
12.kjv: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
12.blb: because on account of him many of the Jews were going away and were believing in Jesus.
12.bbe: For because of him a great number of the Jews went away and had belief in Jesus.

12.msb: The next day a great crowd that had come to the feast heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem.
12.kjv: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
12.blb: On the next day the great crowd, having come to the feast, having heard that Jesus is coming into Jerusalem,
12.bbe: The day after, a great number of people who were there for the feast, when they had the news that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
12.heading: The Triumphal Entry

12.msb: They took palm branches and went out to meet Him, crying out: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Blessed is the King of Israel!”
12.kjv: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
12.blb: took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet Him, and they were shouting: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is the One coming in the name of the Lord!” “And the King of Israel!”
12.bbe: Took branches of palm-trees and went out to him, crying, A blessing on him who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!

12.msb: Finding a young donkey, Jesus sat on it, as it is written:
12.kjv: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
12.blb: Now Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it, just as it is written:
12.bbe: And Jesus saw a young ass and took his seat on it; as the Writings say,

12.msb: “Do not be afraid, O Daughter of Zion. See, your King is coming, seated on the colt of a donkey.”
12.kjv: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass’s colt.
12.blb: “Do not fear, daughter of Zion; behold, your King comes, sitting on the colt of a donkey.”
12.bbe: Have no fear, daughter of Zion: see your King is coming, seated on a young ass.

12.msb: At first His disciples did not understand these things, but after Jesus was glorified they remembered what had been done to Him, and they realized that these very things had also been written about Him.
12.kjv: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
12.blb: His disciples did not know these things from the first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written of Him and these things they did to Him.
12.bbe: (These things were not clear to his disciples at first: but when Jesus had been lifted up into his glory, then it came to their minds that these things in the Writings were about him and that they had been done to him.)

12.msb: Meanwhile, many people who had been with Jesus when He called Lazarus from the tomb and raised him from the dead continued to testify.
12.kjv: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
12.blb: Therefore the crowd being with Him when He called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him out from the dead were testifying.
12.bbe: Now the people who were with him when his voice came to Lazarus in the place of the dead, and gave him life again, had been talking about it.

12.msb: That is also why the crowd went out to meet Him, because they heard that He had performed this sign.
12.kjv: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
12.blb: Because of this the crowd also met Him, because they heard of His having done this sign.
12.bbe: And that was the reason the people went out to him, because it had come to their ears that he had done this sign.

12.msb: Then the Pharisees said to one another, “You can see that this is doing you no good. Look how the whole world has gone after Him!”
12.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
12.blb: Therefore the Pharisees said among themselves, “You see that you gain nothing. Behold, the world went away after Him!”
12.bbe: Then the Pharisees said one to another, You see, you are unable to do anything: the world has gone after him.

12.msb: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.
12.kjv: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
12.blb: Now there were certain Greeks among those coming up so that they might worship at the feast.
12.bbe: Now there were some Greeks among the people who had come up to give worship at the feast:
12.heading: Jesus Predicts His Death

12.msb: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and requested of him, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
12.kjv: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
12.blb: Therefore these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and they were asking him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
12.bbe: They came to Philip, who was of Beth-saida in Galilee, and made a request, saying, Sir, we have a desire to see Jesus.

12.msb: Philip relayed this appeal to Andrew, and both of them went and told Jesus.
12.kjv: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
12.blb: Philip comes and tells Andrew; Andrew and Philip come and tell Jesus.
12.bbe: Philip went and gave word of it to Andrew; and Andrew went with Philip to Jesus.

12.msb: But Jesus replied, “The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
12.kjv: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
12.blb: And Jesus answered them, saying, “The hour has come that the Son of Man shall be glorified.
12.bbe: And Jesus said to them in answer, The hour of the glory of the Son of man has come.

12.msb: Truly, truly, I tell you, unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a seed. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
12.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
12.blb: Truly, truly, I say to you, unless the grain of wheat, having fallen into the ground, should die, it remains alone; but if it should die, it bears much fruit.
12.bbe: Truly I say to you, If a seed of grain does not go into the earth and come to an end, it is still a seed and no more; but through its death it gives much fruit.

12.msb: Whoever loves his life will lose it, but whoever hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
12.kjv: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
12.blb: The one loving his life loses it, and the one hating his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
12.bbe: He who is in love with life will have it taken from him; and he who has no care for his life in this world will keep it for ever and ever.

12.msb: If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me; and where I am, My servant will be as well. If anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him.
12.kjv: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
12.blb: If anyone may serve Me, let him follow Me; and where I am, there also My servant will be. If anyone may serve Me, the Father will honor him.
12.bbe: If any man is my servant, let him come after me; and where I am, there will my servant be. If any man becomes my servant, my Father will give him honour.

12.msb: Now My soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save Me from this hour’? No, it is for this purpose that I have come to this hour.
12.kjv: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
12.blb: Now My soul has been troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save Me from this hour’? But because of this I came to this hour.
12.bbe: Now is my soul troubled; and what am I to say? Father, keep me from this hour. No: for this purpose have I come to this hour.

12.msb: Father, glorify Your name!” Then a voice came from heaven: “I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again.”
12.kjv: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
12.blb: Father, glorify Your name!” Therefore a voice came from heaven: “I have both glorified it, and I will glorify it again.”
12.bbe: Father, give glory to your name. Then there came a voice out of heaven, saying, I have given it glory, and I will give it glory again.

12.msb: The crowd standing there heard it and said that it had thundered. Others said that an angel had spoken to Him.
12.kjv: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
12.blb: Therefore the crowd, having stood and having heard, was saying, “There has been thunder.” Others were saying, “An angel has spoken to Him.”
12.bbe: Hearing the sound, a number of people who were there said that it was thunder: others said, An angel was talking to him.

12.msb: In response, Jesus said, “This voice was not for My benefit, but yours.
12.kjv: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
12.blb: Jesus answered and said, “This voice has not come because of Me, but because of you.
12.bbe: Jesus said in answer, This voice came not for me but for you.

12.msb: Now judgment is upon this world; now the prince of this world will be cast out.
12.kjv: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
12.blb: Now is the judgment of this world; now the ruler of this world will be cast out.
12.bbe: Now is this world to be judged: now will the ruler of this world be sent out.

12.msb: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw everyone to Myself.”
12.kjv: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
12.blb: And I, when I shall be lifted up from the earth, will draw all to Myself.”
12.bbe: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will make all men come to me.

12.msb: He said this to indicate the kind of death He was going to die.
12.kjv: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
12.blb: Now He was saying this signifying by what death He was about to die.
12.bbe: (This he said, pointing to the sort of death he would have.)

12.msb: The crowd replied, “We have heard from the Law that the Christ will remain forever. So how can You say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
12.kjv: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
12.blb: Then the crowd answered Him, “We heard from the Law that the Christ remains to the age, and how do You say that it is necessary for the Son of Man to be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
12.bbe: Then the people in answer said to him, The law says that the Christ will have life without end: how say you then that it is necessary for the Son of man to be lifted up? Who is this Son of man?

12.msb: Then Jesus told them, “For a little while longer, the Light will be with you. Walk while you have the Light, so that darkness will not overtake you. The one who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going.
12.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
12.blb: Therefore Jesus said to them, “Yet a little time the Light is among you. Walk while you have the Light, so that darkness might not overtake you. And the one walking in the darkness does not know where he goes.
12.bbe: Jesus said to them, For a little time longer the light will be among you; while you have the light go on walking in it, so that the dark may not overtake you: one walking in the dark has no knowledge of where he is going.

12.msb: While you have the Light, believe in the Light, so that you may become sons of light.” After Jesus had spoken these things, He went away and was hidden from them.
12.kjv: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.
12.blb: While you have the Light, believe in the Light, so that you may become sons of light.” Jesus spoke these things, and having gone away, He was hidden from them.
12.bbe: In so far as you have the light, put your faith in the light so that you may become sons of light. With these words Jesus went away and for a time was not seen again by them.

12.msb: Although Jesus had performed so many signs in their presence, they still did not believe in Him.
12.kjv: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
12.blb: But of Him having done so many signs before them, they did not believe in Him,
12.bbe: But though he had done such a number of signs before them, they still had no belief in him:
12.heading: Belief and Unbelief

12.msb: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: “Lord, who has believed our message? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
12.kjv: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
12.blb: so that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled that said: “Lord, who has believed our report? And to whom was the arm of the Lord revealed?”
12.bbe: So that the words of the prophet Isaiah might come true, when he said, Lord, who has any belief in our preaching? and the arm of the Lord, to whom has it been unveiled?

12.msb: For this reason they were unable to believe. For again, Isaiah says:
12.kjv: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
12.blb: Because of this, they were not able to believe, because again Isaiah said:
12.bbe: For this reason they were unable to have belief, because Isaiah said again,

12.msb: “He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so that they cannot see with their eyes, and understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.”
12.kjv: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
12.blb: “He has blinded their eyes and hardened their heart, so that they might not see with the eyes, and understand with the heart, and turn, and I will heal them.”
12.bbe: He has made their eyes blind, and their hearts hard; for fear that they might see with their eyes and get knowledge with their hearts, and be changed, and I might make them well.

12.msb: Isaiah said these things when he saw Jesus’ glory and spoke about Him.
12.kjv: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
12.blb: Isaiah said these things because he saw His glory and spoke about Him.
12.bbe: (Isaiah said these words because he saw his glory. His words were about him.)

12.msb: Nevertheless, many of the leaders believed in Him. But because of the Pharisees they did not confess Him, for fear that they would be put out of the synagogue.
12.kjv: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
12.blb: Nevertheless, indeed many of the rulers also believed in Him, but because of the Pharisees they were not confessing, so that they might not be put out of the synagogue;
12.bbe: However, a number even of the rulers had belief in him, but because of the Pharisees they did not say so openly for fear that they might be shut out from the Synagogue:

12.msb: For they loved praise from men more than praise from God.
12.kjv: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
12.blb: for they loved the glory of men more than the glory of God.
12.bbe: For the praise of men was dearer to them than the approval of God.

12.msb: Then Jesus cried out, “Whoever believes in Me does not believe in Me alone, but in the One who sent Me.
12.kjv: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
12.blb: And Jesus cried out and said, “The one believing in Me does not believe in Me but in the One having sent Me.
12.bbe: Then Jesus said with a loud voice, He who has faith in me, has faith not in me, but in him who sent me.

12.msb: And whoever sees Me sees the One who sent Me.
12.kjv: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
12.blb: And the one beholding Me beholds the One having sent Me.
12.bbe: And he who sees me, sees him who sent me.

12.msb: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness.
12.kjv: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
12.blb: I have come into the world as a light, so that everyone believing in Me should not remain in the darkness.
12.bbe: I have come as a light into the world, so that no one who has faith in me will go on living in the dark.

12.msb: As for anyone who hears My words and does not believe, I do not judge him. For I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
12.kjv: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
12.blb: And if anyone might hear My words and not keep them, I do not judge him; for I did not come so that I might judge the world, but so that I might save the world.
12.bbe: And if any man gives ear to my words and does not keep them, I am not his judge: I did not come to be judge of the world but to give salvation to the world.

12.msb: There is a judge for the one who rejects Me and does not receive My words: The word that I have spoken will judge him on the last day.
12.kjv: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
12.blb: The one rejecting Me and not receiving My words has one judging him: The word that I spoke, which will judge him in the last day.
12.bbe: He who puts me on one side and does not take my words to heart, is not without a judge: the word which I have said will be his judge on the last day.

12.msb: I have not spoken on My own, but the Father who sent Me has commanded Me what to say and how to say it.
12.kjv: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
12.blb: For I did not speak from Myself, but the Father Himself, having sent Me, has given Me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.
12.bbe: For I have not said it on my authority, but the Father who sent me gave me orders what to say and how to say it.

12.msb: And I know that His command leads to eternal life. So I speak exactly what the Father has told Me to say.”
12.kjv: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
12.blb: And I know that His commandment is eternal life. Therefore what I speak, just as the Father has said to Me, so I speak.”
12.bbe: And I have knowledge that his order is eternal life: so that the things which I say, I say them even as the Father says them to me.

13.msb: It was now just before the Passover Feast, and Jesus knew that His hour had come to leave this world and return to the Father. Having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the very end.
13.kjv: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
13.blb: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus knowing that His hour had come, that He would depart out of this world to the Father, having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the end.
13.bbe: Now before the feast of the Passover, it was clear to Jesus that the time had come for him to go away from this world to the Father. Having once had love for those in the world who were his, his love for them went on to the end.
13.heading: Jesus Washes His Disciples’ Feet

13.msb: By the time the evening meal had ended, the devil had already put into the heart of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.
13.kjv: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him;
13.blb: And supper taking place and the devil already having put into the heart of Judas son of Simon Iscariot that he should betray Him,
13.bbe: So while a meal was going on, the Evil One having now put it into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to be false to him,

13.msb: Jesus knew that the Father had delivered all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was returning to God.
13.kjv: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;
13.blb: knowing that the Father has given to Him all things into the hands, and that He came forth from God and He is going to God,
13.bbe: Jesus, being conscious that the Father had put everything into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,

13.msb: So He got up from the supper, laid aside His outer garments, and wrapped a towel around His waist.
13.kjv: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
13.blb: He rises from the supper and lays aside His garments. And having taken a towel, He girded Himself.
13.bbe: Got up from table, put off his robe and took a cloth and put it round him.

13.msb: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and dry them with the towel that was around Him.
13.kjv: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
13.blb: After that, He pours water into the basin, and He began to wash the feet of the disciples and to wipe them with the towel with which He was girded.
13.bbe: Then he put water into a basin and was washing the feet of the disciples and drying them with the cloth which was round him.

13.msb: He came to Simon Peter, who asked Him, “Lord, are You going to wash my feet?”
13.kjv: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
13.blb: Then He comes to Simon Peter, who says to Him, “Lord, do You wash my feet?”
13.bbe: So he came to Simon Peter. Peter said, Lord, are my feet to be washed by you?

13.msb: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
13.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
13.blb: Jesus answered and said to him, “What I do, you do not know presently, but you will know after these things.”
13.bbe: And Jesus, answering, said to him, What I do is not clear to you now, but it will be clear to you in time to come.

13.msb: “Never shall You wash my feet!” Peter told Him. Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.”
13.kjv: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
13.blb: Peter says to Him, “Never shall You wash my feet, to the age!” Jesus answered him, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.”
13.bbe: Peter said, I will never let my feet be washed by you, never. Jesus said in answer, If I do not make you clean you have no part with me.

13.msb: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well!”
13.kjv: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
13.blb: Simon Peter says to Him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also the hands and the head!”
13.bbe: Simon Peter said to him, Lord, not my feet only, but my hands and my head.

13.msb: Jesus told him, “Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you.”
13.kjv: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
13.blb: Jesus says to him, “The one having been bathed has no need to wash, except the feet, but is wholly clean. And you all are clean, but not all.”
13.bbe: Jesus said to him, He who is bathed has need only to have his feet washed and then he is clean all over: and you, my disciples, are clean, but not all of you.

13.msb: For He knew who would betray Him. That is why He said, “Not all of you are clean.”
13.kjv: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
13.blb: For He knew the one who is betraying Him; on account of this He said, “You are not all clean.”
13.bbe: (He had knowledge who was false to him; that is why he said, You are not all clean.)

13.msb: When Jesus had washed their feet and put on His outer garments, He reclined with them again and asked, “Do you know what I have done for you?
13.kjv: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
13.blb: Therefore when He washed their feet and took His garments and reclined again, He said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?
13.bbe: Then, after washing their feet and putting on his robe again, he took his seat and said to them, Do you see what I have done to you?

13.msb: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and rightly so, because I am.
13.kjv: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
13.blb: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and you say rightly, for I am.
13.bbe: You give me the name of Master and Lord: and you are right; that is what I am.

13.msb: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.
13.kjv: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet.
13.blb: Therefore if I, the Lord and the Teacher, washed your feet, you also ought to wash the feet of one another.
13.bbe: If then I, the Lord and the Master, have made your feet clean, it is right for you to make one another's feet clean.

13.msb: I have set you an example so that you should do as I have done for you.
13.kjv: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
13.blb: For I gave you an example so that as I did to you, you also should do.
13.bbe: I have given you an example, so that you may do what I have done to you.

13.msb: Truly, truly, I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.
13.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
13.blb: Truly, truly, I say to you, a servant is not greater than his master, nor a messenger greater than the one having sent him.
13.bbe: Truly I say to you, A servant is not greater than his lord; and he who is sent is not greater than the one who sent him.

13.msb: If you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
13.kjv: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
13.blb: If you know these things, you are blessed if you do them.
13.bbe: If these things are clear to you, happy are you if you do them.

13.msb: I am not speaking about all of you; I know whom I have chosen. But this is to fulfill the Scripture: ‘The one who shares bread with Me has lifted up his heel against Me.’
13.kjv: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.
13.blb: I speak not about all of you—I know whom I chose—but so that the Scripture may be fulfilled: ‘The one eating My bread lifted up his heel against Me.’
13.bbe: I am not talking of you all: I have knowledge of my true disciples, but things are as they are, so that the Writings may come true, The foot of him who takes bread with me is lifted up against me.
13.heading: Jesus Predicts His Betrayal

13.msb: I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it comes to pass, you will believe that I am He.
13.kjv: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.
13.blb: I am telling you from this time, before it comes to pass, so that when it comes to pass you should believe that I am He.
13.bbe: From this time forward, I give you knowledge of things before they come about, so that when they come about you may have belief that I am he.

13.msb: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever receives the one I send receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives the One who sent Me.”
13.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
13.blb: Truly, truly, I say to you, the one receiving anyone I shall send receives Me, and the one receiving Me receives the One having sent Me.”
13.bbe: Truly I say to you, He who takes to his heart anyone whom I send, takes me to his heart; and he who so takes me, takes him who sent me.

13.msb: After Jesus had said this, He became troubled in spirit and testified, “Truly, truly, I tell you, one of you will betray Me.”
13.kjv: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
13.blb: Having said these things, Jesus was troubled in spirit, and He testified and said, “Truly, truly, I say to you that one of you will deliver Me up.”
13.bbe: When Jesus had said this he was troubled in spirit, and gave witness, saying, Truly I say to you, that one of you will be false to me.

13.msb: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed as to which of them He meant.
13.kjv: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
13.blb: The disciples began to look upon one another, being uncertain of whom He is speaking.
13.bbe: Then the eyes of the disciples were turned on one another, in doubt as to whom he had in mind.

13.msb: One of His disciples, the one whom Jesus loved, was reclining at His side.
13.kjv: Now there was leaning on Jesus’ bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
13.blb: There was reclining one of His disciples, whom Jesus loved, in the bosom of Jesus.
13.bbe: There was at table one of his disciples, the one dear to Jesus, resting his head on Jesus' breast.

13.msb: So Simon Peter motioned to him to ask Jesus which one He was talking about.
13.kjv: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
13.blb: Therefore Simon Peter motions to this one to ask who it is about whom He is speaking.
13.bbe: Making a sign to him, Simon Peter said, Who is it he is talking about?

13.msb: Falling back upon Jesus, he asked, “Lord, who is it?”
13.kjv: He then lying on Jesus’ breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
13.blb: Then he thus, having leaned on the breast of Jesus, says to Him, “Lord, who is it?”
13.bbe: He, then, resting his head on Jesus' breast, said to him, Lord, who is it?

13.msb: Jesus answered, “It is the one to whom I give this morsel after I have dipped it.” Then He dipped the morsel and gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.
13.kjv: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.
13.blb: Then Jesus answers, “It is he to whom I will dip the morsel and will give it to him.” Then, having dipped the morsel, He takes it and gives it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.
13.bbe: This was the answer Jesus gave: It is the one to whom I will give this bit of bread after I have put it in the vessel. Then he took the bit of bread, put it into the vessel, and gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

13.msb: And when Judas had taken the morsel, Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to Judas, “What you are about to do, do quickly.”
13.kjv: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.
13.blb: And after the morsel, then Satan entered into him. Therefore Jesus says to him, “What you do, do quickly.”
13.bbe: And when Judas took the bread Satan went into him. Then Jesus said to him, Do quickly what you have to do.

13.msb: But no one at the table knew why Jesus had said this to him.
13.kjv: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
13.blb: Now none of those reclining knew toward what He said this to him.
13.bbe: Now it was not clear to anyone at table why he said this to him.

13.msb: Since Judas kept the money bag, some thought that Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the feast, or to give something to the poor.
13.kjv: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
13.blb: For some were thinking, since Judas had the money bag, that Jesus is saying to him, “Buy what things we have need of for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.
13.bbe: Some were of the opinion that because Judas kept the money-bag Jesus said to him, Get the things we have need of for the feast; or, that he was to give something to the poor.

13.msb: As soon as he had received the morsel, Judas went out into the night.
13.kjv: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
13.blb: Therefore, having received the morsel, he went out immediately. And it was night.
13.bbe: So Judas, having taken the bit of bread, straight away went out: and it was night.

13.msb: When Judas had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.
13.kjv: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
13.blb: Therefore when he had gone out, Jesus says, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in Him.
13.bbe: Then when he had gone out, Jesus said, Now is glory given to the Son of man, and God is given glory in him.
13.heading: Love One Another

13.msb: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify the Son in Himself—and will glorify Him at once.
13.kjv: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
13.blb: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify Him in Himself, and He will glorify Him immediately.
13.bbe: If God is given glory in him, God will give him glory in himself, and will give him glory even now.

13.msb: Little children, I am with you only a little while longer. You will look for Me, and as I said to the Jews, so now I say to you: ‘Where I am going, you cannot come.’
13.kjv: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.
13.blb: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. You will seek Me, and as I said to the Jews, now I say also to you: ‘Where I go, you are not able to come.’
13.bbe: My dear children, I am only to be with you a little longer. Then you will be looking for me: and as I said to the Jews, so now I say to you, Where I am going you may not come.

13.msb: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.
13.kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
13.blb: A new commandment I give to you, that you should love one another. As I have loved you, so you also should love one another.
13.bbe: I give you a new law: Have love one for another; even as I have had love for you, so are you to have love one for another.

13.msb: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.”
13.kjv: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
13.blb: By this all will know that you are My disciples, if you shall have love among one another.”
13.bbe: By this it will be clear to all men that you are my disciples, if you have love one for another.

13.msb: “Lord, where are You going?” Simon Peter asked. Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now, but you will follow Me later.”
13.kjv: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
13.blb: Simon Peter says to Him, “Lord, where are You going?” Jesus answered him, “Where I go, you are not able to follow Me now, but you will follow afterward.”
13.bbe: Simon Peter said to him, Lord, where are you going? Jesus said in answer, Where I am going you may not come with me now, but you will come later.
13.heading: Jesus Predicts Peter’s Denial

13.msb: “Lord,” said Peter, “why can’t I follow You now? I will lay down my life for You.”
13.kjv: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
13.blb: Peter says to Him, “Lord, why am I not able to follow You presently? I will lay down my life for You.”
13.bbe: Peter said to him, Why may I not come with you even now? I will give up my life for you.

13.msb: “Will you lay down your life for Me?” Jesus replied. “Truly, truly, I tell you, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.
13.kjv: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
13.blb: Jesus answered, “Will you lay down your life for Me? Truly, truly, I say to you, the rooster will not crow until you will deny Me three times.
13.bbe: Jesus said in answer, Will you give up your life for me? Truly I say to you, Before the cry of the cock you will have said three times that you are not my disciple.

14.msb: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.
14.kjv: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
14.blb: “ Let not your heart be troubled. You believe in God; believe also in Me.
14.bbe: Let not your heart be troubled: have faith in God and have faith in me.
14.heading: In My Father’s House Are Many Rooms

14.msb: In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?
14.kjv: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
14.blb: In My Father’s house are many dwelling places. And if not so, would I have told you that I am going to prepare a place for you?
14.bbe: In my Father's house are rooms enough; if it was not so, would I have said that I am going to make ready a place for you?

14.msb: And if I go, I will prepare a place for you. I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.
14.kjv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
14.blb: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I am coming again, and I will receive you to Myself, so that where I am, you may be also.
14.bbe: And if I go and make ready a place for you, I will come back again and will take you to be with me, so that you may be where I am.

14.msb: You know the place where I am going and you know the way.”
14.kjv: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
14.blb: And you know the way to where I am going.”
14.bbe: And you all have knowledge of where I am going, and of the way to it.

14.msb: “Lord,” said Thomas, “we do not know where You are going, so how can we know the way?”
14.kjv: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
14.blb: Thomas says to Him, “Lord, we do not know where You are going; how can we know the way?”
14.bbe: Thomas said, Lord, we have no knowledge of where you are going; how may we have knowledge of the way?
14.heading: The Way, the Truth, and the Life

14.msb: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
14.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
14.blb: Jesus says to him, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father if not through Me.
14.bbe: Jesus said to him, I am the true and living way: no one comes to the Father but by me.

14.msb: If you had known Me, you would know My Father as well. From now on you do know Him and have seen Him.”
14.kjv: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
14.blb: If you had known Me, you would also have known My Father. From now, you know Him and have seen Him.”
14.bbe: If you had knowledge of me, you would have knowledge of my Father: you have knowledge of him now and have seen him.

14.msb: Philip said to Him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
14.kjv: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
14.blb: Philip says to Him, “Lord, show us the Father, and it is enough for us.”
14.bbe: Philip said to him, Lord, let us see the Father, and we have need of nothing more.

14.msb: Jesus replied, “Philip, I have been with you all this time, and still you do not know Me? Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
14.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?
14.blb: Jesus says to him, “Am I with you so long a time, and you have not known Me, Philip? The one having seen Me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
14.bbe: Jesus said to him, Philip, have I been with you all this time, and still you have no knowledge of me? He who has seen me has seen the Father. Why do you say, Let us see the Father?

14.msb: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words I say to you, I do not speak on My own. Instead, it is the Father dwelling in Me, performing His works.
14.kjv: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
14.blb: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words that I speak to you I do not speak from Myself; but the Father dwelling in Me does His works.
14.bbe: Have you not faith that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The words which I say to you, I say not from myself: but the Father who is in me all the time does his works.

14.msb: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me—or at least believe Me on account of the works themselves.
14.kjv: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
14.blb: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me; but if not, believe because of the works themselves.
14.bbe: Have faith that I am in the Father and that the Father is in me: at least, have faith in me because of what I do.

14.msb: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever believes in Me will also do the works that I am doing. He will do even greater things than these, because I am going to My Father.
14.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
14.blb: Truly, truly, I say to you, the one believing in Me, the works that I do, he will also do. And he will do greater than these, because I am going to the Father.
14.bbe: Truly I say to you, He who puts his faith in me will do the very works which I do, and he will do greater things than these, because I am going to my Father.

14.msb: And I will do whatever you ask in My name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
14.kjv: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
14.blb: And whatever you might ask in My name, this I will do, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
14.bbe: And whatever request you make in my name, that I will do, so that the Father may have glory in the Son.

14.msb: If you ask Me for anything in My name, I will do it.
14.kjv: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
14.blb: If you ask Me anything in My name, I will do it.
14.bbe: If you make any request to me in my name, I will do it.

14.msb: If you love Me, keep My commandments.
14.kjv: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
14.blb: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
14.bbe: If you have love for me, you will keep my laws.
14.heading: Jesus Promises the Holy Spirit

14.msb: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to abide with you forever—
14.kjv: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
14.blb: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate so that He may be with you to the age—
14.bbe: And I will make prayer to the Father and he will give you another Helper to be with you for ever,

14.msb: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. But you do know Him, for He abides with you and will be in you.
14.kjv: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
14.blb: the Spirit of truth, whom the world is not able to receive, because it does not see Him, nor does it know Him. But you know Him, for He abides with you and will be in you.
14.bbe: Even the Spirit of true knowledge. That Spirit the world is not able to take to its heart because it sees him not and has no knowledge of him: but you have knowledge of him, because he is ever with you and will be in you.

14.msb: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
14.kjv: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
14.blb: I will not leave you as orphans; I am coming to you.
14.bbe: I will not let you be without a friend: I am coming to you.

14.msb: In a little while the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you also will live.
14.kjv: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
14.blb: Yet a little while, and the world sees Me no more, but you see Me. Because I live, you also will live.
14.bbe: A little time longer, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me; and you will be living because I am living.

14.msb: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you are in Me, and I am in you.
14.kjv: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
14.blb: In that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you in Me, and I in you.
14.bbe: At that time it will be clear to you that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I in you.

14.msb: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.”
14.kjv: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
14.blb: The one having My commandments and keeping them, he is the one loving Me. Now the one loving Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him, and I will show Myself to him.”
14.bbe: He who has my laws and keeps them, he it is who has love for me: and he who has love for me will be loved by my Father, and I will have love for him and will let myself be seen clearly by him.

14.msb: Judas (not Iscariot) asked Him, “Lord, why are You going to reveal Yourself to us and not to the world?”
14.kjv: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
14.blb: Judas (not Iscariot) says to Him, “Lord, then what has occurred that You are about to manifest Yourself to us and not to the world?”
14.bbe: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, How is it that you will let yourself be seen clearly by us and not by the world?

14.msb: Jesus replied, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word. My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.
14.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
14.blb: Jesus answered and said to him, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word, and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and will make a home with him.
14.bbe: Jesus said to him in answer, If anyone has love for me, he will keep my words: and he will be dear to my Father; and we will come to him and make our living-place with him.

14.msb: Whoever does not love Me does not keep My words. The word that you hear is not My own, but it is from the Father who sent Me.
14.kjv: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s which sent me.
14.blb: The one not loving Me does not keep My words. And the word that you hear is not Mine, but that of the Father having sent Me.
14.bbe: He who has no love for me does not keep my words; and the word which you are hearing is not my word but the Father's who sent me.

14.msb: All this I have spoken to you while I am still with you.
14.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
14.blb: These things I have said to you, remaining with you.
14.bbe: I have said all this to you while I am still with you.

14.msb: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.
14.kjv: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
14.blb: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you all things and will remind you of all the things that I said to you.
14.bbe: But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will be your teacher in all things and will put you in mind of everything I have said to you.

14.msb: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
14.kjv: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
14.blb: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. Not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your heart be troubled, nor let it be afraid.
14.bbe: May peace be with you; my peace I give to you: I give it not as the world gives. Let not your heart be troubled; let it be without fear.
14.heading: Peace I Leave with You

14.msb: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because My Father is greater than I.
14.kjv: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
14.blb: You heard that I said to you, ‘I am going away and I am coming to you.’ If you loved Me, you would have rejoiced that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.
14.bbe: Keep in mind how I said to you, I go away and come to you again. If you had love for me you would be glad, because I am going to the Father: for the Father is greater than I.

14.msb: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.
14.kjv: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
14.blb: And now I have told you before it comes to pass, so that when it shall have come to pass, you may believe.
14.bbe: And now I have given you word of it before it comes, so that, when it comes, you may have faith.

14.msb: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.
14.kjv: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
14.blb: No longer will I speak much with you; for the ruler of the world comes, and in Me he has nothing.
14.bbe: After this I will not say much to you, because the ruler of this world comes: and he has no power over me;

14.msb: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father. Get up! Let us go on from here.
14.kjv: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
14.blb: But so that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded Me, thus I do. Rise up, let us go from here.
14.bbe: But he comes so that the world may see that I have love for the Father, and that I am doing as I am ordered by the Father. Get up, and let us go.

15.msb: “I am the true vine, and My Father is the keeper of the vineyard.
15.kjv: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
15.blb: “ I am the true vine, and My Father is the vinedresser.
15.bbe: I am the true vine and my Father is the gardener.
15.heading: Jesus the True Vine

15.msb: He cuts off every branch in Me that bears no fruit, and every branch that does bear fruit, He prunes to make it even more fruitful.
15.kjv: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
15.blb: Every branch not bearing fruit in Me, He takes it away; and every one bearing fruit, He prunes it clean so that it may bear more fruit.
15.bbe: He takes away every branch in me which has no fruit, and every branch which has fruit he makes clean, so that it may have more fruit.

15.msb: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.
15.kjv: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
15.blb: Already you are clean because of the word that I have spoken to you.
15.bbe: You are clean, even now, through the teaching which I have given you.

15.msb: Remain in Me, and I will remain in you. Just as no branch can bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in Me.
15.kjv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
15.blb: Remain in Me, and I in you. As the branch is not able to bear fruit of itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither you, unless you remain in Me.
15.bbe: Be in me at all times as I am in you. As the branch is not able to give fruit of itself, if it is not still on the vine, so you are not able to do so if you are not in me.

15.msb: I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit. For apart from Me you can do nothing.
15.kjv: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
15.blb: I am the vine; you are the branches. The one remaining in Me and I in him, he bears much fruit. For apart from Me you are able to do nothing.
15.bbe: I am the vine, you are the branches: he who is in me at all times as I am in him, gives much fruit, because without me you are able to do nothing.

15.msb: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is like a branch that is thrown away and withers. Such branches are gathered up, thrown into the fire, and burned.
15.kjv: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
15.blb: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is thrown out like the branch and is dried up; and they gather them and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
15.bbe: If a man does not keep himself in me, he becomes dead and is cut off like a dry branch; such branches are taken up and put in the fire and burned.

15.msb: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, then you will ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
15.kjv: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
15.blb: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, you shall ask whatever you wish, and to you it will come to pass.
15.bbe: If you are in me at all times, and my words are in you, then anything for which you make a request will be done for you.

15.msb: This is to My Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, proving yourselves to be My disciples.
15.kjv: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
15.blb: In this My Father is glorified, that you should bear much fruit, and you shall be My disciples.
15.bbe: Here is my Father's glory, in that you give much fruit and so are my true disciples.

15.msb: As the Father has loved Me, so have I loved you. Remain in My love.
15.kjv: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
15.blb: As the Father has loved Me, I also have loved you. Remain in My love.
15.bbe: Even as the Father has given me his love, so I have given my love to you: be ever in my love.
15.heading: No Greater Love

15.msb: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.
15.kjv: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.
15.blb: If you keep My commandments, you will abide in My love, as I have kept My Father’s commandments and abide in His love.
15.bbe: If you keep my laws, you will be ever in my love, even as I have kept my Father's laws, and am ever in his love.

15.msb: I have told you these things so that My joy may abide in you and your joy may be complete.
15.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
15.blb: These things I have spoken to you so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be full.
15.bbe: I have said these things to you so that I may have joy in you and so that your joy may be complete.

15.msb: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.
15.kjv: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
15.blb: This is My commandment, that you should love one another as I have loved you.
15.bbe: This is the law I give you: Have love one for another, even as I have love for you.

15.msb: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.
15.kjv: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
15.blb: Greater love has no one than this, that one should lay down his life for his friends.
15.bbe: Greater love has no man than this, that a man gives up his life for his friends.

15.msb: You are My friends if you do whatever I command you.
15.kjv: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
15.blb: You are My friends if you do what I command you.
15.bbe: You are my friends, if you do what I give you orders to do.

15.msb: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.
15.kjv: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
15.blb: No longer do I call you servants, because the servant does not know what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because all things that I heard from My Father I have made known to you.
15.bbe: No longer do I give you the name of servants; because a servant is without knowledge of what his master is doing: I give you the name of friends, because I have given you knowledge of all the things which my Father has said to me.
