15.msb: You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
15.kjv: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
15.blb: You did not choose Me, but I chose you, and I appointed you so that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain, so that whatever you might ask the Father in My name, He may give you.
15.bbe: You did not take me for yourselves, but I took you for myself; and I gave you the work of going about and producing fruit which will be for ever; so that whatever request you make to the Father in my name he may give it to you.

15.msb: This is My command to you: Love one another.
15.kjv: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
15.blb: These things I command you, that you love one another.
15.bbe: So this is my law for you: Have love one for another.

15.msb: If the world hates you, understand that it hated Me first.
15.kjv: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
15.blb: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated Me before you.
15.bbe: If you are hated by the world, keep in mind that I was hated by the world before you.
15.heading: The Hatred of the World

15.msb: If you were of the world, it would love you as its own. Instead, the world hates you, because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world.
15.kjv: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
15.blb: If you were of the world, the world would love you as its own; but because you are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, on account of this, the world hates you.
15.bbe: If you were of the world, you would be loved by the world: but because you are not of the world, but I have taken you out of the world, you are hated by the world.

15.msb: Remember the word that I spoke to you: ‘No servant is greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will persecute you as well; if they kept My word, they will keep yours as well.
15.kjv: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
15.blb: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will also persecute you; if they kept My word, they will keep yours also.
15.bbe: Keep in mind the words I said to you, A servant is not greater than his lord. If they were cruel to me, they will be cruel to you; if they kept my words, they will keep yours.

15.msb: But they will treat you like this because of My name, since they do not know the One who sent Me.
15.kjv: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.
15.blb: But they will do all these things against you on account of My name, because they do not know the One having sent Me.
15.bbe: They will do all this to you because of my name — because they have no knowledge of him who sent me.

15.msb: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. Now, however, they have no excuse for their sin.
15.kjv: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.
15.blb: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
15.bbe: If I had not come and been their teacher they would have had no sin: but now they have no reason to give for their sin.

15.msb: Whoever hates Me hates My Father as well.
15.kjv: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
15.blb: The one hating Me hates My Father also.
15.bbe: He who has hate for me has hate for my Father.

15.msb: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have seen and hated both Me and My Father.
15.kjv: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
15.blb: If I had not done among them the works that no other has done, they would not have had sin; but now they have both seen and hated both Me and My Father.
15.bbe: If I had not done among them the works which no other man ever did, they would have had no sin: but now they have seen, and they have had hate in their hearts for me and my Father.

15.msb: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated Me without reason.’
15.kjv: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
15.blb: But this is so that the word having been written in their Law may be fulfilled: ‘They hated Me without cause.’
15.bbe: This comes about so that the writing in their law may be made true, Their hate for me was without cause.

15.msb: When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father—He will testify about Me.
15.kjv: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
15.blb: When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth who goes forth from the Father, He will testify about Me.
15.bbe: When the Helper comes, whom I will send to you from the Father even the Spirit of true knowledge who comes from the Father — he will give witness about me;

15.msb: And you also must testify, because you have been with Me from the beginning.
15.kjv: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
15.blb: And you also testify, because you are with Me from the beginning.
15.bbe: And you, in addition, will give witness because you have been with me from the first.

16.msb: “I have told you these things so that you will not fall away.
16.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
16.blb: “ I have spoken these things to you so that you should not fall away.
16.bbe: I have said these things to you so that you may not be in doubt.
16.heading: Persecution Foretold

16.msb: They will put you out of the synagogues. In fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.
16.kjv: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
16.blb: They will put you out of the synagogues; but an hour is coming that everyone having killed you will think he is offering a service to God.
16.bbe: They will put you out of the Synagogues: yes, the time is coming when whoever puts you to death will have the belief that he is doing God's pleasure.

16.msb: They will do these things because they have not known the Father or Me.
16.kjv: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
16.blb: And they will do these things because they do not know the Father nor Me.
16.bbe: They will do these things to you because they have not had knowledge of the Father or of me.

16.msb: But I have told you these things so that when the hour comes, you will remember that I told you about them. I did not tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
16.kjv: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
16.blb: But I have said these things to you so that when their hour might have come, you may remember that I said them to you. Now I did not say these things to you from the beginning, because I was with you.
16.bbe: I have said these things to you so that when the time comes, what I have said may come to your mind. I did not say them to you at the first, because then I was still with you.

16.msb: Now, however, I am going to Him who sent Me; yet none of you asks Me, ‘Where are You going?’
16.kjv: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
16.blb: But now I am going away to the One having sent Me, and none of you asks Me, ‘Where are You going?’
16.bbe: But now I am going to him who sent me; and not one of you says to me, Where are you going?
16.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

16.msb: Instead, your hearts are filled with sorrow because I have told you these things.
16.kjv: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
16.blb: But because I have said these things to you, sorrow has filled your heart.
16.bbe: But your hearts are full of sorrow because I have said these things.

16.msb: But I tell you the truth, it is for your benefit that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you.
16.kjv: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
16.blb: But I say to you the truth, it is profitable for you that I should go away. For unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you.
16.bbe: But what I am saying is true: my going is for your good: for if I do not go away, the Helper will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.

16.msb: And when He comes, He will convict the world in regard to sin and righteousness and judgment:
16.kjv: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
16.blb: And having come, He will convict the world concerning sin and concerning righteousness and concerning judgment:
16.bbe: And he, when he comes, will make the world conscious of sin, and of righteousness, and of being judged:

16.msb: in regard to sin, because they do not believe in Me;
16.kjv: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
16.blb: concerning sin indeed, because they do not believe in Me;
16.bbe: Of sin, because they have not faith in me;

16.msb: in regard to righteousness, because I am going to My Father and you will no longer see Me;
16.kjv: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
16.blb: and concerning righteousness, because I am going away to the Father and you see Me no longer;
16.bbe: Of righteousness, because I go to the Father and you will see me no more;

16.msb: and in regard to judgment, because the prince of this world has been condemned.
16.kjv: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
16.blb: and concerning judgment, because the ruler of this world has been judged.
16.bbe: Of being judged, because the ruler of this world has been judged.

16.msb: I still have much to tell you, but you cannot yet bear to hear it.
16.kjv: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
16.blb: I still have many things to say to you, but you are not able to bear them now.
16.bbe: I have still much to say to you, but you are not strong enough for it now.

16.msb: However, when the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all truth. For He will not speak on His own, but He will speak what He hears, and He will declare to you what is to come.
16.kjv: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
16.blb: But when He, the Spirit of truth, shall come, He will guide you into all the truth. For He will not speak from Himself, but whatever He may hear, He will speak. And He will declare to you the things coming.
16.bbe: However, when he, the Spirit of true knowledge, has come, he will be your guide into all true knowledge: for his words will not come from himself, but whatever has come to his hearing, that he will say: and he will make clear to you the things to come.

16.msb: He will glorify Me by taking from what is Mine and disclosing it to you.
16.kjv: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
16.blb: He will glorify Me, for He will take from that which is Mine and will declare it to you.
16.bbe: He will give me glory, because he will take of what is mine, and make it clear to you.

16.msb: Everything that belongs to the Father is Mine. That is why I said that the Spirit will take from what is Mine and disclose it to you.
16.kjv: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
16.blb: All things, as many as the Father has, are Mine. Because of this, I said that He will take from that which is Mine and will declare it to you.
16.bbe: Everything which the Father has is mine: that is why I say, He will take of what is mine and will make it clear to you.

16.msb: In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me, because I am going away to the Father.”
16.kjv: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
16.blb: A little while and you see Me no longer; and again a little while and you will look on Me.”
16.bbe: After a little time you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me.

16.msb: Then some of His disciples asked one another, “Why is He telling us, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’ and ‘Because I am going to the Father’?”
16.kjv: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
16.blb: Therefore some of His disciples said to one another, “What is this that He says to us, ‘A little while and you do not see Me; and again a little while and you will look on Me,’ and ‘Because I am going to the Father’?”
16.bbe: So some of the disciples said one to another, What is this he is saying, After a little time, you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me? and, I am going to the Father?
16.heading: Grief Will Turn to Joy

16.msb: They kept asking, “Why is He saying, ‘a little while’? We do not understand what He is saying.”
16.kjv: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
16.blb: Therefore they were saying, “What is this that He says, ‘A little while’? We do not know what He is saying.”
16.bbe: So they said again and again, What is this he is saying, A little time? His words are not clear to us.

16.msb: Aware that they wanted to question Him, Jesus said to them, “Are you asking one another why I said, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’?
16.kjv: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
16.blb: Jesus knew that they were wanting to ask Him, and He said to them, “Do you inquire among one another concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while and you do not see Me, and again a little while and you will look on Me’?
16.bbe: Jesus saw that they had a desire to put the question to him, so he said to them, Is this what you are questioning one with another, why I said, After a little time, you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me?

16.msb: Truly, truly, I tell you, you will weep and wail while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.
16.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
16.blb: Truly, truly, I say to you that you will weep and will lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be grieved, but your grief will turn to joy.
16.bbe: Truly I say to you, You will be weeping and sorrowing, but the world will be glad: you will be sad, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

16.msb: A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come; but when she brings forth her child, she forgets her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.
16.kjv: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
16.blb: The woman has pain when she is giving birth, because her hour has come; but when she brings forth the child, she remembers the tribulation no longer, because of the joy that a man has been born into the world.
16.bbe: When a woman is about to give birth she has sorrow, because her hour is come; but when she has given birth to the child, the pain is put out of her mind by the joy that a man has come into the world.

16.msb: So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.
16.kjv: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
16.blb: Therefore you also indeed have grief now; but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy from you.
16.bbe: So you have sorrow now: but I will see you again, and your hearts will be glad, and no one will take away your joy.

16.msb: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Truly, truly, I tell you, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
16.kjv: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
16.blb: And in that day you will ask of Me nothing. Truly, truly, I say to you, whatever you may ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
16.bbe: And on that day you will put no questions to me. Truly I say to you, Whatever request you make to the Father, he will give it to you in my name.
16.heading: Ask in My Name

16.msb: Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.
16.kjv: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
16.blb: Until now you have asked nothing in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be full.
16.bbe: Up to now you have made no request in my name: do so, and it will be answered, so that your hearts may be full of joy.

16.msb: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But an hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you this way, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
16.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
16.blb: I have spoken these things to you in allegories; an hour is coming when I will speak to you no more in allegories, but I will report to you plainly concerning the Father.
16.bbe: All this I have said to you in veiled language: but the time is coming when I will no longer say things in veiled language but will give you knowledge of the Father clearly.

16.msb: In that day you will ask in My name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.
16.kjv: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
16.blb: In that day you will ask in My name, and I do not say to you that I will implore the Father for you.
16.bbe: In that day you will make requests in my name: and I do not say that I will make prayer to the Father for you,

16.msb: For the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came from God.
16.kjv: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
16.blb: For the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came forth from God.
16.bbe: For the Father himself gives his love to you, because you have given your love to me and have had faith that I came from God.

16.msb: I came from the Father and entered the world. In turn, I will leave the world and go to the Father.”
16.kjv: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
16.blb: I came forth from the Father and have come into the world; again I leave the world and go to the Father.”
16.bbe: I came out from the Father and have come into the world: again, I go away from the world and go to the Father.

16.msb: His disciples said to Him, “See, now You are speaking plainly and without figures of speech.
16.kjv: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
16.blb: His disciples say, “Behold, now You speak in openness, and You do not speak allegory.
16.bbe: His disciples said, Now you are talking clearly and not in veiled language.

16.msb: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You. Because of this, we believe that You came from God.”
16.kjv: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
16.blb: Now we know that You know all things and have no need that anyone should ask You. In this we believe that You came forth from God.”
16.bbe: Now we are certain that you have knowledge of all things and have no need for anyone to put questions to you: through this we have faith that you came from God.

16.msb: “Do you finally believe?” Jesus replied.
16.kjv: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
16.blb: Jesus answered them, “Now do you believe?
16.bbe: Jesus made answer, Have you faith now?

16.msb: “Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.
16.kjv: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
16.blb: Behold, an hour is coming and has come when you shall be scattered, each to his own, and Me you shall leave alone. Yet I am not alone, for the Father is with Me.
16.bbe: See, a time is coming, yes, it is now here, when you will go away in all directions, every man to his house, and I will be by myself: but I am not by myself, because the Father is with me.

16.msb: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”
16.kjv: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
16.blb: I have spoken these things to you so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”
16.bbe: I have said all these things to you so that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble: but take heart! I have overcome the world.

17.msb: When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may also glorify You.
17.kjv: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:
17.blb: Jesus spoke these things, and having lifted up His eyes to heaven, He said, “Father, the hour has come; glorify Your Son, that the Son may glorify You,
17.bbe: Jesus said these things; then, lifting his eyes to heaven, he said, Father, the time has now come; give glory to your Son, so that the Son may give glory to you:
17.heading: Prayer for the Son

17.msb: For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He will give eternal life to all those You have given Him.
17.kjv: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
17.blb: as You gave to Him authority over all flesh, so that all whom You have given to Him, He may give to them eternal life.
17.bbe: Even as you gave him authority over all flesh, to give eternal life to all those whom you have given to him.

17.msb: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
17.kjv: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
17.blb: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You sent.
17.bbe: And this is eternal life: to have knowledge of you, the only true God, and of him whom you have sent, even Jesus Christ.

17.msb: I have glorified You on earth. I have accomplished the work You gave Me to do.
17.kjv: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
17.blb: I glorified You on the earth, having completed the work that You have given to Me that I should do.
17.bbe: I have given you glory on the earth, having done all the work which you gave me to do.

17.msb: And now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed.
17.kjv: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
17.blb: And now, glorify Me—You, Father, with Yourself—with the glory that I had with You before the world existed.
17.bbe: And now, Father, let me have glory with you, even that glory which I had with you before the world was.

17.msb: I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.
17.kjv: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
17.blb: I revealed Your name to the men whom You gave to Me out of the world. They were Yours, and to Me You gave them, and they have kept Your word.
17.bbe: I have given knowledge of your name to the men whom you gave me out of the world: yours they were, and you gave them to me, and they have kept your words.
17.heading: Prayer for the Disciples

17.msb: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.
17.kjv: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
17.blb: Now they have known that all things, as many as You have given to Me, are from You.
17.bbe: Now it is clear to them that whatever you have given to me comes from you:

17.msb: For I have given them the words You gave Me, and they have received them. They knew with certainty that I came from You, and they believed that You sent Me.
17.kjv: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
17.blb: For the words that You gave to Me, I have given to them, and they received them, and they knew truly that I came forth from You; and they believed that You sent Me.
17.bbe: Because I have given them the words which you gave to me; and they have taken them to heart, and have certain knowledge that I came from you, and they have faith that you sent me.

17.msb: I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.
17.kjv: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
17.blb: I ask concerning them. I do not ask concerning the world, but concerning those whom You have given to Me, for they are Yours.
17.bbe: My prayer is for them: my prayer is not for the world, but for those whom you have given to me, because they are yours

17.msb: All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified.
17.kjv: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.
17.blb: And all things of Mine are Yours, and Yours Mine, and I have been glorified in them.
17.bbe: (All mine are yours, and yours are mine) and I have glory in them.

17.msb: I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.
17.kjv: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.
17.blb: And I am no longer in the world, and they are themselves in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, keep them in Your name, which You have given to Me, so that they may be one as We are.
17.bbe: And now I will be no longer in the world, but they are in the world and I come to you. Holy Father, keep them in your name which you have given to me, so that they may be one even as we are one.

17.msb: While I was with them in the world, I protected and preserved by Your name those You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.
17.kjv: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
17.blb: When I was with them, I was keeping them in Your name, which You have given to Me. And I guarded them, and none of them perished except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
17.bbe: While I was with them I kept them safe in your name which you have given to me: I took care of them and not one of them has come to destruction, but only the son of destruction, so that the Writings might come true.

17.msb: But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.
17.kjv: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
17.blb: But now I am coming to You, and I speak these things in the world so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.
17.bbe: And now I come to you; and these things I say in the world so that they may have my joy complete in them.

17.msb: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them. For they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
17.kjv: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
17.blb: I have given to them Your word, and the world hated them, because they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
17.bbe: I have given your word to them; and they are hated by the world, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

17.msb: I am not asking that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from the evil one.
17.kjv: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.
17.blb: I do not ask that You would take them out of the world, but that You would keep them from evil.
17.bbe: My prayer is not that you will take them out of the world, but that you will keep them from the Evil One.

17.msb: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
17.kjv: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
17.blb: They are not of the world, as I am not of the world.
17.bbe: They are not of the world any more than I am of the world.

17.msb: Sanctify them by Your truth; Your word is truth.
17.kjv: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
17.blb: Sanctify them in the truth; Your word is truth.
17.bbe: Make them holy by the true word: your word is the true word.

17.msb: As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.
17.kjv: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
17.blb: As You sent Me into the world, I also sent them into the world;
17.bbe: Even as you have sent me into the world, so I have sent them into the world.

17.msb: For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth.
17.kjv: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
17.blb: and for them I sanctify Myself, so that they also may be sanctified in truth.
17.bbe: And for them I make myself holy, so that they may be made truly holy.

17.msb: I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message,
17.kjv: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
17.blb: But I do not ask for these only, but also for those believing in Me through their word,
17.bbe: My prayer is not for them only, but for all who will have faith in me through their word;
17.heading: Prayer for All Believers

17.msb: that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be one in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.
17.kjv: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
17.blb: that all may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I in You, that they also may be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.
17.bbe: May they all be one! Even as you, Father, are in me and I am in you, so let them be in us, so that all men may come to have faith that you sent me.

17.msb: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—
17.kjv: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
17.blb: And I have given to them the glory that You have given to Me, so that they may be one as We are one—
17.bbe: And the glory which you have given to me I have given to them, so that they may be one even as we are one;

17.msb: I in them and You in Me—that they may be perfectly united and that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me.
17.kjv: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
17.blb: I in them and You in Me—so that they may be perfected in unity, so that the world may know that You sent Me and loved them even as You loved Me.
17.bbe: I in them, and you in me, so that they may be made completely one, and so that it may become clear to all men that you have sent me and that they are loved by you as I am loved by you.

17.msb: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
17.kjv: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
17.blb: Father, those whom You have given to Me, I want that they also may be with Me where I am, so that they may behold My glory that You have given to Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
17.bbe: Father, it is my desire that these whom you have given to me may be by my side where I am, so that they may see my glory which you have given to me, because you had love for me before the world came into being.

17.msb: Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.
17.kjv: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
17.blb: Righteous Father, although the world did not know You, yet I knew You, and these knew that You sent Me.
17.bbe: Father of righteousness, I have knowledge of you, though the world has not; and to these it is clear that you sent me;

17.msb: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.”
17.kjv: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
17.blb: And I made known to them Your name and will make it known, so that the love with which You loved Me may be in them, and I in them.”
17.bbe: And I have given to them knowledge of your name, and will give it, so that the love which you have for me may be in them and I in them.

18.msb: After Jesus had spoken these words, He went out with His disciples across the Kidron Valley, where they entered a garden.
18.kjv: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
18.blb: Having said these things, Jesus went out with His disciples beyond the Brook of Kidron, where there was a garden into which He and His disciples entered.
18.bbe: When Jesus had said these words he went out with his disciples over the stream Kedron to a garden, into which he went with his disciples.
18.heading: The Betrayal of Jesus

18.msb: Now Judas His betrayer also knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with His disciples.
18.kjv: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
18.blb: Now Judas, who is delivering Him up, also knew the place, because Jesus often gathered together there with His disciples.
18.bbe: And Judas, who was false to him, had knowledge of the place because Jesus went there frequently with his disciples.

18.msb: So Judas brought a band of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees. They arrived at the garden carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.
18.kjv: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
18.blb: Therefore Judas, having procured the cohort and officers from the chief priests and from the Pharisees, comes there with lanterns and torches and weapons.
18.bbe: So Judas, getting a band of armed men and police from the chief priests and Pharisees, went there with lights and with arms.

18.msb: Jesus, knowing all that was coming upon Him, stepped forward and asked them, “Whom are you seeking?”
18.kjv: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
18.blb: Jesus, therefore, knowing all things that are coming upon Him, having gone out, also said to them, “Whom do you seek?”
18.bbe: Then Jesus, having knowledge of everything which was coming on him, went forward and said to them, Who are you looking for?

18.msb: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered. Jesus said, “I am He.” And Judas His betrayer was standing there with them.
18.kjv: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
18.blb: They answered Him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” He says to them, “I am He.” Now Judas, who is delivering Him up, also had been standing with them.
18.bbe: Their answer was, Jesus the Nazarene. Jesus said, I am he. And Judas, who was false to him, was there at their side.

18.msb: When Jesus said, “I am He,” they drew back and fell to the ground.
18.kjv: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
18.blb: Therefore when He said to them, “I am He,” they drew toward the back and fell to the ground.
18.bbe: And when he said to them, I am he, they went back, falling to the earth.

18.msb: So He asked them again, “Whom are you seeking?” “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered.
18.kjv: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
18.blb: Again, therefore, He questioned them, “Whom do you seek?” And they said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”
18.bbe: So again he put the question to them, Who are you looking for? And they said, Jesus the Nazarene.

18.msb: “I told you that I am He,” Jesus replied. “So if you are looking for Me, let these men go.”
18.kjv: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
18.blb: Jesus answered, “I said to you that I am He. Therefore if you seek Me, allow these to go away,”
18.bbe: Jesus made answer, I have said that I am he; if you are looking for me, let these men go away.

18.msb: This was to fulfill the word He had spoken: “I have not lost one of those You have given Me.”
18.kjv: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
18.blb: so that the word that He had spoken might be fulfilled: “Those whom You have given Me, I did not lose any of them, not one.”
18.bbe: (He said this so that his words might come true, I have kept safe all those whom you gave to me.)

18.msb: Then Simon Peter drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
18.kjv: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
18.blb: Then Simon Peter, having a sword, drew it and struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his right ear. Now the servant’s name was Malchus.
18.bbe: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, took it out and gave the high priest's servant a blow, cutting off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

18.msb: “Put your sword back in its sheath!” Jesus said to Peter. “Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given Me?”
18.kjv: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
18.blb: Therefore Jesus said to Peter, “Put the sword into the sheath! The cup that the Father has given Me, shall I not drink it?”
18.bbe: Then Jesus said to Peter, Put back your sword: am I not to take the cup which my Father has given to me?

18.msb: Then the band of soldiers, with its commander and the officers of the Jews, arrested Jesus and bound Him.
18.kjv: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
18.blb: Then the cohort and the commander and the officers of the Jews took hold of Jesus and bound Him.
18.bbe: Then the band and the chief captain and the police took Jesus and put cords round him.

18.msb: They led Him away first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.
18.kjv: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
18.blb: And they led Him away to Annas first; for he was father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was high priest the same year.
18.bbe: They took him first to Annas, because Annas was the father-in-law of Caiaphas who was the high priest that year.

18.msb: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it would be better if one man perished for the people.
18.kjv: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
18.blb: Now Caiaphas was the one having given counsel to the Jews that it is profitable for one man to perish for the people.
18.bbe: It was Caiaphas who had said to the Jews that it was in their interest for one man to be put to death for the people.

18.msb: Now Simon Peter and the other disciple were following Jesus. Since that disciple was known to the high priest, he also went with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest.
18.kjv: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
18.blb: And Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Now since that disciple was known to the high priest, he also entered with Jesus into the court of the high priest.
18.bbe: And Simon Peter went after Jesus with another disciple. Now that disciple was a friend of the high priest and he went in with Jesus into the house of the high priest;
18.heading: Peter’s First Denial

18.msb: But Peter stood outside at the door. Then the disciple who was known to the high priest went out and spoke to the doorkeeper, and brought Peter in.
18.kjv: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
18.blb: But Peter stood at the door outside. Therefore the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to the doorkeeper and brought in Peter.
18.bbe: But Peter was kept outside at the door. Then this other disciple, who was a friend of the high priest, came out and had a word with the girl who kept the door, and took Peter in.

18.msb: At this, the servant girl watching the door said to Peter, “Aren’t you also one of this man’s disciples?” “I am not,” he answered.
18.kjv: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man’s disciples? He saith, I am not.
18.blb: Therefore the servant girl, the doorkeeper, says to Peter, “Are you not also of the disciples of this man?” He says, “I am not.”
18.bbe: Then the girl who was the door-keeper said to Peter, Are you not one of this man's disciples? In answer he said, I am not.

18.msb: Because it was cold, the servants and officers were standing around a charcoal fire they had made to keep warm. And Peter was standing with them, warming himself.
18.kjv: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
18.blb: Now the servants and the officers were standing, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold and they were warming themselves. And Peter was also standing with them and warming himself.
18.bbe: Now the servants and the police had made a fire of coals because it was cold; they were warming themselves in front of it and Peter was there with them, warming himself.

18.msb: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about His disciples and His teaching.
18.kjv: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
18.blb: Then the high priest questioned Jesus concerning His disciples and concerning His teaching.
18.bbe: Then the high priest put questions to Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.
18.heading: Jesus before the High Priest

18.msb: “I have spoken openly to the world,” Jesus answered. “I always taught in the synagogues and at the temple, where the Jews always come together. I said nothing in secret.
18.kjv: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
18.blb: Jesus answered him, “I have spoken openly to the world. I always taught in the synagogue and in the temple, where all the Jews come together; and I spoke nothing in secret.
18.bbe: Jesus made answer, I said things openly to the world at all times; I have given my teaching in the Synagogues and in the Temple to which all the Jews come; and I have said nothing secretly.

18.msb: Why are you asking Me? Ask those who heard My message. Surely they know what I said.”
18.kjv: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
18.blb: Why do you question Me? Question those having heard what I spoke to them. Behold, they know what I said.”
18.bbe: Why are you questioning me? put questions to my hearers about what I have said to them: they have knowledge of what I said.

18.msb: When Jesus had said this, one of the officers standing nearby slapped Him in the face and said, “Is this how You answer the high priest?”
18.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
18.blb: Now on His having said these things, one of the officers standing by gave a slap to Jesus, having said, “Do You answer the high priest thus?”
18.bbe: When he said this, one of the police by his side gave him a blow with his open hand, saying, Do you give such an answer to the high priest?

18.msb: Jesus replied, “If I said something wrong, testify as to what was wrong. But if I spoke correctly, why did you strike Me?”
18.kjv: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
18.blb: Jesus answered him, “If I spoke evil, testify concerning the evil; but if rightly, why do you strike Me?”
18.bbe: Jesus said in answer, If I have said anything evil, give witness to the evil: but if I said what is true, why do you give me blows?

18.msb: Then Annas sent Him, still bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.
18.kjv: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
18.blb: Then Annas sent Him, bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.
18.bbe: Then Annas sent him chained to Caiaphas, the high priest.

18.msb: Simon Peter was still standing and warming himself. So they asked him, “Aren’t you also one of His disciples?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
18.kjv: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
18.blb: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. Therefore they said to him, “Are you not also one of His disciples?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
18.bbe: But Simon Peter was still there warming himself by the fire. They said to him, Are you not one of his disciples? He said, No, I am not.
18.heading: Peter’s Second and Third Denials

18.msb: One of the high priest’s servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, asked, “Didn’t I see you with Him in the garden?”
18.kjv: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
18.blb: One of the servants of the high priest, being a kinsman of him whose ear Peter had cut off, says, “Did I not see you in the garden with Him?”
18.bbe: One of the servants of the high priest, a relation of him whose ear had been cut off by Peter, said, Did I not see you with him in the garden?

18.msb: Peter denied it once more, and immediately a rooster crowed.
18.kjv: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
18.blb: Again, then, Peter denied it, and immediately a rooster crowed.
18.bbe: Then again Peter said, No. And straight away a cock gave its cry.

18.msb: Then they led Jesus away from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. By now it was early morning, and the Jews did not enter the Praetorium, to avoid being defiled and unable to eat the Passover.
18.kjv: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
18.blb: Then they are leading Jesus from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. Now it was early, and they did not enter into the Praetorium, so that they should not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.
18.bbe: So they took Jesus from the house of Caiaphas to the Praetorium. It was early. They themselves did not go into the Praetorium, so that they might not become unclean, but might take the Passover.
18.heading: Jesus before Pilate

18.msb: So Pilate went out to them and asked, “What accusation are you bringing against this man?”
18.kjv: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?
18.blb: Therefore Pilate went forth out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”
18.bbe: So Pilate came out to them and put the question: What have you to say against this man?

18.msb: “If He were not a criminal,” they replied, “we would not have handed Him over to you.”
18.kjv: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
18.blb: They answered and said to him, “If He were not doing evil, we would not have delivered Him up to you.”
18.bbe: They said to him in answer, If the man was not a wrongdoer we would not have given him up to you.

18.msb: “You take Him and judge Him by your own law,” Pilate told them. “We are not permitted to execute anyone,” the Jews then replied.
18.kjv: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
18.blb: Therefore Pilate said to them, “Take Him yourselves and judge Him according to your law.” The Jews said to him, “It is not permitted to us to put anyone to death,”
18.bbe: Then Pilate said to them, Take him yourselves and let him be judged by your law. But the Jews said to him, We have no right to put any man to death.

18.msb: This was to fulfill the word that Jesus had spoken to indicate the kind of death He was going to die.
18.kjv: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
18.blb: so that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which He said signifying what death He was about to die.
18.bbe: (That the word of Jesus might come true, pointing to the sort of death he would have.)

18.msb: Pilate went back into the Praetorium, summoned Jesus, and asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?”
18.kjv: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
18.blb: Therefore Pilate entered again into the Praetorium, and he called Jesus and said to Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?”
18.bbe: Then Pilate went back into the Praetorium and sent for Jesus and said to him, Are you the King of the Jews?

18.msb: “Are you saying this on your own,” Jesus asked him, “or did others tell you about Me?”
18.kjv: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
18.blb: Jesus answered, “Do you say this from yourself, or did others say it to you concerning Me?”
18.bbe: Jesus made answer, Do you say this of yourself, or did others say it about me?

18.msb: “Am I a Jew?” Pilate replied. “Your own people and chief priests handed You over to me. What have You done?”
18.kjv: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
18.blb: Pilate answered, “Am I a Jew? Your nation and the chief priests delivered You up to me. What did You do?”
18.bbe: Pilate said, Am I a Jew? Your nation and the chief priests have given you into my hands: what have you done?

18.msb: Jesus answered, “My kingdom is not of this world; if it were, My servants would fight to prevent My arrest by the Jews. But now My kingdom is not of this realm.”
18.kjv: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
18.blb: Jesus answered, “My kingdom is not of this world; if My kingdom were of this world, My attendants would fight so that I would not be delivered up to the Jews. But now My kingdom is not from here.”
18.bbe: Jesus said in answer, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom was of this world, my disciples would have made a good fight to keep me out of the hands of the Jews: but my kingdom is not here.

18.msb: “Then You are a king!” Pilate said. “You say that I am a king,” Jesus answered. “For this reason I was born and have come into the world, to testify to the truth. Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to My voice.”
18.kjv: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
18.blb: Therefore Pilate said to Him, “Then You are a king!” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this I have been born, and for this I have come into the world, so that I may testify to the truth. Everyone being of the truth hears My voice.”
18.bbe: Then Pilate said to him, Are you then a king? Jesus made answer, You say that I am a king. For this purpose was I given birth, and for this purpose I came into the world, that I might give witness to what is true. Every lover of what is true gives ear to my voice.

18.msb: “What is truth?” Pilate asked. And having said this, he went out again to the Jews and told them, “I find no basis for a charge against Him.
18.kjv: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
18.blb: Pilate says to Him, “What is truth?” And having said this, he went out again to the Jews and says to them, “I find no guilt in Him.
18.bbe: Pilate said to him, True? what is true? Having said this he went out again to the Jews and said to them, I see no wrong in him.

18.msb: But it is your custom that I release to you one prisoner at the Passover. So then, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
18.kjv: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
18.blb: But it is your custom that I should release to you one at the Passover; therefore do you wish that I should release to you the King of the Jews?”
18.bbe: But every year you make a request to me to let a prisoner go free at the Passover. Is it your desire that I let the King of the Jews go free?

18.msb: “Not this man,” they all shouted, “but Barabbas!” (Now Barabbas was an insurrectionist.)
18.kjv: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
18.blb: Then they cried out again, saying, “Not this one, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
18.bbe: Then again they gave a loud cry, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was an outlaw.

19.msb: Then Pilate took Jesus and had Him flogged.
19.kjv: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
19.blb: So at that time Pilate took Jesus and flogged Him.
19.bbe: Then Pilate took Jesus and had him whipped with cords.
19.heading: The Soldiers Mock Jesus

19.msb: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns, set it on His head, and dressed Him in a purple robe.
19.kjv: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
19.blb: And the soldiers, having twisted together a crown of thorns, put it on His head and cast around Him a purple garment.
19.bbe: And the men of the army made a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and they put a purple robe on him.

19.msb: And they kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and slapping Him in the face.
19.kjv: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.
19.blb: And they were coming up to Him and saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” And they kept giving Him slaps.
19.bbe: And they kept coming and saying, Long life to the King of the Jews! And they gave him blows with their hands.

19.msb: Once again Pilate came out and said to the Jews, “Look, I am bringing Him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against Him.”
19.kjv: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.
19.blb: And Pilate went forth outside again, and he says to them, “Behold, I bring Him out to you so that you may know that I find no guilt in Him.”
19.bbe: And Pilate went out again and said to them, See, I let him come out to you to make it clear to you that I see no wrong in him.

19.msb: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, “Here is the man!”
19.kjv: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!
19.blb: Therefore Jesus went forth outside, wearing the thorny crown and the purple garment. And he says to them, “Behold the man!”
19.bbe: Then Jesus came out with the crown of thorns and the purple robe. And Pilate said to them, Here is the man!

19.msb: As soon as the chief priests and officers saw Him, they shouted, “Crucify Him! Crucify Him!” “You take Him and crucify Him,” Pilate replied, “for I find no basis for a charge against Him.”
19.kjv: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.
19.blb: Therefore when the chief priests and the officers saw Him, they cried out, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate says to them, “Take Him yourselves and crucify Him, for I find no guilt in Him.”
19.bbe: So when the chief priests and the police saw him they gave a loud cry, To the cross! to the cross! Pilate said to them, Take him yourselves and put him on the cross: I see no crime in him.

19.msb: “We have a law,” answered the Jews, “and according to our law He must die, because He declared Himself to be the Son of God.”
19.kjv: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
19.blb: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and according to the law He ought to die, because He made Himself the Son of God.”
19.bbe: And the Jews made answer, We have a law, and by that law it is right for him to be put to death because he said he was the Son of God.

19.msb: When Pilate heard this statement, he was even more afraid,
19.kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
19.blb: Therefore when Pilate heard this word, he was even more afraid.
19.bbe: When this saying came to Pilate's ears his fear became greater;

19.msb: and he went back into the Praetorium. “Where are You from?” he asked. But Jesus gave no answer.
19.kjv: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
19.blb: And he went into the Praetorium again, and he says to Jesus, “Where are You from?” But Jesus did not give him an answer.
19.bbe: And he went again into the Praetorium and said to Jesus, Where do you come from? But Jesus gave him no answer.

19.msb: So Pilate said to Him, “Do You refuse to speak to me? Do You not know that I have authority to crucify You and authority to release You?”
19.kjv: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
19.blb: Therefore Pilate says to Him, “Do You not speak to me? Do You not know that I have authority to release You, and I have authority to crucify You?”
19.bbe: Then Pilate said to him, You say nothing to me? is it not clear to you that I have power to let you go free and power to put you to death on the cross?

19.msb: Jesus answered, “You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you is guilty of greater sin.”
19.kjv: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
19.blb: Jesus answered him, “You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Because of this, the one having delivered Me up to you has greater sin.”
19.bbe: Jesus gave this answer: You would have no power at all over me if it was not given to you by God; so that he who gave me up to you has the greater sin.

19.msb: From then on, Pilate tried to release Him, but the Jews kept crying out, “If you release this man, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who declares himself a king is defying Caesar.”
19.kjv: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Cæsar’s friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Cæsar.
19.blb: From this time Pilate was seeking to release Him; but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you are not a friend of Caesar. Everyone making himself a king speaks against Caesar.”
19.bbe: Hearing this, Pilate had a desire to let him go free, but the Jews said in a loud voice, If you let this man go, you are not Caesar's friend: everyone who makes himself a king goes against Caesar.

19.msb: When Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat on the judgment seat at a place called the Stone Pavement, which in Hebrew is Gabbatha.
19.kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
19.blb: Therefore Pilate, having heard these words, brought Jesus out and sat down upon the judgment seat at a place called The Stone Pavement, and in Hebrew, Gabbatha.
19.bbe: So when these words came to Pilate's ear, he took Jesus out, seating himself in the judge's seat in a place named in Hebrew, Gabbatha, or the Stone Floor.

19.msb: It was the day of Preparation for the Passover, about the sixth hour. And Pilate said to the Jews, “Here is your King!”
19.kjv: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!
19.blb: Now it was the Preparation of the Passover; it was about the sixth hour. And he says to the Jews, “Behold your King!”
19.bbe: (It was the day when they made ready for the Passover; and it was about the sixth hour.) And he said to the Jews, There is your King!

19.msb: At this, they shouted, “Away with Him! Away with Him! Crucify Him!” “Shall I crucify your King?” Pilate asked. “We have no king but Caesar,” replied the chief priests.
19.kjv: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cæsar.
19.blb: So they cried out, “Away with Him, away! Crucify Him!” Pilate says to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king except Caesar.”
19.bbe: Then they gave a loud cry, Away with him! away with him! to the cross! Pilate said to them, Am I to put your King to death on the cross? The chief priests said in answer, We have no king but Caesar.

19.msb: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be crucified, and the soldiers took Him and led Him away.
19.kjv: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.
19.blb: So then he delivered Him to them so that He might be crucified. Therefore they took Jesus.
19.bbe: So then he gave him up to them to be put to death on the cross. And they took Jesus away;
19.heading: The Crucifixion

19.msb: Carrying His own cross, He went out to a place called The Place of the Skull, which in Hebrew is called Golgotha.
19.kjv: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
19.blb: And bearing His own cross, He went out to the place called Place of the Skull, which in Hebrew is called Golgotha,
19.bbe: And he went out with his cross on him to the place which is named Dead Man's Head (in Hebrew, Golgotha):

19.msb: There they crucified Him, and with Him two others, one on each side, with Jesus in the middle.
19.kjv: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
19.blb: where they crucified Him, and with Him two others, on this side and on that side, and Jesus in between.
19.bbe: Where they put him on the cross with two others, one on this side and one on that, and Jesus in the middle.

19.msb: Pilate also had a notice posted on the cross. It read: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
19.kjv: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.
19.blb: And Pilate also wrote a title and put it on the cross. And it was written: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
19.bbe: And Pilate put on the cross a statement in writing. The writing was: JESUS THE NAZARENE, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

19.msb: Many of the Jews read this sign, because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and it was written in Hebrew, Greek, and Latin.
19.kjv: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
19.blb: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.
19.bbe: The writing was seen by a number of the Jews, for the place where Jesus was put to death on the cross was near the town; and the writing was in Hebrew and Latin and Greek.

19.msb: So the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, “Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but only that He said, ‘I am the King of the Jews.’”
19.kjv: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.
19.blb: Therefore the chief priests of the Jews were saying to Pilate, “Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but that He said, ‘I am King of the Jews.’”
19.bbe: Then the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, Do not put, The King of the Jews, but, He said, I am the King of the Jews.

19.msb: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
19.kjv: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
19.blb: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
19.bbe: But Pilate made answer, What I have put in writing will not be changed.

19.msb: When the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they divided His garments into four parts, one for each soldier, with the tunic remaining. It was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.
19.kjv: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
19.blb: Then the soldiers, when they crucified Jesus, took His garments and made four parts, to each soldier a part, and also the tunic. Now the tunic was seamless, woven from the top all throughout.
19.bbe: And when Jesus was nailed to the cross, the men of the army took his clothing, and made a division of it into four parts, to every man a part, and they took his coat: now the coat was without a join, made out of one bit of cloth.

19.msb: So they said to one another, “Let us not tear it. Instead, let us cast lots to see who will get it.” This was to fulfill the Scripture: “They divided My garments among them, and cast lots for My clothing.” So that is what the soldiers did.
19.kjv: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
19.blb: Therefore they said to one another, “Let us not tear it, but let us cast a lot for it, whose it will be,” so that the Scripture would be fulfilled, the one saying: “They divided My garments among them, and for My clothing they cast a lot.” Therefore indeed the soldiers did these things.
19.bbe: So they said among themselves, Let this not be cut up, but let us put it to the decision of chance and see who gets it. (They did this so that the Writings might come true, which say, They made a distribution of my clothing among them, and my coat they put to the decision of chance.) This was what the men of the army did.

19.msb: Near the cross of Jesus stood His mother and her sister, as well as Mary the wife of Clopas and Mary Magdalene.
19.kjv: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
19.blb: Now His mother, and the sister of His mother, and Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene had been standing by the cross of Jesus.
19.bbe: Now by the side of the cross of Jesus were his mother, and his mother's sister Mary, the wife of Cleopas, and Mary Magdalene.

19.msb: When Jesus saw His mother and the disciple whom He loved standing nearby, He said to His mother, “Woman, here is your son.”
19.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!
19.blb: Therefore Jesus, having seen His mother and the disciple whom He loved standing by, says to His mother, “Woman, behold your son.”
19.bbe: So when Jesus saw his mother and the disciple who was dear to him, he said to his mother, Mother, there is your son!

19.msb: Then He said to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” So from that hour, this disciple took her into his home.
19.kjv: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
19.blb: Then He says to the disciple, “Behold your mother.” And from that hour the disciple took her to his own.
19.bbe: Then he said to the disciple, There is your mother! And from that hour the disciple took her to his house.

19.msb: After this, seeing that everything had now been accomplished, and to fulfill the Scripture, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”
19.kjv: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
19.blb: After this, Jesus, knowing that now all things had been accomplished, so that the Scripture might be fulfilled, says, “I thirst.”
19.bbe: After this, being conscious that all things had now been done so that the Writings might come true, Jesus said, Give me water.
19.heading: The Death of Jesus

19.msb: A jar of sour wine was sitting there. So they soaked a sponge in the wine, put it on a stalk of hyssop, and lifted it to His mouth.
19.kjv: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
19.blb: A vessel had been set there, full of sour wine; therefore, having put on a stalk of hyssop a sponge filled with sour wine, they brought it to the mouth.
19.bbe: Now there was a vessel ready, full of bitter wine, and they put a sponge full of it on a stick and put it to his mouth.

19.msb: When Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, “It is finished.” And bowing His head, He yielded up His spirit.
19.kjv: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
19.blb: Therefore when Jesus took the sour wine, He said, “It has been finished.” And having bowed the head, He yielded up the spirit.
19.bbe: So when Jesus had taken the wine he said, All is done. And with his head bent he gave up his spirit.

19.msb: It was the day of Preparation, and the next day was a High Sabbath. In order that the bodies would not remain on the cross during the Sabbath, the Jews asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies removed.
19.kjv: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
19.blb: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation, so that the bodies would not remain on the cross on the Sabbath—for that Sabbath was a high day—asked Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.
19.bbe: Now it was the day of getting ready for the Passover, and so that the bodies might not be on the cross on the Sabbath (because the day of that Sabbath was a great day), the Jews made a request to Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
19.heading: Jesus’ Side Is Pierced

19.msb: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and those of the other.
19.kjv: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
19.blb: So the soldiers came, and indeed they broke the legs of the first, and of the other one having been crucified with Him.
19.bbe: So the men of the army came, and the legs of the first were broken and then of the other who was put to death on the cross with Jesus:

19.msb: But when they came to Jesus and saw that He was already dead, they did not break His legs.
19.kjv: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
19.blb: But having come to Jesus, when they saw Him already having been dead, they did not break His legs.
19.bbe: But when they came to Jesus, they saw that he was dead by this time, and so his legs were not broken;

19.msb: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and immediately blood and water flowed out.
19.kjv: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
19.blb: But one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and blood and water came out immediately.
19.bbe: But one of the men made a wound in his side with a spear, and straight away there came out blood and water.

19.msb: The one who saw it has testified to this, and his testimony is true. He knows that he is telling the truth, so that you may believe.
19.kjv: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
19.blb: And the one having seen has testified, and his testimony is true. And he knows that he is speaking the truth, so that you also might believe.
19.bbe: And he who saw it has given witness (and his witness is true; he is certain that what he says is true) so that you may have belief.

19.msb: Now these things happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of His bones will be broken.”
19.kjv: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
19.blb: For these things took place so that the Scripture might be fulfilled: “Not one bone of Him will be broken.”
19.bbe: These things came about so that the Writings might be true, No bone of his body will be broken.

19.msb: And, as another Scripture says: “They will look on the One they have pierced.”
19.kjv: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
19.blb: And again, another Scripture says: “They will look on the One they pierced.”
19.bbe: And again another verse says, They will see him who was wounded by their spears.

19.msb: Afterward, Joseph of Arimathea, who was a disciple of Jesus (but secretly for fear of the Jews), asked Pilate to let him remove the body of Jesus. Pilate gave him permission, so he came and removed the body of Jesus.
19.kjv: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
19.blb: And after these things, Joseph from Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus (but concealed because of the fear of the Jews) asked Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus; and Pilate gave permission. Therefore he came and took away His body.
19.bbe: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, who was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, made a request to Pilate to let him take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate said he might do so. So he went and took away his body.
19.heading: The Burial of Jesus

19.msb: Nicodemus, who had previously come to Jesus at night, also brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.
