19.kjv: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
19.blb: And Nicodemus, the one having come to Him by night at the first, also came bearing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred litras.
19.bbe: And Nicodemus came (he who had first come to Jesus by night) with a roll of myrrh and aloes mixed, about a hundred pounds.

19.msb: So they took the body of Jesus and wrapped it in linen cloths with the spices, according to the Jewish burial custom.
19.kjv: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
19.blb: Therefore they took the body of Jesus and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as is the custom among the Jews to prepare for burial.
19.bbe: Then they took the body of Jesus, folding linen about it with the spices, as is the way of the Jews when they put the dead to rest.

19.msb: Now there was a garden in the place where Jesus was crucified, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had yet been laid.
19.kjv: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
19.blb: Now there was a garden in the place where He was crucified, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one was yet having been laid.
19.bbe: Now there was a garden near the cross, and in the garden a new place for the dead in which no man had ever been put.

19.msb: And because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and the tomb was nearby, they placed Jesus there.
19.kjv: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews’ preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
19.blb: Therefore because of the Preparation of the Jews and since the tomb was near, they laid Jesus there.
19.bbe: So they put Jesus there, because it was the Jews' day of getting ready for the Passover, and the place was near.

20.msb: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.
20.kjv: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
20.blb: Now on the first of the Sabbaths, Mary Magdalene comes to the tomb early, it being still dark, and she sees the stone having been removed from the tomb.
20.bbe: Now on the first day of the week, very early, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene came to the place and saw that the stone had been taken away from it.
20.heading: The Resurrection

20.msb: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved. “They have taken the Lord out of the tomb,” she said, “and we do not know where they have put Him!”
20.kjv: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
20.blb: Therefore she runs and comes to Simon Peter and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and she says to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we do not know where they laid Him!”
20.bbe: Then she went running to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple who was loved by Jesus, and said to them, They have taken away the Lord out of the place of the dead and we have no knowledge where they have put him.

20.msb: Then Peter and the other disciple set out for the tomb.
20.kjv: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.
20.blb: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out and were coming to the tomb.
20.bbe: So Peter and the other disciple went out to the place of the dead.

20.msb: The two were running together, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.
20.kjv: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
20.blb: And the two were running together, and the other disciple ran ahead faster than Peter and came to the tomb first.
20.bbe: They went running together, and the other disciple got in front of Peter and came first to the hole in the rock;

20.msb: He bent down and looked in at the linen cloths lying there, but he did not go in.
20.kjv: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
20.blb: And having stooped down, he sees the linen cloths lying there, but he did not enter.
20.bbe: And looking in, he saw the linen bands on the earth; but he did not go in,

20.msb: Simon Peter arrived just after him. He entered the tomb and saw the linen cloths lying there.
20.kjv: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
20.blb: Then Simon Peter also comes, following him, and he entered into the tomb and sees the linen cloths lying there,
20.bbe: Then Simon Peter came after him and went into the hole in the rock; and he saw the linen bands on the earth,

20.msb: The cloth that had been around Jesus’ head was rolled up, lying separate from the linen cloths.
20.kjv: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
20.blb: and the soudarion that was upon His head not lying with the linen cloths but having been folded up in a place by itself.
20.bbe: And the cloth, which had been round his head, not with the linen bands but rolled up in a place by itself.

20.msb: Then the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went in. And he saw and believed.
20.kjv: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
20.blb: So then the other disciple, the one having come to the tomb first, also entered; and he saw and believed.
20.bbe: Then the other disciple who came there first went in; and he saw and belief came to him.

20.msb: For they still did not understand from the Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.
20.kjv: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
20.blb: For not yet did they understand the Scripture, that it is necessary for Him to rise out from the dead.
20.bbe: For at that time they had no knowledge that the Writings said that he would have to come again from the dead.

20.msb: Then the disciples returned to their homes.
20.kjv: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
20.blb: Therefore the disciples went away again to their own.
20.bbe: So then the disciples went away again to their houses.
20.heading: Jesus Appears to Mary Magdalene

20.msb: But Mary stood outside the tomb weeping. And as she wept, she bent down to look into the tomb,
20.kjv: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,
20.blb: But Mary stood outside at the tomb weeping. Then as she was weeping, she stooped down into the tomb,
20.bbe: But Mary was still there outside the hole in the rock, weeping; and while she was weeping and looking into the hole,

20.msb: and she saw two angels in white sitting where the body of Jesus had lain, one at the head and the other at the feet.
20.kjv: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
20.blb: and she sees two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
20.bbe: She saw two angels in white seated where the body of Jesus had been, one at the head and the other at the feet.

20.msb: “Woman, why are you weeping?” they asked. “Because they have taken my Lord away,” she said, “and I do not know where they have put Him.”
20.kjv: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.
20.blb: And they say to her, “Woman, why do you weep?” She says to them, “Because they took away my Lord, and I do not know where they laid Him.”
20.bbe: They said to her, Woman, why are you weeping? She said to them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I have no knowledge where they have put him.

20.msb: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there. But she did not recognize that it was Jesus.
20.kjv: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
20.blb: Having said these things, she turned back around, and she sees Jesus standing there, and she had not known that it is Jesus.
20.bbe: And then looking round, she saw Jesus there, but had no idea that it was Jesus.

20.msb: “Woman, why are you weeping?” Jesus asked. “Whom are you seeking?” Thinking He was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried Him off, tell me where you have put Him, and I will get Him.”
20.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
20.blb: Jesus says to her, “Woman, why do you weep? Whom do you seek?” Thinking that He is the gardener, she says to Him, “Sir, if you carried Him off, tell me where you laid Him, and I will take Him away.”
20.bbe: Jesus said to her, Woman, why are you weeping? who are you looking for? She, taking him for the gardener, said to him, Sir, if you have taken him away from here, say where you have put him and I will take him away.

20.msb: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to Him, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).
20.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
20.blb: Jesus says to her, “Mary.” Having turned around, she says to Him in Hebrew, “Rabboni!” (which is to say “Teacher”).
20.bbe: Jesus said to her, Mary! Turning, she said to him in Hebrew, Rabboni! (which is to say, Master).

20.msb: “Do not cling to Me,” Jesus said, “for I have not yet ascended to My Father. But go and tell My brothers, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, to My God and your God.’”
20.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.
20.blb: Jesus says to her, “Do not touch Me, for not yet have I ascended to the Father. But go to My brothers and say to them, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, and to My God and your God.’”
20.bbe: Jesus said to her, Do not put your hand on me, for I have not gone up to the Father: but go to my brothers and say to them, I go up to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.

20.msb: Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples that she had seen the Lord. And she told them what He had said to her.
20.kjv: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.
20.blb: Mary Magdalene comes, bringing word to the disciples: “I have seen the Lord,” and that He had said these things to her.
20.bbe: Mary Magdalene went with the news to the disciples, and said she had seen the Lord and that he had said these things to her.

20.msb: It was the first day of the week, and that very evening, while the disciples were gathered together with the doors locked for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood among them. “Peace be with you!” He said to them.
20.kjv: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
20.blb: Therefore, it being evening the same day, the first of the week, and the doors where the disciples were having been shut because of the fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and He says to them, “Peace to you.”
20.bbe: At evening on that day, the first day of the week, when, for fear of the Jews, the doors were shut where the disciples were, Jesus came among them and said to them, May peace be with you!
20.heading: Jesus Appears to the Disciples

20.msb: After He had said this, He showed them His hands and His side. The disciples rejoiced when they saw the Lord.
20.kjv: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
20.blb: And having said this, He showed both His hands and His side to them. Then the disciples rejoiced, having seen the Lord.
20.bbe: And when he had said this, he let them see his hands and his side. Then the disciples were glad when they saw the Lord.

20.msb: Again Jesus said to them, “Peace be with you. As the Father has sent Me, so also I am sending you.”
20.kjv: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
20.blb: Therefore Jesus said to them again, “Peace to you. As the Father has sent Me forth, I also send you.”
20.bbe: And Jesus said to them again, May peace be with you! As the Father sent me, even so I now send you.

20.msb: When He had said this, He breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
20.kjv: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
20.blb: And having said this, He breathed on them, and He says to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
20.bbe: And when he had said this, breathing on them, he said to them, Let the Holy Spirit come on you:

20.msb: If you forgive anyone his sins, they are forgiven; if you withhold forgiveness from anyone, it is withheld.”
20.kjv: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
20.blb: If you might forgive the sins of any, they are forgiven them; if you might retain any, they are retained.”
20.bbe: Any to whom you give forgiveness, will be made free from their sins; and any from whom you keep back forgiveness, will still be in their sins.

20.msb: Now Thomas called Didymus, one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.
20.kjv: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
20.blb: But Thomas, one of the Twelve, the one called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
20.bbe: Now Thomas, one of the twelve, named Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
20.heading: Jesus Appears to Thomas

20.msb: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he replied, “Unless I see the nail marks in His hands, and put my finger where the nails have been, and put my hand into His side, I will never believe.”
20.kjv: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
20.blb: Therefore the other disciples were saying to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in His hands the mark of the nails, and I put my finger into the mark of the nails, and I put my hands into His side, I will never believe.”
20.bbe: So the other disciples said to him, We have seen the Lord. But he said to them, If I do not see in his hands the print of the nails and put my finger into the print of the nails, and if I do not put my hand into his side, I will never have belief.

20.msb: Eight days later, His disciples were once again inside with the doors locked, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you.”
20.kjv: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.
20.blb: And after eight days His disciples were again inside, and Thomas with them, the doors having been shut. Jesus comes, and He stood in the midst and said, “Peace to you.”
20.bbe: And after eight days, his disciples were again in the house and Thomas was with them. Though the doors were shut, Jesus came, and taking his place in the middle of them, he said, May peace be with you!

20.msb: Then Jesus said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Stop doubting and believe.”
20.kjv: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
20.blb: Then He says to Thomas, “Bring your finger here and see My hands, and bring your hand and put it into My side; and be not unbelieving, but believing.”
20.bbe: Then he said to Thomas, Put out your finger, and see my hands; and put your hand here into my side: and be no longer in doubt but have belief.

20.msb: Thomas replied, “My Lord and my God!”
20.kjv: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.
20.blb: Thomas answered and said to Him, “My Lord and my God!”
20.bbe: And Thomas said in answer, My Lord and my God!

20.msb: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen Me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”
20.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
20.blb: Jesus says to him, “Because you have seen Me, have you believed? Blessed are those not having seen, and having believed.”
20.bbe: Jesus said to him, Because you have seen me you have belief: a blessing will be on those who have belief though they have not seen me!

20.msb: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book.
20.kjv: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
20.blb: Therefore indeed Jesus also did many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book.
20.bbe: A number of other signs Jesus did before his disciples which are not recorded in this book:
20.heading: The Purpose of John’s Book

20.msb: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in His name.
20.kjv: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
20.blb: But these have been written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and so that, believing, you may have life in His name.
20.bbe: But these are recorded, so that you may have faith that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and so that, having this faith you may have life in his name.

21.msb: Later, by the Sea of Tiberias, Jesus again revealed Himself to the disciples. He made Himself known in this way:
21.kjv: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
21.blb: After these things, Jesus revealed Himself again to the disciples at the Sea of Tiberias. Now He revealed Himself in this way:
21.bbe: After these things Jesus let himself be seen again by the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and it came about in this way.
21.heading: Jesus Appears by the Sea of Tiberias

21.msb: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.
21.kjv: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
21.blb: Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael from Cana of Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of His disciples were together.
21.bbe: Simon Peter, Thomas named Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were all together.

21.msb: Simon Peter told them, “I am going fishing.” “We will go with you,” they said. So they went out and immediately got into the boat, but caught nothing that night.
21.kjv: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
21.blb: Simon Peter says to them, “I am going to fish.” They say to him, “We are also coming with you.” They went out and went up into the boat, and in that night they caught nothing.
21.bbe: Simon Peter said to them, I am going fishing. They said to him, And we will come with you. They went out and got into the boat; but that night they took no fish.

21.msb: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not recognize that it was Jesus.
21.kjv: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
21.blb: Now morning already having come, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not know that it is Jesus.
21.bbe: Now very early in the morning Jesus was there by the edge of the sea (though the disciples were not conscious that it was Jesus).

21.msb: So He called out to them, “Children, do you have any fish?” “No,” they answered.
21.kjv: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.
21.blb: Therefore Jesus says to them, “Children, do you have any food?” They answered Him, “No.”
21.bbe: So Jesus said to them, Children, have you taken any fish? They made answer, No.

21.msb: He told them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” So they cast it there, and they were unable to haul it in because of the great number of fish.
21.kjv: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
21.blb: And He said to them, “Cast the net to the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” Therefore they cast, and they were not able to haul it in from the multitude of the fish.
21.bbe: And he said to them, Let down the net on the right side of the boat and you will get some. So they put it in the water and now they were not able to get it up again because of the great number of fish.

21.msb: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It is the Lord!” As soon as Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment (for he had removed it) and jumped into the sea.
21.kjv: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher’s coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
21.blb: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved says to Peter, “It is the Lord!” Therefore Simon Peter, having heard that it is the Lord, put on the outer garment (for he was naked), and he cast himself into the sea.
21.bbe: So the disciple who was dear to Jesus said to Peter, It is the Lord! Hearing that it was the Lord, Peter put his coat round him (because he was not clothed) and went into the sea.

21.msb: The other disciples came ashore in the boat. They dragged in the net full of fish, for they were not far from land, only about a hundred yards.
21.kjv: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
21.blb: And the other disciples came in the boat, dragging the net with the fish, for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away.
21.bbe: And the other disciples came in the little boat (they were not far from land, only about two hundred cubits off) pulling the net full of fish.

21.msb: When they landed, they saw a charcoal fire there with fish on it, and some bread.
21.kjv: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
21.blb: Therefore when they got out onto the land, they see a fire of coals lying, and a fish lying on it, and bread.
21.bbe: When they got to land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish cooking on it, and bread.

21.msb: Jesus told them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”
21.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.
21.blb: Jesus says to them, “Bring some of the fish that you have now caught.”
21.bbe: Jesus said to them, Get some of the fish which you have now taken.

21.msb: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many, the net was not torn.
21.kjv: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
21.blb: Therefore Simon Peter went up and drew the net to the land, full of large fish, a hundred fifty-three. Even there being so many, the net was not torn.
21.bbe: So Peter went to the boat and came back pulling the net to land, full of great fish, a hundred and fifty-three; and though there was such a number the net was not broken.

21.msb: “Come, have breakfast,” Jesus said to them. None of the disciples dared to ask Him, “Who are You?” They knew it was the Lord.
21.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
21.blb: Jesus says to them, “Come, have breakfast.” But none of the disciples dared to ask Him, “Who are You?” knowing that it is the Lord.
21.bbe: Jesus said to them, Come and take some food. And all the disciples were in fear of putting the question, Who are you? being conscious that it was the Lord.

21.msb: Jesus then came and took the bread and gave it to them, and He did the same with the fish.
21.kjv: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.
21.blb: Jesus comes and takes the bread and gives it to them, and the fish likewise.
21.bbe: Then Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and the fish in the same way.

21.msb: This was now the third time that Jesus appeared to His disciples after He was raised from the dead.
21.kjv: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
21.blb: This was now the third time Jesus was revealed to the disciples, having been raised out from the dead.
21.bbe: Now this was the third time that Jesus let himself be seen by the disciples after he had come back from the dead.

21.msb: When they had finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter, “Simon son of Jonah, do you love Me more than these?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus replied, “Feed My lambs.”
21.kjv: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
21.blb: Therefore when they had dined, Jesus says to Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these?” He says to Him, “Yes, Lord, You know that I dearly love You.” He says to him, “Feed My lambs.”
21.bbe: Then when they had taken food, Jesus said to Simon Peter, Simon, son of John, is your love for me greater than the love of these others? He said to him, Yes, Lord; you are certain of my love for you. He said to him, Then give my lambs food.
21.heading: Jesus and Peter

21.msb: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of Jonah, do you love Me?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus told him, “Shepherd My sheep.”
21.kjv: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
21.blb: He says to him again a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” He says to Him, “Yes, Lord, You know that I dearly love You.” He says to him, “Shepherd My sheep.”
21.bbe: Again, a second time, he said to him, Simon, son of John, have you any love for me? Yes, Lord, he said, you are certain of my love for you. Then take care of my sheep, said Jesus.

21.msb: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of Jonah, do you love Me?” Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time, “Do you love Me?” “Lord, You know all things,” he replied. “You know I love You.” Jesus said to him, “Feed My sheep.
21.kjv: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
21.blb: He says to him the third time, “Simon son of John, do you dearly love Me?” Peter was grieved because He said to him the third time, “Do you dearly love Me?” And he said to Him, “Lord, You know all things; You know that I dearly love You.” Jesus says to him, “Feed My sheep.
21.bbe: He said to him a third time, Simon, son of John, am I dear to you? Now Peter was troubled in his heart because he put the question a third time, Am I dear to you? And he said to him, Lord, you have knowledge of all things; you see that you are dear to me. Jesus said to him, Then give my sheep food.

21.msb: Truly, truly, I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted; but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.”
21.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
21.blb: Truly, truly, I say to you, when you were younger, you were girding yourself and were walking where you were wanting; but when you shall be old, you will stretch forth your hands, and another will gird you and will bring you where you do not want.”
21.bbe: Truly I say to you, When you were young, you made yourself ready and went wherever you had a desire to go: but when you are old, you will put out your hands and another will make you ready, and you will be taken where you have no desire to go.

21.msb: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. And after He had said this, He told him, “Follow Me.”
21.kjv: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
21.blb: Now He said this, signifying by what death he will glorify God. And having said this, He says to him, “Follow Me.”
21.bbe: Now this he said, pointing out the sort of death by which he would give God glory. And after saying this, he said to him, Come after me.

21.msb: Peter turned and saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following them. He was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper to ask, “Lord, who is going to betray You?”
21.kjv: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?
21.blb: Having turned, Peter sees the disciple whom Jesus loved following, who also reclined on His bosom at the supper and said, “Lord, who is it who is delivering You up?”
21.bbe: Then Peter, turning round, saw the disciple who was dear to Jesus coming after them — the disciple who was resting on his breast at the last meal, and said, Lord, who is it who will be false to you?
21.heading: Jesus and the Beloved Disciple

21.msb: When Peter saw him, he asked, “Lord, what about him?”
21.kjv: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?
21.blb: Therefore, having seen him, Peter says to Jesus, “Lord, and what about this one?”
21.bbe: Seeing him, Peter said to Jesus, What about this man?

21.msb: Jesus answered, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you? You follow Me!”
21.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
21.blb: Jesus says to him, “If I want him to remain until I come, what is it to you? You follow Me!”
21.bbe: Jesus said to him, If it is my desire for him to be here till I come back, what is that to you? come yourself after me.

21.msb: Because of this, the rumor spread among the brothers that this disciple would not die. However, Jesus did not say that he would not die, but only, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you?”
21.kjv: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?
21.blb: Therefore this saying went out among the brothers that this disciple does not die. But Jesus did not say to him that he does not die, but, “If I want him to remain until I come, what is it to you?”
21.bbe: So this saying went about among the brothers that this disciple would not undergo death: Jesus, however, did not say that he would not undergo death, but, If it is my desire for him to be here till I come back, what is that to you?

21.msb: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who has written them down. And we know that his testimony is true.
21.kjv: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
21.blb: This is the disciple testifying concerning these things, and the one having written these things. And we know that his testimony is true.
21.bbe: This is the disciple who gives witness about these things and who put them in writing: and we have knowledge that his witness is true.

21.msb: There are many more things that Jesus did. If all of them were written down, I suppose that not even the world itself would have space for the books that would be written. Amen.
21.kjv: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
21.blb: Now there are also many other things that Jesus did, which if every one should be written, I suppose not even the world itself will have space for the books being written.
21.bbe: And Jesus did such a number of other things that, if every one was recorded, it is my opinion that even the world itself is not great enough for the books there would be.

1.msb: In my first book, O Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach,
1.kjv: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
1.blb: The first account, indeed, I made concerning all the things, O Theophilus, that Jesus began both to do and to teach,
1.bbe: I have given an earlier account, O Theophilus, of all the things which Jesus did, and of his teaching from the first,
1.heading: Prologue

1.msb: until the day He was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles He had chosen.
1.kjv: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:
1.blb: until the day in which, having given commands through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom He chose, He was taken up,
1.bbe: Till the day when he was taken up to heaven after he had given his orders, through the Holy Spirit, to the Apostles of whom he had made selection:

1.msb: After His suffering, He presented Himself to them with many convincing proofs that He was alive. He appeared to them over a span of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.
1.kjv: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
1.blb: to whom He also presented Himself alive after His suffering, with many convincing proofs, being seen by them through forty days and speaking the things concerning the kingdom of God.
1.bbe: And to whom he gave clear and certain signs that he was living, after his death; for he was seen by them for forty days, and gave them teaching about the kingdom of God:

1.msb: And while they were gathered together, He commanded them: “Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift the Father promised, which you have heard Me discuss.
1.kjv: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.
1.blb: And being assembled together, He instructed them not to depart from Jerusalem, but to await the promise of the Father: “That which you heard of Me;
1.bbe: And when they were all together, with him, he gave them orders not to go away from Jerusalem, but to keep there, waiting till the word of the Father was put into effect, of which, he said, I have given you knowledge:

1.msb: For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
1.kjv: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.
1.blb: for John indeed baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit not many days after these.”
1.bbe: For the baptism of John was with water, but you will have baptism with the Holy Spirit, after a little time.

1.msb: So when they came together, they asked Him, “Lord, will You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?”
1.kjv: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
1.blb: Therefore indeed those having come together were asking Him, saying, “Lord, at this time do You restore the kingdom to Israel?”
1.bbe: So, when they were together, they said to him, Lord, will you at this time give back the kingdom to Israel?
1.heading: The Ascension

1.msb: Jesus replied, “It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority.
1.kjv: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.
1.blb: And He said to them, “It is not yours to know times or seasons that the Father set by His own authority.
1.bbe: And he said to them, It is not for you to have knowledge of the time and the order of events which the Father has kept in his control.

1.msb: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be witnesses to Me in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”
1.kjv: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
1.blb: But you will receive power at the Holy Spirit having come upon you, and you will be My witnesses, both in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the end of the earth.”
1.bbe: But you will have power, when the Holy Spirit has come on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem and all Judaea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.

1.msb: After He had said this, they watched as He was taken up, and a cloud hid Him from their sight.
1.kjv: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
1.blb: And having said these things, in their looking on, He was lifted up, and a cloud took Him from their eyes.
1.bbe: And when he had said these things, while they were looking, he was taken up, and went from their view into a cloud.

1.msb: They were looking intently into the sky as He was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.
1.kjv: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;
1.blb: And as they were looking intently into heaven in His going, then behold, two men in white apparel stood by them,
1.bbe: And while they were looking up to heaven with great attention, two men came to them, in white clothing,

1.msb: “Men of Galilee,” they said, “why do you stand here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen Him go into heaven.”
1.kjv: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
1.blb: who also said, “Men, Galileans, why do you stand looking into heaven? This Jesus, having been taken up from you into heaven, will thus come in that manner you saw Him going into heaven.”
1.bbe: And said, O men of Galilee, why are you looking up into heaven? This Jesus, who was taken from you into heaven, will come again, in the same way as you saw him go into heaven.

1.msb: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, which is near the city, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
1.kjv: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day’s journey.
1.blb: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, holding a Sabbath’s journey.
1.bbe: Then they went back to Jerusalem from the mountain named Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day's journey away.
1.heading: Matthias Replaces Judas

1.msb: When they arrived, they went to the upper room where they were staying: Peter and James, John and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.
1.kjv: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.
1.blb: And when they had entered, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, both Peter and John, and James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James son of Alphaeus and Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.
1.bbe: And when they came in, they went up into the room where they were living; Peter and John and James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James, the son of Alphaeus, and Simon the Zealot, and Judas, the son of James.

1.msb: With one accord they all continued in prayer and petition, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.
1.kjv: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
1.blb: All these were steadfastly continuing with one accord in prayer, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.
1.bbe: And they all with one mind gave themselves up to prayer, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and his brothers.

1.msb: In those days Peter stood up among the disciples (a gathering of about a hundred and twenty) and said,
1.kjv: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)
1.blb: And in these days, Peter, having risen up in the midst of the brothers, said (and the multitude of names at the same place was about a hundred twenty),
1.bbe: And in those days Peter got up among the brothers (there were about one hundred and twenty of them), and said,

1.msb: “Brothers, this Scripture had to be fulfilled that the Holy Spirit foretold through the mouth of David concerning Judas, who became a guide for those who arrested Jesus.
1.kjv: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.
1.blb: “Men, brothers, it was necessary for the Scripture to have been fulfilled that the Holy Spirit spoke beforehand by the mouth of David concerning Judas, the one having become guide to those having arrested Jesus.
1.bbe: My brothers, the word of God had to be put into effect, which the Holy Spirit had said before, by the mouth of David, about Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus,

1.msb: He was one of our number and shared in this ministry.”
1.kjv: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.
1.blb: For he was numbered among us and was allotted the share of this ministry.”
1.bbe: For he was numbered among us, and had his part in our work.

1.msb: (Now with the reward for his wickedness Judas bought a field; there he fell headlong and burst open in the middle, and all his intestines spilled out.
1.kjv: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
1.blb: (Then indeed this man acquired a field out of the reward of unrighteousness, and having fallen headlong, he burst open in the middle, and all his intestines poured out.
1.bbe: (Now this man, with the reward of his evil-doing, got for himself a field, and falling head first, came to a sudden and violent end there.

1.msb: This became known to all who lived in Jerusalem, so they called that field in their own language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)
1.kjv: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
1.blb: And it became known to all those dwelling in Jerusalem, so that that field was called in their own language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)
1.bbe: And this came to the knowledge of all those who were living in Jerusalem, so that the field was named in their language, Akel-dama, or, The field of blood.)

1.msb: “For it is written in the book of Psalms: ‘May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it,’ and, ‘May another take his position.’
1.kjv: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.
1.blb: “For it has been written in the book of Psalms: ‘May his homestead become desolate, and let there be no one dwelling in it,’ and, ‘May another take his oversight.’
1.bbe: For in the book of Psalms it says, Let his house be waste, and let no man be living in it: and, Let his position be taken by another.

1.msb: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have accompanied us the whole time the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
1.kjv: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
1.blb: Therefore it is necessary for the men having accompanied us in all the time that the Lord Jesus came in and went out among us,
1.bbe: For this reason, of the men who have been with us all the time, while the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

1.msb: beginning from John’s baptism until the day Jesus was taken up from us. For one of these must become a witness with us of His resurrection.”
1.kjv: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
1.blb: having begun from the baptism of John until the day in which He was taken up from us, one of these, to become a witness with us of His resurrection.”
1.bbe: Starting from the baptism of John till he went up from us, one will have to be a witness with us of his coming back from death.

1.msb: So they proposed two men: Joseph called Barsabas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.
1.kjv: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
1.blb: And they set two, Joseph called Barsabbas, who was called upon as Justus, and Matthias.
1.bbe: And they made selection of two, Joseph, named Barsabbas, whose other name was Justus, and Matthias.

1.msb: And they prayed, “Lord, You know everyone’s heart. Show us which of these two You have chosen
1.kjv: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,
1.blb: And having prayed, they said, “You, Lord, knower of the heart of all, show which one of these two You chose
1.bbe: And they made prayers and said, Lord, having knowledge of the hearts of all men, make clear which of these two has been marked out by you,

1.msb: to receive a portion in this ministry and apostleship that Judas abandoned to go to his rightful place.”
1.kjv: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.
1.blb: to take the place of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas turned aside to go to his own place.”
1.bbe: To take that position as a servant and Apostle, from which Judas by his sin was shut out, so that he might go to his place.

1.msb: Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias. So he was added to the eleven apostles.
1.kjv: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
1.blb: And they gave lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias, and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
1.bbe: And they put it to the decision of chance, and the decision was given for Matthias, and he was numbered with the eleven Apostles.

2.msb: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all with one accord in one place.
2.kjv: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
2.blb: And in the arriving of the day of Pentecost, they were all together at the same place.
2.bbe: And when the day of Pentecost was come, they were all together in one place.
2.heading: The Holy Spirit at Pentecost

2.msb: Suddenly a sound like a mighty rushing wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.
2.kjv: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
2.blb: And suddenly a sound like a violent rushing of wind came out of heaven, and it filled the whole house where they were sitting.
2.bbe: And suddenly there came from heaven a sound like the rushing of a violent wind, and all the house where they were was full of it.

2.msb: They saw tongues like flames of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.
2.kjv: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
2.blb: And there appeared to them dividing tongues as of fire, and they sat upon each one of them.
2.bbe: And they saw tongues, like flames of fire, coming to rest on every one of them.

2.msb: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.
2.kjv: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
2.blb: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit was giving to them to declare forth.
2.bbe: And they were all full of the Holy Spirit, and were talking in different languages, as the Spirit gave them power.

2.msb: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.
2.kjv: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.
2.blb: Now there were Jews dwelling in Jerusalem, devout men from every nation under heaven.
2.bbe: Now there were living at Jerusalem, Jews, God-fearing men, from every nation under heaven.

2.msb: And when this sound rang out, a crowd came together in bewilderment, because each one heard them speaking his own language.
2.kjv: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.
2.blb: Now this sound having happened, the multitude came together and was confounded, because each one was hearing them speaking in his own language.
2.bbe: And when this sound came to their ears, they all came together, and were greatly surprised because every man was hearing the words of the disciples in his special language.

2.msb: Astounded and amazed, they asked one another, “Are not all these who are speaking Galileans?
2.kjv: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilæans?
2.blb: And they were amazed and were marveling, saying, “Behold, are not all these who are speaking Galileans?
2.bbe: And they were full of wonder and said, Are not all these men Galilaeans?

2.msb: How is it then that each of us hears them in his own native language?
2.kjv: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?
2.blb: And how do we each hear our own language in which we were born?
2.bbe: And how is it that every one of us is hearing their words in the language which was ours from our birth?

2.msb: Parthians, Medes, and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,
2.kjv: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judæa, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
2.blb: Parthians and Medes and Elamites; and those inhabiting Mesopotamia, also Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,
2.bbe: Men of Parthia, Media, and Elam, and those living in Mesopotamia, in Judaea and Cappadocia, in Pontus and Asia,

2.msb: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome,
2.kjv: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,
2.blb: both Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya that are around Cyrene; and those visiting from Rome,
2.bbe: In Phrygia and Pamphylia, in Egypt and the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and those who have come from Rome, Jews by birth and others who have become Jews,

2.msb: both Jews and converts to Judaism; Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!”
2.kjv: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.
2.blb: both Jews and converts; Cretans and Arabs—we hear them speaking in our own tongues the great things of God!”
2.bbe: Men of Crete and Arabia, to all of us they are talking in our different languages, of the great works of God.

2.msb: Astounded and perplexed, they asked one another, “What does this mean?”
2.kjv: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
2.blb: And all were amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this wish to be?”
2.bbe: And they were all surprised and in doubt saying to one another, What is the reason of this?

2.msb: But others mocked them and said, “They are drunk on new wine!”
2.kjv: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
2.blb: But others, mocking, were saying, “They are full of new wine!”
2.bbe: But others, making sport of them, said, They are full of new wine.

2.msb: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, lifted up his voice, and addressed the crowd: “Men of Judea and all who dwell in Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen carefully to my words.
2.kjv: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judæa, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
2.blb: But Peter, having stood up with the Eleven, lifted up his voice and declared forth to them: “Men of Judea and all those inhabiting Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and give heed to my words.
2.bbe: But Peter, getting up, with the eleven, said in a loud voice, O men of Judaea, and all you who are living in Jerusalem, take note of this and give ear to my words.
2.heading: Peter Addresses the Crowd

2.msb: These men are not drunk, as you suppose. It is only the third hour of the day!
2.kjv: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
2.blb: For these are not drunkards, as you suppose, for it is the third hour of the day!
2.bbe: For these men are not overcome with wine, as it seems to you, for it is only the third hour of the day;

2.msb: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:
2.kjv: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;
2.blb: But this is that having been spoken by the prophet Joel:
2.bbe: But this is the thing which was said by the prophet Joel;

2.msb: ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.
2.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
2.blb: ‘And it will come to pass in the last days, God says, that I will pour out from My Spirit upon all flesh, and your sons and your daughters will prophesy, and your young men will see visions, and your old men will dream dreams.
2.bbe: And it will come about, in the last days, says God, that I will send out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will be prophets, and your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams:

2.msb: Even on My menservants and maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.
2.kjv: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:
2.blb: And even on My menservants and on My maidservants I will pour out from My Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.
2.bbe: And on my men-servants and my women-servants I will send my Spirit, and they will be prophets.

2.msb: I will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and billows of smoke.
2.kjv: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:
2.blb: And I will show wonders in the heaven above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and vapor of smoke.
2.bbe: And wonders will be seen in heaven, and signs on the earth, blood and fire and smoke:

2.msb: The sun will be turned to darkness, and the moon to blood, before the coming of the great and glorious Day of the Lord.
2.kjv: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:
2.blb: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the coming Day of the Lord, great and glorious.
2.bbe: The sun will become dark and the moon will be turned to blood, before that great day of the Lord comes in glory:

2.msb: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
2.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
2.blb: And it will come to pass that everyone who shall call upon the name of the Lord will be saved.”
2.bbe: And whoever makes his prayer to the Lord will have salvation.

2.msb: Men of Israel, listen to this message: Jesus of Nazareth was a man certified by God to you by miracles, wonders, and signs, which God did among you through Him, as you yourselves know.
2.kjv: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
2.blb: Men, Israelites, hear these words: Jesus of Nazareth, a man having been set forth by God to you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did through Him in your midst, as you yourselves know,
2.bbe: Men of Israel, give ear to these words: Jesus of Nazareth, a man who had the approval of God, as was made clear to you by the great works and signs and wonders which God did by him among you, as you yourselves have knowledge,

2.msb: He was delivered up by God’s set plan and foreknowledge, and you, by the hands of the lawless, took and put Him to death by nailing Him to the cross.
2.kjv: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
2.blb: Him delivered up by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, you put to death, having crucified by lawless hands—
2.bbe: Him, when he was given up, by the decision and knowledge of God, you put to death on the cross, by the hands of evil men:

2.msb: But God raised Him from the dead, releasing Him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for death to keep Him in its grip.
2.kjv: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
2.blb: whom God raised up, having loosed the agony of death, inasmuch as it was not possible for Him to be held by it.
2.bbe: But God gave him back to life, having made him free from the pains of death because it was not possible for him to be overcome by it.

2.msb: David says about Him: ‘I saw the Lord always before me; because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
2.kjv: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
2.blb: For David says about Him: ‘I foresaw the Lord before me through all, because He is at my right hand, that I should not be shaken.
2.bbe: For David said of him, I saw the Lord before my face at all times, for he is at my right hand, so that I may not be moved:

2.msb: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell in hope,
2.kjv: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:
2.blb: Because of this my heart was glad and my tongue rejoiced, and now also my flesh will dwell in hope,
2.bbe: And for this cause my heart was glad and my tongue full of joy, and my flesh will be resting in hope:

2.msb: because You will not abandon my soul to Hades, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
2.kjv: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
2.blb: for You will not abandon my soul into Hades, nor will You give Your Holy One to see decay.
2.bbe: For you will not let my soul be in hell and you will not give up your Holy One to destruction.

2.msb: You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.’
2.kjv: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
2.blb: You made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.’
2.bbe: You have made me see the ways of life; I will be full of joy when I see your face.

2.msb: Brothers, I can tell you with confidence that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
2.kjv: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
2.blb: Men, brothers, it is permitted me to speak with freedom to you concerning the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is among us unto this day,
2.bbe: My brothers, I may say to you openly that David came to his death, and was put in the earth, and his resting-place is with us today.

2.msb: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that from his descendants according to the flesh He would raise up the Christ to seat Him on his throne.
2.kjv: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;
2.blb: being therefore a prophet and knowing that God swore to him with an oath to seat one out of the fruit of his loins upon his throne.
2.bbe: But being a prophet, and having in mind the oath which God had given to him, that of the fruit of his body one would take his place as a king,

2.msb: Foreseeing this, David spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that His soul was not abandoned to Hades, nor did His body see decay.
2.kjv: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.
2.blb: Having foreseen, he spoke concerning the resurrection of the Christ, that neither was He abandoned into Hades, nor did His flesh see decay.
2.bbe: He, having knowledge of the future, was talking of the coming again of Christ from the dead, that he was not kept in hell and his body did not see destruction.

2.msb: God has raised this Jesus to life, to which we are all witnesses.
2.kjv: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.
2.blb: This Jesus God raised up, of which we all are witnesses.
2.bbe: This Jesus God has given back to life, of which we all are witnesses.

2.msb: Exalted, then, to the right hand of God, He has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.
2.kjv: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.
2.blb: Therefore, having been exalted to the right hand of God and having received the promise of the Holy Spirit from the Father, He poured out this which you both see and hear.
2.bbe: And so, being lifted up to the right hand of God, and having the Father's word that the Holy Spirit would come, he has sent this thing, which now you see and have knowledge of.

2.msb: For David did not ascend into heaven, but he himself says: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand
2.kjv: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
2.blb: For David did not ascend into the heavens, but he himself says: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand
2.bbe: For David has not gone up into heaven, but says, himself, The Lord said to my Lord, Be seated at my right hand,

2.msb: until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’
2.kjv: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
2.blb: until I place Your enemies as a footstool for Your feet.”’
2.bbe: Till I put all those who are against you under your feet.

2.msb: Therefore let all Israel know with certainty that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ!”
2.kjv: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
2.blb: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly that God made Him both Lord and Christ—this Jesus whom you crucified.”
2.bbe: For this reason, let all Israel be certain that this Jesus, whom you put to death on the cross, God has made Lord and Christ.

2.msb: When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and asked Peter and the other apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”
2.kjv: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?
2.blb: And having heard, they were pierced to the heart and said to Peter and the other apostles, “Men, brothers, what shall we do?”
2.bbe: Now when these words came to their ears their hearts were troubled, and they said to Peter and the other Apostles, Brothers, what are we to do?
2.heading: Three Thousand Believe

2.msb: Peter replied, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
2.kjv: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
2.blb: And Peter says to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
2.bbe: And Peter said, Let your hearts be changed, every one of you, and have baptism in the name of Jesus Christ, for the forgiveness of your sins; and you will have the Holy Spirit given to you.

2.msb: This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off—to all whom the Lord our God will call to Himself.”
2.kjv: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.
2.blb: For the promise is to you and to your children and to all those at a distance, as many as the Lord our God shall summon.”
2.bbe: For the word of God is for you and for your children and for all those who are far off, even all those who may be marked out by the Lord our God.

2.msb: With many other words he testified, and he urged them, “Be saved from this corrupt generation.”
2.kjv: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.
2.blb: And he earnestly testified many other words and was exhorting them, saying, “Be saved from this crooked generation.”
2.bbe: And with more such words he gave his witness, offering them salvation and saying, Come out from this evil generation.

2.msb: Those who gladly embraced his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to the believers that day.
2.kjv: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.
2.blb: Therefore those indeed having received his word were baptized, and on that day about three thousand souls were added.
2.bbe: Then those who gave hearing to his words had baptism: and about three thousand souls were joined to them that day.

2.msb: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.
2.kjv: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
2.blb: Now they were steadfastly continuing in the teaching of the apostles and in the fellowship, in the breaking of the bread and in the prayers.
2.bbe: And they kept their attention fixed on the Apostles' teaching and were united together in the taking of broken bread and in prayer.
2.heading: The Fellowship of Believers

2.msb: A sense of awe came over everyone, and the apostles performed many wonders and signs.
2.kjv: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.
2.blb: And fear was coming upon every soul, and many wonders and signs were taking place through the apostles.
2.bbe: But fear came on every soul: and all sorts of wonders and signs were done by the Apostles.

2.msb: All the believers were together and had everything in common.
2.kjv: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
2.blb: And all those believing were in the same place and were having all things in common.
2.bbe: And all those who were of the faith kept together, and had all things in common;

2.msb: Selling their possessions and goods, they shared with anyone who was in need.
2.kjv: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.
2.blb: And they were selling the possessions and the goods and were dividing them to all, as anyone had need.
2.bbe: And exchanging their goods and property for money, they made division of it among them all, as they had need.

2.msb: With one accord they continued to meet daily in the temple courts and to break bread from house to house, sharing their meals with gladness and sincerity of heart,
2.kjv: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,
2.blb: And every day they were steadfastly continuing with one accord in the temple and breaking bread at each house. They were partaking of food with gladness and sincerity of heart,
2.bbe: And day by day, going in agreement together regularly to the Temple and, taking broken bread together in their houses, they took their food with joy and with true hearts,

2.msb: praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily those who were being saved.
2.kjv: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
2.blb: praising God and having favor with all the people. And the Lord kept adding every day to the same those being saved.
2.bbe: Giving praise to God, and having the approval of all the people; and every day the number of those who had salvation was increased by the Lord.

3.msb: One afternoon Peter and John were going up together to the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
3.kjv: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.
3.blb: Now Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth.
3.bbe: Now Peter and John were going up to the Temple at the ninth hour, the hour of prayer;
3.heading: A Lame Man Walks

3.msb: And a man who was lame from birth was being carried to the temple gate called Beautiful, where he was put every day to beg from those entering the temple courts.
3.kjv: And a certain man lame from his mother’s womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
3.blb: And a certain man was being carried, being lame from his mother’s womb, whom they placed every day at the temple gate called Beautiful to ask for alms from those going into the temple,
3.bbe: And a certain man who from birth had had no power in his legs, was taken there every day, and put down at the door of the Temple which is named Beautiful, requesting money from those who went into the Temple;

3.msb: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for money.
3.kjv: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.
3.blb: who, having seen Peter and John being about to enter into the temple, was asking to receive alms.
3.bbe: He then, seeing Peter and John going into the Temple, made a request to them.

3.msb: Peter looked directly at him, as did John. “Look at us!” said Peter.
3.kjv: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.
3.blb: And Peter, having looked intently upon him, with John, said, “Look toward us!”
3.bbe: And Peter, looking at him, with John, said, Keep your eyes on us.

3.msb: So the man gave them his attention, expecting to receive something from them.
3.kjv: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.
3.blb: And he began to give heed to them, expecting to receive something from them.
3.bbe: And he gave attention to them, hoping to get something from them.

3.msb: But Peter said, “Silver or gold I do not have, but what I have I give you: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”
3.kjv: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.
3.blb: But Peter said, “Silver and gold, unto me there is none; but what I have, this I give to you: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, rise up and walk!”
3.bbe: But Peter said, I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give to you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up on your feet.

3.msb: Taking him by the right hand, Peter helped him up, and at once the man’s feet and ankles were made strong.
3.kjv: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
3.blb: And having taken him by the right hand, he raised him up, and immediately his feet and ankles were strengthened.
3.bbe: And he took him by his right hand, lifting him up; and straight away his feet and the bones of his legs became strong,

3.msb: He sprang to his feet and began to walk. Then he went with them into the temple courts, walking and leaping and praising God.
3.kjv: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
3.blb: And leaping up, he stood and began walking, and he entered into the temple with them, walking and leaping and praising God.
3.bbe: And, jumping up, he got on to his feet and went into the Temple with them, walking and jumping and giving praise to God.

3.msb: When all the people saw him walking and praising God,
3.kjv: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
3.blb: And all the people saw him walking and praising God,
3.bbe: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:

3.msb: they recognized him as the man who used to sit begging at the Beautiful Gate of the temple, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
3.kjv: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
3.blb: and they recognized him, that he was the one sitting for alms at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. And they were filled with wonder and amazement at that having happened to him.
3.bbe: And they saw that it was the man who made requests for money at the door of the Temple, and they were full of wonder and surprise at what had taken place.

3.msb: While the lame man who had been healed clung to Peter and John, all the people were astonished and ran to them in the walkway called Solomon’s Colonnade.
3.kjv: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.
3.blb: Now of him clinging to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the colonnade called Solomon’s, greatly amazed.
3.bbe: And while he kept his hands on Peter and John, all the people came running together to the covered way which is named Solomon's, full of wonder.
3.heading: Peter Speaks in Solomon’s Colonnade

3.msb: And when Peter saw this, he addressed the people: “Men of Israel, why are you surprised by this? Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?
3.kjv: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?
3.blb: But having seen, Peter answered to the people: “Men, Israelites, why do you wonder at this? Or why do you look intently on us as if by our own power or godliness we have made him to walk?
3.bbe: And when Peter saw it he said to the people, You men of Israel, why are you so greatly surprised at this man? or why are you looking at us as if by our power or virtue we had given him the use of his legs?

3.msb: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified His servant Jesus. You handed Him over and rejected Him before Pilate, even though he had decided to release Him.
3.kjv: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.
3.blb: The God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified His servant Jesus, whom indeed you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, that one having adjudged to release Him.
3.bbe: The God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, has given glory to his servant Jesus; whom you gave up, turning your backs on him, when Pilate had made the decision to let him go free.

3.msb: You rejected the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you.
3.kjv: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;
3.blb: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and requested a man, a murderer, to be granted to you.
3.bbe: But you would have nothing to do with the Holy and Upright One, and made request for a man of blood to be given to you,

3.msb: You killed the Author of life, but God raised Him from the dead, and we are witnesses of this fact.
3.kjv: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.
