3.blb: And you killed the Author of life, whom God raised out from the dead, of which we are witnesses.
3.bbe: And put to death the Lord of life; whom God gave back from the dead; of which fact we are witnesses.

3.msb: By faith in the name of Jesus, this man whom you see and know has been made strong. It is Jesus’ name and the faith that comes through Him that has given him this complete healing in your presence.
3.kjv: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
3.blb: And on the faith in His name, this man whom you see and know, His name strengthened; and the faith that is through Him has given to him this complete soundness before all of you.
3.bbe: And his name, through faith in his name, has made this man strong, whom you see and have knowledge of: yes, the faith which is through him has made him well, before you all.

3.msb: And now, brothers, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did your leaders.
3.kjv: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.
3.blb: And now, brothers, I know that you acted in ignorance, as your rulers also.
3.bbe: And now, my brothers, I am conscious that you did this, as did your rulers, without knowledge.

3.msb: But in this way God has fulfilled what He foretold through all His prophets, saying that the Christ would suffer.
3.kjv: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.
3.blb: But what God foretold through the mouth of all the prophets, that His Christ should suffer, He thus fulfilled.
3.bbe: But the things which God had made clear before, by the mouth of all the prophets, that the Christ would have to undergo, he has put into effect in this way.

3.msb: Repent, then, and turn back, so that your sins may be wiped away,
3.kjv: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
3.blb: Repent, therefore, and turn back, for the blotting out of your sins,
3.bbe: So then, let your hearts be changed and be turned to God, so that your sins may be completely taken away, and times of blessing may come from the Lord;

3.msb: that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord, and that He may send Jesus, the Christ, who has been appointed for you.
3.kjv: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:
3.blb: so that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord, and that He may send the One having been appointed to you, Christ Jesus,
3.bbe: And that he may send the Christ who was marked out for you from the first, even Jesus:

3.msb: Heaven must take Him in until the time comes for the restoration of all things, which God announced long ago through all His holy prophets.
3.kjv: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.
3.blb: whom indeed it is necessary for heaven to receive until the times of restoration of all things, of which God spoke by the mouth of His holy prophets from the age.
3.bbe: Who is to be kept in heaven till the time when all things are put right, of which God has given word by the mouth of his holy prophets, who have been from the earliest times.

3.msb: For Moses said to the fathers, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers. You must listen to Him in everything He tells you.
3.kjv: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.
3.blb: Indeed Moses said, ‘The Lord your God will raise up to you a prophet like me out of your brothers. You will listen to Him in all things, as many as He might say to you.
3.bbe: For Moses said, The Lord will give you a prophet from among your people, like me; you will give ear to everything which he will say to you.

3.msb: Everyone who does not listen to Him will be completely cut off from among his people.’
3.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.
3.blb: And it will come to pass that every soul who might not heed that prophet will be utterly destroyed out of the people.’
3.bbe: And every soul who does not give attention to that prophet, will be cut off from among the people.

3.msb: Indeed, all the prophets from Samuel on, as many as have spoken, have proclaimed these days.
3.kjv: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.
3.blb: And also all the prophets from Samuel, and those subsequently, as many as have spoken—they also proclaimed these days.
3.bbe: And all the prophets from Samuel and those who came after, every one of them, gave word of these days.

3.msb: And you are sons of the prophets and of the covenant God made with our fathers when He said to Abraham, ‘Through your offspring all the families of the earth will be blessed.’
3.kjv: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
3.blb: You are the sons of the prophets and of the covenant that God made with your fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘And in your seed all the families of the earth will be blessed.’
3.bbe: You are the sons of the prophets, and of the agreement which God made with your fathers, saying to Abraham, Through your seed a blessing will come on all the families of the earth.

3.msb: When God raised up His servant Jesus, He sent Him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways.”
3.kjv: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.
3.blb: God, having raised up His servant, sent Him first to you, blessing you in turning away each one from your wickednesses.”
3.bbe: To you, first, God sent his servant, blessing you by turning every one of you from his sins.

4.msb: While Peter and John were speaking to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple guard and the Sadducees came up to them,
4.kjv: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,
4.blb: And of them speaking to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came upon them,
4.bbe: And while they were talking to the people, the priests and the captain of the Temple and the Sadducees came up to them,
4.heading: Peter and John before the Sanhedrin

4.msb: greatly disturbed that they were teaching the people and proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection of the dead.
4.kjv: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
4.blb: being distressed because of their teaching the people and proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection out from the dead.
4.bbe: Being greatly troubled because they were teaching the people and preaching Jesus as an example of the coming back from the dead.

4.msb: They seized Peter and John, and because it was evening, they put them in custody until the next day.
4.kjv: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.
4.blb: And they laid hands on them and put them in custody until the next day, for it was already evening.
4.bbe: And they took them and put them in prison till the morning, for it was now evening.

4.msb: But many who heard the message believed, and the number of men grew to about five thousand.
4.kjv: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.
4.blb: But many of those having heard the word believed, and the number of the men became about five thousand.
4.bbe: But a number of those who gave hearing to the word had faith; and they were now about five thousand.

4.msb: The next day the rulers, elders, and scribes assembled in Jerusalem,
4.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,
4.blb: And it came to pass on the next day that their rulers and elders and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem,
4.bbe: And on the day after, the rulers and those in authority and the scribes came together in Jerusalem;

4.msb: along with Annas the high priest, Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and many others from the high priest’s family.
4.kjv: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.
4.blb: and Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of high-priestly descent.
4.bbe: And Annas, the high priest, was there, and Caiaphas and John and Alexander, and all the relations of the high priest.

4.msb: They had Peter and John brought in and began to question them: “By what power or what name did you do this?”
4.kjv: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?
4.blb: And having placed them in the midst, they began to inquire, “In what power or in what name did you do this?”
4.bbe: Then sending for Peter and John, they said, By what power and in whose name have you done this?

4.msb: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “Rulers and elders of the people of Israel!
4.kjv: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
4.blb: Then Peter, having been filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “Rulers of the people and elders,
4.bbe: Then Peter, being full of the Holy Spirit, said to them, O you rulers of the people and men of authority,

4.msb: If we are being examined today about a kind service to a man who was lame, to determine how he was healed,
4.kjv: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;
4.blb: if we are being examined this day as to a good work to the ailing man, how he has been healed,
4.bbe: If we are questioned today about a good work done to a man who was ill, as to how he has been made well,

4.msb: then let this be known to all of you and to all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.
4.kjv: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.
4.blb: let it be known to all of you, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth—whom you crucified, whom God raised out from the dead—in Him this man stands before you sound.
4.bbe: Take note, all of you, and all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you put to death on the cross, whom God gave back from the dead, even through him is this man now before you completely well.

4.msb: This Jesus is ‘the stone you builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone.’
4.kjv: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.
4.blb: This is ‘the stone having been rejected by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’
4.bbe: He is the stone which you builders had no use for, but which has been made the chief stone of the building.

4.msb: Salvation exists in no one else, for there is no other name given to men by which we must be saved.”
4.kjv: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
4.blb: And there is salvation in no other, for there is not another name under heaven having been given among men by which it is necessary for us to be saved.”
4.bbe: And in no other is there salvation: for there is no other name under heaven, given among men, through which we may have salvation.

4.msb: When they saw the boldness of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they marveled and took note that these men had been with Jesus.
4.kjv: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
4.blb: Now seeing the boldness of Peter and of John, and having understood that they are unschooled and ordinary men, they were astonished. And they recognized them, that they had been with Jesus.
4.bbe: Now when they saw that Peter and John were without fear, though they were men of no education or learning, they were greatly surprised; and they took note of them that they had been with Jesus.
4.heading: The Name Forbidden

4.msb: And seeing the man who had been healed standing there with them, they had nothing to say in response.
4.kjv: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
4.blb: And beholding the man having been healed standing with them, they had nothing to contradict.
4.bbe: And, seeing that the man who had been made well was there with them, they were not able to say anything against it.

4.msb: So they ordered them to leave the Sanhedrin and then conferred together.
4.kjv: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
4.blb: But having commanded them to go outside the Council, they began to confer with one another,
4.bbe: But when they had given them orders to go out of the Sanhedrin, they had a discussion among themselves,

4.msb: “What shall we do with these men?” they asked. “It is clear to everyone living in Jerusalem that a remarkable miracle has occurred through them, and we cannot deny it.
4.kjv: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we can not deny it.
4.blb: saying, “What shall we do to these men? For truly that a noteworthy sign has come to pass through them is evident to all those dwelling in Jerusalem, and we are not able to deny it.
4.bbe: Saying, What are we to do with these men? for certainly it is clear to all who are living in Jerusalem that a most important sign has been done by them, and it is not possible to say that it is not so.

4.msb: But to keep this message from spreading any further among the people, we must strictly warn them not to speak to anyone in this name.”
4.kjv: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.
4.blb: But so that it might not spread further on among the people, let us threaten them to speak no longer in this name to any man.”
4.bbe: But so that it may not go farther among the people, let us put them in fear of punishment if they say anything in future in this name.

4.msb: Then they called them in again and commanded them not to speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus.
4.kjv: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
4.blb: And having summoned them, they commanded them not to speak, nor to teach at all, in the name of Jesus.
4.bbe: And they sent for them, and gave them orders not to make statements or give teaching in the name of Jesus.

4.msb: But Peter and John replied, “Judge for yourselves whether it is right in God’s sight to listen to you rather than God.
4.kjv: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.
4.blb: But Peter and John, answering, said to them, “Whether it is right before God to listen to you rather than God, you must judge.
4.bbe: But Peter and John in answer said to them, It is for you to say if it is right in the eyes of God to give attention to you more than to God:

4.msb: For we cannot stop speaking about what we have seen and heard.”
4.kjv: For we can not but speak the things which we have seen and heard.
4.blb: For we are unable to stop speaking about what we saw and heard.”
4.bbe: For it is not possible for us to keep from saying what we have seen and have knowledge of.

4.msb: After further threats they let them go. They could not find a way to punish them, because all the people were glorifying God for what had happened.
4.kjv: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.
4.blb: And having further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way they might punish them, on account of the people, because all were glorifying God for that having happened.
4.bbe: And when they had said more sharp words to them, they let them go, not seeing what punishment they might give them, because of the people; for all men were giving praise to God for what had taken place.

4.msb: For the man who was miraculously healed was over forty years old.
4.kjv: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.
4.blb: For the man on whom this sign of healing had taken place was more than forty years old.
4.bbe: For the man on whom this act of power was done was more than forty years old.

4.msb: On their release, Peter and John returned to their own people and reported everything that the chief priests and elders had said to them.
4.kjv: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.
4.blb: Now having been let go, they came to their own and reported how much the chief priests and the elders had said to them.
4.bbe: And when they had been made free, they came back to their friends, and gave an account of all the things which the chief priests and the authorities had said to them.
4.heading: The Believers’ Prayer

4.msb: When the believers heard this, they lifted up their voices to God with one accord. “Sovereign Lord,” they said, “You are God, who made the heaven and the earth and the sea and everything in them.
4.kjv: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:
4.blb: And having heard, they lifted up their voice with one accord to God and said, “Sovereign Lord, You made the heaven and the earth and the sea and all that is in them,
4.bbe: And hearing it, they all, with one mind, made prayer to God and said, O Lord, maker of heaven and earth and the sea and all things in them:

4.msb: You spoke through the mouth of Your servant David: ‘Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
4.kjv: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?
4.blb: having spoken by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of Your servant, our father David: ‘Why did the Gentiles rage and the peoples devise vain things?
4.bbe: Who has said, by the Holy Spirit, through the mouth of our father David your servant, Why are the nations so violently moved, and why are the thoughts of the people so foolish?

4.msb: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together against the Lord and against His Anointed One.’
4.kjv: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.
4.blb: The kings of the earth took their stand, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord and against His Christ.’
4.bbe: The kings of the earth were lifted up, the rulers came together, against the Lord, and against his Christ:

4.msb: In fact, Herod and Pontius Pilate conspired with the Gentiles and the people of Israel against Your holy servant Jesus, whom You anointed.
4.kjv: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,
4.blb: For in truth, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the peoples of Israel, were gathered together in this city against Your holy servant Jesus, whom You anointed,
4.bbe: For, truly, in this town, against your holy servant, Jesus, who was marked out by you as Christ, Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, came together,

4.msb: They carried out what Your hand and will had decided beforehand would happen.
4.kjv: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.
4.blb: to do whatever Your hand and Your purpose predetermined to happen.
4.bbe: To do that which had been fixed before by your hand and your purpose.

4.msb: And now, Lord, consider their threats, and enable Your servants to speak Your word with complete boldness,
4.kjv: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,
4.blb: And now, Lord, look upon their threats, and grant to Your servants to speak Your word with all boldness,
4.bbe: And now, Lord, take note of their cruel words, and give your servants power to be preachers of your word without fear,

4.msb: as You stretch out Your hand to heal and perform signs and wonders through the name of Your holy servant Jesus.”
4.kjv: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.
4.blb: while You stretch out Your hand for healing and signs and wonders to take place through the name of Your holy servant Jesus.”
4.bbe: While your hand is stretched out to do works of mercy; so that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy servant Jesus.

4.msb: After they had prayed, their meeting place was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.
4.kjv: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
4.blb: And on their having prayed, the place in which they were assembled was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and were speaking the word of God with boldness.
4.bbe: And when their prayer was ended, the place where they were was violently moved, and they all became full of the Holy Spirit, preaching the word of God without fear.

4.msb: The multitude of believers was one in heart and soul. No one claimed that any of their possessions was his own, but they shared everything they owned.
4.kjv: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
4.blb: Now the multitude of those having believed were one in heart and soul, and no one claimed anything of that being his to be his own, but all things were to them in common.
4.bbe: And all those who were of the faith were one in heart and soul: and not one of them said that any of the things which he had was his property only; but they had all things in common.
4.heading: Sharing among Believers

4.msb: With great power the apostles continued to give their testimony about the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And abundant grace was upon them all.
4.kjv: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
4.blb: And with great power the apostles were giving testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and great grace was upon them all.
4.bbe: And with great power the Apostles gave witness of the coming back of the Lord Jesus from the dead; and grace was on them all.

4.msb: There were no needy ones among them, because those who owned lands or houses would sell their property, bring the proceeds from the sales,
4.kjv: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,
4.blb: For there was not even anyone in need among them, for as many as were owners of lands or houses, selling them, were bringing the proceeds of what is sold
4.bbe: And no one among them was in need; for everyone who had land or houses, exchanging them for money, took the price of them,

4.msb: and lay them at the apostles’ feet for distribution to anyone as he had need.
4.kjv: And laid them down at the apostles’ feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.
4.blb: and were laying them at the feet of the apostles, and distribution was made to each just as anyone had need.
4.bbe: And put it at the feet of the Apostles for distribution to everyone as he had need.

4.msb: Joses, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (meaning Son of Encouragement),
4.kjv: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,
4.blb: Now Joseph having been called Barnabas by the apostles (which is translated Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a Cypriot by birth,
4.bbe: And Joseph, who was given by the Apostles the name of Barnabas (the sense of which is, Son of comfort), a Levite and a man of Cyprus by birth,

4.msb: sold a field he owned, brought the money, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
4.kjv: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
4.blb: having sold a field being his, brought the money and laid it at the feet of the apostles.
4.bbe: Having a field, got money for it and put the money at the feet of the Apostles.

5.msb: Now a man named Ananias, together with his wife Sapphira, also sold a piece of property.
5.kjv: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
5.blb: Now a certain man named Ananias, with his wife Sapphira, sold a property,
5.bbe: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, got money for his property,
5.heading: Ananias and Sapphira

5.msb: With his wife’s full knowledge, he kept back some of the proceeds for himself, but brought a portion and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
5.kjv: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
5.blb: and he kept back from the proceeds, also the wife being aware of it, and having brought a certain portion, he laid it at the feet of the apostles.
5.bbe: And kept back part of the price, his wife having knowledge of it, and took the rest and put it at the feet of the Apostles.

5.msb: Then Peter said, “Ananias, how is it that Satan has filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and withhold some of the proceeds from the land?
5.kjv: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
5.blb: But Peter said, “Ananias, why did Satan fill your heart for you to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back from the proceeds of the land?
5.bbe: But Peter said, Ananias, why has the Evil One put it into your heart to be false to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

5.msb: Did it not belong to you before it was sold? And after it was sold, was it not at your disposal? How could you conceive such a deed in your heart? You have not lied to men, but to God!”
5.kjv: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.
5.blb: Remaining, did it not remain yours? And having been sold, was it not in your own authority? Why did you purpose this deed in your heart? You did not lie to men but to God!”
5.bbe: While you had it, was it not your property? and after you had given it in exchange, was it not still in your power? how has this purpose come into your mind? you have been false, not to men, but to God.

5.msb: On hearing these words, Ananias fell down and died. And great fear came over all who heard what had happened.
5.kjv: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.
5.blb: And hearing these words, Ananias, having fallen down, breathed his last. And great fear came upon all those hearing.
5.bbe: And at these words, Ananias went down on the earth, and his life went from him: and great fear came on all who were present.

5.msb: Then the young men stepped forward, wrapped up his body, and carried him out and buried him.
5.kjv: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.
5.blb: And the young ones, having arisen, wrapped him up, and having carried him out, buried him.
5.bbe: And the young men went and made ready his body, and took it out, and put it in the earth.

5.msb: About three hours later his wife also came in, unaware of what had happened.
5.kjv: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
5.blb: Now it came to pass about three hours afterward that his wife also came in, not knowing that having happened.
5.bbe: And about three hours after, his wife, having no knowledge of what had taken place, came in.

5.msb: “Tell me,” said Peter, “is this the price you and your husband got for the land?” “Yes,” she answered, “that is the price.”
5.kjv: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.
5.blb: And Peter responded to her, “Tell me if you sold the land for so much?” And she said, “Yes, for so much.”
5.bbe: And Peter said to her, Give me an answer: was this amount of money the price of the land? And she said, Yes, it was.

5.msb: “How could you agree to test the Spirit of the Lord?” Peter replied. “Look, the feet of the men who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out also.”
5.kjv: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.
5.blb: But Peter said to her, “Why is it that you have agreed together to test the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those having buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”
5.bbe: But Peter said to her, Why have you made an agreement together to be false to the Spirit of the Lord? See, the feet of the young men who have put the body of your husband in the earth, are at the door, and they will take you out.

5.msb: At that instant she fell down at his feet and died. Then the young men came in and, finding her dead, carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
5.kjv: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.
5.blb: And immediately she fell down at his feet and breathed her last. And the young men, having come in, found her dead; and having carried her out, they buried her by her husband.
5.bbe: And straight away she went down at his feet, and her life went from her: and the young men came in and saw her dead, and they took her out and put her in the earth with her husband.

5.msb: And great fear came over the whole church and all who heard about these events.
5.kjv: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.
5.blb: And great fear came upon the whole church and upon all those hearing these things.
5.bbe: Then great fear came on all the church and on all who had knowledge of these things.

5.msb: The apostles performed many signs and wonders among the people, and with one accord the believers gathered together in Solomon’s Colonnade.
5.kjv: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
5.blb: Now by the hands of the apostles, many signs and wonders were happening among the people, and they were all with one accord in Solomon’s Colonnade.
5.bbe: Now a number of signs and wonders were done among the people by the hands of the Apostles; and they were all together in Solomon's covered way.
5.heading: The Apostles Heal Many

5.msb: Although the people regarded them highly, no one else dared to join them.
5.kjv: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.
5.blb: Now none of the rest dared to join them, but the people were magnifying them.
5.bbe: The others, in fear, kept back from joining them: but the people made much of them;

5.msb: Yet more and more believers were brought to the Lord—large numbers of both men and women.
5.kjv: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)
5.blb: And more believing in the Lord were added, multitudes of both men and women,
5.bbe: And a great number of men and women had faith, and were joined to the Lord;

5.msb: As a result, people brought the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mats, so that at least Peter’s shadow might fall on some of them as he passed by.
5.kjv: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
5.blb: so as even to bring out the sick into the streets and to put them on cots and mats, so that of Peter coming, at least the shadow might envelop some of them.
5.bbe: And they even took into the streets people who were ill, and put them on beds, so that when Peter went by, some of them might be in his shade.

5.msb: Crowds also gathered from the towns around Jerusalem, bringing the sick and those tormented by unclean spirits, and all of them were healed.
5.kjv: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.
5.blb: Now the multitude from the cities surrounding Jerusalem also were coming together, bringing the sick and those being tormented by unclean spirits, who were all healed.
5.bbe: And numbers of people came together from the towns round about Jerusalem, with those who were ill and those who were troubled with unclean spirits: and they were all made well.

5.msb: Then the high priest and all his associates, who belonged to the party of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy. They went out
5.kjv: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,
5.blb: But the high priest, having risen up, and all those with him, being the sect of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy,
5.bbe: But the high priest and those who were with him (the Sadducees) were full of envy,
5.heading: The Apostles Arrested and Freed

5.msb: and arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.
5.kjv: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
5.blb: and they laid the hands on the apostles and put them in the public jail.
5.bbe: And they took the Apostles and put them in the common prison.

5.msb: But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the doors of the jail and brought them out, saying,
5.kjv: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,
5.blb: But during the night an angel of the Lord, having opened the doors of the jail and having brought them out, said,
5.bbe: But in the night an angel of the Lord, opening the doors of the prison, took them out and said,

5.msb: “Go, stand in the temple courts and tell the people the full message of this new life.”
5.kjv: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.
5.blb: “Go, and having stood in the temple, speak to the people all the words of this life.”
5.bbe: Go, take your place in the Temple and give the people all the teaching about this Life.

5.msb: At daybreak the apostles entered the temple courts as they had been told and began to teach the people. When the high priest and his associates arrived, they convened the Sanhedrin—the full assembly of the elders of Israel—and sent to the jail for the apostles.
5.kjv: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
5.blb: And having heard, they entered into the temple at the dawn and were teaching. Now the high priest having come, and those with him, they called together the Council—even all the senate of the sons of Israel—and they sent to the prison house to bring them.
5.bbe: And hearing this, they went into the Temple at dawn, and were teaching. But the high priest and those who were with him got together the Sanhedrin and the representatives of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to get them.

5.msb: But on arriving at the jail, the officers did not find them there. So they returned with the report:
5.kjv: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,
5.blb: But the officers, having come, did not find them in the prison. And having returned, they reported back,
5.bbe: But the men who were sent saw that they were not in the prison, and came back with the news,

5.msb: “We indeed found the jail securely locked, with the guards posted before the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside.”
5.kjv: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
5.blb: saying, “We found the prison house shut with all security and the guards standing before the doors; but having opened them, we found no one inside.”
5.bbe: Saying, The doors of the prison were safely shut, and the keepers were at the doors, but when they were open, there was nobody inside.

5.msb: When the high priest and the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests heard this account, they were perplexed as to what was happening.
5.kjv: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.
5.blb: Now when both the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these words, they were perplexed concerning them, what this might be.
5.bbe: Now, at these words, the captain of the Temple and the chief priests were greatly troubled about what might be the end of this business.
5.heading: The Apostles before the Sanhedrin

5.msb: Then someone came in and announced, “Look, the men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people!”
5.kjv: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.
5.blb: And a certain one, having come, reported to them, “Behold, the men whom you put in the prison are standing in the temple and teaching the people!”
5.bbe: And someone came and said to them, The men, whom you put in prison, are in the Temple teaching the people.

5.msb: At that point, the captain went with the officers and brought the apostles—but not by force, for fear the people would stone them.
5.kjv: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.
5.blb: Then the captain, having gone with the officers, was bringing them, not with force—for they were afraid of the people, lest they might be stoned.
5.bbe: Then the captain and some of the police went and took them, but not violently, for fear that they might be stoned by the people.

5.msb: They brought them in and made them stand before the Sanhedrin, where the high priest interrogated them.
5.kjv: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,
5.blb: And having brought them, they set them in the Council. And the high priest questioned them,
5.bbe: And they took them into the Sanhedrin, and the high priest said to them,

5.msb: “Did we not give you strict orders not to teach in this name?” he asked. “Yet you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to make us responsible for this man’s blood.”
5.kjv: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.
5.blb: saying, “By a charge we commanded you not to teach in this name, and behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and you intend to bring upon us the blood of this man.”
5.bbe: We gave you very clear orders not to give teaching in this name: and now Jerusalem is full of your teaching, and you are attempting to make us responsible for this man's death.

5.msb: But Peter and the other apostles replied, “We must obey God rather than men.
5.kjv: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
5.blb: But Peter and the apostles, answering, said, “It is necessary to obey God rather than men.
5.bbe: But Peter and the Apostles, answering, said, We have to do the orders of God, not of man.

5.msb: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you had killed by hanging Him on a tree.
5.kjv: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.
5.blb: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, having hanged Him on a tree.
5.bbe: The God of our fathers gave Jesus back to life, whom you had put to death, hanging him on a tree.

5.msb: God exalted Him to His right hand as Prince and Savior, in order to grant repentance and forgiveness of sins to Israel.
5.kjv: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
5.blb: God exalted Him to His right hand as Prince and Savior to give repentance to Israel and forgiveness of sins.
5.bbe: Him God has put on high at his right hand, as a Ruler and a Saviour, to give to Israel a change of heart and forgiveness of sins.

5.msb: We are His witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey Him.”
5.kjv: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
5.blb: And we are witnesses of these things, and also the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those obeying Him.”
5.bbe: And we are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who keep his laws.

5.msb: When the Council members heard this, they were enraged, and they resolved to put the apostles to death.
5.kjv: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.
5.blb: And having heard, they were cut, and they were intending to put them to death.
5.bbe: But when these words came to their ears, they were cut to the heart, and had a mind to put them to death.
5.heading: Gamaliel’s Advice

5.msb: But a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law who was honored by all the people, stood up in the Sanhedrin and ordered that the apostles be put outside for a short time.
5.kjv: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;
5.blb: But a certain man having risen up in the Council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law honored by all the people, commanded them to put the men outside for a short while.
5.bbe: But one of the Sanhedrin, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a man of learning in the law, of whom all the people had a high opinion, got up and made a suggestion for the men to be put outside for a little time.

5.msb: “Men of Israel,” he said, “consider carefully what you are about to do to these men.
5.kjv: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.
5.blb: And he said to them, “Men, Israelites, take heed to yourselves what you are about to do with these men.
5.bbe: And he said to them, Men of Israel, take care what you do about these men.

5.msb: Some time ago Theudas rose up, claiming to be somebody, and about four hundred men rallied to him. He was killed, all his followers were dispersed, and it all came to nothing.
5.kjv: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.
5.blb: For before these days, Theudas rose up, affirming himself to be somebody—to whom a number of men, about four hundred, were joined—who was put to death, and all, as many as were persuaded by him, were dispersed; and it came to nothing.
5.bbe: For before this there was Theudas, who said he was someone important, to whom about four hundred men gave their support: he was put to death, and his band was broken up and came to nothing.

5.msb: After him, Judas the Galilean appeared in the days of the census and drew away many people after him. He too perished, and all his followers were scattered.
5.kjv: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.
5.blb: After this man, Judas the Galilean rose up in the days of the registration and drew away people after him. And he perished, and all, as many as were persuaded by him, were scattered.
5.bbe: After this man, there was Judas of Galilee, at the time of the numbering, and some of the people went after him: he was put to death, and all his supporters were put to flight.

5.msb: So in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone. Let them go! For if their purpose or endeavor is of human origin, it will fail.
5.kjv: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:
5.blb: And now I say to you, withdraw from these men and let them alone, for if this purpose or this work may be from men, it will be overthrown.
5.bbe: And now I say to you, Do nothing to these men, but let them be: for if this teaching or this work is of men, it will come to nothing:

5.msb: But if it is from God, you cannot stop it. You may even find yourselves fighting against God.”
5.kjv: But if it be of God, ye can not overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
5.blb: But if it is from God, you will not be able to overthrow them, lest perhaps you would be found fighting against God.”
5.bbe: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overcome them, and you are in danger of fighting against God.

5.msb: At this, they yielded to Gamaliel. They called the apostles in and had them flogged. Then they ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and released them.
5.kjv: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
5.blb: And they were persuaded by him. And having summoned the apostles, having beaten them, they commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and they released them.
5.bbe: And he seemed to them to be right: and they sent for the Apostles, and, after having them whipped and giving them orders to give no teaching in the name of Jesus, they let them go.

5.msb: The apostles left the Sanhedrin, rejoicing that they had been counted worthy of suffering disgrace for the name of Jesus.
5.kjv: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
5.blb: Therefore they indeed departed from the presence of the Council, rejoicing that they had been counted worthy to suffer dishonor for the Name.
5.bbe: So they went away from the Sanhedrin, happy to undergo shame for the Name.

5.msb: Every day, in the temple courts and from house to house, they did not stop teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Christ.
5.kjv: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.
5.blb: And every day, in the temple and in the house, they did not cease teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Christ.
5.bbe: And every day, in the Temple and privately, they went on teaching and preaching Jesus as the Christ.

6.msb: In those days when the disciples were increasing in number, the Grecian Jews among them began to grumble against the Hebraic Jews because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution of food.
6.kjv: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
6.blb: Now in these days of the disciples multiplying, there arose a grumbling of the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution.
6.bbe: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was increasing, protests were made by the Greek Jews against the Hebrews, because their widows were not taken care of in the distribution of food every day.
6.heading: The Choosing of the Seven

6.msb: So the Twelve summoned all the disciples and said, “It is unacceptable for us to neglect the word of God in order to wait on tables.
6.kjv: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.
6.blb: So the Twelve, having summoned the multitude of the disciples, said, “It is not desirable for us, having neglected the word of God, to attend tables.
6.bbe: And the Apostles sent for all the disciples and said, It is not right for us to give up preaching the word of God in order to make distribution of food.

6.msb: Therefore, brothers, select from among you seven men confirmed to be full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom. We will assign this responsibility to them
6.kjv: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
6.blb: Therefore, brothers, select from yourselves seven men being well attested, full of the Spirit and of wisdom, whom we will appoint over this task.
6.bbe: Take then from among you seven men of good name, full of the Spirit and of wisdom, to whom we may give control of this business.

6.msb: and will devote ourselves to prayer and to the ministry of the word.”
6.kjv: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.
6.blb: And we will steadfastly continue in prayer and the ministry of the word.”
6.bbe: Then we will give all our time to prayer and the teaching of the word.

6.msb: This proposal pleased the whole group. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, as well as Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.
6.kjv: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:
6.blb: And the statement was pleasing before all the multitude. And they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas, a convert of Antioch,
6.bbe: And this saying was pleasing to all of them: and they made selection of Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, and Philip and Prochorus and Nicanor and Timon and Parmenas and Nicolas of Antioch, who had become a Jew:

6.msb: They presented these seven to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.
6.kjv: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
6.blb: whom they set before the apostles. And having prayed, they laid the hands on them.
6.bbe: These they took to the Apostles, who, after prayer, put their hands on them.

6.msb: So the word of God continued to spread. The number of disciples in Jerusalem grew rapidly, and a great number of priests became obedient to the faith.
6.kjv: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
6.blb: And the word of God kept increasing, and the number of the disciples in Jerusalem was multiplied exceedingly, and a great multitude of the priests were becoming obedient to the faith.
6.bbe: And the word of God was increasing in power; and the number of the disciples in Jerusalem became very great, and a great number of priests were in agreement with the faith.

6.msb: Now Stephen, who was full of faith and power, was performing great wonders and signs among the people.
6.kjv: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
6.blb: Now Stephen, full of grace and power, was doing great wonders and signs among the people.
6.bbe: And Stephen, full of grace and power, did great wonders and signs among the people.
6.heading: The Arrest of Stephen

6.msb: But resistance arose from what was called the Synagogue of the Freedmen, including Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and men from the provinces of Cilicia and Asia. They disputed with Stephen,
6.kjv: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.
6.blb: But there arose certain ones of those of the synagogue called Freedmen—including Cyrenians and Alexandrians and those from Cilicia and Asia—disputing with Stephen.
6.bbe: But some of those who were of the Synagogue named that of the Libertines, and some of the men of Cyrene and of Alexandria and those from Cilicia and Asia, had arguments with Stephen.

6.msb: but they could not stand up to his wisdom or the Spirit by whom he spoke.
6.kjv: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.
6.blb: And they were not able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by whom he was speaking.
6.bbe: But they were not able to get the better of him, for his words were full of wisdom and of the Spirit.

6.msb: Then they prompted some men to say, “We heard Stephen speak words of blasphemy against Moses and against God.”
6.kjv: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.
6.blb: Then they suborned men to say, “We have heard him speaking blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
6.bbe: Then they got men to say, He has said evil against Moses and against God, in our hearing.

6.msb: So they stirred up the people, elders, and scribes and confronted Stephen. They seized him and brought him before the Sanhedrin,
6.kjv: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,
6.blb: And they stirred up the people and the elders and the scribes; and having come upon him, they seized him and brought him to the Council.
6.bbe: And the people, with the rulers and the scribes, were moved against him, and they came and took him before the Sanhedrin,

6.msb: where they presented false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemies against this holy place and against the law.
6.kjv: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
6.blb: And they set up false witnesses, saying, “This man does not stop speaking words against this holy place and the law.
6.bbe: And they got false witnesses who said, This man is for ever saying things against this holy place and against the law:

6.msb: For we have heard him say that Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs that Moses handed down to us.”
6.kjv: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.
6.blb: For we have heard him saying that this Jesus of Nazareth will demolish this place and will change the customs that Moses delivered to us.”
6.bbe: For he has said in our hearing that this Jesus of Nazareth will put this place to destruction and make changes in the rules which were handed down to us by Moses.

6.msb: All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at Stephen, and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
6.kjv: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
6.blb: And having looked intently on him, all the ones sitting in the Council saw his face as the face of an angel.
6.bbe: And all those who were in the Sanhedrin, looking at him, saw that his face was like the face of an angel.

7.msb: Then the high priest asked Stephen, “Are these charges true?”
7.kjv: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
7.blb: And the high priest said, “Are these things so?”
7.bbe: Then the high priest said, Are these things true?
7.heading: Stephen’s Address: The Call of Abraham

7.msb: And Stephen declared: “Brothers and fathers, listen to me! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
7.kjv: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,
7.blb: And he began to speak: “Men, brothers and fathers, listen! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham, being in Mesopotamia before his dwelling in Haran,
7.bbe: And he said, My brothers and fathers, give hearing. The God of glory came to our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he was living in Haran,

7.msb: and told him, ‘Leave your country and your kindred and go to the land I will show you.’
7.kjv: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.
7.blb: and He said to him, ‘Go out of your country and from your kindred, and come into the land that I will show to you.’
7.bbe: And said to him, Go out of your land, and away from your family, and come into the land to which I will be your guide.

7.msb: So Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, God brought him out of that place and into this land where you are now living.
7.kjv: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldæans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
7.blb: Then, having gone out from the land of the Chaldeans, he dwelt in Haran. And from there, after his father died, He transferred him into this land in which you now dwell.
7.bbe: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and went into Haran; and from there, when his father was dead, he was guided by God into this land, where you are living now:

7.msb: He gave him no inheritance here, not even a foot of ground. But God promised to give possession of the land to Abraham and his descendants, even though he did not yet have a child.
7.kjv: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
7.blb: And He did not give to him an inheritance in it, not even the length of a foot; but He promised to give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him—there being to him no child.
7.bbe: And God gave him no heritage in it, not even enough to put his foot on: but he gave him an undertaking that he would give it to him and to his children after him, though he had no child at that time.

7.msb: God told him that his descendants would be foreigners in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.
7.kjv: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
7.blb: And God spoke thus, that his seed will be a sojourner in a strange land, and they will enslave it and will mistreat it four hundred years.
7.bbe: And God said that his seed would be living in a strange land, and that they would make them servants, and be cruel to them for four hundred years.

7.msb: ‘But I will punish the nation that enslaves them,’ God said, ‘and afterward they will come forth and worship Me in this place.’
7.kjv: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
7.blb: ‘And the nation to which they will be in bondage, I will judge,’ God said, ‘and after these things they will come out and will serve Me in this place.’
7.bbe: And I will be the judge, said God, of that nation which made them servants: and after that, they will come out and give me worship in this place.

7.msb: Then God gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision, and Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day. And Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob of the twelve patriarchs.
7.kjv: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
7.blb: And He gave to him the covenant of circumcision; and thus he begat Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day, and Isaac Jacob, and Jacob the twelve patriarchs.
7.bbe: And he made with him the agreement of which circumcision was the sign. And so Abraham had a son, Isaac, and gave him circumcision on the eighth day; and Isaac had a son, Jacob, and Jacob was the father of the twelve heads of the families of Israel.

7.msb: Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him as a slave into Egypt. But God was with him
7.kjv: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
7.blb: And the patriarchs, having envied Joseph, sold him into Egypt. And God was with him,
7.bbe: And the brothers, moved with envy against Joseph, gave him to the Egyptians for money: but God was with him,
7.heading: Joseph Sold into Egypt

7.msb: and rescued him from all his troubles. He granted Joseph favor and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt, who appointed him ruler over Egypt and all his household.
7.kjv: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
7.blb: and He rescued him out of all his tribulations, and He gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he appointed him ruler over Egypt and over all his house.
7.bbe: And made him free from all his troubles, and gave him wisdom and the approval of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, who made him ruler over Egypt and all his house.

7.msb: Then famine and great suffering swept across the land of Egypt and Canaan, and our fathers could not find food.
7.kjv: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
7.blb: And there was a famine upon all Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction, and our fathers were not finding sustenance.
7.bbe: Now there was no food to be had in all Egypt and Canaan, and there was great trouble: and our fathers were not able to get food.

7.msb: When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our fathers on their first visit.
7.kjv: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
7.blb: Now Jacob, having heard there is grain in Egypt, sent forth our fathers first.
7.bbe: But Jacob, hearing that there was grain in Egypt, sent out our fathers the first time.

7.msb: On their second visit, Joseph revealed his identity to his brothers, and his family became known to Pharaoh.
7.kjv: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph’s kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
7.blb: And on the second time, Joseph was made known to his brothers, and the family of Joseph became known to Pharaoh.
7.bbe: And the second time his brothers had a meeting with Joseph, and Pharaoh had knowledge of Joseph's family.

7.msb: Then Joseph sent for his father Jacob and all his relatives, seventy-five in all.
7.kjv: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
7.blb: And Joseph, having sent, called for his father Jacob and all his kindred, seventy-five souls in all.
7.bbe: Then Joseph sent for Jacob his father and all his family, seventy-five persons.

7.msb: So Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our fathers died.
7.kjv: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
7.blb: And Jacob went down into Egypt, and he died—he and our fathers,
7.bbe: And Jacob went down to Egypt, and came to his end there, and so did our fathers;
7.heading: Israel Oppressed in Egypt

7.msb: Their bones were carried back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor of Shechem for a price he paid in silver.
7.kjv: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
7.blb: and they were carried over into Shechem and were placed in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price of silver from the sons of Hamor in Shechem.
7.bbe: And they were taken over to Shechem, and put to rest in the place which Abraham got for a price in silver from the sons of Hamor in Shechem.

7.msb: As the time drew near for God to fulfill His promise to Abraham, our people in Egypt increased greatly in number.
7.kjv: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
7.blb: Now as the time of the promise that God swore to Abraham was drawing near, the people increased and multiplied in Egypt,
7.bbe: But when the time was near for putting into effect the undertaking which God had given to Abraham, the people were increasing in Egypt,

7.msb: Then another king, who knew nothing of Joseph, arose.
7.kjv: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
7.blb: until there arose another king over Egypt, who did not know Joseph.
7.bbe: Till another king came to power, who had no knowledge of Joseph.

7.msb: He exploited our people and oppressed our fathers, forcing them to abandon their infants so they would die.
7.kjv: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
7.blb: Having dealt treacherously with our kindred, this one mistreated our fathers, making them expose their infants, that they would not live.
7.bbe: He, having evil designs against our nation, was cruel to our fathers, and they were forced to put out their young children, so that they might not go on living.

7.msb: At that time Moses was born, and he was beautiful in the sight of God. For three months he was nurtured in his father’s house.
7.kjv: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father’s house three months:
7.blb: In that time Moses was born (and he was beautiful to God), who was brought up three months in the house of his father.
7.bbe: At which time Moses came to birth, and he was very beautiful; and he was kept for three months in his father's house:
7.heading: The Birth and Adoption of Moses

7.msb: When he was set outside, Pharaoh’s daughter took him and brought him up as her own son.
7.kjv: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
7.blb: And on his having been exposed, the daughter of Pharaoh took him up and brought him up for herself for a son.
7.bbe: And when he was put out, Pharaoh's daughter took him and kept him as her son.

7.msb: So Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.
7.kjv: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
7.blb: And Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and he was mighty in his words and deeds.
7.bbe: And Moses was trained in all the wisdom of Egypt, and was great in his words and works.

7.msb: When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
7.kjv: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
7.blb: Now when a period of forty years was fulfilled to him, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the sons of Israel.
7.bbe: But when he was almost forty years old, it came into his heart to go and see his brothers, the children of Israel.
7.heading: The Rejection and Flight of Moses

7.msb: And when he saw one of them being mistreated, Moses went to his defense and avenged him by striking down the Egyptian who was oppressing him.
7.kjv: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
7.blb: And having seen a certain one being wronged, he defended and did vengeance for the one being oppressed, having struck down the Egyptian.
7.bbe: And seeing one of them being attacked, he went to his help and gave the Egyptian a death-blow:

7.msb: He assumed his brothers would understand that God was using him to deliver them, but they did not.
7.kjv: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
7.blb: And he was supposing his brothers to understand that God is giving them salvation by his hand, but they did not understand.
7.bbe: And he was hoping that his brothers would see that God had sent him to be their saviour; but they did not see.

7.msb: The next day he came upon two Israelites who were fighting, and he urged them to make peace, saying, ‘Men, you are brothers. Why are you mistreating each other?’
7.kjv: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
7.blb: And on the following day, he appeared to those who were quarreling and urged them to peace, having said, ‘Men, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’
7.bbe: And the day after, he came to them, while they were having a fight, and would have made peace between them, saying, Sirs, you are brothers; why do you do wrong to one another?

7.msb: But the man who was abusing his neighbor pushed Moses aside and said, ‘Who made you ruler and judge over us?
7.kjv: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
7.blb: But the one mistreating the neighbor pushed him away, having said, ‘Who appointed you ruler and judge over us?
7.bbe: But the man who was doing wrong to his neighbour, pushing him away, said, Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

7.msb: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
7.kjv: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?
7.blb: Do you want to kill me the same way you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
7.bbe: Will you put me to death as you did the Egyptian yesterday?

7.msb: At this remark, Moses fled to the land of Midian, where he lived as a foreigner and had two sons.
7.kjv: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
7.blb: Now at this word Moses fled, and he became a sojourner in the land of Midian, where he begat two sons.
7.bbe: And at these words, Moses went in flight to the land of Midian, and was living there for a time, and had two sons.

7.msb: After forty years had passed, an angel of the Lord appeared to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
7.kjv: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
7.blb: And forty years having been fulfilled, an angel appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire of a bush.
7.bbe: At the end of forty years, an angel came to him in the waste land of Sinai, in the flame of a burning thorn-tree.
7.heading: The Call of Moses

7.msb: When Moses saw it, he marveled at the sight. As he approached to look more closely, the voice of the Lord came to him:
7.kjv: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,
7.blb: And Moses, having seen, marveled at the vision. And on his coming near to behold, there was the voice of the Lord:
7.bbe: And Moses, seeing it, was full of wonder, and when he came up to have a nearer view of it, the voice of the Lord came to him, saying,

7.msb: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.’ Moses trembled with fear and did not dare to look.
7.kjv: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
7.blb: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham and of Isaac and of Jacob.’ And Moses, having become terrified, did not dare to look.
7.bbe: I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham and of Isaac and of Jacob. And Moses, shaking with fear, kept his eyes from looking at it.

7.msb: Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.
7.kjv: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
7.blb: And the Lord said to him, ‘Loose the sandal of your feet, for the place on which you stand is holy ground.
7.bbe: And the Lord said, Take off the shoes from your feet, for the place where you are is holy.

7.msb: I have indeed seen the oppression of My people in Egypt. I have heard their groaning and have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you back to Egypt.’
7.kjv: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
7.blb: I have surely seen the oppression of My people in Egypt, and I heard their groans, and I came down to deliver them. And now come, I will send you to Egypt.’
7.bbe: Truly, I have seen the sorrows of my people in Egypt, and their cries have come to my ears, and I have come down to make them free: and now, come, I will send you to Egypt.

7.msb: This Moses, whom they had rejected with the words, ‘Who made you ruler and judge?’ is the one whom God sent to be their ruler and redeemer through the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
7.kjv: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
7.blb: This Moses, whom they rejected, having said, ‘Who appointed you ruler and judge?’—this one whom God sent as both ruler and redeemer by the hand of the angel having appeared to him in the bush—
7.bbe: This Moses, whom they would not have, saying, Who made you a ruler and a judge? him God sent to be a ruler and a saviour, by the hand of the angel whom he saw in the thorn-tree.

7.msb: He led them out and performed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, at the Red Sea, and for forty years in the wilderness.
7.kjv: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
7.blb: this one led them out, having done wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
7.bbe: This man took them out, having done wonders and signs in Egypt and in the Red Sea and in the waste land, for forty years.

7.msb: This is the same Moses who told the Israelites, ‘The Lord our God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers.’
7.kjv: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.
7.blb: This is the Moses having said to the sons of Israel, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers.’
7.bbe: This is the same Moses, who said to the children of Israel, God will give you a prophet from among your brothers, like me.

7.msb: He was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers. And he received a living word to pass on to us.
7.kjv: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
7.blb: This is the one having been in the congregation in the wilderness with the angel speaking to him in Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living oracles to give to us,
7.bbe: This is the man who was in the church in the waste land with the angel who was talking to him in Sinai, and with our fathers; and to him were given the living words of God, so that he might give them to you.

7.msb: But our fathers refused to obey him. Instead, they rejected him and in their heart turned back to Egypt.
7.kjv: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
7.blb: to whom our fathers were not willing to be obedient, but pushed away, and they turned back in their hearts to Egypt,
7.bbe: By whom our fathers would not be controlled; but they put him on one side, turning back in their hearts to Egypt,
7.heading: The Rebellion of Israel

7.msb: They said to Aaron, ‘Make us gods who will go before us! As for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him.’
7.kjv: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
7.blb: having said to Aaron, ‘Make us gods who will go before us. As for this Moses, who brought us out from the land of Egypt, we do not know what happened to him.’
7.bbe: And saying to Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: as for this Moses, who took us out of the land of Egypt, we have no idea what has become of him.

7.msb: At that time they made a calf and offered a sacrifice to the idol, rejoicing in the works of their hands.
7.kjv: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
7.blb: And in those days they made a calf and offered a sacrifice to the idol, and they were rejoicing in the works of their hands.
7.bbe: And they made the image of a young ox in those days, and made an offering to it, and had joy in the work of their hands.

7.msb: But God turned away from them and gave them over to the worship of the host of heaven, as it is written in the book of the prophets: ‘Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
7.kjv: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?
7.blb: But God turned away and delivered them to worship the host of heaven, as it has been written in the book of the prophets: ‘Did you offer slain beasts and sacrifices to Me forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
