7.bbe: But God was turned from them and let them give worship to the stars of heaven, as it says in the book of the prophets, Did you make offerings to me of sheep and oxen for forty years in the waste land, O house of Israel?

7.msb: You have taken along the tabernacle of Molech and the star of your god Remphan, the idols you made to worship. Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Babylon.’
7.kjv: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
7.blb: And you took up the tabernacle of Molech and the star of your god Rephan, the images that you made to worship them; and I will remove you beyond Babylon.’
7.bbe: And you took up the tent of Moloch and the star of the god Rephan, images which you made to give worship to them: and I will take you away, farther than Babylon.

7.msb: Our fathers had the tabernacle of the Testimony with them in the wilderness. It was constructed exactly as God had directed Moses, according to the pattern he had seen.
7.kjv: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.
7.blb: The tabernacle of the Testimony was with our fathers in the wilderness, just as the One speaking to Moses had commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen,
7.bbe: Our fathers had the Tent of witness in the waste land, as God gave orders to Moses to make it after the design which he had seen.
7.heading: The Tabernacle of the Testimony

7.msb: And our fathers who received it brought it in with Joshua when they dispossessed the nations God drove out before them. It remained until the time of David,
7.kjv: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
7.blb: and which, having received it by succession, our fathers brought in with Joshua in taking possession of the nations whom God drove out from the face of our fathers, until the days of David,
7.bbe: Which our fathers, in their turn, took with them when, with Joshua, they came into the heritage of the nations whom God was driving out before the face of our fathers, till the time of David,

7.msb: who found favor in the sight of God and asked to provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.
7.kjv: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
7.blb: who found favor before God and asked to find a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.
7.bbe: Who was pleasing to God; and he had a desire to make a holy tent for the God of Jacob.

7.msb: But it was Solomon who built the house for Him.
7.kjv: But Solomon built him an house.
7.blb: But Solomon built for Him a house.
7.bbe: But Solomon was the builder of his house.

7.msb: However, the Most High does not dwell in temples made by human hands. As the prophet says:
7.kjv: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,
7.blb: But the Most High does not dwell in hand-made houses. As the prophet says:
7.bbe: But still, the Most High has not his resting-place in houses made with hands, as the prophet says,

7.msb: ‘Heaven is My throne and the earth is My footstool. What kind of house will you build for Me, says the Lord, or where will My place of repose be?
7.kjv: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
7.blb: ‘Heaven is unto Me a throne, and the earth a footstool for My feet. What kind of house will you build for Me, says the Lord, or what is the place of My rest?
7.bbe: Heaven is the seat of my power, and earth is a resting-place for my feet: what sort of house will you make for me, says the Lord, or what is my place of rest?

7.msb: Has not My hand made all these things?’
7.kjv: Hath not my hand made all these things?
7.blb: Did not My hand make all these things?’
7.bbe: Did not my hand make all these things?

7.msb: You stiff-necked people with uncircumcised heart and ears! You always resist the Holy Spirit, just as your fathers did.
7.kjv: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
7.blb: You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in hearts and ears! You always resist the Holy Spirit! As did your fathers, also you do.
7.bbe: You whose hearts are hard and whose ears are shut to me; you are ever working against the Holy Spirit; as your fathers did, so do you.

7.msb: Which of the prophets did your fathers fail to persecute? They even killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One. And now you are His betrayers and murderers—
7.kjv: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
7.blb: Which of the prophets did your fathers not persecute? And they killed those having foretold about the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers,
7.bbe: Which of the prophets was not cruelly attacked by your fathers? and they put to death those who gave them the news of the coming of the Upright One; whom you have now given up and put to death;

7.msb: you who received the law ordained by angels, yet have not kept it.”
7.kjv: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
7.blb: you who received the law by the ordination of angels, and did not keep it.”
7.bbe: You, to whom the law was given as it was ordered by angels, and who have not kept it.

7.msb: On hearing this, the members of the Sanhedrin were enraged, and they gnashed their teeth at him.
7.kjv: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
7.blb: Now hearing these things, they were cut in their hearts, and they were gnashing the teeth at him.
7.bbe: Hearing these things, they were cut to the heart and moved with wrath against him.
7.heading: The Stoning of Stephen

7.msb: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked intently into heaven and saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.
7.kjv: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
7.blb: But being full of the Holy Spirit, having looked intently into heaven, he saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God,
7.bbe: But he was full of the Holy Spirit, and looking up to heaven, he saw the glory of God and Jesus at the right hand of God.

7.msb: “Look,” he said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.”
7.kjv: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
7.blb: and he said, “Behold, I see the heavens having been opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.”
7.bbe: And he said, Now I see heaven open, and the Son of man at the right hand of God.

7.msb: At this they covered their ears, cried out in a loud voice, and rushed together at him.
7.kjv: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
7.blb: And having cried out in a loud voice, they held their ears and rushed upon him with one accord,
7.bbe: But with loud cries, and stopping their ears, they made an attack on him all together,

7.msb: They dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. Meanwhile the witnesses laid their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
7.kjv: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man’s feet, whose name was Saul.
7.blb: and having cast him out of the city, they began to stone him. And the witnesses laid aside their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
7.bbe: Driving him out of the town and stoning him: and the witnesses put their clothing at the feet of a young man named Saul.

7.msb: While they were stoning him, Stephen appealed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.”
7.kjv: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
7.blb: And as they were stoning Stephen, he was calling out and saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.”
7.bbe: And Stephen, while he was being stoned, made prayer to God, saying, Lord Jesus, take my spirit.

7.msb: Falling on his knees, he cried out in a loud voice, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them.” And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
7.kjv: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
7.blb: And having fallen on his knees, he cried out in a loud voice, “Lord, do not place this sin on them.” And having said this, he fell asleep.
7.bbe: And going down on his knees, he said in a loud voice, Lord, do not make them responsible for this sin. And when he had said this, he went to his rest.

8.msb: And Saul was there, giving approval to Stephen’s death. On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.
8.kjv: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judæa and Samaria, except the apostles.
8.blb: And Saul was there consenting to his killing. And on that day a great persecution arose against the church that was in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria.
8.bbe: And Saul gave approval to his death. Now at that time a violent attack was started against the church in Jerusalem; and all but the Apostles went away into all parts of Judaea and Samaria.
8.heading: Saul Persecutes the Church

8.msb: God-fearing men buried Stephen and mourned deeply over him.
8.kjv: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
8.blb: Now devout men buried Stephen and made great lamentation over him.
8.bbe: And God-fearing men put Stephen's body in its last resting-place, making great weeping over him.

8.msb: But Saul began to destroy the church. Going from house to house, he dragged off men and women and put them in prison.
8.kjv: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.
8.blb: But Saul was destroying the church. Entering into the houses and dragging off men and women, he was delivering them to prison.
8.bbe: But Saul was burning with hate against the church, going into every house and taking men and women and putting them in prison.

8.msb: Those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went.
8.kjv: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
8.blb: Then indeed those having been scattered went about preaching the word.
8.bbe: But those who had gone in flight went everywhere preaching the word.
8.heading: Philip in Samaria

8.msb: Philip went down to a city in Samaria and proclaimed the Christ to them.
8.kjv: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.
8.blb: Now Philip, having gone down to a city of Samaria, was proclaiming the Christ to them.
8.bbe: And Philip went down to Samaria and was teaching them about Christ.

8.msb: The crowds all paid close attention to Philip’s message and to the signs they saw him perform.
8.kjv: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
8.blb: And the crowds, with one accord, were giving heed to the things being spoken by Philip in their hearing and seeing the signs that he was performing.
8.bbe: And all the people gave attention to the words which Philip said, when they saw the signs which he did.

8.msb: With loud shrieks, unclean spirits came out of many who were possessed, and many of the paralyzed and lame were healed.
8.kjv: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.
8.blb: For from many of those having unclean spirits they were coming out, crying in a loud voice. And many having been paralyzed and lame were healed.
8.bbe: For unclean spirits came out from those who had them, crying with a loud voice; and a number of those who were ill and broken in body were made well.

8.msb: So there was great joy in that city.
8.kjv: And there was great joy in that city.
8.blb: So there was great joy in that city.
8.bbe: And there was much joy in that town.

8.msb: Prior to that time, a man named Simon had practiced sorcery in the city and astounded the people of Samaria. He claimed to be someone great,
8.kjv: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
8.blb: Now a certain man named Simon had been formerly practicing sorcery in the city and amazing the people of Samaria, declaring himself to be someone great,
8.bbe: But there was a certain man named Simon, who in the past had been a wonder-worker and a cause of surprise to the people of Samaria, saying that he himself was a great man:
8.heading: Simon the Sorcerer

8.msb: and from the least to the greatest they heeded his words and said, “This man is the great power of God.”
8.kjv: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.
8.blb: to whom they were all giving heed, from small to great, saying, “This one is the power of God that is called Great.”
8.bbe: To whom they all gave attention, from the smallest to the greatest, saying, This man is that power of God which is named Great.

8.msb: They paid close attention to him because he had astounded them for a long time with his sorcery.
8.kjv: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
8.blb: Now they were giving heed to him because for a long time he had amazed them with the magic arts.
8.bbe: And they gave attention to him, because for a long time his wonder-working powers had kept them under his control.

8.msb: But when they believed Philip as he preached the gospel of the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
8.kjv: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
8.blb: But when they believed Philip proclaiming the gospel concerning the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
8.bbe: But when they had faith in the good news given by Philip about the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, a number of men and women had baptism.

8.msb: Even Simon himself believed and was baptized. He followed Philip closely and was astounded by the miracles and signs he observed.
8.kjv: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.
8.blb: And Simon himself also believed, and having been baptized, he was steadfastly continuing with Philip. And beholding the signs and great miracles being performed, he was amazed.
8.bbe: And Simon himself had faith and, having had baptism, he went with Philip and, seeing the signs and the great wonders which he did, he was full of surprise.

8.msb: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them.
8.kjv: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
8.blb: Now the apostles in Jerusalem, having heard that Samaria had received the word of God, sent to them Peter and John,
8.bbe: Now when the Apostles at Jerusalem had news that the people of Samaria had taken the word of God into their hearts, they sent to them Peter and John;

8.msb: On their arrival, they prayed for them to receive the Holy Spirit.
8.kjv: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:
8.blb: who, having come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit.
8.bbe: Who, when they came there, made prayer for them, that the Holy Spirit might be given to them:

8.msb: For the Holy Spirit had not yet fallen upon any of them; they had simply been baptized into the name of Jesus Christ.
8.kjv: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)
8.blb: For He was not yet fallen upon any of them, but they had only been baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.
8.bbe: For up to that time he had not come on any of them; only baptism had been given to them in the name of the Lord Jesus.

8.msb: Then Peter and John laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
8.kjv: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.
8.blb: Then they began laying the hands upon them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
8.bbe: Then they put their hands on them, and the Holy Spirit came on them.

8.msb: When Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money.
8.kjv: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles’ hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
8.blb: Now Simon, having seen that the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, offered to them money,
8.bbe: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the touch of the Apostles' hands, he made them an offering of money, saying,

8.msb: “Give me this power as well,” he said, “so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit.”
8.kjv: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.
8.blb: saying, “Give also to me this authority, so that on whomever I may lay the hands, he may receive the Holy Spirit.”
8.bbe: Give me this power, so that when I put my hands on anyone he may get the Holy Spirit.

8.msb: But Peter replied, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could buy the gift of God with money!
8.kjv: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.
8.blb: But Peter said to him, “Your silver with you, may it be to destruction, because you thought the gift of God was to be obtained by money!
8.bbe: But Peter said, May your money come to destruction with you, because you had the idea that what is freely given by God may be got for a price.

8.msb: You have no part or share in our ministry, because your heart is not right in the sight of God.
8.kjv: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.
8.blb: To you there is no part nor lot in this matter, for your heart is not right before God.
8.bbe: You have no part in this business, because your heart is not right before God.

8.msb: Repent, therefore, of your wickedness, and pray to God. Perhaps He will forgive you for the intent of your heart.
8.kjv: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.
8.blb: Repent, therefore, of this wickedness of yours, and pray earnestly to the Lord, if indeed the intent of your heart will be forgiven you.
8.bbe: Let your heart be changed, and make prayer to God that you may have forgiveness for your evil thoughts.

8.msb: For I see that you are poisoned by bitterness and captive to iniquity.”
8.kjv: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.
8.blb: For I see you being in the gall of bitterness and the bond of iniquity.”
8.bbe: For I see that you are prisoned in bitter envy and the chains of sin.

8.msb: Then Simon answered, “Pray to the Lord for me, so that nothing you have said may happen to me.”
8.kjv: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.
8.blb: And Simon, answering, said, “You pray earnestly to the Lord on behalf of me, so that nothing of which you have spoken may come upon me.”
8.bbe: And Simon, answering, said, Make prayer for me to the Lord, so that these things which you have said may not come on me.

8.msb: And after Peter and John had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many of the Samaritan villages.
8.kjv: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
8.blb: Then they indeed, having earnestly testified and having spoken the word of the Lord, traveled back to Jerusalem, and they were preaching the gospel to many villages of the Samaritans.
8.bbe: So they, having given their witness and made clear the word of the Lord, went back to Jerusalem, giving the good news on their way in a number of the small towns of Samaria.

8.msb: Now an angel of the Lord said to Philip, “Get up and go south to the desert road that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
8.kjv: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.
8.blb: Now an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Rise up and go toward the south, to the road going down from Jerusalem to Gaza.” (This is desert.)
8.bbe: But an angel of the Lord said to Philip, Get up, and go to the south, to the road which goes from Jerusalem to Gaza, through the waste land.
8.heading: Philip and the Ethiopian

8.msb: So he started out, and on his way he met an Ethiopian eunuch, a court official in charge of the entire treasury of Candace, the queen of the Ethiopians. He had gone to Jerusalem to worship,
8.kjv: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,
8.blb: And having risen up, he went. And behold, a man, an Ethiopian eunuch, a potentate of Kandake, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.
8.bbe: And he went and there was a man of Ethiopia, a servant of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, and controller of all her property, who had come up to Jerusalem for worship;

8.msb: and on his return was sitting in his chariot reading Isaiah the prophet.
8.kjv: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.
8.blb: And he was returning and sitting in his chariot, and he was reading the prophet Isaiah.
8.bbe: He was going back, seated in his carriage, and was reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.

8.msb: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go over to that chariot and stay by it.”
8.kjv: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
8.blb: And the Spirit said to Philip, “Go near and join yourself to this chariot.”
8.bbe: And the Spirit said to Philip, Go near, and get on his carriage.

8.msb: So Philip ran up and heard the man reading Isaiah the prophet. “Do you understand what you are reading?” Philip asked.
8.kjv: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
8.blb: And Philip, having run up, heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and he said, “Do you then understand what you are reading?”
8.bbe: And Philip, running up to him, saw that he was reading Isaiah the prophet, and said to him, Is the sense of what you are reading clear to you?

8.msb: “How can I,” he said, “unless someone guides me?” And he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.
8.kjv: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
8.blb: And he said, “How indeed could I be able, unless someone will guide me?” And he invited Philip, having come up, to sit with him.
8.bbe: And he said, How is that possible when I have no guide? And he made Philip get up by his side.

8.msb: The eunuch was reading this passage of Scripture: “He was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before the shearer is silent, so He did not open His mouth.
8.kjv: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:
8.blb: Now the passage of Scripture that he was reading was this: “He was led as a sheep to slaughter, and as a lamb before the one shearing it is silent, so He does not open His mouth.
8.bbe: Now the place in the book where he was reading was this: He was taken, like a sheep, to be put to death; and as a lamb is quiet when its wool is being cut, so he made no sound:

8.msb: In His humiliation He was deprived of justice. Who can recount His descendants? For His life was removed from the earth.”
8.kjv: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
8.blb: In His humiliation, justice was taken away from Him. Who will describe His generation? For His life is removed from the earth.”
8.bbe: Being of low degree, his cause was not given a hearing: who has knowledge of his family? for his life is cut off from the earth.

8.msb: “Tell me,” said the eunuch, “who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?”
8.kjv: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?
8.blb: And the eunuch, answering, said to Philip, “I beseech you, about whom does the prophet say this? About himself, or about some other?”
8.bbe: And the Ethiopian said to Philip, About whom are these words said by the prophet? about himself, or some other?

8.msb: Then Philip began with this very Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.
8.kjv: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.
8.blb: And Philip, having opened his mouth and having begun from this Scripture, proclaimed the good news to him—Jesus.
8.bbe: So Philip, starting from this writing, gave him the good news about Jesus.

8.msb: As they traveled along the road and came to some water, the eunuch said, “Look, here is water! What is there to prevent me from being baptized?”
8.kjv: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
8.blb: And as they were going along the road, they came upon some water, and the eunuch says, “Behold, water! What prevents my being baptized?”
8.bbe: And while they were going on their way, they came to some water, and the Ethiopian said, See, here is water; why may I not have baptism?

8.kjv: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.

8.msb: And he gave orders to stop the chariot. Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
8.kjv: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
8.blb: And he commanded the chariot to stop. And they both went down to the water—both Philip and the eunuch—and he baptized him.
8.bbe: And he gave orders for the carriage to be stopped, and the two of them went down into the water, and Philip gave him baptism.

8.msb: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord carried Philip away, and the eunuch saw him no more, but went on his way rejoicing.
8.kjv: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
8.blb: Now when they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord carried away Philip, and the eunuch saw him no longer. For he went on his way rejoicing.
8.bbe: And when they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord took Philip away; and the Ethiopian saw him no more, for he went on his way full of joy.

8.msb: But Philip appeared at Azotus and traveled through that region, preaching the gospel in all the towns until he came to Caesarea.
8.kjv: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Cæsarea.
8.blb: But Philip was found at Azotus, and passing through, he was proclaiming the gospel to all the towns until his coming to Caesarea.
8.bbe: But Philip came to Azotus, and went through all the towns, preaching the good news, till he came to Caesarea.

9.msb: Meanwhile, Saul was still breathing out murderous threats against the disciples of the Lord. He approached the high priest
9.kjv: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
9.blb: Now Saul, still breathing out threats and murder toward the disciples of the Lord, having gone to the high priest,
9.bbe: But Saul, still burning with desire to put to death the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest,
9.heading: The Road to Damascus

9.msb: and requested letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any men or women belonging to the Way, he could bring them as prisoners to Jerusalem.
9.kjv: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.
9.blb: requested letters from him to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any being of the Way, both men and women, having bound them, he might bring them to Jerusalem.
9.bbe: And made a request for letters from him to the Synagogues of Damascus, so that if there were any of the Way there, men or women, he might take them as prisoners to Jerusalem.

9.msb: As Saul drew near to Damascus on his journey, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.
9.kjv: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:
9.blb: Now in going, it came to pass that he drew near to Damascus, and suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.
9.bbe: And while he was journeying, he came near Damascus; and suddenly he saw a light from heaven shining round him;

9.msb: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?”
9.kjv: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
9.blb: And having fallen on the ground, he heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?”
9.bbe: And he went down on the earth, and a voice said to him, Saul, Saul, why are you attacking me so cruelly?

9.msb: “Who are You, Lord?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,” replied the Lord.
9.kjv: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
9.blb: And he said, “Who are You, Lord?” And He said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
9.bbe: And he said, Who are you, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus, whom you are attacking:

9.msb: “Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do.”
9.kjv: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
9.blb: “But rise up and enter into the city, and it will be told to you that which it is necessary for you to do.”
9.bbe: But get up, and go into the town, and it will be made clear to you what you have to do.

9.msb: The men traveling with Saul stood there speechless. They heard the voice but did not see anyone.
9.kjv: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
9.blb: And the men traveling with him stood speechless, hearing the voice indeed, but seeing no one.
9.bbe: And the men who were with him were not able to say anything; hearing the voice, but seeing no one.

9.msb: Saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes he could not see a thing. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.
9.kjv: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
9.blb: And Saul rose up from the ground, but his eyes having been opened, he could see nothing. And leading him by the hand, they brought him to Damascus.
9.bbe: And Saul got up from the earth, and when his eyes were open, he saw nothing; and he was guided by the hand into Damascus.

9.msb: For three days he was without sight, and he did not eat or drink anything.
9.kjv: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.
9.blb: And he was three days without seeing, and he did not eat, nor did he drink.
9.bbe: And for three days he was not able to see, and he took no food or drink.

9.msb: In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. The Lord spoke to him in a vision, “Ananias!” “Here I am, Lord,” he answered.
9.kjv: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.
9.blb: Now there was a certain disciple in Damascus named Ananias. And the Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” And he said, “Behold, it is I, Lord.”
9.bbe: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and the Lord said to him in a vision, Ananias! and he said, Here I am, Lord.
9.heading: Ananias Baptizes Saul

9.msb: “Get up!” the Lord told him. “Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying.
9.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
9.blb: And the Lord said to him, “Having risen up, go into the street called Straight, and seek in the house of Judas the one of Tarsus named Saul, for behold, he is praying,
9.bbe: And the Lord said to him, Get up, and go to the street which is named Straight, and make search at the house of Judas for one named Saul of Tarsus: for he is at prayer;

9.msb: In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place a hand on him to restore his sight.”
9.kjv: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
9.blb: and he saw in a vision a man named Ananias having come and having put the hands on him so that he might see again.”
9.bbe: And he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and putting his hands on him, so that he may be able to see.

9.msb: But Ananias answered, “Lord, many people have told me about this man and all the harm he has done to Your saints in Jerusalem.
9.kjv: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
9.blb: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many concerning this man, how many evils he did to Your saints in Jerusalem.
9.bbe: But Ananias said, Lord, I have had accounts of this man from a number of people, how much evil he has done to your saints at Jerusalem:

9.msb: And now he is here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on Your name.”
9.kjv: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.
9.blb: And here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all those calling on Your name.”
9.bbe: And here he has authority from the chief priests to make prisoners all who give worship to your name.

9.msb: “Go!” said the Lord. “This man is My chosen instrument to carry My name before the Gentiles and their kings, and before the people of Israel.
9.kjv: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
9.blb: But the Lord said to him, “Go, for this man is to Me a vessel of choice to carry My name before the Gentiles, and also kings and the sons of Israel.
9.bbe: But the Lord said, Go without fear: for he is a special vessel for me, to give to the Gentiles and kings and to the children of Israel the knowledge of my name:

9.msb: I will show him how much he must suffer for My name.”
9.kjv: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name’s sake.
9.blb: For I will show to him how much it is necessary for him to suffer for My name.”
9.bbe: For I will make clear to him what troubles he will have to undergo for me.

9.msb: So Ananias went to the house, and when he arrived, he placed his hands on Saul. “Brother Saul,” he said, “the Lord, who appeared to you on the road as you were coming here, has sent me so that you may see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
9.kjv: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
9.blb: And Ananias went away and entered into the house; and having laid the hands upon him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, the One having appeared to you on the road by which you were coming, has sent me so that you may see again and may be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
9.bbe: And Ananias went out and came to the house, and putting his hands on him, said, Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, whom you saw when you were on your journey, has sent me, so that you may be able to see, and be full of the Holy Spirit.

9.msb: At that instant, something like scales fell from Saul’s eyes, and his sight was restored. He got up and was baptized,
9.kjv: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
9.blb: And immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he saw again. And having risen up, he was baptized,
9.bbe: And straight away it seemed as if a veil was taken from his eyes, and he was able to see; and he got up, and had baptism;

9.msb: and after taking some food, he regained his strength. And Saul spent several days with the disciples in Damascus.
9.kjv: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
9.blb: and having taken food, he was strengthened. And he was some days with the disciples in Damascus.
9.bbe: And when he had taken food his strength came back. And for some days he kept with the disciples who were in Damascus.

9.msb: Saul promptly began to proclaim Christ in the synagogues, declaring, “He is the Son of God.”
9.kjv: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
9.blb: And immediately he began proclaiming Jesus in the synagogues, that He is the Son of God.
9.bbe: And straight away, in the Synagogues, he was preaching Jesus as the Son of God.
9.heading: Saul Preaches at Damascus

9.msb: All who heard him were astounded and asked, “Isn’t this the man who wreaked havoc in Jerusalem on those who call on this name? And hasn’t he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?”
9.kjv: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?
9.blb: And all those hearing were amazed and were saying, “Is this not the one having ravaged those in Jerusalem calling on this name? And he had come here for this, so that he might bring them, having been bound, to the chief priests.”
9.bbe: And all those hearing him were full of wonder and said, Is not this the man who in Jerusalem was attacking all the worshippers of this name? and he had come here so that he might take them as prisoners before the chief priests.

9.msb: But Saul was empowered all the more, and he confounded the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Christ.
9.kjv: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
9.blb: But Saul was empowered all the more and kept confounding the Jews dwelling in Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.
9.bbe: But Saul went on increasing in power, and the Jews in Damascus were not able to give answers to the arguments by which he made it clear that Jesus was the Christ.

9.msb: After many days had passed, the Jews conspired to kill him,
9.kjv: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:
9.blb: Now when many days had passed, the Jews plotted together to kill him,
9.bbe: Then, after some days, the Jews made an agreement together to put him to death:
9.heading: The Escape from Damascus

9.msb: but Saul learned of their plot. Day and night they watched the city gates in order to kill him.
9.kjv: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.
9.blb: but their plot became known to Saul. And now they were closely watching the gates day and also night so that they might kill him.
9.bbe: But Saul got knowledge of their design. And they kept watch day and night on the roads out of the town, so that they might put him to death:

9.msb: One night, however, the disciples took him and lowered him in a basket through a window in the wall.
9.kjv: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.
9.blb: But having taken him by night, his disciples let him down through the wall, having lowered him in a basket.
9.bbe: But his disciples took him by night and let him down from the wall in a basket.

9.msb: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
9.kjv: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
9.blb: And having arrived in Jerusalem, he was attempting to join the disciples, and all were afraid of him, not believing that he is a disciple.
9.bbe: And when he came to Jerusalem, he made an attempt to be joined to the disciples, but they were all in fear of him, not taking him for a disciple.
9.heading: Saul in Jerusalem

9.msb: Then Barnabas brought him to the apostles and described how Saul had seen the Lord, who had spoken to him on the road to Damascus, and how Saul had spoken boldly in that city in the name of Jesus.
9.kjv: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
9.blb: But Barnabas, having taken him, brought him to the apostles and related to them how he had seen the Lord on the road, and that He had spoken to him, and how in Damascus he had spoken boldly in the name of Jesus.
9.bbe: But Barnabas took him to the Apostles and gave them an account of how he had seen the Lord on the road, and had given hearing to his words, and how at Damascus he had been preaching in the name of Jesus without fear.

9.msb: So Saul stayed with them, moving about freely in Jerusalem and speaking boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus.
9.kjv: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.
9.blb: And he was coming in and going out with them in Jerusalem, speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.
9.bbe: And he was with them, going in and out at Jerusalem,

9.msb: He talked and debated with the Grecian Jews, but they tried to kill him.
9.kjv: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
9.blb: And he was speaking and was debating with the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.
9.bbe: Preaching in the name of the Lord without fear; and he had discussions with the Greek Jews; but they were working for his death.

9.msb: When the brothers learned of this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
9.kjv: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Cæsarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
9.blb: But the brothers, having known, brought him down to Caesarea and sent him away to Tarsus.
9.bbe: And when the brothers had knowledge of it, they took him to Caesarea and sent him to Tarsus.

9.msb: Then the churches throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria experienced a time of peace. They grew in strength and numbers, living in the fear of the Lord and the encouragement of the Holy Spirit.
9.kjv: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judæa and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
9.blb: Then indeed the church throughout all of Judea and Galilee and Samaria had peace, being edified. And going on in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit, they were multiplied.
9.bbe: And so the church through all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria had peace and was made strong; and, living in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit, was increased greatly.
9.heading: The Healing of Aeneas

9.msb: As Peter traveled throughout the area, he went to visit the saints in Lydda.
9.kjv: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
9.blb: Now it came to pass that Peter, passing through all quarters, also went down to the saints inhabiting Lydda.
9.bbe: And it came about that while Peter was going through all parts of the country he came to the saints who were living at Lydda.

9.msb: There he found a man named Aeneas who had been paralyzed and bedridden for eight years.
9.kjv: And there he found a certain man named Æneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.
9.blb: And he found there a certain man named Aeneas, who was paralyzed, lying on a bed for eight years.
9.bbe: And there was a certain man there, named Aeneas, who for eight years had been in bed, without power of moving.

9.msb: “Aeneas,” Peter said to him, “Jesus Christ heals you! Get up and put away your mat.” Immediately Aeneas got up,
9.kjv: And Peter said unto him, Æneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.
9.blb: And Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you; rise up and make the bed for yourself.” And immediately he rose up,
9.bbe: And Peter said to him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ makes you well: get up and make your bed. And straight away he got up.

9.msb: and all who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.
9.kjv: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.
9.blb: and all those inhabiting Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.
9.bbe: And all those living in Lydda and Sharon saw him, and were turned to the Lord.

9.msb: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (which is translated as Dorcas), who was always occupied with works of kindness and charity.
9.kjv: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
9.blb: Now in Joppa there was a certain disciple named Tabitha (which, translated, is called Dorcas). She was full of good works and of alms that she continually did.
9.bbe: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, that is, Dorcas: this woman was given to good works and acts of mercy at all times.
9.heading: The Raising of Tabitha

9.msb: At that time, however, she became sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upper room.
9.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.
9.blb: But in those days it came to pass that having become sick, she died. And having washed her, they put her in an upper room.
9.bbe: And it came about, in those days, that she got ill and came to her death: and when she had been washed, they put her in a room which was high up.

9.msb: Since Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent to urge him, “Come to them without delay.”
9.kjv: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.
9.blb: Now Lydda being near Joppa, the disciples, having heard that Peter is in it, sent two men to him, imploring, “Do not delay to come to us.”
9.bbe: And because Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, having knowledge that Peter was there, sent two men to him, requesting him to come to them straight away.

9.msb: So Peter got up and went with them. On his arrival, they took him to the upper room. All the widows stood around him, weeping and showing him the tunics and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.
9.kjv: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.
9.blb: And Peter, having risen up, went with them, who, having arrived, brought him into the upper room. And all the widows stood by him, weeping and showing the tunics and garments that Dorcas had made while being with them.
9.bbe: And Peter went with them. And when he had come, they took him into the room: and all the widows were there, weeping and putting before him the coats and clothing which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

9.msb: Then Peter sent them all out of the room. He knelt down and prayed, and turning toward her body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and seeing Peter, she sat up.
9.kjv: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
9.blb: And Peter, having put all outside and having bowed the knees, prayed. And having turned to the body he said, “Tabitha, arise!” And she opened her eyes, and having seen Peter, she sat up.
9.bbe: But Peter made them all go outside, and went down on his knees in prayer; and turning to the body, he said, Tabitha, get up. And, opening her eyes, she saw Peter and got up.

9.msb: Peter took her by the hand and helped her up. Then he called the saints and widows and presented her to them alive.
9.kjv: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
9.blb: And having given her his hand, he raised her up. And having called the saints and the widows, he presented her being alive.
9.bbe: And he took her hand, lifting her up; and, sending for the saints and widows, he gave her to them, living.

9.msb: This became known all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.
9.kjv: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.
9.blb: And it became known throughout all of Joppa, and many believed on the Lord.
9.bbe: And news of it went all through Joppa, and a number of people had faith in the Lord.

9.msb: And Peter stayed for several days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.
9.kjv: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
9.blb: And it came to pass that he stayed many days in Joppa with a certain Simon, a tanner.
9.bbe: And he was living in Joppa for some time with Simon, a leather-worker.

10.msb: At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion in what was called the Italian Regiment.
10.kjv: There was a certain man in Cæsarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,
10.blb: Now a certain man in Caesarea named Cornelius was a centurion of the cohort that is called Italian,
10.bbe: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, named Cornelius, the captain of the Italian band of the army;
10.heading: Cornelius Sends for Peter

10.msb: He and all his household were devout and God-fearing. He gave generously to the people and prayed to God regularly.
10.kjv: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.
10.blb: devout and fearing God with all his household, doing many alms to the people and praying to God through all.
10.bbe: A serious-minded man, fearing God with all his family; he gave much money to the poor, and made prayer to God at all times.

10.msb: One day at about the ninth hour, he had a clear vision of an angel of God who came to him and said, “Cornelius!”
10.kjv: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.
10.blb: He saw clearly in a vision, as it was about the ninth hour of the day, an angel of God having come to him and having said to him, “Cornelius!”
10.bbe: He saw in a vision, clearly, at about the ninth hour of the day, an angel of the Lord coming to him and saying to him, Cornelius!

10.msb: Cornelius stared at him in fear and asked, “What is it, Lord?” The angel answered, “Your prayers and gifts to the poor have ascended as a memorial offering before God.
10.kjv: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.
10.blb: And having looked intently at him, and having become afraid, he said, “What is it, Lord?” And he said to him, “Your prayers and your alms have ascended as a memorial before God.
10.bbe: And he, looking on him in fear, said, What is it, Lord? And he said to him, Your prayers and your offerings have come up to God, and he has kept them in mind.

10.msb: Now send men to Joppa to call for Simon who is called Peter.
10.kjv: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:
10.blb: And now send men to Joppa and summon a certain Simon, who is called Peter.
10.bbe: Now send men to Joppa, and get one Simon, named Peter,

10.msb: He is staying with Simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea.”
10.kjv: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
10.blb: He lodges with a certain Simon, a tanner whose house is by the sea.”
10.bbe: Who is living with Simon, a leather-worker, whose house is by the sea.

10.msb: When the angel who spoke to him had gone, Cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier from among his attendants.
10.kjv: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
10.blb: And when the angel speaking to him went away, having called two of the servants and a devout soldier of those attending him,
10.bbe: And when the angel who said these words to him had gone away, he sent for two of his house-servants, and a God-fearing man of the army, one of those who were waiting on him at all times;

10.msb: He explained what had happened and sent them to Joppa.
10.kjv: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
10.blb: and having related all things to them, he sent them to Joppa.
10.bbe: And having given them an account of everything, he sent them to Joppa.

10.msb: The next day at about the sixth hour, as the men were approaching the city on their journey, Peter went up on the roof to pray.
10.kjv: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
10.blb: Now on the next day, in their journeying and approaching the city, Peter went up on the housetop about the sixth hour to pray.
10.bbe: Now the day after, when they were on their journey and were near the town, Peter went up to the top of the house for prayer, about the sixth hour:
10.heading: Peter’s Vision

10.msb: He became hungry and wanted something to eat, but while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.
10.kjv: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
10.blb: And he became hungry and desired to eat. But in their preparing, a trance fell upon him,
10.bbe: And he was in need of food: but while they were getting it ready, a deep sleep came on him;

10.msb: He saw heaven open and something like a large sheet being let down to earth to him, bound at its four corners.
10.kjv: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
10.blb: and he sees heaven opening and a certain vessel as a great sheet descending, being let down upon the earth by four corners,
10.bbe: And he saw the heavens opening, and a vessel coming down, like a great cloth let down on the earth,

10.msb: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, and reptiles, as well as birds of the air.
10.kjv: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
10.blb: in which were all the quadrupeds and creeping things of the earth and birds of heaven.
10.bbe: In which were all sorts of beasts and birds.

10.msb: Then a voice said to him: “Get up, Peter, kill and eat!”
10.kjv: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
10.blb: And a voice came to him: “Having risen up, Peter, kill and eat!”
10.bbe: And a voice came to him, saying, Come, Peter; take them for food.

10.msb: “No, Lord!” Peter answered. “I have never eaten anything impure or unclean.”
10.kjv: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
10.blb: But Peter said, “In no way, Lord! For never have I eaten anything common or unclean.”
10.bbe: But Peter said, No, Lord; for I have never taken food which is common or unclean.

10.msb: The voice spoke to him a second time: “Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.”
10.kjv: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
10.blb: And a voice came again to him for the second time: “What God has cleansed, you do not call common.”
10.bbe: And the voice came to him a second time, What God has made clean, do not you make common.

10.msb: This happened three times, and again the sheet was taken back up into heaven.
10.kjv: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
10.blb: Now this took place for three times, and immediately the vessel was taken up into heaven.
10.bbe: And this was done three times: and then the vessel was taken back into heaven.

10.msb: While Peter was puzzling over the meaning of the vision, the men sent by Cornelius found Simon’s house and approached the gate.
10.kjv: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon’s house, and stood before the gate,
10.blb: And while Peter was perplexed in himself as to what the vision that he had seen might be, behold, the men having been sent from Cornelius, having inquired for the house of Simon, stood at the gate.
10.bbe: Now while Peter was in doubt as to the purpose of this vision, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made search for Simon's house, came to the door,
10.heading: Peter Called to Caesarea

10.msb: They called out to ask if Simon called Peter was staying there.
10.kjv: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.
10.blb: And having called out, they were asking if Simon who is called Peter is lodged here.
10.bbe: To see if Simon, named Peter, was living there.

10.msb: As Peter continued to reflect on the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, men are looking for you.
10.kjv: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
10.blb: And of Peter thinking over the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men are seeking you.
10.bbe: And, while Peter was turning the vision over in his mind, the Spirit said to him, See, three men are looking for you.

10.msb: So get up! Go downstairs and accompany them without hesitation, because I have sent them.”
10.kjv: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.
10.blb: But having risen, go down and proceed with them, doubting nothing, because I have sent them.”
10.bbe: Go down, then, and go with them, doubting nothing, for I have sent them.

10.msb: So Peter went down to the men and said, “Here am I, the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
10.kjv: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
10.blb: And Peter, having gone down to the men, said, “Behold, I am whom you seek; what is the cause for which you are here?”
10.bbe: And Peter went down to the men, and said, I am the man you are looking for: why have you come?

10.msb: “Cornelius the centurion has sent us,” they said. “He is a righteous and God-fearing man with a good reputation among the whole Jewish nation. A holy angel instructed him to request your presence in his home so he could hear a message from you.”
10.kjv: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
10.blb: And they said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a man righteous and fearing God—and being well testified to by all the nation of the Jews—was divinely instructed by a holy angel to send for you to his house and to hear a message from you.”
10.bbe: And they said, Cornelius, a captain, an upright and God-fearing man, respected by all the nation of the Jews, had word from God by an angel to send for you to his house, and to give hearing to your words.

10.msb: So Peter invited them in as his guests. And the next day he went with them, accompanied by some of the brothers from Joppa.
10.kjv: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
10.blb: Therefore, having called them in, he lodged them. And on the next day, having risen up, he went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa went with him.
10.bbe: So he took them in for the night. And the day after, he went with them, taking some of the brothers from Joppa with him.

10.msb: The following day they arrived in Caesarea, where Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.
10.kjv: And the morrow after they entered into Cæsarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
10.blb: And on the next day, he entered into Caesarea. Now Cornelius was expecting them, having called together his relatives and close friends.
10.bbe: And the day after that, they came to Caesarea. And Cornelius was waiting for them, having got together his relations and his near friends.
10.heading: Peter Visits Cornelius

10.msb: As Peter was about to enter, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet to worship him.
10.kjv: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
10.blb: And as Peter was entering, Cornelius, having met him, having fallen at his feet, worshiped him.
10.bbe: And when Peter came in, Cornelius came to him and, falling down at his feet, gave him worship.

10.msb: But Peter helped him up. “Stand up,” he said, “I am only a man myself.”
10.kjv: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
10.blb: But Peter lifted him up, saying, “Rise up, I myself am also a man.”
10.bbe: But Peter, lifting him up, said, Get up, for I am a man as you are.

10.msb: As Peter talked with him, he went inside and found many people gathered together.
10.kjv: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.
10.blb: And talking with him, he entered, and he finds many having gathered together.
10.bbe: And saying these words, he went in, and saw that a great number of people had come together;

10.msb: He said to them, “You know how unlawful it is for a Jew to associate with a foreigner or visit him. But God has shown me that I should not call any man impure or unclean.
10.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
10.blb: And he was saying to them, “You know how it is unlawful for a man, a Jew, to unite himself or to come near to a foreigner. But God showed to me not to call a man common or unclean.
10.bbe: And he said to them, You yourselves have knowledge that it is against the law for a man who is a Jew to be in the company of one who is of another nation; but God has made it clear to me that no man may be named common or unclean:

10.msb: So when I was invited, I came without objection. I ask, then, why have you sent for me?”
10.kjv: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
10.blb: Therefore also without objection I came, having been summoned. I ask, therefore for what reason did you summon me?”
10.bbe: And so I came without question, when I was sent for. What then is your purpose in sending for me?

10.msb: Cornelius answered: “Four days ago I was in my house fasting and praying at this, the ninth hour. Suddenly a man in radiant clothing stood before me
10.kjv: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
10.blb: And Cornelius was saying, “Four days ago until this hour, the ninth hour, I was praying in my house; and behold, a man in bright apparel stood before me,
10.bbe: And Cornelius said, Four days from now I was in my house in prayer at the ninth hour; and I saw before me a man in shining clothing,

10.msb: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer has been heard, and your gifts to the poor have been remembered before God.
10.kjv: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.
10.blb: and he said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer was heard, and your alms have been remembered before God.
10.bbe: Who said, Cornelius, your prayer has come to the ears of God, and your offerings are kept in his memory.

10.msb: Therefore send to Joppa for Simon, who is called Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, by the sea. He will speak to you when he arrives.’
10.kjv: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.
10.blb: Therefore send to Joppa and call for Simon, who is called Peter; he lodges in the house of Simon, a tanner by the sea.’
10.bbe: Send, then, to Joppa, and get Simon, named Peter, to come to you; he is living in the house of Simon, a leather-worker, by the sea.

10.msb: So I sent for you immediately, and you were kind enough to come. Now then, we are all here in the presence of God to listen to everything God has instructed you to tell us.”
10.kjv: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
10.blb: Therefore I sent to you at once, and you did well, having come. Now, therefore, we are all present before God to hear all the things having been commanded you by the Lord.”
10.bbe: So, straight away, I sent for you; and you have done well to come. And now, we are all present before God, ready to give attention to all the things which the Lord has given you to say.

10.msb: Then Peter began to speak: “I now truly understand that God does not show favoritism,
10.kjv: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
10.blb: And Peter, having opened the mouth, said, “Of a truth I understand that God is not One who shows partiality,
10.bbe: Then Peter said, Truly, I see clearly that God is no respecter of persons:
10.heading: Good News for the Gentiles

10.msb: but welcomes those from every nation who fear Him and do what is right.
10.kjv: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
10.blb: but in every nation the one fearing Him and working righteousness is acceptable to Him,
10.bbe: But in every nation, the man who has fear of him and does righteousness is pleasing to him.

10.msb: He has sent this message to the people of Israel, proclaiming the gospel of peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.
10.kjv: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)
10.blb: the word that He sent to the sons of Israel, proclaiming the gospel, peace by Jesus Christ—this One is Lord of all.
10.bbe: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, giving the good news of peace through Jesus Christ (who is Lord of all) —

10.msb: You yourselves know what has happened throughout Judea, beginning in Galilee with the baptism that John proclaimed:
10.kjv: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judæa, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
10.blb: You yourselves know the declaration having come through all Judea, having begun from Galilee, after the baptism that John proclaimed:
10.bbe: That word you yourselves have knowledge of, which was made public through all Judaea, starting from Galilee, after the baptism of which John was the preacher,

10.msb: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, and how Jesus went around doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, because God was with Him.
10.kjv: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
10.blb: Jesus from Nazareth—how God anointed Him with the Holy Spirit and with power—who went about doing good and healing all those being oppressed by the devil, because God was with Him.
10.bbe: About Jesus of Nazareth, how God gave the Holy Spirit to him, with power: and how he went about doing good and making well all who were troubled by evil spirits, for God was with him.

10.msb: We are witnesses of all that He did, both in the land of the Jews and in Jerusalem. And although they put Him to death by hanging Him on a tree,
10.kjv: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:
10.blb: And we are witnesses of all that He did—both in the region of the Jews and in Jerusalem—whom they also put to death, having hanged Him on a tree.
10.bbe: And we are witnesses of all the things which he did in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they put to death, hanging him on a tree.

10.msb: God raised Him up on the third day and caused Him to be seen—
10.kjv: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;
10.blb: This One God raised up on the third day and gave Him to become manifest,
10.bbe: On the third day God gave him back to life, and let him be seen,

10.msb: not by all the people, but by the witnesses God had chosen beforehand, by us who ate and drank with Him after He rose from the dead.
10.kjv: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
10.blb: not to all the people, but to the witnesses having been chosen beforehand by God, to us who ate and drank with Him after His rising out from the dead.
10.bbe: Not by all the people, but by witnesses marked out before by God, even by us, who took food and drink with him after he came back from the dead.

10.msb: And He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that He is the One appointed by God to judge the living and the dead.
10.kjv: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
10.blb: And He instructed us to proclaim to the people and to testify fully that He is the One having been appointed by God as Judge of the living and the dead.
10.bbe: And he gave us orders to give news of this to the people, and to give public witness that this is he whom God has made judge of the living and the dead.

10.msb: All the prophets testify about Him that everyone who believes in Him receives forgiveness of sins through His name.”
10.kjv: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
10.blb: To this One all the prophets testify that everyone believing in Him receives forgiveness of sins through His name.”
10.bbe: To him all the prophets give witness, that through his name everyone who has faith in him will have forgiveness of sins.

10.msb: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell upon all who heard his message.
10.kjv: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
10.blb: Peter still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell upon all those hearing the word.
10.bbe: While Peter was saying these words, the Holy Spirit came on all those who were hearing the word.
10.heading: The Gentiles Receive the Holy Spirit

10.msb: All the circumcised believers who had accompanied Peter were astounded that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on the Gentiles.
10.kjv: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
10.blb: And the believers from the circumcision, as many as had come with Peter, were amazed that the gift of the Holy Spirit has been poured out even on the Gentiles.
10.bbe: And the Jews of the faith, who had come with Peter, were full of wonder, because the Holy Spirit was given to the Gentiles,

10.msb: For they heard them speaking in tongues and exalting God. Then Peter said,
10.kjv: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,
10.blb: For they were hearing them speaking in tongues and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,
10.bbe: And they were talking in tongues, and giving glory to God. Then Peter said,

10.msb: “Can anyone withhold the water to baptize these people? They have received the Holy Spirit just as we have!”
10.kjv: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
10.blb: “Is anyone able to withhold the water to baptize these who have received the Holy Spirit just as we also have?”
10.bbe: Will any man say that these may not have baptism who have been given the Holy Spirit as we have?

10.msb: So he ordered that they be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then they asked him to stay for a few days.
10.kjv: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
10.blb: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to remain some days.
10.bbe: And he gave orders for them to have baptism in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they kept him with them for some days.

11.msb: The apostles and brothers throughout Judea soon heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
11.kjv: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judæa heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
11.blb: Now the apostles and the brothers being in Judea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
11.bbe: Now the Apostles and the brothers who were in Judaea had news that the word of God had been given to the Gentiles.
11.heading: Peter’s Report at Jerusalem

11.msb: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers took issue with him
11.kjv: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
11.blb: And when Peter went up to Jerusalem, those of the circumcision began contending with him,
11.bbe: And when Peter came to Jerusalem, those who kept the rule of circumcision had an argument with him,

11.msb: and said, “You visited uncircumcised men and ate with them.”
11.kjv: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
11.blb: saying, “You went to men having uncircumcision and ate with them.”
11.bbe: Saying, You went to men without circumcision, and took food with them.

11.msb: But Peter began and explained to them the whole sequence of events:
11.kjv: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,
11.blb: Now Peter, having begun, set it forth to them in order, saying,
11.bbe: But Peter gave them an account of it all in order, saying to them,

11.msb: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision of something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came right down to me.
11.kjv: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
11.blb: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision, a certain vessel like a great sheet descending, being let down out of heaven by four corners, and it came as far as me.
11.bbe: I was in the town of Joppa, at prayer: and falling into a deep sleep, I saw in a vision a vessel like a great cloth let down from heaven, and it came down to me:

11.msb: I looked at it closely and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds of the air.
11.kjv: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
11.blb: Having looked intently on it, I was observing it, and I saw the quadrupeds of the earth and the wild beasts and the creeping things and the birds of the air.
11.bbe: And looking on it with attention I saw in it all sorts of beasts and birds.

11.msb: Then I heard a voice saying to me, ‘Get up, Peter, kill and eat.’
11.kjv: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
11.blb: And also I heard a voice saying to me, ‘Having risen up, Peter, kill and eat.’
11.bbe: And a voice came to my ears saying, Come, Peter; take them for food.

11.msb: ‘No, Lord,’ I said, ‘for nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’
11.kjv: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
11.blb: But I said, ‘In no way, Lord, for never has a common or unclean thing entered into my mouth.’
11.bbe: But I said, No, Lord; for nothing common or unclean has ever come into my mouth.

11.msb: But the voice spoke to me from heaven a second time, ‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’
11.kjv: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
11.blb: But for a second time the voice answered out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, you do not call common.’
11.bbe: But the voice, coming a second time from heaven, said, What God has made clean, do not you make common.
