4.kjv: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
4.blb: and having been fully assured that what He has promised, He is also able to do.
4.bbe: And being certain that God was able to keep his word.

4.msb: This is why “it was credited to him as righteousness.”
4.kjv: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
4.blb: Therefore also “it was reckoned to him as righteousness.”
4.bbe: For which reason it was put to his account as righteousness.

4.msb: Now the words “it was credited to him” were written not only for Abraham,
4.kjv: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
4.blb: Now it was not written because of him alone that “it was reckoned to him,”
4.bbe: Now, it was not because of him only that this was said,

4.msb: but also for us, to whom righteousness will be credited—for us who believe in Him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.
4.kjv: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
4.blb: but also because of us, to whom it is about to be reckoned, to those believing on the One having raised Jesus our Lord out from the dead,
4.bbe: But for us in addition, to whose account it will be put, if we have faith in him who made Jesus our Lord come back again from the dead,

4.msb: He was delivered over to death for our trespasses and was raised to life for our justification.
4.kjv: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
4.blb: who was delivered over because of our trespasses, and was raised because of our justification.
4.bbe: Who was put to death for our evil-doing, and came to life again so that we might have righteousness.

5.msb: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
5.kjv: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
5.blb: Therefore, having been justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
5.bbe: For which reason, because we have righteousness through faith, let us be at peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
5.heading: The Triumph of Faith

5.msb: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we stand. And we rejoice in the hope of the glory of God.
5.kjv: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
5.blb: through whom also we have access by faith into this grace in which we stand; and we boast in hope of the glory of God.
5.bbe: Through whom, in the same way, we have been able by faith to come to this grace in which we now are; and let us have joy in hope of the glory of God.

5.msb: Not only that, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;
5.kjv: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
5.blb: And not only so, but also we boast in tribulations, knowing that tribulation produces perseverance;
5.bbe: And not only so, but let us have joy in our troubles: in the knowledge that trouble gives us the power of waiting;

5.msb: perseverance, character; and character, hope.
5.kjv: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
5.blb: and perseverance, character; and character, hope.
5.bbe: And waiting gives experience; and experience, hope:

5.msb: And hope does not disappoint us, because God has poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, whom He has given us.
5.kjv: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
5.blb: And hope does not put us to shame, because the love of God has been poured out in our hearts through the Holy Spirit, the One having been given to us.
5.bbe: And hope does not put to shame; because our hearts are full of the love of God through the Holy Spirit which is given to us.

5.msb: For at the right time, while we were still powerless, Christ died for the ungodly.
5.kjv: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
5.blb: Still indeed Christ, in our still being weak, according to the right time, died for the ungodly.
5.bbe: For when we were still without strength, at the right time Christ gave his life for evil-doers.
5.heading: Christ’s Sacrifice for the Ungodly

5.msb: Very rarely will anyone die for a righteous man, though for a good man someone might possibly dare to die.
5.kjv: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
5.blb: For hardly anyone will die for a righteous man, though for the good man perhaps someone would even dare to die.
5.bbe: Now it is hard for anyone to give his life even for an upright man, though it might be that for a good man someone would give his life.

5.msb: But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
5.kjv: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
5.blb: But God demonstrates His own love to us, that in our being still sinners, Christ died for us.
5.bbe: But God has made clear his love to us, in that, when we were still sinners, Christ gave his life for us.

5.msb: Therefore, since we have now been justified by His blood, how much more shall we be saved from wrath through Him!
5.kjv: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
5.blb: Therefore much more, having been justified now by His blood, we will be saved by Him from wrath!
5.bbe: Much more, if we now have righteousness by his blood, will salvation from the wrath of God come to us through him.

5.msb: For if, when we were enemies of God, we were reconciled to Him through the death of His Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through His life!
5.kjv: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
5.blb: For if, being enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of His Son, much more, having been reconciled, we will be saved in His life!
5.bbe: For if, when we were haters of God, the death of his Son made us at peace with him, much more, now that we are his friends, will we have salvation through his life;

5.msb: Not only that, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.
5.kjv: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
5.blb: And not only so, but also we are boasting in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we now received reconciliation.
5.bbe: And not only so, but we have joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we are now at peace with God.

5.msb: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, so also death was passed on to all men, because all sinned.
5.kjv: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
5.blb: Because of this, just as through one man sin entered into the world, and death through sin, so also death passed through to all men, because all sinned.
5.bbe: For this reason, as through one man sin came into the world, and death because of sin, and so death came to all men, because all have done evil:
5.heading: Death in Adam, Life in Christ

5.msb: For sin was in the world before the law was given; but sin is not taken into account when there is no law.
5.kjv: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
5.blb: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not imputed, there being no law.
5.bbe: Because, till the law came, sin was in existence, but sin is not put to the account of anyone when there is no law to be broken.

5.msb: Nevertheless, death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those who did not sin in the way that Adam transgressed. He is a pattern of the One to come.
5.kjv: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
5.blb: Nevertheless, death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those not having sinned in the likeness of the transgression of Adam, who is a type of the coming One.
5.bbe: But still death had power from Adam till Moses, even over those who had not done wrong like Adam, who is a picture of him who was to come.

5.msb: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died by the trespass of the one man, how much more did God’s grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many!
5.kjv: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.
5.blb: But not as the trespass, so also is the gracious gift; for if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more the grace of God and the gift in grace, that of the one man, Jesus Christ, abounded to the many!
5.bbe: But the free giving of God is not like the wrongdoing of man. For if, by the wrongdoing of one man death came to numbers of men, much more did the grace of God, and the free giving by the grace of one man, Jesus Christ, come to men.

5.msb: Again, the gift is not like the result of the one man’s sin: The judgment that followed one sin brought condemnation, but the gift that followed many trespasses brought justification.
5.kjv: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
5.blb: And not as through one having sinned is the gift; for indeed the judgment out of one is to condemnation; but the gracious gift out of many trespasses is to justification.
5.bbe: And the free giving has not the same effect as the sin of one: for the effect of one man's sin was punishment by the decision of God, but the free giving had power to give righteousness to wrongdoers in great number.

5.msb: For if, by the trespass of the one man, death reigned through that one man, how much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man, Jesus Christ!
5.kjv: For if by one man’s offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
5.blb: For if, by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one, much more will those receiving the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ!
5.bbe: For, if by the wrongdoing of one, death was ruling through the one, much more will those to whom has come the wealth of grace and the giving of righteousness, be ruling in life through the one, even Jesus Christ.

5.msb: So then, just as one trespass brought condemnation for all men, so also one act of righteousness brought justification and life for all men.
5.kjv: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.
5.blb: So then, just as through one trespass is condemnation to all men so also through one righteous act is justification of life to all men.
5.bbe: So then, as the effect of one act of wrongdoing was that punishment came on all men, even so the effect of one act of righteousness was righteousness of life for all men.

5.msb: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.
5.kjv: For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
5.blb: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the One the many will be made righteous.
5.bbe: Because, as numbers of men became sinners through the wrongdoing of one man, even so will great numbers get righteousness through the keeping of the word of God by one man.

5.msb: The law came in so that the trespass would increase; but where sin increased, grace increased all the more,
5.kjv: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
5.blb: And the law entered so that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace overabounded,
5.bbe: And the law came in addition, to make wrongdoing worse; but where there was much sin, there was much more grace:

5.msb: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
5.kjv: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
5.blb: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
5.bbe: That, as sin had power in death, so grace might have power through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

6.msb: What then shall we say? Shall we continue in sin so that grace may increase?
6.kjv: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
6.blb: What then will we say? Shall we continue in sin so that grace may abound?
6.bbe: What may we say, then? are we to go on in sin so that there may be more grace?
6.heading: Dead to Sin, Alive to God

6.msb: Certainly not! How can we who died to sin live in it any longer?
6.kjv: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
6.blb: Never may it be! We who died to sin, how shall we still live in it?
6.bbe: In no way. How may we, who are dead to sin, be living in it any longer?

6.msb: Or aren’t you aware that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death?
6.kjv: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?
6.blb: Or are you ignorant that as many as were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death?
6.bbe: Or are you without the knowledge that all we who had baptism into Christ Jesus, had baptism into his death?

6.msb: We were therefore buried with Him through baptism into death, in order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, we too may walk in newness of life.
6.kjv: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
6.blb: We were buried, therefore, with Him through baptism into death, so that, just as Christ was raised out from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also should walk in newness of life.
6.bbe: We have been placed with him among the dead through baptism into death: so that as Christ came again from the dead by the glory of the Father, we, in the same way, might be living in new life.

6.msb: For if we have been united with Him like this in His death, we will certainly also be united with Him in His resurrection.
6.kjv: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:
6.blb: For if we have become united in the likeness of His death, yet also we will be of the resurrection,
6.bbe: For, if we have been made like him in his death, we will, in the same way, be like him in his coming to life again;

6.msb: We know that our old self was crucified with Him so that the body of sin might be rendered powerless, that we should no longer be slaves to sin.
6.kjv: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
6.blb: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with Him, so that the body of sin might be nullified, for us no longer to be slaves to sin.
6.bbe: Being conscious that our old man was put to death on the cross with him, so that the body of sin might be put away, and we might no longer be servants to sin.

6.msb: For anyone who has died has been freed from sin.
6.kjv: For he that is dead is freed from sin.
6.blb: For the one having died has been justified from sin.
6.bbe: Because he who is dead is free from sin.

6.msb: Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with Him.
6.kjv: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:
6.blb: Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with Him,
6.bbe: But if we are dead with Christ, we have faith that we will be living with him;

6.msb: For we know that since Christ was raised from the dead, He cannot die again; death no longer has dominion over Him.
6.kjv: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.
6.blb: knowing that Christ, having been raised out from the dead, dies no more; death no longer rules over Him.
6.bbe: Having knowledge that because Christ has come back from the dead, he will never again go down to the dead; death has no more power over him.

6.msb: The death He died, He died to sin once for all; but the life He lives, He lives to God.
6.kjv: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
6.blb: For that which He died, He died to sin once for all; but that which He lives, He lives to God.
6.bbe: For his death was a death to sin, but his life now is a life which he is living to God.

6.msb: So you too must count yourselves dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
6.kjv: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
6.blb: So also you, reckon yourselves to be dead indeed to sin, but living to God in Christ Jesus.
6.bbe: Even so see yourselves as dead to sin, but living to God in Christ Jesus.

6.msb: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body so that you obey it in its desires.
6.kjv: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.
6.blb: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body, in order to obey its desires.
6.bbe: For this cause do not let sin be ruling in your body which is under the power of death, so that you give way to its desires;

6.msb: Do not present the parts of your body to sin as instruments of wickedness, but present yourselves to God as those who have been brought from death to life; and present the parts of your body to Him as instruments of righteousness.
6.kjv: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.
6.blb: Neither present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as living out from the dead, and your members to God as instruments of righteousness.
6.bbe: And do not give your bodies to sin as the instruments of wrongdoing, but give yourselves to God, as those who are living from the dead, and your bodies as instruments of righteousness to God.

6.msb: For sin shall not be your master, because you are not under law, but under grace.
6.kjv: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
6.blb: For sin will not rule over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.
6.bbe: For sin may not have rule over you: because you are not under law, but under grace.

6.msb: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law, but under grace? Certainly not!
6.kjv: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.
6.blb: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law, but under grace? Never may it be!
6.bbe: What then? are we to go on in sin because we are not under law but under grace? Let it not be so.
6.heading: The Wages of Sin

6.msb: Do you not know that when you offer yourselves as obedient slaves, you are slaves to the one you obey, whether you are slaves to sin leading to death, or to obedience leading to righteousness?
6.kjv: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
6.blb: Do you not know that to whom you present yourselves as slaves for obedience, you are slaves to the one whom you obey, whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
6.bbe: Are you not conscious that you are the servants of him to whom you give yourselves to do his desire? if to sin, the end being death, or if to do the desire of God, the end being righteousness.

6.msb: But thanks be to God that, though you once were slaves to sin, you wholeheartedly obeyed the form of teaching to which you were committed.
6.kjv: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
6.blb: But thanks be to God that you used to be slaves of sin, but you obeyed from the heart the form of teaching to which you were delivered up.
6.bbe: But praise be to God that though you were the servants of sin, you have now given yourselves freely to that form of teaching under which you were placed;

6.msb: You have been set free from sin and have become slaves to righteousness.
6.kjv: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.
6.blb: Now having been set free from sin, you became slaves to righteousness.
6.bbe: And being made free from sin you have been made the servants of righteousness.

6.msb: I am speaking in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. Just as you used to offer the parts of your body in slavery to impurity and to escalating wickedness, so now offer them in slavery to righteousness leading to holiness.
6.kjv: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
6.blb: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. For just as you presented your members as slaves to uncleanness and to lawlessness unto lawlessness, so now present your members as slaves to righteousness unto sanctification.
6.bbe: I am using words in the way of men, because your flesh is feeble: as you gave your bodies as servants to what is unclean, and to evil to do evil, so now give them as servants to righteousness to do what is holy.

6.msb: For when you were slaves to sin, you were free of obligation to righteousness.
6.kjv: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.
6.blb: For when you were slaves of sin, you were free from righteousness.
6.bbe: When you were servants of sin you were free from righteousness.

6.msb: What fruit did you reap at that time from the things of which you are now ashamed? The outcome of those things is death.
6.kjv: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
6.blb: What fruit, therefore, were you having then in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
6.bbe: What fruit had you at that time in the things which are now a shame to you? for the end of such things is death.

6.msb: But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves to God, the fruit you reap leads to holiness, and the outcome is eternal life.
6.kjv: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.
6.blb: But now, having been set free from sin and having become slaves to God, you have your fruit unto sanctification, and the end is eternal life.
6.bbe: But now, being free from sin, and having been made servants to God, you have your fruit in that which is holy, and the end is eternal life.

6.msb: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
6.kjv: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
6.blb: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
6.bbe: For the reward of sin is death; but what God freely gives is eternal life in Jesus Christ our Lord.

7.msb: Do you not know, brothers (for I am speaking to those who know the law), that the law has authority over a man only as long as he lives?
7.kjv: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?
7.blb: Or are you ignorant, brothers (for I speak to those knowing the law), that the law rules over the man for as long as the time he lives?
7.bbe: Is it not clear, my brothers (I am using an argument to those who have knowledge of the law), that the law has power over a man as long as he is living?
7.heading: Release from the Law

7.msb: For instance, a married woman is bound by law to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is released from the law of marriage.
7.kjv: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.
7.blb: For the married woman is bound by law to the living husband; but if the husband should die, she is released from the law of the husband.
7.bbe: For the woman who has a husband is placed by the law under the power of her husband as long as he is living; but if her husband is dead, she is free from the law of the husband.

7.msb: So then, if she is joined to another man while her husband is still alive, she is called an adulteress; but if her husband dies, she is free from that law and is not an adulteress if she marries another man.
7.kjv: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
7.blb: So then, of the husband being alive, if she becomes unto another man, she will be called an adulteress; but if the husband should die, she is free from the law, so as not for her to be an adulteress, having become unto another man.
7.bbe: So if, while the husband is living, she is joined to another man, she will get the name of one who is untrue to her husband: but if the husband is dead, she is free from the law, so that she is not untrue, even if she takes another man.

7.msb: Therefore, my brothers, you also died to the law through the body of Christ, that you might belong to another, to Him who was raised from the dead, in order that we might bear fruit to God.
7.kjv: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.
7.blb: Likewise, my brothers, you also have been put to death to the law through the body of Christ, for you to become unto another, unto the One having been raised out from the dead, so that we should bear fruit to God.
7.bbe: In the same way, my brothers, you were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, so that you might be joined to another, even to him who came again from the dead, so that we might give fruit to God.

7.msb: For when we lived according to the flesh, the sinful passions aroused by the law were at work in our bodies, bearing fruit for death.
7.kjv: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
7.blb: For when we were in the flesh, the passions of sins that were through the law were working in our members, to the bearing of fruit to death.
7.bbe: For when we were in the flesh, the evil passions which came into being through the law were working in our bodies to give the fruit of death.

7.msb: But now, having died to what bound us, we have been released from the law, so that we serve in the new way of the Spirit, and not in the old way of the written code.
7.kjv: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
7.blb: But now we have been released from the law, having died to that by which we were held, so as for us to serve in the newness of the Spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
7.bbe: But now we are free from the law, having been made dead to that which had power over us; so that we are servants in the new way of the spirit, not in the old way of the letter.

7.msb: What then shall we say? Is the law sin? Certainly not! Indeed, I would not have been mindful of sin if not for the law. For I would not have been aware of coveting if the law had not said, “Do not covet.”
7.kjv: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.
7.blb: What then will we say? Is the law sin? Never may it be! But I did not know sin, if not through the law. For I would not have been conscious of covetousness if the law had not said, “You shall not covet.”
7.bbe: What then is to be said? is the law sin? in no way. But I would not have had knowledge of sin but for the law: for I would not have been conscious of desire if the law had not said, You may not have a desire for what is another's.
7.heading: God’s Law Is Holy

7.msb: But sin, seizing its opportunity through the commandment, produced in me every kind of covetous desire. For apart from the law, sin is dead.
7.kjv: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
7.blb: But sin, having taken the opportunity through the commandment, produced in me all covetousness; for apart from the law, sin is dead.
7.bbe: But sin, taking its chance through that which was ordered by the law, was working in me every form of desire: because without the law sin is dead.

7.msb: Once I was alive apart from the law; but when the commandment came, sin sprang to life and I died.
7.kjv: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
7.blb: And I was once alive apart from the law, but on the commandment's having come, sin revived and I died;
7.bbe: And there was a time when I was living without the law: but when the law gave its orders, sin came to life and put me to death;

7.msb: So I discovered that the very commandment that was meant to bring life actually brought death.
7.kjv: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
7.blb: and the commandment that was unto life, this was found by me unto death.
7.bbe: And I made the discovery that the law whose purpose was to give life had become a cause of death:

7.msb: For sin, seizing its opportunity through the commandment, deceived me and through the commandment put me to death.
7.kjv: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.
7.blb: For sin, having taken the opportunity through the commandment, deceived me and through it killed me.
7.bbe: For I was tricked and put to death by sin, which took its chance through the law.

7.msb: So then, the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous, and good.
7.kjv: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
7.blb: So indeed, the law is holy, and the commandment is holy and righteous and good.
7.bbe: But the law is holy, and its orders are holy, upright, and good.

7.msb: Has that which is good, then, become death to me? Certainly not! But in order that sin might be exposed as sin, it produced death in me through what was good, so that through the commandment sin might become utterly sinful.
7.kjv: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
7.blb: Did that which is good, then, become death to me? Never may it be! But so that sin might be shown as sin, it is producing death through that which is good to me, so that through the commandment sin might become sinful beyond excess.
7.bbe: Was then that which is good, death to me? In no way. But the purpose was that sin might be seen to be sin by working death to me through that which is good; so that through the orders of the law sin might seem much more evil.
7.heading: Struggling with Sin

7.msb: We know that the law is spiritual; but I am unspiritual, sold as a slave to sin.
7.kjv: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
7.blb: For we have known that the law is spiritual; but I am fleshly, having been sold as a slave under sin.
7.bbe: For we are conscious that the law is of the spirit; but I am of the flesh, given into the power of sin.

7.msb: I do not understand what I do. For what I want to do, I do not do. But what I hate, I do.
7.kjv: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
7.blb: For what I carry out, I do not understand. For what I want, this I do not practice; but what I hate, this I do.
7.bbe: And I have no clear knowledge of what I am doing, for that which I have a mind to do, I do not, but what I have hate for, that I do.

7.msb: And if I do what I do not want to do, I admit that the law is good.
7.kjv: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.
7.blb: Now if what I do not want, this I do, I assent to the law, that it is good.
7.bbe: But, if I do that which I have no mind to do, I am in agreement with the law that the law is good.

7.msb: In that case, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.
7.kjv: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
7.blb: But now I no longer carry it out, but the sin dwelling in me.
7.bbe: So it is no longer I who do it, but the sin living in me.

7.msb: I know that nothing good lives in me, that is, in my flesh; for I have the desire to do what is good, but I cannot discover how to carry it out.
7.kjv: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.
7.blb: For I know that there does not dwell in me—that is, in my flesh—good. For to want is present with me, but not to carry out the good.
7.bbe: For I am conscious that in me, that is, in my flesh, there is nothing good: I have the mind but not the power to do what is right.

7.msb: For I do not do the good I want to do. Instead, I keep on doing the evil I do not want to do.
7.kjv: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
7.blb: For the good that I want, I do not do; but the evil that I do not want, this I practice.
7.bbe: For the good which I have a mind to do, I do not: but the evil which I have no mind to do, that I do.

7.msb: And if I do what I do not want, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.
7.kjv: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
7.blb: Now if what I do not want, this I do, no longer do I carry it out, but sin dwelling in me.
7.bbe: But if I do what I have no mind to do, it is no longer I who do it, but the sin living in me.

7.msb: So this is the principle I have discovered: When I want to do good, evil is right there with me.
7.kjv: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
7.blb: I find, then, the law in my wanting to do good, that evil is present with me.
7.bbe: So I see a law that, though I have a mind to do good, evil is present in me.

7.msb: For in my inner being I delight in God’s law.
7.kjv: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
7.blb: For I delight in the law of God according to the inner man,
7.bbe: In my heart I take pleasure in the law of God,

7.msb: But I see another law at work in my body, warring against the law of my mind and holding me captive to the law of sin that dwells within me.
7.kjv: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
7.blb: but I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind and making me captive to the law of sin being in my members.
7.bbe: But I see another law in my body, working against the law of my mind, and making me the servant of the law of sin which is in my flesh.

7.msb: What a wretched man I am! Who will rescue me from this body of death?
7.kjv: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
7.blb: O wretched man that I am! Who will deliver me out of this body of death?
7.bbe: How unhappy am I! who will make me free from the body of this death?

7.msb: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then, with my mind I serve the law of God, but with my flesh I serve the law of sin.
7.kjv: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
7.blb: But thanks be to God through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then, I myself indeed with the mind serve God’s law, but with the flesh the law of sin.
7.bbe: I give praise to God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So with my mind I am a servant to the law of God, but with my flesh to the law of sin.

8.msb: Therefore there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus, who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.
8.kjv: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
8.blb: Therefore there is now no condemnation to those in Christ Jesus.
8.bbe: For this cause those who are in Christ Jesus will not be judged as sinners.
8.heading: Walking by the Spirit

8.msb: For in Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit of life set me free from the law of sin and death.
8.kjv: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
8.blb: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus set you free from the law of sin and death.
8.bbe: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has made me free from the law of sin and death.

8.msb: For what the law was powerless to do in that it was weakened by the flesh, God did by sending His own Son in the likeness of sinful man, as an offering for sin. He thus condemned sin in the flesh,
8.kjv: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
8.blb: For what the law was incapable of in that it was weak through the flesh, God, having sent His Son in the likeness of flesh of sin and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh,
8.bbe: For what the law was not able to do because it was feeble through the flesh, God, sending his Son in the image of the evil flesh, and as an offering for sin, gave his decision against sin in the flesh:

8.msb: so that the righteous standard of the law might be fulfilled in us, who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.
8.kjv: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
8.blb: so that the righteous requirement of the law might be fulfilled in us, those not walking according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.
8.bbe: So that what was ordered by the law might be done in us, who are living, not in the way of the flesh, but in the way of the Spirit.

8.msb: Those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh; but those who live according to the Spirit set their minds on the things of the Spirit.
8.kjv: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
8.blb: For those being according to the flesh mind the things of the flesh, but those according to the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
8.bbe: For those who are living in the way of the flesh give their minds to the things of the flesh, but those who go in the way of the Spirit, to the things of the Spirit.

8.msb: The mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace,
8.kjv: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
8.blb: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace,
8.bbe: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace:

8.msb: because the mind of the flesh is hostile to God: It does not submit to God’s law, nor can it do so.
8.kjv: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.
8.blb: because the mind of the flesh is hostility toward God; for it does not subject itself to the law of God, for it is not even able.
8.bbe: Because the mind of the flesh is opposite to God; it is not under the law of God, and is not able to be:

8.msb: Those controlled by the flesh cannot please God.
8.kjv: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
8.blb: And those being in the flesh are not able to please God.
8.bbe: So that those who are in the flesh are not able to give pleasure to God.

8.msb: You, however, are controlled not by the flesh, but by the Spirit, if the Spirit of God lives in you. And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he does not belong to Christ.
8.kjv: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
8.blb: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if indeed the Spirit of God dwells in you; and if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, this one is not of Him.
8.bbe: You are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if the Spirit of God is in you. But if any man has not the Spirit of Christ he is not one of his.

8.msb: But if Christ is in you, your body is dead because of sin, yet your spirit is alive because of righteousness.
8.kjv: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
8.blb: But if Christ is in you, the body is indeed dead because of sin, but the spirit is life because of righteousness.
8.bbe: And if Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

8.msb: And if the Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, He who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit, who lives in you.
8.kjv: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
8.blb: And if the Spirit of the One having raised Jesus out from the dead dwells in you, the One having raised Christ Jesus out from the dead will also make alive your mortal bodies through His Spirit, the One dwelling in you.
8.bbe: But if the Spirit of him who made Jesus come again from the dead is in you, he who made Christ Jesus come again from the dead will in the same way, through his Spirit which is in you, give life to your bodies which now are under the power of death.

8.msb: Therefore, brothers, we have an obligation, but it is not to the flesh, to live according to it.
8.kjv: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
8.blb: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live according to the flesh.
8.bbe: So then, my brothers, we are in debt, not to the flesh to be living in the way of the flesh:
8.heading: Heirs with Christ

8.msb: For if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
8.kjv: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
8.blb: For if you live according to the flesh, you are about to die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
8.bbe: For if you go in the way of the flesh, death will come on you; but if by the Spirit you put to death the works of the body, you will have life.

8.msb: For all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God.
8.kjv: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
8.blb: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are sons of God.
8.bbe: And all those who are guided by the Spirit of God are sons of God.

8.msb: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns you to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption to sonship, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
8.kjv: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
8.blb: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery again unto fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption as sons, in whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
8.bbe: For you did not get the spirit of servants again to put you in fear, but the spirit of sons was given to you, by which we say, Abba, Father.

8.msb: The Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children.
8.kjv: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
8.blb: The Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God,
8.bbe: The Spirit is witness with our spirit that we are children of God:

8.msb: And if we are children, then we are heirs: heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ—if indeed we suffer with Him, so that we may also be glorified with Him.
8.kjv: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
8.blb: and if children, also heirs: heirs indeed of God, and co-heirs of Christ, if indeed we suffer with Him, so that we may also be glorified with Him.
8.bbe: And if we are children, we have a right to a part in the heritage; a part in the things of God, together with Christ; so that if we have a part in his pain, we will in the same way have a part in his glory.

8.msb: I consider that our present sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.
8.kjv: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
8.blb: For I reckon that the sufferings of the present time are not comparable to the glory about to be revealed in us.
8.bbe: I am of the opinion that there is no comparison between the pain of this present time and the glory which we will see in the future.
8.heading: Future Glory

8.msb: The creation waits in eager expectation for the revelation of the sons of God.
8.kjv: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
8.blb: For the eager expectation of the creation eagerly awaits the revelation of the sons of God.
8.bbe: For the strong desire of every living thing is waiting for the revelation of the sons of God.

8.msb: For the creation was subjected to futility, not by its own will, but because of the One who subjected it, in hope
8.kjv: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,
8.blb: For the creation was subjected to futility, not willingly, but because of the One having subjected it, in hope
8.bbe: For every living thing was put under the power of change, not by its desire, but by him who made it so, in hope

8.msb: that the creation itself will be set free from its bondage to decay and brought into the glorious freedom of the children of God.
8.kjv: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
8.blb: that the creation itself will also be set free from the bondage of decay, into the freedom of the glory of the children of God.
8.bbe: That all living things will be made free from the power of death and will have a part with the free children of God in glory.

8.msb: We know that the whole creation has been groaning together in the pains of childbirth until the present time.
8.kjv: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
8.blb: For we know that all the creation groans together and travails together until now.
8.bbe: For we are conscious that all living things are weeping and sorrowing in pain together till now.

8.msb: Not only that, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption as sons, the redemption of our bodies.
8.kjv: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
8.blb: And not only so, but we ourselves, even having the firstfruit of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, eagerly awaiting adoption as sons, the redemption of our body.
8.bbe: And not only so, but we who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we have sorrow in our minds, waiting for the time when we will take our place as sons, that is, the salvation of our bodies.

8.msb: For in this hope we were saved; but hope that is seen is no hope at all. Why would one hope for what he can already see?
8.kjv: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
8.blb: For in hope we were saved, but hope being seen is not hope. For does anyone hope for what he sees?
8.bbe: For our salvation is by hope: but hope which is seen is not hope: for who is hoping for what he sees?

8.msb: But if we hope for what we do not yet see, we wait for it patiently.
8.kjv: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
8.blb: But if we hope for what we do not see, we eagerly await in perseverance.
8.bbe: But if we have hope for that which we see not, then we will be able to go on waiting for it.

8.msb: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weaknesses. For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.
8.kjv: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
8.blb: Now likewise also, the Spirit joins to help in our weakness; for we do not know the things that we should pray for as it is necessary, but the Spirit Himself intercedes with inexpressible groanings.
8.bbe: And in the same way the Spirit is a help to our feeble hearts: for we are not able to make prayer to God in the right way; but the Spirit puts our desires into words which are not in our power to say;

8.msb: And He who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of God.
8.kjv: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
8.blb: And the One searching hearts knows what is the mind of the Spirit, because He intercedes for the saints according to God.
8.bbe: And he who is the searcher of hearts has knowledge of the mind of the Spirit, because he is making prayers for the saints in agreement with the mind of God.

8.msb: And we know that all things work together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
8.kjv: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
8.blb: And we know that God works together all things for good to those loving God, to those being called according to purpose,
8.bbe: And we are conscious that all things are working together for good to those who have love for God, and have been marked out by his purpose.
8.heading: God Works in All Things

8.msb: For those God foreknew, He also predestined to be conformed to the image of His Son, so that He would be the firstborn among many brothers.
8.kjv: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
8.blb: because whom He foreknew, He also predestined to be conformed to the image of His Son, for Him to be firstborn among many brothers.
8.bbe: Because those of whom he had knowledge before they came into existence, were marked out by him to be made like his Son, so that he might be the first among a band of brothers:

8.msb: And those He predestined, He also called; those He called, He also justified; those He justified, He also glorified.
8.kjv: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
8.blb: And whom He predestined, these also He called; and whom He called, these also He justified; and whom He justified, these also He glorified.
8.bbe: And those who were marked out by him were named; and those who were named were given righteousness; and to those to whom he gave righteousness, in the same way he gave glory.

8.msb: What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
8.kjv: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
8.blb: What then will we say to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us—
8.bbe: What may we say about these things? If God is for us, who is against us?

8.msb: He who did not spare His own Son but gave Him up for us all, how will He not also, along with Him, freely give us all things?
8.kjv: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
8.blb: He who indeed did not spare His own Son, but delivered Him up for us all, how will He not also with Him graciously give us all things?
8.bbe: He who did not keep back his only Son, but gave him up for us all, will he not with him freely give us all things?

8.msb: Who will bring any charge against God’s elect? It is God who justifies.
8.kjv: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God’s elect? It is God that justifieth.
8.blb: Who will bring an accusation against the chosen ones of God? God is the One justifying.
8.bbe: Who will say anything against the saints of God? It is God who makes us clear from evil;

8.msb: Who is there to condemn us? For Christ, who died, and more than that was raised to life, is at the right hand of God—and He is interceding for us.
8.kjv: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
8.blb: Who is the one condemning? Christ Jesus the One having died, now rather having been raised, is He who is also at the right hand of God, and who is interceding for us.
8.bbe: Who will give a decision against us? It is Christ Jesus who not only was put to death, but came again from the dead, who is now at the right hand of God, taking our part.

8.msb: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?
8.kjv: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
8.blb: Who will separate us from the love of Christ? Will tribulation or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?
8.bbe: Who will come between us and the love of Christ? Will trouble, or pain, or cruel acts, or the need of food or of clothing, or danger, or the sword?
8.heading: More than Conquerors

8.msb: As it is written: “For Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.”
8.kjv: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
8.blb: As it has been written: “For Your sake we face death all the day; we were reckoned as sheep of slaughter.”
8.bbe: As it is said in the holy Writings, Because of you we are put to death every day; we are like sheep ready for destruction.

8.msb: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.
8.kjv: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
8.blb: But in all these things we are more than conquerors through the One having loved us.
8.bbe: But we are able to overcome all these things and more through his love.

8.msb: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor principalities nor powers, neither the present nor the future,
8.kjv: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
8.blb: For I am persuaded that neither death nor life, nor angels nor principalities, nor things present nor things about to be, nor powers,
8.bbe: For I am certain that not death, or life, or angels, or rulers, or things present, or things to come, or powers,

8.msb: neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
8.kjv: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
8.blb: nor height nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
8.bbe: Or things on high, or things under the earth, or anything which is made, will be able to come between us and the love of God which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

9.msb: I speak the truth in Christ; I am not lying, as confirmed by my conscience in the Holy Spirit.
9.kjv: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
9.blb: I speak truth in Christ—I am not lying, my conscience is testifying with me in the Holy Spirit
9.bbe: I say what is true in Christ, and not what is false, my mind giving witness with me in the Holy Spirit,
9.heading: Paul’s Concern for the Jews

9.msb: I have deep sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart.
9.kjv: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
9.blb: that sorrow to me is great, and unceasing pain is in my heart.
9.bbe: That I am full of sorrow and pain without end.

9.msb: For I could wish that I myself were cursed and cut off from Christ for the sake of my brothers, my own flesh and blood,
9.kjv: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
9.blb: For I could wish myself to be accursed, apart from Christ for my brothers, my kinsmen according to the flesh,
9.bbe: For I have a desire to take on myself the curse for my brothers, my family in the flesh:

9.msb: the people of Israel. Theirs is the adoption as sons; theirs the divine glory and the covenants; theirs the giving of the law, the temple worship, and the promises.
9.kjv: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
9.blb: who are Israelites, whose is the adoption as sons and the glory and the covenants and the lawgiving and the service and the promises,
9.bbe: Who are Israelites: who have the place of sons, and the glory, and the agreements with God, and the giving of the law, and the worship, and the hope offered by God:

9.msb: Theirs are the patriarchs, and from them proceeds the human descent of Christ, who is God over all, forever worthy of praise! Amen.
9.kjv: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
9.blb: whose are the fathers, and from whom is Christ according to the flesh, being God over all, blessed to the ages! Amen.
9.bbe: Whose are the fathers, and of whom came Christ in the flesh, who is over all, God, to whom be blessing for ever. So be it.

9.msb: It is not as though God’s word has failed. For not all who are descended from Israel are Israel.
9.kjv: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
9.blb: But it is not as though the word of God has failed. For not all who are of Israel, are these Israel.
9.bbe: But it is not as if the word of God was without effect. For they are not all Israel, who are of Israel:
9.heading: God’s Sovereign Choice

9.msb: Nor because they are Abraham’s descendants are they all his children. On the contrary, “Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.”
9.kjv: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
9.blb: Nor because they are seed of Abraham are all children. Rather, “In Isaac a seed will be called to you.”
9.bbe: And they are not all children because they are the seed of Abraham; but, In Isaac will your seed be named.

9.msb: So it is not the children of the flesh who are God’s children, but it is the children of the promise who are regarded as offspring.
9.kjv: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
9.blb: That is, the children of the flesh, these are not children of God; but the children of the promise are reckoned for seed.
9.bbe: That is, it is not the children of the flesh, but the children of God's undertaking, who are named as the seed.

9.msb: For this is what the promise stated: “At the appointed time I will return, and Sarah will have a son.”
9.kjv: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.
9.blb: For this is the word of promise: “At this time I will come, and to Sarah there will be a son.”
9.bbe: For this is the word of God's undertaking, At this time will I come, and Sarah will have a son.

9.msb: Not only that, but Rebecca’s children were conceived by one man, our father Isaac.
9.kjv: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
9.blb: And not only so, but also Rebecca, having conception by one, Isaac our father—
9.bbe: And not only so, but Rebecca being about to have a child by our father Isaac —

9.msb: Yet before the twins were born or had done anything good or evil, in order that God’s plan of election might stand,
9.kjv: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)
9.blb: for they not yet having been born nor having done anything good or evil, so that the purpose of God according to election might stand—
9.bbe: Before the children had come into existence, or had done anything good or bad, in order that God's purpose and his selection might be effected, not by works, but by him whose purpose it is,

9.msb: not by works but by Him who calls, she was told, “The older will serve the younger.”
9.kjv: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.
9.blb: not of works but of the One calling, it was said to her, “The greater will serve the lesser.”
9.bbe: It was said to her, The older will be the servant of the younger.

9.msb: So it is written: “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
9.kjv: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
9.blb: As it has been written: “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
9.bbe: Even as it is said, I had love for Jacob, but for Esau I had hate.

9.msb: What then shall we say? Is God unjust? Certainly not!
9.kjv: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
9.blb: What then will we say? Is there injustice with God? Never may it be!
9.bbe: What may we say then? is God not upright? let it not be said.

9.msb: For He says to Moses: “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
9.kjv: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
9.blb: For He says to Moses: “I will have mercy on whom I may have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I may have compassion.”
9.bbe: For he says to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and pity on whom I will have pity.

9.msb: So then, it does not depend on man’s desire or effort, but on God’s mercy.
9.kjv: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
9.blb: So then, it is not of the one willing, nor of the one running, but of God having mercy.
9.bbe: So then, it is not by the desire or by the attempt of man, but by the mercy of God.

9.msb: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh: “I raised you up for this very purpose, that I might display My power in you, and that My name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”
9.kjv: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
9.blb: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh: “For this very thing I raised you up, so that I might display My power in you, and that My name should be declared in all the earth.”
9.bbe: For the holy Writings say to Pharaoh, For this same purpose did I put you on high, so that I might make my power seen in you, and that there might be knowledge of my name through all the earth.

9.msb: Therefore God has mercy on whom He wants to have mercy, and He hardens whom He wants to harden.
9.kjv: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
9.blb: So then, He has mercy on whom He wants, and He hardens whom He wants.
9.bbe: So then, at his pleasure he has mercy on a man, and at his pleasure he makes the heart hard.

9.msb: One of you will say to me, “Why does God still find fault? For who can resist His will?”
9.kjv: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?
9.blb: You will say, then, to me, “Why then does He still find fault? For who has resisted His will?”
9.bbe: But you will say to me, Why does he still make us responsible? who is able to go against his purpose?

9.msb: But who are you, O man, to talk back to God? Shall what is formed say to Him who formed it, “Why did You make me like this?”
9.kjv: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
9.blb: But rather, O man, who are you answering against God? Will the thing formed say to the One having formed it, “Why did you make me thus?”
9.bbe: But, O man, who are you, to make answer against God? May the thing which is made say to him who made it, Why did you make me so?

9.msb: Does not the potter have the right to make from the same lump of clay one vessel for special occasions and another for common use?
9.kjv: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
9.blb: Or does the potter not have authority over the clay to make out of the same lump the one vessel indeed for honor, but the one for dishonor?
9.bbe: Or has not the potter the right to make out of one part of his earth a vessel for honour, and out of another a vessel for shame?

9.msb: What if God, intending to show His wrath and make His power known, bore with great patience the vessels of His wrath, prepared for destruction?
9.kjv: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
9.blb: And what if God, desiring to display the wrath and to make known His power, bore with much patience vessels of wrath, having been fitted for destruction,
9.bbe: What if God, desiring to let his wrath and his power be seen, for a long time put up with the vessels of wrath which were ready for destruction:

9.msb: What if He did this to make the riches of His glory known to the vessels of His mercy, whom He prepared in advance for glory—
9.kjv: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
9.blb: so that He might also make known the riches of His glory upon vessels of mercy, which He prepared beforehand for glory,
9.bbe: And to make clear the wealth of his glory to vessels of mercy, which he had before made ready for glory,

9.msb: including us, whom He has called not only from the Jews, but also from the Gentiles?
9.kjv: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?
9.blb: even us, whom He called not only out from Jews, but also out from Gentiles?
9.bbe: Even us, who were marked out by him, not only from the Jews, but from the Gentiles?

9.msb: As He says in Hosea: “I will call them ‘My People’ who are not My people, and I will call her ‘My Beloved’ who is not My beloved,”
9.kjv: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.
9.blb: As He also says in Hosea: “I will call that which is not My people ‘My People,’ and her not beloved ‘Beloved,’”
9.bbe: As he says in Hosea, They will be named my people who were not my people, and she will be loved who was not loved.

9.msb: and, “It will happen that in the very place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’”
9.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.
9.blb: and, “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ there they will be called ‘sons of the living God.””
9.bbe: And in the place where it was said to them, You are not my people, there they will be named the sons of the living God.

9.msb: Isaiah cries out concerning Israel: “Though the number of the Israelites is like the sand of the sea, only the remnant will be saved.
9.kjv: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
9.blb: And Isaiah cries out concerning Israel: “Though the number of the sons of Israel may be like the sand of the sea, only the remnant will be saved.
9.bbe: And Isaiah says about Israel, Even if the number of the children of Israel is as the sand of the sea, only a small part will get salvation:

9.msb: For the Lord will carry out His sentence thoroughly and decisively in righteousness, because He will cut short the matter on the earth.”
9.kjv: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.
9.blb: For the Lord will execute His word, finishing and accomplishing swiftly upon the earth.”
9.bbe: For the Lord will give effect to his word on the earth, putting an end to it and cutting it short.

9.msb: It is just as Isaiah foretold: “Unless the Lord of Hosts had left us descendants, we would have become like Sodom, we would have resembled Gomorrah.”
9.kjv: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.
9.blb: And, as Isaiah forewarned: “Unless the Lord of Hosts had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and we would have been made like Gomorrah.”
9.bbe: And, as Isaiah had said before, If the Lord of armies had not given us a seed, we would have been like Sodom and Gomorrah.

9.msb: What then will we say? That the Gentiles, who did not pursue righteousness, have obtained it, a righteousness that is by faith;
9.kjv: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
9.blb: What then will we say? That the Gentiles, not pursuing righteousness, obtained righteousness—and righteousness that is by faith;
9.bbe: What then may we say? That the nations who did not go after righteousness have got righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith:
9.heading: Israel’s Unbelief

9.msb: but Israel, who pursued a law of righteousness, has not attained it.
9.kjv: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.
9.blb: but Israel, pursuing a law of righteousness, did not attain to that law.
9.bbe: But Israel, going after a law of righteousness, did not get it.

9.msb: Why not? Because their pursuit was not by faith, but as if it were by works of the law. For they stumbled over the stumbling stone,
9.kjv: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
9.blb: Why? Because it was not by faith, but as by works. They stumbled over the stone of stumbling,
9.bbe: Why? Because they were not searching for it by faith, but by works. They came up against the stone which was in the way;

9.msb: as it is written: “See, I lay in Zion a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense; and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
9.kjv: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
9.blb: as it has been written: “Behold, I lay in Zion a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense; and the one believing on Him will not be put to shame.”
9.bbe: As it is said, See, I am putting in Zion a stone causing a fall, and a rock in the way: but he who has faith in him will not be put to shame.

10.msb: Brothers, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for the Israelites is for their salvation.
10.kjv: Brethren, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.
10.blb: Brothers, indeed the good pleasure of my heart and my supplication to God on behalf of them is for salvation.
10.bbe: Brothers, my heart's desire and my prayer to God for them is, that they may get salvation.
10.heading: The Word Brings Salvation

10.msb: For I testify about them that they are zealous for God, but not on the basis of knowledge.
10.kjv: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
10.blb: For I testify about them that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
10.bbe: For I give witness of them that they have a strong desire for God, but not with knowledge.

10.msb: Because they were ignorant of God’s righteousness and sought to establish their own, they did not submit to God’s righteousness.
10.kjv: For they being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.
10.blb: For being ignorant of the righteousness of God and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they did not submit to the righteousness of God.
10.bbe: Because, not having knowledge of God's righteousness, and desiring to give effect to their righteousness, they have not put themselves under the righteousness of God.

10.msb: For Christ is the end of the law, to bring righteousness to everyone who believes.
10.kjv: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
10.blb: For the end of law is Christ, unto righteousness to everyone believing.
10.bbe: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to everyone who has faith.

10.msb: For concerning the righteousness that is by the law, Moses writes: “The man who does these things will live by them.”
10.kjv: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.
10.blb: For Moses writes of the righteousness that is of the law, that, “The man having done these things will live in them.”
10.bbe: For Moses says that the man who does the righteousness which is of the law will get life by it.

10.msb: But the righteousness that is by faith says: “Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down)
10.kjv: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)
10.blb: But the righteousness of faith speaks thus: “You should not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring down Christ),
10.bbe: But the righteousness which is of faith says these words, Say not in your heart, Who will go up to heaven? (that is, to make Christ come down:)

10.msb: or, ‘Who will descend into the Abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead).”
10.kjv: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)
10.blb: or, ‘Who will descend into the Abyss?’ (that is, to bring up Christ out from the dead).”
10.bbe: Or, Who will go down into the deep? (that is, to make Christ come again from the dead:)

10.msb: But what does it say? “The word is near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart,” that is, the word of faith we are proclaiming:
10.kjv: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
10.blb: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart,” that is, the word of faith that we proclaim,
10.bbe: But what does it say? The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart: that is, the word of faith of which we are the preachers:

10.msb: that if you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
10.kjv: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
10.blb: that if you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart that God raised Him out from the dead, you will be saved.
10.bbe: Because, if you say with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and have faith in your heart that God has made him come back from the dead, you will have salvation:

10.msb: For with your heart you believe and are justified, and with your mouth you confess and are saved.
10.kjv: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
10.blb: For with the heart one believes unto righteousness, and with the mouth one confesses unto salvation.
10.bbe: For with the heart man has faith to get righteousness, and with the mouth he says that Jesus is Lord to get salvation.

10.msb: It is just as the Scripture says: “Anyone who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
10.kjv: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
10.blb: For the Scripture says, “Everyone believing on Him will not be put to shame.”
10.bbe: Because it is said in the holy Writings, Whoever has faith in him will not be shamed.

10.msb: For there is no difference between Jew and Greek: The same Lord is Lord of all, and gives richly to all who call on Him,
10.kjv: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
10.blb: For there is no difference between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord of all is rich to all those calling upon Him,
10.bbe: And the Jew is not different from the Greek: for there is the same Lord of all, who is good to all who have hope in his name:
