10.msb: for, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
10.kjv: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
10.blb: for, “Whoever shall call upon the name of the Lord will be saved.”
10.bbe: Because, Whoever will give worship to the name of the Lord will get salvation.

10.msb: How then will they call on the One in whom they have not believed? And how will they believe in the One of whom they have not heard? And how will they hear without someone to preach?
10.kjv: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
10.blb: How then can they call upon One in whom they did not believe? And how can they believe in One of whom they did not hear? And how can they hear apart from one preaching?
10.bbe: But how will they give worship to him in whom they have no faith? and how will they have faith in him of whom they have not had news? and how will they have news without a preacher?

10.msb: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news of peace, who bring good news of good things!”
10.kjv: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
10.blb: And how can they preach unless they can be sent? As it has been written: “How beautiful are the feet of those proclaiming good news of good things!”
10.bbe: And how will there be preachers if they are not sent? As it is said, How beautiful are the feet of those who give the glad news of good things.

10.msb: But not all of them welcomed the good news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our message?”
10.kjv: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?
10.blb: But not all heeded the good news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”
10.bbe: But they have not all given ear to the good news. For Isaiah says, Lord, who has had faith in our word?

10.msb: Consequently, faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
10.kjv: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
10.blb: So faith is by hearing, and hearing is through the word of Christ.
10.bbe: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.

10.msb: But I ask, did they not hear? Indeed they did: “Their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”
10.kjv: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.
10.blb: But I say, did they not hear? Indeed: “Their voice went out into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world.”
10.bbe: But I say, Did not the word come to their ears? Yes, certainly: Their sound has gone out into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world.

10.msb: I ask instead, did Israel not understand? First, Moses says: “I will make you jealous by those who are not a nation; I will make you angry by a nation without understanding.”
10.kjv: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
10.blb: But I say, did Israel not know? First, Moses says: “I will provoke you to jealousy by those not a nation; I will provoke you to anger by a nation without understanding.”
10.bbe: But I say, Had Israel no knowledge? First Moses says, You will be moved to envy by that which is not a nation, and by a foolish people I will make you angry.

10.msb: And Isaiah boldly says: “I was found by those who did not seek Me; I revealed Myself to those who did not ask for Me.”
10.kjv: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.
10.blb: And Isaiah is very bold and says: “I was found by those not seeking Me; I made Myself manifest to those not inquiring after Me.”
10.bbe: And Isaiah says without fear, Those who were not searching for me made discovery of me; and I was seen by those whose hearts were turned away from me.

10.msb: But as for Israel he says: “All day long I have held out My hands to a disobedient and obstinate people.”
10.kjv: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
10.blb: But to Israel he says: “All the day I stretched out My hands to a disobeying and contradicting people.”
10.bbe: But about Israel he says; All the day my hands have been stretched out to a people whose hearts were turned away, and who put themselves against my word.

11.msb: I ask then, did God reject His people? Certainly not! I am an Israelite myself, a descendant of Abraham, from the tribe of Benjamin.
11.kjv: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
11.blb: I say then, did God thrust away His people? Never may it be! For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
11.bbe: So I say, Has God put his people on one side? Let there be no such thought. For I am of Israel, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
11.heading: A Remnant Chosen by Grace

11.msb: God did not reject His people, whom He foreknew. Do you not know what the Scripture says about Elijah, how he appealed to God against Israel, saying,
11.kjv: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,
11.blb: God did not thrust away His people, whom He foreknew. Or do you not know what the Scripture says in Elijah, how he pleads with God against Israel:
11.bbe: God has not put away the people of his selection. Or have you no knowledge of what is said about Elijah in the holy Writings? how he says words to God against Israel,

11.msb: “Lord, they have killed Your prophets and torn down Your altars. I am the only one left, and they are seeking my life as well”?
11.kjv: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
11.blb: “Lord, they killed Your prophets, they tore down Your altars, and I alone was left, and they seek my life”?
11.bbe: Lord, they have put your prophets to death, and made waste your altars, and now I am the last, and they are searching for me to take away my life.

11.msb: And what was the divine reply to him? “I have reserved for Myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”
11.kjv: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
11.blb: But what does the divine answer say to him? “I left to Myself seven thousand men, who did not bow the knee to Baal.”
11.bbe: But what answer does God make to him? I have still seven thousand men whose knees have not been bent to Baal.

11.msb: In the same way, at the present time there is a remnant chosen by grace.
11.kjv: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
11.blb: So then also in the present time, there has been a remnant according to the election of grace,
11.bbe: In the same way, there are at this present time some who are marked out by the selection of grace.

11.msb: And if it is by grace, then it is no longer by works. Otherwise, grace would no longer be grace. But if it is by works, then it is no longer by grace. Otherwise, work would no longer be work.
11.kjv: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
11.blb: and if by grace, no longer out of works; otherwise grace no longer is grace.
11.bbe: But if it is of grace, then it is no longer of works: or grace would not be grace.

11.msb: What then? What Israel was seeking, it failed to obtain, but the elect did. The others were hardened,
11.kjv: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded
11.blb: What then? What Israel seeks after, this it did not obtain, but the elect obtained it. And the rest were hardened,
11.bbe: What then? That which Israel was searching for he did not get, but those of the selection got it and the rest were made hard.

11.msb: as it is written: “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that could not see, and ears that could not hear, to this very day.”
11.kjv: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
11.blb: as it has been written: God gave “them a spirit of stupor, eyes not to see, and ears not to hear, unto this very day.”
11.bbe: As it was said in the holy Writings, God gave them a spirit of sleep, eyes which might not see, and ears which have no hearing, to this day.

11.msb: And David says: “May their table become a snare and a trap, a stumbling block and a retribution to them.
11.kjv: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:
11.blb: And David says: May their table “become for a snare and for a trap, and for a stumbling block and for a retribution to them.
11.bbe: And David says, Let their table be made a net for taking them, and a stone in their way, and a punishment:

11.msb: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.”
11.kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
11.blb: May their eyes be darkened not to see, and their backs bent over through all time.”
11.bbe: Let their eyes be made dark so that they may not see, and let their back be bent down at all times.

11.msb: I ask then, did they stumble so as to fall beyond recovery? Certainly not! However, because of their trespass, salvation has come to the Gentiles to make Israel jealous.
11.kjv: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
11.blb: I say then, did they stumble so that they might fall? Never may it be! But in their trespass is salvation to the Gentiles, so as to provoke them to jealousy.
11.bbe: So I say, Were their steps made hard in order that they might have a fall? In no way: but by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, so that they might be moved to envy.
11.heading: The Ingrafting of the Gentiles

11.msb: But if their trespass means riches for the world, and their failure means riches for the Gentiles, how much greater riches will their fullness bring!
11.kjv: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
11.blb: But if their trespass is the riches of the world, and their failure is the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!
11.bbe: Now, if their fall is the wealth of the world, and their loss the wealth of the Gentiles, how much greater will be the glory when they are made full?

11.msb: I am speaking to you Gentiles. Inasmuch as I am the apostle to the Gentiles, I magnify my ministry
11.kjv: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:
11.blb: Now I speak to you, the Gentiles. Therefore indeed inasmuch I am an apostle of the Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,
11.bbe: But I say to you, Gentiles, in so far as I am the Apostle of the Gentiles, I make much of my position:

11.msb: in the hope that I may provoke my own people to jealousy and save some of them.
11.kjv: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
11.blb: if somehow I will provoke my own flesh to jealousy and will save some of them.
11.bbe: If in any way those who are of my flesh may be moved to envy, so that some of them may get salvation by me.

11.msb: For if their rejection is the reconciliation of the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?
11.kjv: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
11.blb: For if their rejection is the reconciliation of the world, what will be the acceptance if not life out from the dead?
11.bbe: For, if by their putting away, the rest of men have been made friends with God, what will their coming back again be, but life from the dead?

11.msb: If the first part of the dough is holy, so is the whole batch; if the root is holy, so are the branches.
11.kjv: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
11.blb: Now if the firstfruit is holy, also is the lump; and if the root is holy, also are the branches.
11.bbe: And if the first-fruit is holy, so is the mass: and if the root is holy, so are the branches.

11.msb: Now if some branches have been broken off, and you, a wild olive shoot, have been grafted in among the others to share in the nourishment of the olive root,
11.kjv: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
11.blb: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive tree, were grafted in among them and became a fellow partaker of the fatness of the root of the olive tree,
11.bbe: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, an olive-tree of the fields, were put in among them, and were given a part with them in the root by which the olive-tree is made fertile,

11.msb: do not boast over those branches. If you do, remember this: You do not support the root, but the root supports you.
11.kjv: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
11.blb: do not boast over the branches. But if you boast over them, you do not support the root, but the root you.
11.bbe: Do not be uplifted in pride over the branches: because it is not you who are the support of the root, but it is by the root that you are supported.

11.msb: You will say then, “Branches were broken off so that I could be grafted in.”
11.kjv: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
11.blb: You will say, then, “Branches were broken off so that I might be grafted in.”
11.bbe: You will say, Branches were broken off so that I might be put in.

11.msb: That is correct: They were broken off because of unbelief, but you stand by faith. Do not be arrogant, but be afraid.
11.kjv: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
11.blb: Rightly so: They were broken off by unbelief, but you have stood by faith. Do not be high-minded, but be afraid.
11.bbe: Truly, because they had no faith they were broken off, and you have your place by reason of your faith. Do not be lifted up in pride, but have fear;

11.msb: For if God did not spare the natural branches, He will certainly not spare you either.
11.kjv: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
11.blb: For if God did not spare the natural branches, perhaps He will not spare you.
11.bbe: For, if God did not have mercy on the natural branches, he will not have mercy on you.

11.msb: Take notice, therefore, of the kindness and severity of God: severity to those who fell, but kindness to you, if you continue in His kindness. Otherwise you also will be cut off.
11.kjv: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
11.blb: Behold, therefore, the kindness and severity of God: severity indeed upon those having fallen, but kindness of God upon you, if you continue in the kindness; otherwise you also will be cut off.
11.bbe: See then that God is good but his rules are fixed: to those who were put away he was hard, but to you he has been good, on the condition that you keep in his mercy; if not, you will be cut off as they were.

11.msb: And if they also do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
11.kjv: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.
11.blb: And even those, if they do not continue in unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
11.bbe: And they, if they do not go on without faith, will be united to the tree again, because God is able to put them in again.

11.msb: For if you were cut from a wild olive tree, and contrary to nature were grafted into one that is cultivated, how much more readily will these, the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree!
11.kjv: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?
11.blb: For if you were cut off out of the naturally wild olive tree, and contrary to nature were grafted into a cultivated olive tree, how much more will these, the natural, be grafted into their own olive tree!
11.bbe: For if you were cut out of a field olive-tree, and against the natural use were united to a good olive-tree, how much more will these, the natural branches, be united again with the olive-tree which was theirs?

11.msb: I do not want you to be ignorant of this mystery, brothers, so that you will not be conceited: A hardening in part has come to Israel, until the full number of the Gentiles has come in.
11.kjv: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
11.blb: For I do not want you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you may not be wise in yourselves: A hardening in part has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles may come in.
11.bbe: For it is my desire, brothers, that this secret may be clear to you, so that you may not have pride in your knowledge, that Israel has been made hard in part, till all the Gentiles have come in;
11.heading: All Israel Will Be Saved

11.msb: And so all Israel will be saved, as it is written: “The Deliverer will come from Zion; He will remove godlessness from Jacob.
11.kjv: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
11.blb: And thus all Israel will be saved, as it has been written: “The Delivering One will come out of Zion; He will remove ungodliness from Jacob.
11.bbe: And so all Israel will get salvation: as it is said in the holy Writings, There will come out of Zion the One who makes free; by him wrongdoing will be taken away from Jacob:

11.msb: And this is My covenant with them when I take away their sins.”
11.kjv: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
11.blb: And this is the covenant from Me to them, when I may take away their sins.”
11.bbe: And this is my agreement with them, when I will take away their sins.

11.msb: Regarding the gospel, they are enemies on your account; but regarding election, they are loved on account of the patriarchs.
11.kjv: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sakes.
11.blb: For regarding the gospel, they are enemies on account of you; but as regards election, beloved on account of the fathers.
11.bbe: As far as the good news is in question, they are cut off from God on account of you, but as far as the selection is in question, they are loved on account of the fathers.

11.msb: For God’s gifts and His call are irrevocable.
11.kjv: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.
11.blb: For the gracious gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
11.bbe: Because God's selection and his mercies may not be changed.

11.msb: For just as you who formerly disobeyed God have now received mercy through their disobedience,
11.kjv: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
11.blb: For as you once disobeyed God, but now received mercy by the disobedience of these,
11.bbe: For as you, in time past, were not under the rule of God, but now have got mercy through their turning away,

11.msb: so they too have now disobeyed, in order that they too may receive mercy through the mercy shown to you.
11.kjv: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
11.blb: so these also now disobeyed so that through your mercy they also may now receive mercy.
11.bbe: So in the same way these have gone against the orders of God, so that by the mercy given to you they may now get mercy.

11.msb: For God has consigned everyone to disobedience so that He may have mercy on everyone.
11.kjv: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
11.blb: For God closed up all in disobedience so that He may have mercy on all.
11.bbe: For God has let them all go against his orders, so that he might have mercy on them all.

11.msb: O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
11.kjv: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
11.blb: O, the depth of riches, both of wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
11.bbe: O how deep is the wealth of the wisdom and knowledge of God! no one is able to make discovery of his decisions, and his ways may not be searched out.
11.heading: A Hymn of Praise

11.msb: “Who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been His counselor?”
11.kjv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
11.blb: “For who knew the mind of the Lord, or who became His counselor?”
11.bbe: Who has knowledge of the mind of the Lord? or who has taken part in his purposes?

11.msb: “Who has first given to God, that God should repay him?”
11.kjv: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
11.blb: Or “who first gave to Him, and it will be given back to him?”
11.bbe: Or who has first given to him, and it will be given back to him again?

11.msb: For from Him and through Him and to Him are all things. To Him be the glory forever! Amen.
11.kjv: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
11.blb: For from Him and through Him and unto Him are all things. To Him be the glory to the ages! Amen.
11.bbe: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things. To him be the glory for ever. So be it.

12.msb: Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.
12.kjv: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
12.blb: Therefore I exhort you, brothers, through the compassions of God, to present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy to God, well-pleasing, which is your reasonable service.
12.bbe: For this reason I make request to you, brothers, by the mercies of God, that you will give your bodies as a living offering, holy, pleasing to God, which is the worship it is right for you to give him.
12.heading: Living Sacrifices

12.msb: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.
12.kjv: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
12.blb: And do not be conformed to this age, but be transformed by the renewing of the mind, for you to discern what is the good and well-pleasing and perfect will of God.
12.bbe: And let not your behaviour be like that of this world, but be changed and made new in mind, so that by experience you may have knowledge of the good and pleasing and complete purpose of God.

12.msb: For by the grace given me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but think of yourself with sober judgment, according to the measure of faith God has given you.
12.kjv: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
12.blb: For through the grace having been given to me, I say to everyone being among you not to be high-minded above what it is necessary to think, but to think so as to be sound-minded, as God allotted to each a measure of faith.
12.bbe: But I say to every one of you, through the grace given to me, not to have an over-high opinion of himself, but to have wise thoughts, as God has given to every one a measure of faith.

12.msb: Just as each of us has one body with many members, and not all members have the same function,
12.kjv: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
12.blb: For just as in one body we have many members, and not all the members have the same function,
12.bbe: For, as we have a number of parts in one body, but all the parts have not the same use,

12.msb: so in Christ we who are many are one body, and each member belongs to one another.
12.kjv: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
12.blb: so we, the many, are one body in Christ, and individually members one of another.
12.bbe: So we, though we are a number of persons, are one body in Christ, and are dependent on one another;

12.msb: We have different gifts according to the grace given us. If one’s gift is prophecy, let him use it in proportion to his faith;
12.kjv: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
12.blb: And we are having different gifts according to the grace having been given to us: if prophecy, according to the proportion of faith;
12.bbe: And having different qualities by reason of the grace given to us, such as the quality of a prophet, let it be made use of in relation to the measure of our faith;

12.msb: if it is serving, let him serve; if it is teaching, let him teach;
12.kjv: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
12.blb: and if service, in the service; and if teaching, in the teaching;
12.bbe: Or the position of a Deacon of the church, let a man give himself to it; or he who has the power of teaching, let him make use of it;

12.msb: if it is encouraging, let him encourage; if it is giving, let him give generously; if it is leading, let him lead with diligence; if it is showing mercy, let him do it cheerfully.
12.kjv: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.
12.blb: and if exhorting, in the exhortation; giving, in generosity; leading, in diligence; showing mercy, in cheerfulness.
12.bbe: He who has the power of comforting, let him do so; he who gives, let him give freely; he who has the power of ruling, let him do it with a serious mind; he who has mercy on others, let it be with joy.

12.msb: Love must be sincere. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good.
12.kjv: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
12.blb: Let love be unfeigned: abhorring evil, cleaving to good,
12.bbe: Let love be without deceit. Be haters of what is evil; keep your minds fixed on what is good.
12.heading: Love, Zeal, Hope, Hospitality

12.msb: Be devoted to one another in brotherly love. Outdo yourselves in honoring one another.
12.kjv: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
12.blb: devoted to one another in brotherly love, esteeming one another in honor,
12.bbe: Be kind to one another with a brother's love, putting others before yourselves in honour;

12.msb: Do not let your zeal subside; keep your spiritual fervor, serving the Lord.
12.kjv: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
12.blb: not slothful in diligence, being fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,
12.bbe: Be not slow in your work, but be quick in spirit, as the Lord's servants;

12.msb: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, persistent in prayer.
12.kjv: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
12.blb: rejoicing in hope, enduring in tribulation, persisting in prayer,
12.bbe: Being glad in hope, quiet in trouble, at all times given to prayer,

12.msb: Share with the saints who are in need. Practice hospitality.
12.kjv: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
12.blb: contributing to the needs of the saints, pursuing hospitality.
12.bbe: Giving to the needs of the saints, ready to take people into your houses.

12.msb: Bless those who persecute you. Bless and do not curse.
12.kjv: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
12.blb: Bless those persecuting you; bless and do not curse,
12.bbe: Give blessing and not curses to those who are cruel to you.
12.heading: Forgiveness

12.msb: Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.
12.kjv: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
12.blb: to rejoice with the rejoicing, to weep with the weeping,
12.bbe: Take part in the joy of those who are glad, and in the grief of those who are sorrowing.

12.msb: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but associate with the lowly. Do not be conceited.
12.kjv: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
12.blb: minding the same thing toward one another, not minding the high things, but going along with the lowly. Do not be wise in yourselves,
12.bbe: Be in harmony with one another. Do not have a high opinion of yourselves, but be in agreement with common people. Do not give yourselves an air of wisdom.

12.msb: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Carefully consider what is right in the eyes of everybody.
12.kjv: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
12.blb: repaying to no one evil for evil, giving forethought to right things before all men;
12.bbe: Do not give evil for evil to any man. Let all your business be well ordered in the eyes of all men.

12.msb: If it is possible on your part, live at peace with everyone.
12.kjv: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
12.blb: if possible of you, being at peace with all men;
12.bbe: As far as it is possible for you be at peace with all men.

12.msb: Do not avenge yourselves, beloved, but leave room for God’s wrath. For it is written: “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay, says the Lord.”
12.kjv: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
12.blb: not avenging yourselves, beloved; but give place to wrath, for it has been written: “Vengeance is Mine, I will repay, says the Lord.”
12.bbe: Do not give punishment for wrongs done to you, dear brothers, but give way to the wrath of God; for it is said in the holy Writings, Punishment is mine, I will give reward, says the Lord.

12.msb: Therefore, “If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him a drink. For in so doing, you will heap burning coals on his head.”
12.kjv: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
12.blb: Rather, “If your enemy should hunger, feed him; if he should thirst, give him a drink; for doing this, you will heap coals of fire upon his head.”
12.bbe: But if one who has hate for you is in need of food or of drink, give it to him, for in so doing you will put coals of fire on his head.

12.msb: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
12.kjv: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
12.blb: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil in good.
12.bbe: Do not let evil overcome you, but overcome evil by good.

13.msb: Everyone must submit himself to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which is from God. The authorities that exist have been appointed by God.
13.kjv: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.
13.blb: Let every soul be subject to the authorities being above him. For there is no authority except by God; but those existing are appointed by God.
13.bbe: Let everyone put himself under the authority of the higher powers, because there is no power which is not of God, and all powers are ordered by God.
13.heading: Submission to Authorities

13.msb: Consequently, whoever resists authority is opposing what God has set in place, and those who do so will bring judgment on themselves.
13.kjv: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
13.blb: Therefore the one setting himself against the authority has resisted the ordinance of God, and those having resisted will receive judgment to themselves.
13.bbe: For which reason everyone who puts himself against the authority puts himself against the order of God: and those who are against it will get punishment for themselves.

13.msb: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to bad. Do you want to be unafraid of the one in authority? Then do what is right, and you will have his approval.
13.kjv: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:
13.blb: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to evil. Now do you want not to fear the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from him.
13.bbe: For rulers are not a cause of fear to the good work but to the evil. If you would have no fear of the authority, do good and you will have praise;

13.msb: For he is God’s servant for your good. But if you do wrong, be afraid, for he does not carry the sword in vain. He is God’s servant, an agent of retribution to the wrongdoer.
13.kjv: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
13.blb: For he is God’s servant to you for good. But if you do evil, be afraid, for he does not bear the sword in vain. For he is God’s servant, an avenger for wrath to the one practicing evil.
13.bbe: For he is the servant of God to you for good. But if you do evil, have fear; for the sword is not in his hand for nothing: he is God's servant, making God's punishment come on the evil-doer.

13.msb: Therefore it is necessary to submit to authority, not only to avoid punishment, but also as a matter of conscience.
13.kjv: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
13.blb: Therefore it is necessary to be subject, not only because of wrath, but also because of the conscience.
13.bbe: So put yourselves under the authority, not for fear of wrath, but because you have the knowledge of what is right.

13.msb: This is also why you pay taxes. For the authorities are God’s servants, who devote themselves to their work.
13.kjv: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God’s ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
13.blb: For because of this, you also pay taxes; for they are ministers of God, attending continually to this very thing.
13.bbe: For the same reason, make payment of taxes; because the authority is God's servant, to take care of such things at all times.

13.msb: Therefore pay everyone what you owe him: taxes to whom taxes are due, revenue to whom revenue is due, respect to whom respect is due, honor to whom honor is due.
13.kjv: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
13.blb: Pay to all their dues: tax to whom tax, revenue to whom revenue, fear to whom fear, honor to whom honor.
13.bbe: Give to all what is their right: taxes to him whose they are, payment to him whose right it is, fear to whom fear, honour to whom honour is to be given.

13.msb: Be indebted to no one, except to one another in love. For he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
13.kjv: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
13.blb: Owe nothing to anyone, except to love one another; for the one loving the other has fulfilled the law.
13.bbe: Be in debt for nothing, but to have love for one another: for he who has love for his neighbour has kept all the law.
13.heading: Love Fulfills the Law

13.msb: The commandments “Do not commit adultery,” “Do not murder,” “Do not steal,” “Do not covet,” and any other commandments, are summed up in this one decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
13.kjv: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
13.blb: For, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and if any other commandment, it is summed up in this word: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
13.bbe: And this, Do not be untrue in married life, Do not put to death, Do not take what is another's, Do not have desire for what is another's, and if there is any other order, it is covered by this word, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself.

13.msb: Love does no wrong to its neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.
13.kjv: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
13.blb: Love works no evil to the neighbor; therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.
13.bbe: Love does no wrong to his neighbour, so love makes the law complete.

13.msb: And do this, understanding the occasion. The hour has come for us to wake up from our slumber, for our salvation is nearer now than when we first believed.
13.kjv: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
13.blb: And do this, knowing the time, that it is already the hour for you to be awakened out of sleep; for our salvation is nearer now than when we came to believe.
13.bbe: See then that the time has come for you to be awake from sleep: for now is your salvation nearer than when you first had faith.
13.heading: The Day Is Near

13.msb: The night is nearly over; the day has drawn near. So let us lay aside the deeds of darkness and put on the armor of light.
13.kjv: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
13.blb: The night is advanced, and the day has drawn near; therefore let us lay aside the works of darkness, and let us put on the armor of light.
13.bbe: The night is far gone, and the day is near: so let us put off the works of the dark, arming ourselves with light,

13.msb: Let us behave decently, as in the daytime, not in carousing and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and debauchery, not in dissension and jealousy.
13.kjv: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
13.blb: Let us walk properly as in daytime, not in carousing and drunkenness, not in promiscuity and sensuality, not in strife and jealousy.
13.bbe: With right behaviour as in the day; not in pleasure-making and drinking, not in bad company and unclean behaviour, not in fighting and envy.

13.msb: Instead, clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the desires of the flesh.
13.kjv: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
13.blb: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ and make no forethought for the desires of the flesh.
13.bbe: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not give thought to the flesh to do its desires.

14.msb: Accept him whose faith is weak, without passing judgment on his opinions.
14.kjv: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
14.blb: And receive the one being weak in the faith, not for passing judgment on reasonings.
14.bbe: Do not put on one side him who is feeble in faith, and do not put him in doubt by your reasonings.
14.heading: The Law of Liberty

14.msb: For one person has faith to eat all things, while another, who is weak, eats only vegetables.
14.kjv: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
14.blb: Indeed, one believes to eat all things, but the one being weak eats vegetables.
14.bbe: One man has faith to take all things as food: another who is feeble in faith takes only green food.

14.msb: The one who eats everything must not belittle the one who does not, and the one who does not eat everything must not judge the one who does, for God has accepted him.
14.kjv: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
14.blb: The one eating, let him not despise the one not eating; and the one not eating, let him not judge the one eating, for God received him.
14.bbe: Let not him who takes food have a low opinion of him who does not: and let not him who does not take food be a judge of him who does; for he has God's approval.

14.msb: Who are you to judge someone else’s servant? To his own master he stands or falls. And he will stand, for God is able to make him stand.
14.kjv: Who art thou that judgest another man’s servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
14.blb: Who are you, judging another’s servant? To his own master he stands or falls. And he will be made to stand, for the Lord is able to make him stand.
14.bbe: Who are you to make yourself a judge of another man's servant? it is to his master that he is responsible for good or bad. Yes, his place will be safe, because the Lord is able to keep him from falling.

14.msb: One person regards a certain day above the others, while someone else considers every day alike. Each one should be fully convinced in his own mind.
14.kjv: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
14.blb: For indeed, one judges a day above a day, but one judges every day alike. Let each be fully assured in his own mind.
14.bbe: This man puts one day before another: to that man they are the same. Let every man be certain in his mind.

14.msb: He who observes a special day does so to the Lord. And he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats does so to the Lord, for he gives thanks to God; and he who abstains does so to the Lord and gives thanks to God.
14.kjv: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
14.blb: The one regarding the day regards it to the Lord; the one eating eats to the Lord, for he gives thanks to God; and the one not eating does not eat to the Lord, and he gives thanks to God.
14.bbe: He who keeps the day, keeps it to the Lord; and he who takes food, takes it as to the Lord, for he gives praise to God; and he who does not take food, to the Lord he takes it not, and gives praise to God.

14.msb: For none of us lives to himself alone, and none of us dies to himself alone.
14.kjv: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
14.blb: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
14.bbe: For every man's life and every man's death has a relation to others as well as to himself.

14.msb: If we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord. So whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.
14.kjv: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord’s.
14.blb: For both if we should live, we live to the Lord, and if we should die, we die to the Lord. Therefore both if we should live and if we should die, we are the Lord’s.
14.bbe: As long as we have life we are living to the Lord; or if we give up our life it is to the Lord; so if we are living, or if our life comes to an end, we are the Lord's.

14.msb: For this reason Christ died and rose and returned to life, that He might be the Lord of both the dead and the living.
14.kjv: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
14.blb: For unto this Christ died and lived again, so that He might be Lord over both the dead and the living.
14.bbe: And for this purpose Christ went into death and came back again, that he might be the Lord of the dead and of the living.

14.msb: Why, then, do you judge your brother? Or why do you belittle your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
14.kjv: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
14.blb: But why do you judge your brother? Or why also do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of God.
14.bbe: But you, why do you make yourself your brother's judge? or again, why have you no respect for your brother? because we will all have to take our place before God as our judge.

14.msb: It is written: “As surely as I live, says the Lord, every knee will bow before Me; every tongue will confess to God.”
14.kjv: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
14.blb: For it has been written: “As I live, says the Lord, every knee will bow to Me, and every tongue will confess to God.”
14.bbe: For it is said in the holy Writings, By my life, says the Lord, to me every knee will be bent, and every tongue will give worship to God.

14.msb: So then, each of us will give an account of himself to God.
14.kjv: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
14.blb: So then, each of us will give account concerning himself to God.
14.bbe: So every one of us will have to give an account of himself to God.

14.msb: Therefore let us stop judging one another. Instead, make up your mind not to put any stumbling block or obstacle in your brother’s way.
14.kjv: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother’s way.
14.blb: May we no longer, therefore, judge one another; but rather you decide this, not to put a stumbling block or obstacle before a brother.
14.bbe: Then let us not be judges of one another any longer: but keep this in mind, that no man is to make it hard for his brother, or give him cause for doubting.
14.heading: The Law of Love

14.msb: I am convinced and fully persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself. But if anyone regards something as unclean, then for him it is unclean.
14.kjv: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
14.blb: I know and I am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself, except to him reckoning anything to be unclean, to that one it is unclean.
14.bbe: I am conscious of this, and am certain in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean in itself; but for the man in whose opinion it is unclean, for him it is unclean.

14.msb: If your brother is distressed by what you eat, you are no longer acting in love. Do not by your eating destroy your brother, for whom Christ died.
14.kjv: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
14.blb: For if because of food your brother is grieved, no longer do you walk according to love. Do not destroy with your food that one for whom Christ died.
14.bbe: And if because of food your brother is troubled, then you are no longer going on in the way of love. Do not let your food be destruction to him for whom Christ went into death.

14.msb: Do not allow what you consider good, then, to be spoken of as evil.
14.kjv: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
14.blb: Therefore do not let your good be spoken of as evil.
14.bbe: Let it not be possible for men to say evil about your good:

14.msb: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking, but of righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
14.kjv: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
14.blb: For the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.
14.bbe: For the kingdom of God is not food and drink, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.

14.msb: For whoever serves Christ in these things is pleasing to God and approved by men.
14.kjv: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
14.blb: For the one serving Christ in in this is well-pleasing to God and approved by men.
14.bbe: And he who in these things is Christ's servant, is pleasing to God and has the approval of men.

14.msb: So then, let us pursue what leads to peace and to mutual edification.
14.kjv: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
14.blb: So then, may we pursue the things of peace, and the things of building up one another.
14.bbe: So then, let us go after the things which make peace, and the things by which we may be a help to one another.

14.msb: Do not destroy the work of God for the sake of food. All food is clean, but it is wrong for a man to let his eating be a stumbling block.
14.kjv: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
14.blb: Do not demolish the work of God for the sake of food. All things indeed are clean, but it is evil to the man eating through a stumbling block.
14.bbe: Do not let the work of God come to nothing on account of food. All things are certainly clean; but it is evil for that man who by taking food makes it hard for another.

14.msb: It is better not to eat meat or drink wine or to do anything to cause your brother to stumble or to be hindered or weakened.
14.kjv: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
14.blb: It is good neither to eat meat nor to drink wine nor anything in which your brother stumbles.
14.bbe: It is better not to take meat or wine or to do anything which might be a cause of trouble to your brother.

14.msb: Keep your belief about such matters between yourself and God. Blessed is the one who does not condemn himself by what he approves.
14.kjv: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
14.blb: The faith that you have, have it to yourself before God. Blessed is the one not judging himself in what he approves.
14.bbe: The faith which you have, have it to yourself before God. Happy is the man who is not judged by that to which he gives approval.

14.msb: But the one who has doubts is condemned if he eats, because his eating is not from faith; and everything that is not from faith is sin.
14.kjv: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
14.blb: But the one doubting has been condemned if he eats, because it is not of faith; and everything that is not of faith is sin.
14.bbe: But he who is in doubt is judged if he takes food, because he does it not in faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

14.msb: Now to Him who is able to strengthen you by my gospel and by the proclamation of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery concealed for ages past
14.heading: Doxology

14.msb: but now revealed and made known through the writings of the prophets by the command of the eternal God, in order to lead all nations to the obedience that comes from faith—
to the only wise God be glory forever through Jesus Christ! Amen.

15.msb: We who are strong ought to bear with the shortcomings of the weak and not to please ourselves.
15.kjv: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
15.blb: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the powerless and not to please ourselves.
15.bbe: We who are strong have to be a support to the feeble, and not give pleasure to ourselves.
15.heading: Accept One Another

15.msb: Each of us should please his neighbor for his good, to build him up.
15.kjv: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
15.blb: Let each of us please the neighbor unto good, for building up.
15.bbe: Let every one of us give pleasure to his neighbour for his good, to make him strong.

15.msb: For even Christ did not please Himself, but as it is written: “The insults of those who insult You have fallen on Me.”
15.kjv: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.
15.blb: For even Christ did not please Himself, but as it has been written: “The reproaches of those reproaching You fell on Me.”
15.bbe: For Christ did not give pleasure to himself, but, as it is said, The bitter words of those who were angry with you came on me.

15.msb: For what was written in the past was written for our instruction, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures, we might have hope.
15.kjv: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
15.blb: For as much as was written before was all written for our instruction, so that through endurance and through the encouragement of the Scriptures, we might have the hope.
15.bbe: Now those things which were put down in writing before our time were for our learning, so that through quiet waiting and through the comfort of the holy Writings we might have hope.

15.msb: Now may the God who gives endurance and encouragement grant you harmony with one another in Christ Jesus,
15.kjv: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:
15.blb: Now may the God of endurance and encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another, according to Christ Jesus,
15.bbe: Now may the God who gives comfort and strength in waiting make you of the same mind with one another in harmony with Christ Jesus:

15.msb: so that with one mind and one voice you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
15.kjv: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
15.blb: so that with one accord, with one mouth, you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
15.bbe: So that with one mouth you may give glory to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

15.msb: Accept one another, then, just as Christ accepted you, in order to bring glory to God.
15.kjv: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.
15.blb: Therefore receive one another as Christ also received you, to the glory of God.
15.bbe: So then, take one another to your hearts, as Christ took us, to the glory of God.
15.heading: Christ the Servant of Jews and Gentiles

15.msb: Now I tell you that Christ Jesus has become a servant of the circumcised on behalf of God’s truth, to confirm the promises made to the patriarchs,
15.kjv: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
15.blb: For I say that Christ has become a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, in order to confirm the promises to the fathers,
15.bbe: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision to give effect to the undertakings given by God to the fathers,

15.msb: so that the Gentiles may glorify God for His mercy. As it is written: “Therefore I will praise You among the Gentiles; I will sing hymns to Your name.”
15.kjv: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
15.blb: and for the Gentiles to glorify God for mercy, as it has been written: “Because of this I will praise You among the Gentiles, and I will sing praises to Your name.”
15.bbe: And so that the Gentiles might give glory to God for his mercy; as it is said, For this reason I will give praise to you among the Gentiles, and I will make a song to your name.

15.msb: Again, it says: “Rejoice, O Gentiles, with His people.”
15.kjv: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
15.blb: And again it says: “Rejoice, O Gentiles, with His people.”
15.bbe: And again he says, Take part, you Gentiles, in the joy of his people.

15.msb: And again: “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and extol Him, all you peoples.”
15.kjv: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
15.blb: And again: “Praise the Lord, all the Gentiles, and extol Him, all the peoples.”
15.bbe: And again, Give praise to the Lord, all you Gentiles; and let all the nations give praise to him.

15.msb: And once more, Isaiah says: “The Root of Jesse will appear, One who will arise to rule over the Gentiles; in Him the Gentiles will put their hope.”
15.kjv: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.
15.blb: And again, Isaiah says: “There will be the root of Jesse, and the One arising to rule over the Gentiles; in Him the Gentiles will hope.”
15.bbe: And again Isaiah says, There will be the root of Jesse, and he who comes to be the ruler over the Gentiles; in him will the Gentiles put their hope.

15.msb: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you believe in Him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
15.kjv: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
15.blb: And may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, for you to abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
15.bbe: Now may the God of hope make you full of joy and peace through faith, so that all hope may be yours in the power of the Holy Spirit.

15.msb: I myself am convinced, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, brimming with knowledge, and able to instruct others.
15.kjv: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
15.blb: And I myself also am persuaded concerning you, my brothers, that you yourselves are also full of goodness, being filled with all knowledge, and being able to admonish one another.
15.bbe: And I myself am certain of you, brothers, that you are full of what is good, complete in all knowledge, able to give direction to one another.
15.heading: Paul the Minister to the Gentiles

15.msb: However, brothers, I have written you a bold reminder on some points, because of the grace God has given me
15.kjv: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,
15.blb: But I wrote to you more boldly in part, as reminding you, because of the grace having been given to me by God
15.bbe: But I have, in some measure, less fear in writing to you to put these things before you again, because of the grace which was given to me by God,

15.msb: to be a minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles in the priestly service of the gospel of God, so that the Gentiles might become an offering acceptable to God, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
15.kjv: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.
15.blb: for me to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest in the gospel of God, so that the offering of the Gentiles might become acceptable, having been sanctified in the Holy Spirit.
15.bbe: To be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, doing the work of a priest in the good news of God, so that the offering of the Gentiles might be pleasing to God, being made holy by the Holy Spirit.

15.msb: Therefore I exult in Christ Jesus in my service to God.
15.kjv: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.
15.blb: Therefore I have ground for boasting in Christ Jesus in the things pertaining to God.
15.bbe: So I have pride in Christ Jesus in the things which are God's.

15.msb: I will not presume to speak of anything except what Christ has accomplished through me in leading the Gentiles to obedience by word and deed,
15.kjv: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
15.blb: For I will not dare to speak of anything that Christ did not work through me for the obedience of the Gentiles by word and deed,
15.bbe: And I will keep myself from talking of anything but those things which Christ has done by me to put the Gentiles under his rule in word and in act,

15.msb: by the power of signs and wonders, and by the power of the Spirit of God. So from Jerusalem all the way around to Illyricum, I have fully proclaimed the gospel of Christ.
15.kjv: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
15.blb: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of the Spirit of God, so as for me, from Jerusalem and around as far as Illyricum, to have fully proclaimed the gospel of Christ,
15.bbe: By signs and wonders, in the power of the Holy Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and round about as far as Illyricum I have given all the good news of Christ;

15.msb: In this way I have aspired to preach the gospel where Christ was not known, so that I would not be building on someone else’s foundation.
15.kjv: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man’s foundation:
15.blb: and thus striving earnestly to preach the gospel where Christ was not named, so that I might not build upon another’s foundation.
15.bbe: Making it my purpose not to take the good news where Christ was named, so that my work might not be resting on that of others;

15.msb: Rather, as it is written: “Those who were not told about Him will see, and those who have not heard will understand.”
15.kjv: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
15.blb: But as it has been written: “They will see, to whom it was not announced concerning Him; and those who have not heard will understand.”
15.bbe: But as it is said in the holy Writings, They will see, to whom the news of him had not been given, and those to whose ears it had not come will have knowledge.

15.msb: That is why I have often been hindered from coming to you.
15.kjv: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
15.blb: Therefore also I was being himdered many times from coming to you.
15.bbe: For which reason I was frequently kept from coming to you:

15.msb: But now that there are no further opportunities for me in these regions, and since I have longed for many years to visit you,
15.kjv: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
15.blb: But now, no longer having a place in these regions, and having a great desire for many years to come to you,
15.bbe: But now, having no longer any place in these parts and having had for a number of years a great desire to come to you,
15.heading: Paul’s Travel Plans

15.msb: I hope to come to see you on my way to Spain. And after I have enjoyed your company for a while, you can equip me for my journey.
15.kjv: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
15.blb: as I may go to Spain, I hope, for going through, to see you and to be sent forth there by you, if first I should be filled up of you in part.
15.bbe: Whenever I go to Spain (for it is my hope to see you on my way, and to be sent on there by you, if first I may in some measure have been comforted by your company) —

15.msb: Now, however, I am on my way to Jerusalem to serve the saints there.
15.kjv: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
15.blb: But now I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
15.bbe: But now I go to Jerusalem, taking help for the saints.

15.msb: For Macedonia and Achaia were pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the saints in Jerusalem.
15.kjv: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
15.blb: For Macedonia and Achaia were pleased to make some contribution for the poor of the saints who are in Jerusalem.
15.bbe: For it has been the good pleasure of those of Macedonia and Achaia to send a certain amount of money for the poor among the saints at Jerusalem.

15.msb: They were pleased to do it, and indeed they owe it to them. For if the Gentiles have shared in their spiritual blessings, they are obligated to minister to them with material blessings.
15.kjv: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
15.blb: For they were pleased, and they are debtors of them. For if the Gentiles have shared in their spiritual things, they ought also to minister to them in the fleshly things.
15.bbe: Yes, it has been their good pleasure; and they are in their debt. For if the Gentiles have had a part in the things of the Spirit which were theirs, it is right for them, in the same way, to give them help in the things of the flesh.

15.msb: So after I have completed this service and have safely delivered this bounty to them, I will set off to Spain by way of you.
15.kjv: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
15.blb: Therefore, having completed this, and having sealed this fruit to them, I will depart through you to Spain.
15.bbe: So when I have done this, and have given them this fruit of love, I will go on by you into Spain.

15.msb: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
15.kjv: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
15.blb: And I know that coming to you I will come in the fullness of the blessing of Christ.
15.bbe: And I am certain that when I come, I will be full of the blessing of Christ.

15.msb: Now I urge you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to join me in my struggle by praying to God for me.
15.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ’s sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
15.blb: Now I exhort you, brothers, through our Lord Jesus Christ and through the love of the Spirit, to strive together with me in the prayers for me to God,
15.bbe: Now I make request to you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that you will be working together with me in your prayers to God for me;

15.msb: Pray that I may be delivered from the unbelievers in Judea, and that my service in Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints there,
15.kjv: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
15.blb: so that I may be delivered from the unbelieving ones in Judea, and that my service in Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,
15.bbe: So that I may be kept safe from those in Judaea who have not put themselves under the rule of God, and that the help which I am taking for Jerusalem may be pleasing to the saints;

15.msb: so that by God’s will I may come to you with joy and together with you be refreshed.
15.kjv: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.
15.blb: so that having come to you in joy, through the will of God I may be refreshed together with you.
15.bbe: So that I may come to you in joy by the good pleasure of God, and have rest with you.

15.msb: The God of peace be with all of you. Amen.
15.kjv: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
15.blb: Now the God of peace be with all of you. Amen.
15.bbe: Now may the God of peace be with you all. So be it.

16.msb: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, a servant of the church in Cenchrea.
16.kjv: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
16.blb: Now I commend to you Phoebe our sister, being also a servant of the church in Cenchrea,
16.bbe: It is my desire to say a good word for Phoebe, who is a servant of the church in Cenchreae:
16.heading: Personal Greetings and Love

16.msb: Welcome her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the saints, and assist her with anything she may need from you. For she has been a great help to many people, including me.
16.kjv: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
16.blb: so that you might receive her in the Lord worthily of the saints, and you might assist her in whatever matter she may need of you. For she also has been a patroness of many, and of myself.
16.bbe: That you will take her in kindly, after the way of the saints, as one who is the Lord's, and give her help in anything in which she may have need of you: because she has been a help to a great number and to myself.

16.msb: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
16.kjv: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:
16.blb: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus—
16.bbe: Give my love to Prisca and Aquila, workers with me in Christ Jesus,

16.msb: who have risked their lives for me. Not only I but all the churches of the Gentiles are grateful to them.
16.kjv: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
16.blb: who laid down their own neck for my life, whom not only I thank, but also all the churches of the Gentiles—
16.bbe: Who for my life put their necks in danger; to whom not only I but all the churches of the Gentiles are in debt:

16.msb: Greet also the church that meets at their house. Greet my beloved Epenetus, who was the first convert to Christ in Achaia.
16.kjv: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.
16.blb: and the church at their house. Greet Epenetus, my beloved, who is the firstfruit of Asia for Christ.
16.bbe: And say a kind word to the church which is in their house. Give my love to my dear Epaenetus, who is the first fruit of Asia to Christ.

16.msb: Greet Mary, who has worked very hard for us.
16.kjv: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
16.blb: Greet Mary, who toiled much for you.
16.bbe: Give my love to Mary, who gave much care to you.

16.msb: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my fellow countrymen and fellow prisoners. They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in Christ before I was.
16.kjv: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
16.blb: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles and who were in Christ before me.
16.bbe: Give my love to Andronicus and Junia, my relations, who were in prison with me, who are noted among the Apostles, and who were in Christ before me.

16.msb: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.
16.kjv: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.
16.blb: Greet Ampliatus, my beloved in the Lord.
16.bbe: Give my love to Ampliatus, who is dear to me in the Lord,

16.msb: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and my beloved Stachys.
16.kjv: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
16.blb: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and my beloved Stachys.
16.bbe: Give my love to Urbanus, a worker in Christ with us, and to my dear Stachys.

16.msb: Greet Apelles, who is approved in Christ. Greet those who belong to the household of Aristobulus.
16.kjv: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus’ household.
16.blb: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those of the household of Aristobulus.
16.bbe: Give my love to Apelles, who has the approval of Christ. Say a kind word to those who are of the house of Aristobulus.

16.msb: Greet Herodion, my fellow countryman. Greet those from the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.
16.kjv: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
16.blb: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet those of the household of Narcissus being in the Lord.
16.bbe: Give my love to Herodion, my relation. Say a kind word to those of the house of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

16.msb: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, women who have worked hard in the Lord. Greet my beloved Persis, who has worked very hard in the Lord.
16.kjv: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
16.blb: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, those toiling in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who toiled much in the Lord.
16.bbe: Give my love to Tryphaena and Tryphosa, workers in the Lord. Give my love to my dear Persis, who did much work in the Lord.

16.msb: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother, who has been a mother to me as well.
16.kjv: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
16.blb: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
16.bbe: Give my love to Rufus, one of the Lord's selection, and to his mother and mine.

16.msb: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brothers with them.
16.kjv: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.
16.blb: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers with them.
16.bbe: Give my love to Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

16.msb: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas and all the saints with them.
16.kjv: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
16.blb: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas and all the saints with them.
16.bbe: Give my love to Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

16.msb: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The churches of Christ send you greetings.
16.kjv: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.
16.blb: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ greet you.
16.bbe: Give one another a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ send their love to you.

16.msb: Now I urge you, brothers, to watch out for those who create divisions and obstacles that are contrary to the teaching you have learned. Turn away from them.
16.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
16.blb: Now I exhort you, brothers, to watch out for those causing divisions and obstacles contrary to the teaching that you learned, and turn away from them.
16.bbe: Now, it is my desire, brothers, that you will take note of those who are causing division and trouble among you, quite against the teaching which was given to you: and keep away from them.
16.heading: Avoid Divisions

16.msb: For such people are not serving our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own appetites. By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive.
16.kjv: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
16.blb: For such do not serve our Lord Christ, but their own belly; and through smooth talk and blessing they deceive the hearts of the innocent.
16.bbe: For such people are not servants of the Lord Christ, but of their stomachs; and by their smooth and well-said words the hearts of those who have no knowledge of evil are tricked.

16.msb: Everyone has heard about your obedience, so I rejoice over you. But I want you to be wise indeed about what is good and innocent about what is evil.
16.kjv: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
16.blb: For your obedience has reached to all. Therefore I rejoice over you. But I want you to be wise to good, and innocent to evil.
16.bbe: For all have knowledge of how you do what you are ordered. For this reason I have joy in you, but it is my desire that you may be wise in what is good, and without knowledge of evil.

16.msb: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
16.kjv: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
16.blb: And the God of peace will crush Satan under your feet in quickness. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
16.bbe: And the God of peace will be crushing Satan under your feet before long. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

16.msb: Timothy, my fellow worker, sends you greetings, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my fellow countrymen.
