7.blb: But if also you shall have married, you did not sin; and if the virgin shall have married, she did not sin. But such will have tribulation in the flesh, and I am sparing you.
7.bbe: If you get married it is not a sin; and if an unmarried woman gets married it is not a sin. But those who do so will have trouble in the flesh. But I will not be hard on you.

7.msb: What I am saying, brothers, is that the time is short. From now on those who have wives should live as if they had none;
7.kjv: But this I say, brethren, the time is short: it remaineth, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;
7.blb: Now I say this, brothers: The time is shortened—so that from now on both those having wives should be as not having;
7.bbe: But I say this, my brothers, the time is short; and from now it will be wise for those who have wives to be as if they had them not;

7.msb: those who weep, as if they did not; those who are joyful, as if they were not; those who make a purchase, as if they had nothing;
7.kjv: And they that weep, as though they wept not; and they that rejoice, as though they rejoiced not; and they that buy, as though they possessed not;
7.blb: and those weeping, as not weeping; and those rejoicing, as not rejoicing; and those buying, as not possessing;
7.bbe: And for those who are in sorrow, to give no signs of it; and for those who are glad, to give no signs of joy; and for those who are getting property, to be as if they had nothing;

7.msb: and those who use the things of this world, as if not dependent on them. For this world in its present form is passing away.
7.kjv: And they that use this world, as not abusing it: for the fashion of this world passeth away.
7.blb: and those using the world, as not using it up. For the form of this world is passing away.
7.bbe: And for those who make use of the world, not to be using it fully; for this world's way of life will quickly come to an end.

7.msb: I want you to be free from concern. The unmarried man is concerned about the work of the Lord, how he will please the Lord.
7.kjv: But I would have you without carefulness. He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord, how he may please the Lord:
7.blb: But I want you to be without concern. The unmarried man is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he should please the Lord;
7.bbe: But it is my desire for you to be free from cares. The unmarried man gives his mind to the things of the Lord, how he may give pleasure to the Lord:

7.msb: But the married man is concerned about the affairs of this world, how he will please his wife.
7.kjv: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world, how he may please his wife.
7.blb: but the one being married is concerned for the things of the world, how he should please the wife,
7.bbe: But the married man gives his attention to the things of this world, how he may give pleasure to his wife.

7.msb: And there is a difference between the wife and the virgin. The unmarried woman is concerned about the work of the Lord, how she can be holy in both body and spirit. But the married woman is concerned about the affairs of this world, how she will please her husband.
7.kjv: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.
7.blb: and is divided. And the unmarried woman and virgin is concerned for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit; but the one being married is concerned for the things of the world, how she should please the husband.
7.bbe: And the wife is not the same as the virgin. The virgin gives her mind to the things of the Lord, so that she may be holy in body and in spirit: but the married woman takes thought for the things of the world, how she may give pleasure to her husband.

7.msb: I am saying this for your own good, not to restrict you, but in order to promote proper decorum and undivided devotion to the Lord.
7.kjv: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.
7.blb: Now I say this for your own profit, not so that I might place upon you a restraint, but for what is seemly and devoted to the Lord, without distraction.
7.bbe: Now I say this for your profit; not to make things hard for you, but because of what is right, and so that you may be able to give all your attention to the things of the Lord.

7.msb: However, if someone thinks he is acting inappropriately toward his betrothed, and if she is beyond her youth and they ought to marry, let him do as he wishes; he is not sinning; they should get married.
7.kjv: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.
7.blb: But if anyone supposes himself to be acting unbecomingly to his virgin, if she is beyond youth, and it ought to be so, let him do what he wills; he does not sin; let them marry.
7.bbe: But if, in any man's opinion, he is not doing what is right for his virgin, if she is past her best years, and there is need for it, let him do what seems right to him; it is no sin; let them be married.

7.msb: But the man who is firmly established in his heart and under no constraint, with control over his will and resolve in his heart not to marry the virgin, he will do well.
7.kjv: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but hath power over his own will, and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin, doeth well.
7.blb: But he who has stood steadfast in his heart, not having necessity but having authority over his own will, and has judged this in his own heart, to keep his own virgin, he will do well.
7.bbe: But the man who is strong in mind and purpose, who is not forced but has control over his desires, does well if he comes to the decision to keep her a virgin.

7.msb: So then, he who marries her does well, but he who does not marry her does even better.
7.kjv: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better.
7.blb: So then also, the one marrying his own virgin does well, and the one not marrying will do better.
7.bbe: So then, he who gets married to his virgin does well, and he who keeps her unmarried does better.

7.msb: A wife is bound by law to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, as long as he belongs to the Lord.
7.kjv: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.
7.blb: A wife has been bound for as long a time as her husband may live; but if the husband shall have died, she is free to be married to whom she wants, only in the Lord.
7.bbe: It is right for a wife to be with her husband as long as he is living; but when her husband is dead, she is free to be married to another; but only to a Christian.

7.msb: In my judgment, however, she is happier if she remains as she is. And I think that I too have the Spirit of God.
7.kjv: But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit of God.
7.blb: But she is more blessed if she should remain in the same manner, according to my judgment; and I think myself also to have the Spirit of God.
7.bbe: But it will be better for her to keep as she is, in my opinion: and it seems to me that I have the Spirit of God.

8.msb: Now about food sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
8.kjv: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.
8.blb: Now concerning the things sacrificed to idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
8.bbe: Now about things offered to images: we all seem to ourselves to have knowledge. Knowledge gives pride, but love gives true strength.
8.heading: Food Sacrificed to Idols

8.msb: The one who thinks he knows something does not yet know as he ought to know.
8.kjv: And if any man think that he knoweth any thing, he knoweth nothing yet as he ought to know.
8.blb: If anyone thinks to known anything, he does not yet know as it is necessary to know.
8.bbe: If anyone seems to himself to have knowledge, so far he has not the right sort of knowledge about anything;

8.msb: But the one who loves God is known by God.
8.kjv: But if any man love God, the same is known of him.
8.blb: But if anyone loves God, he is known by Him.
8.bbe: But if anyone has love for God, God has knowledge of him.

8.msb: So about eating food sacrificed to idols: We know that an idol is nothing at all in the world, and that there is no other God but one.
8.kjv: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is none other God but one.
8.blb: Therefore concerning the eating of the things sacrificed to idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world and that there is no God except one.
8.bbe: So, then, as to the question of taking food offered to images, we are certain that an image is nothing in the world, and that there is no God but one.

8.msb: For even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth (as there are many so-called gods and lords),
8.kjv: For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,)
8.blb: For even if indeed there are those called gods, whether in heaven or on earth—just as there are many gods and many lords—
8.bbe: For though there are those who have the name of gods, in heaven or on earth, as there are a number of gods and a number of lords,

8.msb: yet for us there is but one God, the Father, from whom all things came and for whom we exist. And there is but one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom all things came and through whom we exist.
8.kjv: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.
8.blb: yet to us there is one God the Father, of whom are all things, and we for Him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we through Him.
8.bbe: There is for us only one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we are for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we have our being through him.

8.msb: But not everyone has this knowledge. Some people with consciousness of the idol still eat such food as if it were sacrificed to an idol. And since their conscience is weak, it is defiled.
8.kjv: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge: for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.
8.blb: But the knowledge is not in all. And some, by habit of the idol until now, eat such as a thing sacrificed to an idol; and their conscience being weak, it is defiled.
8.bbe: Still, all men have not that knowledge: but some, being used till now to the image, are conscious that they are taking food which has been offered to the image; and because they are not strong in the faith, their minds are troubled.

8.msb: But food does not bring us closer to God: We are no better if we do not eat, and no worse if we do.
8.kjv: But meat commendeth us not to God: for neither, if we eat, are we the better; neither, if we eat not, are we the worse.
8.blb: But food will not commend us to God; neither if we should eat do we fall short, nor if we should not eat do we excel.
8.bbe: But God's approval of us is not based on the food we take: if we do not take it we are no worse for it; and if we take it we are no better.

8.msb: Be careful, however, that your freedom does not become a stumbling block to the weak.
8.kjv: But take heed lest by any means this liberty of yours become a stumblingblock to them that are weak.
8.blb: But take care, lest somehow this authority of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.
8.bbe: But take care that this power of yours does not give cause for trouble to the feeble.

8.msb: For if someone with a weak conscience sees you who are well informed eating in an idol’s temple, will he not be encouraged to eat food sacrificed to idols?
8.kjv: For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol’s temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;
8.blb: For if anyone should see you, the one having knowledge, reclining in an idol’s temple, will not the conscience of him being weak be built up to eat the things sacrificed to idols?
8.bbe: For if a man sees you, who have knowledge, taking food as a guest in the house of an image, will it not give him, if he is feeble, the idea that he may take food offered to images?

8.msb: Should this weak brother, for whom Christ died, be destroyed by your knowledge?
8.kjv: And through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish, for whom Christ died?
8.blb: For the one being weak is destroyed by your knowledge—the brother for whom Christ died.
8.bbe: And so, through your knowledge, you are the cause of destruction to your brother, for whom Christ underwent death.

8.msb: By sinning against your brothers in this way and wounding their weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
8.kjv: But when ye sin so against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, ye sin against Christ.
8.blb: And thus sinning against the brothers and wounding their conscience, it being weak, you sin against Christ.
8.bbe: And in this way, doing evil to the brothers, and causing trouble to those whose faith is feeble, you are sinning against Christ.

8.msb: Therefore, if what I eat causes my brother to stumble, I will never eat meat again, so that I will not cause him to stumble.
8.kjv: Wherefore, if meat make my brother to offend, I will eat no flesh while the world standeth, lest I make my brother to offend.
8.blb: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, never shall I eat meat to the age, so that I shall not cause my brother to stumble.
8.bbe: For this reason, if food is a cause of trouble to my brother, I will give up taking meat for ever, so that I may not be a cause of trouble to my brother.

9.msb: Am I not an apostle? Am I not free? Have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? Are you yourselves not my workmanship in the Lord?
9.kjv: Am I not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? are not ye my work in the Lord?
9.blb: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you not my work in the Lord?
9.bbe: Am I not free? am I not an Apostle? have I not seen Jesus our Lord? are you not my work in the Lord?
9.heading: The Rights of an Apostle

9.msb: Even if I am not an apostle to others, surely I am to you. For you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
9.kjv: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.
9.blb: If I am not an apostle to others, yet indeed I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
9.bbe: If to others I am not an Apostle, at least I am one to you: for the fact that you are Christians is the sign that I am an Apostle.

9.msb: This is my defense to those who scrutinize me:
9.kjv: Mine answer to them that do examine me is this,
9.blb: This is my defense to those examining me:
9.bbe: My answer to those who are judging me is this.

9.msb: Have we no right to food and to drink?
9.kjv: Have we not power to eat and to drink?
9.blb: Have we no authority to eat and to drink?
9.bbe: Have we no right to take food and drink?

9.msb: Have we no right to take along a believing wife, as do the other apostles and the Lord’s brothers and Cephas?
9.kjv: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?
9.blb: Have we no authority to take along a sister—a wife—as also the other apostles and the brothers of the Lord and Cephas?
9.bbe: Have we no right to take about with us a Christian wife, like the rest of the Apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

9.msb: Or are Barnabas and I the only apostles who must work for a living?
9.kjv: Or I only and Barnabas, have not we power to forbear working?
9.blb: Or do only I and Barnabas have no authority to work?
9.bbe: Or I only and Barnabas, have we no right to take a rest from work?

9.msb: Who serves as a soldier at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat of its fruit? Or who tends a flock and does not drink of its milk?
9.kjv: Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges? who planteth a vineyard, and eateth not of the fruit thereof? or who feedeth a flock, and eateth not of the milk of the flock?
9.blb: Who serves as a soldier at his own expense at any time? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat its fruit? Or who shepherds a flock and does not drink from the milk of the flock?
9.bbe: Who ever goes to war without looking to someone to be responsible for his payment? who puts in vines and does not take the fruit of them? or who takes care of sheep without drinking of their milk?

9.msb: Do I say this from a human perspective? Doesn’t the Law say the same thing?
9.kjv: Say I these things as a man? or saith not the law the same also?
9.blb: Do I not speak these things according to man, or does the law not also say these things?
9.bbe: Am I talking as a man? does not the law say the same?

9.msb: For it is written in the Law of Moses: “Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.” Is it about oxen that God is concerned?
9.kjv: For it is written in the law of Moses, Thou shalt not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treadeth out the corn. Doth God take care for oxen?
9.blb: For in the law of Moses it has been written: “You shall not muzzle an ox treading out grain.” Is there care for the oxen with God?
9.bbe: For it says in the law of Moses, It is not right to keep the ox from taking the grain when he is crushing it. Is it for the oxen that God is giving orders?

9.msb: Isn’t He actually speaking on our behalf? Indeed, this was written for us, because when the plowman plows and the thresher threshes, they should also expect to share in the harvest.
9.kjv: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.
9.blb: Or does He speak because of us entirely? For it was written because of us, because in hope the one plowing ought to plow, and the one threshing—in hope to partake.
9.bbe: Or has he us in mind? Yes, it was said for us; because it is right for the ploughman to do his ploughing in hope, and for him who is crushing the grain to do his work hoping for a part in the fruits of it.

9.msb: If we have sown spiritual seed among you, is it too much for us to reap a material harvest from you?
9.kjv: If we have sown unto you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?
9.blb: If we sowed spiritual things among you, is it too much if we will reap fleshly things from you?
9.bbe: If we have been planting the things of the Spirit for you, does it seem a great thing for you to give us a part in your things of this world?

9.msb: If others have this right to your support, shouldn’t we have it all the more? But we did not exercise this right. Instead, we put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel of Christ.
9.kjv: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.
9.blb: If others partake of the authority over you, should we not more? But we did not use this authority. But we bear all things, so that we should not give any hindrance to the gospel of Christ.
9.bbe: If others have a part in this right over you, have we not even more? But we did not make use of our right, so that we might put nothing in the way of the good news of Christ.

9.msb: Do you not know that those who work in the temple eat of its food, and those who serve at the altar partake of its offerings?
9.kjv: Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar?
9.blb: Do you not know that those working in the temple eat the things of the temple, and those attending at the altar partake in the altar?
9.bbe: Do you not see that the servants of the holy things get their living from the Temple, and the servants of the altar have their part in the food which is offered on the altar?

9.msb: In the same way, the Lord has prescribed that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel.
9.kjv: Even so hath the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.
9.blb: So also, the Lord directed those proclaiming the gospel to live from the gospel.
9.bbe: Even so did the Lord give orders that the preachers of the good news might get their living from the good news.

9.msb: But I have not used any of these rights. And I am not writing this to suggest that something be done for me. Indeed, I would rather die than let anyone nullify my boast.
9.kjv: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for it were better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.
9.blb: But I have not used any of these. And neither did I write these things so that it should be thus with me; for it is good for me rather to die than that anyone will make void my boasting.
9.bbe: But I have not made use of any of these things: and I am not writing this in the hope that it may be so for me: for it would be better for me to undergo death, than for any man to make this pride of mine of no effect.

9.msb: Yet when I preach the gospel, I have no reason to boast, because I am obligated to preach. Woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!
9.kjv: For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!
9.blb: For if I preach the gospel, there is no boasting to me, for necessity is laid upon me. But woe be to me if I should not preach the gospel!
9.bbe: For if I am a preacher of the good news, I have no cause for pride in this; because I am forced to do so, for a curse is on me if I do not.

9.msb: If my preaching is voluntary, I have a reward. But if it is not voluntary, I am still entrusted with a responsibility.
9.kjv: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.
9.blb: For if I do this willingly, I have a reward; but if unwillingly, I have been entrusted with a stewardship.
9.bbe: But if I do it gladly, I have a reward; and if not, I am under orders to do it.

9.msb: What then is my reward? That in preaching the gospel I may offer the gospel of Christ free of charge, and so not use up my rights in preaching it.
9.kjv: What is my reward then? Verily that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I abuse not my power in the gospel.
9.blb: What then is my reward? That preaching the gospel, I should lay down the gospel free of charge, so as not to use up my authority in the gospel.
9.bbe: What then is my reward? This, that when I am giving the good news, I may give it without payment, not making use of my rights as a preacher of the good news.

9.msb: Though I am free of obligation to anyone, I make myself a slave to everyone, to win as many as possible.
9.kjv: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.
9.blb: For being free from all, I myself became a slave to all, so that I might gain the more.
9.bbe: For though I was free from all men, I made myself a servant to all, so that more might have salvation.
9.heading: Paul the Servant to All

9.msb: To the Jews I became like a Jew, to win the Jews. To those under the law I became like one under the law, to win those under the law.
9.kjv: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain the Jews; to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;
9.blb: And I became to the Jews as a Jew, so that I might gain the Jews; to those under the law, as under the law (myself not being under the law), so that I might gain those under the law;
9.bbe: And to the Jews I was as a Jew, so that I might give the good news to them; to those under the law I was the same, not as being myself under the law, but so that I might give the good news to those under the law.

9.msb: To those without the law I became like one without the law (though I am not outside the law of God but am under the law of Christ), to win those without the law.
9.kjv: To them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to God, but under the law to Christ,) that I might gain them that are without law.
9.blb: to those without the law, as without the law (not being without the law of God, but within the law of Christ), so that I might gain those without the law.
9.bbe: To those without the law I was as one without the law, not as being without law to God, but as under law to Christ, so that I might give the good news to those without the law.

9.msb: To the weak I became like one who is weak, to win the weak. I have become all things to all people so that by all possible means I might save some.
9.kjv: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all men, that I might by all means save some.
9.blb: To the weak I became weak, so that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all, so that by all means I might save some.
9.bbe: To the feeble, I was as one who is feeble, so that they might have salvation: I have been all things to all men, so that some at least might have salvation.

9.msb: I do this for the sake of the gospel, so that I may share in its blessings.
9.kjv: And this I do for the gospel’s sake, that I might be partaker thereof with you.
9.blb: Now I do all because of the gospel, so that I might become a fellow partaker of it.
9.bbe: And I do all things for the cause of the good news, so that I may have a part in it.

9.msb: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one receives the prize? Run in such a way as to take the prize.
9.kjv: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.
9.blb: Do you not know that those running in a race indeed all run, but one receives the prize? Run thus, so that you might obtain it.
9.bbe: Do you not see that in a running competition all take part, but only one gets the reward? So let your minds be fixed on the reward.
9.heading: Run Your Race to Win

9.msb: Everyone who competes in the games trains with strict discipline. They do it for a crown that is perishable, but we do it for a crown that is imperishable.
9.kjv: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.
9.blb: Now everyone striving controls himself in all things; these indeed then so that they might receive a perishable crown, but we an imperishable.
9.bbe: And every man who takes part in the sports has self-control in all things. Now they do it to get a crown which is of this world, but we for an eternal crown.

9.msb: Therefore I do not run aimlessly; I do not fight like I am beating the air.
9.kjv: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:
9.blb: Therefore I run thus, not as aimlessly; I fight thus, not as beating the air.
9.bbe: So then I am running, not uncertainly; so I am fighting, not as one who gives blows in the air:

9.msb: No, I discipline my body and make it my slave, so that after I have preached to others, I myself will not be disqualified.
9.kjv: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.
9.blb: But I batter my body and bring it into servitude, lest somehow, having preached to others, I myself might be disqualified.
9.bbe: But I give blows to my body, and keep it under control, for fear that, after having given the good news to others, I myself might not have God's approval.

10.msb: Now I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, that our forefathers were all under the cloud, and that they all passed through the sea.
10.kjv: Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
10.blb: For I do not want you to be ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud and all passed through the sea.
10.bbe: For it is my desire, my brothers, that you may keep in mind how all our fathers were under the cloud, and they all went through the sea;
10.heading: Warnings from Israel’s Past

10.msb: They were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea.
10.kjv: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
10.blb: And all were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea,
10.bbe: And they all had baptism from Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

10.msb: They all ate the same spiritual food
10.kjv: And did all eat the same spiritual meat;
10.blb: and all ate the same spiritual food,
10.bbe: And they all took the same holy food;

10.msb: and drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ.
10.kjv: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.
10.blb: and all drank the same spiritual drink; for they were drinking from the spiritual rock accompanying them, and the rock was Christ.
10.bbe: And the same holy drink: for they all took of the water from the holy rock which came after them: and the rock was Christ.

10.msb: Nevertheless, God was not pleased with most of them, for they were struck down in the wilderness.
10.kjv: But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
10.blb: But God was not well pleased in most of them, for they were strewn in the wilderness.
10.bbe: But with most of them God was not pleased: for they came to their end in the waste land.

10.msb: These things took place as examples to keep us from craving evil things as they did.
10.kjv: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.
10.blb: Now these things became types of us, for us not to be desirers of evil things, as those also desired.
10.bbe: Now these things were for an example to us, so that our hearts might not go after evil things, as they did.

10.msb: Do not be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written: “The people sat down to eat and to drink, and got up to indulge in revelry.”
10.kjv: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
10.blb: And do not become idolaters, as some of them, just as it has been written: “The people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.”
10.bbe: Then do not go after false gods, as some of them did; as it is said in the holy Writings, After resting and feasting, the people got up to take their pleasure.

10.msb: We should not commit sexual immorality, as some of them did, and in one day twenty-three thousand of them died.
10.kjv: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
10.blb: And we should not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed sexual immorality, and twenty-three thousand fell in one day.
10.bbe: Again, let us not give way to the desires of the flesh, as some of them did, of whom twenty-three thousand came to their end in one day.

10.msb: We should not test Christ, as some of them also did, and were killed by snakes.
10.kjv: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.
10.blb: And we should not test Christ, as some of them tested, and were destroyed by serpents.
10.bbe: And let us not put the Lord to the test, as some of them did, and came to their death by snakes.

10.msb: And do not complain, as also some of them did, and were killed by the destroying angel.
10.kjv: Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.
10.blb: And do not grumble, as some of them grumbled, and were destroyed by the destroyer.
10.bbe: And do not say evil things against the Lord, as some of them did, and destruction overtook them.

10.msb: Now all these things happened to them as examples and were written down as warnings for us, on whom the fulfillment of the ages has come.
10.kjv: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.
10.blb: Now these things happened to those as types and were written for our admonition, to whom the ends of the ages have come.
10.bbe: Now these things were done as an example; and were put down in writing for our teaching, on whom the last days have come.

10.msb: So the one who thinks he is standing firm should be careful not to fall.
10.kjv: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
10.blb: Therefore the one thinking to stand, let him observe, lest he fall.
10.bbe: So let him who seems to himself to be safe go in fear of a fall.

10.msb: No temptation has seized you except what is common to man. And God is faithful; He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, He will also provide an escape, so that you can stand up under it.
10.kjv: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
10.blb: No temptation has overtaken you except what is human. And faithful is God, who will not allow you to be tempted beyond what you are able, but He will also provide with the temptation the escape, to be able to bear up under it.
10.bbe: You have been put to no test but such as is common to man: and God is true, who will not let any test come on you which you are not able to undergo; but he will make with the test a way out of it, so that you may be able to go through it.

10.msb: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
10.kjv: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.
10.blb: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
10.bbe: For this cause, my dear brothers, give no worship to false gods.
10.heading: Flee from Idolatry

10.msb: I speak to reasonable people; judge for yourselves what I say.
10.kjv: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.
10.blb: I speak as to sensible ones; judge for yourselves what I say.
10.bbe: What I am saying is for wise men, do you be the judges of it.

10.msb: Is not the cup of blessing that we bless a participation in the blood of Christ? And is not the bread that we break a participation in the body of Christ?
10.kjv: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
10.blb: The cup of blessing that we bless, is it not a fellowship of the blood of Christ? The bread that we break, is it not a fellowship of the body of Christ?
10.bbe: The cup of blessing which we take, does it not give us a part in the blood of Christ? and is not the broken bread a taking part in the body of Christ?

10.msb: Because there is one loaf, we who are many are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf.
10.kjv: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.
10.blb: Because there is one loaf, we the many are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf.
10.bbe: Because we, being a number of persons, are one bread, we are one body: for we all take part in the one bread.

10.msb: Consider the people of Israel: Are not those who eat the sacrifices fellow partakers in the altar?
10.kjv: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?
10.blb: Consider Israel according to flesh: Are not those eating the sacrifices fellow sharers of the altar?
10.bbe: See Israel after the flesh: do not those who take as food the offerings of the altar take a part in the altar?

10.msb: Am I suggesting, then, that an idol is anything, or that food sacrificed to an idol is anything?
10.kjv: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?
10.blb: Then what do I say? That what is sacrificed to an idol is anything, or that an idol is anything?
10.bbe: Do I say, then, that what is offered to images is anything, or that the image is anything?

10.msb: No, but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons, not to God. And I do not want you to be participants with demons.
10.kjv: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.
10.blb: No, but that which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God. And I do not want you to be fellow sharers with demons.
10.bbe: What I say is that the things offered by the Gentiles are offered to evil spirits and not to God; and it is not my desire for you to have any part with evil spirits.

10.msb: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons too; you cannot partake in the table of the Lord and the table of demons too.
10.kjv: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord’s table, and of the table of devils.
10.blb: You are not able to drink a cup of the Lord and a cup of demons. You are not able to partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.
10.bbe: It is not possible for you, at the same time, to take the cup of the Lord and the cup of evil spirits; you may not take part in the table of the Lord and the table of evil spirits.

10.msb: Are we trying to provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than He?
10.kjv: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
10.blb: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than He?
10.bbe: Or may we be the cause of envy to the Lord? are we stronger than he?

10.msb: “Everything is permissible for me,” but not everything is beneficial. “Everything is permissible for me,” but not everything is edifying.
10.kjv: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.
10.blb: “All things are lawful,” but not all things are profitable; “All things are lawful,” but not all things edify.
10.bbe: We are free to do all things, but there are things which it is not wise to do. We are free to do all things, but not all things are for the common good.
10.heading: All to God’s Glory

10.msb: No one should seek his own good, but each one should seek the good of others.
10.kjv: Let no man seek his own, but every man another’s wealth.
10.blb: Let no one seek the good of himself, but that of the other.
10.bbe: Let a man give attention not only to what is good for himself, but equally to his neighbour's good.

10.msb: Eat anything sold in the meat market without raising questions of conscience,
10.kjv: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:
10.blb: Eat everything being sold in the meat market, inquiring nothing because of conscience,
10.bbe: Whatever meat may be had at the public market, take as food without question of right or wrong;

10.msb: for, “The earth is the Lord’s, and the fullness thereof.”
10.kjv: For the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof.
10.blb: for, “The earth is the Lord’s, and the fullness of it.”
10.bbe: For the earth is the Lord's and all things in it.

10.msb: If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you want to go, eat anything set before you without raising questions of conscience.
10.kjv: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.
10.blb: If any of the unbelieving ones invites you, and you want to go, eat everything being set before you, inquiring nothing because of conscience.
10.bbe: If a Gentile makes a feast for you, and you are pleased to go as a guest, take whatever is put before you, without question of right or wrong.

10.msb: But if someone tells you, “This food was offered to idols,” then do not eat it, for the sake of the one who told you and for the sake of conscience—for the earth is the Lord’s, and the fullness thereof—
10.kjv: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof:
10.blb: But if anyone should say to you, “This is offered to an idol,” do not eat it, because of the one having informed you, and conscience—
10.bbe: But if anyone says to you, This food has been used as an offering, do not take it, on account of him who said it, and on account of his sense of right and wrong:

10.msb: the other one’s conscience, I mean, not your own. For why should my freedom be determined by someone else’s conscience?
10.kjv: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man’s conscience?
10.blb: and I do not say your own conscience, but that of the other; for why is my freedom judged by another’s conscience?
10.bbe: Right and wrong, I say, not for you, but for the other man; for the fact that I am free is not dependent on another man's sense of right or wrong.

10.msb: If I partake in the meal with thankfulness, why am I denounced because of that for which I give thanks?
10.kjv: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
10.blb: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I spoken evil of for that for which I give thanks?
10.bbe: But if I give praise to God for the food which I take, let no man say evil of me for that reason.

10.msb: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all to the glory of God.
10.kjv: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
10.blb: Therefore whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do all things to the glory of God.
10.bbe: So then, if it is a question of food or drink, or any other thing, whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

10.msb: Do not become a stumbling block, whether to Jews or Greeks or the church of God—
10.kjv: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:
10.blb: Be without offense both to Jews and to Greeks and to the church of God—
10.bbe: Give no cause of trouble to Jews, or to Greeks, or to the church of God.

10.msb: as I also try to please everyone in all I do. For I am not seeking my own good, but the good of many, that they may be saved.
10.kjv: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.
10.blb: even as I also please all in all things, not seeking my own profit, but that of the many, so that they may be saved.
10.bbe: Even as I give way to all men in all things, not looking for profit for myself, but for the good of others, that they may get salvation.

11.msb: You are to imitate me, just as I imitate Christ.
11.kjv: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
11.blb: Be imitators of me, as I also am of Christ.
11.bbe: So take me for your example, even as I take Christ for mine.
11.heading: Roles in Worship

11.msb: Now I commend you, brothers, for remembering me in everything and for maintaining the traditions, just as I passed them on to you.
11.kjv: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.
11.blb: Now I commend you because you have remembered me in all things, and you hold fast the traditions just as I delivered them to you.
11.bbe: Now I am pleased to see that you keep me in memory in all things, and that you give attention to the teaching which was handed down from me to you.

11.msb: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
11.kjv: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.
11.blb: But I want you to know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is the man, and the head of Christ is God.
11.bbe: But it is important for you to keep this fact in mind, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man, and the head of Christ is God.

11.msb: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.
11.kjv: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
11.blb: Every man praying or prophesying having anything on his head dishonors his head.
11.bbe: Every man who takes part in prayer, or gives teaching as a prophet, with his head covered, puts shame on his head.

11.msb: And every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, for it is just as if her head were shaved.
11.kjv: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.
11.blb: And every woman praying or prophesying with the head uncovered dishonors her head; for it is one and the same with having been shaven.
11.bbe: But every woman who does so with her head unveiled, puts shame on her head: for it is the same as if her hair was cut off.

11.msb: If a woman does not cover her head, she should have her hair cut off. And if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut or shaved off, she should cover her head.
11.kjv: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.
11.blb: For if a woman does not cover her head, also let her be shorn. And if it is shameful to a woman to be shorn or to be shaven, let her cover her head.
11.bbe: For if a woman is not veiled, let her hair be cut off; but if it is a shame to a woman to have her hair cut off, let her be veiled.

11.msb: A man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God; but woman is the glory of man.
11.kjv: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
11.blb: For indeed a man ought not to cover the head, being the image and glory of God; but the woman is the glory of man.
11.bbe: For it is not right for a man to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.

11.msb: For man did not come from woman, but woman from man.
11.kjv: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.
11.blb: For man is not of woman, but woman of man.
11.bbe: For the man did not come from the woman, but the woman from the man.

11.msb: Neither was man created for woman, but woman for man.
11.kjv: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.
11.blb: For also man was not created because of the woman, but woman because of the man.
11.bbe: And the man was not made for the woman, but the woman for the man.

11.msb: For this reason a woman ought to have a sign of authority on her head, because of the angels.
11.kjv: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.
11.blb: Because of this, the woman ought to have authority on the head, because of the angels.
11.bbe: For this reason it is right for the woman to have a sign of authority on her head, because of the angels.

11.msb: In the Lord, however, man is not independent of woman, nor is woman independent of man.
11.kjv: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.
11.blb: However, neither is woman apart from man, nor man apart from woman in the Lord.
11.bbe: But the woman is not separate from the man, and the man is not separate from the woman in the Lord.

11.msb: For just as woman came from man, so also man is born of woman. But everything comes from God.
11.kjv: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.
11.blb: For just as the woman is of the man, so also the man is through the woman. And all things are of God.
11.bbe: For as the woman is from the man, so the man is through the woman; but all things are from God.

11.msb: Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?
11.kjv: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?
11.blb: Judge in yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God uncovered?
11.bbe: Be judges yourselves of the question: does it seem right for a woman to take part in prayer unveiled?

11.msb: Doesn’t nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him,
11.kjv: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?
11.blb: Does not even nature itself teach you that indeed if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him,
11.bbe: Does it not seem natural to you that if a man has long hair, it is a cause of shame to him?

11.msb: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given as a covering.
11.kjv: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.
11.blb: but if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her? For the long hair instead of a covering is given to her.
11.bbe: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given to her for a covering.

11.msb: If anyone is inclined to dispute this, we have no other practice, nor do the churches of God.
11.kjv: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
11.blb: Now if anyone thinks to be contentious, we have no such custom, nor do the churches of God.
11.bbe: But if any man will not be ruled in this question, this is not our way of doing things, and it is not done in the churches of God.

11.msb: In the following instructions I have no praise to offer, because your gatherings do more harm than good.
11.kjv: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.
11.blb: Now in this instructing, I do not praise you, because not for the better, but for the worse, do you come together.
11.bbe: But in giving you this order, there is one thing about which I am not pleased: it is that when you come together it is not for the better but for the worse.
11.heading: Sharing in the Lord’s Supper

11.msb: First of all, I hear that when you come together as a church, there are divisions among you, and in part I believe it.
11.kjv: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
11.blb: For first indeed, on your coming together in an assembly, I hear there to be divisions among you, and in part I believe it.
11.bbe: For first of all, it has come to my ears that when you come together in the church, there are divisions among you, and I take the statement to be true in part.

11.msb: And indeed, there must be differences among you to show which of you are approved.
11.kjv: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.
11.blb: For also it is necessary for there to be factions among you, so that also the ones approved should become evident among you.
11.bbe: For divisions are necessary among you, in order that those who have God's approval may be clearly seen among you.

11.msb: Now then, when you come together, it is not the Lord’s Supper you eat.
11.kjv: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord’s supper.
11.blb: Therefore, on your coming together in the same place, it is not to eat the Lord’s supper.
11.bbe: But now, when you come together, it is not possible to take the holy meal of the Lord:

11.msb: For as you eat, each of you goes ahead without sharing his meal. While one remains hungry, another gets drunk.
11.kjv: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
11.blb: For in eating, each takes first his own supper. And indeed this one is hungry, but that one is drunk.
11.bbe: For when you take your food, everyone takes his meal before the other; and one has not enough food, and another is the worse for drink.

11.msb: Don’t you have your own homes in which to eat and drink? Or do you despise the church of God and humiliate those who have nothing? What can I say to you? Shall I praise you for this? No, I will not!
11.kjv: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
11.blb: What! Have you no houses in which to eat and to drink? Or do you despise the church of God and put to shame those not having? What shall I say to you? Shall I praise you? In this I do not praise you!
11.bbe: What? have you not houses to take your meals in? or have you no respect for the church of God, putting the poor to shame? What am I to say to you? am I to give you praise? certainly not.

11.msb: For I received from the Lord what I also passed on to you: The Lord Jesus, on the night He was betrayed, took bread,
11.kjv: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:
11.blb: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus, in the night in which He was delivered up, took bread,
11.bbe: For it was handed down to me from the Lord, as I gave it to you, that the Lord Jesus, on the night when Judas was false to him, took bread,

11.msb: and when He had given thanks, He broke it and said, “Take and eat. This is My body, which is broken for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”
11.kjv: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
11.blb: and having given thanks, He broke it and said, “This is My body, which is for you; do this to the remembrance of Me.”
11.bbe: And when it had been broken with an act of praise, he said, This is my body which is for you: do this in memory of me.

11.msb: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood; do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me.”
11.kjv: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.
11.blb: Likewise also the cup after having supped, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood; do this, as often as you may drink it, to the remembrance of Me.”
11.bbe: In the same way, with the cup, after the meal, he said, This cup is the new testament in my blood: do this, whenever you take it, in memory of me.

11.msb: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until He comes.
11.kjv: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord’s death till he come.
11.blb: For as often as you may eat this bread and may drink the cup, you proclaim the death of the Lord until He should come.
11.bbe: For whenever you take the bread and the cup you give witness to the Lord's death till he comes.

11.msb: Therefore, whoever eats this bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in a manner unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.
11.kjv: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
11.blb: Therefore, whoever may eat the bread or may drink the cup of the Lord unworthily will be guilty of the body and of the blood of the Lord.
11.bbe: If, then, anyone takes the bread or the cup of the Lord in the wrong spirit, he will be responsible for the body and blood of the Lord.

11.msb: Each one must examine himself before he eats of the bread and drinks of the cup.
11.kjv: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.
11.blb: But let a man examine himself, and thus let him eat of the bread, and let him drink of the cup.
11.bbe: But let no man take of the bread and the cup without testing himself.

11.msb: For anyone who eats and drinks unworthily, without recognizing the body of the Lord, eats and drinks judgment on himself.
11.kjv: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord’s body.
11.blb: For the one eating and drinking, not discerning the body, eats and drinks judgment on himself.
11.bbe: For a man puts himself in danger, if he takes part in the holy meal without being conscious that it is the Lord's body.

11.msb: That is why many among you are weak and sick, and a number of you have fallen asleep.
11.kjv: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.
11.blb: Because of this, many are weak and sick among you, and many are fallen asleep.
11.bbe: For this cause a number of you are feeble and ill, and a number are dead.

11.msb: Now if we judged ourselves properly, we would not come under judgment.
11.kjv: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
11.blb: For if we were discerning of ourselves, we would not be being judged.
11.bbe: But if we were true judges of ourselves, punishment would not come on us.

11.msb: But when we are judged by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned with the world.
11.kjv: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.
11.blb: But being judged by the Lord, we are disciplined, so that we should not be condemned with the world.
11.bbe: But if punishment does come, it is sent by the Lord, so that we may be safe when the world is judged.

11.msb: So, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
11.kjv: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.
11.blb: So then, my brothers, in coming together in order to eat, wait for one another.
11.bbe: So then, my brothers, when you come together to the holy meal of the Lord, let there be waiting for one another.

11.msb: If anyone is hungry, he should eat at home, so that when you come together it will not result in judgment. And when I come, I will give instructions about the remaining matters.
11.kjv: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.
11.blb: If anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, so that you may not come together for judgment; and I will prescribe the other things as soon as I shall come.
11.bbe: If any man is in need of food, let him take his meal in his house; so that you may not come together to your damage. And the rest I will put in order when I come.

12.msb: Now about spiritual gifts, brothers, I do not want you to be uninformed.
12.kjv: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
12.blb: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brothers, I do not want you to be ignorant.
12.bbe: But about the things of the spirit, my brothers, it is not right for you to be without teaching.
12.heading: Spiritual Gifts

12.msb: You know that when you were pagans, you were influenced and led astray to mute idols.
12.kjv: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.
12.blb: You know that when you were pagans, you were led even as to mute idols, being led astray.
12.bbe: You are conscious that when you were Gentiles, in whatever way you were guided, you went after images without voice or power.

12.msb: Therefore I inform you that no one who is speaking by the Spirit of God calls Jesus accursed, and no one can call Jesus Lord, except by the Holy Spirit.
12.kjv: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.
12.blb: Therefore I make known to you that no one speaking in the Spirit of God says, “Jesus is accursed,” and no one is able to say, “Jesus is Lord,” except in the Holy Spirit.
12.bbe: So it is my desire for you to be clear about this; that no one is able to say by the Spirit of God that Jesus is cursed; and no one is able to say that Jesus is Lord, but by the Holy Spirit.

12.msb: There are different gifts, but the same Spirit.
12.kjv: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
12.blb: Now there are varieties of gifts, but the same Spirit;
12.bbe: Now there are different qualities given to men, but the same Spirit.

12.msb: There are different ministries, but the same Lord.
12.kjv: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.
12.blb: and there are varieties of services, and the same Lord;
12.bbe: And there are different sorts of servants, but the same Lord.

12.msb: There are different ways of working, but the same God works all things in all people.
12.kjv: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.
12.blb: and there are varieties of workings, but the same God who is working all things in all.
12.bbe: And there are different operations, but the same God, who is working all things in all.

12.msb: Now to each one the manifestation of the Spirit is given for the common good.
12.kjv: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
12.blb: Now to each is given the manifestation of the Spirit, for the common profiting.
12.bbe: But to every man some form of the Spirit's working is given for the common good.

12.msb: To one there is given through the Spirit the message of wisdom, to another the message of knowledge by the same Spirit,
12.kjv: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;
12.blb: For indeed, to one is given a word of wisdom through the Spirit, and to another a word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,
12.bbe: For to one are given words of wisdom through the Spirit; and to another words of knowledge through the same Spirit:

12.msb: to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healing by that same Spirit,
12.kjv: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;
12.blb: and to a different one faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healing in the one Spirit,
12.bbe: To another faith in the same Spirit; and to another the power of taking away disease, by the one Spirit;

12.msb: to another the working of miracles, to another prophecy, to another distinguishing between spirits, to another speaking in various tongues, and to still another the interpretation of tongues.
12.kjv: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:
12.blb: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another distinguishing of spirits, and to a different one various kinds of tongues, and to another interpretation of tongues.
12.bbe: And to another the power of working wonders; and to another the prophet's word; and to another the power of testing spirits; to another different sorts of tongues; and to another the power of making clear the sense of the tongues:

12.msb: All these are the work of one and the same Spirit, who apportions them to each one as He determines.
12.kjv: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
12.blb: Now one and the same the Spirit works all these things, apportioning individually to each as He wills.
12.bbe: But all these are the operations of the one and the same Spirit, giving to every man separately as his pleasure is.

12.msb: The body is a unit, though it is composed of many parts. And although its parts are many, they all form one body. So it is with Christ.
12.kjv: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
12.blb: For just as the body is one, and it has many members, and all the members of the body being many are one body, so also is Christ.
12.bbe: For as the body is one, and has a number of parts, and all the parts make one body, so is Christ.
12.heading: The Body of Christ

12.msb: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, slave or free, and we were all given into one Spirit to drink.
12.kjv: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.
12.blb: For also in one Spirit we all were baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free, and we were all made to drink of one Spirit.
12.bbe: For through the baptism of the one Spirit we were all formed into one body, Jews or Greeks, servants or free men, and were all made full of the same Spirit.

12.msb: For the body does not consist of one part, but of many.
12.kjv: For the body is not one member, but many.
12.blb: For also the body is not one member, but many.
12.bbe: For the body is not one part, but a number of parts.

12.msb: If the foot should say, “Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.
12.kjv: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
12.blb: If the foot should say, “Because I am not a hand, I am not of the body,” not on account of this is it not of the body.
12.bbe: If the foot says, Because I am not the hand, I am not a part of the body; it is no less a part of the body.

12.msb: And if the ear should say, “Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.
12.kjv: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
12.blb: And if the ear should say, “Because I am not an eye, I am not of the body,” not on account of this is it not of the body.
12.bbe: And if the ear says, Because I am not the eye, I am not a part of the body; it is a part of the body all the same.

12.msb: If the whole body were an eye, where would the sense of hearing be? If the whole body were an ear, where would the sense of smell be?
12.kjv: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
12.blb: If the whole body were an eye, where is the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where is the sense of smell?
12.bbe: If all the body was an eye, where would be the hearing? if all was hearing, where would be the smelling?

12.msb: But in fact, God has arranged the members of the body, every one of them, according to His design.
12.kjv: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.
12.blb: But now God placed the members, each one of them in the body, as He wanted.
12.bbe: But now God has put every one of the parts in the body as it was pleasing to him.

12.msb: If they were all one part, where would the body be?
12.kjv: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
12.blb: And if all were one member, where is the body?
12.bbe: And if they were all one part, where would the body be?

12.msb: As it is, there are many parts, but one body.
12.kjv: But now are they many members, yet but one body.
12.blb: But now indeed, there are many members, but one body.
12.bbe: But now they are all different parts, but one body.

12.msb: The eye cannot say to the hand, “I do not need you.” Nor can the head say to the feet, “I do not need you.”
12.kjv: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
12.blb: Now the eye is not able to say to the hand, “I have no need of you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need of you.”
12.bbe: And the eye may not say to the hand, I have no need of you: or again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

12.msb: On the contrary, the parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,
12.kjv: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:
12.blb: But much more, the members of the body seeming to be weaker are essential,
12.bbe: No, those parts which seem to be feeble are the more necessary;

12.msb: and the parts we consider less honorable, we treat with greater honor. And our unpresentable parts are treated with special modesty,
12.kjv: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
12.blb: and those of the body we think to be less honorable, on these we bestow more abundant honor. And our unseemly parts have more abundant decorum,
12.bbe: And to those parts of the body which seem to have less honour we give all the more honour; and to those parts of the body which are a cause of shame to us we give the greater respect;

12.msb: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God has composed the body and has given greater honor to the parts that lacked it,
12.kjv: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:
12.blb: but our seemly parts have no need. But God composed the body, having given more abundant honor to the parts lacking it,
12.bbe: But those parts of the body which are beautiful have no need of such care: and so the body has been joined together by God in such a way as to give more honour to those parts which had need of it;

12.msb: so that there should be no divisions in the body, but that its members should have mutual concern for one another.
12.kjv: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.
12.blb: so that there may be no division in the body, but the members may have the same concern for one another.
12.bbe: So that there might be no division in the body; but all the parts might have the same care for one another.

12.msb: If one part suffers, every part suffers with it; if one part is honored, every part rejoices with it.
12.kjv: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.
12.blb: And if one member suffers, all the members suffer with it; if one member is glorified, all the members rejoice with it.
12.bbe: And if there is pain in one part of the body, all the parts will be feeling it; or if one part is honoured, all the parts will be glad.

12.msb: Now you are the body of Christ, and each of you is a member of it.
12.kjv: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
12.blb: Now you are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
12.bbe: Now you are the body of Christ, and every one of you the separate parts of it.
12.heading: The Greater Gifts

12.msb: And in the church God has appointed first of all apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then workers of miracles, and those with gifts of healing, helping, administration, and various tongues.
12.kjv: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.
12.blb: And some indeed God placed in the church, first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracles, then gifts of healings, helping, administrating, various kinds of tongues.
12.bbe: And God has put some in the church, first, Apostles; second, prophets; third, teachers; then those with wonder-working powers, then those with the power of taking away disease, helpers, wise guides, users of strange tongues.

12.msb: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?
12.kjv: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?
12.blb: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?
12.bbe: Are all Apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? have all the power of working wonders?

12.msb: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?
12.kjv: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
12.blb: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?
12.bbe: Are all able to take away disease? have all the power of tongues? are all able to give their sense?

12.msb: But eagerly desire the better gifts. And now I will show you the most excellent way.
12.kjv: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
12.blb: But zealously desire the greater gifts. And now I show to you a more surpassing way.
12.bbe: But let your desires be turned to the more important things given by the Spirit. And now I am pointing out to you an even better way.

13.msb: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am only a ringing gong or a clanging cymbal.
13.kjv: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
13.blb: If I should speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I have become a sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.
13.bbe: If I make use of the tongues of men and of angels, and have not love, I am like sounding brass, or a loud-tongued bell.
13.heading: Love

13.msb: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have absolute faith so as to move mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
13.kjv: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
13.blb: And if I should have prophecy and should understand all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I should have all faith so as to remove mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
13.bbe: And if I have a prophet's power, and have knowledge of all secret things; and if I have all faith, by which mountains may be moved from their place, but have not love, I am nothing.

13.msb: If I give all I possess to the poor and surrender my body to be burned, but have not love, I gain nothing.
13.kjv: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
13.blb: And if I should give away all my possessions, and if I should deliver up my body that I may boast, but have not love, I am profited nothing.
13.bbe: And if I give all my goods to the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but have not love, it is of no profit to me.

13.msb: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.
13.kjv: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
13.blb: Love is patient, it is kind; love does not envy, love does not boast, it is not puffed up.
13.bbe: Love is never tired of waiting; love is kind; love has no envy; love has no high opinion of itself, love has no pride;

13.msb: It is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no account of wrongs.
13.kjv: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
13.blb: It does not act unbecomingly, it does not seek its own things, it is not provoked, it keeps no reckoning of evil.
13.bbe: Love's ways are ever fair, it takes no thought for itself; it is not quickly made angry, it takes no account of evil;

13.msb: Love takes no pleasure in evil, but rejoices in the truth.
13.kjv: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
13.blb: It does not rejoice at unrighteousness, but it rejoices with the truth.
13.bbe: It takes no pleasure in wrongdoing, but has joy in what is true;

13.msb: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
13.kjv: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
13.blb: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
13.bbe: Love has the power of undergoing all things, having faith in all things, hoping all things.

13.msb: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be restrained; where there is knowledge, it will be dismissed.
13.kjv: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
13.blb: Love never fails; but if there are prophecies, they will be made null; and if there are tongues, they will cease; and if there is knowledge, it will be made null.
13.bbe: Though the prophet's word may come to an end, tongues come to nothing, and knowledge have no more value, love has no end.

13.msb: Now we know in part and we prophesy in part,
13.kjv: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
13.blb: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;
13.bbe: For our knowledge is only in part, and the prophet's word gives only a part of what is true:

13.msb: but when the perfect comes, the partial passes away.
13.kjv: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.
13.blb: but when the perfect should come, the partial will be made null.
13.bbe: But when that which is complete is come, then that which is in part will be no longer necessary.

13.msb: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I set aside childish ways.
13.kjv: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
13.blb: When I was a child, I was speaking like a child, I was thinking like a child, I was reasoning like a child; when I became a man, I have made null the things of the child.
13.bbe: When I was a child, I made use of a child's language, I had a child's feelings and a child's thoughts: now that I am a man, I have put away the things of a child.

13.msb: Now we see but a dim reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.
13.kjv: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
13.blb: For now we see through a glass in obscurity, but then, face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I have been fully known.
