13.bbe: For now we see things in a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now my knowledge is in part; then it will be complete, even as God's knowledge of me.

13.msb: And now these three remain: faith, hope, and love; but the greatest of these is love.
13.kjv: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
13.blb: But now these three things remain: faith, hope, love; but the greatest of these is love.
13.bbe: But now we still have faith, hope, love, these three; and the greatest of these is love.

14.msb: Earnestly pursue love and eagerly desire spiritual gifts, especially the gift of prophecy.
14.kjv: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.
14.blb: Pursue love, and zealously desire spiritual gifts, and especially that you may prophesy.
14.bbe: Go after love; still desiring to have the things which the Spirit gives, but most of all that you may have the prophet's power.
14.heading: Prophecy and Tongues

14.msb: For he who speaks in a tongue does not speak to men, but to God. Indeed, no one understands him; he utters mysteries in the Spirit.
14.kjv: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.
14.blb: For the one speaking in a tongue speaks not to men, but to God. For no one hears, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.
14.bbe: For he who makes use of tongues is not talking to men but to God; because no one has the sense of what he is saying; but in the Spirit he is talking of secret things.

14.msb: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, encouragement, and comfort.
14.kjv: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.
14.blb: But the one prophesying speaks to men for edification and encouragement and comfort.
14.bbe: But the word of the prophet gives men knowledge and comfort and strength.

14.msb: The one who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but the one who prophesies edifies the church.
14.kjv: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
14.blb: The one speaking in a tongue edifies himself, but the one prophesying edifies the church.
14.bbe: He who makes use of tongues may do good to himself; but he who gives the prophet's word does good to the church.

14.msb: I wish that all of you could speak in tongues, but I would rather have you prophesy. For he who prophesies is greater than one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets so that the church may be edified.
14.kjv: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
14.blb: Now I wish for all of you to speak in tongues, but rather that you may prophesy. And the one prophesying is greater than the one speaking in tongues, except if he may interpret, so that the church might receive edification.
14.bbe: Now though it is my desire for you all to have the power of tongues, it would give me more pleasure to be hearing the prophet's word from you; for this is a greater thing than using tongues, if the sense is not given at the same time, for the good of the church.

14.msb: Now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you, unless I bring you some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
14.kjv: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
14.blb: But now, brothers, if I should come to you speaking in tongues, what will I profit you, unless I should speak to you either in revelation, or in knowledge, or in prophecy, or in teaching?
14.bbe: But, now, my brothers, if I come to you using tongues, what profit will it be to you, if I do not give you a revelation, or knowledge, or the word of the prophet, or teaching?

14.msb: Even in the case of lifeless instruments, such as the flute or harp, how will anyone recognize the tune they are playing unless the notes are distinct?
14.kjv: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
14.blb: Even lifeless things giving a sound—whether the flute or harp—unless they give distinction to the sounds, how will it be known what is being piped or being harped?
14.bbe: Even things without life, having a voice, such as a music-pipe or other instrument, if they do not give out different sounds, who may be certain what is being played?

14.msb: Again, if the trumpet sounds a muffled call, who will prepare for battle?
14.kjv: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
14.blb: For also if the trumpet gives an indistinct sound, who will prepare himself for battle?
14.bbe: For if the war-horn gives out an uncertain note, who will get ready for the fight?

14.msb: So it is with you. Unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.
14.kjv: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
14.blb: So also you, unless you give intelligible speech through the tongue, how will it be known what is being spoken? For you will be speaking into the air.
14.bbe: So if you, in using a strange tongue, say words which have no sense, how will anyone take in what you are saying? for you will be talking to the air.

14.msb: Assuredly, there are many different languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.
14.kjv: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
14.blb: There are, if it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none without meaning.
14.bbe: There are, it may be, a number of different voices in the world, and no voice is without sense.

14.msb: If, then, I do not know the meaning of someone’s language, I am a foreigner to the speaker, and he is a foreigner to me.
14.kjv: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.
14.blb: Therefore unless I know the power of the voice, I will be a barbarian to the one speaking, and the one speaking, a barbarian to me.
14.bbe: But if the sense of the voice is not clear to me, I am like a man from a strange country to him who is talking, and he will be the same to me.

14.msb: It is the same with you. Since you are eager to have spiritual gifts, strive to excel in gifts that build up the church.
14.kjv: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.
14.blb: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek for the edification of the church, so that you may abound.
14.bbe: So if you are desiring the things which the Spirit gives, let your minds be turned first to the things which are for the good of the church.

14.msb: Therefore, the one who speaks in a tongue should pray that he may interpret.
14.kjv: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
14.blb: Therefore, the one speaking in a tongue, let him pray that he may interpret.
14.bbe: For this reason, let the man who has the power of using tongues make request that he may, at the same time, be able to give the sense.

14.msb: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.
14.kjv: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
14.blb: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.
14.bbe: For if I make use of tongues in my prayers, my spirit makes the prayer, but not my mind.

14.msb: What then shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my mind. I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my mind.
14.kjv: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
14.blb: What then is it? I will pray with the spirit, but I will also pray with the mind. I will sing praise with the spirit, but I will also sing praise with the mind.
14.bbe: What then? let my prayer be from the spirit, and equally from the mind; let my song be from the spirit, and equally from mind.

14.msb: Otherwise, if you speak a blessing in spirit, how can someone who is uninstructed say “Amen” to your thanksgiving, since he does not know what you are saying?
14.kjv: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?
14.blb: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will the one filling up the place of the uninstructed say the “Amen” to your thanksgiving, since he does not know what you say?
14.bbe: For if you give a blessing with the spirit, how will the man who has no knowledge say, So be it, after your prayer, seeing that he has not taken in what you are saying?

14.msb: You may be giving thanks well enough, but the other one is not edified.
14.kjv: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
14.blb: For indeed, you give thanks well, but the other is not edified.
14.bbe: For your giving of the blessing is certainly well done, but of no profit to the man without knowledge.

14.msb: I thank my God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.
14.kjv: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:
14.blb: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.
14.bbe: I give praise to God that I am able to make use of tongues more than you all:

14.msb: But in the church, I would rather speak five coherent words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.
14.kjv: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
14.blb: But in the church, I wish to speak five words with my mind, so that also I might instruct others, rather than myriads of words in a tongue.
14.bbe: But in the church it would be better for me to make use of five words of which the sense was clear, so that others might have profit, than ten thousand words in a strange tongue.

14.msb: Brothers, stop thinking like children. In regard to evil be infants, but in your thinking be mature.
14.kjv: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.
14.blb: Brothers, do not be children in the minds. But in evil be little children; and in thinking be mature.
14.bbe: My brothers, do not be children in mind: in evil be as little children, but in mind be of full growth.

14.msb: It is written in the Law: “By strange tongues and foreign lips I will speak to this people, but even then they will not listen to Me, says the Lord.”
14.kjv: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.
14.blb: In the law it has been written: “With other tongues and with different lips I will speak to this people, and not even thus will they hear Me, says the Lord.”
14.bbe: In the law it is said, By men of other tongues and by strange lips will my words come to this people; and not even so will they give ear to me, says the Lord.

14.msb: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers, but for unbelievers. Prophecy, however, is for believers, not for unbelievers.
14.kjv: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
14.blb: So then, tongues are for a sign, not to the believing, but to the unbelieving; but prophecy is not to the unbelieving, but to the believing.
14.bbe: For this reason tongues are for a sign, not to those who have faith, but to those who have not: but the prophet's word is for those who have faith, and not for the rest who have not.

14.msb: So if the whole church comes together and everyone speaks in tongues, and some who are uninstructed or some unbelievers come in, will they not say that you are out of your minds?
14.kjv: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?
14.blb: Therefore, if the whole church might gather together in the same place and all may speak in tongues, and uninstructed ones or unbelievers should come in, will not they say that you are out of your minds?
14.bbe: If, then, the church has come together, and all are using tongues, and there come in men without knowledge or faith, will they not say that you are unbalanced?

14.msb: But if an unbeliever or uninstructed person comes in while everyone is prophesying, he will be convicted and called to account by all,
14.kjv: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
14.blb: But if all prophesy and some unbeliever or uninstructed one should come in, he is convicted by all, he is examined by all,
14.bbe: But if all are teaching as prophets, and a man without faith or knowledge comes in, he is tested by all, he is judged by all;

14.msb: and so the secrets of his heart will be made known. So he will fall facedown and worship God, proclaiming, “God is truly among you!”
14.kjv: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.
14.blb: and the secrets of his heart become manifest. And thus having fallen upon his face, he will worship God, declaring that “God is really among you!”
14.bbe: The secrets of his heart are made clear; and he will go down on his face and give worship to God, saying that God is truly among you.

14.msb: What then shall we say, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm or a teaching, a tongue, a revelation, or an interpretation. All of these must be done to build up the church.
14.kjv: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
14.blb: What then is it, brothers? When you may come together, each has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has a tongue, has an interpretation. Let all things be done for edification.
14.bbe: What is it then, my brothers? when you come together everyone has a holy song, or a revelation, or a tongue, or is giving the sense of it. Let everything be done for the common good.
14.heading: Orderly Worship

14.msb: If anyone speaks in a tongue, two, or at most three, should speak in turn, and someone must interpret.
14.kjv: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.
14.blb: If anyone speaks in a tongue, be by two, or at the most three, and each in turn; and let one interpret.
14.bbe: If any man makes use of a tongue, let it not be more than two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let someone give the sense:

14.msb: But if there is no interpreter, he should remain silent in the church and speak only to himself and God.
14.kjv: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
14.blb: But if there may be no interpreter, let him be silent in the church, and let him speak to himself and to God.
14.bbe: But if there is no one to give the sense, let him keep quiet in the church; and let his words be to himself and to God.

14.msb: Two or three prophets should speak, and the others should weigh carefully what is said.
14.kjv: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
14.blb: And let two or three prophets speak, and let the others discern.
14.bbe: And let the prophets give their words, but not more than two or three, and let the others be judges of what they say.

14.msb: And if a revelation comes to someone who is seated, the first speaker should stop.
14.kjv: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.
14.blb: But if anything should be revealed to another sitting, let the first be silent.
14.bbe: But if a revelation is given to another who is seated near, let the first be quiet.

14.msb: For you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged.
14.kjv: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
14.blb: For you are all able to prophesy one by one, so that all may learn and all may be exhorted.
14.bbe: For you may all be prophets in turn so that all may get knowledge and comfort;

14.msb: The spirits of prophets are subject to prophets.
14.kjv: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.
14.blb: And the spirits of prophets are subject to prophets.
14.bbe: And the spirits of the prophets are controlled by the prophets;

14.msb: For God is not a God of disorder, but of peace—as in all the churches of the saints.
14.kjv: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
14.blb: For He is not the God of disorder, but of peace, as in all the churches of the saints.
14.bbe: For God is not a God whose ways are without order, but a God of peace; as in all the churches of the saints.

14.msb: Your women are to be silent in the churches. They are not permitted to speak, but must be in submission, as the law says.
14.kjv: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.
14.blb: Let the women be silent in the churches. For it is not permitted to them to speak, but to be subject, as the law also says.
14.bbe: Let women keep quiet in the churches: for it is not right for them to be talking; but let them be under control, as it says in the law.

14.msb: If they wish to inquire about something, they are to ask their own husbands at home; for it is dishonorable for a woman to speak in the church.
14.kjv: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
14.blb: But if they wish to learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home; for it is shameful for a woman to speak in the church.
14.bbe: And if they have a desire for knowledge about anything, let them put questions to their husbands privately: for talking in the church puts shame on a woman.

14.msb: Did the word of God originate with you? Or are you the only ones it has reached?
14.kjv: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?
14.blb: Or did the word of God go out from you? Or did it come to you only?
14.bbe: What? was it from you that the word of God went out? or did it only come in to you?

14.msb: If anyone considers himself a prophet or spiritual person, let him acknowledge that what I am writing you is the Lord’s command.
14.kjv: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
14.blb: If anyone thinks to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize that the things I write to you are commands of the Lord.
14.bbe: If any man seems to himself to be a prophet or to have the Spirit, let him take note of the things which I am writing to you, as being the word of the Lord.

14.msb: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.
14.kjv: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
14.blb: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignored.
14.bbe: But if any man is without knowledge, let him be so.

14.msb: So, brothers, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.
14.kjv: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
14.blb: So, my brothers, zealously desire to prophesy, and do not forbid to speak in tongues.
14.bbe: So then, my brothers, let it be your chief desire to be prophets; but let no one be stopped from using tongues.

14.msb: But everything must be done in a proper and orderly manner.
14.kjv: Let all things be done decently and in order.
14.blb: But let all things be done properly and according to order.
14.bbe: Let all things be done in the right and ordered way.

15.msb: Now, brothers, I want to remind you of the gospel I preached to you, which you received, and in which you stand firm.
15.kjv: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;
15.blb: Now I make known to you, brothers, the gospel that I proclaimed to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,
15.bbe: Now I am going to make clear to you, my brothers, what the good news was which I gave to you, and which you took, and on which your faith is based,
15.heading: The Resurrection of Christ

15.msb: By this gospel you are saved, if you hold firmly to the word I preached to you. Otherwise, you have believed in vain.
15.kjv: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.
15.blb: by which you are also being saved in what word I proclaimed to you, if you hold fast—unless you believed in vain.
15.bbe: By which you have salvation; that is to say, the form in which it was given to you, if it is fixed in your minds, and if your faith in it is not without effect.

15.msb: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
15.kjv: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
15.blb: For I delivered to you as of first importance what I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
15.bbe: For I gave to you first of all what was handed down to me, how Christ underwent death for our sins, as it says in the Writings;

15.msb: that He was buried, that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
15.kjv: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
15.blb: and that He was buried, and that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
15.bbe: And he was put in the place of the dead; and on the third day he came back from the dead, as it says in the Writings;

15.msb: and that He appeared to Cephas and then to the Twelve.
15.kjv: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
15.blb: and that He appeared to Cephas, then to the Twelve.
15.bbe: And he was seen by Cephas; then by the twelve;

15.msb: After that, He appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once, most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.
15.kjv: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
15.blb: Afterward, He appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, the greater part of whom remain until now, but some have fallen asleep.
15.bbe: Then by more than five hundred brothers at the same time, most of whom are still living, but some are sleeping;

15.msb: Then He appeared to James, then to all the apostles.
15.kjv: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
15.blb: Afterward, He appeared to James, then to all the apostles.
15.bbe: Then he was seen by James; then by all the Apostles.

15.msb: And last of all He appeared to me also, as to one of untimely birth.
15.kjv: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
15.blb: And last of all, as to one of untimely birth, He appeared also to me.
15.bbe: And last of all, as by one whose birth was out of the right time, he was seen by me.

15.msb: For I am the least of the apostles and am unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
15.kjv: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
15.blb: For I am the least of the apostles, who am not sufficient to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
15.bbe: For I am the least of the Apostles, having no right to be named an Apostle, because of my cruel attacks on the church of God.

15.msb: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace to me was not in vain. No, I worked harder than all of them—yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.
15.kjv: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
15.blb: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace toward me was not empty. But I toiled more abundantly than all of them, yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.
15.bbe: But by the grace of God, I am what I am: and his grace which was given to me has not been for nothing; for I did more work than all of them; though not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

15.msb: Whether, then, it was I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed.
15.kjv: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
15.blb: Whether, then, I or they, thus we preach, and thus you believed.
15.bbe: If then it is I who am the preacher, or they, this is our word, and to this you have given your faith.

15.msb: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
15.kjv: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
15.blb: Now if Christ is preached, that He has been raised out from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
15.bbe: Now if the good news says that Christ came back from the dead, how do some of you say that there is no coming back from the dead?
15.heading: The Resurrection of the Dead

15.msb: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.
15.kjv: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
15.blb: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.
15.bbe: But if there is no coming back from the dead, then Christ has not come back from the dead:

15.msb: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is worthless, and so is your faith.
15.kjv: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
15.blb: And if Christ has not been raised, then also our preaching is void, and your faith is void.
15.bbe: And if Christ did not come again from the dead, then our good news and your faith in it are of no effect.

15.msb: In that case, we are also exposed as false witnesses about God. For we have testified about God that He raised Christ from the dead, but He did not raise Him if in fact the dead are not raised.
15.kjv: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
15.blb: Then also we are found false witnesses of God, because we have witnessed concerning God that He raised Christ, whom He has not raised if then the dead are not raised.
15.bbe: Yes, and we are seen to be false witnesses of God; because we gave witness of God that by his power Christ came again from the dead: which is not true if there is no coming back from the dead.

15.msb: For if the dead are not raised, then not even Christ has been raised.
15.kjv: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
15.blb: For if the dead are not raised, neither has Christ been raised.
15.bbe: For if it is not possible for the dead to come to life again, then Christ has not come to life again:

15.msb: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.
15.kjv: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
15.blb: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.
15.bbe: And if that is so, your faith is of no effect; you are still in your sins.

15.msb: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
15.kjv: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
15.blb: Then also those having fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
15.bbe: And, in addition, the dead in Christ have gone to destruction.

15.msb: If our hope in Christ is for this life alone, we are to be pitied more than all men.
15.kjv: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
15.blb: If only in this life we are having hope in Christ, we are more to be pitied than all men.
15.bbe: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most unhappy.

15.msb: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead and has become the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.
15.kjv: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
15.blb: But now Christ has been raised out from the dead, the firstfruit of those having fallen asleep.
15.bbe: But now Christ has truly come back from the dead, the first-fruits of those who are sleeping.
15.heading: The Order of Resurrection

15.msb: For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man.
15.kjv: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
15.blb: For since death is through a man, also through a man is the resurrection of the dead.
15.bbe: For as by man came death, so by man there is a coming back from the dead.

15.msb: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.
15.kjv: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
15.blb: For just as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive—
15.bbe: For as in Adam death comes to all, so in Christ will all come back to life.

15.msb: But each in his own turn: Christ the firstfruits; then at His coming, those who belong to Him.
15.kjv: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ’s at his coming.
15.blb: but each in his own order: Christ the firstfruit, then those of Christ at His coming,
15.bbe: But every man in his right order: Christ the first-fruits; then those who are Christ's at his coming.

15.msb: Then the end will come, when He hands over the kingdom to God the Father after He has destroyed all dominion, authority, and power.
15.kjv: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
15.blb: then the end, when He shall deliver the kingdom to God, even the Father, when He shall have made null all rule and all authority and power.
15.bbe: Then comes the end, when he will give up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he will have put an end to all rule and to all authority and power.

15.msb: For He must reign until He has put all His enemies under His feet.
15.kjv: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
15.blb: For it is necessary for Him to reign until He shall have put all the enemies under His feet.
15.bbe: For his rule will go on till he has put all those who are against him under his feet.

15.msb: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.
15.kjv: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
15.blb: The last enemy to be made null is death.
15.bbe: The last power to come to an end is death.

15.msb: For “God has put everything under His feet.” Now when it says that everything has been put under Him, this clearly does not include the One who put everything under Him.
15.kjv: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
15.blb: For “He has subjected all things under His feet.” But when it may be said that all things have been subjected, it is evident that the One having subjected all things to Him is excepted.
15.bbe: For, as it says, He has put all things under his feet. But when he says, All things are put under him, it is clear that it is not said about him who put all things under him.

15.msb: And when all things have been subjected to Him, then the Son Himself will also be made subject to Him who put all things under Him, so that God may be all in all.
15.kjv: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
15.blb: Now when all things shall be subjected to Him, then also the Son Himself will be subjected to the One having subjected all things to Him, so that God may be all in all.
15.bbe: And when all things have been put under him, then will the Son himself be under him who put all things under him, so that God may be all in all.

15.msb: If these things are not so, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for the dead?
15.kjv: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
15.blb: Otherwise, what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are they also baptized for them?
15.bbe: Again, what will they do who are given baptism for the dead? if the dead do not come back at all, why are people given baptism for them?

15.msb: And why do we endanger ourselves every hour?
15.kjv: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
15.blb: And why are we in danger every hour?
15.bbe: And why are we in danger every hour?

15.msb: I face death every day, as surely as I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord.
15.kjv: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
15.blb: I die every day, as surely as the boasting in you, brothers, which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord.
15.bbe: Yes, truly, by your pride in me, my brothers in Christ Jesus our Lord, my life is one long death.

15.msb: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus for human motives, what did I gain? If the dead are not raised, “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
15.kjv: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
15.blb: If according to man I fought wild beasts in Ephesus, what is the gain to me? If the dead are not raised, “Let us eat and let us drink, for tomorrow we die.”
15.bbe: If, after the way of men, I was fighting with beasts at Ephesus, what profit is it to me? If the dead do not come to life again, let us take our pleasure in feasting, for tomorrow we come to an end.

15.msb: Do not be deceived: “Bad company corrupts good character.”
15.kjv: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
15.blb: Do not be led astray: “Bad companionships corrupt good morals.”
15.bbe: Do not be tricked by false words: evil company does damage to good behaviour.

15.msb: Sober up as you ought, and stop sinning; for some of you are ignorant of God. I say this to your shame.
15.kjv: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
15.blb: Sober up righteously and do not sin, for some have ignorance of God. I speak to you for shame.
15.bbe: Be awake to righteousness and keep yourselves from sin; for some have no knowledge of God: I say this to put you to shame.

15.msb: But someone will ask, “How are the dead raised? With what kind of body will they come?”
15.kjv: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
15.blb: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised? And with what kind of body do they come?”
15.bbe: But someone will say, How do the dead come back? and with what sort of body do they come?
15.heading: The Resurrection Body

15.msb: You fool! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
15.kjv: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
15.blb: You Fool! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
15.bbe: Foolish man, it is necessary for the seed which you put into the earth to undergo death in order that it may come to life again:

15.msb: And what you sow is not the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or something else.
15.kjv: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
15.blb: And what you sow is not the body that will be, but you sow a bare grain, if it may be of wheat or of some of the rest.
15.bbe: And when you put it into the earth, you do not put in the body which it will be, but only the seed, of grain or some other sort of plant;

15.msb: But God gives it a body as He has designed, and to each kind of seed He gives its own body.
15.kjv: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
15.blb: But God gives it a body as He willed, and to each of the seeds, its own body.
15.bbe: But God gives it a body, as it is pleasing to him, and to every seed its special body.

15.msb: Not all flesh is the same: Men have one kind of flesh, animals have another, fish another, and birds another.
15.kjv: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
15.blb: Not all flesh is the same, but indeed one flesh is of men, and another flesh is of beasts, and another flesh is of birds, and another is of fish.
15.bbe: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one flesh of men, another of beasts, another of birds, and another of fishes.

15.msb: There are also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies. But the splendor of the heavenly bodies is of one degree, and the splendor of the earthly bodies is of another.
15.kjv: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
15.blb: And there are heavenly bodies and earthly bodies. But indeed, the glory of the heavenly is one kind, and that of the earthly is another.
15.bbe: And there are bodies of heaven and bodies of earth, but the glory of the one is different from that of the other.

15.msb: The sun has one degree of splendor, the moon another, and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.
15.kjv: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
15.blb: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for star differs from star in glory.
15.bbe: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for the glory of one star is different from that of another.

15.msb: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead: What is sown is perishable; it is raised imperishable.
15.kjv: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
15.blb: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption, it is raised in incorruptibility;
15.bbe: So is it with the coming back from the dead. It is planted in death; it comes again in life:

15.msb: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
15.kjv: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
15.blb: it is sown in dishonor, it is raised in glory; it is sown in weakness, it is raised in power;
15.bbe: It is planted in shame; it comes again in glory: feeble when it is planted, it comes again in power:

15.msb: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body; there is also a spiritual body.
15.kjv: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
15.blb: it is sown a natural body, it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual.
15.bbe: It is planted a natural body; it comes again as a body of the spirit. If there is a natural body, there is equally a body of the spirit.

15.msb: So it is written: “The first man Adam became a living being;” the last Adam a life-giving spirit.
15.kjv: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
15.blb: So also it has been written: “The first man Adam became into a living soul;” the last Adam into a life-giving spirit.
15.bbe: And so it is said, The first man Adam was a living soul. The last Adam is a life-giving spirit.

15.msb: The spiritual, however, was not first, but the natural, and then the spiritual.
15.kjv: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
15.blb: But the spiritual was not first, but the natural, then the spiritual.
15.bbe: But that which is natural comes before that which is of the spirit.

15.msb: The first man was of the dust of the earth; the second man is the Lord from heaven.
15.kjv: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.
15.blb: The first man was out of the earth, made of dust; the second man out of heaven.
15.bbe: The first man is from the earth, and of the earth: the second man is from heaven.

15.msb: As was the earthly man, so also are those who are of the earth; and as is the heavenly man, so also are those who are of heaven.
15.kjv: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
15.blb: As was the one made of dust, such are also those made of dust; and as is the heavenly one, such are also the heavenly.
15.bbe: Those who are of the earth are like the man who was from the earth: and those who are of heaven are like the one from heaven.

15.msb: And just as we have borne the likeness of the earthly man, so also let us bear the likeness of the heavenly man.
15.kjv: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
15.blb: And as we bore the image of the one made of dust, we will also bear the image of the heavenly one.
15.bbe: And in the same way as we have taken on us the image of the man from the earth, so we will take on us the image of the one from heaven.

15.msb: Now I declare to you, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God, nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.
15.kjv: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
15.blb: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood is not able to inherit the kingdom of God, nor does corruption inherit incorruptibility.
15.bbe: Now I say this, my brothers, that it is not possible for flesh and blood to have a part in the kingdom of God; and death may not have a part in life.
15.heading: Where, O Death, Is Your Victory?

15.msb: Listen, I tell you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—
15.kjv: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
15.blb: Behold, I speak to you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—
15.bbe: See, I am giving you the revelation of a secret: we will not all come to the sleep of death, but we will all be changed.

15.msb: in an instant, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.
15.kjv: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
15.blb: in an instant, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.
15.bbe: In a second, in the shutting of an eye, at the sound of the last horn: for at that sound the dead will come again, free for ever from the power of death, and we will be changed.

15.msb: For the perishable must be clothed with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality.
15.kjv: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
15.blb: For it is necessary for this, the corruptible to put on incorruptibility, and this, the mortal to put on immortality.
15.bbe: For this body which comes to destruction will be made free from the power of death, and the man who is under the power of death will put on eternal life.

15.msb: When the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable and the mortal with immortality, then the saying that is written will come to pass: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.”
15.kjv: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
15.blb: Now when this corruptible shall have put on incorruptibility, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then the word having been written will come to pass: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.”
15.bbe: But when this has taken place, then that which was said in the Writings will come true, Death is overcome by life.

15.msb: “Where, O Death, is your sting? Where, O Hades, is your victory?”
15.kjv: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
15.blb: “Where, O death, is your victory? Where, O death, is your sting?”
15.bbe: O death, where is your power? O death, where are your pains?

15.msb: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
15.kjv: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
15.blb: Now the sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
15.bbe: The pain of death is sin; and the power of sin is the law:

15.msb: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!
15.kjv: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
15.blb: But thanks be to God, the One giving us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
15.bbe: But praise be to God who gives us strength to overcome through our Lord Jesus Christ.

15.msb: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
15.kjv: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
15.blb: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, knowing that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
15.bbe: For this cause, my dear brothers, be strong in purpose and unmoved, ever giving yourselves to the work of the Lord, because you are certain that your work is not without effect in the Lord.

16.msb: Now about the collection for the saints, you are to do as I directed the churches of Galatia:
16.kjv: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.
16.blb: Now concerning the collection that is for the saints, as I directed the churches of Galatia, so also you are to do.
16.bbe: Now about the giving of money for the saints, as I gave orders to the churches of Galatia, so do you.
16.heading: The Collection for the Saints

16.msb: On the first day of every week, each of you should set aside a portion of his income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will be needed.
16.kjv: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
16.blb: Every first of the week, let each one of you put aside, treasuring up whatever he may be prospered in, so that when I might come, then there should be no collections.
16.bbe: On the first day of the week, let every one of you put by him in store, in measure as he has done well in business, so that it may not be necessary to get money together when I come.

16.msb: Then, on my arrival, I will send letters with those you recommend to carry your gift to Jerusalem.
16.kjv: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
16.blb: And when I shall have arrived, whomever you might approve, I will send these with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
16.bbe: And when I come, I will send the men of your selection with letters to take the money you have got together to Jerusalem.

16.msb: And if it is advisable for me to go also, they can travel with me.
16.kjv: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
16.blb: And if it may be worthy for me also to go, they will go with me.
16.bbe: And if it is possible for me to go there, they will go with me.

16.msb: After I go through Macedonia, however, I will come to you; for I will be going through Macedonia.
16.kjv: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
16.blb: But I will come to you when I shall have gone through Macedonia, for I am going through Macedonia.
16.bbe: But I will come to you after I have gone through Macedonia, for that is my purpose;
16.heading: Paul’s Travel Plans

16.msb: Perhaps I will stay with you awhile, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go.
16.kjv: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
16.blb: And perhaps I will stay with you, or even I will winter, so that you may send me forth wherever I may go.
16.bbe: But I may be with you for a time, or even for the winter, so that you may see me on my way, wherever I go.

16.msb: For I do not want to see you now only in passing; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.
16.kjv: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
16.blb: For I do not want to see you now in passing; for I hope to remain a certain time with you, if the Lord might permit.
16.bbe: For it is not my desire to see you now, on my way; because it is my hope to be with you for some time, if that is the Lord's pleasure.

16.msb: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
16.kjv: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
16.blb: But I will remain in Ephesus until Pentecost.
16.bbe: But I will be at Ephesus till Pentecost;

16.msb: because a great door for effective work has opened to me, even though many oppose me.
16.kjv: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
16.blb: For a door has opened to me, great and effective, and many are opposing.
16.bbe: For a great and important door there is open to me, and there are a number of people against me.

16.msb: If Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is doing the work of the Lord, just as I am.
16.kjv: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.
16.blb: Now if Timothy might come, see that he may be with you without fear, for he works the work of the Lord, as I also.
16.bbe: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear; because he is doing the Lord's work, even as I am:
16.heading: Timothy and Apollos

16.msb: No one, then, should treat him with contempt. Send him on his way in peace so that he can return to me, for I am expecting him along with the brothers.
16.kjv: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
16.blb: Therefore no one should despise him. But send him forth in peace, so that he might come to me; for I am expecting him with the brothers.
16.bbe: See then that he has the honour which is right. But send him on his way in peace, so that he may come to me: for I am looking for him with the brothers.

16.msb: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. He was not at all inclined to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.
16.kjv: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
16.blb: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I exhorted him much that he should go to you with the brothers, and his will was not at all that he should come now; but he will come when he shall have opportunity.
16.bbe: But as for Apollos, the brother, I had a great desire for him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not his pleasure to come now; but he will come when he has a chance.

16.msb: Be on the alert. Stand firm in the faith. Be men of courage. Be strong.
16.kjv: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
16.blb: Be watchful; stand firm in the faith; act like men; be strong.
16.bbe: Be on the watch, unmoved in the faith, and be strong like men.
16.heading: Concluding Exhortations

16.msb: Do everything in love.
16.kjv: Let all your things be done with charity.
16.blb: Let all your things be done in love.
16.bbe: Let all you do be done in love.

16.msb: You know that Stephanas and his household were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints. Now I urge you, brothers,
16.kjv: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
16.blb: Now I exhort you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruit of Achaia, and they devoted themselves to service to the saints—
16.bbe: Now I make my request to you, my brothers, for you have knowledge that the house of Stephanas is the first-fruits of Achaia, and that they have made themselves the servants of the saints,

16.msb: to submit to such as these, and to every fellow worker and laborer.
16.kjv: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.
16.blb: that you also be subject to such, and to everyone working with us and laboring.
16.bbe: That you put yourselves under such, and under everyone who is helping the Lord's work.

16.msb: I am glad that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have arrived, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.
16.kjv: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
16.blb: Now I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus, because these filled up your deficiency.
16.bbe: And I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for they have done what was needed to make your work complete.

16.msb: For they refreshed my spirit and yours as well. Show your appreciation, therefore, to such men.
16.kjv: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
16.blb: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore recognize such men.
16.bbe: For they gave comfort to my spirit and to yours: for which cause give respect to such people.

16.msb: The churches in the province of Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.
16.kjv: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
16.blb: The churches of Asia greet you. Aquila and Prisca, with the church at their house, greet you much in the Lord.
16.bbe: The churches of Asia send their love to you. So do Aquila and Prisca, with the church which is in their house.
16.heading: Signature and Final Greetings

16.msb: All the brothers here send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
16.kjv: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.
16.blb: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
16.bbe: All the brothers send their love to you. Give one another a holy kiss.

16.msb: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul.
16.kjv: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
16.blb: The greeting is in my own hand—Paul.
16.bbe: I, Paul, send you these words of love in my writing.

16.msb: If anyone does not love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be under a curse. Come, O Lord!
16.kjv: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
16.blb: If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be accursed. Maranatha!
16.bbe: If any man has not love for the Lord, let him be cursed. Maran atha (our Lord comes).

16.msb: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
16.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
16.blb: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.
16.bbe: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

16.msb: My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
16.kjv: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
16.blb: My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
16.bbe: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. So be it.

1.msb: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God in Corinth, together with all the saints throughout Achaia:
1.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
1.blb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy the brother, To the church of God being in Corinth, with all the saints being in all Achaia:
1.bbe: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ by the purpose of God, and Timothy the brother, to the church of God which is in Corinth, with all the saints who are in all Achaia:
1.heading: Paul Greets the Corinthians

1.msb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.blb: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.bbe: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.msb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,
1.kjv: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
1.blb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassions and God of all comfort,
1.bbe: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and the God of all comfort;
1.heading: The God of All Comfort

1.msb: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves have received from God.
1.kjv: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
1.blb: the One comforting us in all our tribulation, for us to be able to comfort those in every tribulation through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God,
1.bbe: Who gives us comfort in all our troubles, so that we may be able to give comfort to others who are in trouble, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

1.msb: For just as the sufferings of Christ overflow to us, so also through Christ our comfort overflows.
1.kjv: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
1.blb: because just as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, so through Christ our comfort also abounds.
1.bbe: For as we undergo more of the pain which Christ underwent, so through Christ does our comfort become greater.

1.msb: If we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation, which accomplishes in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we experience. And our hope for you is sure; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort and salvation,
1.kjv: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
1.blb: But if we are hard pressed, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, operating in the endurance of the same sufferings that we also suffer.
1.bbe: But if we are troubled, it is for your comfort and salvation; or if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which takes effect through your quiet undergoing of the same troubles which we undergo:

1.msb: because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you will share in our comfort.
1.kjv: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
1.blb: And our hope for you is sure, knowing that as you are fellow partakers of the sufferings, so also of the comfort.
1.bbe: And our hope for you is certain; in the knowledge that as you take part in the troubles, so you will take part in the comfort.

1.msb: We do not want you to be unaware, brothers, of the hardships we encountered in the province of Asia. We were under a burden far beyond our ability to endure, so that we despaired even of life.
1.kjv: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
1.blb: For we do not want you to be ignorant brothers, as to our tribulation having happened in Asia, that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so as for us to despair even to live.
1.bbe: For it is our desire that you may not be without knowledge of our trouble which came on us in Asia, that the weight of it was very great, more than our power, so that it seemed that we had no hope even of life:

1.msb: Indeed, we felt we were under the sentence of death, in order that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God, who raises the dead.
1.kjv: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:
1.blb: But we have had in ourselves the sentence of death, so that we should not be trusting in ourselves, but in God, the One raising the dead,
1.bbe: Yes, we ourselves have had the answer of death in ourselves, so that our hope might not be in ourselves, but in God who is able to give life to the dead:

1.msb: He has delivered us from such a deadly peril, and He continues to deliver us. In Him we have placed our hope that He will yet again deliver us,
1.kjv: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;
1.blb: who delivered us from so great a death and will deliver us, in whom we have hoped that also He will deliver us still,
1.bbe: Who gave us salvation from so great a death: on whom we have put our hope that he will still go on to give us salvation;

1.msb: as you help us by your prayers. Then many will give thanks on your behalf for the favor shown us in answer to their prayers.
1.kjv: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
1.blb: in your also together helping us by supplication, so that thanks may be given for us by many faces for the gracious gift to us through many.
1.bbe: You at the same time helping together by your prayer for us; so that for what has been given to us through a number of persons, praise may go up to God for us from all of them.

1.msb: For this is our boast: Our conscience testifies that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially in relation to you, in the integrity and sincerity that are from God—not in worldly wisdom, but in the grace of God.
1.kjv: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
1.blb: For our boasting is this: The testimony of our conscience, that in the simplicity and sincerity of God, and not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we conducted ourselves in the world and more abundantly toward you.
1.bbe: For our glory is in this, in the knowledge which we have that our way of life in the world, and most of all in relation to you, has been holy and true in the eyes of God; not in the wisdom of the flesh, but in the grace of God.
1.heading: Paul’s Change of Plans

1.msb: For we do not write you anything that is beyond your ability to read and understand. And I hope that you will understand us completely,
1.kjv: For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;
1.blb: For we write no other things to you but what you read or also understand. And I hope that you will understand to the end,
1.bbe: For in our letters we say no other things to you, but those which you are reading, and to which you give agreement, and, it is my hope, will go on doing so to the end:

1.msb: as you have already understood us in part, that you may boast of us just as we will boast of you in the day of the Lord Jesus.
1.kjv: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.
1.blb: as also you understood us in part, so that we are your boast, even as you are also ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.
1.bbe: Even as you have been ready, in part, to say that we are your glory, in the same way that you are ours, in the day of the Lord Jesus.

1.msb: Confident of this, I planned to visit you first, so that you might receive a double blessing.
1.kjv: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;
1.blb: And with this confidence I was purposing to come to you before, so that you might have a second grace,
1.bbe: And being certain of this, it was my purpose to come to you before, so that you might have a second grace;

1.msb: I wanted to visit you on my way to Macedonia, and to return to you from Macedonia, and then to have you help me on my way to Judea.
1.kjv: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.
1.blb: and through you to pass through into Macedonia, and to come to you again from Macedonia, and to be sent forth by you to Judea.
1.bbe: And by way of Corinth to go into Macedonia, and from there to come back again to you, so that you might send me on my way to Judaea.

1.msb: When I planned this, did I do it carelessly? Or do I make my plans by human standards, so as to say “Yes, yes” and also “No, no”?
1.kjv: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?
1.blb: Therefore, purposing this, then, did I use lightness? Or do I purpose what I purpose according to flesh, so that with me it may be “Yes, yes” and “No, no”?
1.bbe: If then I had such a purpose, did I seem to be changing suddenly? or am I guided in my purposes by the flesh, saying, Yes, today, and, No, tomorrow?

1.msb: But as surely as God is faithful, our message to you was not “Yes” and “No.”
1.kjv: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.
1.blb: But faithful is God, that our word to you is not “Yes” and “No.”
1.bbe: As God is true, our word to you is not Yes and No.

1.msb: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was proclaimed among you by me and Silvanus and Timothy, was not “Yes” and “No,” but in Him it has always been “Yes.”
1.kjv: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.
1.blb: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, having been proclaimed among you by us—by me and Silvanus and Timothy—was not “Yes” and “No,” but it has been “Yes” in Him.
1.bbe: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, whom we were preaching among you, even I and Silvanus and Timothy, was not Yes and No, but in him is Yes.

1.msb: For all the promises of God are “Yes” in Christ. And so in Him, our “Amen” is spoken to the glory of God.
1.kjv: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
1.blb: For as many as are the promises of God, in Him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through Him the “Amen” through us is for glory to God.
1.bbe: For he is the Yes to all the undertakings of God: and by him all the words of God are made certain and put into effect, to the glory of God through us.

1.msb: Now it is God who establishes both us and you in Christ. He anointed us,
1.kjv: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;
1.blb: Now the One establishing us with you into Christ, and having anointed us, is God,
1.bbe: Now he who makes our faith strong together with you, in Christ, and has given us of his grace, is God;

1.msb: placed His seal on us, and put His Spirit in our hearts as a pledge of what is to come.
1.kjv: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
1.blb: the One also having sealed us and having given the pledge of the Spirit in our hearts.
1.bbe: And it is he who has put his stamp on us, even the Spirit, as the sign in our hearts of the coming glory.

1.msb: I call God as my witness that it was in order to spare you that I did not return to Corinth.
1.kjv: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
1.blb: But I call God as witness upon my soul, that sparing you I did not yet come to Corinth.
1.bbe: But God is my witness that it was in pity for you that I did not come to Corinth at that time.

1.msb: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we are fellow workers with you for your joy, because it is by faith that you stand firm.
1.kjv: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
1.blb: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we are fellow workers with you of joy; for in the faith you stand firm.
1.bbe: Not that we have authority over your faith, but we are helpers of your joy: for it is faith which is your support.

2.msb: So I made up my mind not to make another painful visit to you.
2.kjv: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.
2.blb: For I decided this within myself, not to come to you again in grief.
2.bbe: But it was my decision for myself, not to come again to you with sorrow.
2.heading: Reaffirm Your Love

2.msb: For if I grieve you, who is left to cheer me but those whom I have grieved?
2.kjv: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?
2.blb: For if I grieve you, then who is gladdening me except the one being grieved by me?
2.bbe: For if I give you sorrow, who then will make me glad, but he who is made sad by me?

2.msb: I wrote to you as I did so that on my arrival I would not be grieved by those who ought to make me rejoice. I had confidence in all of you, that you would share my joy.
2.kjv: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
2.blb: And I wrote this same thing so that, having come, I might not have grief from those for whom it was necessary for me to rejoice, having been confident in you all, that my joy is of all of you.
2.bbe: And I said this very thing in my letter, for fear that when I came I might have sorrow from those from whom it was right for me to have joy; being certain of this, that my joy is the joy of you all.

2.msb: For through many tears I wrote you out of great distress and anguish of heart, not to grieve you but to let you know how much I love you.
2.kjv: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
2.blb: For out of much tribulation and anguish of heart, I wrote to you through many tears, not that you might be grieved, but that you might know the love that I have more abundantly toward you.
2.bbe: For out of much trouble and pain of heart and much weeping I sent my letter to you; not to give you sorrow, but so that you might see how great is the love which I have to you.

2.msb: Now if anyone has caused grief, he has not grieved me but all of you—to some degree, not to overstate it.
2.kjv: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
2.blb: But if anyone has caused grief, he has not grieved me, but in part (so that I might not be severe) all of you.
2.bbe: But if anyone has been a cause of sorrow, he has been so, not to me only, but in some measure to all of you (I say this that I may not be over-hard on you).

2.msb: The punishment imposed on him by the majority is sufficient for him.
2.kjv: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.
2.blb: Sufficient to such a one is the punishment that is by the majority,
2.bbe: Let it be enough for such a man to have undergone the punishment which the church put on him;

2.msb: So instead, you ought to forgive and comfort him, so that he will not be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.
2.kjv: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
2.blb: so that on the contrary, it is rather for you to forgive and to comfort him, lest somehow such a one might be overwhelmed by more abundant grief.
2.bbe: So that now, on the other hand, it is right for him to have forgiveness and comfort from you, for fear that his sorrow may be over-great.

2.msb: Therefore I urge you to reaffirm your love for him.
2.kjv: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.
2.blb: Therefore I exhort you to confirm love toward him.
2.bbe: For which cause my desire is that you will make your love to him clear by your acts.

2.msb: My purpose in writing you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.
2.kjv: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.
2.blb: For this indeed also I wrote, so that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient to everything.
2.bbe: And for the same reason I sent you a letter so that I might be certain of your desire to do my orders in all things.

2.msb: If you forgive anyone, I also forgive him. And if I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven it in the presence of Christ for your sake,
2.kjv: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;
2.blb: Now to whomever you forgive anything, I also do; and indeed to whom I have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, it is on account of you in the face of Christ,
2.bbe: But if you give forgiveness to anyone, I do the same: for if I have given forgiveness for anything, I have done it because of you, in the person of Christ;

2.msb: in order that Satan should not outwit us. For we are not unaware of his schemes.
2.kjv: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
2.blb: so that we should not be exploited by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his schemes.
2.bbe: So that Satan may not get the better of us: for we are not without knowledge of his designs.

2.msb: Now when I went to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ and a door stood open for me in the Lord,
2.kjv: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ’s gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,
2.blb: Now having come to Troas for the gospel of Christ, a door also having been opened to me in the Lord,
2.bbe: Now when I came to Troas for the good news of Christ, and there was an open door for me in the Lord,
2.heading: Triumph in Christ

2.msb: I had no peace in my spirit, because I did not find my brother Titus there. So I said goodbye to them and went on to Macedonia.
2.kjv: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.
2.blb: I have had no rest in my spirit in my not finding Titus my brother, but having taken leave of them, I went out to Macedonia.
2.bbe: I had no rest in my spirit because Titus my brother was not there: so I went away from them, and came into Macedonia.

2.msb: But thanks be to God, who always leads us triumphantly as captives in Christ and through us spreads everywhere the fragrance of the knowledge of Him.
2.kjv: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
2.blb: But thanks be to God, the One always leading us in triumph in Christ and making manifest the fragrance of the knowledge of Him through us in every place.
2.bbe: But praise be to God who makes us strong to overcome in Christ, and makes clear through us in every place the value of the knowledge of him.

2.msb: For we are to God the sweet aroma of Christ among those who are being saved and those who are perishing.
2.kjv: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
2.blb: For we are a sweet smell of Christ to God among those being saved and among those perishing:
2.bbe: For we are a sweet perfume of Christ to God in those who are getting salvation and in those who are going to destruction;

2.msb: To the one we are an odor that brings death, to the other a fragrance that brings life. And who is qualified for such a task?
2.kjv: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
2.blb: to one indeed a smell from death to death, but to one a smell from life to life. And who is sufficient for these things?
2.bbe: To the one it is a perfume of death to death; to the other a perfume of life to life. And who is enough for such things?

2.msb: For we are not like others, who peddle the word of God for profit. On the contrary, in Christ we speak before God with sincerity, as men sent from God.
2.kjv: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
2.blb: For we are not like the many, peddling the word of God, but as from sincerity—but as from God—we speak before God in Christ.
2.bbe: For we are not like the great number who make use of the word of God for profit: but our words are true, as from God, being said as before God in Christ.

3.msb: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Do we need, like some people, letters of recommendation to you or from you?
3.kjv: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?
3.blb: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or like some, do we need letters of recommendation to you or from you?
