3.bbe: Do we seem to be again attempting to put ourselves in the right? or have we need, as some have, of letters of approval to you or from you?
3.heading: Ministers of a New Covenant

3.msb: You yourselves are our letter, inscribed on our hearts, known and read by everyone.
3.kjv: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
3.blb: You are our letter, having been inscribed in our hearts, being known and being read by all men,
3.bbe: You yourselves are our letter, whose writing is in our heart, open for every man's reading and knowledge;

3.msb: It is clear that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
3.kjv: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.
3.blb: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, having been ministered to by us, having been inscribed not in ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not in tablets of stone but in tablets of fleshly hearts.
3.bbe: For you are clearly a letter of Christ, the fruit of our work, recorded not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in stone, but in hearts of flesh.

3.msb: Such confidence before God is ours through Christ.
3.kjv: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:
3.blb: Now we have such confidence through Christ toward God.
3.bbe: And this is the certain faith which we have in God through Christ:

3.msb: Not that we are competent in ourselves to claim that anything comes from us, but our competence comes from God.
3.kjv: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;
3.blb: Not that we are sufficient from ourselves to reckon anything as of ourselves, but our sufficiency is of God,
3.bbe: Not as if we were able by ourselves to do anything for which we might take the credit; but our power comes from God;

3.msb: And He has qualified us as ministers of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
3.kjv: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
3.blb: who also made us sufficient as ministers of a new covenant, not of the letter, but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
3.bbe: Who has made us able to be servants of a new agreement; not of the letter, but of the Spirit: for the letter gives death, but the Spirit gives life.

3.msb: Now if the ministry of death, which was engraved in letters on stone, came with such glory that the Israelites could not gaze at the face of Moses because of its fleeting glory,
3.kjv: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:
3.blb: Now if the ministry of death, having been engraved in letters on stones, came into being in glory so as for the sons of Israel not to be able to look intently into the face of Moses on account of the glory of his face that is fading away,
3.bbe: For if the operation of the law, giving death, recorded in letters on stone, came with glory, so that the eyes of the children of Israel had to be turned away from the face of Moses because of its glory, a glory which was only for a time:
3.heading: The Glory of the New Covenant

3.msb: will not the ministry of the Spirit be even more glorious?
3.kjv: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?
3.blb: how will the ministry of the Spirit not be more in glory?
3.bbe: Will not the operation of the Spirit have a much greater glory?

3.msb: For if the ministry of condemnation was glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry of righteousness!
3.kjv: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
3.blb: For if in the ministry of condemnation was glory, much more does the ministry of righteousness abound in glory!
3.bbe: For if the operation of the law, producing punishment, had its glory, how much greater will be the operation of the Spirit causing righteousness?

3.msb: Indeed, what was once glorious has no glory now in comparison to the glory that surpasses it.
3.kjv: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.
3.blb: For even that having been glorious has no glory in this respect, on account of the glory surpassing it.
3.bbe: For the glory of the first no longer seems to be glory, because of the greater glory of that which comes after.

3.msb: For if what was fading away came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which endures!
3.kjv: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.
3.blb: For if that which is fading away was through glory, much more is that remaining in glory!
3.bbe: For if the order which was for a time had its glory, much more will the eternal order have its glory.

3.msb: Therefore, since we have such a hope, we are very bold.
3.kjv: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
3.blb: Therefore having such a hope, we use much boldness,
3.bbe: Having then such a hope, we keep nothing back,

3.msb: We are not like Moses, who would put a veil over his face to keep the Israelites from gazing at the end of what was fading away.
3.kjv: And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:
3.blb: and not as Moses would put a veil over his face for the sons of Israel not to look intently into the end of what was fading away.
3.bbe: And are not like Moses, who put a veil on his face, so that the children of Israel might not see clearly to the end of the present order of things:

3.msb: But their minds were closed. For to this day the same veil remains at the reading of the old covenant. It has not been lifted, because only in Christ can it be removed.
3.kjv: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.
3.blb: But their minds were hardened; for until the present day, the same veil remains upon the reading of the old covenant, not being unveiled, which is removed in Christ.
3.bbe: But their minds were made hard: for to this very day at the reading of the old agreement the same veil is still unlifted; though it is taken away in Christ.

3.msb: And even to this day when Moses is read, a veil covers their hearts.
3.kjv: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
3.blb: But until today when Moses is read, a veil lies upon their heart.
3.bbe: But to this day, at the reading of the law of Moses, a veil is over their heart.

3.msb: But whenever anyone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
3.kjv: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.
3.blb: But whenever one may turn to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
3.bbe: But when it is turned to the Lord, the veil will be taken away.

3.msb: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
3.kjv: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
3.blb: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, freedom is.
3.bbe: Now the Lord is the Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there the heart is free.

3.msb: And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into His image with intensifying glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
3.kjv: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
3.blb: And we all, having been unveiled in face, reflecting the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.
3.bbe: But we all, with unveiled face giving back as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord who is the Spirit.

4.msb: Therefore, since God in His mercy has given us this ministry, we do not lose heart.
4.kjv: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
4.blb: On account of this, having this ministry, just as we received mercy, we do not grow fainthearted.
4.bbe: For this reason, because we have been made servants of this new order, through the mercy given to us, we are strong:
4.heading: The Light of the Gospel

4.msb: Instead, we have renounced secret and shameful ways. We do not practice deceit, nor do we distort the word of God. On the contrary, by open proclamation of the truth, we commend ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
4.kjv: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
4.blb: But we renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor distorting the word of God, but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every conscience of men before God.
4.bbe: And we have given up the secret things of shame, not walking in false ways, and not making use of the word of God with deceit; but by the revelation of what is true, as before God, we have the approval of every man's sense of right and wrong.

4.msb: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.
4.kjv: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
4.blb: But if indeed our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those perishing,
4.bbe: But if our good news is veiled, it is veiled from those who are on the way to destruction:

4.msb: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so that the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, might not dawn upon them.
4.kjv: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.
4.blb: in whom the god of this age blinded the minds of the unbelieving, so as not to shine forth the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.
4.bbe: Because the god of this world has made blind the minds of those who have not faith, so that the light of the good news of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, might not be shining on them.

4.msb: For we do not proclaim ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake.
4.kjv: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus’ sake.
4.blb: For we do not proclaim ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants on account of Jesus.
4.bbe: For our preaching is not about ourselves, but about Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants through Jesus.

4.msb: For God, who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” made His light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
4.kjv: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
4.blb: For God is the One having said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who shone in our hearts for the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
4.bbe: Seeing that it is God who said, Let light be shining out of the dark, who has put in our hearts the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

4.msb: Now we have this treasure in jars of clay to show that this surpassingly great power is from God and not from us.
4.kjv: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
4.blb: Now we have this treasure in earthen vessels, so that the supereminence of the power may be from God and not from us,
4.bbe: But we have this wealth in vessels of earth, so that it may be seen that the power comes not from us but from God;
4.heading: Treasure in Jars of Clay

4.msb: We are hard pressed on all sides, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;
4.kjv: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
4.blb: being pressed in every way but not being crushed, being perplexed but not despairing,
4.bbe: Troubles are round us on every side, but we are not shut in; things are hard for us, but we see a way out of them;

4.msb: persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed.
4.kjv: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
4.blb: being persecuted but not being forsaken, being struck down but not being destroyed,
4.bbe: We are cruelly attacked, but not without hope; we are made low, but we are not without help;

4.msb: We always carry around in our body the death of the Lord Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
4.kjv: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
4.blb: always carrying around the death of Jesus in the body, so that the life of Jesus also may be revealed in our body.
4.bbe: In our bodies there is ever the mark of the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may be seen in our bodies.

4.msb: For we who are alive are always consigned to death for Jesus’ sake, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our mortal body.
4.kjv: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
4.blb: For we the living are always being delivered to death on account of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our mortal flesh.
4.bbe: For, while living, we are still being given up to death because of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may be seen in our flesh, though it is under the power of death.

4.msb: So then, death is at work in us, but life is at work in you.
4.kjv: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
4.blb: So then, death works in us, but life in you.
4.bbe: So then, death is working in us, but life in you.

4.msb: And in keeping with what is written, “I believed, therefore I have spoken,” we who have the same spirit of faith also believe and therefore speak,
4.kjv: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
4.blb: But having the same spirit of faith according to that having been written: “I believed, therefore I spoke,” we also believe, and therefore we speak,
4.bbe: But having the same spirit of faith, as it is said in the Writings, The words of my mouth came from the faith in my heart; in the same way, our words are the outcome of our faith;

4.msb: knowing that the One who raised the Lord Jesus will also raise us through Jesus and present us with you in His presence.
4.kjv: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.
4.blb: knowing that the One having raised the Lord Jesus also will raise us with Jesus and will present us with you.
4.bbe: Because we are certain that he who made the Lord Jesus come back from the dead, will do the same for us, and will give us a place in his glory with you.

4.msb: All this is for your benefit, so that the grace that is extending to more and more people may cause thanksgiving to overflow, to the glory of God.
4.kjv: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
4.blb: For all things are on account of you, so that the grace having increased on account of more people may make abundant the thanksgiving, to the glory of God.
4.bbe: For we go through all things on account of you, because the greater the number to whom the grace is given, the greater is the praise to the glory of God.

4.msb: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though our outer self is wasting away, yet the inner self is being renewed day by day.
4.kjv: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
4.blb: Therefore we do not grow fainthearted; but if also our outer man decays, yet our inner one is renewed day and day.
4.bbe: For which cause we do not give way to weariness; but though our outer man is getting feebler, our inner man is made new day by day.

4.msb: For our light and momentary affliction is producing for us an eternal weight of glory that is far beyond comparison.
4.kjv: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
4.blb: For the momentary lightness of our affliction is producing for us an eternal weight of glory, from supereminence to supereminence,
4.bbe: For our present trouble, which is only for a short time, is working out for us a much greater weight of glory;

4.msb: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen. For what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.
4.kjv: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
4.blb: in our not looking at the things being seen, but the things not being seen. For the things being seen are temporary, but the things not being seen are eternal.
4.bbe: While our minds are not on the things which are seen, but on the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are for a time; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

5.msb: For we know that if the earthly tent we live in is dismantled, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.
5.kjv: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
5.blb: For we know that if our earthly house, the tent, should be torn down, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
5.bbe: For we are conscious that if this our tent of flesh is taken down, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in heaven.
5.heading: Our Eternal Dwelling

5.msb: For in this tent we groan, longing to be clothed with our heavenly dwelling,
5.kjv: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:
5.blb: For also in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our dwelling that is from heaven,
5.bbe: For in this we are crying in weariness, greatly desiring to be clothed with our house from heaven:

5.msb: because when we are clothed, we will not be found naked.
5.kjv: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
5.blb: if indeed also having been clothed, we will not be found naked.
5.bbe: So that our spirits may not be unclothed.

5.msb: For while we are in this tent, we groan under our burdens, because we do not wish to be unclothed but clothed, so that our mortality may be swallowed up by life.
5.kjv: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
5.blb: For indeed, being in the tent we groan, being burdened, because we do not want to be unclothed but to be clothed, so that the mortal should be swallowed up by life.
5.bbe: For truly, we who are in this tent do give out cries of weariness, for the weight of care which is on us; not because we are desiring to be free from the body, but so that we may have our new body, and death may be overcome by life.

5.msb: And it is God who has prepared us for this very purpose and has given us the Spirit as a pledge of what is to come.
5.kjv: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
5.blb: Now the One having prepared us for this very thing is God, the One having given to us the pledge of the Spirit,
5.bbe: Now he who has made us for this very thing is God, who has given us the Spirit as a witness of what is to come.

5.msb: Therefore we are always confident, although we know that while we are at home in the body, we are away from the Lord.
5.kjv: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
5.blb: being confident, then, always, and knowing that being at home in the body we are away from the Lord.
5.bbe: So, then, we are ever without fear, and though conscious that while we are in the body we are away from the Lord,

5.msb: For we walk by faith, not by sight.
5.kjv: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
5.blb: For we walk by faith, not by sight.
5.bbe: (For we are walking by faith, not by seeing,)

5.msb: We are confident, then, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord.
5.kjv: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
5.blb: Now we are confident and we are well pleased rather to be away, out of the body, and to be at home with the Lord.
5.bbe: We are without fear, desiring to be free from the body, and to be with the Lord.

5.msb: So we aspire to please Him, whether we are at home in this body or away from it.
5.kjv: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
5.blb: Therefore also we strive earnestly, whether being at home or being away, to be well-pleasing to Him.
5.bbe: For this reason we make it our purpose, in the body or away from it, to be well-pleasing to him.

5.msb: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, that each one may receive his due for the things done in the body, whether good or bad.
5.kjv: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
5.blb: For it is necessary for us all to appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each may receive back the things done through the body according to what he did, whether good or evil.
5.bbe: For we all have to come before Christ to be judged; so that every one of us may get his reward for the things done in the body, good or bad.

5.msb: Therefore, since we know what it means to fear the Lord, we try to persuade men. What we are is clear to God, and I hope it is clear to your conscience as well.
5.kjv: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
5.blb: Therefore, knowing the fear of the Lord, we persuade men. And we have been made manifest to God, and I hope to have been made manifest in your consciences also.
5.bbe: Having in mind, then, the fear of the Lord, we put these things before men, but God sees our hearts; and it is my hope that we may seem right in your eyes.
5.heading: Ambassadors for Christ

5.msb: For we are not commending ourselves to you again. Instead, we are giving you an occasion to be proud of us, so that you can answer those who take pride in appearances rather than in the heart.
5.kjv: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
5.blb: We do not commend ourselves to you again, but are giving to you occasion of boasting on behalf of us, so that you may have something toward those boasting in appearance and not in heart.
5.bbe: We are not again requesting your approval, but we are giving you the chance of taking pride in us, so that you may be able to give an answer to those whose glory is in seeming, and not in the heart.

5.msb: If we are out of our mind, it is for God; if we are of sound mind, it is for you.
5.kjv: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
5.blb: For if we were beside ourselves, it is to God; and if we are sound-minded, it is for you.
5.bbe: For if we are foolish, it is to God; or if we are serious, it is for you.

5.msb: For Christ’s love compels us, because we are convinced that if One died for all, therefore all died.
5.kjv: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
5.blb: For the love of Christ compels us, having judged this, that One died for all, therefore all died.
5.bbe: For it is the love of Christ which is moving us; because we are of the opinion that if one was put to death for all, then all have undergone death;

5.msb: And He died for all, that those who live should no longer live for themselves, but for Him who died for them and was raised again.
5.kjv: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
5.blb: And He died for all, that those living no longer should live to themselves, but to the One having died for them and having been raised again.
5.bbe: And that he underwent death for all, so that the living might no longer be living to themselves, but to him who underwent death for them and came back from the dead.

5.msb: So from now on we regard no one according to the flesh. Although we once regarded Christ in this way, we do so no longer.
5.kjv: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.
5.blb: Therefore, from now, we know no one according to the flesh. Even if we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know Him thus no longer.
5.bbe: For this reason, from this time forward we have knowledge of no man after the flesh: even if we have had knowledge of Christ after the flesh, we have no longer any such knowledge.

5.msb: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away. Behold, all things have become new!
5.kjv: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
5.blb: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things passed away; behold, the new things have come into being!
5.bbe: So if any man is in Christ, he is in a new world: the old things have come to an end; they have truly become new.

5.msb: All this is from God, who reconciled us to Himself through Jesus Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:
5.kjv: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
5.blb: Now all things are of God, the One having reconciled us to Himself through Christ, and having given to us the ministry of reconciliation:
5.bbe: But all things are of God, who has made us at peace with himself through Christ, and has given to us the work of making peace;

5.msb: that God was reconciling the world to Himself in Christ, not counting men’s trespasses against them. And He has committed to us the message of reconciliation.
5.kjv: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
5.blb: how that God was in Christ reconciling the world to Himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having put into us the word of reconciliation.
5.bbe: That is, that God was in Christ making peace between the world and himself, not putting their sins to their account, and having given to us the preaching of this news of peace.

5.msb: Therefore we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God were making His appeal through us. We implore you on behalf of Christ: Be reconciled to God.
5.kjv: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ’s stead, be ye reconciled to God.
5.blb: Therefore we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God is appealing through us. We implore on behalf of Christ: Be reconciled to God.
5.bbe: So we are the representatives of Christ, as if God was making a request to you through us: we make our request to you, in the name of Christ, be at peace with God.

5.msb: For God made Him who knew no sin to be sin on our behalf, so that in Him we might become the righteousness of God.
5.kjv: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
5.blb: He made the One not having known sin to be sin for us, so that we might become the righteousness of God in Him.
5.bbe: For him who had no knowledge of sin God made to be sin for us; so that we might become the righteousness of God in him.

6.msb: As God’s fellow workers, then, we urge you not to receive God’s grace in vain.
6.kjv: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
6.blb: And working together, we also exhort you not to receive the grace of God in vain.
6.bbe: We then, working together with God, make our request to you not to take the grace of God to no purpose.
6.heading: Paul’s Hardships and God’s Grace

6.msb: For He says: “In the time of favor I heard you, and in the day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the time of favor; now is the day of salvation!
6.kjv: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)
6.blb: For He says: “In the acceptable time I listened to you, and in the day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the favorable time; behold, now is the day of salvation.
6.bbe: (For he says, I have given ear to you at a good time, and I have been your helper in a day of salvation: see, now is the good time; now is the day of salvation):

6.msb: We put no obstacle in anyone’s way, so that no one can discredit our ministry.
6.kjv: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
6.blb: We are giving no cause of stumbling among anyone, so that the ministry should not be blamed,
6.bbe: Giving no cause for trouble in anything, so that no one may be able to say anything against our work;

6.msb: Rather, as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way: in great endurance; in troubles, hardships, and calamities;
6.kjv: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
6.blb: but in everything we are commending ourselves as God’s servants: in much endurance, in tribulations, in hardships, in distresses;
6.bbe: But in everything making it clear that we are the servants of God, in quiet strength, in troubles, in need, in sorrow,

6.msb: in beatings, imprisonments, and riots; in labor, sleepless nights, and hunger;
6.kjv: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
6.blb: in beatings, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labors, in sleepless nights, in fastings;
6.bbe: In blows, in prisons, in attacks, in hard work, in watchings, in going without food;

6.msb: in purity, knowledge, patience, and kindness; in the Holy Spirit and in sincere love;
6.kjv: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
6.blb: in purity, in knowledge, in patience, in kindness; in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love;
6.bbe: In a clean heart, in knowledge, in long waiting, in being kind, in the Holy Spirit, in true love,

6.msb: in truthful speech and in the power of God; with the weapons of righteousness in the right hand and in the left;
6.kjv: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
6.blb: in the word of truth, in the power of God; through the weapons of righteousness for the right hand and for the left;
6.bbe: In the true word, in the power of God; with the arms of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

6.msb: through glory and dishonor, slander and praise; viewed as imposters, yet genuine;
6.kjv: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
6.blb: through glory and dishonor, through bad report and good report; as imposters yet true;
6.bbe: By glory and by shame, by an evil name and a good name; as untrue, and still true;

6.msb: unknown, yet well-known; dying, and yet we live on; punished, yet not killed;
6.kjv: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
6.blb: as being unknown yet being well-known; as dying, yet behold, we live; as being disciplined yet not being put to death;
6.bbe: Unnoted, but still kept fully in mind; as near to death, but still living; as undergoing punishment, but not put to death;

6.msb: sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich; having nothing, and yet possessing everything.
6.kjv: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
6.blb: as being sorrowful yet always rejoicing; as poor yet enriching many; as having nothing and yet possessing everything.
6.bbe: As full of sorrow, but ever glad; as poor, but giving wealth to others; as having nothing, but still having all things.

6.msb: We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians. Our hearts are open wide.
6.kjv: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
6.blb: Our mouth has been open to you, Corinthians; our heart has been enlarged.
6.bbe: Our mouth is open to you, O Corinthians, our heart is wide.

6.msb: It is not our affection, but yours, that is restrained.
6.kjv: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.
6.blb: You are not restrained by us, but you are restrained in your own inner parts.
6.bbe: It is not our feelings to you which are narrow, but yours to us.

6.msb: As a fair exchange—I speak as to my children—open wide your hearts also.
6.kjv: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.
6.blb: Now as the same recompense—I speak as to children—you be enlarged also.
6.bbe: Now to give me back payment of the same sort (I am talking as to my children), let your hearts be wide open to me.

6.msb: Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers. For what partnership can righteousness have with wickedness? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
6.kjv: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
6.blb: Do not become unequally yoked together with unbelievers. For what partnership have righteousness and lawlessness? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?
6.bbe: Do not keep company with those who have not faith: for what is there in common between righteousness and evil, or between light and dark?
6.heading: Do Not Be Unequally Yoked

6.msb: What harmony is there between Christ and Belial? Or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?
6.kjv: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?
6.blb: And what harmony has Christ with Beliar? Or what part to a believer is with an unbeliever?
6.bbe: And what agreement is there between Christ and the Evil One? or what part has one who has faith with one who has not?

6.msb: What agreement can exist between the temple of God and idols? For you are the temple of the living God. As God has said: “I will dwell with them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they will be My people.”
6.kjv: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
6.blb: And what agreement has the temple of God with idols? For we are the temple of the living God. As God has said: “I will dwell in them, and I will walk among them, and I will be their God, and they will be My people.”
6.bbe: And what agreement has the house of God with images? for we are a house of the living God; even as God has said, I will be living among them, and walking with them; and I will be their God, and they will be my people.

6.msb: “Therefore come out from among them and be separate, says the Lord. Touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you.”
6.kjv: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,
6.blb: “Therefore come out from their midst and be separate, says the Lord, and touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you.”
6.bbe: For which cause, Come out from among them, and be separate, says the Lord, and let no unclean thing come near you; and I will take you for myself,

6.msb: And: “I will be a Father to you, and you will be My sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.”
6.kjv: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
6.blb: And: “I will be for a Father to you, and you will be for sons and daughters to Me, says the Lord Almighty.”
6.bbe: And will be a Father to you; and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord, the Ruler of all.

7.msb: Therefore, beloved, since we have these promises, let us cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
7.kjv: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
7.blb: Therefore having these promises, beloved, we should cleanse ourselves from every defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
7.bbe: Because God, then, will give us such rewards, dear brothers, let us make ourselves clean from all evil of flesh and spirit, and become completely holy in the fear of God.
7.heading: Paul’s Joy in the Corinthians

7.msb: Make room for us in your hearts. We have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have exploited no one.
7.kjv: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
7.blb: Make room for us. We wronged no one, we corrupted no one, we took advantage of no one.
7.bbe: Let your hearts be open to us: we have done no man wrong, no man has been damaged by us, we have made no profit out of any man,

7.msb: I do not say this to condemn you. I have said before that you so occupy our hearts that we live and die together with you.
7.kjv: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.
7.blb: I do not speak for condemnation; for I have before said that you are in our hearts for us to die together and to live together.
7.bbe: It is not with the purpose of judging you that I say this: for I have said before that you are in our hearts for life and death together.

7.msb: Great is my confidence in you; great is my pride in you; I am filled with encouragement; in all our troubles my joy overflows.
7.kjv: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.
7.blb: Much is my boldness toward you; much is my boasting on behalf of you; I have been filled with encouragement; I overabound with joy upon all our tribulation.
7.bbe: My words to you are without fear, I am full of pride on account of you: I have great comfort and joy in all our troubles.

7.msb: For when we arrived in Macedonia, our bodies had no rest, but we were pressed from every direction—conflicts on the outside, fears within.
7.kjv: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.
7.blb: For also of our having come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest; but we are being pressed in every way: conflicts on the outside, fears within.
7.bbe: For even when we had come into Macedonia our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; there were fightings outside and fears inside.

7.msb: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the arrival of Titus,
7.kjv: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
7.blb: But God, the One comforting the downcast, comforted us in the coming of Titus,
7.bbe: But God who gives comfort to the poor in spirit gave us comfort by the coming of Titus;

7.msb: and not only by his arrival, but also by the comfort he had received from you. He told us about your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced all the more.
7.kjv: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
7.blb: and not only in his coming, but also in the comfort with which he was comforted over you, declaring to us your longing, your mourning, your zeal for me, so as for me to rejoice the more.
7.bbe: And not by his coming only, but by the comfort which he had in you, while he gave us word of your desire, your sorrow, your care for me; so that I was still more glad.

7.msb: Even if I caused you sorrow by my letter, I do not regret it. Although I did regret it—for I see that my letter caused you sorrow, but only for a short time—
7.kjv: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.
7.blb: For if also I grieved you in the letter, I do not regret it—even if I did regret it; for I see that the letter grieved you, that even if for an hour.
7.bbe: For though my letter gave you pain, I have no regret for it now, though I had before; for I see that the letter gave you pain, but only for a time.

7.msb: yet now I rejoice, not because you were made sorrowful, but because your sorrow led you to repentance. For you felt the sorrow that God had intended, and so were not harmed in any way by us.
7.kjv: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.
7.blb: Now I rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved unto repentance. For you were grieved according to God, so that you might suffer loss in nothing through us.
7.bbe: Now I am glad, not that you had sorrow, but that your sorrow was the cause of a change of heart; for yours was a holy sorrow so that you might undergo no loss by us in anything.

7.msb: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation without regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.
7.kjv: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
7.blb: For grief according to God works repentance unto salvation without regret; but the grief of the world produces death.
7.bbe: For the sorrow which God gives is the cause of salvation through a change of heart, in which there is no reason for grief: but the sorrow of the world is a cause of death.

7.msb: Consider what this godly sorrow of yours has produced in you: what earnestness, what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what zeal, what vindication! In every way you have proved yourselves to be innocent in this matter.
7.kjv: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
7.blb: For behold how much earnestness this same thing—to have been grieved according to God—produced in you: but defense, but indignation, but fear, but longing, but zeal, but avenging! In everything, you commended yourselves to be innocent in the matter.
7.bbe: For you see what care was produced in you by this very sorrow of yours before God, what clearing of yourselves, what wrath against sin, what fear, what desire, what serious purpose, what punishment. In everything you have made it clear that you are free from sin in this business.

7.msb: So even though I wrote to you, it was not on account of the one who did wrong or the one who was harmed, but rather that your earnestness on our behalf would be made clear to you in the sight of God.
7.kjv: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.
7.blb: So even if I wrote to you, it was not for the sake of the one having done wrong, nor for the sake of the one having suffered wrong, but for the sake of your earnestness for us being made manifest to you before God.
7.bbe: So though I sent you a letter, it was not only because of the man who did the wrong, or because of him to whom the wrong was done, but so that your true care for us might be made clear in the eyes of God.

7.msb: On account of this, we are encouraged. And in your encouragement, we were even more delighted by the joy of Titus. For his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.
7.kjv: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
7.blb: On account of this, we have been comforted. And upon our comfort, we rejoiced more abundantly rather at the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.
7.bbe: So we have been comforted: and we had the greater joy in our comfort because of the joy of Titus, for his spirit had been made glad by you all.

7.msb: Indeed, I was not embarrassed by anything I had boasted to him about you. But just as everything we said to you was true, so our boasting to Titus has proved to be true as well.
7.kjv: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.
7.blb: For if I have boasted anything to him about you, I was not put to shame; but as we spoke all things to you in truth, so also our boasting to Titus became truth.
7.bbe: For I was not put to shame in anything in which I may have made clear to him my pride in you; but as we said nothing to you but what was true, so the good things which I said to Titus about you were seen by him to be true.

7.msb: And his affection for you is even greater when he remembers that you were all obedient as you welcomed him with fear and trembling.
7.kjv: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.
7.blb: And his affections are more abundantly for you, remembering the obedience of all of you, how you received him with fear and trembling.
7.bbe: And his love to you is the more increased by his memory of you all, how you gave way to his authority, and how you took him to your hearts with fear and honour.

7.msb: I rejoice that I can have complete confidence in you.
7.kjv: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.
7.blb: I rejoice that in everything I am confident in you.
7.bbe: It gives me great joy to see you answering to my good opinion of you in every way.

8.msb: Now, brothers, we want you to know about the grace that God has given the churches of Macedonia.
8.kjv: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
8.blb: Now we make known to you, brothers, the grace of God having been given in the churches of Macedonia,
8.bbe: And now we give you news, brothers, about the grace of God which has been given to the churches of Macedonia;
8.heading: Generosity Commended

8.msb: In the terrible ordeal they suffered, their abundant joy and deep poverty overflowed into rich generosity.
8.kjv: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
8.blb: that in much proof of tribulation, the abundance of their joy and of their deep poverty abounded into the riches of their generosity.
8.bbe: How while they were undergoing every sort of trouble, and were in the greatest need, they took all the greater joy in being able to give freely to the needs of others.

8.msb: For I testify that they gave according to their ability and even beyond it. Of their own accord,
8.kjv: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
8.blb: For I testify that according to their power and beyond their power, of their own accord,
8.bbe: For I give them witness, that as they were able, and even more than they were able, they gave from the impulse of their hearts,

8.msb: they earnestly pleaded with us for the privilege of sharing in this service to the saints.
8.kjv: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
8.blb: with much entreaty they were imploring us for the grace and the fellowship of the service to the saints.
8.bbe: Seriously requesting us that they might have a part in this grace of being servants to the needs of the saints:

8.msb: And not only did they do as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, through the will of God.
8.kjv: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.
8.blb: And not even as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the Lord and to us by the will of God.
8.bbe: And going even farther than our hope, they first gave themselves to the Lord and to us after the purpose of God.

8.msb: So we urged Titus to help complete your act of grace, just as he had started it.
8.kjv: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
8.blb: Accordingly, we exhorted Titus that just as he began before, so also he might complete to you also this grace,
8.bbe: So that we made a request to Titus that, as he had made a start before, so he might make this grace complete in you.

8.msb: But just as you excel in everything—in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in complete earnestness, and in your love for us—see that you also excel in this grace of giving.
8.kjv: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.
8.blb: but just as you abound in everything—in faith and word and knowledge and all earnestness and in the love from us in you—that also you may abound in this grace.
8.bbe: And that as you are full of every good thing, of faith, of the word, of knowledge, of a ready mind, and of love to us, so you may be full of this grace in the same way.

8.msb: I am not giving a command, but I am testing the sincerity of your love through the earnestness of others.
8.kjv: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
8.blb: I do not speak as a command, but proving the genuineness of your love through the earnestness of others also.
8.bbe: I am not giving you an order, but using the ready mind of others as a test of the quality of your love.

8.msb: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though He was rich, yet for your sake He became poor, so that you through His poverty might become rich.
8.kjv: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
8.blb: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that being rich, on account of you He became poor, so that you by that poverty might be enriched.
8.bbe: For you see the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, how though he had wealth, he became poor on your account, so that through his need you might have wealth.

8.msb: And this is my opinion about what is helpful for you in this matter: Last year you were the first not only to give, but even to have such a desire.
8.kjv: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.
8.blb: And I give a judgment in this matter, for this is profitable for you, who not only began before to do, but also to will, from a year ago.
8.bbe: And in this I give my opinion: for it is to your profit, who were the first to make a start a year before, not only to do this, but to make clear that your minds were more than ready to do it.

8.msb: Now finish the work, so that you may complete it with the same eager desire, according to your means.
8.kjv: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.
8.blb: And now also complete the doing, so that just as there was the readiness to will, so also there may be to complete out of that which you have.
8.bbe: Then make the doing of it complete; so that as you had a ready mind, you may give effect to it as you are able.

8.msb: For if the eagerness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what he does not have.
8.kjv: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.
8.blb: For if the readiness is present, it is acceptable as if he may have, not as he does not have.
8.bbe: For if there is a ready mind, a man will have God's approval in the measure of what he has, and not of what he has not.

8.msb: It is not our intention that others may be relieved while you are burdened, but that there may be equality.
8.kjv: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:
8.blb: For it is not that to others is relief and for you tribulation, but of equality.
8.bbe: And I am not saying this so that others may get off free, while the weight comes on you:

8.msb: At the present time, your surplus will meet their need, so that in turn their surplus will meet your need. This way there will be equality.
8.kjv: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
8.blb: At the present time, your abundance is for their need, so that their abundance also may be for your need, so that there may be equality.
8.bbe: But so that things may be equal; that from those things of which you have more than enough at the present time their need may be helped, and that if you are in any need they may be a help to you in the same way, making things equal.

8.msb: As it is written: “He who gathered much had no excess, and he who gathered little had no shortfall.”
8.kjv: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.
8.blb: As it has been written: “The one who gathered much did not abound, and the one who gathered little did not lack.”
8.bbe: As it says in the Writings, He who had taken up much had nothing over and he who had little had enough.

8.msb: But thanks be to God, who put into the heart of Titus the same devotion I have for you.
8.kjv: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
8.blb: But thanks to God, the One putting the same earnestness for you in the heart of Titus.
8.bbe: But praise be to God, who puts the same care for you into the heart of Titus.
8.heading: Titus Commended

8.msb: For not only did he welcome our appeal, but he is eagerly coming to you of his own volition.
8.kjv: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.
8.blb: For indeed he accepted the exhortation, but being more earnest, of his own accord he went out to you.
8.bbe: For while he gladly gave ear to our request, he was interested enough to go to you from the impulse of his heart.

8.msb: Along with Titus we are sending the brother who is praised by all the churches for his work in the gospel.
8.kjv: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;
8.blb: And we sent with him the brother whose praise in the gospel is through all of the churches,
8.bbe: And with him we have sent a brother whose praise in the good news has gone through all the churches;

8.msb: More than that, this brother was chosen by the churches to accompany us with the gracious gift we administer to honor the Lord Himself and to show our eagerness to help.
8.kjv: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
8.blb: and not only that, but also having been appointed by the churches, he is our fellow traveler with this grace that is being ministered by us toward the glory of the Lord Himself and to our readiness,
8.bbe: And not only so, but he was marked out by the churches to go with us in the grace of this giving which we have undertaken to the glory of the Lord and to make clear that our mind was ready:

8.msb: We want to avoid any criticism of the way we administer this generous gift.
8.kjv: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
8.blb: avoiding this, lest anyone should blame us in this abundance being ministered by us.
8.bbe: And so that no man might be able to say anything against us in the business of this giving which has been put into our hands:

8.msb: We are taking great care to do what is right, not only in the eyes of the Lord, but also in the eyes of men.
8.kjv: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
8.blb: For we are giving forethought to what is right, not only before the Lord but also before men.
8.bbe: For the business has been so ordered by us as to have the approval, not only of the Lord, but of men.

8.msb: And we are sending along with them our brother who has proven his earnestness to us many times and in many ways, and now even more so by his great confidence in you.
8.kjv: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.
8.blb: Now we sent with them our brother, whom we proved often in many things to be earnest, but now much more earnest by his confidence that is in you.
8.bbe: And we have sent with them our brother, whose ready spirit has been made clear to us at times and in ways without number, but it is now all the more so because of the certain faith which he has in you.

8.msb: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker among you. As for our brothers, they are messengers of the churches, the glory of Christ.
8.kjv: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.
8.blb: Whether as regards Titus my partner and fellow worker for you. or our brothers, they are apostles of the churches, the glory of Christ—
8.bbe: If any question comes up about Titus, he is my brother-worker, working with me for you; or about the others, they are the representatives of the churches to the glory of Christ.

8.msb: In full view of the churches, then, show these men the proof of your love and the reason for our boasting about you.
8.kjv: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
8.blb: the demonstration therefore of your love and of our boasting on behalf of you to them, demonstrated to the face of the churches.
8.bbe: Make clear then to them, as representatives of the churches, the quality of your love, and that the things which we have said about you are true.

9.msb: Now about the service to the saints, there is no need for me to write to you.
9.kjv: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
9.blb: For indeed, concerning the ministry to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you.
9.bbe: But there is no need for me to say anything in my letter about the giving to the saints:
9.heading: God Loves a Cheerful Giver

9.msb: For I know your eagerness to help, and I have been boasting to the Macedonians that since last year you in Achaia were prepared to give. And your zeal has stirred most of them to do likewise.
9.kjv: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.
9.blb: For I know your readiness, which I boast of to Macedonians on behalf of you, that Achaia has been prepared from a year ago, and your zeal provoked the greater part.
9.bbe: For I have before made clear to those of Macedonia my pride in your ready mind, saying to them that Achaia has been ready for a year back; and a great number have been moved to do the same by your example.

9.msb: But I am sending the brothers in order that our boasting about you in this matter should not prove empty, but that you will be prepared, just as I said.
9.kjv: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:
9.blb: But I sent the brothers so that our boasting that is on behalf of you in this matter should not be made void, so that you may be prepared, as I have been saying—
9.bbe: But I have sent the brothers, so that the good things we said about you may be seen to be true, and that, as I said, you may be ready:

9.msb: Otherwise, if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we—to say nothing of you—would be ashamed of having been so confident in our boasting.
9.kjv: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
9.blb: lest perhaps if Macedonians should come with me and should find you unprepared, we would be put to shame—not that we might say you—in this confidence.
9.bbe: For fear that, if any from Macedonia come with me, and you are not ready, we (not to say, you) might be put to shame in this thing.

9.msb: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to visit you beforehand and make arrangements for the generous gift that was announced. This way, your gift will be prepared generously and not begrudgingly.
9.kjv: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
9.blb: Therefore I deemed it necessary to exhort the brothers that they should go before to you and should complete beforehand your foreannounced blessing, thus for this to be ready as a blessing and not as covetousness.
9.bbe: So it seemed to me wise for the brothers to go before, and see that the amount which you had undertaken to give was ready, so that it might be a cause for praise, and not as if we were making profit out of you.

9.msb: Remember this: Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.
9.kjv: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
9.blb: Now this: The one sowing sparingly will also reap sparingly, and the one sowing upon blessings will also reap upon blessings,
9.bbe: But in the Writings it says, He who puts in only a small number of seeds, will get in the same; and he who puts them in from a full hand, will have produce in full measure from them.

9.msb: Each one should give what he decides in his heart to give, not out of regret or compulsion. For God loves a cheerful giver.
9.kjv: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
9.blb: each as he has purposed in the heart, not out of grief or out of necessity. For God loves a cheerful giver.
9.bbe: Let every man do after the purpose of his heart; not giving with grief, or by force: for God takes pleasure in a ready giver.

9.msb: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that in all things, at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.
9.kjv: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
9.blb: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that in every way, always, having all sufficiency, you may abound to every good work.
9.bbe: And God is able to give you all grace in full measure; so that ever having enough of all things, you may be full of every good work:

9.msb: As it is written: “He has scattered abroad His gifts to the poor; His righteousness endures forever.”
9.kjv: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.
9.blb: As it has been written: “He scattered abroad; He gave to the poor; His righteousness remains to the age.”
9.bbe: As it is said in the Writings, He has sent out far and wide, he has given to the poor; his righteousness is for ever.

9.msb: Now may He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food supply and multiply your store of seed and increase the harvest of your righteousness.
9.kjv: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)
9.blb: Now the One supplying seed to the one sowing and bread for food will supply and will multiply your seed and will increase the fruits of your righteousness,
9.bbe: And he who gives seed for putting into the field and bread for food, will take care of the growth of your seed, at the same time increasing the fruits of your righteousness;

9.msb: May you be enriched in every way to be generous on every occasion, so that through us your generosity may produce thanksgiving to God.
9.kjv: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.
9.blb: being enriched in every way to all generosity, which produces through us thanksgiving to God.
9.bbe: Your wealth being increased in everything, with a simple mind, causing praise to God through us.

9.msb: For this ministry of service is not only supplying the needs of the saints, but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanksgiving to God.
9.kjv: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;
9.blb: For the ministry of this service is not only supplying the needs of the saints, but is also abounding through many thanksgivings to God,
9.bbe: For this work of giving not only takes care of the needs of the saints, but is the cause of much praise to God;

9.msb: Because of the proof this ministry provides, the saints will glorify God for your obedient confession of the gospel of Christ, and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all the others.
9.kjv: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;
9.blb: through the proof of this ministry, glorifying God upon your submission of confession to the gospel of Christ, and the generosity of the fellowship to them and to all.
9.bbe: For when, through this work of giving, they see what you are, they give glory to God for the way in which you have given yourselves to the good news of Christ, and for the wealth of your giving to them and to all;

9.msb: And their prayers for you will express their affection for you, because of the surpassing grace God has given you.
9.kjv: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.
9.blb: And their supplication is for you, longing for you on account of the surpassing grace of God upon you.
9.bbe: While their hearts go out to you in love and in prayer for you, because of the great grace of God which is in you.

9.msb: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!
9.kjv: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
9.blb: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!
9.bbe: Praise be to God for what he has given, which words have no power to say.

10.msb: Now by the mildness and gentleness of Christ, I appeal to you—I, Paul, who am humble when face to face with you, but bold when away.
10.kjv: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:
10.blb: Now I, Paul, myself exhort you by the mildness and gentleness of Christ—I who indeed as to presence am humble among you, but being absent am bold toward you.
10.bbe: Now I, Paul, myself make request to you by the quiet and gentle behaviour of Christ, I who am poor in spirit when with you, but who say what is in my mind to you without fear when I am away from you:
10.heading: Paul’s Apostolic Authority

10.msb: I beg you that when I come I may not need to be as bold as I expect toward those who presume that we live according to the flesh.
10.kjv: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
10.blb: Now I implore you that being present, I need not to be bold with the confidence with which I reckon to be daring toward some reckoning us as walking according to the flesh.
10.bbe: Yes, I make my request to you, so that when I am with you I may not have to make use of the authority which may be needed against some to whom we seem to be walking after the flesh.

10.msb: For though we live in the flesh, we do not wage war according to the flesh.
10.kjv: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
10.blb: For walking in flesh, we do not wage war according to the flesh.
10.bbe: For though we may be living in the flesh, we are not fighting after the way of the flesh

10.msb: The weapons of our warfare are not the weapons of the flesh. Instead, they have divine power to demolish strongholds.
10.kjv: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
10.blb: For the weapons of our warfare are not fleshly, but powerful before God toward the tearing down of strongholds,
10.bbe: (For the arms with which we are fighting are not those of the flesh, but are strong before God for the destruction of high places);

10.msb: We demolish arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge of God; and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.
10.kjv: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
10.blb: tearing down arguments and every high thing lifting itself up against the knowledge of God, and taking captive every thought into the obedience of Christ,
10.bbe: Putting an end to reasonings, and every high thing which is lifted up against the knowledge of God, and causing every thought to come under the authority of Christ;

10.msb: And we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience, as soon as your obedience is complete.
10.kjv: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
10.blb: and having readiness within to avenge all disobedience, when your obedience shall have been fulfilled.
10.bbe: Being ready to give punishment to whatever is against his authority, after you have made it clear that you are completely under his control.

10.msb: You are looking at outward appearances. If anyone is confident that he belongs to Christ, he should remind himself that we belong to Christ just as much as he belongs to Christ.
10.kjv: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ’s, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ’s, even so are we Christ’s.
10.blb: You are looking at things according to appearance. If anyone has been persuaded in himself to be of Christ, let him reckon this upon himself again, that as he is of Christ, so also are we.
10.bbe: Give attention to the things which are before you. If any man seems to himself to be Christ's, let him keep in mind that we are as much Christ's as he is.

10.msb: For even if I boast somewhat excessively about the authority the Lord gave us for building you up rather than tearing you down, I will not be ashamed.
10.kjv: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
10.blb: For even if I should boast somewhat more abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave us for building up and not for tearing you down, I will not be ashamed,
10.bbe: For though I might take pride in our authority (which the Lord gave for building you up, and not for your destruction), it will not be a cause of shame to me:

10.msb: I do not want to seem to be trying to frighten you by my letters.
10.kjv: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
10.blb: so that I might not seem as if to frighten you through the letters.
10.bbe: That I may not seem to have the desire of causing you fear by my letters.

10.msb: For some say, “His letters are weighty and forceful, but his physical presence is unimpressive, and his speaking is of no account.”
10.kjv: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
10.blb: For they say, “The letters indeed are weighty and strong, but the presence of the body is weak, and the word is of no account.”
10.bbe: For his letters, they say, have weight and are strong; but in body he is feeble, and his way of talking has little force.

10.msb: Such people should consider that what we are in our letters when absent, we will be in our actions when present.
10.kjv: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
10.blb: Let such a one reckon this, that such as we are in word through letters being absent, also such we are in deed being present.
10.bbe: Let those who say this keep in mind that, what we are in word by letters when we are away, so will we be in act when we are present.

10.msb: We do not dare to classify or compare ourselves with some who commend themselves. When they measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves, they show their ignorance.
10.kjv: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
10.blb: For we do not dare to classify or to compare ourselves with some commending themselves. But these, measuring themselves by themselves and comparing themselves with themselves, do not understand.
10.bbe: For we will not make comparison of ourselves with some of those who say good things about themselves: but these, measuring themselves by themselves, and making comparison of themselves with themselves, are not wise.

10.msb: We, however, will not boast beyond our limits, but only within the field of influence that God has assigned to us—a field that reaches even to you.
10.kjv: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
10.blb: But we will not boast unto the things without measure, but according to the measure of the area that God apportioned to us, a measure to reach even as far as you.
10.bbe: We will not give glory to ourselves in over-great measure, but after the measure of the rule which God has given us, a measure which comes even to you.

10.msb: We are not overstepping our bounds, as if we had not come to you. Indeed, we were the first to reach you with the gospel of Christ.
10.kjv: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
10.blb: For we are not overextending ourselves, as not reaching to you. For we came also as far as you in the gospel of Christ,
10.bbe: For we have no need to make ourselves seem more than we are, as if our authority did not come as far as to you: for we came even as far as you with the good news of Christ:

10.msb: Neither do we boast beyond our limits in the labors of others. But we hope that as your faith increases, our area of influence among you will greatly increase as well,
10.kjv: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men’s labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
10.blb: not boasting unto the things without measure in others’ labors, but having hope of your faith increasing among you to be enlarged according to our area, to abundance,
10.bbe: Not taking credit to ourselves for what is not our business, that is, for the work of others; but having hope that, with the growth of your faith, we may get the credit for an increase which is the effect of our work,

10.msb: so that we can preach the gospel in the regions beyond you. Then we will not be boasting in the work already done in another man’s territory.
10.kjv: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man’s line of things made ready to our hand.
10.blb: so as to preach the gospel in the places beyond you, not to boast in the things ready in another’s area.
10.bbe: So that we may be able to go on and take the good news to countries still farther away than you are, and not take credit for another man's work in making things ready to our hand.

10.msb: Rather, “Let him who boasts boast in the Lord.”
10.kjv: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
10.blb: But, “The one boasting, let him boast in the Lord.”
10.bbe: But whoever has a desire for glory, let his glory be in the Lord.

10.msb: For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.
10.kjv: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
10.blb: For the one commending himself, that one is not approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.
10.bbe: For the Lord's approval of a man is not dependent on his opinion of himself, but on the Lord's opinion of him.

11.msb: I hope you will put up with a little of my foolishness, but you are already doing that.
11.kjv: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
11.blb: I wish you were bearing with me in a little foolishness, but you also bear with me.
11.bbe: Put up with me if I am a little foolish: but, truly, you do put up with me.
11.heading: Paul and the False Apostles
