11.msb: I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
11.kjv: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
11.blb: For I am jealous as to you with the jealousy of God. For I betrothed you to one husband, to present a pure virgin to Christ.
11.bbe: For I have a very great care for you: because you have been married by me to one husband, and it is my desire to give you completely holy to Christ.

11.msb: I am afraid, however, that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s cunning, your minds may be led astray from the simplicity that is in Christ.
11.kjv: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
11.blb: But I fear, lest somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity and the purity that is to Christ.
11.bbe: But I have a fear, that in some way, as Eve was tricked by the deceit of the snake, your minds may be turned away from their simple and holy love for Christ.

11.msb: For if someone comes and proclaims a Jesus other than the One we proclaimed, or if you receive a different spirit than the One you received, or a different gospel than the one you accepted, you put up with it very easily.
11.kjv: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.
11.blb: For if indeed the one coming proclaims another Jesus whom we did not proclaim, or you receive a different spirit that you did not receive, or a different gospel that you did not accept, you bear with it well.
11.bbe: For if anyone comes preaching another Jesus from the one whose preachers we are, or if you have got a different spirit, or a different sort of good news from those which came to you, how well you put up with these things.

11.msb: I consider myself in no way inferior to those “super-apostles.”
11.kjv: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
11.blb: For I reckon in nothing to have been lacking to the “most eminent apostles.”
11.bbe: For in my opinion, I am in no way less than the most important of the Apostles.

11.msb: Although I am not a polished speaker, I am certainly not lacking in knowledge. We have been made known to you in every way possible.
11.kjv: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
11.blb: But even if I am unskilled in word, yet not in knowledge; but in every way, we were made manifest to you in all things.
11.bbe: But though I am rough in my way of talking, I am not so in knowledge, as we have made clear to all by our acts among you.

11.msb: Was it a sin for me to humble myself in order to exalt you, because I preached the gospel of God to you free of charge?
11.kjv: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
11.blb: Or did I commit a sin, humbling myself so that you might be exalted, because I preached the gospel of God to you freely?
11.bbe: Or did I do wrong in making myself low so that you might be lifted up, because I gave you the good news of God without reward?

11.msb: I robbed other churches by accepting their support in order to serve you.
11.kjv: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
11.blb: I robbed other churches, having received support for ministry to you.
11.bbe: I took money from other churches as payment for my work, so that I might be your servant;

11.msb: And when I was with you and in need, I was not a burden to anyone; for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied my needs. I have refrained from being a burden to you in any way, and I will continue to do so.
11.kjv: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.
11.blb: And being present with you and having been in need, I burdened no one; for the brothers having come from Macedonia supplied my need, and in everything I kept and will keep myself unburdensome to you.
11.bbe: And when I was present with you, and was in need, I let no man be responsible for me; for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, gave me whatever was needed; and in everything I kept myself from being a trouble to you, and I will go on doing so.

11.msb: As surely as the truth of Christ is in me, this boasting of mine will not be silenced in the regions of Achaia.
11.kjv: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
11.blb: The truth of Christ is in me, that this boasting of mine will not be stopped in the regions of Achaia.
11.bbe: As the true word of Christ is in me, I will let no man take from me this my cause of pride in the country of Achaia.

11.msb: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do!
11.kjv: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
11.blb: Because of what? Because I do not love you? God knows I do!
11.bbe: Why? because I have no love for you? let God be judge.

11.msb: But I will keep on doing what I am doing, in order to undercut those who want an opportunity to be regarded as our equals in the things of which they boast.
11.kjv: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
11.blb: But what I do, I also will do, so that I might cut off the opportunity of those wanting an opportunity that in what they boast they might be found according as also we.
11.bbe: But what I do, that I will go on doing, so that I may give no chance to those who are looking for one; so that, in the cause of their pride, they may be seen to be the same as we are.

11.msb: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as apostles of Christ.
11.kjv: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.
11.blb: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, disguising themselves as apostles of Christ.
11.bbe: For such men are false Apostles, workers of deceit, making themselves seem like Apostles of Christ.

11.msb: And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.
11.kjv: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
11.blb: And no wonder, for Satan himself disguises himself as an angel of light.
11.bbe: And it is no wonder; for even Satan himself is able to take the form of an angel of light.

11.msb: It is not surprising, then, if his servants masquerade as servants of righteousness. Their end will correspond to their actions.
11.kjv: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
11.blb: Therefore it is not great if his servants also disguise themselves as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.
11.bbe: So it is no great thing if his servants make themselves seem to be servants of righteousness; whose end will be the reward of their works.

11.msb: I repeat: Let no one take me for a fool. But if you do, then receive me as a fool, so that I too may boast a little.
11.kjv: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
11.blb: Again I say, no one should think me to be a fool; but if otherwise, receive me even as a fool, that I also may boast a little.
11.bbe: I say again, Let me not seem foolish to anyone; but if I do, put up with me as such, so that I may take a little glory to myself.
11.heading: Paul’s Suffering and Service

11.msb: In this confident boasting of mine, I am not speaking as the Lord would, but as a fool.
11.kjv: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
11.blb: What I am speaking, I am not speaking according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
11.bbe: What I am now saying is not by the order of the Lord, but as a foolish person, taking credit to myself, as it seems.

11.msb: Since many are boasting according to the flesh, I too will boast.
11.kjv: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
11.blb: Since many boast according to the flesh, I also will boast.
11.bbe: Seeing that there are those who take credit to themselves after the flesh, I will do the same.

11.msb: For you gladly put up with fools, since you are so wise.
11.kjv: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
11.blb: For gladly you bear with fools—being wise!
11.bbe: For you put up with the foolish gladly, being wise yourselves.

11.msb: In fact, you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or exploits you or takes advantage of you or exalts himself or strikes you in the face.
11.kjv: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
11.blb: For you bear with it if anyone enslaves you, if anyone devours you, if anyone takes from you, if anyone lifts himself up, if anyone strikes you in the face.
11.bbe: You put up with a man if he makes servants of you, if he makes profit out of you, if he makes you prisoners, if he puts himself in a high place, if he gives you blows on the face.

11.msb: To my shame I concede that we were too weak for that! Speaking as a fool, however, I can match what anyone else dares to boast about.
11.kjv: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
11.blb: I speak as to dishonor, as that we have been weak! But in that which anyone may dare—I speak in foolishness—I also dare.
11.bbe: I say this by way of shaming ourselves, as if we had been feeble. But if anyone puts himself forward (I am talking like a foolish person), I will do the same.

11.msb: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I.
11.kjv: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
11.blb: Are they Hebrews? I also. Are they Israelites? I also. Are they seed of Abraham? I also.
11.bbe: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they of Israel? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.

11.msb: Are they servants of Christ? (I am speaking as if I were out of my mind.) I am so much more: in harder labor, in worse beatings, in more imprisonments, in frequent danger of death.
11.kjv: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
11.blb: Are they servants of Christ? I speak as being beside myself—I too above measure: in labors more abundantly, in imprisonments more abundantly, in beatings surpassingly, in deaths often.
11.bbe: Are they servants of Christ? (I am talking foolishly) I am more so; I have had more experience of hard work, of prisons, of blows more than measure, of death.

11.msb: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.
11.kjv: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
11.blb: Five times I received from the Jews forty lashes minus one.
11.bbe: Five times the Jews gave me forty blows but one.

11.msb: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked. I spent a night and a day in the open sea.
11.kjv: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
11.blb: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked. I have passed a night and a day in the deep;
11.bbe: Three times I was whipped with rods, once I was stoned, three times the ship I was in came to destruction at sea, a night and a day I have been in the water;

11.msb: In my frequent journeys, I have been in danger from rivers and from bandits, in danger from my countrymen and from the Gentiles, in danger in the city and in the country, in danger on the sea and among false brothers,
11.kjv: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
11.blb: in journeyings often, in dangers of rivers, in dangers of robbers; in dangers from kindred, in dangers from the Gentiles; in dangers in the city, in dangers in the wilderness; in dangers in the sea, in dangers among false brothers;
11.bbe: In frequent travels, in dangers on rivers, in dangers from outlaws, in dangers from my countrymen, in dangers from the Gentiles, in dangers in the town, in dangers in the waste land, in dangers at sea, in dangers among false brothers;

11.msb: in labor and toil and often without sleep, in hunger and thirst and often without food, in cold and exposure.
11.kjv: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
11.blb: in labor and toil, in sleepless nights often; in hunger and thirst, in fastings often; in cold and nakedness.
11.bbe: In hard work and weariness, in frequent watchings, going without food and drink, cold and in need of clothing.

11.msb: Apart from these external trials, I face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches.
11.kjv: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
11.blb: Apart from the external things, the crowding on me on every day is the care of all the churches.
11.bbe: In addition to all the other things, there is that which comes on me every day, the care of all the churches.

11.msb: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is led into sin, and I do not burn with grief?
11.kjv: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
11.blb: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I am not burned?
11.bbe: Who is feeble and I am not feeble? who is in danger of falling, and I am not angry?

11.msb: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.
11.kjv: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
11.blb: If it is necessary to boast, I will boast in the things of my weakness.
11.bbe: If I have to take credit to myself, I will do so in the things in which I am feeble.

11.msb: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, who is forever worthy of praise, knows that I am not lying.
11.kjv: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.
11.blb: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, the One being blessed to the ages, knows that I am not lying.
11.bbe: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, to whom be praise for ever, is witness that the things which I say are true.

11.msb: In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas secured the city of the Damascenes wishing to arrest me.
11.kjv: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
11.blb: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas was guarding the city of the Damascenes to seize me.
11.bbe: In Damascus, the ruler under Aretas the king kept watch over the town of the people of Damascus, in order to take me:

11.msb: But I was lowered in a basket through a window in the wall and escaped his grasp.
11.kjv: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
11.blb: But I was let down in a basket through a window through the wall, and I escaped his hands.
11.bbe: And being let down in a basket from the wall through a window, I got free from his hands.

12.msb: Surely it is not beneficial for me to boast, yet I will go on to visions and revelations from the Lord.
12.kjv: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
12.blb: It is necessary to boast; it is not profitable indeed, but I will go to visions and revelations of the Lord.
12.bbe: As it is necessary for me to take glory to myself, though it is not a good thing, I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
12.heading: Paul’s Revelation

12.msb: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. Whether it was in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows.
12.kjv: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
12.blb: I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I do not know, or out of the body, I do not know; God knows—such a man, having been caught up to the third heaven.
12.bbe: I have knowledge of a man in Christ, fourteen years back (if he was in the body, or out of the body, I am not able to say, but God only), who was taken up to the third heaven.

12.msb: And I know that this man—whether in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows—
12.kjv: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
12.blb: And I know such a man—whether in the body or apart from the body, I do not know; God knows—
12.bbe: And I have knowledge of such a man (if he was in the body, or out of the body, I am not able to say, but God only),

12.msb: was caught up to Paradise. The things he heard were inexpressible, things that man is not permitted to tell.
12.kjv: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
12.blb: that he was caught up into Paradise, and he heard inexpressible words, not being permitted to man to speak.
12.bbe: How he was taken up into Paradise, and words came to his ears which may not be said, and which man is not able to say.

12.msb: I will boast about such a man, but I will not boast about myself, except in my weaknesses.
12.kjv: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.
12.blb: On behalf of such a man I will boast; but on behalf of myself I will not boast, except in the weaknesses.
12.bbe: On account of such a one I will have glory: for myself I will take no glory, but only in my feeble body.
12.heading: Paul’s Thorn and God’s Grace

12.msb: Even if I wanted to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so no one will credit me with more than he sees in me or hears from me,
12.kjv: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.
12.blb: For if I should want to boast, I will not be a fool, for I will be speaking the truth. But I refrain, lest anyone should reckon to me above what he sees in me or anything he hears of me,
12.bbe: For if I had a desire to take credit to myself, it would not be foolish, for I would be saying what is true: but I will not, for fear that I might seem to any man more than he sees me to be, or has word from me that I am.

12.msb: or because of these surpassingly great revelations. So to keep me from becoming conceited, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.
12.kjv: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
12.blb: and the surpassingness of the revelations. Therefore, so that I should not be over-exalted, a thorn in my flesh was given to me, a messenger of Satan, that he might buffet me, so that I should not be over-exalted.
12.bbe: And because the revelations were so very great, in order that I might not be overmuch lifted up, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, one sent from Satan to give me pain.

12.msb: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.
12.kjv: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
12.blb: Three times I entreated the Lord for this, that it might depart from me.
12.bbe: And about this thing I made request to the Lord three times that it might be taken away from me.

12.msb: But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
12.kjv: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
12.blb: And He has said to me, “My grace suffices for you, for the power is perfected in weakness.” Most gladly, therefore, rather, I will boast in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
12.bbe: And he said to me, My grace is enough for you, for my power is made complete in what is feeble. Most gladly, then, will I take pride in my feeble body, so that the power of Christ may be on me.

12.msb: That is why, for the sake of Christ, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.
12.kjv: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ’s sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
12.blb: Therefore I am well pleased in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions and difficulties—for Christ; for when I may be weak, then I am powerful.
12.bbe: So I take pleasure in being feeble, in unkind words, in needs, in cruel attacks, in troubles, on account of Christ: for when I am feeble, then am I strong.

12.msb: I have become a fool in my boasting, but you drove me to it. In fact, you should have commended me, since I am in no way inferior to those “super-apostles,” even though I am nothing.
12.kjv: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
12.blb: I have become a fool; you compelled me. For I ought to have been commended by you. For in nothing was I lacking to the “most eminent apostles,” even if I am nothing.
12.bbe: I have been forced by you to become foolish, though it was right for my praise to have come from you: for in no way was I less than the chief of the Apostles, though I am nothing.
12.heading: Paul’s Concern for the Corinthians

12.msb: The marks of a true apostle—signs, wonders, and miracles—were performed among you with great perseverance.
12.kjv: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
12.blb: Indeed, the signs of the apostle were performed among you in all perseverance, both in signs and wonders and miracles.
12.bbe: Truly the signs of an Apostle were done among you in quiet strength, with wonders and acts of power.

12.msb: In what way were you inferior to the other churches, except that I was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
12.kjv: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
12.blb: For in what is it that you were inferior beyond the rest of the churches, except that I myself did not burden you? Forgive me this wrong!
12.bbe: For what is there in which you were made less than the other churches, but in the one thing that I was not a trouble to you? Let me have forgiveness for this wrong.

12.msb: See, I am ready to come to you a third time, and I will not be a burden to you, because I am not seeking your possessions, but you. For children should not have to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.
12.kjv: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
12.blb: Behold, this third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden. For I do not seek what is yours, but you. For the children ought not to treasure up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
12.bbe: This is now the third time that I am ready to come to you; and I will not be a trouble to you: my desire is for you, not for your property: for it is not the children's business to make store for their fathers, but the fathers for the children.

12.msb: And for the sake of your souls, I will most gladly spend my money and myself, even if the more I love you, the less you love me.
12.kjv: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
12.blb: Now I will spend most gladly, and will be utterly spent for your souls. If loving you more abundantly, am I loved less?
12.bbe: And I will gladly give all I have for your souls. If I have the more love for you, am I to be loved the less?

12.msb: Be that as it may, I was not a burden to you; but crafty as I am, I caught you by trickery.
12.kjv: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
12.blb: But be it so, I did not burden you; but being crafty, I took you by trickery.
12.bbe: But let it be so, that I was not a trouble to you myself; but (someone may say) being false, I took you with deceit.

12.msb: Did I exploit you by anyone I sent you?
12.kjv: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
12.blb: By any of whom I have sent to you, did I take advantage of you by him?
12.bbe: Did I make a profit out of you by any of those whom I sent to you?

12.msb: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent our brother with him. Did Titus exploit you in any way? Did we not walk in the same Spirit and follow in the same footsteps?
12.kjv: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
12.blb: I exhorted Titus to go, and I sent with him the brother. Did Titus take advantage of you? Did we not walk in the same Spirit? Not in the same footsteps?
12.bbe: I gave orders to Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus make any profit out of you? were we not guided by the same Spirit, in the same ways?

12.msb: Do you still think that we are making a defense to you? We speak before God in Christ, and all of this, beloved, is to build you up.
12.kjv: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
12.blb: Do you think all along that we are making a defense to you? We speak in Christ before God, and all things, beloved, for your edification.
12.bbe: It may seem to you that all this time we have been attempting to put ourselves in the right; but we are saying these things before God in Christ. For all things, dear brothers, are for your profit.

12.msb: For I am afraid that when I come, I may not find you as I wish, and you may not find me as you wish. I fear that there may be quarrels, jealousies, rage, rivalry, slander, gossip, arrogance, and disorder.
12.kjv: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
12.blb: For I fear lest somehow, having come, I might not find you such as I wish, and I might be found by you such as you do not wish; lest somehow there is strife, jealousy, rage, rivalries, slander, gossip, conceit, disorder;
12.bbe: For I have a fear that, when I come, you may not be answering to my desire, and that I may not be answering to yours; that there may be fighting, hate, angry feeling, divisions, evil talk about others, secrets, thoughts of pride, outbursts against authority;

12.msb: I am afraid that when I come again, my God will humble me before you, and I will be grieved over many who have sinned earlier and have not repented of their acts of impurity, sexual immorality, and debauchery.
12.kjv: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
12.blb: lest on my having come again, my God should humble me as to you, and I should mourn many of those having before sinned and not having repented of the impurity and sexual immorality and sensuality that they have practiced.
12.bbe: And that when I come again, my God may put me to shame among you, and I may have grief for those who have done wrong before and have had no regret for their unclean ways, and for the evil desires of the flesh to which they have given way.

13.msb: This is the third time I am coming to you. “Every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.”
13.kjv: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
13.blb: This third time I am coming to you. “On the mouth of two or three witnesses every word will be established.”
13.bbe: This is the third time that I am coming to you. From the mouth of two or three witnesses will every word be made certain.
13.heading: Examine Yourselves

13.msb: I already warned you the second time I was with you. So now in my absence I write to warn those who sinned earlier and everyone else: If I return, I will not spare anyone,
13.kjv: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
13.blb: I have said before, and I say it before as being present the second time and being absent now, to those having sinned before and to all the rest, that if I come to the same again, I will not spare anyone,
13.bbe: I said before, and still say it before I come, as being present for the second time, though I am still away from you, to those who have done wrong before, and to all the others, that if I come again I will not have pity;

13.msb: since you are demanding proof that Christ is speaking through me. He is not weak in dealing with you, but is powerful among you.
13.kjv: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
13.blb: since you seek proof of Christ speaking in me, who is not weak toward you but is powerful among you.
13.bbe: Seeing that you are looking for a sign of Christ giving out his word in me; who is not feeble in relation to you, but is strong in you:

13.msb: For although He was indeed crucified in weakness, yet He lives by God’s power. For we are also weak in Him, yet by God’s power we will live with Him concerning you.
13.kjv: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
13.blb: For also He was crucified out of weakness, yet He lives out of God's power. For we also are weak in Him, but we will live with Him out of God’s power toward you.
13.bbe: For he was feeble in that he was put to death on the cross, but he is living by the power of God. And we are feeble in him, but we will be living with him through the power of God in relation to you.

13.msb: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Do you not realize that Jesus Christ is in you—unless you actually fail the test?
13.kjv: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?
13.blb: Test yourselves, whether you are in the faith; examine yourselves. Or do you not recognize yourselves that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless you are unapproved.
13.bbe: Make a test of yourselves, if you are in the faith; make certain of yourselves. Or are you not conscious in yourselves that Jesus Christ is in you, if you are truly Christ's?

13.msb: And I hope you will realize that we have not failed the test.
13.kjv: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
13.blb: And I trust that you will learn that we are not unapproved.
13.bbe: But it is my hope that you will have no doubt that we are truly Christ's.

13.msb: Now I pray to God that you will not do anything wrong—not that we will appear to have stood the test, but that you will do what is right, even if we appear to have failed.
13.kjv: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
13.blb: Now we pray to God for you to do nothing wrong, not that we might appear approved, but that you may do what is right, though we might appear as unapproved.
13.bbe: Now our prayer to God is that you may do no evil; not in order that it may be put to our credit, but so that you may do what is right, whatever we may seem.

13.msb: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.
13.kjv: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
13.blb: For we have no power against the truth, but for the truth.
13.bbe: Because we are able to do nothing against what is true, but only for it.

13.msb: In fact, we rejoice when we are weak but you are strong, and our prayer is for your perfection.
13.kjv: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
13.blb: For we rejoice when we may be weak but you may be powerful. This also we pray for: your perfection.
13.bbe: For we are glad when we are feeble and you are strong: and this is our prayer, even that you may be made complete.

13.msb: This is why I write these things while absent, so that when I am present I will not need to be severe in my use of the authority that the Lord gave me for building you up, not for tearing you down.
13.kjv: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.
13.blb: Because of this, I write these things being absent, so that being present I should not treat you severely according to the authority that the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.
13.bbe: For this cause I am writing these things while I am away, so that there may be need for me, when I am present, to make use of sharp measures, by the authority which the Lord has given me for building up and not for destruction.

13.msb: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Aim for perfect harmony, encourage one another, be of one mind, live in peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.
13.kjv: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
13.blb: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected, be exhorted, be of the same mind, be at peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.
13.bbe: Let this be my last word, brothers; be glad; be complete; be comforted; be of the same mind; be at peace with one another: and the God of love and peace will be with you.
13.heading: Benediction and Farewell

13.msb: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
13.kjv: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
13.blb: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
13.bbe: Give one another a holy kiss.

13.msb: All the saints send you greetings.
13.kjv: All the saints salute you.
13.blb: All the saints greet you.
13.bbe: All the saints send their love to you.

13.msb: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you. Amen.
13.kjv: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
13.blb: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you.
13.bbe: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the harmony of the Holy Spirit, be with you all.

1.msb: Paul, an apostle—sent not from men nor by man, but by Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised Him from the dead—
1.kjv: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
1.blb: Paul, an apostle—not from men nor through man, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father, the One having raised Him out from the dead—
1.bbe: Paul, an Apostle (not from men, and not through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who made him come back from the dead),
1.heading: Paul’s Greeting to the Galatians

1.msb: and all the brothers with me, To the churches of Galatia:
1.kjv: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
1.blb: and all the brothers with me, To the churches of Galatia:
1.bbe: And all the brothers who are with me, to the churches of Galatia:

1.msb: Grace and peace to you from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,
1.kjv: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
1.blb: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,
1.bbe: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

1.msb: who gave Himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,
1.kjv: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
1.blb: the One having given Himself for our sins so that He might rescue us out of the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,
1.bbe: Who gave himself for our sins, so that he might make us free from this present evil world, after the purpose of our God and Father:

1.msb: to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
1.kjv: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
1.blb: to whom be the glory to the ages of the ages. Amen.
1.bbe: To whom be the glory for ever and ever. So be it.

1.msb: I am amazed how quickly you are deserting the One who called you by the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel—
1.kjv: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
1.blb: I marvel that so quickly you are deserting from the One having called you in the grace of Christ to another gospel,
1.bbe: I am surprised that you are being so quickly turned away from him whose word came to you in the grace of Christ, to good news of a different sort;
1.heading: No Other Gospel

1.msb: which is not even a gospel. Evidently some people are troubling you and trying to distort the gospel of Christ.
1.kjv: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
1.blb: which is not another, except there are some who are troubling you and are wanting to pervert the gospel of Christ.
1.bbe: Which is not another sort: only there are some who give you trouble, desiring to make changes in the good news of Christ.

1.msb: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel contrary to the one we preached to you, let him be under a curse!
1.kjv: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
1.blb: But even if we or an angel out of heaven should preach a gospel to you contrary to what we preached to you, let him be accursed!
1.bbe: But even if we, or an angel from heaven, were to be a preacher to you of good news other than that which we have given you, let there be a curse on him.

1.msb: As we have said before, so now I say again: If anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be under a curse!
1.kjv: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
1.blb: As we have said before, even now I say again: If anyone preaches a gospel to you contrary to what you received, let him be accursed!
1.bbe: As we have said before, so say I now again, If any man is a preacher to you of any good news other than that which has been given to you, let there be a curse on him.

1.msb: Am I now seeking the approval of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still trying to please men, I would not be a servant of Christ.
1.kjv: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
1.blb: For presently do I appease men, or God? Or do I seek to please men? If I were still pleasing men, I would not be a servant of Christ.
1.bbe: Am I now using arguments to men, or God? or is it my desire to give men pleasure? if I was still pleasing men, I would not be a servant of Christ.
1.heading: Paul Preaches the Gospel

1.msb: But I want you to know, brothers, that the gospel I preached was not devised by man.
1.kjv: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
1.blb: For I make known to you, brothers, the gospel having been preached by me, that it is not according to man.
1.bbe: Because I say to you, my brothers, that the good news of which I was the preacher is not man's.

1.msb: I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
1.blb: For I neither received it from man, nor was I taught it, but through a revelation of Jesus Christ.
1.bbe: For I did not get it from man, and I was not given teaching in it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

1.msb: For you have heard of my former way of life in Judaism, how severely I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy it.
1.kjv: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
1.blb: For you heard of my conduct formerly in Judaism, that according to excess I was persecuting the church of God and was ravaging it.
1.bbe: For news has come to you of my way of life in the past in the Jews' religion, how I was cruel without measure to the church of God, and did great damage to it:

1.msb: I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries and was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
1.kjv: And profited in the Jews’ religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
1.blb: And I was advancing in Judaism beyond many contemporaries among my kindred, being more abundantly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
1.bbe: And I went farther in the Jews' religion than a number of my generation among my countrymen, having a more burning interest in the beliefs handed down from my fathers.

1.msb: But when God, who set me apart from my mother’s womb and called me by His grace, was pleased
1.kjv: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me by his grace,
1.blb: But when God was well pleased—the One having set me apart from the womb of my mother and having called me by His grace—
1.bbe: But when it was the good pleasure of God, by whom I was marked out even from my mother's body, through his grace,

1.msb: to reveal His Son in me so that I might preach Him among the Gentiles, I did not rush to consult with flesh and blood,
1.kjv: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
1.blb: to reveal His Son in me so that I might preach Him among the Gentiles, I conferred not immediately with flesh and blood,
1.bbe: To give the revelation of his Son in me, so that I might give the news of him to the Gentiles; then I did not take the opinion of flesh and blood,

1.msb: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to the apostles who came before me, but I went into Arabia and later returned to Damascus.
1.kjv: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
1.blb: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to the apostles before me, but I went away to Arabia and returned again to Damascus.
1.bbe: And I went not up to Jerusalem to those who were Apostles before me; but I went away into Arabia, and again I came back to Damascus.

1.msb: Only after three years did I go up to Jerusalem to confer with Peter, and I stayed with him fifteen days.
1.kjv: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
1.blb: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to make acquaintance with Cephas, and I remained with him fifteen days.
1.bbe: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Cephas, and was there with him fifteen days.

1.msb: But I saw none of the other apostles except James, the Lord’s brother.
1.kjv: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord’s brother.
1.blb: But I did not see any of the other apostles except James, the brother of the Lord.
1.bbe: But of the other Apostles I saw only James, the Lord's brother.

1.msb: I assure you before God that what I am writing to you is no lie.
1.kjv: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
1.blb: Now the things I write to you, behold before God that I do not lie.
1.bbe: Now God is witness that the things which I am writing to you are true.

1.msb: Later I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
1.kjv: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
1.blb: Then I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
1.bbe: Then I came to the parts of Syria and Cilicia.

1.msb: I was personally unknown, however, to the churches of Judea that are in Christ.
1.kjv: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
1.blb: But I was unknown by face to the churches of Judea that are in Christ.
1.bbe: And the churches of Judaea which were in Christ still had no knowledge of my face or person:

1.msb: They only heard the account: “The man who formerly persecuted us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy.”
1.kjv: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
1.blb: But they were only hearing that “the one formerly persecuting us now preaches the faith that formerly he was ravaging.”
1.bbe: Only it came to their ears that he who at one time was cruel to us is now preaching the faith which before had been attacked by him;

1.msb: And they glorified God because of me.
1.kjv: And they glorified God in me.
1.blb: And they were glorifying God in me.
1.bbe: And they gave glory to God in me.

2.msb: Fourteen years later I went up again to Jerusalem, accompanied by Barnabas. I took Titus along also.
2.kjv: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
2.blb: Then after fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, having taken along Titus also.
2.bbe: Then after the space of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus with me.
2.heading: The Council at Jerusalem

2.msb: I went in response to a revelation and set before them the gospel that I preach among the Gentiles. But I spoke privately to those recognized as leaders, for fear that I was running or had already run in vain.
2.kjv: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
2.blb: Now I went up according to a revelation, and I set before them the gospel that I proclaim among the Gentiles; but in private to those esteemed, lest somehow I might be running or had run in vain.
2.bbe: And I went up by revelation; and I put before them the good news which I was preaching among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were of good name, so that the work which I was or had been doing might not be without effect.

2.msb: Yet not even Titus, who was with me, was compelled to be circumcised, even though he was a Greek.
2.kjv: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
2.blb: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised,
2.bbe: But not even Titus who was with me, being a Greek, was made to undergo circumcision:

2.msb: This issue arose because some false brothers had come in under false pretenses to spy on our freedom in Christ Jesus, in order to enslave us.
2.kjv: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
2.blb: even because of the false brothers introduced stealthily, who came in stealthily to spy on our freedom that we have in Christ Jesus, so that they will enslave us,
2.bbe: And that because of the false brothers let in secretly, who came searching out our free condition which we have in Christ Jesus, so that they might make servants of us;

2.msb: We did not give in to them for a moment, so that the truth of the gospel would remain with you.
2.kjv: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
2.blb: to whom we did not yield in submission for even an hour, so that the truth of the gospel might remain with you.
2.bbe: To whom we gave way not even for an hour; so that the true words of the good news might still be with you.

2.msb: But as for the highly esteemed—whatever they were makes no difference to me; God does not show favoritism—those leaders added nothing to me.
2.kjv: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man’s person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
2.blb: Now of those being esteemed to be something, whatever they were formerly makes no difference to me—God does not accept the face of man——for those being esteemed imparted nothing to me.
2.bbe: But from those who seemed to be important (whatever they were has no weight with me: God does not take man's person into account): those who seemed to be important gave nothing new to me;

2.msb: On the contrary, they saw that I had been entrusted to preach the gospel to the uncircumcised, just as Peter had been to the circumcised.
2.kjv: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;
2.blb: But on the contrary, having seen that I have been entrusted with the gospel of the uncircumcision just as Peter of the circumcision—
2.bbe: But, quite the opposite, when they saw that I had been made responsible for preaching the good news to those without circumcision, even as Peter had been for those of the circumcision

2.msb: For the One who was at work in Peter’s apostleship to the circumcised was also at work in my apostleship to the Gentiles.
2.kjv: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)
2.blb: for the One having worked in Peter for an apostleship of the circumcision worked also in me for the Gentiles—
2.bbe: (Because he who was working in Peter as the Apostle of the circumcision was working no less in me among the Gentiles);

2.msb: And recognizing the grace that I had been given, James, Cephas, and John—those reputed to be pillars—gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, so that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcised.
2.kjv: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
2.blb: and having known the grace having been given to me, James and Cephas and John, those esteemed to be pillars, gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship, that we are unto the Gentiles, but they unto the circumcision,
2.bbe: When they saw the grace which was given to me, James and Cephas and John, who had the name of being pillars, gave to me and Barnabas their right hands as friends so that we might go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision;

2.msb: They only asked us to remember the poor, the very thing I was eager to do.
2.kjv: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.
2.blb: only that we should remember the poor, also the same thing that I was eager to do.
2.bbe: Only it was their desire that we would give thought to the poor; which very thing I had much in mind to do.

2.msb: When Peter came to Antioch, however, I opposed him to his face, because he stood condemned.
2.kjv: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
2.blb: But when Cephas came to Antioch, I opposed him to his face because he was standing condemned.
2.bbe: But when Cephas came to Antioch, I made a protest against him to his face, because he was clearly in the wrong.
2.heading: Paul Confronts Cephas

2.msb: For before certain men came from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles. But when they arrived, he began to draw back and separate himself, for fear of those in the circumcision group.
2.kjv: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.
2.blb: For before certain ones came from James, he was eating with the Gentiles. But when they came, he was drawing back and was separating himself, fearing those of the circumcision.
2.bbe: For before certain men came from James, he did take food with the Gentiles: but when they came, he went back and made himself separate, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

2.msb: The other Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that by their hypocrisy even Barnabas was led astray.
2.kjv: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
2.blb: And also the rest of the Jews acted hypocritically with him, so that even Barnabas was carried away by their hypocrisy.
2.bbe: And the rest of the Jews went after him, so that even Barnabas was overcome by their false ways.

2.msb: When I saw that they were not walking in line with the truth of the gospel, I said to Peter in front of them all, “If you, who are a Jew, live like a Gentile and not like a Jew, how can you compel the Gentiles to live like Jews?”
2.kjv: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
2.blb: But when I saw that they are not walking in line with the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas before all, “If you, being a Jew, live like a Gentile and not like a Jew, how do you compel the Gentiles to Judaize?”
2.bbe: But when I saw that they were not living uprightly in agreement with the true words of the good news, I said to Cephas before them all, If you, being a Jew, are living like the Gentiles, and not like the Jews, how will you make the Gentiles do the same as the Jews?

2.msb: We who are Jews by birth and not Gentile “sinners”
2.kjv: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
2.blb: We by nature Jews and not “sinners of the Gentiles,”
2.bbe: We being Jews by birth, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

2.msb: know that a man is not justified by works of the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ. So we, too, have believed in Christ Jesus, that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the law, because by works of the law no one will be justified.
2.kjv: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
2.blb: are knowing now that a man is not justified by works of the law, except through faith from Jesus Christ. We also believed in Christ Jesus, that we may be justified by faith from Christ and not by works of the law, because by works of the law not any flesh will be justified.
2.bbe: Being conscious that a man does not get righteousness by the works of the law, but through faith in Jesus Christ, we had faith in Christ Jesus, so that we might get righteousness by faith in Christ, and not by the works of the law: because by the works of the law will no flesh get righteousness.

2.msb: But if, while we seek to be justified in Christ, we ourselves are found to be sinners, does that make Christ a minister of sin? Certainly not!
2.kjv: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.
2.blb: But if, seeking to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ then a minister of sin? Never may it be!
2.bbe: But if, while we were desiring to get righteousness through Christ, we ourselves were seen to be sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? In no way!

2.msb: If I rebuild what I have already torn down, I prove myself to be a lawbreaker.
2.kjv: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
2.blb: For if I build again these things that I tore down, I prove myself a transgressor.
2.bbe: For if I put up again those things which I gave to destruction, I am seen to be a wrongdoer.

2.msb: For through the law I died to the law so that I might live to God.
2.kjv: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.
2.blb: For through the law I died to the law so that I might live to God.
2.bbe: For I, through the law, have become dead to the law, so that I might be living to God.

2.msb: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.
2.kjv: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
2.blb: I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. And that which I now live in the flesh, I live in faith of the Son of God, the One having loved me and having given up Himself for me.
2.bbe: I have been put to death on the cross with Christ; still I am living; no longer I, but Christ is living in me; and that life which I now am living in the flesh I am living by faith, the faith of the Son of God, who in love for me, gave himself up for me.

2.msb: I do not set aside the grace of God. For if righteousness comes through the law, then Christ died for nothing.
2.kjv: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
2.blb: I do not set aside the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing.
2.bbe: I do not make the grace of God of no effect: because if righteousness is through the law, then Christ was put to death for nothing.

3.msb: O foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched you not to obey the truth? Before your very eyes Jesus Christ was clearly portrayed among you as crucified.
3.kjv: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
3.blb: O foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched you, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was previously written as having been crucified?
3.bbe: O foolish Galatians, by what strange powers have you been tricked, to whom it was made clear that Jesus Christ was put to death on the cross?
3.heading: Faith and Belief

3.msb: I would like to learn just one thing from you: Did you receive the Spirit by works of the law, or by hearing with faith?
3.kjv: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
3.blb: I want only to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit out of works of the law or out of hearing of faith?
3.bbe: Give me an answer to this one question, Did the Spirit come to you through the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

3.msb: Are you so foolish? After starting in the Spirit, are you now finishing in the flesh?
3.kjv: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
3.blb: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now finishing in the flesh?
3.bbe: Are you so foolish? having made a start in the Spirit, will you now be made complete in the flesh?

3.msb: Have you suffered so much for nothing, if it really was for nothing?
3.kjv: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
3.blb: Did you suffer so much in vain, if indeed even in vain?
3.bbe: Did you undergo such a number of things to no purpose? if it is in fact to no purpose.

3.msb: Does God lavish His Spirit on you and work miracles among you because you practice the law, or because you hear and believe?
3.kjv: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
3.blb: Therefore, the One supplying to you the Spirit and working miracles among you, is it out of works of the law, or out of hearing of faith—
3.bbe: He who gives you the Spirit, and does works of power among you, is it by the works of law, or by the hearing of faith?

3.msb: So also, “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.”
3.kjv: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
3.blb: just as, “Abraham believed God and it was reckoned to him for righteousness”?
3.bbe: Even as Abraham had faith in God, and it was put to his account as righteousness.

3.msb: Understand, then, that those who have faith are sons of Abraham.
3.kjv: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
3.blb: Know, then, that those of faith, these are sons of Abraham.
3.bbe: Be certain, then, that those who are of faith, the same are sons of Abraham.

3.msb: The Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, and foretold the gospel to Abraham: “All nations will be blessed through you.”
3.kjv: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
3.blb: Now the Scripture, having foreseen that God justifies the Gentiles by faith, proclaimed the gospel beforehand to Abraham: “All the nations will be blessed in you.”
3.bbe: And the holy Writings, seeing before the event that God would give the Gentiles righteousness by faith, gave the good news before to Abraham, saying, In you will all the nations have a blessing.

3.msb: So those who have faith are blessed along with Abraham, the man of faith.
3.kjv: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
3.blb: So then, those of faith are blessed along with the faithful Abraham.
3.bbe: So then those who are of faith have a part in the blessing of Abraham who was full of faith.

3.msb: All who rely on works of the law are under a curse. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the Book of the Law.”
3.kjv: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
3.blb: For as many as are of works of the law, they are under a curse, for it has been written: “Cursed is everyone who does not continue in all things having been written in the Book of the Law, to do them.”
3.bbe: For all who are of the works of the law are under a curse: because it is said in the Writings, A curse is on everyone who does not keep on doing all the things which are ordered in the book of the law.
3.heading: Christ Has Redeemed Us

3.msb: Now it is clear that no one is justified before God by the law, because, “The righteous will live by faith.”
3.kjv: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
3.blb: Now it is evident that no one is justified before God in the law, because, “The righteous will live out of faith.”
3.bbe: Now that no man gets righteousness by the law in the eyes of God, is clear; because, The upright will be living by faith.

3.msb: The law, however, is not based on faith; on the contrary, “The man who does these things will live by them.”
3.kjv: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
3.blb: But the law is not out of faith; rather, “The one having done these things will live in them.”
3.bbe: And the law is not of faith; but, He who does them will have life by them.

3.msb: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree.”
3.kjv: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
3.blb: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us—for it has been written: “Cursed is everyone hanging on a tree,”
3.bbe: Christ has made us free from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us: because it is said in the Writings, A curse on everyone who is put to death by hanging on a tree:

3.msb: He redeemed us in order that the blessing promised to Abraham would come to the Gentiles in Christ Jesus, so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit.
3.kjv: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
3.blb: so that the blessing of Abraham might come to the Gentiles in Christ Jesus, so that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
3.bbe: So that on the Gentiles might come the blessing of Abraham in Christ Jesus; in order that we through faith might have the Spirit which God had undertaken to give.

3.msb: Brothers, let me put this in human terms. Even a human covenant, once it is ratified, cannot be canceled or amended.
3.kjv: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man’s covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
3.blb: Brothers, I am speaking according to man. Even a covenant of man having been ratified, no one sets it aside or adds thereto.
3.bbe: Brothers, as men would say, even a man's agreement, when it has been made certain, may not be put on one side, or have additions made to it.
3.heading: The Purpose of the Law

3.msb: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. The Scripture does not say, “and to seeds,” meaning many, but “and to your seed,” meaning One, who is Christ.
3.kjv: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
3.blb: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. It does not say “and to seeds,” as of many, but as of One, “and to your seed,” who is Christ.
3.bbe: Now to Abraham were the undertakings given, and to his seed. He says not, And to seeds, as of a great number; but as of one, he says, And to your seed, which is Christ.

3.msb: What I mean is this: The law that came 430 years later does not revoke the covenant previously established by God in Christ, so as to nullify the promise.
3.kjv: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
3.blb: Now I say this: The law, having come four hundred and thirty years afterward, does not repeal the covenant having been ratified beforehand by God, so as to nullify the promise.
3.bbe: Now this I say: The law, which came four hundred and thirty years after, does not put an end to the agreement made before by God, so as to make the undertaking without effect.

3.msb: For if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on a promise; but God freely granted it to Abraham through a promise.
3.kjv: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
3.blb: For if the inheritance is by the law, it is no longer by a promise. But God has granted it to Abraham through a promise.
3.bbe: Because if the heritage is by the law, it is no longer dependent on the word of God; but God gave it to Abraham by his word.

3.msb: Why then was the law given? It was added because of transgressions, until the arrival of the seed to whom the promise referred. It was administered through angels by a mediator.
3.kjv: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
3.blb: Why then the law? It was added on account of transgressions, until the seed to whom promise has been made shall have come, having been ordained through angels in the hand of a mediator.
3.bbe: What then is the law? It was an addition made because of sin, till the coming of the seed to whom the undertaking had been given; and it was ordered through angels by the hand of a go-between.

3.msb: A mediator is unnecessary, however, for only one party; but God is one.
3.kjv: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
3.blb: Now the mediator is not of one; but God is one.
3.bbe: Now a go-between is not a go-between of one; but God is one.

3.msb: Is the law, then, opposed to the promises of God? Certainly not! For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come from the law.
3.kjv: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
3.blb: Is the law, therefore, contrary to the promises of God? Never may it be! For if a law were given being able to make alive, then righteousness indeed would have been from out of the law.
3.bbe: Is the law then against the words of God? in no way; because if there had been a law which was able to give life, truly righteousness would have been by the law.

3.msb: But the Scripture pronounces all things confined by sin, so that by faith in Jesus Christ the promise might be given to those who believe.
3.kjv: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
3.blb: But the Scripture shut in all things under sin, so that by faith from Jesus Christ the promise might be given to those believing.
3.bbe: However, the holy Writings have put all things under sin, so that that for which God gave the undertaking, based on faith in Jesus Christ, might be given to those who have such faith.

3.msb: Before this faith came, we were held in custody under the law, locked up until faith should be revealed.
3.kjv: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
3.blb: Now before the faith came, we were being held in custody under the law, having been shut in until the faith being about to be revealed,
3.bbe: But before faith came, we were kept in prison under the law, waiting for the revelation of the faith which was to come.

3.msb: So the law became our guardian to lead us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
3.kjv: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
3.blb: so that the law has become our tutor unto Christ, so that we might be justified by faith.
3.bbe: So the law has been a servant to take us to Christ, so that we might have righteousness by faith.

3.msb: Now that faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian.
3.kjv: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
3.blb: And faith having come, we are no longer under a tutor.
3.bbe: But now that faith is come, we are no longer under a servant.

3.msb: You are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
3.kjv: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
3.blb: For you are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
3.bbe: Because you are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
3.heading: Sons through Faith in Christ

3.msb: For all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.
3.kjv: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
3.blb: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ, you put on Christ.
3.bbe: For all those of you who were given baptism into Christ did put on Christ.

3.msb: There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
3.kjv: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
3.blb: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free, there is neither male and female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
3.bbe: There is no Jew or Greek, servant or free, male or female: because you are all one in Jesus Christ.

3.msb: And if you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s seed and heirs according to the promise.
3.kjv: And if ye be Christ’s, then are ye Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.
3.blb: Now if you are of Christ, then you are Abraham’s seed, heirs according to promise.
3.bbe: And if you are Christ's, then you are Abraham's seed, and yours is the heritage by the right of God's undertaking given to Abraham.

4.msb: What I am saying is that as long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a slave, although he is the owner of everything.
4.kjv: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
4.blb: Now I say, for as long a time as the heir is a child, he differs nothing from a slave, though being lord of all.
4.bbe: But I say that as long as the son is a child, he is in no way different from a servant, though he is lord of all;
4.heading: Sons and Heirs

4.msb: He is subject to guardians and trustees until the date set by his father.
4.kjv: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
4.blb: But he is under guardians and managers until the appointed time of the father.
4.bbe: But is under keepers and managers till the time fixed by the father.

4.msb: So also, when we were children, we were enslaved under the basic principles of the world.
4.kjv: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
4.blb: So also we, when we were children, were enslaved under the elements of the world.
4.bbe: So we, when we were young, were kept under the first rules of the world;

4.msb: But when the time had fully come, God sent His Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
4.kjv: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
4.blb: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent forth His Son, having been born of a woman, having been born under the law,
4.bbe: But when the time had come, God sent out his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

4.msb: to redeem those under the law, that we might receive our adoption as sons.
4.kjv: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
4.blb: that He might redeem those under the law, that we might receive the adoption as sons.
4.bbe: That he might make them free who were under the law, and that we might be given the place of sons.

4.msb: And because you are sons, God sent the Spirit of His Son into your hearts, crying out, “Abba, Father!”
4.kjv: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
4.blb: And because you are sons, God sent forth the Spirit of His Son into our hearts, crying out, “Abba, Father!”
4.bbe: And because you are sons, God has sent out the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, saying, Abba, Father.

4.msb: So you are no longer a slave, but a son; and since you are a son, you are also an heir of God through Christ.
4.kjv: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
4.blb: So you are no longer a slave but a son; and if a son, also an heir through God.
4.bbe: So that you are no longer a servant, but a son; and if a son, then the heritage of God is yours.

4.msb: Formerly, when you did not know God, you were slaves to those who by nature are not gods.
4.kjv: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
4.blb: But then, indeed, not knowing God, you were in slavery to those by nature not being gods.
4.bbe: But at that time, having no knowledge of God, you were servants to those who by right are no gods:
4.heading: Paul’s Concern for the Galatians

4.msb: But now that you know God, or rather are known by God, how is it that you are turning back to those weak and worthless principles? Do you wish to be enslaved by them all over again?
4.kjv: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?
4.blb: But now, having known God, but rather having been known by God, how do you turn again to the weak and poor elements, to which you want to be in slavery again anew?
4.bbe: But now that you have come to have knowledge of God, or more truly, God has knowledge of you, how is it that you go back again to the poor and feeble first things, desiring to be servants to them again?

4.msb: You are observing special days and months and seasons and years!
4.kjv: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
4.blb: You observe days and months and seasons and years!
4.bbe: You keep days, and months, and fixed times, and years.

4.msb: I fear for you, that my efforts for you may have been in vain.
4.kjv: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.
4.blb: I fear for you, lest somehow I have toiled for you in vain.
4.bbe: I am in fear of you, that I may have been working for you to no purpose.

4.msb: I beg you, brothers, become like me, for I became like you. You have done me no wrong.
4.kjv: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.
4.blb: I implore you, brothers, become as I am, because I also am as you. You wronged me in nothing.
4.bbe: My desire for you, brothers, is that you may be as I am, because I am as you are. You have done me no wrong;

4.msb: You know that it was because of an illness that I first preached the gospel to you.
4.kjv: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
4.blb: Now you know that in weakness of the flesh I preached the gospel to you the first time.
