4.bbe: But you have knowledge that with a feeble body I was preaching the good news to you the first time;

4.msb: And although my illness was a trial to me, you did not despise or reject me. Instead, you welcomed me as if I were an angel of God, as if I were Christ Jesus Himself.
4.kjv: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
4.blb: And the test of you in my flesh, you did not despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, as Christ Jesus.
4.bbe: And you did not have a poor opinion of me because of the trouble in my flesh, or put shame on it; but you took me to your hearts as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

4.msb: What then has become of your blessing? For I can testify that, if it were possible, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me.
4.kjv: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
4.blb: Where then is your blessedness? For I testify to you that, if possible, having gouged out your eyes, you would have given them to me.
4.bbe: Where then is that happy condition of yours? because I give you witness, that, if possible, you would have taken out your eyes and given them to me.

4.msb: Have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?
4.kjv: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
4.blb: So have I become your enemy speaking truth to you?
4.bbe: So then am I no longer your friend, because I give you true words?

4.msb: Those people are zealous for you, but not in a good way. Instead, they want to isolate you from us, so that you may be zealous for them.
4.kjv: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.
4.blb: They are zealous for you, not nobly, but they want to exclude you from us, so that you may be zealous for them.
4.bbe: Their interest in you is not good; but their desire is that you may be shut out, so that you may go after them.

4.msb: Nevertheless, it is good to be zealous if it serves a noble purpose—at any time, and not only when I am with you.
4.kjv: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
4.blb: Now it is good to be zealous in a good thing, always and not only in my being present with you.
4.bbe: But it is good to have an interest in a good cause at all times, and not only when I am present with you.

4.msb: My little children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is formed in you,
4.kjv: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
4.blb: My children, of whom I travail again until that Christ shall have been formed in you,
4.bbe: My children, of whom I am again in birth-pains till Christ is formed in you,

4.msb: how I wish I could be with you now and change my tone, because I am perplexed about you.
4.kjv: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.
4.blb: I was wishing indeed to be present with you now and to change my tone, because I am perplexed as to you.
4.bbe: Truly my desire is to be present with you now, using a changed voice; for I am troubled about you.

4.msb: Tell me, you who want to be under the law, do you not understand what the law says?
4.kjv: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
4.blb: Tell me, those wanting to be under the law, do you not listen to the law?
4.bbe: Say, you whose desire it is to be under the law, do you not give ear to the law?
4.heading: Hagar and Sarah

4.msb: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.
4.kjv: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
4.blb: For it has been written that Abraham had two sons, one of the slave woman and one of the free woman.
4.bbe: Because it is in the Writings, that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant-woman, and one by the free woman.

4.msb: His son by the slave woman was born according to the flesh, but his son by the free woman was born through the promise.
4.kjv: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
4.blb: But indeed, the one of the slave woman has been born according to flesh, but the one of the free woman through the promise,
4.bbe: Now the son by the servant-woman has his birth after the flesh; but the son by the free woman has his birth through the undertaking of God.

4.msb: These things serve as illustrations, for the women represent two covenants. One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children into slavery: This is Hagar.
4.kjv: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
4.blb: which things are allegorized, for these are two covenants: one indeed from Mount Sinai begetting unto slavery, which is Hagar.
4.bbe: Which things have a secret sense; because these women are the two agreements; one from the mountain of Sinai, giving birth to servants, which is Hagar.

4.msb: For Hagar stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present-day Jerusalem, and she is in slavery with her children.
4.kjv: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
4.blb: Now Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present Jerusalem, for she is in slavery with her children.
4.bbe: Now this Hagar is the mountain Sinai in Arabia, and is the image of the Jerusalem which now is: which is a servant with her children.

4.msb: But the Jerusalem above is free, and she is the mother of us all.
4.kjv: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
4.blb: But the Jerusalem above is free, who is our mother.
4.bbe: But the Jerusalem on high is free, which is our mother.

4.msb: For it is written: “Rejoice, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth and cry aloud, you who have never travailed; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband.”
4.kjv: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.
4.blb: For it has been written: “Rejoice O barren woman, the one not bearing; break forth and cry out, the one not travailing; because many more are the children of the desolate woman than of her having the husband.”
4.bbe: For it is in the Writings, You who have never given birth, be glad; give cries of joy, you who have had no birth-pains; for the children of her who has been given up by her husband are more than those of the woman who has a husband.

4.msb: Now we, brothers, like Isaac, are children of promise.
4.kjv: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
4.blb: Now you, brothers, like Isaac, are children of promise.
4.bbe: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are the children of the undertaking of God.

4.msb: At that time, however, the son born by the flesh persecuted the son born by the Spirit. It is the same now.
4.kjv: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
4.blb: But just as then the one having been born according to flesh was persecuting the one born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.
4.bbe: But as in those days he who had birth after the flesh was cruel to him who had birth after the Spirit, even so it is now.

4.msb: But what does the Scripture say? “Expel the slave woman and her son, for the slave woman’s son will never share in the inheritance with the free woman’s son.”
4.kjv: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.
4.blb: But what does the Scripture say? “Cast out the slave woman and her son, for the son of the slave woman will never inherit with the son of the free woman.”
4.bbe: What then do the Writings say? Send away the servant-woman and her son; for the son of the servant-woman will not have a part in the heritage with the son of the free woman.

4.msb: Therefore, brothers, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman.
4.kjv: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
4.blb: Therefore, brothers, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman.
4.bbe: So, brothers, we are not children of the servant-woman, but of the free woman.

5.msb: In the freedom with which Christ has set us free, stand firm, then, and do not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery.
5.kjv: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
5.blb: In freedom Christ set us free. Stand firm, therefore, and do not be entangled again in a yoke of slavery.
5.bbe: Christ has truly made us free: then keep your free condition and let no man put a yoke on you again.
5.heading: Freedom in Christ

5.msb: Take notice: I, Paul, tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no value to you at all.
5.kjv: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
5.blb: Behold, I, Paul, say to you that if you may become circumcised, Christ will profit you nothing.
5.bbe: See, I Paul say to you, that if you undergo circumcision, Christ will be of no use to you.

5.msb: Again I testify to every man who gets himself circumcised that he is obligated to obey the whole law.
5.kjv: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
5.blb: Now I testify again to every man becoming circumcised that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
5.bbe: Yes, I give witness again to every man who undergoes circumcision, that he will have to keep all the law.

5.msb: You who are trying to be justified by the law have been severed from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.
5.kjv: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
5.blb: You were severed from Christ, whoever are being justified in the law; you fell away from grace.
5.bbe: You are cut off from Christ, you who would have righteousness by the law; you are turned away from grace.

5.msb: But by faith we eagerly await through the Spirit the hope of righteousness.
5.kjv: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
5.blb: For through the Spirit, by faith, we eagerly await the hope of righteousness.
5.bbe: For we through the Spirit by faith are waiting for the hope of righteousness.

5.msb: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value. All that matters is faith expressing itself through love.
5.kjv: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
5.blb: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any power, but faith working through love.
5.bbe: Because in Christ Jesus, having circumcision or not having circumcision are equally of no profit; but only faith working through love.

5.msb: You were running so well. Who has obstructed you from obeying the truth?
5.kjv: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?
5.blb: You were running well. Who obstructed you not to obey the truth?
5.bbe: You were going on well; who was the cause of your not giving ear to what is true?

5.msb: Such persuasion does not come from the One who calls you.
5.kjv: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
5.blb: This persuasion is not of the One calling you.
5.bbe: This ready belief did not come from him who had made you his.

5.msb: A little leaven works through the whole batch of dough.
5.kjv: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
5.blb: A little leaven leavens the whole lump.
5.bbe: A little leaven makes a change in all the mass.

5.msb: I am confident in the Lord that you will take no other view. The one who is troubling you will bear the judgment, whoever he may be.
5.kjv: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
5.blb: I am confident as to you in the Lord that you will have no other mind. But the one troubling you will bear the judgment, whoever he might be.
5.bbe: I am certain about you in the Lord, that you will be of no other mind; but he who is troubling you will have his punishment, whoever he is.

5.msb: Now, brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? In that case the offense of the cross has been abolished.
5.kjv: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
5.blb: Now, brothers, if I still proclaim circumcision, why still am I persecuted? Then the offense of the cross has been nullified.
5.bbe: But I, brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still attacked? then has the shame of the cross been taken away.

5.msb: As for those who are agitating you, I wish they would proceed to emasculate themselves!
5.kjv: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
5.blb: I wish those upsetting you also will cut themselves off!
5.bbe: My desire is that they who give you trouble might even be cut off themselves.

5.msb: For you, brothers, were called to freedom; but do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh. Rather, serve one another in love.
5.kjv: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
5.blb: For you were called to freedom, brothers, only not the freedom for an opportunity to the flesh. But serve one another through love.
5.bbe: Because you, brothers, were marked out to be free; only do not make use of your free condition to give the flesh its chance, but through love be servants one to another.

5.msb: The entire law is fulfilled in a single decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
5.kjv: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
5.blb: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
5.bbe: For all the law is made complete in one word, even in this, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself.

5.msb: But if you keep on biting and devouring one another, watch out, or you will be consumed by one another.
5.kjv: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
5.blb: But if you bite and devour one another, watch out, lest you might be consumed by one another.
5.bbe: But if you are given to fighting with one another, take care that you are not the cause of destruction one to another.

5.msb: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.
5.kjv: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
5.blb: Now I say, walk by the Spirit, and you shall never complete the desire of the flesh.
5.bbe: But I say, Go on in the Spirit, and you will not come under the rule of the evil desires of the flesh.
5.heading: Walking by the Spirit

5.msb: For the flesh craves what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are opposed to each other, so that you do not do what you want.
5.kjv: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
5.blb: For the flesh desires against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh. For these are opposed to one another so that the things you may want, these things you may not do.
5.bbe: For the flesh has desires against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; because these are opposite the one to the other; so that you may not do the things which you have a mind to do.

5.msb: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
5.kjv: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
5.blb: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
5.bbe: But if you are guided by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

5.msb: The acts of the flesh are obvious: adultery, sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery;
5.kjv: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
5.blb: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are sexual immorality, impurity, sensuality,
5.bbe: Now the works of the flesh are clear, which are these: evil desire, unclean things, wrong use of the senses,

5.msb: idolatry and sorcery; hostilities, quarrels, jealousies, and rage; rivalries, divisions, factions,
5.kjv: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
5.blb: idolatry, sorcery, hostilities, strife, jealousy, outbursts of rage, rivalries, dissensions, factions,
5.bbe: Worship of images, use of strange powers, hates, fighting, desire for what another has, angry feelings, attempts to get the better of others, divisions, false teachings,

5.msb: envy, and murders; drunkenness, orgies, and the like. I warn you, as I did before, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
5.kjv: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
5.blb: envies, drunkennesses, carousings, and things like these, as to which I say to you beforehand, as also I said before, that those doing such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
5.bbe: Envy, uncontrolled drinking and feasting, and such things: of which I give you word clearly, even as I did in the past, that they who do such things will have no part in the kingdom of God.

5.msb: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
5.kjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
5.blb: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
5.bbe: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, a quiet mind, kind acts, well-doing, faith,

5.msb: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
5.kjv: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
5.blb: gentleness, self-control. Against such things there is no law.
5.bbe: Gentle behaviour, control over desires: against such there is no law.

5.msb: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
5.kjv: And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
5.blb: Now those of Christ Jesus crucified the flesh with the passions and the desires.
5.bbe: And those who are Christ's have put to death on the cross the flesh with its passions and its evil desires.

5.msb: Since we live by the Spirit, let us walk in step with the Spirit.
5.kjv: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
5.blb: If we live by the Spirit, we should also walk by the Spirit.
5.bbe: If we are living by the Spirit, by the Spirit let us be guided.

5.msb: Let us not become conceited, provoking and envying one another.
5.kjv: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
5.blb: We should not become conceited, provoking one another, envying one another.
5.bbe: Let us not be full of self-glory, making one another angry, having envy of one another.

6.msb: Brothers, if someone is caught in a trespass, you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness. But watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.
6.kjv: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
6.blb: Brothers, even if a man should be overtaken in some trespass, you the spiritual ones, restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking at yourself, lest you also be tempted.
6.bbe: Brothers, if a man is taken in any wrongdoing, you who are of the Spirit will put such a one right in a spirit of love; keeping watch on yourself, for fear that you yourself may be tested.
6.heading: Carry One Another’s Burdens

6.msb: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
6.kjv: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
6.blb: Bear one another’s burdens and thus you will fulfill the law of Christ.
6.bbe: Take on yourselves one another's troubles, and so keep the law of Christ.

6.msb: If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
6.kjv: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
6.blb: For if anyone thinks himself to be something being nothing, he deceives himself.
6.bbe: For if a man has an idea that he is something when he is nothing, he is tricked by himself.

6.msb: Each one should test his own work. Then he will have reason to boast in himself alone, and not in someone else.
6.kjv: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
6.blb: But let each test his own work, and then he will have boasting in regard to himself alone, and not in regard to another.
6.bbe: But let every man make test of his work, and then will his cause for glory be in himself only, and not in his neighbour.

6.msb: For each one should carry his own load.
6.kjv: For every man shall bear his own burden.
6.blb: For each will bear his own load.
6.bbe: Because every man is responsible for his part of the work.

6.msb: Nevertheless, the one who receives instruction in the word must share in all good things with his instructor.
6.kjv: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
6.blb: Now let the one being instructed in the word share with the one instructing in all good things.
6.bbe: But let him who gets teaching in the word give a part in all good things to his teacher.

6.msb: Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.
6.kjv: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
6.blb: Do not be led astray: God is not mocked. For whatever a man may sow, this also he will reap.
6.bbe: Be not tricked; God is not made sport of: for whatever seed a man puts in, that will he get back as grain.

6.msb: The one who sows to please his flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction; but the one who sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.
6.kjv: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
6.blb: For the one sowing to his flesh, from the flesh will reap corruption; but the one sowing to the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.
6.bbe: Because he who puts in the seed of the flesh will of the flesh get the reward of death; but he who puts in the seed of the Spirit will of the Spirit get the reward of eternal life.

6.msb: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
6.kjv: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
6.blb: And we should not grow fainthearted in doing good, for in due time we will reap, not giving up.
6.bbe: And let us not get tired of well-doing; for at the right time we will get in the grain, if we do not give way to weariness.

6.msb: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.
6.kjv: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
6.blb: So then, as we have opportunity, we should work good toward all, and especially toward those of the household of the faith.
6.bbe: So then, as we have the chance, let us do good to all men, and specially to those who are of the family of the faith.

6.msb: See what large letters I am using to write to you with my own hand!
6.kjv: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
6.blb: See what large letters I have written to you with my own hand!
6.bbe: See the size of the handwriting which I myself have made use of in writing to you.
6.heading: Final Warnings and Blessings

6.msb: Those who want to make a good impression outwardly are trying to compel you to be circumcised. They only do this to avoid persecution for the cross of Christ.
6.kjv: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
6.blb: As many as want to have a fair appearance in the flesh, these compel you to be circumcised, only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
6.bbe: Those who have the desire to seem important in the flesh, put force on you to undergo circumcision; only that they may not be attacked because of the cross of Christ.

6.msb: For the circumcised do not even keep the law themselves, yet they want you to be circumcised that they may boast in your flesh.
6.kjv: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
6.blb: For not even those being circumcised keep the law themselves, but they want you to be circumcised that they may boast in your flesh.
6.bbe: Because even those who undergo circumcision do not themselves keep the law; but they would have you undergo circumcision, so that they may have glory in your flesh.

6.msb: But as for me, may I never boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
6.kjv: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
6.blb: But for me, may it be never to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
6.bbe: But far be it from me to have glory in anything, but only in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which this world has come to an end on the cross for me, and I for it.

6.msb: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything. What counts is a new creation.
6.kjv: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
6.blb: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision is anything, but a new creation.
6.bbe: For having circumcision is nothing, and not having circumcision is nothing, but only a new order of existence.

6.msb: Peace and mercy to all who walk by this rule, even to the Israel of God.
6.kjv: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
6.blb: And as many as those who will walk by this rule, peace and mercy be upon them, and upon the Israel of God.
6.bbe: And on all who are guided by this rule be peace and mercy, and on the Israel of God.

6.msb: From now on let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
6.kjv: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
6.blb: Henceforth, let no one cause to me troubles, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.
6.bbe: From this time on let no man be a trouble to me; because my body is marked with the marks of Jesus.

6.msb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
6.kjv: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
6.blb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
6.bbe: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. So be it.

1.msb: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, To the saints in Ephesus, the faithful in Christ Jesus:
1.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
1.blb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, To the saints being in Ephesus, and faithful in Christ Jesus:
1.bbe: Paul, an Apostle of Christ Jesus by the purpose of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and those who have faith in Christ Jesus:
1.heading: Paul’s Greeting to the Ephesians

1.msb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.blb: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.bbe: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.msb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.
1.kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
1.blb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the One having blessed us with every spiritual blessing in Christ in the heavenly realms,
1.bbe: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has given us every blessing of the Spirit in the heavens in Christ:
1.heading: Spiritual Blessings

1.msb: For He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless in His presence. In love
1.kjv: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
1.blb: just as He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world for us to be holy and blameless before Him, in love
1.bbe: Even as he made selection of us in him from the first, so that we might be holy and free from all evil before him in love:

1.msb: He predestined us for adoption as His sons through Jesus Christ, according to the good pleasure of His will,
1.kjv: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
1.blb: having predestined us to adoption as sons through Jesus Christ to Himself, according to the good pleasure of His will,
1.bbe: As we were designed before by him for the position of sons to himself, through Jesus Christ, in the good pleasure of his purpose,

1.msb: to the praise of His glorious grace, by which He has bestowed favor upon us in the Beloved One.
1.kjv: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
1.blb: to the praise of the glory of His grace, which He graciously gave us in the Beloved One,
1.bbe: To the praise of the glory of his grace, which he freely gave to us in the Loved One:

1.msb: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace
1.kjv: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
1.blb: in whom we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of trespasses, according to the riches of His grace,
1.bbe: In whom we have salvation through his blood, the forgiveness of our sins, through the wealth of his grace,

1.msb: that He lavished on us with all wisdom and understanding.
1.kjv: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
1.blb: which He abounded to us in all wisdom and understanding,
1.bbe: Which he gave us in full measure in all wisdom and care;

1.msb: And He has made known to us the mystery of His will according to His good pleasure, which He purposed in Christ
1.kjv: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
1.blb: having made known to us the mystery of His will according to His good pleasure, which He purposed in Him
1.bbe: Having made clear to us the secret of his purpose, in agreement with the design which he had in mind, to put into his hands

1.msb: as a plan for the fullness of time, to bring all things in heaven and on earth together in Christ.
1.kjv: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:
1.blb: for the administration of the fullness of the times, to bring together all things in Christ—the things in the heavens and the things upon the earth—
1.bbe: The ordering of the times when they are complete, so that all things might come to a head in Christ, the things in heaven and the things on the earth; in him, I say,

1.msb: In Him we were also chosen as God’s own, having been predestined according to the plan of Him who works out everything by the counsel of His will,
1.kjv: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:
1.blb: in Him, in whom also we obtained an inheritance, having been predestined according to the purpose of the One working all things according to the counsel of His will
1.bbe: In whom we have a heritage, being marked out from the first in his purpose who does all things in agreement with his designs;

1.msb: in order that we, who were the first to hope in Christ, would be for the praise of His glory.
1.kjv: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.
1.blb: for us to be to the praise of His glory, the ones having first hoped in Christ,
1.bbe: So that his glory might have praise through us who first had hope in Christ:

1.msb: And in Him you also—having heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation—believed and were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,
1.kjv: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
1.blb: in whom you also, having heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation, in whom also having believed, you were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,
1.bbe: In whom you, having been given the true word, the good news of your salvation, and through your faith in him, were given the sign of the Holy Spirit of hope,

1.msb: who is the pledge of our inheritance until the redemption of those who are God’s possession, to the praise of His glory.
1.kjv: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
1.blb: who is the pledge of our inheritance to the redemption of the acquired possession, to the praise of His glory.
1.bbe: Which is the first-fruit of our heritage, till God gets back that which is his, to the praise of his glory.

1.msb: For this reason, ever since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints,
1.kjv: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,
1.blb: Because of this, I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus among you and the love to all the saints,
1.bbe: For this cause I, having had news of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and which you make clear to all the saints,
1.heading: Spiritual Wisdom

1.msb: I have not stopped giving thanks for you, remembering you in my prayers,
1.kjv: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
1.blb: do not cease giving thanks for you, making remembrance in my prayers,
1.bbe: Give praise without end for you, keeping you in mind in my prayers;

1.msb: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.
1.kjv: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
1.blb: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of Him,
1.bbe: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;

1.msb: I ask that the eyes of your heart may be enlightened, so that you may know the hope of His calling, the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints,
1.kjv: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
1.blb: the eyes your of heart being enlightened for you to know what is the hope of His calling, what are the riches of the glory of His inheritance in the saints,
1.bbe: And that having the eyes of your heart full of light, you may have knowledge of what is the hope of his purpose, what is the wealth of the glory of his heritage in the saints,

1.msb: and the surpassing greatness of His power to us who believe. These are in accordance with the working of His mighty strength,
1.kjv: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,
1.blb: and what is the surpassing greatness of His power to us, those believing, according to the working of the power of His strength,
1.bbe: And how unlimited is his power to us who have faith, as is seen in the working of the strength of his power,

1.msb: which He exerted in Christ when He raised Him from the dead and seated Him at His right hand in the heavenly realms,
1.kjv: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,
1.blb: which He worked in Christ, having raised Him out from the dead, and having seated Him at His right hand in the heavenly realms,
1.bbe: By which he made Christ come back from the dead, and gave him a place at his right hand in heaven,

1.msb: far above all rule and authority, power and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in the present age but also in the one to come.
1.kjv: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
1.blb: far above every principality and authority and power and lordship and every name being named, not only in this age, but also in the one about to be.
1.bbe: Far over all rule and authority and power and every name which is named, not only in the present order, but in that which is to come:

1.msb: And God put everything under His feet and made Him head over everything for the church,
1.kjv: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
1.blb: And He subjected all things under His feet and gave Him to be head over all things to the church,
1.bbe: And he has put all things under his feet, and has made him to be head over all things to the church,

1.msb: which is His body, the fullness of Him who fills all in all.
1.kjv: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
1.blb: which is His body, the fullness of the One filling all in all.
1.bbe: Which is his body, the full measure of him in whom all things are made complete.

2.msb: And you were dead in your trespasses and sins,
2.kjv: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
2.blb: And you, being dead in your trespasses and sins—
2.bbe: And to you did he give life, when you were dead through your wrongdoing and sins,
2.heading: Alive with Christ

2.msb: in which you used to walk when you conformed to the ways of this world and of the ruler of the power of the air, the spirit who is now at work in the sons of disobedience.
2.kjv: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:
2.blb: in which once you walked according to the age of this world, according to the ruler of the authority of the air, the spirit now working in the sons of disobedience,
2.bbe: In which you were living in the past, after the ways of this present world, doing the pleasure of the lord of the power of the air, the spirit who is now working in those who go against the purpose of God;

2.msb: All of us also lived among them at one time, fulfilling the cravings of our flesh and indulging its desires and thoughts. Like the rest, we were by nature children of wrath.
2.kjv: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
2.blb: among whom we all also once conducted ourselves in the desires of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of its thoughts; and we were by nature children of wrath even as the rest.
2.bbe: Among whom we all at one time were living in the pleasures of our flesh, giving way to the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and the punishment of God was waiting for us even as for the rest.

2.msb: But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,
2.kjv: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
2.blb: But God, being rich in mercy, because of His much love with which He loved us,
2.bbe: But God, being full of mercy, through the great love which he had for us,

2.msb: made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. It is by grace you have been saved!
2.kjv: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)
2.blb: even us being dead in trespasses, made us alive with Christ—by grace you are saved—
2.bbe: Even when we were dead through our sins, gave us life together with Christ (by grace you have salvation),

2.msb: And God raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,
2.kjv: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:
2.blb: and He raised us up together and seated us together in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,
2.bbe: So that we came back from death with him, and are seated with him in the heavens, in Christ Jesus;

2.msb: in order that in the coming ages He might display the surpassing riches of His grace, demonstrated by His kindness to us in Christ Jesus.
2.kjv: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
2.blb: so that in the ages that are coming, He might display the surpassing riches of His grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus.
2.bbe: That in the time to come he might make clear the full wealth of his grace in his mercy to us in Christ Jesus:

2.msb: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God,
2.kjv: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
2.blb: For by grace you are saved through faith, and this not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,
2.bbe: Because by grace you have salvation through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is given by God:

2.msb: not by works, so that no one can boast.
2.kjv: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
2.blb: not by works, so that no one may boast.
2.bbe: Not by works, so that no man may take glory to himself.

2.msb: For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.
2.kjv: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
2.blb: For we are His workmanship, having been created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand that we should walk in them.
2.bbe: For by his act we were given existence in Christ Jesus to do those good works which God before made ready for us so that we might do them.

2.msb: Therefore remember that formerly you who are Gentiles in the flesh and called uncircumcised by the so-called circumcision (that done in the body by human hands)—
2.kjv: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
2.blb: Therefore remember that once you—the Gentiles in the flesh, the ones being called the uncircumcision by that being called the circumcision, done by hands in the flesh—
2.bbe: For this reason keep it in mind that in the past you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are looked on as being outside the circumcision by those who have circumcision, in the flesh, made by hands;
2.heading: One in Christ

2.msb: remember that at that time you were separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of the promise, without hope and without God in the world.
2.kjv: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
2.blb: that at that time you were apart from Christ, having been alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and foreigners to the covenants of the promise, not having hope and without God in the world.
2.bbe: That you were at that time without Christ, being cut off from any part in Israel's rights as a nation, having no part in God's agreement, having no hope, and without God in the world.

2.msb: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have been brought near through the blood of Christ.
2.kjv: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.
2.blb: But now in Christ Jesus you, the ones once being far off, became near by the blood of Christ.
2.bbe: But now in Christ Jesus you who at one time were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

2.msb: For He Himself is our peace, who has made the two one and has torn down the dividing wall of hostility
2.kjv: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
2.blb: For He Himself is our peace, having made both one and having broken down the middle wall of the partition, the hostility,
2.bbe: For he is our peace, who has made the two into one, and by whom the middle wall of division has been broken down,

2.msb: by abolishing in His flesh the law of commandments and decrees. He did this to create in Himself one new man out of the two, thus making peace
2.kjv: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;
2.blb: having annulled in His flesh the law of commandments in decrees, so that He might create in Himself the two into one new man, making peace,
2.bbe: Having in his flesh put an end to that which made the division between us, even the law with its rules and orders, so that he might make in himself, of the two, one new man, so making peace;

2.msb: and reconciling both of them to God in one body through the cross, by which He put to death their hostility.
2.kjv: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:
2.blb: and that He might reconcile both to God in one body through the cross, having put to death the hostility by it.
2.bbe: And that the two might come into agreement with God in one body through the cross, so putting an end to that division.

2.msb: He came and preached peace to you who were far away and to those who were near.
2.kjv: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
2.blb: And having come, He preached good news: peace to you, the ones far off, and peace to those near.
2.bbe: And he came preaching peace to you who were far off, and to those who were near;

2.msb: For through Him we both have access to the Father by one Spirit.
2.kjv: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.
2.blb: For through Him we both have access in one Spirit to the Father.
2.bbe: Because through him the two of us are able to come near in one Spirit to the Father.

2.msb: Therefore you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints and members of God’s household,
2.kjv: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
2.blb: So then, you are no longer strangers and aliens, but you are fellow citizens of the saints and of the household of God,
2.bbe: So then you are no longer as those who have no part or place in the kingdom of God, but you are numbered among the saints, and of the family of God,
2.heading: Christ Our Cornerstone

2.msb: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Jesus Christ Himself as the cornerstone.
2.kjv: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;
2.blb: having been built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus Himself being the cornerstone,
2.bbe: Resting on the base of the Apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief keystone,

2.msb: In Him the whole building is fitted together and grows into a holy temple in the Lord.
2.kjv: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:
2.blb: in whom all the building, being fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord,
2.bbe: In whom all the building, rightly joined together, comes to be a holy house of God in the Lord;

2.msb: And in Him you too are being built together into a dwelling place for God in His Spirit.
2.kjv: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.
2.blb: in whom you also are being built together into a habitation of God in the Spirit.
2.bbe: In whom you, with the rest, are united together as a living-place of God in the Spirit.

3.msb: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles...
3.kjv: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,
3.blb: For reason of this, I Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for you Gentiles...
3.bbe: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for you Gentiles,
3.heading: The Mystery of the Gospel

3.msb: Surely you have heard about the stewardship of God’s grace that was given to me for you,
3.kjv: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:
3.blb: If indeed you heard of the administration of the grace of God having been given to me for you,
3.bbe: If that ordering of the grace of God has come to your knowledge, which was given to me for you,

3.msb: that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as I have already written briefly.
3.kjv: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
3.blb: that by revelation was made known to me, the mystery, just as I wrote before in few words,
3.bbe: How by revelation the secret was made clear to me, as I said before in a short letter,

3.msb: In reading this, then, you will be able to understand my insight into the mystery of Christ,
3.kjv: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)
3.blb: which, by reading it, you are able to understand my insight in the mystery of Christ,
3.bbe: By the reading of which you will be clear about my knowledge of the secret of Christ;

3.msb: which was not made known to men in other generations as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to God’s holy apostles and prophets.
3.kjv: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;
3.blb: which was not made known to the sons of men in other generations as now it was revealed to His holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,
3.bbe: Which in other generations was not given to the sons of men, but the revelation of it has now been made to his holy Apostles and prophets in the Spirit;

3.msb: This mystery is that through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs, fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of His promise in Christ.
3.kjv: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:
3.blb: that the Gentiles are joint-heirs, and a joint-body, and joint-partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus, through the gospel,
3.bbe: Which is that the Gentiles have a part in the heritage, and in the same body, and in the same hope in Christ through the good news,

3.msb: I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God’s grace, given me through the working of His power.
3.kjv: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.
3.blb: of which I became servant according to the gift of the grace of God having been given to me according to the working of His power.
3.bbe: Of which I was made a preacher, through that grace of God which was given to me in the measure of the working of his power.

3.msb: Though I am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: to preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
3.kjv: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
3.blb: To me, the very least of all saints, was given this grace: to preach good news to the Gentiles, the untraceable riches of Christ,
3.bbe: To me, who am less than the least of all the saints, was this grace given, so that I might make clear to the Gentiles the good news of the unending wealth of Christ:

3.msb: and to illuminate for everyone the stewardship of this mystery, which for ages past was kept hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ.
3.kjv: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:
3.blb: and to enlighten all what is the administration of the mystery having been hidden away from the ages in God, the One having created all things,
3.bbe: And make all men see what is the ordering of the secret which from the first has been kept in God who made all things;

3.msb: His purpose was that now, through the church, the manifold wisdom of God should be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,
3.kjv: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,
3.blb: so that there might be made known now to the rulers and the authorities in the heavenly realms, through the church, the manifold wisdom of God,
3.bbe: So that now to the rulers and the authorities in the heavens might be made clear through the church the wide-shining wisdom of God,

3.msb: according to the eternal purpose that He accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
3.kjv: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
3.blb: according to the purpose of the ages, which He accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord,
3.bbe: Which is seen in his eternal purpose in Christ Jesus our Lord:

3.msb: In Him and through faith in Him we may enter God’s presence with boldness and confidence.
3.kjv: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.
3.blb: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence through the faith from Him.
3.bbe: By whom we come near to God without fear through faith in him.

3.msb: So I ask you not to be discouraged because of my sufferings for you, which are your glory.
3.kjv: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
3.blb: Therefore I ask you not to grow fainthearted in my tribulations for you, which are your glory.
3.bbe: For this reason it is my prayer that you may not become feeble because of my troubles for you, which are your glory.

3.msb: ... for this reason I bow my knees before the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
3.kjv: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
3.blb: ... for reason of this, I bow my knees to the Father,
3.bbe: For this cause I go down on my knees before the Father,
3.heading: Paul’s Prayer for the Ephesians

3.msb: from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.
3.kjv: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
3.blb: from whom every family in the heavens and on earth is named,
3.bbe: From whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

3.msb: I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,
3.kjv: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;
3.blb: that He might give to you according to the riches of His glory, to be strengthened with power through His Spirit in the inner man,
3.bbe: That in the wealth of his glory he would make you strong with power through his Spirit in your hearts;

3.msb: so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith. Then you, being rooted and grounded in love,
3.kjv: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
3.blb: for Christ to dwell in your hearts through faith, having been rooted and having been founded in love,
3.bbe: So that Christ may have his place in your hearts through faith; and that you, being rooted and based in love,

3.msb: will have power, together with all the saints, to comprehend the length and width and depth and height
3.kjv: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;
3.blb: that you may be fully able, with all the saints, to comprehend what is the breadth and length and height and depth,
3.bbe: May have strength to see with all the saints how wide and long and high and deep it is,

3.msb: of the love of Christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
3.kjv: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
3.blb: and to know the love of Christ surpassing knowledge, that you may be filled to all the fullness of God.
3.bbe: And to have knowledge of the love of Christ which is outside all knowledge, so that you may be made complete as God himself is complete.

3.msb: Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
3.kjv: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
3.blb: Now to the One being able to do exceedingly above all things that we ask or think, according to the power that is working in us,
3.bbe: Now to him who is able to do in full measure more than all our desires or thoughts, through the power which is working in us,

3.msb: to Him be the glory in the church in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
3.kjv: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.
3.blb: to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus to all the generations of the age of the ages. Amen.
3.bbe: To him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus to all generations for ever and ever. So be it.

4.msb: As a prisoner in the Lord, then, I urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling you have received:
4.kjv: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,
4.blb: Therefore I, the prisoner in the Lord, exhort you to walk worthily of the calling to which you were called,
4.bbe: I then, the prisoner in the Lord, make this request from my heart, that you will see that your behaviour is a credit to the position which God's purpose has given you,
4.heading: Unity in the Body

4.msb: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
4.kjv: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
4.blb: with all humility and gentleness; with patience, bearing with one another in love;
4.bbe: With all gentle and quiet behaviour, taking whatever comes, putting up with one another in love;

4.msb: and with diligence to preserve the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.
4.kjv: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
4.blb: being diligent to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace;
4.bbe: Taking care to keep the harmony of the Spirit in the yoke of peace.

4.msb: There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope when you were called;
4.kjv: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
4.blb: one body and one Spirit, just as also you were called in one hope of your calling;
4.bbe: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you have been marked out by God in the one hope of his purpose for you;

4.msb: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
4.kjv: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
4.blb: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
4.bbe: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,

4.msb: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.
4.kjv: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
4.blb: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.
4.bbe: One God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in all.

4.msb: Now to each one of us grace has been given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
4.kjv: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
4.blb: Now to each one of us grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
4.bbe: But to every one of us has grace been given in the measure of the giving of Christ.

4.msb: This is why it says: “When He ascended on high, He led captives away, and gave gifts to men.”
4.kjv: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.
4.blb: Therefore it says: “Having ascended on high, He led captive captivity, and gave gifts to men.”
4.bbe: For this reason he says, He went up on high, taking his prisoners with him, and gave freely to men.

4.msb: What does “He ascended” mean, except that He also descended first to the lower parts of the earth?
4.kjv: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
4.blb: Now what is the saying “He ascended,” except that He also descended into the lower regions of the earth?
4.bbe: (Now this, He went up, what is it but that he first went down into the lower parts of the earth?

4.msb: He who descended is the very One who ascended above all the heavens, in order to fill all things.
4.kjv: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)
4.blb: The One having descended is also the same One having ascended far above all the heavens, so that He might fill all things.
4.bbe: He who went down is the same who went up far over all the heavens so that he might make all things complete.)

4.msb: And it was He who gave some to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to be evangelists, and some to be pastors and teachers,
4.kjv: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
4.blb: And He gave some indeed as apostles, and some as prophets, and some as evangelists, and some as shepherds and teachers,
4.bbe: And he gave some as Apostles, and some, prophets; and some, preachers of the good news; and some to give care and teaching;

4.msb: to equip the saints for works of ministry and to build up the body of Christ,
4.kjv: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
4.blb: toward the perfecting of the saints for the work of ministry, for the building up of the body of Christ,
4.bbe: For the training of the saints as servants in the church, for the building up of the body of Christ:

4.msb: until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God, as we mature to the full measure of the stature of Christ.
4.kjv: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:
4.blb: until we all may come to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a complete man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,
4.bbe: Till we all come to the harmony of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to full growth, to the full measure of Christ:

4.msb: Then we will no longer be infants, tossed about by the waves and carried around by every wind of teaching and by the clever cunning of men in their deceitful scheming.
4.kjv: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
4.blb: so that no longer may we be infants, being tossed by waves and being carried around by every wind of teaching in the cunning of men in craftiness to the scheming of deceit.
4.bbe: So that we may be no longer children, sent this way and that, turned about by every wind of teaching, by the twisting and tricks of men, by the deceits of error;

4.msb: Instead, speaking the truth in love, we will in all things grow up into Christ Himself, who is the head.
4.kjv: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
4.blb: But speaking the truth in love, we should grow in all things into Him who is the head, Christ,
4.bbe: But saying true words in love, may come to full growth in him, who is the head, even Christ;

4.msb: From Him the whole body, fitted and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love through the work of each individual part.
4.kjv: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
4.blb: from whom all the body, being fit together and being knit together by every joint of its supply, according to the working in the measure of each single part, the increase of the body makes for the building up of itself in love.
4.bbe: Through whom all the body, being rightly formed and united together, by the full working of every part, is increased to the building up of itself in love.

4.msb: So I tell you this, and insist on it in the Lord, that you must no longer walk as the other Gentiles do, in the futility of their thinking.
4.kjv: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
4.blb: This therefore I say and testify in the Lord: You are no longer to walk as also the Gentiles walk, in the futility of their mind,
4.bbe: This I say, then, and give witness in the Lord, that you are to go no longer in the way of the Gentiles whose minds are turned to that which has no profit,
4.heading: New Life in Christ

4.msb: They are darkened in their understanding and alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them due to the hardness of their hearts.
4.kjv: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
4.blb: being darkened in the understanding, being alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance being in them on account of the hardness of their heart,
4.bbe: Whose thoughts are dark, to whom the life of God is strange because they are without knowledge, and their hearts have been made hard;

4.msb: Having lost all sense of shame, they have given themselves over to sensuality for the practice of every kind of impurity, with a craving for more.
4.kjv: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
4.blb: who, having ceased to feel, gave themselves up to sensuality for the working of all impurity with covetousness.
4.bbe: Who having no more power of feeling, have given themselves up to evil passions, to do all unclean things with overmuch desire.

4.msb: But this is not the way you came to know Christ.
4.kjv: But ye have not so learned Christ;
4.blb: But you did not learn Christ this way,
4.bbe: For this was not the teaching of Christ which was given to you;

4.msb: Surely you heard of Him and were taught in Him—in keeping with the truth that is in Jesus—
4.kjv: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
4.blb: if indeed you heard Him and were taught in Him, just as the truth is in Jesus,
4.bbe: If in fact you gave ear to him, and were given teaching in him, even as what is true is made clear in Jesus:

4.msb: to put off your former way of life, your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires;
4.kjv: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
4.blb: you are to put off concerning the former way of life the old man, which is being corrupted according to the desires of deceit,
4.bbe: That you are to put away, in relation to your earlier way of life, the old man, which has become evil by love of deceit;

4.msb: to be renewed in the spirit of your minds;
4.kjv: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
4.blb: and to be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
4.bbe: And be made new in the spirit of your mind,

4.msb: and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.
4.kjv: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
4.blb: and to have put on the new man, having been created according to God in righteousness and holiness of truth.
4.bbe: And put on the new man, to which God has given life, in righteousness and a true and holy way of living.

4.msb: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.
4.kjv: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
4.blb: Therefore, having put off falsehood, let each one speak truth with his neighbor, because we are members of one another.
4.bbe: And so, putting away false words, let everyone say what is true to his neighbour: for we are parts one of another.

4.msb: “Be angry, yet do not sin.” Do not let the sun set upon your anger,
4.kjv: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
4.blb: “Be angry, and do not sin.” Do not let the sun set upon your anger,
4.bbe: Be angry without doing wrong; let not the sun go down on your wrath;

4.msb: and do not give the devil a foothold.
4.kjv: Neither give place to the devil.
4.blb: neither give place to the devil.
4.bbe: And do not give way to the Evil One.

4.msb: He who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing good with his hands, that he may have something to share with the one in need.
4.kjv: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
4.blb: The one stealing, let him steal no longer, but rather let him toil, working with his own hands what is good, so that he may have something to impart to the one having need.
4.bbe: Let him who was a thief be so no longer, but let him do good work with his hands, so that he may have something to give to him who is in need.

4.msb: Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.
4.kjv: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
4.blb: Do not let any rotten word go forth out of your mouth, but if any is good for edification of the need, so that it may give grace to those hearing.
4.bbe: Let no evil talk come out of your mouth, but only what is good for giving necessary teaching, and for grace to those who give ear.

4.msb: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
4.kjv: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
4.blb: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
4.bbe: And do not give grief to the Holy Spirit of God, by whom you were marked for the day of salvation.

4.msb: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, along with every form of malice.
4.kjv: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
4.blb: Let all bitterness and rage and wrath and outcry and slander be removed from you, with all malice.
4.bbe: Let all bitter, sharp and angry feeling, and noise, and evil words, be put away from you, with all unkind acts;

4.msb: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave us.
4.kjv: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.
4.blb: And be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving each other, just as also God in Christ forgave you.
4.bbe: And be kind to one another, full of pity, having forgiveness for one another, even as God in Christ had forgiveness for you.

5.msb: Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children,
5.kjv: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
5.blb: Therefore be imitators of God, as beloved children,
5.bbe: Let it then be your desire to be like God, as well-loved children;
5.heading: Imitators of God

5.msb: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.
5.kjv: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
5.blb: and walk in love, just as Christ also loved us and gave Himself up for us as an offering and a sacrifice to God, into a fragrance of a sweet smell.
5.bbe: And be living in love, even as Christ had love for you, and gave himself up for us, an offering to God for a perfume of a sweet smell.

5.msb: But among you, as is proper among the saints, there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed.
5.kjv: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
5.blb: But let sexual immorality and all impurity or covetousness not even be named among you, just as is proper to saints,
5.bbe: But evil acts of the flesh and all unclean things, or desire for others' property, let it not even be named among you, as is right for saints;

5.msb: Nor should there be obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are out of character, but rather thanksgiving.
5.kjv: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
5.blb: and shamefulness, and foolish talk, or crude joking, which are not fitting, but rather thanksgiving.
5.bbe: And let there be no low behaviour, or foolish talk, or words said in sport, which are not right, but in place of them the giving of praise.

5.msb: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
5.kjv: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
5.blb: For this you know, realizing that every sexually immoral person, or impure person, or covetous person (who is an idolater), has no inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
5.bbe: Being certain of this, that no man who gives way to the passions of the flesh, no unclean person, or one who has desire for the property of others, or who gives worship to images, has any heritage in the kingdom of Christ and God.

5.msb: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of such things the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
5.kjv: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
5.blb: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the sons of disobedience.
5.bbe: Do not be turned from the right way by foolish words; for because of these things the punishment of God comes on those who do not put themselves under him.

5.msb: Therefore do not be partakers with them.
5.kjv: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
5.blb: Therefore do not be partakers with them.
5.bbe: Have no part with such men;

5.msb: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
5.kjv: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
5.blb: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light—
5.bbe: For you at one time were dark, but now are light in the Lord: let your behaviour be that of children of light
5.heading: Children of Light

5.msb: for the fruit of the Spirit consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth.
5.kjv: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
5.blb: for the fruit of the light is in all goodness and righteousness and truth—
5.bbe: (Because the fruit of the light is in all righteousness and in everything which is good and true),

5.msb: Test and prove what pleases the Lord.
5.kjv: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
5.blb: discerning what is well-pleasing to the Lord.
5.bbe: Testing by experience what is well-pleasing to the Lord;

5.msb: Have no fellowship with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.
5.kjv: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
5.blb: And do not have fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even expose them.
5.bbe: And have no company with the works of the dark, which give no fruit, but make their true quality clear;

5.msb: For it is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.
5.kjv: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
5.blb: For it is shameful even to speak of the things being done by them in secret.
5.bbe: For the things which are done by them in secret it is shame even to put into words.

5.msb: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible, for everything that is illuminated becomes a light itself.
5.kjv: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.
5.blb: But everything being exposed by the light is made manifest, for everything being made manifest is light.
5.bbe: But all things, when their true quality is seen, are made clear by the light: because everything which is made clear is light.

5.msb: So it is said: “Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
5.kjv: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
5.blb: Therefore it says: “Awake you, the one sleeping, and rise up out from the dead, and Christ will shine upon you.”
