5.bbe: For this reason he says, Be awake, you who are sleeping, and come up from among the dead, and Christ will be your light.

5.msb: Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,
5.kjv: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
5.blb: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,
5.bbe: Take care then how you are living, not as unwise, but as wise;

5.msb: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
5.kjv: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
5.blb: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
5.bbe: Making good use of the time, because the days are evil.

5.msb: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord’s will is.
5.kjv: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
5.blb: Because of this, do not be foolish, but understand what is the will of the Lord.
5.bbe: For this reason, then, do not be foolish, but be conscious of the Lord's pleasure.

5.msb: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless indiscretion. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.
5.kjv: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
5.blb: And do not be drunk with wine, in which is debauchery, but be filled in the Spirit,
5.bbe: And do not take overmuch wine by which one may be overcome, but be full of the Spirit;

5.msb: Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord,
5.kjv: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
5.blb: speaking to each other in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord,
5.bbe: Joining with one another in holy songs of praise and of the Spirit, using your voice in songs and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

5.msb: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
5.kjv: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
5.blb: giving thanks always for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to the God and Father.
5.bbe: Giving praise at all times for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;

5.msb: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
5.kjv: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
5.blb: Be submitting to one another in fear of Christ:
5.bbe: Letting yourselves be ruled by one another in the fear of Christ.
5.heading: Wives and Husbands

5.msb: Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord.
5.kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
5.blb: wives, to your own husbands as to the Lord;
5.bbe: Wives, be under the authority of your husbands, as of the Lord.

5.msb: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, and He is the Savior of the body.
5.kjv: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
5.blb: for the husband is head of the wife as also Christ is the head of the church, He Himself Savior of the body.
5.bbe: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ is the head of the church, being himself the saviour of the body.

5.msb: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
5.kjv: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
5.blb: But as the church submits to Christ, so also wives to their husbands in everything.
5.bbe: And as the church is under Christ's authority, so let wives be under the rule of their husbands in all things.

5.msb: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her
5.kjv: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
5.blb: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ also loved the church and gave Himself up for her,
5.bbe: Husbands, have love for your wives, even as Christ had love for the church, and gave himself for it;

5.msb: to sanctify her, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word,
5.kjv: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
5.blb: so that He might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water in the word,
5.bbe: So that he might make it holy, having made it clean with the washing of water by the word,

5.msb: and to present her to Himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.
5.kjv: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
5.blb: so that He might present to Himself the church in glory, not having spot or wrinkle or any of such things, but that she may be holy and blameless.
5.bbe: And might take it for himself, a church full of glory, not having one mark or fold or any such thing; but that it might be holy and complete.

5.msb: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
5.kjv: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.
5.blb: So also husbands ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. The one loving his own wife loves himself.
5.bbe: Even so it is right for husbands to have love for their wives as for their bodies. He who has love for his wife has love for himself:

5.msb: Indeed, no one ever hated his own body, but he nourishes and cherishes it, just as the Lord does the church.
5.kjv: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
5.blb: For no one at any time hated his own flesh, but he nourishes and cherishes it just as Christ also does the church.
5.bbe: For no man ever had hate for his flesh; but he gives it food and takes care of it, even as Christ does for the church;

5.msb: For we are members of His body—of His flesh and of His bones.
5.kjv: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
5.blb: For we are members of His body.
5.bbe: Because we are parts of his body.

5.msb: “For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”
5.kjv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
5.blb: “Because of this, a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will be into one flesh.”
5.bbe: For this cause will a man go away from his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.

5.msb: This mystery is profound, but I am speaking about Christ and the church.
5.kjv: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
5.blb: This mystery is great, but I speak as to Christ and as to the church.
5.bbe: This is a great secret: but my words are about Christ and the church.

5.msb: Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
5.kjv: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
5.blb: However, you also, every one, let each so love his wife as himself; and the wife, that she may respect the husband.
5.bbe: But do you, everyone, have love for his wife, even as for himself; and let the wife see that she has respect for her husband.

6.msb: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
6.kjv: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
6.blb: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
6.bbe: Children, do what is ordered by your fathers and mothers in the Lord: for this is right.
6.heading: Children and Parents

6.msb: “Honor your father and mother” (which is the first commandment with a promise),
6.kjv: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)
6.blb: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise,
6.bbe: Give honour to your father and mother (which is the first rule having a reward),

6.msb: “that it may go well with you and that you may have a long life on the earth.”
6.kjv: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
6.blb: “that it may be well with you and you will be long-lived upon the earth.”
6.bbe: So that all may be well for you, and your life may be long on the earth.

6.msb: Fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath; instead, bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
6.kjv: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
6.blb: And fathers, do not provoke to anger your children, but nourish them in the discipline and admonition of the Lord.
6.bbe: And, you fathers, do not make your children angry: but give them training in the teaching and fear of the Lord.

6.msb: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear and sincerity of heart, just as you would obey Christ.
6.kjv: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
6.blb: Slaves, obey the masters according to the flesh with fear and trembling, in sincerity of your heart, as to Christ,
6.bbe: Servants, do what is ordered by those who are your natural masters, having respect and fear for them, with all your heart, as to Christ;
6.heading: Serving with Honor

6.msb: And do this not only to please them while they are watching, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.
6.kjv: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
6.blb: not with eye-service as men-pleasers, but as slaves of Christ, doing the will of God from the soul,
6.bbe: Not only under your master's eye, as pleasers of men; but as servants of Christ, doing the pleasure of God from the heart;

6.msb: Serve with good will, as to the Lord and not to men,
6.kjv: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
6.blb: serving with good will, as to the Lord and not to men,
6.bbe: Doing your work readily, as to the Lord, and not to men:

6.msb: because you know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good he does, whether he is slave or free.
6.kjv: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
6.blb: knowing that each one, whatever good he might have done, this he will receive from the Lord, whether slave or free.
6.bbe: In the knowledge that for every good thing anyone does, he will have his reward from the Lord, If he is a servant or if he is free.

6.msb: And masters, do the same for your slaves. Give up your use of threats, because you know that your Master is in heaven, and there is no favoritism with Him.
6.kjv: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
6.blb: And masters, do the same things toward them, giving up threatening, knowing that also their Master and yours is in the heavens, and there is no partiality with Him.
6.bbe: And, you masters, do the same things to them, not making use of violent words: in the knowledge that their Master and yours is in heaven, and he has no respect for a man's position.

6.msb: Finally, my brothers, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
6.kjv: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
6.blb: Henceforth, be empowered in the Lord and in the might of His strength.
6.bbe: Lastly, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his power.
6.heading: The Full Armor of God

6.msb: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can make your stand against the devil’s schemes.
6.kjv: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
6.blb: Put on the full armor of God, for you to be able to stand against the schemes of the devil,
6.bbe: Take up God's instruments of war, so that you may be able to keep your position against all the deceits of the Evil One.

6.msb: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this world’s darkness, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
6.kjv: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
6.blb: because to us the wrestling is not against blood and flesh, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the world powers of this darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
6.bbe: For our fight is not against flesh and blood, but against authorities and powers, against the world-rulers of this dark night, against the spirits of evil in the heavens.

6.msb: Therefore take up the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you will be able to stand your ground, and having done everything, to stand.
6.kjv: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
6.blb: Because of this, take up the full armor of God, so that you may be able to withstand in the day of evil, and having done all things, to stand.
6.bbe: For this reason take up all the arms of God, so that you may be able to be strong in the evil day, and, having done all, to keep your place.

6.msb: Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed,
6.kjv: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
6.blb: Stand therefore, having girded your loins in truth, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
6.bbe: Take your place, then, having your body clothed with the true word, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness;

6.msb: and with your feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace.
6.kjv: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
6.blb: and having shod the feet in the readiness of the gospel of peace;
6.bbe: Be ready with the good news of peace as shoes on your feet;

6.msb: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
6.kjv: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
6.blb: in all, having taken up the shield of faith, in which you will be able to quench all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
6.bbe: And most of all, using faith as a cover to keep off all the flaming arrows of the Evil One.

6.msb: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
6.kjv: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
6.blb: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God,
6.bbe: And take salvation for your head-dress and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

6.msb: Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. To this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints.
6.kjv: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
6.blb: through all prayer and supplication, praying in the Spirit in every season and unto this very thing, staying awake with all perseverance and supplication for all the saints,
6.bbe: With prayers and deep desires, making requests at all times in the Spirit, and keeping watch, with strong purpose, in prayer for all the saints,

6.msb: Pray also for me, that whenever I open my mouth, words may be given me so that I will boldly make known the mystery of the gospel,
6.kjv: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
6.blb: and for me, that word may be given to me in the opening of my mouth, to make known in boldness the mystery of the gospel,
6.bbe: And for me, that words may be given to me in the opening of my mouth, to make clear without fear the secret of the good news,

6.msb: for which I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may proclaim it fearlessly, as I should.
6.kjv: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
6.blb: for which I am an ambassador in a chain, that in it I may be bold, as it is necessary for me to speak.
6.bbe: For which I am a representative in chains, and that I may say without fear the things which it is right for me to say.

6.msb: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know about me and what I am doing.
6.kjv: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
6.blb: And so that you also may know the things concerning me—what I am doing—Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things,
6.bbe: But so that you may have knowledge of my business, and how I am, Tychicus, the well-loved brother and tested servant in the Lord, will give you news of all things:
6.heading: Final Greetings

6.msb: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.
6.kjv: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
6.blb: whom I sent to you for this, that you might know the things concerning us, and he may encourage your hearts.
6.bbe: Whom I have sent to you for this very purpose, so that you may have knowledge of our position, and that he may give comfort to your hearts.

6.msb: Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
6.kjv: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
6.blb: Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
6.bbe: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

6.msb: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love. Amen.
6.kjv: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
6.blb: Grace be with all those loving our Lord Jesus Christ in incorruptibility.
6.bbe: Grace be with all those who have true love for our Lord Jesus Christ.

1.msb: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:
1.kjv: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
1.blb: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus being in Philippi, with the overseers and deacons:
1.bbe: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, with the Bishops and Deacons of the church:
1.heading: Greetings from Paul and Timothy

1.msb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.blb: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.bbe: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.msb: I thank my God every time I remember you.
1.kjv: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
1.blb: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
1.bbe: I give praise to my God at every memory of you,
1.heading: Thanksgiving and Prayer

1.msb: In every prayer for all of you, I always pray with joy,
1.kjv: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
1.blb: always in my every supplication for all of you, making the supplication with joy,
1.bbe: And in all my prayers for you all, making my request with joy,

1.msb: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,
1.kjv: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
1.blb: for your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,
1.bbe: Because of your help in giving the good news from the first day till now;

1.msb: being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
1.kjv: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
1.blb: being persuaded of this very thing, that the One having begun a good work in you will complete it until the day of Christ Jesus.
1.bbe: For I am certain of this very thing, that he by whom the good work was started in you will make it complete till the day of Jesus Christ:

1.msb: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart. For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.
1.kjv: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.
1.blb: Accordingly, it is right for me to think this about all of you, because of me having you in the heart. Both in my chains and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel, you all are fellow partakers of grace with me.
1.bbe: So it is right for me to take thought for you all in this way, because I have you in my heart; for in my chains, and in my arguments before the judges in support of the good news, making clear that it is true, you all have your part with me in grace.

1.msb: God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.
1.blb: For God is my witness how I long for you all in the inner affections of Christ Jesus.
1.bbe: For God is my witness, how my love goes out to you all in the loving mercies of Christ Jesus.

1.msb: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,
1.kjv: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
1.blb: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
1.bbe: And my prayer is that you may be increased more and more in knowledge and experience;

1.msb: so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
1.kjv: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;
1.blb: for you to approve the things being excellent, so that you may be pure and blameless unto the day of Christ,
1.bbe: So that you may give your approval to the best things; that you may be true and without wrongdoing till the day of Christ;

1.msb: filled with the fruits of righteousness that come through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
1.kjv: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.
1.blb: being filled with the fruit of righteousness that is through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
1.bbe: Being full of the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

1.msb: Now I want you to know, brothers, that my circumstances have actually served to advance the gospel.
1.kjv: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
1.blb: Now I want you to know brothers, that the things concerning me really have come to the advancement of the gospel,
1.bbe: Now it is my purpose to make clear to you, brothers, that the cause of the good news has been helped by my experiences;
1.heading: Paul’s Trials Advance the Gospel

1.msb: As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.
1.kjv: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;
1.blb: so as for my chains in Christ to have become manifest in all the Praetorium and to all the rest;
1.bbe: So that it became clear through all the Praetorium, and to all the rest, that I was a prisoner on account of Christ;

1.msb: And most of the brothers, confident in the Lord by my chains, now dare more greatly to speak the word without fear.
1.kjv: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
1.blb: and most of the brothers, trusting in the Lord by my chains, dare more abundantly to speak fearlessly the word.
1.bbe: And most of the brothers in the Lord, taking heart because of my chains, are all the stronger to give the word of God without fear.

1.msb: It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill.
1.kjv: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
1.blb: Indeed, some, even through envy and strife, but some also through goodwill, preach Christ—
1.bbe: Though some are preaching Christ out of envy and competition, others do it out of a good heart:

1.msb: The former preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can add to the distress of my chains.
1.kjv: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
1.blb: the ones indeed out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel;
1.bbe: These do it from love, conscious that I am responsible for the cause of the good news:

1.msb: The latter do so in love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel.
1.kjv: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
1.blb: but the others proclaim Christ out of self-interest, not purely, supposing to add tribulation to my chains.
1.bbe: But those are preaching Christ in a spirit of competition, not from their hearts, but with the purpose of giving me pain in my prison.

1.msb: What then is the issue? Just this: that in every way, whether by false motives or true, Christ is preached. And in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice,
1.kjv: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.
1.blb: What then? Only that in every way, whether in pretext or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. And in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will rejoice,
1.bbe: What then? only that in every way, falsely or truly, the preaching of Christ goes on; and in this I am glad, and will be glad.

1.msb: because I know that through your prayers and the provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, my distress will turn out for my deliverance.
1.kjv: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
1.blb: for I know that this will turn out for me to deliverance, through your supplication and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
1.bbe: For I am conscious that this will be for my salvation, through your prayer and the giving out of the stored wealth of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

1.msb: I eagerly expect and hope that I will in no way be ashamed, but will have complete boldness so that now as always Christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.
1.kjv: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.
1.blb: according to my eager expectation and hope that I will be ashamed in nothing, but in all boldness, as always, also now, Christ will be magnified in my body, whether through life or through death.
1.bbe: In the measure of my strong hope and belief that in nothing will I be put to shame, but that without fear, as at all times, so now will Christ have glory in my body, by life or by death.

1.msb: For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
1.kjv: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
1.blb: For to me, to live is Christ and to die is gain.
1.bbe: For to me life is Christ and death is profit.
1.heading: To Live Is Christ

1.msb: But if I go on living in the body, this will mean fruitful labor for me. So what shall I choose? I do not know.
1.kjv: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
1.blb: But if I am to live in flesh, this for me is the fruit of work; and what will I choose? I do not know.
1.bbe: But if I go on living in the flesh — if this is the fruit of my work — then I do not see what decision to make.

1.msb: I am torn between the two. I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
1.kjv: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
1.blb: But I am pressed by the two, having the desire to depart and to be with Christ, for it is very much better,
1.bbe: I am in a hard position between the two, having a desire to go away and be with Christ, which is very much better:

1.msb: But it is more necessary for you that I remain in the body.
1.kjv: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
1.blb: but to remain in the flesh is more necessary on account of you.
1.bbe: Still, to go on in the flesh is more necessary because of you.

1.msb: Convinced of this, I know that I will remain and will continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith,
1.kjv: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
1.blb: And having been persuaded of this, I know that I will remain and will continue with all of you for your progress and joy of the faith,
1.bbe: And being certain of this, I am conscious that I will go on, yes, and go on with you all, for your growth and joy in the faith;

1.msb: so that through my coming to you again your exultation in Christ Jesus will resound on account of me.
1.kjv: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.
1.blb: so that through my coming to you again your boasting in me may abound in Christ Jesus.
1.bbe: So that your pride in me may be increased in Christ Jesus through my being present with you again.

1.msb: Nevertheless, conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you in my absence, I will know that you stand firm in one spirit, contending side by side for the faith of the gospel,
1.kjv: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
1.blb: Only conduct yourselves worthily of the gospel of Christ, so that, whether having come and having seen you, or being absent, I might hear the things concerning you, that you stand firm in one spirit, contending together with one mind for the faith of the gospel,
1.bbe: Only let your behaviour do credit to the good news of Christ, so that if I come and see you or if I am away from you, I may have news of you that you are strong in one spirit, working together with one soul for the faith of the good news;
1.heading: Worthy of the Gospel

1.msb: without being frightened in any way by those who oppose you. This is indeed a clear sign of their destruction but of your salvation, and it is from God.
1.kjv: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
1.blb: and not being frightened in anything by those opposing you, which is a demonstration of destruction to them, but of salvation to you—and this from God.
1.bbe: Having no fear of those who are against you; which is a clear sign of their destruction, but of your salvation, and that from God;

1.msb: For it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for Him,
1.kjv: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
1.blb: For it was granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer on behalf of Him,
1.bbe: Because to you it has been given in the cause of Christ not only to have faith in him, but to undergo pain on his account:

1.msb: since you are encountering the same struggle you saw I had, and now hear that I still have.
1.kjv: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
1.blb: having the same struggle such as you saw in me and now hear of in me.
1.bbe: Fighting the same fight which you saw in me, and now have word of in me.

2.msb: Therefore if you have any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort from His love, if any fellowship with the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,
2.kjv: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
2.blb: Therefore, if there is any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any inner affections and compassions,
2.bbe: If then there is any comfort in Christ, any help given by love, any uniting of hearts in the Spirit, any loving mercies and pity,
2.heading: One in Christ

2.msb: then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being united in spirit and purpose.
2.kjv: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
2.blb: fulfill my joy so that you may be of the same mind, having the same love, united in soul, minding the one thing,
2.bbe: Make my joy complete by being of the same mind, having the same love, being in harmony and of one mind;

2.msb: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride, but in humility consider others more important than yourselves.
2.kjv: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
2.blb: nothing according to self-interest or according to vain conceit, but in humility esteeming one another surpassing yourselves,
2.bbe: Doing nothing through envy or through pride, but with low thoughts of self let everyone take others to be better than himself;

2.msb: Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.
2.kjv: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
2.blb: each looking at not the things of yourselves, but each also the things of others.
2.bbe: Not looking everyone to his private good, but keeping in mind the things of others.

2.msb: Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus:
2.kjv: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
2.blb: Let this mind be in you that was also in Christ Jesus:
2.bbe: Let this mind be in you which was in Christ Jesus,
2.heading: The Mind of Christ

2.msb: Who, existing in the form of God, did not consider equality with God something to be grasped,
2.kjv: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
2.blb: Who, existing in the form of God, did not consider to be equal with God something to be grasped,
2.bbe: To whom, though himself in the form of God, it did not seem that to take for oneself was to be like God;

2.msb: but emptied Himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in human likeness.
2.kjv: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
2.blb: but emptied Himself, having taken the form of a servant, having been made in the likeness of men.
2.bbe: But he made himself as nothing, taking the form of a servant, being made like men;

2.msb: And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to death—even death on a cross.
2.kjv: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
2.blb: And having been found in appearance as a man He humbled Himself, having become obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
2.bbe: And being seen in form as a man, he took the lowest place, and let himself be put to death, even the death of the cross.

2.msb: Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names,
2.kjv: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
2.blb: Therefore God also highly exalted Him and granted to Him the name above every name,
2.bbe: For this reason God has put him in the highest place and has given to him the name which is greater than every name;

2.msb: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
2.kjv: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;
2.blb: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in the heavens and on earth and under the earth,
2.bbe: So that at the name of Jesus every knee may be bent, of those in heaven and those on earth and those in the underworld,

2.msb: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
2.kjv: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
2.blb: and every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
2.bbe: And that every tongue may give witness that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

2.msb: Therefore, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now even more in my absence, continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling.
2.kjv: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
2.blb: Therefore, my beloved, just as always you obeyed, not only as in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
2.bbe: So then, my loved ones, as you have at all times done what I say, not only when I am present, but now much more when I am not with you, give yourselves to working out your salvation with fear in your hearts;
2.heading: Lights in the World

2.msb: For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose.
2.kjv: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
2.blb: For God is the One working in you both to will and to work on behalf of His good pleasure.
2.bbe: For it is God who is the cause of your desires and of your acts, for his good pleasure.

2.msb: Do everything without complaining or arguing,
2.kjv: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
2.blb: Do all things without grumblings and disputings,
2.bbe: Do all things without protests and arguments;

2.msb: so that you may be blameless and pure, children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse generation, in which you shine as lights in the world
2.kjv: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
2.blb: so that you may be blameless and innocent, children of God unblemished in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you shine as lights in the world,
2.bbe: So that you may be holy and gentle, children of God without sin in a twisted and foolish generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

2.msb: as you hold forth the word of life, in order that I may boast on the day of Christ that I did not run or labor in vain.
2.kjv: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
2.blb: holding forth the word of life for a boast to me in the day of Christ that I did not run in vain, nor did I toil in vain.
2.bbe: Offering the word of life; so that I may have glory in you in the day of Christ, because my running was not for nothing and my work was not without effect.

2.msb: But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you.
2.kjv: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
2.blb: But even if I am being poured out as a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice and rejoice with you all.
2.bbe: And even if I am offered like a drink offering, giving myself for the cause and work of your faith, I am glad and have joy with you all:

2.msb: So you too should be glad and rejoice with me.
2.kjv: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
2.blb: And likewise you also be glad and rejoice with me.
2.bbe: And in the same way do you be glad and have a part in my joy.

2.msb: Now I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered when I learn how you are doing.
2.kjv: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
2.blb: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be of good spirit, having known the things concerning you.
2.bbe: But I am hoping in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you before long, so that I may be comforted when I have news of you.
2.heading: Timothy and Epaphroditus

2.msb: I have nobody else like him who will genuinely care for your needs.
2.kjv: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
2.blb: For I have no one like-minded, who genuinely will care for the things concerning you.
2.bbe: For I have no man of like mind who will truly have care for you.

2.msb: For all the others look after their own interests, not those of Christ Jesus.
2.kjv: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ’s.
2.blb: For those all seek the things of themselves, not the things of Jesus Christ.
2.bbe: For they all go after what is theirs, not after the things of Christ.

2.msb: But you know Timothy’s proven worth, that as a child with his father he has served with me to advance the gospel.
2.kjv: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
2.blb: But you know his proven worth, that as a child with a father he served with me in the gospel.
2.bbe: But his quality is clear to you; how, as a child is to its father, so he was a help to me in the work of the good news.

2.msb: So I hope to send him as soon as I see what happens with me.
2.kjv: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
2.blb: Therefore indeed I hope to send him immediately, when I shall have seen the things concerning me.
2.bbe: Him then I am hoping to send as quickly as possible, when I am able to see how things will go for me:

2.msb: And I trust in the Lord that I myself will come soon.
2.kjv: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
2.blb: And I am persuaded in the Lord that I myself will also come soon.
2.bbe: But I have faith in the Lord that I myself will come before long.

2.msb: But I thought it necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier, who is also your messenger and minister to my needs.
2.kjv: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
2.blb: Now I deemed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother and fellow worker and fellow soldier, and your messenger and minister of my need,
2.bbe: But it seemed to me necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, who has taken part with me in the work and in the fight, and your servant, sent by you for help in my need;

2.msb: For he has been longing for all of you and is distressed because you heard he was ill.
2.kjv: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.
2.blb: since he was longing for you all and being deeply distressed because you heard that he was sick.
2.bbe: Because his heart was with you all, and he was greatly troubled because you had news that he was ill:

2.msb: He was sick indeed, nearly unto death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, to spare me sorrow upon sorrow.
2.kjv: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
2.blb: And indeed he was sick, nearly unto death. But God had mercy on him, and not on him only but also on me, that I might not have sorrow upon sorrow.
2.bbe: For in fact he was ill almost to death: but God had mercy on him; and not only on him but on me, so that I might not have grief on grief.

2.msb: Therefore I am all the more eager to send him, so that when you see him again you may rejoice, and I may be less anxious.
2.kjv: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
2.blb: Therefore I sent him all the more eagerly, so that having seen him again you may rejoice, and I may be less anxious.
2.bbe: I have sent him, then, the more gladly, so that when you see him again, you may be happy and I may have the less sorrow.

2.msb: Welcome him in the Lord with great joy, and honor men like him,
2.kjv: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
2.blb: Therefore receive him in the Lord with all joy, and hold such in honor,
2.bbe: So take him to your hearts in the Lord with all joy, and give honour to such as he is:

2.msb: because he nearly died for the work of Christ, disregarding his life to make up for your deficit of service to me.
2.kjv: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
2.blb: because on account of the work of Christ he drew near unto death, having disregarded his life so that he might fill up your deficiency of service toward me.
2.bbe: Because for the work of Christ he was near to death, putting his life in danger to make your care for me complete.

3.msb: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. It is no trouble for me to write the same things to you again, and it is a safeguard for you.
3.kjv: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
3.blb: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you indeed is not troublesome to me, and is secure for you.
3.bbe: For the rest, my brothers, be glad in the Lord. Writing the same things to you is no trouble to me, and for you it is safe.
3.heading: Righteousness through Faith in Christ

3.msb: Watch out for those dogs, those workers of evil, those mutilators of the flesh!
3.kjv: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
3.blb: Look out for the dogs! Look out for the evil workers! Look out for the mutilation!
3.bbe: Be on the watch against dogs, against the workers of evil, against those of the circumcision:

3.msb: For it is we who are the circumcision, we who worship by the Spirit of God, who glory in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh—
3.kjv: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
3.blb: For we are the circumcision, those worshiping in the Spirit of God and boasting in Christ Jesus, and not having put confidence in the flesh—
3.bbe: For we are the circumcision, who give worship to God and have glory in Jesus Christ, and have no faith in the flesh:

3.msb: though I myself could have such confidence. If anyone else thinks he has grounds for confidence in the flesh, I have more:
3.kjv: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
3.blb: though I have confidence even in the flesh. If any other thinks to have confidence in the flesh, I more:
3.bbe: Even though I myself might have faith in the flesh: if any other man has reason to have faith in the flesh, I have more:

3.msb: circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin; a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;
3.kjv: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
3.blb: circumcision on the eighth day; of the nation of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin; a Hebrew of Hebrews; according to the law, a Pharisee;
3.bbe: Being given circumcision on the eighth day, of the nation of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; in relation to the law, a Pharisee:

3.msb: as to zeal, persecuting the church; as to righteousness in the law, faultless.
3.kjv: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
3.blb: according to zeal, persecuting the church; according to righteousness that is in the law, having become blameless.
3.bbe: In bitter hate I was cruel to the church; I kept all the righteousness of the law to the last detail.

3.msb: But whatever was gain to me I count as loss for the sake of Christ.
3.kjv: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
3.blb: But whatever things were gain to me, these I have deemed loss because of Christ.
3.bbe: But those things which were profit to me, I gave up for Christ.

3.msb: More than that, I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have lost all things. I consider them rubbish, that I may gain Christ
3.kjv: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
3.blb: But indeed, therefore, I also deem all things to be loss because of the surpassing knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord, because of whom I have lost all things and deem them rubbish, that I may gain Christ
3.bbe: Yes truly, and I am ready to give up all things for the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord, which is more than all: for whom I have undergone the loss of all things, and to me they are less than nothing, so that I may have Christ as my reward,

3.msb: and be found in Him, not having my own righteousness from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God on the basis of faith.
3.kjv: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
3.blb: and may be found in Him, not having my own righteousness that is of the law, but that which is through faith from Christ, the righteousness of God upon faith,
3.bbe: And be seen in him, not having my righteousness which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:

3.msb: I want to know Christ and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to Him in His death,
3.kjv: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
3.blb: to know Him and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to His death,
3.bbe: That I may have knowledge of him, and of the power of his coming back from the dead, and a part with him in his pains, becoming like him in his death;

3.msb: and so, somehow, to attain to the resurrection from the dead.
3.kjv: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
3.blb: if somehow I may attain to the resurrection out from the dead.
3.bbe: If in any way I may have the reward of life from the dead.

3.msb: Not that I have already obtained all this, or have already been made perfect, but I press on to take hold of that for which Christ Jesus took hold of me.
3.kjv: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
3.blb: Not that I already obtained it or already have been perfected, but I pursue, if also I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
3.bbe: Not as if I had even now got the reward or been made complete: but I go on in the hope that I may come to the knowledge of that for which I was made the servant of Christ Jesus.
3.heading: Pressing on toward the Goal

3.msb: Brothers, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead,
3.kjv: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
3.blb: Brothers, I do not reckon myself to have taken hold of it. But one thing: Indeed, forgetting the things behind and stretching forward to the things ahead,
3.bbe: Brothers, it is clear to me that I have not come to that knowledge; but one thing I do, letting go those things which are past, and stretching out to the things which are before,

3.msb: I press on toward the goal to win the prize of God’s heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.
3.kjv: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
3.blb: I pursue toward the goal for the prize of the upward calling of God in Christ Jesus.
3.bbe: I go forward to the mark, even the reward of the high purpose of God in Christ Jesus.

3.msb: All of us who are mature should embrace this point of view. And if you think differently about some issue, God will reveal this to you as well.
3.kjv: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
3.blb: Therefore as many as are mature, we should be of this mind. And if you are minded in anything differently, even this God will reveal to you.
3.bbe: Then let us all, who have come to full growth, be of this mind: and if in anything you are of a different mind, even this will God make clear to you:

3.msb: Nevertheless, we must live up to the standard we have already attained, being of the same mind.
3.kjv: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
3.blb: However, to that which we have attained, walk by the same.
3.bbe: Only, as far as we have got, let us be guided by the same rule.

3.msb: Join one another in following my example, brothers, and carefully observe those who walk according to the pattern we set for you.
3.kjv: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.
3.blb: Be imitators together of me, brothers, and look at those walking thus, as you have a pattern in us.
3.bbe: Brothers, take me as your example, and take note of those who are walking after the example we have given.
3.heading: Citizenship in Heaven

3.msb: For as I have often told you before, and now say again even with tears: Many live as enemies of the cross of Christ.
3.kjv: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:
3.blb: For many walk—of whom I told you often, and now I say even weeping—as enemies of the cross of Christ,
3.bbe: For there are those, of whom I have given you word before, and do so now with sorrow, who are haters of the cross of Christ;

3.msb: Their end is destruction, their god is their belly, and their glory is in their shame. Their minds are set on earthly things.
3.kjv: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
3.blb: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly and their glory is in their shame, those minding earthly things.
3.bbe: Whose end is destruction, whose god is the stomach, and whose glory is in their shame, whose minds are fixed on the things of the earth.

3.msb: But our citizenship is in heaven, and we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ,
3.kjv: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
3.blb: For our citizenship is in the heavens, from where also we eagerly await a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,
3.bbe: For our country is in heaven; from where the Saviour for whom we are waiting will come, even the Lord Jesus Christ:

3.msb: who, by the power that enables Him to subject all things to Himself, will transform our lowly bodies to be like His glorious body.
3.kjv: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
3.blb: who will transform our body of humiliation to be conformed to the body of His glory, according to the working of His powering, even to subject all things to Himself.
3.bbe: By whom this poor body of ours will be changed into the image of the body of his glory, in the measure of the working by which he is able to put all things under himself.

4.msb: Therefore, my brothers, whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, that is how you must stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.
4.kjv: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
4.blb: Therefore my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, in this way stand firm in the Lord, beloved.
4.bbe: So my brothers, well loved and very dear to me, my joy and crown, be strong in the Lord, my loved ones.
4.heading: Rejoice in the Lord

4.msb: I urge Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.
4.kjv: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
4.blb: I exhort Euodia and I exhort Syntyche to be of the same mind in the Lord.
4.bbe: I make request to Euodias and Syntyche to be of the same mind in the Lord.

4.msb: Yes, and I ask you, my true yokefellow, to help these women who have contended side by side with me for the gospel, along with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the Book of Life.
4.kjv: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.
4.blb: Yes, and I ask you, genuine yokefellow, assist these women who in the gospel contended together with me, with Clement also and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.
4.bbe: And I make request to you, true helper in my work, to see to the needs of those women who took part with me in the good news, with Clement and the rest of my brother-workers whose names are in the book of life.

4.msb: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
4.kjv: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
4.blb: Rejoice in the Lord always; again I will say, rejoice!
4.bbe: Be glad in the Lord at all times: again I say, Be glad.

4.msb: Let your gentleness be apparent to all. The Lord is near.
4.kjv: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
4.blb: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is near.
4.bbe: Let your gentle behaviour be clear to all men. The Lord is near.

4.msb: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
4.kjv: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
4.blb: Be anxious about nothing, but in everything, by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
4.bbe: Have no cares; but in everything with prayer and praise put your requests before God.

4.msb: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
4.kjv: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
4.blb: And the peace of God, that is surpassing all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
4.bbe: And the peace of God, which is deeper than all knowledge, will keep your hearts and minds in Christ Jesus.

4.msb: Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable—if anything is excellent or praiseworthy—think on these things.
4.kjv: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
4.blb: Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is well spoken of—if any excellence and if any praise—think on these things.
4.bbe: For the rest, my brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things have honour, whatever things are upright, whatever things are holy, whatever things are beautiful, whatever things are of value, if there is any virtue and if there is any praise, give thought to these things.

4.msb: Whatever you have learned or received or heard from me, or seen in me, put it into practice. And the God of peace will be with you.
4.kjv: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
4.blb: And what you learned and received and heard and saw in me, practice these things. And the God of peace will be with you.
4.bbe: The things which came to you by my teaching and preaching, and which you saw in me, these things do, and the God of peace will be with you.

4.msb: Now I rejoice greatly in the Lord that at last you have revived your concern for me. You were indeed concerned, but you had no opportunity to show it.
4.kjv: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.
4.blb: But I rejoiced greatly in the Lord that now at last you revived your being mindful for me, upon whom also you were mindful, but you were lacking opportunity.
4.bbe: But I am very glad in the Lord that your care for me has come to life again; though you did in fact take thought for me, but you were not able to give effect to it.
4.heading: The Generosity of the Philippians

4.msb: I am not saying this out of need, for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances.
4.kjv: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
4.blb: Not that I speak according to deficiency, for I have learned to be content in that which I am.
4.bbe: But I will not say anything about my needs, for I am able, wherever I am, to be dependent on myself.

4.msb: I know how to live humbly, and I know how to abound. In any and every situation I have learned the secret of being filled and being hungry, of having plenty and having need.
4.kjv: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
4.blb: I know also how to be brought low, and I know how to abound. In everything and in all things, I have learned the secret also to be full and to hunger, also to abound and to be deficient.
4.bbe: It is the same to me if I am looked down on or honoured; everywhere and in all things I have the secret of how to be full and how to go without food; how to have wealth and how to be in need.

4.msb: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
4.kjv: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
4.blb: I have strength for all things in the One empowering me.
4.bbe: I am able to do all things through him who gives me strength.

4.msb: Nevertheless, you have done well to share in my affliction.
4.kjv: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
4.blb: However, you did well having fellowship in my affliction.
4.bbe: But you did well to have care for me in my need.

4.msb: And as you Philippians know, in the early days of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church but you partnered with me in the matter of giving and receiving.
4.kjv: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.
4.blb: And you also know, Philippians, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I went out from Macedonia, not one church shared with me as to the matter of giving and receiving, except you only.
4.bbe: And you have knowledge, Philippians, that when the good news first came to you, when I went away from Macedonia, no church took part with me in the business of giving to the saints, but you only;

4.msb: For even while I was in Thessalonica, you provided for my needs again and again.
4.kjv: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.
4.blb: For even in Thessalonica, both once and twice, you sent for my need.
4.bbe: Because even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to me in my need.

4.msb: Not that I am seeking a gift, but I am looking for the fruit that may be credited to your account.
4.kjv: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
4.blb: Not that I seek after the gift, but I seek after the fruit abounding to your account.
4.bbe: Not that I am looking for an offering, but for fruit which may be put to your credit.

4.msb: I have all I need and more, now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus. They are a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.
4.kjv: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.
4.blb: But I have all things, and I abound. I have been filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things from you, a fragrance of a sweet smell, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.
4.bbe: I have all things and more than enough: I am made full, having had from Epaphroditus the things which came from you, a perfume of a sweet smell, an offering well pleasing to God.

4.msb: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
4.kjv: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
4.blb: And my God will fill all your need according to His riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
4.bbe: And my God will give you all you have need of from the wealth of his glory in Christ Jesus.

4.msb: To our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.
4.kjv: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
4.blb: Now to our God and Father be the glory to the ages of the ages. Amen.
4.bbe: Now to God our Father be glory for ever and ever. So be it.

4.msb: Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you greetings.
4.kjv: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
4.blb: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers with me greet you.
4.bbe: Give words of love to every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you their love.
4.heading: Final Greetings

4.msb: All the saints send you greetings, especially those from the household of Caesar.
4.kjv: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar’s household.
4.blb: All the saints greet you, and especially those of Caesar's household.
4.bbe: All the saints send their love to you, specially those who are of Caesar's house.

4.msb: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
4.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
4.blb: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
4.bbe: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.

1.msb: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
1.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,
1.blb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy the brother,
1.bbe: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ, by the purpose of God, and Timothy our brother,
1.heading: Greetings from Paul and Timothy

1.msb: To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.blb: To the saints in Colossae and faithful brothers in Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father.
1.bbe: To the saints and true brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father.

1.msb: We always thank the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ when we pray for you,
1.kjv: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
1.blb: We give thanks to God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
1.bbe: We give praise to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, making prayer for you at all times,
1.heading: Thanksgiving and Prayer

1.msb: because we have heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all the saints—
1.kjv: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,
1.blb: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and the love that you have for all the saints,
1.bbe: After hearing of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which you have for all the saints,

1.msb: the faith and love proceeding from the hope stored up for you in heaven, of which you have already heard in the word of truth, the gospel
1.kjv: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
1.blb: because of the hope being laid up for you in the heavens, which you heard of before in the word of truth, the gospel,
1.bbe: Through the hope which is in store for you in heaven; knowledge of which was given to you before in the true word of the good news,

1.msb: that has come to you. All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing, just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood the grace of God.
1.kjv: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:
1.blb: the one being present unto you, just as also in all the world it is bearing fruit and growing, just as also among you from the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,
1.bbe: Which has come to you; and which in all the world is giving fruit and increase, as it has done in you from the day when it came to your ears and you had true knowledge of the grace of God;

1.msb: You also learned it from Epaphras, our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on your behalf,
1.kjv: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
1.blb: just as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on behalf of us,
1.bbe: As it was given to you by Epaphras, our well-loved helper, who is a true servant of Christ for us,

1.msb: and who also informed us of your love in the Spirit.
1.kjv: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
1.blb: the one also having made known to us your love in the Spirit.
1.bbe: And who, himself, made clear to us your love in the Spirit.

1.msb: For this reason, since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you and asking God to fill you with the knowledge of His will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
1.kjv: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
1.blb: Because of this, we also from the day we heard do not cease praying for you and asking that you may be filled with the knowledge of His will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding
1.bbe: For this reason, we, from the day when we had word of it, keep on in prayer for you, that you may be full of the knowledge of his purpose, with all wisdom and experience of the Spirit,

1.msb: so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord and may please Him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,
1.kjv: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
1.blb: to walk worthily of the Lord: pleasing in all, bearing fruit in every good work, and growing in the knowledge of God,
1.bbe: Living uprightly in the approval of the Lord, giving fruit in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

1.msb: being strengthened with all power according to His glorious might so that you may have full endurance and patience, and joyfully
1.kjv: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
1.blb: being empowered with all power according to the power of His glory unto all endurance and patience, with joy
1.bbe: Full of strength in the measure of the great power of his glory, so that you may undergo all troubles with joy;

1.msb: giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified us to share in the inheritance of the saints in the light.
1.kjv: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
1.blb: giving thanks to the Father, the One having qualified you for the share of the inheritance of the saints in the light,
1.bbe: Giving praise to the Father who has given us a part in the heritage of the saints in light;

1.msb: He has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of His beloved Son,
1.kjv: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
1.blb: who delivered us from the authority of darkness and transferred us into the kingdom of His beloved Son,
1.bbe: Who has made us free from the power of evil and given us a place in the kingdom of the Son of his love;

1.msb: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.
1.kjv: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
1.blb: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.
1.bbe: In whom we have our salvation, the forgiveness of sins:

1.msb: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.
1.kjv: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
1.blb: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation,
1.bbe: Who is the image of the unseen God coming into existence before all living things;
1.heading: The Supremacy of the Son

1.msb: For in Him all things were created, things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through Him and for Him.
1.kjv: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
1.blb: because in Him were created all things in the heavens and on the earth, the visible and the invisible, whether thrones or lordships or rulers or authorities; all things have been created through Him and for Him.
1.bbe: For by him all things were made, in heaven and on earth, things seen and things unseen, authorities, lords, rulers, and powers; all things were made by him and for him;

1.msb: He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.
1.kjv: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
1.blb: And He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.
1.bbe: He is before all things, and in him all things have being.

1.msb: And He is the head of the body, the church; He is the beginning and firstborn from among the dead, so that in all things He may have preeminence.
1.kjv: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
1.blb: And He is the head of the body, the church, who is the beginning, firstborn out from the dead, so that He might be having preeminence in all things,
1.bbe: And he is the head of the body, the church: the starting point of all things, the first to come again from the dead; so that in all things he might have the chief place.

1.msb: For God was pleased to have all His fullness dwell in Him,
1.kjv: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;
1.blb: because all the fullness was well pleased to dwell in Him,
1.bbe: For God in full measure was pleased to be in him;

1.msb: and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through the blood of His cross.
1.kjv: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.
1.blb: and through Him to reconcile all things to Himself, having made peace through the blood of His cross through Him, whether the things on the earth or the things in the heavens.
1.bbe: Through him uniting all things with himself, having made peace through the blood of his cross; through him, I say, uniting all things which are on earth or in heaven.

1.msb: Once you were alienated from God and were hostile in your minds, engaging in evil deeds.
1.kjv: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled
1.blb: And you, being once alienated and enemies in the mind, in the evil works—
1.bbe: And you, who in the past were cut off and at war with God in your minds through evil works, he has now made one

1.msb: But now He has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy, unblemished, and blameless in His presence—
1.kjv: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
1.blb: but now He has reconciled you in His body of flesh through death, to present you holy and unblemished and blameless before Him,
1.bbe: In the body of his flesh through death, so that you might be holy and without sin and free from all evil before him:

1.msb: if you continue in your faith, established and firm, not moved from the hope of the gospel you heard, which has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.
