1.kjv: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
1.blb: if indeed you continue in the faith, established and steadfast, and not being moved away from the hope of the gospel that you heard, the one having been proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, became a minister.
1.bbe: If you keep yourselves safely based in the faith, not moved from the hope of the good news which came to you, and which was given to every living being under heaven; of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

1.msb: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body, which is the church.
1.kjv: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the church:
1.blb: Now I rejoice in the sufferings for you, and I am filling up that which is lacking of the tribulations of Christ in my flesh for His body, which is the church,
1.bbe: Now I have joy in my pain because of you, and in my flesh I undergo whatever is still needed to make the sorrows of Christ complete, for the salvation of his body, the church;
1.heading: Paul’s Suffering for the Church

1.msb: I became its servant by the commission God gave me to fully proclaim to you the word of God,
1.kjv: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;
1.blb: of which I became a minister according to the administration of God having been given to me toward you, to fulfill the word of God,
1.bbe: Of which I became a servant by the purpose of God which was given to me for you, to give effect to the word of God,

1.msb: the mystery that was hidden for ages and generations but is now revealed to His saints.
1.kjv: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
1.blb: the mystery having been hidden away from the ages and from the generations, but now having been manifested to His saints,
1.bbe: The secret which has been kept from all times and generations, but has now been made clear to his saints,

1.msb: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
1.kjv: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
1.blb: to whom God willed to make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory,
1.bbe: To whom God was pleased to give knowledge of the wealth of the glory of this secret among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

1.msb: We proclaim Him, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone perfect in Christ Jesus.
1.kjv: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
1.blb: whom we proclaim, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, so that we may present every man perfect in Christ.
1.bbe: Whom we are preaching; guiding and teaching every man in all wisdom, so that every man may be complete in Christ;

1.msb: To this end I also labor, striving with all His energy working powerfully within me.
1.kjv: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
1.blb: Unto this also I toil, striving according to His energy, which is working in me in power.
1.bbe: And for this purpose I am working, using all my strength by the help of his power which is working in me strongly.

2.msb: For I want you to know how much I am struggling for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me face to face,
2.kjv: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
2.blb: For I want you to know how great a struggle I have for you and those in Laodicea and as many as have not seen my face in the flesh,
2.bbe: For it is my desire to give you news of the great fight I am making for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not seen my face in the flesh;
2.heading: Absent in Body, Present in Spirit

2.msb: that they may be encouraged in heart, knit together in love, and filled with the full riches of complete understanding, so that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,
2.kjv: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
2.blb: that their hearts may be encouraged, having been knit together in love, and to all the riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the knowledge of the mystery of God: Christ,
2.bbe: So that their hearts may be comforted, and that being joined together in love, they may come to the full wealth of the certain knowledge of the secret of God, even Christ,

2.msb: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
2.kjv: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
2.blb: in whom are hidden away all the treasures of wisdom and of knowledge.
2.bbe: In whom are all the secret stores of wisdom and knowledge.

2.msb: I say this so that no one will deceive you by smooth rhetoric.
2.kjv: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
2.blb: I say this so that no one may delude you by persuasive speech.
2.bbe: I say this so that you may not be turned away by any deceit of words.

2.msb: For although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I delight to see your orderly condition and firm faith in Christ.
2.kjv: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
2.blb: For even if I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order and the firmness of your faith in Christ.
2.bbe: For though I am not present in the flesh, still I am with you in the spirit, seeing with joy your order, and your unchanging faith in Christ.

2.msb: Therefore, just as you have received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to walk in Him,
2.kjv: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:
2.blb: Therefore, as you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in Him,
2.bbe: As, then, you took Christ Jesus the Lord, so go on in him,
2.heading: Alive with Christ

2.msb: rooted and built up in Him, established in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing in it with thankfulness.
2.kjv: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
2.blb: having been rooted and being built up in Him, and being confirmed in the faith, just as you were taught, abounding in thanksgiving.
2.bbe: Rooted and based together in him, strong in the faith which the teaching gave you, giving praise to God at all times.

2.msb: See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception, which are based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world rather than on Christ.
2.kjv: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
2.blb: See, lest there will be anyone taking you captive through philosophy and empty deceit, according to the tradition of men, according to the elements of the world and not according to Christ,
2.bbe: Take care that no one takes you away by force, through man's wisdom and deceit, going after the beliefs of men and the theories of the world, and not after Christ:

2.msb: For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity dwells in bodily form.
2.kjv: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
2.blb: because in Him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily.
2.bbe: For in him all the wealth of God's being has a living form,

2.msb: And you have been made complete in Christ, who is the head over every ruler and authority.
2.kjv: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
2.blb: And you are made complete in Him, who is the head of all rule and authority,
2.bbe: And you are complete in him, who is the head of all rule and authority:

2.msb: In Him you were also circumcised, in the putting off of your sinful nature, with the circumcision performed by Christ and not by human hands.
2.kjv: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:
2.blb: in whom also you were circumcised with the circumcision done without hands in the putting off of the body of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,
2.bbe: In whom you had a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ;

2.msb: And having been buried with Him in baptism, you were raised with Him through your faith in the power of God, who raised Him from the dead.
2.kjv: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
2.blb: having been buried with Him in baptism, in which also you were raised with Him through the faith from the working of God, the One having raised Him out from the dead.
2.bbe: Having been put to death with him in baptism, by which you came to life again with him, through faith in the working of God, who made him come back from the dead.

2.msb: When you were dead in your trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your sinful nature, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our trespasses,
2.kjv: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
2.blb: And you being dead in the trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your flesh, He made alive together with Him, having forgiven us all the trespasses,
2.bbe: And you, being dead through your sins and the evil condition of your flesh, to you, I say, he gave life together with him, and forgiveness of all our sins;

2.msb: having canceled the debt ascribed to us in the decrees that stood against us. He took it away, nailing it to the cross!
2.kjv: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
2.blb: having blotted out the handwriting in the decrees against us, which was adverse to us. And He has taken it out of the midst, having nailed it to the cross.
2.bbe: Having put an end to the handwriting of the law which was against us, taking it out of the way by nailing it to his cross;

2.msb: And having disarmed the powers and authorities, He made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross.
2.kjv: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
2.blb: Having divested the rulers and the authorities, He made a show of them in public, having triumphed over them in it.
2.bbe: Having made himself free from the rule of authorities and powers, he put them openly to shame, glorying over them in it.

2.msb: Therefore let no one judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a feast, a New Moon, or a Sabbath.
2.kjv: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
2.blb: Therefore let no one judge you in food or in drink or in the part of a feast or of a New Moon or of Sabbaths,
2.bbe: For this reason let no man be your judge in any question of food or drink or feast days or new moons or Sabbaths:

2.msb: These are a shadow of the things to come, but the body that casts it belongs to Christ.
2.kjv: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.
2.blb: which are a shadow the things about to be; but the body is of the Christ.
2.bbe: For these are an image of the things which are to come; but the body is Christ's.

2.msb: Do not let anyone who delights in false humility and the worship of angels disqualify you with speculation about what he has not seen. Such a person is puffed up without basis by his unspiritual mind.
2.kjv: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
2.blb: Let no one disqualify you, delighting in humility and worship of the angels, going into what he has seen, vainly being puffed up by the mind of his flesh,
2.bbe: Let no man take your reward from you by consciously making little of himself and giving worship to angels; having his thoughts fixed on the things which he has seen, being foolishly lifted up in his natural mind,

2.msb: He has lost connection to the head, from whom the whole body, supported and knit together by its joints and ligaments, grows as God causes it to grow.
2.kjv: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.
2.blb: and not holding fast to the head, from whom all the body, being supplied and being knit together by the joints and ligaments, grows with the growth of God.
2.bbe: And not joined to the Head, from whom all the body, being given strength and kept together through its joins and bands, has its growth with the increase of God.

2.msb: If you have died with Christ to the spiritual forces of the world, why, as though you still belonged to the world, do you submit to its regulations:
2.kjv: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
2.blb: If you died with Christ, away from the elements of the world, why, as if living in the world, are you subject to decrees:
2.bbe: If you were made free, by your death with Christ, from the rules of the world, why do you put yourselves under the authority of orders

2.msb: “Do not handle, do not taste, do not touch!”?
2.kjv: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;
2.blb: “You should not handle! You should not taste! You should not touch!”—
2.bbe: Which say there may be no touching, tasting, or taking in your hands,

2.msb: These will all perish with use, because they are based on human commands and teachings.
2.kjv: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
2.blb: which are all unto decay with the use, according to the precepts and teachings of men,
2.bbe: (Rules which are all to come to an end with their use) after the orders and teaching of men?

2.msb: Such restrictions indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-prescribed worship, their false humility, and their harsh treatment of the body; but they are of no value against the indulgence of the flesh.
2.kjv: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.
2.blb: which, having indeed a word of wisdom in self-willed worship and humility and harsh treatment of the body, are not in any value toward the indulgence of the flesh.
2.bbe: These things seem to have a sort of wisdom in self-ordered worship and making little of oneself, and being cruel to the body, not honouring it by giving it its natural use.

3.msb: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
3.kjv: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
3.blb: If, then, you were raised with Christ, seek the things above, where Christ is sitting at the right hand of God.
3.bbe: If then you have a new life with Christ, give your attention to the things of heaven, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
3.heading: Put On the New Self

3.msb: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
3.kjv: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
3.blb: Mind the things above, not the things on the earth.
3.bbe: Keep your mind on the higher things, not on the things of earth.

3.msb: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
3.kjv: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
3.blb: For you died, and your life has been hidden with Christ in God.
3.bbe: For your life on earth is done, and you have a secret life with Christ in God.

3.msb: When Christ, who is our life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.
3.kjv: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.
3.blb: When Christ, your life, shall appear, then you also will appear with Him in glory.
3.bbe: At the coming of Christ who is our life, you will be seen with him in glory.

3.msb: Put to death, therefore, the components of your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry.
3.kjv: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
3.blb: Put to death, therefore, the members that are upon the earth: sexual immorality, impurity, passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry,
3.bbe: Then put to death your bodies which are of the earth; wrong use of the flesh, unclean things, passion, evil desires and envy, which is the worship of strange gods;

3.msb: Because of these, the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
3.kjv: For which things’ sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:
3.blb: because of which things the wrath of God comes on the sons of disobedience,
3.bbe: Because of which the wrath of God comes on those who go against his orders;

3.msb: When you lived among them, you also used to walk in these ways.
3.kjv: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.
3.blb: in which you also walked once when you were living in them.
3.bbe: Among whom you were living in the past, when you did such things.

3.msb: But now you must put aside all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.
3.kjv: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
3.blb: But now you also put off all these things: wrath, rage, malice, slander, shameful talk out of your mouth.
3.bbe: But now it is right for you to put away all these things; wrath, passion, bad feeling, curses, unclean talk;

3.msb: Do not lie to one another, since you have taken off the old self with its practices,
3.kjv: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
3.blb: Do not lie to one another, having put off the old man with his practices,
3.bbe: Do not make false statements to one another; because you have put away the old man with all his doings,

3.msb: and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.
3.kjv: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
3.blb: and having put on the new, the one being renewed in knowledge according to the image of the One having created him,
3.bbe: And have put on the new man, which has become new in knowledge after the image of his maker;

3.msb: Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free, but Christ is all and is in all.
3.kjv: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.
3.blb: where there is not Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, slave, free; but Christ is all and in all.
3.bbe: Where there is no Greek or Jew, no one with circumcision or without circumcision, no division between nations, no servant or free man: but Christ is all and in all.

3.msb: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
3.kjv: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
3.blb: Put on, therefore, as the chosen ones of God, holy and beloved, inner parts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, patience,
3.bbe: As saints of God, then, holy and dearly loved, let your behaviour be marked by pity and mercy, kind feeling, a low opinion of yourselves, gentle ways, and a power of undergoing all things;

3.msb: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as Christ forgave you.
3.kjv: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
3.blb: bearing with one another and forgiving each other, if anyone may have a complaint toward another. Just as also the Lord forgave you, so also you.
3.bbe: Being gentle to one another and having forgiveness for one another, if anyone has done wrong to his brother, even as the Lord had forgiveness for you:

3.msb: And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.
3.kjv: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
3.blb: And over all these, put on love, which is the bond of perfection.
3.bbe: And more than all, have love; the only way in which you may be completely joined together.

3.msb: Let the peace of God rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.
3.kjv: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
3.blb: And let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body. And be thankful.
3.bbe: And let the peace of Christ be ruling in your hearts, as it was the purpose of God for you to be one body; and give praise to God at all times.

3.msb: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to the Lord.
3.kjv: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
3.blb: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom, teaching and admonishing each other in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, in grace singing in your hearts to God.
3.bbe: Let the word of Christ be in you in all wealth of wisdom; teaching and helping one another with songs of praise and holy words, making melody to God with grace in your hearts.

3.msb: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
3.kjv: And what soever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
3.blb: And everything, whatever you may do in word or in work, do all things in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
3.bbe: And whatever you do, in word or in act, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving praise to God the Father through him.

3.msb: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
3.kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
3.blb: Wives, submit yourselves to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
3.bbe: Wives, be under the authority of your husbands, as is right in the Lord.
3.heading: Christian Households

3.msb: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.
3.kjv: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
3.blb: Husbands, love your wives and do not be bitter toward them.
3.bbe: Husbands, have love for your wives, and be not bitter against them.

3.msb: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.
3.kjv: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
3.blb: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this is well-pleasing in the Lord.
3.bbe: Children, do the orders of your fathers and mothers in all things, for this is pleasing to the Lord.

3.msb: Fathers, do not provoke your children, so they will not become discouraged.
3.kjv: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
3.blb: Fathers, do not provoke your children, so that they may not become discouraged.
3.bbe: Fathers, do not be hard on your children, so that their spirit may not be broken.

3.msb: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything, not only to please them while they are watching, but with sincerity of heart and fear of God.
3.kjv: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:
3.blb: Slaves, obey according to all things the masters according to flesh, not with eye-services as men-pleasers, but in sincerity of heart, fearing the Lord.
3.bbe: Servants, in all things do the orders of your natural masters; not only when their eyes are on you, as pleasers of men, but with all your heart, fearing the Lord:
3.heading: Serving with Honor

3.msb: And whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, as for the Lord and not for men,
3.kjv: And what soever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
3.blb: That which you may do, work from the soul, as to the Lord and not to men,
3.bbe: Whatever you do, do it readily, as to the Lord and not to men;

3.msb: because you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward. For it is the Lord Christ you are serving.
3.kjv: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
3.blb: knowing that you will receive back from the Lord the reward of the inheritance. You serve the Lord Christ.
3.bbe: Being certain that the Lord will give you the reward of the heritage: for you are the servants of the Lord Christ.

3.msb: But whoever does wrong will be repaid for his wrong, and there is no favoritism.
3.kjv: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
3.blb: For the one doing wrong will receive what he has done wrong, and there is no partiality.
3.bbe: For the wrongdoer will have punishment for the wrong he has done, without respect for any man's position.

4.msb: Masters, supply your slaves with what is right and fair, since you know that you also have a Master in heaven.
4.kjv: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
4.blb: Masters, provide to your slaves that which is right and that which is equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
4.bbe: Masters, give your servants what is right and equal, conscious that you have a Master in heaven.
4.heading: Prayerful Speech and Actions

4.msb: Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful,
4.kjv: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
4.blb: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it in thanksgiving,
4.bbe: Give yourselves to prayer at all times, keeping watch with praise;

4.msb: as you pray also for us, that God may open to us a door for the word, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I am in chains.
4.kjv: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
4.blb: praying at the same time also for us, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, on account of which also I have been bound,
4.bbe: And making prayer for us, that God may give us an open door for the preaching of the word, the secret of Christ, for which I am now in chains;

4.msb: Pray that I may declare it clearly, as I should.
4.kjv: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
4.blb: so that I may make it clear, as it is necessary for me to speak.
4.bbe: So that I may make it clear, as it is right for me to do.

4.msb: Act wisely toward outsiders, redeeming the time.
4.kjv: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
4.blb: Walk in wisdom toward those outside, redeeming the time.
4.bbe: Be wise in your behaviour to those who are outside, making good use of the time.

4.msb: Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.
4.kjv: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
4.blb: Let your word be always in grace, having been seasoned with salt, to know how it is necessary for you to answer each one.
4.bbe: Let your talk be with grace, mixed with salt, so that you may be able to give an answer to everyone.

4.msb: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a beloved brother, a faithful minister, and a fellow servant in the Lord.
4.kjv: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:
4.blb: All the things concerning me, Tychicus will make known to you—the beloved brother and faithful servant and fellow servant in the Lord,
4.bbe: Tychicus will give you news of all my business: he is a dear brother and true servant and helper in the word;
4.heading: Greetings from Paul’s Fellow Workers

4.msb: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that he may know about you, and that he may encourage your hearts.
4.kjv: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
4.blb: whom I sent to you for this, that you may know the things concerning us, and he may encourage your hearts,
4.bbe: And I have sent him to you for this very purpose, so that you may have news of how we are, and so that he may give your hearts comfort;

4.msb: With him I am sending Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will tell you about everything here.
4.kjv: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
4.blb: with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is of you. They will make known to you all things here.
4.bbe: And with him I have sent Onesimus, the true and well-loved brother, who is one of you. They will give you word of everything which is taking place here.

4.msb: My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you greetings, as does Mark the cousin of Barnabas. You have already received instructions about him: If he comes to you, welcome him.
4.kjv: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister’s son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
4.blb: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas, concerning whom you received commands—if he shall come to you, welcome him—
4.bbe: Aristarchus, my brother-prisoner, sends his love to you, and Mark, a relation of Barnabas (about whom you have been given orders: if he comes to you, be kind to him),

4.msb: Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings. These are the only Jews among my fellow workers for the kingdom of God, and they have been a comfort to me.
4.kjv: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.
4.blb: and also Jesus who is called Justus, these being the only fellow workers for the kingdom of God of the circumcision, who became a comfort to me.
4.bbe: And Jesus, whose other name is Justus; these are of the circumcision: they are my only brother-workers for the kingdom of God, who have been a comfort to me.

4.msb: Epaphras, who is one of you and a servant of Christ, sends you greetings. He is always wrestling in prayer for you, so that you may stand mature and complete in the full will of God.
4.kjv: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
4.blb: Epaphras greets you, who is of you, a servant of Christ Jesus, always striving for you in the prayers, so that you may stand mature and fully assured in all the will of God.
4.bbe: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ Jesus, sends you his love, ever taking thought for you in his prayers, that you may be complete and fully certain of all the purpose of God.

4.msb: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you and for those at Laodicea and Hierapolis.
4.kjv: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
4.blb: For I testify for him that he has much distress for you and those in Laodicea and those in Hierapolis.
4.bbe: For I give witness of him that he has undergone much trouble for you and for those in Laodicea and in Hierapolis.

4.msb: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas send you greetings.
4.kjv: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
4.blb: Luke, the beloved physician, greets you, and Demas.
4.bbe: Luke, our well-loved medical friend, and Demas, send you their love.

4.msb: Greet the brothers in Laodicea, as well as Nymphas and the church that meets at his house.
4.kjv: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
4.blb: Greet the brothers in Laodicea, and Nympha and the church in her house.
4.bbe: Give my love to the brothers in Laodicea and to Nymphas and the church in their house.
4.heading: Signature and Final Instructions

4.msb: After this letter has been read among you, make sure that it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans, and that you in turn read the letter from Laodicea.
4.kjv: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
4.blb: And when the letter may be read among you, cause that it may be read also in the church of the Laodiceans, and that you also may read the one from Laodicea.
4.bbe: And when this letter has been made public among you, let the same be done in the church of Laodicea; and see that you have the letter from Laodicea.

4.msb: Tell Archippus: “See to it that you complete the ministry you have received in the Lord.”
4.kjv: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
4.blb: And say to Archippus: “See to the ministry that you received in the Lord, that you may fulfill it.”
4.bbe: Say to Archippus, See that you do the work which the Lord has given you to do.

4.msb: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.
4.kjv: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
4.blb: The greeting is in my hand—Paul. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.
4.bbe: I, Paul, give you this word of love in my handwriting. Keep in memory that I am a prisoner. Grace be with you.

1.msb: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.blb: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.
1.bbe: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.
1.heading: Greetings to the Thessalonians

1.msb: We always thank God for all of you, remembering you in our prayers
1.kjv: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
1.blb: We give thanks to God always concerning all of you, making mention in our prayers,
1.bbe: We give praise to God at all times for you, keeping you in memory in our prayers;

1.msb: and continually recalling before our God and Father your work of faith, your labor of love, and your enduring hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
1.blb: unceasingly remembering before our God and Father your work of faith and labor of love, and the endurance of the hope of our Lord Jesus Christ,
1.bbe: Having ever in mind your work of faith and acts of love and the strength of your hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father;

1.msb: Brothers who are beloved by God, we know that He has chosen you,
1.kjv: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
1.blb: knowing, brothers beloved by God, your election,
1.bbe: Being conscious, my brothers, dear to God, that you have been marked out by God's purpose;

1.msb: because our gospel came to you not only in word, but also in power, in the Holy Spirit, and with great conviction—just as you know we lived among you for your sake.
1.kjv: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
1.blb: because our gospel came to you not in word only, but also in power and in the Holy Spirit and with much full assurance, just as you know what we were among you on account of you.
1.bbe: Because our good news came to you, not in word only, but in power, and in the Holy Spirit, so that you were completely certain of it; even as you saw what our behaviour to you was like from our love to you.

1.msb: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord when you welcomed the message with the joy of the Holy Spirit, in spite of your great suffering.
1.kjv: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:
1.blb: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord, having accepted the word in much tribulation with the joy of the Holy Spirit,
1.bbe: And you took us and the Lord as your example, after the word had come to you in much trouble, with joy in the Holy Spirit;

1.msb: As a result, you have become examples to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
1.kjv: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
1.blb: so as for you to become a pattern to all the believing ones in Macedonia and in Achaia.
1.bbe: So that you became an example to all those who have faith in Christ in Macedonia and Achaia.

1.msb: For not only did the message of the Lord ring out from you to Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone out to every place, so that we have no need to say anything more.
1.kjv: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
1.blb: For from you the word of the Lord has sounded forth not only in Macedonia and in Achaia, but in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so as for us to have no need to say anything.
1.bbe: For not only was the word of the Lord sounding out from you in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place your faith in God is made clear; so that we have no need to say anything.

1.msb: For they themselves report what kind of welcome you gave us, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God
1.kjv: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
1.blb: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of entrance we had to you, and how you turned to God from idols, to serve the living and true God,
1.bbe: For they themselves give the news of how we came among you; and how you were turned from images to God, to the worship of a true and living God,

1.msb: and to await His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead—Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath.
1.kjv: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
1.blb: and to await His Son from the heavens, whom He raised out from the dead—Jesus, the One delivering us from the coming wrath.
1.bbe: Waiting for his Son from heaven, who came back from the dead, even Jesus, our Saviour from the wrath to come.

2.msb: You yourselves know, brothers, that our visit to you was not in vain.
2.kjv: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:
2.blb: For you yourselves know, brothers, that our entrance to you has not been in vain.
2.bbe: For you yourselves, brothers, are conscious that our coming among you was not without effect:
2.heading: Paul’s Ministry

2.msb: As you are aware, we had already endured suffering and shameful treatment in Philippi. But in the face of strong opposition, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God.
2.kjv: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.
2.blb: But having previously suffered and having been mistreated (just as you know) in Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God in much struggle.
2.bbe: But after we had first undergone much pain and been cruelly attacked as you saw, at Philippi, by the help of God we gave you the good news without fear, though everything was against us.

2.msb: For our appeal does not arise from deceit or ulterior motives or trickery.
2.kjv: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
2.blb: For our exhortation was not out of deceit, nor out of impurity, nor in trickery;
2.bbe: For our witness does not come from error or from an unclean heart or from deceit:

2.msb: Instead, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, not in order to please men but God, who examines our hearts.
2.kjv: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
2.blb: but just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, so we speak, not as pleasing men, but God, the One proving our hearts.
2.bbe: But even as the good news was given to us by the approval of God, so we give it out; not as pleasing men, but God by whom our hearts are tested.

2.msb: As you know, we never used words of flattery or any pretext for greed. God is our witness!
2.kjv: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:
2.blb: For neither at any time were we with a word of flattery, just as you know, nor with a pretext for greed—God is witness—
2.bbe: For it is common knowledge among you that we never made use of smooth-sounding false words, and God is witness that at no time were we secretly desiring profit for ourselves,

2.msb: Nor did we seek praise from you or from anyone else, although as apostles of Christ we had authority to demand it.
2.kjv: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.
2.blb: nor seeking glory from men, nor from you, nor from others, though having power to be with authority as apostles of Christ.
2.bbe: Or looking for glory from men, from you or from others, when we might have made ourselves a care to you as Apostles of Christ.

2.msb: On the contrary, we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her children.
2.kjv: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
2.blb: But we were gentle in your midst, as a nursing mother should cherish her own children.
2.bbe: But we were gentle among you, like a woman caring for her little ones:

2.msb: We cared so deeply that we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but our own lives as well. That is how beloved you have become to us.
2.kjv: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.
2.blb: So yearning over you, we were well pleased to have imparted to you not only the gospel of God, but also our own lives, because you have become beloved to us.
2.bbe: Even so, being full of loving desire for you, we took delight in giving you not only God's good news, but even our lives, because you were dear to us.

2.msb: Surely you recall, brothers, our labor and toil. We worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to anyone while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.
2.kjv: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.
2.blb: For you remember, brothers, our labor and toil: Working night and day in order not to be burdensome upon any of you, we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.
2.bbe: For you have the memory, my brothers, of our trouble and care; how, working night and day, so that we might not be a trouble to any of you, we gave you the good news of God.

2.msb: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous, and blameless our conduct was among you who believed.
2.kjv: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:
2.blb: You are witnesses, and God, how devoutly and righteously and blamelessly we behaved toward you, those believing,
2.bbe: You are witnesses, with God, how holy and upright and free from all evil was our way of life among you who have faith;

2.msb: For you know that we treated each of you as a father treats his own children—
2.kjv: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,
2.blb: just as you know how, each one of you, as a father his own children,
2.bbe: Even as you saw how, like a father with his children, we were teaching and comforting you all, and giving witness,

2.msb: encouraging you, comforting you, and urging you to walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.
2.kjv: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.
2.blb: we were exhorting and comforting you and charging unto you to walk worthily of God, the One calling you into His own kingdom and glory.
2.bbe: So that your lives might be pleasing to God, who has given you a part in his kingdom and his glory.

2.msb: And we continually thank God because, when you received the word of God that you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as the true word of God—the word which is now at work in you who believe.
2.kjv: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.
2.blb: And because of this, we also give thanks to God unceasingly that, having received the word of God, hearing from us, you accepted, not the word of men, but just as truly it is, the word of God, which also works in you, those believing.
2.bbe: And for this cause we still give praise to God, that, when the word came to your ears through us, you took it, not as the word of man, but, as it truly is, the word of God, which has living power in you who have faith.

2.msb: For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God in Judea that are in Christ Jesus. You suffered from your own countrymen the very things they suffered from the Jews,
2.kjv: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:
2.blb: For you became imitators, brothers, of the churches of God being in Judea in Christ Jesus, because you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen as they also did from the Jews,
2.bbe: For you, my brothers, took as your examples the churches of God which are in Judaea in Christ Jesus; because you underwent the same things from your countrymen as they did from the Jews;

2.msb: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out as well. They are displeasing to God and hostile to all men,
2.kjv: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:
2.blb: who, having killed both the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and having driven us out; and they are not pleasing God and contrary to all men,
2.bbe: Who put to death the Lord Jesus and the prophets, violently driving us out; who are unpleasing to God and against all men;

2.msb: hindering us from telling the Gentiles how they may be saved. As a result, they continue to heap up their sins to full capacity; the utmost wrath has come upon them.
2.kjv: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.
2.blb: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles so that they might be saved, so as to fill up their sins always. Now the wrath has come upon them to the end.
2.bbe: Who, to make the measure of their sins complete, kept us from giving the word of salvation to the Gentiles: but the wrath of God is about to come on them in the fullest degree.

2.msb: Brothers, although we were torn away from you for a short time (in person, not in heart), our desire to see you face to face was even more intense.
2.kjv: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.
2.blb: But we, brothers, having been bereaved of you for the time of an hour—in face, not in heart—were more abundantly eager with much desire to see your face.
2.bbe: But we, my brothers, being away from you for a short time, in body but not in heart, had all the more desire to see your face;
2.heading: Paul’s Longing to Visit

2.msb: Therefore we wanted to come to you—indeed I, Paul, tried again and again—but Satan obstructed us.
2.kjv: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
2.blb: Therefore we wanted to come to you—indeed I, Paul, both once and twice—and Satan obstructed us.
2.bbe: For which reason we made attempts to come to you, even I, Paul, once and again; but Satan kept us from coming.

2.msb: After all, who is our hope, our joy, our crown of boasting, if it is not you yourselves in the presence of our Lord Jesus at His coming?
2.kjv: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?
2.blb: For who is our hope or joy or crown of boasting? Or are not even you, before our Lord Jesus at His coming?
2.bbe: For what is our hope or joy or crown of glory? Are not even you, before our Lord Jesus, at his coming?

2.msb: You are indeed our glory and our joy.
2.kjv: For ye are our glory and joy.
2.blb: For you are our glory and joy.
2.bbe: For you are our glory and our joy.

3.msb: So when we could bear it no longer, we were willing to be left on our own in Athens.
3.kjv: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;
3.blb: Therefore, bearing it no longer, we thought it good to be left in Athens alone,
3.bbe: At last our desire to have news of you was so strong that, while we ourselves were waiting at Athens,
3.heading: Timothy’s Visit

3.msb: We sent Timothy, our brother and minister for God, and our fellow worker in the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,
3.kjv: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
3.blb: and we sent Timothy, our brother and fellow worker of God in the gospel of Christ, in order to strengthen and to encourage you on behalf of your faith,
3.bbe: We sent Timothy, our brother and God's servant in the good news of Christ, to give you strength and comfort in your faith;

3.msb: so that none of you would be shaken by these trials. For you know that we are destined for this.
3.kjv: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.
3.blb: that no one be disturbed in these tribulations. For you yourselves know that we are destined for this.
3.bbe: So that no man might be moved by these troubles; because you see that these things are part of God's purpose for us.

3.msb: Indeed, when we were with you, we kept warning you that we would suffer persecution; and as you know, it has come to pass.
3.kjv: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.
3.blb: For even when we were with you, we were saying beforehand to you that we are about to suffer tribulation, just as also it came to pass, and you know.
3.bbe: And when we were with you, we said to you that trouble was before us; and so it came about, as you see.

3.msb: For this reason, when I could bear it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith, for fear that the tempter had somehow tempted you and caused our labor to be in vain.
3.kjv: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.
3.blb: Because of this I also, bearing it no longer, sent in order to know your faith, lest somehow the one tempting had tempted you, and our labor might be in vain.
3.bbe: For this reason, when I was no longer able to keep quiet, I sent to get news of your faith, fearing that you might be tested by the Evil One and that our work might come to nothing.

3.msb: But just now, Timothy has returned from his visit with the good news about your faith, your love, and the fond memories you have preserved, longing to see us just as we long to see you.
3.kjv: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:
3.blb: But presently, Timothy having come to us from you and having brought good news to us of your faith and love, and that you have a good remembrance of us always, longing to see us just as also we you,
3.bbe: But now that Timothy has come to us from you, and has given us good news of your faith and love, and that you have happy memories of us, desiring greatly to see us, even as we do to see you;
3.heading: Timothy’s Encouraging Report

3.msb: For this reason, brothers, in all our persecution and distress, we have been reassured about you, because of your faith.
3.kjv: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:
3.blb: because of this, brothers, we were encouraged over you in all our hardship and tribulation, because of your faith.
3.bbe: For this cause, brothers, in all our trouble and grief we were comforted about you because of your faith;

3.msb: For now we can go on living, as long as you are standing firm in the Lord.
3.kjv: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.
3.blb: For now we live, if you are standing firm in the Lord.
3.bbe: For it is life to us if you keep your faith in the Lord unchanged.

3.msb: How can we adequately thank God for you in return for our great joy over you in His presence?
3.kjv: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
3.blb: For what thanksgiving are we able to recompense to God concerning you over all the joy with which we rejoice before our God because of you,
3.bbe: For how great is the praise which we give to God for you, and how great the joy with which we are glad because of you before our God;

3.msb: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you face to face and supply what is lacking from your faith.
3.kjv: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
3.blb: night and day imploring exceedingly in order to see your face and to complete the things lacking of your faith?
3.bbe: Night and day requesting God again and again that we may see your face and make your faith complete.

3.msb: Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
3.kjv: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.
3.blb: Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you.
3.bbe: Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus make a way for us to come to you;

3.msb: And may the Lord cause you to increase and overflow with love for one another and for everyone else, just as our love for you overflows,
3.kjv: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
3.blb: And may the Lord cause you to increase and to abound in love for one another and for all, just as also we for you,
3.bbe: And the Lord give you increase of love in fullest measure to one another and to all men, even as our love to you;

3.msb: so that He may establish your hearts in blamelessness and holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all His saints.
3.kjv: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.
3.blb: in order to strengthen your hearts, blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints. Amen.
3.bbe: So that your hearts may be strong and free from all sin before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

4.msb: Finally, brothers, we ask and encourage you in the Lord Jesus to live in a way that is pleasing to God, just as you have received from us. So you should do so all the more.
4.kjv: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.
4.blb: Finally then, brothers, we ask and exhort you in the Lord Jesus that, just as you received from us how it is necessary for you to walk and to please God, just as also you walk, that you may abound more.
4.bbe: And last of all, the prayer which we make to you from our heart and in the name of the Lord Jesus, is this: that as we made clear to you what sort of behaviour is pleasing to God, as in fact you are doing now, so you will go on in these ways, but more and more.
4.heading: Living to Please God

4.msb: For you know the instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
4.kjv: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
4.blb: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
4.bbe: Because you have in mind the orders we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

4.msb: For it is God’s will that you should be holy: You must abstain from sexual immorality;
4.kjv: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:
4.blb: For this is the will of God—your sanctification: for you to abstain from sexual immorality;
4.bbe: For the purpose of God for you is this: that you may be holy, and may keep yourselves from the desires of the flesh;

4.msb: each of you must know how to control his own body in holiness and honor,
4.kjv: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;
4.blb: for each of you to know how to possess his own vessel in sanctification and honor,
4.bbe: So that every one of you may keep his body holy and in honour;

4.msb: not in lustful passion like the Gentiles who do not know God;
4.kjv: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:
4.blb: not in the passion of lust just as also the Gentiles, those not knowing God;
4.bbe: Not in the passion of evil desires, like the Gentiles, who have no knowledge of God;

4.msb: and no one should ever violate or exploit his brother in this regard, because the Lord will avenge all such acts, as we have already told you and solemnly warned you.
4.kjv: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
4.blb: not to go beyond and to take advantage of his brother in the matter, because the Lord is avenging concerning all these things, just as also we said before to you and earnestly testified.
4.bbe: And that no man may make attempts to get the better of his brother in business: for the Lord is the judge in all these things, as we said to you before and gave witness.

4.msb: For God has not called us to impurity, but to holiness.
4.kjv: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.
4.blb: For God did not call us to impurity, but in sanctification.
4.bbe: Because it is God's purpose that our way of life may be not unclean but holy.

4.msb: Anyone, then, who rejects this command does not reject man but God, the very One who has given you His Holy Spirit.
4.kjv: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.
4.blb: So then, the one setting this aside does not set aside man but God, the One also giving His Holy Spirit to you.
4.bbe: Whoever, then, goes against this word, goes against not man but God, who gives his Holy Spirit to you.

4.msb: Now about brotherly love, you do not need anyone to write to you, because you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another.
4.kjv: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.
4.blb: Now concerning brotherly love, you have no need for one to write to you, for you yourselves are taught by God to love one another.
4.bbe: But about loving the brothers, there is no need for me to say anything to you in this letter: for you have the teaching of God that love for one another is right and necessary;

4.msb: And you are indeed showing this love to all the brothers throughout Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers, to excel more and more
4.kjv: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;
4.blb: For also you are doing this to all the brothers, the ones in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, to abound more,
4.bbe: And, truly, you are lovers of all the brothers in Macedonia; but it is our desire that your love may be increased still more;

4.msb: and to aspire to live quietly, to attend to your own matters, and to work with your own hands, as we instructed you.
4.kjv: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
4.blb: and to strive earnestly to live quietly and to do your own things, and to work with your own hands, just as we commanded you,
4.bbe: And that you may take pride in being quiet and doing your business, working with your hands as we gave you orders;

4.msb: Then you will behave properly toward outsiders, without being dependent on anyone.
4.kjv: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.
4.blb: so that you may walk properly toward those outside and may have need of no one.
4.bbe: That you may be respected by those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

4.msb: Brothers, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you will not grieve like the rest, who are without hope.
4.kjv: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
4.blb: But we do not want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those having fallen asleep, so that you should not be grieved, just as also the rest, those having no hope.
4.bbe: But it is our desire, brothers, that you may be certain about those who are sleeping; so that you may have no need for sorrow, as others have who are without hope.
4.heading: The Return of the Lord

4.msb: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, we also believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in Him.
4.kjv: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
4.blb: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, so also through Jesus God will bring with Him those having fallen asleep.
4.bbe: For if we have faith that Jesus underwent death and came back again, even so those who are sleeping will come again with him by God's power.

4.msb: By the word of the Lord, we declare to you that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will by no means precede those who have fallen asleep.
4.kjv: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.
4.blb: For this we say to you in the word of the Lord, that we the living, remaining unto the coming of the Lord, shall not precede those having fallen asleep,
4.bbe: For this we say to you by the word of the Lord, that we who are still living at the coming of the Lord, will not go before those who are sleeping.

4.msb: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a loud command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise.
4.kjv: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
4.blb: because the Lord Himself with a loud command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God will descend from heaven, and the dead in Christ will rise first.
4.bbe: Because the Lord himself will come down from heaven with a word of authority, with the voice of the chief angel, with the sound of a horn: and the dead in Christ will come to life first;

4.msb: After that, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.
4.kjv: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
4.blb: Then we, the living remaining, will be caught up together with them in the clouds for the meeting of the Lord in the air; and so we will be always with the Lord.
4.bbe: Then we who are still living will be taken up together with them into the clouds to see the Lord in the air: and so will we be for ever with the Lord.

4.msb: Therefore encourage one another with these words.
4.kjv: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
4.blb: Therefore encourage one another in these words.
4.bbe: So then, give comfort to one another with these words.

5.msb: Now about the times and seasons, brothers, we do not need to write to you.
5.kjv: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.
5.blb: Now concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need to be written to you.
5.bbe: But about the times and their order, my brothers, there is no need for me to say anything to you.
5.heading: The Day of the Lord

5.msb: For you are fully aware that the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
5.kjv: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
5.blb: For you yourselves thoroughly know that the day of the Lord comes in this way, as a thief in the night.
5.bbe: For you yourselves have the knowledge that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

5.msb: For while people are saying, “Peace and security,” destruction will come upon them suddenly, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
5.kjv: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.
5.blb: When they may say, “Peace and security,” then suddenly destruction comes upon them, as the labor pains to her having in womb; and they shall not escape.
5.bbe: When they say, There is peace and no danger, then sudden destruction will come on them, as birth-pains on a woman with child; and they will not be able to get away from it.

5.msb: But you, brothers, are not in the darkness so that this day should overtake you like a thief.
5.kjv: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
5.blb: But you, brothers, are not in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.
5.bbe: But you, my brothers, are not in the dark, for that day to overtake you like a thief:

5.msb: You are all sons of the light and sons of the day; we do not belong to the night or to the darkness.
5.kjv: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
5.blb: For you are all sons of light and sons of day; we are not of night and not of darkness.
5.bbe: For you are all sons of light and of the day: we are not of the night or of the dark.

5.msb: So then, let us not sleep as the others do, but let us remain awake and sober.
5.kjv: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.
5.blb: So then, we should not sleep as the rest, but we should watch and we should be sober.
5.bbe: So then, let us not take our rest as the others do, but let us be self-controlled and awake.

5.msb: For those who sleep, sleep at night; and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.
5.kjv: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
5.blb: For those sleeping, sleep by night; and those becoming drunk, get drunk by night.
5.bbe: For those who are sleeping do so in the night; and those who are the worse for drink are so in the night;

5.msb: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.
5.kjv: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
5.blb: But we, being of the day, should be sober, having put on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet—the hope of salvation,
5.bbe: But let us, who are of the day, be serious, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and on our heads, the hope of salvation.

5.msb: For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.
5.kjv: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
5.blb: because God did not set us for wrath, but for obtaining salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
5.bbe: For God's purpose for us is not wrath, but salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

5.msb: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with Him.
5.kjv: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
5.blb: the One having died for us, so that whether we may watch or we may sleep, we may live together with Him.
5.bbe: Who was put to death for us, so that, awake or sleeping, we may have a part in his life.

5.msb: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.
5.kjv: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
5.blb: Therefore encourage one another and build up one another, just as also you are doing.
5.bbe: So then, go on comforting and building up one another, as you have been doing.

5.msb: But we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, who preside over you in the Lord and give you instruction.
5.kjv: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
5.blb: But we ask you, brothers, to know those toiling among you and presiding over you in the Lord and admonishing you,
5.bbe: But we make this request to you, my brothers: give attention to those who are working among you, who are over you in the Lord to keep order among you;
5.heading: Christian Living

5.msb: In love, hold them in highest regard because of their work. Live in peace with one another.
5.kjv: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
5.blb: and to esteem them exceedingly in love because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.
5.bbe: And have a high opinion of them in love because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.

5.msb: And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
5.kjv: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
5.blb: And we exhort you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, support the weak, be patient toward all.
5.bbe: And our desire is that you will keep control over those whose lives are not well ordered, giving comfort to the feeble-hearted, supporting those with little strength, and putting up with much from all.

5.msb: Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.
5.kjv: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
5.blb: See that no one shall repay to anyone evil for evil, but always pursue the good also to one another and to all.
5.bbe: Let no one give evil for evil; but ever go after what is good, for one another and for all.

5.msb: Rejoice at all times.
5.kjv: Rejoice evermore.
5.blb: Always rejoice.
5.bbe: Have joy at all times.

5.msb: Pray without ceasing.
5.kjv: Pray without ceasing.
5.blb: Unceasingly pray.
5.bbe: Keep on with your prayers.

5.msb: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
5.kjv: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
5.blb: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God for you in Christ Jesus.
5.bbe: In everything give praise: for this is the purpose of God in Christ Jesus for you.

5.msb: Do not extinguish the Spirit.
5.kjv: Quench not the Spirit.
5.blb: Do not quench the Spirit.
5.bbe: Do not put out the light of the Spirit;

5.msb: Do not treat prophecies with contempt,
5.kjv: Despise not prophesyings.
5.blb: Do not despise prophecies,
5.bbe: Do not make little of the words of the prophets;

5.msb: but test all things. Hold fast to what is good.
5.kjv: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.
5.blb: but test all things. Hold fast to the good.
5.bbe: Let all things be tested; keep to what is good;

5.msb: Abstain from every form of evil.
5.kjv: Abstain from all appearance of evil.
5.blb: Abstain from every form of evil.
5.bbe: Keep from every form of evil.

5.msb: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
5.kjv: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
5.blb: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit and soul and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
5.bbe: And may the God of peace himself make you holy in every way; and may your spirit and soul and body be free from all sin at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
5.heading: Final Blessings and Instructions

5.msb: The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it.
5.kjv: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
5.blb: Faithful is the One calling you, who also will do it.
5.bbe: God, by whom you have been marked out in his purpose, is unchanging and will make it complete.

5.msb: Brothers, pray for us.
5.kjv: Brethren, pray for us.
5.blb: Brothers, pray also for us.
5.bbe: Brothers, keep us in mind in your prayers.

5.msb: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
5.kjv: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.
5.blb: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
5.bbe: Give all the brothers a holy kiss.

5.msb: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the holy brothers.
5.kjv: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.
5.blb: I adjure you by the Lord for the letter to be read to all the brothers.
5.bbe: I give orders in the name of the Lord that all the brothers are to be present at the reading of this letter.

5.msb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
5.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
5.blb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
5.bbe: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

1.msb: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
1.kjv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
1.blb: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
1.bbe: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
1.heading: Greetings to the Thessalonians

1.msb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.blb: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.bbe: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.msb: We are obligated to thank God for you all the time, brothers, as is fitting, because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.
1.kjv: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
1.blb: We ought to thank God always concerning you, brothers, just as it is worthy, because your faith is growing exceedingly, and the love of each one of you all to one another is increasing,
1.bbe: It is right for us to give praise to God at all times for you, brothers, because of the great increase of your faith, and the wealth of your love for one another;

1.msb: That is why we boast among God’s churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring.
1.kjv: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
1.blb: so as for us ourselves to boast in you in the churches of God for your endurance and faith in all your persecutions and in the tribulations that you are bearing,
