1.bbe: So that we ourselves take pride in you in the churches of God for your untroubled mind and your faith in all the troubles and sorrows which you are going through;

1.msb: All this is clear evidence of God’s righteous judgment. And so you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.
1.kjv: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
1.blb: a plain token of the righteous judgment of God, for you to be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which also you suffer.
1.bbe: Which is a clear sign of the decision which God in his righteousness has made; to give you a part in his kingdom, for which you have undergone this pain;
1.heading: Christ’s Coming

1.msb: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
1.kjv: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
1.blb: For indeed it is righteous with God to repay those oppressing you with tribulation,
1.bbe: For it is an act of righteousness on God's part to give trouble as their reward to those who are troubling you,

1.msb: and to grant relief to you who are oppressed and to us as well. This will take place when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels
1.kjv: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
1.blb: and to you being oppressed, relief with us at the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven with the angels of His power
1.bbe: And to you who are troubled, rest with us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with the angels of his power in flames of fire,

1.msb: in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
1.kjv: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
1.blb: in a fire of flame, giving vengeance on those not knowing God and on those not obeying the gospel of our Lord Jesus,
1.bbe: To give punishment to those who have no knowledge of God, and to those who do not give ear to the good news of our Lord Jesus:

1.msb: They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the Lord and the glory of His might,
1.kjv: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
1.blb: who will pay the penalty of eternal destruction away from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of His power,
1.bbe: Whose reward will be eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his strength,

1.msb: on the day He comes to be glorified in His saints and regarded with wonder by all who have believed, including you who have believed our testimony.
1.kjv: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
1.blb: when He shall come to be glorified in His saints and to be marveled at among all those having believed—because our testimony to you was believed—in that day.
1.bbe: At his coming, when he will have glory in his saints, and will be a cause of wonder in all those who had faith (because our witness among you had effect) in that day.

1.msb: To this end, we always pray for you, that our God will count you worthy of His calling, and that He will powerfully fulfill your every good desire and work of faith,
1.kjv: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:
1.blb: For this also we pray always for you, that our God may count you worthy of the calling and may fulfill every good pleasure of goodness and work of faith in power,
1.bbe: For this reason, you are ever in our prayers, that you may seem to our God such as may have a part in his purpose and that by his power he will make all his good purpose, and the work of faith, complete;

1.msb: so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.blb: so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.bbe: So that glory may be given to the name of our Lord Jesus through you, and you may have glory in him, by the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

2.msb: Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered together to Him, we ask you, brothers,
2.kjv: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,
2.blb: Now we ask you, brothers, on behalf of the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and of our gathering together unto Him,
2.bbe: Now as to the coming of the Lord Jesus Christ, and our meeting with him, it is our desire, my brothers,
2.heading: The Man of Lawlessness

2.msb: not to be easily disconcerted or alarmed by any spirit or message or letter seeming to be from us, alleging that the Day of Christ has already come.
2.kjv: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
2.blb: for you not quickly to be shaken in mind, nor to be alarmed, neither through spirit nor through word, nor through letter as through us, as that the day of the Lord is present.
2.bbe: That you may not be moved in mind or troubled by a spirit, or by a word, or by a letter as from us, with the suggestion that the day of the Lord is even now come;

2.msb: Let no one deceive you in any way, for it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of sin—the son of destruction—is revealed.
2.kjv: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
2.blb: Let no one deceive you in any way, because it is not unless the apostasy shall have come first, and the man of lawlessness shall have been revealed—the son of destruction,
2.bbe: Give no belief to false words: because there will first be a falling away from the faith, and the revelation of the man of sin, the son of destruction,

2.msb: He will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship. So he will seat himself as God in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God.
2.kjv: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
2.blb: the one opposing and exalting himself above every so-called god or object of worship—so as for him to sit down in the temple of God, setting forth that he himself is God.
2.bbe: Who puts himself against all authority, lifting himself up over all which is named God or is given worship; so that he takes his seat in the Temple of God, putting himself forward as God.

2.msb: Do you not remember that I told you these things while I was still with you?
2.kjv: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
2.blb: Do you not remember that, being still with you, I was saying these things to you?
2.bbe: Have you no memory of what I said when I was with you, giving you word of these things?

2.msb: And you know what is now restraining him, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.
2.kjv: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.
2.blb: And now you know what is restraining for him to be revealed in his own time.
2.bbe: And now it is clear to you what is keeping back his revelation till the time comes for him to be seen.

2.msb: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work, but the one who now restrains it will continue until he is taken out of the way.
2.kjv: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
2.blb: For the mystery of lawlessness is working already, only the one at present is restraining it until he might be out of the midst.
2.bbe: For the secret of evil is even now at work: but there is one who is keeping back the evil till he is taken out of the way.

2.msb: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will consume with the breath of His mouth and annihilate by the majesty of His arrival.
2.kjv: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
2.blb: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will slay with the breath of His mouth and will annul by the appearing of His coming,
2.bbe: And then will come the revelation of that evil one, whom the Lord Jesus will put to death with the breath of his mouth, and give to destruction by the revelation of his coming;

2.msb: The coming of the lawless one will be accompanied by the working of Satan, with every kind of power, sign, and false wonder,
2.kjv: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
2.blb: whose coming is according to the working of Satan, in every power and in signs and in wonders of falsehood,
2.bbe: Even the one whose coming is marked by the working of Satan, with all power and signs and false wonders,

2.msb: and with every wicked deception directed against those who are perishing, because they refused the love of the truth that would have saved them.
2.kjv: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
2.blb: and in every deception of wickedness to those perishing, because they did not receive the love of the truth in order for them to be saved.
2.bbe: And with every deceit of wrongdoing among those whose fate is destruction; because they were quite without that love of the true faith by which they might have salvation.

2.msb: For this reason God will send them a powerful delusion so that they believe the lie,
2.kjv: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
2.blb: And because of this, God sends to them a working of delusion for them to believe the lie,
2.bbe: And for this cause, God will give them up to the power of deceit and they will put their faith in what is false:

2.msb: in order that judgment may come upon all who have disbelieved the truth and delighted in wickedness.
2.kjv: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
2.blb: so that all those not having believed the truth but having been well pleased in unrighteousness should be judged.
2.bbe: So that they all may be judged, who had no faith in what is true, but took pleasure in evil.

2.msb: But we should always thank God for you, brothers who are loved by the Lord, because God has chosen you from the beginning to be saved by the sanctification of the Spirit and by faith in the truth.
2.kjv: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
2.blb: But we ought to give thanks to God always concerning you, brothers beloved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning unto salvation in the sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth,
2.bbe: But it is right for us to give praise to God at all times for you, brothers, loved by the Lord, because it was the purpose of God from the first that you might have salvation, being made holy by the Spirit and by faith in what is true:
2.heading: Stand Firm

2.msb: To this He called you through our gospel, so that you may share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
2.kjv: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
2.blb: to which also He called you through our gospel to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
2.bbe: And in this purpose he gave you a part through the good news of which we were the preachers, even that you might have part in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

2.msb: Therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.
2.kjv: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.
2.blb: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold fast to the traditions that you were taught, whether by word or by letter from us.
2.bbe: So then, brothers, be strong in purpose, and keep the teaching which has been given to you by word or by letter from us.

2.msb: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and our God and Father, who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope,
2.kjv: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
2.blb: Now our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, the One having loved us and having given us eternal comfort and good hope in grace,
2.bbe: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father who had love for us and has given us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

2.msb: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good word and deed.
2.kjv: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
2.blb: may He comfort your hearts, and may He strengthen you in every good work and word.
2.bbe: Give you comfort and strength in every good work and word.

3.msb: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread quickly and be held in honor, just as it was with you.
3.kjv: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:
3.blb: Finally, brothers, pray for us that the word of the Lord may run and may be glorified, just as also with you,
3.bbe: For the rest, my brothers, let there be prayer for us that the word of the Lord may go forward with increasing glory, even as it does with you;
3.heading: Request for Prayer

3.msb: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men; for not everyone holds to the faith.
3.kjv: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.
3.blb: and that we may be delivered from perverse and evil men; for the faith is not unto all.
3.bbe: And that we may be made free from foolish and evil men; for not all have faith.

3.msb: But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
3.kjv: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
3.blb: But faithful is the Lord, who will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
3.bbe: But the Lord is true, who will give you strength and keep you safe from evil.

3.msb: And we have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do what we command you.
3.kjv: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.
3.blb: And we are persuaded in the Lord as to you, that both you are doing and you will do what we command.
3.bbe: And we have faith in the Lord about you, that you are doing and will do the things about which we give you orders.

3.msb: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.
3.kjv: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
3.blb: And may the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God and into the perseverance of Christ.
3.bbe: And may your hearts be guided by the Lord into the love of God and quiet waiting for Christ.

3.msb: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from any brother who leads an undisciplined life that is not in keeping with the tradition you received from us.
3.kjv: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
3.blb: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to withdraw yourselves from every brother walking in an unruly manner and not according to the tradition that you received from us.
3.bbe: Now we give you orders, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from all those whose behaviour is not well ordered and in harmony with the teaching which they had from us.
3.heading: A Warning against Idleness

3.msb: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not undisciplined among you,
3.kjv: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
3.blb: For you yourselves know how it is necessary to imitate us, because we were not unruly among you,
3.bbe: For you yourselves are used to taking us as your example, because our life among you was ruled by order,

3.msb: nor did we eat anyone’s food without paying for it. Instead, in labor and toil, we worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to any of you.
3.kjv: Neither did we eat any man’s bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
3.blb: nor did we eat bread from anyone without payment, but in labor and toil, working night and day in order not to be burdensome upon any of you,
3.bbe: And we did not take food from any man for nothing, but were working hard night and day not to be a trouble to any of you:

3.msb: Not that we lack this right, but we wanted to offer ourselves as an example for you to imitate.
3.kjv: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
3.blb: not that we do not have authority, but so that we might give ourselves as a pattern to you for you to imitate us.
3.bbe: Not because we have not the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, so that you might do the same.

3.msb: For even while we were with you, we gave you this command: “If anyone is unwilling to work, he shall not eat.”
3.kjv: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
3.blb: For even when we were with you, we were commanding you this, that “if anyone is not willing to work, neither let him eat.”
3.bbe: For even when we were with you we gave you orders, saying, If any man does no work, let him not have food.

3.msb: Yet we hear that some of you are leading undisciplined lives and accomplishing nothing but being busybodies.
3.kjv: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
3.blb: For we hear some are walking among you in an unruly manner, not working at all, but being busybodies.
3.bbe: For it has come to our ears that there are some among you whose behaviour is uncontrolled, who do no work at all, but are over-interested in the business of others.

3.msb: We command and urge such people by our Lord Jesus Christ to begin working quietly to earn their own living.
3.kjv: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
3.blb: Now to such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that, working with quietness, they should eat their own bread.
3.bbe: Now to such we give orders and make request in the Lord Jesus, that, working quietly, they get their living.

3.msb: But as for you, brothers, do not grow weary in well-doing.
3.kjv: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
3.blb: Now you, brothers, should not grow weary in well-doing.
3.bbe: And you, my brothers, do not get tired of well-doing.

3.msb: Take note of anyone who does not obey the instructions we have given in this letter. Do not associate with him, so that he may be ashamed.
3.kjv: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
3.blb: And if anyone does not obey our word through the letter, take note of this one not to mix with him, so that he may be ashamed.
3.bbe: And if any man does not give attention to what we have said in this letter, take note of that man, and keep away from him, so that he may be shamed.

3.msb: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but warn him as a brother.
3.kjv: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
3.blb: And do not deem him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
3.bbe: Have no feeling of hate for him, but take him in hand seriously as a brother.

3.msb: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
3.kjv: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
3.blb: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give to you peace through everything in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
3.bbe: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. May the Lord be with you all.
3.heading: Signature and Final Greetings

3.msb: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. This is my mark in every letter; it is the way I write.
3.kjv: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
3.blb: The greeting is in my own hand—Paul, which is my sign in every letter. In this way I write.
3.bbe: These words of love to you at the end are in my writing, Paul's writing, and this is the mark of every letter from me.

3.msb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you. Amen.
3.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
3.blb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.
3.bbe: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

1.msb: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the command of God our Savior and of the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,
1.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;
1.blb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,
1.bbe: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ, by the order of God our Saviour and Christ Jesus our hope;
1.heading: Paul’s Greeting to Timothy

1.msb: To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
1.kjv: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
1.blb: To Timothy, my genuine child in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
1.bbe: To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

1.msb: As I urged you on my departure to Macedonia, you should stay on at Ephesus to instruct certain men not to teach false doctrines
1.kjv: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
1.blb: Just as I exhorted you to remain in Ephesus in my going to Macedonia, so that you might charge certain ones not to teach other doctrines
1.bbe: It was my desire, when I went on into Macedonia, that you might make a stop at Ephesus, to give orders to certain men not to put forward a different teaching,
1.heading: Correcting False Teachers

1.msb: or devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculation rather than the stewardship of God’s work, which is by faith.
1.kjv: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.
1.blb: nor to give heed to myths and endless genealogies, which cause controversies rather than the stewardship of God that is in faith.
1.bbe: Or to give attention to stories and long lists of generations, from which come questionings and doubts, in place of God's ordered way of life which is in faith;

1.msb: The goal of our instruction is the love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and a sincere faith.
1.kjv: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
1.blb: Now the goal of our charge is love out of a pure heart and a good conscience and a sincere faith,
1.bbe: But the effect of the order is love coming from a clean heart, and a knowledge of what is right, and true faith:

1.msb: Some have strayed from these ways and turned aside to empty talk.
1.kjv: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;
1.blb: from which certain ones, having missed the mark, turned aside to empty talk,
1.bbe: From which some have been turned away, giving themselves to foolish talking;

1.msb: They want to be teachers of the law, but they do not understand what they are saying or that which they so confidently assert.
1.kjv: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
1.blb: wanting to be teachers of the law, understanding neither what they say nor that about which they confidently assert.
1.bbe: Desiring to be teachers of the law, though they have no knowledge of what they say or of the statements which they make so certainly.

1.msb: Now we know that the law is good, if one uses it legitimately.
1.kjv: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;
1.blb: Now we know that the law is good, if one uses it lawfully,
1.bbe: We are conscious that the law is good, if a man makes a right use of it,

1.msb: We realize that law is not enacted for the righteous, but for the lawless and rebellious, for the ungodly and sinful, for the unholy and profane, for killers of father or mother, for murderers,
1.kjv: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
1.blb: knowing this, that law is not laid for a righteous one, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinful, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for slayers of man,
1.bbe: With the knowledge that the law is made, not for the upright man, but for those who have no respect for law and order, for evil men and sinners, for the unholy and those who have no religion, for those who put their fathers or mothers to death, for takers of life,

1.msb: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave traders and liars and perjurers, and for anyone else who is averse to sound teaching
1.kjv: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
1.blb: for the sexually immoral, homosexuals, enslavers, liars, perjurers, and if anything other is opposed to being sound in the teaching,
1.bbe: For those who go after loose women, for those with unnatural desires, for those who take men prisoners, who make false statements and false oaths, and those who do any other things against the right teaching,

1.msb: that agrees with the glorious gospel of the blessed God, with which I have been entrusted.
1.kjv: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
1.blb: according to the gospel of the glory of the blessed God, with which I was entrusted.
1.bbe: Which may be seen in the good news of the glory of the great God, which was given into my care.

1.msb: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has strengthened me, that He considered me faithful and appointed me to service.
1.kjv: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
1.blb: I have gratitude to the One having empowered me, Christ Jesus our Lord, that He esteemed me faithful, having put me to service,
1.bbe: I give praise to him who gave me power, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he took me to be true, making me his servant,
1.heading: God’s Grace to Paul

1.msb: I was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and a violent man; yet because I had acted in ignorance and unbelief, I was shown mercy.
1.kjv: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
1.blb: formerly being a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and insolent; but I was shown mercy, because, being ignorant, I did it in unbelief.
1.bbe: Though I had said violent words against God, and done cruel acts, causing great trouble: but I was given mercy, because I did it without knowledge, not having faith;

1.msb: And the grace of our Lord overflowed to me, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
1.kjv: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
1.blb: And the grace of our Lord exceedingly abounded with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
1.bbe: And the grace of our Lord was very great, with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

1.msb: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst.
1.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
1.blb: Trustworthy is the word, and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the foremost.
1.bbe: It is a true saying, in which all may put their faith, that Christ Jesus came into the world to give salvation to sinners, of whom I am the chief:

1.msb: But for this very reason I was shown mercy, so that in me, the worst of sinners, Jesus Christ might display all His patience as an example to those who would believe in Him for eternal life.
1.kjv: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
1.blb: But because of this I was shown mercy, so that in me, the foremost, Christ Jesus might display all patience, as a pattern for those being about to believe on Him unto eternal life.
1.bbe: But for this reason I was given mercy, so that in me, the chief of sinners, Jesus Christ might make clear all his mercy, as an example to those who in the future would have faith in him to eternal life.

1.msb: Now to the King eternal, immortal, and invisible, the only wise God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
1.kjv: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
1.blb: Now to the King of the ages, the immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory to the ages of the ages! Amen.
1.bbe: Now to the King eternal, ever-living, unseen, the only God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. So be it.

1.msb: Timothy, my child, I entrust you with this command in keeping with the previous prophecies about you, so that by them you may fight the good fight,
1.kjv: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;
1.blb: I commit to you this charge, Timothy my child, according to the prophecies upon you going before, so that by them you may wage the good warfare,
1.bbe: This order I give to you, Timothy my son, in harmony with the words of the prophets about you, so that by them you may be strong, fighting the good fight,

1.msb: holding on to faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected and thereby shipwrecked their faith.
1.kjv: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
1.blb: having faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away, made a shipwreck concerning the faith,
1.bbe: Keeping faith, and being conscious of well-doing; for some, by not doing these things, have gone wrong in relation to the faith:

1.msb: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.
1.kjv: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
1.blb: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I handed over to Satan so that they should be disciplined not to blaspheme.
1.bbe: Such are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have given up to Satan, so that they may say no more evil words against God.

2.msb: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgiving be offered for everyone—
2.kjv: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
2.blb: I exhort, therefore, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings to be made for all men,
2.bbe: My desire is, first of all, that you will make requests and prayers and give praise for all men;
2.heading: A Call to Prayer

2.msb: for kings and all those in authority—so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.
2.kjv: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
2.blb: for kings and all those being in authority, so that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and dignity.
2.bbe: For kings and all those in authority; so that we may have a calm and quiet life in all fear of God and serious behaviour.

2.msb: For this is good and pleasing in the sight of God our Savior,
2.kjv: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
2.blb: This is good and acceptable before God our Savior,
2.bbe: This is good and pleasing in the eyes of God our Saviour;

2.msb: who wants everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
2.kjv: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
2.blb: who wants all men to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
2.bbe: Whose desire is that all men may have salvation and come to the knowledge of what is true.

2.msb: For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
2.kjv: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
2.blb: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
2.bbe: For there is one God and one peacemaker between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

2.msb: who gave Himself as a ransom for all—the testimony that was given at just the right time.
2.kjv: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
2.blb: the One having given Himself as a ransom for all, the testimony in their own proper times,
2.bbe: Who gave himself as an offering for all; witness of which was to be given at the right time;

2.msb: For this reason I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a faithful and true teacher of the Gentiles. I am telling the truth in Christ; I am not lying about anything.
2.kjv: Where unto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
2.blb: in regard to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I speak the truth; I do not lie—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
2.bbe: And of this I became a preacher and an Apostle (what I say is true, not false,) and a teacher of the Gentiles in the true faith.

2.msb: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or dissension.
2.kjv: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
2.blb: Therefore I want the men in every place to pray, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and dissension.
2.bbe: It is my desire, then, that in every place men may give themselves to prayer, lifting up holy hands, without wrath or argument.

2.msb: Likewise, I want the women to adorn themselves with respectable apparel, with modesty, and with self-control, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes,
2.kjv: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
2.blb: Likewise also women are to adorn themselves in respectable apparel, with modesty and sound-mindedness, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or costly clothing,
2.bbe: And that women may be dressed in simple clothing, with a quiet and serious air; not with twisted hair and gold or jewels or robes of great price;
2.heading: Instructions to Women

2.msb: but with good deeds, as is proper for women who profess to worship God.
2.kjv: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
2.blb: but with what is proper to women professing the fear of God through good works.
2.bbe: But clothed with good works, as is right for women who are living in the fear of God.

2.msb: A woman must learn in quietness and full submissiveness.
2.kjv: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
2.blb: Let a woman learn in quietness, in all submission.
2.bbe: Let a woman quietly take the place of a learner and be under authority.

2.msb: I do not permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; she is to remain quiet.
2.kjv: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
2.blb: But I do not permit a woman to teach, nor to use authority over a man, but to be in quietness.
2.bbe: In my opinion it is right for a woman not to be a teacher, or to have rule over a man, but to be quiet.

2.msb: For Adam was formed first, and then Eve.
2.kjv: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
2.blb: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.
2.bbe: For Adam was first formed, then Eve;

2.msb: And it was not Adam who was deceived, but the woman who was deceived and fell into transgression.
2.kjv: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
2.blb: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman, having been deceived, has come into transgression.
2.bbe: And Adam was not taken by deceit, but the woman, being tricked, became a wrongdoer.

2.msb: Women, however, will be saved through childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.
2.kjv: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
2.blb: But she will be saved through childbearing, if they remain in faith and love and holiness, with sound-mindedness.
2.bbe: But if they go on in faith and love and holy self-control, she will be kept safe at the time of childbirth.

3.msb: This is a trustworthy saying: If anyone aspires to be an overseer, he desires a noble task.
3.kjv: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
3.blb: Trustworthy is the word: If anyone aspires to overseership, he is desirous of a good work.
3.bbe: This is a true saying, A man desiring the position of a Bishop has a desire for a good work.
3.heading: Qualifications for Overseers

3.msb: An overseer, then, must be above reproach, the husband of but one wife, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,
3.kjv: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
3.blb: Therefore it is necessary for the overseer to be above reproach, the husband of one wife, sober, sound-minded, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,
3.bbe: The Bishop, then, is to be a man of good name, the husband of one wife, self-controlled, serious-minded, having respect for order, opening his house freely to guests, a ready teacher;

3.msb: not dependent on wine, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, peaceable, and free of the love of money.
3.kjv: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
3.blb: not given to wine, not a striker but gentle, not quarrelsome, not loving money,
3.bbe: Not quickly moved to wrath or blows, but gentle; no fighter, no lover of money;

3.msb: An overseer must manage his own household well and keep his children under control, with complete dignity.
3.kjv: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
3.blb: presiding over his own house well, having children in submission, with all dignity—
3.bbe: Ruling his house well, having his children under control with all serious behaviour;

3.msb: For if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how can he care for the church of God?
3.kjv: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
3.blb: but if anyone does not know how to preside over his own household, how will he take care of the church of God?—
3.bbe: (For if a man has not the art of ruling his house, how will he take care of the church of God?)

3.msb: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall under the same condemnation as the devil.
3.kjv: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
3.blb: not a novice, lest, having been puffed up, he might fall into the judgment of the devil.
3.bbe: Not one newly taken into the church, for fear that, through his high opinion of himself, he may come into the same sin as the Evil One.

3.msb: Furthermore, he must have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the snare of the devil.
3.kjv: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
3.blb: And it is necessary for him also to have a good testimony from those outside, so that he might not fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
3.bbe: And he is to have a good name among those outside the church, so that nothing may be said against him and he may not be taken by the designs of the Evil One.

3.msb: Deacons likewise must be dignified, not double-tongued or given to much wine or greedy for money.
3.kjv: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
3.blb: Deacons likewise must be dignified, not double-tongued, not being given to much wine, not greedy for shameful gain,
3.bbe: Deacons, in the same way, are to be serious in their behaviour, not false in word, not given to taking much wine or greatly desiring the wealth of this world;
3.heading: Qualifications for Deacons

3.msb: They must hold to the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience.
3.kjv: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
3.blb: holding the mystery of the faith with a pure conscience.
3.bbe: Keeping the secret of the faith in a heart free from sin.

3.msb: Additionally, they must first be tested. Then, if they are above reproach, let them serve as deacons.
3.kjv: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
3.blb: And these also, let them be tested first; then let them serve, being blameless.
3.bbe: And let these first be put to the test; then let them become Deacons if there is nothing against them.

3.msb: In the same way, the women must be dignified, not slanderers, but temperate and faithful in all things.
3.kjv: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
3.blb: Women likewise must be dignified, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
3.bbe: Women are to be serious in behaviour, saying no evil of others, controlling themselves, true in all things.

3.msb: A deacon must be the husband of but one wife, a good manager of his children and of his own household.
3.kjv: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
3.blb: Let deacons be husbands of one wife, presiding over their children and their own households well.
3.bbe: Let Deacons be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their houses well.

3.msb: For those who have served well as deacons acquire for themselves a high standing and great confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus.
3.kjv: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
3.blb: For those having served well acquire a good standing for themselves and great confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus.
3.bbe: For those who have done good work as Deacons get for themselves a good position and become free from fear in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

3.msb: Although I hope to come to you soon, I am writing you these things
3.kjv: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:
3.blb: I write these things to you, hoping to come to you in quickness,
3.bbe: I am writing these things to you, though I am hoping to come to you before long;
3.heading: The Mystery of Godliness

3.msb: in case I am delayed, so that you will know how each one must conduct himself in God’s household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.
3.kjv: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
3.blb: but if I should delay, so that you may know how it is necessary to conduct oneself in the household of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and base of the truth.
3.bbe: But if I am long in coming, this will make clear to you what behaviour is right for men in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and base of what is true.

3.msb: By common confession, the mystery of godliness is great: God appeared in the flesh, was vindicated by the Spirit, was seen by angels, was proclaimed among the nations, was believed in throughout the world, was taken up in glory.
3.kjv: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
3.blb: And confessedly, great is the mystery of godliness: He who appeared in flesh, was justified in the Spirit, was seen by angels, was proclaimed among the nations, was believed on in the world, was taken up in glory.
3.bbe: And without argument, great is the secret of religion: He who was seen in the flesh, who was given God's approval in the spirit, was seen by the angels, of whom the good news was given among the nations, in whom the world had faith, who was taken up in glory.

4.msb: Now the Spirit expressly states that in later times some will abandon the faith to follow deceitful spirits and the teachings of demons,
4.kjv: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
4.blb: But the Spirit expressly says that in later times some will depart from the faith, giving heed to deceiving spirits and teachings of demons,
4.bbe: But the Spirit says clearly that in later times some will be turned away from the faith, giving their minds to spirits of deceit, and the teachings of evil spirits,
4.heading: A Warning against Apostasy

4.msb: influenced by the hypocrisy of liars, whose consciences are seared with a hot iron.
4.kjv: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
4.blb: in the hypocrisy of liars, having been seared in their own conscience,
4.bbe: Through the false ways of men whose words are untrue, whose hearts are burned as with a heated iron;

4.msb: They will prohibit marriage and require abstinence from certain foods that God has created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
4.kjv: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
4.blb: forbidding to marry, requiring to abstain from foods that God created for reception with thanksgiving by the faithful and by those knowing the truth.
4.bbe: Who keep men from being married and from taking food which God made to be taken with praise by those who have faith and true knowledge.

4.msb: For every creation of God is good, and nothing that is received with thanksgiving should be rejected,
4.kjv: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
4.blb: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, being received with thanksgiving,
4.bbe: Because everything which God has made is good, and nothing is evil, if it is taken with praise:

4.msb: because it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
4.kjv: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
4.blb: for it is sanctified by the word of God and intercession.
4.bbe: For it is made holy by the word of God and by prayer.

4.msb: By pointing out these things to the brothers, you will be a good servant of Jesus Christ, nourished by the words of faith and sound instruction that you have followed.
4.kjv: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
4.blb: Laying before the brothers these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, being nourished in the words of the faith and of the good teaching that you have closely followed.
4.bbe: If you keep these things before the minds of the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, trained in the words of the faith and of the right teaching which has been your guide:
4.heading: A Good Servant of Jesus Christ

4.msb: But reject irreverent, silly myths. Instead, train yourself for godliness.
4.kjv: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.
4.blb: But reject profane and silly myths. Rather, train yourself unto godliness.
4.bbe: But have nothing to do with unclean and foolish stories. Give yourself training in religion:

4.msb: For physical exercise is of limited value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for the present life and for the one to come.
4.kjv: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
4.blb: For bodily exercise is to a little profit, but godliness is profitable for everything, having the promise of the present life and of the one about to be.
4.bbe: For the training of the body is of profit for a little, but religion is of profit in every way, giving hope for the life which now is, and for that which is to come.

4.msb: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance.
4.kjv: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
4.blb: Trustworthy is the word, and worthy of full acceptance.
4.bbe: This is a true saying, in which all may put their faith.

4.msb: To this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our hope on the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, and especially of those who believe.
4.kjv: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
4.blb: For unto this we toil and strive, because we have hoped on the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of believers.
4.bbe: And this is the purpose of all our work and our fighting, because our hope is in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, and specially of those who have faith.

4.msb: Command and teach these things.
4.kjv: These things command and teach.
4.blb: Command and teach these things.
4.bbe: Let these be your orders and your teaching.

4.msb: Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
4.kjv: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
4.blb: Let no one despise your youth, but be a pattern for the believers in word, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
4.bbe: Let no one make little of you because you are young, but be an example to the church in word, in behaviour, in love, in faith, in holy living.

4.msb: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, and to teaching.
4.kjv: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
4.blb: Until I come, give heed to the reading, to exhortation, to teaching.
4.bbe: Till I come, give attention to the reading of the holy Writings, to comforting the saints, and to teaching.

4.msb: Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given you through the prophecy spoken over you at the laying on of the hands of the elders.
4.kjv: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
4.blb: Do not be negligent of the gift in you, which was given to you through prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elderhood.
4.bbe: Make use of that grace in you, which was given to you by the word of the prophets, when the rulers of the church put their hands on you.

4.msb: Be diligent in these matters and absorbed in them, so that your progress will be evident to all.
4.kjv: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
4.blb: Ponder these things; be in them, so that your advancement may be apparent to all.
4.bbe: Have a care for these things; give yourself to them with all your heart, so that all may see how you go forward.

4.msb: Pay close attention to your life and to your teaching. Persevere in these things, for by so doing you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
4.kjv: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
4.blb: Give heed to yourself and to the teaching. Continue in them; for doing this, you will save both yourself and those hearing you.
4.bbe: Give attention to yourself and your teaching. Go on in these things; for in doing so you will get salvation for yourself and for those who give hearing to you.

5.msb: Do not rebuke an older man, but appeal to him as to a father. Treat younger men as brothers,
5.kjv: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;
5.blb: Do not rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; younger men as brothers;
5.bbe: Do not say sharp words to one who has authority in the church, but let your talk be as to a father, and to the younger men as to brothers:
5.heading: Reproof and Respect

5.msb: older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters, with absolute purity.
5.kjv: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
5.blb: older women as mothers; younger women as sisters, in all purity.
5.bbe: To the older women as to mothers, to the younger as to sisters, with a clean heart.

5.msb: Honor the widows who are truly widows.
5.kjv: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
5.blb: Honor widows who are truly widows.
5.bbe: Give honour to widows who are truly widows.
5.heading: Honoring True Widows

5.msb: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to show godliness to their own family and repay their parents, for this is pleasing in the sight of God.
5.kjv: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
5.blb: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn to be devout first to their own household and to give back recompense to parents, for this is acceptable before God.
5.bbe: But if any widow has children or children's children, let these see that it is right to take care of their family and their fathers and mothers: for this is pleasing in the eyes of God.

5.msb: The widow who is truly in need and left all alone puts her hope in God and continues night and day in her petitions and prayers.
5.kjv: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
5.blb: Now she who is truly a widow and having been left alone has hoped on God and continues in supplications and prayers night and day.
5.bbe: Now she who is truly a widow and without family puts her hope in God, giving herself to prayer day and night.

5.msb: But she who lives for pleasure is dead even while she is still alive.
5.kjv: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
5.blb: But she given to luxury has died while living.
5.bbe: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she is living.

5.msb: Give these instructions to the believers, so that they will be above reproach.
5.kjv: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
5.blb: Also command these things, so that they may be above reproach.
5.bbe: Give orders to this effect, so that no evil may be said of anyone.

5.msb: If anyone does not provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
5.kjv: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
5.blb: But if anyone does not provide for his own, and especially his household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
5.bbe: If anyone has no care for his family and those in his house, he is false to the faith, and is worse than one who has no faith.

5.msb: A widow should be enrolled if she is at least sixty years old, faithful to her husband,
5.kjv: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,
5.blb: Let a widow be enrolled, being not less than sixty years old, the wife of one man,
5.bbe: Let no woman be numbered among the widows who is under sixty years old, and only if she has been the wife of one man,

5.msb: and well known for good deeds such as bringing up children, entertaining strangers, washing the feet of the saints, imparting relief to the afflicted, and devoting herself to every good work.
5.kjv: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints’ feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
5.blb: being testified to in good works: if she brought up children, if she entertained strangers, if she washed the feet of the saints, if she gave relief to those being oppressed, if she followed after every good work.
5.bbe: And if witness is given of her good works; if she has had the care of children, if she has been kind to travellers, washing the feet of the saints, helping those who are in trouble, giving herself to good works.

5.msb: But refuse to enroll younger widows. For when their passions draw them away from Christ, they will want to marry,
5.kjv: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
5.blb: But refuse younger widows; for when they might grow wanton against Christ, they want to marry,
5.bbe: But to the younger widows say No: for when their love is turned away from Christ, they have a desire to be married;

5.msb: and thus will incur judgment because they are setting aside their first faith.
5.kjv: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
5.blb: having judgment because they set aside the first faith.
5.bbe: And they are judged because they have been false to their first faith;

5.msb: At the same time they will also learn to be idle, going from house to house and being not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, discussing things they should not mention.
5.kjv: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
5.blb: And at the same time also they learn to be idle, going around the houses, and not only idle but also gossips and busybodies, speaking things not being proper.
5.bbe: And they get into the way of doing no work, going about from house to house; and not only doing no work, but talking foolishly, being over-interested in the business of others, saying things which they have no right to say.

5.msb: So I advise the younger widows to marry, have children, and manage their households, denying the adversary occasion for slander.
5.kjv: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
5.blb: Therefore I intend for younger ones to marry, to bear children, to manage their households, to give the one opposing no occasion in favor of reviling.
5.bbe: So it is my desire that the younger widows may be married and have children, controlling their families, and giving the Evil One no chance to say anything against them,

5.msb: For some have already turned aside to follow Satan.
5.kjv: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
5.blb: For already some turned aside after Satan.
5.bbe: For even now some are turned away to Satan.

5.msb: If any believing man or believing woman has dependent widows, they must assist them and not allow the church to be burdened, so that it can help the widows who are truly in need.
5.kjv: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
5.blb: If any believing woman has widows, let her give relief to them, and let the church not be burdened, so that it may give relief to those truly widows.
5.bbe: If any woman of the faith has relations who are widows, let her give them help, so that the care of them does not come on the church, and so it may give help to those who are truly widowed.

5.msb: Elders who lead effectively are worthy of double honor, especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching.
5.kjv: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
5.blb: Let the elders presiding well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those laboring in the word and the teaching.
5.bbe: Let rulers whose rule is good be honoured twice over, specially those whose work is preaching and teaching.
5.heading: Honoring Elders

5.msb: For the Scripture says, “Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain,” and, “The worker is worthy of his wages.”
5.kjv: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
5.blb: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle an ox treading out grain,” and, “The worker is worthy of his wages.”
5.bbe: For the Writings say, It is not right to keep the ox from taking the grain when he is crushing it. And, The worker has a right to his reward.

5.msb: Do not entertain an accusation against an elder, except on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
5.kjv: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
5.blb: Do not receive an accusation against an elder, except upon two or three witnesses.
5.bbe: Do not take as true any statement made against one in authority, but only if two or three give witness to it.

5.msb: Those who persist in sin should be rebuked in front of everyone, so that the others will stand in fear of sin.
5.kjv: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
5.blb: But those sinning, rebuke before all, so that the rest may have fear also.
5.bbe: Say sharp words to sinners when all are present, so that the rest may be in fear.

5.msb: I solemnly charge you before God and the Lord Jesus Christ and the elect angels to maintain these principles without bias, and to do nothing out of partiality.
5.kjv: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
5.blb: I earnestly testify before God and Christ Jesus and the chosen angels that you should keep these things without prejudice, doing nothing according to partiality.
5.bbe: I give you orders before God and Christ Jesus and the angels of God's selection, to keep these orders without giving thought to one side more than another.
5.heading: A Charge to Timothy

5.msb: Do not be too quick in the laying on of hands and thereby share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
5.kjv: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men’s sins: keep thyself pure.
5.blb: Lay hands on no one quickly, nor share in the sins of others; keep yourself pure.
5.bbe: Do not put hands on any man without thought, and have no part in other men's sins: keep yourself clean.

5.msb: Stop drinking only water and use a little wine instead, because of your stomach and your frequent ailments.
5.kjv: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach’s sake and thine often infirmities.
5.blb: No longer drink water, but use a little wine, because of the stomach and your frequent ailments.
5.bbe: Do not take only water as your drink, but take a little wine for the good of your stomach, and because you are frequently ill.

5.msb: The sins of some men are obvious, going ahead of them to judgment; but the sins of others do not surface until later.
5.kjv: Some men’s sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
5.blb: The sins of some men are evident, going before them to judgment; but some also they follow after.
5.bbe: The sins of some men are clearly seen, going before them to be judged; but with others, their sins go after them.

5.msb: In the same way, good deeds are obvious, and even the ones that are inconspicuous cannot remain hidden.
5.kjv: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise can not be hid.
5.blb: Likewise also, the good works are evident, and even those being otherwise are not able to be hidden.
5.bbe: In the same way, there are good works which are clearly seen; and those which are not so, may not be kept secret.

6.msb: All who are under the yoke of slavery should regard their masters as fully worthy of honor, so that God’s name and our teaching will not be discredited.
6.kjv: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.
6.blb: As many as are under a yoke as slaves, let them esteem their own masters worthy of all honor, so that the name of God and the teaching may not be blasphemed.
6.bbe: Let all who are servants under the yoke give all honour to their masters, so that no evil may be said against the name of God and his teaching.
6.heading: Serving with Honor

6.msb: Those who have believing masters should not show disrespect because they are brothers, but should serve them all the more, since those receiving their good service are beloved believers. Teach and encourage these principles.
6.kjv: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
6.blb: Now those having believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers; but rather, let them serve, because those being helped by the good work are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.
6.bbe: And let those whose masters are of the faith have respect for them because they are brothers, working for them the more readily, because those who take part in the good work are of the faith and are dear. Give orders and teaching about these things.

6.msb: If anyone teaches another doctrine and disagrees with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and with godly teaching,
6.kjv: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
6.blb: If anyone teaches another doctrine and does not draw near, being sound in the words of our Lord Jesus Christ and the teaching according to godliness,
6.bbe: If any man gives different teaching, not in agreement with the true words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and with the teaching which is in agreement with true religion,
6.heading: Reject False Doctrines

6.msb: he is conceited and understands nothing. Instead, he has an unhealthy interest in controversies and disputes about words, out of which come envy, strife, abusive talk, evil suspicions,
6.kjv: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
6.blb: he is puffed up, knowing nothing, but diseased about controversies and fights about words, out of which come envy, strife, slander, evil suspicions,
6.bbe: He has an over-high opinion of himself; being without knowledge, having only an unhealthy love of questionings and wars of words, from which come envy, fighting, cruel words, evil thoughts,

6.msb: and constant friction between men of depraved mind who are devoid of the truth. These men regard godliness as a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.
6.kjv: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
6.blb: and constant arguing of men thoroughly corrupted in mind and deprived of the truth, supposing godliness to be a means of gain.
6.bbe: Bitter talk of men who, being evil in mind and dead to what is true, take the faith to be a way of making profit.

6.msb: Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain.
6.kjv: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
6.blb: But godliness with contentment is a means of great gain.
6.bbe: But true faith, with peace of mind, is of great profit:
6.heading: Godliness with Contentment

6.msb: For we brought nothing into the world, so certainly we cannot carry anything out of it.
6.kjv: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
6.blb: For we brought nothing into the world, because neither are we able to bring out anything.
6.bbe: For we came into the world with nothing, and we are not able to take anything out;

6.msb: But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with these.
6.kjv: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
6.blb: But having sustenance and coverings, with these we will be content.
6.bbe: But if we have food and a roof over us, let that be enough.

6.msb: Those who want to be rich, however, fall into temptation and become ensnared by many foolish and harmful desires that plunge them into ruin and destruction.
6.kjv: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
6.blb: But those wishing to be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and many foolish and harmful desires, which plunge men into ruin and destruction.
6.bbe: But those who have a desire for wealth are falling into danger, and are taken as in a net by a number of foolish and damaging desires, through which men are overtaken by death and destruction.

6.msb: For the love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. By craving it, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many sorrows.
6.kjv: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
6.blb: For the love of money is a root of all evils, which some, stretching after, were led astray away from the faith and pierced themselves with many sorrows.
6.bbe: For the love of money is a root of all evil: and some whose hearts were fixed on it have been turned away from the faith, and been wounded with unnumbered sorrows.

6.msb: But you, O man of God, flee from these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
6.kjv: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
6.blb: But you, O man of God, flee these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance, and gentleness.
6.bbe: But you, O man of God, keep yourself from these things, and go after righteousness, religion, faith, love, a quiet mind, gentle behaviour.
6.heading: Fight the Good Fight

6.msb: Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made the good confession before many witnesses.
6.kjv: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, where unto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
6.blb: Fight the good fight of the faith. Lay hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession before many witnesses.
6.bbe: Be fighting the good fight of the faith; take for yourself the life eternal, for which you were marked out, and of which you gave witness in the eyes of all.

6.msb: I charge you in the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who made the good confession in His testimony before Pontius Pilate:
6.kjv: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;
6.blb: I charge you before God, the One giving life to all things, and Christ Jesus, the One having testified the good confession before Pontius Pilate,
6.bbe: I give you orders before God, the giver of life, and Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate gave witness to the faith,

6.msb: Keep this commandment without stain or reproach until the appearance of our Lord Jesus Christ,
6.kjv: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
6.blb: for you to keep the commandment, without stain, above reproach, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
6.bbe: To keep the word untouched by evil, clear from all shame, till the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ:

6.msb: which the blessed and only Sovereign One—the King of kings and Lord of lords—will bring about in His own time.
6.kjv: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;
6.blb: which He will show in His own times, the blessed and only Sovereign, the King of those being kings and the Lord of those being lords,
6.bbe: Which at the right time he will make clear, who is the eternal and only Ruler, King of kings, and Lord of lords;

6.msb: He alone is immortal and dwells in unapproachable light. No one has ever seen Him, nor can anyone see Him. To Him be honor and eternal dominion! Amen.
6.kjv: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.
6.blb: the One alone having immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no one of men has seen nor is able to see, to whom be honor and eternal dominion! Amen.
6.bbe: Who only has life for ever, living in light to which no man may come near; whom no man has seen or is able to see: to whom be honour and power for ever. So be it.

6.msb: Instruct those who are rich in the present age not to be conceited and not to put their hope in the uncertainty of wealth, but in the living God, who richly provides all things for us to enjoy.
6.kjv: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
6.blb: Charge the rich in the present age not to be high-minded, nor to have hoped on the uncertainty of riches, but on God, the One richly providing us all things for enjoyment;
6.bbe: Give orders to those who have money and goods in this life, not to be lifted up in their minds, or to put their hope in the uncertain chances of wealth, but in God who gives us in full measure all things for our use;
6.heading: A Charge to the Rich

6.msb: Instruct them to do good, to be rich in good works, and to be generous and ready to share,
6.kjv: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
6.blb: to do good, to be rich in good works, to be generous in distributing, ready to share,
6.bbe: And to do good, having wealth in good works, being quick to give, taking part with one another;

6.msb: treasuring up for themselves a firm foundation for the future, so that they may take hold of eternal life.
6.kjv: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
6.blb: treasuring up for themselves a good foundation for that which is about to be, so that they may lay hold of that which is truly life.
6.bbe: Making ready for themselves a safe place for the time to come, so that the true life may be theirs.

6.msb: O Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to you. Avoid irreverent, empty chatter and the opposing arguments of so-called “knowledge,”
6.kjv: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
6.blb: O Timothy, guard the deposit entrusted, avoiding profane, empty utterances, and opposing arguments of that which is falsely named “knowledge,”
6.bbe: O Timothy, take good care of that which is given to you, turning away from the wrong and foolish talk and arguments of that knowledge which is falsely so named;
6.heading: Guard the Faith

6.msb: which some have professed and thus swerved away from the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
6.kjv: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.
6.blb: which some, professing, missed the mark concerning the faith. Grace be with you all.
6.bbe: Through which some, who gave their minds to it, have been turned away from the faith. Grace be with you.

1.msb: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life in Christ Jesus,
1.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
1.blb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, according to the promise of life that is in Christ Jesus,
1.bbe: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ by the purpose of God, in the hope of the life which is in Christ Jesus,
1.heading: Paul’s Greeting to Timothy

1.msb: To Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
1.kjv: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
1.blb: To Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
1.bbe: To Timothy, my well-loved child: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

1.msb: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as did my forefathers, as I constantly remember you night and day in my prayers.
1.kjv: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
1.blb: I have gratitude to God, whom I serve from the forefathers with a pure conscience, as I have unceasing remembrance of you in my prayers night and day,
