1.bbe: I give praise to God, whose servant I have been, with a heart free from sin, from the time of my fathers, because in my prayers at all times the thought of you is with me, night and day
1.heading: Faithfulness under Persecution

1.msb: Recalling your tears, I long to see you so that I may be filled with joy.
1.kjv: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
1.blb: longing to see you, recalling your tears, so that I may be filled with joy,
1.bbe: Desiring to see you, keeping in my memory your weeping, so that I may be full of joy;

1.msb: I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am convinced is in you as well.
1.kjv: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
1.blb: having taken remembrance of the unfeigned faith in you, which dwelt first in your grandmother Lois and in your mother Eunice, and I am persuaded that it is in you also.
1.bbe: Having in mind your true faith, which first was in your mother's mother Lois, and in your mother Eunice, and, I am certain, is now in you.

1.msb: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
1.kjv: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
1.blb: Because of this reason, I remind you to rekindle the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
1.bbe: For this reason I say to you, Let that grace of God which is in you, given to you by my hands, have living power.

1.msb: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
1.kjv: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
1.blb: For God did not give us a spirit of timidity, but of power and love and soundness of mind.
1.bbe: For God did not give us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of self-control.

1.msb: So do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, or of me, His prisoner. Instead, join me in suffering for the gospel by the power of God.
1.kjv: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
1.blb: Therefore you should not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me, His prisoner; but suffer together for the gospel according to the power of God,
1.bbe: Have no feeling of shame, then, for the witness of our Lord or for me, his prisoner: but undergo all things for the good news in the measure of the power of God;

1.msb: He has saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works, but by His own purpose and by the grace He granted us in Christ Jesus before time began.
1.kjv: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
1.blb: the One having saved us and having called us with a holy calling, not according to our works but according to His own purpose and grace, having been given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,
1.bbe: Who gave us salvation, marking us out for his purpose, not on account of our works, but in the measure of his purpose and his grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

1.msb: And now He has revealed this grace through the appearing of our Savior, Jesus Christ, who has abolished death and illuminated the way to life and immortality through the gospel,
1.kjv: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
1.blb: and now having been made manifest through the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus, having indeed abolished death and having brought to light life and immortality through the gospel,
1.bbe: But has now been made clear by the revelation of our Saviour Christ Jesus, who put an end to death and made life unending come to light through the good news,

1.msb: to which I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
1.kjv: Where unto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
1.blb: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle and a teacher.
1.bbe: Of which I was made a preacher and an Apostle and a teacher;

1.msb: For this reason, even though I suffer as I do, I am not ashamed; for I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that He is able to guard what I have entrusted to Him for that day.
1.kjv: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
1.blb: Because of this reason I also suffer these things. But I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that He is able to guard my deposit entrusted for that day.
1.bbe: And for which I undergo these things: but I have no feeling of shame. For I have knowledge of him in whom I have faith, and I am certain that he is able to keep that which I have given into his care till that day.

1.msb: Hold on to the pattern of sound teaching you have heard from me, with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
1.kjv: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
1.blb: Hold the pattern of sound words, which you heard from me, in the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
1.bbe: Keep the form of those true words which you had from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
1.heading: Holding to Sound Teaching

1.msb: Guard the treasure entrusted to you, with the help of the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.
1.kjv: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
1.blb: Guard the good deposit entrusted by the Holy Spirit, the One dwelling in us.
1.bbe: That good thing which was given to you keep safe, through the Holy Spirit which is in us.

1.msb: You know that everyone in the province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
1.kjv: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
1.blb: You know this, that all those in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
1.bbe: You have had news that all those in Asia went away from me; among whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes:

1.msb: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he has often refreshed me and was unashamed of my chains.
1.kjv: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
1.blb: May the Lord give mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he refreshed me often, and he was not ashamed of my chain.
1.bbe: May the Lord give mercy to the house of Onesiphorus because he frequently gave me help, and had no feeling of shame because I was in chains;

1.msb: Indeed, when he arrived in Rome, he searched very diligently until he found me.
1.kjv: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
1.blb: But being in Rome, he earnestly sought me and found me.
1.bbe: But when he was in Rome, he went in search of me everywhere, and came to me

1.msb: May the Lord grant Onesiphorus His mercy on that day. You know very well how much he ministered to me in Ephesus.
1.kjv: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
1.blb: May the Lord give to him to find mercy from the Lord in that day! And you know very well how much he served in Ephesus.
1.bbe: (May he have the Lord's mercy in that day); and of all he did for me at Ephesus you have full knowledge.

2.msb: You therefore, my child, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
2.kjv: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
2.blb: You, therefore, my child, be empowered in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
2.bbe: So then, my child, be strong in the grace which is in Christ Jesus.
2.heading: Grace and Perseverance

2.msb: And the things that you have heard me say among many witnesses, entrust these to faithful men who will be qualified to teach others as well.
2.kjv: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
2.blb: And the things that you heard from me through many witnesses, entrust these to faithful men such as will be sufficient to teach others also.
2.bbe: And the things which I have said to you before a number of witnesses, give to those of the faith, so that they may be teachers of others.

2.msb: Endure hardship, therefore, like a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
2.kjv: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
2.blb: Share in suffering as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
2.bbe: Be ready to do without the comforts of life, as one of the army of Christ Jesus.

2.msb: A soldier refrains from entangling himself in civilian affairs, in order to please the one who enlisted him.
2.kjv: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
2.blb: No one serving as a soldier entangles himself in the affairs of life, so that he might please the one having enlisted him.
2.bbe: A fighting man, when he is with the army, keeps himself free from the business of this life so that he may be pleasing to him who has taken him into his army.

2.msb: Likewise, a competitor does not receive the crown unless he competes according to the rules.
2.kjv: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
2.blb: Now also, if anyone competes, he is not crowned unless he shall have competed lawfully.
2.bbe: And if a man takes part in a competition he does not get the crown if he has not kept the rules.

2.msb: The hardworking farmer should be the first to partake of the crops.
2.kjv: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.
2.blb: It is necessary for the toiling farmer first to partake of the fruits.
2.bbe: It is right for the worker in the fields to be the first to take of the fruit.

2.msb: Consider what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all things.
2.kjv: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
2.blb: Consider what I say, for the Lord will give you understanding in all things.
2.bbe: Give thought to what I say; for the Lord will give you wisdom in all things.

2.msb: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David, as proclaimed by my gospel,
2.kjv: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
2.blb: Remember Jesus Christ, having been raised out from the dead, of the seed of David, according to my gospel,
2.bbe: Keep in mind Jesus Christ, of the seed of David, who came back from the dead, as my good news gives witness:

2.msb: for which I suffer to the extent of being chained like a criminal. But the word of God cannot be chained!
2.kjv: Where in I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
2.blb: in which I suffer hardship even to chains as an evildoer. But the word of God has not been bound!
2.bbe: In which I put up with the hardest conditions, even prison chains, like one who has done a crime; but the word of God is not in chains.

2.msb: For this reason I endure all things for the sake of the elect, so that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
2.kjv: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
2.blb: Because of this, I endure all things because of the chosen ones, so that they also may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
2.bbe: But I undergo all things for the saints, so that they may have salvation in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

2.msb: This is a trustworthy saying: If we died with Him, we will also live with Him;
2.kjv: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
2.blb: Trustworthy is the word: For if we died together with Him, we will also live together with Him;
2.bbe: This is a true saying: If we undergo death with him, then will we be living with him:

2.msb: if we endure, we will also reign with Him; if we deny Him, He will also deny us;
2.kjv: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
2.blb: if we endure, we will also reign together with Him; if we will deny Him, He also will deny us;
2.bbe: If we go on to the end, then we will be ruling with him: if we say we have no knowledge of him, then he will say he has no knowledge of us:

2.msb: if we are faithless, He remains faithful; He cannot deny Himself.
2.kjv: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he can not deny himself.
2.blb: if we are faithless, He remains faithful, for He is not able to deny Himself.
2.bbe: If we are without faith, still he keeps faith, for he will never be untrue to himself.

2.msb: Remind the believers of these things, charging them before the Lord to avoid quarreling over words, which succeeds only in leading the listeners to ruin.
2.kjv: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
2.blb: Remind them these things, earnestly testifying before God not to fight about words, useful for nothing but to the subversion of those hearing.
2.bbe: Put these things before them, giving them orders in the name of the Lord to keep themselves from fighting about words, which is of no profit, only causing error in their hearers.
2.heading: The Lord’s Approved Workman

2.msb: Make every effort to present yourself approved to God, an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth.
2.kjv: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
2.blb: Be diligent to present yourself approved to God, a workman unashamed, straightly cutting the word of truth.
2.bbe: Let it be your care to get the approval of God, as a workman who has no cause for shame, giving the true word in the right way.

2.msb: But avoid irreverent, empty chatter, which will only lead to more ungodliness,
2.kjv: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
2.blb: But avoid profane, empty utterances, for they will advance to more ungodliness,
2.bbe: But take no part in wrong and foolish talk, for those who do so will go farther into evil,

2.msb: and the talk of such men will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
2.kjv: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
2.blb: and their word will have pasture like gangrene, of whom are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
2.bbe: And their words will be like poisoned wounds in the flesh: such are Hymenaeus and Philetus;

2.msb: who have deviated from the truth. They say that the resurrection has already occurred, and they undermine the faith of some.
2.kjv: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
2.blb: who missed the mark concerning the truth, saying the resurrection already to have happened; and they are overturning the faith of some.
2.bbe: Men whose ideas are all false, who say that the coming back from the dead has even now taken place, overturning the faith of some.

2.msb: Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity.”
2.kjv: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
2.blb: Nevertheless, the firm foundation of God has stood, having this seal: “The Lord knows those being His,” and, “Let everyone naming the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”
2.bbe: But God's strong base is unchanging, having this sign, The Lord has knowledge of those who are his: and, Let everyone by whom the name of the Lord is named be turned away from evil.

2.msb: A large house contains not only vessels of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay. Some indeed are for honorable use, but others are for common use.
2.kjv: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
2.blb: Now in a great house there are not only golden and silver vessels, but also wooden and earthen; and some indeed for honor, but some for dishonor.
2.bbe: Now in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and silver, but others of wood and earth, and some which are honoured and some without honour.

2.msb: So if anyone cleanses himself of what is unfit, he will be a vessel for honor: sanctified, useful to the Master, and prepared for every good work.
2.kjv: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.
2.blb: Therefore if anyone shall have cleansed himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, having been sanctified, useful to the Master, having been prepared for every good work.
2.bbe: If a man makes himself clean from these, he will be a vessel for honour, made holy, ready for the master's use, ready for every good work.

2.msb: Flee from youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
2.kjv: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
2.blb: Now flee youthful lusts and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, along with those calling on the Lord out of a pure heart.
2.bbe: But keep yourself from those desires of the flesh which are strong when the body is young, and go after righteousness, faith, love, peace, with those whose prayers go up to the Lord from a clean heart.

2.msb: But reject foolish and ignorant speculation, for you know that it breeds quarreling.
2.kjv: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
2.blb: And refuse foolish and ignorant controversies, knowing that they beget quarrels.
2.bbe: And put away foolish and uncontrolled questionings, seeing that they are a cause of trouble.

2.msb: And a servant of the Lord must not be quarrelsome, but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, and forbearing.
2.kjv: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
2.blb: And it is necessary for a servant of the Lord not to quarrel, but to be kind toward all, able to teach, forbearing,
2.bbe: For it is not right for the Lord's servant to make trouble, but he is to be gentle to all, ready in teaching, putting up with wrong,

2.msb: He must gently reprove those who oppose him, in the hope that God may grant them repentance leading to a knowledge of the truth.
2.kjv: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
2.blb: in gentleness disciplining those opposing, lest ever God may give them repentance unto a knowledge of the truth,
2.bbe: Gently guiding those who go against the teaching; if by chance God may give them a change of heart and true knowledge,

2.msb: Then they will come to their senses and escape the snare of the devil, who has taken them captive to his will.
2.kjv: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
2.blb: and they might come to their senses out of the snare of the devil, having been captured by him unto his will.
2.bbe: And so they may get themselves free from the net of the Evil One, being made the prisoners of the Lord's servant, for the purpose of God.

3.msb: But understand this: In the last days terrible times will come.
3.kjv: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
3.blb: But know this, that in the last days difficult times will be present.
3.bbe: But be certain of this, that in the last days times of trouble will come.
3.heading: Evil in the Last Days

3.msb: For men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,
3.kjv: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
3.blb: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boasters, proud, verbally abusive, disobedient to parents, ungrateful, unholy,
3.bbe: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, uplifted in pride, given to bitter words, going against the authority of their fathers, never giving praise, having no religion,

3.msb: unloving, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, without love of good,
3.kjv: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
3.blb: unloving, unforgiving, slanderous, without control, savage, without love of good,
3.bbe: Without natural love, bitter haters, saying evil of others, violent and uncontrolled, hating all good,

3.msb: traitorous, reckless, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
3.kjv: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
3.blb: betrayers, reckless, having been puffed up, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
3.bbe: False to their friends, acting without thought, lifted up in mind, loving pleasure more than God;

3.msb: having a form of godliness but denying its power. Turn away from such as these!
3.kjv: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
3.blb: having a form of godliness but having denied its power. And turn away from these.
3.bbe: Having a form of religion, but turning their backs on the power of it: go not with these.

3.msb: They are the kind who worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women who are weighed down with sins and led astray by various passions,
3.kjv: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
3.blb: For out of these are those slipping into households and taking captive weak women, heaped up with sins, being led by various passions,
3.bbe: For these are they who go secretly into houses, making prisoners of foolish women, weighted down with sin, turned from the way by their evil desires,

3.msb: who are always learning but never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.
3.kjv: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
3.blb: always learning and never being able to come to a knowledge of the truth.
3.bbe: Ever learning, and never coming to the knowledge of what is true.

3.msb: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these men oppose the truth. They are depraved in mind and disqualified from the faith.
3.kjv: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
3.blb: Now by which way Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these oppose the truth, men having been corrupted in mind, disqualified concerning the faith.
3.bbe: And as James and Jambres went against Moses, so do these go against what is true: men of evil minds, who, tested by faith, are seen to be false.

3.msb: But they will not advance much further. For just like Jannes and Jambres, their folly will be plain to everyone.
3.kjv: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.
3.blb: But they will not advance much further, for their folly will be evident to all, as also that of those two became.
3.bbe: But they will go no farther: for their foolish behaviour will be clear to all men, as theirs was in the end.

3.msb: You, however, have observed my teaching, my conduct, my purpose, my faith, my patience, my love, my perseverance,
3.kjv: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
3.blb: But you have closely followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, endurance,
3.bbe: But you took as your example my teaching, behaviour, purpose, and faith; my long waiting, my love, my quiet undergoing of trouble;
3.heading: All Scripture Is God-Breathed

3.msb: my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. What persecutions I endured! Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.
3.kjv: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
3.blb: persecutions, sufferings, such as happened to me in Antioch, in Iconium, in Lystra; what manner of persecutions I bore up under! And the Lord delivered me out of all.
3.bbe: My punishments and pain; the things which came to me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; the cruel attacks made on me: and the Lord made me free from them all.

3.msb: Indeed, all who desire to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,
3.kjv: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
3.blb: And all those also wanting to live godlily in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.
3.bbe: Yes, and all whose purpose is to be living in the knowledge of God in Christ Jesus, will be cruelly attacked.

3.msb: while evil men and imposters go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
3.kjv: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
3.blb: But evil men and imposters will advance to the worse, deceiving and being deceived.
3.bbe: Evil and false men will become worse and worse, using deceit and themselves overcome by deceit.

3.msb: But as for you, continue in the things you have learned and firmly believed, since you know from whom you have learned them.
3.kjv: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;
3.blb: But you, abide in the things you learned and were convinced of, having known from whom you learned,
3.bbe: But see that you keep to the teaching you have been given and the things of which you are certain, conscious of who has been your teacher;

3.msb: From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
3.kjv: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
3.blb: and that from infancy you have known the sacred writings, which are able to make you wise unto salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
3.bbe: And that from the time when you were a child, you have had knowledge of the holy Writings, which are able to make you wise to salvation, through faith in Christ Jesus.

3.msb: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
3.kjv: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
3.blb: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
3.bbe: Every holy Writing which comes from God is of profit for teaching, for training, for guiding, for education in righteousness:

3.msb: so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.
3.kjv: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
3.blb: so that the man of God may be complete, having been completely equipped toward every good work.
3.bbe: So that the man of God may be complete, trained and made ready for every good work.

4.msb: I charge you, therefore, in the presence of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of His appearing and His kingdom:
4.kjv: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
4.blb: I earnestly testify before God and Christ Jesus, the One being about to judge the living and the dead, and by His appearing and His kingdom:
4.bbe: I give you orders, before God and Christ Jesus, who will be the judge of the living and the dead, and by his revelation and his kingdom;
4.heading: Preach the Word

4.msb: Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and encourage with every form of patient instruction.
4.kjv: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
4.blb: Preach the word; be ready in season and out of season; convict, rebuke, exhort, in all patience and teaching.
4.bbe: Be preaching the word at all times, in every place; make protests, say sharp words, give comfort, with long waiting and teaching;

4.msb: For the time will come when men will not tolerate sound doctrine, but with itching ears they will gather around themselves teachers to suit their own desires.
4.kjv: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
4.blb: For there will be a season when they will not bear with sound teaching, but according to their own passions, having an itching ear, they will heap up teachers to themselves,
4.bbe: For the time will come when they will not take the true teaching; but, moved by their desires, they will get for themselves a great number of teachers for the pleasure of hearing them;

4.msb: So they will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.
4.kjv: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
4.blb: and indeed they will turn away from hearing the truth, and they will be turned aside to myths.
4.bbe: And shutting their ears to what is true, will be turned away to belief in foolish stories.

4.msb: But you, be sober in all things, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
4.kjv: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
4.blb: But you, be sober in all things, suffer hardships, do the work of an evangelist, fully carry out your ministry.
4.bbe: But be self-controlled in all things, do without comfort, go on preaching the good news, completing the work which has been given you to do.

4.msb: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time of my departure is at hand.
4.kjv: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
4.blb: For I am already being poured out as a drink offering, and the time of my departure has come.
4.bbe: For I am even now being offered, and my end is near.

4.msb: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
4.kjv: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
4.blb: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith.
4.bbe: I have made a good fight, I have come to the end of my journey, I have kept the faith:

4.msb: From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day—and not only to me, but to all who crave His appearing.
4.kjv: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
4.blb: From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me in that day; but not only to me, but also to all those loving His appearing.
4.bbe: From now on, the crown of righteousness is made ready for me, which the Lord, the upright judge, Will give to me at that day: and not only to me, but to all those who have had love for his revelation.

4.msb: Make every effort to come to me quickly,
4.kjv: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
4.blb: Be diligent to come to me quickly,
4.bbe: Do your best to come to me before long:
4.heading: Personal Concerns

4.msb: because Demas, in his love of this world, has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.
4.kjv: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
4.blb: for Demas deserted me, having loved the present age, and he went to Thessalonica, Crescens to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.
4.bbe: For Demas has gone away from me, for love of this present life, and has gone to Thessalonica: Crescens has gone to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.

4.msb: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is useful to me in the ministry.
4.kjv: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
4.blb: Luke alone is with me. Having taken Mark, bring him with you, for he is useful to me for the ministry.
4.bbe: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and take him with you; for he is of use to me in the work.

4.msb: Tychicus, however, I have sent to Ephesus.
4.kjv: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
4.blb: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
4.bbe: Tychicus I sent to Ephesus.

4.msb: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.
4.kjv: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
4.blb: Upon coming, bring the cloak that I left in Troas with Carpus, and the books, especially the parchments.
4.bbe: The coat which I did not take from Troas and which is with Carpus, get when you come, and the books, specially the papers.

4.msb: Alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me. May the Lord repay him according to his deeds.
4.kjv: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
4.blb: Alexander the coppersmith did much harm to me. The Lord will repay to him according to his works,
4.bbe: Alexander the copper-worker did me much wrong: the Lord will give him the reward of his works:

4.msb: You too should beware of him, for he has vigorously opposed our message.
4.kjv: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
4.blb: of whom you also beware, for exceedingly he opposed our word.
4.bbe: But be on the watch for him, for he was violent in his attacks on our teaching.

4.msb: At my first defense, no one stood with me, but everyone deserted me. May it not be charged against them.
4.kjv: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
4.blb: In my first defense, no one came beside me, but all deserted me. May it not be reckoned to them!
4.bbe: At my first meeting with my judges, no one took my part, but all went away from me. May it not be put to their account.
4.heading: The Lord Remains Faithful

4.msb: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, so that through me the message would be fully proclaimed, and all the Gentiles would hear it. So I was delivered from the mouth of the lion.
4.kjv: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
4.blb: But the Lord stood by me and empowered me, so that through me the proclamation might be fully carried out, and all the Gentiles might hear. And I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
4.bbe: But the Lord was by my side and gave me strength; so that through me the news might be given out in full measure, and all the Gentiles might give ear: and I was taken out of the mouth of the lion.

4.msb: And the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
4.kjv: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
4.blb: The Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom, to whom is the glory unto the ages of the ages. Amen.
4.bbe: The Lord will keep me safe from every evil work and will give me salvation in his kingdom in heaven: to whom be glory for ever and ever. So be it.

4.msb: Greet Prisca and Aquila, as well as the household of Onesiphorus.
4.kjv: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
4.blb: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
4.bbe: Give my love to Prisca and Aquila and those of the house of Onesiphorus.
4.heading: Final Greetings

4.msb: Erastus has remained at Corinth, and Trophimus I left sick in Miletus.
4.kjv: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
4.blb: Erastus remained in Corinth, but Trophimus I left being sick in Miletus.
4.bbe: Erastus was stopping at Corinth; but Trophimus, when I last saw him was at Miletus, ill.

4.msb: Make every effort to come to me before winter. Eubulus sends you greetings, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
4.kjv: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
4.blb: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus greets you, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brothers.
4.bbe: Do your best to come before the winter. Eubulus sends you his love, and Pudens and Linus and Claudia, and all the brothers.

4.msb: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you all. Amen.
4.kjv: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
4.blb: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all.
4.bbe: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you.

1.msb: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ for the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness,
1.kjv: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
1.blb: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of the chosen of God and the knowledge of the truth that is according to godliness,
1.bbe: Paul, a servant of God, and an Apostle of Jesus Christ, in agreement with the faith of the saints of God and the full knowledge of what is true in harmony with religion,
1.heading: Paul’s Greeting to Titus

1.msb: in the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began.
1.kjv: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
1.blb: upon the hope of eternal life, which God, who is without falsehood, promised before times eternal
1.bbe: In the hope of eternal life, which was made certain before eternal time, by the word of God who is ever true;

1.msb: In His own time He has made His word evident in the proclamation entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior.
1.kjv: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
1.blb: and revealed in His own seasons in His word, in the proclamation with which I was entrusted according to the command of God our Savior.
1.bbe: Who, in his time, made clear his word in the good news, of which, by the order of God our Saviour, I became a preacher;

1.msb: To Titus, my true child in our common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
1.kjv: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
1.blb: To Titus, my genuine child according to a common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.
1.bbe: To Titus, my true child in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Saviour.

1.msb: The reason I left you in Crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.
1.kjv: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
1.blb: For the sake of this I left you in Crete, that you might set in order the things lacking and might appoint elders in every city, as I directed you,
1.bbe: I did not take you with me when I went away from Crete, so that you might do what was necessary to put things in order there, placing men in authority over the churches in every town, as I said to you;
1.heading: Appointing Elders on Crete

1.msb: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.
1.kjv: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
1.blb: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having believing children, not under accusation of debauchery, or insubordinate.
1.bbe: Men having a good record, husbands of one wife, whose children are of the faith, children of whom it may not be said that they are given to loose living or are uncontrolled.

1.msb: As God’s steward, an overseer must be above reproach—not self-willed, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not greedy for money.
1.kjv: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
1.blb: For it is necessary for the overseer to be blameless, as God’s steward—not self-pleasing, not prone to anger, not given to wine, not a striker, not greedy for shameful gain,
1.bbe: For it is necessary for a Bishop to be a man of virtue, as God's servant; not pushing himself forward, not quickly moved to wrath or blows, not desiring profit for himself;

1.msb: Instead, he must be hospitable, a lover of good, self-controlled, upright, holy, and disciplined.
1.kjv: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
1.blb: but hospitable, a lover of good, sound-minded, righteous, holy, and self-controlled,
1.bbe: But opening his house freely to guests; a lover of what is good, serious-minded, upright, holy, self-controlled;

1.msb: He must hold firmly to the faithful word as it was taught, so that he can encourage others by sound teaching and refute those who contradict it.
1.kjv: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
1.blb: holding to the faithful word according to the teaching, that he may be able both to exhort in sound teaching and to convict those contradicting it.
1.bbe: Keeping to the true word of the teaching, so that he may be able to give comfort by right teaching and overcome the arguments of the doubters.

1.msb: For many are rebellious and full of empty talk and deception, especially those of the circumcision,
1.kjv: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
1.blb: For there are also many insubordinate ones, empty talkers, and mind-deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
1.bbe: For there are men who are not ruled by law; foolish talkers, false teachers, specially those of the circumcision,
1.heading: Correcting False Teachers

1.msb: who must be silenced. For the sake of dishonorable gain, they undermine entire households and teach things they should not.
1.kjv: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre’s sake.
1.blb: whom it is necessary to silence, who overturn whole households, teaching things that it is necessary not to teach, for the sake of shameful gain.
1.bbe: By whom some families have been completely overturned; who take money for teaching things which are not right; these will have to be stopped.

1.msb: As one of their own prophets has said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.”
1.kjv: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
1.blb: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.”
1.bbe: One of their prophets has said, The men of Crete are ever false, evil beasts, lovers of food, hating work.

1.msb: This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sternly, so that they will be sound in the faith
1.kjv: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
1.blb: This testimony is true, through which cause you are to rebuke them severely, so that they may be sound in the faith,
1.bbe: This witness is true. So say sharp words to them so that they may come to the right faith,

1.msb: and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the commands of men who have rejected the truth.
1.kjv: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
1.blb: not giving heed to Jewish myths and commandments of men turning away from the truth.
1.bbe: Giving no attention to the fictions of the Jews and the rules of men who have no true knowledge.

1.msb: To the pure, all things are pure; but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure. Indeed, both their minds and their consciences are defiled.
1.kjv: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
1.blb: All things are pure to the pure; but to those being defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure. But both their mind and conscience are defiled.
1.bbe: To the clean in heart all things are clean: but to those who are unclean and without faith nothing is clean; they become unclean in mind and in thought.

1.msb: They profess to know God, but by their actions they deny Him. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.
1.kjv: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
1.blb: They profess to know God, but in works they deny Him, being abominable and disobedient and unfit for any good work.
1.bbe: They say that they have knowledge of God, while by their acts they are turning their backs on him; they are hated by all, hard-hearted, and judged to be without value for any good work.

2.msb: But as for you, speak the things that are consistent with sound doctrine.
2.kjv: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
2.blb: But you, speak the things that are fitting for sound teaching.
2.bbe: But let your words be in agreement with true and right teaching:
2.heading: Teaching Sound Doctrine

2.msb: Older men are to be temperate, dignified, self-controlled, and sound in faith, love, and perseverance.
2.kjv: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
2.blb: Older men are to be sober-minded, dignified, sound-minded, being sound in faith, in love, in endurance;
2.bbe: That old men are to be simple in their tastes, serious, wise, true in faith, in love, and of a quiet mind.

2.msb: Older women, likewise, are to be reverent in their behavior, not slanderers or addicted to much wine, but teachers of good.
2.kjv: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
2.blb: older women likewise reverent in behavior, not slanderers, not being enslaved to much wine, teachers of good,
2.bbe: That old women are to be self-respecting in behaviour, not saying evil of others, not given to taking much wine, teachers of that which is good,

2.msb: In this way they can train the young women to love their husbands and children,
2.kjv: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
2.blb: so that they may make sober-minded the young women to be lovers of their husbands, lovers of their children,
2.bbe: Training the younger women to have love for their husbands and children,

2.msb: to be self-controlled, pure, managers of their households, kind, and submissive to their own husbands, so that the word of God will not be discredited.
2.kjv: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
2.blb: sound-minded, pure, keepers at home, good, being subject to their own husbands, so that the word of God may not be blasphemed.
2.bbe: To be wise in mind, clean in heart, kind; working in their houses, living under the authority of their husbands; so that no evil may be said of the word of God.

2.msb: In the same way, urge the younger men to be self-controlled.
2.kjv: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
2.blb: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sound-minded.
2.bbe: To the young men give orders to be wise and serious-minded:

2.msb: In everything, show yourself to be an example by doing good works. In your teaching show integrity, dignity, incorruptibility,
2.kjv: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
2.blb: Concerning all things, be holding forth yourself as a pattern of good works, in the teaching, incorruptibility, dignity,
2.bbe: In all things see that you are an example of good works; holy in your teaching, serious in behaviour,

2.msb: and wholesome speech that is above reproach, so that anyone who opposes us will be ashamed, having nothing bad to say about us.
2.kjv: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
2.blb: sound speech, uncondemnable, so that the one of the contrary should be ashamed, having nothing evil to say concerning us.
2.bbe: Saying true and right words, against which no protest may be made, so that he who is not on our side may be put to shame, unable to say any evil of us.

2.msb: Slaves are to submit to their own masters in everything, to be well-pleasing, not argumentative,
2.kjv: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
2.blb: Slaves are to be subject to their own masters in everything, to be well-pleasing, not contradicting,
2.bbe: Servants are to be under the authority of their masters, pleasing them in all things, without argument;

2.msb: not stealing from them, but showing all good faith, so that in every respect they will adorn the teaching about God our Savior.
2.kjv: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
2.blb: not pilfering, but demonstrating all good faithfulness, so that they may adorn the teaching of God our Savior in all things.
2.bbe: Not taking what is not theirs, but giving clear signs of their good faith, in all things doing credit to the teaching of God our Saviour.

2.msb: For the saving grace of God has appeared to everyone.
2.kjv: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
2.blb: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
2.bbe: For the grace of God has come, giving salvation to all men,
2.heading: God’s Grace Brings Salvation

2.msb: It instructs us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live sensible, upright, and godly lives in the present age,
2.kjv: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
2.blb: instructing us that having denied ungodliness and worldly passions, we should live sound-mindedly and righteously and godlily in the present age,
2.bbe: Training us so that, turning away from evil and the desires of this world, we may be living wisely and uprightly in the knowledge of God in this present life;

2.msb: as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
2.kjv: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
2.blb: awaiting the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ,
2.bbe: Looking for the glad hope, the revelation of the glory of our great God and Saviour Jesus Christ;

2.msb: He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.
2.kjv: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
2.blb: who gave Himself for us that He might redeem us from all lawlessness and might purify to Himself a people specially His, zealous for good works.
2.bbe: Who gave himself for us, so that he might make us free from all wrongdoing, and make for himself a people clean in heart and on fire with good works.

2.msb: Speak these things as you encourage and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.
2.kjv: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
2.blb: Speak these things and exhort and convict with all authority. Let no one despise you.
2.bbe: On all these points give teaching and help, and make clear what is right with all authority. Let all men give you honour.

3.msb: Remind the believers to submit to rulers and authorities, to be obedient and ready for every good work,
3.kjv: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
3.blb: Remind them to be subject to rulers, to authorities, to obey rulers, to be ready for every good work,
3.bbe: Make clear to them that they are to put themselves under rulers and authorities, to do what they are ordered, to be ready for every good work,
3.heading: Heirs of Grace

3.msb: to malign no one, and to be peaceable and gentle, showing full consideration to everyone.
3.kjv: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
3.blb: to speak evil of no one, to be not quarrelsome, gentle, showing all meekness toward all men.
3.bbe: To say no evil of any man, not to be fighters, to give way to others, to be gentle in behaviour to all men.

3.msb: For at one time we too were foolish, disobedient, misled, and enslaved to all sorts of desires and pleasures—living in malice and envy, being hated and hating one another.
3.kjv: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
3.blb: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, being deceived, being in slavery to various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, hating one another.
3.bbe: For in the past we were foolish, hard in heart, turned from the true way, servants of evil desires and pleasures, living in bad feeling and envy, hated and hating one another.

3.msb: But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared,
3.kjv: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
3.blb: But when the kindness and the love of mankind of God our Savior appeared,
3.bbe: But when the mercy of God our Saviour, and his love to man was seen,

3.msb: He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
3.kjv: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
3.blb: not by works in righteousness that we did, but according to His mercy, He saved us through the washing of regeneration and a renewing of the Holy Spirit,
3.bbe: Not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but in the measure of his mercy, he gave us salvation, through the washing of the new birth and the giving of new life in the Holy Spirit,

3.msb: This is the Spirit He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,
3.kjv: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
3.blb: whom He poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior,
3.bbe: Which he gave us freely through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

3.msb: so that, having been justified by His grace, we would become heirs with the hope of eternal life.
3.kjv: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
3.blb: so that, having been justified by His grace, we might become heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
3.bbe: So that, having been given righteousness through grace, we might have a part in the heritage, the hope of eternal life.

3.msb: This saying is trustworthy. And I want you to emphasize these things, so that those who have believed God will take care to devote themselves to good deeds. These things are excellent and profitable for the people.
3.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
3.blb: Trustworthy is the word, and I want you to affirm strongly concerning these things, so that those having believed God may take thought to devote themselves to good works. These things are good and profitable to men.
3.bbe: This is a true saying; and it is my desire that you may give certain witness about these things, so that those who have had faith in God may give attention to good works. These things are good and of profit to men;

3.msb: But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, arguments, and quarrels about the law, because these things are pointless and worthless.
3.kjv: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
3.blb: But avoid foolish controversies and genealogies and contentions and quarrels about the law; for they are unprofitable and futile.
3.bbe: But have nothing to do with foolish questionings, and lists of generations, and fights and arguments about the law; for they are of no profit and foolish.
3.heading: Avoid Divisions

3.msb: Reject a divisive man after a first and second admonition,
3.kjv: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
3.blb: Reject a divisive man after one and a second admonition,
3.bbe: A man whose opinions are not those of the church, after a first and second protest, is to be kept out of your society;

3.msb: knowing that such a man is corrupt and sinful; he is self-condemned.
3.kjv: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
3.blb: knowing that such a man is warped and is sinning, being self-condemned.
3.bbe: Clearly he is in error and a sinner, being self-judged.

3.msb: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.
3.kjv: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
3.blb: When I shall send Artemas or Tychicus to you, be diligent to come to me at Nicopolis, for I have decided to winter there.
3.bbe: When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me at Nicopolis: for it is my purpose to be there for the winter.
3.heading: Final Remarks and Greetings

3.msb: Do your best to equip Zenas the lawyer and Apollos, so that they will have everything they need.
3.kjv: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
3.blb: Diligently send forth Zenas the lawyer and Apollos, so that nothing may be lacking to them.
3.bbe: Send Zenas, the man of law, and Apollos on their journey with all care, so that they may be in need of nothing.

3.msb: And our people must also learn to devote themselves to good works in order to meet the pressing needs of others, so that they will not be unfruitful.
3.kjv: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
3.blb: And also let our people learn to devote themselves to good works for necessary needs, so that they may not be unfruitful.
3.bbe: And let our people go on with good works for necessary purposes, so that they may not be without fruit.

3.msb: All who are with me send you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with all of you. Amen.
3.kjv: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
3.blb: All those with me greet you. Greet those loving us in the faith. Grace be with all of you.
3.bbe: All who are with me send you their love. Give our love to our friends in the faith. Grace be with you all.

1.msb: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our beloved fellow worker,
1.kjv: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,
1.blb: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy the brother, To Philemon, our beloved and fellow worker,
1.bbe: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our dear helper in the faith,
1.heading: Greetings from Paul and Timothy

1.msb: to Apphia our beloved, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church that meets at your house:
1.kjv: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:
1.blb: and to Apphia the sister, and to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church at your house:
1.bbe: And to Apphia, our sister, and to Archippus, our brother in God's army, and to the church in your house:

1.msb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.blb: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.bbe: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.msb: I always thank my God, remembering you in my prayers,
1.kjv: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,
1.blb: I thank my God always, making remembrance of you in my prayers,
1.bbe: I give praise to God at all times and make prayer for you,
1.heading: Philemon’s Faith and Love

1.msb: because I hear about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints.
1.kjv: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;
1.blb: hearing of your love and the faith that you have toward the Lord Jesus and for all the saints,
1.bbe: Hearing of the love and the faith which you have to the Lord Jesus and to all the saints;

1.msb: I pray that your partnership in the faith may become effective as you fully acknowledge every good thing that is ours in Christ Jesus.
1.kjv: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.
1.blb: so that the fellowship of your faith might become effective in the full knowledge of every good thing that is in us in Christ.
1.bbe: That the faith which you have in common with them may be working with power, in the knowledge of every good thing in you, for Christ.

1.msb: We take great joy and encouragement in your love, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the saints.
1.kjv: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.
1.blb: For I have much joy and encouragement on the basis of your love, because the inner parts of the saints have been refreshed by you, brother.
1.bbe: For I had great joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been made strong again through you, brother.

1.msb: So although in Christ I am bold enough to order you to do what is proper,
1.kjv: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,
1.blb: Therefore, having much boldness in Christ to order you to do what is fitting,
1.bbe: And so, though I might, in the name of Christ, give you orders to do what is right,
1.heading: Paul’s Appeal for Onesimus

1.msb: I prefer to appeal on the basis of love. For I, Paul, am now aged, and a prisoner of Jesus Christ as well.
1.kjv: Yet for love’s sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
1.blb: because of love, rather, I exhort you, being such a one as Paul, now an elderly man and also a prisoner of Christ Jesus.
1.bbe: Still, because of love, in place of an order, I make a request to you, I, Paul, an old man and now a prisoner of Christ Jesus:

1.msb: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whose father I became while I was in my chains.
1.kjv: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:
1.blb: I exhort you concerning my child whom I begot in chains, Onesimus,
1.bbe: My request is for my child Onesimus, the child of my chains,

1.msb: Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.
1.kjv: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:
1.blb: the one once useless to you, but now useful both to you and to me,
1.bbe: Who in the past was of no profit to you, but now is of profit to you and to me:

1.msb: I am sending back for you to receive him who is my very heart.
1.kjv: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:
1.blb: whom I sent back to you himself—this one who is my inner parts—
1.bbe: Whom I have sent back to you, him who is my very heart:

1.msb: I would have liked to keep him with me, so that on your behalf he could minister to me in my chains for the gospel.
1.kjv: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:
1.blb: whom I was wishing to keep with myself, so that on behalf of you he might minister to me in the chains of the gospel.
1.bbe: Though my desire was to keep him with me, to be my servant in the chains of the good news, in your place:

1.msb: But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that your goodness will not be out of compulsion, but by your own free will.
1.kjv: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.
1.blb: But apart from your consent I wanted to do nothing, so that your good may be not as according to necessity, but according to willingness.
1.bbe: But without your approval I would do nothing; so that your good works might not be forced, but done freely from your heart.

1.msb: For perhaps this is why he was separated from you for a while, so that you might have him back for good—
1.kjv: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;
1.blb: For perhaps because of this he was separated for an hour, so that you might have him back eternally,
1.bbe: For it is possible that for this reason he was parted from you for a time, so that you might have him for ever;

1.msb: no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a beloved brother. He is especially beloved to me, but even more so to you, both in person and in the Lord.
1.kjv: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
1.blb: no longer as a slave, but above a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
1.bbe: No longer as a servant, but more than a servant, a brother, very dear to me specially, but much more to you, in the flesh as well as in the Lord.

1.msb: So if you consider me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
1.kjv: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.
1.blb: Therefore, if you hold me a partner, receive him as me.
1.bbe: If then you take me to be your friend and brother, take him in as myself.

1.msb: But if he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
1.kjv: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;
1.blb: But if in any way he wronged you or he owes you, impute this to me.
1.bbe: If he has done you any wrong or is in debt to you for anything, put it to my account.

1.msb: I, Paul, write this with my own hand. I will repay it—not to mention that you owe me your very self.
1.kjv: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.
1.blb: I, Paul, wrote with my own hand. I will repay it, that I may not say to you that you also owe to me even yourself.
1.bbe: I, Paul, writing this myself, say, I will make payment to you: and I do not say to you that you are in debt to me even for your life.

1.msb: Yes, brother, let me have some benefit from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
1.kjv: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.
1.blb: Yes, brother, may I have profit from you in the Lord. Refresh my inner parts in Christ.
1.bbe: So brother, let me have joy of you in the Lord: give new life to my heart in Christ.

1.msb: Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I ask.
1.kjv: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.
1.blb: Being persuaded of your obedience, I wrote to you, knowing that you will do even above what I say.
1.bbe: Being certain that you will do my desire, I am writing to you, in the knowledge that you will do even more than I say.

1.msb: In the meantime, prepare a guest room for me, because I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
1.kjv: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
1.blb: Now at the same time, also prepare a lodging for me; for I hope that through your prayers I will be graciously given to you.
1.bbe: And make a room ready for me; for I am hoping that through your prayers I will be given to you.

1.msb: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings,
1.kjv: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;
1.blb: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
1.bbe: Epaphras, my brother-prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you his love;
1.heading: Additional Greetings

1.msb: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
1.kjv: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.
1.blb: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
1.bbe: And so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my brother-workers.

1.msb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
1.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
1.blb: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
1.bbe: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. So be it.

1.msb: On many past occasions and in many different ways, God spoke to our fathers through the prophets.
1.kjv: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,
1.blb: God, having spoken long ago to the fathers in the prophets in many portions and in many ways,
1.bbe: In times past the word of God came to our fathers through the prophets, in different parts and in different ways;
1.heading: The Supremacy of the Son

1.msb: But in these last days He has spoken to us by His Son, whom He appointed heir of all things, and through whom He made the universe.
1.kjv: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
1.blb: in these last days spoke to us in His Son, whom He appointed heir of all things, through whom also He made the ages,
1.bbe: But now, at the end of these days, it has come to us through his Son, to whom he has given all things for a heritage, and through whom he made the order of the generations;

1.msb: The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the exact representation of His nature, upholding all things by His powerful word. After He had provided purification for our sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.
1.kjv: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
1.blb: who, being the radiance of His glory and the exact imprint of His substance and bearing all things by the word of power—through His having made purification of sins—sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high,
1.bbe: Who, being the outshining of his glory, the true image of his substance, supporting all things by the word of his power, having given himself as an offering making clean from sins, took his seat at the right hand of God in heaven;

1.msb: So He became as far superior to the angels as the name He has inherited is excellent beyond theirs.
1.kjv: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
1.blb: having become so much better than the angels, as much as He has inherited a name more excellent beyond theirs.
1.bbe: Having become by so much better than the angels, as the name which is his heritage is more noble than theirs.

1.msb: For to which of the angels did God ever say: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father”? Or again: “I will be His Father, and He will be My Son”?
1.kjv: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
1.blb: For to which of the angels did He ever say: “You are My Son; today I have begotten You”? And again: “I will be to Him for a Father, and He will be to Me for a Son”?
1.bbe: To which of the angels did God say at any time, You are my Son, this day I have given you being? or, I will be his Father, and he will be my Son?

1.msb: And again, when God brings His firstborn into the world, He says: “Let all God’s angels worship Him.”
1.kjv: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.
1.blb: And again, when He brings the firstborn into the world, He says: “And let all angels of God worship Him.”
1.bbe: And again, when he is sending his only Son into the world, he says, Let all the angels of God give him worship.

1.msb: Now about the angels He says: “He makes His angels winds, His servants flames of fire.”
1.kjv: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.
1.blb: And indeed to the angels He says: “The One making His angels winds, and His ministers a flame of fire.”
1.bbe: And of the angels he says, Who makes his angels winds, and his servants flames of fire:

1.msb: But about the Son He says: “Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
1.kjv: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
1.blb: But to the Son: “Your throne, O God, is to the age of the age, and the scepter of uprightness is the scepter of Your kingdom.
1.bbe: But of the Son he says, Your seat of power, O God, is for ever and ever; and the rod of your kingdom is a rod of righteousness.

1.msb: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, Your God, has anointed You above Your companions with the oil of joy.”
1.kjv: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
1.blb: You loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; because of this, God, Your God, anointed You with the oil of exultation beyond Your companions.”
1.bbe: You have been a lover of righteousness and a hater of evil; and so God, your God, has put the oil of joy on your head more than on the heads of those who are with you.

1.msb: And: “In the beginning, O Lord, You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
1.kjv: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:
1.blb: And: “You, in the beginning, Lord, laid the foundation of the earth, and the heavens are works of Your hands.
1.bbe: You, Lord, at the first did put the earth on its base, and the heavens are the works of your hands:

1.msb: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment.
1.kjv: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
1.blb: They will perish, but You remain; and all will grow old like a garment;
1.bbe: They will come to their end; but you are for ever; they will become old as a robe;

1.msb: You will roll them up like a robe; they will be changed; but You remain the same, and Your years will never end.”
1.kjv: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.
1.blb: and like a robe You will roll them up, and like a garment they will be changed; but You are the same, and Your years will not come to an end.”
1.bbe: They will be rolled up like a cloth, even like a robe, and they will be changed: but you are the same and your years will have no end.

1.msb: Yet to which of the angels did God ever say: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet”?
1.kjv: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?
1.blb: Now to which of the angels has He ever said: “Sit at My right hand until I shall place Your enemies as a footstool for Your feet”?
1.bbe: But of which of the angels has he said at any time, Take your seat at my right hand till I put all those who are against you under your feet?

1.msb: Are not the angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?
1.kjv: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
1.blb: Are they not all ministering spirits being sent forth for service for the sake of those being about to inherit salvation?
1.bbe: Are they not all helping spirits, who are sent out as servants to those whose heritage will be salvation?

2.msb: We must pay closer attention, therefore, to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away.
2.kjv: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
2.blb: Because of this, it is necessary for us to give heed more abundantly to the things having been heard, lest ever we should drift away.
2.bbe: For this reason there is the more need for us to give attention to the things which have come to our ears, for fear that by chance we might be slipping away.
2.heading: Salvation Confirmed
