9.kjv: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.
9.blb: And likewise he sprinkled both the tabernacle and all the vessels of the sacred service with blood.
9.bbe: And the blood was put on the Tent and all the holy vessels in the same way.

9.msb: According to the law, in fact, nearly everything must be purified with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.
9.kjv: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
9.blb: And almost all things are purified with blood according to the law, and without blood-shedding there is no forgiveness.
9.bbe: And by the law almost all things are made clean with blood, and without blood there is no forgiveness.

9.msb: So it was necessary for the copies of the heavenly things to be purified with these sacrifices, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
9.kjv: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
9.blb: Therefore there was a necessity indeed for the representations of the things in the heavens to be purified with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
9.bbe: For this cause it was necessary to make the copies of the things in heaven clean with these offerings; but the things themselves are made clean with better offerings than these.

9.msb: For Christ did not enter a man-made copy of the true sanctuary, but He entered heaven itself, now to appear on our behalf in the presence of God.
9.kjv: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:
9.blb: For Christ entered not into holy places made by hands, copies of the true ones, but into heaven itself, now to appear for us in the presence of God,
9.bbe: For Christ did not go into a holy place which had been made by men's hands as the copy of the true one; but he went into heaven itself, and now takes his place before the face of God for us.

9.msb: Nor did He enter heaven to offer Himself again and again, as the high priest enters the Most Holy Place every year with blood that is not his own.
9.kjv: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;
9.blb: nor that He should offer Himself many times, just as the high priest enters into the holy places every year with the blood of another.
9.bbe: And he did not have to make an offering of himself again and again, as the high priest goes into the holy place every year with blood which is not his;

9.msb: Otherwise, Christ would have had to suffer repeatedly since the foundation of the world. But now He has appeared once for all at the end of the ages to do away with sin by the sacrifice of Himself.
9.kjv: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
9.blb: Otherwise it was necessary for Him to have suffered many times from the foundation of the world. But now He has been revealed once in the consummation of the ages for the putting away of sin by the sacrifice of Himself.
9.bbe: For then he would have undergone a number of deaths from the time of the making of the world: but now he has come to us at the end of the old order, to put away sin by the offering of himself.

9.msb: Just as man is appointed to die once, and after that to face judgment,
9.kjv: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
9.blb: And inasmuch as it is apportioned to men to die once, and after this, judgment,
9.bbe: And because by God's law death comes to men once, and after that they are judged;

9.msb: so also Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many; and He will appear a second time, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who eagerly await Him.
9.kjv: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.
9.blb: so also Christ, having been offered once in order to bear the sins of many, will appear for a second time, apart from sin, to those eagerly awaiting Him for salvation.
9.bbe: So Christ, having at his first coming taken on himself the sins of men, will be seen a second time, without sin, by those who are waiting for him, for their salvation.

10.msb: For the law is only a shadow of the good things to come, not the realities themselves. The same sacrifices offered year after year can never make perfect those who draw near to worship.
10.kjv: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
10.blb: For the law, having a shadow of the good things about to be, not the image of the things themselves, every year with the same sacrifices that they offer unto perpetuity, never is able to perfect those coming near.
10.bbe: For the law, being only a poor copy of the future good things, and not the true image of those things, is never able to make the people who come to the altar every year with the same offerings completely clean.
10.heading: Christ’s Perfect Sacrifice

10.msb: If it could, would not the offerings have ceased? For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all, and would no longer have felt the guilt of their sins.
10.kjv: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
10.blb: Otherwise, would they not have ceased being offered, because of no more having conscience of sins, those serving having been cleansed once?
10.bbe: For if this had been possible, would there not have been an end of those offerings, because the worshippers would have been made completely clean and would have been no longer conscious of sins?

10.msb: Instead, those sacrifices are an annual reminder of sins,
10.kjv: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.
10.blb: But in these is a reminder of sins every year.
10.bbe: But year by year there is a memory of sins in those offerings.

10.msb: because it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
10.kjv: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.
10.blb: For it is impossible for the blood of bulls and of goats to take away sins.
10.bbe: Because it is not possible for the blood of oxen and goats to take away sins.

10.msb: Therefore, when Christ came into the world, He said: “Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but a body You prepared for Me.
10.kjv: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:
10.blb: Therefore, coming into the world, He says: “Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but a body You prepared for Me.
10.bbe: So that when he comes into the world, he says, You had no desire for offerings, but you made a body ready for me;

10.msb: In burnt offerings and sin offerings You took no delight.
10.kjv: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.
10.blb: In burnt offerings and concerning sin offerings You were not well pleased.
10.bbe: You had no joy in burned offerings or in offerings for sin.

10.msb: Then I said, ‘Here I am, it is written about Me in the scroll: I have come to do Your will, O God.’”
10.kjv: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.
10.blb: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come—in the scroll of the book it has been written about Me—to do Your will, O God.’”
10.bbe: Then I said, See, I have come to do your pleasure, O God (as it is said of me in the roll of the book).

10.msb: In the passage above He says, “Sacrifice and offering, burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not desire, nor did You delight in them” (although they are offered according to the law).
10.kjv: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;
10.blb: Saying above, “Sacrifices and offerings and burnt offerings and those for sin You did not desire, nor were You well pleased” (which are offered according to the law),
10.bbe: After saying, You had no desire for offerings, for burned offerings or offerings for sin (which are made by the law) and you had no pleasure in them,

10.msb: Then He adds, “Here I am, I have come to do Your will, O God.” He takes away the first to establish the second.
10.kjv: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
10.blb: then He has said, “Behold, I have come to do Your will.” He takes away the first so that He might establish the second,
10.bbe: Then he said, See, I have come to do your pleasure. He took away the old order, so that he might put the new order in its place.

10.msb: And by that will, we have been sanctified through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
10.kjv: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
10.blb: in which act of will, we are having been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
10.bbe: By that pleasure we have been made holy, by the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once and for ever.

10.msb: Day after day every priest stands to minister and to offer again and again the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.
10.kjv: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
10.blb: And indeed every priest has stood every day, serving and offering the same sacrifices many times, which never are able to take away sins.
10.bbe: And every priest takes his place at the altar day by day, doing what is necessary, and making again and again the same offerings which are never able to take away sins.

10.msb: But when this Priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins, He sat down at the right hand of God.
10.kjv: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;
10.blb: But this One, having offered one sacrifice for sins unto perpetuity, sat down at the right hand of God,
10.bbe: But when Jesus had made one offering for sins for ever, he took his place at the right hand of God;

10.msb: Since that time, He waits for His enemies to be made a footstool for His feet,
10.kjv: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
10.blb: as to the rest awaiting until His enemies should be placed as a footstool for His feet.
10.bbe: And has been waiting there from that time, till all who are against him are made a foot-rest for his feet.

10.msb: because by a single offering He has made perfect for all time those who are being sanctified.
10.kjv: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
10.blb: For by one offering, He has perfected unto perpetuity those being sanctified.
10.bbe: Because by one offering he has made complete for ever those who are made holy.

10.msb: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this. First He says:
10.kjv: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
10.blb: And the Holy Spirit also testifies to us. For after having said:
10.bbe: And the Holy Spirit is a witness for us: for after he had said,

10.msb: “This is the covenant I will make with them after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their minds.”
10.kjv: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
10.blb: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, says the Lord, giving My laws on their hearts, and I will inscribe them on their mind,”
10.bbe: This is the agreement which I will make with them after those days, says the Lord; I will put my laws in their hearts, writing them in their minds; he said,

10.msb: Then He adds: “Their sins and lawless acts I will remember no more.”
10.kjv: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.
10.blb: then He says: “Their sins and their lawless acts, I will remember no more.”
10.bbe: And I will keep no more memory of their sins and of their evil-doings.

10.msb: And where these have been forgiven, an offering for sin is no longer needed.
10.kjv: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
10.blb: Now where there is forgiveness of these, no longer is there an offering concerning sin.
10.bbe: Now where there is forgiveness of these, there is no more offering for sin.

10.msb: Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,
10.kjv: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,
10.blb: Therefore, brothers, having confidence for entrance to the holy places in the blood of Jesus,
10.bbe: So then, my brothers, being able to go into the holy place without fear, because of the blood of Jesus,
10.heading: A Call to Persevere

10.msb: by the new and living way opened for us through the curtain of His body,
10.kjv: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
10.blb: by a new and living way, which He inaugurated for us through the veil, that is, His flesh,
10.bbe: By the new and living way which he made open for us through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

10.msb: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,
10.kjv: And having an high priest over the house of God;
10.blb: and having a great priest over the house of God,
10.bbe: And having a great priest over the house of God,

10.msb: let us draw near with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.
10.kjv: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
10.blb: we should come near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, the hearts having been sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and the body having been washed with pure water.
10.bbe: Let us go in with true hearts, in certain faith, having our hearts made free from the sense of sin and our bodies washed with clean water:

10.msb: Let us hold resolutely to the hope we profess, for He who promised is faithful.
10.kjv: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
10.blb: We should hold fast to the confession of our hope, unwavering; for the One having promised is faithful.
10.bbe: Let us keep the witness of our hope strong and unshaking, for he is true who has given his word:

10.msb: And let us consider how to spur one another on to love and good deeds.
10.kjv: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
10.blb: And we should carefully consider toward stirring up one another to love and to good works,
10.bbe: And let us be moving one another at all times to love and good works;

10.msb: Let us not neglect meeting together, as some have made a habit, but let us encourage one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
10.kjv: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
10.blb: not forsaking the assembling together of ourselves, as is the custom with some, but exhorting, and so much more as you see the Day drawing near.
10.bbe: Not giving up our meetings, as is the way of some, but keeping one another strong in faith; and all the more because you see the day coming near.

10.msb: If we deliberately go on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no further sacrifice for sins remains,
10.kjv: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
10.blb: For if we are sinning willingly after receiving the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins,
10.bbe: For if we do evil on purpose after we have had the knowledge of what is true, there is no more offering for sins,

10.msb: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume all adversaries.
10.kjv: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
10.blb: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and zeal of fire being about to devour the adversaries.
10.bbe: But only a great fear of being judged, and of the fire of wrath which will be the destruction of the haters of God.

10.msb: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
10.kjv: He that despised Moses’ law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
10.blb: Anyone having set aside the law of Moses dies without mercies on the basis of two or three witnesses.
10.bbe: A man who has gone against the law of Moses is put to death without pity on the word of two or three witnesses:

10.msb: How much more severely do you think one deserves to be punished who has trampled on the Son of God, profaned the blood of the covenant that sanctified him, and insulted the Spirit of grace?
10.kjv: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
10.blb: How much worse punishment do you think he will be worthy of, the one having trampled upon the Son of God, and having deemed common the blood of the covenant in which he was sanctified, and having insulted the Spirit of grace?
10.bbe: But will not the man by whom the Son of God has been crushed under foot, and the blood of the agreement with which he was washed clean has been taken as an unholy thing, and who has had no respect for the Spirit of grace, be judged bad enough for a very much worse punishment?

10.msb: For we know Him who said, “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay, says the Lord,” and again, “The Lord will judge His people.”
10.kjv: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
10.blb: For we know the One having said, “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay,” and again, “The Lord will judge His people.”
10.bbe: For we have had experience of him who says, Punishment is mine, I will give reward. And again, The Lord will be judge of his people.

10.msb: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
10.kjv: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
10.blb: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
10.bbe: We may well go in fear of falling into the hands of the living God.

10.msb: Remember the early days that you were in the light. In those days, you endured a great conflict in the face of suffering.
10.kjv: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
10.blb: But recall the former days in which, having been enlightened, you endured a great conflict of sufferings,
10.bbe: But give thought to the days after you had seen the light, when you went through a great war of troubles;

10.msb: Sometimes you were publicly exposed to ridicule and persecution; at other times you were partners with those who were so treated.
10.kjv: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
10.blb: this indeed, being made a spectacle both by reproaches and tribulations; now this, having become partners of those being treated thus.
10.bbe: In part, in being attacked by angry words and cruel acts, before the eyes of everyone, and in part, in being united with those who were attacked in this way.

10.msb: You sympathized with me in my chains and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, knowing that you yourselves had a better and permanent possession in heaven.
10.kjv: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
10.blb: For you also sympathized with the prisoners and you accepted the plundering of your possessions with joy, knowing yourselves to have a better and abiding possession.
10.bbe: For you had pity on those who were in prison, and had joy in the loss of your property, in the knowledge that you still had a better property and one which you would keep for ever.

10.msb: So do not throw away your confidence; it holds a great reward.
10.kjv: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
10.blb: Therefore do not throw away your confidence, which has a great reward.
10.bbe: So do not give up your hope which will be greatly rewarded.

10.msb: You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.
10.kjv: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
10.blb: For you have need of perseverance, so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.
10.bbe: For, having done what was right in God's eyes, you have need of waiting before his word has effect for you.

10.msb: For, “In just a little while, He who is coming will come and will not delay.
10.kjv: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
10.blb: For “Yet in a very little while, the One coming will come, and will not delay.
10.bbe: In a very little time he who is coming will come; he will not be slow.

10.msb: But the righteous will live by faith; and if he shrinks back, I will take no pleasure in him.”
10.kjv: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
10.blb: But My righteous one will live by faith; and if he might shrink back, My soul is not well pleased in him.”
10.bbe: But the upright man will be living by his faith; and if he goes back, my soul will have no pleasure in him.

10.msb: But we are not of those who shrink back and are destroyed, but of those who have faith and preserve their souls.
10.kjv: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
10.blb: But we are not of those shrinking back to destruction, but of faith to the preserving of the soul.
10.bbe: But we are not of those who go back to destruction; but of those who have faith even to the salvation of the soul.

11.msb: Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see.
11.kjv: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
11.blb: Now faith is the assurance of things hoped for, the conviction of things not being seen.
11.bbe: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, and the sign that the things not seen are true.
11.heading: Faith and Assurance

11.msb: This is why the ancients were commended.
11.kjv: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
11.blb: For in this the ancients were well-attested.
11.bbe: For by it our fathers had God's approval.

11.msb: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.
11.kjv: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
11.blb: By faith we understand the ages to have been completed thoroughly by the word of God, in order for that being seen not to have come into being out of the things being visible.
11.bbe: By faith it is clear to us that the order of events was fixed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made from things which only seem to be.

11.msb: By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. By faith he was commended as righteous when God gave approval to his gifts. And by faith he still speaks, even though he is dead.
11.kjv: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
11.blb: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he was testified to be righteous, God testifying about his gifts; and through it, having died, he still speaks.
11.bbe: By faith Abel made a better offering to God than Cain, and he had witness through it of his righteousness, God giving his approval of his offering: and his voice still comes to us through it though he is dead.
11.heading: The Faith of Abel, Enoch, Noah

11.msb: By faith Enoch was taken up so that he did not see death: “He could not be found, because God had taken him away.” For before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.
11.kjv: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
11.blb: By faith Enoch was translated not to see death, “and he was not found, because God translated him.” For before the translation, he had been testified to have pleased God.
11.bbe: By faith Enoch was taken up to heaven so that he did not see death; he was seen no longer, for God took him away: for before he was taken, witness had been given that he was well-pleasing to God:

11.msb: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who approaches Him must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him.
11.kjv: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
11.blb: And without faith it is impossible to please Him, for it is necessary for the one coming to God to believe that He is and that He becomes a rewarder to those seeking Him out.
11.bbe: And without faith it is not possible to be well-pleasing to him, for it is necessary for anyone who comes to God to have the belief that God is, and that he is a rewarder of all those who make a serious search for him.

11.msb: By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in godly fear built an ark to save his family. By faith he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness that comes by faith.
11.kjv: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
11.blb: By faith Noah, having been divinely warned concerning the things not yet being seen, having been moved with fear, prepared an ark for the salvation of his household, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righeousness according to faith.
11.bbe: By faith Noah, being moved by the fear of God, made ready an ark for the salvation of his family, because God had given him news of things which were not seen at the time; and through it the world was judged by him, and he got for his heritage the righteousness which is by faith.

11.msb: By faith Abraham, when called to go to the place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, without knowing where he was going.
11.kjv: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
11.blb: By faith Abraham, being called to go out into a place that he was about to receive for an inheritance, obeyed and went out, not knowing where he is going.
11.bbe: By faith Abraham did as God said when he was ordered to go out into a place which was to be given to him as a heritage, and went out without knowledge of where he was going.
11.heading: The Faith of Abraham and Sarah

11.msb: By faith he dwelt in the promised land as a stranger in a foreign country. He lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who were heirs with him of the same promise.
11.kjv: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
11.blb: By faith he sojourned in the land of the promise as in a foreign country, having dwelt in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the co-heirs of the same promise.
11.bbe: By faith he was a wanderer in the land of the agreement, as in a strange land, living in tents with Isaac and Jacob, who had a part with him in the same heritage:

11.msb: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.
11.kjv: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
11.blb: For he was awaiting the city having foundations, of which the architect and builder is God.
11.bbe: For he was looking for the strong town, whose builder and maker is God.

11.msb: By faith Sarah, even though she was beyond the proper age, received power and was enabled to conceive a child, because she considered Him faithful who had promised.
11.kjv: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
11.blb: By faith also Sarah, herself barren, received power for the conception of seed even beyond the opportune age, since she esteemed faithful the One having promised.
11.bbe: And by faith Sarah herself had power to give birth, when she was very old, because she had faith in him who gave his word;

11.msb: And so from one man, and he as good as dead, came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.
11.kjv: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
11.blb: Therefore also were born from one man, and these of one having become as dead, as the stars of heaven in multitude, and as the sand by the shore of the sea, countless.
11.bbe: So that from one man, who was near to death, came children in number as the stars in heaven, or as the sand by the seaside, which may not be numbered.

11.msb: All these people died in faith, without having received the things they were promised. However, they saw them and welcomed them from afar. And they acknowledged that they were strangers and exiles on the earth.
11.kjv: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
11.blb: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them from afar, and having welcomed them, and having confessed that they are strangers and sojourners on the earth.
11.bbe: All these came to their end in faith, not having had the heritage; but having seen it with delight far away, they gave witness that they were wanderers and not of the earth.

11.msb: Now those who say such things show that they are seeking a country of their own.
11.kjv: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
11.blb: For those saying such things make manifest that they are seeking out a homeland.
11.bbe: For those who say such things make it clear that they are searching for a country for themselves.

11.msb: If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.
11.kjv: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
11.blb: And indeed if they had been remembering that from which they came out, they would have had opportunity to return.
11.bbe: And truly if they had kept in mind the country from which they went out, they would have had chances of turning back.

11.msb: Instead, they were longing for a better country, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for He has prepared a city for them.
11.kjv: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
11.blb: But now they stretch forward to a better one, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God; for He prepared a city for them.
11.bbe: But now their desire is for a better country, that is to say, for one in heaven; and so it is no shame to God to be named their God; for he has made ready a town for them.

11.msb: By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac on the altar. He who had received the promises was ready to offer his one and only son,
11.kjv: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
11.blb: By faith Abraham, being tested. has offered up Isaac. Even the one having received the promises was offering up his only begotten,
11.bbe: By faith Abraham made an offering of Isaac, when he was tested: and he with whom the agreement had been made gave up as an offering the only son of his body,

11.msb: even though God had said to him, “Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.”
11.kjv: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:
11.blb: as to whom it was said, “In Isaac a seed will be called to you,”
11.bbe: Of whom it had been said, From Isaac will your seed take their name:

11.msb: Abraham reasoned that God could raise the dead, and in a sense, he did receive Isaac back from death.
11.kjv: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
11.blb: having reasoned that God was able even to raise him out from the dead, from where he received him back also in a simile.
11.bbe: Judging that God was able to give life even to the dead; and because of this he did get him back as if from death.

11.msb: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning the future.
11.kjv: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
11.blb: By faith also Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning the things about to be.
11.bbe: By faith Isaac, blessing Jacob and Esau, gave news of things to come.
11.heading: The Faith of Isaac, Jacob, and Joseph

11.msb: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph’s sons and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.
11.kjv: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
11.blb: By faith Jacob, dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph and worshiped on the top of his staff.
11.bbe: By faith Jacob gave a blessing to the two sons of Joseph, when he was near to death; and gave God worship, supported by his stick.

11.msb: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, spoke about the exodus of the Israelites and gave instructions about his bones.
11.kjv: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
11.blb: By faith Joseph, finishing life, made mention concerning the exodus of the sons of Israel and gave commands concerning his bones.
11.bbe: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, said that the children of Israel would go out of Egypt; and gave orders about his bones.

11.msb: By faith Moses’ parents hid him for three months after his birth, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were unafraid of the king’s edict.
11.kjv: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
11.blb: By faith Moses, having been born, was hidden three months by his parents, because they saw the child was beautiful, and they did not fear the edict of the king.
11.bbe: By faith Moses was kept secretly by his father and mother for three months after his birth, because they saw that he was a fair child; and they had no fear of the king's orders.
11.heading: The Faith of Moses

11.msb: By faith Moses, when he was grown, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.
11.kjv: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter;
11.blb: By faith Moses, having become grown, refused to be called the son of the daughter of Pharaoh,
11.bbe: By faith Moses, when he became a man, had no desire to be named the son of Pharaoh's daughter;

11.msb: He chose to suffer oppression with God’s people rather than to experience the fleeting enjoyment of sin.
11.kjv: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
11.blb: having chosen to suffer mistreatment with the people of God rather than to have the temporary enjoyment of sin,
11.bbe: Feeling that it was better to undergo pain with the people of God, than for a short time to have a taste of the pleasures of sin;

11.msb: He valued disgrace for Christ above the treasures of Egypt, for he was looking ahead to his reward.
11.kjv: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
11.blb: having esteemed the reproach of Christ greater wealth than the treasures of Egypt; for he was looking to the reward.
11.bbe: Judging a part in the shame of Christ to be better than all the wealth of Egypt; for he was looking forward to his reward.

11.msb: By faith Moses left Egypt, not fearing the king’s anger; he persevered because he saw Him who is invisible.
11.kjv: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
11.blb: By faith he left Egypt, not having feared the anger of the king; for as seeing the Invisible One, he persevered.
11.bbe: By faith he went out of Egypt, not being turned from his purpose by fear of the wrath of the king; for he kept on his way, as seeing him who is unseen.

11.msb: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch Israel’s own firstborn.
11.kjv: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
11.blb: By faith he has kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, so that the one destroying the firstborn should not touch them.
11.bbe: By faith he kept the Passover, and put the sign of the blood on the houses, so that the angel of destruction might not put their oldest sons to death.

11.msb: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land; but when the Egyptians tried to follow, they were drowned.
11.kjv: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
11.blb: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as through dry land, which the Egyptians, having made an attempt, were swallowed up.
11.bbe: By faith they went through the Red Sea as if it had been dry land, though the Egyptians were overcome by the water when they made an attempt to do the same.

11.msb: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the people had marched around them for seven days.
11.kjv: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
11.blb: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, having been encircled for seven days.
11.bbe: By faith the walls of Jericho came down, after they had been circled for seven days.
11.heading: The Faith of Many

11.msb: By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies in peace, did not perish with those who were disobedient.
11.kjv: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
11.blb: By faith Rahab the prostitute did not perish with those having disobeyed, having welcomed the spies with peace.
11.bbe: By faith Rahab, the loose woman, was not put to death with those who had gone against God's orders, because she had taken into her house in peace those sent to see the land.

11.msb: And what more shall I say? Time will not allow me to tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets,
11.kjv: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
11.blb: And what more shall I say? For the time will fail me recounting fully about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, also David and Samuel and the prophets,
11.bbe: What more am I to say? For there would not be time to give the stories of Gideon, Barak, Samson, and Jephthah, of David and Samuel and the prophets:

11.msb: who through faith conquered kingdoms, administered justice, and gained what was promised; who shut the mouths of lions,
11.kjv: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
11.blb: who by faith conquered kingdoms, worked justice, obtained promises, shut the mouths of lions,
11.bbe: Who through faith overcame kingdoms, did righteousness, got their reward, kept the mouths of lions shut,

11.msb: quenched the raging fire, and escaped the edge of the sword; who gained strength from weakness, became mighty in battle, and put foreign armies to flight.
11.kjv: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
11.blb: quenched the power of fire, escaped the mouths of the sword, were made powerful out of weakness, became strong in war, and put to flight foreign armies.
11.bbe: Put out the power of fire, got safely away from the edge of the sword, were made strong when they had been feeble, became full of power in war, and put to flight the armies of the nations.

11.msb: Women received back their dead, raised to life again. Others were tortured and refused their release, so that they might gain a better resurrection.
11.kjv: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
11.blb: Women received their dead by resurrection; and others were tortured, not having accepted release, so that they might obtain a better resurrection.
11.bbe: Women had their dead given back to them living; others let themselves be cruelly attacked, having no desire to go free, so that they might have a better life to come;

11.msb: Still others endured mocking and flogging, and even chains and imprisonment.
11.kjv: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
11.blb: And others received the trial of mockings and of scourgings, and even of chains and of imprisonment.
11.bbe: And others were tested by being laughed at or by blows, and even with chains and prisons:

11.msb: They were stoned, they were sawed in two, they were put to the test, they were put to death by the sword. They went around in sheepskins and goatskins, destitute, oppressed, and mistreated.
11.kjv: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
11.blb: They were stoned, they were sawed in two, they died by slaughter of the sword; they wandered in sheepskins, in goatskins, being destitute, being oppressed, being mistreated—
11.bbe: They were stoned, they were cut up with knives, they were tested, they were put to death with the sword, they went about in sheepskins and in goatskins; being poor and in pain and cruelly attacked,

11.msb: The world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains, and hid in caves and holes in the ground.
11.kjv: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
11.blb: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts and mountains and caves and holes of the earth.
11.bbe: Wandering in waste places and in mountains and in holes in the rocks; for whom the world was not good enough.

11.msb: These were all commended for their faith, yet they did not receive what was promised.
11.kjv: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
11.blb: And these all, having been testified to through faith, did not receive the promise,
11.bbe: And not one of these got the good things of the agreement, though they all had a good record through faith,

11.msb: God had planned something better for us, so that together with us they would be made perfect.
11.kjv: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
11.blb: God having planned something better for us, so that not apart from us, they should be perfected.
11.bbe: Because God had kept some better thing for us, so that it was not possible for them to become complete without us.

12.msb: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.
12.kjv: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
12.blb: Therefore we also, having such a great cloud of witnesses encompassing us, having put off every weight and the sin easily entangling, should run through perseverance the race lying before us,
12.bbe: For this reason, as we are circled by so great a cloud of witnesses, putting off every weight, and the sin into which we come so readily, let us keep on running in the way which is marked out for us,
12.heading: A Call to Endurance

12.msb: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
12.kjv: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
12.blb: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who in view of the joy lying before Him endured the cross, having despised its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
12.bbe: Having our eyes fixed on Jesus, the guide and end of our faith, who went through the pains of the cross, not caring for the shame, because of the joy which was before him, and who has now taken his place at the right hand of God's seat of power.

12.msb: Consider Him who endured such hostility from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.
12.kjv: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
12.blb: For consider fully the One having endured such great contradiction by sinners against Himself, so that you might not grow weary, fainting in your souls.
12.bbe: Give thought to him who has undergone so much of the hate of sinners against himself, so that you may not be tired and feeble of purpose.

12.msb: In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.
12.kjv: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
12.blb: Not yet did you resist unto blood, struggling against sin,
12.bbe: Till now you have not given your blood in your fight against sin:
12.heading: God Disciplines His Sons

12.msb: And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not take lightly the discipline of the Lord, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you.
12.kjv: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
12.blb: and you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as to sons: “My son, do not regard lightly the discipline of the Lord, nor faint being reproved by Him.
12.bbe: And you have not kept in mind the word which says to you as to sons, My son, do not make little of the Lord's punishment, and do not give up hope when you are judged by him;

12.msb: For the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and He chastises every son He receives.”
12.kjv: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
12.blb: For the Lord disciplines whom He loves, and He scourges every son whom He receives.”
12.bbe: For the Lord sends punishment on his loved ones; everyone whom he takes as his son has experience of his rod.

12.msb: Endure suffering as discipline; God is treating you as sons. For what son is not disciplined by his father?
12.kjv: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
12.blb: It is for discipline that you endure; God is treating you as sons; for what son is there whom his father does not discipline?
12.bbe: It is for your training that you undergo these things; God is acting to you as a father does to his sons; for what son does not have punishment from his father?

12.msb: If you do not experience discipline like everyone else, then you are illegitimate children and not true sons.
12.kjv: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
12.blb: But if you are without discipline, of which they have all become partakers, then you are illegitimate children and not sons.
12.bbe: But if you have not that punishment of which we all have our part, then you are not true sons, but children of shame.

12.msb: Furthermore, we have all had earthly fathers who disciplined us, and we respected them. Should we not much more submit to the Father of our spirits and live?
12.kjv: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
12.blb: Furthermore indeed, we have had fathers of our flesh, discipliners, and we respected them; and will we not much more be in subjection to the Father of spirits and will live?
12.bbe: And again, if the fathers of our flesh gave us punishment and had our respect, how much more will we be under the authority of the Father of spirits, and have life?

12.msb: Our fathers disciplined us for a short time as they thought best, but God disciplines us for our good, so that we may share in His holiness.
12.kjv: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
12.blb: For indeed, for a few days according to that seeming good to them, they were disciplining us—but He for our benefitting, in order to share His holiness.
12.bbe: For they truly gave us punishment for a short time, as it seemed good to them; but he does it for our profit, so that we may become holy as he is.

12.msb: No discipline seems enjoyable at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it yields a harvest of righteousness and peace to those who have been trained by it.
12.kjv: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
12.blb: And all discipline indeed for the present does not seem to be of joy, but of grief; but afterward it yields the peaceable fruit of righteousness to those having been trained by it.
12.bbe: At the time all punishment seems to be pain and not joy: but after, those who have been trained by it get from it the peace-giving fruit of righteousness.

12.msb: Therefore strengthen your limp hands and weak knees.
12.kjv: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
12.blb: Therefore set straight again the drooping hands and the enfeebled knees,
12.bbe: For this cause let the hands which are hanging down be lifted up, and let the feeble knees be made strong,

12.msb: Make straight paths for your feet, so that the lame may not be disabled, but rather healed.
12.kjv: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
12.blb: and make straight paths for your feet, so that the lame should not be turned aside, but rather should be healed.
12.bbe: And make straight roads for your feet, so that the feeble may not be turned out of the way, but may be made strong.

12.msb: Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.
12.kjv: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
12.blb: Pursue peace with all, and holiness, without which no one will see the Lord,
12.bbe: Let your desire be for peace with all men, and to be made holy, without which no man may see the Lord;
12.heading: A Call to Holiness

12.msb: See to it that no one falls short of the grace of God, and that no root of bitterness springs up to cause trouble and defile many.
12.kjv: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
12.blb: overseeing, lest any be falling short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up should trouble you, and by this the many might be defiled,
12.bbe: Looking with care to see that no man among you in his behaviour comes short of the grace of God; for fear that some bitter root may come up to be a trouble to you, and that some of you may be made unclean by it;

12.msb: See to it that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his birthright.
12.kjv: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
12.blb: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, as Esau, who for one meal sold his birthright.
12.bbe: And that there may not be any evil liver, or any man without respect for God, like Esau, who let his birthright go for a plate of food.

12.msb: For you know that afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected. He could find no ground for repentance, though he sought the blessing with tears.
12.kjv: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
12.blb: For you know that even afterward, wanting to inherit the blessing, he was rejected; for he found no place of repentance, although having sought it out with tears.
12.bbe: For you have knowledge that even long after, when he was desiring the blessing for his heritage, he was turned away, though he made his request frequently and with weeping; because the past might not be changed.

12.msb: For you have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire; to blackness, darkness, and storm;
12.kjv: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
12.blb: For you have not come to that being touched and having been kindled with fire, and to darkness and to gloom and to storm,
12.bbe: You have not come to a mountain which may be touched, and is burning with fire, and to a black cloud, and a dark smoke, and a violent wind,
12.heading: An Unshakable Kingdom

12.msb: to a trumpet blast or to a voice that made its hearers beg that no further word be spoken.
12.kjv: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
12.blb: and to the sound of a trumpet, and to a voice of sayings which those having heard begged that the word not be addressed to them,
12.bbe: And to the sound of a horn, and the voice of words, the hearers of which made request that not a word more might be said to them:

12.msb: For they could not bear what was commanded: “If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned.”
12.kjv: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
12.blb: for they could not bear that being commanded: “If even a beast should touch the mountain, it will be stoned.”
12.bbe: For the order which said, If the mountain is touched even by a beast, the beast is to be stoned, seemed hard to them;

12.msb: The sight was so terrifying that even Moses said, “I am trembling with fear.”
12.kjv: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
12.blb: And the thing appearing was so fearful that Moses said, “I am greatly afraid and trembling.”
12.bbe: And the vision was so overpowering that even Moses said, I am shaking and full of fear.

12.msb: Instead, you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem. You have come to myriads of angels
12.kjv: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
12.blb: But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, to the heavenly Jerusalem, and to myriads of angels,
12.bbe: But you have come to the mountain of Zion, to the place of the living God, to the Jerusalem which is in heaven, and to an army of angels which may not be numbered,

12.msb: in joyful assembly, to the congregation of the firstborn, enrolled in heaven. You have come to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,
12.kjv: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
12.blb: and to the assembly, to the church of the firstborn having been enrolled in the heavens, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of the righteous having been perfected,
12.bbe: To the great meeting and church of the first of those who are named in heaven, and to God the judge of all, and to the spirits of good men made complete,

12.msb: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.
12.kjv: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
12.blb: and to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, speaking a better thing than that of Abel.
12.bbe: And to Jesus by whom the new agreement has been made between God and man, and to the sign of the blood which says better things than Abel's blood.

12.msb: See to it that you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if the people did not escape when they refused Him who warned them on earth, how much less will we escape if we reject Him who warns us from heaven?
12.kjv: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:
12.blb: Watch out, lest you refuse the One speaking. For if they did not escape, having refused the One divinely warning them on earth, much less we, turning away from the One from the heavens,
12.bbe: See that you give ear to his voice which comes to you. For if those whose ears were shut to the voice which came to them on earth did not go free from punishment, what chance have we of going free if we give no attention to him whose voice comes from heaven?

12.msb: At that time His voice shook the earth, but now He has promised, “Once more I will shake not only the earth, but heaven as well.”
12.kjv: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
12.blb: whose voice shook the earth at that time; but now He has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also heaven.”
12.bbe: Whose voice was the cause of the shaking of the earth; but now he has made an oath, saying, There will be still one more shaking, not only of the earth, but of heaven.

12.msb: The words “Once more” signify the removal of what can be shaken—that is, created things—so that the unshakable may remain.
12.kjv: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
12.blb: And this, “Yet once more,” makes evident the removing of the things being shaken, as having been made, so that the things not being shaken should remain.
12.bbe: And the words, Still one more, make it clear that there will be a taking away of those things which are shaking, as of things which are made, so that there may be only those things of which no shaking is possible.

12.msb: Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us be filled with gratitude, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and godly fear.
12.kjv: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
12.blb: Therefore, receiving an unshakable kingdom, we may have grace, by which we may serve God well pleasingly, with reverence and awe.
12.bbe: If then, we have a kingdom which will never be moved, let us have grace, so that we may give God such worship as is pleasing to him with fear and respect:

12.msb: “For our God is a consuming fire.”
12.kjv: For our God is a consuming fire.
12.blb: “For also, our God is a consuming fire.”
12.bbe: For our God is an all-burning fire.

13.msb: Continue in brotherly love.
13.kjv: Let brotherly love continue.
13.blb: Let brotherly love remain.
13.bbe: Go on loving your brothers in the faith.
13.heading: Brotherly Love

13.msb: Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.
13.kjv: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
13.blb: Do not be forgetful of hospitality, for through this, some entertained angels unawares.
13.bbe: Take care to keep open house: because in this way some have had angels as their guests, without being conscious of it.

13.msb: Remember those in prison as if you were bound with them, and those who are mistreated as if you were suffering with them.
13.kjv: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
13.blb: Remember the prisoners as having been bound with them, those being mistreated as yourselves also being in the body.
13.bbe: Keep in mind those who are in chains, as if you were chained with them, and those who are in trouble, as being yourselves in the body.

13.msb: Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
13.kjv: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
13.blb: Let marriage be honored in all, and the marriage bed undefiled; for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
13.bbe: Let married life be honoured among all of you and not made unclean; for men untrue in married life will be judged by God.

13.msb: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”
13.kjv: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
13.blb: your manner of life let be without love of money, being satisfied with the present; for He Himself has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”
13.bbe: Be free from the love of money and pleased with the things which you have; for he himself has said, I will be with you at all times.
13.heading: Christ’s Unchanging Nature

13.msb: So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
13.kjv: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
13.blb: So we are confident to say: “The Lord is to me a helper, and I will not be afraid; what will man do to me?”
13.bbe: So that we say with a good heart, The Lord is my helper; I will have no fear: what is man able to do to me?

13.msb: Remember your leaders who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.
13.kjv: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
13.blb: Remember those leading you who spoke the word of God to you, of whom, considering the outcome of their conduct, imitate the faith.
13.bbe: Keep in mind those who were over you, and who gave you the word of God; seeing the outcome of their way of life, let your faith be like theirs.

13.msb: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
13.kjv: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
13.blb: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and to the ages.
13.bbe: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and for ever.

13.msb: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace and not by foods of no value to those devoted to them.
13.kjv: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
13.blb: Do not be carried along by various and strange teachings; for it is good for the heart to be confirmed by grace, not by foods, in which those walking were not profited.
13.bbe: Do not be turned away by different strange teachings, because it is good for your hearts to be made strong by grace, and not by meats, which were of no profit to those who took so much trouble over them.

13.msb: We have an altar from which those who serve at the tabernacle have no right to eat.
13.kjv: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
13.blb: We have an altar from which those serving in the tabernacle have no authority to eat.
13.bbe: We have an altar from which those priests who are servants in the Tent may not take food.

13.msb: Although the high priest brings the blood of animals into the Holy Place as a sacrifice for sin, the bodies are burned outside the camp.
13.kjv: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
13.blb: For animals whose blood is brought for sin into the holy places by the high priest—the bodies of those are burned outside the camp.
13.bbe: For the bodies of the beasts whose blood is taken into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin are burned outside the circle of the tents.

13.msb: And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate, to sanctify the people by His own blood.
13.kjv: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
13.blb: Therefore Jesus also suffered outside the gate. so that He might sanctify the people by His own blood,
13.bbe: For this reason Jesus was put to death outside the walls, so that he might make the people holy by his blood.

13.msb: Therefore let us go to Him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace He bore.
13.kjv: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
13.blb: Therefore we should go out to Him outside the camp, bearing His reproach.
13.bbe: Let us then go out to him outside the circle of the tents, taking his shame on ourselves.

13.msb: For here we do not have a permanent city, but we are looking for the city that is to come.
13.kjv: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
13.blb: For here we do not have an abiding city, but we are seeking for the one about to be.
13.bbe: For here we have no fixed resting-place, but our search is for the one which is to come.

13.msb: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
13.kjv: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
13.blb: Through Him, then, we should offer up a sacrifice of praise through all time to God, that is, the fruit of lips confessing His name.
13.bbe: Let us then make offerings of praise to God at all times through him, that is to say, the fruit of lips giving witness to his name.
13.heading: Sacrifice, Obedience, and Prayer

13.msb: And do not neglect to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.
13.kjv: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
13.blb: And do not be forgetful of doing good and of sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
13.bbe: But go on doing good and giving to others, because God is well-pleased with such offerings.

13.msb: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch over your souls as those who must give an account. To this end, allow them to lead with joy and not with grief, for that would be of no advantage to you.
13.kjv: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
13.blb: Obey you those leading and be subject, for they watch over your souls as those who will give an account, so that they may do this with joy and not groaning, for this is unprofitable for you.
13.bbe: Give ear to those who are rulers over you, and do as they say: for they keep watch over your souls, ready to give an account of them; let them be able to do this with joy and not with grief, because that would be of no profit to you.

13.msb: Pray for us; we are convinced that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.
13.kjv: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
13.blb: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, wanting to conduct ourselves well in all things.
13.bbe: Make prayers for us, for we are certain that our hearts are free from the sense of sin, desiring the right way of life in all things.

13.msb: And I especially urge you to pray that I may be restored to you soon.
13.kjv: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
13.blb: And more abundantly I exhort you to do this, so that I may be restored to you more quickly.
13.bbe: I make this request more strongly, in the hope of coming back to you more quickly.

13.msb: Now may the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,
13.kjv: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
13.blb: Now may the God of peace, the One having brought up out from the dead the great Shepherd of the sheep, our Lord Jesus, by the blood of the eternal covenant,
13.bbe: Now may the God of peace, who made that great keeper of his flock, even our Lord Jesus, come back from the dead through the blood of the eternal agreement,
13.heading: Benediction and Farewell

13.msb: equip you with every good work to do His will. And may He accomplish in you what is pleasing in His sight through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
13.kjv: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
13.blb: equip you in everything good in order to do His will, doing in us that which is well pleasing before Him, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory to the ages of the ages. Amen.
13.bbe: Make you full of every good work and ready to do all his desires, working in us whatever is pleasing in his eyes through Jesus Christ; and may the glory be given to him for ever and ever. So be it.

13.msb: I urge you, brothers, to bear with my word of exhortation, for I have only written to you briefly.
13.kjv: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.
13.blb: Now I exhort you, brothers, bear with the word of exhortation, for I have also written to you by few words.
13.bbe: But, brothers, take kindly the words which I have said for your profit; for I have not sent you a long letter.

13.msb: Be aware that our brother Timothy has been released. If he arrives soon, I will come with him to see you.
13.kjv: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
13.blb: You know our brother Timothy has been released, with whom I will see you if he should come more quickly.
13.bbe: Our brother Timothy has been let out of prison; and if he comes here in a short time, he and I will come to you together.

13.msb: Greet all your leaders and all the saints. Those from Italy send you greetings.
13.kjv: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
13.blb: Greet all those leading you and all the saints. Those from Italy greet you.
13.bbe: Give words of love from me to those who are rulers over you, and to all the saints. Those who are in Italy send you their love.

13.msb: Grace be with all of you. Amen.
13.kjv: Grace be with you all. Amen.
13.blb: Grace be with all of you.
13.bbe: May grace be with you all.

1.msb: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes of the Dispersion: Greetings.
1.kjv: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
1.blb: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes in the Diaspora: Greetings.
1.bbe: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, sends words of love to the twelve tribes of the Jews living in all parts of the earth.
1.heading: A Greeting from James

1.msb: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds,
1.kjv: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
1.blb: Esteem it all joy, my brothers, when you might fall into various trials,
1.bbe: Let it be all joy to you, my brothers, when you undergo tests of every sort;
1.heading: Rejoicing in Trials

1.msb: because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.
1.kjv: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
1.blb: knowing that the testing of your faith produces perseverance.
1.bbe: Because you have the knowledge that the testing of your faith gives you the power of going on in hope;

1.msb: Allow perseverance to finish its work, so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.
1.kjv: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
1.blb: And let endurance have its perfect work, so that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
1.bbe: But let this power have its full effect, so that you may be made complete, needing nothing.

1.msb: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
1.kjv: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
1.blb: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask from God, the One giving generously to all and not reproaching, and it will be given to him.
1.bbe: But if any man among you is without wisdom, let him make his request to God, who gives freely to all without an unkind word, and it will be given to him.

1.msb: But he must ask in faith, without doubting, because he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.
1.kjv: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
1.blb: But let him ask in faith, doubting nothing, for the one doubting is like a wave of the sea, being blown and being tossed by the wind.
1.bbe: Let him make his request in faith, doubting nothing; for he who has doubt in his heart is like the waves of the sea, which are troubled by the driving of the wind.

1.msb: That man should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.
1.kjv: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
1.blb: For let that man not suppose that he will receive anything from the Lord.
1.bbe: Let it not seem to such a man that he will get anything from the Lord;

1.msb: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
1.kjv: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
1.blb: He is a double-souled man, unstable in all his ways.
1.bbe: For there is a division in his mind, and he is uncertain in all his ways.

1.msb: The brother in humble circumstances should exult in his high position.
1.kjv: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
1.blb: But let the brother of humbleness boast in his exaltation,
1.bbe: But let the brother of low position be glad that he is lifted up;

1.msb: But the one who is rich should exult in his low position, because he will pass away like a flower of the field.
1.kjv: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
1.blb: and the one who is rich in his humiliation, because he will pass away like a flower of grass.
1.bbe: But the man of wealth, that he is made low; because like the flower of the grass he will come to his end.

1.msb: For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its flower falls and its beauty is lost. So too, the rich man will fade away in the midst of his pursuits.
1.kjv: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
1.blb: For the sun rose with its burning heat and withered the grass, and its flower fell, and the beauty of its appearance perished. Thus also the rich man will fade away in his pursuits.
1.bbe: For when the sun comes up with its burning heat, the grass gets dry and the grace of its form is gone with the falling flower; so the man of wealth comes to nothing in his ways.

1.msb: Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that the Lord has promised to those who love Him.
1.kjv: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
1.blb: Blessed is the man who endures trial, because, having been approved, he will receive the crown of life that He promised to those loving Him.
1.bbe: There is a blessing on the man who undergoes testing; because, if he has God's approval, he will be given the crown of life, which the Lord has said he will give to those who have love for him.
