1.msb: When tempted, no one should say, “God is tempting me.” For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does He tempt anyone.
1.kjv: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
1.blb: Let no one being tempted say, “I am being tempted from God.” For God is unable to be tempted by evils, and He Himself tempts no one.
1.bbe: Let no man say when he is tested, I am tested by God; for it is not possible for God to be tested by evil, and he himself puts no man to such a test:
1.heading: Good and Perfect Gifts

1.msb: But each one is tempted when by his own evil desires he is lured away and enticed.
1.kjv: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
1.blb: But each one is tempted, being dragged away and being enticed by his own desire.
1.bbe: But every man is tested when he is turned out of the right way by the attraction of his desire.

1.msb: Then after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.
1.kjv: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.
1.blb: Then desire, having conceived, gives birth to sin; and sin, having become fully grown, brings forth death.
1.bbe: Then when its time comes, desire gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is of full growth, gives birth to death.

1.msb: Do not be deceived, my beloved brothers.
1.kjv: Do not err, my beloved brethren.
1.blb: Do not be misled, my beloved brothers.
1.bbe: Do not be turned from the right way, dear brothers.

1.msb: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
1.kjv: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
1.blb: Every good act of giving and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the lights, with whom there is no variation or shadow of turning.
1.bbe: Every good and true thing is given to us from heaven, coming from the Father of lights, with whom there is no change or any shade made by turning.

1.msb: He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we would be a kind of firstfruits of His creation.
1.kjv: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
1.blb: Having willed it, He brought us forth by the word of truth, for us to be a certain firstfruits of His creatures.
1.bbe: Of his purpose he gave us being, by his true word, so that we might be, in a sense, the first-fruits of all the things which he had made.

1.msb: So then, my beloved brothers, everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
1.kjv: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
1.blb: Know this, my beloved brothers: But let every man be quick to hear, slow to speak, slow to anger;
1.bbe: You have knowledge of this, dear brothers. But let every man be quick in hearing, slow in words, slow to get angry;
1.heading: Hearing and Doing

1.msb: for man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness that God desires.
1.kjv: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
1.blb: for man’s anger does not produce the righteousness of God.
1.bbe: For the righteousness of God does not come about by the wrath of man.

1.msb: Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and every expression of evil, and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save your souls.
1.kjv: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
1.blb: Therefore, having put off all filthiness and abundance of wickedness, accept in meekness the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
1.bbe: For this reason, putting away all dirty behaviour and the overweight of evil, take into your souls without pride the word which, being planted there, is able to give you salvation.

1.msb: Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.
1.kjv: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
1.blb: But be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deluding yourselves,
1.bbe: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers of it, blinding yourselves with false ideas.

1.msb: For anyone who hears the word but does not carry it out is like a man who looks at his face in a mirror,
1.kjv: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
1.blb: because if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, this one is like a man observing his natural face in a mirror,
1.bbe: Because if any man is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a glass;

1.msb: and after observing himself goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.
1.kjv: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
1.blb: for he observed himself and has gone away, and immediately he forgot what kind he was.
1.bbe: For after looking at himself he goes away, and in a short time he has no memory of what he was like.

1.msb: But the one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom, and continues to do so—not being a forgetful hearer, but an effective doer—he will be blessed in what he does.
1.kjv: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
1.blb: But the one having looked intently into the perfect law, that of freedom, and having continued in it, not having been a forgetful hearer but a doer of the work—this one will be blessed in his doing.
1.bbe: But he who goes on looking into the true law which makes him free, being not a hearer without memory but a doer putting it into effect, this man will have a blessing on his acts.

1.msb: If anyone among you considers himself religious and yet does not bridle his tongue, he deceives his heart and his religion is worthless.
1.kjv: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man’s religion is vain.
1.blb: If anyone thinks to be religious, not bridling his tongue, but deceiving his heart, the religion of this one is futile.
1.bbe: If a man seems to have religion and has no control over his tongue but lets himself be tricked by what is false, this man's religion is of no value.

1.msb: Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.
1.kjv: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
1.blb: Pure and undefiled religion before the God and Father is this: to visit orphans and widows in their tribulation, to keep oneself unstained from the world.
1.bbe: The religion which is holy and free from evil in the eyes of our God and Father is this: to take care of children who have no fathers and of widows who are in trouble, and to keep oneself untouched by the world.

2.msb: My brothers, as you hold out your faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, do not show favoritism.
2.kjv: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
2.blb: My brothers, do not in partiality hold the faith from our Lord Jesus Christ of glory.
2.bbe: My brothers, if you have the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory, do not take a man's position into account.
2.heading: A Warning against Favoritism

2.msb: Suppose a man comes into your meeting wearing a gold ring and fine clothes, and a poor man in shabby clothes also comes in.
2.kjv: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;
2.blb: For if a man might come into your synagogue in splendid apparel with a gold ring, and a poor one in filthy apparel also might come in,
2.bbe: For if a man comes into your Synagogue in fair clothing and with a gold ring, and a poor man comes in with dirty clothing,

2.msb: If you lavish attention on the man in fine clothes and say, “Here is a seat of honor,” but say to the poor man, “You must stand” or “Sit here under my footstool,”
2.kjv: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:
2.blb: and you might look upon the man bearing the splendid apparel and might say, “You sit here well,” and to the poor one might say, “You stand,” or, “Sit there under my footstool,”
2.bbe: And you do honour to the man in fair clothing and say, Come here and take this good place; and you say to the poor man, Take up your position there, or be seated at my feet;

2.msb: have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?
2.kjv: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
2.blb: then did you not make a distinction among yourselves and become judges with evil reasonings?
2.bbe: Is there not a division in your minds? have you not become judges with evil thoughts?

2.msb: Listen, my beloved brothers: Has not God chosen the poor of this world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom He promised those who love Him?
2.kjv: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?
2.blb: Listen, my beloved brothers: Did not God choose the poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the kingdom that He promised to those loving Him?
2.bbe: Give ear, my dear brothers; are not those who are poor in the things of this world marked out by God to have faith as their wealth, and for their heritage the kingdom which he has said he will give to those who have love for him?

2.msb: But you have dishonored the poor. Is it not the rich who oppress you and drag you into court?
2.kjv: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
2.blb: But you dishonored the poor one. Do not the rich oppress you, and they drag you into court?
2.bbe: But you have put the poor man to shame. Are not the men of wealth rulers over you? do they not take you by force before their judges?

2.msb: Are they not the ones who blaspheme the noble name by which you have been called?
2.kjv: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?
2.blb: Do they not blaspheme the good Name having been called upon you?
2.bbe: Do they not say evil of the holy name which was given to you?

2.msb: If you really fulfill the royal law stated in Scripture, “Love your neighbor as yourself,” you are doing well.
2.kjv: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:
2.blb: If indeed you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you are doing well.
2.bbe: But if you keep the greatest law of all, as it is given in the holy Writings, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself, you do well:

2.msb: But if you show favoritism, you sin and are convicted by the law as transgressors.
2.kjv: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
2.blb: But if you show partiality, you are working sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.
2.bbe: But if you take a man's position into account, you do evil, and are judged as evil-doers by the law.

2.msb: Whoever keeps the whole law but stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.
2.kjv: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
2.blb: For whoever shall keep the whole law, but shall stumble in one part, he has become guilty of all.
2.bbe: For anyone who keeps all the law, but makes a slip in one point, is judged to have gone against it all.

2.msb: For He who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not murder.” If you do not commit adultery, but do commit murder, you have become a lawbreaker.
2.kjv: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.
2.blb: For the One having said, “You shall not commit adultery,” also said, “You shall not murder.” But if you do not commit adultery, but you do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.
2.bbe: For he who said, Do not be untrue in married life, is the same who said, Put no man to death. Now if you are not untrue in married life, but you put a man to death, the law is broken.

2.msb: Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom.
2.kjv: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
2.blb: So speak and so act as being about to be judged by the law of freedom.
2.bbe: Let your words and your acts be those of men who are to be judged by the law which makes free.

2.msb: For judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
2.kjv: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.
2.blb: For judgment without mercy will be to the one not having done mercy. Mercy exults over judgment.
2.bbe: For the man who has had no mercy will be judged without mercy, but mercy takes pride in overcoming judging.

2.msb: What good is it, my brothers, if someone claims to have faith, but has no deeds? Can such faith save him?
2.kjv: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
2.blb: What is the gain, my brothers, if anyone says to have faith, but has no works? Is the faith able to save him?
2.bbe: What use is it, my brothers, for a man to say that he has faith, if he does nothing? will such a faith give him salvation?
2.heading: Faith and Works

2.msb: Suppose a brother or sister is without clothes and daily food.
2.kjv: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
2.blb: Now if a brother or a sister is naked and lacking of daily food,
2.bbe: If a brother or a sister is without clothing and in need of the day's food,

2.msb: If one of you tells him, “Go in peace; stay warm and well fed,” but does not provide for his physical needs, what good is that?
2.kjv: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?
2.blb: and anyone of you says to them, “Go in peace; be warmed and be filled,” but does not give to them the needful things for the body, what is the gain?
2.bbe: And one of you says to them, Go in peace, be warm and full of food; but you do not give them the things of which their bodies have need, what profit is there in this?

2.msb: So too, faith by itself, if it does not result in action, is dead.
2.kjv: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
2.blb: So also, faith, if it has no works, is dead by itself.
2.bbe: Even so faith without works is dead.

2.msb: But someone will say, “You have faith and I have deeds.” Show me your faith apart from your deeds, and I will show you my faith by my deeds.
2.kjv: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.
2.blb: But someone will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show to me your faith without works, and I will show to you faith by my works.
2.bbe: But a man may say, You have faith and I have works; let me see your faith without your works, and I will make my faith clear to you by my works.

2.msb: You believe that God is one. Good for you! Even the demons believe that—and shudder.
2.kjv: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
2.blb: You believe that God is one. You do well! Even the demons believe that, and shudder!
2.bbe: You have the belief that God is one, and you do well: the evil spirits have the same belief, shaking with fear.

2.msb: O foolish man, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is dead?
2.kjv: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
2.blb: But do you want to know, O foolish man, that faith without works is idle?
2.bbe: Do you not see, O foolish man, that faith without works is of no use?

2.msb: Was not our father Abraham justified by what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?
2.kjv: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
2.blb: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, having offered his son Isaac upon the altar?
2.bbe: Was not the righteousness of Abraham our father judged by his works, when he made an offering of Isaac his son on the altar?

2.msb: You see that his faith was working with his actions, and his faith was perfected by what he did.
2.kjv: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
2.blb: You see that faith was working with his works, and by works, faith was perfected.
2.bbe: You see that his faith was helping his works and was made complete by them;

2.msb: And the Scripture was fulfilled that says, “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness,” and he was called a friend of God.
2.kjv: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.
2.blb: And the Scripture was fulfilled, the one saying, “And Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned to him for righteousness,” and he was called a friend of God.
2.bbe: And the holy Writings were put into effect which said, And Abraham had faith in God and it was put to his account as righteousness; and he was named the friend of God.

2.msb: As you can see, then, a man is justified by his deeds and not by faith alone.
2.kjv: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
2.blb: You see that a man is justified by works and not by faith alone.
2.bbe: You see that a man's righteousness is judged by his works and not by his faith only.

2.msb: In the same way, was not even Rahab the prostitute justified by her actions when she welcomed the spies and sent them off on another route?
2.kjv: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
2.blb: And likewise was not Rahab the prostitute also justified by works, having received the messengers and having sent them out by another way?
2.bbe: And in the same way, was not the righteousness of Rahab, the loose woman, judged by her works, when she took into her house those who were sent and let them go out by another way?

2.msb: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.
2.kjv: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
2.blb: For just as the body without spirit is dead, so also faith without works is dead.
2.bbe: For as the body without the spirit is dead even so faith without works is dead.

3.msb: Not many of you should become teachers, my brothers, because you know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.
3.kjv: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
3.blb: Let not many become teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive greater judgment.
3.bbe: Do not all be teachers, my brothers, because we teachers will be judged more hardly than others.
3.heading: Taming the Tongue

3.msb: We all stumble in many ways. If anyone is never at fault in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to control his whole body.
3.kjv: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
3.blb: For we all stumble in many ways. If anyone does not stumble in word, this one is a perfect man, able to bridle even the whole body.
3.bbe: For we all go wrong in a number of things. If a man never makes a slip in his talk, then he is a complete man and able to keep all his body in control.

3.msb: Indeed, when we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we can guide the whole animal.
3.kjv: Behold, we put bits in the horses’ mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
3.blb: Now if we put bits into the mouths of the horses for them to obey us, we turn about even their whole body.
3.bbe: Now if we put bits of iron into horses' mouths so that they may be guided by us, we have complete control of their bodies.

3.msb: Consider ships as well. Although they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are steered by a very small rudder wherever the pilot is inclined.
3.kjv: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
3.blb: Behold also the ships, being so great and being driven by strong winds, are turned about by a very small rudder where the impulse of the one steering intends.
3.bbe: And again ships, though they are so great and are moved by violent winds, are turned by a very small guiding-blade, at the impulse of the man who is using it.

3.msb: In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts of great things. Consider how small a spark sets a great forest ablaze.
3.kjv: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!
3.blb: So also the tongue is a small member, and it boasts great things. Behold what size a fire, what size a forest it kindles.
3.bbe: Even so the tongue is a small part of the body, but it takes credit for great things. How much wood may be lighted by a very little fire!

3.msb: The tongue also is a fire, a world of wickedness among the parts of the body. It pollutes the whole person, sets the course of his life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.
3.kjv: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
3.blb: And the tongue is a fire, the world of unrighteousness. The tongue is set among our members, staining the whole body, and setting aflame the course of nature, and itself being set aflame by Gehenna.
3.bbe: And the tongue is a fire; it is the power of evil placed in our bodies, making all the body unclean, putting the wheel of life on fire, and getting its fire from hell.

3.msb: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and creatures of the sea are being tamed and have been tamed by man,
3.kjv: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:
3.blb: For every nature both of beasts and of birds, both of creeping things and things of the sea, is subdued and has been subdued by the human race,
3.bbe: For every sort of beast and bird and every living thing on earth and in the sea has been controlled by man and is under his authority;

3.msb: but no man can tame the tongue. It is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
3.kjv: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
3.blb: but no one of men is able to subdue the tongue; it is an unstable evil, full of deadly poison.
3.bbe: But the tongue may not be controlled by man; it is an unresting evil, it is full of the poison of death.

3.msb: With the tongue we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men, who have been made in God’s likeness.
3.kjv: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.
3.blb: With it we bless the Lord and Father, and with it we curse men, those having been made according to the likeness of God.
3.bbe: With it we give praise to our Lord and Father; and with it we put a curse on men who are made in God's image.

3.msb: Out of the same mouth come blessing and cursing. My brothers, this should not be!
3.kjv: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
3.blb: Out of the same mouth come out blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.
3.bbe: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, it is not right for these things to be so.

3.msb: Can both fresh water and salt water flow from the same spring?
3.kjv: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
3.blb: Does the spring send forth out of the same opening sweet and bitter?
3.bbe: Does the fountain send from the same outlet sweet and bitter water?

3.msb: My brothers, can a fig tree grow olives, or a grapevine bear figs? In the same way, no spring can produce both salt water and fresh water.
3.kjv: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
3.blb: Is a fig tree able, my brothers, to make olives, or a vine, figs? Neither can salt prooduce sweet water.
3.bbe: Is a fig-tree able to give us olives, my brothers, or do we get figs from a vine, or sweet water from the salt sea?

3.msb: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it by his good conduct, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.
3.kjv: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
3.blb: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it out of the good conduct his works in meekness of wisdom.
3.bbe: Who has wisdom and good sense among you? let him make his works clear by a life of gentle wisdom.
3.heading: The Wisdom from Above

3.msb: But if you harbor bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast in it or deny the truth.
3.kjv: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
3.blb: But if you have bitter jealousy and self-interest in your heart, do not boast and lie against the truth.
3.bbe: But if you have bitter envy in your heart and the desire to get the better of others, have no pride in this, talking falsely against what is true.

3.msb: Such wisdom does not come from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.
3.kjv: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
3.blb: This is not the wisdom coming down from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.
3.bbe: This wisdom is not from heaven, but is of the earth and the flesh and the Evil One.

3.msb: For where jealousy and selfish ambition exist, there will be disorder and every evil practice.
3.kjv: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.
3.blb: For where jealousy and self-interest are, there are disorder and every evil thing.
3.bbe: For where envy is, and the desire to get the better of others, there is no order, but every sort of evil-doing.

3.msb: But the wisdom from above is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, accommodating, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial, and sincere.
3.kjv: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
3.blb: But the wisdom from above is indeed first pure, then peaceable, gentle, compliant, full of mercy and of good fruits, impartial, unhypocritical.
3.bbe: But the wisdom which is from heaven is first holy, then gentle, readily giving way in argument, full of peace and mercy and good works, not doubting, not seeming other than it is.

3.msb: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of righteousness.
3.kjv: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
3.blb: And the fruit of righteousness in peace is sown by those making peace.
3.bbe: And the fruit of righteousness is planted in peace for those who make peace.

4.msb: What causes conflicts and quarrels among you? Don’t they come from the passions at war within you?
4.kjv: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
4.blb: From where are battles and from where are fights among you? Is it not from there, out of your pleasures warring in your members?
4.bbe: What is the cause of wars and fighting among you? is it not in your desires which are at war in your bodies?
4.heading: A Warning against Pride

4.msb: You crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it. You quarrel and fight. You do not have, because you do not ask.
4.kjv: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
4.blb: You desire, and you do not have. You murder and are jealous, and you are not able to obtain. You fight and battle. You do not have, because you do not ask.
4.bbe: You are burning with desire, and have not your desire, so you put men to death; you are full of envy, and you are not able to get your desire, so you are fighting and making war; you have not your desire, because you do not make request for it.

4.msb: And when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may squander it on your pleasures.
4.kjv: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
4.blb: You ask and do not receive, because you ask wrongly, that you may spend it in your pleasures.
4.bbe: You make your request but you do not get it, because your request has been wrongly made, desiring the thing only so that you may make use of it for your pleasure.

4.msb: You adulterers and adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Therefore, whoever chooses to be a friend of the world renders himself an enemy of God.
4.kjv: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.
4.blb: Adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship of the world is enmity with God? Therefore whoever should wish to be a friend of the world is appointed an enemy of God.
4.bbe: O you who are false to God, do you not see that the friends of this world are not God's friends? Every man desiring to be a friend of this world makes himself a hater of God.

4.msb: Or do you think the Scripture says without reason that the Spirit who dwells in us yearns with envy?
4.kjv: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?
4.blb: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit that He made to dwell in us yearns with envy”?
4.bbe: Or does it seem to you that it is for nothing that the holy Writings say, The spirit which God put into our hearts has a strong desire for us?

4.msb: But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
4.kjv: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
4.blb: But He gives greater grace. Therefore it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
4.bbe: But he gives more grace. So that the Writings say, God is against the men of pride, but he gives grace to those who make themselves low before him.

4.msb: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
4.kjv: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
4.blb: Therefore subject yourselves to God. But resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
4.bbe: For this cause be ruled by God; but make war on the Evil One and he will be put to flight before you.
4.heading: Drawing Near to God

4.msb: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
4.kjv: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
4.blb: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify hearts, you double-souled.
4.bbe: Come near to God and he will come near to you. Make your hands clean, you evil-doers; put away deceit from your hearts, you false in mind.

4.msb: Grieve, mourn, and weep. Turn your laughter to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
4.kjv: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
4.blb: Be miserable and mourn and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and the joy to gloom.
4.bbe: Be troubled, with sorrow and weeping; let your laughing be turned to sorrow and your joy to grief.

4.msb: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
4.kjv: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
4.blb: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
4.bbe: Make yourselves low in the eyes of the Lord and you will be lifted up by him.

4.msb: Brothers, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against his brother and judges him speaks against the law and judges it. And if you judge the law, you are not a practitioner of the law, but a judge of it.
4.kjv: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
4.blb: Do not speak against one another, brothers. The one speaking against a brother or judging his brother speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law, but a judge.
4.bbe: Do not say evil against one another, my brothers. He who says evil against his brother or makes himself his brother's judge, says evil against the law and is judging the law: and in judging the law you become, not a doer of the law but a judge.

4.msb: There is only one Lawgiver, the One who is able to save and destroy. But who are you to judge the other?
4.kjv: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
4.blb: One is the Lawgiver and Judge, the One being able to save and to destroy. But who are you, the one judging the neighbor?
4.bbe: There is only one judge and law-giver, even he who has the power of salvation and of destruction; but who are you to be your neighbour's judge?

4.msb: Come now, you who say, “Today and tomorrow let us go to this or that city, spend a year there, carry on business, and make a profit.”
4.kjv: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
4.blb: Come now, those saying, “Today or tomorrow we will go into this city, and will spend a year there and will trade and make gain,”
4.bbe: How foolish it is to say, Today or tomorrow we will go into this town, and be there for a year and do business there and get wealth:
4.heading: Do Not Boast about Tomorrow

4.msb: You do not even know what will happen tomorrow! What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.
4.kjv: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
4.blb: who do not know what is of tomorrow. What is your life? For it is a vapor appearing for a little while and then vanishing.
4.bbe: When you are not certain what will take place tomorrow. What is your life? It is a mist, which is seen for a little time and then is gone.

4.msb: Instead, you ought to say, “If the Lord is willing, let us live and do this or that.”
4.kjv: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
4.blb: Instead, you ought to say, “If the Lord is willing, both we will live and we will do this or that.”
4.bbe: But the right thing to say would be, If it is the Lord's pleasure and if we are still living, we will do this and that.

4.msb: As it is, you boast in your proud intentions. All such boasting is evil.
4.kjv: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
4.blb: But now you boast in your arrogance. All such boasting is evil.
4.bbe: But now you go on glorying in your pride: and all such glorying is evil.

4.msb: Anyone, then, who knows the right thing to do, yet fails to do it, is guilty of sin.
4.kjv: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
4.blb: Therefore to the one knowing to do good, and not doing it, to him it is sin.
4.bbe: The man who has knowledge of how to do good and does not do it, to him it is sin.

5.msb: Come now, you who are rich, weep and wail over the misery to come upon you.
5.kjv: Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.
5.blb: Come now, you rich, weep, wailing over the miseries that are coming upon you.
5.bbe: Come now, you men of wealth, give yourselves to weeping and crying because of the bitter troubles which are coming to you.
5.heading: A Warning to the Rich

5.msb: Your riches have rotted and moths have eaten your clothes.
5.kjv: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
5.blb: Your riches have rotted and your garments have become moth-eaten.
5.bbe: Your wealth is unclean and insects have made holes in your clothing.

5.msb: Your gold and silver are corroded. Their corrosion will testify against you and consume your flesh like fire. You have hoarded treasure in the last days.
5.kjv: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.
5.blb: Your gold and silver have corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You treasured up in the last days.
5.bbe: Your gold and your silver are wasted and their waste will be a witness against you, burning into your flesh. You have put by your store in the last days.

5.msb: Look, the wages you withheld from the workmen who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord of Hosts.
5.kjv: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.
5.blb: Behold, the wage of the workers having mowed your fields—that having been kept back by you—cries out, and the cries of those having reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Hosts.
5.bbe: See, the money which you falsely kept back from the workers cutting the grass in your field, is crying out against you; and the cries of those who took in your grain have come to the ears of the Lord of armies.

5.msb: You have lived on earth in luxury and self-indulgence. You have fattened your hearts as in the day of slaughter.
5.kjv: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
5.blb: You lived in luxury and you lived in self-indulgence upon the earth. You fattened your hearts in the day of slaughter.
5.bbe: You have been living delicately on earth and have taken your pleasure; you have made your hearts fat for a day of destruction.

5.msb: You have condemned and murdered the righteous, who did not resist you.
5.kjv: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.
5.blb: You condemned and murdered the righteous one; he does not resist you.
5.bbe: You have given your decision against the upright man and have put him to death. He puts up no fight against you.

5.msb: Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil—how patient he is for the fall and spring rains.
5.kjv: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
5.blb: Be patient, therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the earth, being patient for it until it receives the early and the late.
5.bbe: Go on waiting calmly, my brothers, till the coming of the Lord, like the farmer waiting for the good fruit of the earth till the early and late rains have come.
5.heading: Patience in Suffering

5.msb: You, too, be patient and strengthen your hearts, because the Lord’s coming is near.
5.kjv: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
5.blb: You also be patient; strengthen your hearts, because the coming of the Lord has drawn near.
5.bbe: Be as calm in your waiting; let your hearts be strong: because the coming of the Lord is near.

5.msb: Do not complain about one another, brothers, so that you will not be judged. Look, the Judge is standing at the door!
5.kjv: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.
5.blb: Do not groan against one another, brothers, so that you might not be judged. Behold, the Judge is standing before the doors.
5.bbe: Say no hard things against one another, brothers, so that you will not be judged; see, the judge is waiting at the doors.

5.msb: My brothers, as an example of patience in affliction, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
5.kjv: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
5.blb: Brothers, as an example of suffering evil and of patience, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
5.bbe: Take as an example of pain nobly undergone and of strength in trouble, the prophets who gave to men the words of the Lord.

5.msb: See how blessed we consider those who have persevered. You have heard of Job’s perseverance and have seen the outcome from the Lord. He is full of compassion and mercy.
5.kjv: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
5.blb: Behold, we count blessed those having endured. You heard of the perseverance of Job, and you saw the outcome of the Lord, that the Lord is full of compassion and is merciful.
5.bbe: We say that those men who have gone through pain are happy: you have the story of Job and the troubles through which he went and have seen that the Lord was full of pity and mercy in the end.

5.msb: Above all, my brothers, do not swear, not by heaven or earth or by any other oath. Simply let your “Yes” be yes, and your “No,” no, so that you will not fall into hypocrisy.
5.kjv: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
5.blb: But before all things, my brothers, do not swear, neither by heaven nor the earth nor any other oath. But let your “Yes” be yes, and the “No,” no, so that you might not fall under judgment.
5.bbe: But most of all, my brothers, do not take oaths, not by the heaven, or by the earth, or by any other thing: but let your Yes be Yes, and your No be No: so that you may not be judged.

5.msb: Is any one of you suffering? He should pray. Is anyone cheerful? He should sing praises.
5.kjv: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
5.blb: Is anyone among you suffering evil? Let him pray. Is anyone cheerful? Let him sing praises.
5.bbe: Is anyone among you in trouble? let him say prayers. Is anyone glad? let him make a song of praise.
5.heading: The Prayer of Faith

5.msb: Is any one of you sick? He should call the elders of the church to pray over him and anoint him with oil in the name of the Lord.
5.kjv: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
5.blb: Is anyone among you sick? Let him summon the elders of the church, and let them pray over him, having anointed him with oil in the name of the Lord.
5.bbe: Is anyone among you ill? let him send for the rulers of the church; and let them say prayers over him, putting oil on him in the name of the Lord.

5.msb: And the prayer offered in faith will restore the one who is sick. The Lord will raise him up. If he has sinned, he will be forgiven.
5.kjv: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
5.blb: And the prayer of faith will save the one ailing, and the Lord will raise him up, and if he might be one having committed sins, it will be forgiven him.
5.bbe: And by the prayer of faith the man who is ill will be made well, and he will be lifted up by the Lord, and for any sin which he has done he will have forgiveness.

5.msb: Confess your trespasses to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous man has great power to prevail.
5.kjv: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
5.blb: Therefore confess the sins to one another and pray for one another, so that you may be healed. The supplication of a righteous man being made effective prevails much.
5.bbe: So then, make a statement of your sins to one another, and say prayers for one another so that you may be made well. The prayer of a good man is full of power in its working.

5.msb: Elijah was a man just like us. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three and a half years.
5.kjv: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
5.blb: Elijah was a man of like nature to us, and with prayer he prayed for it not to rain, and it did not rain upon the land three years and six months.
5.bbe: Elijah was a man of flesh and blood as we are, and he made a strong prayer that there might be no rain; and there was no rain on the earth for three years and six months.

5.msb: Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth yielded its crops.
5.kjv: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
5.blb: And again he prayed, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.
5.bbe: And he made another prayer, and the heaven sent down rain and the earth gave her fruit.

5.msb: Brothers, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring him back,
5.kjv: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
5.blb: My brothers, if anyone among you should wander from the truth, and anyone should turn him back,
5.bbe: My brothers, if one of you has gone out of the way of the true faith and another has made him see his error,
5.heading: Restoring a Sinner

5.msb: consider this: Whoever turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and cover over a multitude of sins.
5.kjv: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
5.blb: let him know that the one having turned back a sinner from the wandering of his way will save his soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
5.bbe: Be certain that he through whom a sinner has been turned from the error of his way, keeps a soul from death and is the cause of forgiveness for sins without number.

1.msb: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To the elect who are exiles of the Dispersion throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia, chosen
1.kjv: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
1.blb: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To the chosen sojourners of the Diaspora of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
1.bbe: Peter, an Apostle of Jesus Christ, to the saints who are living in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
1.heading: A Greeting from Peter

1.msb: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.
1.kjv: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
1.blb: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in the sanctification of the Spirit for obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: May grace and peace be multiplied to you.
1.bbe: Who, through the purpose of God, have been made holy by the Spirit, disciples of Jesus, made clean by his blood: May you have grace and peace in full measure.

1.msb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! By His great mercy He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
1.kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
1.blb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the One according to His great mercy having begotten us again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ out from the dead,
1.bbe: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who through his great mercy has given us a new birth and a living hope by the coming again of Jesus Christ from the dead,
1.heading: A Living Hope

1.msb: and into an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for you,
1.kjv: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
1.blb: into an inheritance imperishable and undefiled and unfading, being kept in the heavens for you,
1.bbe: And a heritage fair, holy and for ever new, waiting in heaven for you,

1.msb: who through faith are shielded by God’s power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.
1.kjv: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
1.blb: who are being guarded in the power of God through faith for the salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
1.bbe: Who, by the power of God are kept, through faith, for that salvation, which will be seen at the last day.

1.msb: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials
1.kjv: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
1.blb: In this you exult, presently for a little while if it is being necessary, having been grieved by various trials,
1.bbe: You have cause for great joy in this, though it may have been necessary for you to be troubled for a little time, being tested in all sorts of ways,

1.msb: so that the proven character of your faith—more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire—may result in praise, honor, and glory at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
1.blb: so that the proven genuineness of your faith, more precious than gold, which is perishing though being proved by fire, may be found unto praise and glory and honor in the revelation of Jesus Christ,
1.bbe: So that the true metal of your faith, being of much greater value than gold (which, though it comes to an end, is tested by fire), may come to light in praise and glory and honour, at the revelation of Jesus Christ:

1.msb: Though you have not known Him, you love Him; and though you do not see Him now, you believe in Him and rejoice with an inexpressible and glorious joy,
1.kjv: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
1.blb: whom, not having seen, you love, in whom, presently not seeing yet believing, you exult with joy inexpressible and filled with glory,
1.bbe: To whom your love is given, though you have not seen him; and the faith which you have in him, though you do not see him now, gives you joy greater than words and full of glory:

1.msb: now that you are receiving the goal of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
1.kjv: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
1.blb: receiving the outcome of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
1.bbe: For so you have the true end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

1.msb: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who foretold the grace to come to you searched and investigated carefully,
1.kjv: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
1.blb: Concerning this salvation the prophets sought out and searched out, those having prophesied concerning the grace unto you,
1.bbe: For the prophets who gave the news of the grace which would come to you, made search with all care for knowledge of this salvation;

1.msb: trying to determine the time and setting to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow.
1.kjv: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
1.blb: searching into what or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ in them was making evident, testifying beforehand unto the sufferings of Christ and the glories after these,
1.bbe: Attempting to see what sort of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them was pointing to, when it gave witness to the pains which Christ would undergo and the glories which would come after them.

1.msb: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves, but you, when they foretold the things now announced by those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even angels long to look into these things.
1.kjv: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
1.blb: to whom it was revealed that they were ministering not to themselves but to you in these things, which now were proclaimed to you through those having proclaimed the gospel to you in the Holy Spirit having been sent from heaven, into which angels long to look.
1.bbe: And it was made clear to those prophets that they were God's servants not for themselves but for you, to give you word of the things which have now come to your ears from the preachers of the good news through the Holy Spirit sent down from heaven; things which even angels have a desire to see.

1.msb: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober-minded. Set your hope fully on the grace to be given you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
1.blb: Therefore having girded up the loins of your mind, being sober, hope completely upon the grace being brought to you in the revelation of Jesus Christ,
1.bbe: So make your minds ready, and keep on the watch, hoping with all your power for the grace which is to come to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
1.heading: A Call to Holiness

1.msb: As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.
1.kjv: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
1.blb: as children of obedience, not being conformed to the passions in your former ignorance.
1.bbe: Like children ruled by God, do not go back to the old desires of the time when you were without knowledge:

1.msb: But just as He who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do,
1.kjv: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;
1.blb: But according as the One having called you is holy, be holy yourselves also in all your conduct,
1.bbe: But be holy in every detail of your lives, as he, whose servants you are, is holy;

1.msb: for it is written: “Be holy, because I am holy.”
1.kjv: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
1.blb: because it has been written: “You shall be holy, because I am holy.”
1.bbe: Because it has been said in the Writings, You are to be holy, for I am holy.

1.msb: Since you call on a Father who judges each one’s work impartially, conduct yourselves in reverent fear during your stay as foreigners.
1.kjv: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
1.blb: And if you call on as Father the One judging impartially according to the work of each, conduct yourselves in fear in the time of your sojourn,
1.bbe: And if you give the name of Father to him who, judging every man by his acts, has no respect for a man's position, then go in fear while you are on this earth:

1.msb: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,
1.kjv: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
1.blb: knowing that were you redeemed from your futile conduct handed down from your fathers, not with perishable things—with silver or with gold—
1.bbe: Being conscious that you have been made free from that foolish way of life which was your heritage from your fathers, not through a payment of things like silver or gold which come to destruction,

1.msb: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot.
1.kjv: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
1.blb: but with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb unblemished and spotless,
1.bbe: But through holy blood, like that of a clean and unmarked lamb, even the blood of Christ:

1.msb: He was known before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in the last times for your sake.
1.kjv: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
1.blb: having been foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but having been made manifest in the last times on account of you,
1.bbe: Who was marked out by God before the making of the world, but was caused to be seen in these last times for you,

1.msb: Through Him you believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and glorified Him; and so your faith and hope are in God.
1.kjv: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
1.blb: who through Him are believers in God, the One having raised Him out from the dead and having given Him glory, so as for your faith and hope to be in God.
1.bbe: Who through him have faith in God who took him up again from the dead into glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.

1.msb: Since you have purified your souls by obedience to the truth through the Spirit so that you have a genuine love for your brothers, love one another deeply, from a pure heart.
1.kjv: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:
1.blb: Having purified your souls in the obedience of the truth unto unfeigned brotherly love, love one another earnestly, out of a pure heart,
1.bbe: And as you have made your souls clean, being ruled by what is true, and loving one another without deceit, see that your love is warm and from the heart:
1.heading: The Enduring Word

1.msb: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and forever enduring word of God.
1.kjv: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
1.blb: having been born again, not of perishable seed but of imperishable, by the word of God, living and abiding,
1.bbe: Because you have had a new birth, not from the seed of man, but from eternal seed, through the word of a living and unchanging God.

1.msb: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all the glory of man like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,
1.kjv: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:
1.blb: because, “All flesh is like grass, and all the glory of it like a flower of grass. The grass withered, and the flower fell off,
1.bbe: For it is said, All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flower of the grass. The grass becomes dry and the flower dead:

1.msb: but the word of the Lord stands forever.” And this is the word that was proclaimed to you.
1.kjv: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
1.blb: but the word of the Lord remains to the age.” And this is the word having been proclaimed as good news to you.
1.bbe: But the word of the Lord is eternal. And this is the word of the good news which was given to you.

2.msb: Rid yourselves, therefore, of all malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander.
2.kjv: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
2.blb: Therefore, having put off all malice and all deceit and hypocrisies and envies and all evil-speakings,
2.bbe: So putting away all wrongdoing, and all tricks and deceits and envies and evil talk,
2.heading: The Living Stone and Chosen People

2.msb: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow,
2.kjv: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
2.blb: like newborn babies, long for the reasonable, unspoiled milk, so that in it you may grow up into salvation,
2.bbe: Be full of desire for the true milk of the word, as babies at their mothers' breasts, so that you may go on to salvation;

2.msb: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is good.
2.kjv: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
2.blb: if you tasted that the Lord is good.
2.bbe: If you have had a taste of the grace of the Lord:

2.msb: As you come to Him, the living stone, rejected by men but chosen and precious in God’s sight,
2.kjv: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
2.blb: Coming to Him, a living stone, indeed rejected by men but chosen and precious with God,
2.bbe: To whom you come, as to a living stone, not honoured by men, but of great and special value to God;

2.msb: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house, a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
2.kjv: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.
2.blb: you yourselves also, as living stones, are being built up as a spiritual house into a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
2.bbe: You, as living stones, are being made into a house of the spirit, a holy order of priests, making those offerings of the spirit which are pleasing to God through Jesus Christ.

2.msb: For it stands in Scripture: “See, I lay in Zion a stone, a chosen and precious cornerstone; and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
2.kjv: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.
2.blb: Therefore it is contained in Scripture: “Behold, I lay in Zion a stone, a chosen and precious cornerstone; and the one believing on Him shall never be put to shame.”
2.bbe: Because it is said in the Writings, See, I am placing a keystone in Zion, of great and special value; and the man who has faith in him will not be put to shame.

2.msb: To you who believe, then, this stone is precious. But to those who are disobedient, “The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”
2.kjv: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
2.blb: Therefore the preciousness is to you who are believing. But to those disbelieving, “The stone that those building rejected, this became into the head of the corner,”
2.bbe: And the value is for you who have faith; but it is said for those without faith, The very stone which the builders put on one side, was made the chief stone of the building;

2.msb: and, “A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense.” They stumble because they disobey the word—and to this they were appointed.
2.kjv: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
2.blb: and, “A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense.” They stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.
2.bbe: And, A stone of falling, a rock of trouble; the word is the cause of their fall, because they go against it, and this was the purpose of God.

2.msb: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.
2.kjv: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
2.blb: But you are a chosen kindred, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for His possession, so that you may proclaim the excellencies of the One having called you out of darkness into His marvelous light,
2.bbe: But you are a special people, a holy nation, priests and kings, a people given up completely to God, so that you may make clear the virtues of him who took you out of the dark into the light of heaven.

2.msb: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
2.kjv: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
2.blb: who once were not a people, but now are the people of God—those not having received mercy, but now having received mercy.
2.bbe: In the past you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; then there was no mercy for you, but now mercy has been given to you.

2.msb: Beloved, I urge you, as foreigners and exiles, to abstain from the desires of the flesh, which war against your soul.
2.kjv: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
2.blb: Beloved, I exhort you, as foreigners and sojourners, to abstain from fleshly desires, which war against the soul,
2.bbe: My loved ones, I make this request with all my heart, that, as those for whom this world is a strange country, you will keep yourselves from the desires of the flesh which make war against the soul;

2.msb: Conduct yourselves with such honor among the Gentiles that, though they slander you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day He visits us.
2.kjv: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
2.blb: having your conduct among the Gentiles good, so that wherein which they speak against you as evildoers, out of having witnessed the good works, they may glorify God in the day of visitation.
2.bbe: Being of good behaviour among the Gentiles; so that though they say now that you are evil-doers, they may see your good works and give glory to God when he comes to be their judge.

2.msb: Therefore submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to the king as the supreme authority,
2.kjv: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
2.blb: Be in subjection to every human creation because of the Lord, whether to the king as being supreme,
2.bbe: Keep all the laws of men because of the Lord; those of the king, who is over all,
2.heading: Submission to Authorities

2.msb: or to governors as those sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to praise those who do right.
2.kjv: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.
2.blb: or to governors as being sent by him for punishment to evildoers and praise to doers of good,
2.bbe: And those of the rulers who are sent by him for the punishment of evil-doers and for the praise of those who do well.

2.msb: For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish men.
2.kjv: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
2.blb: because the will of God is this: doing good, to put to silence the ignorance of foolish men,
2.bbe: Because it is God's pleasure that foolish and narrow-minded men may be put to shame by your good behaviour:

2.msb: Live in freedom, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as servants of God.
2.kjv: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.
2.blb: as free, and not having the freedom as a cover-up for evil, but as servants of God.
2.bbe: As those who are free, not using your free position as a cover for wrongdoing, but living as the servants of God;

2.msb: Treat everyone with high regard: Love the brotherhood of believers, fear God, honor the king.
2.kjv: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
2.blb: Honor everyone: love the brotherhood, fear God, honor the king.
2.bbe: Have respect for all, loving the brothers, fearing God, honouring the king.

2.msb: Servants, submit yourselves to your masters with all respect, not only to those who are good and gentle, but even to those who are unreasonable.
2.kjv: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
2.blb: Servants, be subject in all fear to your masters, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the crooked.
2.bbe: Servants, take orders from your masters with all respect; not only if they are good and gentle, but even if they are bad-humoured.

2.msb: For if anyone endures the pain of unjust suffering because he is conscious of God, this is to be commended.
2.kjv: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
2.blb: For this is grace, if because of conscience toward God, anyone bears up under griefs, suffering unjustly.
2.bbe: For it is a sign of grace if a man, desiring to do right in the eyes of God, undergoes pain as punishment for something which he has not done.

2.msb: How is it to your credit if you are beaten for doing wrong and you endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God.
2.kjv: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
2.blb: For what kind of renown is it if sinning and being battered, you shall endure? But if doing good and suffering, you shall endure, this is grace with God.
2.bbe: What credit is it if, when you have done evil, you take your punishment quietly? but if you are given punishment for doing right, and take it quietly, this is pleasing to God.

2.msb: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow in His footsteps:
2.kjv: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:
2.blb: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example so that you should follow after His footsteps:
2.bbe: This is God's purpose for you: because Jesus himself underwent punishment for you, giving you an example, so that you might go in his footsteps:
2.heading: Christ’s Example of Suffering

2.msb: “He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in His mouth.”
2.kjv: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
2.blb: “Who committed no sin, nor was deceit found in His mouth.”
2.bbe: Who did no evil, and there was no deceit in his mouth:

2.msb: When they heaped abuse on Him, He did not retaliate; when He suffered, He made no threats, but entrusted Himself to Him who judges justly.
2.kjv: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:
2.blb: Who, being reviled, was not reviling in return; suffering, was not threatening, but He was giving Himself up to the One judging justly,
2.bbe: To sharp words he gave no sharp answer; when he was undergoing pain, no angry word came from his lips; but he put himself into the hands of the judge of righteousness:

2.msb: He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree, so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. “By His stripes you are healed.”
2.kjv: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
2.blb: who Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree, so that, having been dead to sins, we might live to righteousness, “by whose stripes you were healed.”
2.bbe: He took our sins on himself, giving his body to be nailed on the tree, so that we, being dead to sin, might have a new life in righteousness, and by his wounds we have been made well.

2.msb: For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
2.kjv: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
2.blb: For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
2.bbe: Because, like sheep, you had gone out of the way; but now you have come back to him who keeps watch over your souls.

3.msb: Wives, in the same way, submit yourselves to your husbands, so that even if they refuse to believe the word, they will be won over without words by the behavior of their wives
3.kjv: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
3.blb: Likewise, wives, be subject to your own husbands, so that even if any are disobedient to the word, they will be won over without word by the conduct of the wives,
3.bbe: Wives, be ruled by your husbands; so that even if some of them give no attention to the word, their hearts may be changed by the behaviour of their wives,
3.heading: Wives and Husbands

3.msb: when they see your pure and reverent demeanor.
3.kjv: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
3.blb: having witnessed your respectful, pure conduct,
3.bbe: When they see your holy behaviour in the fear of God.

3.msb: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as braided hair or gold jewelry or fine clothes,
3.kjv: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
3.blb: whose adornment let not be the external, of braiding of hair and putting around of gold or putting on of garments,
3.bbe: Do not let your ornaments be those of the body such as dressing of the hair, or putting on of jewels of gold or fair clothing;

3.msb: but from the inner disposition of your heart, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in God’s sight.
3.kjv: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
3.blb: but the hidden man of the heart, in the imperishable quality of the gentle and quiet spirit, which is of great worth before God.
3.bbe: But let them be those of the unseen man of the heart, the ever-shining ornament of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is of great price in the eyes of God.

3.msb: For this is how the holy women of the past adorned themselves. They put their hope in God and were submissive to their husbands,
3.kjv: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
3.blb: For in this way formerly the holy women also hoping in God used to adorn themselves, being subject to their own husbands,
3.bbe: And these were the ornaments of the holy women of the past, whose hope was in God, being ruled by their husbands:

3.msb: just as Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him lord. And you are her children if you do what is right and refuse to give way to fear.
3.kjv: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
3.blb: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, of whom you became children, doing good and not fearing any terror.
3.bbe: As Sarah was ruled by Abraham, naming him lord; whose children you are if you do well, and are not put in fear by any danger.

3.msb: Husbands, in the same way, dwell with your wives in an understanding manner. Treat them with honor as a delicate vessel and as fellow heirs of the gracious gift of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered.
3.kjv: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
3.blb: Husbands do likewise, dwelling with them according to knowledge, as with a weaker vessel, with the female, rendering honor as co-heirs also of the grace of life, in order for your prayers not to be hindered.
3.bbe: And you husbands, give thought to your way of life with your wives, giving honour to the woman who is the feebler vessel, but who has an equal part in the heritage of the grace of life; so that you may not be kept from prayer.

3.msb: Finally, all of you, be like-minded and sympathetic, love as brothers, be tenderhearted and courteous.
3.kjv: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
3.blb: Now the end: All be single-minded, sympathetic, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, humble,
