3.bbe: Last of all, see that you are all in agreement; feeling for one another, loving one another like brothers, full of pity, without pride:
3.heading: Turning from Evil

3.msb: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, knowing that to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.
3.kjv: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
3.blb: not giving back evil for evil or reviling for reviling; but on the contrary blessing, because to this you were called, so that you should inherit a blessing.
3.bbe: Not giving back evil for evil, or curse for curse, but in place of cursing, blessing; because this is the purpose of God for you that you may have a heritage of blessing.

3.msb: For, “Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech.
3.kjv: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
3.blb: For, “The one wanting to love life and to see good days, let him stop the tongue from evil, and the lips not speak deceit.
3.bbe: For it is said, Let the man who has a love of life, desiring to see good days, keep his tongue from evil and his lips from words of deceit:

3.msb: He must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it.
3.kjv: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
3.blb: And let him turn away from evil, and let him do good; let him seek peace and let him pursue it.
3.bbe: And let him be turned from evil and do good; searching for peace and going after it with all his heart.

3.msb: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
3.kjv: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
3.blb: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears toward their prayer. But the face of the Lord is on those doing evil.”
3.bbe: For the eyes of the Lord are on the upright, and his ears are open to their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.

3.msb: Who can harm you if you are imitators of what is good?
3.kjv: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
3.blb: And who is the one who will do evil to you if you should be zealous for that which is good?
3.bbe: Who will do you any damage if you keep your minds fixed on what is good?

3.msb: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear what they fear; do not be shaken.”
3.kjv: But and if ye suffer for righteousness’ sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
3.blb: But even if you should suffer because of righteousness, you are blessed. “And you should not be afraid of their fear, nor should you be troubled.”
3.bbe: But you are happy if you undergo pain because of righteousness; have no part in their fear and do not be troubled;
3.heading: Suffering for Righteousness

3.msb: But in your hearts sanctify the Lord God. Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. But respond with gentleness and respect,
3.kjv: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
3.blb: But in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord, always ready for a defense to everyone who is asking you an account concerning the hope in you, but with meekness and fear,
3.bbe: But give honour to Christ in your hearts as your Lord; and be ready at any time when you are questioned about the hope which is in you, to give an answer in the fear of the Lord and without pride;

3.msb: keeping a clear conscience, so that those who slander you as evildoers may be put to shame by your good behavior in Christ.
3.kjv: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.
3.blb: having a good conscience, so that in that which they speak against you, they shall be put to shame—those reviling your good conduct in Christ.
3.bbe: Being conscious that you have done no wrong; so that those who say evil things about your good way of life as Christians may be put to shame.

3.msb: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
3.kjv: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
3.blb: For it is better to suffer doing good, if the will of God wills it, than doing evil,
3.bbe: Because if it is God's purpose for you to undergo pain, it is better to do so for well-doing than for evil-doing.

3.msb: For Christ also suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit,
3.kjv: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
3.blb: because Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous, so that He might bring you to God, having been put to death indeed in the flesh, but having been made alive in the Spirit,
3.bbe: Because Christ once went through pain for sins, the upright one taking the place of sinners, so that through him we might come back to God; being put to death in the flesh, but given life in the Spirit;

3.msb: in whom He also went and preached to the spirits in prison
3.kjv: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
3.blb: in whom also, having gone, He preached to the spirits in prison
3.bbe: By whom he went to the spirits in prison, preaching to those

3.msb: who disobeyed long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built. In the ark a few people, only eight souls, were saved through water.
3.kjv: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
3.blb: at one time having disobeyed, when the longsuffering of God was waiting in the days of Noah, of the ark being prepared, in which a few—that is, eight souls—were saved through water,
3.bbe: Who, in the days of Noah, went against God's orders; but God in his mercy kept back the punishment, while Noah got ready the ark, in which a small number, that is to say eight persons, got salvation through water:

3.msb: And this water symbolizes the baptism that now saves us also—not the removal of dirt from the body, but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
3.kjv: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
3.blb: which also corresponds to the baptism now saving you, not a putting away of the filth of flesh, but the demand of a good conscience toward God, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
3.bbe: And baptism, of which this is an image, now gives you salvation, not by washing clean the flesh, but by making you free from the sense of sin before God, through the coming again of Jesus Christ from the dead;

3.msb: who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God, with angels, authorities, and powers subject to Him.
3.kjv: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
3.blb: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers having been subjected to Him.
3.bbe: Who has gone into heaven, and is at the right hand of God, angels and authorities and powers having been put under his rule.

4.msb: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in His body, arm yourselves with the same resolve, because anyone who has suffered in his body is done with sin.
4.kjv: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
4.blb: Therefore, Christ having suffered in the flesh, you also arm yourselves with the same mind, because the one having suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
4.bbe: So that as Jesus was put to death in the flesh, do you yourselves be of the same mind; for the death of the flesh puts an end to sin;
4.heading: Living for God’s Glory

4.msb: Consequently, he does not live out his remaining time on earth for human passions, but for the will of God.
4.kjv: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
4.blb: in order to live the remaining time in the flesh no longer to men’s lusts, but to the will of God.
4.bbe: So that you may give the rest of your lives in the flesh, not to the desires of men, but to the purpose of God.

4.msb: For we have spent enough of our past lifetime carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles: living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and detestable idolatry.
4.kjv: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:
4.blb: For the time past is sufficient to have carried out the intent of the Gentiles, having walked in debaucheries, lusts, drunkenness, orgies, carousings, and unlawful idolatries.
4.bbe: Because for long enough, in times past, we have been living after the way of the Gentiles, given up to the desires of the flesh, to drinking and feasting and loose behaviour and unclean worship of images;

4.msb: Because of this, they consider it strange of you not to plunge with them into the same flood of reckless indiscretion, and they heap abuse on you.
4.kjv: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:
4.blb: In this, they think it strange of you not running with them into the same overflow of dissipation, slandering,
4.bbe: And they are wondering that you no longer go with them in this violent wasting of life, and are saying evil things of you:

4.msb: But they will have to give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
4.kjv: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
4.blb: who will give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
4.bbe: But they will have to give an account of themselves to him who is ready to be the judge of the living and the dead.

4.msb: That is why the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
4.kjv: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
4.blb: For unto this the gospel was proclaimed even to the dead, so that they might be judged indeed according to men in the flesh, but they might live according to God in the spirit.
4.bbe: For this was the reason why the good news of Jesus was given even to the dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but might be living before God in the spirit.

4.msb: The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear-minded and sober, so that you can pray.
4.kjv: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
4.blb: Now the end of all things has drawn near. Therefore be sound-minded and be sober unto prayers,
4.bbe: But the end of all things is near: so be serious in your behaviour and keep on the watch with prayer;

4.msb: Above all, love one another deeply, because love will cover over a multitude of sins.
4.kjv: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
4.blb: before all things having fervent love among yourselves because love covers a multitude of sins,
4.bbe: And most of all be warm in your love for one another; because in love there is forgiveness for sins without number:

4.msb: Show hospitality to one another without complaining.
4.kjv: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
4.blb: hospitable to one another without grumbling,
4.bbe: Keep open house for all with a glad heart;

4.msb: As good stewards of the manifold grace of God, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.
4.kjv: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
4.blb: just as each received a gift, ministering it to each other as good stewards of the manifold grace of God:
4.bbe: Making distribution among one another of whatever has been given to you, like true servants of the unmeasured grace of God;

4.msb: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
4.kjv: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
4.blb: if anyone speaks, as oracles of God; if anyone ministers, as out of strength that God supplies, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom is the glory and the power to the ages of the ages. Amen.
4.bbe: If anyone has anything to say, let it be as the words of God; if anyone has the desire to be the servant of others, let him do it in the strength which is given by God; so that in all things God may have the glory through Jesus Christ, whose are the glory and the power for ever.

4.msb: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial that has come upon you, as though something strange were happening to you.
4.kjv: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
4.blb: Beloved, do not think strange the fiery ordeal among you taking place for a trial to you, as if a strange thing were happening to you.
4.bbe: Dear brothers, do not be surprised, as if it was something strange, if your faith is tested as by fire:
4.heading: Suffering as Christians

4.msb: But rejoice that you share in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed at the revelation of His glory.
4.kjv: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.
4.blb: But as you share in the sufferings of Christ, rejoice, so that also in the revelation of His glory you may rejoice, exulting.
4.bbe: But be glad that you are given a part in the pains of Christ; so that at the revelation of his glory you may have great joy.

4.msb: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. Indeed, on their part He is blasphemed, but on your part He is glorified.
4.kjv: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
4.blb: If you are reproached in the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
4.bbe: If men say evil things of you because of the name of Christ, happy are you; for the Spirit of glory and of God is resting on you.

4.msb: Indeed, none of you should suffer as a murderer or thief or wrongdoer, or even as a meddler.
4.kjv: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men’s matters.
4.blb: For let not any of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evildoer, or as a meddler,
4.bbe: Let no one among you undergo punishment as a taker of life, or as a thief, or as an evil-doer, or as one who is over-interested in other men's business;

4.msb: But if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but glorify God in this matter.
4.kjv: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.
4.blb: but if as a Christian, let him not be ashamed, but let him glorify God in this name.
4.bbe: But if he undergoes punishment as a Christian, that is no shame to him; let him give glory to God in this name.

4.msb: For it is time for judgment to begin with the family of God; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who disobey the gospel of God?
4.kjv: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?
4.blb: For it is the time for the judgment to have begun from the house of God; and if from us first, what will be the end of those being disobedient to the gospel of God?
4.bbe: For the time has come for the judging, starting with the church of God; but if it makes a start with us, what will be the end of those who are not under the rule of God?

4.msb: And, “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”
4.kjv: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?
4.blb: And, “If the righteous one is saved with difficulty, where will appear the ungodly and sinner?”
4.bbe: And if it is hard for even the good man to get salvation, what chance has the man without religion or the sinner?

4.msb: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should entrust their souls to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.
4.kjv: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.
4.blb: Therefore also, those suffering according to the will of God, let them commit their souls to the faithful Creator in doing good.
4.bbe: For this reason let those who by the purpose of God undergo punishment, keep on in well-doing and put their souls into the safe hands of their Maker.

5.msb: As a fellow elder, a witness of Christ’s sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, I appeal to the elders among you:
5.kjv: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
5.blb: I exhort the elders among you as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ and a partaker of the glory being about to be revealed:
5.bbe: I who am myself one of the rulers of the church, and a witness of the death of Christ, having my part in the coming glory, send this serious request to the chief men among you:
5.heading: Instructions to Elders

5.msb: Be shepherds of God’s flock that is among you, watching over them not out of compulsion, but willingly; not out of greed, but out of eagerness;
5.kjv: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
5.blb: Shepherd the flock of God among you, exercising oversight, not under compulsion but willingly according to God; and not for shameful gain but eagerly,
5.bbe: Keep watch over the flock of God which is in your care, using your authority, not as forced to do so, but gladly; and not for unclean profit but with a ready mind;

5.msb: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.
5.kjv: Neither as being lords over God’s heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.
5.blb: not as exercising lordship over those in your charge, but being examples to the flock.
5.bbe: Not as lords over God's heritage, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

5.msb: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.
5.kjv: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
5.blb: And on the Chief Shepherd having been made manifest, you will receive the unfading crown of glory.
5.bbe: And at the coming of the chief Keeper of the sheep, you will be given the eternal crown of glory.

5.msb: Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility, being subject to one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
5.kjv: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
5.blb: Likewise, younger ones, be subject to your elders. And all, gird on humility to one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
5.bbe: And in the same way, let the younger men be ruled by the older ones. Let all of you put away pride and make yourselves ready to be servants: for God is a hater of pride, but he gives grace to those who make themselves low.
5.heading: Cast Your Cares on Him

5.msb: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.
5.kjv: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:
5.blb: Humble yourselves, therefore, under the mighty hand of God, so that He may exalt you in due time,
5.bbe: For this cause make yourselves low under the strong hand of God, so that when the time comes you may be lifted up;

5.msb: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
5.kjv: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
5.blb: having cast all your anxiety on Him, because with Him there is care about you.
5.bbe: Putting all your troubles on him, for he takes care of you.

5.msb: Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
5.kjv: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
5.blb: Be sober-minded; be alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around as a roaring lion seeking whom to swallow up,
5.bbe: Be serious and keep watch; the Evil One, who is against you, goes about like a lion with open mouth in search of food;

5.msb: Resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering.
5.kjv: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
5.blb: whom you should resist, firm in the faith, knowing the same sufferings in your brotherhood to be experienced in the world.
5.bbe: Do not give way to him but be strong in your faith, in the knowledge that your brothers who are in the world undergo the same troubles.

5.msb: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ Jesus, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
5.kjv: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
5.blb: And the God of all grace, the One having called you to His eternal glory in Christ, having suffered a little while, He Himself will complete, will confirm, will strengthen, and will establish you.
5.bbe: And after you have undergone pain for a little time, the God of all grace who has given you a part in his eternal glory through Christ Jesus, will himself give you strength and support, and make you complete in every good thing;
5.heading: Benediction and Farewell

5.msb: To Him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
5.kjv: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
5.blb: To Him be the power to the ages of the ages. Amen.
5.bbe: His is the power for ever. So be it.

5.msb: Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
5.kjv: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.
5.blb: Through Silvanus, the faithful brother as I reckon him, I wrote to you through few words, exhorting and testifying this to be the true grace of God, in which you stand.
5.bbe: I have sent you this short letter by Silvanus, a true brother, in my opinion; comforting you and witnessing that this is the true grace of God; keep to it.

5.msb: The church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, as does my son Mark.
5.kjv: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.
5.blb: She in Babylon chosen with you greets you, and my son Mark.
5.bbe: She who is in Babylon, who has a part with you in the purpose of God, sends you her love; and so does my son Mark.

5.msb: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
5.kjv: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
5.blb: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to you all who are in Christ.
5.bbe: Give one another the kiss of love. Peace be to you all in Christ.

1.msb: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours:
1.kjv: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:
1.blb: Simeon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those having obtained a faith equally precious with ours, through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ:
1.bbe: Simon Peter, a servant and Apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who with us have a part in the same holy faith in the righteousness of our God and Saviour Jesus Christ:
1.heading: A Greeting from Peter

1.msb: Grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
1.kjv: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
1.blb: Grace and peace be multiplied to you in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
1.bbe: May grace and peace ever be increasing in you, in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord;

1.msb: His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.
1.kjv: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:
1.blb: Accordingly, His divine power has given to us all things toward life and godliness, through the knowledge of the One having called us by His own glory and excellence,
1.bbe: Because by his power he has given us everything necessary for life and righteousness, through the knowledge of him who has been our guide by his glory and virtue;
1.heading: Partakers of the Divine Nature

1.msb: Through these He has given us His precious and magnificent promises, so that through them you may become partakers of the divine nature, now that you have escaped the corruption in the world caused by evil desires.
1.kjv: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
1.blb: through which He has given to us the precious and magnificent promises, so that through these you might become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption in the world in evil desire.
1.bbe: And through this he has given us the hope of great rewards highly to be valued; so that by them we might have our part in God's being, and be made free from the destruction which is in the world through the desires of the flesh.

1.msb: For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith virtue; and to virtue, knowledge;
1.kjv: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
1.blb: Now also for this very reason, having brought in all diligence, supply in your faith virtue, and in virtue knowledge,
1.bbe: So, for this very cause, take every care; joining virtue to faith, and knowledge to virtue,

1.msb: and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness;
1.kjv: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;
1.blb: and in knowledge self-control, and in self-control perseverance, and in perseverance godliness,
1.bbe: And self-control to knowledge, and a quiet mind to self-control, and fear of God to a quiet mind,

1.msb: and to godliness, brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness, love.
1.kjv: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.
1.blb: and in godliness brotherly affection, and in brotherly affection love.
1.bbe: And love of the brothers to fear of God, and to love of the brothers, love itself.

1.msb: For if you possess these qualities and continue to grow in them, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
1.blb: For these things being in you and abounding make you neither idle nor unfruitful in regard to the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
1.bbe: For if you have these things in good measure, they will make you fertile and full of fruit in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

1.msb: But whoever lacks these traits is nearsighted to the point of blindness, having forgotten that he has been cleansed from his past sins.
1.kjv: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
1.blb: For in whomever these things are not present, he is blind, being shortsighted, having received forgetfulness of the cleansing from his former sins.
1.bbe: For the man who has not these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having no memory of how he was made clean from his old sins.

1.msb: Therefore, brothers, strive to make your calling and election sure. For if you practice these things you will never stumble,
1.kjv: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:
1.blb: Therefore, brothers, be diligent, rather, to make your calling and election sure. For in doing these things, never at any time shall you stumble.
1.bbe: For this reason, my brothers, take all the more care to make your selection and approval certain; for if you do these things you will never have a fall:

1.msb: and you will receive a lavish reception into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
1.blb: For in this way the entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will be richly supplied to you.
1.bbe: For so the way will be open to you into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

1.msb: Therefore I will not neglect to remind you of these things, even though you know them and are established in the truth you now have.
1.kjv: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be established in the present truth.
1.blb: Therefore I will be ready always to remind you concerning these things, though knowing them and having been strengthened in the truth being present.
1.bbe: For this reason I will be ready at all times to keep your memory of these things awake, though you have the knowledge of them now and are well based in your present faith.

1.msb: I think it is right to refresh your memory as long as I live in the tent of my body,
1.kjv: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
1.blb: Now I esteem it right, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up in a reminder,
1.bbe: And it seems right to me, as long as I am in this tent of flesh, to keep your minds awake by working on your memory;

1.msb: because I know that this tent will soon be laid aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.
1.kjv: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.
1.blb: knowing that the putting off of my tabernacle is soon, as also our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
1.bbe: For I am conscious that in a short time I will have to put off this tent of flesh, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.

1.msb: And I will make every effort to ensure that after my departure, you will be able to recall these things at all times.
1.kjv: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.
1.blb: And I will be diligent also for you to have at every time after my departure these things, to make a lasting remembrance.
1.bbe: And I will take every care so that you may have a clear memory of these things after my death.

1.msb: For we did not follow cleverly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of His majesty.
1.kjv: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
1.blb: For we did not make known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ having followed after cleverly devised myths, but having been eyewitnesses of His majesty.
1.bbe: For when we gave you news of the power and the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, our teaching was not based on stories put together by art, but we were eye-witnesses of his glory.
1.heading: Eyewitnesses of His Majesty

1.msb: For He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to Him from the Majestic Glory, saying, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
1.kjv: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
1.blb: For having received honor and glory from God the Father, a voice such as follows was brought to Him by the Majestic Glory: “This is My Son, My beloved, in whom I was well pleased.”
1.bbe: For God the Father gave him honour and glory, when such a voice came to him out of the great glory, saying, This is my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased.

1.msb: And we ourselves heard this voice from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain.
1.kjv: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
1.blb: And we heard this voice having been brought out of heaven, being with Him in the holy mountain.
1.bbe: And this voice came from heaven even to our ears, when we were with him on the holy mountain.

1.msb: We also have the word of the prophets as confirmed beyond doubt. And you will do well to pay attention to it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.
1.kjv: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
1.blb: And we have the more certain prophetic word, to which you do well taking heed, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until this day shall have dawned and the morning star shall have arisen in your hearts,
1.bbe: And so the words of the prophets are made more certain; and it is well for you to give attention to them as to a light shining in a dark place, till the dawn comes and the morning star is seen in your hearts;

1.msb: Above all, you must understand that no prophecy of Scripture comes from one’s own interpretation.
1.kjv: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.
1.blb: knowing this first, that every prophecy of Scripture is not of its own interpretation.
1.bbe: Being conscious in the first place that no man by himself may give a special sense to the words of the prophets.

1.msb: For no such prophecy was ever brought forth by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.
1.kjv: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
1.blb: For not by the will of man was prophecy brought forth at any time, but being carried by the Holy Spirit, men spoke from God.
1.bbe: For these words did not ever come through the impulse of men: but the prophets had them from God, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

2.msb: Now there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them—bringing swift destruction on themselves.
2.kjv: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.
2.blb: But there were also false prophets among the people, as also among you there will be false teachers who will stealthily introduce destructive heresies, even denying the Master having bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction.
2.bbe: But there were false prophets among the people, as there will be false teachers among you, who will secretly put forward wrong teachings for your destruction, even turning away from the Lord who gave himself for them; whose destruction will come quickly, and they themselves will be the cause of it.
2.heading: Deliverance from False Prophets

2.msb: Many will follow in their depravity, and because of them the way of truth will be defamed.
2.kjv: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.
2.blb: And many will follow after their sensuality, through whom the way of the truth will be blasphemed.
2.bbe: And a great number will go with them in their evil ways, through whom the true way will have a bad name.

2.msb: In their greed, these false teachers will exploit you with deceptive words. The longstanding verdict against them remains in force, and their destruction will not sleep.
2.kjv: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
2.blb: And through covetousness they will exploit you with fabricated words, for whom the judgment of long ago is not idle, and their destruction does not slumber.
2.bbe: And in their desire for profit they will come to you with words of deceit, like traders doing business in souls: whose punishment has been ready for a long time and their destruction is watching for them.

2.msb: For if God did not spare the angels when they sinned, but cast them deep into hell, placing them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment;
2.kjv: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
2.blb: For if God did not spare the angels having sinned, but having cast them down to Tartarus in chains of gloomy darkness, He delivered them, being kept for judgment;
2.bbe: For if God did not have pity for the angels who did evil, but sent them down into hell, to be kept in chains of eternal night till they were judged;

2.msb: if He did not spare the ancient world when He brought the flood on its ungodly people, but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, among the eight;
2.kjv: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
2.blb: and He did not spare the ancient world, but He preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, one of eight, having brought the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
2.bbe: And did not have mercy on the world which then was, but only kept safe Noah, a preacher of righteousness, with seven others, when he let loose the waters over the world of the evil-doers;

2.msb: if He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction, reducing them to ashes as an example of what is coming on the ungodly;
2.kjv: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;
2.blb: and He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction, having reduced them to ashes, having set an example of what is coming on the ungodly;
2.bbe: And sent destruction on Sodom and Gomorrah, burning them up with fire as an example to those whose way of life might in the future be unpleasing to him;

2.msb: and if He rescued Lot, a righteous man distressed by the depraved conduct of the lawless
2.kjv: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
2.blb: and He delivered righteous Lot, being distressed by the conduct in sensuality of the lawless
2.bbe: And kept safe Lot, the upright man, who was deeply troubled by the unclean life of the evil-doers

2.msb: (for that righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard)—
2.kjv: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)
2.blb: (for that righteous man dwelling, among them, day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul in seeing and hearing their lawless works)—
2.bbe: (Because the soul of that upright man living among them was pained from day to day by seeing and hearing their crimes):

2.msb: if all this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment.
2.kjv: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:
2.blb: then the Lord knows to deliver the devout out of trial and to keep the unrighteous being punished unto the day of judgment,
2.bbe: The Lord is able to keep the upright safe in the time of testing, and to keep evil-doers under punishment till the day of judging;

2.msb: Such punishment is specially reserved for those who indulge the corrupt desires of the flesh and despise authority. Bold and self-willed, they are unafraid to slander glorious beings.
2.kjv: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.
2.blb: and especially those going after the flesh in the passion of defilement and despising authority. Bold, self-willed, they are not afraid of blaspheming glorious ones,
2.bbe: But specially those who go after the unclean desires of the flesh, and make sport of authority. Ready to take chances, uncontrolled, they have no fear of saying evil of those in high places:

2.msb: Yet not even angels, though greater in strength and power, dare to bring such slanderous charges against them before the Lord.
2.kjv: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.
2.blb: whereas angels, being greater in strength and power, do not bring against them a blasphemous judgment before the Lord.
2.bbe: Though the angels, who are greater in strength and power, do not make use of violent language against them before the Lord.

2.msb: These men are like irrational animals, creatures of instinct, born to be captured and destroyed. They blaspheme in matters they do not understand, and like such creatures, they will be destroyed.
2.kjv: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;
2.blb: But these, as irrational animals having been born naturally for capture and destruction, blaspheming in what they are ignorant of, in their destruction also will be destroyed,
2.bbe: But these men, like beasts without reason, whose natural use is to be taken and put to death, crying out against things of which they have no knowledge, will undergo that same destruction which they are designing for others;

2.msb: They will receive the wages of their wickedness. They consider it a pleasure to carouse in broad daylight. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their deception as they feast with you.
2.kjv: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;
2.blb: suffering harm as the wage of unrighteousness; esteeming luxury in daytime as pleasure; spots and blemishes, luxuriating in their deceptions, feasting with you;
2.bbe: For the evil which overtakes them is the reward of their evil-doing: such men take their pleasure in the delights of the flesh even in the daytime; they are like the marks of a disease, like poisoned wounds among you, feasting together with you in joy;

2.msb: Their eyes are full of adultery; their desire for sin is never satisfied; they seduce the unstable. They are accursed children with hearts trained in greed.
2.kjv: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:
2.blb: having eyes full of adultery, and unceasing from sin; enticing unstable souls; having a heart having been trained in covetousness—children of a curse!
2.bbe: Having eyes full of evil desire, never having enough of sin; turning feeble souls out of the true way; they are children of cursing, whose hearts are well used to bitter envy;

2.msb: They have left the straight way and wandered off to follow the way of Balaam son of Bosor, who loved the wages of wickedness.
2.kjv: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
2.blb: Having forsaken the straight way, they went astray, having followed after the way of Balaam son of Beor, who loved the wage of unrighteousness.
2.bbe: Turning out of the true way, they have gone wandering in error, after the way of Balaam, the son of Beor, who was pleased to take payment for wrongdoing;

2.msb: But he was rebuked for his transgression by a donkey, otherwise without speech, that spoke with a man’s voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.
2.kjv: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man’s voice forbad the madness of the prophet.
2.blb: But he had reproof for his own violation of the law by a mute donkey; having spoken in a man’s voice, it restrained the madness of the prophet.
2.bbe: But his wrongdoing was pointed out to him: an ass, talking with a man's voice, put a stop to the error of the prophet.

2.msb: These men are springs without water and clouds driven by a storm. Blackest darkness is forever reserved for them.
2.kjv: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.
2.blb: These are springs without waters and mists being driven by a storm, for whom the gloom of darkness has been kept.
2.bbe: These are fountains without water, and mists before a driving storm; for whom the eternal night is kept in store.

2.msb: With lofty but empty words, they appeal to the sensual passions of the flesh and entice those who have truly escaped from others who live in error.
2.kjv: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.
2.blb: For speaking great swelling words of vanity, they entice in the passions of the flesh to sensuality those barely escaping from those conducting themselves in error,
2.bbe: For with high-sounding false words, making use of the attraction of unclean desires of the flesh, they get into their power those newly made free from those who are living in error;

2.msb: They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves to depravity. For a man is a slave to whatever has mastered him.
2.kjv: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.
2.blb: promising to them freedom, themselves being slaves of corruption. For by what anyone has been subdued, by that also he is enslaved.
2.bbe: Saying that they will be free, while they themselves are the servants of destruction; because whatever gets the better of a man makes a servant of him.

2.msb: If indeed they have escaped the corruption of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, only to be entangled and overcome by it again, their final condition is worse than it was at first.
2.kjv: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
2.blb: For if, having escaped from the pollutions of the world in the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, now again having been entangled in these they are subdued, the last state has become worse to them than the first.
2.bbe: For if, after they have got free from the unclean things of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again taken in the net and overcome, their last condition is worse than their first.

2.msb: It would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than to have known it and then to turn away from the holy commandment passed on to them.
2.kjv: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.
2.blb: For it would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than, having known it, to have turned from the holy commandment having been delivered to them.
2.bbe: For it would have been better for them to have had no knowledge of the way of righteousness, than to go back again from the holy law which was given to them, after having knowledge of it.

2.msb: Of them the proverbs are true: “A dog returns to its vomit,” and, “A sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud.”
2.kjv: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
2.blb: The thing of the true proverb has happened to them: “A dog having returned to its own vomit,” and, “A sow, having washed, to her rolling place in the mire.”
2.bbe: They are an example of that true saying, The dog has gone back to the food it had put out, and the pig which had been washed to its rolling in the dirty earth.

3.msb: Beloved, this is now my second letter to you. Both of them are reminders to stir you to wholesome thinking
3.kjv: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
3.blb: Beloved, this is now the second letter I am writing to you in which I am stirring up your pure mind in a reminder
3.bbe: My loved ones, this is now my second letter to you, and in this as in the first, I am attempting to keep your true minds awake;
3.heading: The Coming Judgment

3.msb: by recalling what was foretold by the holy prophets and commanded by our Lord and Savior through your apostles.
3.kjv: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:
3.blb: to remember the words having been spoken beforehand by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of the Lord and Savior by your apostles,
3.bbe: So that you may keep in mind the words of the holy prophets in the past, and the law of the Lord and Saviour which was given to you by his Apostles.

3.msb: Most importantly, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, following their own evil desires.
3.kjv: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,
3.blb: first knowing this, that in the last days scoffers will come with scoffing, going according to their own passions
3.bbe: Having first of all the knowledge that in the last days there will be men who, ruled by their evil desires, will make sport of holy things,

3.msb: “Where is the promise of His coming?” they will ask. “Ever since our fathers fell asleep, everything continues as it has from the beginning of creation.”
3.kjv: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
3.blb: and saying, “Where is the promise of His coming? For from which time the fathers fell asleep, all things continue in this way from the beginning of creation.”
3.bbe: Saying, Where is the hope of his coming? From the death of the fathers till now everything has gone on as it was from the making of the world.

3.msb: But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water,
3.kjv: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:
3.blb: For this is hidden from them willingly, that the heavens were long ago, and the earth, out of water and through water having been composed by the word of God,
3.bbe: But in taking this view they put out of their minds the memory that in the old days there was a heaven, and an earth lifted out of the water and circled by water, by the word of God;

3.msb: through which the world of that time perished in the flood.
3.kjv: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
3.blb: through which the world at that time was destroyed, having been deluged with water.
3.bbe: And that the world which then was came to an end through the overflowing of the waters.

3.msb: And by His word, the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
3.kjv: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
3.blb: But by the same word the present heavens and the earth are having been stored up for fire, being kept unto the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
3.bbe: But the present heaven and the present earth have been kept for destruction by fire, which is waiting for them on the day of the judging and destruction of evil men.

3.msb: Beloved, do not let this one thing escape your notice: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.
3.kjv: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
3.blb: But let this one thing not be hidden from you, beloved, that with the Lord one day is as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
3.bbe: But, my loved ones, keep in mind this one thing, that with the Lord one day is the same as a thousand years, and a thousand years are no more than one day.
3.heading: The Day of the Lord

3.msb: The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise as some understand slowness, but is patient with us, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.
3.kjv: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
3.blb: The Lord is not slow in the promise, as some esteem slowness, but is patient toward you, not wishing for any to perish, but all to receive a place for repentance.
3.bbe: The Lord is not slow in keeping his word, as he seems to some, but he is waiting in mercy for you, not desiring the destruction of any, but that all may be turned from their evil ways.

3.msb: But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night. The heavens will disappear with a roar, the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and its works will be burned up.
3.kjv: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
3.blb: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief, in which the heavens will pass away with a rushing sound, and the elements will be dissolved, burning with heat, and the earth and the works in it will not be found.
3.bbe: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief; and in that day the heavens will be rolled up with a great noise, and the substance of the earth will be changed by violent heat, and the world and everything in it will be burned up.

3.msb: Since everything will be destroyed, then, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to conduct yourselves in holiness and godliness
3.kjv: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
3.blb: All these things being dissolved in this way, what kind is it necessary for you to be? It is in holy conduct and godliness,
3.bbe: Seeing then that all these things are coming to such an end, what sort of persons is it right for you to be, in all holy behaviour and righteousness,

3.msb: as you anticipate and hasten the coming of the day of God, when the heavens will be destroyed by fire and the elements will melt in the heat.
3.kjv: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
3.blb: anticipating and hastening the coming of the day of God, by which the heavens will be dissolved, being set on fire, and the elements melt, burning with heat.
3.bbe: Looking for and truly desiring the coming of the day of God, when the heavens will come to an end through fire, and the substance of the earth will be changed by the great heat?

3.msb: But in keeping with God’s promise, we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells.
3.kjv: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
3.blb: But according to His promise, we anticipate a new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
3.bbe: But having faith in his word, we are looking for a new heaven and a new earth, which will be the resting-place of righteousness.

3.msb: Therefore, beloved, as you anticipate these things, make every effort to be found at peace—spotless and blameless in His sight.
3.kjv: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
3.blb: Therefore, beloved, anticipating these things, be diligent, without spot and without blemish, to be found by Him in peace.
3.bbe: For this reason, my loved ones, as you are looking for these things, take great care that when he comes you may be in peace before him, free from sin and every evil thing.
3.heading: Final Exhortations

3.msb: Consider also that our Lord’s patience brings salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom God gave him.
3.kjv: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;
3.blb: And esteem the patience of our Lord as salvation, just as also our beloved brother Paul according to the wisdom having been given to him, wrote to you,
3.bbe: And be certain that the long waiting of the Lord is for salvation; even as our brother Paul has said in his letters to you, from the wisdom which was given to him;

3.msb: He writes this way in all his letters, speaking in them about such matters. Some parts of his letters are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, as they do the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.
3.kjv: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
3.blb: as also in all the letters, speaking in them concerning these things, in which some things are difficult to be understood, which the unlearned and unstable distort, as also the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.
3.bbe: And as he said in all his letters, which had to do with these things; in which are some hard sayings, so that, like the rest of the holy Writings, they are twisted by those who are uncertain and without knowledge, to the destruction of their souls.

3.msb: Therefore, beloved, since you already know these things, be on your guard so that you will not be carried away by the error of the lawless and fall from your secure standing.
3.kjv: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.
3.blb: You, therefore, beloved, knowing this beforehand, be on guard, lest, having been led away by the error of the lawless, you should fall from your own steadfastness.
3.bbe: For this reason, my loved ones, having knowledge of these things before they take place, take care that you are not turned away by the error of the uncontrolled, so falling from your true faith.

3.msb: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
3.kjv: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
3.blb: But grow in grace and in knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
3.bbe: But be increased in grace and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. May he have glory now and for ever. So be it.

1.msb: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands—this is the Word of life.
1.kjv: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
1.blb: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we looked at and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life—
1.bbe: That which was from the first, which has come to our ears, and which we have seen with our eyes, looking on it and touching it with our hands, about the Word of life
1.heading: The Word of Life

1.msb: And this is the life that was revealed; we have seen it and testified to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.
1.kjv: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
1.blb: and the life was made manifest, and we have seen and bear witness, and we declare to you the eternal life, which was with the Father and was made manifest to us—
1.bbe: (And the life was made clear to us, and we have seen it and are witnessing to it and giving you word of that eternal life which was with the Father and was seen by us);

1.msb: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And this fellowship of ours is with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
1.blb: that which we have seen and have heard we declare to you also, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And indeed our fellowship is with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.
1.bbe: We give you word of all we have seen and everything which has come to our ears, so that you may be united with us; and we are united with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ:

1.msb: We write these things to you so that our joy may be complete.
1.kjv: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
1.blb: And these things we write so that our joy may be full.
1.bbe: And we are writing these things to you so that our joy may be made complete.

1.msb: And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.
1.kjv: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
1.blb: And this is the message that we have heard from Him and we announce to you, that God is light, and in Him is no darkness—none.
1.bbe: This is the word which came to us from him and which we give to you, that God is light and in him there is nothing dark.
1.heading: Walking in the Light

1.msb: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.
1.kjv: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
1.blb: If we should say that we have fellowship with Him and should walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.
1.bbe: If we say we are joined to him, and are walking still in the dark, our words are false and our acts are untrue:

1.msb: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ His Son cleanses us from all sin.
1.kjv: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
1.blb: But if we should walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
1.bbe: But if we are walking in the light, as he is in the light, we are all united with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son makes us clean from all sin.

1.msb: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
1.kjv: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
1.blb: If we should say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us.
1.bbe: If we say that we have no sin, we are false to ourselves and there is nothing true in us.

1.msb: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
1.kjv: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
1.blb: If we should confess our sins, He is faithful and righteous, that He may forgive us our sins and may cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
1.bbe: If we say openly that we have done wrong, he is upright and true to his word, giving us forgiveness of sins and making us clean from all evil.

1.msb: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.
1.kjv: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
1.blb: If we should say that we have not sinned, we make Him a liar and His word is not in us.
1.bbe: If we say that we have no sin, we make him false and his word is not in us.

2.msb: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
2.kjv: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
2.blb: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you might not sin. And if anyone might sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the Righteous One.
2.bbe: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you may be without sin. And if any man is a sinner, we have a friend and helper with the Father, Jesus Christ, the upright one:
2.heading: Jesus Our Advocate

2.msb: He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.
2.kjv: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
2.blb: And He is the propitiation for our sins, and not only for ours, but also for those of the whole world.
2.bbe: He is the offering for our sins; and not for ours only, but for all the world.

2.msb: By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.
2.kjv: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
2.blb: And by this we know that we have known Him, if we may keep His commandments.
2.bbe: And by this we may be certain that we have knowledge of him, if we keep his laws.

2.msb: If anyone says, “I know Him,” but does not keep His commandments, he is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
2.kjv: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
2.blb: The one saying, “I have known Him,” and not keeping His commandments, he is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
2.bbe: The man who says, I have knowledge of him, and does not keep his laws, is false, and there is nothing true in him:

2.msb: But if anyone keeps His word, the love of God has been truly perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him:
2.kjv: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
2.blb: But whoever may keep His word, truly in him the love of God has been perfected. In this we know that we are in Him:
2.bbe: But in every man who keeps his word, the love of God is made complete. By this we may be certain that we are in him:

2.msb: Whoever claims to abide in Him must walk as Jesus walked.
2.kjv: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
2.blb: The one claiming to remain in Him ought, according to the manner that He walked, also himself in the same way to walk.
2.bbe: He who says that he is living in him, will do as he did.

2.msb: Brothers, I am not writing to you a new commandment, but an old one, which you have had from the beginning. This commandment is the message you have heard from the beginning.
2.kjv: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
2.blb: Beloved, I am not writing to you a new commandment, but an old commandment, which you have had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word that you heard.
2.bbe: My loved ones, I do not give you a new law, but an old law which you had from the first; this old law is the word which came to your ears.
2.heading: A New Commandment

2.msb: Then again, I am also writing to you a new commandment, which is true in Him and also in you. For the darkness is fading and the true light is already shining.
2.kjv: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
2.blb: Again, I am writing to you a new commandment, which is true in Him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light is already shining.
2.bbe: Again, I give you a new law, which is true in him and in you; for the night is near its end and the true light is even now shining out.

2.msb: If anyone claims to be in the light but hates his brother, he is still in the darkness.
2.kjv: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
2.blb: The one claiming to be in the light and hating his brother is in the darkness until now.
2.bbe: He who says that he is in the light, and has hate in his heart for his brother, is still in the dark.

2.msb: Whoever loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no cause of stumbling in him.
2.kjv: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
2.blb: The one loving his brother remains in the light, and in him there is no cause for stumbling.
2.bbe: He who has love for his brother is in the light, and there is no cause of error in him.

2.msb: But whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness. He does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
2.kjv: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.
2.blb: But the one hating his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness; and he does not know where he goes, because the darkness blinded his eyes.
2.bbe: But he who has hate for his brother is in the dark, walking in the dark with no knowledge of where he is going, unable to see because of the dark.

2.msb: I am writing to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven through His name.
2.kjv: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
2.blb: I write to you, little children, because the sins have been forgiven you through His name.
2.bbe: I am writing to you, my children, because you have forgiveness of sins through his name.

2.msb: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I am writing to you, children, because you know the Father.
2.kjv: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
2.blb: I write to you, fathers because you have known Him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I wrote to you, children, because you have known the Father.
2.bbe: I am writing to you, fathers, because you have knowledge of him who was from the first. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the Evil One. I have sent a letter to you, children, because you have knowledge of the Father.

2.msb: I have written to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
2.kjv: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
2.blb: I wrote to you, fathers, because you have known Him who is from the beginning. I wrote to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
2.bbe: I have sent a letter to you, fathers, because you have knowledge of him who was from the first. I have sent a letter to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God is in you, and because you have overcome the Evil One.

2.msb: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
2.kjv: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
2.blb: Do not love the world nor the things in the world. If anyone should love the world, the love of the Father is not in him,
2.bbe: Have no love for the world or for the things which are in the world. If any man has love for the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
2.heading: Do Not Love the World

2.msb: For all that is in the world—the desires of the flesh, the desires of the eyes, and the pride of life—is not from the Father but from the world.
2.kjv: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
2.blb: because all that is in the world, the desire of the flesh and the desire of the eyes and the vaunting of life, is not from the Father but is from the world.
2.bbe: Because everything in the world, the desire of the flesh, the desire of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father but of the world.

2.msb: The world is passing away, along with its desires; but whoever does the will of God remains forever.
2.kjv: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
2.blb: And the world is passing away, and its desire; but the one doing the will of God remains to the age.
2.bbe: And the world and its desires is coming to an end: but he who does God's pleasure is living for ever.

2.msb: Children, it is the last hour; and just as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, so now many antichrists have appeared. This is how we know it is the last hour.
2.kjv: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
2.blb: Children, it is the last hour, and just as you heard that antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen, whereby we know that it is the last hour.
2.bbe: Little children, it is the last hour; and as you were given word that the Antichrist would come, so now a number of Antichrists have come to you; and by this we are certain that it is the last hour.
2.heading: Beware of Antichrists

2.msb: They went out from us, but they did not belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. But their departure made it clear that none of them belonged to us.
2.kjv: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
2.blb: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have remained with us. But it is so that it might be made manifest that they are not all of us.
2.bbe: They went out from us but they were not of us; if they had been of us they would still be with us: but they went out from us so that it might be made clear that they were not of us.

2.msb: You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and you know all things.
2.kjv: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
2.blb: And you have the anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know.
2.bbe: And you have the Spirit from the Holy One and you all have knowledge.
