2.msb: I have not written to you because you lack knowledge of the truth, but because you have it, and because no lie comes from the truth.
2.kjv: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
2.blb: I did not write to you because you do not know the truth, but because you know it, and because any lie is not of the truth.
2.bbe: I have not sent you this letter because you have no knowledge of what is true, but because you have knowledge, and because that which is false has nothing in common with that which is true.

2.msb: Who is the liar, if it is not the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, who denies the Father and the Son.
2.kjv: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
2.blb: Who is the liar, except the one denying that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, the one denying the Father and the Son.
2.bbe: Who is false but he who says that Jesus is not the Christ? He is the Antichrist who has no belief in the Father or the Son.

2.msb: Whoever denies the Son does not have the Father.
2.kjv: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: [but] he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
2.blb: Everyone denying the Son, neither does he have the Father. The one confessing the Son has the Father also.
2.bbe: He who has no belief in the Son has not the Father: he who makes clear his belief in the Son has the Father.

2.msb: As for you, then, let what you have heard from the beginning remain in you. If it does, you will also remain in the Son and in the Father.
2.kjv: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
2.blb: You, let that which you heard from the beginning remain in you. If that which you heard from the beginning should remain in you, you also will remain in the Son and in the Father.
2.bbe: But as for you, keep in your hearts the things which were made clear to you from the first. If you keep these things in your hearts you will be kept in the Father and the Son.
2.heading: Remain in Christ

2.msb: And this is the promise that He Himself made to us: eternal life.
2.kjv: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
2.blb: And this is the promise that He promised us: eternal life.
2.bbe: And this is the hope which he gave you, even eternal life.

2.msb: I have written these things to you about those who are trying to deceive you.
2.kjv: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
2.blb: I wrote these things to you concerning those leading you astray.
2.bbe: I am writing these things to you about those whose purpose is that you may be turned out of the true way.

2.msb: And as for you, the anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But just as the same true and genuine anointing teaches you about all things, so you must remain in Him as you have been taught.
2.kjv: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
2.blb: And you, the anointing that you received from Him remains in you, and you have no need that anyone should teach you. But as the same anointing teaches you concerning all things and is true and is not a lie, and just as it taught you, remain in Him.
2.bbe: As for you, the Spirit which he gave you is still in you, and you have no need of any teacher; but as his Spirit gives you teaching about all things, and is true and not false, so keep your hearts in him, through the teaching which he has given you.

2.msb: And now, little children, remain in Christ, so that when He appears, we may be confident and unashamed before Him at His coming.
2.kjv: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
2.blb: And now, little children, remain in Him, so that when He should be made manifest, we might have confidence and not be ashamed before Him at His coming.
2.bbe: And now, my children, keep your hearts in him; so that at his revelation, we may have no fear or shame before him at his coming.

2.msb: If you know that He is righteous, you also know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of Him.
2.kjv: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.
2.blb: If you know that He is righteous, you know also that everyone doing righteousness has been born of Him.
2.bbe: If you have knowledge that he is upright, it is clear to you that everyone who does righteousness is his offspring.

3.msb: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. The reason the world does not know you is that it did not know Him.
3.kjv: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
3.blb: See what kind of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God—and we are! Because of this, the world does not know us, because it did not know Him.
3.bbe: See what great love the Father has given us in naming us the children of God; and such we are. For this reason the world does not see who we are, because it did not see who he was.
3.heading: Children of God

3.msb: Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.
3.kjv: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
3.blb: Beloved, now we are children of God, and what we will be was not yet made manifest. We know that if He should be made manifest, we will be like Him, for we will see Him just as He is.
3.bbe: My loved ones, now we are children of God, and at present it is not clear what we are to be. We are certain that at his revelation we will be like him; for we will see him as he is.

3.msb: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.
3.kjv: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
3.blb: And everyone having this hope in Him purifies himself, just as He is pure.
3.bbe: And everyone who has this hope in him makes himself holy, even as he is holy.

3.msb: Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well. Indeed, sin is lawlessness.
3.kjv: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
3.blb: Everyone who is doing sin also does lawlessness; and sin is lawlessness.
3.bbe: Everyone who is a sinner goes against the law, for sin is going against the law.

3.msb: But you know that Christ appeared to take away our sins, and in Him there is no sin.
3.kjv: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
3.blb: And you know that He appeared so that He should take away sins; and in Him there is no sin.
3.bbe: And you have knowledge that he came to take away sin: and in him there is no sin.

3.msb: No one who remains in Him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has seen Him or known Him.
3.kjv: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.
3.blb: Everyone who is remaining in Him does not sin; everyone who is sinning has not seen Him, nor has he known Him.
3.bbe: Anyone who is in him does no sin; anyone who is a sinner has not seen him and has no knowledge of him.

3.msb: Little children, let no one deceive you: The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.
3.kjv: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
3.blb: Little children, let no one lead you astray; the one doing righteousness is righteous, just as He is righteous.
3.bbe: My little children, let no man take you out of the true way: he who does righteousness is upright, even as he is upright;

3.msb: The one who practices sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the very start. This is why the Son of God was revealed, to destroy the works of the devil.
3.kjv: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
3.blb: The one doing sin is of the devil, because the devil is sinning from the beginning. For this the Son of God was made manifest, so that He might destroy the works of the devil.
3.bbe: The sinner is a child of the Evil One; for the Evil One has been a sinner from the first. And the Son of God was seen on earth so that he might put an end to the works of the Evil One.

3.msb: Anyone born of God refuses to practice sin, because God’s seed abides in him; he cannot go on sinning, because he has been born of God.
3.kjv: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
3.blb: Everyone having been born of God does not do sin, because His seed remains in him, and he is not able to sin, because he has been born of God.
3.bbe: Anyone who is a child of God does no sin, because he still has God's seed in him; he is not able to be a sinner, because God is his Father.

3.msb: By this the children of God are distinguished from the children of the devil: Anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is anyone who does not love his brother.
3.kjv: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
3.blb: In this the children of God and the children of the devil are manifest: everyone not doing righteousness is not of God, and the one not loving his brother.
3.bbe: In this way it is clear who are the children of God and who are the children of the Evil One; anyone who does not do righteousness or who has no love for his brother, is not a child of God.

3.msb: This is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should love one another.
3.kjv: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
3.blb: For this is the message that you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another,
3.bbe: Because this is the word which was given to you from the first, that we are to have love for one another;
3.heading: Love One Another

3.msb: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did Cain slay him? Because his own deeds were evil, while those of his brother were righteous.
3.kjv: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
3.blb: not as Cain, who was of the evil one and slew his brother. And why did he slay him? Because his works were evil, but those of his brother were righteous.
3.bbe: Not being of the Evil One like Cain, who put his brother to death. And why did he put him to death? Because his works were evil and his brother's works were good.

3.msb: So do not be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.
3.kjv: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
3.blb: And do not marvel, brothers, if the world hates you.
3.bbe: Do not be surprised, my brothers, if the world has no love for you.

3.msb: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers. The one who does not love his brother remains in death.
3.kjv: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
3.blb: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love our brothers. The one not loving remains in death.
3.bbe: We are conscious that we have come out of death into life because of our love for the brothers. He who has no love is still in death.

3.msb: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that eternal life does not reside in a murderer.
3.kjv: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
3.blb: Everyone hating his brother is a murderer; and you know that any murderer does not have eternal life remaining in him.
3.bbe: Anyone who has hate for his brother is a taker of life, and you may be certain that no taker of life has eternal life in him.

3.msb: By this we know what love is: Jesus laid down His life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.
3.kjv: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
3.blb: In this we have known love, because He laid down His life for us; and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.
3.bbe: In this we see what love is, because he gave his life for us; and it is right for us to give our lives for the brothers.

3.msb: If anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need, but withholds his compassion from him, how can the love of God abide in him?
3.kjv: But whoso hath this world’s good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
3.blb: Now whoever may have the goods of the world, and may see his brother having need, and might shut his heart from him, how does the love of God remain in him?
3.bbe: But if a man has this world's goods, and sees that his brother is in need, and keeps his heart shut against his brother, how is it possible for the love of God to be in him?

3.msb: My little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.
3.kjv: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
3.blb: Little children, may we love not in word nor in tongue, but in work and in truth.
3.bbe: My little children, do not let our love be in word and in tongue, but let it be in act and in good faith.

3.msb: And by this we know that we belong to the truth, and assure our hearts in His presence:
3.kjv: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
3.blb: And in this we will know that we are of the truth, and we will assure our heart before Him,
3.bbe: In this way we may be certain that we are true, and may give our heart comfort before him,

3.msb: Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts, and He knows all things.
3.kjv: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
3.blb: that if our heart may condemn us, that God is greater than our heart, and He knows all things.
3.bbe: When our heart says that we have done wrong; because God is greater than our heart, and has knowledge of all things.

3.msb: Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God,
3.kjv: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
3.blb: Beloved, if our heart may not condemn us, we have confidence toward God,
3.bbe: My loved ones, if our heart does not say that we have done wrong, we have no fear before him;

3.msb: and we will receive from Him whatever we ask, because we keep His commandments and do what is pleasing in His sight.
3.kjv: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
3.blb: and whatever we may ask, we receive from Him, because we keep His commandments and we do the things pleasing before Him.
3.bbe: And he gives us all our requests, because we keep his laws and do the things which are pleasing in his eyes.

3.msb: And this is His commandment: that we should believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and we should love one another just as He commanded.
3.kjv: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
3.blb: And this is His commandment, that we should believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and we should love one another, just as He gave the commandment to us.
3.bbe: And this is his law, that we have faith in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love for one another, even as he said to us.

3.msb: Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God, and God in him. And by this we know that He remains in us: by the Spirit He has given us.
3.kjv: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
3.blb: And the one keeping His commandments remains in Him, and He in him. And in this we know that He remains in us: by the Spirit whom He gave to us.
3.bbe: He who keeps his laws is in God and God is in him. And the Spirit which he gave us is our witness that he is in us.

4.msb: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.
4.kjv: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
4.blb: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
4.bbe: My loved ones, do not put your faith in every spirit, but put them to the test, to see if they are from God: because a great number of false prophets have gone out into the world.
4.heading: Testing the Spirits

4.msb: By this you will know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,
4.kjv: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
4.blb: In this you know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses Jesus Christ having come in the flesh is of God,
4.bbe: By this you may have knowledge of the Spirit of God: every spirit which says that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God:

4.msb: and every spirit that does not confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and which is already in the world at this time.
4.kjv: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
4.blb: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not of God, and this is that of the antichrist, which you heard that is coming, and now is already in the world.
4.bbe: And every spirit which does not say this is not from God: this is the spirit of Antichrist, of which you have had word; and it is in the world even now.

4.msb: You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.
4.kjv: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
4.blb: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is the One in you than the one in the world.
4.bbe: You are of God, my little children, and you have overcome them because he who is in you is greater than he who is in the world.

4.msb: They are of the world. That is why they speak from the world’s perspective, and the world listens to them.
4.kjv: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.
4.blb: They are of the world; because of this they speak from out of the world, and the world hears them.
4.bbe: They are of the world, so their talk is the world's talk, and the world gives ear to them.

4.msb: We are from God. Whoever knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. That is how we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deception.
4.kjv: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
4.blb: We are of God. The one knowing God hears us. The one who is not of God does not hear us. By this we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of error.
4.bbe: We are of God: he who has the knowledge of God gives ear to us; he who is not of God does not give ear to us. By this we may see which is the true spirit, and which is the spirit of error.

4.msb: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
4.kjv: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
4.blb: Beloved, may we love one another, because love is of God; and everyone loving has been born of God and knows God.
4.bbe: My loved ones, let us have love for one another: because love is of God, and everyone who has love is a child of God and has knowledge of God.
4.heading: Love Comes from God

4.msb: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
4.kjv: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
4.blb: The one not loving has not known God, because God is love.
4.bbe: He who has no love has no knowledge of God, because God is love.

4.msb: This is how God’s love was revealed among us: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.
4.kjv: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
4.blb: In this the love of God was made manifest among us, that God has sent His only begotten Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.
4.bbe: And the love of God was made clear to us when he sent his only Son into the world so that we might have life through him.

4.msb: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
4.kjv: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
4.blb: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as a propitiation for our sins.
4.bbe: And this is love, not that we had love for God, but that he had love for us, and sent his Son to be an offering for our sins.

4.msb: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
4.kjv: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
4.blb: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
4.bbe: My loved ones, if God had such love for us, it is right for us to have love for one another.

4.msb: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.
4.kjv: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.
4.blb: No one has seen God at any time; if we may love one another, God remains in us, and His love is having been perfected in us.
4.bbe: No man has ever seen God: if we have love for one another, God is in us and his love is made complete in us:

4.msb: By this we know that we remain in Him, and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.
4.kjv: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
4.blb: In this we know that we remain in Him and He in us: because from out of His Spirit He has given to us.
4.bbe: And his Spirit which he has given us is the witness that we are in him and he is in us.

4.msb: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent His Son to be the Savior of the world.
4.kjv: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
4.blb: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as Savior of the world.
4.bbe: And we have seen and give witness that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.

4.msb: If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.
4.kjv: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
4.blb: Whoever should confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.
4.bbe: Everyone who says openly that Jesus is the Son of God, has God in him and is in God.

4.msb: And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
4.kjv: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
4.blb: And we have known and have believed the love that God has in us. God is love, and the one remaining in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
4.bbe: And we have seen and had faith in the love which God has for us. God is love, and everyone who has love is in God, and God is in him.

4.msb: In this way, love has been perfected among us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment; for in this world we are just like Him.
4.kjv: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
4.blb: In this, love has been perfected with us, so that we may have confidence in the day of judgment, because just as He is, also are we in this world.
4.bbe: In this way love is made complete in us, so that we may be without fear on the day of judging, because as he is, so are we in this world.

4.msb: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.
4.kjv: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
4.blb: There is no fear in love, but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment; and the one fearing has not been perfected in love.
4.bbe: There is no fear in love: true love has no room for fear, because where fear is, there is pain; and he who is not free from fear is not complete in love.

4.msb: We love Him because He first loved us.
4.kjv: We love him, because he first loved us.
4.blb: We love because He first loved us.
4.bbe: We have the power of loving, because he first had love for us.

4.msb: If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, how can he love God, whom he has not seen?
4.kjv: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
4.blb: If anyone should say, “I love God,” and should hate his brother, he is a liar. For the one not loving his brother, whom he has seen, is not able to love God, whom he has not seen.
4.bbe: If a man says, I have love for God, and has hate for his brother, his words are false: for how is the man who has no love for his brother whom he has seen, able to have love for God whom he has not seen?

4.msb: And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.
4.kjv: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.
4.blb: And this commandment we have from Him, that the one loving God should love his brother also.
4.bbe: And this is the word which we have from him, that he who has love for God is to have the same love for his brother.

5.msb: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.
5.kjv: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
5.blb: Everyone believing that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone loving the One having begotten also loves the one having been born of Him.
5.bbe: Everyone who has faith that Jesus is the Christ is a child of God: and everyone who has love for the Father has love for his child.
5.heading: Overcoming the World

5.msb: By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and keep His commandments.
5.kjv: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
5.blb: In this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep His commandments.
5.bbe: In this way, we are certain that we have love for the children of God, when we have love for God and keep his laws.

5.msb: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome,
5.kjv: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
5.blb: For this is the love of God, that we should keep His commandments; and His commandments are not burdensome.
5.bbe: For loving God is keeping his laws: and his laws are not hard.

5.msb: because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
5.kjv: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
5.blb: For everyone having been born of God overcomes the world; and this is the victory having overcome the world: our faith.
5.bbe: Anything which comes from God is able to overcome the world: and the power by which we have overcome the world is our faith.

5.msb: Who then overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
5.kjv: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
5.blb: Now who is the one overcoming the world, except the one believing that Jesus is the Son of God?
5.bbe: Who is able to overcome the world but the man who has faith that Jesus is the Son of God?

5.msb: This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ—not by water alone, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies to this, because the Spirit is the truth.
5.kjv: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.
5.blb: This is the One having come by water and blood, Jesus Christ—not in water only, but in water and in blood. And the Spirit is the One testifying, because the Spirit is the truth.
5.bbe: This is he who came by water and by blood, Jesus Christ; not by water only but by water and by blood.

5.msb: For there are three that testify:
5.kjv: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
5.blb: For there are three testifying:
5.bbe: And the Spirit is the witness, because the Spirit is true.

5.msb: the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and these three are in agreement.
5.kjv: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
5.blb: the Spirit and the water and the blood—and the three are into the one.
5.bbe: There are three witnesses, the Spirit, the water, and the blood: and all three are in agreement.

5.msb: Even if we accept human testimony, the testimony of God is greater. For this is the testimony that God has given about His Son.
5.kjv: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.
5.blb: If we receive the testimony of men, the testimony of God is greater, because this is the testimony of God that He has testified concerning His Son.
5.bbe: If we take the witness of men to be true, the witness of God is greater: because this is the witness which God has given about his Son.
5.heading: God’s Testimony about His Son

5.msb: Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony within him; whoever does not believe God has made Him out to be a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given about His Son.
5.kjv: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.
5.blb: The one believing in the Son of God has the testimony in himself; the one not believing God has made Him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has testified concerning His Son.
5.bbe: He who has faith in the Son of God has the witness in himself: he who has not faith in God makes him false, because he has not faith in the witness which God has given about his Son.

5.msb: And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
5.kjv: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
5.blb: And this is the testimony: that God has given to us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
5.bbe: And his witness is this, that God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

5.msb: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
5.kjv: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
5.blb: The one having the Son has life; the one not having the Son of God does not have life.
5.bbe: He who has the Son has the life; he who has not the Son of God has not the life.

5.msb: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life and that you may believe in the name of the Son of God.
5.kjv: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
5.blb: I wrote these things to you, the ones believing in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
5.bbe: I have put these things in writing for you who have faith in the name of the Son of God, so that you may be certain that you have eternal life.
5.heading: Effective Prayer

5.msb: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
5.kjv: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
5.blb: And this is the confidence that we have toward Him, that if we may ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
5.bbe: And we are certain that if we make any request to him which is right in his eyes, he will give ear to us:

5.msb: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we already possess what we have asked of Him.
5.kjv: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
5.blb: And if we know that He hears us, whatever we may ask, we know that we have the requests that we have asked from Him.
5.bbe: And if we are certain that he gives ear to all our requests, we are equally certain that we will get our requests.

5.msb: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should ask God, who will give life to those who commit this kind of sin. There is a sin that leads to death; I am not saying he should ask regarding that sin.
5.kjv: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
5.blb: If anyone should see his brother sinning a sin not unto death, he shall ask, and He will give to him life—to those sinning not unto death. There is a sin unto death; I do not say that he should implore concerning that.
5.bbe: If a man sees his brother doing a sin which is not bad enough for death, let him make a prayer to God, and God will give life to him whose sin was not bad enough for death. There is a sin whose punishment is death: I do not say that he may make such a request then.

5.msb: All unrighteousness is sin, yet there is sin that does not lead to death.
5.kjv: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
5.blb: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not unto death.
5.bbe: All evil-doing is sin: but death is not the punishment for every sort of sin.

5.msb: We know that anyone born of God does not keep on sinning; the one who was born of God protects himself, and the evil one cannot touch him.
5.kjv: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.
5.blb: We know that everyone having been born of God does not sin, but the One having been begotten of God keeps him, and the evil one does not touch him.
5.bbe: We are certain that one who is a child of God will do no sin, but the Son of God keeps him so that he is not touched by the Evil One.
5.heading: The True God

5.msb: We know that we are of God, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.
5.kjv: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
5.blb: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the evil one.
5.bbe: We are certain that we are of God, but all the world is in the power of the Evil One.

5.msb: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
5.kjv: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
5.blb: Now we know that the Son of God is come, and He has given to us understanding, so that we may know the One who is true; and we are in the One who is true, in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
5.bbe: And we are certain that the Son of God has come, and has given us a clear vision, so that we may see him who is true, and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.

5.msb: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
5.kjv: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
5.blb: Little children, guard yourselves from idols.
5.bbe: My little children, keep yourselves from false gods.

1.msb: The elder, To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth—and not I alone, but also all who know the truth—
1.kjv: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
1.blb: The elder, To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not only I, but also all those having known the truth—
1.bbe: I, a ruler in the church, send word to the noble sister who is of God's selection, and to her children, for whom I have true love; and not only I, but all who have knowledge of what is true;
1.heading: A Greeting from the Elder

1.msb: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:
1.kjv: For the truth’s sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
1.blb: because of the truth remaining in us and that will be with us to the age:
1.bbe: Because of this true knowledge which is in us, and will be with us for ever:

1.msb: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love.
1.kjv: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
1.blb: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
1.bbe: May grace, mercy, and peace be with us from God the Father, and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in all true love.

1.msb: I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father has commanded us.
1.kjv: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
1.blb: I rejoiced exceedingly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, just as we received a commandment from the Father.
1.bbe: It gave me great joy to see some of your children walking in the true way, even as we were ordered to do by the Father.
1.heading: Walking in the Truth

1.msb: And now I urge you, dear lady—not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.
1.kjv: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
1.blb: And now I implore you, lady, not as writing to you a new commandment, but that which we have had from the beginning, that we should love one another.
1.bbe: And now, my sister, I make a request to you, not sending you a new law, but the law which we had from the first, that we have love for one another.

1.msb: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the very commandment you have heard from the beginning, that you must walk in love.
1.kjv: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
1.blb: And this is love, that we should walk according to His commandments. This is the commandment, just as you heard from the beginning, so that you should walk in it.
1.bbe: And love is the keeping of his laws. This is the law which was given to you from the first, so that you might keep it.

1.msb: For many deceivers have entered into the world, refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
1.kjv: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
1.blb: For many deceivers went out into the world, those not confessing Jesus Christ coming in flesh. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.
1.bbe: Because a number of false teachers have gone out into the world, who do not give witness that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. Such a one is a false teacher and Antichrist.
1.heading: Beware of Deceivers

1.msb: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be fully rewarded.
1.kjv: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
1.blb: Watch yourselves, so that you may not lose what things we worked for, but you may receive a full reward.
1.bbe: Keep watch over yourselves, so that you do not make our work of no effect, but may get your full reward.

1.msb: Anyone who transgresses without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in the teaching of Christ has both the Father and the Son.
1.kjv: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
1.blb: Everyone going on ahead and not remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. The one remaining in the teaching, this one has both the Father and the Son.
1.bbe: Anyone who goes on and does not keep to the teaching of Christ, has not God: he who keeps to the teaching has the Father and the Son.

1.msb: If anyone comes to you but does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your home or even greet him.
1.kjv: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:
1.blb: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into the house, and do not speak to him to greet him.
1.bbe: If anyone comes to you not having this teaching, do not take him into your house or give him words of love:

1.msb: Whoever greets such a person shares in his evil deeds.
1.kjv: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
1.blb: For the one speaking to him to greet him partakes in his evil works.
1.bbe: For he who gives him words of love has a part in his evil works.

1.msb: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
1.kjv: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
1.blb: Having many things to write to you, I intended not with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak mouth to mouth, so that our joy may be full.
1.bbe: Having much to say to you, it is not my purpose to put it all down with paper and ink: but I am hoping to come to you, and to have talk with you face to face, so that your joy may be full.
1.heading: Conclusion

1.msb: The children of your elect sister send you greetings. Amen.
1.kjv: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
1.blb: The children of your chosen sister greet you.
1.bbe: The children of your noble sister, who is of God's selection, send you their love.

1.msb: The elder, To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth:
1.kjv: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
1.blb: The elder, To Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
1.bbe: I, a ruler in the church, send word to the well loved Gaius, for whom I have true love.
1.heading: A Greeting from the Elder

1.msb: Beloved, I pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health, as your soul also prospers.
1.kjv: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
1.blb: Beloved, concerning all things I pray you to prosper and to be in good health, just as your soul prospers.
1.bbe: My loved one, it is my prayer that you may do well in all things, and be healthy in body, even as your soul does well.

1.msb: For I was overjoyed when the brothers came and testified about your devotion to the truth, in which you continue to walk.
1.kjv: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.
1.blb: For I rejoiced exceedingly on the brothers' coming and testifying of your truth, just as you are walking in truth.
1.bbe: For it gave me great joy when some of the brothers came and gave witness that you had the true faith and were walking in the true way.

1.msb: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in truth.
1.kjv: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
1.blb: I have no greater joy than these things, that I should hear of my children walking in the truth.
1.bbe: I have no greater joy than to have news that my children are walking in the true way.

1.msb: Beloved, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers and for those who are strangers to you.
1.kjv: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;
1.blb: Beloved, you are doing faithfully whatever you might work for the brothers, and they are strangers,
1.bbe: My loved one, you are doing a good work in being kind to those brothers who come from other places;
1.heading: Gaius Commended for Hospitality

1.msb: They have testified to the church about your love. You will do well to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God.
1.kjv: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:
1.blb: who testified of your love before the church, whom you will do well having sent forward worthily of God.
1.bbe: Who have given witness to the church of your love for them: and you will do well to send them on their way well cared for, as is right for servants of God:

1.msb: For they went out on behalf of the Name, accepting nothing from the Gentiles.
1.kjv: Because that for his name’s sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
1.blb: For they went out on behalf of the Name, receiving nothing from the Gentiles.
1.bbe: For they went out for love of the Name, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

1.msb: Therefore we ought to receive such men, so that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
1.kjv: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.
1.blb: Therefore we ought to support such, so that we may be fellow workers in the truth.
1.bbe: So it is right for us to take in such men as guests, so that we may take our part in the work of the true faith.

1.msb: I have written to the church about this, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not accept our instruction.
1.kjv: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
1.blb: I did write something to the church; but the one loving to be first among them, Diotrephes, does not welcome us.
1.bbe: I sent a letter to the church, but Diotrephes, whose desire is ever to have the first place among them, will not have us there.
1.heading: Diotrephes and Demetrius

1.msb: So if I come, I will call attention to his malicious slander against us. And unsatisfied with that, he refuses to welcome the brothers and forbids those who want to do so, even putting them out of the church.
1.kjv: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.
1.blb: Because of this, if I should come, I will bring to remembrance his works that he is doing, prattling against us with evil words; and not being satisfied with these, neither does he welcome the brothers himself, and he forbids those intending, and he casts them out of the church.
1.bbe: So if I come, I will keep in mind the things he does, talking against us with evil words: and as if this was not enough, he does not take the brothers into his house, and those who are ready to take them in, he keeps from doing so, putting them out of the church if they do.

1.msb: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.
1.kjv: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
1.blb: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one doing good is of God; the one doing evil has not seen God.
1.bbe: My loved one, do not be copying what is evil, but what is good. He who does good is of God: he who does evil has not seen God.

1.msb: Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself. We also testify for him, and you know that our testimony is true.
1.kjv: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.
1.blb: Testimony has been given to Demetrius by all, and by the truth itself; and we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.
1.bbe: Demetrius has the approval of all men and of what is true: and we give the same witness, and you are certain that our witness is true.

1.msb: I have many things to write, but I would prefer not to do so with pen and ink.
1.kjv: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:
1.blb: I had many things to write to you, but I do not want to write to you with ink and pen;
1.bbe: I had much to say to you, but it is not my purpose to put it all down with ink and pen:
1.heading: Conclusion

1.msb: Instead, I hope to see you soon and speak with you face to face. Peace to you. The friends here send you greetings. Greet each of our friends there by name.
1.kjv: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
1.blb: but I hope to see you soon, and we will speak mouth to mouth. Peace to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
1.bbe: But I am hoping to see you in a short time, and to have talk with you face to face. May you have peace. Your friends here send you their love. Give my love to our friends by name.

1.msb: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, To those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept in Jesus Christ:
1.kjv: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:
1.blb: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, To those called, having been loved in God the Father and having been kept in Jesus Christ.
1.bbe: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James, to those of God's selection who have been made holy by God the Father and are kept safe for Jesus Christ:
1.heading: A Greeting from Jude

1.msb: Mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
1.kjv: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
1.blb: Mercy and peace and love be multiplied to you.
1.bbe: May mercy and peace and love be increased in you.

1.msb: Beloved, although I made every effort to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt it necessary to write and urge you to contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all to the saints.
1.kjv: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.
1.blb: Beloved, using all diligence to write to you concerning our common salvation, I had necessity to write to you, exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith having been delivered once for all to the saints.
1.bbe: My loved ones, while my thoughts were full of a letter which I was going to send you about our common salvation, it was necessary for me to send you one requesting you with all my heart to go on fighting strongly for the faith which has been given to the saints once and for ever.
1.heading: God’s Judgment on the Ungodly

1.msb: For certain men have crept in among you unnoticed—ungodly ones who were designated long ago for condemnation. They turn the grace of our God into a license for immorality, and they deny God our only Master and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.
1.blb: For certain men came in stealthily, those having been designated long ago unto this judgment, ungodly ones changing the grace of our God into sensuality and denying our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
1.bbe: For certain men have come among you secretly, marked out before in the holy Writings for this evil fate, men without the fear of God, turning his grace into an unclean thing, and false to our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.

1.msb: Although you are fully aware of this, I want to remind you that after the Lord had delivered His people out of the land of Egypt, He destroyed those who did not believe.
1.kjv: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
1.blb: Now I want to remind you—you knowing all things once for all—that Jesus, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, secondly destroyed those not having believed.
1.bbe: Now it is my purpose to put you in mind, though you once had knowledge of all these things, of how the Lord, having taken a people safely out of Egypt, later sent destruction on those who had no faith;

1.msb: And the angels who did not stay within their own domain but abandoned their proper dwelling—these He has kept in eternal chains under darkness, bound for judgment on that great day.
1.kjv: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
1.blb: And the angels not having kept their domain, but having abandoned their own dwelling, He has kept in eternal chains under gloomy darkness unto the judgment of the great day,
1.bbe: And the angels who did not keep to their kingdom but went out from the place which was theirs, he has put in eternal chains and in dark night till the great day of the judging.

1.msb: In like manner, Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, who indulged in sexual immorality and pursued strange flesh, are on display as an example of those who sustain the punishment of eternal fire.
1.kjv: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.
1.blb: as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, in like manner to these having indulged in sexual immorality and having gone after other flesh, are set forth as an example, undergoing the penalty of eternal fire.
1.bbe: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the towns near them, having like these, given themselves up to unclean desires and gone after strange flesh, have been made an example, undergoing the punishment of eternal fire.

1.msb: Yet in the same way these dreamers defile their bodies, reject authority, and slander glorious beings.
1.kjv: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.
1.blb: Yet likewise also these dreaming ones indeed defile the flesh, and set aside authority, and blaspheme glorious ones.
1.bbe: In the same way these dreamers make the flesh unclean, having no respect for authorities, and say evil of rulers.

1.msb: But even the archangel Michael, when he disputed with the devil over the body of Moses, did not presume to bring a slanderous charge against him, but said, “The Lord rebuke you!”
1.kjv: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
1.blb: But Michael the archangel, when disputing with the devil, reasoning about the body of Moses, did not dare to bring against him a judgment of blasphemy, but he said, “The Lord rebuke you!”
1.bbe: Now when Michael, one of the chief angels, was fighting against the Evil One for the body of Moses, fearing to make use of violent words against him, he only said, May the Lord be your judge.

1.msb: These men, however, slander what they do not understand, and like irrational animals, they will be destroyed by the things they do instinctively.
1.kjv: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.
1.blb: But these indeed blaspheme whatever things they have not seen; and whatever things they understand naturally, as the irrational animals, in these things they corrupt themselves.
1.bbe: But these men say evil about such things as they have no knowledge of; and the things of which they have natural knowledge, like beasts without reason, are the cause of their destruction.

1.msb: Woe to them! They have traveled the path of Cain; they have rushed for profit into the error of Balaam; they have perished in Korah’s rebellion.
1.kjv: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.
1.blb: Woe to them, because they went in the way of Cain, and they rushed for profit to the error of Balaam, and they perished in the rebellion of Korah.
1.bbe: A curse on them! They have gone in the way of Cain, running uncontrolled into the error of Balaam for reward, and have come to destruction by saying evil against the Lord, like Korah.

1.msb: These men are hidden reefs in your love feasts, shamelessly feasting with you but shepherding only themselves. They are clouds without water, carried along by the wind; fruitless trees in autumn, twice dead after being uprooted.
1.kjv: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
1.blb: These are the ones in your love feasts, hidden reefs feasting with you fearlessly, shepherding themselves; clouds without waters, being carried about by winds; autumnal trees without fruit, twice having died, having been uprooted;
1.bbe: These men are unseen rocks at your love-feasts, when they take part in them with you, keepers of sheep who without fear take the food of the sheep; clouds without water rushing before the wind, wasted trees without fruit, twice dead, pulled up by the roots,

1.msb: They are wild waves of the sea, foaming up their own shame; wandering stars, for whom blackest darkness has been reserved forever.
1.kjv: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
1.blb: wild waves of the sea, foaming out of their shame; wandering stars, for whom the gloom of darkness has been kept unto the age.
1.bbe: Violent waves of the sea, streaming with their shame, wandering stars for whom the darkest night is kept in store for ever.

1.msb: Enoch, the seventh from Adam, also prophesied about them: “Behold, the Lord is coming with myriads of His holy ones
1.kjv: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,
1.blb: And Enoch, the seventh from Adam, also prophesied as to these, saying: “Behold, the Lord came amidst myriads of His holy ones,
1.bbe: The prophet Enoch, who was the seventh after Adam, said of these men, The Lord came with tens of thousands of his saints,

1.msb: to execute judgment on everyone, and to convict all the ungodly among them of every ungodly act of wickedness and every harsh word spoken against Him by ungodly sinners.”
1.kjv: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
1.blb: to do judgment against all, and to convict all the ungodly concerning all their works of ungodliness that they did in an ungodly way, and concerning all the harsh things that ungodly sinners spoke against Him.”
1.bbe: To be the judge of all, and to give a decision against all those whose lives are unpleasing to him, because of the evil acts which they have done, and because of all the hard things which sinners without fear of God have said against him.

1.msb: These men are discontented grumblers, following after their own lusts; their mouths spew arrogance; they flatter others for their own advantage.
1.kjv: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men’s persons in admiration because of advantage.
1.blb: These are grumblers, discontented, going according to their own passions; and their mouth speaks great swelling words, flattering faces for the sake of profit.
1.bbe: These are the men who make trouble, ever desiring change, going after evil pleasures, using high-sounding words, respecting men's position in the hope of reward.

1.msb: But you, beloved, remember what was foretold by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ
1.kjv: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;
1.blb: But you, beloved, remember the words having been spoken beforehand by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ,
1.bbe: But you, my loved ones, keep in memory the words which were said before by the Apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ,
1.heading: A Call to Persevere

1.msb: when they said to you, “In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow after their own ungodly desires.”
1.kjv: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.
1.blb: that they were saying to you, “In the last time there will be scoffers, going according to their own passions of ungodlinesses.”
1.bbe: How they said to you, In the last days there will be men who, guided by their evil desires, will make sport of holy things.

1.msb: These are the ones who cause divisions, who are worldly and devoid of the Spirit.
1.kjv: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.
1.blb: These are those causing divisions, natural men, not having the Spirit.
1.bbe: These are the men who make divisions, natural men, not having the Spirit.

1.msb: But you, beloved, by building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit,
1.kjv: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,
1.blb: But you, beloved, building up yourselves in your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,
1.bbe: But you, my loved ones, building yourselves up on your most holy faith, and making prayers in the Holy Spirit,

1.msb: keep yourselves in the love of God as you await the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you eternal life.
1.kjv: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
1.blb: keep yourselves in the love of God, awaiting the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
1.bbe: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for life eternal through the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ.

1.msb: And indeed, have mercy on some, making a distinction;
1.kjv: And of some have compassion, making a difference:
1.blb: And indeed have mercy on those who are doubting;
1.bbe: And have pity on those who are in doubt;

1.msb: save others with fear by snatching them from the fire, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
1.kjv: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
1.blb: and save others, snatching them out of the fire; and show mercy to others with fear, hating even the clothing having been stained from the flesh.
1.bbe: And to some give salvation, pulling them out of the fire; and on some have mercy with fear, hating even the clothing which is made unclean by the flesh.

1.msb: Now to Him who is able to keep them from stumbling and to present them unblemished in His glorious presence, with great joy—
1.kjv: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
1.blb: Now to Him being able to keep you from stumbling and to present you blameless in the presence of His glory, with exultation—
1.bbe: Now to him who is able to keep you from falling, and to give you a place in his glory, free from all evil, with great joy,
1.heading: Doxology

1.msb: to the only wise God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion and authority both now and for all eternity. Amen.
1.kjv: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
1.blb: to the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority, before all time and now and to all the ages. Amen.
1.bbe: To the only God our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, let us give glory and honour and authority and power, before all time and now and for ever. So be it.

1.msb: This is the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass. He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John,
1.kjv: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:
1.blb: The revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave to Him to show to His servants what is necessary to take place in quickness. And He signified it through having sent His angel to His servant John,
1.bbe: The Revelation of Jesus Christ which God gave him so that his servants might have knowledge of the things which will quickly take place: and he sent and made it clear by his angel to his servant John;
1.heading: Prologue

1.msb: who testifies to everything he saw. This is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.
1.blb: who testified to the word of God and to the testimony of Jesus Christ, as much as he saw.
1.bbe: Who gave witness of the word of God, and of the witness of Jesus Christ, even of all the things which he saw.

1.msb: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear and obey what is written in it, because the time is near.
1.kjv: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
1.blb: Blessed is the one reading and those hearing the words of the prophecy and keeping the things written in it; for the time is near.
1.bbe: A blessing be on the reader, and on those who give ear to the prophet's words, and keep the things which he has put in the book: for the time is near.

1.msb: John, To the seven churches in the province of Asia: Grace and peace to you from God who is and was and is to come, and from the seven spirits before His throne,
1.kjv: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
1.blb: John, To the seven churches in Asia: Grace to you and peace from the One who is and who was and who is coming, and from the seven Spirits before His throne,
1.bbe: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace to you and peace, from him who is and was and is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his high seat;
1.heading: John Greets the Seven Churches

1.msb: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and has washed us from our sins by His blood,
1.kjv: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
1.blb: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To the One loving us and releasing us from our sins in His blood—
1.bbe: And from Jesus Christ, the true witness, the first to come back from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who had love for us and has made us clean from our sins by his blood;

1.msb: who has made us to be a kingdom, priests to His God and Father—to Him be the glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
1.kjv: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
1.blb: and He made us a kingdom, priests to His God and Father—to Him be the glory and the dominion to the ages of the ages. Amen.
1.bbe: And has made us to be a kingdom and priests to his God and Father; to him let glory and power be given for ever and ever. So be it.

1.msb: Behold, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him—even those who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him. So shall it be! Amen.
1.kjv: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
1.blb: Behold, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him, even those who pierced Him, and all the tribes of the earth will wail because of Him. Yes! Amen.
1.bbe: See, he comes with the clouds, and every eye will see him, and those by whom he was wounded; and all the tribes of the earth will be sorrowing because of him. Yes, so be it.

1.msb: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, who is and was and is to come—the Almighty.
1.kjv: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
1.blb: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, the One who is and who was and who is coming, the Almighty.
1.bbe: I am the First and the Last, says the Lord God who is and was and is to come, the Ruler of all.

1.msb: I, John, your brother and partner in the tribulation and kingdom and perseverance that are in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and my testimony about Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
1.blb: I, John, your brother and fellow partaker in the tribulation and kingdom and endurance in Jesus, was in the island called Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.
1.bbe: I, John, your brother, who have a part with you in the trouble and the kingdom and the quiet strength of Jesus, was in the island which is named Patmos, for the word of God and the witness of Jesus.
1.heading: John’s Vision on Patmos

1.msb: On the Lord’s day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,
1.kjv: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
1.blb: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, as of a trumpet,
1.bbe: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and a great voice at my back, as of a horn, came to my ears,

1.msb: saying, “Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
1.kjv: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
1.blb: saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven churches: to Ephesus, and to Smyrna, and to Pergamum, and to Thyatira, and to Sardis, and to Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”
1.bbe: Saying, What you see, put in a book, and send it to the seven churches; to Ephesus and to Smyrna and to Pergamos and to Thyatira and to Sardis and to Philadelphia and to Laodicea.

1.msb: And there I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me. And having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,
1.kjv: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
1.blb: And I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me. And having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,
1.bbe: And turning to see the voice which said these words to me, I saw seven gold vessels with lights burning in them;

1.msb: and among the seven lampstands was One like the Son of Man, dressed in a long robe, with a golden sash around His chest.
1.kjv: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
1.blb: and in the midst of the lampstands, One like the Son of Man, dressed to the foot, and girded around at the breasts with a golden sash.
1.bbe: And in the middle of them one like a son of man, clothed with a robe down to his feet, and with a band of gold round his breasts.

1.msb: The hair of His head was white like wool, as white as snow, and His eyes were like a blazing fire.
1.kjv: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
1.blb: And His head and the hairs were white as wool, white as snow, and His eyes as a flame of fire,
1.bbe: And his head and his hair were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;

1.msb: His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace, and His voice was like the roar of many waters.
1.kjv: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
1.blb: and His feet like burnished bronze, as having been refined in a furnace, and His voice as a voice of many waters,
1.bbe: And his feet like polished brass, as if it had been burned in a fire; and his voice was as the sound of great waters.

1.msb: He held in His right hand seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword came from His mouth. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
1.kjv: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
1.blb: and having in His right hand seven stars, and a sharp two-edged sword is going forth out of His mouth; and His face is as the sun shining in its power.
1.bbe: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth came a sharp two-edged sword: and his face was like the sun shining in its strength.

1.msb: When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man. But He placed His right hand on me and said, “Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,
1.kjv: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
1.blb: And when I saw Him, I fell at His feet as dead. And He placed His right hand upon me, saying, “Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,
1.bbe: And when I saw him, I went down on my face at his feet as one dead. And he put his right hand on me, saying, Have no fear; I am the first and the last and the Living one;

1.msb: the Living One. I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever and ever. Amen. And I hold the keys of Death and of Hades.
1.kjv: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
1.blb: and the Living One. And I became dead, and behold I am living to the ages of the ages, and I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
1.bbe: And I was dead, and see, I am living for ever, and I have the keys of death and of Hell.

1.msb: Therefore write down the things you have seen, the things that are, and the things that will happen after this.
1.kjv: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
1.blb: Therefore write the things that you saw, and the things that are, and the things that are about to take place after these.
1.bbe: Put in writing, then, the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will be after these;

1.msb: This is the mystery of the seven stars you saw in My right hand and of the seven golden lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
1.kjv: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.
1.blb: The mystery of the seven stars, which you saw on My right hand, and the seven golden lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
1.bbe: The secret of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and of the seven gold vessels with burning lights. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven lights are the seven churches.
