22.heading: Jesus Is Coming

22.msb: “Behold, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of prophecy in this book.”
22.kjv: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.
22.blb: “And behold, I am coming quickly. Blessed is the one keeping the words of the prophecy of this book.”
22.bbe: See, I come quickly. A blessing on him who keeps the words of this book of the prophet.

22.msb: And I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. And when I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.
22.kjv: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.
22.blb: And I, John, am the one hearing and seeing these things. And when I heard and saw, I fell to worship before the feet of the angel showing me these things.
22.bbe: And I, John, am he who saw these things and to whose ears they came. And when I had seen and given ear, I went down on my face to give worship at the feet of the angel who made these things clear to me.

22.msb: But he said to me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God!”
22.kjv: Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.
22.blb: And he says to me, “See, no! I am your fellow servant, and of your brothers the prophets, and of those keeping the words of this book. Worship God!”
22.bbe: And he said to me, See you do it not; I am a brother-servant with you and with your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book: give worship to God.

22.msb: Then he told me, “Do not seal up the words of prophecy in this book, because the time is near.
22.kjv: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.
22.blb: And he says to me, “Do not seal the words of the prophecy of this book; for the time is near.
22.bbe: And he said to me, Let not the words of this prophet's book be kept secret, because the time is near.

22.msb: Let the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous, and the vile continue to be vile; let the righteous continue to practice righteousness, and the holy continue to be holy.”
22.kjv: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.
22.blb: The one being unrighteous, let him be unrighteous still; and the filthy one, let him be filthy still; and the righteous one, let him practice righteousness still; and the holy one, let him be holy still.”
22.bbe: Let the evil man go on in his evil: and let the unclean be still unclean: and let the upright go on in his righteousness: and let the holy be holy still.

22.msb: “Behold, I am coming soon, and My reward is with Me, to give to each one according to what he has done.
22.kjv: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
22.blb: “Behold, I am coming quickly, and My reward is with Me, to render to each as is his work.
22.bbe: See, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give to every man the outcome of his works.

22.msb: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.”
22.kjv: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
22.blb: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.”
22.bbe: I am the First and the Last, the start and the end.

22.msb: Blessed are those who do His commandments, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by its gates.
22.kjv: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.
22.blb: Blessed are those washing their robes, that their authority will be over the tree of life, and by the gates they might enter into the city.
22.bbe: A blessing on those whose robes are washed, so that they may have a right to the tree of life, and may go in by the doors into the town.

22.msb: But outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
22.kjv: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.
22.blb: Outside are the dogs, and the sorcerers, and the sexually immoral, and the murderers, and the idolaters, and everyone loving and practicing falsehood.
22.bbe: Outside are the dogs, and those who make use of evil powers, those who make themselves unclean, and the takers of life, and those who give worship to images, and everyone whose delight is in what is false.

22.msb: “I, Jesus, have sent My angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright Morning Star.”
22.kjv: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
22.blb: “I, Jesus, sent My angel to testify to you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, the bright morning star.”
22.bbe: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to give witness to you of these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, the bright and morning star.

22.msb: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Let the one who hears say, “Come!” And let the one who is thirsty come, and the one who desires the water of life drink freely.
22.kjv: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
22.blb: And the Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” And the one hearing, let him say, “Come!” And the one thirsting, let him come; the one wanting, let him take the water of life freely.
22.bbe: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him who gives ear, say, Come. And let him who is in need come; and let everyone desiring it take of the water of life freely.

22.msb: I testify to everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this book: If anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book.
22.kjv: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:
22.blb: I testify to everyone hearing the words of the prophecy of this book: If anyone should add to these things, God will add unto him the plagues written in this book.
22.bbe: For I say to every man to whose ears have come the words of this prophet's book, If any man makes an addition to them, God will put on him the punishments which are in this book:
22.heading: Nothing May Be Added or Removed

22.msb: And if anyone takes away from the words of this book of prophecy, may God take away his share in the tree of life and the holy city, which are described in this book.
22.kjv: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.
22.blb: And if anyone should take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, of those written in this book.
22.bbe: And if any man takes away from the words of this book, God will take away from him his part in the tree of life and the holy town, even the things which are in this book.

22.msb: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen. Yes, come, Lord Jesus!
22.kjv: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
22.blb: The One testifying these things says, “Yes, I am coming quickly.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
22.bbe: He who gives witness to these things says, Truly, I come quickly. Even so come, Lord Jesus.

22.msb: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.
22.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
22.blb: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints. Amen.
22.bbe: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with the saints. So be it.
